name: NLAlib.exp_cubic_le
statement: private lemma exp_cubic_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 1 + a + a ^ 2 / 2 + a ^ 3 / 6 ≤ Real.exp a
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg ha 4
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exp_le_four
statement: private lemma exp_le_four {a : ℝ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) : Real.exp a ≤ 4 * (Real.exp a - a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := exp_cubic_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a)
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a - 1) (by nlinarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a ^ 2 + 4 * a + 2)]

name: NLAlib.exp_integrable
statement:
private lemma exp_integrable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [NeZero d] (X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hMeas : Measurable X)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) {L θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X ω) ≤ L) :
    Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hEcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
      NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  refine Integrable.of_bound (hEcont.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hMeas.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
  filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω hH hB
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc _ hH]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH hB x hx) hθ)

name: NLAlib.intrinsic_hermitian_bernstein_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.intrinsic_hermitian_bernstein_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hV : V ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVarianceBound : (∫ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ V) :
    let Y
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let v := specNorm V
    (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sqrt v + L / 3 ≤ t →
      μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
        4 * intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3)) := by
  intro Y v
  
  have hsecond : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ X id id measurable_id measurable_id
      hMeas hIndep hL2 hL2 hMean
    show (∫ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ
    simpa only [id, sq] using h
  refine ⟨hsecond, ?_⟩
  
  have hXint : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k => (hL2 k).integrable one_le_two
  have hYmeas : Measurable Y := Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω h
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => h k)
  have hYint : Integrable Y μ := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXint k)
  have hS : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef]
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hH
    have : Y ω ^ 2 = Matrix.conjTranspose (Y ω) * Y ω := by rw [hH.eq, sq]
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, this]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).nonneg
  have hVS : (V - ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := hVarianceBound
  have hVpsd : V.PosSemidef := by simpa using hVS.add hS
  have hv : 0 < v := by
    show 0 < ‖V‖
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hV
  have hr : 0 ≤ intrinsicDimension V :=
    div_nonneg (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hVpsd.trace_nonneg).1 (le_of_lt hv)
  intro t ht
  have hsq := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv
  have hsqsq : Real.sqrt v ^ 2 = v := Real.sq_sqrt hv.le
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLpos
  · 
    subst hL0
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hzero : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X k ω = 0 := by
      intro k
      have hneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (-X k ω).PosSemidef := by
        filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω hH hB
        exact neg_posSemidef _ hH hB
      have hint : Integrable (fun ω => (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re) μ :=
        trace_re_integrable μ (fun ω => -X k ω) (hXint k).neg
      have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re := by
        filter_upwards [hneg] with ω h
        exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp h.trace_nonneg).1
      have hI : ∫ ω, (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re ∂μ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_trace_re μ (fun ω => -X k ω) (hXint k).neg, integral_neg, hMean k]
        simp
      have htr0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hnn hint).mp hI
      filter_upwards [hneg, htr0] with ω h1 h2
      have h3 := Complex.nonneg_iff.mp h1.trace_nonneg
      have htr : Matrix.trace (-X k ω) = 0 :=
        Complex.ext (by simpa using h2) (by simpa using h3.2.symm)
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp (h1.trace_eq_zero_iff.mp htr)
    have hY0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y ω = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hzero] with ω h
      show ∑ k, X k ω = 0
      simp [h]
    have hnull : μ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} = 0 := by
      rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
      filter_upwards [hY0] with ω h
      simp only [h, lambdaMax_zero, not_le]
      exact htpos
    rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hr) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · 
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [div_pos hLpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    have hts : Real.sqrt v ≤ t := by linarith [div_pos hLpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    have hDpos : 0 < v + L * t / 3 := by positivity
    have ht2 : v + L * t / 3 ≤ t ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht htpos.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hts hsq.le]
    obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ, θ = t / (v + L * t / 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hθ : 0 < θ := by rw [hθdef]; positivity
    have hθL : θ < 3 / L := by
      rw [hθdef, div_lt_div_iff₀ hDpos hLpos]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ, g = (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h1θ : 1 - θ * L / 3 = v / (v + L * t / 3) := by
      rw [hθdef]; field_simp; ring
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g := by
      rw [hgdef, h1θ]; positivity
    have hgv : g * v = θ * t + -(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3) := by
      rw [hgdef, h1θ, hθdef]; field_simp; ring
    have ha : 1 ≤ θ * t := by
      rw [hθdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← sq, le_div_iff₀ hDpos]; linarith
    
    set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (θ * x) - θ * x - 1 with hψdef
    have hψnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x := fun x => by
      simp only [hψdef]; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (θ * x)]
    have hψmono : MonotoneOn ψ (Set.Ici 0) := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [hψdef]
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ θ * x := mul_nonneg hθ.le hx
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (θ * (y - x))
      have h2 : Real.exp (θ * y) = Real.exp (θ * x) * Real.exp (θ * (y - x)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      have h3 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (θ * x) := Real.one_le_exp hx0
      have h4 : 0 ≤ θ * (y - x) := mul_nonneg hθ.le (by linarith)
      rw [h2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.exp_pos (θ * x)).le]
    have hψt : 0 < ψ t := by
      simp only [hψdef]
      have := Real.add_one_lt_exp (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hθ htpos))
      linarith
    
    have hExpk : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := fun k =>
      exp_integrable μ (X k) (hMeas k) (hHerm k) hθ.le (hBound k)
    have hYexp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
      integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExpk
    have hTEint : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
      trace_re_integrable μ _ hYexp
    have hYtrint : Integrable (fun ω => (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ :=
      trace_re_integrable μ Y hYint
    have hYtr0 : ∫ ω, (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [integral_trace_re μ Y hYint]
      have : ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ = 0 := by
        show ∫ ω, ∑ k, X k ω ∂μ = 0
        rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXint k)]
        simp [hMean]
      rw [this]; simp
    have hψeq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) =
        traceExp (θ • Y ω) - θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re - d := by
      filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hH
      rw [traceFunction_eq_sum ψ _ hH, traceExp_smul_eq_sum _ hH θ, trace_re_eq_sum _ hH]
      simp only [hψdef, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hψint : Integrable (fun ω => traceFunction ψ (Y ω)) μ :=
      ((hTEint.sub (hYtrint.const_mul θ)).sub (integrable_const (d : ℝ))).congr
        (hψeq.mono fun _ h => h.symm)
    have hψI : ∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ = ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ - d := by
      have hA : Integrable (fun ω => θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ := hYtrint.const_mul θ
      have hB : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω) - θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ :=
        hTEint.sub hA
      rw [integral_congr_ae hψeq, integral_sub hB (integrable_const _),
        integral_sub hTEint hA, integral_const_mul, hYtr0]
      simp
    have hLap := measure_lambdaMax_ge_le_integral_traceFunction_div μ Y ψ hYmeas hYHerm hψnn hψmono hψint t htpos.le hψt
    
    have hE1 : ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ ≤ traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := by
      calc ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ = ∫ ω, traceExp (∑ k, θ • X k ω) ∂μ := by
            congr 1; funext ω; show traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) = _; rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        _ ≤ _ := trace_cgf_subadditivity μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExpk
    have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian :=
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
    have hcum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ (g • ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      have hk : ∀ k, (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X k ω) ∂μ)) ≤
          (g • ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
        intro k
        rw [hgdef]
        exact (bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L θ hLpos hθ hθL (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hL2 k)
          (hMean k) (hBound k)).2
      unfold cumulantSum
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k)
    rw [← hsecond] at hcum
    have hgS : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).IsHermitian :=
      hS.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
    have hgV : (g • V).IsHermitian :=
      hVpsd.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
    have hSV : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ (g • V) := by
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [← smul_sub]
      exact hVS.smul hg0
    have hE2 : traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ traceExp (g • V) :=
      (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcumH hgS hcum).trans
        (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hgS hgV hSV)
    
    have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) := by
      refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
      intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
      have := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (g * x)) (Set.mem_univ (g * y)) ha hb hab
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at this ⊢
      have e : g * (a * x + b * y) = a * (g * x) + b * (g * y) := by ring
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [this, hab]
    have hID := traceFunction_le_intrinsicDimension_mul (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) hconv (by simp) V hVpsd
    have hφeq : traceFunction (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) V = traceExp (g • V) - d := by
      rw [traceFunction_eq_sum _ _ hVpsd.isHermitian, traceExp_smul_eq_sum _ hVpsd.isHermitian g]
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hnum : ∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ ≤ intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) := by
      rw [hψI]
      have h1 : intrinsicDimension V * (Real.exp (g * ‖V‖) - 1) ≤
          intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hr
        show Real.exp (g * v) - 1 ≤ Real.exp (g * v)
        linarith
      linarith [hφeq ▸ hID]
    have hfour := exp_le_four ha
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))
    calc μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)}
        ≤ (∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ) / ψ t := hLap
      _ ≤ intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) / ψ t :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hψt.le
      _ ≤ 4 * intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3)) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hψt, hgv, Real.exp_add]
          simp only [hψdef]
          have hrE := mul_nonneg hr hE.le
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfour hrE]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ} (hV : V ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian) (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVarianceBound : (∫ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ V) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : Real.sqrt (specNorm V) + L / 3 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤
      4 * intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (specNorm V + L * t / 3))
proof:
:=
  (intrinsic_hermitian_bernstein_package μ X L hL V hV hMeas hIndep hHerm hL2 hMean hBound
    hVarianceBound).2 t ht

name: NLAlib.log_two_mul_card_le
proof:
:= by
  have h17 : log (17 : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
    apply (log_le_iff_le_exp (by norm_num)).mpr
    have h := sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 by norm_num) 6
    norm_num [sum_range_succ] at h
    linarith
  have h2 : log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    apply (log_le_iff_le_exp (by norm_num)).mpr
    have h := sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 by norm_num) 3
    norm_num [sum_range_succ] at h
    linarith
  have hlog := log_le_log (show (0 : ℝ) < k by exact_mod_cast hkpos) hk
  rw [log_pow] at hlog
  rw [log_mul (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hkpos.ne')]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h17 (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ d by positivity)
  have hdR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_of_quadratic_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_of_quadratic_hasSubgaussianMGF
    {n Ω : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ) (hX : Measurable X)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (c : NNReal) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hsg : ∀ u : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => quadForm (X ω) u) c μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (X ω)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, specNorm (X ω) ∂μ) ≤ sqrt (12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : Nonempty n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨N, hNunit, hNcard, hNcover⟩ :=
    exists_finset_sphere_net n (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8 by norm_num)
  norm_num at hNcard
  have hNnonempty : N.Nonempty := by
    let u : n → ℝ := Pi.single (Classical.arbitrary n) 1
    have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by simp only [u, single_dotProduct, Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := hNcover u hu
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  let : Nonempty N := hNnonempty.to_subtype
  let Y : N → Ω → ℝ := fun u ω => quadForm (X ω) (u : n → ℝ)
  have hunit (u : N) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (u : n → ℝ)‖ = 1 := by
    have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (u : n → ℝ)
    rw [hNunit u u.property] at h
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (u : n → ℝ))]
  have hY (u : N) : HasSubgaussianMGF (Y u) c μ := hsg u (hunit u)
  let m : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ⨆ u : N, |Y u ω|
  have hm : Integrable m μ := integrable_iSup_abs_of_hasSubgaussianMGF Y c hY
  have hm0 (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ m ω := by
    obtain ⟨u⟩ := ‹Nonempty N›
    change 0 ≤ ⨆ u : N, |Y u ω|
    exact (abs_nonneg (Y u ω)).trans
      (le_ciSup (f := fun u : N => |Y u ω|) (Finite.bddAbove_range _) u)
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (X ω) ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * m ω := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    have h := specNorm_le_div_of_net_quadForm hω N (ε := 1 / 8) (M := m ω)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (hm0 ω)
      (fun u hu => by
        have he := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self u
        rw [hNunit u hu] at he
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 u)])
      (fun y hy => by
        have he : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hy, one_pow]
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hNcover y he
        refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        have h := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self (x - y)
        rw [← h] at hxy
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y))])
      (fun u hu => by
        change |Y ⟨u, hu⟩ ω| ≤ ⨆ v : N, |Y v ω|
        exact le_ciSup (f := fun v : N => |Y v ω|) (Finite.bddAbove_range _) (⟨u, hu⟩ : N))
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (X ω)) μ := by
    apply (hm.const_mul (4 / 3 : ℝ)).mono'
    · have hc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => specNorm A) := by
        simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
        fun_prop
      exact (hc.measurable.comp hX).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)] using hω
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  have hmax := integral_iSup_abs_le_sqrt_of_hasSubgaussianMGF Y c hY
  have hlog : log (2 * (Fintype.card N : ℝ)) ≤ 27 / 8 * Fintype.card n := by
    rw [Fintype.card_coe]
    exact log_two_mul_card_le _ _ hd hNcard hNnonempty.card_pos
  have hnorm := integral_mono_ae hi (hm.const_mul (4 / 3 : ℝ)) hbound
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hnorm
  refine hnorm.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax (by norm_num)).trans ?_)
  have harg : 2 * (c : ℝ) * log (2 * (Fintype.card N : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * (c : ℝ) * (27 / 8 * Fintype.card n) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (by positivity)
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt harg
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤
      2 * (c : ℝ) * (27 / 8 * Fintype.card n) by positivity)
  have hfinal := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n by positivity)
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * (c : ℝ) * log (2 * (Fintype.card N : ℝ))),
    Real.sqrt_nonneg (12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n)]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_quadForm_gaussian
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_quadForm_gaussian
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℝ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hmean : (∫ Z, Z ∂γ) = 0) (u : n → ℝ) (c : NNReal)
    (hvariance : Var[fun Z => quadForm Z u; γ] ≤ c) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun Z => quadForm Z u) c γ
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := quadFormContinuousLinearMap u
  let v : NNReal := (Var[fun Z => quadForm Z u; γ]).toNNReal
  have hLi := L.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
  change (∫ Z, L Z ∂γ) = L (∫ Z, Z ∂γ) at hLi
  have hm : (∫ Z, L Z ∂γ) = 0 := by rw [hLi, hmean, map_zero]
  have hmap : γ.map L = gaussianReal 0 v := by
    have hmap' := IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal (μ := γ) L
    rw [hm] at hmap'
    exact hmap'
  have hq : AEMeasurable (fun Z => quadForm Z u) γ := L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hbase : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun Z => quadForm Z u) v γ := by
    rw [← HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hq]
    change HasSubgaussianMGF id v (γ.map L)
    rw [hmap]
    exact hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal v
  have hvc : (v : ℝ) ≤ c := by
    simpa only [v, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (variance_nonneg _ _)] using hvariance
  refine ⟨hbase.integrable_exp_mul, fun t => (hbase.mgf_le t).trans ?_⟩
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hvc (sq_nonneg t)) (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℝ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hmean : (∫ Z, Z ∂γ) = 0) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian)
    (c : NNReal) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℝ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => quadForm Z u; γ] ≤ c) :
    Integrable (fun Z => specNorm Z) γ ∧
      (∫ Z, specNorm Z ∂γ) ≤ sqrt (12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n)
proof:
:=
  integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_of_quadratic_hasSubgaussianMGF
    id measurable_id hHerm c hd
    (fun u hu => hasSubgaussianMGF_quadForm_gaussian γ hmean u c (hvariance u hu))

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_sampling_aux
statement:
private lemma matrix_chernoff_sampling_aux (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ}
    [NeZero d] (hN : 0 < N) (M : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (M k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun M μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (M k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (M k ω) ≤ L)
    (hMean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, M k ω ∂μ = 1) :
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ε < 1 →
      μ.real {ω | lambdaMin ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • ∑ k, M k ω) ≤ 1 - ε} ≤
        chernoffLowerTail d 1 (L / N) ε) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε →
      μ.real {ω | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • ∑ k, M k ω)} ≤
        chernoffUpperTail d 1 (L / N) ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (N : ℝ) := by positivity
  let X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun k ω => (1 / (N : ℝ)) • M k ω
  have hXMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k) := fun k =>
    (measurable_const_smul (1 / (N : ℝ))).comp (hMeas k)
  have hXIndep : iIndepFun X μ :=
    hIndep.comp (fun _ A => (1 / (N : ℝ)) • A) (fun _ => measurable_const_smul _)
  have hXPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef := fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hPSD k] with ω h
    exact h.smul hc.le
  have hXBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L / N := fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω h
    simp only [X, lambdaMax_smul_of_pos _ hc]
    rw [div_eq_mul_one_div L, mul_comm L]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hc.le
  have hsum : ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ = 1 := by
    simp only [X, integral_smul, hMean, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul, mul_one_div_cancel hNr.ne', one_smul]
  have hY : ∀ ω, ∑ k, X k ω = (1 / (N : ℝ)) • ∑ k, M k ω := fun ω => by
    simp only [X, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine ⟨fun ε hε0 hε1 => ?_, fun ε hε0 => ?_⟩
  · have := measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_chernoffLowerTail μ X (by positivity)
      hXMeas hXIndep hXPSD hXBound hε0 hε1
    rw [hsum, lambdaMin_one, mul_one] at this
    simpa only [hY] using this
  · have := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_chernoffUpperTail μ X (by positivity)
      hXMeas hXIndep hXPSD hXBound hε0
    rw [hsum, lambdaMax_one, mul_one] at this
    simpa only [hY] using this

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_sampling_lower
statement:
theorem matrix_chernoff_sampling_lower (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ}
    [NeZero d] (hN : 0 < N) (M : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (M k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun M μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (M k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (M k ω) ≤ L)
    (hMean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, M k ω ∂μ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    μ.real {ω | lambdaMin ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • ∑ k, M k ω) ≤ 1 - ε}
      ≤ d * exp (-(ε ^ 2) * N / (2 * L))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((matrix_chernoff_sampling_aux μ hN M L hL hMeas hIndep hPSD hBound hMean).1
    ε hε0 hε1).trans ?_
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hLN : L / N ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h1ε : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
  rw [chernoffLowerTail, if_neg hLN]
  gcongr
  rw [show Real.rpow (1 - ε) (1 - ε) = exp (log (1 - ε) * (1 - ε)) from rpow_def_of_pos h1ε _,
    ← exp_sub, show Real.rpow (exp (-ε - log (1 - ε) * (1 - ε))) (1 / (L / N)) =
      exp ((-ε - log (1 - ε) * (1 - ε)) * (1 / (L / N))) from (exp_mul _ _).symm]
  gcongr
  have key := neg_sub_mul_log_one_sub_le hε0 hε1
  have hNL : 0 ≤ 1 / (L / N) := by positivity
  calc (-ε - log (1 - ε) * (1 - ε)) * (1 / (L / N)) ≤ -(ε ^ 2 / 2) * (1 / (L / N)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hNL
    _ = -(ε ^ 2) * N / (2 * L) := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_sampling_upper
statement:
theorem matrix_chernoff_sampling_upper (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ}
    [NeZero d] (hN : 0 < N) (M : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (M k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun M μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (M k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (M k ω) ≤ L)
    (hMean : ∀ k, ∫ ω, M k ω ∂μ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    μ.real {ω | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • ∑ k, M k ω)}
      ≤ d * exp (-(ε ^ 2) * N / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((matrix_chernoff_sampling_aux μ hN M L hL hMeas hIndep hPSD hBound hMean).2
    ε hε0).trans ?_
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hLN : L / N ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h1ε : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  rw [chernoffUpperTail, if_neg hLN]
  gcongr
  rw [show Real.rpow (1 + ε) (1 + ε) = exp (log (1 + ε) * (1 + ε)) from rpow_def_of_pos h1ε _,
    ← exp_sub, show Real.rpow (exp (ε - log (1 + ε) * (1 + ε))) (1 / (L / N)) =
      exp ((ε - log (1 + ε) * (1 + ε)) * (1 / (L / N))) from (exp_mul _ _).symm]
  gcongr
  have key := sub_mul_log_one_add_le hε0 hε1
  have hNL : 0 ≤ 1 / (L / N) := by positivity
  calc (ε - log (1 + ε) * (1 + ε)) * (1 / (L / N)) ≤ -(ε ^ 2 / 3) * (1 / (L / N)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hNL
    _ = -(ε ^ 2) * N / (3 * L) := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.mulCLM_apply
statement:
private lemma mulCLM_apply (p q r : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin r) ℂ) :
    mulCLM p q r A B = A * B
proof:
:= by
  simp [mulCLM]

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n a b c N : ℕ}
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (f : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ → Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℂ)
    (g : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ → Matrix (Fin b) (Fin c) ℂ)
    (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (_hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hfL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => f (X k ω)) 2 μ)
    (hgL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => g (X k ω)) 2 μ)
    (hfMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, f (X k ω) ∂μ) = 0) :
    (∫ ω, (∑ k, f (X k ω)) * (∑ k, g (X k ω)) ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, f (X k ω) * g (X k ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun ω => f (X j ω) * g (X k ω)) μ := by
    intro j k
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => f (X j ω) * g (X k ω)) μ :=
      Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable₂
        (g := fun (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin c) ℂ) => A * B)
        (continuous_fst.matrix_mul continuous_snd) (hfL2 j).1 (hgL2 k).1
    have h1 := MemLp.of_bilin (p := 2) (q := 2) (r := 1)
      (fun (A : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin b) (Fin c) ℂ) => A * B) 1
      (hfL2 j) (hgL2 k) hm
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simpa using Matrix.l2_opNNNorm_mul _ _)
    exact memLp_one_iff_integrable.1 h1
  have hcross : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → ∫ ω, f (X j ω) * g (X k ω) ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro j k hjk
    have hind : IndepFun (fun ω => f (X j ω)) (fun ω => g (X k ω)) μ :=
      (hIndep.indepFun hjk).comp hf hg
    have h2 := hind.integral_bilin ((hfL2 j).integrable one_le_two)
      ((hgL2 k).integrable one_le_two) (mulCLM a b c)
    simp only [mulCLM_apply] at h2
    rw [h2, hfMean j, Matrix.zero_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.mul_sum]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hint j k))]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hint j k)]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun k _ hkj => hcross j k (Ne.symm hkj)) (by simp)]

name: NLAlib.hermitianSecondMoment_dilation_eq_rectSecondMoment
statement:
theorem NLAlib.hermitianSecondMoment_dilation_eq_rectSecondMoment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (Z : Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hL2 : MemLp Z 2 μ) :
    hermitianSecondMoment μ (fun ω => dilation (Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)) =
      rectSecondMoment μ (fun ω => Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hW2 : MemLp (fun ω => Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ) 2 μ := hL2.sub (memLp_const _)
  have hWsq : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    hW2.integrable_norm_pow (p := 2) two_ne_zero
  have hP : Integrable
      (fun ω => (Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ) * (Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)ᴴ) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' hWsq ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    · have hc : Continuous (fun X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ => X * Xᴴ) :=
        continuous_id.matrix_mul continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose
      exact hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hW2.1
    · calc _ ≤ ‖Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ‖ * ‖(Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)ᴴ‖ := l2_opNorm_mul _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [l2_opNorm_conjTranspose, sq]
  have hQ : Integrable
      (fun ω => (Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)ᴴ * (Z ω - ∫ ω', Z ω' ∂μ)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' hWsq ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    · have hc : Continuous (fun X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ => Xᴴ * X) :=
        continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose.matrix_mul continuous_id
      exact hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hW2.1
    · rw [l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, sq]
  unfold hermitianSecondMoment rectSecondMoment
  simp_rw [dilation_sq]
  rw [specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_eq_norm, specNorm_eq_norm, integral_fromBlocks_diag μ _ _ hP hQ,
    norm_fromBlocks_diag]

name: NLAlib.scalar_bound
statement:
private lemma scalar_bound (L θ x : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxL : x ≤ L) :
    Real.exp (θ * x) ≤ 1 + chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernoffCgfCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · have : x = 0 := by linarith
    subst this; simp
  · have hLp : 0 < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hL (Ne.symm h)
    set t := x / L with ht
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg hx0 hL
    have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hLp).mpr hxL
    have hc := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) (Set.mem_univ (θ * L))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) ht0 (by ring)
    have hxe : x = t * L := by rw [ht]; field_simp
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at hc
    calc Real.exp (θ * x) = Real.exp (t * (θ * L)) := by rw [hxe]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ (1 - t) + t * Real.exp (θ * L) := hc
      _ = 1 + (Real.exp (θ * L) - 1) / L * x := by rw [hxe]; field_simp; ring

name: NLAlib.spec_mem
statement:
private lemma spec_mem {d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (L : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ lambdaMin A ∧ lambdaMax A ≤ L) : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ A, 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hfin : (spectrum ℝ A).Finite := by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact Set.finite_range _
  exact ⟨hB.1.trans (csInf_le hfin.bddBelow hx), (le_csSup hfin.bddAbove hx).trans hB.2⟩

name: NLAlib.affine_eq
statement:
private lemma affine_eq {d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + c • A = cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + c * x) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfc_const_add 1 (fun x : ℝ => c * x) A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint,
    cfc_const_mul_id c A hA.isSelfAdjoint, map_one]

name: NLAlib.pointwise
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc A hA, affine_eq A hA]
  refine cfc_mono (fun x hx => ?_) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  have := spec_mem A hA L hB x hx
  exact scalar_bound L θ x hL this.1 this.2

name: NLAlib.norm_le
statement:
private lemma norm_le {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (L : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hB : 0 ≤ lambdaMin A ∧ lambdaMax A ≤ L) : ‖A‖ ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_cfc_le (a := A) (f := fun x : ℝ => x) hL (fun x hx => by
    have := spec_mem A hA L hB x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg this.1]; exact this.2)
  rwa [cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isSelfAdjoint] at h

name: NLAlib.norm_exp_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc A hA]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  intro x hx
  have := spec_mem A hA L hB x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  calc θ * x ≤ |θ * x| := le_abs_self _
    _ = |θ| * x := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg this.1]
    _ ≤ |θ| * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this.2 (abs_nonneg θ)

name: NLAlib.nonneg
statement:
private lemma nonneg {d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (L : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ lambdaMin A ∧ lambdaMax A ≤ L) : (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ cfc (fun x : ℝ => x) A :=
    cfc_nonneg (fun x hx => (spec_mem A hA L hB x hx).1)
  rwa [cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isSelfAdjoint] at h

name: NLAlib.one_add_le_exp
statement:
private lemma one_add_le_exp {d : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    1 + B ≤ matrixExp B
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + B = cfc (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x) B := by
    rw [cfc_const_add 1 (fun x : ℝ => x) B (by fun_prop) hB.isSelfAdjoint,
      cfc_id' ℝ B hB.isSelfAdjoint, map_one]
  rw [e1, matrixExp, ← CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hB.isSelfAdjoint]
  refine cfc_mono (fun x _ => ?_) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x]

name: NLAlib.log_one_add_le
statement:
private lemma log_one_add_le {d : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hpd : (1 + B).PosDef) :
    matrixLog (1 + B) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hH : (1 + B).IsHermitian := hpd.isHermitian
  have hspec : ∀ y ∈ spectrum ℝ (1 + B), 0 < y := by
    rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hpd.eigenvalues_pos i
  have e2 : cfc (fun y : ℝ => y - 1) (1 + B) = B := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun y : ℝ => y) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (1 + B) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
      cfc_id' ℝ (1 + B) hH.isSelfAdjoint, cfc_const_one ℝ (1 + B) hH.isSelfAdjoint]
    abel
  calc matrixLog (1 + B) ≤ cfc (fun y : ℝ => y - 1) (1 + B) := by
        unfold matrixLog
        refine cfc_mono (fun y hy => Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hspec y hy)) ?_ (by fun_prop)
        exact Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun y hy => (hspec y hy).ne')
    _ = B := e2

name: NLAlib.chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le
statement:
theorem NLAlib.chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : Measurable X) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (X ω) ∧ lambdaMax (X ω) ≤ L)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (matrixExp (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ • (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ))) ∧
    (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ)) ≤
      (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ • (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  set g := chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ with hg
  have hXae : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ := hMeas.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hXint : Integrable X μ := Integrable.of_bound hXae L (by
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω h1 h2
    exact norm_le (X ω) h1 L hL h2)
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
    NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  have hcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hEint : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) μ :=
    Integrable.of_bound (hcont.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hXae) (Real.exp (|θ| * L)) (by
      filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω h1 h2
      exact norm_exp_le (X ω) h1 L θ h2)
  
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤
      ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + g • X ω) - matrixExp (θ • X ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω h1 h2
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (pointwise (X ω) h1 L θ hL h2)
  have h0 := integral_nonneg_of_ae hdiff
  have hAint : Integrable (fun ω => (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + g • X ω) μ :=
    (integrable_const _).add (hXint.smul g)
  have hI : ∫ ω, ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + g • X ω) - matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ =
      (1 + g • ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) - ∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_sub hAint hEint, integral_add (f := fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) (g := fun ω => g • X ω)
        (integrable_const _) (hXint.smul g),
      integral_const, integral_smul]
    simp
  rw [hI] at h0
  have hE_le : (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ) ≤ 1 + g • ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ := sub_nonneg.mp h0
  
  have hM0 : (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω h1 h2
    exact nonneg (X ω) h1 L h2
  have hMherm : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ).IsHermitian := (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hM0).isHermitian
  have hBherm : (g • ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ).IsHermitian :=
    hMherm.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
  have h1B := one_add_le_exp _ hBherm
  refine ⟨Matrix.le_iff.mp (hE_le.trans h1B), ?_⟩
  
  have hEpd : (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ).PosDef := by
    apply posDef_integral_of_ae_posDef μ _ hEint
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω h1
    exact (posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp _ (h1.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial θ)))).1
  have hD := Matrix.le_iff.mp hE_le
  have h1Bpd : ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + g • ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ).PosDef := by
    have := hEpd.add_posSemidef hD
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this
  have hlog1 : (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ)) ≤
      (matrixLog ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + g • ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ)) :=
    CFC.log_monotoneOn hEpd.isStrictlyPositive h1Bpd.isStrictlyPositive (Matrix.le_iff.mpr hD)
  have hlog2 := log_one_add_le _ h1Bpd
  exact Matrix.le_iff.mp ((Matrix.le_iff.mpr hlog1).trans hlog2)

name: NLAlib.extrema_mem
statement:
private lemma extrema_mem {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    lambdaMax A ∈ spectrum ℝ A ∧ lambdaMin A ∈ spectrum ℝ A
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (spectrum ℝ A).Nonempty :=
    ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.spectrum_nonempty A hA
  exact ⟨(spectrum.isCompact (𝕜 := ℝ) A).sSup_mem hn, (spectrum.isCompact (𝕜 := ℝ) A).sInf_mem hn⟩

name: NLAlib.max_measurable_projection
proof:
:= by
  let p := fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ =>
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
  have hp : Continuous p := by
    simp only [p, selfAdjointPart_apply_coe]
    fun_prop
  have hsp := (upperHemicontinuous_spectrum ℝ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).comp hp
  have hupper : UpperSemicontinuous (fun A => lambdaMax (p A)) := by
    intro A y hy
    have hsub : spectrum ℝ (p A) ⊆ Iio y := fun z hz =>
      (le_csSup (spectrum.isCompact (p A)).bddAbove hz).trans_lt hy
    have hev := hsp A (Iio y) (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhdsSet.mpr hsub)
    filter_upwards [hev] with B hB
    exact subset_of_mem_nhdsSet hB (extrema_mem (p B) (selfAdjointPart ℝ B).property).1
  exact hupper.measurable

name: NLAlib.min_measurable_projection
proof:
:= by
  let p := fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ =>
    (selfAdjointPart ℝ A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
  have hp : Continuous p := by
    simp only [p, selfAdjointPart_apply_coe]
    fun_prop
  have hsp := (upperHemicontinuous_spectrum ℝ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).comp hp
  have hlower : LowerSemicontinuous (fun A => lambdaMin (p A)) := by
    intro A y hy
    have hsub : spectrum ℝ (p A) ⊆ Ioi y := fun z hz =>
      hy.trans_le (csInf_le (spectrum.isCompact (p A)).bddBelow hz)
    have hev := hsp A (Ioi y) (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhdsSet.mpr hsub)
    filter_upwards [hev] with B hB
    exact subset_of_mem_nhdsSet hB (extrema_mem (p B) (selfAdjointPart ℝ B).property).2
  exact hlower.measurable

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_and_lambdaMin
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_and_lambdaMin {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeas : Measurable Y) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hInt : Integrable Y μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMax (Y ω)) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMin (Y ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun ω => (selfAdjointPart ℝ (Y ω) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) =ᵐ[μ] Y := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    exact IsSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ hω
  constructor
  · apply hInt.norm.mono'
    · exact (max_measurable_projection.comp hMeas).aestronglyMeasurable.congr
        (heq.mono fun ω hω => congrArg lambdaMax hω)
    · filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
      exact spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem (extrema_mem (Y ω) hω).1
  · apply hInt.norm.mono'
    · exact (min_measurable_projection.comp hMeas).aestronglyMeasurable.congr
        (heq.mono fun ω hω => congrArg lambdaMin hω)
    · filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
      exact spectrum.norm_le_norm_of_mem (extrema_mem (Y ω) hω).2

name: NLAlib.aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian
statement:
theorem aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → M}
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) :
    AEMeasurable (fun ω => lambdaMax (D + X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun Z : M => lambdaMax (selfAdjointPart ℝ (D + Z) : M)) :=
    continuous_lambdaMax_selfAdjointPart.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  apply (hc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hX).congr
  filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
  exact congrArg lambdaMax ((hD.add hω).isSelfAdjoint.coe_selfAdjointPart_apply ℝ)

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : Integrable X μ) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMax (X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => lambdaMax (X ω)) μ := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian
      0 Matrix.isHermitian_zero hX.aemeasurable hHerm
  refine hX.norm.mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
  have hb := abs_lambdaMax_sub_le_specNorm_sub (X ω) 0 hω Matrix.isHermitian_zero
  have hzero : lambdaMax (0 : M) = 0 := by simp [lambdaMax, spectrum.zero_eq]
  simpa only [hzero, sub_zero, specNorm_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hb

name: NLAlib.quadraticWeakVariance_nonneg
statement: theorem quadraticWeakVariance_nonneg (μ : Measure M) : 0 ≤ quadraticWeakVariance μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sSup_nonneg
  rintro _ ⟨u, _, rfl⟩
  exact variance_nonneg _ _

name: NLAlib.variance_re_quadForm_le_integral_specNorm_sq
statement:
theorem variance_re_quadForm_le_integral_specNorm_sq
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ)
    {u : n → ℂ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; μ] ≤ ∫ Z, specNorm Z ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let q : M → ℝ := fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re
  have hq : Measurable q := by
    dsimp [q]
    simp only [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
    fun_prop
  have hi : Integrable (fun Z : M => specNorm Z ^ 2) μ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, id_eq] using hμ.norm.integrable_sq
  have hb (Z : M) : q Z ^ 2 ≤ specNorm Z ^ 2 := by
    have hnorm := norm_quadForm_le_specNorm Z u
    rw [hu, one_pow, mul_one] at hnorm
    have habs := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (quadForm Z u)).trans hnorm
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)).mpr habs
  have hqi : Integrable (fun Z => q Z ^ 2) μ := by
    apply hi.mono' (hq.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with Z
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sq] using hb Z
  exact (variance_le_expectation_sq hq.aestronglyMeasurable).trans (integral_mono hqi hi hb)

name: NLAlib.bddAbove_range_variance_re_quadForm
statement:
theorem bddAbove_range_variance_re_quadForm
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ) :
    BddAbove ((fun u : n → ℂ => Var[fun Z : M => (quadForm Z u).re; μ]) ''
      {u | ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1})
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∫ Z, specNorm Z ^ 2 ∂μ, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  exact variance_re_quadForm_le_integral_specNorm_sq μ hμ hu

name: NLAlib.variance_re_quadForm_le_quadraticWeakVariance
statement:
theorem variance_re_quadForm_le_quadraticWeakVariance
    (μ : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : MemLp (id : M → M) 2 μ)
    {u : n → ℂ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; μ] ≤ quadraticWeakVariance μ
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_range_variance_re_quadForm μ hμ) ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.variance_re_quadForm_le_sq_sqrt_quadraticWeakVariance_gaussian
statement:
theorem variance_re_quadForm_le_sq_sqrt_quadraticWeakVariance_gaussian
    (μ : Measure M) [IsGaussian μ] {u : n → ℂ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
    Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; μ] ≤ Real.sqrt (quadraticWeakVariance μ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (quadraticWeakVariance_nonneg μ)]
  exact variance_re_quadForm_le_quadraticWeakVariance μ IsGaussian.memLp_two_id hu

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_of_centered_bilinear_moment
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_of_centered_bilinear_moment
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂ρ, Z.IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((Z - ∫ H, H ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent Z ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent H ζ) ∂ρ)
      ⟨σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4, by positivity⟩ ρ
proof:
:= by
  let D : M := ∫ Z, Z ∂ρ
  let γ := ρ.map (fun Z => Z-D)
  have hshift : AEMeasurable (fun Z : M => Z-D) ρ := by fun_prop
  have hD : D.IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_integral hHerm
  have hγ : IsGaussian γ := by dsimp [γ]; infer_instance
  let := hγ
  have hγHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian := by
    have hm : MeasurableSet {Z : M | Z.IsHermitian} :=
      (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun Z : M => Zᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
    apply (ae_map_iff hshift hm).mpr
    exact hHerm.mono fun Z hZ => hZ.sub hD
  have hγmean : (∫ Z, Z ∂γ) = 0 := by
    change (∫ Z : M, id Z ∂ρ.map (fun Z => Z-D)) = 0
    rw [integral_map hshift aestronglyMeasurable_id]
    change (∫ Z, Z-D ∂ρ) = 0
    rw [integral_sub (f := fun Z : M => Z) (g := fun _ : M => D)
      IsGaussian.integrable_id (integrable_const D), integral_const,
      probReal_univ, one_smul]
    exact sub_self _
  have hγbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
        (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
    intro v w hv hw
    rw [integral_map hshift]
    · exact hbilinear v w hv hw
    · exact (Matrix.bilinearCLM v w).continuous.measurable.norm.pow_const 2
        |>.aestronglyMeasurable
  have he (Z : M) : D+(Z-D)=Z := by abel
  have hobs : (∫ Z, specNorm (resolvent (D+Z) ζ) ∂γ) =
      ∫ Z, specNorm (resolvent Z ζ) ∂ρ := by
    rw [integral_map hshift]
    · simp only [he]
    · exact (((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp
        (measurable_const.add measurable_id)).norm).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_bilinear_second_moment
    γ D hD hγHerm hγmean hσ hγbilinear ζ hζ
  have hpull := HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map hshift hsg
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, he, hobs] using hpull

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂ρ, Z.IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ ((Z - ∫ H, H ∂ρ) *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent Z ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) ρ ≤
      (∫ Z, specNorm (resolvent Z ζ) ∂ρ) +
        Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p)
proof:
:= by
  exact lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _)
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_gaussian_of_centered_bilinear_moment
      ρ hHerm hσ hbilinear ζ hζ) hp

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_bilinear_sum_pi_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_bilinear_sum_pi_eq_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((∑ i, Z i (x i)) *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) =
      ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let L := Matrix.bilinearCLM a.ofLp b.ofLp
  have hZi (i : ι) : MemLp (Z i) 2 (ν i) :=
    MemLp.of_bound (hZm i).aestronglyMeasurable R (hZ i)
  have hLi (i : ι) : MemLp (fun ω => L (Z i ω)) 2 (ν i) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using L.comp_memLp' (hZi i)
  have hLm (i : ι) : ∫ ω, L (Z i ω) ∂ν i = 0 := by
    rw [L.integral_comp_comm ((hZi i).integrable one_le_two), hmean i, map_zero]
  have h := integral_norm_sq_sum_pi_of_mean_zero ν (fun i ω => L (Z i ω)) hLi hLm
  change (∫ x : ι → Ω, ‖L (∑ i, Z i (x i))‖ ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) =
    ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖L (Z i ω)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i
  simpa only [map_sum] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_integral_traceExp_add_matrixLog
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_integral_traceExp_add_matrixLog {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (H X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeasH : Measurable H) (hMeasX : Measurable X)
    (hHermH : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (H ω).IsHermitian)
    (hHermX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : IndepFun H X μ)
    (hExpX : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) μ)
    (hIntTotal : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (H ω + X ω)) μ)
    (hIntReplaced : Integrable (fun ω =>
      traceExp (H ω + matrixLog (∫ u, matrixExp (X u) ∂μ))) μ) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (H ω + X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ ω, traceExp (H ω + matrixLog (∫ u, matrixExp (X u) ∂μ)) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let M := Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ M := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ M
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : M × M => traceExp (p.1 + p.2)) := by
    dsimp [traceExp, matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hec : Continuous (fun A : M => matrixExp A) := by
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hrc : Continuous (fun A : M =>
      traceExp (A + matrixLog (∫ u, matrixExp (X u) ∂μ))) := by
    dsimp [traceExp, matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hclosed : MeasurableSet {A : M | A.IsHermitian} := by
    exact (isClosed_eq continuous_star continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hmap := hIndep.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hMeasH.aemeasurable hMeasX.aemeasurable
  have hp : Integrable (fun p : M × M => traceExp (p.1 + p.2))
      ((μ.map H).prod (μ.map X)) := by
    rw [← hmap]
    exact (integrable_map_measure hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (hMeasH.prodMk hMeasX).aemeasurable).2 hIntTotal
  have hr : Integrable (fun A : M =>
      traceExp (A + matrixLog (∫ u, matrixExp (X u) ∂μ))) (μ.map H) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hrc.aestronglyMeasurable hMeasH.aemeasurable).2 hIntReplaced
  have he : Integrable (fun A : M => matrixExp A) (μ.map X) :=
    (integrable_map_measure hec.aestronglyMeasurable hMeasX.aemeasurable).2 hExpX
  have hmx : ∀ᵐ A ∂μ.map X, A.IsHermitian :=
    (ae_map_iff hMeasX.aemeasurable hclosed).2 hHermX
  have hmh : ∀ᵐ A ∂μ.map H, A.IsHermitian :=
    (ae_map_iff hMeasH.aemeasurable hclosed).2 hHermH
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hMeasX.aemeasurable
  calc
    (∫ ω, traceExp (H ω + X ω) ∂μ) =
        ∫ p : M × M, traceExp (p.1 + p.2) ∂((μ.map H).prod (μ.map X)) := by
      rw [← hmap, integral_map (hMeasH.prodMk hMeasX).aemeasurable hc.aestronglyMeasurable]
    _ = ∫ A : M, ∫ B : M, traceExp (A + B) ∂μ.map X ∂μ.map H := integral_prod _ hp
    _ ≤ ∫ A : M, traceExp (A + matrixLog (∫ u, matrixExp (X u) ∂μ)) ∂μ.map H := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hp.integral_prod_left hr
      filter_upwards [hmh] with A hA
      have h := integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_matrixLog (μ.map X) A hA id measurable_id hmx he
      simpa only [id_eq, integral_map hMeasX.aemeasurable hec.aestronglyMeasurable] using h
    _ = _ := integral_map hMeasH.aemeasurable hrc.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.pointwise_bound
statement:
private lemma pointwise_bound {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (ψ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hNonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) (hMono : MonotoneOn ψ (Set.Ici 0))
    (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (htB : t ≤ lambdaMax B) : ψ t ≤ traceFunction ψ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceFunction_eq_sum ψ B hB]
  have hn : (Set.range hB.eigenvalues).Nonempty := Set.range_nonempty _
  have hf : (Set.range hB.eigenvalues).Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have hmax : lambdaMax B ∈ Set.range hB.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [lambdaMax, hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hn.csSup_mem hf
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmax
  rw [← hi] at htB
  calc ψ t ≤ ψ (hB.eigenvalues i) :=
        hMono (Set.mem_Ici.mpr ht) (Set.mem_Ici.mpr (ht.trans htB)) htB
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ψ (hB.eigenvalues j) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hNonneg (hB.eigenvalues j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.measure_lambdaMax_ge_le_integral_traceFunction_div
statement:
theorem NLAlib.measure_lambdaMax_ge_le_integral_traceFunction_div {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (_hMeas : Measurable Y) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hNonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) (hMono : MonotoneOn ψ (Set.Ici 0))
    (hInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceFunction ψ (Y ω)) μ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hψt : 0 < ψ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
      (∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ) / ψ t
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (0 : ℝ) ≤ traceFunction ψ (Y ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    rw [traceFunction_eq_sum ψ _ hω]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hNonneg _)
  have hs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} →
      ω ∈ {ω | ψ t ≤ traceFunction ψ (Y ω)} := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω h
    exact pointwise_bound ψ hNonneg hMono _ hω t ht h
  have hsub : μ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤ μ {ω | ψ t ≤ traceFunction ψ (Y ω)} :=
    measure_mono_ae hs
  have hreal : μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
      μ.real {ω | ψ t ≤ traceFunction ψ (Y ω)} :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) hsub
  have hmarkov := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hpos hInt (ψ t)
  rw [measureReal_def] at hmarkov
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hψt, mul_comm]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal hψt.le).trans hmarkov

name: NLAlib.bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le
statement:
theorem NLAlib.bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L θ : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθL : θ < 3 / L)
    (hMeas : Measurable X) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : MemLp X 2 μ) (hMean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X ω) ≤ L) :
    (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (matrixExp (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • (∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ))) ∧
    (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ)) ≤
      (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • (∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  have hθL' : θ * L < 3 := (lt_div_iff₀ hL).mp hθL
  set c := (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) with hc
  
  have hXint : Integrable X μ := hL2.integrable one_le_two
  have hX2int : Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hL2.integrable_norm_pow two_ne_zero) ?_
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    · exact (continuous_pow 2).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hL2.1
    · rw [sq, sq]
      exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
  have hEcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
      NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hEint : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X ω)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound (hEcont.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hMeas.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω hH hB
    rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc _ hH]
    apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH hB x hx) hθ.le)
  have hXθ : Integrable (fun ω => θ • X ω) μ := hXint.smul θ
  have hX2c : Integrable (fun ω => c • X ω ^ 2) μ := hX2int.smul c
  have hlin : Integrable (fun ω => (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + θ • X ω) μ :=
    (integrable_const 1).add hXθ
  have hQint : Integrable (fun ω => (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) + θ • X ω + c • X ω ^ 2) μ :=
    hlin.add hX2c
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ≤ 1 + θ • X ω + c • X ω ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hBound] with ω hH hB
    exact matrixExp_smul_le_one_add_smul_add_smul_sq_of_spectrum_le _ hH
      (fun x hx => exp_mul_le_one_add_mul_add_sq_mul_of_le hθ hθL'
        (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH hB x hx))
  have hI1 : ∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ ≤ 1 + c • ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_mono_ae hEint hQint hpt
    rw [integral_add hlin hX2c, integral_add (integrable_const 1) hXθ,
      integral_const, integral_smul, integral_smul, hMean] at h
    simpa using h
  
  have hS : (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hH
    have : X ω ^ 2 = Matrix.conjTranspose (X ω) * X ω := by rw [hH.eq, sq]
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, this]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).nonneg
  set S := ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hSdef
  have hSH : S.IsHermitian := (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hS).isHermitian
  have hBH : (c • S).IsHermitian := hSH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial c))
  have h1 : ∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ ≤ matrixExp (c • S) :=
    hI1.trans (one_add_le_matrixExp_of_isHermitian _ hBH)
  refine ⟨Matrix.le_iff.mp h1, ?_⟩
  have hMPD : (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ).PosDef := by
    apply posDef_integral_of_ae_posDef μ _ hEint
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hH
    exact (posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp _ (hH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial θ)))).1
  obtain ⟨hEPD, hlog⟩ := posDef_matrixExp_and_matrixLog_matrixExp (c • S) hBH
  have h2 : (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X ω) ∂μ)) ≤ (matrixLog (matrixExp (c • S))) :=
    CFC.log_monotoneOn hMPD.isStrictlyPositive hEPD.isStrictlyPositive h1
  rwa [hlog] at h2

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_sum_le
statement:
private lemma integral_traceExp_sum_le (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) (hθ : θ ≠ 0) :
    0 < ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ ∧
    (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤ traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  have hYExp := integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp
  have hTrInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω)) μ := by
    exact Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp
      ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hYExp)
  have hTrNonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hω
    exact (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hPos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hω
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hθ with hneg | hpos
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le
          ((exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).2.2 hneg)
      · exact (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le
          ((exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).2.1 hpos)
    apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae hTrNonneg hTrInt).2
    have hFull : Function.support (fun ω => traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω)) =ᵐ[μ]
        (Set.univ : Set Ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hPos] with ω hω
      apply propext
      change (traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) ≠ 0) ↔ True
      exact iff_true_intro hω.ne'
    rw [measure_congr hFull]
    simp
  · simpa only [Finset.smul_sum] using
      trace_cgf_subadditivity μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)) / θ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hCGF⟩ := integral_traceExp_sum_le μ X hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp hθ.ne'
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  exact (integral_lambdaMax_le_log_integral_traceExp_div μ (fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω) hθ
    (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)) hYHerm
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hInt k))
    (integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp)).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.log_le_log hpos hCGF) hθ.le)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤
      Real.exp (-θ * t) * traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hCGF⟩ := integral_traceExp_sum_le μ X hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp hθ.ne'
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  exact (measureReal_lambdaMax_ge_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp μ (fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω) hθ hYHerm
    (integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp) t).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCGF (Real.exp_pos _).le)

name: NLAlib.log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div_le_integral_lambdaMin_sum
statement:
theorem log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div_le_integral_lambdaMin_sum (hθ : θ < 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) :
    Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)) / θ ≤ (∫ ω, lambdaMin (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hCGF⟩ := integral_traceExp_sum_le μ X hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp hθ.ne
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  exact (div_le_div_of_nonpos_of_le hθ.le (Real.log_le_log hpos hCGF)).trans
    (log_integral_traceExp_div_le_integral_lambdaMin μ (fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω) hθ
      (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)) hYHerm
      (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hInt k))
      (integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum (hθ : θ < 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | lambdaMin (∑ k, X k ω) ≤ t} ≤
      Real.exp (-θ * t) * traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hCGF⟩ := integral_traceExp_sum_le μ X hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp hθ.ne
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  exact (measureReal_lambdaMin_le_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp μ (fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω) hθ hYHerm
    (integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp) t).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCGF (Real.exp_pos _).le)

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow_le
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow_le
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (i : κ) {m : ℕ} (hm : Even m) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x i * (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (m + 1)).trace.re
        ∂(rademacherVector _)) ≤
      (m + 1 : ℕ) *
        ∫ x : κ → ℝ, (A i ^ 2 * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ m).trace.re
          ∂(rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (rademacherVector κ)
  let Y := fun x : κ → ℝ => ∑ j, x j • A j
  let T := fun x : κ → ℝ => Function.update x i (-x i)
  let f := fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * (A i * Y x ^ (m + 1)).trace.re
  let g := fun x : κ → ℝ => (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re
  have hf : Continuous f := by
    have h := (continuous_apply i).mul
      (continuous_re_trace_series_product A (A i) 1 (m + 1) 0)
    have he : ((fun x : κ → ℝ => x i) * fun x =>
        (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (m + 1) * 1 * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ 0).trace.re) = f := by
      funext x
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, pow_zero, mul_one]
      rfl
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
      continuous_re_trace_series_product A (A i ^ 2) 1 m 0
  have hfi : Integrable f μ :=
    integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (A i) (m + 1) i
  have hgi : Integrable g μ := integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (A i ^ 2) m
  have hmp := measurePreserving_update_neg_rademacherVector i
  have hTfi : Integrable (fun x => f (T x)) μ := hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable hfi
  have hTgi : Integrable (fun x => g (T x)) μ := hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable hgi
  have hYi (x) : (Y x).IsHermitian := isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x
  have hD (x) : Y x - Y (T x) = (2 * x i) • A i :=
    sum_smul_sub_sum_smul_update_neg A x i
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      2 * (f x + f (T x)) ≤ 2 * (m + 1 : ℕ) * (g x + g (T x)) := by
    have hsign : ∀ᵐ x : κ → ℝ ∂μ, x i = 1 ∨ x i = -1 :=
      (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := fun _ : κ => rademacherMeasure) (i := i)).eventually
        ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_rademacherMeasure
    filter_upwards [hsign] with x hx
    have hxi : x i ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hx with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have hmean := re_trace_sub_mul_sub_pow_le (Y x) (Y (T x)) (hYi x) (hYi (T x)) hm
    rw [hD] at hmean
    have hsq : ((2 * x i) • A i) ^ 2 = (4 : ℝ) • A i ^ 2 := by
      rw [smul_pow, mul_pow, hxi, mul_one]
      norm_num
    rw [hsq] at hmean
    have hleft : (((2 * x i) • A i) *
        (Y x ^ (m + 1) - Y (T x) ^ (m + 1))).trace.re =
        2 * (f x + f (T x)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul,
        mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, Complex.sub_re, f, T, Function.update_self]
      ring
    have hright : ((4 : ℝ) • A i ^ 2 * (Y x ^ m + Y (T x) ^ m)).trace.re =
        4 * (g x + g (T x)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul,
        mul_add, Matrix.trace_add, Complex.add_re, g]
    rw [hleft, hright] at hmean
    nlinarith [hmean]
  have hi := integral_mono_ae ((hfi.add hTfi).const_mul 2)
    ((hgi.add hTgi).const_mul (2 * (m + 1 : ℕ))) hpoint
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_add hfi hTfi,
    integral_add hgi hTgi, integral_update_neg_rademacherVector i f hf.measurable,
    integral_update_neg_rademacherVector i g hg.measurable] at hi
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_even_pow_le_recursion
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_even_pow_le_recursion
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re
        ∂(rademacherVector _)) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) *
        ∫ x : κ → ℝ,
          ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re
          ∂(rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (rademacherVector κ)
  let Y := fun x : κ → ℝ => ∑ i, x i • A i
  let q := 2 * p - 1
  let m := 2 * p - 2
  have hmq : m + 1 = q := by dsimp [m, q]; omega
  have hpow : 2 * p = q + 1 := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hm : Even m := by
    have he : m = 2 * (p - 1) := by dsimp [m]; omega
    rw [he]
    exact even_two_mul _
  have hexpand (x : κ → ℝ) : (Y x ^ (2 * p)).trace.re =
      ∑ i, x i * (A i * Y x ^ q).trace.re := by
    rw [hpow, pow_succ', show Y x = ∑ i, x i • A i by rfl,
      Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcoord (i : κ) := integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow_le A hA i hm
  rw [hmq] at hcoord
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset κ)) => hcoord i
  have hM : (∫ x, (Y x ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ x, x i * (A i * Y x ^ q).trace.re ∂μ := by
    simp_rw [hexpand]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (A i) q i
  have hW : (∫ x, ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂μ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ x, (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂μ := by
    simp_rw [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (A i ^ 2) m
  rw [hM, hW]
  simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using hsum

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_pow_le
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_pow_le
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re
        ∂(rademacherVector _)) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) ^ p).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_re_trace_pow_le_of_polynomial_recursion
    (∑ i, A i ^ 2) (posSemidef_sum_sq_of_isHermitian A hA)
    (fun x : κ → ℝ => ∑ i, x i • A i)
    (ae_of_all _ (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA)) hp
  · simpa only [one_mul] using integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A 1 (2 * p)
  · exact integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (∑ i, A i ^ 2) (2 * p - 2)
  · exact integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_even_pow_le_recursion A hA hp

name: NLAlib.integrable_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul
statement:
theorem integrable_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul
    (A : M) {X : Ω → M} (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  let C := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  let B := (traceExpHessian A).bilinearComp C C
  have h := integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp_two B hX
  simpa only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply, C,
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv_symm',
    iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_hessian] using h

  let B := (traceExpHessian A).bilinearComp C C

theorem integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_second_moments_eq
    (A : M) {X : Ω → M} {Z : Ω' → M}

name: NLAlib.integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_centered_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_centered_covariance_eq
    (A : M) {X : Ω → M} {Z : Ω' → M}
    (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ)
    (hZ : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Z ω)) 2 ν)
    (hXmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) ∂μ) = 0)
    (hZmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (Z ω) ∂ν) = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i, fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j; μ] =
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Z ω) i, fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (Z ω) j; ν]) :
    (∫ ω, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • Z ω)) 0 ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq A hX hZ _ hcov
  intro i
  have hx := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : J => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm
    (hX.integrable one_le_two)
  have hz := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : J => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm
    (hZ.integrable one_le_two)

name: finite_tensorization
statement:
private lemma finite_tensorization {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (X k ω)) μ)
    (s : Finset (Fin N)) (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      traceExp (H + ∑ k ∈ s, matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (X k ω) ∂μ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm (s : Finset (Fin N)) : Measurable (fun ω => ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) :=
    Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  have hh (s : Finset (Fin N)) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ k ∈ s, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => hω k)
  have he (s : Finset (Fin N)) : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (∑ k ∈ s, X k ω)) μ := by
    let Z : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun k ω => if k ∈ s then X k ω else 0
    have hZm (k : Fin N) : Measurable (Z k) := by
      dsimp [Z]
      split_ifs
      · exact hMeas k
      · exact measurable_const
    have hZh (k : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z k ω).IsHermitian := by
      dsimp [Z]
      split_ifs
      · exact hHerm k
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Matrix.isHermitian_zero)
    have hZe (k : Fin N) : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp ((1 : ℝ) • Z k ω)) μ := by
      dsimp [Z]
      split_ifs
      · simpa using hExp k
      · simp
    have hZi : iIndepFun Z μ := by
      exact hIndep.comp (fun k A => if k ∈ s then A else 0) (fun k => by
        split_ifs <;> fun_prop)
    have h := integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ Z 1 hZm hZh hZi hZe
    simpa [Z] using h
  have hshift (s : Finset (Fin N)) (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
      Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (B + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω)) μ :=
    (integrable_matrixExp_add_and_traceExp_add μ B hB _ (hm s) (hh s) (he s)).2
  induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing H with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    let L := matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (X a ω) ∂μ)
    have hL : L.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate Real.log _
    have hrm : Measurable (fun ω => H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) := measurable_const.add (hm s)
    have hrh : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω).IsHermitian := by
      filter_upwards [hh s] with ω hω
      exact hH.add hω
    have hri : IndepFun (fun ω => H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) (X a) μ := by
      have hi := hIndep.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem hMeas ha
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_apply, id_eq] using
        hi.comp (φ := fun A => H + A) (ψ := id) (by fun_prop) measurable_id
    have htotal : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp ((H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) + X a ω)) μ := by
      simpa only [Finset.sum_insert ha, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hshift (insert a s) H hH
    have hreplaced : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp ((H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) + L)) μ := by
      simpa only [add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using hshift s (H + L) (hH.add hL)
    have step := integral_traceExp_add_le_integral_traceExp_add_matrixLog μ (fun ω => H + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω)
      (X a) hrm (hMeas a) hrh (hHerm a) hri (hExp a) htotal hreplaced
    have finish := ih (H + L) (hH.add hL)
    have step' : (∫ ω, traceExp (H + ∑ k ∈ insert a s, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
        ∫ ω, traceExp (H + L + ∑ k ∈ s, X k ω) ∂μ := by
      simpa only [L, Finset.sum_insert ha, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using step
    simpa only [L, Finset.sum_insert ha, add_assoc] using step'.trans finish

name: NLAlib.trace_cgf_subadditivity
statement:
theorem NLAlib.trace_cgf_subadditivity {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (∑ k, θ • X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := fun k ω => θ • X k ω
  have hZm (k : Fin N) : Measurable (Z k) := by
    dsimp [Z]
    exact (hMeas k).const_smul θ
  have hZh (k : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z k ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm k] with ω hω
    exact hω.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr rfl)
  have hZi : iIndepFun Z μ := hIndep.comp (fun _ A => θ • A) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  have h := finite_tensorization μ Z hZm hZh hZi hExp Finset.univ 0 Matrix.isHermitian_zero
  simpa only [zero_add, cumulantSum] using h

name: NLAlib.scalar_expect
statement:
private lemma scalar_expect {x a b L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
      x ≤ (a + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * b) / θ) :
    x ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * b * a) + L * a / 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with rfl | hb'
  · 
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, Real.sqrt_zero, zero_add, add_zero] at h ⊢
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hcon
    have h1 : a / x < 3 / L := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hx hL]; linarith
    have h2 : a / x < (a / x + 3 / L) / 2 := by linarith
    have h0 : 0 < (a / x + 3 / L) / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (div_nonneg ha hx.le) h2
    have h3 := h _ h0 (by linarith)
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hx] at h2
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h0] at h3
    linarith
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha'
  · 
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, zero_div, zero_add] at h ⊢
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    set D := b + 2 * x * L / 3 with hDdef
    have hD : 0 < D := by positivity
    have h0 : 0 < x / D := div_pos hcon hD
    have hθD : x / D * D = x := div_mul_cancel₀ x hD.ne'
    have hθL : x / D < 3 / L := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hD hL]; nlinarith
    have hq : 0 < 1 - x / D * L / 3 := by
      have : x / D * L < 3 := by
        have := (div_lt_div_iff₀ hD hL).mp hθL
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hD]; linarith
      linarith
    have h3 := h _ h0 hθL
    have e : (x / D) ^ 2 / 2 / (1 - x / D * L / 3) * b / (x / D) =
        x / D * b / (2 * (1 - x / D * L / 3)) := by
      field_simp
    rw [e, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h3
    set θ := x / D
    rw [hDdef] at hθD
    nlinarith
  · 
    set r := Real.sqrt (2 * b * a) with hrdef
    have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = 2 * b * a := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    set s := r / b with hsdef
    have hs : 0 < s := div_pos hr hb'
    set u := 1 + s * L / 3 with hudef
    have hu : 0 < u := by positivity
    have hθ0 : 0 < s / u := div_pos hs hu
    have hθL : s / u < 3 / L := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hu hL, hudef]; nlinarith
    have hq : 1 - s / u * L / 3 = 1 / u := by
      field_simp
      rw [hudef]; ring
    have h3 := h (s / u) hθ0 hθL
    rw [hq] at h3
    have e : (a + (s / u) ^ 2 / 2 / (1 / u) * b) / (s / u) =
        a / s + a * L / 3 + s * b / 2 := by
      field_simp
      rw [hudef]; ring
