    have e2 : a / s = r / 2 := by
      rw [hsdef]; field_simp; nlinarith [hr2]
    have e3 : s * b / 2 = r / 2 := by
      rw [hsdef]; field_simp
    rw [e, e2, e3] at h3
    linarith

name: NLAlib.scalar_tail
statement:
private lemma scalar_tail {P c v L t : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (ht : 0 < t)
    (h : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
      P ≤ c * Real.exp (-θ * t + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v)) :
    P ≤ c * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hv.eq_or_lt with rfl | hv'
  · have h0 : 0 < 3 / (2 * L) := by positivity
    have h1 : 3 / (2 * L) < 3 / L := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hL]; nlinarith
    have h3 := h _ h0 h1
    have e : -(3 / (2 * L)) * t + (3 / (2 * L)) ^ 2 / 2 / (1 - 3 / (2 * L) * L / 3) * 0 =
        -(t ^ 2 / 2) / (0 + L * t / 3) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rwa [e] at h3
  · set D := v + L * t / 3 with hDdef
    have hD : 0 < D := by positivity
    have h0 : 0 < t / D := div_pos ht hD
    have h1 : t / D < 3 / L := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hD hL, hDdef]; nlinarith
    have hq : 1 - t / D * L / 3 = v / D := by
      field_simp
      rw [hDdef]; ring
    have h3 := h _ h0 h1
    rw [hq] at h3
    have e : -(t / D) * t + (t / D) ^ 2 / 2 / (v / D) * v = -(t ^ 2 / 2) / D := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rwa [e] at h3

name: NLAlib.hermitian_bernstein_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.hermitian_bernstein_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) :
    let Y
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let v := hermitianSecondMoment μ Y
    v = specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ∧
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * v * Real.log d) + L * Real.log d / 3 ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail d v L t := by
  intro Y v
  have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hd
  
  have hsm : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ X id id measurable_id measurable_id hMeas
      hIndep (fun k => hL2 k) (fun k => hL2 k) hMean

    simp only [Y, sq]
    exact h
  have hv : v = specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    show specNorm (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = _
    rw [hsm]
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv ▸ specNorm_nonneg _
  have hBpsd : (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
    intro k _
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hHerm k] with ω hH
    have : X k ω ^ 2 = Matrix.conjTranspose (X k ω) * X k ω := by rw [hH.eq, sq]
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, this]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).nonneg
  have hBH : (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ).IsHermitian := hBpsd.isHermitian
  have hP1 : ∀ t : ℝ, μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤ d := fun t =>
    (measureReal_le_one (μ := μ)).trans hd
  have htail0 : bernsteinTail d v L 0 = d := by
    unfold bernsteinTail
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rfl
    · exact absurd rfl h2
    · simp
  have htailNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ bernsteinTail d v L t := by
    intro t
    unfold bernsteinTail
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLpos
  · 
    subst hL0
    have hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (Y ω) ≤ 0 := by
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ k, (X k ω).IsHermitian ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [ae_all_iff]
        intro k
        filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2 using ⟨h1, h2⟩
      filter_upwards [h1] with ω hω
      have hle : (∑ k, X k ω) ≤ 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonpos
        intro k _
        have := le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ (hω k).1 (hω k).2)
          (hω k).1.isSelfAdjoint
        simpa using this
      have hYH : (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => (hω k).1)
      have hspec : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ (∑ k, X k ω), x ≤ 0 :=
        (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le (r := (0 : ℝ)) hYH.isSelfAdjoint).mp (by simpa using hle)
      exact Real.sSup_nonpos hspec
    refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ 0 := integral_nonpos_of_ae hY
      have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * v * Real.log d) + 0 * Real.log d / 3 := by
        rw [zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    · intro t ht
      rcases ht.eq_or_lt with h0 | htp
      · subst h0
        rw [htail0]
        exact hP1 0
      · have hnull : μ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} = 0 := by
          rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
          filter_upwards [hY] with ω hω
          simp only [not_le]
          linarith
        rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
        exact htailNonneg t
  · 
    set B := ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hBdef
    have hcumH : ∀ θ : ℝ, (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian := fun θ =>
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
    have hInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k => (hL2 k).integrable one_le_two
    have hEcont : ∀ θ : ℝ,
        Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
      intro θ
      let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
        NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
      dsimp [matrixExp]
      fun_prop
    have hExp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := by
      intro θ hθ k
      refine Integrable.of_bound
        ((hEcont θ).comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
      filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω hH hB
      rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc _ hH]
      apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      intro x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH hB x hx) hθ.le)
    have hcgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
          d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v) := by
      intro θ hθ hθL
      have hg : 0 ≤ (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) := by
        have : θ * L < 3 := (lt_div_iff₀ hLpos).mp hθL
        apply div_nonneg (by positivity)
        linarith
      have hsum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • B) := by
        unfold cumulantSum
        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
        rw [hBdef, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => (bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L θ hLpos hθ hθL
          (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hL2 k) (hMean k) (hBound k)).2)
      calc traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
          ≤ traceExp (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • B) :=
            traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ (hcumH θ)
              (hBH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))) hsum
        _ ≤ d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * ‖B‖) := traceExp_smul_le_mul_exp_mul_norm _ hBH hg
        _ = _ := by rw [hv, specNorm_eq_norm]
    have hE : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
          (Real.log d + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v) / θ := by
      intro θ hθ hθL
      have h1 := (integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div μ X hθ hMeas hHerm hInt hIndep (hExp θ hθ))
      have hpos : 0 < traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian _ (hcumH θ)
      have hlog : Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)) ≤
          Real.log d + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v := by
        calc _ ≤ Real.log (d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v)) :=
              Real.log_le_log hpos (hcgf θ hθ hθL)
          _ = _ := by rw [Real.log_mul hd0.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
      exact h1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hθ.le)
    have hT : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
          d * Real.exp (-θ * t + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v) := by
      intro t θ hθ hθL
      have h1 := (measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum μ X hθ hMeas hHerm hIndep (hExp θ hθ) t)
      calc _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * t) * traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := h1
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * t) * (d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcgf θ hθ hθL) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := scalar_expect hLpos (Real.log_nonneg hd) hv0 hE
      simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using this
    · intro t ht
      rcases ht.eq_or_lt with h0 | htp
      · subst h0
        rw [htail0]
        exact hP1 0
      · have hD : v + L * t / 3 ≠ 0 := by
          have := mul_pos hLpos htp
          apply ne_of_gt
          linarith
        unfold bernsteinTail
        rw [if_neg hD]
        exact scalar_tail hLpos hv0 htp (hT t)

name: NLAlib.hermitianSecondMoment_sum_eq
statement:
theorem hermitianSecondMoment_sum_eq (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0) :
    hermitianSecondMoment μ (fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω) = specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ X id id measurable_id measurable_id hMeas
    hIndep (fun k => hL2 k) (fun k => hL2 k) hMean
  unfold hermitianSecondMoment
  simp only [sq]
  exact congrArg specNorm h

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_of_lambdaMax_le
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_of_lambdaMax_le {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) * Real.log d) + L * Real.log d / 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv, hE, -⟩ := hermitian_bernstein_package μ X L hL hMeas hHerm hL2 hIndep hMean hBound
  rwa [hv] at hE

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_bernsteinTail {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail d (specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) L t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv, -, hT⟩ := hermitian_bernstein_package μ X L hL hMeas hHerm hL2 hIndep hMean hBound
  have := hT t ht
  rwa [hv] at this

name: NLAlib.mem_spec_bounds
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (spectrum ℝ A).Finite := by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact Set.finite_range _
  exact ⟨csInf_le hf.bddBelow hx, le_csSup hf.bddAbove hx⟩

name: NLAlib.eig_bounds
proof:
:=
  mem_spec_bounds A hA (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)

name: NLAlib.traceExp_le_max
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hB c]
  calc ∑ i, Real.exp (c * hB.eigenvalues i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin d, Real.exp (c * lambdaMax B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (eig_bounds B hB i).2 hc)
    _ = d * Real.exp (c * lambdaMax B) := by simp

name: NLAlib.traceExp_le_min
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hB c]
  calc ∑ i, Real.exp (c * hB.eigenvalues i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin d, Real.exp (c * lambdaMin B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left (eig_bounds B hB i).1 hc)
    _ = d * Real.exp (c * lambdaMin B) := by simp

name: NLAlib.lambda_zero
statement:
private lemma lambda_zero {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] :
    lambdaMax (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = 0 ∧ lambdaMin (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold lambdaMax lambdaMin
  rw [spectrum.zero_eq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.g_nonneg
statement: private lemma g_nonneg {L θ : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : 0 ≤ chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernoffCgfCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hθ
  · have hLp : 0 < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hL (Ne.symm h)
    apply div_nonneg _ hLp.le
    have : 1 ≤ Real.exp (θ * L) := Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hθ hL)
    linarith

name: NLAlib.g_nonpos
statement: private lemma g_nonpos {L θ : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hθ : θ ≤ 0) : chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernoffCgfCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hθ
  · have hLp : 0 < L := lt_of_le_of_ne hL (Ne.symm h)
    apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg _ hLp.le
    have : Real.exp (θ * L) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hθ hL)
    linarith

name: NLAlib.g_pos
statement:
private lemma g_pos {L θ : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ = (Real.exp (θ * L) - 1) / L
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernoffCgfCoefficient
  rw [if_neg hL.ne']

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (X k ω) ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) :
    let Y
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let a := lambdaMin (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ)
    let b := lambdaMax (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ)
    a = lambdaMin (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) ∧
    b = lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ →
      (1 - Real.exp (-θ)) / θ * a - L * Real.log d / θ ≤
        (∫ ω, lambdaMin (Y ω) ∂μ) ∧
      (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
        (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * b + L * Real.log d / θ) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ε < 1 →
      μ.real {ω | lambdaMin (Y ω) ≤ (1 - ε) * a} ≤
        chernoffLowerTail d a L ε) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε →
      μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * b ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
        chernoffUpperTail d b L ε) := by
  intro Y a b
  have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hd
  have hnorm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖X k ω‖ ≤ L := fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2
    exact norm_le _ h1 hL h2.1 h2.2
  have hInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k =>
    Integrable.of_bound (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable L (hnorm k)
  have hExp : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := by
    intro θ k
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
      NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    refine Integrable.of_bound ?_ (Real.exp (|θ| * L)) ?_
    · have hcont : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) :=
        NormedSpace.exp_continuous.comp (continuous_const_smul θ)
      exact hcont.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hHerm k, hnorm k] with ω h1 h2
      exact (norm_exp_le _ h1 θ).trans
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg θ)))
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B, B = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hYB : ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ = B := by
    rw [hBdef]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hInt k)
  have ha : a = lambdaMin B := by
    show lambdaMin (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) = _
    rw [hYB]
  have hb : b = lambdaMax B := by
    show lambdaMax (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) = _
    rw [hYB]
  
  have hXnonneg : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ X k ω := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.nonneg
    rw [h1.posSemidef_iff_eigenvalues_nonneg]
    intro i
    exact h2.1.trans (eig_bounds _ h1 i).1
  have hBH : B.IsHermitian := by
    rw [hBdef]
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ =>
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae (hXnonneg k))).isHermitian)
  
  have hcumH : ∀ θ : ℝ, (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian := fun θ =>
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
  have hcum : ∀ θ : ℝ, traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
      traceExp (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ • B) := by
    intro θ
    have hk := fun k => (chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L hL (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hBound k) θ).2
    have hsum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ • B) := by
      unfold cumulantSum
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [hBdef, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k)
    exact traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ (hcumH θ)
      (hBH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))) hsum
  have htrU : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
      d * Real.exp (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ * lambdaMax B) := fun θ hθ =>
    (hcum θ).trans (traceExp_le_max B hBH (g_nonneg hL hθ))
  have htrL : ∀ θ : ℝ, θ ≤ 0 → traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
      d * Real.exp (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ * lambdaMin B) := fun θ hθ =>
    (hcum θ).trans (traceExp_le_min B hBH (g_nonpos hL hθ))
  have hlog : ∀ θ c : ℝ, traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ d * Real.exp c →
      Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)) ≤ Real.log d + c := by
    intro θ c h
    calc _ ≤ Real.log (d * Real.exp c) := Real.log_le_log (traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian _ (hcumH θ)) h
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.log_mul hd0.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
  have hP1 : ∀ s : Set Ω, μ.real s ≤ d := fun s =>
    (measureReal_le_one (μ := μ)).trans hd
  have hYdef : ∀ ω, Y ω = ∑ k, X k ω := fun ω => rfl
  clear_value Y a b
  subst ha hb
  refine ⟨by rw [hBdef], by rw [hBdef], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro θ hθ
    rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLp
    · 
      subst hL0
      have hX0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ k, X k ω = 0 := by
        rw [ae_all_iff]
        intro k
        filter_upwards [hnorm k] with ω h
        exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp h
      have hB0 : B = 0 := by
        rw [hBdef]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro k _
        rw [integral_congr_ae (hX0.mono fun ω h => h k)]
        simp
      have hmin : ∫ ω, lambdaMin (Y ω) ∂μ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_congr_ae (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))]
        · simp
        · filter_upwards [hX0] with ω h
          simp [hYdef, h, lambda_zero]
      have hmax : ∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_congr_ae (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))]
        · simp
        · filter_upwards [hX0] with ω h
          simp [hYdef, h, lambda_zero]
      rw [hmin, hmax, hB0, lambda_zero.1, lambda_zero.2]
      simp
    · constructor
      · have hθ' : -θ / L < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_lt_zero.mpr hθ) hLp
        have h1 := log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div_le_integral_lambdaMin_sum μ X hθ' hMeas hHerm hInt hIndep (hExp _)
        have h2 := hlog _ _ (htrL _ hθ'.le)
        have h3 := div_le_div_of_nonpos_of_le hθ'.le h2
        have e : (Real.log d + chernoffCgfCoefficient L (-θ / L) * lambdaMin B) / (-θ / L) =
            (1 - Real.exp (-θ)) / θ * lambdaMin B - L * Real.log d / θ := by
          rw [g_pos hLp, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hLp.ne']
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [e] at h3
        simp only [hYdef]
        linarith
      · have hθ' : 0 < θ / L := div_pos hθ hLp
        have h1 := integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div μ X hθ' hMeas hHerm hInt hIndep (hExp _)
        have h2 := hlog _ _ (htrU _ hθ'.le)
        have h3 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 hθ'.le
        have e : (Real.log d + chernoffCgfCoefficient L (θ / L) * lambdaMax B) / (θ / L) =
            (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * lambdaMax B + L * Real.log d / θ := by
          rw [g_pos hLp, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hLp.ne']
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [e] at h3
        simp only [hYdef]
        linarith
  · 
    intro ε hε0 hε1
    rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLp
    · unfold chernoffLowerTail
      rw [if_pos hL0.symm]
      exact hP1 _
    rcases hε0.eq_or_lt with hε | hεp
    · subst hε
      unfold chernoffLowerTail
      rw [if_neg hLp.ne']
      simpa using hP1 _
    have h1e : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
    have hθ' : Real.log (1 - ε) / L < 0 :=
      div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (Real.log_neg h1e (by linarith)) hLp
    have h1 := measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum μ X hθ' hMeas hHerm hIndep (hExp _)
      ((1 - ε) * lambdaMin B)
    have h2 := htrL _ hθ'.le
    rw [g_pos hLp, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hLp.ne', Real.exp_log h1e] at h2
    unfold chernoffLowerTail
    rw [if_neg hLp.ne']
    have hbase : 0 < Real.exp (-ε) / Real.rpow (1 - ε) (1 - ε) :=
      div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1e _)
    have e : Real.rpow (Real.exp (-ε) / Real.rpow (1 - ε) (1 - ε)) (lambdaMin B / L) =
        Real.exp (-(Real.log (1 - ε) / L) * ((1 - ε) * lambdaMin B) +
          (1 - ε - 1) / L * lambdaMin B) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hbase, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
        Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos _).ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1e _).ne',
        Real.log_exp, Real.log_rpow h1e]
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e, Real.exp_add]
    simp only [hYdef]
    calc _ ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by ring
  · 
    intro ε hε0
    rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLp
    · unfold chernoffUpperTail
      rw [if_pos hL0.symm]
      exact hP1 _
    rcases hε0.eq_or_lt with hε | hεp
    · subst hε
      unfold chernoffUpperTail
      rw [if_neg hLp.ne']
      simpa using hP1 _
    have h1e : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
    have hθ' : 0 < Real.log (1 + ε) / L :=
      div_pos (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) hLp
    have h1 := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum μ X hθ' hMeas hHerm hIndep (hExp _)
      ((1 + ε) * lambdaMax B)
    have h2 := htrU _ hθ'.le
    rw [g_pos hLp, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hLp.ne', Real.exp_log h1e] at h2
    unfold chernoffUpperTail
    rw [if_neg hLp.ne']
    have hbase : 0 < Real.exp ε / Real.rpow (1 + ε) (1 + ε) :=
      div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1e _)
    have e : Real.rpow (Real.exp ε / Real.rpow (1 + ε) (1 + ε)) (lambdaMax B / L) =
        Real.exp (-(Real.log (1 + ε) / L) * ((1 + ε) * lambdaMax B) +
          (1 + ε - 1) / L * lambdaMax B) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_eq_pow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hbase, Real.rpow_eq_pow,
        Real.log_div (Real.exp_pos _).ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1e _).ne',
        Real.log_exp, Real.log_rpow h1e]
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e, Real.exp_add]
    simp only [hYdef]
    calc _ ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.chernoff_hyp
statement:
private lemma chernoff_hyp {L : ℝ} (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) :
    (∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian) ∧
    (∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (X k ω) ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun k => (hPSD k).mono fun ω h => h.isHermitian, fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hPSD k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2
    exact ⟨lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef h1, h2⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMin_sum_ge_chernoff
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMin_sum_ge_chernoff {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    (1 - Real.exp (-θ)) / θ * lambdaMin (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) - L * Real.log d / θ ≤
      (∫ ω, lambdaMin (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hHerm, hB⟩ := chernoff_hyp μ X hPSD hBound
  obtain ⟨ha, -, hE, -, -⟩ := matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL hMeas hIndep hHerm hB
  have := (hE θ hθ).1
  rwa [ha] at this

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_chernoff {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) + L * Real.log d / θ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hHerm, hB⟩ := chernoff_hyp μ X hPSD hBound
  obtain ⟨-, hb, hE, -, -⟩ := matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL hMeas hIndep hHerm hB
  have := (hE θ hθ).2
  rwa [hb] at this

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_chernoffLowerTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMin_sum_le_le_chernoffLowerTail {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    μ.real {ω | lambdaMin (∑ k, X k ω) ≤ (1 - ε) * lambdaMin (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ)} ≤
      chernoffLowerTail d (lambdaMin (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ)) L ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hHerm, hB⟩ := chernoff_hyp μ X hPSD hBound
  obtain ⟨ha, -, -, hT, -⟩ := matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL hMeas hIndep hHerm hB
  have := hT ε hε0 hε1
  rwa [ha] at this

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_chernoffUpperTail
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_chernoffUpperTail {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤
      chernoffUpperTail d (lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ)) L ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hHerm, hB⟩ := chernoff_hyp μ X hPSD hBound
  obtain ⟨-, hb, -, -, hT⟩ := matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL hMeas hIndep hHerm hB
  have := hT ε hε0
  rwa [hb] at this

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMin_sum_ge_and_measure_lt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMin_sum_ge_and_measure_lt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
    {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (W : Fin N → Ω → M) (ν : Fin N → Measure M)
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ H, H ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, (-R) • (1 : M) ≤ H)
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hγHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hγmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hγcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ])
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) :
    (∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) -
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * Real.log (Fintype.card n)) -
          (R / 3) * Real.log (Fintype.card n) ≤
        (∫ ω, lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) ∂P) ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
        lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) < (∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) -
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) - (R / 3) * s} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s)) ∧
    (0 < R → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
        lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) ≤ (∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) -
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) - (R / 3) * s} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s))
proof:
:= by
  let (i : Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) :=
    (hW i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  let η : Fin N → Measure M := fun i => (ν i).map (fun H : M => -H)
  let (i : Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (η i) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have hlaw (i : Fin N) : HasLaw (fun H : M => -H) (η i) (ν i) := ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩
  have hWneg (i : Fin N) : HasLaw (fun ω => -W i ω) (η i) P := (hlaw i).comp (hW i)
  have hindneg : iIndepFun (fun i ω => -W i ω) P :=
    hind.comp (fun _ H => -H) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  have hη2 (i : Fin N) : MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (η i) := by
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff continuous_matrixRealCoordinates.aestronglyMeasurable
      (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun H : M => -H) (ν i))).mpr
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_neg, Pi.neg_def] using (hν2 i).neg
  have hηmean (i : Fin N) : (∫ H, H ∂η i) = 0 := by
    have hm := integral_map (μ := ν i) (φ := fun H : M => -H) (f := fun H : M => H)
      (by fun_prop) aestronglyMeasurable_id
    rw [hm, integral_neg, hνmean i, neg_zero]
  have hHermSet : MeasurableSet {H : M | H.IsHermitian} :=
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun H : M => Hᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hηHerm (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ H ∂η i, H.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun H : M => -H) (ν i)) hHermSet).mpr
    exact (hνHerm i).mono fun H hH => hH.neg
  have hηbound (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ H ∂η i, H ≤ R • (1 : M) := by
    have hbset : MeasurableSet {H : M | H ≤ R • (1 : M)} :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_id continuous_const).measurableSet
    apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun H : M => -H) (ν i)) hbset).mpr
    filter_upwards [hbound i] with H hH
    simpa only [neg_smul, neg_neg] using neg_le_neg hH
  have hηcov (i : Fin N) (a b : J) :
      cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; η i] =
        cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i] := by
    have he := (hlaw i).covariance_fun_comp
      ((measurable_pi_apply a).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates).aemeasurable
      ((measurable_pi_apply b).comp measurable_matrixRealCoordinates).aemeasurable
    simp only [Function.comp_def, map_neg, Pi.neg_apply] at he
    change cov[-(fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a), -(fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b); ν i] = _ at he
    simp only [covariance_neg_left, covariance_neg_right, neg_neg] at he
    exact he.symm
  have hcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; η i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ] := by
    intro a b
    simpa only [hηcov] using hγcov a b
  have h := integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
    (fun i ω => -W i ω) η hWneg hindneg hη2 hηmean hηHerm hR hηbound
    γ hγHerm hγmean hcov (-D) hD.neg
  have hmaxneg (ω : Ω) : lambdaMax ((∑ i, -W i ω) + -D) =
      -lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) := by
    have he : (∑ i, -W i ω) + -D = -((∑ i, W i ω) + D) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_add]
    rw [he, lambdaMax_neg]
  have hγmax : (∫ Z, lambdaMax (-D + Z) ∂γ) = -(∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) := by
    have hi := integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ (-D) hD.neg hγHerm hγmean
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (quadraticWeakVariance γ))
      (fun u hu => variance_re_quadForm_le_sq_sqrt_quadraticWeakVariance_gaussian γ hu)
    have hs := IsGaussian.integral_comp_neg_eq_of_integral_eq_zero γ hγmean
      (fun Z => lambdaMax (-D + Z)) hi
    have he (Z : M) : lambdaMax (-D + -Z) = -lambdaMin (D + Z) := by
      rw [← neg_add, lambdaMax_neg]
    simp_rw [he] at hs
    rw [integral_neg] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have he := h.1
    simp_rw [hmaxneg] at he
    rw [integral_neg, hγmax] at he
    linarith
  · intro s hs
    have hset : {ω | lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) < (∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) -
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) - (R / 3) * s} =
        {ω | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (-D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, -W i ω) + -D)} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [hmaxneg, hγmax]
      constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
    rw [hset]
    exact h.2.1 s hs
  · intro hRpos s hs
    have hset : {ω | lambdaMin ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) ≤ (∫ Z, lambdaMin (D + Z) ∂γ) -
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) - (R / 3) * s} =
        {ω | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (-D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, -W i ω) + -D)} := by
      ext ω
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      rw [hmaxneg, hγmax]
      constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
    rw [hset]
    exact h.2.2 hRpos s hs

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff
    {Ω ι n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun Z μ) (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤
        (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) +
          R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hSqMeas : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => A ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [pow_two, id_eq] using
      (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_id :
        Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => A * A))
  have hSqPSD : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω ^ 2).PosSemidef := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hHerm i] with ω hω
    simpa only [hω.eq, pow_two] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)
  have hSqBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω ^ 2) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with ω hω hb
    have hs : specNorm (Z i ω) ^ 2 = specNorm (Z i ω ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [hω.eq, pow_two] using specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)
    rw [← hs]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hR).mpr hb
  have hSqInt : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Z i ω ^ 2) μ := by
    intro i
    refine Integrable.of_bound (hSqMeas.comp (hMeas i)).aestronglyMeasurable (R ^ 2) ?_
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hSqBound i
  have hSumInt : Integrable (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) μ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using
      (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hSqInt i)).norm
  refine ⟨hSumInt, ?_⟩
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    let := hn
    have hnorm : ∀ A : Matrix n n ℂ, specNorm A = 0 := by
      intro A
      rw [Subsingleton.elim A 0, specNorm_zero]
    simp only [hnorm, integral_zero, mul_zero, Fintype.card_eq_zero,
      Nat.cast_zero, Real.log_zero, add_zero, le_refl]
  | inr hn =>
    let := hn
    let : NeZero (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
    let e := Fintype.equivFin n
    let f := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
    let E : Matrix n n ℂ ≃ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
      Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ e e
    let Y : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → Ω →
        Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
      fun k ω => E (Z (f k) ω ^ 2)
    have hEMeas : Measurable E := E.toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.measurable
    have hYMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (Y k) := by
      intro k
      exact hEMeas.comp (hSqMeas.comp (hMeas (f k)))
    have hYIndep : iIndepFun Y μ := by
      exact (iIndepFun.precomp f.injective hIndep).comp
        (fun _ A => E (A ^ 2)) (fun _ => hEMeas.comp hSqMeas)
    have hYPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y k ω).PosSemidef := by
      intro k
      exact (hSqPSD (f k)).mono (fun ω hω => hω.submatrix e.symm)
    have hYBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (Y k ω) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      filter_upwards [hYPSD k, hSqBound (f k)] with ω hω hb
      rw [hω.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm]
      change specNorm ((Z (f k) ω ^ 2).reindex e e) ≤ R ^ 2
      rwa [specNorm_reindex]
    have hSumPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).PosSemidef := by
      filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hSqPSD] with ω hω
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun i _ => hω i)
    have hMeanPSD : (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
      apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
      intro i _
      rw [← Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef]
      exact integral_nonneg_of_ae ((hSqPSD i).mono (fun ω hω => hω.nonneg))
    have hYsum (ω : Ω) : (∑ k, Y k ω) = E (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) := by
      change (∑ k, E (Z (f k) ω ^ 2)) = _
      rw [← map_sum]
      exact congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => Z i ω ^ 2))
    have hYmean : (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      calc
        (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) = ∑ k, E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          exact integral_reindex μ e (fun ω => Z (f k) ω ^ 2)
        _ = E (∑ k, ∫ ω, Z (f k) ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := (map_sum E _ _).symm
        _ = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) :=
          congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ))
    have hLeft : (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, Y k ω) ∂μ) =
        ∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hSumPSD] with ω hω
      rw [hYsum]
      change lambdaMax ((∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).reindex e e) = _
      have hp : ((∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).reindex e e).PosSemidef := hω.submatrix e.symm
      rw [hp.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm, specNorm_reindex]
    have hRight : lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) =
        specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      rw [hYmean]
      change lambdaMax ((∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).reindex e e) = _
      have hp : ((∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).reindex e e).PosSemidef :=
        hMeanPSD.submatrix e.symm
      rw [hp.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm, specNorm_reindex]
    have hc := integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_chernoff μ Y (sq_nonneg R)
      hYMeas hYIndep hYPSD hYBound (θ := 1) zero_lt_one
    rw [hLeft, hRight] at hc
    simpa only [div_one] using hc

name: NLAlib.gaussianProxyVariance_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianProxyVariance_nonneg
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 ≤ gaussianProxyVariance γ R
proof:
:= by
  have hφ := integral_lambdaMax_gaussian_nonneg γ hHerm hmean
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg (quadraticWeakVariance γ))
    (fun u hu => variance_re_quadForm_le_sq_sqrt_quadraticWeakVariance_gaussian γ hu)
  exact add_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hR hφ) (by norm_num))
    (quadraticWeakVariance_nonneg γ)

name: NLAlib.integrable_traceExp_smul_sum_add_pi_of_upper_bound
statement:
private theorem integrable_traceExp_smul_sum_add_pi_of_upper_bound
    {N : ℕ} (ν : Fin N → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W.IsHermitian)
    {R θ : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    Integrable (fun W : Fin N → M => traceExp (θ • ((∑ i, W i) + D))) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hνHerm i))
  have hB : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, W i ≤ R • (1 : M) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hbound i))
  have hsumH : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, (θ • ∑ i, W i).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [hH] with W hW
    have hs : (∑ i, W i).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hW i)
    exact hs.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)
  have hsumB : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν,
      θ • ∑ i, W i ≤ (θ * ((N : ℝ) * R)) • (1 : M) := by
    filter_upwards [hB] with W hW
    have hs : (∑ i, W i) ≤ ((N : ℝ) * R) • (1 : M) := by
      have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hW i)
      simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul] using hh
    simpa only [smul_smul] using Matrix.matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg hs hθ
  have hi := integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_upper_bound (θ • D)
    (hD.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ))
    (show Continuous (fun W : Fin N → M => θ • ∑ i, W i) from by fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
    hsumH hsumB
  simpa only [smul_add, add_comm] using hi

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sum_pi_sub_and_integral_le_gaussian_proxy
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sum_pi_sub_and_integral_le_gaussian_proxy
    {N : ℕ} (ν : Fin N → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ W, W ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hγHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hγmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hγcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W a, fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ])
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθR : θ * R < 3) :
    Integrable (fun W : Fin N → M => Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D) -
      ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ))) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
    (∫ W : Fin N → M, Real.exp (θ * (lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D) -
      ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (gaussianProxyVariance γ R * θ ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - (R / 3) * θ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsumH : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, (∑ i, W i).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hνHerm i))
    exact hh.mono fun W hW => isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hW i)
  have htrace := integrable_traceExp_smul_sum_add_pi_of_upper_bound ν hνHerm hbound D hD hθ
  have hcomp := integral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_pi_le_gaussianTraceInflation
    ν hν2 hνmean hνHerm hbound γ hγHerm hγmean hγcov
    (θ • D) (hD.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)) hθ
  have hcomp' : (∫ W : Fin N → M, traceExp (θ • ((∑ i, W i) + D)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ Z, traceExp (θ • D + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z) ∂γ := by
    simpa only [smul_add, add_comm] using hcomp
  have h := integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sub_and_integral_le_of_trace_comparison
    (fun W : Fin N → M => ∑ i, W i) (by fun_prop) hsumH D hD γ hγHerm hγmean
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg (quadraticWeakVariance γ))
    (fun u hu => variance_re_quadForm_le_sq_sqrt_quadraticWeakVariance_gaussian γ hu)
    hR hθ hθR htrace hcomp'
  simpa only [Real.sq_sqrt (quadraticWeakVariance_nonneg γ), gaussianProxyVariance, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_pi_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_pi_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy
    {N : ℕ} (ν : Fin N → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ W, W ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hγHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hγmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hγcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W a, fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ])
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) :
    (∫ W : Fin N → M, lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * Real.log (Fintype.card n)) +
          (R / 3) * Real.log (Fintype.card n) ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      (Measure.pi ν).real {W : Fin N → M |
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D)} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s)) ∧
    (0 < R → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      (Measure.pi ν).real {W : Fin N → M |
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D)} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s))
proof:
:= by
  have hV := gaussianProxyVariance_nonneg γ hγHerm hγmean hR
  have hc : 0 ≤ R / 3 := div_nonneg hR (by norm_num)
  have hd : 1 ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := n)
  have hmoment (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hdom : (R / 3) * θ < 1) :=
    integrable_exp_mul_lambdaMax_sum_pi_sub_and_integral_le_gaussian_proxy
      ν hν2 hνmean hνHerm hR hbound γ hγHerm hγmean hγcov D hD hθ
      (show θ * R < 3 by nlinarith)
  have hX : Integrable (fun W : Fin N → M => lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i) + D)) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    have hi (i : Fin N) : MemLp (fun W : Fin N → M => matrixRealCoordinates (W i)) 2
        (Measure.pi ν) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (hν2 i).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval ν i)
    have hh (i : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, (W i).IsHermitian :=
      (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hνHerm i)
    simpa only [one_smul, add_comm] using
      integrable_lambdaMax_add_sum_smul_of_memLp_matrixRealCoordinates D hD (fun _ : Fin N => (1 : ℝ))
        (fun i (W : Fin N → M) => W i) hi hh
  refine ⟨integral_le_sqrt_log_add_of_subgamma_mgf hX hd hV hc
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).1)
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    exact measureReal_gt_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf hd hV hc
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).1)
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).2) hs
  · intro hRpos s hs
    exact measureReal_ge_sqrt_add_le_of_subgamma_mgf hd hV hc
      (Or.inr (div_pos hRpos (by norm_num)))
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).1)
      (fun θ hθ hdom => (hmoment θ hθ hdom).2) hs

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy_of_hasLaw
    {N : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (W : Fin N → Ω → M) (ν : Fin N → Measure M)
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ H, H ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hγHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hγmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hγcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ])
    (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D) ∂P) ≤
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * Real.log (Fintype.card n)) +
          (R / 3) * Real.log (Fintype.card n) ∧
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s)) ∧
    (0 < R → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → P.real {ω |
        (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) +
          (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} ≤
            (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (-s))
proof:
:= by
  let (i : Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) :=
    (hW i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hlaw := hind.hasLaw_pi hW
  have hid := hlaw.identDistrib (HasLaw.id (μ := Measure.pi ν))
  have hsumH : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, (∑ i, x i).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (x i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hνHerm i))
    exact hh.mono fun x hx => isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hx i)
  have ho : AEMeasurable (fun x : Fin N → M => lambdaMax ((∑ i, x i) + D)) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian
      D hD (show Measurable (fun x : Fin N → M => ∑ i, x i) from by fun_prop).aemeasurable hsumH
  have hobs := hid.comp_of_aemeasurable (by rw [hlaw.map_eq]; exact ho)
  simp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] at hobs
  have h := integral_lambdaMax_sum_pi_le_and_measure_gt_le_gaussian_proxy
    ν hν2 hνmean hνHerm hR hbound γ hγHerm hγmean hγcov D hD
  refine ⟨hobs.integral_eq.trans_le h.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    have he : P.real {ω | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) + (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} =
        (Measure.pi ν).real {x | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) + (R / 3) * s < lambdaMax ((∑ i, x i) + D)} :=
      congrArg ENNReal.toReal (hobs.measure_mem_eq measurableSet_Ioi)
    exact he.trans_le (h.2.1 s hs)
  · intro hRpos s hs
    have he : P.real {ω | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) + (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, W i ω) + D)} =
        (Measure.pi ν).real {x | (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * gaussianProxyVariance γ R * s) + (R / 3) * s ≤ lambdaMax ((∑ i, x i) + D)} :=
      congrArg ENNReal.toReal (hobs.measure_mem_eq measurableSet_Ici)
    exact he.trans_le (h.2.2 hRpos s hs)

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_sqrt_proxy_expectation
statement:
theorem lpNorm_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_sqrt_proxy_expectation
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    let E
proof:
:= ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i)-Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
    lpNorm (fun x : ι → Ω => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
      ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν)
        ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) ≤
      4*Real.sqrt (12*E*p) +
        8*Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))*p := by
  let E := ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i)-Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
      ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
  let c := Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := integral_nonneg fun _ =>
    matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hXm : Measurable (fun x : ι → Ω => A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) := by
    exact measurable_const.add (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ
      (fun i _ => (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))
  have hXH : ∀ᵐ x : ι → Ω ∂Measure.pi ν, (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)).IsHermitian := by
    have hh : ∀ᵐ x : ι → Ω ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (Z i (x i)).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZH i)
    exact hh.mono fun x hx => hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => hx i)
  have hmem := memLp_specNorm_resolvent (Measure.pi ν) _ hXm.aemeasurable hXH hζ
    ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)
  apply lpNorm_two_mul_le_sqrt_add_of_subgamma_mgf hp
    (hmem.sub (memLp_const _)) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hE) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  · intro s _ _ e _
    exact integrable_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hZH ζ hζ s e
  · intro s hs hdom e he
    have h := integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
      ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hR hZH hZ ζ hζ hs hdom he
    apply h.trans_eq
    congr 1
    dsimp only [E, c]
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_integral_add_of_bilinear_moments
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_integral_add_of_bilinear_moments
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    let B
proof:
:= (2/|ζ.im|^4)*(8*v+64*R*
      ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
      (32*R^2/|ζ.im|^6)*((Real.exp 1-1)*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i)+
        R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
    lpNorm (fun x : ι → Ω => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ))
      ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
          4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p) +
            8*Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))*p := by
  let f (x : ι → Ω) := specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ)
  let m := ∫ x : ι → Ω, f x ∂Measure.pi ν
  let B := (2/|ζ.im|^4)*(8*v+64*R*
    ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
    (32*R^2/|ζ.im|^6)*((Real.exp 1-1)*specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i)+
      R^2*Real.log (Fintype.card n))
  let E := ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i)-Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
      ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
  have hEB : E ≤ B := (integrable_and_integral_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_pi_le
    ν Z hZm hR (abs_pos.mpr hζ) hZH hZ hmean hvariance).2
  have hfl := lpNorm_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_sqrt_proxy_expectation
    ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hR hZH hZ ζ hζ hp
  have hs : Real.sqrt (12*E*p) ≤ Real.sqrt (12*B*p) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEB (by norm_num)) (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
  have hm : 0 ≤ m := integral_nonneg fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _
  have he : f = (fun _ : ι → Ω => m)+(fun x => f x-m) := by ext x; simp
  change lpNorm f ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) ≤ m +
    4*Real.sqrt (12*B*p) + 8*Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))*p
  calc
    _ ≤ lpNorm (fun _ : ι → Ω => m) ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) +
        lpNorm (fun x => f x-m) ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [he]
      apply lpNorm_add_le (memLp_const _)
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2*p)
    _ = m + lpNorm (fun x => f x-m) ((2*p : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) (Measure.pi ν) := by
      rw [lpNorm_const' (by positivity) (by finiteness), probReal_univ, Real.one_rpow,
        mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hm]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have hroot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)
      have hadd := add_le_add hroot (le_refl
        (8*Real.sqrt (6*(16*R^2/|ζ.im|^4+64*R^4/|ζ.im|^6))*p))
      simpa only [add_assoc] using add_le_add (le_refl m) (hfl.trans hadd)

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixExp_add_and_traceExp_add
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integrable_matrixExp_add_and_traceExp_add {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hH : H.IsHermitian)
    (X : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeas : Measurable X) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (X ω)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (H + X ω)) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (H + X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
    NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  have hInt : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (H + X ω)) μ := by
    have hBoundInt : Integrable (fun ω =>
        (1 + ‖matrixExp H‖) * (1 + ‖matrixExp (X ω)‖)) μ :=
      ((integrable_const 1).add hExp.norm).const_mul _
    apply hBoundInt.mono' ?_ ?_
    · have hc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (H + A)) := by
        dsimp [matrixExp]
        fun_prop
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable hMeas
    · filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
      have hh : ∀ k : Fin 2, (![H, X ω] k).IsHermitian := by
        intro k
        fin_cases k
        · exact hH
        · exact hω
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two] using
        norm_matrixExp_sum_le_prod ![H, X ω] hh
  exact ⟨hInt, Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp
    ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hInt)⟩

name: NLAlib.measureReal_le_exp_neg_mul_integral
statement:
private lemma measureReal_le_exp_neg_mul_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (F : Ω → ℝ) (s : Set Ω)
    (a : ℝ) (hF : Integrable F μ) (hpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ F ω)
    (hs : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ω ∈ s → Real.exp a ≤ F ω) :
    μ.real s ≤ Real.exp (-a) * ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : μ s ≤ μ {ω | Real.exp a ≤ F ω} :=
    measure_mono_ae hs
  have hreal : μ.real s ≤ μ.real {ω | Real.exp a ≤ F ω} :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) hsub
  have hmarkov := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hpos hF (Real.exp a)
  have hmul : Real.exp a * μ.real s ≤ ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (Real.exp_pos a).le).trans hmarkov
  calc
    μ.real s = Real.exp (-a) * (Real.exp a * μ.real s) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      simp
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (Real.exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_ge_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp
statement:
theorem NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_ge_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
      Real.exp (-θ * t) * (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
    integrable_re_trace μ _ hExp
  have hnonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ traceExp (θ • Y ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    exact (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).1
  have h := measureReal_le_exp_neg_mul_integral μ (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω))
    {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} (θ * t) hInt hnonneg ?_
  · simpa only [neg_mul] using h
  · filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    intro ht
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hθ.le)).trans
      ((exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).2.1 hθ)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMin_le_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp
statement:
theorem NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMin_le_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ < 0)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | lambdaMin (Y ω) ≤ t} ≤
      Real.exp (-θ * t) * (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
    integrable_re_trace μ _ hExp
  have hnonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ traceExp (θ • Y ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    exact (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).1
  have h := measureReal_le_exp_neg_mul_integral μ (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω))
    {ω | lambdaMin (Y ω) ≤ t} (θ * t) hInt hnonneg ?_
  · simpa only [neg_mul] using h
  · filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
    intro ht
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left ht hθ.le)).trans
      ((exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul _ hω θ).2.2 hθ)

name: NLAlib.integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} {c : NNReal} (hg : HasSubgaussianMGF g c μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, matrixExp ((θ * g ω) • A) ∂μ) = cfc (fun x => mgf g μ (θ * x)) A
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * (θ * g ω))) μ := by
    intro t
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hg.integrable_exp_mul (t * θ)
  rw [(integrable_and_integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_mgf μ A hA (fun ω => θ * g ω) hs).2]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [mgf_const_mul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_matrixExp_smul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem integral_matrixExp_smul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : HasSubgaussianMGF g 1 μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, matrixExp ((θ * g ω) • A) ∂μ) ≤ matrixExp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => mgf g μ (θ * x)) :=
    (continuous_mgf hg.integrable_exp_mul).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  rw [integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_of_hasSubgaussianMGF A hA hg θ, matrixExp_smul_sq_eq_cfc A hA]
  refine cfc_mono (fun x _ => ?_) hcont.continuousOn (by fun_prop)
  calc mgf g μ (θ * x) ≤ Real.exp (1 * (θ * x) ^ 2 / 2) := by simpa using hg.mgf_le (θ * x)
    _ = Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * x ^ 2) := by congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.matrixLog_integral_matrixExp_smul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF
statement:
theorem matrixLog_integral_matrixExp_smul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF [NeZero μ]
    (A : Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : HasSubgaussianMGF g 1 μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp ((θ * g ω) • A) ∂μ) ≤ (θ ^ 2 / 2) • A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => mgf g μ (θ * x)) :=
    (continuous_mgf hg.integrable_exp_mul).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  have hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < mgf g μ (θ * x) := fun x =>
    mgf_pos' (NeZero.ne μ) (hg.integrable_exp_mul (θ * x))
  rw [integral_matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc_of_hasSubgaussianMGF A hA hg θ, smul_sq_eq_cfc A hA, matrixLog,
    ← cfc_comp' Real.log (fun x => mgf g μ (θ * x)) A
      (Real.continuousOn_log.mono (by
        rintro _ ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
        exact (hpos x).ne')) hcont.continuousOn]
  refine cfc_mono (fun x _ => ?_) ?_ (by fun_prop)
  · calc Real.log (mgf g μ (θ * x)) ≤ Real.log (Real.exp (1 * (θ * x) ^ 2 / 2)) :=
          Real.log_le_log (hpos x) (by simpa using hg.mgf_le (θ * x))
      _ = θ ^ 2 / 2 * x ^ 2 := by rw [Real.log_exp]; ring
  · exact Real.continuousOn_log.comp hcont.continuousOn (fun x _ => (hpos x).ne')

name: NLAlib.mul_integral_le_log_integral
statement:
private lemma mul_integral_le_log_integral {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f g : Ω → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Real.exp (θ * f ω) ≤ g ω) :
    θ * (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (∫ ω, g ω ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hscaled : Integrable (fun ω => θ * f ω) μ := hf.const_mul θ
  have he : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (θ * f ω)) μ :=
    hg.mono' (Real.continuous_exp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hscaled.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (hbound.mono fun ω hω => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using hω)
  have hj := convexOn_exp.map_integral_le Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    isClosed_univ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => Set.mem_univ _) hscaled he
  have hle : Real.exp (θ * (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ)) ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ := by
    calc
      Real.exp (θ * (∫ ω, f ω ∂μ)) = Real.exp (∫ ω, θ * f ω ∂μ) := by rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, Real.exp (θ * f ω) ∂μ := hj
      _ ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ := integral_mono_ae he hg hbound
  exact (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le ((Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hle)).mpr hle

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_le_log_integral_traceExp_div
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_le_log_integral_traceExp_div {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hMeas : Measurable Y) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hInt : Integrable Y μ)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ) / θ
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ := by
    exact Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp
      ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hExp)
  obtain ⟨hmax, -⟩ := integrable_lambdaMax_and_lambdaMin μ Y hMeas hHerm hInt
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hθ).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  apply mul_integral_le_log_integral μ _ _ θ hmax ht
  filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
  exact (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul (Y ω) hω θ).2.1 hθ

name: NLAlib.log_integral_traceExp_div_le_integral_lambdaMin
statement:
theorem NLAlib.log_integral_traceExp_div_le_integral_lambdaMin {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (Y : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ < 0)
    (hMeas : Measurable Y) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian)
    (hInt : Integrable Y μ)
    (hExp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ) :
    Real.log (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ) / θ ≤ (∫ ω, lambdaMin (Y ω) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ := by
    exact Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp
      ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin d) ℂ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hExp)
  obtain ⟨-, hmin⟩ := integrable_lambdaMax_and_lambdaMin μ Y hMeas hHerm hInt
  apply (div_le_iff_of_neg hθ).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  apply mul_integral_le_log_integral μ _ _ θ hmin ht
  filter_upwards [hHerm] with ω hω
  exact (exp_mul_lambdaMax_lambdaMin_le_traceExp_smul (Y ω) hω θ).2.2 hθ

name: NLAlib.integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun
statement:
theorem NLAlib.integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
    NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  let f : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ → ℝ := fun A => 1 + ‖matrixExp (θ • A)‖
  have hfcont : Continuous f := by
    dsimp [f, matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hfmap (k : Fin N) : Integrable f (μ.map (X k)) := by
    apply (integrable_map_measure hfcont.aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aemeasurable).2
    exact (integrable_const 1).add (hExp k).norm
  have hprod : Integrable (fun ω => ∏ k, f (X k ω)) μ := by
    have hpi := Integrable.fintype_prod hfmap
    rw [← hIndep.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun k => (hMeas k).aemeasurable)] at hpi
    have hpc : Continuous (fun x : Fin N → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => ∏ i, f (x i)) :=
      continuous_finsetProd _ (fun i _ => hfcont.comp (continuous_apply i))
    exact (integrable_map_measure hpc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ hMeas).aemeasurable).1 hpi
  apply hprod.mono' ?_ ?_
  · apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
      (f := fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A))
      (by dsimp [matrixExp]; fun_prop) |>.comp_measurable
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω hω
    simpa only [Finset.smul_sum] using
      norm_matrixExp_sum_le_prod (fun k => θ • X k ω) (fun k => (hω k).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr rfl))

name: NLAlib.log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le_of_bounded
statement:
theorem log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le_of_bounded
    (D : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hDm : ∀ i, Measurable (D i))
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hD : ∀ i ω, specNorm (D i ω) ≤ 2 * R)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s < 1) :
    Real.log (∫ x : ι → Ω,
      Real.exp (s * resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η)
        ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s * (∫ x : ι → Ω, resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η
        ∂Measure.pi ν) / (1 - (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s)
proof:
:= by
  let α := 2 / η ^ 4
  let β := 8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6
  let W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η
  let Wi : ι → (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun i x =>
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun j => D j (x j)) (Finset.univ.erase i) R η
  have hα : 0 ≤ α := by dsimp [α]; positivity
  have hβ : 0 ≤ β := by dsimp [β]; positivity
  have hWm : Measurable W :=
    (measurable_matrixVarianceProxy Finset.univ α β).comp
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => (hDm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hW0 (x : ι → Ω) : 0 ≤ W x :=
    matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg _ _ hα hβ
  have hWb (x : ι → Ω) : |W x| ≤ (α + β) * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (4 * R ^ 2) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hW0 x)]
    exact matrixVarianceProxy_le_card_mul _ hR hα hβ (fun i => hD i (x i))
  have hlower (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) : Wi i x ≤ W x :=
    matrixVarianceProxy_mono _ (Finset.erase_subset _ _) hα hβ
  have hindep (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) (t : Ω) : Wi i (Function.update x i t) = Wi i x := by
    apply matrixVarianceProxy_congr
    intro j hj
    simp only [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]
  have hsum (x : ι → Ω) : ∑ i, (W x - Wi i x) ^ 2 ≤
      (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * W x :=
    sum_sq_sub_resolventVarianceProxy_erase_le _ hR (fun i => hD i (x i))
  exact log_integral_exp_mul_pi_le_of_bounded_deletions ν W hWm _ (by positivity)
    hWb Wi hlower hindep (by positivity) hsum hs hdom

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le
    (D : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hDm : ∀ i, Measurable (D i))
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hD : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (D i ω) ≤ 2 * R)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s < 1) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω =>
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω =>
      Real.exp (s * resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
    Real.log (∫ x : ι → Ω,
      Real.exp (s * resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η)
        ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      s * (∫ x : ι → Ω, resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η
        ∂Measure.pi ν) / (1 - (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Dc : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i ω =>
    if specNorm (D i ω) ≤ 2 * R then D i ω else 0
  have hDcm (i : ι) : Measurable (Dc i) := by
    apply Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le ?_ measurable_const) (hDm i) measurable_const
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (hDm i).norm
  have hDcb (i : ι) (ω : Ω) : specNorm (Dc i ω) ≤ 2 * R := by
    dsimp only [Dc]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h
    · simpa only [specNorm_zero] using mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hR
  have hDce (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, Dc i ω = D i ω :=
    (hD i).mono fun ω hω => if_pos hω
  have harray : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, (fun i => Dc i (x i)) = fun i => D i (x i) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i =>
      (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hDce i))] with x hx
    exact funext hx
  let W : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => D i (x i)) Finset.univ R η
  let Wc : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Dc i (x i)) Finset.univ R η
  have hWe : Wc =ᵐ[Measure.pi ν] W := harray.mono fun x hx => congrArg
    (fun E => resolventVarianceProxy E Finset.univ R η) hx
  let α := 2 / η ^ 4
  let β := 8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6
  let M := (α + β) * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (4 * R ^ 2)
  have hα : 0 ≤ α := by dsimp [α]; positivity
  have hβ : 0 ≤ β := by dsimp [β]; positivity
  have hWcm : Measurable Wc :=
    (measurable_matrixVarianceProxy Finset.univ α β).comp
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => (hDcm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i))
  have hWcb (x : ι → Ω) : |Wc x| ≤ M := by
    change |matrixVarianceProxy (fun i => Dc i (x i)) Finset.univ α β| ≤ M
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg _ _ hα hβ)]
    exact matrixVarianceProxy_le_card_mul _ hR hα hβ (fun i => hDcb i (x i))
  have hWci : Integrable Wc (Measure.pi ν) := Integrable.of_bound
    hWcm.aestronglyMeasurable M (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simpa using hWcb x)
  have hWcexp : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (s * Wc x)) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) (Real.exp (|s| * M))
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
        Real.exp_mul_le_exp_abs_mul_of_abs_le (s := s) (hWcb x)
  have hE : (fun x => Real.exp (s * Wc x)) =ᵐ[Measure.pi ν]
      fun x => Real.exp (s * W x) := hWe.mono fun x hx => congrArg (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (s * w)) hx
  refine ⟨hWci.congr hWe, hWcexp.congr hE, ?_⟩
  have h := log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le_of_bounded ν Dc hDcm hR hDcb hs hdom
  change Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * Wc x) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
    s * (∫ x, Wc x ∂Measure.pi ν) / _ at h
  rw [integral_congr_ae hE, integral_congr_ae hWe] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_le
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R η : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s < 1) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η)
        ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) ∧
    Integrable (fun q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω) =>
      Real.exp (s * resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η))
        ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) ∧
    Real.log (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      Real.exp (s * resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η)
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) ≤
      s * (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) /
        (1 - (16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6) * s)
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let D : ι → Ω × Ω → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i p => Z i p.1 - Z i p.2
  have hDm (i : ι) : Measurable (D i) :=
    ((hZm i).comp measurable_fst).sub ((hZm i).comp measurable_snd)
  have hDb (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ p ∂(ν i).prod (ν i), specNorm (D i p) ≤ 2 * R := by
    filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_fst (μ := ν i) (ν := ν i)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i),
      (measurePreserving_snd (μ := ν i) (ν := ν i)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i)] with p h1 h2
    exact (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have h := integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_pi_le
    (fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)) D hDm hR hDb hs hdom
  let F : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ := fun q =>
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η
  have hFm : Measurable F :=
    (measurable_matrixVarianceProxy Finset.univ (2 / η ^ 4) (8 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 6)).comp
      (measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i =>
        ((hZm i).comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_fst)).sub
          ((hZm i).comp ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp measurable_snd)))
  have hp := measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow Ω Ω ι ν ν
  have hFexp : Measurable (fun q => Real.exp (s * F q)) := (measurable_const.mul hFm).exp
  have hi : Integrable F ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) :=
    (hp.integrable_comp hFm.aestronglyMeasurable).mp h.1
  have hiexp : Integrable (fun q => Real.exp (s * F q)) ((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) :=
    (hp.integrable_comp hFexp.aestronglyMeasurable).mp h.2.1
  refine ⟨hi, hiexp, ?_⟩
  have he := hp.hasLaw.integral_comp hFm.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hexp := hp.hasLaw.integral_comp hFexp.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at he hexp
  have hlog := h.2.2
  change Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (s * F ((MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Ω Ω ι) x))
      ∂Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)) ≤
    s * (∫ x, F ((MeasurableEquiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow Ω Ω ι) x)
      ∂Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).prod (ν i)) / _ at hlog
  rw [hexp, he] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: NLAlib.lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
statement:
theorem lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lpNorm (fun Z => specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) γ ≤
      (∫ Z, specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) ∂γ) +
        Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p)
proof:
:= by
  exact lpNorm_le_integral_add_sqrt_of_centered_hasSubgaussianMGF
    (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _)
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_of_bilinear_second_moment
      γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hbilinear ζ hζ) hp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_gt_le
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hbilinear : ∀ v w : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ = 1 →
      (∫ Z, ‖star v ⬝ᵥ (Z *ᵥ w)‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤ σ ^ 2)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    γ.real {Z | specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) +
      Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p) +
        (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
      lpNorm (fun H => specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) γ} ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := lpNorm_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_le_integral_add_sqrt
    γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hbilinear ζ hζ hp
  apply (measureReal_mono (μ := γ) (fun Z hZ => ?_)).trans
    (measureReal_lt_abs_specNorm_resolvent_add_gaussian_sub_mean_le
      γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hbilinear ζ hζ ht)
  change (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
    |specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) - ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ|
  change specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) +
    Real.sqrt (4 * (σ ^ 2 * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4) * p) +
      (σ * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 2) * t <
    lpNorm (fun H => specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ)) (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) γ at hZ
  have hs := neg_le_abs (specNorm (resolvent (D + Z) ζ) -
    ∫ H, specNorm (resolvent (D + H) ζ) ∂γ)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilinearSquareMass_of_ae_bound
statement:
theorem integrable_bilinearSquareMass_of_ae_bound
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun ω => bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (measurable_bilinearSquareMass (n := n) (ι := ι) Finset.univ).comp
    (measurable_pi_lambda _ hZm)
  apply Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R ^ 2)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hZ] with ω hω
  change ‖bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ‖ ≤ _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (bilinearSquareMass_nonneg _ _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, specNorm (Z i ω) ^ 2 := by
      simpa using bilinearSquareMass_le_sum_specNorm_sq (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, R ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
      (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hω i)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_le
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun q : Ω × Ω =>
      bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) Finset.univ) (μ.prod μ) ∧
      (∫ q : Ω × Ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) Finset.univ ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
        4 * ∫ ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hBi := integrable_bilinearSquareMass_of_ae_bound μ Z hZm hR hZ
  have hDm (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : Ω × Ω => Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) :=
