    ((hZm i).comp measurable_fst).sub ((hZm i).comp measurable_snd)
  have hDB (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ q : Ω × Ω ∂μ.prod μ, specNorm (Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) ≤ 2 * R := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae (hZ i),
      Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae (hZ i)] with q h₁ h₂
    change ‖Z i q.1‖ ≤ R at h₁
    change ‖Z i q.2‖ ≤ R at h₂
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hDi := integrable_bilinearSquareMass_of_ae_bound (μ.prod μ)
    (fun i q => Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) hDm (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R) hDB
  refine ⟨hDi, ?_⟩
  have h := integral_mono hDi (((hBi.comp_fst μ).const_mul 2).add ((hBi.comp_snd μ).const_mul 2))
    (fun q => bilinearSquareMass_sub_le (fun i => Z i q.1) (fun i => Z i q.2) Finset.univ)
  change (∫ q : Ω × Ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.1 - Z i q.2) Finset.univ ∂μ.prod μ) ≤
    ∫ q : Ω × Ω, 2 * bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.1) Finset.univ +
      2 * bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.2) Finset.univ ∂μ.prod μ at h
  rw [integral_add ((hBi.comp_fst μ).const_mul 2) ((hBi.comp_snd μ).const_mul 2),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at h
  have hf : (∫ q : Ω × Ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.1) Finset.univ ∂μ.prod μ) =
      ∫ ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ ∂μ := by
    simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
      integral_fun_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ) (fun ω => bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ)
  have hs : (∫ q : Ω × Ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i q.2) Finset.univ ∂μ.prod μ) =
      ∫ ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ ∂μ := by
    simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
      integral_fun_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ) (fun ω => bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i ω) Finset.univ)
  rw [hf, hs] at h
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_pi_le
statement:
theorem integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_pi_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) ≤
      8 * v + 64 * R * ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  have hm (i : ι) : Measurable (fun x : ι → Ω => Z i (x i)) :=
    (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hb (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x : ι → Ω ∂Measure.pi ν, specNorm (Z i (x i)) ≤ R :=
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i)
  have hcopy := (integrable_and_integral_bilinearSquareMass_copy_sub_le
    (Measure.pi ν) (fun i x => Z i (x i)) hm hR hb).2
  have hbase := integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le_of_ae_bound ν Z hZm hR hZ hmean hvariance
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) (c : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun Z => lambdaMax (D + c • Z)) γ
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian
    γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance c).integrable
  have hh := h.add (integrable_const (∫ H, lambdaMax (D + c • H) ∂γ))
  simpa only [Pi.add_def, sub_add_cancel] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_gaussian_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_gaussian_nonneg
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    0 ≤ ∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  let tr : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.reCLM.comp (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ).toContinuousLinearMap
  have htr := tr.integrable_comp (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
  have hmeantr := tr.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
  simp only [id_eq] at htr hmeantr
  rw [hmean, map_zero] at hmeantr
  have hmax : Integrable (fun Z => lambdaMax Z) γ := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ 0 Matrix.isHermitian_zero
      hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
  have hle : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, tr Z ≤ (Fintype.card n : ℝ) * lambdaMax Z := by
    filter_upwards [hHerm] with Z hZ
    change Z.trace.re ≤ _
    have he : Z.trace.re = ∑ i, hZ.eigenvalues i := by
      rw [hZ.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]
      simp
    rw [he]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : n, lambdaMax Z := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hZ.eigenvalue_le_lambdaMax i
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hb := integral_mono_ae htr (hmax.const_mul (Fintype.card n : ℝ)) hle
  rw [hmeantr, integral_const_mul] at hb
  exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right hb (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos)

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_gaussian_le
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∫ Z, lambdaMax (a • D + b • Z) ∂γ) ≤
      a * (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) +
        (b - a) * (∫ Z, lambdaMax Z ∂γ)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := integrable_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian γ (a • D)
    (hD.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all a)) hHerm hmean hσ hvariance b
  have hbase := integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
  have hzero : Integrable (fun Z => lambdaMax Z) γ := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ 0 Matrix.isHermitian_zero
      hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
  have hright := (hbase.const_mul a).add (hzero.const_mul (b - a))
  have hmono := integral_mono_ae hleft hright (hHerm.mono fun Z hZ =>
    lambdaMax_smul_add_smul_le D Z hD hZ ha hab)
  have he := integral_add (hbase.const_mul a) (hzero.const_mul (b - a))
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at he hmono
  rw [he, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hmono
  exact hmono

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_gaussian
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_gaussian
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun Z => lambdaMax (D + Z) - ∫ H, lambdaMax (D + H) ∂γ)
      ⟨σ ^ 2, sq_nonneg σ⟩ γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hrep⟩ := exists_hermitian_gaussian_series_representation γ hmean hHerm
  let J := (n × n) ⊕ (n × n)
  let S : (J → ℝ) → M := fun x => ∑ i, x i • A i
  have hSm : Measurable S := by fun_prop
  have hid : IdentDistrib S (id : M → M) (gaussianVector J) γ :=
    ⟨hSm.aemeasurable, aemeasurable_id, by simpa only [Measure.map_id] using hrep.symm⟩
  have hvarianceS : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun x : J → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector J] ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
    intro u hu
    have hq : Measurable (fun Z : M => (quadForm Z u).re) := by
      simp only [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
      fun_prop
    have he := (hid.comp hq).variance_eq
    have he' : Var[fun x : J → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector J] =
        Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, S] using he
    exact he'.trans_le (hvariance u hu)
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance
    D hD A hA hσ hvarianceS
  have ho : AEMeasurable (fun Z : M => lambdaMax (D + Z)) ((gaussianVector J).map S) := by
    rw [← hrep]
    exact aemeasurable_lambdaMax_add_of_ae_isHermitian D hD aemeasurable_id hHerm
  have hobs := hid.comp_of_aemeasurable ho
  simp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, S] at hobs
  have hmeanobs : (∫ x : J → ℝ, lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector J) =
      ∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ := hobs.integral_eq
  have hcenter := hobs.sub_const (∫ H, lambdaMax (D + H) ∂γ)
  have hsg' : HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : J → ℝ => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) -
        ∫ H, lambdaMax (D + H) ∂γ) ⟨σ ^ 2, sq_nonneg σ⟩ (gaussianVector J) := by
    rw [← hmeanobs]
    exact hsg
  exact hsg'.congr_identDistrib hcenter

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    Integrable (fun Z => lambdaMax (D + Z)) γ
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance).integrable
  have hh := h.add (integrable_const (∫ H, lambdaMax (D + H) ∂γ))
  simpa only [Pi.add_def, sub_add_cancel] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_lambdaMax_add_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_lambdaMax_add_gaussian_le
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ Z, Real.exp (t * lambdaMax (D + Z)) ∂γ) ≤
      Real.exp (t * (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + Z) ∂γ) + t ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : M → ℝ := fun Z => lambdaMax (D + Z)
  let m : ℝ := ∫ Z, f Z ∂γ
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_gaussian γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance
  have he : mgf f γ t = mgf (fun Z => f Z - m) γ t * Real.exp (t * m) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
      (mgf_add_const (X := fun Z => f Z - m) (μ := γ) (t := t) m)
  change mgf f γ t ≤ Real.exp (t * m + t ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (t * m) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsg.mgf_le t) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) (c : ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun Z => lambdaMax (D + c • Z) - ∫ H, lambdaMax (D + c • H) ∂γ)
      ⟨c ^ 2 * σ ^ 2, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg c) (sq_nonneg σ)⟩ γ
proof:
:= by
  let L : M →L[ℝ] M := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _
  have hL (Z : M) : L Z = c • Z := rfl
  have hhermL : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ.map L, Z.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · filter_upwards [hHerm] with Z hZ
      simpa only [hL] using hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c)
    · exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun Z : M => Zᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hmeanL : (∫ Z, Z ∂γ.map L) = 0 := by
    have hm := integral_map (μ := γ) (φ := L) (f := fun Z : M => Z)
      L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable aestronglyMeasurable_id
    have hli := L.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
    simp only [id_eq] at hli
    rw [hm, hli, hmean, map_zero]
  have hvarL : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ.map L] ≤ (|c| * σ) ^ 2 := by
    intro u hu
    have hq : (fun Z : M => (quadForm (L Z) u).re) =
        fun Z => c * (quadForm Z u).re := by
      ext Z
      simp only [hL, quadForm, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, Complex.real_smul,
        Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    have hqm : Measurable (fun Z : M => (quadForm Z u).re) := by
      simp only [quadForm, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
      fun_prop
    rw [variance_map hqm.aemeasurable L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable]
    change Var[fun Z => (quadForm (L Z) u).re; γ] ≤ _
    rw [hq, variance_const_mul]
    simpa only [mul_pow, sq_abs] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hvariance u hu) (sq_nonneg c)
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_gaussian (γ.map L) D hD hhermL hmeanL
    (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hσ) hvarL
  have hi := integrable_lambdaMax_add_gaussian (γ.map L) D hD hhermL hmeanL
    (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hσ) hvarL
  have hmi := integral_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hi.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hpull := HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hsg
  rw [hmi] at hpull
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, hL, mul_pow, sq_abs] using hpull

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian_le
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ Z, Real.exp (lambdaMax (D + c • Z)) ∂γ) ≤
      Real.exp ((∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + c • Z) ∂γ) + c ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : M → ℝ := fun Z => lambdaMax (D + c • Z)
  let m : ℝ := ∫ Z, f Z ∂γ
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance c
  have he : mgf f γ 1 = mgf (fun Z => f Z - m) γ 1 * Real.exp m := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, one_mul] using
      (mgf_add_const (X := fun Z => f Z - m) (μ := γ) (t := 1) m)
  have hgoal : mgf f γ 1 ≤ Real.exp (m + c ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [he]
    have hh := hsg.mgf_le 1
    simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at hh
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp (c ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp m :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  simpa only [mgf, one_mul] using hgoal

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian_le_exp_mean
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian_le_exp_mean
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (D : M) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun Z => (quadForm Z u).re; γ] ≤ σ ^ 2) (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ Z, traceExp (D + c • Z) ∂γ) ≤
      (Fintype.card n : ℝ) *
        Real.exp ((∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + c • Z) ∂γ) + c ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance c
  have hexp := (hsg.integrable_exp_mul 1).mul_const
    (Real.exp (∫ Z, lambdaMax (D + c • Z) ∂γ))
  have hi : Integrable (fun Z => Real.exp (lambdaMax (D + c • Z))) γ := by
    simpa only [one_mul, ← Real.exp_add, sub_add_cancel] using hexp
  have ht := integrable_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian γ D hD hHerm c
  have hmono := integral_mono_ae ht (hi.const_mul (Fintype.card n : ℝ))
    (hHerm.mono fun Z hZ => traceExp_le_card_mul_exp_lambdaMax _
      (hD.add (hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c))))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hmono
  exact hmono.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (integral_exp_lambdaMax_add_smul_gaussian_le γ D hD hHerm hmean hσ hvariance c)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_bilinear_moments
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_bilinear_moments
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    let B
proof:
:= (2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4) * (8 * v + 64 * R *
      ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
      (32 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 6) * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) *
        specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) + R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n))
    (Measure.pi ν).real {x | Real.sqrt (24 * B * t) +
      Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * t <
        |specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
          ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-t) := by
  let B := (2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4) * (8 * v + 64 * R *
    ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) +
    (32 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 6) * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) *
      specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂ν i) + R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n))
  let E := ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
      ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
  have hEB : E ≤ B := (integrable_and_integral_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_pi_le
    ν Z hZm hR (abs_pos.mpr hζ) hZH hZ hmean hvariance).2
  have hs : Real.sqrt (24 * E * t) ≤ Real.sqrt (24 * B * t) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEB (by norm_num)) ht)
  have h := measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
    ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hR hZH hZ ζ hζ ht
  let c := Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6))
  let f (x : ι → Ω) := |specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
    ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν|
  have hset : {x : ι → Ω | Real.sqrt (24 * B * t) + c * t < f x} ⊆
      {x | Real.sqrt (24 * E * t) + c * t < f x} :=
    fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_lt (add_le_add hs (le_refl (c * t))) hx
  exact (measureReal_mono (μ := Measure.pi ν) hset).trans h

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_pos
statement:
private theorem integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_pos
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s < 1)
    {e : ℝ} (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, Real.exp (s * (e *
      (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
        ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν)))
      ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
    Real.exp ((6 * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) * s ^ 2 /
      (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s))
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let P := μ.prod μ
  let η := |ζ.im|
  let a := 16 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / η ^ 6
  let b := 2 * R / η ^ 2
  let M := η⁻¹
  let X : (ι → Ω) → Matrix n n ℂ := fun x => A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)
  let f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ)
  let fc : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => min M (f x)
  let W : ((ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω)) → ℝ := fun q =>
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R η
  have hη : 0 < η := abs_pos.mpr hζ
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := inv_nonneg.mpr hη.le
  have hXm : Measurable X := by
    dsimp [X]
    fun_prop
  have hfm : Measurable f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_def] using ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp hXm).norm
  have hfcm : Measurable fc := measurable_const.min hfm
  have hfcb (x : ι → Ω) : |fc x| ≤ M := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_min hM (specNorm_nonneg _))]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, (Z i (x i)).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (Z i (x i)) ≤ R := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ((hZH i).and (hZB i))
  have hXH (x : ι → Ω) (hx : ∀ i, (Z i (x i)).IsHermitian) : (X x).IsHermitian :=
    hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hx i))
  have hfe : fc =ᵐ[μ] f := hgood.mono fun x hx =>
    min_eq_right ((hXH x (fun i => (hx i).1)).specNorm_resolvent_le hζ)
  have hreplace (x : ι → Ω) (i : ι) (t : Ω) :
      X (Function.update x i t) = X x - (Z i (x i) - Z i t) := by
    have hfun : (fun j => Z j (Function.update x i t j)) =
        Function.update (fun j => Z j (x j)) i (Z i t) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [hj]
    have hbase := Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i) (fun j => Z j (x j)) (Z i (x i))
    simp only [Function.update_eq_self] at hbase
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [hfun, Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), hbase]
    abel
  have hjoint : ∀ᵐ q ∂P,
      (∀ i, (Z i (q.1 i)).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (Z i (q.1 i)) ≤ R) ∧
      (∀ i, (Z i (q.2 i)).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (Z i (q.2 i)) ≤ R) := by
    exact ((measurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hgood).and
      ((measurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hgood)
  have hfirst : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, fc q.1 = f q.1 :=
    (measurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hfe
  have hupdated (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ q ∂P,
      fc (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)) = f (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i)) := by
    have hp := (measurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).comp
      (measurePreserving_prod_pi_update_swap ν i)
    exact hp.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hfe
  have hgrad : ∀ᵐ q ∂P,
      (∑ i, max (fc q.1 - fc (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))) 0 ^ 2) ≤ W q := by
    filter_upwards [hjoint, hfirst, ae_all_iff.mpr hupdated] with q hq hf hu
    simp_rw [hf, hu]
    have h := sum_posPart_sq_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le_resolventVarianceProxy
      (X q.1) (hXH q.1 (fun i => (hq.1 i).1))
      (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i))
      (fun i => (hq.1 i).1.sub (hq.2 i).1) hR.le
      (fun i => (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [(hq.1 i).2, (hq.2 i).2])) ζ hζ
    simpa only [f, hreplace] using h
  have hdiff (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ q ∂P,
      |fc q.1 - fc (Function.update q.1 i (q.2 i))| ≤ b := by
    filter_upwards [hjoint, hfirst, hupdated i] with q hq hf hu
    rw [hf, hu]
    have hD := (hq.1 i).1.sub (hq.2 i).1
    have hH := hXH q.1 (fun j => (hq.1 j).1)
    have h := abs_specNorm_resolvent_sub_le (X q.1)
      (X q.1 - (Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i))) hH (hH.sub hD) ζ hζ
    have hsub : X q.1 - (X q.1 - (Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i))) =
        Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i) := by abel
    rw [hsub] at h
    have hbD : specNorm (Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) ≤ 2 * R :=
      (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [(hq.1 i).2, (hq.2 i).2])
    have hl := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbD (sq_nonneg _))
    simpa only [f, hreplace, b, η, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hl
  have hba : b ^ 2 ≤ a := by
    have hb2 : b ^ 2 = 4 * R ^ 2 / η ^ 4 := by dsimp [b]; ring
    rw [hb2]
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg R] : 4 * R ^ 2 ≤ 16 * R ^ 2)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ η ^ 4)).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  have hθdom : a * (2 * a)⁻¹ < 1 := by
    rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hp := integrable_and_log_integral_exp_resolventVarianceProxy_copy_le
    ν Z hZm hR.le hZB (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * a)) hθdom
  change Integrable W P ∧ Integrable (fun q => Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q)) P ∧
    Real.log (∫ q, Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q) ∂P) ≤
      (2 * a)⁻¹ * (∫ q, W q ∂P) / (1 - a * (2 * a)⁻¹) at hp
  have hfunexp : (fun q => Real.exp ((2 * a)⁻¹ * W q)) =
      (fun q => Real.exp (W q / (2 * a))) := by ext q; congr 1; ring
  rw [hfunexp] at hp
  have hlog : Real.log (∫ q, Real.exp (W q / (2 * a)) ∂P) ≤ (∫ q, W q ∂P) / a := by
    apply hp.2.2.trans_eq
    field_simp [ha.ne']
    ring
  have h := integral_exp_sign_mul_sub_integral_pi_le_of_random_proxy ν fc hfcm M hM hfcb
    W hp.1 hgrad ha hb hba hdiff hp.2.1 hlog hs hdom he
  have hmean : (∫ x, fc x ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ := integral_congr_ae hfe
  change (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * (fc x - ∫ y, fc y ∂μ))) ∂μ) ≤ _ at h
  rw [hmean] at h
  have heq : (fun x => Real.exp (s * (e * (fc x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)))) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun x => Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ))) :=
    hfe.mono fun x hx => congrArg (fun z => Real.exp (s * (e * (z - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)))) hx
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
statement:
theorem integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s < 1)
    {e : ℝ} (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, Real.exp (s * (e *
      (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
        ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν)))
      ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
    Real.exp ((6 * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
      resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
        ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) * s ^ 2 /
      (1 - Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR.eq_or_lt with hzero | hpos
  · subst R
    let μ := Measure.pi ν
    let f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ)
    let c := specNorm (resolvent A₀ ζ)
    have hZ0 (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, Z i ω = 0 := (hZB i).mono fun ω hω => by
      apply norm_eq_zero.mp
      exact le_antisymm (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω) (norm_nonneg _)
    have harray : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, Z i (x i) = 0 := ae_all_iff.mpr fun i =>
      (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ0 i)
    have hfe : f =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => c := harray.mono fun x hx => by simp [f, c, hx]
    have hmean : (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = c := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae hfe, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    have hcenter : (fun x => Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)))) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => 1 :=
      hfe.mono fun x hx => by simp only [hmean, hx, sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    have hleft : (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ))) ∂μ) = 1 := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae hcenter, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]
    change (∫ x, Real.exp (s * (e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ))) ∂μ) ≤ _
    rw [hleft]
    simp only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_pow (by decide : 4 ≠ 0), mul_zero, zero_mul,
      zero_div, add_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, sub_zero, div_one]
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ 0 |ζ.im|
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν)) :=
      integral_nonneg fun _ => matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    exact Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6) hW0) (sq_nonneg s))
  · exact integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le_of_pos
      ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hpos hZH hZB ζ hζ hs hdom he

name: NLAlib.integrable_traceExp_add_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_traceExp_add_gaussian
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ, H.IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (fun H => traceExp (A + H)) μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have := hn
    have hzero (B : Matrix n n ℂ) : traceExp B = 0 := by simp [traceExp, Matrix.trace]
    simpa only [hzero] using (integrable_const (0 : ℝ) : Integrable (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) μ)
  | inr hn =>
    have := hn
    refine ((IsGaussian.integrable_exp_mul_norm μ 1).const_mul (traceExp A)).mono'
      (((contDiff_traceExp (k := 1)).continuous.comp
        (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ?_
    filter_upwards [hH] with H hH
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hA.add hH))]
    have hb := traceExp_le_exp_mul_traceExp_of_norm_sub_le (A + H) A (hA.add hH) hA
      (δ := ‖H‖) (by simp)
    simpa only [one_mul, mul_comm, mul_one] using hb

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_of_map_neg_eq
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_of_map_neg_eq
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ, H.IsHermitian)
    (hneg : μ.map (fun H : Matrix n n ℂ => -H) = μ)
    (hplus : Integrable (fun H => traceExp (A + H)) μ)
    (hsecond : Integrable
      (fun H => iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) 0) μ) :
    traceExp A + (1 / 2) *
      (∫ H, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) 0 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ H, traceExp (A + H) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : Integrable (fun H => traceExp (A + H))
      (μ.map (fun H : Matrix n n ℂ => -H)) := by
    rw [hneg]
    exact hplus
  have hminus : Integrable (fun H => traceExp (A - H)) μ := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_eq_add_neg] using hmap.comp_measurable (by fun_prop)
  have hbound := integral_mono_ae
    ((integrable_const (2 * traceExp A)).add hsecond)
    (hplus.add hminus)
    (hH.mono fun H hherm => two_mul_traceExp_add_iteratedDeriv_two_le_add_traceExp A H hA hherm)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hbound
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) hsecond, integral_add hplus hminus,
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hbound
  have hsym : (∫ H, traceExp (A - H) ∂μ) = ∫ H, traceExp (A + H) ∂μ := by
    have hi := integral_map (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun H : Matrix n n ℂ => -H) μ)
      hmap.aestronglyMeasurable
    simpa only [hneg, sub_eq_add_neg] using hi.symm
  rw [hsym] at hbound
  linarith

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ, H.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ H, H ∂μ = 0) :
    traceExp A + (1 / 2) *
      (∫ H, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) 0 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ H, traceExp (A + H) ∂μ
proof:
:=
  traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_of_map_neg_eq μ A hA hH
    (IsGaussian.map_neg_eq_self_of_integral_eq_zero μ hmean)
    (integrable_traceExp_add_gaussian μ A hA hH)
    (integrable_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul A
      (memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_gaussian μ))

name: NLAlib.traceExp_add_sq_div_two_mul_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
statement:
theorem traceExp_add_sq_div_two_mul_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ, H.IsHermitian) (hmean : ∫ H, H ∂μ = 0) (c : ℝ) :
    traceExp A + (c ^ 2 / 2) *
      (∫ H, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • H)) 0 ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ H, traceExp (A + c • H) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _
  have hL (H : Matrix n n ℂ) : L H = c • H := rfl
  have hherm : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ.map L, H.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · filter_upwards [hH] with H hH
      simpa only [hL] using hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c)
    · exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun H : Matrix n n ℂ => Hᴴ))
        continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hmeanL : (∫ H, H ∂μ.map L) = 0 := by
    change (∫ H, id H ∂μ.map L) = 0
    rw [integral_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable aestronglyMeasurable_id]
    have hi := L.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := μ))
    simpa only [id_eq, hmean, map_zero] using hi
  have h := traceExp_add_half_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
    (μ.map L) A hA hherm hmeanL
  have hplus := integrable_traceExp_add_gaussian (μ.map L) A hA hherm
  have hsecond := integrable_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul A
    (memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_gaussian (μ.map L))
  rw [integral_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hplus.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hsecond.aestronglyMeasurable] at h
  simp only [hL] at h
  simp_rw [iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_smul_zero] at h
  rw [integral_const_mul] at h
  convert! h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ, H.IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun H => traceExp (A + c • H)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] Matrix n n ℂ := c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _
  have hherm : ∀ᵐ H ∂μ.map L, H.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · filter_upwards [hH] with H hH
      exact hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c)
    · exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun H : Matrix n n ℂ => Hᴴ))
        continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hi := integrable_traceExp_add_gaussian (μ.map L) A hA hherm
  exact hi.comp_measurable L.continuous.measurable

statement:

    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) (g : ι → ℝ) :

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussian_rectangular_blocks_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussian_rectangular_blocks_le
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hlog : Real.log (2 * ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n)) ≤ t ^ 2) :
    ((∫ g, specNorm (∑ i, g i • B i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      10 * t * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B))) ∧
    ((∫ g, specNorm (∑ i, g i • B i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      10 * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B) +
        t * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)))
proof:
:= by
  let D := realCoefficientDilation B
  let σ := Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance D))
  let κ := coefficientBlockKappa D
  let R := specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)
  let V := specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)
  let L := Real.sqrt (Real.log (Fintype.card (m ⊕ n)))
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := add_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _)
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := specNorm_nonneg _
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (by norm_num) ht
  have hσ : σ ≤ R := sqrt_specNorm_variance_realCoefficientDilation_le B
  have hb := (coefficientBlock_variance_covariance_bounds D
    (isHermitian_realCoefficientDilation B)).2.2.2
  have hκσ : κ ≤ σ := hb.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hκV : κ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * V := by
    exact (hb.trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans_eq
      (sqrt_specNorm_covariance_realCoefficientDilation B)
  have hL : L ≤ t := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨ht0, ?_⟩
    have hd : 0 < (Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n := by positivity
    have hsmall := Real.log_le_log hd (show
      (Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n ≤
        2 * ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n) by linarith)
    simpa only [Fintype.card_sum, Nat.cast_add] using hsmall.trans hlog
  have hG : (∫ g, specNorm (∑ i, g i • B i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * σ + 6 * κ * L := by
    have h := integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose D
      (isHermitian_realCoefficientDilation B)
    simpa only [D, specNorm_sum_smul_realCoefficientDilation] using h
  constructor
  · have hk : κ * L ≤ R * t :=
      mul_le_mul (hκσ.trans hσ) hL (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hR0
    have htr : 0 ≤ (t - 1) * R := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht) hR0
    change (∫ g, specNorm (∑ i, g i • B i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ 10 * t * R
    nlinarith only [hG, hσ, hk, htr, hR0]
  · have hk : κ * L ≤ (Real.sqrt 2 * V) * t :=
      mul_le_mul hκV hL (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have hs : 6 * Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 10 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)]
    have hc : 0 ≤ (10 - 6 * Real.sqrt 2) * (V * t) :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs) (mul_nonneg hV0 ht0)
    change (∫ g, specNorm (∑ i, g i • B i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ 10 * (R + t * V)
    nlinarith only [hG, hσ, hk, hc, hR0]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_subgaussian_rectangular_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_subgaussian_rectangular_le
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hlog : Real.log (2 * ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n)) ≤ t ^ 2) :
    (∫ y, specNorm (∑ i, y i • B i) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (100 * K * t) * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := integral_norm_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq ν K hK hcenter hpsi B
  have hg := (integral_specNorm_gaussian_rectangular_blocks_le B ht hlog).1
  simp only [← specNorm_eq_norm] at hc
  apply hc.trans
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (show 0 ≤ 10 * K by positivity)
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_subgaussian_rectangular_strong_le
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_subgaussian_rectangular_strong_le
    (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (hcenter : ∀ i, ∫ x, x ∂ν i = 0)
    (hpsi : ∀ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((x / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν i ≤ 2)
    (B : ι → Matrix m n ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hlog : Real.log (2 * ((Fintype.card m : ℝ) + Fintype.card n)) ≤ t ^ 2) :
    (∫ y, specNorm (∑ i, y i • B i) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (100 * K) * (specNorm (coefficientRow B) + specNorm (coefficientColumn B)) +
        (100 * K * t) * specNorm (coefficientEntryRows B)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := integral_norm_sum_smul_pi_le_gaussian_of_lintegral_exp_sq ν K hK hcenter hpsi B
  have hg := (integral_specNorm_gaussian_rectangular_blocks_le B ht hlog).2
  simp only [← specNorm_eq_norm] at hc
  apply hc.trans
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (show 0 ≤ 10 * K by positivity)
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.variance_additivity
statement:
theorem NLAlib.variance_additivity {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (_hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ k, X k ω) - ∫ ω', ∑ k, X k ω' ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, (X k ω - ∫ ω', X k ω' ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set c : Fin N → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun k => ∫ ω', X k ω' ∂μ with hc
  set Y : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun k ω => X k ω - c k with hY
  have hXint : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k => (hL2 k).integrable one_le_two
  have hsum : ∀ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) - ∫ ω', ∑ k, X k ω' ∂μ = ∑ k, Y k ω := by
    intro ω
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXint k), ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hYMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (Y k) := fun k => (hMeas k).sub_const _
  have hYIndep : iIndepFun Y μ :=
    hIndep.comp (fun k (x : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) => x - c k)
      (fun k => measurable_id.sub_const _)
  have hYL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => id (Y k ω)) 2 μ := fun k =>
    (hL2 k).sub (memLp_const (c k))
  have hYMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, id (Y k ω) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    intro k
    simp only [id, hY]
    rw [integral_sub (hXint k) (integrable_const _), integral_const]
    simp [hc]
  have key := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ Y id id measurable_id measurable_id
    hYMeas hYIndep hYL2 hYL2 hYMean
  simp only [id] at key
  simp_rw [hsum, sq]
  exact key

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_fixed_chernoff
statement:
private theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_fixed_chernoff
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d] (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (X k ω) ≤ L) (t : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | (Real.exp 1 - 1) * lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) +
      L * (Real.log d + t) ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤ Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  let θ : ℝ := L⁻¹
  let g : ℝ := (Real.exp 1 - 1) / L
  let B := ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ
  have hθ : 0 < θ := inv_pos.mpr hL
  have hg : 0 < g := div_pos (by linarith [Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr zero_lt_one]) hL
  have hgdef : chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ = g := by
    simp only [chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne', θ, inv_mul_cancel₀ hL.ne']
    rfl
  have hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian :=
    fun k => (hPSD k).mono fun _ h => h.isHermitian
  have hSpec : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (X k ω) ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hPSD k, hBound k] with ω hp hb
    exact ⟨lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef hp, by rwa [hp.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm]⟩
  have hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := by
    intro k
    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
      NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
    have hc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
      dsimp [matrixExp]
      fun_prop
    refine Integrable.of_bound (hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
    filter_upwards [hHerm k, hSpec k] with ω hH hB
    rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc (X k ω) hH]
    apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hθ.le
    have hf : (spectrum ℝ (X k ω)).Finite := by
      rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
      exact Set.finite_range _
    exact (le_csSup hf.bddAbove hx).trans hB.2
  have hBH : B.IsHermitian := by
    apply isSelfAdjoint_sum
    intro k _
    exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
      (integral_nonneg_of_ae ((hPSD k).mono fun _ h => h.nonneg))).isHermitian
  have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian := by
    apply isSelfAdjoint_sum
    intro k _
    unfold matrixLog
    exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc
  have hcum : cumulantSum μ X θ ≤ g • B := by
    have hk := fun k => (chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L hL.le
      (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hSpec k) θ).2
    unfold cumulantSum
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    dsimp only [B]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
    intro k _
    simpa only [hgdef] using (Matrix.le_iff.mp (hk k))
  have htrace : traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * Real.exp (g * lambdaMax B) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ traceExp (g • B) := traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcumH
        (hBH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))) hcum
      _ ≤ _ := by
        convert traceExp_le_card_mul_exp_lambdaMax (g • B)
          (hBH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))) using 1
        simp only [Fintype.card_fin, lambdaMax_smul_of_pos B hg]
  have hm := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum μ X
    hθ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExp
    ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * lambdaMax B + L * (Real.log d + t))
  refine hm.trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htrace (Real.exp_pos _).le).trans_eq ?_)
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (NeZero.pos d)
  have hexp : -θ * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * lambdaMax B + L * (Real.log d + t)) +
      g * lambdaMax B = -(Real.log d + t) := by
    dsimp only [θ, g]
    field_simp [hL.ne']
    ring
  calc
    _ = (d : ℝ) * Real.exp
        (-θ * ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * lambdaMax B + L * (Real.log d + t)) +
          g * lambdaMax B) := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    _ = (d : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(Real.log d + t)) := by rw [hexp]
    _ = Real.exp (-t) := by
      rw [neg_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hd]
      field_simp [hd.ne']

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff
    {Ω ι n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [Nonempty n] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hMeas : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i)) (hIndep : iIndepFun Z μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    MemLp (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ∧
      lpNorm (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) (q : ℝ≥0∞) μ ≤
        (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) +
          R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hSqMeas : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => A ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [pow_two, id_eq] using
      (measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_id : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => A * A))
  have hMassMeas : Measurable (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Finset.sum_apply, Function.comp_apply] using
      (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hSqMeas.comp (hMeas i)).norm
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hR with hR0 | hRp
  · subst R
    have hZ : ∀ i, Z i =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [hBound i] with ω hω
      apply norm_eq_zero.mp
      apply le_antisymm _ (norm_nonneg _)
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω
    have hMass : (fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hZ] with ω hω
      simp [hω, specNorm_zero]
    have hMean : (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
      exact (hZ i).mono fun ω hω => by simp [hω]
    refine ⟨(memLp_congr_ae hMass).mpr MemLp.zero, ?_⟩
    rw [← toReal_eLpNorm hMassMeas.aestronglyMeasurable,
      eLpNorm_congr_ae hMass]
    simp [hMean, specNorm_zero]
  have hSqPSD : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z i ω ^ 2).PosSemidef := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hHerm i] with ω hω
    simpa only [hω.eq, pow_two] using Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)
  have hSqBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z i ω ^ 2) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with ω hω hb
    have hs : specNorm (Z i ω) ^ 2 = specNorm (Z i ω ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [hω.eq, pow_two] using specNorm_sq_eq_specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z i ω)
    rw [← hs]
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hR).mpr hb
  let : NeZero (Fintype.card n) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin n
  let f := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  let E : Matrix n n ℂ ≃ₗ[ℝ] Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
    Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ e e
  let Y : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (Fintype.card n)) (Fin (Fintype.card n)) ℂ :=
    fun k ω => E (Z (f k) ω ^ 2)
  have hEMeas : Measurable E := E.toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.measurable
  have hYMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (Y k) :=
    fun k => hEMeas.comp (hSqMeas.comp (hMeas (f k)))
  have hYIndep : iIndepFun Y μ :=
    (iIndepFun.precomp f.injective hIndep).comp
      (fun _ A => E (A ^ 2)) (fun _ => hEMeas.comp hSqMeas)
  have hYPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y k ω).PosSemidef :=
    fun k => (hSqPSD (f k)).mono fun _ h => h.submatrix e.symm
  have hYBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Y k ω) ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hSqBound (f k)] with ω hb
    change specNorm ((Z (f k) ω ^ 2).reindex e e) ≤ R ^ 2
    rwa [specNorm_reindex]
  have hYsum (ω : Ω) : (∑ k, Y k ω) = E (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) := by
    change (∑ k, E (Z (f k) ω ^ 2)) = _
    rw [← map_sum]
    exact congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => Z i ω ^ 2))
  have hYmean : (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) = E (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ k, E (∫ ω, Z (f k) ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact integral_reindex μ e (fun ω => Z (f k) ω ^ 2)
      _ = E (∑ k, ∫ ω, Z (f k) ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := (map_sum E _ _).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg E (f.sum_comp (fun i => ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ))
  have hSumPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hSqPSD] with ω hω
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun i _ => hω i)
  have hMeanPSD : (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
    intro i _
    rw [← Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef]
    exact integral_nonneg_of_ae ((hSqPSD i).mono fun _ h => h.nonneg)
  have hLeft : (fun ω => lambdaMax (∑ k, Y k ω)) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hSumPSD] with ω hω
    rw [hYsum]
    change lambdaMax ((∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).reindex e e) = _
    have hp : ((∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2).reindex e e).PosSemidef := hω.submatrix e.symm
    rw [hp.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm, specNorm_reindex]
  have hRight : lambdaMax (∑ k, ∫ ω, Y k ω ∂μ) =
      specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    rw [hYmean]
    change lambdaMax ((∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).reindex e e) = _
    have hp : ((∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ).reindex e e).PosSemidef :=
      hMeanPSD.submatrix e.symm
    rw [hp.lambdaMax_eq_specNorm, specNorm_reindex]
  let a := (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) +
    R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
    apply add_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg (by linarith [Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr zero_lt_one]) (specNorm_nonneg _)
    · exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.log_nonneg (by
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Fintype.card_pos : 0 < Fintype.card n))))
  have hTail : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      μ.real {ω | a + R ^ 2 * t < specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)} ≤ Real.exp (-t) := by
    intro t _ht
    have hc := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_fixed_chernoff μ Y (sq_pos_of_pos hRp)
      hYMeas hYIndep hYPSD hYBound t
    rw [hRight] at hc
    have he : μ.real {ω | a + R ^ 2 * t ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)} =
        μ.real {ω | (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) +
          R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + t) ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, Y k ω)} := by
      apply measureReal_congr
      filter_upwards [hLeft] with ω hω
      apply propext
      change (a + R ^ 2 * t ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)) ↔
        ((Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ^ 2 ∂μ) +
          R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + t) ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, Y k ω))
      rw [hω]
      dsimp only [a]
      ring_nf
    calc
      _ ≤ μ.real {ω | a + R ^ 2 * t ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)} := by
        refine measureReal_mono ?_ (measure_ne_top μ _)
        intro ω hω
        change a + R ^ 2 * t < specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2) at hω
        change a + R ^ 2 * t ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i ω ^ 2)
        exact hω.le
      _ ≤ _ := he.symm ▸ hc
  obtain ⟨hm, hn⟩ := memLp_and_lpNorm_le_of_shifted_exponential_tail μ _
    hMassMeas.aemeasurable (fun _ => specNorm_nonneg _) ha (sq_pos_of_pos hRp) hTail q hq
  refine ⟨hm, hn.trans_eq ?_⟩
  dsimp only [a]
  ring

name: NLAlib.variance_re_quadForm_gaussianSeries
statement:
theorem variance_re_quadForm_gaussianSeries
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (u : n → ℂ) :
    Var[fun x : ι → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector ι] =
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : (fun x : ι → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re) =
      ∑ i, (fun x : ι → ℝ => (quadForm (A i) u).re * x i) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, quadForm, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, Complex.real_smul,
      Complex.re_sum, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact mul_comm _ _
  rw [he, variance_sum_pi]
  · change (∑ i, Var[fun x : ℝ => (quadForm (A i) u).re * id x; gaussianReal 0 1]) = _
    simp only [variance_const_mul, variance_id_gaussianReal, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one]
  · intro i
    exact (IsGaussian.memLp_two_id (μ := gaussianReal 0 1)).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.abs_lambdaMax_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem abs_lambdaMax_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy [Nonempty n]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    |lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) - lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, y i • A i)| ≤
      σ * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : (D + ∑ i, x i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    hD.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hy : (D + ∑ i, y i • A i).IsHermitian :=
    hD.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun i _ => (hA i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _))
  have hd : (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) - (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) =
      ∑ i, (x i - y i) • A i := by
    simp only [sub_smul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    abel
  exact (abs_lambdaMax_sub_le_specNorm_sub _ _ hx hy).trans
    (hd ▸ specNorm_sum_smul_le_of_quadratic_energy A hA hσ henergy (fun i => x i - y i))

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy [Nonempty n]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : ι → ℝ => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) -
        ∫ y, lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι)
      ⟨σ ^ 2, sq_nonneg σ⟩ (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [one_mul] using hasSubgaussianMGF_of_logSobolev
    hasEuclideanLogSobolev_gaussianVector
    (fun x : ι → ℝ => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i)) σ hσ
    (abs_lambdaMax_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy D hD A hA hσ henergy)

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_variance [Nonempty n]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      Var[fun x : ι → ℝ => (quadForm (∑ i, x i • A i) u).re; gaussianVector ι] ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun x : ι → ℝ => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) -
        ∫ y, lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, y i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι)
      ⟨σ ^ 2, sq_nonneg σ⟩ (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy D hD A hA hσ
  simpa only [variance_re_quadForm_gaussianSeries] using hvariance

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy [Nonempty n]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i)) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  exact integrable_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector _ σ hσ
    (abs_lambdaMax_affineSeries_sub_le_of_quadratic_energy D hD A hA hσ henergy)

name: NLAlib.integral_exp_mul_lambdaMax_affineSeries_le_of_quadratic_energy
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_lambdaMax_affineSeries_le_of_quadratic_energy [Nonempty n]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
    (A : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (henergy : ∀ u : n → ℂ, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∑ i, (quadForm (A i) u).re ^ 2 ≤ σ ^ 2) (t : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, Real.exp (t * lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i)) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      Real.exp (t * (∫ x, lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) +
        t ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, x i • A i)
  let m : ℝ := ∫ x, f x ∂gaussianVector ι
  have hsg := hasSubgaussianMGF_lambdaMax_affineSeries_of_quadratic_energy D hD A hA hσ henergy
  have he : mgf f (gaussianVector ι) t =
      mgf (fun x => f x - m) (gaussianVector ι) t * Real.exp (t * m) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
      (mgf_add_const (X := fun x => f x - m) (μ := gaussianVector ι) (t := t) m)
  change mgf f (gaussianVector ι) t ≤ Real.exp (t * m + t ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / 2)
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (σ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (t * m) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsg.mgf_le t) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.posDef_integral_of_ae_posDef
statement:
theorem NLAlib.posDef_integral_of_ae_posDef {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : ℕ}
    (Z : Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hInt : Integrable Z μ) (hPD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Z ω).PosDef) :
    (∫ ω, Z ω ∂μ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hNonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ Z ω := by
    filter_upwards [hPD] with ω hω
    exact hω.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hMeanHerm : (∫ ω, Z ω ∂μ).IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae hNonneg)).isHermitian
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hMeanHerm
  intro v hv
  let L : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toFun := fun A => star v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v)
      map_add' := by intros; simp [Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
      map_smul' := by intros; simp [Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul] }
  let T := L.toContinuousLinearMap
  have htInt : Integrable (fun ω => T (Z ω)) μ := T.integrable_comp hInt
  have hreInt := Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp htInt
  have htpos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < T (Z ω) := by
    filter_upwards [hPD] with ω hω
    exact hω.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
  have hrePos : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 < (T (Z ω)).re := by
    filter_upwards [htpos] with ω hω
    exact (Complex.pos_iff.1 hω).1
  have himZero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (T (Z ω)).im = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [htpos] with ω hω
    exact (Complex.pos_iff.1 hω).2.symm
  have hposInt : 0 < ∫ ω, (T (Z ω)).re ∂μ := by
    apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae (hrePos.mono (fun _ h => h.le)) hreInt).2
    have hs : Function.support (fun ω => (T (Z ω)).re) =ᵐ[μ] (Set.univ : Set Ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hrePos] with ω hω
      apply propext
      change (T (Z ω)).re ≠ 0 ↔ True
      exact iff_true_intro hω.ne'
    rw [measure_congr hs]
    simp
  change 0 < T (∫ ω, Z ω ∂μ)
  rw [← T.integral_comp_comm hInt, Complex.pos_iff]
  constructor
  · change 0 < Complex.reCLM (∫ x, T (Z x) ∂μ)
    rw [← Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm htInt]
    exact hposInt
  · change 0 = Complex.imCLM (∫ x, T (Z x) ∂μ)
    rw [← Complex.imCLM.integral_comp_comm htInt]
    change 0 = ∫ x, (T (Z x)).im ∂μ
    rw [integral_congr_ae himZero, integral_zero]

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_of_loewnerLE
statement:
private lemma posSemidef_of_loewnerLE {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    (F : Ω → Matrix d d ℂ) (hF : ∀ ω, (F ω).PosSemidef) (V : Matrix d d ℂ)
    (h : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) ≤ V) : V.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : Matrix d d ℂ) ≤ ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg_of_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hF ω).nonneg)
  have hI : (∫ ω, F ω ∂μ).PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp h0
  have : V = (V - ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ := by abel
  rw [this]
  exact PosSemidef.add h hI

name: NLAlib.norm_le_trace
statement:
private lemma norm_le_trace {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] [Nonempty d]
    {P : Matrix d d ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef) : ‖P‖ ≤ (trace P).re
proof:
:= by
  have hH : P.IsHermitian := hP.isHermitian
  have hsa : IsSelfAdjoint P := hH
  have htr : (trace P).re = ∑ i, hH.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hH.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]; simp
  have hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hH.eigenvalues i := fun i => hP.eigenvalues_nonneg i
  have key : ∃ i, ‖P‖ ≤ hH.eigenvalues i := by
    rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum hsa with h | h
    · rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      exact ⟨i, hi.ge⟩
    · rw [hH.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      have := hnn i
      have := norm_nonneg P
      linarith
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := key
  rw [htr]
  exact hi.trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnn j) (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: NLAlib.one_le_intrinsicDimension
statement:
private lemma one_le_intrinsicDimension {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    {P : Matrix d d ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef) (hne : P ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ intrinsicDimension P
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < ‖P‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  have : Nonempty d := by
    by_contra hd
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at hd
    exact hne (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  unfold intrinsicDimension
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos, one_mul]
  exact norm_le_trace hP

name: NLAlib.exponent_le
statement:
private lemma exponent_le {v L μ₀ τ : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hμ : 0 < μ₀) (hτ : μ₀ ≤ τ) :
    -(τ ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * τ / 3) ≤ -((μ₀ / 2) / (v + L * μ₀ / 3)) * τ
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < v + L * μ₀ / 3 := by positivity
  have hB : 0 < v + L * τ / 3 := by have : 0 < τ := hμ.trans_le hτ; positivity
  rw [neg_div, neg_mul, neg_le_neg_iff, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hA hB]
  have : 0 < τ := hμ.trans_le hτ
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hτ (le_of_lt (mul_pos this hv))]

name: NLAlib.integral_exp
statement:
private lemma integral_exp {K c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), K * Real.exp (-c * t) = K / c
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : -c < 0) 0]
  simp
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp
statement:
private lemma integrable_exp {K c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => K * Real.exp (-c * t)) (Set.Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hc).const_mul K

name: NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_expectation_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_expectation_package :
    ∀ {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
      {m n N : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
      (S : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
    ∀ (V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      (V₁ ≠ 0 ∨ V₂ ≠ 0) →
      (∀ k, Measurable (S k)) → iIndepFun S μ →
      (∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0) →
      (∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L) →
      (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω) * (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) ≤ V₁ →
      (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose * (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤ V₂ →
      let r
proof:
:= intrinsicDimension (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)
      let v := max (specNorm V₁) (specNorm V₂)
      (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤
        20 * (Real.sqrt (v * Real.log (1 + r)) + L * Real.log (1 + r)) := by
  intro Ω _ μ _ m n N _ _ S L hL V₁ V₂ hV hMeas hIndep hMean hBound hVar₁ hVar₂ r v
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm] at hBound ⊢
  
  have hV₁ : V₁.PosSemidef := posSemidef_of_loewnerLE _
    (fun ω => Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose _) V₁ hVar₁
  have hV₂ : V₂.PosSemidef := posSemidef_of_loewnerLE _
    (fun ω => Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _) V₂ hVar₂
  
  have hv : 0 < v := by
    rcases hV with h | h
    · exact lt_max_of_lt_left (norm_pos_iff.mpr h)
    · exact lt_max_of_lt_right (norm_pos_iff.mpr h)
  
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by
    apply one_le_intrinsicDimension (posSemidef_fromBlocks_diag hV₁ hV₂)
    intro h0
    rw [← Matrix.fromBlocks_zero, Matrix.fromBlocks_inj] at h0
    rcases hV with h | h
    · exact h h0.1
    · exact h h0.2.2.2
  set ℓ := Real.log (1 + r) with hℓdef
  have hℓ : 1 / 2 ≤ ℓ := by
    have h2 : Real.log 2 ≤ ℓ := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp (-ℓ) = 1 / (1 + r) := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, hℓdef, Real.exp_log (by linarith), one_div]
  obtain ⟨hμ₀, hμpos, hc, hfinal⟩ := scalar hv hL hℓ (by linarith) hexp
  set μ₀ := 2 * Real.sqrt (ℓ * v) + 2 * ℓ * L with hμ₀def
  set c := (μ₀ / 2) / (v + L * μ₀ / 3) with hcdef
  
  have htail (t : ℝ) := measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp
    μ S hL hV hMeas hIndep hMean hBound hVar₁ hVar₂ (t := t)
  
  by_cases hint : Integrable (fun ω => ‖∑ k, S k ω‖) μ
  swap
  · rw [integral_undef hint]
    have : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (v * ℓ) + L * ℓ := by
      have : 0 ≤ ℓ := by linarith
      positivity
    linarith
  set W : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => max (‖∑ k, S k ω‖ - μ₀) 0 with hWdef
  have hWint : Integrable W μ := (hint.sub (integrable_const μ₀)).pos_part
  have hsplit : (∫ ω, ‖∑ k, S k ω‖ ∂μ) ≤ μ₀ + ∫ ω, W ω ∂μ := by
    have h1 : (∫ ω, ‖∑ k, S k ω‖ ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, (μ₀ + W ω) ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hint ((integrable_const μ₀).add hWint) fun ω => by
        simp only [hWdef]
        have := le_max_left (‖∑ k, S k ω‖ - μ₀) 0
        linarith
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const μ₀) hWint, integral_const] at h1
    simpa using h1
  have hW : (∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) ≤ 4 * r * Real.exp (-c * μ₀) / c := by
    rw [hWint.integral_eq_integral_meas_le (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => le_max_right _ _)]
    have hK : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (4 * r * Real.exp (-c * μ₀)) * Real.exp (-c * t) =
        4 * r * Real.exp (-c * μ₀) / c := integral_exp hc
    rw [← hK]
    refine integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => measureReal_nonneg)
      (integrable_exp hc) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_)
    have ht : 0 < t := ht
    have hsub : {a | t ≤ W a} ⊆ {ω | t + μ₀ ≤ ‖∑ k, S k ω‖} := by
      intro a ha
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hWdef] at ha ⊢
      rcases le_max_iff.mp ha with h | h
      · linarith
      · linarith
    calc μ.real {a | t ≤ W a} ≤ μ.real {ω | t + μ₀ ≤ ‖∑ k, S k ω‖} :=
          measureReal_mono hsub
      _ ≤ 4 * r * Real.exp (-((t + μ₀) ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * (t + μ₀) / 3)) :=
          htail (t + μ₀) (by linarith)
      _ ≤ 4 * r * Real.exp (-c * (t + μ₀)) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (exponent_le hv hL hμpos (by linarith))) (by linarith)
      _ = 4 * r * Real.exp (-c * μ₀) * Real.exp (-c * t) := by
          rw [show -c * (t + μ₀) = -c * μ₀ + -c * t by ring, Real.exp_add]; ring
  calc (∫ ω, ‖∑ k, S k ω‖ ∂μ) ≤ μ₀ + 4 * r * Real.exp (-c * μ₀) / c := by
        linarith
    _ ≤ 20 * (Real.sqrt (v * ℓ) + L * ℓ) := hfinal

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_sum_le_of_intrinsicDimension
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_sum_le_of_intrinsicDimension {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n N : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (S : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    {V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hV : V₁ ≠ 0 ∨ V₂ ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVariance₁ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω) * (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) ≤ V₁)
    (hVariance₂ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose * (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤ V₂) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      20 * (Real.sqrt (max (specNorm V₁) (specNorm V₂) *
        Real.log (1 + intrinsicDimension (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂))) +
        L * Real.log (1 + intrinsicDimension (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)))
proof:
:=
  intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_expectation_package μ S L hL V₁ V₂ hV hMeas hIndep hMean hBound
    hVariance₁ hVariance₂

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_smul_sq_eq_sum_sq
statement:
theorem integral_sum_smul_sq_eq_sum_sq {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] {N : ℕ}
    (A : Fin N → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (g : Fin N → Ω → ℝ) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ)
    (h2 : ∀ k, MemLp (g k) 2 μ) (h0 : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ∂μ = 0)
    (h1 : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ k, g k ω • A k) ^ 2 ∂μ = ∑ k, A k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : ∀ ω, (∑ k, g k ω • A k) ^ 2 = ∑ j, ∑ k, (g j ω * g k ω) • (A j * A k) := by
    intro ω
    rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    simp only [smul_mul_smul_comm]
  have hint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun ω => g j ω * g k ω) μ := fun j k =>
    (h2 j).integrable_mul (h2 k)
  have hcorr : ∀ j k, ∫ ω, g j ω * g k ω ∂μ = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j k
    split_ifs with hjk
    · subst hjk
      simpa [sq] using h1 j
    · rw [(hIndep.indepFun hjk).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
        (hMeas j).aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable, h0 j, zero_mul]
  simp_rw [hexp]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hint j k).smul_const _))]
  have hinner : ∀ j, ∫ ω, ∑ k, (g j ω * g k ω) • (A j * A k) ∂μ = A j ^ 2 := by
    intro j
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hint j k).smul_const _)]
    simp_rw [integral_smul_const, hcorr]
    simp [sq]
  simp_rw [hinner]

name: NLAlib.hermitianSecondMoment_hermitianSeries_eq
statement:
theorem hermitianSecondMoment_hermitianSeries_eq (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ) (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ)
    (hVar : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    hermitianSecondMoment μ (fun ω => ∑ k, g k ω • A k) = specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermitianSecondMoment
  rw [integral_sum_smul_sq_eq_sum_sq μ A g hMeas hIndep (fun k => (hSG k).memLp 2)
    (fun k => integral_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (hSG k)) hVar]

name: NLAlib.traceExp_cumulantSum_le
statement:
private lemma traceExp_cumulantSum_le (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ) ≤
      d * Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hBherm : (∑ k, A k ^ 2).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => (hA k).pow 2)
  have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ).IsHermitian :=
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
  have hk : ∀ k, (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • (g k ω • A k)) ∂μ)) ≤
      ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • A k ^ 2) := by
    intro k
    have e : (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • (g k ω • A k))) =
        fun ω => matrixExp ((θ * g k ω) • A k) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [smul_smul]
    rw [e]
    exact matrixLog_integral_matrixExp_smul_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (A k) (hA k) (hSG k) θ
  have hsum : (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ) ≤ ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • ∑ k, A k ^ 2) := by
    unfold cumulantSum
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k)
  have hBH' : ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • ∑ k, A k ^ 2).IsHermitian :=
    hBherm.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))
  calc traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ)
      ≤ traceExp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) • ∑ k, A k ^ 2) := traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcumH hBH' hsum
    _ ≤ d * Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * ‖∑ k, A k ^ 2‖) :=
        traceExp_smul_le_mul_exp_mul_norm _ hBherm (by positivity)
    _ = d * Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2)) := by rw [specNorm_eq_norm]

name: NLAlib.master_package
statement:
private lemma master_package (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ) (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∀ k, Measurable (fun ω => g k ω • A k)) ∧
    (∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (g k ω • A k).IsHermitian) ∧
    (∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => g k ω • A k) μ) ∧
    iIndepFun (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) μ ∧
    (∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • (g k ω • A k))) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmulMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun s : ℝ => s • A k) := fun k =>
    (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).measurable
  refine ⟨fun k => (hsmulMeas k).comp (hMeas k), fun k =>
    ae_of_all _ (fun ω => (hA k).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))),
    fun k => ((hSG k).integrable).smul_const (A k),
    hIndep.comp (fun k s => s • A k) hsmulMeas, fun k =>
    exp_integrable μ (A k) (hA k) (g k) (hMeas k) (hSG k).integrable_exp_mul θ⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_hermitianSeries_le
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_hermitianSeries_le (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, g k ω • A k) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2) * Real.log d)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hd
  set v := specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2) with hv
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := specNorm_nonneg _
  refine scalar (Real.log_nonneg hd) hv0 (fun θ hθ => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hXMeas, hXHerm, hXInt, hXIndep, hXExp⟩ := master_package μ A g hA hMeas hIndep hSG θ
  have h1 := integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k)
    hθ hXMeas hXHerm hXInt hXIndep hXExp
  have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ).IsHermitian :=
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
  have hpos : 0 < traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ) :=
    traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian _ hcumH
  have hlog : Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ)) ≤
      Real.log d + θ ^ 2 / 2 * v := by
    calc _ ≤ Real.log (d * Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * v)) :=
          Real.log_le_log hpos (traceExp_cumulantSum_le μ A g hA hSG θ)
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.log_mul hd0.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
  calc (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, g k ω • A k) ∂μ)
      ≤ Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ)) / θ := h1
    _ ≤ (Real.log d + θ ^ 2 / 2 * v) / θ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hθ.le
    _ = Real.log d / θ + θ * v / 2 := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_hermitianSeries_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_hermitianSeries_ge_le (hA : ∀ k, (A k).IsHermitian)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, g k ω • A k)} ≤
      gaussianSeriesTail d (specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2)) t
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  set v := specNorm (∑ k, A k ^ 2) with hv
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := specNorm_nonneg _
  have hT : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∀ t : ℝ, μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, g k ω • A k)} ≤
      d * Real.exp (-θ * t + θ ^ 2 / 2 * v) := by
    intro θ hθ t
    obtain ⟨hXMeas, hXHerm, -, hXIndep, hXExp⟩ := master_package μ A g hA hMeas hIndep hSG θ
    have h1 := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_exp_mul_traceExp_cumulantSum μ
      (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) hθ hXMeas hXHerm hXIndep hXExp t
    calc _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * t) * traceExp (cumulantSum μ (fun k ω => g k ω • A k) θ) := h1
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * t) * (d * Real.exp (θ ^ 2 / 2 * v)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (traceExp_cumulantSum_le μ A g hA hSG θ) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
  have hP1 : ∀ t : ℝ, μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, g k ω • A k)} ≤ d := fun t =>
    (measureReal_le_one (μ := μ)).trans hd
  unfold gaussianSeriesTail
  split_ifs with hv0' ht0
  · exact hP1 t
  · have htp : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht (Ne.symm ht0)
    have hlin : Tendsto (fun θ : ℝ => -θ * t) atTop atBot := by
      have := (tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp (Filter.tendsto_id.atTop_mul_const htp))
      refine this.congr (fun θ => ?_)
      simp [neg_mul]
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun θ : ℝ => (d : ℝ) * Real.exp (-θ * t + θ ^ 2 / 2 * v)) atTop
        (𝓝 0) := by
      rw [hv0']
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
      simpa using (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hlin).const_mul (d : ℝ)
    exact ge_of_tendsto hlim ((eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono fun θ hθ => hT θ hθ t)
  · have hvp : 0 < v := lt_of_le_of_ne hv0 (Ne.symm hv0')
    rcases ht.eq_or_lt with h0 | htp
    · subst h0
      simpa using hP1 0
    · have h := hT (t / v) (div_pos htp hvp) t
      have e : -(t / v) * t + (t / v) ^ 2 / 2 * v = -(t ^ 2) / (2 * v) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rwa [e] at h
