name: NLAlib.specNorm_le_two_mul_card_mul_of_realCoordinates_le
statement:
private theorem specNorm_le_two_mul_card_mul_of_realCoordinates_le
    (A : M) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0≤t) (hA : ∀ j : J, |matrixRealCoordinates A j|≤t) :
    specNorm A≤2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*t
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (j k : n) : ‖A j k‖≤2*t := by
    have hr := hA (Sum.inl (j,k))
    have hi := hA (Sum.inr (j,k))
    exact (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans (by
      simpa only [matrixRealCoordinates_inl,matrixRealCoordinates_inr,two_mul] using add_le_add hr hi)
  have hfrob : frobSq A≤(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*(2*t)^2 := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : n, ∑ _k : n, (2*t)^2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hentry j k) 2
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  have hs := (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq A).trans hfrob
  have hb : 0≤2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*t := by positivity
  nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg A]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_centered_gaussian_dual
statement:
private theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_centered_gaussian_dual
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (L : M →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0)
    (hvar : Var[L;ρ]≤v) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun A => L (A-∫ B, B ∂ρ)) v ρ
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology M := inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let v0 : ℝ≥0 := (Var[L;ρ]).toNNReal
  have hraw : HasLaw (fun A : M => L A) (gaussianReal (∫ A, L A ∂ρ) v0) ρ :=
    ⟨L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable,IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal L⟩
  have hshift := gaussianReal_sub_const hraw (∫ A, L A ∂ρ)
  have hbase : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun A : M => L A-∫ B, L B ∂ρ) v0 ρ := by
    rw [← HasSubgaussianMGF.id_map_iff hshift.aemeasurable,hshift.map_eq,sub_self]
    exact hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal v0
  have hv0 : (v0 : ℝ)≤v := by
    simpa only [v0,Real.coe_toNNReal _ (variance_nonneg _ _)] using hvar
  have hs : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun A : M => L A-∫ B, L B ∂ρ) v ρ := by
    refine ⟨hbase.integrable_exp_mul,fun s => (hbase.mgf_le s).trans ?_⟩
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv0 (sq_nonneg s)) (by norm_num)
  have hm : (∫ A : M, L A ∂ρ)=L (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) :=
    L.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := ρ))
  simpa only [map_sub,hm] using hs

name: NLAlib.measureReal_centered_specNorm_gt_le_gaussian_of_bilinear_budget
statement:
theorem measureReal_centered_specNorm_gt_le_gaussian_of_bilinear_budget
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] {v s : ℝ} (hv : 0≤v) (hs : 0≤s)
    (hbudget : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖=1 → ‖b‖=1 →
      (∫ A, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ ((A-∫ B, B ∂ρ) *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖^2 ∂ρ)≤v) :
    ρ.real {A | 4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.sqrt v*Real.sqrt s <
      specNorm (A-∫ B, B ∂ρ)} ≤
        4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)^2*Real.exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology M := inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let D : M := ∫ A, A ∂ρ
  let E := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  let L (j : J) : M →L[ℝ] ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).comp E.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL (j : J) (A : M) : L j A=matrixRealCoordinates A j := rfl
  have hXm : MemLp (fun A : M => A-D) 2 ρ :=
    (IsGaussian.memLp_two_id (μ := ρ)).sub (memLp_const D)
  let e (j : n) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n := EuclideanSpace.single j 1
  have heNorm (j : n) : ‖e j‖=1 := by simp [e]
  have heval (j k : n) (A : M) : star (e j).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (e k).ofLp)=A j k := by simp [e]
  have heM (j k : n) : MemLp (fun A : M => (A-D) j k) 2 ρ := by
    have hh := ((Matrix.bilinearCLM (e j).ofLp (e k).ofLp).restrictScalars ℝ).comp_memLp' hXm
    change MemLp (fun A : M => Matrix.bilinearCLM (e j).ofLp (e k).ofLp (A-D)) 2 ρ at hh
    simpa only [Matrix.bilinearCLM_apply,heval] using hh
  have heBudget (j k : n) : (∫ A : M, ‖(A-D) j k‖^2 ∂ρ)≤v := by
    simpa only [heval] using hbudget (e j) (e k) (heNorm j) (heNorm k)
  have hcoordBudget (j : J) : (∫ A : M, (L j (A-D))^2 ∂ρ)≤v := by
    have hi : MemLp (fun A : M => L j (A-D)) 2 ρ := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (L j).comp_memLp' hXm
    rcases j with ⟨j,k⟩ | ⟨j,k⟩
    all_goals
      apply (integral_mono_ae hi.integrable_sq ((heM j k).integrable_norm_pow (by decide : 2≠0))
        (Eventually.of_forall fun A => ?_)).trans (heBudget j k)
      dsimp only
      rw [hL]
      simp only [matrixRealCoordinates_inl,matrixRealCoordinates_inr,
        Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((A-D) j k).re,sq_nonneg ((A-D) j k).im]
  have hvariance (j : J) : Var[L j;ρ]≤v := by
    have hm : (∫ A : M, L j A ∂ρ)=L j (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) :=
      (L j).integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := ρ))
    rw [variance_eq_integral (L j).continuous.measurable.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [map_sub,hm,D] using hcoordBudget j
  have hsg (j : J) : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun A : M => L j (A-D)) ⟨v,hv⟩ ρ :=
    hasSubgaussianMGF_centered_gaussian_dual ρ (L j) ⟨v,hv⟩ (hvariance j)
  let t := Real.sqrt v*Real.sqrt (2*s)
  have ht : 0≤t := by dsimp [t]; positivity
  have htail (j : J) : ρ.real {A : M | t < |L j (A-D)|}≤2*Real.exp (-s) := by
    have hh := measureReal_sqrt_mul_lt_abs_le_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (hsg j)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2*s))
    change ρ.real {A : M | Real.sqrt v*Real.sqrt (2*s) < |L j (A-D)|} ≤
      2*Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (2*s))^2/2) at hh
    have he : -(Real.sqrt (2*s))^2/2= -s := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]; ring
    simpa only [t,he] using hh
  have hscale : 2*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*t ≤
      4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.sqrt v*Real.sqrt s := by
    have hroot : Real.sqrt (2*s)≤2*Real.sqrt s := by
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0≤2*s),Real.sq_sqrt hs,
        Real.sqrt_nonneg (2*s),Real.sqrt_nonneg s]
    dsimp only [t]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card n)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg v),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroot
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card n)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg v))]
  have hsub : {A : M | 4*(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.sqrt v*Real.sqrt s<specNorm (A-D)} ⊆
      ⋃ j : J, {A : M | t < |L j (A-D)|} := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra hnot
    have hb : ∀ j : J, |matrixRealCoordinates (A-D) j|≤t := by
      intro j
      have hj : ¬ t < |L j (A-D)| := fun hj => hnot (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j,hj⟩)
      simpa only [hL] using le_of_not_gt hj
    exact (not_lt_of_ge ((specNorm_le_two_mul_card_mul_of_realCoordinates_le (A-D) ht hb).trans hscale)) hA
  calc
    _ ≤ ρ.real (⋃ j : J, {A : M | t < |L j (A-D)|}) := measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ j : J, ρ.real {A : M | t < |L j (A-D)|} := measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : J, 2*Real.exp (-s) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => htail j
    _ = _ := by simp [Fintype.card_sum,Fintype.card_prod]; ring

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_smul_mul_sum_smul_eq
statement:
theorem integral_sum_smul_mul_sum_smul_eq {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {N : ℕ} {p q r : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (g : Fin N → Ω → ℝ) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ)
    (h2 : ∀ k, MemLp (g k) 2 μ) (h0 : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ∂μ = 0)
    (h1 : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (X : Fin N → Matrix p q ℂ) (Y : Fin N → Matrix q r ℂ) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ j, g j ω • X j) * (∑ k, g k ω • Y k) ∂μ = ∑ k, X k * Y k
proof:
:= by
  have hint : ∀ j k, Integrable (fun ω => g j ω * g k ω) μ := fun j k =>
    (h2 j).integrable_mul (h2 k)
  have hcorr : ∀ j k, ∫ ω, g j ω * g k ω ∂μ = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j k
    split_ifs with hjk
    · subst hjk; simpa [sq] using h1 j
    · rw [IndepFun.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral (hIndep.indepFun hjk)
        (hMeas j).aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable, h0 j, zero_mul]
  have e : ∀ ω, (∑ j, g j ω • X j) * (∑ k, g k ω • Y k) =
      ∑ j, ∑ k, (g j ω * g k ω) • (X j * Y k) := by
    intro ω
    rw [Matrix.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
  simp_rw [e]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _
    (fun k _ => (hint j k).smul_const _))]
  have h2' : ∀ j, ∫ ω, ∑ k, (g j ω * g k ω) • (X j * Y k) ∂μ = X j * Y j := by
    intro j
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hint j k).smul_const _)]
    simp_rw [integral_smul_const, hcorr, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
    simp
  simp_rw [h2']

name: NLAlib.rectSecondMoment_matrixSeries_eq
statement:
theorem rectSecondMoment_matrixSeries_eq (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hSG : ∀ k, HasSubgaussianMGF (g k) 1 μ) (hVar : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    rectSecondMoment μ (fun ω => ∑ k, g k ω • B k) =
      max (specNorm (∑ k, B k * (B k)ᴴ)) (specNorm (∑ k, (B k)ᴴ * B k))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ∀ k, MemLp (g k) 2 μ := fun k => (hSG k).memLp 2
  have h0 : ∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ∂μ = 0 := fun k => integral_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF (hSG k)
  have hZh : ∀ ω, (∑ k, g k ω • B k)ᴴ = ∑ k, g k ω • (B k)ᴴ := by
    intro ω
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Matrix.conjTranspose_smul]
  unfold rectSecondMoment
  simp_rw [hZh]
  rw [integral_sum_smul_mul_sum_smul_eq μ g hMeas hIndep h2 h0 hVar B (fun k => (B k)ᴴ),
    integral_sum_smul_mul_sum_smul_eq μ g hMeas hIndep h2 h0 hVar (fun k => (B k)ᴴ) B]

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_smul_dilationFamily, lambdaMax_reindex, specNorm_eq_norm]

    (dilation_identities (∑ k, g k ω • B k)).2.2.2

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sum_dilationFamily_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ k, dilationFamily B k ^ 2 =
      Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (dilation (B k) ^ 2) := by
    intro k
    rw [dilationFamily, ← Matrix.coe_reindexAlgEquiv ℝ, map_pow]
  have hsum : ∑ k, dilation (B k) ^ 2 =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (∑ k, B k * (B k)ᴴ) 0 0 (∑ k, (B k)ᴴ * B k) := by
    simp_rw [dilation_sq]
    ext i j
    rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;> simp [Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [hsq]
  rw [← Matrix.coe_reindexLinearEquiv ℝ ℂ finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv,
    ← map_sum, hsum]
  simp only [Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_apply, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_reindex, norm_fromBlocks_diag]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_matrixSeries_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_matrixSeries_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (g k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun g μ) (hg : ∀ k, HasLaw (g k) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ k, g k ω • B k) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * max (specNorm (∑ k, B k * (B k)ᴴ)) (specNorm (∑ k, (B k)ᴴ * B k)) *
        Real.log (m + n))
proof:
:=

name: NLAlib.integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_le_algebraMap
statement:
theorem integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_le_algebraMap {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [Nonempty n]
    {H X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ} (hHMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable H μ)
    (hXMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hH : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (H ω).IsHermitian) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {h a : ℝ} (hHBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, H ω ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) h)
    (hXBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n ℂ) a) :
    Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (H ω + X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.of_bound (continuous_traceExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hHMeas.add hXMeas))
    ((Fintype.card n : ℝ) * Real.exp (h + a)) ?_
  filter_upwards [hH, hX, hHBound, hXBound] with ω hH hX hHb hXb
  have hsum : H ω + X ω ≤ (h + a) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, add_smul] using add_le_add hHb hXb
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hH.add hX))]
  exact (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ (hH.add hX)
    (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)) hsum).trans_eq
      (traceExp_smul_one_eq_card_mul_exp (h + a))

name: NLAlib.measurable_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one
statement:
theorem measurable_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y) (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (w : List Bool) :
    Measurable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace)
proof:
:= by
  have hyi (i : ι) : Measurable (fun ω => y ω i) := (measurable_pi_apply i).comp hy
  have hmat : ∀ (w : List Bool) (i j : ι),
      Measurable (fun ω => insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w i j) := by
    intro w
    induction w with
    | nil => intro i j; simp only [insertionWord, List.map_nil, List.prod_nil]; fun_prop
    | cons b w ih =>
      intro i j
      cases b
      · change Measurable (fun ω => ∑ k, A i k * insertionWord A
          (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w k j)
        exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ => measurable_const.mul (ih k j)
      · change Measurable (fun ω => ∑ k, (y ω i * y ω k - (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i k) *
          insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w k j)
        exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ => ((hyi i).mul (hyi k) |>.sub_const _).mul (ih k j)
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => hmat w i i

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_insertionWord_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_insertionWord_sub_one_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : List Bool) {B : ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ l ≤ w.count true,
      Integrable (fun ω => (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A *
        vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace ∂μ) ≤
          B * (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace) :
    Integrable (fun ω =>
      (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        2 ^ w.count true * B * (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace
proof:
:= by
  let C := cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A
  let f (v : ℕ × List Bool) (ω : Ω) := (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ v.2.count true).trace
  have hi (v : ℕ × List Bool) (hv : v ∈ subInsertionWords w) : Integrable (f v) μ :=
    (hmoment _ (by have h := (counts_of_mem_subInsertionWords hv).2; omega)).1
  have hls : ∀ ls : List (ℕ × List Bool), (∀ v ∈ ls, v ∈ subInsertionWords w) →
      Integrable (fun ω => (ls.map fun v => f v ω).sum) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (ls.map fun v => f v ω).sum ∂μ) ≤ (ls.length : ℝ) * (B * C.trace) := by
    intro ls
    induction ls with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons v ls ih =>
      intro hmem
      have hv := hmem v (by simp)
      obtain ⟨hit, hbt⟩ := ih (fun u hu => hmem u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu))
      have hiv := hi v hv
      have hb := (hmoment (v.2.count true)
        (by have h := (counts_of_mem_subInsertionWords hv).2; omega)).2
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      refine ⟨hiv.add hit, ?_⟩
      rw [integral_add hiv hit]
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      change (∫ ω, f v ω ∂μ) + (∫ ω, (ls.map fun v => f v ω).sum ∂μ) ≤ _
      change (∫ ω, f v ω ∂μ) ≤ B * C.trace at hb
      linarith
  obtain ⟨hG, hbG⟩ := hls _ (fun _ h => h)
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      |(insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace| ≤
        ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v => f v ω).sum :=
    abs_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one_le_sum hA (y ω) w
  have hW : Integrable (fun ω =>
      (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace) μ :=
    hG.mono' (measurable_trace_insertionWord_vecMulVec_sub_one y hy A w).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hpoint ω)
  refine ⟨hW, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ ω, ((subInsertionWords w).map fun v => f v ω).sum ∂μ :=
      integral_mono hW hG fun ω => (le_abs_self _).trans (hpoint ω)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [length_subInsertionWords, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using hbG

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_eq
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_eq
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω)).trace ∂μ) = C.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hm (i : ι) : AEMeasurable (fun ω => y ω i) μ :=
    ((measurable_pi_apply i).comp hy).aemeasurable
  have he (ω : Ω) : (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω)).trace = quadForm C (y ω) := by
    simp only [mul_vecMulVec, trace_vecMulVec, quadForm_def, star_trivial, dotProduct_comm]
  constructor
  · simpa only [he] using integrable_quadForm_of_second_moments C hm hsecond
  · simp_rw [he]
    exact integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments C hm hsecond

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_sub_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_sub_one_eq_zero
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)).trace ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_eq y hy hsecond C
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_sub]
  exact ⟨hi.sub (integrable_const _), by rw [integral_sub hi (integrable_const _), he]; simp⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_sub_one_sq_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_sub_one_sq_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {v : ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ v * (x ⬝ᵥ x))
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) ^ 2).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) ^ 2).trace ∂μ) ≤ v * C.trace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi1, he1⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_eq y hy hsecond C
  have hm (x : ι → ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 1 * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 1 * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ v * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using hmoment x
  obtain ⟨hi2, hb2⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ_le y 1 hm C hC
  norm_num only [Nat.reduceAdd] at hi2 hb2
  have he (ω : Ω) :
      (C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) ^ 2).trace =
        (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ 2).trace -
          2 * (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω)).trace + C.trace := by
    have hm : C * (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) ^ 2 =
        C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ 2 - C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) -
          C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) + C := by noncomm_ring
    rw [hm]
    simp only [Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub]
    ring
  constructor
  · simp_rw [he]
    exact (hi2.sub (hi1.const_mul 2)).add (integrable_const _)
  · simp_rw [he]
    have hadd := integral_add (hi2.sub (hi1.const_mul 2)) (integrable_const C.trace)
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hadd
    rw [hadd, integral_sub hi2 (hi1.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, he1]
    simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
    linarith [hC.trace_nonneg]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_centered_insertionWord_le_factorial
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_centered_insertionWord_le_factorial
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (w : List Bool)
    (hw : 2 ≤ w.count true) {v R : ℝ} (hv : 2 ≤ v) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hraw : ∀ l, 2 ≤ l → l ≤ w.count true → ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
          ((l.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * v * R ^ (l - 2) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    Integrable (fun ω =>
      (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        ((w.count true).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * (4 * v) * (2 * R) ^ (w.count true - 2) *
          (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A).trace
proof:
:= by
  let j := w.count true
  let B : ℝ := ((j.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * v * R ^ (j - 2)
  let C := cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ w.count false) A
  have hC : C.PosSemidef := posSemidef_cfc_of_nonneg_eigenvalues hA
    (fun _ => pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
  have hjfact : (2 : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 ≤ j.factorial from (by simpa using Nat.factorial_le hw))
  have hB : 1 ≤ B := by
    apply one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
    · apply one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
      · linarith
      · linarith
    · exact one_le_pow₀ hR
  have hm (l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ w.count true) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ l).trace ∂μ) ≤ B * C.trace := by
    by_cases hl0 : l = 0
    · subst l
      simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.mul_one]
      refine ⟨integrable_const _, ?_⟩
      simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_left hC.trace_nonneg hB
    by_cases hl1 : l = 1
    · subst l
      simp only [pow_one]
      obtain ⟨hi, he⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_eq y hy hsecond C
      exact ⟨hi, he.le.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left hC.trace_nonneg hB)⟩
    have hl2 : 2 ≤ l := by omega
    have htrace := integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ_le
      y (l - 1) (hraw l hl2 hl) C hC
    rw [show l - 1 + 1 = l by omega] at htrace
    refine ⟨htrace.1, htrace.2.trans ?_⟩
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hC.trace_nonneg
    dsimp [B]
    have hfact : (l.factorial : ℝ) ≤ j.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le hl
    have hpow : R ^ (l - 2) ≤ R ^ (j - 2) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hR (by omega)
    gcongr
  obtain ⟨hi, hb⟩ := integrable_and_integral_trace_insertionWord_sub_one_le y hy hA w hm
  refine ⟨hi, hb.trans_eq ?_⟩
  change 2 ^ j * B * C.trace = _
  have he : (2 : ℝ) ^ j = 4 * 2 ^ (j - 2) := by
    rw [show j = (j - 2) + 2 by dsimp [j]; omega, pow_add]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [he]
  dsimp [B, C, j]
  rw [mul_pow]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_add_centered_rankOne_pow_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_add_centered_rankOne_pow_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hy : Measurable y)
    (hsecond : ∀ i j, (∫ ω, y ω i * y ω j ∂μ) = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    {v R : ℝ} (hv : 2 ≤ v) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hraw : ∀ l, 2 ≤ l → l ≤ 2 * p → ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ (l - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤
          ((l.factorial : ℝ) / 2) * v * R ^ (l - 2) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ((A + (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)) ^ (2 * p)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, ((A + (vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (A ^ (2 * p)).trace + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 *
            (4 * v) * (2 * R) ^ k *
              (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (2 * p - (k + 2))) A).trace
proof:
:= by
  let X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ := fun ω => vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) - 1
  have hlin (w : List Bool) (hw : w.count true = 1) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ ∧
        (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [trace_insertionWord_of_count_true_eq_one A _ w hw]
    exact integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_sub_one_eq_zero y hy hsecond _
  have hword (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * p) (w : List Bool) (hw : w ∈ insertionWords (2 * p) j)
      (hj2 : 2 ≤ j) :=
    integrable_and_integral_trace_centered_insertionWord_le_factorial y hy hsecond hA w
      (by rw [(length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw).2]; exact hj2) hv hR
      (fun l hl2 hlj => hraw l hl2
        (le_trans hlj (by rw [(length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw).2]; exact hj)))
  have hi (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * p) (w : List Bool) (hw : w ∈ insertionWords (2 * p) j) :
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · have hc : w.count true = 0 := by simpa [hj0] using (length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw).2
      simp_rw [insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero A _ w hc]
      exact integrable_const _
    by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · exact (hlin w (by simpa [hj1] using (length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw).2)).1
    exact (hword j hj w hw (by omega)).1
  refine ⟨(integrable_and_integral_trace_add_pow_eq_sum_insertionWords A X (2 * p) hi).1, ?_⟩
  apply integral_trace_add_pow_le_of_centered_word_budgets A X (by omega) (4 * v) (2 * R)
    (fun n => (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ n) A).trace) hi
  · intro w hw
    exact (hlin w (length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw).2).2
  · intro j hj2 hj w hw
    have hcounts := length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw
    have hc : w.count false = 2 * p - j := by
      have htotal := count_false_add_count_true_eq_length w
      omega
    simpa only [hcounts.2, hc, mul_assoc] using (hword j hj w hw hj2).2

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable_matrixRealCoordinates
    {X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMax (X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  have hi := C.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hX
  have he (ω : Ω) : C.symm (matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) = X ω :=
    matrixRealCoordinates.symm_apply_apply (X ω)
  have hmatrix : Integrable X μ := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using hi
  exact integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable hmatrix hHerm

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_add_smul_of_memLp_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_add_smul_of_memLp_matrixRealCoordinates [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian) {X : Ω → Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (c : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMax (D + c • X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  have hi := C.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp (hX.integrable one_le_two)
  have he (ω : Ω) : C.symm (matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) = X ω :=
    matrixRealCoordinates.symm_apply_apply (X ω)
  have hmatrix : Integrable X μ := by
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using hi
  apply integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable ((integrable_const D).add (hmatrix.smul c))
  exact hHerm.mono fun ω hω => hD.add (hω.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all c))

name: NLAlib.integrable_lambdaMax_add_sum_smul_of_memLp_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem integrable_lambdaMax_add_sum_smul_of_memLp_matrixRealCoordinates
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (D : Matrix n n ℂ) (hD : D.IsHermitian) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (X : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X i ω)) 2 μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X i ω).IsHermitian) :
    Integrable (fun ω => lambdaMax (D + ∑ i, c i • X i ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  have hmatrix (i : ι) : Integrable (X i) μ := by
    have hi := C.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp ((hX i).integrable one_le_two)
    have he (ω : Ω) : C.symm (matrixRealCoordinates (X i ω)) = X i ω :=
      matrixRealCoordinates.symm_apply_apply (X i ω)
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using hi
  have hsum : Integrable (fun ω => D + ∑ i, c i • X i ω) μ :=
    (integrable_const D).add
      (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hmatrix i).smul (c i)))
  apply integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable hsum
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hHerm] with ω hω
  exact hD.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => (hω i).smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (c i))))

name: NLAlib.intrinsicDimension_reindex
statement:
private lemma intrinsicDimension_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    intrinsicDimension (Matrix.reindex e e A) = intrinsicDimension A
proof:
:= by
  unfold intrinsicDimension
  rw [trace_reindex, norm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.fromBlocks_diag_sub
statement:
private lemma fromBlocks_diag_sub (A A' : Matrix m m ℂ) (B B' : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    fromBlocks A 0 0 B - fromBlocks A' 0 0 B' = fromBlocks (A - A') 0 0 (B - B')
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, fromBlocks_neg, fromBlocks_add]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: NLAlib.ctCLM_apply
statement:
private lemma ctCLM_apply {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (A : Matrix m n ℂ) :
    ctCLM m n A = Aᴴ
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.Φ_apply
statement:
private lemma Φ_apply {p q : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) ℂ) :
    Φ p q A = Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (dilation A)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n N : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n]
    (S : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) (V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hV : V₁ ≠ 0 ∨ V₂ ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVariance₁ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω) * (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) ≤ V₁)
    (hVariance₂ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose * (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤ V₂) :
    let Z
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, S k ω
    let r := intrinsicDimension (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)
    let v := max (specNorm V₁) (specNorm V₂)
    (∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ ∧
    (∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sqrt v + L / 3 ≤ t →
      μ.real {ω | t ≤ specNorm (Z ω)} ≤
        4 * r * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3)) := by
  intro Z r v
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm] at hBound ⊢
  
  have hSL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (S k) 2 μ := fun k =>
    MemLp.of_bound (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable L (by
      filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω h
      simpa using h)
  have hct_meas : Measurable (fun A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ => A.conjTranspose) :=
    (ctCLM (Fin m) (Fin n)).continuous.measurable
  have hSHL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => (S k ω).conjTranspose) 2 μ := fun k =>
    (ctCLM (Fin m) (Fin n)).comp_memLp' (hSL2 k)
  have hSHmean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) = 0 := by
    intro k
    have := (ctCLM (Fin m) (Fin n)).integral_comp_comm ((hSL2 k).integrable one_le_two)
    simp only [ctCLM_apply, hMean k, Matrix.conjTranspose_zero] at this
    exact this
  
  have h1 : (∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, S k ω * (S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ := by
    have := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ S id Matrix.conjTranspose measurable_id
      hct_meas hMeas hIndep hSL2 hSHL2 hMean
    show (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω) * (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) = _
    simp_rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
    exact this
  have h2 : (∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ) =
      ∑ k, ∫ ω, (S k ω).conjTranspose * S k ω ∂μ := by
    have := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ S Matrix.conjTranspose id hct_meas
      measurable_id hMeas hIndep hSHL2 hSL2 hSHmean
    show (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose * (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) = _
    simp_rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
    exact this
  refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
  
  have hZL2 : MemLp Z 2 μ := memLp_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hSL2 k)
  have hZsq : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Z ω‖ ^ 2) μ :=
    hZL2.integrable_norm_pow (p := 2) two_ne_zero
  have hP : Integrable (fun ω => Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' hZsq ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    · have hc : Continuous (fun X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ => X * X.conjTranspose) :=
        continuous_id.matrix_mul continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose
      exact hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hZL2.1
    · calc _ ≤ ‖Z ω‖ * ‖(Z ω).conjTranspose‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose, sq]
  have hQ : Integrable (fun ω => (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' hZsq ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    · have hc : Continuous (fun X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ => X.conjTranspose * X) :=
        continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose.matrix_mul continuous_id
      exact hc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hZL2.1
    · rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self, sq]
  
  have hPpsd : (∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      fun ω => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose (Z ω))))
  have hQpsd : (∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ).PosSemidef :=
    Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      fun ω => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Z ω))))
  have hD₁ : (V₁ - ∫ ω, Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose ∂μ).PosSemidef := hVariance₁
  have hD₂ : (V₂ - ∫ ω, (Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω ∂μ).PosSemidef := hVariance₂
  have hV₁ : V₁.PosSemidef := by simpa using hD₁.add hPpsd
  have hV₂ : V₂.PosSemidef := by simpa using hD₂.add hQpsd
  
  have : NeZero (m + n) := ⟨by have := NeZero.ne m; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Matrix (Fin (m + n)) (Fin (m + n)) ℂ,
      V = Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVne : V ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [hVdef] at h
    have h' : Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂ = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv.symm finSumFinEquiv.symm) h
      simpa using this
    have h0 : Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂ =
        Matrix.fromBlocks (0 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) 0 0 (0 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) :=
      h'.trans Matrix.fromBlocks_zero.symm
    have h00 := Matrix.fromBlocks_inj.mp h0
    rcases hV with hv | hv
    · exact hv h00.1
    · exact hv h00.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨-, hnorm, -⟩ := intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂
  have hvV : ‖V‖ = v := by
    rw [hVdef]
    rw [norm_reindex]
    exact hnorm
  have hrV : intrinsicDimension V = r := by
    rw [hVdef, intrinsicDimension_reindex]
  have hY : ∀ ω, ∑ k, Φ m n (S k ω) = Φ m n (Z ω) := fun ω =>
    (map_sum (Φ m n) (fun k => S k ω) Finset.univ).symm
  have hlam : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ, lambdaMax (Φ m n A) = ‖A‖ := by
    intro A
    rw [Φ_apply, lambdaMax_reindex]
    exact (dilation_identities A).2.2.1.trans (dilation_identities A).2.2.2
  have hXmeas : ∀ k, Measurable (fun ω => Φ m n (S k ω)) := fun k =>
    (Φ m n).continuous.measurable.comp (hMeas k)
  have hXindep : iIndepFun (fun k ω => Φ m n (S k ω)) μ :=
    hIndep.comp (fun _ => Φ m n) (fun _ => (Φ m n).continuous.measurable)
  have hXherm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Φ m n (S k ω)).IsHermitian := fun k =>
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (dilation_identities (S k ω)).1.reindex _
  have hXL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => Φ m n (S k ω)) 2 μ := fun k =>
    (Φ m n).comp_memLp' (hSL2 k)
  have hXmean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, Φ m n (S k ω) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    intro k
    rw [(Φ m n).integral_comp_comm ((hSL2 k).integrable one_le_two), hMean k, map_zero]
  have hXbound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (Φ m n (S k ω)) ≤ L := fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hBound k] with ω h
    rw [hlam]; exact h
  have hVar : (∫ ω, (∑ k, Φ m n (S k ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ V := by
    have hsq : ∀ ω, (Φ m n (Z ω)) ^ 2 = Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
        (Matrix.fromBlocks (Z ω * (Z ω).conjTranspose) 0 0 ((Z ω).conjTranspose * Z ω)) := by
      intro ω
      rw [Φ_apply, ← dilation_sq, ← Matrix.coe_reindexAlgEquiv ℝ, map_pow]
    simp_rw [hY, hsq]
    rw [integral_reindex, integral_fromBlocks_diag μ _ _ hP hQ, hVdef]
    rw [Matrix.le_iff]
    rw [← Matrix.coe_reindexLinearEquiv ℂ ℂ, ← map_sub, Matrix.coe_reindexLinearEquiv,
      fromBlocks_diag_sub, Matrix.reindex_apply]
    obtain ⟨hpsd, -⟩ := intrinsicDimension_fromBlocks _ _ hD₁ hD₂
    exact hpsd.submatrix _
  
  intro t ht
  have := measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp μ
    (fun k ω => Φ m n (S k ω)) hL hVne
    hXmeas hXindep hXherm hXL2 hXmean hXbound hVar
    (t := t) (by rw [specNorm_eq_norm, hvV]; exact ht)
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, hY, hlam, hvV, hrV] at this
  exact this

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {m n N : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    [NeZero n] (S : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℂ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    {V₁ : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ} {V₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hV : V₁ ≠ 0 ∨ V₂ ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (S k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun S μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, S k ω ∂μ) = 0) (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVariance₁ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω) * (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose ∂μ) ≤ V₁)
    (hVariance₂ : (∫ ω, (∑ k, S k ω).conjTranspose * (∑ k, S k ω) ∂μ) ≤ V₂) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : Real.sqrt (max (specNorm V₁) (specNorm V₂)) + L / 3 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | t ≤ specNorm (∑ k, S k ω)} ≤
      4 * intrinsicDimension (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂) *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (max (specNorm V₁) (specNorm V₂) + L * t / 3))
proof:
:=
  (intrinsic_matrix_bernstein_package μ S L hL V₁ V₂ hV hMeas hIndep hMean hBound hVariance₁
    hVariance₂).2.2 t ht

name: NLAlib.integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_upper_bound
statement:
theorem integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_upper_bound
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {X : Ω → M}
    (hXmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ R • (1 : M)) :
    Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (A + X ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hR : (R • (1 : M)).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all R)
  refine Integrable.of_bound
    (continuous_traceExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add hXmeas))
    (traceExp (A + R • (1 : M))) ?_
  filter_upwards [hHerm, hbound] with ω hω hωb
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hA.add hω))]
  exact traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ (hA.add hω) (hA.add hR) (add_le_add le_rfl hωb)

name: NLAlib.integrable_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero
statement:
theorem integrable_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero
    (A : M) {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => deriv (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0) μ
proof:
:= by
  let C := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  let L := (fderiv ℝ traceExp A).comp C
  have h := L.integrable_comp hX
  simpa only [L, C, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv_symm',
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_fderiv] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_zero
    (A : M) {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) μ)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) ∂μ) = 0) :
    (∫ ω, deriv (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 ∂μ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let C := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  let L := (fderiv ℝ traceExp A).comp C
  have h := L.integral_comp_comm hX
  rw [hmean, map_zero] at h
  simpa only [L, C, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv_symm',
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_fderiv] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ)
    (hmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) ∂μ) = 0)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ R • (1 : M)) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (A + X ω) ∂μ) ≤ traceExp A +
      (∫ ω, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 ∂μ) *
        expSecondRemainderCoefficient R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hXi := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hfirst := integrable_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero A hXi
  have hsecond := integrable_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul A hX
  have hupper : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp A +
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 +
      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 *
        expSecondRemainderCoefficient R) μ :=
    ((integrable_const (traceExp A)).add hfirst).add (hsecond.mul_const (expSecondRemainderCoefficient R))
  have hXmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ := by
    let C := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm
    have hh := C.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hX.aestronglyMeasurable
    simpa only [C, matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv,
      LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv_symm', LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (A + X ω)) μ := by
    refine hupper.mono' (continuous_traceExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
      (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add hXmeas)) ?_
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hbound] with ω hω hωb
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hA.add hω))]
    exact traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient_of_le A (X ω) hA hω hωb
  have hle := integral_mono_ae hi hupper (by
    filter_upwards [hHerm, hbound] with ω hω hωb
    exact traceExp_add_le_add_deriv_add_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient_of_le A (X ω) hA hω hωb)
  have hs := integral_add ((integrable_const (traceExp A)).add hfirst)
    (hsecond.mul_const (expSecondRemainderCoefficient R))
  have hsfirst := integral_add (integrable_const (traceExp A)) hfirst
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hs hsfirst
  rw [hs, hsfirst, integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, integral_deriv_traceExp_add_smul_zero_eq_zero A hXi hmean,
    integral_mul_const, add_zero] at hle
  exact hle

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (s e : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => Real.exp (s * (e *
      (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
        ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν))))
      (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let μ := Measure.pi ν
  let X : (ι → Ω) → Matrix n n ℂ := fun x => A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)
  let f : (ι → Ω) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (resolvent (X x) ζ)
  have hXm : Measurable X := by dsimp [X]; fun_prop
  have hfm : Measurable f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_def] using
      ((measurable_matrix_resolvent ζ).comp hXm).norm
  have hgood : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, (Z i (x i)).IsHermitian :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZH i)
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |f x| ≤ |ζ.im|⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [hgood] with x hx
    have hH : (X x).IsHermitian := hA₀.add (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hx i))
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
    exact hH.specNorm_resolvent_le hζ
  have hcb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |e * (f x - ∫ y, f y ∂μ)| ≤
      |e| * (|ζ.im|⁻¹ + |∫ y, f y ∂μ|) := by
    filter_upwards [hbound] with x hx
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((abs_sub (f x) (∫ y, f y ∂μ)).trans (add_le_add hx le_rfl)) (abs_nonneg e)
  exact integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc ((hfm.sub measurable_const).const_mul e).aemeasurable
    (hcb.mono fun x hx => abs_le.mp hx)

name: NLAlib.resolvent_sign_subgamma_mgf
statement:
private theorem resolvent_sign_subgamma_mgf
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hdom : Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s < 1)
    {e : ℝ} (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, Real.exp (s * (e *
      (specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
        ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν)))
      ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      (1 : ℝ) * Real.exp ((12 * ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) * s ^ 2 /
        (2 * (1 - Real.sqrt (6 *
          (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * s)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
    ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hR hZH hZB ζ hζ hs hdom he
  apply h.trans_eq
  rw [one_mul]
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_abs_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (A₀ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (Measure.pi ν).real {x | Real.sqrt
      (24 * (∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
        resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
          ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))) * t) +
      Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)) * t <
        |specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ) -
          ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-t)
proof:
:= by
  let E := ∫ q : (ι → Ω) × (ι → Ω),
    resolventVarianceProxy (fun i => Z i (q.1 i) - Z i (q.2 i)) Finset.univ R |ζ.im|
      ∂((Measure.pi ν).prod (Measure.pi ν))
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := integral_nonneg fun _ =>
    matrixVarianceProxy_nonneg _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have h := measureReal_gt_abs_sub_sqrt_add_le_of_sign_subgamma_mgf
    (μ := Measure.pi ν)
    (X := fun x => specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (x i)) ζ))
    (m := ∫ y : ι → Ω, specNorm (resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, Z i (y i)) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (d := 1) (V := 12 * E)
    (c := Real.sqrt (6 * (16 * R ^ 2 / |ζ.im| ^ 4 + 64 * R ^ 4 / |ζ.im| ^ 6)))
    (by norm_num) (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (fun e _ s _ _ => integrable_exp_sign_mul_centered_specNorm_resolvent_pi
      ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hZH ζ hζ s e)
    (fun e he s hs hdom => resolvent_sign_subgamma_mgf
      ν A₀ hA₀ Z hZm hR hZH hZB ζ hζ hs hdom he) ht
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * (12 * E) * t) = Real.sqrt (24 * E * t) := by
    congr 1
    ring
  simpa only [hsqrt, E, mul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.bernsteinTail_le_exp_at_four_sqrt_add
statement:
private theorem bernsteinTail_le_exp_at_four_sqrt_add
    {v R σ s : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hscale : 0 < σ+R) (hvariance : v ≤ σ^2) (d : ℕ) :
    bernsteinTail d v R (4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s) ≤ (d : ℝ)*Real.exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  let t := 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    have hh : 0 < σ ∨ 0 < R := by
      by_cases hpos : 0 < σ
      · exact Or.inl hpos
      · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
    rcases hh with hh | hh <;> dsimp [t] <;> positivity
  have hden : 0 ≤ v+R*t/3 := by positivity
  change bernsteinTail d v R t ≤ _
  by_cases hzero : v+R*t/3 = 0
  · rw [bernsteinTail, if_pos hzero, if_neg ht.ne']
    positivity
  · have hdenpos : 0 < v+R*t/3 := lt_of_le_of_ne hden (Ne.symm hzero)
    have htsq : t^2 = 16*σ^2*s+32*σ*R*s*Real.sqrt s+16*R^2*s^2 := by
      calc
        _ = 16*σ^2*(Real.sqrt s)^2+32*σ*R*s*Real.sqrt s+16*R^2*s^2 := by
          dsimp [t]
          ring
        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hs.le]
    have hexpand : 2*s*(v+R*t/3) =
        2*s*v+(8/3)*σ*R*s*Real.sqrt s+(8/3)*R^2*s^2 := by dsimp [t]; ring
    have hquad : 2*s*(v+R*t/3) ≤ t^2 := by
      rw [htsq, hexpand]
      have hv' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvariance
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hs.le)
      have h1 : 0 ≤ σ^2*s := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hs.le
      have h2 : 0 ≤ σ*R*s*Real.sqrt s := by positivity
      have h3 : 0 ≤ R^2*s^2 := by positivity
      nlinarith only [hv', h1, h2, h3]
    rw [bernsteinTail, if_neg hzero]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).mpr
    nlinarith only [hquad]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sum_pi_gt_four_sqrt_add_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sum_pi_gt_four_sqrt_add_le
    {ι n Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R σ s : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hs : 0 < s) (hscale : 0 < σ+R)
    (hZH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, (Z i ω).IsHermitian)
    (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : specNorm (∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i) ≤ σ^2) :
    (Measure.pi ν).real {x : ι → Ω |
      4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s < specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i))} ≤
        (2*Fintype.card n : ℝ)*Real.exp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Y (i : ι) (x : ι → Ω) := Z i (x i)
  have hYm : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i) := fun i => (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hYH : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, (Y i x).IsHermitian := fun i =>
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZH i)
  have hYB : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, specNorm (Y i x) ≤ R := fun i =>
    (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hZ i)
  have hYmean : ∀ i, ∫ x, Y i x ∂Measure.pi ν = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [show (∫ x, Y i x ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i from
      integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i) (hZm i).aestronglyMeasurable, hmean]
  have hYsq : (∑ i, ∫ x, Y i x^2 ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∑ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω^2 ∂ν i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simpa only [Y, pow_two] using integral_comp_eval (μ := ν) (i := i)
      ((hZm i).matrix_mul (hZm i)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have ht : 0 ≤ 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s := by positivity
  have hraw := (integral_and_measureReal_specNorm_sum_le_bernstein_hermitian
    (Measure.pi ν) Y hR hYm (iIndepFun_pi fun i => (hZm i).aemeasurable)
      hYH hYB hYmean).2 _ ht
  rw [hYsq] at hraw
  have hsub : {x : ι → Ω | 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s < specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i))} ⊆
      {x : ι → Ω | 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Y i x)} := by
    intro x hx
    change 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s < specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) at hx
    change 4*σ*Real.sqrt s+4*R*s ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i))
    exact hx.le
  apply (measureReal_mono (μ := Measure.pi ν) hsub).trans (hraw.trans ?_)
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    bernsteinTail_le_exp_at_four_sqrt_add (specNorm_nonneg _) hR hσ hs hscale hvariance
      (2*Fintype.card n)

name: NLAlib.lintegral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_le_gaussianTraceInflation_sum
statement:
theorem lintegral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_le_gaussianTraceInflation_sum
    {N : ℕ} (ν γ : Fin N → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    [∀ i, IsGaussian (γ i)]
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ W, matrixRealCoordinates W ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (hγHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ i, Z.IsHermitian)
    (hγmean : ∀ i, (∫ Z, Z ∂γ i) = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i a b,
      cov[fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W a, fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W b; ν i] =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; γ i])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    (∫⁻ W, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (A + θ • ∑ i, W i)) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫⁻ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • ∑ i, Z i))
        ∂Measure.pi γ
proof:
:= by
  let g := gaussianTraceInflation R θ
  have hstep (i : Fin N) (B : M) (hB : B ∈ selfAdjoint M) :
      (∫⁻ W, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (B + θ • W)) ∂ν i) ≤
        ∫⁻ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (B + g • Z)) ∂γ i := by
    change B.IsHermitian at hB
    have hθHerm : ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, (θ • W).IsHermitian :=
      (hνHerm i).mono fun W hW => hW.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)
    have hθbound : ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, θ • W ≤ (θ * R) • (1 : M) := by
      filter_upwards [hbound i] with W hW
      simpa only [smul_smul] using Matrix.matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg hW hθ
    have hiW : Integrable (fun W : M => traceExp (B + θ • W)) (ν i) :=
      integrable_traceExp_add_of_ae_upper_bound B hB
        (show Continuous (fun W : M => θ • W) from by fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
        hθHerm hθbound
    have hiZ := integrable_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian (γ i) B hB (hγHerm i) g
    have hnW : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν i] (fun W => traceExp (B + θ • W)) :=
      hθHerm.mono fun W hW => traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hB.add hW)
    have hnZ : 0 ≤ᵐ[γ i] (fun Z => traceExp (B + g • Z)) :=
      (hγHerm i).mono fun Z hZ =>
        traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hB.add (hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all g)))
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hiW hnW,
      ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hiZ hnZ]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      (integral_traceExp_add_smul_le_integral_traceExp_add_gaussianTraceInflation
        B hB (hν2 i) (hνmean i) (hνHerm i) (hbound i) (γ i) (hγHerm i) (hγmean i)
        (hcov i) hθ)
  have h := lintegral_add_sum_apply_pi_le_of_lintegral_add_apply_le ν γ
    (selfAdjoint M) (fun _ W => θ • W) (fun _ Z => g • Z)
    (fun _ => by fun_prop) (fun _ => by fun_prop)
    (fun i => (hνHerm i).mono fun W hW => hW.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ))
    (fun i => (hγHerm i).mono fun Z hZ => hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all g))
    (fun B => ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp B))
    (by exact ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp continuous_traceExp.measurable)
    hstep A hA
  simpa only [← Finset.smul_sum] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_pi_le_gaussianTraceInflation
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_pi_le_gaussianTraceInflation
    {N : ℕ} (ν : Fin N → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ W, W ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ W ∂ν i, W ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ]
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂ρ, Z.IsHermitian) (hρmean : (∫ Z, Z ∂ρ) = 0)
    (hρcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W a, fun W => matrixRealCoordinates W b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z a, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z b; ρ])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    (∫ W, traceExp (A + θ • ∑ i, W i) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ Z, traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z) ∂ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose γ hγ hγmean hγHerm hγcov using fun i =>
    exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq
      (ν i) (hν2 i) (hνmean i) (hνHerm i)
  let (i : Fin N) : IsGaussian (γ i) := hγ i
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  have hνint (i : Fin N) : Integrable (fun W : M => W) (ν i) := by
    have hi := C.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' (hν2 i)
    have he (W : M) : C.symm (matrixRealCoordinates W) = W :=
      matrixRealCoordinates.symm_apply_apply W
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using
      hi.integrable one_le_two
  have hνcoordsmean (i : Fin N) : (∫ W, matrixRealCoordinates W ∂ν i) = 0 := by
    change (∫ W, C W ∂ν i) = 0
    have hc := C.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (hνint i)
    change (∫ W, C W ∂ν i) = C (∫ W, W ∂ν i) at hc
    rw [hc, hνmean i, map_zero]
  have hmap : (Measure.pi γ).map (fun Z : Fin N → M => ∑ i, Z i) = ρ := by
    apply map_sum_pi_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq γ ρ hγmean hρmean
    intro a b
    simpa only [hγcov] using hρcov a b
  have hlin := lintegral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_le_gaussianTraceInflation_sum
    ν γ hν2 hνcoordsmean hνHerm hbound hγHerm hγmean
    (fun i a b => (hγcov i a b).symm) A hA hθ
  have hright : (∫⁻ Z, ENNReal.ofReal
      (traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • ∑ i, Z i)) ∂Measure.pi γ) =
      ∫⁻ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z)) ∂ρ := by
    rw [← hmap]
    symm
    exact lintegral_map
      (f := fun Z : M => ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z)))
      (g := fun Z : Fin N → M => ∑ i, Z i)
      (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
        (continuous_traceExp.comp (by fun_prop)).measurable) (by fun_prop)
  rw [hright] at hlin
  have hnleft : 0 ≤ᵐ[Measure.pi ν] (fun W : Fin N → M => traceExp (A + θ • ∑ i, W i)) := by
    have hs : ∀ᵐ W ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (W i).IsHermitian :=
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := ν)).eventually (hνHerm i))
    filter_upwards [hs] with W hW
    have hsum : (∑ i, W i).IsHermitian := by
      change (∑ i, W i)ᴴ = ∑ i, W i
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hW i)
    exact traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _ (hA.add (hsum.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)))
  have hnright : 0 ≤ᵐ[ρ] (fun Z => traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z)) :=
    hρHerm.mono fun Z hZ => traceExp_nonneg_of_isHermitian _
      (hA.add (hZ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)))
  have hiright := integrable_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian ρ A hA hρHerm
    (gaussianTraceInflation R θ)
  have hfinite : (∫⁻ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z)) ∂ρ) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hiright hnright]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnleft
      (continuous_traceExp.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnright hiright.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite hlin

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_smul_sum_add_le_gaussianTraceInflation_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_smul_sum_add_le_gaussianTraceInflation_of_hasLaw
    {N : ℕ} {Ω Ω' : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {Q : Measure Ω'}
    (W : Fin N → Ω → M) (ν : Fin N → Measure M)
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ H, H ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H.IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (Z : Ω' → M) (ρ : Measure M) [IsGaussian ρ] (hZ : HasLaw Z ρ Q)
    (hρHerm : ∀ᵐ H ∂ρ, H.IsHermitian) (hρmean : (∫ H, H ∂ρ) = 0)
    (hρcov : ∀ a b,
      (∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i]) =
        cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ρ])
    (Δ : M) (hΔ : Δ.IsHermitian) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (θ • ((∑ i, W i ω) + Δ)) ∂P) ≤
      ∫ ω, traceExp (gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z ω + θ • Δ) ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  let (i : Fin N) : IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i) :=
    (hW i).isProbabilityMeasure_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hleft := (hind.hasLaw_pi hW).integral_comp
    (f := fun x : Fin N → M => traceExp (θ • Δ + θ • ∑ i, x i))
      (continuous_traceExp.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hright := hZ.integral_comp
    (f := fun H : M => traceExp (θ • Δ + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • H))
      (continuous_traceExp.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := integral_traceExp_add_smul_sum_pi_le_gaussianTraceInflation
    ν hν2 hνmean hνHerm hbound ρ hρHerm hρmean hρcov
    (θ • Δ) (hΔ.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)) hθ
  rw [← hleft, ← hright] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, smul_add, add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_pow_le_of_polynomial_recursion
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_pow_le_of_polynomial_recursion
    (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hV : V.PosSemidef) (Y : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hM : Integrable (fun ω => (Y ω ^ (2 * p)).trace.re) μ)
    (hW : Integrable (fun ω => (V * Y ω ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re) μ)
    (hrec : (∫ ω, (Y ω ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) * ∫ ω, (V * Y ω ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re ∂μ) :
    (∫ ω, (Y ω ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * (V ^ p).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      (p : ℝ) * (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) * (V * Y ω ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * (V ^ p).trace.re +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * (Y ω ^ (2 * p)).trace.re :=
    hY.mono fun ω hω => nat_mul_mul_re_trace_mul_pow_le V (Y ω) hV hω hp
  have hi := integral_mono_ae (hW.const_mul ((p : ℝ) * (2 * p - 1 : ℕ)))
    ((integrable_const _).add (hM.const_mul (p - 1 : ℕ))) hpoint
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (integrable_const _)
    (hM.const_mul (p - 1 : ℕ)), integral_const, integral_const_mul] at hi
  simp only [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] at hi
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrec (Nat.cast_nonneg p : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p)
  have hcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) - 1 := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using (Nat.cast_sub (R := ℝ) hp)
  rw [hcast] at hi
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_sampleCons

name: NLAlib.hasFiniteNatMoments_coordinate_of_dotProduct
statement:
theorem hasFiniteNatMoments_coordinate_of_dotProduct {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ) (a : Fin r) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => y ω a) μ
proof:
:= by
  have heven (p : ℕ) : Integrable (fun ω => y ω a ^ (2 * p)) μ := by
    apply (hmom p).mono' (((measurable_pi_apply a).comp hy).pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    change ‖y ω a ^ (2 * p)‖ ≤ (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ((even_two_mul p).pow_nonneg _)]
    have hs : (y ω a) ^ 2 ≤ y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω := by
      simpa only [dotProduct, pow_two] using
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => mul_self_nonneg (y ω j))
          (Finset.mem_univ a)
    simpa only [← pow_mul] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (sq_nonneg (y ω a)) hs p
  intro p
  apply ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).add (heven p)).mono'
    (((measurable_pi_apply a).comp hy).pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  change ‖y ω a ^ p‖ ≤ 1 + y ω a ^ (2 * p)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have he : y ω a ^ (2 * p) = |y ω a ^ p| ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq_abs, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm p 2]
  rw [he]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|y ω a ^ p| - 1)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum
statement:
theorem integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ) (n p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω ^ p).trace)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord (a : Fin r) := hasFiniteNatMoments_coordinate_of_dotProduct hy hmom a
  have hentry (i j : Fin r) :
      HasFiniteNatMoments (fun ω => centeredRankOneCovariance (y ω) i j) μ := by
    simpa only [centeredRankOneCovariance, Matrix.sub_apply, vecMulVec_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
      using ((hcoord i).mul (hcoord j)).add (hasFiniteNatMoments_const (-(1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) i j))
  have hsum (i j : Fin r) : HasFiniteNatMoments
      (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => rankOneCovarianceSum y ω i j)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ) := by
    simp only [rankOneCovarianceSum, Matrix.sum_apply]
    exact HasFiniteNatMoments.sum Finset.univ fun a _ =>
      (hentry i j).comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin n => μ) a)
  exact (HasFiniteNatMoments.trace_matrix_pow hsum p).integrable

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_pow_covarianceSum_succ
statement:
private theorem integral_trace_pow_covarianceSum_succ {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ) (n p : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin (n + 1) → Ω, (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω ^ p).trace
      ∂Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => μ) =
    ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, ∫ v, ((rankOneCovarianceSum y ω + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ p).trace
      ∂μ ∂Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (measurePreserving_sampleCons μ n).integral_comp
    (measurableEmbedding_sampleCons n)]
  have hi := (measurePreserving_sampleCons μ n).integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom (n + 1) p)
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def] at hi
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with v
  rw [rankOneCovarianceSum_cons]

name: NLAlib.rankOneCovarianceMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem rankOneCovarianceMoment_nonneg (y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) (n p : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold rankOneCovarianceMoment
  exact div_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun ω =>
    trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul p))
    (Nat.cast_nonneg r)

theorem rankOneCovarianceMoment_zero {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

statement:

name: NLAlib.integrable_covarianceMomentEnvelope
statement:
private theorem integrable_covarianceMomentEnvelope {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ) (n k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => covarianceMomentEnvelope (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) k)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom n _).div_const r).sqrt_mul_sqrt
    ((integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom n _).div_const r)
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
      (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
      (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg r))

name: NLAlib.integral_covarianceMomentEnvelope_le
statement:
private theorem integral_covarianceMomentEnvelope_le {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ) (n k : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, covarianceMomentEnvelope (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) k
      ∂Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ) ≤ evenMomentInterpolation (rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ n) k
proof:
:= by
  have hb := integral_sqrt_mul_sqrt_le
    ((integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom n (2 * (k / 2))).div_const r)
    ((integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom n (2 * ((k + 1) / 2))).div_const r)
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
      (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
    (fun ω => div_nonneg (trace_pow_nonneg_of_even
      (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul _)) (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
  simpa only [covarianceMomentEnvelope, evenMomentInterpolation, rankOneCovarianceMoment,
    integral_div] using hb

name: NLAlib.rankOneCovarianceMoment_succ_le
statement:
theorem rankOneCovarianceMoment_succ_le {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ)
    (hr : 0 < r) {ν R : ℝ} (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (n p : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ, A.IsHermitian →
      (∫ v, ((A + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (A ^ (2 * p)).trace + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ k *
            (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (2 * p - (k + 2))) A).trace) :
    rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ (n + 1) p ≤
      rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ n p + finiteMomentUpdate ν R (rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ n) p
proof:
:= by
  let C (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
    ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ k
  have hC (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ C k := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hpoint (ω : Fin n → Ω) :
      (∫ v, ((rankOneCovarianceSum y ω + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) / r ≤
      (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω ^ (2 * p)).trace / r +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1), C k *
          covarianceMomentEnvelope (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (2 * p - (k + 2)) := by
    have ha := isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω
    have hb := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hstep _ ha) (Nat.cast_nonneg r)
    rw [add_div, Finset.sum_div] at hb
    apply hb.trans
    apply add_le_add le_rfl
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    rw [mul_div_assoc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (div_trace_cfc_abs_pow_le_sqrt_div_trace_even_pow ha _ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < r)) (hC k)
  have hi := (measurePreserving_sampleCons μ n).integrable_comp_of_integrable
    (integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom (n + 1) (2 * p))
  have hint : Integrable (fun ω : Fin n → Ω =>
      (∫ v, ((rankOneCovarianceSum y ω + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) / r)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, rankOneCovarianceSum_cons] using
      hi.integral_prod_right.div_const (r : ℝ)
  have henv := fun k => integrable_covarianceMomentEnvelope hy hmom n (2 * p - (k + 2))
  have hs := integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range (2 * p - 1))
    (fun k _ => (henv k).const_mul (C k))
  have hbase := (integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom n (2 * p)).div_const (r : ℝ)
  have hmono := integral_mono hint (hbase.add hs) hpoint
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hmono
  rw [integral_add hbase hs, integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (henv k).const_mul (C k))] at hmono
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul] at hmono
  simp only [integral_div] at hmono
  have henvbound :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1), C k *
        ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω, covarianceMomentEnvelope (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)
          (2 * p - (k + 2)) ∂Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ) ≤
      finiteMomentUpdate ν R (rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ n) p := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_covarianceMomentEnvelope_le hy hmom n _) (hC k)
  calc
    rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ (n + 1) p =
        ∫ ω : Fin n → Ω,
          (∫ v, ((rankOneCovarianceSum y ω + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) / r
          ∂Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => μ := by
      rw [rankOneCovarianceMoment, integral_trace_pow_covarianceSum_succ hy hmom, integral_div]
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [integral_div]
      exact hmono.trans (add_le_add le_rfl henvbound)

name: NLAlib.rankOneCovarianceMoment_le_sqrt_add_mul_pow
statement:
theorem rankOneCovarianceMoment_le_sqrt_add_mul_pow {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ)
    (hr : 0 < r) {ν R : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) {q m : ℕ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hstep : ∀ p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q → ∀ A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ, A.IsHermitian →
      (∫ v, ((A + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (A ^ (2 * p)).trace + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ k *
            (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (2 * p - (k + 2))) A).trace) :
    rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ m q ≤
      (2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * ν * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * R) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_sqrt_add_mul_pow_of_finiteMomentUpdate hν hR hq hm
    (rankOneCovarianceMoment_nonneg y μ)
    (rankOneCovarianceMoment_zero y hr)
  · intro p hp _
    exact rankOneCovarianceMoment_zero_samples y μ (by omega)
  · intro n p hp hpq
    exact rankOneCovarianceMoment_succ_le hy hmom hr hν.le hR n p (hstep p hp hpq)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_specNorm_rankOneCovarianceSum_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_specNorm_rankOneCovarianceSum_le {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ)
    {m q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => μ).real {ω | t < specNorm (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)} ≤
      (r : ℝ) * rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ m q / t ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  let μm := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => μ
  have hi := integrable_trace_pow_rankOneCovarianceSum hy hmom m (2 * q)
  have hnonneg (ω : Fin m → Ω) :=
    trace_pow_nonneg_of_even (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) (even_two_mul q)
  have hevent : {ω : Fin m → Ω | t < specNorm (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)} ⊆
      {ω | t ^ (2 * q) ≤ (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω ^ (2 * q)).trace} := by
    intro ω hω
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ ht.le hω.le _).trans
      (specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_trace_pow (isHermitian_rankOneCovarianceSum y ω) hq)
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnonneg) hi (t ^ (2 * q))
  have hprob := measureReal_mono (μ := μm) hevent
  have hmul := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprob (pow_nonneg ht.le (2 * q))).trans hm
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos ht (2 * q))).2
  rw [mul_comm]
  have htrace : (∫ ω : Fin m → Ω, (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω ^ (2 * q)).trace ∂μm) =
      (r : ℝ) * rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ m q := by
    by_cases hr : r = 0
    · subst r
      simp [Matrix.trace, rankOneCovarianceMoment]
    · unfold rankOneCovarianceMoment
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by exact_mod_cast hr : (r : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
  rw [← htrace]
  exact hmul

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lt_specNorm_smul_rankOneCovarianceSum_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_lt_specNorm_smul_rankOneCovarianceSum_le {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {y : Ω → Fin r → ℝ} (hy : Measurable y)
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p) μ)
    (hr : 0 < r) {ν R : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) {q m : ℕ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hm : 1 ≤ m) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hstep : ∀ p, 1 ≤ p → p ≤ q → ∀ A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ, A.IsHermitian →
      (∫ v, ((A + centeredRankOneCovariance (y v)) ^ (2 * p)).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (A ^ (2 * p)).trace + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * p - 1),
          ((2 * p).choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ k *
            (cfc (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (2 * p - (k + 2))) A).trace) :
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => μ).real
      {ω | ε < specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)} ≤
      (r : ℝ) * ((2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * ν * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * R) /
        ((m : ℝ) * ε)) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hm
  have he : {ω : Fin m → Ω | ε < specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)} =
      {ω | (m : ℝ) * ε < specNorm (rankOneCovarianceSum y ω)} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hmR.le)]
    exact lt_inv_mul_iff₀ hmR
  rw [he]
  have hbar := rankOneCovarianceMoment_le_sqrt_add_mul_pow hy hmom hr hν hR hq hm hstep
  calc
    _ ≤ (r : ℝ) * rankOneCovarianceMoment y μ m q / ((m : ℝ) * ε) ^ (2 * q) :=
      measureReal_lt_specNorm_rankOneCovarianceSum_le hy hmom (by omega) (mul_pos hmR hε)
    _ ≤ (r : ℝ) * (2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * ν * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * R) ^ (2 * q) /
        ((m : ℝ) * ε) ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbar (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
        (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg hmR.le hε.le) _)
    _ = _ := by rw [div_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_mem
statement:
private lemma lambdaMax_mem {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) : ∃ i, hB.eigenvalues i = lambdaMax B
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (Set.range hB.eigenvalues).Nonempty := Set.range_nonempty _
  have hf : (Set.range hB.eigenvalues).Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have hmax : lambdaMax B ∈ Set.range hB.eigenvalues := by
    simpa only [lambdaMax, hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] using hn.csSup_mem hf
  exact hmax

name: NLAlib.eig_le_lambdaMax
statement:
private lemma eig_le_lambdaMax {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (B : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : Fin d) : hB.eigenvalues i ≤ lambdaMax B
proof:
:= by
  unfold lambdaMax
  rw [hB.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  exact le_csSup (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove (Set.mem_range_self i)

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_eq_norm
statement:
private lemma lambdaMax_eq_norm {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (P : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hP : P.PosSemidef) : lambdaMax P = ‖P‖
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hP.isHermitian
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := lambdaMax_mem P hA
    rw [← hi]
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_le_norm_of_mem_spectrum P (hA.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i))
  · have hbdd : BddAbove (spectrum ℝ P) := by
      rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]; exact (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
    rcases CStarAlgebra.norm_or_neg_norm_mem_spectrum (hA : IsSelfAdjoint P) with h | h
    · exact le_csSup hbdd h
    · have h1 : -‖P‖ ≤ lambdaMax P := le_csSup hbdd h
      rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      have h2 := hP.eigenvalues_nonneg i
      rw [hi] at h2
      have h3 : ‖P‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [h3] at h1 ⊢
      linarith

name: NLAlib.intrinsic_ge_one
statement:
private lemma intrinsic_ge_one {d : ℕ} [NeZero d] (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (hP : M.PosSemidef) (hM : M ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ intrinsicDimension M
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hP.isHermitian
  have htr : (Matrix.trace M).re = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i := by
    rw [hA.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues]; simp
  have hn : 0 < ‖M‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hM
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := lambdaMax_mem M hA
  have hle : ‖M‖ ≤ ∑ j, hA.eigenvalues j := by
    rw [← lambdaMax_eq_norm M hP, ← hi]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hP.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  unfold intrinsicDimension
  rw [htr, le_div_iff₀ hn, one_mul]
  exact hle

name: NLAlib.W_facts
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hP.isHermitian
  have e : traceExp (c • B) - d = ∑ i, (Real.exp (c * hA.eigenvalues i) - 1) := by
    rw [traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hA c, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; simp
  have hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ Real.exp (c * hA.eigenvalues i) - 1 := fun i => by
    have := Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hc (hP.eigenvalues_nonneg i)); linarith
  rw [e]
  refine ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn i), ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := lambdaMax_mem B hA
  rw [← hi]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnn j) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.traceFunction_psi
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hP.isHermitian
  rw [traceFunction_eq_sum _ B hA, traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hA c]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => max_eq_right
    (sub_nonneg.2 (Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hc (hP.eigenvalues_nonneg i)))))]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; simp

name: NLAlib.traceFunction_expm1
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceFunction_eq_sum _ B hA, traceExp_smul_eq_sum B hA c, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
