  simp

name: NLAlib.expm1_convex
statement:
private lemma expm1_convex (g : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (g * x) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, fun x _ y _ a b ha hb hab => ?_⟩
  have h := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (g * x)) (Set.mem_univ (g * y)) ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
  have e : g * (a * x + b * y) = a * (g * x) + b * (g * y) := by ring
  rw [e]
  calc Real.exp (a * (g * x) + b * (g * y)) - 1
      ≤ a * Real.exp (g * x) + b * Real.exp (g * y) - 1 := by linarith
    _ = a * (Real.exp (g * x) - 1) + b * (Real.exp (g * y) - 1) := by linear_combination hab

name: NLAlib.log1p_concave
statement:
private lemma log1p_concave :
    ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (1 + u))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab => ?_⟩
  have hx' : (1 + x) ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]; simp only [Set.mem_Ici] at hx; linarith
  have hy' : (1 + y) ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]; simp only [Set.mem_Ici] at hy; linarith
  have h := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn.2 hx' hy' ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
  have e : a * (1 + x) + b * (1 + y) = 1 + (a * x + b * y) := by linear_combination hab
  rw [e] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_chernoff_package
statement:
private lemma NLAlib.intrinsic_matrix_chernoff_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hM : M ≠ 0)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
    (hMeanBound : (∫ ω, ∑ k, X k ω ∂μ) ≤ M) :
    let Y
proof:
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let r := intrinsicDimension M
    let a := lambdaMax M
    (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * a + L / θ * Real.log (2 * r)) ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, L / a ≤ ε →
      μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * a ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
        2 * r * Real.exp (a / L * (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε))) := by
  intro Y r a
  
  have hXnorm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖X k ω‖ ≤ L := fun k => by
    filter_upwards [hPSD k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2
    rw [← lambdaMax_eq_norm _ h1]; exact h2
  have hXInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k =>
    Integrable.of_bound (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable L (hXnorm k)
  have hXHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian := fun k =>
    (hPSD k).mono fun ω h => h.isHermitian
  have hYMeas : Measurable Y := Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  have hYPSD : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).PosSemidef := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hPSD] with ω h
    exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => h k)
  have hYnorm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖Y ω‖ ≤ N * L := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hXnorm] with ω h
    calc ‖Y ω‖ ≤ ∑ k, ‖X k ω‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin N, L := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h k)
      _ = N * L := by simp
  have hInt1 : (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ :=
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXInt k)
  have hIntPSD : (∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    have h0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) ≤ Y ω :=
      hYPSD.mono fun ω h => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr h
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (integral_nonneg_of_ae h0)
  have hMPSD : M.PosSemidef := by
    have h := hMeanBound.add hIntPSD
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h
  have ha : a = ‖M‖ := lambdaMax_eq_norm M hMPSD
  have hapos : 0 < a := ha ▸ norm_pos_iff.mpr hM
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := intrinsic_ge_one M hMPSD hM
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := zero_le_one.trans hr1
  
  let _ : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
    NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
  have hcontExp : ∀ c : ℝ, Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (c • A)) := by
    intro c
    dsimp [matrixExp]
    fun_prop
  have hcontTr : ∀ c : ℝ, Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => traceExp (c • A)) := by
    intro c
    unfold traceExp
    exact Complex.continuous_re.comp ((continuous_id.matrix_trace).comp (hcontExp c))
  
  have key : ∀ θ' : ℝ, 0 < θ' →
      Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d) ∂μ) ≤
        r * Real.exp (chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ' * a) := by
    intro θ' hθ'
    set g := chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ' with hg_def
    have hg : g = (Real.exp (θ' * L) - 1) / L := by
      rw [hg_def, chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne']
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g := by
      rw [hg]
      exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hθ'.le hL.le))) hL.le
    have hTInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ' • Y ω)) μ := by
      refine Integrable.of_bound ((hcontTr θ').comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        hYMeas.aestronglyMeasurable) (d * Real.exp (θ' * (N * L))) ?_
      filter_upwards [hYPSD, hYnorm] with ω h1 h2
      have hnn : 0 ≤ traceExp (θ' • Y ω) := by
        have := (W_facts _ h1 hθ'.le).1; have : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := by positivity
        linarith
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnn, traceExp_smul_eq_sum _ h1.isHermitian]
      calc ∑ i, Real.exp (θ' * h1.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin d, Real.exp (θ' * (N * L)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i _
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hθ'.le
            exact ((le_abs_self _).trans (abs_le_norm_of_mem_spectrum _
              (h1.isHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i))).trans h2
        _ = d * Real.exp (θ' * (N * L)) := by simp
    have hWInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d) μ :=
      hTInt.sub (integrable_const _)
    refine ⟨hWInt, ?_⟩
    have hExp : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ' • X k ω)) μ := by
      intro k
      refine Integrable.of_bound ((hcontExp θ').comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable) (Real.exp (|θ'| * L)) ?_
      filter_upwards [hXHerm k, hXnorm k] with ω h1 h2
      exact (norm_exp_le _ h1 θ').trans
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)))
    have hsub := trace_cgf_subadditivity μ X θ' hMeas hXHerm hIndep hExp
    have e1 : (fun ω => traceExp (∑ k, θ' • X k ω)) = fun ω => traceExp (θ' • Y ω) := by
      funext ω
      simp only [Y, Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [e1] at hsub
    have hk : ∀ k, (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ' • X k ω) ∂μ)) ≤
        (g • ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) := by
      intro k
      have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (X k ω) ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L := by
        filter_upwards [hPSD k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2
        exact ⟨lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef h1, h2⟩
      exact (chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L hL.le (hMeas k) (hXHerm k) hb θ').2
    have hsum : (cumulantSum μ X θ') ≤ (g • ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) := by
      unfold cumulantSum
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k)
    rw [← hInt1] at hsum
    have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ X θ').IsHermitian :=
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
    have hgYH : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ).IsHermitian :=
      hIntPSD.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))
    have hgMH : (g • M).IsHermitian :=
      hMPSD.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))
    have hle2 : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ) ≤ (g • M) := by
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [← smul_sub]
      exact Matrix.PosSemidef.smul hMeanBound hg0
    have hT : (∫ ω, traceExp (θ' • Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ traceExp (g • M) :=
      hsub.trans ((traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcumH hgYH hsum).trans
        (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hgYH hgMH hle2))
    have hID := traceFunction_le_intrinsicDimension_mul (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1)
      (expm1_convex g) (by simp) M hMPSD
    rw [traceFunction_expm1 M hMPSD.isHermitian g] at hID
    have hE : (∫ ω, (traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d) ∂μ) = (∫ ω, traceExp (θ' • Y ω) ∂μ) - d := by
      rw [integral_sub hTInt (integrable_const _)]
      simp
    rw [hE]
    calc (∫ ω, traceExp (θ' • Y ω) ∂μ) - d ≤ traceExp (g • M) - d := by linarith
      _ ≤ r * (Real.exp (g * a) - 1) := by
        have : ‖M‖ = a := ha.symm
        rw [this] at hID
        exact hID
      _ ≤ r * Real.exp (g * a) := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨hInt1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro θ hθ
    set θ' := θ / L with hθ'_def
    have hθ' : 0 < θ' := div_pos hθ hL
    obtain ⟨hWInt, hWle⟩ := key θ' hθ'
    set g := chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ' with hg_def
    have hg : g = (Real.exp θ - 1) / L := by
      rw [hg_def, chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne', hθ'_def, div_mul_cancel₀ θ hL.ne']
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g := by
      rw [hg]; exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (Real.one_le_exp hθ.le)) hL.le
    set W := fun ω => traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d with hW_def
    have hW0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ W ω := hYPSD.mono fun ω h => (W_facts _ h hθ'.le).1
    have hlogInt : Integrable (fun ω => Real.log (1 + W ω)) μ := by
      refine hWInt.mono' ?_ ?_
      · exact (Real.measurable_log.comp_aemeasurable
          (hWInt.aemeasurable.const_add 1)).aestronglyMeasurable
      · filter_upwards [hW0] with ω h
        have h1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + W ω) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
        have h2 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1 + W ω by linarith)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h1]
        linarith
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (Y ω) ≤ Real.log (1 + W ω) / θ' := by
      filter_upwards [hYPSD] with ω h
      have h1 := (W_facts _ h hθ'.le).2
      have h2 : Real.exp (θ' * lambdaMax (Y ω)) ≤ 1 + W ω := by
        simp only [hW_def]; linarith
      have h3 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h2
      rw [Real.log_exp] at h3
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hθ']
      linarith
    have hnn : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, 0 ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω) := by
      filter_upwards [hYPSD] with ω h
      rw [lambdaMax_eq_norm _ h]; exact norm_nonneg _
    have hstep1 : (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, Real.log (1 + W ω) / θ' ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg hnn (hlogInt.div_const θ') hpt
    rw [integral_div] at hstep1
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (1 + u)) (Set.Ici 0) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.log (continuousOn_const.add continuousOn_id)
      intro x hx
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x := by simp only [Set.mem_Ici] at hx; linarith
      exact h0.ne'
    have hm : (∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) := integral_nonneg_of_ae hW0
    have hJ := ConcaveOn.le_map_integral_of_integral_mem μ (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) (fun u => Real.log (1 + u)) W
      log1p_concave hcont hW0 hWInt hlogInt hm
    have hEa : 0 ≤ g * a := mul_nonneg hg0 hapos.le
    have h1 : 1 ≤ r * Real.exp (g * a) := by
      have := Real.one_le_exp hEa
      nlinarith
    have hm' : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, W ω ∂μ := hm
    have hlog2 : Real.log (1 + ∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (2 * r) + g * a := by
      calc Real.log (1 + ∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) ≤ Real.log (2 * r * Real.exp (g * a)) := by
            apply Real.log_le_log (by linarith)
            have : (∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) ≤ r * Real.exp (g * a) := hWle
            linarith
        _ = Real.log (2 * r) + g * a := by
            rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
    calc (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ (∫ ω, Real.log (1 + W ω) ∂μ) / θ' := hstep1
      _ ≤ Real.log (1 + ∫ ω, W ω ∂μ) / θ' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hJ hθ'.le
      _ ≤ (Real.log (2 * r) + g * a) / θ' := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog2 hθ'.le
      _ = (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * a + L / θ * Real.log (2 * r) := by
          rw [hg, hθ'_def]
          field_simp
          ring
  · 
    intro ε hε
    have hεa : L ≤ ε * a := by rwa [div_le_iff₀ hapos] at hε
    have hε0 : 0 < ε := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      nlinarith
    have h1ε : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
    set θ' := Real.log (1 + ε) / L with hθ'_def
    have hθ' : 0 < θ' := div_pos (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) hL
    obtain ⟨hWInt, hWle⟩ := key θ' hθ'
    have hg : chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ' = ε / L := by
      rw [chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne', hθ'_def, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL.ne',
        Real.exp_log h1ε]
      ring
    rw [hg] at hWle
    set t := (1 + ε) * a with ht_def
    have ht : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
    set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max 0 (Real.exp (θ' * x) - 1) with hψ_def
    have hψnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x := fun x => le_max_left _ _
    have hψmono : MonotoneOn ψ (Set.Ici 0) := by
      intro x _ y _ hxy
      exact max_le_max le_rfl (sub_le_sub_right
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy hθ'.le)) 1)
    have hψY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) = traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d := by
      filter_upwards [hYPSD] with ω h
      exact traceFunction_psi _ h hθ'.le
    have hψInt : Integrable (fun ω => traceFunction ψ (Y ω)) μ :=
      hWInt.congr (hψY.mono fun ω h => h.symm)
    
    have hlogε : ε ≤ (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε) := by
      have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-Real.log (1 + ε))
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log h1ε] at h
      have h2 : (1 + ε) * (-Real.log (1 + ε) + 1) ≤ (1 + ε) * (1 + ε)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h h1ε.le
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h1ε.ne'] at h2
      linarith
    have hs1 : 1 ≤ θ' * t := by
      have e : θ' * t = ((1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε)) * a / L := by
        rw [hθ'_def, ht_def]; ring
      rw [e, le_div_iff₀ hL, one_mul]
      exact hεa.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlogε hapos.le)
    have hX2 : 2 ≤ Real.exp (θ' * t) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (θ' * t); linarith
    have hψt : ψ t = Real.exp (θ' * t) - 1 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
    have hψtpos : 0 < ψ t := by rw [hψt]; linarith
    have hlap := measure_lambdaMax_ge_le_integral_traceFunction_div μ Y ψ hYMeas (hYPSD.mono fun ω h => h.isHermitian)
      hψnn hψmono hψInt t ht hψtpos
    rw [integral_congr_ae hψY, hψt] at hlap
    have hEpos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (ε / L * a) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    set E := Real.exp (ε / L * a) with hE_def
    set Xs := Real.exp (θ' * t) with hXs_def
    have hXpos : 0 < Xs := by linarith
    calc μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * a ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)}
        ≤ (∫ ω, (traceExp (θ' • Y ω) - d) ∂μ) / (Xs - 1) := hlap
      _ ≤ r * E / (Xs - 1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hWle (by linarith)
      _ ≤ 2 * r * (E / Xs) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith), show 2 * r * (E / Xs) * (Xs - 1)
            = (2 * r * E * (Xs - 1)) / Xs by ring, le_div_iff₀ hXpos]
          have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0 hEpos) (sub_nonneg.2 hX2)
          nlinarith
      _ = 2 * r * Real.exp (a / L * (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε))) := by
          rw [hE_def, hXs_def, ← Real.exp_sub]
          congr 2
          rw [hθ'_def, ht_def]
          ring

name: NLAlib.integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_of_intrinsicDimension
statement:
theorem integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_of_intrinsicDimension {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    {M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ} (hM : M ≠ 0) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) (hMeanBound : (∫ ω, ∑ k, X k ω ∂μ) ≤ M)
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω) ∂μ) ≤
      (Real.exp θ - 1) / θ * lambdaMax M + L / θ * Real.log (2 * intrinsicDimension M)
proof:
:=
  (intrinsic_matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL M hM hMeas hIndep hPSD hBound hMeanBound).2.1 θ hθ

name: NLAlib.measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp_chernoff
statement:
theorem measureReal_lambdaMax_sum_ge_le_intrinsicDimension_mul_exp_chernoff {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    {M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ} (hM : M ≠ 0) (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ) (hPSD : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).PosSemidef)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) (hMeanBound : (∫ ω, ∑ k, X k ω ∂μ) ≤ M)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : L / lambdaMax M ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | (1 + ε) * lambdaMax M ≤ lambdaMax (∑ k, X k ω)} ≤
      2 * intrinsicDimension M *
        Real.exp (lambdaMax M / L * (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε)))
proof:
:=
  (intrinsic_matrix_chernoff_package μ X L hL M hM hMeas hIndep hPSD hBound hMeanBound).2.2 ε hε

name: NLAlib.quadraticWeakVariance_le_of_real_quadratic_variance
statement:
theorem quadraticWeakVariance_le_of_real_quadratic_variance
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hreal : ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (Matrix.reCLM A).map Complex.ofReal = A)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℝ,
      Var[fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u; γ] ≤ c * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 4) :
    quadraticWeakVariance γ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sSup_le _ hc
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  change Var[fun A => (quadForm A u).re; γ] ≤ c
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 at hu
  let a : n → ℝ := fun i => (u i).re
  let b : n → ℝ := fun i => (u i).im
  let X : M → ℝ := fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) a
  let Y : M → ℝ := fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) b
  have hX : MemLp X 2 γ :=
    ((quadFormContinuousLinearMap a).comp Matrix.reCLM).comp_memLp' IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 γ :=
    ((quadFormContinuousLinearMap b).comp Matrix.reCLM).comp_memLp' IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
  have he : (fun A => (quadForm A u).re) =ᵐ[γ] fun A => X A + Y A := by
    filter_upwards [hreal] with A hA
    simpa only [hA] using re_quadForm_map_ofReal (Matrix.reCLM A) u
  rw [variance_congr he]
  have hsum := variance_add_le_mul_sq_add_of_le_mul_sq hX hY hc
    (sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖) (sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖)
    (by simpa only [← pow_mul] using hvariance a)
    (by simpa only [← pow_mul] using hvariance b)
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simpa only [a, b, hu, one_pow] using norm_toLp_re_sq_add_norm_toLp_im_sq u
  simpa only [hn, one_pow, mul_one] using hsum

name: NLAlib.variance_quadForm_reCLM_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq_real
statement:
theorem variance_quadForm_reCLM_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq_real
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (hγmean : (∫ A, A ∂γ) = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) i,
        fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) j; μ] =
      cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; γ])
    (u : n → ℝ) :
    Var[fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u; γ] = Var[fun ω => quadForm (X ω) u; μ]
proof:
:= by
  let C : Matrix n n ℝ →L[ℝ] M :=
    (realMatrixComplexification (n := n) (𝕜 := ℂ)).toLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
  let E := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  let L := ((quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).comp Matrix.reCLM).comp E.symm.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hCX : MemLp (fun ω => C (X ω)) 2 μ := C.comp_memLp' hX
  have hXC : MemLp (fun ω => E (C (X ω))) 2 μ := E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hCX
  have hZC : MemLp (fun A => E A) 2 γ :=
    E.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
  have hmX : (∫ ω, E (C (X ω)) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (∫ ω, E (C (X ω)) ∂μ) = E (∫ ω, C (X ω) ∂μ) :=
      E.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (hCX.integrable (by norm_num))
    rw [h1, C.integral_comp_comm (hX.integrable (by norm_num)), hmean, map_zero, map_zero]
  have hmZ : (∫ A, E A ∂γ) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (∫ A, E A ∂γ) = E (∫ A, A ∂γ) :=
      E.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
    rw [h1, hγmean, map_zero]
  have hL (A : M) : L (E A) = quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u := by
    simp only [L, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, quadFormContinuousLinearMap_apply]
  have hLX (ω : Ω) : L (E (C (X ω))) = quadForm (X ω) u := by
    rw [hL]
    change quadForm (Matrix.reCLM ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal)) u = _
    rw [Matrix.reCLM_map_ofReal]
  have hmatch := covariance_comp_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    hXC hZC (hmX.trans hmZ.symm) hcov L L
  simp only [hLX, hL] at hmatch
  have hiX : MemLp (fun ω => quadForm (X ω) u) 2 μ :=
    (quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).comp_memLp' hX
  have hiZ : MemLp (fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u) 2 γ :=
    ((quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).comp Matrix.reCLM).comp_memLp' IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
  rw [covariance_self hiX.aemeasurable, covariance_self hiZ.aemeasurable] at hmatch
  exact hmatch.symm

name: NLAlib.quadraticWeakVariance_le_and_integral_lambdaMax_le_of_covariance_eq_real
statement:
theorem quadraticWeakVariance_le_and_integral_lambdaMax_le_of_covariance_eq_real
    [Nonempty n] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) (hmean : (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ] (hγHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hγmean : (∫ A, A ∂γ) = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) i,
        fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) j; μ] =
      cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; γ])
    (c : NNReal) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n)
    (hvariance : ∀ u : n → ℝ,
      Var[fun ω => quadForm (X ω) u; μ] ≤ (c : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 4) :
    quadraticWeakVariance γ ≤ c ∧
      (∫ A, lambdaMax A ∂γ) ≤ Real.sqrt (12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  have hvar (u : n → ℝ) :
      Var[fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u; γ] ≤ (c : ℝ) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ ^ 4 := by
    rw [variance_quadForm_reCLM_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq_real μ X hX hmean γ hγmean hcov]
    exact hvariance u
  have hiVar (i j : n) : Var[fun A => (A i j).im; γ] = 0 :=
    im_variance_eq_zero_of_covariance_eq_real μ X γ hcov i j
  have hreal := ae_eq_map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero γ hγmean hiVar
  refine ⟨quadraticWeakVariance_le_of_real_quadratic_variance γ hreal c.coe_nonneg hvar, ?_⟩
  let ρ := γ.map (Matrix.reCLM (m := n) (n := n))
  have hρ := isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_ae_isHermitian_map_reCLM γ hγmean hγHerm
  have hρvar (u : n → ℝ) (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) :
      Var[fun A => quadForm A u; ρ] ≤ c := by
    rw [variance_map (by exact (quadFormContinuousLinearMap u).continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)
      Matrix.reCLM.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable]
    change Var[fun A => quadForm (Matrix.reCLM A) u; γ] ≤ c
    simpa only [hu, one_pow, mul_one] using hvar u
  have hnet := integrable_specNorm_and_integral_le_sqrt_gaussian_of_quadratic_variance
    ρ hρ.2.1 hρ.2.2 c hd hρvar
  have hn : (∫ A, specNorm A ∂γ) ≤ Real.sqrt (12 * (c : ℝ) * Fintype.card n) := by
    rw [integral_specNorm_eq_integral_specNorm_map_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero γ hγmean hiVar]
    exact hnet.2
  have hiNorm : Integrable (fun A : M => specNorm A) γ := by
    simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, id_eq] using (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)).norm
  have hiMax := integrable_lambdaMax_of_integrable (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)) hγHerm
  exact (integral_mono_ae hiMax hiNorm (hγHerm.mono fun A hA => hA.lambdaMax_le_specNorm)).trans hn

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_le_integral_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_add_le_integral_traceExp_add_smul_gaussian
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ)
    (hXmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) ∂μ) = 0)
    (hXHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hZHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hZmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i, fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j; μ] =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z i, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z j; γ]) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (A + X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ Z, traceExp (A + Real.sqrt (2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient R) • Z) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_gaussian γ
  have hZcoordinates : (∫ Z, matrixRealCoordinates Z ∂γ) = 0 := by
    have h := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).integral_comp_comm
      (fun Z : M => Z) (μ := γ)
    simpa only [matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv,
      LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv', hZmean, map_zero] using h
  have hmeans (i : J) : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i ∂μ) =
      ∫ Z, matrixRealCoordinates Z i ∂γ := by
    have hx := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : J => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm
      (hX.integrable one_le_two)
    have hz := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : J => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm
      (hZ.integrable one_le_two)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, hXmean, hZcoordinates, Pi.zero_apply] at hx hz
    exact hx.trans hz.symm
  have heq := integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
    A hX hZ hmeans hcov
  have hu := integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
    A hA hX hXmean hXHerm hbound
  have hl := traceExp_add_sq_div_two_mul_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
    γ A hA hZHerm hZmean (Real.sqrt (2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient R))
  have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * expSecondRemainderCoefficient R) ^ 2 / 2 =
      expSecondRemainderCoefficient R := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (expSecondRemainderCoefficient_nonneg R))]
    ring
  rw [hs] at hl
  calc
    _ ≤ traceExp A + (∫ ω, iteratedDeriv 2
          (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • X ω)) 0 ∂μ) *
          expSecondRemainderCoefficient R := hu
    _ = traceExp A + expSecondRemainderCoefficient R *
          (∫ Z, iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => traceExp (A + t • Z)) 0 ∂γ) := by
      rw [heq]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := hl

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_add_smul_le_integral_traceExp_add_gaussianTraceInflation
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_add_smul_le_integral_traceExp_add_gaussianTraceInflation
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {X : Ω → M}
    (hX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω)) 2 μ)
    (hXmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) ∂μ) = 0)
    (hXHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ≤ R • (1 : M))
    (γ : Measure M) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hZHerm : ∀ᵐ Z ∂γ, Z.IsHermitian) (hZmean : ∫ Z, Z ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) i, fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X ω) j; μ] =
        cov[fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z i, fun Z => matrixRealCoordinates Z j; γ])
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) :
    (∫ ω, traceExp (A + θ • X ω) ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ Z, traceExp (A + gaussianTraceInflation R θ • Z) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := memLp_two_matrixRealCoordinates_gaussian γ
  have hZcoordinates : (∫ Z, matrixRealCoordinates Z ∂γ) = 0 := by
    have h := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).integral_comp_comm
      (fun Z : M => Z) (μ := γ)
    simpa only [matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv,
      LinearEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv', hZmean, map_zero] using h
  have heq := integral_iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_eq_of_centered_covariance_eq
    A hX hZ hXmean hZcoordinates hcov
  have hθX : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (θ • X ω)) 2 μ := by
    convert! hX.const_smul θ using 1
    ext ω
    simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply]
  have hθmean : (∫ ω, matrixRealCoordinates (θ • X ω) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [map_smul]
    rw [integral_smul, hXmean, smul_zero]
  have hθHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (θ • X ω).IsHermitian :=
    hXHerm.mono fun _ hH => hH.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all θ)
  have hθbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, θ • X ω ≤ (θ * R) • (1 : M) := by
    filter_upwards [hbound] with ω hω
    simpa only [smul_smul] using Matrix.matrix_smul_le_smul_of_nonneg hω hθ
  have hu := integral_traceExp_add_le_traceExp_add_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_mul_coefficient
    A hA hθX hθmean hθHerm hθbound
  have hl := traceExp_add_sq_div_two_mul_integral_iteratedDeriv_two_le_integral_gaussian
    γ A hA hZHerm hZmean (gaussianTraceInflation R θ)
  rw [gaussianTraceInflation_sq_div_two] at hl
  simp_rw [iteratedDeriv_two_traceExp_add_smul_smul_zero] at hu
  rw [integral_const_mul, heq] at hu
  nlinarith [hu, hl]

name: NLAlib.integrable_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product
statement:
theorem integrable_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_rademacherVector_of_polynomial_growth _
    (continuous_re_trace_series_product A B C r s).measurable _ (r + s)
  exact abs_re_trace_series_product_le A B C r s

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) (i : κ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i *
      (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ r * C * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ s).trace.re)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * ‖B‖ * ‖C‖ *
    (∑ j, ‖A j‖) ^ (r + s)
  apply integrable_rademacherVector_of_polynomial_growth _
    ((continuous_apply i).mul (continuous_re_trace_series_product A B C r s)).measurable
    D (r + s + 1)
  intro x
  have hi : |x i| ≤ 1 + ‖x‖ := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm x i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [abs_mul, pow_succ]
  calc _ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) * (D * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (r + s)) :=
      mul_le_mul hi (abs_re_trace_series_product_le A B C r s x)
        (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ q).trace.re)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using integrable_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product A B 1 q 0

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ) (i : κ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ q).trace.re)
      (rademacherVector _)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
    integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_rademacherSeries_product A B 1 q 0 i

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_sum_trace_words
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_sum_trace_words (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (ws : List (List Bool))
    (hi : ∀ w ∈ ws, Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ((ws.map fun w => insertionWord A (X ω) w).sum).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, ((ws.map fun w => insertionWord A (X ω) w).sum).trace ∂μ) =
        (ws.map fun w => ∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction ws with
  | nil => simp
  | cons w ws ih =>
    obtain ⟨hit, het⟩ := ih fun v hv => hi v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv)
    have hiw := hi w (by simp)
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Matrix.trace_add]
    refine ⟨hiw.add hit, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_add hiw hit, het]

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_add_pow_eq_sum_insertionWords
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_add_pow_eq_sum_insertionWords
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hi : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace ∂μ) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ((insertionWords n j).map fun w =>
            ∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ).sum
proof:
:= by
  have hj (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) :=
    integrable_and_integral_sum_trace_words A X (insertionWords n j) (hi j hj)
  have he (ω : Ω) : ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (((insertionWords n j).map (insertionWord A (X ω))).sum).trace := by
    rw [← sum_sum_insertionWords_eq_add_pow A (X ω) n, Matrix.trace_sum]
  constructor
  · simp_rw [he]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j hj' => (hj j (by simpa using Finset.mem_range.mp hj')).1)
  · simp_rw [he]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j hj' => (hj j (by simpa using Finset.mem_range.mp hj')).1)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj'
    exact (hj j (by simpa using Finset.mem_range.mp hj')).2

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_add_pow_le_sum_choose
statement:
theorem integral_trace_add_pow_le_sum_choose
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ)
    (hb : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) ≤ b j) :
    (∫ ω, ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace ∂μ) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose j : ℝ) * b j
proof:
:= by
  rw [(integrable_and_integral_trace_add_pow_eq_sum_insertionWords A X n hi).2]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  have hjn : j ≤ n := by simpa using Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  have hs : ∀ ws : List (List Bool), (∀ w ∈ ws, w ∈ insertionWords n j) →
      (ws.map fun w => ∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ).sum ≤
        (ws.length : ℝ) * b j := by
    intro ws
    induction ws with
    | nil => intro _; simp
    | cons w ws ih =>
      intro hmem
      have hbt := ih (fun v hv => hmem v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv))
      have hbw := hb j hjn w (hmem w (by simp))
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      linarith
  simpa only [length_insertionWords] using hs _ (fun _ h => h)

name: NLAlib.integral_trace_add_pow_le_of_centered_word_budgets
statement:
theorem integral_trace_add_pow_le_of_centered_word_budgets
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (ν R : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hi : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      Integrable (fun ω => (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace) μ)
    (hlinear : ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n 1,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) = 0)
    (hbudget : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ n → ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) ≤
        (j.factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ (j - 2) * T (n - j)) :
    (∫ ω, ((A + X ω) ^ n).trace ∂μ) ≤ (A ^ n).trace +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),
        (n.choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 *
          ν * R ^ k * T (n - (k + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let b (j : ℕ) : ℝ := if j = 0 then (A ^ n).trace else
    if j = 1 then 0 else (j.factorial : ℝ) / 2 * ν * R ^ (j - 2) * T (n - j)
  have hb : ∀ j ≤ n, ∀ w ∈ insertionWords n j,
      (∫ ω, (insertionWord A (X ω) w).trace ∂μ) ≤ b j := by
    intro j hj w hw
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      have hword : (fun ω => insertionWord A (X ω) w) = fun _ => A ^ n := by
        obtain ⟨hl, hc⟩ := length_and_count_of_mem_insertionWords hw
        have hf := count_false_add_count_true_eq_length w
        have hn' : w.count false = n := by omega
        funext ω
        rw [insertionWord_eq_pow_of_count_true_eq_zero _ _ w hc, hn']
      have hword' (ω : Ω) : insertionWord A (X ω) w = A ^ n := congrFun hword ω
      simp only [hword']
      simp [b]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp only [b, if_neg (by decide : (1 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
        exact (hlinear w hw).le
      · simpa only [b, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1] using hbudget j (by omega) hj w hw
  have h := integral_trace_add_pow_le_sum_choose A X n b hi hb
  have hbase : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range 2, (n.choose j : ℝ) * b j) = (A ^ n).trace := by
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, b]
  have htail : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), (n.choose (2 + k) : ℝ) * b (2 + k)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n - 1),
        (n.choose (k + 2) : ℝ) * ((k + 2).factorial : ℝ) / 2 *
          ν * R ^ k * T (n - (k + 2)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [if_neg (by omega : 2 + k ≠ 0), if_neg (by omega : 2 + k ≠ 1)]
    rw [show 2 + k - 2 = k by omega, Nat.add_comm 2 k]
    ring
  rw [show n + 1 = 2 + (n - 1) by omega, Finset.sum_range_add, hbase, htail] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ_le
    (y : Ω → ι → ℝ) (p : ℕ) {a : ℝ}
    (hmoment : ∀ x : ι → ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ω => (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p * (x ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ a * (x ⬝ᵥ x))
    (C : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    Integrable (fun ω => (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ (p + 1)).trace) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ (p + 1)).trace ∂μ) ≤ a * C.trace
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let h := hC.isHermitian
  let x (i : ι) : ι → ℝ := h.eigenvectorBasis i
  have hx (i : ι) : x i ⬝ᵥ x i = 1 := by
    simpa [x] using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis h i i
  have he (ω : Ω) : (C * vecMulVec (y ω) (y ω) ^ (p + 1)).trace =
      ∑ i, h.eigenvalues i * ((y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p * (x i ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2) := by
    rw [trace_mul_vecMulVec_pow_succ]
    have hc := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum h id (y ω)
    rw [cfc_id ℝ C] at hc
    rw [hc, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [id_eq]
    ring
  have hint (i : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => h.eigenvalues i *
      ((y ω ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ p * (x i ⬝ᵥ y ω) ^ 2)) μ :=
    (hmoment (x i)).1.const_mul _
  constructor
  · simp_rw [he]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hint i)
  · simp_rw [he]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hint i)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, h.eigenvalues i * a := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa only [hx, mul_one] using (hmoment (x i)).2)
          (hC.eigenvalues_nonneg i)
      _ = _ := by
        have ht := trace_cfc_eq_sum_eigenvalues h id
        rw [cfc_id ℝ C] at ht
        simp only [id_eq, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id] at ht
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ht]
        ring

name: NLAlib.integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le
statement:
theorem integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le
    (ν : ι → Measure Ω) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → Ω → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZc : ∀ i, Continuous (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i ω, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ x : ι → Ω, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      2 * v + 16 * R * ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let T := {p : EuclideanSpace ℂ n × EuclideanSpace ℂ n // ‖p.1‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1}
  let : Nonempty T := ⟨⟨(0, 0), by simp⟩⟩
  let X (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : ℂ :=
    Matrix.bilinearCLM t.val.1.ofLp t.val.2.ofLp (Z i ω)
  have hXc (i : ι) (t : T) : Continuous (fun ω => X i ω t) :=
    (Matrix.bilinearCLM t.val.1.ofLp t.val.2.ofLp).continuous.comp (hZc i)
  have hX (i : ι) (ω : Ω) (t : T) : ‖X i ω t‖ ≤ R :=
    (norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm (Z i ω) t.val.1 t.val.2
      t.prop.1 t.prop.2).trans (hZ i ω)
  have hZi (i : ι) : Integrable (Z i) (ν i) :=
    Integrable.of_bound (hZc i).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable R
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => hZ i ω)
  have hXm (i : ι) (t : T) : ∫ ω, X i ω t ∂ν i = 0 := by
    change (∫ ω, Matrix.bilinearCLM t.val.1.ofLp t.val.2.ofLp (Z i ω) ∂ν i) = 0
    rw [(Matrix.bilinearCLM t.val.1.ofLp t.val.2.ofLp).integral_comp_comm (hZi i),
      hmean i, map_zero]
  have hXn (t : T) : ∃ u, ∀ i ω, X i ω u = -X i ω t := by
    refine ⟨⟨(-t.val.1, t.val.2), by simpa using t.prop⟩, fun i ω => ?_⟩
    simp [X, Matrix.bilinearCLM_apply, star_neg, neg_dotProduct]
  have hXv (t : T) : (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖X i ω t‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v :=
    hvariance t.val.1 t.val.2 t.prop.1 t.prop.2
  have heq (x : ι → Ω) :
      bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ =
        ⨆ t, ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ∑ i, ‖X i (x i) t‖ ^ 2) := by
      refine ⟨∑ _i : ι, R ^ 2, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR).mpr (hX i (x i) t)
    apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb', he⟩ := exists_bilinearSquareMass_eq (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ
      rw [he]
      simpa [X, Matrix.bilinearCLM_apply] using le_ciSup hb (⟨(a, b), ha, hb'⟩ : T)
    · apply ciSup_le
      intro t
      simpa [X, Matrix.bilinearCLM_apply] using
        sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ
          t.val.1 t.val.2 t.prop.1 t.prop.2
  have hnorm (x : ι → Ω) (t : T) : ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ≤ specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) := by
    rw [show (∑ i, X i (x i) t) =
        Matrix.bilinearCLM t.val.1.ofLp t.val.2.ofLp (∑ i, Z i (x i)) by
      simp only [X, map_sum]]
    exact norm_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm _ t.val.1 t.val.2 t.prop.1 t.prop.2
  have hNi : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i))) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    have hm : Measurable (fun x : ι → Ω => specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i))) := by
      simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Function.comp_def] using
        (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hZc i).comp (continuous_apply i)).norm.measurable
    apply Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable (∑ _i : ι, R)
    apply ae_of_all
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _)]
    exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hZ i (x i))
  have hSi : Integrable (fun x : ι → Ω => ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    apply integrable_ciSup_of_continuous_of_abs_le (Measure.pi ν)
      (fun x t => ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖)
    · intro t
      exact (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hXc i t).comp (continuous_apply i)).norm
    · intro x t
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hX i (x i) t)
  have hle : (∫ x : ι → Ω, ⨆ t, ‖∑ i, X i (x i) t‖ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      ∫ x : ι → Ω, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν :=
    integral_mono hSi hNi (fun x => ciSup_le (hnorm x))
  simp_rw [heq]
  have h := integral_ciSup_sum_norm_sq_le_mean_add_sixteen_mul_of_centered
    ν X hXc hR hX hXm hXn hXv
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le_of_ae_bound
statement:
theorem integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le_of_ae_bound
    {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    (ν : ι → Measure S) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (Z : ι → S → Matrix n n ℂ) (hZm : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i))
    {R v : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hZ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, specNorm (Z i ω) ≤ R)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, Z i ω ∂ν i = 0)
    (hvariance : ∀ a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n, ‖a‖ ≤ 1 → ‖b‖ ≤ 1 →
      (∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i) ≤ v) :
    (∫ x : ι → S, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
      2 * v + 16 * R * ∫ x : ι → S, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  let : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (n → n → ℂ))
  let ρ (i : ι) : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ) := (ν i).map (Z i)
  let : ∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ρ i) := fun i =>
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hZm i).aemeasurable
  let P : Matrix n n ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ := NormedSpace.radialProj R
  have hPc : Continuous P := NormedSpace.continuous_radialProj hR
  have hPB (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : specNorm (P A) ≤ R :=
    NormedSpace.norm_radialProj_le hR A
  have hfix (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂ν i, P (Z i ω) = Z i ω :=
    (hZ i).mono fun ω hω => NormedSpace.radialProj_eq_self hR hω
  have hPm (i : ι) : ∫ A, P A ∂ρ i = 0 := by
    rw [integral_map (hZm i).aemeasurable hPc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact (integral_congr_ae (hfix i)).trans (hmean i)
  have hPv (a b : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) (hb : ‖b‖ ≤ 1) :
      (∑ i, ∫ A, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (P A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ i) ≤ v := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun A => ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (P A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) :=
      ((Matrix.bilinearCLM a.ofLp b.ofLp).continuous.comp hPc).norm.pow 2
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (Z i ω *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [integral_map (hZm i).aemeasurable hc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
        exact integral_congr_ae ((hfix i).mono fun ω hω => congrArg
          (fun A => ‖star a.ofLp ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b.ofLp)‖ ^ 2) hω)
      _ ≤ v := hvariance a b ha hb
  let U (x : ι → S) (i : ι) := Z i (x i)
  have hUm : Measurable U := measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i =>
    (hZm i).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  have hmap : (Measure.pi ν).map U = Measure.pi ρ :=
    Measure.pi_map_pi (fun i => (hZm i).aemeasurable)
  have hfixPi : ∀ᵐ x : ι → S ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, P (Z i (x i)) = Z i (x i) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hfix i)
  let F (x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) := bilinearSquareMass (fun i => P (x i)) Finset.univ
  let G (x : ι → Matrix n n ℂ) := specNorm (∑ i, P (x i))
  have hFc : Continuous F := (continuous_bilinearSquareMass Finset.univ).comp
    (continuous_pi fun i => hPc.comp (continuous_apply i))
  have hGc : Continuous G :=
    (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => hPc.comp (continuous_apply i)).norm
  have hFeq : (∫ x, F x ∂Measure.pi ρ) =
      ∫ x : ι → S, bilinearSquareMass (fun i => Z i (x i)) Finset.univ ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    rw [← hmap, integral_map hUm.aemeasurable hFc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hfixPi] with x hx
    simp only [F, U, hx]
  have hGeq : (∫ x, G x ∂Measure.pi ρ) =
      ∫ x : ι → S, specNorm (∑ i, Z i (x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν := by
    rw [← hmap, integral_map hUm.aemeasurable hGc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hfixPi] with x hx
    simp only [G, U, hx]
  have h := integral_bilinearSquareMass_pi_le ρ (fun _ => P) (fun _ => hPc)
    hR (fun _ => hPB) hPm hPv
  change (∫ x, F x ∂Measure.pi ρ) ≤ 2 * v + 16 * R * ∫ x, G x ∂Measure.pi ρ at h
  rw [hFeq, hGeq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_recursion
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_recursion
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re
        ∂(gaussianVector _)) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) *
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ,
          ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (2 * p - 2)).trace.re
          ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let γ := (gaussianVector (Fin n))
  let Y := fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ∑ i, x i • A i
  let q := 2 * p - 1
  let m := 2 * p - 2
  have hqm : q.pred = m := by dsimp [q, m]; omega
  have hpow : 2 * p = q + 1 := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hm : Even m := by
    have he : m = 2 * (p - 1) := by dsimp [m]; omega
    rw [he]
    exact even_two_mul _
  have hYi (x) : (Y x).IsHermitian := isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x
  have hexpand (x : Fin n → ℝ) : (Y x ^ (2 * p)).trace.re =
      ∑ i, x i * (A i * Y x ^ q).trace.re := by
    rw [hpow, pow_succ', show Y x = ∑ i, x i • A i by rfl,
      Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcoord (i : Fin n) :
      (∫ x, x i * (A i * Y x ^ q).trace.re ∂γ) ≤
        (q : ℝ) * ∫ x, (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂γ := by
    rw [integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow]
    have hbound (l : ℕ) (hl : l ∈ Finset.range q) :
        (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ,
          (A i * Y x ^ (q.pred - l) * A i * Y x ^ l).trace.re ∂γ) ≤
        ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂γ := by
      apply integral_mono
        (integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product A (A i) (A i) (q.pred - l) l)
        (integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A (A i ^ 2) m)
      intro x
      have hlm : l ≤ m := by dsimp [q, m] at *; rw [Finset.mem_range] at hl; omega
      have h := re_trace_mul_pow_mul_le_trace_sq_mul_pow (A i) (Y x)
        (hA i) (hYi x) hm (Nat.sub_le m l)
      simpa only [hqm, Nat.sub_sub_self hlm] using h
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _l ∈ Finset.range q,
          ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂γ :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hbound
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hcoord i
  have hM : (∫ x, (Y x ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂γ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ x, x i * (A i * Y x ^ q).trace.re ∂γ := by
    simp_rw [hexpand]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
      integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A (A i) q i
  have hW : (∫ x, ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂γ) =
      ∑ i, ∫ x, (A i ^ 2 * Y x ^ m).trace.re ∂γ := by
    simp_rw [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A (A i ^ 2) m
  rw [hM, hW]
  simpa only [Finset.mul_sum] using hsum

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re
        ∂(gaussianVector _)) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) ^ p).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_re_trace_pow_le_of_polynomial_recursion
    (∑ i, A i ^ 2) (posSemidef_sum_sq_of_isHermitian A hA)
    (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ∑ i, x i • A i)
    (ae_of_all _ (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA)) hp
  · simpa only [one_mul] using integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A 1 (2 * p)
  · exact integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A (∑ i, A i ^ 2) (2 * p - 2)
  · exact integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_recursion A hA hp

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_gaussianVector {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun g : ι → ℝ => ∑ i, a i * g i)
      ⟨∑ i, a i ^ 2, Finset.sum_nonneg fun _i _ => sq_nonneg _⟩ (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSubgaussianMGF_finset_sum_mul_of_iIndepFun
    (iIndepFun_eval_gaussianVector ι) (s := Finset.univ)
      (fun i _ => hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector i)) a
  have hc : (∑ i, Real.toNNReal (a i ^ 2) * 1) =
      (⟨∑ i, a i ^ 2, Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _⟩ : ℝ≥0) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [sq_nonneg]
  rw [hc] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_spectralAbsoluteFactor_mul_gaussianVector_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_spectralAbsoluteFactor_mul_gaussianVector_le
    {n : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (henv : ∀ i, Real.sqrt (∑ j, B i j ^ 2) * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ D ^ 2) :
    (∫ g, ‖fun i => ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * g k‖
      ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)) ≤ 16 * D
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_norm_pi_le_sixteen_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_log_envelope
    (μ := gaussianVector (Fin n))
    (fun i (g : Fin n → ℝ) => ∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k * g k)
      (fun i => ⟨∑ k, spectralAbsoluteFactor hB i k ^ 2,
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg _⟩)
        (fun i => hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_gaussianVector _) D hD
  intro i
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sum_sq_spectralAbsoluteFactor_row_le hB i)
    (Real.log_nonneg (by have hi : 0 ≤ (((i : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Nat.cast_nonneg _; linarith))).trans (henv i)

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_normSq_dotProduct_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_normSq_dotProduct_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (c : n → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => Complex.normSq (c ⬝ᵥ z)) (circularComplexGaussianVector n) ∧
      ∫ z, Complex.normSq (c ⬝ᵥ z) ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n =
        2*∑ i, Complex.normSq (c i)
proof:
:= by
  let u : n ⊕ n → ℝ := Sum.elim (fun i => (c i).re) (fun i => -(c i).im)
  let v : n ⊕ n → ℝ := Sum.elim (fun i => (c i).im) (fun i => (c i).re)
  have he (z : n → ℂ) : Complex.normSq (c ⬝ᵥ z)=
      (u ⬝ᵥ realifyVector z)^2+(v ⬝ᵥ realifyVector z)^2 := by
    simp [Complex.normSq_apply,dotProduct,Fintype.sum_sum_type,u,v,realifyVector,
      Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib,neg_mul]
    ring
  have hZ := hasLaw_realifyVector_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := n)
  have hsu : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : n ⊕ n → ℝ => (u ⬝ᵥ x)^2)
      (gaussianVector (n ⊕ n)) := (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hsv : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : n ⊕ n → ℝ => (v ⬝ᵥ x)^2)
      (gaussianVector (n ⊕ n)) := (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hiu : Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => (u ⬝ᵥ realifyVector z)^2)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) := by
    have h := integrable_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector u
    rw [← hZ.map_eq] at h
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  have hiv : Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => (v ⬝ᵥ realifyVector z)^2)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) := by
    have h := integrable_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector v
    rw [← hZ.map_eq] at h
    exact h.comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  have hpu := (hZ.integral_comp hsu).trans (integral_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector u)
  have hpv := (hZ.integral_comp hsv).trans (integral_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector v)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hpu hpv
  simp_rw [he]
  refine ⟨hiu.add hiv,?_⟩
  rw [integral_add hiu hiv,hpu,hpv]
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq,Fintype.sum_sum_type,u,v,Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr,neg_sq,Complex.normSq_apply,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_dotProduct_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_dotProduct_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (c : n → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => c ⬝ᵥ z) (circularComplexGaussianVector n) ∧
      ∫ z, c ⬝ᵥ z ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n=0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_normSq_dotProduct_circularComplexGaussianVector c
  have hm : Measurable (fun z : n → ℂ => c ⬝ᵥ z) := by fun_prop
  have hfi : Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => c ⬝ᵥ z) (circularComplexGaussianVector n) :=
    ((integrable_const 1).add hi).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
        change ‖c ⬝ᵥ z‖ ≤ 1+Complex.normSq (c ⬝ᵥ z)
        rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖c ⬝ᵥ z‖-1),norm_nonneg (c ⬝ᵥ z)])
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols (-1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    change (-1 : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ*(-1)=1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_neg,Matrix.conjTranspose_one,neg_mul_neg,Matrix.one_mul]
  have hn := hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_unitary (-1 : Matrix n n ℂ) hU
  have he : (fun z : n → ℂ => (-1 : Matrix n n ℂ)*ᵥz)=fun z => -z := by
    funext z
    rw [Matrix.neg_mulVec,Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [he] at hn
  have h := hn.integral_comp hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,dotProduct_neg,integral_neg] at h
  refine ⟨hfi,?_⟩
  apply Complex.ext
  · have hh := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.neg_re] at hh
    change (∫ z, c ⬝ᵥ z ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n).re=0
    linarith
  · have hh := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp only [Complex.neg_im] at hh
    change (∫ z, c ⬝ᵥ z ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n).im=0
    linarith

name: NLAlib.matrixHermiteExpansion_vacuum
statement:
theorem matrixHermiteExpansion_vacuum (x : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixHermiteExpansion (hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p) x = (1 : Matrix d d ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp [matrixHermiteExpansion, hermiteExpansion, hermiteVacuumEmbedding,
    ite_mul, productHermite]

name: NLAlib.hermiteVacuumEmbedding_support
statement:
theorem hermiteVacuumEmbedding_support (a : d) (α : HermiteIndex ι p) (b : d)
    (hα : 0 < α.degree) : hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p (a, α) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : α ≠ HermiteIndex.vacuum := by
    intro he
    rw [he, HermiteIndex.degree_vacuum] at hα
    exact (lt_irrefl 0 hα)
  simp [hermiteVacuumEmbedding, hn]

name: NLAlib.hermiteSeriesOperator_pow_vacuum_support
statement:
theorem hermiteSeriesOperator_pow_vacuum_support
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (k : ℕ)
    (a : d) (α : HermiteIndex ι p) (b : d) (hα : k < α.degree) :
    (hermiteSeriesOperator A p ^ k * hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p) (a, α) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing a α b with
  | zero => simpa only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul] using hermiteVacuumEmbedding_support a α b hα
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Matrix.mul_assoc]
    apply hermiteSeriesOperator_mul_support A hA _ k
    · intro a' α' b' hα'
      exact ih a' α' b' hα'
    · exact hα

name: NLAlib.matrixHermiteExpansion_pow_vacuum
statement:
theorem matrixHermiteExpansion_pow_vacuum
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ p)
    (x : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixHermiteExpansion (hermiteSeriesOperator A p ^ k * hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p) x =
      (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Matrix.one_mul, matrixHermiteExpansion_vacuum]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Matrix.mul_assoc, matrixHermiteExpansion_operator_mul A hA]
    · rw [ih (by omega), pow_succ']
    · intro a α b hα
      apply hermiteSeriesOperator_pow_vacuum_support A hA k a α b
      have ha := α.property
      change α.degree ≤ p at ha
      omega

name: NLAlib.frobSq_hermiteVacuumEmbedding
statement:
theorem frobSq_hermiteVacuumEmbedding :
    frobSq (hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p) = Fintype.card d
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp [hermiteVacuumEmbedding, ite_mul, Matrix.one_apply,
    apply_ite, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_matrixHermiteExpansion
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_matrixHermiteExpansion {c : Type*} [Fintype c]
    (Z : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) c ℂ) :
    (∫ x, frobSq (matrixHermiteExpansion Z x) ∂gaussianVector ι) = frobSq Z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, matrixHermiteExpansion]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun b _ =>
    integrable_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion (fun α => Z (a, α) b)))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun b _ => integrable_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion _),
    integral_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_eq_frobSq_hermiteVacuum
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_eq_frobSq_hermiteVacuum
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) =
      frobSq (hermiteSeriesOperator A p ^ p * hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_frobSq_matrixHermiteExpansion]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [matrixHermiteExpansion_pow_vacuum A hA p le_rfl,
    frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hX : (∑ i, x i • A i).IsHermitian := by
    apply isSelfAdjoint_sum
    intro i _
    exact (hA i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (by simp))
  change ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re =
    (((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ p)ᴴ * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ p).trace.re
  rw [(hX.pow p).eq, ← pow_add, show p + p = 2 * p by omega]

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingPositions_length
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingPositions_length {m : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    (gaussianPairingPositions π).length = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => rfl
  | one => exact Empty.elim π
  | more m ih _ =>
      rcases π with ⟨j, π⟩
      simp only [gaussianPairingPositions, List.length_cons, List.length_map, ih]

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingPositions_toFinset
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingPositions_toFinset {m : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    (gaussianPairingPositions π).toFinset = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp [gaussianPairingPositions]
  | one => exact Empty.elim π
  | more m ih _ =>
      rcases π with ⟨j, π⟩
      simp only [gaussianPairingPositions, List.toFinset_cons]
      have htail : ∀ a : Fin m, a ∈ gaussianPairingPositions π := by
        intro a
        apply List.mem_toFinset.mp
        rw [ih]
        exact Finset.mem_univ a
      ext i
      constructor
      · intro _; exact Finset.mem_univ _
      · intro _
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun b => ?_) i
        · simp
        · rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove j b with rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩
          · simp
          · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]
            exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, htail a, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingPositions_nodup
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingPositions_nodup {m : ℕ} (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    (gaussianPairingPositions π).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply (Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup
    (m := (gaussianPairingPositions π : Multiset (Fin m)))).mp
  change (gaussianPairingPositions π).toFinset.card = (gaussianPairingPositions π).length
  rw [gaussianPairingPositions_toFinset, gaussianPairingPositions_length,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_sum_gaussianPairingWeight
statement:
theorem integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_sum_gaussianPairingWeight
    {n m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ j, a j ⬝ᵥ x ∂(gaussianVector _) =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings m, gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j => a i ⬝ᵥ a j) π
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero =>
      have : Unique (GaussianPairings 0) := inferInstanceAs (Unique Unit)
      have hsum : (∑ π : GaussianPairings 0,
          gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j => a i ⬝ᵥ a j) π) = 1 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_unique]
        rfl
      rw [hsum]
      simp
  | one =>
      have hh := integral_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
        (∅ : Finset (Fin 0)) (fun j => Fin.elim0 j) (a 0)
      have : IsEmpty (GaussianPairings 1) := inferInstanceAs (IsEmpty Empty)
      have hsum : (∑ π : GaussianPairings 1,
          gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j => a i ⬝ᵥ a j) π) = 0 := by simp
      rw [hsum]
      simpa using hh
  | more m ih _ =>
      have hrec := integral_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m + 1))) (fun j => a j.succ) (a 0)
      have hprod : ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
          (∏ j : Fin (m + 2), a j ⬝ᵥ x) =
          (a 0 ⬝ᵥ x) * ∏ j : Fin (m + 1), a j.succ ⬝ᵥ x :=
        fun x => Fin.prod_univ_succ _
      simp_rw [hprod]
      rw [hrec]
      have herase : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ,
          (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, a k.succ ⬝ᵥ x) =
          ∏ k : Fin m, a (j.succAbove k).succ ⬝ᵥ x := by
        intro j x
        rw [Fin.univ_succAbove m j, Finset.erase_cons, Finset.prod_map]
        rfl
      simp_rw [herase, ih]
      change _ = ∑ π : Fin (m + 1) × GaussianPairings m,
        (a 0 ⬝ᵥ a π.1.succ) * gaussianPairingWeight
          (fun i j => a (π.1.succAbove i).succ ⬝ᵥ a (π.1.succAbove j).succ) π.2
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_odd
statement:
theorem integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_odd
    {n m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (a : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ j, a j ⬝ᵥ x ∂(gaussianVector _) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_sum_gaussianPairingWeight]
  have hEmpty : ∀ m : ℕ, Odd m → IsEmpty (GaussianPairings m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
    | zero => intro h; simp at h
    | one => intro _; exact inferInstanceAs (IsEmpty Empty)
    | more m ih _ =>
        intro h
        have hm : Odd m := by
          rcases h with ⟨r, hr⟩
          cases r with
          | zero => omega
          | succ r => exact ⟨r, by omega⟩
        have := ih hm
        exact inferInstanceAs (IsEmpty (Fin (m + 1) × GaussianPairings m))
  have := hEmpty m hm
  simp

name: NLAlib.gaussianEvenMoment_pos
statement: theorem gaussianEvenMoment_pos (p : ℕ) : 0 < gaussianEvenMoment p
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianEvenMoment
  exact prod_pos fun k _ => by positivity

name: NLAlib.gaussianEvenMoment_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem gaussianEvenMoment_eq_gamma (p : ℕ) :
    gaussianEvenMoment p = 2 ^ p * Real.Gamma ((p : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    simp only [gaussianEvenMoment, range_zero, prod_empty, Nat.cast_zero,
      zero_add, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [Real.Gamma_one_half_eq, div_self (Real.sqrt_pos.2 Real.pi_pos).ne']
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [gaussianEvenMoment, prod_range_succ]
    change gaussianEvenMoment p * (2 * (p : ℝ) + 1) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      show (p : ℝ) + 1 + 1 / 2 = ((p : ℝ) + 1 / 2) + 1 by ring,
      Real.Gamma_add_one (by positivity : (p : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≠ 0)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.gaussianRadialMoment_eq_gamma
statement:
theorem gaussianRadialMoment_eq_gamma {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (p : ℕ) :
    gaussianRadialMoment r p =
      2 ^ p * Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2 + p) / Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < r by omega)
  have hG : Real.Gamma ((r : ℝ) / 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  induction p with
  | zero => simp [gaussianRadialMoment, hG]
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [gaussianRadialMoment, prod_range_succ]
    change gaussianRadialMoment r p * ((r : ℝ) + 2 * p) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
      show (r : ℝ) / 2 + ((p : ℝ) + 1) = ((r : ℝ) / 2 + p) + 1 by ring,
      Real.Gamma_add_one (by positivity : (r : ℝ) / 2 + p ≠ 0)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.factorial_le_gaussianEvenMoment
statement: theorem factorial_le_gaussianEvenMoment (p : ℕ) : (p.factorial : ℝ) ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.factorial_eq_prod_range_add_one, Nat.cast_prod]
  exact prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => by positivity) fun k _ => by push_cast; linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_pow_sum_sq_gaussianVector {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ z : Fin r → ℝ, (∑ i, z i ^ 2) ^ p ∂gaussianVector (Fin r)) =
      gaussianRadialMoment r p
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianRadialMoment_eq_gamma hr]
  simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast] using
    integral_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector r hr (p : ℝ) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_two_mul_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_pow_two_mul_gaussianReal (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ z : ℝ, z ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = gaussianEvenMoment p
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianEvenMoment_eq_gamma]
  have h := integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal (p : ℝ) (by positivity)
  simp only [show (2 : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) = ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring,
    Real.rpow_natCast] at h
  simpa only [abs_pow, even_two_mul, Even.pow_abs] using h

name: NLAlib.gaussianRadialMoment_le_pow
statement:
theorem gaussianRadialMoment_le_pow (r p : ℕ) :
    gaussianRadialMoment r p ≤ ((r : ℝ) + 2 * p) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianRadialMoment
  calc
    (∏ k ∈ range p, ((r : ℝ) + 2 * k)) ≤
        ∏ _k ∈ range p, ((r : ℝ) + 2 * p) := by
      apply prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => by positivity)
      intro k hk
      have hkp : (k : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (mem_range.mp hk).le
      linarith
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_dotProduct_pow_two_mul_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_dotProduct_pow_two_mul_gaussianVector
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (w : α → ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => (w ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p)) (gaussianVector α) ∧
      (∫ z, (w ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianVector α) =
        gaussianEvenMoment p * (w ⬝ᵥ w) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w = 0
  · subst w
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · subst p
      simp [gaussianEvenMoment]
    · simp [zero_pow (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0), hp]
  let N : ℝ := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hw
    apply WithLp.toLp_injective (p := 2)
    simpa only [WithLp.toLp_zero] using (norm_eq_zero.mp h)
  have hN : 0 < N := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) hN0.symm
  let u : α → ℝ := N⁻¹ • w
  have hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 := by
    simp only [u, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hN.le)]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hN0
  have hLaw := hasLaw_dotProduct_gaussianVector u hu
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => (u ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p)) (gaussianVector α) := by
    have h := integrable_pow_gaussianReal (2 * p)
    rw [← hLaw.map_eq] at h
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (2 * p))
        ((gaussianVector α).map (fun z => u ⬝ᵥ z)) := by fun_prop
    exact (integrable_map_measure hmeas hLaw.aemeasurable).1 h
  have he (z : α → ℝ) : (w ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p) = N ^ (2 * p) * (u ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p) := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    congr 1
    simp [u, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hN0]
  have hNsq : N ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self w
  constructor
  · simpa only [← he] using hi.const_mul (N ^ (2 * p))
  · simp_rw [he]
    have hI : (∫ z, (u ⬝ᵥ z) ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianVector α) =
        ∫ z : ℝ, z ^ (2 * p) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hLaw.integral_comp
        (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ (2 * p)) (by fun_prop)
    rw [integral_const_mul, hI,
      integral_pow_two_mul_gaussianReal, pow_mul, hNsq]
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: NLAlib.integrable_specNorm_gaussianSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_specNorm_gaussianSeries_pow (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ q) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ q) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  apply integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth hcont.measurable.aemeasurable
    ((∑ i, specNorm (A i)) ^ q) q
  intro x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _)]
  have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (∑ i, x i • A i))
    (norm_sum_smul_le_sum_norm_mul_one_add_norm A x) q
  simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, mul_pow] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_even_trace_rpow
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_even_trace_rpow
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) ^
        (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i)
  have hf : Continuous f := by
    dsimp [f]
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x := fun x => specNorm_nonneg _
  have hpower := integrable_specNorm_gaussianSeries_pow A (2 * p)
  have hpowR : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ (2 * (p : ℝ))) (gaussianVector ι) := by
    simpa only [← Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, f] using hpower
  have hroot := integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le hf.aestronglyMeasurable hn
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * p by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * p)) hpowR
  simp only [Real.rpow_one, inv_one, one_div] at hroot
  have htrace : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re)
      (gaussianVector ι) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A 1 (2 * p)
  have hint : (∫ x, f x ^ (2 * (p : ℝ)) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      ∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι := by
    apply integral_mono hpowR htrace
    intro x
    have hh := specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_re_trace_pow (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x)
      (show 0 < p by omega)
    simpa only [f, ← Real.rpow_natCast, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
  exact hroot.trans (by
    simpa only [one_div] using Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (integral_nonneg (fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (hn x) _)) hint
      (show 0 ≤ (2 * (p : ℝ))⁻¹ by positivity))

name: NLAlib.memLp_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem memLp_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (i : Fin n) :
    MemLp (fun g => varianceProfileRadius B g i) 2 (gaussianVector (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hV : MemLp (fun g : Fin n → ℝ =>
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => Real.sqrt (B i j) * g j) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      2 (gaussianVector (Fin n)) := by
    rw [memLp_piLp_iff]
    intro j
    exact (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector j)).const_mul _
  simpa only [varianceProfileRadius_eq_norm B hB] using hV.norm

name: NLAlib.integral_varianceProfileRadius_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_varianceProfileRadius_sq_gaussianVector
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (i : Fin n) :
    (∫ g, varianceProfileRadius B g i ^ 2 ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)) = ∑ j, B i j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [varianceProfileRadius_sq B hB]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
    (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector j)).integrable_sq.const_mul _)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sq_eq_one_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector j), mul_one]

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector_le
statement:
theorem integral_norm_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector_le
    (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hB : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j)
    (L : Fin n → ℝ) (hL : ∀ i, 0 ≤ L i) (hLip : ∀ i j, B i j ≤ L i ^ 2)
    (a D : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, B i j ≤ a ^ 2)
    (henv : ∀ i, L i ^ 2 * Real.log (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) ≤ D ^ 2) :
    (∫ g, ‖fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i‖ ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)) ≤ a + 16 * D
proof:
:= by
  let m : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ∫ g, varianceProfileRadius B g i ∂gaussianVector (Fin n)
  have hi (i : Fin n) := memLp_varianceProfileRadius_gaussianVector B hB i
  have hm0 (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ m i := integral_nonneg fun g => varianceProfileRadius_nonneg B g i
  have hm (i : Fin n) : m i ≤ a := by
    apply integral_le_of_integral_sq_le (gaussianVector (Fin n)) _
      ((hi i).integrable (by norm_num)) (hi i).integrable_sq a ha
    rw [integral_varianceProfileRadius_sq_gaussianVector B hB]
    exact hrow i
  have hmgf (i : Fin n) : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun g => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i)
      ⟨L i ^ 2, sq_nonneg _⟩ (gaussianVector (Fin n)) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using hasSubgaussianMGF_of_logSobolev
      hasEuclideanLogSobolev_gaussianVector (fun g => varianceProfileRadius B g i) (L i) (hL i)
        (fun g h => abs_varianceProfileRadius_sub_le B hB g h i (L i) (hL i) (hLip i))
  have hb := integral_norm_pi_le_sixteen_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_log_envelope
    (fun i g => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i) (fun i => ⟨L i ^ 2, sq_nonneg _⟩)
      hmgf D hD henv
  have hmi : MemLp (fun g => fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i)
      2 (gaussianVector (Fin n)) := by
    apply memLp_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact (hi i).sub (memLp_const _)
  have hRi : Integrable (fun g => ‖fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i‖)
      (gaussianVector (Fin n)) :=
    (integrable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => (hi i).integrable (by norm_num))).norm
  have hbound := integral_mono hRi ((integrable_const a).add (hmi.norm.integrable (by norm_num))) (fun g => by
    have hnorm : ‖m‖ ≤ a := (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg ha).mpr (fun i => by
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hm0 i)]
      exact hm i)
    have heq : (fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i) = m + (fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i) := by
      funext i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    change ‖m + (fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i)‖ ≤
      a + ‖fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i‖
    linarith [norm_add_le m (fun i => varianceProfileRadius B g i - m i)])
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hbound
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const a) (hmi.norm.integrable (by norm_num)),
    integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at hbound
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_le_sum_abs_mul_one_add_norm
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_le_sum_abs_mul_one_add_norm {n : ℕ} (a x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    |a ⬝ᵥ x| ≤ (∑ i, |a i|) * (1 + ‖x‖)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul]
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i, |a i * x i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [abs_mul]
      gcongr
      have hh := norm_le_pi_norm x i
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hh
      linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_prod_dotProduct_le_polynomial
statement:
theorem abs_prod_dotProduct_le_polynomial
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    |∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x| ≤ (∏ j ∈ s, ∑ i, |a j i|) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ s.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.abs_prod]
  calc
    _ ≤ (∏ j ∈ s, (∑ i, |a j i|) * (1 + ‖x‖)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
      intro j _
      exact abs_dotProduct_le_sum_abs_mul_one_add_norm (a j) x
    _ = _ := (Finset.prod_mul_pow_card).symm

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → Fin n → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    (Measurable.aemeasurable (by simp only [dotProduct]; fun_prop)) _ s.card
  exact abs_prod_dotProduct_le_polynomial s a

name: NLAlib.integrable_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => (b ⬝ᵥ x) * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    (Measurable.aemeasurable (by simp only [dotProduct]; fun_prop))
    ((∑ i, |b i|) * ∏ j ∈ s, ∑ i, |a j i|) (s.card + 1)
  intro x
  rw [abs_mul, pow_succ]
  calc _ ≤ ((∑ i, |b i|) * (1 + ‖x‖)) *
      ((∏ j ∈ s, ∑ i, |a j i|) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ s.card) :=
        mul_le_mul (abs_dotProduct_le_sum_abs_mul_one_add_norm b x)
          (abs_prod_dotProduct_le_polynomial s a x) (abs_nonneg _)
          (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_dotProduct_update
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_dotProduct_update {n : ℕ} (a x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => a ⬝ᵥ Function.update x i y) (a i) t
proof:
:= by
  let L : (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ∑ j, (a j) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j
  have hh := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_update x i t)
  have hf : (fun y => a ⬝ᵥ Function.update x i y) = L ∘ Function.update x i := by
    funext y
    simp [L, dotProduct]
  rw [hf]
  exact hh.congr_deriv (by simp [L, Pi.single_apply])

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, x i * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x
        ∂(gaussianVector _) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, a j i * ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, a k ⬝ᵥ x
        ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x
  let df : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ j ∈ s, a j i * ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, a k ⬝ᵥ x
  have hupdate : ∀ x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => f (Function.update x i y))
      (df (Function.update x i t)) t := by
    intro x t
    have hh := HasDerivAt.fun_finsetProd (u := s)
      (fun j (_ : j ∈ s) => hasDerivAt_dotProduct_update (a j) x i t)
    exact hh.congr_deriv (by
      dsimp only [df]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm])
  have hfi := integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector s a
  have hxfi : Integrable (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => x i * f x)
      (gaussianVector _) := by
    have hh := integrable_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector s a (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa only [single_dotProduct, one_mul, f] using hh
  have hdfi : Integrable df (gaussianVector _) :=
    integrable_finsetSum s (fun j _ =>
