      (integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector (s.erase j) a).const_mul (a j i))
  have hh := integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update f df i
    hupdate hfi hxfi hdfi
  rw [hh]
  dsimp only [df]
  rw [integral_finsetSum s (fun j _ =>
    (integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector (s.erase j) a).const_mul (a j i))]
  simp only [integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι)
    (a : ι → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, (b ⬝ᵥ x) * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x
        ∂(gaussianVector _) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, (b ⬝ᵥ a j) * ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ k ∈ s.erase j, a k ⬝ᵥ x
        ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin n, Integrable (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => x i * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x)
      (gaussianVector _) := by
    intro i
    have hh := integrable_dotProduct_mul_prod_gaussianVector s a (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa only [single_dotProduct, one_mul] using hh
  have hexpand : ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, (b ⬝ᵥ x) * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x =
      ∑ i, b i * (x i * ∏ j ∈ s, a j ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    intro x
    simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
  simp_rw [hexpand]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hcoord i).const_mul (b i))]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul, integral_coordinate_mul_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.coefficientBlockKappa_le_sqrt_variance_covariance
statement:
theorem coefficientBlockKappa_le_sqrt_variance_covariance [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    coefficientBlockKappa A ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A)))
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (coefficientBlock_variance_covariance_bounds A hA).2.2.2
  have hκ : 0 ≤ coefficientBlockKappa A := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  apply (Real.le_sqrt hκ (by positivity)).mpr
  simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul (hh.trans (min_le_left _ _))
    (hh.trans (min_le_right _ _)) hκ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_log_le_correction
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hDpos : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < D by omega)
  have hlog : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (D : ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  have hDlog : 0 < Real.log (D : ℝ) := htwo.trans_le hlog
  have hquarter : (Real.log 2) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (D : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow htwo.le hlog (by norm_num)
  have hden : 0 < (Real.log 2) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos htwo _
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hquarter (Real.sqrt_nonneg (Real.log (D : ℝ)))
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at hh
  rw [← Real.rpow_add hDlog, show (1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = 3 / 4 by norm_num] at hh
  rw [inv_mul_eq_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, mul_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_covarianceSensitive
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_covarianceSensitive
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        (6 / (Real.log 2) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
            Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))) *
              (Real.log (Fintype.card d)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty d := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (show 0 < Fintype.card d by omega)
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hι => simp [coefficientVariance, specNorm_zero]
  | inr hι =>
    have hκ := coefficientBlockKappa_le_sqrt_variance_covariance A hA
    have hlog := sqrt_log_le_correction (Fintype.card d) hd
    apply (integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose A hA).trans
    apply add_le_add le_rfl
    have hh := mul_le_mul hκ hlog (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hh' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6 by norm_num)
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hh'

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_covarianceSensitive_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_covarianceSensitive_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d)
    {ξ : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ∂μ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        (6 / (Real.log 2) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) *
            Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientCovariance A))) *
              (Real.log (Fintype.card d)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  rw [show (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι from
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_covarianceSensitive A hA hd

name: NLAlib.covarianceSensitiveCorrectionConstant_pos
statement:
theorem covarianceSensitiveCorrectionConstant_pos :

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le_of_hasLaw
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {ξ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (gaussianVector (Fin n)) μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) ≤
      (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) ^ p * ((∑ i, A i ^ 2) ^ p).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re) := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      continuous_re_trace_series_product A 1 1 (2 * p) 0
  rw [show (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂(gaussianVector (Fin n)) from
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le A hA hp

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_rpow_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_rpow_le_of_hasLaw
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {ξ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (gaussianVector (Fin n)) μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂μ) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * p - 1 : ℕ) *
        (((∑ i, A i ^ 2) ^ p).trace.re) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply rpow_le_sqrt_mul_rpow_of_nat_pow_le
  · exact integral_nonneg fun ω => re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even _
      (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA (ξ ω)) (even_two_mul p)
  · exact re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_posSemidef _ (posSemidef_sum_sq_of_isHermitian A hA) p
  · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  · exact hp
  · exact integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_pow_le_of_hasLaw A hA hξ hp

name: NLAlib.integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_eq_zero
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (a : κ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, complexGaussianLinearForm a x ∂gaussianVector κ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hint (k : κ) : Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => (x k : ℂ)) (gaussianVector κ) :=
    ((memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)).integrable one_le_two).ofReal
  have hzero (k : κ) : (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x k ∂gaussianVector κ) = 0 :=
    integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)
  change (∫ x : κ → ℝ, ∑ k, a k * (x k : ℂ) ∂gaussianVector κ) = 0
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => (hint k).const_mul (a k))]
  simp only [integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal, hzero,
    Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (a b : κ → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      complexGaussianLinearForm a x * complexGaussianLinearForm b x)
      (gaussianVector κ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexp : (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      complexGaussianLinearForm a x * complexGaussianLinearForm b x) =
      fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j, (a i * b j) * ((x i * x j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    funext x
    simp only [complexGaussianLinearForm, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    (integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector i j).ofReal.const_mul (a i * b j)

name: NLAlib.integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul
statement:
theorem integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (a b : κ → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, complexGaussianLinearForm a x * complexGaussianLinearForm b x
      ∂gaussianVector κ) = a ⬝ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      complexGaussianLinearForm a x * complexGaussianLinearForm b x) =
      fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j, (a i * b j) * ((x i * x j : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    funext x
    simp only [complexGaussianLinearForm, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    push_cast
    ring
  have hint (i j : κ) : Integrable
      (fun x : κ → ℝ => (a i * b j) * ((x i * x j : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (gaussianVector κ) :=
    (integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector i j).ofReal.const_mul (a i * b j)
  rw [hexp, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hint i j))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hint _ j),
    integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal, integral_mul_apply_gaussianVector]
  simp [dotProduct, apply_ite]

name: NLAlib.pi_gaussianReal_eq_withDensity
statement:
private lemma pi_gaussianReal_eq_withDensity (m : ℕ) :
    (gaussianVector (Fin m))
      = volume.withDensity
          (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.pi_eq (μ := fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 1) fun s hs => ?_
  have hS : MeasurableSet (Set.univ.pi s) := MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs
  rw [withDensity_apply _ hS, ← lintegral_indicator hS]
  have hind : ∀ x : Fin m → ℝ,
      (Set.univ.pi s).indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x i))) x
        = ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i, (s i).indicator (gaussianPDFReal 0 1) (x i)) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.univ.pi s
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hx i (Set.mem_univ i))]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, not_forall] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (Set.indicator_of_notMem hi _)]
      simp
  simp_rw [hind]
  have hint : Integrable (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => ∏ i, (s i).indicator (gaussianPDFReal 0 1) (x i))
      volume := by
    rw [volume_pi]
    exact Integrable.fintype_prod (f := fun i => (s i).indicator (gaussianPDFReal 0 1))
      (fun i => (integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).indicator (hs i))
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
    (ae_of_all _ fun x => Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Set.indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 y) _)]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod, ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg
    (fun i _ => integral_nonneg fun y =>
      Set.indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 y) _)]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [gaussianReal_apply_eq_integral 0 one_ne_zero, integral_indicator (hs i)]

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_ofLp
statement:
private lemma sum_sq_ofLp {m : ℕ} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    ∑ i, (WithLp.ofLp y) i ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: NLAlib.integral_radial_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_radial_gaussianVector (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, φ (Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin m))
      = m * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
        * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m
          * ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) * (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * φ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pi_gaussianReal_eq_withDensity, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by fun_prop)
    (ae_of_all _ fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 _),
    smul_eq_mul, prod_gaussianPDFReal]
  rw [← (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin m)).integral_comp']
  simp only [MeasurableEquiv.toLp_symm_apply]
  simp_rw [sum_sq_ofLp, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  have : Nonempty (Fin m) := ⟨⟨0, hm⟩⟩
  have : Nontrivial (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) := inferInstance
  have := integral_fun_norm_addHaar (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)))
    (fun r => (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m * Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / 2) * φ r)
  rw [this, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [smul_eq_mul]
  have e : ∀ y : ℝ, y ^ (m - 1) * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * φ y)
      = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m * (y ^ (m - 1) * (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * φ y)) := fun y => by
    ring
  simp_rw [e]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two (s : ℝ) (hs : -1 < s) :
    ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ s * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2)
      = 2 ^ ((s + 1) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow (p := 2) (q := s) (b := 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num) hs (by norm_num)
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-(s + 1) / 2) = 2 ^ ((s + 1) / 2) := by
    rw [one_div, Real.inv_rpow (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hhalf] at h
  rw [← h]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
  rw [Real.rpow_two]
  congr 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    Integrable (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ^ q)
      (gaussianVector (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (gaussianVector (Fin m))
  have hLp : MemLp (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => WithLp.toLp 2 x)
      (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * q)) μ := by
    rw [memLp_piLp_iff]
    intro i
    have h := (memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1)
      (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * q)) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).comp_measurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin m => gaussianReal 0 1) i)
    simpa using h
  have hint := hLp.integrable_norm_rpow'
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * q)] at hint
  refine hint.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))‖ ^ (2 * q) = _
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    ∫ x : Fin m → ℝ, (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ^ q
      ∂(gaussianVector (Fin m))
      = 2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q) / Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hcast : ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hm, Nat.cast_one]
  let K : ℝ := m * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
    * (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m
  have hnorm := integral_radial_gaussianVector m hm (fun _ => 1)
  simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hnorm
  rw [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] at hnorm
  have hbase : (∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2))
      = 2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2) := by
    have hfun : (∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2))
        = ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ ((m : ℝ) - 1) * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) := by
      simp_rw [← hcast, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [hfun, integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two _ (by linarith)]
    rw [show ((m : ℝ) - 1 + 1) / 2 = (m : ℝ) / 2 by ring]
  rw [hbase] at hnorm
  have hnorm' : 1 = K * (2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2)) := by
    simpa only [K, mul_assoc] using hnorm
  have hmoment := integral_radial_gaussianVector m hm (fun y => y ^ (2 * q))
  have hleft : (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => (Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2)) ^ (2 * q))
      = (fun x : Fin m → ℝ => (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ^ q) := by
    funext x
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hleft] at hmoment
  have hright : (∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) *
      (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ (2 * q)))
      = 2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q) := by
    have hfun : (∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) *
        (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * y ^ (2 * q)))
        = ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ ((m : ℝ) - 1 + 2 * q) * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y hy => ?_
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, hcast, mul_left_comm, ← Real.rpow_add hy]
      ring
    rw [hfun, integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two _ (by linarith)]
    congr 2 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
  rw [hright] at hmoment
  have hmoment' : (∫ x : Fin m → ℝ, (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ^ q
      ∂(gaussianVector (Fin m)))
      = K * (2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q)) := by
    rw [hmoment]
    simp [K]
    ring
  rw [hmoment', Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
  have hG : Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)).ne'
  apply (eq_div_iff hG).2
  calc K * (2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2) * 2 ^ q * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q))
        * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2)
      = (K * (2 ^ ((m : ℝ) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2)))
        * (2 ^ q * Real.Gamma ((m : ℝ) / 2 + q)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← hnorm', one_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_abs_rpow_gaussianReal (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
    (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ (2 * q) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
      = 2 ^ q * Real.Gamma (q + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_rpow_sum_sq_gaussianVector 1 (by omega) q hq
  have hfun : (fun x : Fin 1 → ℝ => (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ^ q)
      = (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ (2 * q)) ∘ (fun x : Fin 1 → ℝ => x 0) := by
    funext x
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← sq_abs, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg _)]
    congr 1
  rw [hfun] at h
  have heval : (∫ x : Fin 1 → ℝ, |x 0| ^ (2 * q)
      ∂(gaussianVector (Fin 1)))
      = ∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ (2 * q) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    rw [← integral_map (μ := (gaussianVector (Fin 1)))
      (φ := fun x : Fin 1 → ℝ => x 0) (f := fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ (2 * q))
      (measurable_pi_apply 0).aemeasurable
      (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ (2 * q))).aestronglyMeasurable,
      (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin 1 => gaussianReal 0 1) 0).map_eq]
  change (∫ x : Fin 1 → ℝ, |x 0| ^ (2 * q) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin 1))) = _ at h
  rw [heval] at h
  simpa only [Nat.cast_one, add_comm, Real.Gamma_one_half_eq] using h

name: NLAlib.mul_hermiteFunction_succ
statement:
theorem mul_hermiteFunction_succ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    x * hermiteFunction (n + 1) x =
      Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 2) * hermiteFunction (n + 2) x +
        Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) * hermiteFunction n x
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : x * (realHermite (n + 1)).eval x =
      (realHermite (n + 2)).eval x + ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (realHermite n).eval x := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.eval x) (realHermite_succ (n + 1))
    rw [derivative_realHermite_succ] at hh
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_smul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one, eval_add, eval_natCast, eval_one, Nat.add_assoc] at hh
    linarith
  have hf₁ := sqrt_factorial_succ n
  have hf₂ := sqrt_factorial_succ (n + 1)
  have h₁ := sqrt_succ_ne_zero n
  have h₂ : Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hf := sqrt_factorial_ne_zero n
  have hs : Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) + 1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  unfold hermiteFunction
  rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega, hf₂, hf₁]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at *
  rw [show (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by ring]
  field_simp
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun y : ℝ => y * (realHermite n).eval x) hs]

name: NLAlib.productHermite_update
statement:
theorem productHermite_update (a : ι → ℕ) (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    productHermite (Function.update a i n) x =
      hermiteFunction n (x i) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, hermiteFunction (a j) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold productHermite
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [Function.update_self]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hji : j ≠ i := by simpa only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_univ,
    true_and] using hj
  simp [Function.update_of_ne hji]

name: NLAlib.coordinate_mul_productHermite
statement:
theorem coordinate_mul_productHermite {p : ℕ} (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (i : ι)
    (h : a.degree < p) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    x i * productHermite a.val x =
      Real.sqrt ((a.val i : ℝ) + 1) * productHermite (a.raise i h).val x +
        if 0 < a.val i then Real.sqrt (a.val i : ℝ) *
          productHermite (a.lower i).val x else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : productHermite a.val x = hermiteFunction (a.val i) (x i) *
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, hermiteFunction (a.val j) (x j) := by
    unfold productHermite
    exact Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i) _
  have hraise : productHermite (a.raise i h).val x =
      hermiteFunction (a.val i + 1) (x i) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, hermiteFunction (a.val j) (x j) :=
    productHermite_update a.val i (a.val i + 1) x
  have hlower : productHermite (a.lower i).val x =
      hermiteFunction (a.val i - 1) (x i) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, hermiteFunction (a.val j) (x j) :=
    productHermite_update a.val i (a.val i - 1) x
  rw [hsplit, hraise, hlower]
  cases hn : a.val i with
  | zero =>
    have hh : x i = hermiteFunction 1 (x i) := by
      simpa only [hermiteFunction_zero, mul_one] using mul_hermiteFunction_zero (x i)
    simp [← hh]
  | succ n =>
    simp only [hn, Nat.succ_pos, if_true, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hh := mul_hermiteFunction_succ n (x i)
    have he := congrArg (fun y : ℝ => y *
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i}, hermiteFunction (a.val j) (x j)) hh
    rw [show (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by ring]
    convert he using 1 <;> ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_abs_rpow_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_abs_rpow_gaussianReal (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ p) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := 0) (v := 1)
    (ENNReal.ofReal p) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).integrable_norm_rpow'
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp, Real.norm_eq_abs, id_eq] using hh

name: NLAlib.pow_div_four_le_gaussianEvenMoment
statement:
private theorem pow_div_four_le_gaussianEvenMoment (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ((m : ℝ) / 4) ^ m ≤ gaussianEvenMoment m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hm
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hπ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Real.pi_gt_three.le hm0
  have hroot : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * m) := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi * m by positivity)
    have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi * m)
    nlinarith
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ 4 := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_three]
  have hbase : (m : ℝ) / 4 ≤ m / Real.exp 1 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos 1)).mpr
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hm0
  calc
    ((m : ℝ) / 4) ^ m ≤ ((m : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ m := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase m
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * m) * ((m : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ m :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hroot
    _ ≤ m.factorial := Stirling.le_factorial_stirling m
    _ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment m := factorial_le_gaussianEvenMoment m

name: NLAlib.sqrt_div_four_le_even_moment_root
statement:
private theorem sqrt_div_four_le_even_moment_root (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) / 4) ≤ gaussianEvenMoment m ^ (2 * (m : ℝ))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m by omega)
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((m : ℝ) / 4) ^ m by positivity)
    (pow_div_four_le_gaussianEvenMoment m hm)
    (show 0 ≤ (2 * (m : ℝ))⁻¹ by positivity)
  have heq : (((m : ℝ) / 4) ^ m) ^ (2 * (m : ℝ))⁻¹ = Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) / 4) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) / 4 by positivity),
      Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rwa [heq] at hroot

name: NLAlib.sqrt_div_four_le_integral_abs_rpow_root_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem sqrt_div_four_le_integral_abs_rpow_root_gaussianReal
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    Real.sqrt p / 4 ≤ (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ p ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  let m := ⌊p / 2⌋₊
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := Nat.floor_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hmp : 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    have hh := Nat.floor_le (show 0 ≤ p / 2 by positivity)
    change (m : ℝ) ≤ p / 2 at hh
    linarith
  have hpm : p / 4 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    have hh := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (p / 2)
    change p / 2 < (m : ℝ) + 1 at hh
    linarith
  have hscalar :
      (∫ z : ℝ, |z| ^ (2 * (m : ℝ)) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) = gaussianEvenMoment m := by
    have he : 2 * (m : ℝ) = ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [he]
    simp only [Real.rpow_natCast, even_two_mul, Even.pow_abs]
    exact integral_pow_two_mul_gaussianReal m
  have hmono := integral_rpow_root_le_of_nonneg_of_le
    (μ := gaussianReal 0 1) (f := fun z : ℝ => |z|)
    (by fun_prop) (fun z => abs_nonneg z) (show 0 < 2 * (m : ℝ) by positivity) hmp
    (integrable_abs_rpow_gaussianReal p hp0.le)
  rw [hscalar] at hmono
  have hleft : Real.sqrt p / 4 ≤ Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) / 4) := by
    have hh := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (show p / 16 ≤ (m : ℝ) / 4 by linarith)
    have heq : Real.sqrt (p / 16) = Real.sqrt p / 4 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_div hp0.le]
      rw [show Real.sqrt (16 : ℝ) = 4 by
        apply (Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mpr
        norm_num]
    rwa [heq] at hh
  exact hleft.trans ((sqrt_div_four_le_even_moment_root m hm).trans hmono)

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_sq
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_sq
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re
        ∂(gaussianVector _)) = (∑ i, A i ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re =
      ∑ i, x i * (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ 1).trace.re := by
    rw [pow_two, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, pow_one]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
    integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A (A i) 1 i]
  simp_rw [integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, show Nat.pred 1 = 0 by rfl, Nat.sub_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_sq
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_sq
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re
        ∂(rademacherVector _)) = (∑ i, A i ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (x : κ → ℝ) : ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re =
      ∑ i, x i * (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ 1).trace.re := by
    rw [pow_two, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul, pow_one]
  have hcoord (i : κ) :
      (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x i * (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ 1).trace.re
          ∂(rademacherVector _)) = (A i ^ 2).trace.re := by
    have he (x : κ → ℝ) : x i * (A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ 1).trace.re =
        ∑ j, (x i * x j) * (A i * A j).trace.re := by
      rw [pow_one, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
      (integrable_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector i j).mul_const _]
    simp_rw [integral_mul_const, integral_coordinate_mul_coordinate_rademacherVector]
    simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, pow_two]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
    integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_rademacherSeries_pow A (A i) 1 i]
  simp_rw [hcoord]
  rw [Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum]

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_independent_series_sq
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_independent_series_sq
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (ξ : κ → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, Measurable (ξ i))
    (hind : iIndepFun ξ μ) (h2 : ∀ i, MemLp (ξ i) 2 μ)
    (h0 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ξ i ω ∂μ = 0) (h1 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ξ i ω ^ 2 ∂μ = 1) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ i ω • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂μ) = (∑ i, A i ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hexp (ω) : ((∑ i, ξ i ω • A i) ^ 2).trace.re =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (ξ i ω * ξ j ω) * (A i * A j).trace.re := by
    simp [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Matrix.trace_sum, Matrix.trace_smul,
      Complex.re_sum, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  have hint (i j) : Integrable (fun ω => ξ i ω * ξ j ω) μ :=
    (h2 i).integrable_mul (h2 j)
  have hcorr (i j) : ∫ ω, ξ i ω * ξ j ω ∂μ = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    split_ifs with hij
    · subst hij
      simpa [sq] using h1 i
    · rw [(hind.indepFun hij).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
        (hξ i).aestronglyMeasurable (hξ j).aestronglyMeasurable, h0 i, zero_mul]
  simp_rw [hexp]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hint i j).mul_const _))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hint _ j).mul_const _),
    integral_mul_const, hcorr]
  simp [Matrix.trace_sum, Complex.re_sum, sq]

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_sq_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_sq_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A : Fin n → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    {ξ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (gaussianVector (Fin n)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂μ) = (∑ i, A i ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re) := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using continuous_re_trace_series_product A 1 1 2 0
  rw [show (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂(gaussianVector (Fin n)) from
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_sq A

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_sq_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_sq_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    {ξ : Ω → κ → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (rademacherVector (κ)) μ) :
    (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂μ) = (∑ i, A i ^ 2).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : κ → ℝ => ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re) := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using continuous_re_trace_series_product A 1 1 2 0
  rw [show (∫ ω, ((∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ 2).trace.re ∂(rademacherVector (κ)) from
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_re_trace_rademacherSeries_sq A

name: NLAlib.gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply_eq_integral_mul_of_centered
statement:
theorem gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply_eq_integral_mul_of_centered {n : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) (i j : Fin n) :
    gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ i j = ∫ x, x i * x j ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin n, MemLp (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => x i) 2 μ := by
    intro i
    exact IsGaussian.memLp_dual μ (EuclideanSpace.proj i) 2 (by simp)
  have hm : ∀ i : Fin n, ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), x i ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hh := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] ℝ).integral_comp_comm
      (show Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => x) μ from IsGaussian.integrable_id)
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.coe_proj, hmean, map_zero] using hh
  rw [gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply μ IsGaussian.memLp_two_id,
    covariance_eq_sub (hmem i) (hmem j), hm, hm, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_pairings {n m : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) :
    ∫ x, ∏ r, x (idx r) ∂μ =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings m,
        gaussianPairingWeight (fun a b => gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ (idx a) (idx b)) π
proof:
:= by
  let C := gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ
  let L := CFC.sqrt C
  have hC : C.PosSemidef := gaussianCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef μ
  have hL : L.IsSymm := Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg C).isSelfAdjoint
  have hsq : L * L = C := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self C hC.nonneg
  have hdot : ∀ i j : Fin n, (fun a => L i a) ⬝ᵥ (fun a => L j a) = C i j := by
    intro i j
    change (L * Lᵀ) i j = C i j
    rw [hL.eq, hsq]
  have hrep := gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered μ hmean
  have h := integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_sum_gaussianPairingWeight
    (fun r : Fin m => fun a => L (idx r) a)
  have hmap : (∫ x, ∏ r, x (idx r) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ r, (fun a => L (idx r) a) ⬝ᵥ x
        ∂(gaussianVector _) := by
    rw [hrep, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  simpa only [hdot, C] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_integral_mul_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_integral_mul_pairings {n m : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) :
    ∫ x, ∏ r, x (idx r) ∂μ =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings m,
        gaussianPairingWeight (fun a b => ∫ x, x (idx a) * x (idx b) ∂μ) π
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply_eq_integral_mul_of_centered μ hmean] using
    integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_pairings μ hmean idx

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_zero_of_odd
statement:
theorem integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_zero_of_odd {n m : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) (hm : Odd m) :
    ∫ x, ∏ r, x (idx r) ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered μ hmean
  rw [hrep, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  exact integral_prod_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_odd hm
    (fun r a => CFC.sqrt (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ) (idx r) a)

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_eval_gaussian_of_centered
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_eval_gaussian_of_centered {n m : ℕ}
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) :
    Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => ∏ r, x (idx r)) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered μ hmean]
  apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).mpr
  exact integrable_prod_dotProduct_gaussianVector Finset.univ
    (fun r a => CFC.sqrt (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ) (idx r) a)

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_gaussianVector_eq_sum_pairings
statement:
theorem integral_prod_gaussianVector_eq_sum_pairings
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {n m : ℕ} (G : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hG : HasGaussianLaw G P)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, G ω ∂P = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) :
    ∫ ω, ∏ r, G ω (idx r) ∂P =
      ∑ π : GaussianPairings m,
        gaussianPairingWeight (fun a b => ∫ ω, G ω (idx a) * G ω (idx b) ∂P) π
proof:
:= by
  have := hG.isGaussian_map
  have hm : ∫ x, x ∂P.map G = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, G ω ∂P := integral_map hG.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
      _ = 0 := hmean
  have hh := integral_prod_eval_gaussian_eq_sum_integral_mul_pairings (P.map G) hm idx
  have hout : (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ∏ r, x (idx r) ∂P.map G) =
      ∫ ω, ∏ r, G ω (idx r) ∂P := integral_map hG.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
  have hcov : ∀ a b : Fin m,
      (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), x (idx a) * x (idx b) ∂P.map G) =
      ∫ ω, G ω (idx a) * G ω (idx b) ∂P :=
    fun a b => integral_map hG.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
  simpa only [hout, hcov] using hh

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_gaussianVector_of_centered
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_gaussianVector_of_centered
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {n m : ℕ} (G : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hG : HasGaussianLaw G P)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, G ω ∂P = 0) (idx : Fin m → Fin n) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ∏ r, G ω (idx r)) P
proof:
:= by
  have := hG.isGaussian_map
  have hm : ∫ x, x ∂P.map G = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ ω, G ω ∂P := integral_map hG.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
      _ = 0 := hmean
  exact (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hG.aemeasurable).mp
    (integrable_prod_eval_gaussian_of_centered (P.map G) hm idx)

name: NLAlib.operator_mul_apply
statement:
private theorem operator_mul_apply (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (Z : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) c ℂ)
    (a : d) (α : HermiteIndex ι p) (b : c) :
    (hermiteSeriesOperator A p * Z) (a, α) b =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, A i a j *
        ((hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *ᵥ
          (fun β => Z (j, β) b)) α
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermiteSeriesOperator_eq_sum_kronecker A hA]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    Matrix.kronecker_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  conv_lhs => arg 2; ext j; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.matrixHermiteExpansion_operator_mul
statement:
theorem matrixHermiteExpansion_operator_mul
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (Z : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) c ℂ)
    (hZ : ∀ a α b, ¬ α.degree < p → Z (a, α) b = 0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    matrixHermiteExpansion (hermiteSeriesOperator A p * Z) x =
      (∑ i, x i • A i) * matrixHermiteExpansion Z x
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [matrixHermiteExpansion, operator_mul_apply A hA]
  simp_rw [hermiteExpansion_sum, hermiteExpansion_const_mul]
  have hterm (i : ι) (j : d) :
      hermiteExpansion ((hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *ᵥ
        (fun β => Z (j, β) b)) x =
      (x i : ℂ) * hermiteExpansion (fun β => Z (j, β) b) x :=
    hermiteExpansion_creation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec i _
      (fun α hα => hZ j α b hα) x
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.sum_mul, matrixHermiteExpansion]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
  simp only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.hermiteSeriesOperator_mul_support
statement:
theorem hermiteSeriesOperator_mul_support
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    (Z : Matrix (d × HermiteIndex ι p) c ℂ) (k : ℕ)
    (hZ : ∀ a α b, k < α.degree → Z (a, α) b = 0)
    (a : d) (α : HermiteIndex ι p) (b : c) (hα : k + 1 < α.degree) :
    (hermiteSeriesOperator A p * Z) (a, α) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [operator_mul_apply A hA]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [hermiteCreation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec_support i _ k
    (fun β hβ => hZ j β b hβ) α hα, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingEdges_flatMap_eq_gaussianPairingPositions
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingEdges_flatMap_eq_gaussianPairingPositions {m : ℕ}
    (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    (gaussianPairingEdges π).flatMap (fun e => [e.1, e.2]) =
      gaussianPairingPositions π
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => rfl
  | one => exact Empty.elim π
  | more m ih _ =>
      rcases π with ⟨j, π⟩
      simp only [gaussianPairingEdges, gaussianPairingPositions,
        List.flatMap_cons]
      have hmap : ((gaussianPairingEdges π).map (fun e =>
          ((j.succAbove e.1).succ, (j.succAbove e.2).succ))).flatMap
            (fun e => [e.1, e.2]) =
          ((gaussianPairingEdges π).flatMap (fun e => [e.1, e.2])).map
            (fun a => (j.succAbove a).succ) := by
        induction (gaussianPairingEdges π) with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons e T ih =>
            simp [List.flatMap_cons, ih]
      rw [hmap, ih]
      rfl

statement:

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingEdges_endpoints_bijective
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingEdges_endpoints_bijective {m : ℕ}
    (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Sum.elim (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length =>
          ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1)
        (fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length =>
          ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2) :
        Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length ⊕
          Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Fin m)
proof:
:= by
  let E := Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length
  let alpha : E → Fin m := fun e => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1
  let beta : E → Fin m := fun e => ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
  change Function.Bijective (Sum.elim alpha beta)
  apply (Fintype.bijective_iff_surjective_and_card _).2
  constructor
  · intro i
    have hi : i ∈ (gaussianPairingEdges π).flatMap (fun e => [e.1, e.2]) := by
      rw [gaussianPairingEdges_flatMap_eq_gaussianPairingPositions]
      exact List.mem_toFinset.mp (by
        rw [gaussianPairingPositions_toFinset π]
        exact Finset.mem_univ i)
    obtain ⟨e, heL, hei⟩ := (List.mem_flatMap.mp hi)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (List.mem_iff_get.mp heL)
    simp at hei
    rcases hei with hei | hei
    · refine ⟨Sum.inl a, ?_⟩
      change ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get a).1 = i
      rw [ha, hei]
    · refine ⟨Sum.inr a, ?_⟩
      change ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get a).2 = i
      rw [ha, hei]
  · rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hlen := two_mul_gaussianPairingEdges_length π
    omega

name: NLAlib.complexGaussianLinearForm_star
statement:
private theorem complexGaussianLinearForm_star (a : ι → ℂ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => star (a i)) x = star (complexGaussianLinearForm a x)

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm (a : ι → ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ‖complexGaussianLinearForm a x‖^2 ∂gaussianVector ι) = ∑ i, ‖a i‖^2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (x : ι → ℝ) : ‖complexGaussianLinearForm a x‖^2 =
      (complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => star (a i)) x * complexGaussianLinearForm a x).re := by
    rw [complexGaussianLinearForm_star]
    simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  have hRe := integral_re (integrable_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul (fun i => star (a i)) a)
  simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re] at hRe
  rw [hRe, integral_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul]
  simp only [dotProduct, Complex.re_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm (a : ι → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => ‖complexGaussianLinearForm a x‖^2) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (integrable_complexGaussianLinearForm_mul (fun i => star (a i)) a).re
  convert hh using 1
  funext x
  rw [complexGaussianLinearForm_star]
  simp only [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_eq_sum
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_eq_sum (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) = ∑ i, frobSq (A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (x : ι → ℝ) (j k : d) : (∑ i, x i • A i) j k =
      complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => A i j k) x := by
    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul,
      complexGaussianLinearForm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact mul_comm _ _
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, he]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ =>
    integrable_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => A i j k)))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ =>
    integrable_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => A i _ k)),
    integral_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : d, ∑ i : ι, ∑ k : d, ‖A i j k‖^2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_gaussianSeries
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_gaussianSeries (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i)) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (x : ι → ℝ) (j k : d) : (∑ i, x i • A i) j k =
      complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => A i j k) x := by
    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Complex.real_smul, complexGaussianLinearForm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact mul_comm _ _
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, he] using
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ
      (fun k _ => integrable_norm_sq_complexGaussianLinearForm (fun i => A i j k)))

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_le_card_sq_bilinearSquareMass
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_le_card_sq_bilinearSquareMass
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2 * bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_eq_sum]
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : d, ∑ k : d, ∑ i : ι, ‖A i j k‖^2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : d, ∑ _k : d, bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k _
      let e (j : d) : EuclideanSpace ℂ d := EuclideanSpace.single j 1
      have heval (B : Matrix d d ℂ) : star (e j).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ (e k).ofLp) = B j k := by simp [e]
      simpa only [heval] using sum_bilinear_sq_le_bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ
        (e j) (e k) (by simp [e]) (by simp [e])
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_gaussianSeries_gt_bilinear_scale_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_gaussianSeries_gt_bilinear_scale_le [Nonempty d]
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hmass : 0 < bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ |
      4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q <
        specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i)} ≤ 1/(16*q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := 4*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)*Real.sqrt q
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card d := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp only [L]; positivity
  have hLsq : L^2 = 16*(Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ*q := by
    dsimp only [L]
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hmass.le, Real.sq_sqrt hq.le]
    ring
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x : ι → ℝ => frobSq_nonneg (∑ i, x i • A i))
    (integrable_frobSq_gaussianSeries A) (L^2)
  have hsub : {x : ι → ℝ | L < specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i)} ⊆
      {x : ι → ℝ | L^2 ≤ frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i)} := by
    intro x hx
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ hL.le hx.le 2).trans (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq _)
  calc
    _ ≤ (gaussianVector ι).real {x : ι → ℝ | L^2 ≤ frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i)} :=
      measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (∫ x : ι → ℝ, frobSq (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι)/(L^2) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hL)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hm)
    _ ≤ ((Fintype.card d : ℝ)^2*bilinearSquareMass A Finset.univ)/(L^2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (integral_frobSq_gaussianSeries_le_card_sq_bilinearSquareMass A)
        (sq_nonneg L)
    _ = _ := by rw [hLsq]; field_simp
