name: NLAlib.integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (P : ℝ[X]) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x) =
      fun x => ∑ k ∈ P.support, P.coeff k * x ^ k := by
    funext x
    conv_lhs => rw [P.as_sum_support_C_mul_X_pow]
    simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X]
  rw [he]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => (integrable_pow_gaussianReal k).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_mul_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (P : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, x * P.eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, P.derivative.eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x) := P.differentiable
  have hderiv : deriv (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x) = fun x => P.derivative.eval x := by
    funext x
    exact P.deriv
  have hx : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * P.eval x) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    convert integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (X * P) using 1 <;>
      funext x <;> simp
  have hd : Integrable (deriv (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    rw [hderiv]
    exact integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal P.derivative
  simpa only [hderiv] using
    integral_mul_eq_integral_deriv_gaussianReal_of_integrable
      (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x) hdiff
      (integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal P) hx hd

name: NLAlib.realHermite_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem realHermite_zero : realHermite 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHermite, Polynomial.hermite_zero]

name: NLAlib.realHermite_succ
statement:
theorem realHermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    realHermite (n + 1) = X * realHermite n - (realHermite n).derivative
proof:
:= by
  simp [realHermite, Polynomial.hermite_succ, derivative_map]

name: NLAlib.derivative_realHermite_succ
statement:
theorem derivative_realHermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (realHermite (n + 1)).derivative = (n + 1) • realHermite n
proof:
:= by
  change derivative ((hermite (n + 1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) = _
  rw [derivative_map, Polynomial.derivative_hermite_succ]
  simp [realHermite, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_realHermite_mul_polynomial_eval
statement:
theorem integral_realHermite_mul_polynomial_eval (n : ℕ) (P : ℝ[X]) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, (realHermite n).eval x * P.eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, ((Polynomial.derivative^[n]) P).eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing P with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hStein := integral_mul_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (realHermite n * P)
    have h₁ := integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal ((realHermite n).derivative * P)
    have h₂ := integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (realHermite n * P.derivative)
    have h₃ := integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (X * realHermite n * P)
    simp only [derivative_mul, eval_add, eval_mul] at hStein h₁ h₂
    rw [integral_add h₁ h₂] at hStein
    rw [realHermite_succ]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, sub_mul]
    rw [integral_sub (by simpa only [eval_mul, eval_X, mul_assoc] using h₃) h₁]
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ← ih P.derivative]
    simp only [← mul_assoc] at hStein
    linarith

name: NLAlib.natDegree_realHermite
statement: @[simp] theorem natDegree_realHermite (n : ℕ) : (realHermite n).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [realHermite, (Polynomial.hermite_monic n).natDegree_map]
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_hermite

name: NLAlib.iterate_derivative_realHermite_self
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_realHermite_self (n : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.derivative^[n]) (realHermite n) = C (n.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, derivative_realHermite_succ,
      Polynomial.iterate_derivative_smul, ih]
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.integral_realHermite_mul_realHermite
statement:
theorem integral_realHermite_mul_realHermite (n m : ℕ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, (realHermite n).eval x * (realHermite m).eval x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      if n = m then (n.factorial : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst m
    rw [integral_realHermite_mul_polynomial_eval, iterate_derivative_realHermite_self]
    simp
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hnm | hmn
    · have he : (fun x : ℝ => (realHermite n).eval x * (realHermite m).eval x) =
          fun x => (realHermite m).eval x * (realHermite n).eval x := by
        funext x; exact mul_comm _ _
      rw [he, integral_realHermite_mul_polynomial_eval]
      rw [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_eq_zero (by simpa using hnm)]
      simp
    · rw [integral_realHermite_mul_polynomial_eval]
      rw [Polynomial.iterate_derivative_eq_zero (by simpa using hmn)]
      simp

name: NLAlib.hermiteFunction_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem hermiteFunction_zero (x : ℝ) : hermiteFunction 0 x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteFunction]

name: NLAlib.continuous_hermiteFunction
statement: theorem continuous_hermiteFunction (n : ℕ) : Continuous (hermiteFunction n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hermiteFunction
  exact (realHermite n).continuous.div_const _

name: NLAlib.integrable_hermiteFunction_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_hermiteFunction_mul (n m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => hermiteFunction n x * hermiteFunction m x) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (integrable_polynomial_eval_gaussianReal (realHermite n * realHermite m)).div_const
    (Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (m.factorial : ℝ))
  convert h using 1 <;> funext x <;> simp [hermiteFunction, div_mul_div_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_hermiteFunction_mul
statement:
theorem integral_hermiteFunction_mul (n m : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, hermiteFunction n x * hermiteFunction m x ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      if n = m then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun x => hermiteFunction n x * hermiteFunction m x) =
      fun x => ((realHermite n).eval x * (realHermite m).eval x) /
        (Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (m.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [hermiteFunction, div_mul_div_comm]
  rw [he, integral_div, integral_realHermite_mul_realHermite]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst m
    rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _), div_self (by positivity)]
  · exact zero_div _

name: NLAlib.continuous_productHermite
statement:
theorem continuous_productHermite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℕ) :
    Continuous (productHermite a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold productHermite
  exact continuous_finsetProd _ fun i _ =>
    (continuous_hermiteFunction (a i)).comp (continuous_apply i)

name: NLAlib.integrable_productHermite_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_productHermite_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a b : ι → ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => productHermite a x * productHermite b x) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [productHermite, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib] using
    Integrable.fintype_prod (fun i => integrable_hermiteFunction_mul (a i) (b i))

name: NLAlib.integral_productHermite_mul
statement:
theorem integral_productHermite_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a b : ι → ℕ) :
    (∫ x, productHermite a x * productHermite b x ∂gaussianVector ι) =
      if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [productHermite, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod
    (fun (i : ι) (t : ℝ) => hermiteFunction (a i) t * hermiteFunction (b i) t)]
  simp_rw [integral_hermiteFunction_mul]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst b
    simp
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp h
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (if_neg hi)

name: NLAlib.one_sub_exp_gaussian_tail_le_measure_norm_ge
proof:
:= by
  let q := (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := measureReal_nonneg
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by
    have h : (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|} ≤ (gaussianReal 0 1).real univ :=
      measureReal_mono (subset_univ _) (by finiteness)
    simpa only [probReal_univ] using h
  have hs : (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | |x| < t} = 1 - q := by
    have he : {x : ℝ | |x| < t} = {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}ᶜ := by ext x; simp
    rw [he, measureReal_compl (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_abs), probReal_univ]
  have hprod : (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | ∀ i, |g i| < t} = (1 - q) ^ N := by
    have he : {g : Fin N → ℝ | ∀ i, |g i| < t} =
        Set.univ.pi (fun _ => {x : ℝ | |x| < t}) := by ext g; simp
    rw [he, Measure.real, Measure.pi_pi, ENNReal.toReal_prod]
    change (∏ _i : Fin N, (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | |x| < t}) = _
    simp only [hs, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hbad : (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | ‖g‖ < t} ≤ (1 - q) ^ N := by
    rw [← hprod]
    apply measureReal_mono ?_ (by finiteness)
    intro g hg i
    exact (norm_le_pi_norm g i).trans_lt hg
  have hcomp : (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | t ≤ ‖g‖} =
      1 - (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | ‖g‖ < t} := by
    have he : {g : Fin N → ℝ | t ≤ ‖g‖} = {g : Fin N → ℝ | ‖g‖ < t}ᶜ := by ext g; simp
    rw [he, measureReal_compl (measurableSet_lt measurable_norm measurable_const), probReal_univ]
  have hpow : (1 - q) ^ N ≤ Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * q) := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - q) (Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg q) N
    simpa only [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_neg, neg_mul] using h
  rw [hcomp]
  dsimp [q] at hpow hbad
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos
statement: theorem gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_pos : 0 < gaussianMaximumLowerConstant
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianMaximumLowerConstant
  have hc : 0 < Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have h := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (show -(Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) / 2 < 0 by linarith)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_log_le_integral_norm_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem gaussianMaximumLowerConstant_mul_sqrt_log_le_integral_norm_gaussianVector
    (N : ℕ) :
    gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1)) ≤
      ∫ g : Fin N → ℝ, ‖g‖ ∂gaussianVector (Fin N)
proof:
:= by
  have hV : MemLp (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => g) 2 (gaussianVector (Fin N)) := by
    apply memLp_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector i)
  rcases eq_or_ne N 0 with rfl | hN
  · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Real.log_one, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero]
    exact integral_nonneg fun g => norm_nonneg _
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hN
  let t := Real.sqrt (Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1))
  let c := Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  let q := (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := measureReal_nonneg
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hscalar : c / ((N : ℝ) + 1) ≤ q := by
    have h := exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_abs_tail t ht
    have he : Real.exp (-t ^ 2) = ((N : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [t]
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt hlog, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by linarith : 0 < (N : ℝ) + 1)]
    rw [he] at h
    simpa only [c, q, div_eq_mul_inv] using h
  have hNq : c / 2 ≤ (N : ℝ) * q := by
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < (N : ℝ) + 1)).mp hscalar
    have hmul := mul_nonneg hq0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hN1)
    nlinarith
  have htail : gaussianMaximumLowerConstant ≤
      (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | t ≤ ‖g‖} := by
    have h := one_sub_exp_gaussian_tail_le_measure_norm_ge N t
    have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show -(N : ℝ) * q ≤ -c / 2 by nlinarith)
    change 1 - Real.exp (-c / 2) ≤ _
    change 1 - Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * q) ≤ _ at h
    linarith
  have hmean := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun g : Fin N → ℝ => norm_nonneg g))
      (hV.norm.integrable (by norm_num)) t
  calc
    _ ≤ t * (gaussianVector (Fin N)).real {g | t ≤ ‖g‖} := by
      change gaussianMaximumLowerConstant * t ≤ _
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ _ := hmean

name: NLAlib.hermiteExpansion_sum
statement:
theorem hermiteExpansion_sum {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (z : κ → HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    hermiteExpansion (fun a => ∑ k, z k a) x = ∑ k, hermiteExpansion (z k) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteExpansion, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.hermiteExpansion_const_mul
statement:
theorem hermiteExpansion_const_mul (c : ℂ) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    hermiteExpansion (fun a => c * z a) x = c * hermiteExpansion z x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteExpansion, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.expansion_pairing
statement:
private theorem expansion_pairing (z w : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    star (hermiteExpansion z x) * hermiteExpansion w x =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, (star (z a) * w b) *
        ((productHermite a.val x * productHermite b.val x : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteExpansion, map_sum, map_mul, Complex.star_def,
    Complex.conj_ofReal, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_hermiteExpansion_pairing
statement:
theorem integrable_hermiteExpansion_pairing (z w : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x => star (hermiteExpansion z x) * hermiteExpansion w x)
      (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [expansion_pairing]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ =>
    ((integrable_productHermite_mul a.val b.val).ofReal).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_hermiteExpansion_pairing
statement:
theorem integral_hermiteExpansion_pairing (z w : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) :
    (∫ x, star (hermiteExpansion z x) * hermiteExpansion w x ∂gaussianVector ι) =
      ∑ a, star (z a) * w a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [expansion_pairing]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun b _ =>
    ((integrable_productHermite_mul a.val b.val).ofReal).const_mul _))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun b _ =>
    ((integrable_productHermite_mul a.val b.val).ofReal).const_mul _)]
  simp only [integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal, integral_productHermite_mul]
  have he (b : HermiteIndex ι p) : a.val = b.val ↔ a = b := Subtype.ext_iff.symm
  simp_rw [he]
  simp [apply_ite, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.re_star_mul_self
statement: private theorem re_star_mul_self (z : ℂ) : RCLike.re (star z * z) = ‖z‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (star z * z).re = _
  rw [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion
statement:
theorem integral_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) :
    (∫ x, ‖hermiteExpansion z x‖ ^ 2 ∂gaussianVector ι) = ∑ a, ‖z a‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg RCLike.re (integral_hermiteExpansion_pairing z z)
  rw [← integral_re (integrable_hermiteExpansion_pairing z z)] at hh
  simpa only [map_sum, re_star_mul_self] using hh

name: NLAlib.integrable_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_sq_hermiteExpansion (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖hermiteExpansion z x‖ ^ 2) (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [re_star_mul_self] using (integrable_hermiteExpansion_pairing z z).re

name: NLAlib.enJ_eq
statement:
private theorem enJ_eq (k : ℕ) :
    enJ k = 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [enJ, ← integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two (k : ℝ)
    (by have := (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k); linarith)]
  simp_rw [Real.rpow_natCast]

name: NLAlib.enJ_pos
statement: private theorem enJ_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < enJ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [enJ_eq]
  have : 0 < ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 := by positivity
  have := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos this
  positivity

name: NLAlib.enJ_rec
statement: private theorem enJ_rec (k : ℕ) : enJ (k + 2) = (k + 1) * enJ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [enJ_eq, enJ_eq]
  push_cast
  have hG : Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 2 + 1) / 2)
      = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 * Real.Gamma (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) := by
    rw [show ((k : ℝ) + 2 + 1) / 2 = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 + 1 by ring]
    exact Real.Gamma_add_one (by positivity)
  have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (((k : ℝ) + 2 + 1) / 2) = 2 ^ (((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2) * 2 := by
    rw [show ((k : ℝ) + 2 + 1) / 2 = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 + 1 by ring,
      Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one]
  rw [hG, hp]
  ring

name: NLAlib.en_norm_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := integral_radial_gaussianVector m hm (fun _ => 1)
  have h2 := integral_radial_gaussianVector m hm (fun y => y)
  simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h1
  rw [measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one] at h1
  have e1 : ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) * Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) = enJ (m - 1) := rfl
  have e2 : ∫ y in Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (m - 1) * (Real.exp (-y ^ 2 / 2) * y) = enJ m := by
    rw [enJ]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun y _ => ?_
    conv_rhs => rw [show m = m - 1 + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [h2, e2]
  have hJ := enJ_pos (m - 1)
  rw [eq_div_iff hJ.ne']
  have : (m : ℝ) * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
        * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m * enJ m) * enJ (m - 1)
      = enJ m * ((m : ℝ) * (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))).real (Metric.ball 0 1)
        * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ^ m * enJ (m - 1))) := by ring
  rw [this, ← h1, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.enJ_logconvex
statement: private theorem enJ_logconvex (k : ℕ) : enJ (k + 1) ^ 2 ≤ enJ k * enJ (k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [enJ_eq, enJ_eq, enJ_eq]
  push_cast
  set s : ℝ := ((k : ℝ) + 1) / 2 with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by positivity
  have e1 : ((k : ℝ) + 1 + 1) / 2 = s + 1 / 2 := by rw [hs]; ring
  have e3 : ((k : ℝ) + 2 + 1) / 2 = s + 1 := by rw [hs]; ring
  rw [e1, e3, Real.Gamma_add_one hs0.ne', Real.rpow_add (by norm_num),
    Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_one]
  have hGh := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (show 0 < s + 1 / 2 by linarith)
  have hG2 : Real.Gamma (s + 1 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.Gamma s ^ 2 * s :=
    calc Real.Gamma (s + 1 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.Gamma s * √s) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hGh.le (Gamma_add_half_le_mul_sqrt hs0) 2
      _ = Real.Gamma s ^ 2 * s := by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs0.le]
  have hc : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  calc (2 ^ s * 2 ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (s + 1 / 2)) ^ 2
      = (2 ^ s) ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / 4) * Real.Gamma (s + 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
        ring
    _ ≤ (2 ^ s) ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (1 / 4) * (Real.Gamma s ^ 2 * s) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 2 ^ s * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma s * (2 ^ s * 2 * (1 / 2) * (s * Real.Gamma s)) := by
        rw [hc]; ring

name: NLAlib.enB_pos
statement: private theorem enB_pos {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : 0 < enB m
proof:
:= by
  unfold enB
  have : 0 < 3 / (20 * m) := by positivity
  linarith

name: NLAlib.enB_mono_step
statement: private theorem enB_mono_step {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : m ^ 2 * enB (m + 2) ≤ (m + 1) ^ 2 * enB m
proof:
:= by
  unfold enB
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  rw [← sub_nonneg]
  have e : (m + 1) ^ 2 * (m - 1 / 2 + 3 / (20 * m)) - m ^ 2 * (m + 2 - 1 / 2 + 3 / (20 * (m + 2)))
      = (2 * m ^ 2 - 5 * m + 6) / (20 * m * (m + 2)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [e]
  apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - 5 / 4)]

name: NLAlib.enB_le_div
statement: private theorem enB_le_div {M : ℝ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) : M / enB M ≤ 1 + 1 / M
proof:
:= by
  have hB := enB_pos hM
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hB]
  unfold enB
  have hM0 : 0 < M := by linarith
  have e : (1 + 1 / M) * (M - 1 / 2 + 3 / (20 * M)) - M
      = (1 / 2) - 1 / (2 * M) + 3 / (20 * M) + 3 / (20 * M ^ 2) := by
    field_simp; ring
  have h1 : 1 / (2 * M) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; linarith
  have : 0 ≤ 3 / (20 * M) := by positivity
  have : 0 ≤ 3 / (20 * M ^ 2) := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.en_seq_sq_le
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → a (k + 2) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / k * a k := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 := hrec k hk
    have h2 := hrec (k + 1) (by omega)
    have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have ha1 := hpos (k + 1) (by omega)
    push_cast at h2
    rw [show k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by ring] at h2
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  
  have hmono : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → a k ^ 2 / enB k ≤ a (k + 2) ^ 2 / enB ((k + 2 : ℕ)) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
    have hB := enB_pos hk1
    have hB2 := enB_pos (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; linarith)
    rw [hstep k hk, div_le_div_iff₀ hB hB2]
    have hms := enB_mono_step hk1
    push_cast
    have e : (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k * a k) ^ 2 = ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * a k ^ 2 / k ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
    rw [e]
    rw [show ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * a k ^ 2 / k ^ 2 * enB k
        = a k ^ 2 * (((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * enB k) / k ^ 2 by ring]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have : a k ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 * enB (k + 2)) ≤ a k ^ 2 * ((k + 1) ^ 2 * enB k) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hms (sq_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  have hiter : ∀ j : ℕ, a m ^ 2 / enB m ≤ a (m + 2 * j) ^ 2 / enB ((m + 2 * j : ℕ)) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      refine ih.trans ?_
      have := hmono (m + 2 * j) (by omega)
      rwa [show m + 2 * j + 2 = m + 2 * (j + 1) by ring] at this
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hB := enB_pos hm1
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  set ρ := a m ^ 2 / enB m with hρ
  have hρ1 : 1 < ρ := by rw [hρ, lt_div_iff₀ hB]; linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / (ρ - 1))
  set M : ℕ := m + 2 * j with hM
  have hM1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by rw [hM]; push_cast; linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)]
  have hBM := enB_pos hM1
  have h1 := hiter j
  rw [← hM] at h1
  have h2 : a M ^ 2 / enB M ≤ M / enB M :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hsq M (by omega)) hBM.le
  have h3 := enB_le_div hM1
  have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) < j := lt_trans (by positivity) hj
  have hjM : (j : ℝ) ≤ M := by rw [hM]; push_cast; linarith
  have h4 : 1 / (M : ℝ) < ρ - 1 := by
    have : 1 / (M : ℝ) ≤ 1 / j := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hj0 hjM
    have : 1 / (j : ℝ) < ρ - 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hj0]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)] at hj
      linarith
    linarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.en_sqrt_mul_ge
statement:
private theorem en_sqrt_mul_ge {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    m + 1 / 2 - 1 / (8 * m) ≤ Real.sqrt m * Real.sqrt (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith)]
  apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have e : (m + 1 / 2 - 1 / (8 * m)) ^ 2 = m * (m + 1) - 1 / (8 * m) + 1 / (64 * m ^ 2) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [e]
  have : 1 / (64 * m ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (8 * m) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  linarith

name: NLAlib.en_step
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have hb : b = m / a := by field_simp; linarith
  rw [hb]
  set s := Real.sqrt m with hs
  set t := Real.sqrt (m + 1) with ht
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hm0
  have ht0 : 0 < t := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = m := Real.sq_sqrt hm0.le
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 = m + 1 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hst := en_sqrt_mul_ge hm
  rw [← hs, ← ht] at hst
  have hd : t - s = 1 / (t + s) := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith
  have hts : 0 < t + s := by linarith
  have hc : 0 < 1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m) := by
    have : 3 / (20 * m) ≤ 3 / 20 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
    linarith
  have hma : 1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m) ≤ m - a ^ 2 := by unfold enB at hB; linarith
  have hsq : 4 * m + 2 - 1 / (4 * m) ≤ (t + s) ^ 2 := by
    have : (t + s) ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + s ^ 2 + 2 * (s * t) := by ring
    rw [this, ht2, hs2]
    have : 2 * (m + 1 / 2 - 1 / (8 * m)) = 2 * m + 1 - 1 / (4 * m) := by field_simp; ring
    linarith
  have hpoly : enB m ≤ (1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m)) ^ 2 * (4 * m + 2 - 1 / (4 * m)) := by
    unfold enB
    rw [← sub_nonneg]
    have e : (1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m)) ^ 2 * (4 * m + 2 - 1 / (4 * m)) - (m - 1 / 2 + 3 / (20 * m))
        = (640 * m ^ 3 - 676 * m ^ 2 + 132 * m - 9) / (1600 * m ^ 3) := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [e]
    apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - 1), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hm) (sub_nonneg.2 hm)]
  have h5 : a ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m)) * (t + s)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow]
    refine hB.trans (hpoly.trans ?_)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (sq_nonneg _)
  have h6 : a ≤ (1 / 2 - 3 / (20 * m)) * (t + s) :=
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ ha.le (by positivity) (by norm_num)).1 h5
  have hkey : a ≤ (m - a ^ 2) * (t + s) :=
    h6.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hma hts.le)
  have e2 : m / a - a = (m - a ^ 2) / a := by field_simp
  rw [hd, e2, div_le_div_iff₀ hts ha]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.en_seq_diff
statement:
private theorem en_seq_diff (a : ℕ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m)
    (hrec : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m * a (m + 1) = m) (hsq : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m ^ 2 ≤ m)
    {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) :
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤ a N - a n
proof:
:= by
  induction N, hnN using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ k hk ih =>
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := le_trans hn hk
    have hst := en_step (m := (k : ℝ)) (by exact_mod_cast hk1) (hpos k hk1) (hrec k hk1)
      (en_seq_sq_le a hpos hrec hsq k hk1)
    push_cast
    linarith

name: NLAlib.en_props
statement:
private theorem en_props :
    let a : ℕ → ℝ
proof:
:= fun m =>
      ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin m))
    (∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m) ∧ (∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m * a (m + 1) = m) ∧
      (∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m ^ 2 ≤ m) := by
  intro a
  have ha : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m = enJ m / enJ (m - 1) := fun m hm => en_norm_eq m hm
  have hrec : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → a m * a (m + 1) = m := by
    intro m hm
    rw [ha m hm, ha (m + 1) (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have h := enJ_rec (m - 1)
    rw [show m - 1 + 2 = m + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_sub hm] at h
    have h0 := enJ_pos (m - 1)
    have h1 := enJ_pos m
    rw [h]
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring
  have hpos : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 0 < a m := fun m hm => by
    rw [ha m hm]; exact div_pos (enJ_pos _) (enJ_pos _)
  refine ⟨hpos, hrec, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  have hmono : a m ≤ a (m + 1) := by
    rw [ha m hm, ha (m + 1) (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      div_le_div_iff₀ (enJ_pos _) (enJ_pos _)]
    have h := enJ_logconvex (m - 1)
    rw [show m - 1 + 1 = m by omega, show m - 1 + 2 = m + 1 by omega] at h
    nlinarith
  have := hrec m hm
  have := hpos m hm
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sqrt_sum_sq_sub
statement:
theorem sqrt_sub_sqrt_le_integral_sqrt_sum_sq_sub {N n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ N) :
    Real.sqrt N - Real.sqrt n ≤
      ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin N))
        - ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpos, hrec, hsq⟩ := en_props
  exact en_seq_diff (fun m =>
      ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector (Fin m)))
    hpos hrec hsq hn hnN

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_realifyVector
statement:
theorem sum_sq_realifyVector {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (z : n → ℂ) :
    (∑ i : n ⊕ n, realifyVector z i ^ 2) = ∑ i, Complex.normSq (z i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, realifyVector, Complex.normSq_apply,
    Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  funext i
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (hn : 2 ≤ Fintype.card n) :
    Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => (∑ i, Complex.normSq (z i))⁻¹)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) ∧
      ∫ z : n → ℂ, (∑ i, Complex.normSq (z i))⁻¹ ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n =
        1/(2*(Fintype.card n:ℝ)-2)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 3 ≤ Fintype.card (n ⊕ n) := by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega
  have hi := integrable_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := n ⊕ n) hd
  have hv := integral_inv_sum_sq_gaussianVector (ι := n ⊕ n) hd
  have hZ := hasLaw_realifyVector_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := n)
  have hf : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : n ⊕ n → ℝ => (∑ i, x i^2)⁻¹)
      (gaussianVector (n ⊕ n)) := (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hic : Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => (∑ i, realifyVector z i^2)⁻¹)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) := by
    rw [← hZ.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  constructor
  · simpa only [sum_sq_realifyVector] using hic
  · have h := hZ.integral_comp hf
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, sum_sq_realifyVector] at h
    rw [h, hv]
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Nat.cast_add]
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector
    {n d : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] [DecidableEq n]
    (U : Matrix d n ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols Uᴴ) (hd : 2 ≤ Fintype.card d) :
    Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => (∑ i, Complex.normSq ((U*ᵥz) i))⁻¹)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) ∧
      ∫ z : n → ℂ, (∑ i, Complex.normSq ((U*ᵥz) i))⁻¹ ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n =
        1/(2*(Fintype.card d:ℝ)-2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hv⟩ := integrable_and_integral_inv_sum_normSq_circularComplexGaussianVector hd
  have hZ := hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_orthonormalRows U hU
  have hf : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : d → ℂ => (∑ i, Complex.normSq (z i))⁻¹)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector d) := (by fun_prop : Measurable _).aestronglyMeasurable
  constructor
  · rw [← hZ.map_eq] at hi
    exact hi.comp_aemeasurable hZ.aemeasurable
  · exact (hZ.integral_comp hf).trans hv

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_coefficientBlock_moment
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_coefficientBlock_moment
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
          ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
proof:
:=
  (integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_even_trace_rpow A hA hp).trans
    (integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock A hA hp)

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_four
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_four
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        4 * coefficientBlockKappa A * Real.sqrt (Real.log (Fintype.card d))
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := lambdaMax_coefficientBlock_nonneg A hA
  have hM : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p →
      (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
        2 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) *
          Real.sqrt ((Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A))) ^ 2 +
            ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * coefficientBlockKappa A ^ 2) := by
    intro p hp
    simpa only [coefficientBlockKappa, Real.sq_sqrt hmax,
      Real.sq_sqrt (specNorm_nonneg _)] using
      integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_coefficientBlock_moment A hA hp
  have hd : 1 ≤ Fintype.card d := Fintype.card_pos
  by_cases hd₁ : Fintype.card d = 1
  · have hh := hM 1 le_rfl
    simpa only [hd₁, Nat.cast_one, Real.log_one, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero, add_zero,
      Real.one_rpow, Nat.sub_self, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.sqrt_sq (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
      mul_one] using hh
  · have hd₂ : (1 : ℝ) < Fintype.card d := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < Fintype.card d by omega)
    exact Real.le_two_mul_add_four_mul_sqrt_log_of_even_moments
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hd₂ hM

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        6 * coefficientBlockKappa A * Real.sqrt (Real.log (Fintype.card d))
proof:
:= by
  apply (integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_four A hA).trans
  have hκ : 0 ≤ coefficientBlockKappa A := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (Fintype.card d)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hκ hlog]

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_log_two
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_log_two
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) :
    (∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        4 * coefficientBlockKappa A * Real.sqrt (Real.log (2 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply (integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_four A hA).trans
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card d := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hlog := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.log_le_log hd (show (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card d by linarith))
  have hκ : 0 ≤ coefficientBlockKappa A := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) hκ))

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose_of_hasLaw
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian)
    {ξ : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hξ : HasLaw ξ (gaussianVector ι) μ) :
    (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ∂μ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A)) +
        6 * coefficientBlockKappa A * Real.sqrt (Real.log (Fintype.card d))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Continuous (fun x : ι → ℝ => specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  rw [show (∫ ω, specNorm (∑ i, ξ ω i • A i) ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, specNorm (∑ i, x i • A i) ∂gaussianVector ι from
    hξ.integral_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact integral_specNorm_gaussianSeries_le_partialTranspose A hA

name: NLAlib.specNorm_pow_le
statement: private theorem specNorm_pow_le (H : Matrix d d ℂ) (p : ℕ) : specNorm (H ^ p) ≤ specNorm H ^ p
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty d with
  | inl hd =>
    have hz : H ^ p = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hz, specNorm_zero]
    exact pow_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) _
  | inr hd => simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using norm_pow_le H p

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_coefficientBlock
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_coefficientBlock
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) (p : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) *
        (2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
          ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))) ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  let H := hermiteSeriesOperator A p
  let C := 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
    ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
  have hC : specNorm H ≤ C := specNorm_hermiteSeriesCreation_add_conjTranspose_le A hA p
  have hCp : specNorm (H ^ p) ≤ C ^ p :=
    (specNorm_pow_le H p).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hC p)
  rw [integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_eq_frobSq_hermiteVacuum A hA]
  calc
    _ ≤ specNorm (H ^ p) ^ 2 * frobSq (hermiteVacuumEmbedding d ι p) :=
      frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq _ _
    _ ≤ (C ^ p) ^ 2 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := by
      rw [frobSq_hermiteVacuumEmbedding]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hCp 2)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm p 2, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock
statement:
theorem integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
      2 * (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) *
        Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
          ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
proof:
:= by
  let C := 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
    ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  have hM := integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_coefficientBlock A hA p
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι :=
    integral_nonneg fun x => re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even _
      (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x) (even_two_mul p)
  have hh := Real.rpow_le_rpow hn hM (show 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)) by positivity)
  change _ ≤ ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) * C ^ (2 * p)) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) at hh
  have he : 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)) = (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by simp
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hC _), he,
    Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hC (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0)] at hh
  change _ ≤ _ * C at hh
  simpa only [C, he, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_normalized_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock
    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] (A : ι → Matrix d d ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    ((∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) /
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (2 * (p : ℝ))) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
        ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
proof:
:= by
  let C := 2 * Real.sqrt (specNorm (coefficientVariance A) +
    ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * lambdaMax (coefficientBlock A))
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by positivity
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card d := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hM := integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_le_coefficientBlock A hA p
  have hdiv : (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) /
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) ≤ C ^ (2 * p) := by
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr (hM.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _))
  have hn : 0 ≤ (∫ x, ((∑ i, x i • A i) ^ (2 * p)).trace.re ∂gaussianVector ι) /
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) := div_nonneg
    (integral_nonneg fun x => re_trace_pow_nonneg_of_even _
      (isHermitian_sum_smul_real A hA x) (even_two_mul p)) hd.le
  have hh := Real.rpow_le_rpow hn hdiv (show 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)) by positivity)
  have he : 1 / (2 * (p : ℝ)) = (((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by simp
  rw [he, Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast hC (by omega : 2 * p ≠ 0)] at hh
  simpa only [← he, C] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_re_trace_gaussianSeries_even_pow_rpow_le_coefficientBlock_of_hasLaw
statement:

    [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty d] {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_nonneg {m : ℕ} (C : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j) (π : GaussianPairings m) : 0 ≤ gaussianPairingWeight C π
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => exact zero_le_one
  | one => exact Empty.elim π
  | more m ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨j, π⟩ := π
    exact mul_nonneg (hC _ _) (ih _ (fun _ _ => hC _ _) π)

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_le_gaussianPairingWeight
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_le_gaussianPairingWeight {m : ℕ}
    (C D : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ) (hC : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ C i j)
    (hCD : ∀ i j, C i j ≤ D i j) (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    gaussianPairingWeight C π ≤ gaussianPairingWeight D π
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | one => exact Empty.elim π
  | more m ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨j, π⟩ := π
    apply mul_le_mul (hCD _ _) (ih _ _ (fun _ _ => hC _ _) (fun _ _ => hCD _ _) π)
      (gaussianPairingWeight_nonneg _ (fun _ _ => hC _ _) π)
      ((hC _ _).trans (hCD _ _))

name: NLAlib.gaussianPairingWeight_add_eq_sum_orientations
statement:
theorem gaussianPairingWeight_add_eq_sum_orientations {m : ℕ}
    (C D : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ) (π : GaussianPairings m) :
    gaussianPairingWeight (fun i j => C i j + D i j) π =
      ∑ flip : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length → Bool,
        ∏ e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length,
          if flip e then D ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
          else C ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [gaussianPairingWeight_eq_prod_gaussianPairingEdges]
  have hprod :
      ((gaussianPairingEdges π).map (fun e => C e.1 e.2 + D e.1 e.2)).prod =
        ∏ e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length,
          (C ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2 +
            D ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2) := by
    rw [← List.prod_ofFn]
    congr 1
    rw [List.ofFn_comp' (f := fun e : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => (gaussianPairingEdges π).get e)
      (g := fun e => C e.1 e.2 + D e.1 e.2), List.ofFn_get]
  rw [hprod]
  have h := Finset.prod_univ_sum
    (fun _ : Fin (gaussianPairingEdges π).length => (Finset.univ : Finset Bool))
    (fun e flip => if flip then D ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2
      else C ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).1 ((gaussianPairingEdges π).get e).2)
  rw [Fintype.piFinset_univ] at h
  simpa [add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product
statement:
theorem integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ =>
      (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ r * C * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ s).trace.re)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    (continuous_re_trace_series_product A B C r s).measurable.aemeasurable _ (r + s)
  exact abs_re_trace_series_product_le A B C r s

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B C : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (r s : ℕ) (i : κ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i *
      (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ r * C * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ s).trace.re)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ‖(reTraceCLM : Matrix ι ι ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ * ‖B‖ * ‖C‖ *
    (∑ j, ‖A j‖) ^ (r + s)
  apply integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    ((continuous_apply i).mul (continuous_re_trace_series_product A B C r s)).measurable.aemeasurable
    D (r + s + 1)
  intro x
  have hi : |x i| ≤ 1 + ‖x‖ := by
    have h := norm_le_pi_norm x i
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [abs_mul, pow_succ]
  calc _ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) * (D * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (r + s)) :=
      mul_le_mul hi (abs_re_trace_series_product_le A B C r s x)
        (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => (B * (∑ i, x i • A i) ^ q).trace.re)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
    integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product A B 1 q 0

name: NLAlib.integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ) (i : κ) :
    Integrable (fun x : κ → ℝ => x i * (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ q).trace.re)
      (gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using
    integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product A B 1 q 0 i

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow
    (A : κ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (q : ℕ) (i : κ) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x i * (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ q).trace.re
      ∂(gaussianVector _)) =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.range q,
        ∫ x : κ → ℝ,
          (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (q.pred - l) *
            A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ l).trace.re
          ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun x : κ → ℝ => (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ q).trace.re
  let df := fun x : κ → ℝ => ∑ l ∈ Finset.range q,
    (B * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ (q.pred - l) * A i * (∑ j, x j • A j) ^ l).trace.re
  have hdi : Integrable df (gaussianVector _) := by
    apply integrable_finsetSum
    intro l _
    exact integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product A B (A i) (q.pred - l) l
  have hs := integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update f df i
    (fun x t => hasDerivAt_re_trace_mul_series_pow_update A B x i t q)
    (integrable_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A B q)
    (integrable_coordinate_mul_re_trace_mul_gaussianSeries_pow A B q i) hdi
  rw [hs]
  exact integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ =>
    integrable_re_trace_gaussianSeries_product A B (A i) (q.pred - l) l

name: NLAlib.coordinate_hermite_column
statement:
private theorem coordinate_hermite_column (i : ι) (b : HermiteIndex ι p)
    (hb : b.degree < p) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, (hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) a b *
      (productHermite a.val x : ℂ)) =
        (x i : ℂ) * (productHermite b.val x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  simp_rw [hermiteCreation_apply_of_lt i _ b hb]
  simp_rw [hermiteCreation_apply i b]
  simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hh := congrArg Complex.ofReal (coordinate_mul_productHermite b i hb x)
  by_cases hbi : 0 < b.val i
  · simp only [hbi, true_and, ↓reduceIte] at *
    simpa [apply_ite, mul_ite, ite_mul, eq_comm] using hh.symm
  · simp only [hbi, false_and, ↓reduceIte, star_zero, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at *
    simpa [ite_mul] using hh.symm

name: NLAlib.hermiteExpansion_creation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec
statement:
theorem hermiteExpansion_creation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec
    (i : ι) (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ)
    (hz : ∀ a, ¬ a.degree < p → z a = 0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    hermiteExpansion ((hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *ᵥ z) x =
      (x i : ℂ) * hermiteExpansion z x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hermiteExpansion, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ b, z b * ∑ a,
        (hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) a b *
          (productHermite a.val x : ℂ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      ring
    _ = ∑ b, z b * ((x i : ℂ) * (productHermite b.val x : ℂ)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      by_cases hb : b.degree < p
      · rw [coordinate_hermite_column _ _ hb]
      · rw [hz b hb, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intros; ring

name: NLAlib.hermiteCreation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec_support
statement:
theorem hermiteCreation_add_conjTranspose_mulVec_support (i : ι)
    (z : HermiteIndex ι p → ℂ) (k : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ a, k < a.degree → z a = 0)
    (a : HermiteIndex ι p) (ha : k + 1 < a.degree) :
    ((hermiteCreation p i + (hermiteCreation p i)ᴴ) *ᵥ z) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, Pi.add_apply, hermiteCreation_mulVec,
    hermiteCreation_conjTranspose_mulVec]
  have h₁ : (if 0 < a.val i then (Real.sqrt (a.val i) : ℂ) * z (a.lower i) else 0) = 0 := by
    split_ifs with hi
    · rw [hz _ (by have hd := a.degree_lower i hi; omega), mul_zero]
    · rfl
  have h₂ : (if h : a.degree < p then
      (Real.sqrt (a.val i + 1) : ℂ) * z (a.raise i h) else 0) = 0 := by
    split_ifs with hi
    · rw [hz _ (by rw [HermiteIndex.degree_raise]; omega), mul_zero]
    · rfl
  rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.integrable_pow_gaussianReal

:= by
  have h := (memLp_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (k : NNReal)).integrable_norm_pow'
  refine h.mono' (by fun_prop) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_three_gaussianReal
statement: theorem integral_pow_three_gaussianReal : ∫ x, x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∫ x, x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = ∫ x, (-x) ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← neg_zero, ← gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := 0) (v := 1)]
    rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have h2 : ∫ x, (-x) ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = - ∫ x, x ^ 3 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]; congr 1; ext x; ring
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_four_gaussianReal
statement: theorem integral_pow_four_gaussianReal : ∫ x, x ^ 4 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num)]
  have h1 : ∀ x : ℝ, gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x • x ^ 4
      = (fun y : ℝ => (√(2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (y ^ (4:ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1/2) * y ^ (2:ℝ)))) |x| := by
    intro x
    simp only [gaussianPDFReal, smul_eq_mul, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
    have e4 : |x| ^ (4:ℝ) = x ^ 4 := by
      rw [show (4:ℝ) = ((4:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast, pow_abs]
      exact abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)
    have e2 : |x| ^ (2:ℝ) = x ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (2:ℝ) = ((2:ℕ):ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast, sq_abs]
    rw [e4, e2]; ring_nf
  rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h1),
    integral_comp_abs (f := fun y : ℝ =>
      (√(2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (y ^ (4:ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1/2) * y ^ (2:ℝ)))),
    integral_const_mul,
    integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  have hg : Real.Gamma ((4 + 1) / 2) = 3 / 4 * √Real.pi := by
    have := Real.Gamma_nat_add_one_add_half 1
    norm_num [Nat.doubleFactorial] at this
    rw [show ((4:ℝ) + 1) / 2 = 5 / 2 by norm_num, this]; ring
  rw [hg]
  have hb : (1/2 : ℝ) ^ (-(4 + 1) / 2 : ℝ) = 4 * √2 := by
    rw [show (-(4 + 1) / 2 : ℝ) = -(2 + 1/2) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num),
      Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.div_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num), Real.one_rpow,
      Real.div_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num), Real.one_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    norm_num
    field_simp
  rw [hb, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num)]
  have : (0:ℝ) < √2 := by positivity
  have : (0:ℝ) < √Real.pi := by positivity
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_four_eq_three_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_pow_four_eq_three_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
    (hlaw : HasLaw g (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) :
    ∫ ω, g ω ^ 4 ∂μ = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_pow_four_gaussianReal
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq, integral_map hlaw.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hlaw : HasLaw g (gaussianReal 0 1) μ)
    (c : ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (c * g ω)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) c
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq] at h
  exact (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hlaw.aemeasurable).1 h

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal (v : NNReal) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF id v (gaussianReal 0 v) where

proof:
:= by

  mgf_le t := by
    rw [mgf_id_gaussianReal]
    simp only [zero_mul, zero_add, le_refl]

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {g : Ω → ℝ} (hg : HasLaw g (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) :

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_gaussianVector_coordinate_negate
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_gaussianVector_coordinate_negate
    (p : κ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : κ → ℝ => fun k => if p k then -x k else x k)
      (gaussianVector κ) (gaussianVector κ)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : κ => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ : κ => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (f := fun k (t : ℝ) => if p k then -t else t)
  intro k
  by_cases hk : p k
  · simp only [if_pos hk]
    exact ⟨measurable_neg,by simp [gaussianReal_map_neg]⟩
  · simp only [if_neg hk]
    exact MeasurePreserving.id (gaussianReal (0 : ℝ) 1)

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_gaussianVector_coordinate_permute
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_gaussianVector_coordinate_permute (σ : Equiv.Perm κ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : κ → ℝ => fun k => x (σ k))
      (gaussianVector κ) (gaussianVector κ)
proof:
:= by
  convert (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft
    (fun _ : κ => gaussianReal (0 : ℝ) 1) σ.symm) using 1
  funext x k
  simp [MeasurableEquiv.coe_piCongrLeft,Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply]

name: NLAlib.integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hne : T.Nonempty) : Integrable (realSupportFunction T) (stdGaussian E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hbound⟩ := hT.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_le
  have hn : Integrable (fun z : E => ‖z‖) (stdGaussian E) := IsGaussian.integrable_id.norm
  refine (hn.const_mul R).mono' (continuous_realSupportFunction hT hne).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_realSupportFunction_le hT hne hbound z

name: NLAlib.integrable_inner_right
statement:
private theorem integrable_inner_right (a : E) :
    Integrable (fun z : E => inner ℝ z a) (stdGaussian E)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := IsGaussian.integrable_dual (stdGaussian E) (innerSL ℝ a)
  change Integrable (fun z : E => inner ℝ a z) (stdGaussian E) at hi
  exact hi.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => (real_inner_comm a z).symm)

name: NLAlib.integral_inner_right
statement:
private theorem integral_inner_right (a : E) :
    (∫ z : E, inner ℝ z a ∂stdGaussian E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_comm] using
    integral_strongDual_stdGaussian (innerSL ℝ a)

name: NLAlib.integral_realSupportFunction_neg_stdGaussian
proof:
:= by
  let U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E := LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ
  have hU : HasLaw U (stdGaussian E) (stdGaussian E) :=
    ⟨U.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, stdGaussian_map U⟩
  exact hU.integral_comp (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT hne).aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_nonneg
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_nonneg {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ gaussianWidth T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hne
  have h := integral_mono (integrable_inner_right a)
    (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT ⟨a,ha⟩)
    (fun z => inner_le_realSupportFunction hT ha z)
  simpa only [integral_inner_right, gaussianWidth] using h

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_image_add
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_image_add {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) (a : E) :
    gaussianWidth ((fun x => x+a) '' T) = gaussianWidth T
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianWidth
  simp_rw [realSupportFunction_image_add hT hne]
  rw [integral_add (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT hne)
    (integrable_inner_right a), integral_inner_right, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem gaussianWidth_singleton (a : E) : gaussianWidth ({a} : Set E) = 0
proof:

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_image_linearIsometryEquiv
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_image_linearIsometryEquiv {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T)
    (hne : T.Nonempty) (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) : gaussianWidth (U '' T) = gaussianWidth T
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianWidth
  simp_rw [realSupportFunction_image_linearIsometryEquiv]
  have hU : HasLaw U.symm (stdGaussian E) (stdGaussian E) :=
    ⟨U.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, stdGaussian_map U.symm⟩
  exact hU.integral_comp (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT hne).aestronglyMeasurable

statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_convexHull {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) :

proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_closure_convexHull
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_closure_convexHull {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_image_smul
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_image_smul {T : Set E} (hT : IsCompact T) (hne : T.Nonempty)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) : gaussianWidth ((fun x => c • x) '' T) = c * gaussianWidth T
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianWidth
  simp_rw [realSupportFunction_image_smul hT hne hc]

name: NLAlib.gaussianWidth_mono
statement:
theorem gaussianWidth_mono {S T : Set E} (hS : IsCompact S) (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hst : S ⊆ T) : gaussianWidth S ≤ gaussianWidth T
proof:
:= by
  exact integral_mono (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hS hne)
    (integrable_realSupportFunction_stdGaussian hT (hne.mono hst))
    (fun z => realSupportFunction_mono hS hne hT hst z)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthogonal
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthogonal
    (U : Matrix n n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    HasLaw (fun x => U *ᵥ x) (gaussianVector n) (gaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  let L := hU.toLinearIsometry
  let e := L.toLinearIsometryEquiv rfl
  have he : HasLaw e (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ n))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ n)) :=
    ⟨e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, stdGaussian_map e⟩
  have hof : HasLaw (WithLp.ofLp : EuclideanSpace ℝ n → n → ℝ)
      (gaussianVector n) (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ n)) := by
    refine ⟨(by fun_prop : Measurable (WithLp.ofLp : EuclideanSpace ℝ n → n → ℝ)).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    rw [← gaussianVector_map_toLp_eq_stdGaussian,
      Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    exact Measure.map_id
  have hf : (WithLp.ofLp ∘ e ∘ WithLp.toLp 2) = fun x => U *ᵥ x := by
    funext x
    change WithLp.ofLp (L.toLinearIsometryEquiv rfl (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) = _
    rw [LinearIsometry.toLinearIsometryEquiv_apply]
    rfl
  rw [← hf]
  exact hof.comp (he.comp (hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector (n := n)))

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthonormalRows
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthonormalRows
    (U : Matrix m n ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols Uᵀ) :
    HasLaw (fun x => U *ᵥ x) (gaussianVector m) (gaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le
    (card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWe⟩ := exists_unitary_completion Uᵀ hU e
  have hWt : HasOrthonormalCols Wᵀ := by
    change W * Wᵀ = 1
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (show Wᵀ * W = 1 from hW)
  have hrot := hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthogonal Wᵀ hWt
  have hsel := hasLaw_pi_select (fun _ : n => gaussianReal 0 1) e e.injective
  have h := hsel.comp hrot
  have hf : (fun x : n → ℝ => fun j => (Wᵀ *ᵥ x) (e j)) = fun x => U *ᵥ x := by
    ext x j
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, hWe]
  change HasLaw (fun x : n → ℝ => fun j => (Wᵀ *ᵥ x) (e j)) _ _ at h
  rw [hf] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.ae_eq_map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ae_eq_map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero
    (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂γ) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ i j, Var[fun A => (A i j).im; γ] = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (Matrix.reCLM A).map Complex.ofReal = A
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i j : n) : ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, (A i j).im = 0 := by
    let L : Matrix n n ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := Complex.imCLM.comp
      (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ ℂ i j).toContinuousLinearMap
    have hLp : MemLp (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => (A i j).im) 2 γ :=
      L.comp_memLp' (IsGaussian.memLp_two_id (μ := γ))
    have hm : (∫ A, (A i j).im ∂γ) = 0 := by
      have h := L.integral_comp_comm (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
      simpa only [id_eq, hmean, map_zero, L, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        LinearMap.coe_toContinuousLinearMap', Matrix.entryLinearMap_apply,
        Complex.imCLM_apply] using h
    simpa only [hm] using ae_eq_integral_of_variance_eq_zero hLp (hvar i j)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hi i)] with A hA
  exact Matrix.map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_eq_zero A hA

name: NLAlib.im_variance_eq_zero_of_covariance_eq_real
statement:
theorem im_variance_eq_zero_of_covariance_eq_real
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → Matrix n n ℝ) (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hcov : ∀ i j : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n),
      cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) i,
        fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates ((X ω).map Complex.ofReal) j; μ] =
      cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; γ])
    (i j : n) : Var[fun A => (A i j).im; γ] = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := hcov (Sum.inr (i, j)) (Sum.inr (i, j))
  simp only [matrixRealCoordinates_inr, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.ofReal_im,
    covariance_const_left] at hc
  have hs := covariance_self (μ := γ) (X := fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => (A i j).im)
    ((Complex.measurable_im.comp (Matrix.measurable_entry i j)).aemeasurable)
  exact hs.symm.trans hc.symm

name: NLAlib.isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_ae_isHermitian_map_reCLM
statement:
theorem isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_ae_isHermitian_map_reCLM
    (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂γ) = 0) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂γ, A.IsHermitian) :
    IsGaussian (γ.map (Matrix.reCLM (m := n) (n := n))) ∧
      (∫ A, A ∂γ.map (Matrix.reCLM (m := n) (n := n))) = 0 ∧
      ∀ᵐ A ∂γ.map (Matrix.reCLM (m := n) (n := n)), A.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.reCLM.integral_id_map (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)), hmean, map_zero]
  · apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) ?_).mpr
    · exact hHerm.mono fun A hA => hA.reCLM
    · exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => Aᴴ))
        continuous_id).measurableSet

name: NLAlib.integral_specNorm_eq_integral_specNorm_map_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_specNorm_eq_integral_specNorm_map_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero
    (γ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian γ]
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂γ) = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ i j, Var[fun A => (A i j).im; γ] = 0) :
    (∫ A, specNorm A ∂γ) =
      ∫ A, specNorm A ∂γ.map (Matrix.reCLM (m := n) (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous (specNorm : Matrix n n ℝ → ℝ) := by
    change Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => specNorm A)
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact continuous_norm
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) hcont.aestronglyMeasurable]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_eq_map_ofReal_reCLM_of_im_variance_eq_zero γ hmean hvar] with A hA
  have h := specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (Matrix.reCLM A)
  have heq : ((Matrix.reCLM A).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)) = A := by
    change ((Matrix.reCLM A).map Complex.ofReal) = A
    exact hA
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.gaussianCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef
statement:
theorem gaussianCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) : (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  exact (LinearMap.isPosSemidef_iff_posSemidef_toMatrix
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ).toBasis).mp
      (LinearMap.BilinForm.isPosSemidef_iff.mp isPosSemidef_covarianceBilin)

name: NLAlib.gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : MemLp id 2 μ) (i j : ι) :
    gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ i j = cov[fun x => x i, fun x => x j; μ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianCovarianceMatrix, LinearMap.toMatrix₂_apply]
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toBilinForm_apply, covarianceBilin_apply_eq_cov hμ]
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_eq_multivariateGaussian_covariance_of_centered
statement:
theorem gaussian_eq_multivariateGaussian_covariance_of_centered
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) :
    μ = multivariateGaussian 0 (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsGaussian.ext
  · simpa only [id_eq, integral_id_multivariateGaussian] using hmean
  · rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.toBilinForm_inj]
    apply LinearMap.BilinForm.ext_basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ).toBasis
    intro i j
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toBilinForm_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.toBilinForm_apply,
      covarianceBilin_multivariateGaussian (gaussianCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef μ)]
    simp [gaussianCovarianceMatrix, LinearMap.toMatrix₂_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]

name: NLAlib.gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered
statement:
theorem gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : ∫ x, x ∂μ = 0) :
    μ = (gaussianVector ι).map
      (fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (CFC.sqrt (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ) *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ = multivariateGaussian 0 (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μ) :=
      gaussian_eq_multivariateGaussian_covariance_of_centered μ hmean
    _ = _ := by
      rw [multivariateGaussian]
      rw [← map_pi_eq_stdGaussian, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
      congr 1
      funext x
      simp only [Function.comp_def, zero_add, Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp]

name: NLAlib.exists_hermitian_gaussian_series_representation
statement:
theorem exists_hermitian_gaussian_series_representation {n : Type*}
    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsGaussian μ]
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂μ) = 0) (hHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂μ, A.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ A : ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n)) → Matrix n n ℂ,
      (∀ i, (A i).IsHermitian) ∧
      μ = (gaussianVector ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n))).map
        (fun x => ∑ i, x i • A i)
proof:
:= by
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  let e := PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n) => ℝ)
  let T := C.trans e.symm
  let μE := μ.map T
  have : IsGaussian μE := inferInstanceAs (IsGaussian (μ.map T.toContinuousLinearMap))
  have hμE : (∫ x, x ∂μE) = 0 := by
    rw [show (∫ x, x ∂μE) = T (∫ A, A ∂μ) from T.integral_id_map (μ := μ)]
    rw [hmean, map_zero]
  let S := CFC.sqrt (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μE)
  let P := hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (n := n)
  let Q := P.comp e.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hback : μE.map Q = μ := by
    change (μ.map T).map Q = μ
    rw [Measure.map_map Q.continuous.measurable T.continuous.measurable]
    have heq : Q ∘ T =ᵐ[μ] id := by
      filter_upwards [hHerm] with A hA
      change P (e (e.symm (C A))) = A
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA
    rw [Measure.map_congr heq, Measure.map_id]
  have hrep : μ = (gaussianVector ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n))).map
      (fun x => P (S *ᵥ x)) := by
    rw [← hback, gaussian_eq_map_gaussianVector_sqrt_covariance_of_centered μE hμE]
    rw [Measure.map_map Q.continuous.measurable (by fun_prop)]
    rfl
  let L := P.comp S.mulVecLin.toContinuousLinearMap
  let A : ((n × n) ⊕ (n × n)) → Matrix n n ℂ := fun i => L (Pi.single i 1)
  refine ⟨A, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates _
  · rw [hrep]
    congr 1
    funext x
    change L x = ∑ i, x i • L (Pi.single i 1)
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul] using congrArg L (pi_eq_sum_univ' x)

name: NLAlib.complexifyVector_mulVec_realification
statement:
theorem complexifyVector_mulVec_realification (U : Matrix m n ℂ) (x : n ⊕ n → ℝ) :
    complexifyVector (matrixRealification U *ᵥ x) = U *ᵥ complexifyVector x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Complex.ext <;>
    simp [complexifyVector, matrixRealification, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.mulVec,
      dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, neg_mul, add_comm, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_orthonormalRows
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_orthonormalRows
    (U : Matrix m n ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols Uᴴ) :
    HasLaw (fun z => U *ᵥ z) (circularComplexGaussianVector m)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : HasOrthonormalCols (matrixRealification U)ᵀ := by
    rw [← matrixRealification_conjTranspose]
    exact hU.realification
  have hreal := hasLaw_mulVec_gaussianVector_orthonormalRows (matrixRealification U) hR
  have hresult := (hasLaw_complexifyVector_gaussianVector (n := m)).comp hreal
  refine ⟨(by fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : n → ℂ => U *ᵥ z)).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [← (hasLaw_complexifyVector_gaussianVector (n := n)).map_eq,
    Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hf : (fun z : n → ℂ => U *ᵥ z) ∘ complexifyVector =
      complexifyVector ∘ (fun x => matrixRealification U *ᵥ x) := by
    funext x
    exact (complexifyVector_mulVec_realification U x).symm
  rw [hf]
  exact hresult.map_eq

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_unitary
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_unitary
    (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    HasLaw (fun z => U *ᵥ z) (circularComplexGaussianVector n)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  apply hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_orthonormalRows U
  change Uᴴᴴ * Uᴴ = 1
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hU

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_of_hasLaw
