name: NLAlib.norm_normalizeComplexVector
statement:
theorem norm_normalizeComplexVector {z : n → ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (normalizeComplexVector z)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    exact hz ((WithLp.toLp_eq_zero 2).mp (norm_eq_zero.mp he))
  change ‖(‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ = 1
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)), inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]

name: NLAlib.ae_ne_zero_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem ae_ne_zero_circularComplexGaussianVector [Nonempty n] :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n, z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let i : n := Classical.arbitrary n
  have hl := (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector (Sum.inl i)).comp
    (hasLaw_realifyVector_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := n))
  have hz : (circularComplexGaussianVector n) {z | (z i).re = 0} = 0 := by
    have := nullSingletonClass_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (by norm_num)
    have he := hl.measure_eq (p := fun x : ℝ => x = 0) (measurableSet_singleton 0)
    change (circularComplexGaussianVector n) {z | (z i).re = 0} =
      (gaussianReal 0 1) {0} at he
    exact he.trans (measure_singleton 0)
  rw [ae_iff]
  apply measure_mono_null (t := {z : n → ℂ | (z i).re = 0}) _ hz
  intro z h
  change ¬ z ≠ 0 at h
  have he : z = 0 := not_not.mp h
  simp [he]

name: NLAlib.ae_norm_eq_one_complexSphereVector
statement:
theorem ae_norm_eq_one_complexSphereVector [Nonempty n] :
    ∀ᵐ b ∂complexSphereVector n, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold complexSphereVector
  apply (ae_map_iff measurable_normalizeComplexVector.aemeasurable
    (p := fun b : n → ℂ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ = 1) (by
      convert (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun b : n → ℂ => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖))
        (measurableSet_singleton 1) using 1
      ext b
      simp)).mpr
  filter_upwards [ae_ne_zero_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := n)] with z hz
  exact norm_normalizeComplexVector hz

name: NLAlib.normalizeComplexVector_mulVec
statement:
theorem normalizeComplexVector_mulVec {U : Matrix n n ℂ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (z : n → ℂ) :
    normalizeComplexVector (U *ᵥ z) = U *ᵥ normalizeComplexVector z
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ z)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ :=
    hU.toLinearIsometry.norm_map (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
  rw [normalizeComplexVector, hn, normalizeComplexVector, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_mulVec_complexSphereVector_unitary
statement:
theorem hasLaw_mulVec_complexSphereVector_unitary (U : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    HasLaw (fun b => U *ᵥ b) (complexSphereVector n) (complexSphereVector n)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := hasLaw_mulVec_circularComplexGaussianVector_unitary U hU
  have hs := (hasLaw_normalizeComplexVector_circularComplexGaussianVector (n := n)).comp hg
  refine ⟨(by fun_prop : Measurable (fun b : n → ℂ => U *ᵥ b)).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [complexSphereVector, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) measurable_normalizeComplexVector]
  have hf : (fun b : n → ℂ => U *ᵥ b) ∘ normalizeComplexVector =
      normalizeComplexVector ∘ (fun z => U *ᵥ z) := by
    funext z
    exact (normalizeComplexVector_mulVec hU z).symm
  rw [hf]
  exact hs.map_eq

name: NLAlib.gaussian_matrix_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem gaussian_matrix_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
    (μ ν : Measure M) [IsGaussian μ] [IsGaussian ν]
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂μ) = ∫ A, A ∂ν)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; μ] =
        cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; ν]) :
    μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  let L := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  apply L.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding.map_injective
  change μ.map L = ν.map L
  apply IsGaussian.ext_of_pi_mean_covariance_eq
  · rw [L.integral_id_map, L.integral_id_map, hmean]
  · intro i j
    rw [covariance_map_fun (continuous_apply i).aestronglyMeasurable
        (continuous_apply j).aestronglyMeasurable L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable,
      covariance_map_fun (continuous_apply i).aestronglyMeasurable
        (continuous_apply j).aestronglyMeasurable L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable]
    exact hcov i j

name: NLAlib.covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum
    (X : ι → Ω → M) (hX : ∀ k, MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X k ω)) 2 P)
    (hind : iIndepFun X P) (i j : J) :
    cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ k, X k ω) i,
      fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ k, X k ω) j; P] =
        ∑ k, cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X k ω) i,
          fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (X k ω) j; P]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [covariance_fun_sum_fun_sum (fun k => (hX k).eval i) (fun k => (hX k).eval j)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single k
  · intro l _ hlk
    have hh := (hind.indepFun hlk.symm).comp
      (show Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A i) from by fun_prop)
      (show Measurable (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j) from by fun_prop)
    exact hh.covariance_eq_zero ((hX k).eval i) ((hX l).eval j)
  · simp

name: NLAlib.isGaussian_map_sum_pi
statement:
theorem isGaussian_map_sum_pi (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsGaussian (γ k)] :
    IsGaussian ((Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k))
proof:
:= by
  have hLaw (k : ι) : HasLaw (fun x : ι → M => x k) (γ k) (Measure.pi γ) :=
    (measurePreserving_eval γ k).hasLaw
  have hInd : iIndepFun (fun k (x : ι → M) => x k) (Measure.pi γ) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  exact (hInd.hasGaussianLaw_fun_sum (fun k => (hLaw k).hasGaussianLaw)).isGaussian_map

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_pi_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_sum_pi_gaussian (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsGaussian (γ k)] :
    (∫ x : ι → M, ∑ k, x k ∂Measure.pi γ) = ∑ k, ∫ A, A ∂γ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (f := fun k (x : ι → M) => x k) (fun k _ =>
    integrable_eval (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ k)))]
  simp only [integral_eval]

name: NLAlib.integral_id_map_sum_pi_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_id_map_sum_pi_gaussian (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsGaussian (γ k)] :
    (∫ A, A ∂(Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k)) =
      ∑ k, ∫ A, A ∂γ k
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integral_map (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k)
      (Measure.pi γ)) aestronglyMeasurable_id
  simpa only [id_eq] using hi.trans (integral_sum_pi_gaussian γ)

name: NLAlib.covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_map_sum_pi_eq_sum
statement:
theorem covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_map_sum_pi_eq_sum
    (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsGaussian (γ k)] (i j : J) :
    cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j;
      (Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k)] =
      ∑ k, cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i,
        fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; γ k]
proof:
:= by
  have hLaw (k : ι) : HasLaw (fun x : ι → M => x k) (γ k) (Measure.pi γ) :=
    (measurePreserving_eval γ k).hasLaw
  have hInd : iIndepFun (fun k (x : ι → M) => x k) (Measure.pi γ) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  have hX (k : ι) : MemLp (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (x k)) 2
      (Measure.pi γ) :=
    (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap
      |>.comp_memLp' (hLaw k).hasGaussianLaw.memLp_two
  rw [covariance_map_fun (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rw [covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum (fun k (x : ι → M) => x k) hX hInd]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  have hc := covariance_map_fun
    (μ := Measure.pi γ)
    (Z := fun x : ι → M => x k)
    (X := fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A i)
    (Y := fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A j)
    (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (measurable_pi_apply k).aemeasurable
  rw [(measurePreserving_eval γ k).map_eq] at hc
  exact hc.symm

name: NLAlib.map_sum_pi_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem map_sum_pi_gaussian_eq_of_covariance_eq
    (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsGaussian (γ k)]
    (ν : Measure M) [IsGaussian ν]
    (hmean : ∀ k, (∫ A, A ∂γ k) = 0) (hνmean : (∫ A, A ∂ν) = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j : J,
      (∑ k, cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i,
        fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; γ k]) =
          cov[fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i, fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j; ν]) :
    (Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k) = ν
proof:
:= by
  have : IsGaussian ((Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k)) :=
    isGaussian_map_sum_pi γ
  apply gaussian_matrix_eq_of_mean_covariance_eq
  · rw [integral_id_map_sum_pi_gaussian, hνmean]
    simp only [hmean, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro i j
    rw [covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_map_sum_pi_eq_sum]
    exact hcov i j

name: NLAlib.ae_isHermitian_map_sum_pi
statement:
theorem ae_isHermitian_map_sum_pi (γ : ι → Measure M) [∀ k, IsProbabilityMeasure (γ k)]
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ A ∂γ k, A.IsHermitian) :
    ∀ᵐ A ∂(Measure.pi γ).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k), A.IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : MeasurableSet {A : M | A.IsHermitian} :=
    (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : M => Aᴴ)) continuous_id).measurableSet
  apply (ae_map_iff (μ := Measure.pi γ)
    (f := fun x : ι → M => ∑ k, x k) (by fun_prop) hclosed).mpr
  have heval (k : ι) : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi γ, (x k).IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff (measurable_pi_apply k).aemeasurable hclosed).mp
    rw [(measurePreserving_eval γ k).map_eq]
    exact hHerm k
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr heval] with x hx
  change (∑ k, x k)ᴴ = ∑ k, x k
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hx k)

name: NLAlib.exists_isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq {κ : Type*}
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (μ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : MemLp id 2 μ) :
    ∃ ν : Measure (κ → ℝ), IsGaussian ν ∧ (∫ x, x ∂ν) = 0 ∧
      ∀ i j, cov[(fun x => x i), (fun x => x j); ν] =
        cov[(fun x => x i), (fun x => x j); μ]
proof:
:= by
  let e : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ ≃L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) := PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : κ => ℝ)
  let μE : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) := μ.map e.symm
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μE := μ.isProbabilityMeasure_map e.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hμE : MemLp id 2 μE := by
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id
      e.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hμ
  let γ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ κ) := multivariateGaussian 0 (gaussianCovarianceMatrix μE)
  have : IsGaussian γ := inferInstanceAs (IsGaussian (multivariateGaussian _ _))
  let ν := γ.map e
  have : IsGaussian ν := inferInstanceAs (IsGaussian (γ.map e.toContinuousLinearMap))
  refine ⟨ν, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (∫ x, x ∂γ.map e) = 0
    rw [show (∫ x, x ∂γ.map e) = ∫ x, e x ∂γ from
      integral_map e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    have he := e.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm
      (show Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ => x) γ from IsGaussian.integrable_fun_id)
    change (∫ x, e x ∂γ) = e (∫ x, x ∂γ) at he
    rw [he]
    simp only [γ, integral_id_multivariateGaussian, map_zero]
  · intro i j
    have hγlaw : HasLaw e ν γ := ⟨e.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
    have hμlaw : HasLaw e.symm μE μ := ⟨e.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
    have h1 := hγlaw.covariance_fun_comp (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable
      (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable
    have h2 := hμlaw.covariance_fun_comp (by fun_prop : Measurable fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ => x i).aemeasurable
      (by fun_prop : Measurable fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ => x j).aemeasurable
    rw [← h1]
    change cov[(fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ => x i), (fun x => x j); γ] = _
    rw [covariance_eval_multivariateGaussian (gaussianCovarianceMatrix_posSemidef μE),
      gaussianCovarianceMatrix_apply μE hμE]
    exact h2.symm

name: NLAlib.exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq
statement:
theorem exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (μ : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ : MemLp (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A) 2 μ)
    (hmean : (∫ A, A ∂μ) = 0) (hherm : ∀ᵐ A ∂μ, A.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ ν : Measure (Matrix n n ℂ), IsGaussian ν ∧ (∫ A, A ∂ν) = 0 ∧
      (∀ᵐ A ∂ν, A.IsHermitian) ∧
      ∀ i j : (n × n) ⊕ (n × n),
        cov[(fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i), (fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j); ν] =
          cov[(fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A i), (fun A => matrixRealCoordinates A j); μ]
proof:
:= by
  let C := matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)
  let P := hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (n := n)
  let ρ := μ.map C
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ρ := μ.isProbabilityMeasure_map C.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hρ : MemLp id 2 ρ := by
    apply (memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id C.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr
    exact hμ
  have hμint : Integrable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => A) μ := by
    have hi := C.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hμ
    have he (A : Matrix n n ℂ) : C.symm (matrixRealCoordinates A) = A :=
      matrixRealCoordinates.symm_apply_apply A
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using hi.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hρmean : (∫ x, x ∂ρ) = 0 := by
    change (∫ x, x ∂μ.map C) = 0
    rw [show (∫ x, x ∂μ.map C) = ∫ A, C A ∂μ from
      integral_map C.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    rw [show (∫ A, C A ∂μ) = C (∫ A, A ∂μ) from
      C.toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm hμint]
    rw [hmean, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hγmean, hγcov⟩ := exists_isGaussian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq ρ hρ
  have : IsGaussian γ := hγ
  let ν := γ.map P
  have : IsGaussian ν := inferInstanceAs (IsGaussian (γ.map P))
  have hνmean : (∫ A, A ∂ν) = 0 := by
    change (∫ A, A ∂γ.map P) = 0
    rw [show (∫ A, A ∂γ.map P) = ∫ x, P x ∂γ from
      integral_map P.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    rw [show (∫ x, P x ∂γ) = P (∫ x, x ∂γ) from
      P.integral_comp_comm IsGaussian.integrable_fun_id]
    rw [hγmean, map_zero]
  have hνherm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ν, A.IsHermitian := by
    apply (ae_map_iff P.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable ?_).mpr
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates
    · exact (isClosed_eq (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => Aᴴ))
        continuous_id).measurableSet
  have hρP : HasLaw P μ ρ := by
    refine ⟨P.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    change (μ.map C).map P = μ
    rw [Measure.map_map P.continuous.measurable C.continuous.measurable]
    have he : P ∘ C =ᵐ[μ] id := hherm.mono fun A hA =>
      hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA
    rw [Measure.map_congr he, Measure.map_id]
  have hνP : HasLaw P ν γ := ⟨P.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ν, inferInstance, hνmean, hνherm, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  let Li := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).comp (C.toContinuousLinearMap.comp P)
  let Lj := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).comp (C.toContinuousLinearMap.comp P)
  have hsame := covariance_continuousLinearMap_eq_of_coordinate_mean_covariance_eq
    γ ρ IsGaussian.memLp_two_id hρ (hγmean.trans hρmean.symm) hγcov Li Lj
  have hνcov := hνP.covariance_fun_comp
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A i)).aemeasurable
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A j)).aemeasurable
  have hμcov := hρP.covariance_fun_comp
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A i)).aemeasurable
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun A : Matrix n n ℂ => matrixRealCoordinates A j)).aemeasurable
  exact hνcov.symm.trans (hsame.trans hμcov)

name: NLAlib.gaussianVector_map_toLp_eq_stdGaussian
statement:
theorem gaussianVector_map_toLp_eq_stdGaussian :
    (gaussianVector n).map (WithLp.toLp 2) = stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ n)

:=

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem hasLaw_toLp_gaussianVector :
    HasLaw (WithLp.toLp 2) (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ n)) (gaussianVector n) where
  aemeasurable

:= (by fun_prop : Measurable (WithLp.toLp 2 : (n → ℝ) → _)).aemeasurable

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_dotProduct_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem hasLaw_dotProduct_gaussianVector (v : n → ℝ) (hv : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1) :
    HasLaw (fun z => v ⬝ᵥ z) (gaussianReal 0 1) (gaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ n := WithLp.toLp 2 v
  let L : StrongDual ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) := innerSL ℝ w
  have hLsq : ‖L‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [show L = innerSL ℝ w from rfl, innerSL_apply_norm, hv, one_pow]
  have hfun : (fun z : n → ℝ => v ⬝ᵥ z) = L ∘ (WithLp.toLp 2) := by
    funext z
    simp [L, w, PiLp.inner_apply, dotProduct, mul_comm]
  refine ⟨(by rw [hfun]; fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : n → ℝ => v ⬝ᵥ z)).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hfun, ← Measure.map_map L.continuous.measurable (by fun_prop), map_pi_eq_stdGaussian,
    IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal L, integral_strongDual_stdGaussian,
    variance_dual_stdGaussian, hLsq]
  simp

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector (a b : n) :
    Integrable (fun g : n → ℝ => g a * g b) (gaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmono : ∀ g : n → ℝ,
      g a * g b = ∏ c, g c ^ ((if a = c then 1 else 0) + (if b = c then 1 else 0)) := by
    intro g
    simp only [pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_boole, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  simp_rw [hmono]
  exact Integrable.fintype_prod (f := fun c (x : ℝ) =>
    x ^ ((if a = c then 1 else 0) + (if b = c then 1 else 0)))
    (fun c => integrable_pow_gaussianReal _)

name: NLAlib.integral_mul_apply_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_mul_apply_gaussianVector [DecidableEq n] (a b : n) :
    ∫ g, g a * g b ∂(gaussianVector n) = if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : ∀ g : n → ℝ,
      g a * g b = ∏ c, g c ^ ((if a = c then 1 else 0) + (if b = c then 1 else 0)) := by
    intro g
    simp only [pow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_boole, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have gm2 : ∫ x, x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 1 := by
    have h := variance_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)
    rw [variance_of_integral_eq_zero aemeasurable_id
      (by simp [integral_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1)])] at h
    simpa using h
  simp_rw [hmono]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun c (x : ℝ) =>
    x ^ ((if a = c then 1 else 0) + (if b = c then 1 else 0)))]
  by_cases h : a = b
  · subst h
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single a]
    · simp [gm2]
    · intro c _ hc; simp [Ne.symm hc]
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ a) (by simp [Ne.symm h])

name: NLAlib.integrable_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector (w : n → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g : n → ℝ => (w ⬝ᵥ g) ^ 2) (gaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : (fun g : n → ℝ => (w ⬝ᵥ g) ^ 2)
      = fun g => ∑ a, ∑ b, (w a * w b) * (g a * g b) := by
    funext g
    simp only [dotProduct, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ =>
    (integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector a b).const_mul _

name: NLAlib.integral_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_dotProduct_sq_gaussianVector (w : n → ℝ) :
    ∫ g, (w ⬝ᵥ g) ^ 2 ∂(gaussianVector n) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexp : (fun g : n → ℝ => (w ⬝ᵥ g) ^ 2)
      = fun g => ∑ a, ∑ b, (w a * w b) * (g a * g b) := by
    funext g
    simp only [dotProduct, sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  rw [hexp, integral_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ =>
    (integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector a b).const_mul _]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun b _ => (integrable_mul_apply_gaussianVector _ b).const_mul _,
    integral_const_mul, integral_mul_apply_gaussianVector]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp [sq]

  intro i

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_complexifyVector_gaussianVector

theorem hasLaw_complexifyVector_gaussianVector {n : Type*} [Fintype n] :

      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) (gaussianVector (n ⊕ n))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi
    (fun _ : n ⊕ n => gaussianReal 0 1)
  have hp := (measurePreserving_arrowProdEquivProdArrow ℝ ℝ n
    (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1) (fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1)).symm
  have hc : MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (⟨p.1, p.2⟩ : ℂ))
      ((gaussianReal 0 1).prod (gaussianReal 0 1)) circularComplexGaussian :=
    ⟨measurable_mk, rfl⟩
  have hv := measurePreserving_pi
    (fun _ : n => (gaussianReal 0 1).prod (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (fun _ => circularComplexGaussian) (fun _ => hc)
  exact (hv.comp (hp.comp hs)).hasLaw

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_star_circularComplexGaussianVector
statement:
theorem hasLaw_star_circularComplexGaussianVector {n : Type*} [Fintype n] :
    HasLaw (fun z : n → ℂ => star z) (circularComplexGaussianVector n)
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n)
proof:
:= by
  let T : n ⊕ n → ℝ → ℝ := fun i => Sum.elim (fun _ => id) (fun _ => Neg.neg) i
  have hp (i : n ⊕ n) : MeasurePreserving (T i) (gaussianReal 0 1) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    cases i with
    | inl i => exact MeasurePreserving.id _
    | inr i =>
      refine ⟨measurable_neg, ?_⟩
      change (gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun x : ℝ => -x) = gaussianReal 0 1
      simpa only [neg_zero] using (gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := 0) (v := 1))
  have hT := measurePreserving_pi (fun _ : n ⊕ n => gaussianReal 0 1)
    (fun _ : n ⊕ n => gaussianReal 0 1) hp
  have h := hasLaw_complexifyVector_gaussianVector.comp
    (hT.hasLaw.comp hasLaw_realifyVector_circularComplexGaussianVector)
  apply h.congr
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro z
  funext i
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp [T, complexifyVector, realifyVector]

name: NLAlib.exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (hνmean : ∀ i, (∫ H, H ∂ν i) = 0)
    (hνHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ H ∂ν i, H.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ γ : Measure M, IsGaussian γ ∧ (∫ H, H ∂γ) = 0 ∧
      (∀ᵐ H ∂γ, H.IsHermitian) ∧ ∀ a b,
        (∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i]) =
          cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; γ]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose η hη hηmean hηHerm hηcov using fun i =>
    exists_isGaussian_hermitian_integral_eq_zero_covariance_eq
      (ν i) (hν2 i) (hνmean i) (hνHerm i)
  let (i : ι) : IsGaussian (η i) := hη i
  refine ⟨(Measure.pi η).map (fun x : ι → M => ∑ i, x i),
    isGaussian_map_sum_pi η, ?_, ae_isHermitian_map_sum_pi η hηHerm, ?_⟩
  · rw [integral_id_map_sum_pi_gaussian]
    simp only [hηmean, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro a b
    rw [covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_map_sum_pi_eq_sum]
    simp only [hηcov]

name: NLAlib.covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (W : ι → Ω → M) (ν : ι → Measure M)
    (hW : ∀ i, HasLaw (W i) (ν i) P) (hind : iIndepFun W P)
    (hν2 : ∀ i, MemLp (matrixRealCoordinates : M → J → ℝ) 2 (ν i)) (a b : J) :
    cov[fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, W i ω) a,
      fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, W i ω) b; P] =
        ∑ i, cov[fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a, fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b; ν i]
proof:
:= by
  have hW2 (i : ι) : MemLp (fun ω => matrixRealCoordinates (W i ω)) 2 P := by
    have hi := hν2 i
    rw [← (hW i).map_eq] at hi
    exact (memLp_map_measure_iff continuous_matrixRealCoordinates.aestronglyMeasurable
      (hW i).aemeasurable).mp hi
  rw [covariance_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_eq_sum W hW2 hind]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (hW i).covariance_fun_comp
    (f := fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H a) (g := fun H => matrixRealCoordinates H b)
    (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)

name: NLAlib.integral_le_of_half_measure_sublevel_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_le_of_half_measure_sublevel_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) {L a : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2))
    (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (gaussianVector ι).real {x | f x ≤ a}) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂gaussianVector ι) ≤ a + 4 * L
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hbad
  have hneg : ∀ x y, |(-f x) - (-f y)| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2) := by
    intro x y
    simpa only [neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm] using hLip x y
  have ht := measureReal_ge_le_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector (fun x => -f x) L
    hL hneg 4 (by norm_num)
  rw [integral_neg] at ht
  have hsub : {x | f x ≤ a} ⊆
      {x | -(∫ y, f y ∂gaussianVector ι) + L * 4 ≤ -f x} := by
    intro x hx
    change f x ≤ a at hx
    change -(∫ y, f y ∂gaussianVector ι) + L * 4 ≤ -f x
    linarith
  have hsmall : Real.exp (-(4 : ℝ)^2 / 2) < 1 / 2 := by
    have hx : (2 : ℝ) < Real.exp 8 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) < 8 + 1) (Real.add_one_le_exp 8)
    have hh := (inv_lt_inv₀ (Real.exp_pos 8) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).mpr hx
    simpa only [show -(4 : ℝ)^2 / 2 = -8 by norm_num, Real.exp_neg, one_div] using hh
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hhalf) (((measureReal_mono hsub).trans ht).trans_lt hsmall)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_gt_sublevel_add_le_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem measureReal_gt_sublevel_add_le_gaussianVector
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) {L a : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLip : ∀ x y, |f x - f y| ≤ L * Real.sqrt (∑ i, (x i - y i) ^ 2))
    (hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (gaussianVector ι).real {x | f x ≤ a})
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (gaussianVector ι).real {x | a + 4 * L + 2 * L * t < f x} ≤ Real.exp (-t^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := integral_le_of_half_measure_sublevel_gaussianVector f hL hLip hhalf
  have hc := measureReal_ge_le_of_lipschitz_gaussianVector f L hL hLip (2 * t) (by positivity)
  have hsub : {x | a + 4 * L + 2 * L * t < f x} ⊆
      {x | (∫ y, f y ∂gaussianVector ι) + L * (2 * t) ≤ f x} := by
    intro x hx
    change a + 4 * L + 2 * L * t < f x at hx
    change (∫ y, f y ∂gaussianVector ι) + L * (2 * t) ≤ f x
    linarith
  exact ((measureReal_mono hsub).trans hc).trans
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]))

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_unit_interval
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_unit_interval
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2) ≤
      (gaussianReal 0 1).real (Icc t (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc t (t + 1)) :
      Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2) ≤
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x := by
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := ht.trans hx.1
    have hsq : x ^ 2 ≤ (t + 1) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hx.2 2
    have he : -t ^ 2 - 1 ≤ -x ^ 2 / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1)]
    have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he
    simp only [gaussianPDFReal, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
    rw [show Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2) =
      (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 - 1) by
        rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add]; ring]
    simpa only [one_div] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)))
  have hconst : IntegrableOn
      (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2))
      (Icc t (t + 1)) volume := integrableOn_const (isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top.ne)
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on hconst (integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).restrict
    measurableSet_Icc hpoint
  rw [integral_const] at hmono
  simp only [Measure.real, Measure.restrict_apply_univ] at hmono
  change volume.real (Icc t (t + 1)) • _ ≤ _ at hmono
  rw [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith),
    show t + 1 - t = 1 by ring, one_smul] at hmono
  rw [Measure.real, gaussianReal_apply_eq_integral 0 (by norm_num), ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (integral_nonneg fun x => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 x)]
  exact hmono

name: NLAlib.exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_abs_tail
statement:
theorem exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_abs_tail
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Real.exp (-1) / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-t ^ 2) ≤
      (gaussianReal 0 1).real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}
proof:
:= by
  apply (exp_neg_sq_div_sqrt_two_pi_le_gaussianReal_unit_interval t ht).trans
  exact measureReal_mono (fun x hx => hx.1.trans (le_abs_self x)) (by finiteness)

name: NLAlib.integrable_of_abs_bound

name: NLAlib.integrable_exp_mul_of_abs_bound
statement:
private theorem integrable_exp_mul_of_abs_bound {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {f : Ω → ℝ}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M) (s : ℝ) :

proof:
