  simp only [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: NLAlib.sphereDiagonalForm_normalize
statement:
theorem sphereDiagonalForm_normalize (d : n → ℝ) (z : n → ℂ) :
    sphereDiagonalForm d (normalizeComplexVector z) =
      sphereDiagonalForm d z / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold sphereDiagonalForm
  simp only [normalizeComplexVector, Pi.smul_apply, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, inv_pow]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sum_sub_mul_normSq_nonneg_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sum_sub_mul_normSq_nonneg_le
    (d : n → ℝ) {m x : ℝ} (hm : -1 < m) (hm1 : m < 1)
    (hmx : m < x) (hx : x < 1) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∑ i, d i = Fintype.card n * m) :
    (circularComplexGaussianVector n).real
      {z | 0 ≤ ∑ i, (d i-x)*Complex.normSq (z i)} ≤
      exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(x-m)^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  let t := sphereChernoffParameter m x
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    have hxm : -1 < x := hm.trans hmx
    have hden : 0 < 1-x^2 := by nlinarith
    dsimp [t,sphereChernoffParameter]
    positivity
  have hi i : t*(d i-x) < 1/2 :=
    sphereChernoffParameter_mul_sub_lt_half hm hmx hx (hd i).2
  have hint : Integrable (fun z : n → ℂ => exp (t*∑ i, (d i-x)*Complex.normSq (z i)))
      (circularComplexGaussianVector n) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    exact integrable_exp_sum_mul_normSq_circularComplexGaussianVector _ hi
  have hc := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf
    (μ := circularComplexGaussianVector n)
    (X := fun z : n → ℂ => ∑ i, (d i-x)*Complex.normSq (z i)) 0 ht.le hint
  simp only [mul_zero, exp_zero, one_mul, mgf] at hc
  have he : (∫ z : n → ℂ, exp (t*∑ i, (d i-x)*Complex.normSq (z i))
      ∂circularComplexGaussianVector n) =
      exp (-(∑ i, log (1-2*t*(d i-x)))) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [integral_exp_sum_mul_normSq_circularComplexGaussianVector _ hi,
      exp_neg, exp_sum]
    simp_rw [show ∀ i, exp (log (1-2*t*(d i-x))) = 1-2*t*(d i-x) from
      fun i => exp_log (by linarith [hi i])]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  apply hc.trans
  rw [he]
  apply exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hlog := card_mul_sub_sq_div_two_le_sum_log_affine d hm hm1 hmx hx hd hmean
  dsimp [t]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_ge_le_of_interior
statement:
theorem measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_ge_le_of_interior
    (d : n → ℝ) {m x : ℝ} (hm : -1 < m) (hm1 : m < 1)
    (hmx : m < x) (hx : x < 1) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∑ i, d i = Fintype.card n * m) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | x ≤ sphereDiagonalForm d b} ≤
      exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*(x-m)^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hasLaw_normalizeComplexVector_circularComplexGaussianVector.measureReal_eq
    (p := fun b : n → ℂ => x ≤ sphereDiagonalForm d b) (by
      unfold sphereDiagonalForm
      exact measurableSet_le measurable_const (by fun_prop))]
  apply le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_)
    (measureReal_sum_sub_mul_normSq_nonneg_le d hm hm1 hmx hx hd hmean)
  intro z hz
  change x ≤ sphereDiagonalForm d (normalizeComplexVector z) at hz
  change 0 ≤ ∑ i, (d i-x)*Complex.normSq (z i)
  by_cases he : z = 0
  · simp [he]
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact he ((WithLp.toLp_eq_zero 2).mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h))
  rw [sphereDiagonalForm_normalize] at hz
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hn)).mp hz
  rw [normSq_complexVector] at hmul
  simp_rw [sub_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr hmul

name: NLAlib.sphereDiagonalForm_le_norm_sq
statement:
theorem sphereDiagonalForm_le_norm_sq (d : n → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ≤ 1) (b : n → ℂ) :
    sphereDiagonalForm d b ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [normSq_complexVector]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hd i) (Complex.normSq_nonneg (b i))).trans_eq (one_mul _)

name: NLAlib.sphereDiagonalForm_const
statement:
theorem sphereDiagonalForm_const (c : ℝ) (b : n → ℂ) :
    sphereDiagonalForm (fun _ => c) b = c*‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereDiagonalForm, normSq_complexVector, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    (d : n → ℝ) {m r : ℝ} (hm : m ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∑ i, d i = Fintype.card n * m) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | r < sphereDiagonalForm d b-m} ≤
      exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : m+r < 1
  · by_cases hm0 : m = -1
    · have hzero : ∑ i, (d i+1) = 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hmean, hm0]
        simp
      have he (i : n) : d i = -1 := by
        have h := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
          (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => by linarith [(hd j).1])).mp hzero i (mem_univ i)
        linarith
      have hde : d = fun _ => -1 := funext he
      have hz : (complexSphereVector n) {b | r < sphereDiagonalForm d b-m} = 0 := by
        apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
        filter_upwards [ae_norm_eq_one_complexSphereVector (n := n)] with b hb
        rw [hde,sphereDiagonalForm_const,hb,hm0]
        simpa using hr.le
      simp only [Measure.real, hz, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
      exact (exp_pos _).le
    · have hi := measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_ge_le_of_interior d
        (lt_of_le_of_ne hm.1 (Ne.symm hm0)) (by linarith) (by linarith) hx hd hmean
      apply le_trans (measureReal_mono (fun b hb => by
        change r < sphereDiagonalForm d b-m at hb
        change m+r ≤ sphereDiagonalForm d b
        linarith))
        (hi.trans_eq (by congr 1; ring))
  · have hz : (complexSphereVector n) {b | r < sphereDiagonalForm d b-m} = 0 := by
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards [ae_norm_eq_one_complexSphereVector (n := n)] with b hb
      have h := sphereDiagonalForm_le_norm_sq d (fun i => (hd i).2) b
      rw [hb] at h
      exact not_lt_of_ge (by linarith)
    simp only [Measure.real, hz, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    exact (exp_pos _).le

name: NLAlib.measureReal_abs_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_abs_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le [Nonempty n]
    (d : n → ℝ) {m r : ℝ} (hm : m ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∑ i, d i = Fintype.card n * m) :
    (complexSphereVector n).real {b | r < |sphereDiagonalForm d b-m|} ≤
      2*exp (-(Fintype.card n : ℝ)*r^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le d hm hr hd hmean
  have hmn : -m ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by constructor <;> linarith [hm.1,hm.2]
  have hdn i : -d i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by constructor <;> linarith [(hd i).1,(hd i).2]
  have hmean' : ∑ i, -d i = Fintype.card n * -m := by rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib,hmean];ring
  have hn := measureReal_sphereDiagonalForm_sub_mean_gt_le (fun i => -d i) hmn hr hdn hmean'
  have he : ∀ b, sphereDiagonalForm (fun i => -d i) b = -sphereDiagonalForm d b := by
    intro b
    simp [sphereDiagonalForm,neg_mul,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hsub : {b | r < |sphereDiagonalForm d b-m|} ⊆
      {b | r < sphereDiagonalForm d b-m} ∪
      {b | r < sphereDiagonalForm (fun i => -d i) b-(-m)} := by
    intro b hb
    change r < |sphereDiagonalForm d b-m| at hb
    rcases lt_abs.mp hb with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · right
      change r < sphereDiagonalForm (fun i => -d i) b-(-m)
      rw [he]
      linarith
  exact (measureReal_mono hsub).trans ((measureReal_union_le _ _).trans (by linarith))

name: NLAlib.sineTruncation_eq_mul_sinc
statement:
theorem sineTruncation_eq_mul_sinc {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    sineTruncation c y = y * Real.sinc (c⁻¹ * y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simp [sineTruncation, hy]
  · rw [Real.sinc_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hc) hy), sineTruncation]
    field_simp

name: NLAlib.abs_sineTruncation_le
statement:
theorem abs_sineTruncation_le {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    |sineTruncation c y| ≤ |y|
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineTruncation_eq_mul_sinc hc, abs_mul]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sinc_le_one _) (abs_nonneg y)).trans_eq
    (mul_one _)

name: NLAlib.abs_sineTruncation_le_scale
statement:
theorem abs_sineTruncation_le_scale {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (y : ℝ) :
    |sineTruncation c y| ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sineTruncation, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) hc.le).trans_eq (mul_one _)

name: NLAlib.contDiff_sineTruncation_comp
statement:
theorem contDiff_sineTruncation_comp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (c : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => sineTruncation c (f x))
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => c * Real.sin (c⁻¹ * f x))
  exact contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_const.mul hf).sin)

name: NLAlib.fderiv_sineTruncation_comp
statement:
theorem fderiv_sineTruncation_comp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : E → ℝ} {x : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x => sineTruncation c (f x)) x =
      Real.cos (c⁻¹ * f x) • fderiv ℝ f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (((hf.hasFDerivAt.const_mul c⁻¹).sin).const_mul c).fderiv
  have he : c * (Real.cos (c⁻¹ * f x) * c⁻¹) = Real.cos (c⁻¹ * f x) := by
    field_simp
  simpa only [sineTruncation, smul_smul, he] using h

name: NLAlib.tendsto_sineTruncation_nat
statement:
theorem tendsto_sineTruncation_nat (y : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => sineTruncation ((n : ℝ) + 1) y) atTop (nhds y)
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * y) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [one_div, zero_mul] using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.mul_const y
  have hsinc := (Real.continuous_sinc.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hscale
  have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := y)).mul hsinc
  have he (n : ℕ) : sineTruncation ((n : ℝ) + 1) y =
      y * Real.sinc (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * y) :=
    sineTruncation_eq_mul_sinc (by positivity) y
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sinc_zero, mul_one, ← he] using h

name: NLAlib.integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_of_logSobolev_bound
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_of_logSobolev_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] {ν : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → E) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hLSI : ∀ h : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 h →
      Integrable (fun x => h x ^ 2) ν →
      Integrable (fun x => h x ^ 2 * Real.log (h x ^ 2)) ν →
      Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ h x (v i) ^ 2) ν →
      (∫ x, h x ^ 2 * Real.log (h x ^ 2) ∂ν) -
        (∫ x, h x ^ 2 ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ x, h x ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤
          C * ∫ x, ∑ i, fderiv ℝ h x (v i) ^ 2 ∂ν)
    (f : E → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) ν)
    (hdf : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (v i) ^ 2) ν) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) ν
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (n : ℝ) + 1
  have hc (n : ℕ) : 0 < c n := by dsimp [c]; positivity
  let fN : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun n x => sineTruncation (c n) (f x)
  have hNcd (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fN n) := contDiff_sineTruncation_comp hf (c n)
  have hNabs (n : ℕ) (x : E) : |fN n x| ≤ |f x| := abs_sineTruncation_le (hc n).ne' _
  have hNsq (n : ℕ) (x : E) : fN n x ^ 2 ≤ f x ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hNabs n x) 2
  have hN2 (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => fN n x ^ 2) ν := by
    refine hf2.mono' ((hNcd n).continuous.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact hNsq n x
  have hNlog (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => fN n x ^ 2 * Real.log (fN n x ^ 2)) ν := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (c n ^ 4 + 1))
      (Real.continuous_mul_log.comp ((hNcd n).continuous.pow 2)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have habs := abs_sineTruncation_le_scale (hc n) (f x)
    have hsq : fN n x ^ 2 ≤ c n ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) habs 2
    have h4 : (fN n x ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ c n ^ 4 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (fN n x)]
    exact (abs_mul_log_le_sq_add_one (fN n x ^ 2) (sq_nonneg _)).trans (by linarith)
  have hNdf_eq (n : ℕ) (x : E) (i : ι) :
      fderiv ℝ (fN n) x (v i) = Real.cos ((c n)⁻¹ * f x) * fderiv ℝ f x (v i) := by
    rw [fderiv_sineTruncation_comp (hf.differentiable (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hc n).ne']
    rfl
  have hNdf_le (n : ℕ) (x : E) :
      ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fN n) x (v i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (v i) ^ 2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [hNdf_eq, mul_pow]
    have hcos : Real.cos ((c n)⁻¹ * f x) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq ((c n)⁻¹ * f x), sq_nonneg (Real.sin ((c n)⁻¹ * f x))]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (fderiv ℝ f x (v i))]
  have hNdf (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fN n) x (v i) ^ 2) ν := by
    have hm : Continuous (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fN n) x (v i) ^ 2) := by
      exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
        (((hNcd n).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const).pow 2
    refine hdf.mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)]
    exact hNdf_le n x
  let M := ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂ν
  let G := ∫ x, ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (v i) ^ 2 ∂ν
  let B := C * G + M ^ 2 + 2
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have hNmean (n : ℕ) : (∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤ M := integral_mono (hN2 n) hf2 (hNsq n)
  have hNenergy (n : ℕ) : (∫ x, ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fN n) x (v i) ^ 2 ∂ν) ≤ G :=
    integral_mono (hNdf n) hdf (hNdf_le n)
  let F : E → ℝ := fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) + 1
  let FN : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun n x => fN n x ^ 2 * Real.log (fN n x ^ 2) + 1
  have hF0 (x : E) : 0 ≤ F x := by
    have h := Real.self_sub_one_le_mul_log (sq_nonneg (f x))
    dsimp [F]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (f x)]
  have hFN0 (n : ℕ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ FN n x := by
    have h := Real.self_sub_one_le_mul_log (sq_nonneg (fN n x))
    dsimp [FN]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (fN n x)]
  have hFNm (n : ℕ) : Measurable (FN n) :=
    ((Real.continuous_mul_log.comp ((hNcd n).continuous.pow 2)).add continuous_const).measurable
  have hFNi (n : ℕ) : Integrable (FN n) ν := (hNlog n).add (integrable_const _)
  have hFNbound (n : ℕ) : (∫ x, FN n x ∂ν) ≤ B := by
    have hlsi := hLSI (fN n) (hNcd n) (hN2 n) (hNlog n) (hNdf n)
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 ∂ν := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have hmLog := abs_mul_log_le_sq_add_one (∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 ∂ν) hm0
    have hmSq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hm0 (hNmean n) 2
    have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hNenergy n) hC
    have ha := le_abs_self ((∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 ∂ν) * Real.log (∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 ∂ν))
    change (∫ x, fN n x ^ 2 * Real.log (fN n x ^ 2) + 1 ∂ν) ≤ B
    have hOne : (∫ _x : E, (1 : ℝ) ∂ν) = 1 := by simp
    rw [integral_add (hNlog n) (integrable_const _)]
    rw [hOne]
    dsimp [B]
    linarith
  have hFNlim (x : E) : Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x)) atTop
      (nhds (ENNReal.ofReal (F x))) := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => fN n x) atTop (nhds (f x)) := tendsto_sineTruncation_nat (f x)
    have hloglim := (Real.continuous_mul_log.tendsto (f x ^ 2)).comp (hlim.pow 2)
    exact (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp (hloglim.add tendsto_const_nhds)
  have hFatou : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂ν) ≤
      liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x) ∂ν) atTop := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ x, liminf (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x)) atTop ∂ν :=
        lintegral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => (hFNlim x).liminf_eq.symm)
      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_liminf_le fun n => ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (hFNm n)
  have hLinbound (n : ℕ) : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x) ∂ν) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B := by
    rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hFNi n) (ae_of_all _ (hFN0 n))]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hFNbound n)
  have hLiminf : liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x) ∂ν) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B := by
    have h : liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (FN n x) ∂ν) atTop ≤
        liminf (fun _n : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal B) atTop :=
      liminf_le_liminf (Eventually.of_forall hLinbound)
    simpa using h
  have hFin : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (F x) ∂ν) ≠ ∞ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hFatou.trans hLiminf)
  have hFm : AEStronglyMeasurable F ν :=
    ((Real.continuous_mul_log.comp (hf.continuous.pow 2)).add continuous_const).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hFi := (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable hFm (ae_of_all _ hF0)).1 hFin
  have h := hFi.sub (integrable_const (1 : ℝ))
  refine h.congr (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  change (f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) + 1) - 1 = f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussian
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) (gaussianVector ι))
    (hdf : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) ^ 2)
      (gaussianVector ι)) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2))
      (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_of_logSobolev_bound (fun i : ι => Pi.single i 1) 2 (by norm_num)
    (fun h hcd h2 hlog hd => entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sum_sq_fderiv_gaussian h hcd h2 hlog hd)
    f hf hf2 hdf

name: NLAlib.entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sum_sq_fderiv_gaussian_of_integrable
statement:
theorem entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sum_sq_fderiv_gaussian_of_integrable
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) (gaussianVector ι))
    (hdf : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) ^ 2)
      (gaussianVector ι)) :
    ∫ x, f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) ∂(gaussianVector ι)
      - (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianVector ι)) *
        Real.log (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianVector ι)) ≤
      2 * ∫ x, ∑ i, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) ^ 2
        ∂(gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:=
  entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sum_sq_fderiv_gaussian f hf hf2
    (integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussian f hf hf2 hdf) hdf

name: NLAlib.integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussianReal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hdf : Integrable (fun x => deriv f x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_of_logSobolev_bound (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) 2 (by norm_num)
    ?_ f hf hf2 ?_
  · intro h hcd h2 hlog hd
    have hd' : Integrable (fun x => deriv h x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
      simpa only [Fintype.sum_unique, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using hd
    simpa only [Fintype.sum_unique, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using
      entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sq_deriv_gaussianReal h hcd h2 hlog hd'
  · simpa only [Fintype.sum_unique, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using hdf

name: NLAlib.entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sq_deriv_gaussianReal_of_integrable
statement:
theorem entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sq_deriv_gaussianReal_of_integrable
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hdf : Integrable (fun x => deriv f x ^ 2) (gaussianReal 0 1)) :
    ∫ x, f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      - (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) * Real.log (∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) ≤
        2 * ∫ x, deriv f x ^ 2 ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:=
  entropy_sq_le_two_mul_integral_sq_deriv_gaussianReal f hf hf2
    (integrable_sq_mul_log_sq_gaussianReal f hf hf2 hdf) hdf

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_matrix
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_matrix
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (Φ : E → M) (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] M)
    (hΦ : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt Φ (B.flip (f y)) y)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (CΦ C C' : ℝ) (hΦb : ∀ y, specNorm (Φ y) ≤ CΦ)
    (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
      (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) •
          (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
              f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) -
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) •
          ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)
              (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t := by
  have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let Q := P.prod γ
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
  let Y (s : ℝ) (q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E) :=
    resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt s) (Real.sqrt (1 - s))
      (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  let d (q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E) :=
    resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1
  let Lterm q := B (d q)
    (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
      f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
  let Hterm q := B (d q)
    (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2) (d q))
  let Vt : M := ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) • (∫ q, Lterm q ∂Q) -
    ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) • ∫ q, Hterm q ∂Q
  let e (i j : n) : M →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    ((Matrix.entryLinearMap ℂ ℂ i j).toContinuousLinearMap).restrictScalars ℝ
  let Be (i j : n) : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ F M ℂ (e i j)).comp B
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (hf y).continuousAt
  have hΦc : Continuous Φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (hΦ y).continuousAt
  have hX := ((memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hZ := (hγ.memLp_two.integrable one_le_two).comp_snd P
  have hY (s : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable (Y s) Q :=
    (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add
      ((hX.aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul (Real.sqrt s))).add
        (hZ.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul (Real.sqrt (1 - s)))
  have hΦint (s : ℝ) : Integrable (fun q => Φ (Y s q)) Q := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hΦc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hY s)) CΦ
    exact ae_of_all _ fun q => by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hΦb (Y s q)
  have hLint : Integrable Lterm Q := by
    apply Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    exact (integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine ν hν γ a b f hfc C hfb (Be i j)).2
  have hHint : Integrable Hterm Q := by
    apply Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    exact integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine ν hν γ μ a b df hdf C' hdfb (Be i j)
  have heΦ (i j : n) (y : E) :
      HasFDerivAt (fun y => e i j (Φ y)) ((Be i j).flip (f y)) y := by
    have h := (e i j).hasFDerivAt.comp y (hΦ y)
    convert! h using 1
  have heΦb (i j : n) (y : E) : ‖e i j (Φ y)‖ ≤ ‖e i j‖ * CΦ :=
    ((e i j).le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hΦb y) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hentry (i j : n) :
      HasDerivAt (fun s => resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ s i j) (Vt i j) t := by
    have hs := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov
      (fun y => e i j (Φ y)) f df (Be i j) (heΦ i j) hf hdf
      (‖e i j‖ * CΦ) C C' (heΦb i j) hfb hdfb ht ht1
    have heF : resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun y => e i j (Φ y)) =
        (fun s => resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ s i j) := by
      funext s
      exact (Matrix.integral_apply (hΦint s) i j).symm
    rw [heF] at hs
    convert hs using 1
    simp only [Vt, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.integral_apply hLint, Matrix.integral_apply hHint]
    rfl
  have hpi : HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => (fun i j : n => resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ s i j))
      (fun i j : n => Vt i j) t :=
    hasDerivAt_pi.mpr fun i => hasDerivAt_pi.mpr fun j => hentry i j
  let T : (n → n → ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] M :=
    (Matrix.ofLinearEquiv ℂ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hM := (T.toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hpi
  convert hM using 1 <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.indepFun_fst_pair_of_indepFun
statement:
private theorem indepFun_fst_pair_of_indepFun
    {Ω A C Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace A]
    [MeasurableSpace C] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (D : Ω → A) (W : Ω → C) (hDm : Measurable D) (hWm : Measurable W)
    (hDW : IndepFun D W P) :
    IndepFun (fun q : Ω × Z => D q.1) (fun q => (W q.1, q.2)) (P.prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  let δ := P.map D
  let η := P.map W
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure δ := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hDm.aemeasurable
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure η := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hWm.aemeasurable
  have hD : MeasurePreserving D P δ := ⟨hDm, rfl⟩
  have hW : MeasurePreserving W P η := ⟨hWm, rfl⟩
  have hpair : MeasurePreserving (fun p => (D p, W p)) P (δ.prod η) :=
    ⟨hDm.prodMk hWm, hDW.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hDm.aemeasurable hWm.aemeasurable⟩
  have hj := (measurePreserving_prodAssoc δ η γ).comp
    (hpair.prod (MeasurePreserving.id γ))
  have hDl := (hD.comp (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ))).hasLaw
  have hWl := (hW.prod (MeasurePreserving.id γ)).hasLaw
  exact (indepFun_iff_hasLaw_prodMk_prod hDl hWl).mpr hj.hasLaw

name: NLAlib.measurable_resamplingTriple_first_coords
statement:
private theorem measurable_resamplingTriple_first_coords :
    Measurable (resamplingTripleFirst : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
  intro i
  change Measurable (fun x : (ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ => ∑ j, x (j, if j = i then 1 else 0))
  fun_prop

proof:

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C : ℝ) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) =>
      B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
        (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleSecond q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
          (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let D : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) → κ → ℝ :=
    resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst
  have hD : MemLp D 2 P :=
    (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.sub (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).2.1
  have hDQ := hD.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ))
  let W : ((ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ)) → (κ → ℝ) × (κ → ℝ) :=
    fun q => (resamplingTripleSecond q.1, q.2)
  have hW : Measurable W :=
    (measurable_resamplingTriple_second_coords.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  exact integrable_bilin_quadratic_of_memLp _ hDQ W hW.aemeasurable
    (fun w => df (μ + a • (w.1 - μ) + b • w.2)) (by fun_prop)
    C (fun w => hdfb _) B

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C : ℝ) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ),
      B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
        (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleSecond q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
          (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
      ∂((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
          (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) •
        ∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ),
          B (Pi.single i 1)
            (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
          ∂((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let D : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) → κ → ℝ :=
    resamplingTripleOriginal - resamplingTripleFirst
  have hD : MemLp D 2 P :=
    (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.sub (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).2.1
  have hDm : Measurable D := by
    apply Measurable.sub
    · unfold resamplingTripleOriginal
      fun_prop
    · exact measurable_resamplingTriple_first_coords
  have hXm : Measurable
      (resamplingTripleOriginal : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) := by
    unfold resamplingTripleOriginal
    fun_prop
  have hXpm := measurable_resamplingTriple_second_coords (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
  let W : ((ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ)) → (κ → ℝ) × (κ → ℝ) :=
    fun q => (resamplingTripleSecond q.1, q.2)
  have hWm : Measurable W := (hXpm.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd
  have hind : IndepFun (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) => D q.1)
      W (P.prod γ) := indepFun_fst_pair_of_indepFun γ D resamplingTripleSecond hDm hXpm
        (indepFun_resamplingTriple_difference_second ν)
  have hDQ := hD.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ))
  have h := integral_bilin_quadratic_eq_sum_of_indepFun _ hDQ W hWm.aemeasurable hind
    (fun w => df (μ + a • (w.1 - μ) + b • w.2)) (by fun_prop)
    C (fun w => hdfb _) B
  have hid : IdentDistrib W
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) =>
        (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1, q.2)) (P.prod γ) (P.prod γ) := by
    have hpp : MeasurePreserving resamplingTripleSecond P (P.map resamplingTripleSecond) :=
      ⟨hXpm, rfl⟩
    have hpo : MeasurePreserving resamplingTripleOriginal P (P.map resamplingTripleOriginal) :=
      ⟨hXm, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hWm.aemeasurable, (hXm.comp measurable_fst |>.prodMk measurable_snd).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
    change Measure.map (Prod.map resamplingTripleSecond id) (P.prod γ) =
      Measure.map (Prod.map resamplingTripleOriginal id) (P.prod γ)
    rw [(hpp.prod (MeasurePreserving.id γ)).map_eq,
      (hpo.prod (MeasurePreserving.id γ)).map_eq,
      (identDistrib_resamplingTripleSecond_original ν).map_eq]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h
  change (∫ q, B (D q.1)
    (df (μ + a • ((W q).1 - μ) + b • (W q).2) (D q.1)) ∂P.prod γ) = _
  rw [h]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hmom : (∫ q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ),
      D q.1 i * D q.1 j ∂P.prod γ) = ∫ p, D p i * D p j ∂P :=
    (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ)).hasLaw.integral_comp
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ).memLp_of_bilin 1 (hD.eval i) (hD.eval j)).integrable
        le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable
  have htest := (hid.comp (show Measurable (fun w : (κ → ℝ) × (κ → ℝ) =>
      B (Pi.single i 1) (df (μ + a • (w.1 - μ) + b • w.2) (Pi.single j 1))) from
      ((B _).continuous.comp (hdf.comp (by fun_prop) |>.clm_apply continuous_const)).measurable)).integral_eq
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at htest
  rw [hmom, htest]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) γ
      (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ) 1 =
      ∫ x : ι → M, normalizedTrace (resolvent (∑ i, x i) ζ) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  haveI (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  have hΦ : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent (n := n) ζ) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x =>
      (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ hζ x).continuousAt)
  rw [resamplingInterpolation_one _ γ _ hΦ]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ι → M,
        hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ (matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν :=
      ((identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum ν).comp hΦ.measurable).integral_eq
    _ = _ := integral_congr_ae ((ae_isHermitian_sum_pi ν hν).mono fun x hx => by
      dsimp only [hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent]
      rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hx])

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i))
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
      (centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ) 0 =
      ∫ A : M, normalizedTrace (resolvent A ζ) ∂ρ
proof:
:= by
  haveI (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  haveI := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hΦ : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent (n := n) ζ) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x =>
      (hasFDerivAt_hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ hζ x).continuousAt)
  let m : E := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure
    (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
  have hm : m = ∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ := by
    dsimp [m]
    rw [integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν hν, ← hmean]
    exact ((matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm
      (integrable_id_of_hasGaussianLaw_matrixRealCoordinates ρ hρ)).symm
  rw [resamplingInterpolation_zero _ _ _ hΦ]
  change (∫ z : E, hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ (m + z)
    ∂centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) = _
  have hshift : Continuous (fun z : E => hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ (m + z)) :=
    hΦ.comp (by fun_prop)
  have ht := (hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates ρ).integral_comp hshift.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← ht]
  apply integral_congr_ae (hHerm.mono fun A hA => ?_)
  change hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent ζ
    (m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ)) = _
  have he : m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) =
      matrixRealCoordinates A := by rw [hm]; abel
  rw [he]
  dsimp only [hermitianCoordinateTraceResolvent]
  rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA]

name: NLAlib.covariance_rotation_eq
statement:
theorem covariance_rotation_eq (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0) (θ : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    cov[fun ω => -Real.sin θ * X i ω + Real.cos θ * Y i ω,
      fun ω => Real.cos θ * X j ω + Real.sin θ * Y j ω; P]
      = Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ *
        (∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := hXY.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hXm : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.fst.eval t).memLp_two
  have hYm : ∀ t, MemLp (Y t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.snd.eval t).memLp_two
  set s := Real.sin θ
  set c := Real.cos θ
  have hD : MemLp (fun ω => -s * X i ω + c * Y i ω) 2 P :=
    ((hXm i).const_mul _).add ((hYm i).const_mul _)
  have hZ : MemLp (fun ω => c * X j ω + s * Y j ω) 2 P :=
    ((hXm j).const_mul _).add ((hYm j).const_mul _)
  rw [covariance_eq_sub hD hZ]
  have hint : ∀ t, Integrable (X t) P := fun t => (hXm t).integrable one_le_two
  have hintY : ∀ t, Integrable (Y t) P := fun t => (hYm t).integrable one_le_two
  have hD0 : ∫ ω, -s * X i ω + c * Y i ω ∂P = 0 := by
    rw [integral_add ((hint i).const_mul _) ((hintY i).const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul, hX0, hY0]; ring
  rw [hD0, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  have e : (fun ω => (-s * X i ω + c * Y i ω) * (c * X j ω + s * Y j ω))
      = fun ω => (-s * c) * (X i ω * X j ω) + (-s ^ 2) * (X i ω * Y j ω)
        + c ^ 2 * (X j ω * Y i ω) + (c * s) * (Y i ω * Y j ω) := by
    funext ω; ring
  have i1 : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω * X j ω) P := (hXm i).integrable_mul (hXm j)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω * Y j ω) P := (hXm i).integrable_mul (hYm j)
  have i3 : Integrable (fun ω => X j ω * Y i ω) P := (hXm j).integrable_mul (hYm i)
  have i4 : Integrable (fun ω => Y i ω * Y j ω) P := (hYm i).integrable_mul (hYm j)
  rw [e, integral_add (((i1.const_mul _).fun_add (i2.const_mul _)).fun_add (i3.const_mul _))
    (i4.const_mul _), integral_add ((i1.const_mul _).fun_add (i2.const_mul _)) (i3.const_mul _),
    integral_add (i1.const_mul _) (i2.const_mul _), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hcross, hcross]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_sq_eq
statement:
theorem integral_sub_sq_eq (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hXm : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 P) (i j : ι) :
    ∫ ω, (X i ω - X j ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, X i ω * X i ω ∂P + ∫ ω, X j ω * X j ω ∂P
      - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X j ω * X i ω ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have i1 : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω * X i ω) P := (hXm i).integrable_mul (hXm i)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun ω => X j ω * X j ω) P := (hXm j).integrable_mul (hXm j)
  have i3 : Integrable (fun ω => X i ω * X j ω) P := (hXm i).integrable_mul (hXm j)
  have i4 : Integrable (fun ω => X j ω * X i ω) P := (hXm j).integrable_mul (hXm i)
  have e : (fun ω => (X i ω - X j ω) ^ 2) = fun ω => X i ω * X i ω + X j ω * X j ω
      - X i ω * X j ω - X j ω * X i ω := by funext ω; ring
  rw [e, integral_sub ((i1.fun_add i2).sub' i3) i4, integral_sub (i1.fun_add i2) i3,
    integral_add i1 i2]

name: NLAlib.integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg
statement:
theorem integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg {ι Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω}
    (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (g : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (H : ι → ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt F
      (∑ i, g i x • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) i) x)
    (hg : ∀ i x, HasFDerivAt (g i)
      (∑ j, H i j x • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j) x)
    (hHc : ∀ i j, Continuous (H i j))
    (C : ℝ) (hgb : ∀ i x, |g i x| ≤ C) (hHb : ∀ i j x, |H i j x| ≤ C)
    (K : ℝ) (hFb : ∀ x, |F x| ≤ ∑ t, |x t| + K)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j,
      (∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P) * H i j x) :
    ∫ ω, F (fun t => X t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, F (fun t => Y t ω) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hP := hXY.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hXm : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.fst.eval t).memLp_two
  have hYm : ∀ t, MemLp (Y t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.snd.eval t).memLp_two
  have hXi : ∀ t, Integrable (X t) P := fun t => (hXm t).integrable one_le_two
  have hYi : ∀ t, Integrable (Y t) P := fun t => (hYm t).integrable one_le_two
  have hXae : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (X t) P := fun t => (hXm t).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hYae : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (Y t) P := fun t => (hYm t).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hFc : Continuous F := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hF x).continuousAt
  have hgc : ∀ i, Continuous (g i) := fun i =>
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hg i x).continuousAt
  set Z : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ := fun θ ω t => Real.cos θ * X t ω + Real.sin θ * Y t ω with hZ
  set D : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ := fun θ ω t => -Real.sin θ * X t ω + Real.cos θ * Y t ω with hD
  set B : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∑ t, (|X t ω| + |Y t ω|) with hBdef
  have hB : Integrable B P :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun t _ => (hXi t).abs.add (hYi t).abs
  have hZb : ∀ θ ω t, |Z θ ω t| ≤ |X t ω| + |Y t ω| := by
    intro θ ω t
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    gcongr
    · exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one θ))
    · exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sin_le_one θ))
  have hDb : ∀ θ ω t, |D θ ω t| ≤ |X t ω| + |Y t ω| := by
    intro θ ω t
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg]
    gcongr
    · exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sin_le_one θ))
    · exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one θ))
  have hZae : ∀ θ, AEMeasurable (Z θ) P := fun θ =>
    aemeasurable_pi_lambda _ fun t => ((hXae t).const_mul _).add ((hYae t).const_mul _)
  have hDae : ∀ θ t, AEMeasurable (fun ω => D θ ω t) P := fun θ t =>
    ((hXae t).const_mul _).add ((hYae t).const_mul _)
  set Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => ∫ ω, F (Z θ ω) ∂P with hΦ
  set F' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun θ ω => ∑ i, g i (Z θ ω) * D θ ω i with hF'
  have hgD : ∀ θ ω i, |g i (Z θ ω) * D θ ω i| ≤ C * (|X i ω| + |Y i ω|) := by
    intro θ ω i
    rw [abs_mul]
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hgb i (Z θ ω))
    exact mul_le_mul (hgb i _) (hDb θ ω i) (abs_nonneg _) hC
  have hderiv : ∀ θ0, HasDerivAt Φ (∫ ω, F' θ0 ω ∂P) θ0 := by
    intro θ0
    have hFm : ∀ θ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => F (Z θ ω)) P := fun θ =>
      (hFc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hZae θ)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hFint : Integrable (fun ω => F (Z θ0 ω)) P := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (hB.add (integrable_const K)) (hFm θ0)
        (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine (hFb _).trans ?_
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, hBdef]
      gcongr with t
      exact hZb θ0 ω t
    have hF'm : AEStronglyMeasurable (F' θ0) P := by
      refine (Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _ fun i _ => ?_).aestronglyMeasurable
      exact ((hgc i).measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hZae θ0)).mul (hDae θ0 i)
    have hbound : ∀ θ ω, ‖F' θ ω‖ ≤ C * B ω := by
      intro θ ω
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hF', hBdef, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hgD θ ω i)
    have hdiff : ∀ ω θ, HasDerivAt (fun θ => F (Z θ ω)) (F' θ ω) θ := by
      intro ω θ
      have hZd : HasDerivAt (fun θ => Z θ ω) (D θ ω) θ := by
        rw [hasDerivAt_pi]
        intro t
        exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).mul_const (X t ω)).add
          ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).mul_const (Y t ω))
      have := (hF (Z θ ω)).comp_hasDerivAt θ hZd
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp [hF']
    exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := P)
      (F := fun θ ω => F (Z θ ω)) (F' := F') (x₀ := θ0) (bound := fun ω => C * B ω)
      (s := Set.univ)
      Filter.univ_mem (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFm) hFint hF'm
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω θ _ => hbound θ ω) (hB.const_mul C)
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω θ _ => hdiff ω θ)).2
  set Δ : ι → ι → ℝ := fun i j => ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P with hΔdef
  have hHi : ∀ θ i j, Integrable (fun ω => H i j (Z θ ω)) P := fun θ i j =>
    Integrable.mono' (integrable_const C)
      ((hHc i j).measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hZae θ)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hHb i j _)
  have hnonneg : ∀ θ, 0 ≤ Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ → 0 ≤ ∫ ω, F' θ ω ∂P := by
    intro θ hsc
    have hUV : ∀ i, HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (D θ ω i, fun j => Z θ ω j)) P := by
      intro i
      set L : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × (ι → ℝ) :=
        ((-Real.sin θ) • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) i).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ))) +
          Real.cos θ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) i).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ)))).prod
        (Real.cos θ • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ) +
          Real.sin θ • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ)) with hL
      have := hXY.map_fun L
      have heq : (fun ω => (D θ ω i, fun j => Z θ ω j))
          = fun ω => L (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω) := by
        funext ω
        simp only [hL, hD, hZ]
        ext j <;> simp
      rw [heq]; exact this
    have hU0 : ∀ i, ∫ ω, D θ ω i ∂P = 0 := by
      intro i
      simp only [hD]
      rw [integral_add ((hXi i).const_mul _) ((hYi i).const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, hX0, hY0]; ring
    have hIBP : ∀ i, ∫ ω, D θ ω i * g i (Z θ ω) ∂P
        = ∑ j, (Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ * Δ i j) * ∫ ω, H i j (Z θ ω) ∂P := by
      intro i
      have h := integral_mul_eq_sum_covariance_mul_integral (fun ω => D θ ω i)
        (fun j ω => Z θ ω j) (hUV i)
        (hU0 i) (g i) (H i) (fun x => hg i x) (fun j => hHc i j) C (hgb i) (hHb i)
      refine h.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_)
      congr 1
      exact covariance_rotation_eq X Y hXY hX0 hY0 hcross θ i j
    have hDp : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => D θ ω i * g i (Z θ ω)) P := by
      intro i
      refine Integrable.mono' (((hXi i).abs.add (hYi i).abs).const_mul C) (((hDae θ i).mul
        ((hgc i).measurable.comp_aemeasurable (hZae θ))).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
      exact hgD θ ω i
    have e1 : ∫ ω, F' θ ω ∂P = ∑ i, ∫ ω, D θ ω i * g i (Z θ ω) ∂P := by
      simp only [hF']
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => by simpa only [mul_comm] using hDp i)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      congr 1; ext ω; ring
    have e2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, (Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ * Δ i j) * ∫ ω, H i j (Z θ ω) ∂P
        = ∫ ω, ∑ i, ∑ j, (Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ * Δ i j) * H i j (Z θ ω) ∂P := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
        (hHi θ i j).const_mul _)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => (hHi θ i j).const_mul _)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [e1]
    simp_rw [hIBP]
    rw [e2]
    refine integral_nonneg fun ω => ?_
    have e3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, (Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ * Δ i j) * H i j (Z θ ω)
        = (Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) * ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * H i j (Z θ ω) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [e3]
    exact mul_nonneg hsc (hpos _)
  have hcont : Continuous Φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun θ => (hderiv θ).continuousAt
  have hmono : MonotoneOn Φ (Set.Icc 0 (Real.pi / 2)) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 (Real.pi / 2))
      hcont.continuousOn (fun θ _ => (hderiv θ).hasDerivWithinAt) (fun θ hθ => ?_)
    rw [interior_Icc] at hθ
    refine hnonneg θ (mul_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hθ.1.le (by linarith [hθ.2,
      Real.pi_pos])) (Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [hθ.1, Real.pi_pos], hθ.2.le⟩))
  have hpi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have h := hmono ⟨le_refl 0, hpi⟩ ⟨hpi, le_refl _⟩ hpi
  have h0 : Φ 0 = ∫ ω, F (fun t => X t ω) ∂P := by simp [hΦ, hZ]
  have h1 : Φ (Real.pi / 2) = ∫ ω, F (fun t => Y t ω) ∂P := by simp [hΦ, hZ]
  rw [← h0, ← h1]; exact h

name: NLAlib.sl_coord_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem sl_coord_hasFDerivAt (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ u, HasDerivAt φ (φ' u) u) (t : ι)
    (x : ι → ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ι → ℝ => φ (y t)) (φ' (x t) • PR t) x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt φ (φ' (x t)) ((PR t) x) := hφ (x t)
  exact h1.comp_hasFDerivAt x (PR t).hasFDerivAt

name: NLAlib.slF_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem slF_hasFDerivAt (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ u, HasDerivAt φ (φ' u) u) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (slF φ) (∑ i, slG φ φ' i x • PR i) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := HasFDerivAt.finsetProd (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun t _ => sl_coord_hasFDerivAt φ φ' hφ t x)
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [smul_smul, slG, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.slG_hasFDerivAt
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sl_coord_hasFDerivAt φ' φ'' hφ' i x
  have h2 := HasFDerivAt.finsetProd (u := Finset.univ.erase i)
    (fun t _ => sl_coord_hasFDerivAt φ φ' hφ t x)
  have h := h1.mul h2
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [slH, if_true]
  have e : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, slH φ φ' φ'' i j x • (PR j)
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (φ' (x i) * (φ' (x j) * ∏ t ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j, φ (x t))) • (PR j) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    rw [slH, if_neg (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
  simp only [slH] at e
  rw [e, add_comm, Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_
  · rw [mul_comm]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    congr 1
    ring

name: NLAlib.sl_prod_bounds
statement:
private theorem sl_prod_bounds (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∏ t ∈ s, φ (x t) ∧ ∏ t ∈ s, φ (x t) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => h0 _, Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ => h0 _) (fun _ _ => h1 _)⟩

name: NLAlib.slF_nonneg
statement: private theorem slF_nonneg (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ slF φ x
proof:
:=
  (sl_prod_bounds h0 h1 _ x).1

name: NLAlib.slF_le_one
statement: private theorem slF_le_one (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) (x : ι → ℝ) : slF φ x ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (sl_prod_bounds h0 h1 _ x).2

name: NLAlib.slG_abs_le
statement:
private theorem slG_abs_le (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) {C : ℝ} (hC1 : ∀ u, |φ' u| ≤ C)
    (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : |slG φ φ' i x| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p0, p1⟩ := sl_prod_bounds h0 h1 (Finset.univ.erase i) x
  rw [slG, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg p0]
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC1 0)
  calc |φ' (x i)| * _ ≤ C * 1 := mul_le_mul (hC1 _) p1 p0 hC0
    _ = C := mul_one C

name: NLAlib.slH_abs_le
statement:
private theorem slH_abs_le (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) {C : ℝ} (hC1 : ∀ u, |φ' u| ≤ C)
    (hC2 : ∀ u, |φ'' u| ≤ C) (i j : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : |slH φ φ' φ'' i j x| ≤ C + C * C
proof:
:= by
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC1 0)
  unfold slH
  split_ifs with hij
  · obtain ⟨p0, p1⟩ := sl_prod_bounds h0 h1 (Finset.univ.erase i) x
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg p0]
    have := mul_le_mul (hC2 (x i)) p1 p0 hC0
    nlinarith
  · obtain ⟨p0, p1⟩ := sl_prod_bounds h0 h1 ((Finset.univ.erase i).erase j) x
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg p0]
    have a1 := hC1 (x i)
    have a2 := hC1 (x j)
    have b1 := abs_nonneg (φ' (x i))
    have b2 := abs_nonneg (φ' (x j))
    have : |φ' (x j)| * ∏ t ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j, φ (x t) ≤ C :=
      (mul_le_mul a2 p1 p0 hC0).trans (le_of_eq (mul_one C))
    have h3 : 0 ≤ |φ' (x j)| * ∏ t ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j, φ (x t) :=
      mul_nonneg b2 p0
    have := mul_le_mul a1 this h3 hC0
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.slH_nonneg_of_ne
statement:
private theorem slH_nonneg_of_ne (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (hd : ∀ u, φ' u ≤ 0) {i j : ι} (hij : j ≠ i)
    (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ slH φ φ' φ'' i j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [slH, if_neg hij]
  have p0 : 0 ≤ ∏ t ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j, φ (x t) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => h0 _
  have := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hd (x j)) p0
  exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (hd (x i)) this

name: NLAlib.slH_continuous
statement:
private theorem slH_continuous (hφc : Continuous φ) (hφ'c : Continuous φ') (hφ''c : Continuous φ'')
    (i j : ι) : Continuous (slH (ι := ι) φ φ' φ'' i j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold slH
  split_ifs
  · exact (hφ''c.comp (continuous_apply i)).mul
      (continuous_finsetProd _ fun t _ => hφc.comp (continuous_apply t))
  · exact (hφ'c.comp (continuous_apply i)).mul ((hφ'c.comp (continuous_apply j)).mul
      (continuous_finsetProd _ fun t _ => hφc.comp (continuous_apply t)))

name: NLAlib.sl_compare
statement:
private theorem sl_compare (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω * X t ω ∂P = ∫ ω, Y t ω * Y t ω ∂P)
    (hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (X s ω - X t ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y s ω - Y t ω) ^ 2 ∂P)
    (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ u, HasDerivAt φ (φ' u) u)
    (hφ' : ∀ u, HasDerivAt φ' (φ'' u) u) (hφ''c : Continuous φ'')
    (h0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ φ u) (h1 : ∀ u, φ u ≤ 1) (hd : ∀ u, φ' u ≤ 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC1 : ∀ u, |φ' u| ≤ C) (hC2 : ∀ u, |φ'' u| ≤ C) :
    ∫ ω, slF φ (fun t => Y t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, slF φ (fun t => X t ω) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC1 0)
  have hφc : Continuous φ := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun u => (hφ u).continuousAt
  have hφ'c : Continuous φ' := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun u => (hφ' u).continuousAt
  have hXm : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.fst.eval t).memLp_two
  have hYm : ∀ t, MemLp (Y t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.snd.eval t).memLp_two
  
  have hΔo : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P ≤ 0 := by
    intro i j
    have h := hinc i j
    rw [integral_sub_sq_eq X hXm i j, integral_sub_sq_eq Y hYm i j] at h
    have ea : ∫ ω, X j ω * X i ω ∂P = ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P := by
      congr 1; ext ω; ring
    have eb : ∫ ω, Y j ω * Y i ω ∂P = ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P := by
      congr 1; ext ω; ring
    rw [ea, eb, hvar i, hvar j] at h
    linarith
  have hYX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => Y t ω, fun t => X t ω)) P := by
    simpa using hXY.map_fun ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ)).prod
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ι → ℝ) (ι → ℝ)))
  have hKC : C ≤ C + C * C := by nlinarith
  refine integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg Y X hYX hY0 hX0
    (fun s t => by simpa only [mul_comm] using hcross t s) (slF φ) (slG φ φ') (slH φ φ' φ'')
    (slF_hasFDerivAt φ φ' hφ) (slG_hasFDerivAt φ φ' φ'' hφ hφ') (slH_continuous hφc hφ'c hφ''c)
    (C + C * C) (fun i x => (slG_abs_le h0 h1 hC1 i x).trans hKC) (slH_abs_le h0 h1 hC1 hC2)
    1 (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (slF_nonneg h0 h1 x)]
    have := slF_le_one h0 h1 x
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ t, |x t| := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _
    linarith
  · refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · rw [hij, hvar i, sub_self, zero_mul]
    · exact mul_nonneg (by linarith [hΔo i j]) (slH_nonneg_of_ne h0 hd hij x)

name: NLAlib.sl_deriv_zero_of_const
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ y ∈ U, deriv f y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    have : f =ᶠ[nhds y] fun _ => c := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) hf
    rw [this.deriv_eq]; exact deriv_const _ _
  refine ⟨h1 x hx, ?_⟩
  have : deriv f =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) h1
  rw [this.deriv_eq]; exact deriv_const _ _

name: NLAlib.sl_sT_deriv_zero
statement:
private theorem sl_sT_deriv_zero {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 ∧ deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hx
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · exact sl_deriv_zero_of_const isOpen_Iio hx
      (fun y hy => Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hy))
  · exact sl_deriv_zero_of_const isOpen_Ioi hx
      (fun y hy => Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hy))

name: NLAlib.sl_sT_props
statement:
private theorem sl_sT_props :
    (∀ x, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition x) x) ∧
    (∀ x, HasDerivAt (deriv Real.smoothTransition)
      (deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition) x) x) ∧
    Continuous (deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition)) ∧
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition x) ∧
    ∃ C, (∀ x, |deriv Real.smoothTransition x| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ x, |deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition) x| ≤ C)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hc1 : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := by
    simpa using hc.iterate_deriv 1
  have hc2 : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition)) := by
    have := hc.iterate_deriv 2
    simpa [Function.iterate_succ] using this
  have hd0 := hc.differentiable (by simp)
  have hd1 := hc1.differentiable (by simp)
  refine ⟨fun x => (hd0 x).hasDerivAt, fun x => (hd1 x).hasDerivAt, hc2.continuous,
    fun x => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg, ?_⟩
  have s1 : HasCompactSupport (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc fun x hx => (sl_sT_deriv_zero hx).1
  have s2 : HasCompactSupport (deriv (deriv Real.smoothTransition)) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc fun x hx => (sl_sT_deriv_zero hx).2
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hc1.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support s1
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hc2.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support s2
  refine ⟨max C1 C2, fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · exact (hC1 x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact (hC2 x).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.sl_cutoff
statement:
private theorem sl_cutoff (τ : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (∀ u, HasDerivAt (slφ τ δ) (slφ1 τ δ u) u) ∧
    (∀ u, HasDerivAt (slφ1 τ δ) (slφ2 τ δ u) u) ∧
    Continuous (slφ2 τ δ) ∧
    (∀ u, 0 ≤ slφ τ δ u) ∧ (∀ u, slφ τ δ u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ u, slφ1 τ δ u ≤ 0) ∧
    (∀ u, u ≤ τ → slφ τ δ u = 1) ∧ (∀ u, τ + δ ≤ u → slφ τ δ u = 0) ∧
    ∃ C, (∀ u, |slφ1 τ δ u| ≤ C) ∧ (∀ u, |slφ2 τ δ u| ≤ C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d0, d1, c2, pos, C, hC1, hC2⟩ := sl_sT_props
  have ha : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => (τ + δ - u) / δ) (-1 / δ) u := fun u => by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_sub (τ + δ)).div_const δ
  refine ⟨fun u => ?_, fun u => ?_, ?_, fun u => Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _,
    fun u => Real.smoothTransition.le_one _, fun u => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_,
    ⟨(1 / δ + (1 / δ) ^ 2) * C, fun u => ?_, fun u => ?_⟩⟩
  · have := (d0 ((τ + δ - u) / δ)).comp u (ha u)
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [slφ1]; ring
  · have := ((d1 ((τ + δ - u) / δ)).comp u (ha u)).const_mul (-(1 / δ))
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [slφ2]; ring
  · unfold slφ2; fun_prop
  · simp only [slφ1]
    have := pos ((τ + δ - u) / δ)
    have : 0 < 1 / δ := by positivity
    nlinarith
  · simp only [slφ]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith
  · simp only [slφ]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hδ.le
  · have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC1 0)
    simp only [slφ1, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.2 hδ)]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC1 ((τ + δ - u) / δ)) (one_div_pos.2 hδ).le
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 / δ)]
  · have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC1 0)
    simp only [slφ2, abs_mul, abs_pow, abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.2 hδ)]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC2 ((τ + δ - u) / δ)) (sq_nonneg (1 / δ))
    nlinarith [one_div_pos.2 hδ]

name: NLAlib.slepian_inequality
statement:
theorem slepian_inequality {ι Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω'] {P : Measure Ω} {Q : Measure Ω'} (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (Y : ι → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => X t ω) P) (hY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => Y t ω) Q)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂Q = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, Y t ω ^ 2 ∂Q)
    (hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (X s ω - X t ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y s ω - Y t ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) (τ : ℝ) :
    P {ω | τ < ⨆ t, X t ω} ≤ Q {ω | τ < ⨆ t, Y t ω}
proof:
:= by
  have hP := hX.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hQ := hY.isProbabilityMeasure
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · simp only [Real.iSup_of_isEmpty]
    by_cases h : τ < 0 <;> simp [h]
  classical
  set μX := P.map (fun ω t => X t ω) with hμX
  set μY := Q.map (fun ω t => Y t ω) with hμY
  have : IsGaussian μX := hX.isGaussian_map
  have : IsGaussian μY := hY.isGaussian_map
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μX := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX.aemeasurable
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μY := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY.aemeasurable
  have hsup : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, x t) :=
    Measurable.iSup fun t => measurable_pi_apply t
  set S : Set (ι → ℝ) := {x | τ < ⨆ t, x t} with hSdef
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := measurableSet_lt measurable_const hsup
  have eX : P {ω | τ < ⨆ t, X t ω} = μX S :=
    (Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable hS).symm
  have eY : Q {ω | τ < ⨆ t, Y t ω} = μY S :=
    (Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable hS).symm
  rw [eX, eY]
  set T : ℝ → Set (ι → ℝ) := fun a => {x | ⨆ t, x t ≤ a} with hTdef
  have hT : ∀ a, MeasurableSet (T a) := fun a => measurableSet_le hsup measurable_const
  have hmemT : ∀ a x, x ∈ T a ↔ ∀ t, x t ≤ a := fun a x =>
    ciSup_le_iff (Set.finite_range x).bddAbove
  
  set μ := μX.prod μY with hμ
  have hlaw : HasGaussianLaw (fun p : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ) => (fun t => p.1 t, fun t => p.2 t)) μ :=
    IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id
  have hfst : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f → ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μX := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.fst) :=
      (integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_fst_prod, measure_univ, one_smul]
  have hsnd : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f → ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μY := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.snd) :=
      (integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_snd_prod, measure_univ, one_smul]
  have hXf : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun t => X t ω) ∂P := fun f hf => by
    rw [hfst f hf, hμX, integral_map hX.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hYf : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun t => Y t ω) ∂Q := fun f hf => by
    rw [hsnd f hf, hμY, integral_map hY.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hX0' : ∀ t, ∫ p, p.1 t ∂μ = 0 := fun t => by
    rw [hXf (fun x => x t) (measurable_pi_apply t)]; exact hX0 t
  have hY0' : ∀ t, ∫ p, p.2 t ∂μ = 0 := fun t => by
    rw [hYf (fun x => x t) (measurable_pi_apply t)]; exact hY0 t
  have hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ p, p.1 s * p.2 t ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro s t
    rw [hμ, integral_prod_mul (fun x : ι → ℝ => x s) (fun y : ι → ℝ => y t)]
    have : ∫ x, x s ∂μX = 0 := by
      rw [hμX, integral_map hX.aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply s).aestronglyMeasurable]
      exact hX0 s
    rw [this, zero_mul]
  have hvar' : ∀ t, ∫ p, p.1 t * p.1 t ∂μ = ∫ p, p.2 t * p.2 t ∂μ := by
    intro t
    rw [hXf (fun x => x t * x t) (by fun_prop), hYf (fun x => x t * x t) (by fun_prop)]
    simpa only [sq] using hvar t
  have hinc' : ∀ s t, ∫ p, (p.1 s - p.1 t) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ ∫ p, (p.2 s - p.2 t) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    intro s t
    rw [hXf (fun x => (x s - x t) ^ 2) (by fun_prop),
      hYf (fun x => (x s - x t) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)]
    exact hinc s t
  
  have key : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → μY.real (T τ) ≤ μX.real (T (τ + δ)) := by
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨d0, d1, c2, p0, p1, pd, pτ, pτδ, C, hC1, hC2⟩ := sl_cutoff τ hδ
    have hc := sl_compare (P := μ) (fun t p => p.1 t) (fun t p => p.2 t) hlaw hX0' hY0'
      hcross hvar' hinc' (slφ τ δ) (slφ1 τ δ) (slφ2 τ δ) d0 d1 c2 p0 p1 pd C hC1 hC2
    have hFc : Continuous (slF (ι := ι) (slφ τ δ)) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x =>
        (slF_hasFDerivAt (slφ τ δ) (slφ1 τ δ) d0 x).continuousAt
    rw [hfst _ hFc.measurable, hsnd _ hFc.measurable] at hc
    have hFint : ∀ ν : Measure (ι → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Integrable (slF (slφ τ δ)) ν :=
      fun ν _ => Integrable.mono' (integrable_const 1) hFc.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun x => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (slF_nonneg p0 p1 _)]; exact slF_le_one p0 p1 _)
    have hlow : μY.real (T τ) ≤ ∫ x, slF (slφ τ δ) x ∂μY := by
      rw [← integral_indicator_one (hT τ)]
      refine integral_mono ((integrable_const 1).indicator (hT τ)) (hFint μY inferInstance)
        fun x => ?_
      by_cases hx : x ∈ T τ
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.one_apply]
        have : slF (slφ τ δ) x = 1 :=
          Finset.prod_eq_one fun t _ => pτ (x t) ((hmemT τ x).1 hx t)
        rw [this]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]; exact slF_nonneg p0 p1 _
    have hup : ∫ x, slF (slφ τ δ) x ∂μX ≤ μX.real (T (τ + δ)) := by
      rw [← integral_indicator_one (hT (τ + δ))]
      refine integral_mono (hFint μX inferInstance)
        ((integrable_const 1).indicator (hT (τ + δ))) fun x => ?_
      by_cases hx : x ∈ T (τ + δ)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.one_apply]; exact slF_le_one p0 p1 _
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
        have : ¬ ∀ t, x t ≤ τ + δ := fun h => hx ((hmemT _ x).2 h)
        push Not at this
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := this
        have : slF (slφ τ δ) x = 0 :=
          Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ t) (pτδ (x t) ht.le)
        rw [this]
    linarith
  
  set ν := μX.map (fun x : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, x t) with hν
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hsup.aemeasurable
  have hνT : ∀ a, μX.real (T a) = cdf ν a := by
    intro a
    rw [cdf_eq_real, measureReal_def, measureReal_def, hν,
      Measure.map_apply hsup measurableSet_Iic]
    rfl
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (cdf ν) (nhdsWithin τ (Set.Ioi τ)) (nhds (cdf ν τ)) :=
    ((cdf ν).right_continuous τ).mono Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self
  have hreal : μY.real (T τ) ≤ μX.real (T τ) := by
    rw [hνT]
    refine ge_of_tendsto hlim (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun a ha => ?_)
    have := key (a - τ) (sub_pos.2 ha)
    rw [hνT, add_sub_cancel] at this
    exact this
  have hle : μY (T τ) ≤ μX (T τ) := by
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal (μ := μY), ← ofReal_measureReal (μ := μX)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
  have hSc : S = (T τ)ᶜ := by
    ext x; simp [hSdef, hTdef, not_le]
  rw [hSc, prob_compl_eq_one_sub (hT τ), prob_compl_eq_one_sub (hT τ)]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left hle 1

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingStein_first
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingStein_first
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : ℝ)
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
      ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
          (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
            f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
          ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ :=
  integral_bilin_resamplingAffine ν hν γ a b f hfc C hfb B

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingStein_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingStein_gaussian
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (a b : ℝ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C C' : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    (∫ q, B q.2 (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
      ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      (b * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
          (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)
            (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
          ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ := by
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  have hX : AEMeasurable (resamplingTripleOriginal : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) P :=
    (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hg := integral_bilin_gaussian_affine_product P resamplingTripleOriginal hX γ hγ hmean
    μ a b f df hf hdf C C' hfb hdfb B
  simp_rw [hcov, covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_eval ν hν] at hg
  have hquad := integral_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine ν hν γ μ a b df hdf C' hdfb B
  change (∫ q, B q.2 (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
    ∂P.prod γ) = _
  calc
    _ = b • ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) *
          ∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
            (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j) ∂P) •
        ∫ q, B (Pi.single i 1)
          (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
          ∂P.prod γ := by simpa only [resamplingAffinePoint] using hg
    _ = (b * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) • ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∫ p, (resamplingTripleOriginal p i - resamplingTripleFirst p i) *
          (resamplingTripleOriginal p j - resamplingTripleFirst p j) ∂P) •
        ∫ q, B (Pi.single i 1)
          (df (μ + a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
          ∂P.prod γ := by
      simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← hquad]; rfl

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2))
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) ∧
      (∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2)
        ∂Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
        R ^ 2 * Real.log (Fintype.card n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    let := hn
    have hz : ∀ A : M, specNorm A = 0 := by
      intro A
      rw [Subsingleton.elim A 0, specNorm_zero]
    constructor
    · simpa only [hz] using!
        (integrable_zero (ι → E) ℝ (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates))
    · simp only [hz, integral_zero, mul_zero, Fintype.card_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero,
        Real.log_zero, add_zero, le_refl]
  | inr hn =>
    let := hn
    let κ : ι → Measure E := fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates
    have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i) :=
      (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
    let T : (ι → M) → ι → E := fun x i => matrixRealCoordinates (x i)
    let F : (ι → E) → ℝ := fun x => specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2)
    have hFc : Continuous F := by
      simp only [F, specNorm_eq_norm]
      fun_prop
    have hπHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, (x i).IsHermitian :=
      fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hHerm i)
    have hπBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, specNorm (x i) ≤ R :=
      fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hBound i)
    have h := integrable_and_integral_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff (Measure.pi ν)
      (fun i (x : ι → M) => x i) hR (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i)
      (iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)) hπHerm hπBound
    have hsqc : Continuous (fun A : M => A ^ 2) := by fun_prop
    have hSqInt (i : ι) : Integrable (fun A : M => A ^ 2) (ν i) := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound hsqc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable (R ^ 2)
      filter_upwards [hBound i] with A hA
      exact (norm_pow_le A 2).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg A) hA 2)
    have hmoment (i : ι) : (∫ x : ι → M, (x i) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi ν) =
        ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
      exact (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw.integral_comp
        (hSqInt i).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hLaw : HasLaw T (Measure.pi κ) (Measure.pi ν) := hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_pi ν
    have hAE : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, F (T x) = specNorm (∑ i, (x i) ^ 2) := by
      filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hπHerm] with x hx
      dsimp only [F, T]
      apply congrArg specNorm
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates (hx i)]
    have hCompInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => F (T x)) (Measure.pi ν) := h.1.congr (hAE.mono fun x hx => hx.symm)
    have hFint : Integrable F (Measure.pi κ) := by
      rw [← hLaw.map_eq]
      exact (integrable_map_measure hFc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable hLaw.aemeasurable).mpr hCompInt
    have htransport := hLaw.integral_comp hFc.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    change (∫ x : ι → M, F (T x) ∂Measure.pi ν) = ∫ x : ι → E, F x ∂Measure.pi κ at htransport
    have he : (∫ x : ι → E, F x ∂Measure.pi κ) =
        ∫ x : ι → M, specNorm (∑ i, (x i) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν :=
      htransport.symm.trans (integral_congr_ae hAE)
    refine ⟨hFint, ?_⟩
    have hb := h.2
    simp_rw [hmoment] at hb
    exact he.trans_le hb

name: NLAlib.sfS_pos
statement: private theorem sfS_pos [Nonempty ι] (β : ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 < sfS β x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: NLAlib.sfp_nonneg
statement: private theorem sfp_nonneg (β : ℝ) (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ sfp β i x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)

name: NLAlib.sfp_sum
statement: private theorem sfp_sum [Nonempty ι] (β : ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) : ∑ i, sfp β i x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sfp, ← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (sfS_pos β x).ne'

name: NLAlib.sfp_le_one
statement: private theorem sfp_le_one [Nonempty ι] (β : ℝ) (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : sfp β i x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sfp_sum β x]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sfp_nonneg β j x) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: NLAlib.sfS_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem sfS_hasFDerivAt (β : ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (sfS β) (∑ t, (β * Real.exp (β * x t)) • PR t) x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι), HasFDerivAt (fun y : ι → ℝ => Real.exp (β * y t))
      ((β * Real.exp (β * x t)) • PR t) x := by
    intro t _
    have h := (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) t).hasFDerivAt
      (x := x)).const_mul β).exp
    exact h.congr_fderiv (by rw [smul_smul, mul_comm]; rfl)
  have h := HasFDerivAt.sum this
  have e : (sfS β : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) = ∑ t, fun y : ι → ℝ => Real.exp (β * y t) := by
    funext y; simp [sfS]
  rw [e]; exact h

name: NLAlib.sfF_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem sfF_hasFDerivAt [Nonempty ι] (β : ℝ) (hβ : β ≠ 0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (sfF β) (∑ i, sfp β i x • PR i) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((sfS_hasFDerivAt β x).log (sfS_pos β x).ne').mul_const β⁻¹
  have e : (sfF β : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) = fun y => Real.log (sfS β y) * β⁻¹ := by
    funext y; simp [sfF, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [e]
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  ext v
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, FunLike.coe_smul,
    Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, sfp]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.sfp_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem sfp_hasFDerivAt [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι] (β : ℝ) (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (sfp β i) (∑ j, sfH β i j x • PR j) x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : ι → ℝ => Real.exp (β * y i))
      ((β * Real.exp (β * x i)) • PR i) x := by
    have h := (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) i).hasFDerivAt
      (x := x)).const_mul β).exp
    exact h.congr_fderiv (by rw [smul_smul, mul_comm]; rfl)
  have h2 := (hasDerivAt_inv (sfS_pos β x).ne').comp_hasFDerivAt x (sfS_hasFDerivAt β x)
  have h := h1.mul h2
  have e : (sfp β i : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) = fun y => Real.exp (β * y i) * ((fun z => z⁻¹) ∘ sfS β) y := by
    funext y; simp [sfp, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [e]
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  ext v
  have hS := (sfS_pos β x).ne'
  set S := sfS β x with hSdef
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, FunLike.coe_smul,
    Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul, sfH, sfp,
    add_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, ← hSdef]
  have e2 : ∑ j, β * (Real.exp (β * x i) / S * (Real.exp (β * x j) / S)) * v j
      = Real.exp (β * x i) * (S ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ t, β * Real.exp (β * x t) * v t := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    field_simp
  rw [e2]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.sfF_ge_max
statement:
private theorem sfF_ge_max [Nonempty ι] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    (⨆ t, x t) ≤ sfF β x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := x)
  rw [← ht0, sfF, le_div_iff₀ hβ]
  have h1 : Real.exp (β * x t0) ≤ sfS β x :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => Real.exp (β * x t)) (fun t _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
      (Finset.mem_univ t0)
  have h2 := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h1
  rw [Real.log_exp] at h2
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sfF_le_max
statement:
private theorem sfF_le_max [Nonempty ι] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    sfF β x ≤ (⨆ t, x t) + Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β
proof:
:= by
  set M := ⨆ t, x t
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range x) := (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  have h1 : sfS β x ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.exp (β * M) := by
    have : sfS β x ≤ ∑ _t : ι, Real.exp (β * M) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => Real.exp_le_exp.2
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_ciSup hb t) hβ.le)
    simpa using this
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
