  have h2 := Real.log_le_log (sfS_pos β x) h1
  rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp] at h2
  rw [sfF, div_le_iff₀ hβ, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hβ.ne']
  linarith

name: NLAlib.abs_iSup_le_sum
statement: private theorem abs_iSup_le_sum [Nonempty ι] (x : ι → ℝ) : |⨆ t, x t| ≤ ∑ t, |x t|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := x)
  rw [← ht0]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => |x t|) (fun t _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ t0)

name: NLAlib.abs_sfF_le
statement:
private theorem abs_sfF_le [Nonempty ι] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    |sfF β x| ≤ ∑ t, |x t| + Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sfF_ge_max hβ x
  have h2 := sfF_le_max hβ x
  have h3 := abs_iSup_le_sum x
  have hc : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have h4 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β := div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hc) hβ.le
  rw [abs_le] at h3 ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith [h3.1, h3.2]

name: NLAlib.sf_quad_nonneg
statement:
private theorem sf_quad_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hs : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (Δ : ι → ι → ℝ) (h : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * ((if i = j then p i else 0) - p i * p j)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ∀ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * ((if i = j then p i else 0) - p i * p j)
      = ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ i i - Δ i j) := by
    intro i
    simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have : ∑ j, p i * p j * Δ i i = Δ i i * p i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hs]; ring
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  simp_rw [e1]
  have e2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ i i - Δ i j) = ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ j j - Δ j i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  have h3 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hp i) (hp j)) (h i j)
  have e3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ i i - Δ i j) + ∑ i, ∑ j, p i * p j * (Δ j j - Δ j i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  rw [e3, ← e2] at h3
  linarith

name: NLAlib.sfF_continuous
statement:
private theorem sfF_continuous {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (sfF (ι := ι) β)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (sfF_hasFDerivAt β hβ x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.sfp_continuous
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (sfp_hasFDerivAt β i x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.sfH_continuous
proof:
:= by
  unfold sfH
  by_cases h : i = j
  · simp only [h, if_true]
    exact continuous_const.mul ((sfp_continuous β j).sub
      ((sfp_continuous β j).mul (sfp_continuous β j)))
  · simp only [h, if_false]
    exact continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub
      ((sfp_continuous β i).mul (sfp_continuous β j)))

name: NLAlib.sfH_abs_le
statement:
private theorem sfH_abs_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (i j : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) : |sfH β i j x| ≤ 1 + 2 * β
proof:
:= by
  unfold sfH
  have h1 := sfp_nonneg β i x
  have h2 := sfp_le_one β i x
  have h3 := sfp_nonneg β j x
  have h4 := sfp_le_one β j x
  have h5 : 0 ≤ sfp β i x * sfp β j x := mul_nonneg h1 h3
  have h6 : sfp β i x * sfp β j x ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ h2 h3 h4
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hβ]
  have : |(if i = j then sfp β i x else 0) - sfp β i x * sfp β j x| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sf_softmax_compare
statement:
private theorem sf_softmax_compare (X Y : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hXY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (fun t => X t ω, fun t => Y t ω)) P)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, X s ω * Y t ω ∂P = 0)
    (hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (X s ω - X t ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y s ω - Y t ω) ^ 2 ∂P)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    ∫ ω, sfF β (fun t => X t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, sfF β (fun t => Y t ω) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hXm : ∀ t, MemLp (X t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.fst.eval t).memLp_two
  have hYm : ∀ t, MemLp (Y t) 2 P := fun t => (hXY.snd.eval t).memLp_two
  
  set Δ : ι → ι → ℝ := fun i j => ∫ ω, Y i ω * Y j ω ∂P - ∫ ω, X i ω * X j ω ∂P with hΔdef
  have hΔ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i := by
    intro i j
    have h1 := hinc i j
    rw [integral_sub_sq_eq X hXm i j, integral_sub_sq_eq Y hYm i j] at h1
    simp only [hΔdef]
    linarith
  refine integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg X Y hXY hX0 hY0 hcross (sfF β)
    (sfp β) (sfH β) (sfF_hasFDerivAt β hβ.ne') (sfp_hasFDerivAt β) (sfH_continuous β) (1 + 2 * β)
    (fun i x => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sfp_nonneg β i x)]; linarith [sfp_le_one β i x])
    (fun i j x => sfH_abs_le hβ i j x) (Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β) (abs_sfF_le hβ)
    (fun x => ?_)
  have e3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * sfH β i j x
      = β * ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * ((if i = j then sfp β i x else 0) - sfp β i x * sfp β j x) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    unfold sfH; ring
  rw [e3]
  exact mul_nonneg hβ.le (sf_quad_nonneg (fun i => sfp β i x) (sfp_sum β x)
    (fun i => sfp_nonneg β i x) Δ hΔ)

name: NLAlib.sudakov_fernique_inequality
statement:
theorem sudakov_fernique_inequality {ι Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω']
    {P : Measure Ω} {Q : Measure Ω'} (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (Y : ι → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => X t ω) P) (hY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => Y t ω) Q)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂Q = 0)
    (hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (X s ω - X t ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y s ω - Y t ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) :
    ∫ ω, (⨆ t, X t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (⨆ t, Y t ω) ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · simp
  classical
  have hP := hX.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hQ := hY.isProbabilityMeasure
  set μX := P.map (fun ω t => X t ω) with hμX
  set μY := Q.map (fun ω t => Y t ω) with hμY
  have : IsGaussian μX := hX.isGaussian_map
  have : IsGaussian μY := hY.isGaussian_map
  set μ := μX.prod μY with hμ
  have hlaw : HasGaussianLaw (fun p : (ι → ℝ) × (ι → ℝ) => (fun t => p.1 t, fun t => p.2 t)) μ :=
    IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id
  have hfst : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun t => X t ω) ∂P := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.fst) :=
      (integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_fst_prod, measure_univ, one_smul, hμX,
      integral_map hX.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hsnd : ∀ f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun t => Y t ω) ∂Q := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.snd) :=
      (integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_snd_prod, measure_univ, one_smul, hμY,
      integral_map hY.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hX0' : ∀ t, ∫ p, p.1 t ∂μ = 0 := fun t => by
    rw [hfst (fun x => x t) (measurable_pi_apply t)]; exact hX0 t
  have hY0' : ∀ t, ∫ p, p.2 t ∂μ = 0 := fun t => by
    rw [hsnd (fun x => x t) (measurable_pi_apply t)]; exact hY0 t
  have hcross : ∀ s t, ∫ p, p.1 s * p.2 t ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro s t
    rw [hμ, integral_prod_mul (fun x : ι → ℝ => x s) (fun y : ι → ℝ => y t)]
    have : ∫ x, x s ∂μX = 0 := by
      rw [hμX, integral_map hX.aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply s).aestronglyMeasurable]
      exact hX0 s
    rw [this, zero_mul]
  have hinc' : ∀ s t, ∫ p, (p.1 s - p.1 t) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ ∫ p, (p.2 s - p.2 t) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    intro s t
    rw [hfst (fun x => (x s - x t) ^ 2) (by fun_prop),
      hsnd (fun x => (x s - x t) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)]
    exact hinc s t
  have hXi : ∀ t, Integrable (X t) P := fun t => (hX.eval t).integrable
  have hYi : ∀ t, Integrable (Y t) Q := fun t => (hY.eval t).integrable
  have hsup : Measurable (fun x : ι → ℝ => ⨆ t, x t) :=
    Measurable.iSup fun t => measurable_pi_apply t
  have hIX : Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ t, X t ω) P :=
    integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs X hXi _ hsup hX.aemeasurable 0
      (fun x => by rw [add_zero]; exact abs_iSup_le_sum x)
  have hIY : Integrable (fun ω => ⨆ t, Y t ω) Q :=
    integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs Y hYi _ hsup hY.aemeasurable 0
      (fun x => by rw [add_zero]; exact abs_iSup_le_sum x)
  have key : ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∫ ω, (⨆ t, X t ω) ∂P
      ≤ ∫ ω, (⨆ t, Y t ω) ∂Q + Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β := by
    intro β hβ
    have hc := sf_softmax_compare (P := μ) (fun t p => p.1 t) (fun t p => p.2 t) hlaw hX0' hY0'
      hcross hinc' hβ
    rw [hfst (sfF β) (sfF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable,
      hsnd (sfF β) (sfF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable] at hc
    have hFX : Integrable (fun ω => sfF β (fun t => X t ω)) P :=
      integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs X hXi _ (sfF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable hX.aemeasurable _
        (abs_sfF_le hβ)
    have hFY : Integrable (fun ω => sfF β (fun t => Y t ω)) Q :=
      integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs Y hYi _ (sfF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable hY.aemeasurable _
        (abs_sfF_le hβ)
    have h1 : ∫ ω, (⨆ t, X t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, sfF β (fun t => X t ω) ∂P :=
      integral_mono hIX hFX fun ω => sfF_ge_max hβ _
    have h2 : ∫ ω, sfF β (fun t => Y t ω) ∂Q
        ≤ ∫ ω, ((⨆ t, Y t ω) + Real.log (Fintype.card ι) / β) ∂Q :=
      integral_mono hFY (hIY.add (integrable_const _)) fun ω => sfF_le_max hβ _
    rw [integral_add hIY (integrable_const _), integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at h2
    linarith
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
  set Lg := Real.log (Fintype.card ι)
  have hLg : 0 ≤ Lg := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  have hβ : 0 < (Lg + 1) / ε := div_pos (by linarith) hε
  refine (key _ hβ).trans ?_
  gcongr
  rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.memLp_id_map_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem memLp_id_map_matrixRealCoordinates
    (ν : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {p : ENNReal}
    (hν : MemLp (id : M → M) p ν) :
    MemLp (id : E → E) p (ν.map matrixRealCoordinates)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : MemLp (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A) p ν := by
    simpa [matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv, Function.comp_def] using
      (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp_memLp' hν
  exact (memLp_map_measure_iff (f := (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E))
    (g := (id : E → E)) aestronglyMeasurable_id
      (measurable_matrixRealCoordinates (m := n) (n := n)).aemeasurable).mpr hm

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_pi
statement:
theorem hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_pi
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (fun x : ι → M => fun i => matrixRealCoordinates (x i))
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun i =>
    (measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)))).aemeasurable, ?_⟩
  exact Measure.pi_map_pi (fun i =>
    measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable)

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_pi
statement:
theorem hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_pi
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    HasLaw (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i))
      ((Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates).map
        (fun x : ι → E => ∑ i, x i)) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : HasLaw (fun x : ι → E => ∑ i, x i)
      ((Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates).map
        (fun x : ι → E => ∑ i, x i))
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) := ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, map_sum] using hs.comp (hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_pi ν)

name: NLAlib.ae_isHermitian_sum_pi
statement:
theorem ae_isHermitian_sum_pi
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian) :
    ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, (∑ i, x i).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ᵐ x : ι → M ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, (x i).IsHermitian :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => (measurePreserving_eval ν i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hν i))
  filter_upwards [hh] with x hx
  exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun i _ => hx i)

name: NLAlib.map_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_map_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem map_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_map_matrixRealCoordinates
    (ν : Measure M) (hν : ∀ᵐ A ∂ν, A.IsHermitian) :
    (ν.map matrixRealCoordinates).map hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates = ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.map_map hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates.continuous.measurable
    measurable_matrixRealCoordinates]
  calc
    _ = ν.map id := Measure.map_congr (hν.mono fun A hA =>
      hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA)
    _ = ν := Measure.map_id

name: NLAlib.matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_matrixRealCoordinates_reconstruct
statement:
theorem matrixDifferenceThirdMoment_map_matrixRealCoordinates_reconstruct
    (ν : ι → Measure M) (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian) :
    matrixDifferenceThirdMoment (fun i =>
      ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates).map hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates) =
      matrixDifferenceThirdMoment ν
proof:
:= by
  have he : (fun i => ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates).map
      hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates) = ν := by
    funext i
    exact map_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_map_matrixRealCoordinates (ν i) (hν i)
  rw [he]

name: NLAlib.identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum
statement:
theorem identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] :
    IdentDistrib (resamplingTripleOriginal :
      ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) → E)
      (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i))
      (resamplingTripleMeasure fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  haveI (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  have ht := hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
  have hs := hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_pi ν
  exact ⟨ht.aemeasurable, hs.aemeasurable, ht.map_eq.trans hs.map_eq.symm⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i)) :
    (∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure
        (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)) =
      matrixRealCoordinates (∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => x i) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    integrable_eval (μ := ν) (i := i) ((hν i).integrable (by norm_num))
  have hs : Integrable (fun x : ι → M => ∑ i, x i) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    simpa using integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)
  exact (identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum ν).integral_eq.trans
    ((matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm hs)

name: NLAlib.covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem covariance_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)] (a b : J) :
    cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p a),
        (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal p b);
        resamplingTripleMeasure (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)] =
      cov[(fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) a),
        (fun x : ι → M => matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i) b); Measure.pi ν]
proof:
:= by
  haveI (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  have ht := hasLaw_resamplingTripleOriginal (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
  have hs := hasLaw_matrixRealCoordinates_sum_pi ν
  exact (ht.covariance_fun_comp (measurable_pi_apply a).aemeasurable
    (measurable_pi_apply b).aemeasurable).trans
      (hs.covariance_fun_comp (measurable_pi_apply a).aemeasurable
        (measurable_pi_apply b).aemeasurable).symm

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf.fun_mul hh).congr_fderiv ?_
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_smul]

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_inv
proof:
:= by
  refine ((hasDerivAt_inv hx).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf).congr_fderiv ?_
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_log
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf.log hx).congr_fderiv ?_
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_const_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine (hf.const_mul r).congr_fderiv ?_
  simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_sum
proof:
:= by
  have h := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun k _ => hf k)
  have e : (fun y => ∑ k, f k y) = ∑ k, f k := by funext y; simp
  rw [e]
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_smul]

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_exp
proof:
:= by
  have h := (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) a).hasFDerivAt
    (x := x)).const_mul β).exp
  refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
  simp only [ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.gmmS_pos
statement: private theorem gmmS_pos [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (u : U) (x : U × T → ℝ) : 0 < gmmS β u x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: NLAlib.gmmW_pos
statement: private theorem gmmW_pos [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (x : U × T → ℝ) : 0 < gmmW β x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun u _ => inv_pos.2 (gmmS_pos β u x)) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: NLAlib.gmm_exp_le_S
statement:
private theorem gmm_exp_le_S (β : ℝ) (u : U) (t : T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    Real.exp (β * x (u, t)) ≤ gmmS β u x
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun t => Real.exp (β * x (u, t))) (fun _ _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (Finset.mem_univ t)

name: NLAlib.gmm_Sinv_le_W
statement:
private theorem gmm_Sinv_le_W [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (u : U) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    (gmmS β u x)⁻¹ ≤ gmmW β x
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun u => (gmmS β u x)⁻¹)
    (fun v _ => (inv_pos.2 (gmmS_pos β v x)).le) (Finset.mem_univ u)

name: NLAlib.gmmg_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gmmg_nonneg [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ gmmg β a x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmg
  have := gmmS_pos β a.1 x
  have := gmmW_pos β x
  positivity

name: NLAlib.gmmg_sum
statement:
private theorem gmmg_sum [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, gmmg β a x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hW := (gmmW_pos β x).ne'
  have h : ∀ u, ∑ t, gmmg β (u, t) x = (gmmS β u x)⁻¹ * (gmmW β x)⁻¹ := by
    intro u
    have hS := (gmmS_pos β u x).ne'
    simp only [gmmg]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    change gmmS β u x * _ * _ = _
    field_simp
  simp_rw [h]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  change gmmW β x * _ = _
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.gmmg_le_one
statement:
private theorem gmmg_le_one [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    gmmg β a x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gmmg_sum β x]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun b _ => gmmg_nonneg β b x) (Finset.mem_univ a)

name: NLAlib.gmmq_nonneg
statement: private theorem gmmq_nonneg [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a b : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) : 0 ≤ gmmq β a b x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (gmmS_pos β a.1 x).le

name: NLAlib.gmmq_le_one
statement:
private theorem gmmq_le_one [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a b : U × T) (h : a.1 = b.1) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    gmmq β a b x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmq
  rw [div_le_one (gmmS_pos β a.1 x), h]
  exact gmm_exp_le_S β b.1 b.2 x

name: NLAlib.gmmg_le_q
statement:
private theorem gmmg_le_q [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a b : U × T) (h : a.1 = b.1)
    (x : U × T → ℝ) : gmmg β b x ≤ gmmq β a b x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmg gmmq
  rw [h]
  have hS := gmmS_pos β b.1 x
  have hW := gmmW_pos β x
  have h1 := gmm_Sinv_le_W β b.1 x
  have he := Real.exp_pos (β * x b)
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ he.le
  rw [show ((gmmS β b.1 x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (gmmW β x)⁻¹
      = (gmmS β b.1 x)⁻¹ * ((gmmS β b.1 x) * gmmW β x)⁻¹ by field_simp]
  refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (inv_pos.2 hS).le ?_
  rw [inv_le_one₀ (by positivity)]
  calc (1 : ℝ) = gmmS β b.1 x * (gmmS β b.1 x)⁻¹ := by field_simp
    _ ≤ gmmS β b.1 x * gmmW β x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hS.le

name: NLAlib.gmmH_symm
statement:
private theorem gmmH_symm [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a b : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    gmmH β a b x = gmmH β b a x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmH
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab; rfl
  rw [if_neg hab, if_neg (Ne.symm hab)]
  by_cases h1 : a.1 = b.1
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h1.symm]
    obtain ⟨u, t⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨v, s⟩ := b
    simp only at h1
    subst h1
    simp only [gmmg, gmmq]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (Ne.symm h1)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.gmmH_rowsum
statement:
private theorem gmmH_rowsum [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    ∑ b, gmmH β a b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmH
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, gmmg_sum, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ a)]
  have h : ∑ b : U × T, (if a.1 = b.1 then gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x else 0) = gmmg β a x := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_eq_single a.1]
    · simp only [if_true]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      have hS := (gmmS_pos β a.1 x).ne'
      have : ∑ s, gmmq β a (a.1, s) x = 1 := by
        simp only [gmmq]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        exact div_self hS
      rw [this, mul_one]
    · intro v _ hv
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => if_neg (Ne.symm hv)
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gmmH_abs_le
statement:
private theorem gmmH_abs_le [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (a b : U × T)
    (x : U × T → ℝ) : |gmmH β a b x| ≤ 4 * β
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmmH
  have g0 := gmmg_nonneg β a x
  have g1 := gmmg_le_one β a x
  have g0' := gmmg_nonneg β b x
  have g1' := gmmg_le_one β b x
  have hA : |(if a = b then gmmg β a x else 0)| ≤ 1 := by
    split_ifs
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg g0]; exact g1
    · simp
  have hB : |(if a.1 = b.1 then gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x else 0)| ≤ 1 := by
    split_ifs with h
    · have q0 := gmmq_nonneg β a b x
      have q1 := gmmq_le_one β a b h x
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg g0 q0)]
      exact mul_le_one₀ g1 q0 q1
    · simp
  have hC : |gmmg β a x * gmmg β b x| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg g0 g0')]
    exact mul_le_one₀ g1 g0' g1'
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hβ]
  have : |(if a = b then gmmg β a x else 0)
      - 2 * (if a.1 = b.1 then gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x else 0) + gmmg β a x * gmmg β b x|
      ≤ 4 := by
    set A := (if a = b then gmmg β a x else 0)
    set B := (if a.1 = b.1 then gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x else 0)
    set D := gmmg β a x * gmmg β b x
    have e1 := abs_add_le (A - 2 * B) D
    have e2 := abs_sub A (2 * B)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_two] at e2
    linarith
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gmm_coeff_sq
proof:
:= by
  have h := gmm_coeff_mul hf hf
  have e : (fun y => f y ^ 2) = fun y => f y * f y := by funext y; ring
  rw [e]
  refine h.congr_fderiv (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 1; ring

name: NLAlib.gmmS_hasFDerivAt
proof:
:= by
  have h := gmm_coeff_sum (ι := U × T) (κ := T) (fun t => gmm_coeff_exp β (u, t) x)
  refine h.congr_fderiv (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 1
  obtain ⟨v, s⟩ := b
  by_cases hv : v = u
  · subst hv; simp [Prod.ext_iff]
  · simp [Prod.ext_iff, hv]

name: NLAlib.gmmW_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem gmmW_hasFDerivAt [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (gmmW β) (∑ b, (-(β * gmmW β x * gmmg β b x)) • PR b) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := gmm_coeff_sum (κ := U)
    (fun u => gmm_coeff_inv (gmmS_hasFDerivAt β u x) (gmmS_pos β u x).ne')
  refine h.congr_fderiv (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 1
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hS := (gmmS_pos β b.1 x).ne'
  have hW := (gmmW_pos β x).ne'
  unfold gmmg
  generalize gmmW β x = W at hW ⊢
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.gmmF_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem gmmF_hasFDerivAt [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (gmmF β) (∑ b, gmmg β b x • PR b) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := gmm_coeff_const_mul
    (gmm_coeff_log (gmmW_hasFDerivAt β x) (gmmW_pos β x).ne') (-β⁻¹)
  refine h.congr_fderiv (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 1
  have hW := (gmmW_pos β x).ne'
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.gmmg_hasFDerivAt
statement:
private theorem gmmg_hasFDerivAt [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (gmmg β a) (∑ b, gmmH β a b x • PR b) x
proof:
:= by
  have hS := (gmmS_pos β a.1 x).ne'
  have hW := (gmmW_pos β x).ne'
  have h := gmm_coeff_mul (gmm_coeff_mul (gmm_coeff_exp β a x)
    (gmm_coeff_inv (gmm_coeff_sq (gmmS_hasFDerivAt β a.1 x)) (pow_ne_zero 2 hS)))
    (gmm_coeff_inv (gmmW_hasFDerivAt β x) hW)
  have e : gmmg β a = fun y : U × T → ℝ =>
      Real.exp (β * y a) * ((gmmS β a.1 y) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (gmmW β y)⁻¹ := by funext y; rfl
  rw [e]
  refine h.congr_fderiv (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
  congr 1
  unfold gmmH
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab
    simp only [if_true]
    unfold gmmg gmmq
    field_simp
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hab, if_neg (Ne.symm hab)]
    by_cases h1 : a.1 = b.1
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h1.symm]
      obtain ⟨u, t⟩ := a
      obtain ⟨v, s⟩ := b
      simp only at h1
      subst h1
      simp only [gmmg, gmmq]
      field_simp
      ring
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg (Ne.symm h1)]
      simp only [gmmg]
      field_simp
      ring

name: NLAlib.gmmg_continuous
statement:
private theorem gmmg_continuous [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a : U × T) :
    Continuous (gmmg (T := T) β a)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (gmmg_hasFDerivAt β a x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.gmmF_continuous
statement:
private theorem gmmF_continuous [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (gmmF (U := U) (T := T) β)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (gmmF_hasFDerivAt hβ x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.gmmS_continuous
statement: private theorem gmmS_continuous (β : ℝ) (u : U) : Continuous (gmmS (T := T) β u)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (gmmS_hasFDerivAt β u x).continuousAt

name: NLAlib.gmmH_continuous
statement:
private theorem gmmH_continuous [Nonempty U] [Nonempty T] (β : ℝ) (a b : U × T) :
    Continuous (gmmH β a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Continuous (gmmq (T := T) β a b) := by
    unfold gmmq
    exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (gmmS_continuous β a.1)
      (fun x => (gmmS_pos β a.1 x).ne')
  have hg := gmmg_continuous (T := T) β a
  have hg' := gmmg_continuous (T := T) β b
  unfold gmmH
  split_ifs
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((hg.sub (continuous_const.mul (hg.mul hq))).add (hg.mul hg'))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((hg.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_const)).add
      (hg.mul hg'))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul (hg.mul hq))).add
      (hg.mul hg'))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul
      continuous_const)).add (hg.mul hg'))

name: NLAlib.gmm_quad_of_rowsum
statement:
private theorem gmm_quad_of_rowsum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (H Δ : ι → ι → ℝ)
    (hsym : ∀ i j, H i j = H j i) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, H i j = 0) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * H i j
      = -(1 / 2) * ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * (Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * (Δ i i + Δ j j - Δ i j - Δ j i)
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ i i + ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ j j
        - ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ i j - ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ j i := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have e2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ i i = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hrow, zero_mul]
  have e3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ j j = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, show ∑ i, H i j = ∑ i, H j i from
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hsym i j, hrow, zero_mul]
  have e4 : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ j i = ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * H i j := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hsym]; ring
  have e5 : ∑ i, ∑ j, H i j * Δ i j = ∑ i, ∑ j, Δ i j * H i j :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_comm _ _
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, e5]
  ring

name: NLAlib.gmm_hess_nonneg
statement:
private theorem gmm_hess_nonneg {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : U × T → ℝ) (Δ : U × T → U × T → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ a b : U × T, a.1 = b.1 → 0 ≤ Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a)
    (hd : ∀ a b : U × T, a.1 ≠ b.1 → Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a ≤ 0) :
    0 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, Δ a b * gmmH β a b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmm_quad_of_rowsum (fun a b => gmmH β a b x) Δ (fun a b => gmmH_symm β a b x)
    (fun a => gmmH_rowsum β a x)]
  have : ∑ a, ∑ b, gmmH β a b x * (Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a) ≤ 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_nonpos fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonpos fun b _ => ?_
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab
      have : Δ a a + Δ a a - Δ a a - Δ a a = 0 := by ring
      rw [this, mul_zero]
    by_cases h1 : a.1 = b.1
    · have hH : gmmH β a b x ≤ 0 := by
        unfold gmmH
        rw [if_neg hab, if_pos h1]
        have g0 := gmmg_nonneg β a x
        have hq := gmmg_le_q β a b h1 x
        have q0 := gmmq_nonneg β a b x
        have : gmmg β a x * gmmg β b x ≤ gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq g0
        have : 0 ≤ gmmg β a x * gmmq β a b x := mul_nonneg g0 q0
        nlinarith
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hH (hs a b h1)
    · have hH : 0 ≤ gmmH β a b x := by
        unfold gmmH
        rw [if_neg hab, if_neg h1]
        have := mul_nonneg (gmmg_nonneg β a x) (gmmg_nonneg β b x)
        nlinarith
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hH (hd a b h1)
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.gmmS_le_card
statement:
private theorem gmmS_le_card {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (u : U) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    gmmS β u x ≤ (Fintype.card T : ℝ) * Real.exp (β * ⨆ t, x (u, t))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun t => x (u, t)) := (Set.finite_range _).bddAbove
  have : gmmS β u x ≤ ∑ _t : T, Real.exp (β * ⨆ t, x (u, t)) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => Real.exp_le_exp.2
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_ciSup hb t) hβ.le)
  simpa using this

name: NLAlib.gmmS_ge_max
statement:
private theorem gmmS_ge_max (β : ℝ) (u : U) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    Real.exp (β * ⨆ t, x (u, t)) ≤ gmmS β u x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun t => x (u, t))
  rw [← ht0]
  exact gmm_exp_le_S β u t0 x

name: NLAlib.gmmF_ge
statement:
private theorem gmmF_ge {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    (⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t)) - Real.log (Fintype.card U) / β ≤ gmmF β x
proof:
:= by
  set m := ⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t) with hm
  have hmu : ∀ u, m ≤ ⨆ t, x (u, t) := fun u => ciInf_le (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow u
  have hW : gmmW β x ≤ (Fintype.card U : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(β * m)) := by
    have : gmmW β x ≤ ∑ _u : U, Real.exp (-(β * m)) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_
      calc (gmmS β u x)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp (β * ⨆ t, x (u, t)))⁻¹ :=
            inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) (gmmS_ge_max β u x)
        _ = Real.exp (-(β * ⨆ t, x (u, t))) := (Real.exp_neg _).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-(β * m)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by nlinarith [hmu u])
    simpa using this
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card U := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hl := Real.log_le_log (gmmW_pos β x) hW
  rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp] at hl
  have h2 : β⁻¹ * Real.log (gmmW β x) ≤ β⁻¹ * (Real.log (Fintype.card U) + -(β * m)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (inv_nonneg.2 hβ.le)
  have e : β⁻¹ * (Real.log (Fintype.card U) + -(β * m)) = Real.log (Fintype.card U) / β - m := by
    field_simp
    ring
  unfold gmmF
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gmmF_le
statement:
private theorem gmmF_le {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    gmmF β x ≤ (⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t)) + Real.log (Fintype.card T) / β
proof:
:= by
  set m := ⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t) with hm
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ := exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite (f := fun u => ⨆ t, x (u, t))
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card T := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hW : ((Fintype.card T : ℝ) * Real.exp (β * m))⁻¹ ≤ gmmW β x := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (gmm_Sinv_le_W β u0 x)
    refine inv_anti₀ (gmmS_pos β u0 x) ?_
    rw [hm, ← hu0]
    exact gmmS_le_card hβ u0 x
  have hl := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hW
  rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_mul hc.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp] at hl
  have h2 : β⁻¹ * (-(Real.log (Fintype.card T) + β * m)) ≤ β⁻¹ * Real.log (gmmW β x) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (inv_nonneg.2 hβ.le)
  have e : β⁻¹ * (-(Real.log (Fintype.card T) + β * m)) = -(Real.log (Fintype.card T) / β + m) := by
    field_simp
  unfold gmmF
  linarith

name: NLAlib.gmm_abs_minmax_le
statement: private theorem gmm_abs_minmax_le (x : U × T → ℝ) : |⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t)| ≤ ∑ a, |x a|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ := exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite (f := fun u => ⨆ t, x (u, t))
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_finite (f := fun t => x (u0, t))
  rw [← hu0, ← ht0]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => |x a|) (fun a _ => abs_nonneg _)
    (Finset.mem_univ (u0, t0))

name: NLAlib.gmmF_abs_le
statement:
private theorem gmmF_abs_le {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (x : U × T → ℝ) :
    |gmmF β x| ≤ ∑ a, |x a| + (Real.log (Fintype.card U) + Real.log (Fintype.card T)) / β
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := gmmF_ge hβ x
  have h2 := gmmF_le hβ x
  have h3 := gmm_abs_minmax_le x
  have hU : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card U) / β :=
    div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)) hβ.le
  have hT : 0 ≤ Real.log (Fintype.card T) / β :=
    div_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)) hβ.le
  rw [add_div]
  rw [abs_le] at h3 ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith [h3.1, h3.2]

name: NLAlib.gordon_minimax_inequality
statement:
theorem gordon_minimax_inequality {U T Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype U] [Fintype T] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω'] {P : Measure Ω} {Q : Measure Ω'}
    (X : U → T → Ω → ℝ) (Y : U → T → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω (p : U × T) => X p.1 p.2 ω) P)
    (hY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω (p : U × T) => Y p.1 p.2 ω) Q)
    (hX0 : ∀ u t, ∫ ω, X u t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ u t, ∫ ω, Y u t ω ∂Q = 0)
    (hsame : ∀ u t s,
      ∫ ω, (X u t ω - X u s ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (Y u t ω - Y u s ω) ^ 2 ∂Q)
    (hdiff : ∀ u v t s, u ≠ v →
      ∫ ω, (Y u t ω - Y v s ω) ^ 2 ∂Q ≤ ∫ ω, (X u t ω - X v s ω) ^ 2 ∂P) :
    ∫ ω, (⨅ u, ⨆ t, X u t ω) ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, (⨅ u, ⨆ t, Y u t ω) ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hU | hU
  · simp
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty T with hT | hT
  · simp
  classical
  have hP := hX.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hQ := hY.isProbabilityMeasure
  set μX := P.map (fun ω (p : U × T) => X p.1 p.2 ω) with hμX
  set μY := Q.map (fun ω (p : U × T) => Y p.1 p.2 ω) with hμY
  have : IsGaussian μX := hX.isGaussian_map
  have : IsGaussian μY := hY.isGaussian_map
  set μ := μX.prod μY with hμ
  have hlaw : HasGaussianLaw
      (fun p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ) => (fun a => p.1 a, fun a => p.2 a)) μ :=
    IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id
  have hfst : ∀ f : (U × T → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω) ∂P := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.1 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.fst) :=
      (integral_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_fst_prod, measure_univ, one_smul, hμX,
      integral_map hX.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hsnd : ∀ f : (U × T → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable f →
      ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ ω, f (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω) ∂Q := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ∫ p, f p.2 ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂(μ.map Prod.snd) :=
      (integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h1, hμ, Measure.map_snd_prod, measure_univ, one_smul, hμY,
      integral_map hY.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable]
  have hX0' : ∀ a : U × T, ∫ p, p.1 a ∂μ = 0 := fun a => by
    rw [hfst (fun x => x a) (measurable_pi_apply a)]; exact hX0 a.1 a.2
  have hY0' : ∀ a : U × T, ∫ p, p.2 a ∂μ = 0 := fun a => by
    rw [hsnd (fun x => x a) (measurable_pi_apply a)]; exact hY0 a.1 a.2
  have hcross : ∀ a b : U × T, ∫ p, p.1 a * p.2 b ∂μ = 0 := by
    intro a b
    rw [hμ, integral_prod_mul (fun x : U × T → ℝ => x a) (fun y : U × T → ℝ => y b)]
    have : ∫ x, x a ∂μX = 0 := by
      rw [hμX, integral_map hX.aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply a).aestronglyMeasurable]
      exact hX0 a.1 a.2
    rw [this, zero_mul]
  have hXm : ∀ a : U × T, MemLp (fun p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ) => p.1 a) 2 μ :=
    fun a => (hlaw.fst.eval a).memLp_two
  have hYm : ∀ a : U × T, MemLp (fun p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ) => p.2 a) 2 μ :=
    fun a => (hlaw.snd.eval a).memLp_two
  set Δ : U × T → U × T → ℝ := fun a b =>
    ∫ p, p.2 a * p.2 b ∂μ - ∫ p, p.1 a * p.1 b ∂μ with hΔ
  have he : ∀ a b : U × T, Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a
      = ∫ ω, (Y a.1 a.2 ω - Y b.1 b.2 ω) ^ 2 ∂Q - ∫ ω, (X a.1 a.2 ω - X b.1 b.2 ω) ^ 2 ∂P := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := integral_sub_sq_eq (fun (a : U × T) (p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ)) => p.1 a) hXm a b
    have h2 := integral_sub_sq_eq (fun (a : U × T) (p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ)) => p.2 a) hYm a b
    rw [hfst (fun x => (x a - x b) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)] at h1
    rw [hsnd (fun x => (x a - x b) ^ 2) (by fun_prop)] at h2
    simp only at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2, hΔ]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ a b : U × T, a.1 = b.1 → 0 ≤ Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [he]
    obtain ⟨u, t⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨v, s⟩ := b
    simp only at hab ⊢
    subst hab
    linarith [hsame u t s]
  have hd : ∀ a b : U × T, a.1 ≠ b.1 → Δ a a + Δ b b - Δ a b - Δ b a ≤ 0 := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [he]
    linarith [hdiff a.1 b.1 a.2 b.2 hab]
  have hXi : ∀ a : U × T, Integrable (fun ω => X a.1 a.2 ω) P := fun a => (hX.eval a).integrable
  have hYi : ∀ a : U × T, Integrable (fun ω => Y a.1 a.2 ω) Q := fun a => (hY.eval a).integrable
  obtain ⟨mm, hmm⟩ : ∃ f : (U × T → ℝ) → ℝ, f = fun x => ⨅ u, ⨆ t, x (u, t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmmm : Measurable mm := by
    rw [hmm]
    exact Measurable.iInf fun u => Measurable.iSup fun t => measurable_pi_apply (u, t)
  have hmmb : ∀ x, |mm x| ≤ ∑ a, |x a| := fun x => by rw [hmm]; exact gmm_abs_minmax_le x
  have hIX : Integrable (fun ω => mm (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω)) P :=
    integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs (fun a ω => X a.1 a.2 ω) hXi mm hmmm hX.aemeasurable 0
      (fun x => by rw [add_zero]; exact hmmb x)
  have hIY : Integrable (fun ω => mm (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω)) Q :=
    integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs (fun a ω => Y a.1 a.2 ω) hYi mm hmmm hY.aemeasurable 0
      (fun x => by rw [add_zero]; exact hmmb x)
  set Lg := Real.log (Fintype.card U) + Real.log (Fintype.card T) with hLg
  have key : ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∫ ω, mm (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω) ∂P
      ≤ ∫ ω, mm (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω) ∂Q + Lg / β := by
    intro β hβ
    have hgb : ∀ (a : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ), |gmmg β a x| ≤ 1 + 4 * β := fun a x => by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (gmmg_nonneg β a x)]
      linarith [gmmg_le_one β a x]
    have hHb : ∀ (a b : U × T) (x : U × T → ℝ), |gmmH β a b x| ≤ 1 + 4 * β := fun a b x => by
      linarith [gmmH_abs_le hβ a b x]
    have hc := integral_le_integral_of_covariance_hessian_nonneg (P := μ)
      (fun (a : U × T) (p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ)) => p.1 a)
      (fun (a : U × T) (p : (U × T → ℝ) × (U × T → ℝ)) => p.2 a) hlaw hX0' hY0'
      hcross (gmmF β) (gmmg β) (gmmH β) (gmmF_hasFDerivAt hβ.ne') (gmmg_hasFDerivAt β)
      (gmmH_continuous β) (1 + 4 * β) hgb hHb _ (gmmF_abs_le hβ)
      (fun x => gmm_hess_nonneg hβ x Δ hs hd)
    rw [hfst (gmmF β) (gmmF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable,
      hsnd (gmmF β) (gmmF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable] at hc
    have hFX : Integrable (fun ω => gmmF β (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω)) P :=
      integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs (fun (a : U × T) ω => X a.1 a.2 ω) hXi (gmmF β)
        (gmmF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable hX.aemeasurable _ (gmmF_abs_le hβ)
    have hFY : Integrable (fun ω => gmmF β (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω)) Q :=
      integrable_comp_of_abs_le_sum_abs (fun (a : U × T) ω => Y a.1 a.2 ω) hYi (gmmF β)
        (gmmF_continuous hβ.ne').measurable hY.aemeasurable _ (gmmF_abs_le hβ)
    have h1 : ∫ ω, mm (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω) ∂P
        ≤ ∫ ω, (gmmF β (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω) + Real.log (Fintype.card U) / β) ∂P :=
      integral_mono hIX (hFX.add (integrable_const _)) fun ω => by
        have := gmmF_ge hβ (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω)
        rw [hmm]
        linarith
    have h2 : ∫ ω, gmmF β (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω) ∂Q
        ≤ ∫ ω, (mm (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω) + Real.log (Fintype.card T) / β) ∂Q :=
      integral_mono hFY (hIY.add (integrable_const _)) fun ω => by
        have := gmmF_le hβ (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω)
        rw [hmm]
        linarith
    rw [integral_add hIY (integrable_const _), integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at h2
    rw [integral_add hFX (integrable_const _), integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul] at h1
    have : Lg / β = Real.log (Fintype.card U) / β + Real.log (Fintype.card T) / β := by
      rw [hLg, add_div]
    linarith
  have eX : ∫ ω, (⨅ u, ⨆ t, X u t ω) ∂P = ∫ ω, mm (fun a => X a.1 a.2 ω) ∂P := by rw [hmm]
  have eY : ∫ ω, (⨅ u, ⨆ t, Y u t ω) ∂Q = ∫ ω, mm (fun a => Y a.1 a.2 ω) ∂Q := by rw [hmm]
  rw [eX, eY]
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ Lg := add_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos))
    (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos))
  have hβ : 0 < (Lg + 1) / ε := div_pos (by linarith) hε
  refine (key _ hβ).trans ?_
  gcongr
  rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.continuous_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment
statement:
theorem continuous_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    Continuous (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p))
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_resamplingInterpolation ν hν γ _
    (contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p (r := ⊤)).continuous
    ((|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p))
  intro x
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ ζ hp)]
  exact resolventEvenMoment_le_inv_abs_im_pow _
    (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates x)) hζ hp

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p) t =
      (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) t).re
proof:
:= by
  let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let Y : Q → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt t)
    (Real.sqrt (1 - t)) (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun x => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)
  have hY : Measurable Y := by
    unfold Y resamplingAffinePoint resamplingTripleOriginal
    fun_prop
  have hΦ : Continuous Φ :=
    (contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p (r := ⊤)).continuous
  have hi : Integrable (fun q => Φ (Y q)) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    Integrable.of_bound (hΦ.measurable.comp hY).aestronglyMeasurable _
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q =>
        norm_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p (Y q))
  change (∫ q, resolventEvenMoment (A + L (Y q)) ζ p
    ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) = (∫ q, Φ (Y q)
    ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ).re
  calc
    _ = ∫ q, (Φ (Y q)).re ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with q
      exact resolventEvenMoment_eq_re_normalizedTrace_mul_pow
        (hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (Y q))) ζ p
    _ = _ := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hi

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_pos
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_pos [Nonempty n]
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (t : ℝ) :
    0 < resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p) t
proof:
:= by
  let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let Y : Q → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ (Real.sqrt t)
    (Real.sqrt (1 - t)) (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  have hY : Measurable Y := by
    unfold Y resamplingAffinePoint resamplingTripleOriginal
    fun_prop
  change 0 < ∫ q, resolventEvenMoment (A + L (Y q)) ζ p
    ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  apply integral_resolventEvenMoment_pos ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ)
    (fun q => A + L (Y q))
  · exact (measurable_const.add ((L).continuous.measurable.comp hY)).aemeasurable
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q =>
      hA.add (isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (Y q))
  · exact hζ
  · exact hp

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolvent_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolvent_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) γ
      (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ) 1 =
      ∫ x : ι → M, resolvent (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  have hΦ : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ) :=
    continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ
  rw [resamplingInterpolation_one _ γ _ hΦ]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ι → M,
        hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ (matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν :=
      ((identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum ν).comp hΦ.measurable).integral_eq
    _ = _ := integral_congr_ae ((ae_isHermitian_sum_pi ν hν).mono fun x hx => by
      dsimp only [hermitianCoordinateResolvent]
      rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hx])

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolvent_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolvent_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i))
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
      (centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ) 0 =
      ∫ A : M, resolvent A ζ ∂ρ
proof:
:= by
  have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
    (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
  have := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
  have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hΦ : Continuous (hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ) :=
    continuous_hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ
  let m : E := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure
    (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
  have hm : m + matrixRealCoordinates A₀ = ∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ := by
    calc
      _ = matrixRealCoordinates ((∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν) + A₀) := by
        dsimp [m]
        rw [integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν hν, map_add]
      _ = matrixRealCoordinates (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) := by rw [hmean, add_comm A₀]
      _ = _ := ((matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv
        (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm
          (integrable_id_of_hasGaussianLaw_matrixRealCoordinates ρ hρ)).symm
  rw [resamplingInterpolation_zero _ _ _ hΦ]
  change (∫ z : E, hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ (m + z)
    ∂centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) = _
  have hshift : Continuous (fun z : E => hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ (m + z)) :=
    hΦ.comp (by fun_prop)
  have ht := (hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates ρ).integral_comp hshift.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← ht]
  apply integral_congr_ae (hHerm.mono fun A hA => ?_)
  change hermitianCoordinateResolvent A₀ ζ
    (m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ)) = _
  have he : m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) =
      matrixRealCoordinates A - matrixRealCoordinates A₀ := by rw [← hm]; abel
  rw [he]
  dsimp only [hermitianCoordinateResolvent]
  rw [map_sub, hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA,
    hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA₀]
  congr 1
  abel

name: NLAlib.memLp_original_square_mass
statement:
private theorem memLp_original_square_mass
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    {R : ℝ} (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (q : ℝ≥0∞) :
    MemLp (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2)) q (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi ν, ∀ i, specNorm (L (x i)) ≤ R := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    have hi := (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => specNorm (L x) ≤ R) hi.aemeasurable
    rw [hi.map_eq]
    exact hBound i
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2)) := by
    simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
    fun_prop
  apply MemLp.of_bound hc.aestronglyMeasurable ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * R ^ 2)
  filter_upwards [hAll] with x hx
  simp only [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_norm] at hx ⊢
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖L (x i) ^ 2‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, R ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖L (x i)‖ ^ 2 := by simpa only [pow_two] using norm_mul_le (L (x i)) (L (x i))
        _ ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hx i) 2
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_and_abs_deriv_le
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_and_abs_deriv_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun q : ι × C => resamplingTripleOriginal q i),
          (fun q : ι × C => resamplingTripleOriginal q j); resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hsmall : 16 * (p : ℝ) * R ≤ |ζ.im|)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let F
proof:
:= resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p)
    let B := lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2))
      (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν)
    HasDerivAt F (deriv F t) t ∧
      |deriv F t| ≤ 9 * Real.sqrt t * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B *
          (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * F t ^ (((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)) := by
  let := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let P₀ := Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1
  let P := P₀.prod γ
  let Qm := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  let drop : Q → C × E := fun q => (q.1.2, q.2)
  let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
  let x₀ : C × E → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (∑ j, q.1 (j, 0)) q.2
  let z : Q → Fin 3 → ι → E := fun q s i => q.1.2 (i, s)
  let T : (C × E) → ι → ℂ := fun q i => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
    (x₀ q - a • (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1)))
    (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1)) (q.1 (i, 1) - q.1 (i, 2))
  let K : Q → ℂ := fun q => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
    (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2)
    (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
    (resamplingTripleFirst q.1 - resamplingTripleSecond q.1)
  let F := resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p)
  let B := lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2))
    (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν)
  let c : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let α : ℝ := ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * p : ℕ)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := Real.sqrt_nonneg t
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [a]; exact Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr ht1.le
  have hdrop : MeasurePreserving drop Qm P := by
    exact (measurePreserving_snd (μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) (ν := P)).comp
      (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure P₀ γ)
  have hx₀m : Measurable x₀ := by
    unfold x₀ resamplingAffinePoint
    fun_prop
  have hzm : Measurable z := by unfold z; fun_prop
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ q ∂Qm, ∀ s i, specNorm (L (z q s i)) ≤ R := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro s
    have hs := hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy ν γ s
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : ι → E => ∀ i, specNorm (L (x i)) ≤ R) hs.aemeasurable
    rw [hs.map_eq, ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    have hi := (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => specNorm (L x) ≤ R) hi.aemeasurable
    rw [hi.map_eq]
    exact hBound i
  have hOriginalMass := memLp_original_square_mass ν hBound (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞))
  have hq : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hp' : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (p : ℝ≥0∞) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hp)
    calc
      1 ≤ (p : ℝ≥0∞) := hp'
      _ ≤ 2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞) := le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  have hMass := memLp_and_lpNorm_two_mul_sum_resamplingTriple_prod_copy_sq_le
    ν γ L hq hOriginalMass
  have hExpected := integrable_and_norm_integral_sum_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_first_copy_le
    Qm A hA ζ hζ hp (x₀ ∘ drop) (hx₀m.comp hdrop.measurable).aemeasurable
    z hzm.aemeasurable hR hAll ha ha1 hsmall hMass.1
  have hK (q : Q) : K q = T (drop q) q.1.1 := by
    have hY : resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2 =
        x₀ (drop q) - a • (q.1.2 (q.1.1, 0) - q.1.2 (q.1.1, 1)) := by
      have hDiff := resamplingTriple_difference q.1
      dsimp only [x₀, drop, resamplingTripleOriginal, resamplingAffinePoint] at hDiff ⊢
      rw [← hDiff]
      simp only [smul_sub]
      abel
    simp only [K, T, hY, drop, resamplingTriple_difference, resamplingTriple_first_sub_second]
  obtain ⟨hKi, hd⟩ := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_cubicKernel
    ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov hR hBound A hA ζ hζ p ht ht1
  change Integrable K Qm at hKi
  have hAverage : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) • (∫ q, K q ∂Qm) =
      ∫ q : C × E, ∑ i, T q i ∂P := by
    have hEq : K = fun q => T (drop q) q.1.1 := funext hK
    rw [hEq] at hKi ⊢
    exact card_smul_integral_uniform_prod_prod P₀ γ (fun i x z => T (x, z) i) hKi
  have hDropIntegral : (∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm) =
      ∫ q : C × E, ∑ i, T q i ∂P := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ q : ι × (C × E), ∑ i, T q.2 i
          ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure.prod P :=
        (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure P₀ γ).integral_comp'
          (fun q : ι × (C × E) => ∑ i, T q.2 i)
      _ = _ := by
        simpa only [probReal_univ, one_smul] using
          (integral_fun_snd (μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) (ν := P)
            (fun q : C × E => ∑ i, T q i))
  have hF : (∫ q : Q, resolventEvenMoment (A + L (x₀ (drop q))) ζ p ∂Qm) = F t := rfl
  have hFnn : 0 ≤ F t := by
    dsimp only [F, resamplingInterpolation]
    exact integral_nonneg fun q => resolventEvenMoment_nonneg _ ζ hp
  have hBudget : ‖∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm‖ ≤
      c * 3 * (2 * R) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * (6 * B) * F t ^ α := by
    have he := hExpected.2
    change ‖∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm‖ ≤
      c * 3 * (2 * R) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * _ *
        (∫ q : Q, resolventEvenMoment (A + L (x₀ (drop q))) ζ p ∂Qm) ^ α at he
    rw [hF] at he
    refine he.trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMass.2 (by dsimp only [c]; positivity))
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hFnn α)
  let d : ℂ := (a / 4) • ∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm
  have hDerivative : HasDerivAt
      (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p))) d t := by
    apply hd.congr_deriv
    change ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * a / 4) • (∫ q, K q ∂Qm) = d
    dsimp only [d]
    have heq : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) • (∫ q, K q ∂Qm) =
        ∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm := hAverage.trans hDropIntegral.symm
    calc
      _ = (a / 4) • ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) • (∫ q, K q ∂Qm)) := by
        rw [smul_smul]
        congr 1
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [heq]
  have hReal : HasDerivAt F d.re t := by
    have hr := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hDerivative
    have hEq : F = fun s => (resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => normalizedTrace
        (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)) s).re := by
      funext s
      exact resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_eq_re ν γ A hA hζ p s
    rw [hEq]
    exact hr
  refine ⟨hReal.congr_deriv hReal.deriv.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [hReal.deriv]
  calc
    |d.re| ≤ ‖d‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm d
    _ = (a / 4) * ‖∫ q : Q, ∑ i, T (drop q) i ∂Qm‖ := by
      dsimp only [d]
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    _ ≤ (a / 4) * (c * 3 * (2 * R) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * (6 * B) * F t ^ α) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBudget (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by dsimp only [a, c, α]; ring

name: NLAlib.continuous_resamplingInterpolation
statement:
theorem continuous_resamplingInterpolation
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → K) (hΦc : Continuous Φ) (CΦ : ℝ) (hΦb : ∀ y, ‖Φ y‖ ≤ CΦ) :
    Continuous (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  have hX := ((memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hXc := hX.sub (integrable_const μ)
  have hZa : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) => q.2) (P.prod γ) :=
    (measurable_snd : Measurable
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) => q.2)).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h := continuous_integral_affine_path _ _ hXc.aestronglyMeasurable hZa μ
    Real.sqrt (fun t => Real.sqrt (1 - t)) Real.continuous_sqrt
    (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)) Φ hΦc CΦ hΦb
  exact h

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_zero
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_zero
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → K) (hΦc : Continuous Φ) :
    resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ 0 =
      ∫ z, Φ ((∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν) + z) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  have hf0 : Continuous (fun z : κ → ℝ => Φ (μ + z)) := hΦc.comp (by fun_prop)
  simp only [resamplingInterpolation, sub_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, Real.sqrt_one]
  change (∫ q, Φ (resamplingAffinePoint μ 0 1 (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) ∂P.prod γ) = _
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, resamplingAffinePoint, zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero] using
    (measurePreserving_snd (μ := P) (ν := γ)).hasLaw.integral_comp
      hf0.aestronglyMeasurable

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_one
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_one
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → K) (hΦc : Continuous Φ) :
    resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ 1 =
      ∫ p, Φ (resamplingTripleOriginal p) ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
proof:
:= by
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  simp only [resamplingInterpolation, sub_self, Real.sqrt_one, Real.sqrt_zero]
  change (∫ q, Φ (resamplingAffinePoint μ 1 0 (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) ∂P.prod γ) = _
  have hp (q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ)) :
      resamplingAffinePoint μ 1 0 (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2 =
        resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 := by
    simp only [resamplingAffinePoint, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    abel
  simp_rw [hp]
  have hXm : Measurable (resamplingTripleOriginal : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) := by
    unfold resamplingTripleOriginal
    fun_prop
  exact (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ)).hasLaw.integral_comp
    (hΦc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hXm.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable)

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation
    (ν : ι → Measure (κ → ℝ)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p i),
          (fun p : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) => resamplingTripleOriginal p j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (Φ : (κ → ℝ) → ℂ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ)
    (hΦ : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt Φ (B.flip (f y)) y)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (CΦ C C' : ℝ) (hΦb : ∀ y, ‖Φ y‖ ≤ CΦ)
    (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
      (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) •
          (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
              f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) -
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) •
          ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)
              (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1))
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t := by
  have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let P := resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
  let Y := fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) =>
    resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  let DΦ : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℂ := fun y => B.flip (f y)
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (hf y).continuousAt)
  have hDΦc : Continuous DΦ := B.flip.continuous.comp hfc
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg (f 0)).trans (hfb 0)
  have hDΦb (y : κ → ℝ) : ‖DΦ y‖ ≤ ‖B.flip‖ * C :=
    (B.flip.le_opNorm (f y)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfb y) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hX := ((memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hXc := hX.sub (integrable_const μ)
  have hZi : Integrable
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ) => q.2) (P.prod γ) :=
    (hγ.memLp_two.integrable one_le_two).comp_snd P
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_sqrt_affine_path _ _ hXc hZi μ Φ DΦ hΦ hDΦc
    CΦ (‖B.flip‖ * C) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg B.flip) hC0) hΦb hDΦb ht ht1
  have hLi := (integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine ν hν γ a b f hfc C hfb B).1
  have hXm : AEMeasurable (resamplingTripleOriginal : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) P :=
    (memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν).1.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
  have hGi := (integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine_product P resamplingTripleOriginal hXm γ hγ μ a b
    f hfc df hdf C C' hfb hdfb B).1
  have hform : (∫ q, DΦ (Y q)
        ((1 / (2 * a)) • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) -
          (1 / (2 * b)) • q.2) ∂P.prod γ) =
      (1 / (2 * a)) • (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) (f (Y q)) ∂P.prod γ) -
        (1 / (2 * b)) • (∫ q, B q.2 (f (Y q)) ∂P.prod γ) := by
    have hp (q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → κ → ℝ)) × (κ → ℝ)) :
        DΦ (Y q) ((1 / (2 * a)) • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) -
          (1 / (2 * b)) • q.2) =
        (1 / (2 * a)) • B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) (f (Y q)) -
          (1 / (2 * b)) • B q.2 (f (Y q)) := by simp [DΦ]
    simp_rw [hp]
    have hLs : Integrable (fun q => (1 / (2 * a)) •
        B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) (f (Y q))) (P.prod γ) := by
      refine (hLi.smul (1 / (2 * a))).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [] with q
      rfl
    have hGs : Integrable (fun q => (1 / (2 * b)) • B q.2 (f (Y q))) (P.prod γ) := by
      refine (hGi.smul (1 / (2 * b))).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [] with q
      rfl
    rw [integral_sub hLs hGs, integral_smul, integral_smul]
  have hfirst := integral_bilin_resamplingStein_first ν hν γ a b f hfc C hfb B
  have hsecond := integral_bilin_resamplingStein_gaussian ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov a b f df hf hdf
    C C' hfb hdfb B
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith : 0 < 1 - t)).ne'
  have hfacA : (1 / (2 * a)) * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a) := by field_simp; ring
  have hfacB : (1 / (2 * b)) * (b * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) =
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4 := by field_simp; ring
  change HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
    (∫ q, DΦ (Y q) ((1 / (2 * a)) • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) -
      (1 / (2 * b)) • q.2) ∂P.prod γ) t at hd
  apply hd.congr_deriv
  rw [hform, hfirst, hsecond, smul_smul, smul_smul, hfacA, hfacB]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_cubicKernel
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_cubicKernel
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q i),
          (fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
proof:
:= fun x => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)
    let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    let K : Q → ℂ := fun q => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a
      (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2)
      (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
      (resamplingTripleFirst q.1 - resamplingTripleSecond q.1)
    Integrable K ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
      HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
        (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * a / 4) • ∫ q, K q ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t := by
  let := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let P := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
  let Y0 : Q → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2
  let Y1 : Q → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2
  let Y2 : Q → E := fun q => resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2
  let D : Q → E := fun q => resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1
  let V : Q → E := fun q => resamplingTripleFirst q.1 - resamplingTripleSecond q.1
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun x => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let f := fderiv ℝ Φ
  let df := fderiv ℝ f
  let B : E →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →L[ℝ] ℂ)).flip
  have h01 (q : Q) : Y1 q + a • D q = Y0 q := by
    dsimp only [Y0, Y1, D, resamplingAffinePoint]
    simp only [smul_sub]
    abel
  have h12 (q : Q) : Y1 q - a • V q = Y2 q := by
    dsimp only [Y1, Y2, V, resamplingAffinePoint]
    simp only [smul_sub]
    abel
  have hm := memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν
  have hD2 := (hm.1.sub hm.2.1).comp_fst γ
  have hV2 := (hm.2.1.sub hm.2.2).comp_fst γ
  have hY1m : AEMeasurable Y1 P := by
    have hFirst := hm.2.1.comp_fst γ
    have hZ : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun q : Q => q.2) P :=
      measurable_snd.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ((aestronglyMeasurable_const.add
      ((hFirst.aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul a)).add
        (hZ.const_smul b)).aemeasurable
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, ∀ s : Fin 3, ∀ i,
      specNorm (L (q.1.2 (i, s))) ≤ R := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro s
    have hs := hasLaw_resamplingTriple_prod_full_copy ν γ s
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun z : ι → E => ∀ i, specNorm (L (z i)) ≤ R) hs.aemeasurable
    rw [hs.map_eq, ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    have hi := (measurePreserving_eval ν i).hasLaw
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun z : E => specNorm (L z) ≤ R) hi.aemeasurable
    rw [hi.map_eq]
    exact hBound i
  have hDV : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, specNorm (L (D q)) ≤ 2 * R ∧ specNorm (L (V q)) ≤ 2 * R := by
    filter_upwards [hAll] with q hq
    have hsub (s u : Fin 3) : specNorm (L (q.1.2 (q.1.1, s) - q.1.2 (q.1.1, u))) ≤ 2 * R := by
      rw [map_sub]
      exact (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hq s q.1.1, hq u q.1.1])
    constructor
    · simpa only [D, resamplingTriple_difference] using hsub 0 1
    · simpa only [V, resamplingTriple_first_sub_second] using hsub 1 2
  have hTaylor := integrable_and_integral_fderiv_sub_sub_smul_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
    P A hA ζ hζ p a Y1 D V hY1m hD2.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
      hV2.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * R) hDV
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ Φ := contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := hc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hdfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ df := hfc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  let C1 : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 1) * ‖L‖
  let C2 : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 2) * ‖L‖ ^ 2
  have hfb (y : E) : ‖f y‖ ≤ C1 := norm_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p y
  have hdfb (y : E) : ‖df y‖ ≤ C2 := by
    change ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y‖ ≤ C2
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ Φ), norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    exact norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p y
  let I1 : Q → ℂ := fun q => (f (Y0 q) - f (Y1 q)) (D q)
  let I2 : Q → ℂ := fun q => df (Y2 q) (D q) (D q)
  have hI1 : Integrable I1 P := by
    simpa only [I1, B, Y0, Y1, D, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using
      (integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine ν hν γ a b f hfc.continuous C1 hfb B).2
  have hI2 : Integrable I2 P := by
    simpa only [I2, B, Y2, D, resamplingAffinePoint, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using
      integrable_bilin_quadratic_resamplingTriple_affine ν hν γ μ a b df hdfc.continuous C2 hdfb B
  have he : (∫ q, I1 q ∂P) - a • (∫ q, I2 q ∂P) =
      a ^ 2 • ∫ q, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (Y1 q) (D q) (V q) ∂P := by
    have hs := integral_sub hI1 (hI2.smul a)
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, integral_smul] at hs
    rw [← hs]
    simpa only [Φ, I1, I2, f, df, h01, h12, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] using hTaylor.2.2
  refine ⟨hTaylor.1, ?_⟩
  have hd := hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent
    ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov A hA ζ hζ p ht ht1
  apply hd.congr_deriv
  change ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) • (∫ q, I1 q ∂P) -
    ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) • (∫ q, I2 q ∂P) = _
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
  have hcoef : ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) * a = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4 := by
    field_simp
  calc
    _ = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) • ((∫ q, I1 q ∂P) - a • ∫ q, I2 q ∂P) := by
      rw [smul_sub, smul_smul, hcoef]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [he, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      field_simp
      ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_pow_of_symm_even
statement:
private lemma integrable_pow_of_symm_even [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hsym : IdentDistrib X (fun w => -X w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ p, 0 < p → Integrable (fun w => X w ^ (2 * p)) μ)
    (p : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun w => X w ^ p) μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | p
  · simp
  · have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ := hsym.aemeasurable_fst.aestronglyMeasurable
    have h2norm : Integrable (fun w => ‖X w‖ ^ (2 * (p + 1))) μ := by
      have hn := (integrable_norm_iff (hmeas.pow (2 * (p + 1)))).2
        (h2 (p + 1) (by omega))
      refine hn.congr ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, (even_two_mul (p + 1)).pow_abs]
      exact abs_of_nonneg ((even_two_mul (p + 1)).pow_nonneg (X w))
    have hlow : Integrable (fun w => ‖X w‖ ^ (p + 1)) μ :=
      integrable_norm_pow_of_le hmeas (by omega) h2norm
    have hnormres : Integrable (fun w => ‖X w ^ (p + 1)‖) μ := by
      simpa [norm_pow] using hlow
    exact (integrable_norm_iff (hmeas.pow (p + 1))).1 hnormres

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_eq_zero_of_odd_of_symm
statement:
private lemma integral_pow_eq_zero_of_odd_of_symm {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hsym : IdentDistrib X (fun w => -X w) μ μ)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : Odd p)
    (_hint : Integrable (fun w => X w ^ p) μ) :
    ∫ w, X w ^ p ∂μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := hsym.comp (continuous_pow p).measurable
  have heq := hcomp.integral_eq
  have heq' : (∫ x, X x ^ p ∂μ) = ∫ x, (-X x) ^ p ∂μ := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using heq
  have hneg : (fun x => (-X x) ^ p) = fun x => -X x ^ p := by
    funext x
    exact Odd.neg_pow hp (X x)
  rw [hneg, integral_neg] at heq'
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_nonneg_and_le_gaussianReal
statement:
theorem integral_pow_nonneg_and_le_gaussianReal [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hsym : IdentDistrib X (fun w => -X w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => X w ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        ∫ w, X w ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (p : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∫ w, X w ^ p ∂μ ∧ ∫ w, X w ^ p ∂μ ≤ ∫ z, z ^ p ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hint := integrable_pow_of_symm_even hsym (fun p hp => (h2 p hp).1) p
  constructor
  · rcases Nat.even_or_odd' p with ⟨q, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact integral_nonneg (f := fun w => X w ^ (2 * q)) fun w =>
        (even_two_mul q).pow_nonneg (X w)
    · rw [integral_pow_eq_zero_of_odd_of_symm hsym ⟨q, rfl⟩ hint]
  · rcases Nat.even_or_odd' p with ⟨q, rfl | rfl⟩
    · by_cases hq : q = 0
      · subst q
        have hx : (∫ w, X w ^ (2 * 0) ∂μ) = 1 := by
          simp
        have hz : (∫ z, z ^ (2 * 0) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) = 1 := by
          simp
        rw [hx, hz]
      · have hqpos : 0 < q := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq
        have hG : ∫ z, z ^ (2 * q) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = gaussianEvenMoment q :=
          integral_pow_two_mul_gaussianReal q
        rw [hG]
        exact (h2 q hqpos).2
    · have hX0 : ∫ w, X w ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂μ = 0 :=
        integral_pow_eq_zero_of_odd_of_symm hsym ⟨q, rfl⟩ hint
      have hG0 : ∫ z, z ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0 := by
        have h : ∫ z, z ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) =
            ∫ z, (-z) ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [← neg_zero, ← gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := 0) (v := 1)]
          rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
        have h2' : ∫ z, (-z) ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) =
            -∫ z, z ^ (2 * q + 1) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
          rw [← integral_neg]
          congr 1
          ext z
          rw [Odd.neg_pow ⟨q, rfl⟩]
        linarith
      rw [hX0, hG0]

name: NLAlib.hasFiniteNatMoments_of_symm_even
statement:
private theorem hasFiniteNatMoments_of_symm_even [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hsym : IdentDistrib X (fun w => -X w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ p, 0 < p → Integrable (fun w => X w ^ (2 * p)) μ) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments X μ
proof: := fun p => integrable_pow_of_symm_even hsym h2 p

name: NLAlib.hasFiniteNatMoments_eval_gaussianVector
statement:
lemma hasFiniteNatMoments_eval_gaussianVector (e : E) :
    HasFiniteNatMoments (fun x : E → ℝ => x e) (gaussianVector E)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have hlaw := hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector e
  have h := integrable_pow_gaussianReal p
  rw [← hlaw.map_eq] at h
  exact (integrable_map_measure (continuous_pow p).aestronglyMeasurable
    hlaw.aemeasurable).1 h

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_pow_of_symm_even
statement:
private theorem integrable_prod_pow_of_symm_even [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hsym : ∀ e, IdentDistrib (X e) (fun w => -X e w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e p, 0 < p → Integrable (fun w => (X e w) ^ (2 * p)) μ)
    (k : E → ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun w => ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k e)) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ e ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset E),
      HasFiniteNatMoments (fun w => (X e w) ^ (k e)) μ := fun e _ =>
    (hasFiniteNatMoments_of_symm_even (hsym e) (h2 e)).pow (k e)
  exact (HasFiniteNatMoments.prod (Finset.univ) hf).integrable

name: NLAlib.integrable_prod_pow_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_prod_pow_gaussianVector (k : E → ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : E → ℝ => ∏ e, x e ^ (k e)) (gaussianVector E)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ e ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset E),
      HasFiniteNatMoments (fun x : E → ℝ => x e ^ (k e)) (gaussianVector E) := fun e _ =>
    (hasFiniteNatMoments_eval_gaussianVector e).pow (k e)
  exact (HasFiniteNatMoments.prod (Finset.univ) hf).integrable

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_prod_pow
statement:
private theorem integrable_mul_prod_pow [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
