    (hsym : ∀ e, IdentDistrib (X e) (fun w => -X e w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e p, 0 < p → Integrable (fun w => (X e w) ^ (2 * p)) μ)
    (t : τ) :
    Integrable (fun w => c t * ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e)) μ
proof:
:=
  (integrable_prod_pow_of_symm_even hsym h2 (k t)).const_mul (c t)

name: NLAlib.integrable_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector
statement:
private theorem integrable_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector (t : τ) :
    Integrable (fun x : E → ℝ => c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e)) (gaussianVector E)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_prod_pow_gaussianVector (k t)).const_mul (c t)

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_pow_le_integral_prod_pow_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_prod_pow_le_integral_prod_pow_gaussianVector [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hX : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hsym : ∀ e, IdentDistrib (X e) (fun w => -X e w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => (X e w) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        ∫ w, (X e w) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (k : E → ℕ) :
    ∫ w, ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k e) ∂μ ≤
      ∫ x : E → ℝ, ∏ e, x e ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianVector E)
proof:
:= by
  have hmom : ∀ e, 0 ≤ ∫ w, (X e w) ^ (k e) ∂μ ∧
      ∫ w, (X e w) ^ (k e) ∂μ ≤ ∫ z, z ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := fun e =>
    integral_pow_nonneg_and_le_gaussianReal (hsym e) (h2 e) (k e)
  calc
    ∫ w, ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k e) ∂μ = ∏ e, ∫ w, (X e w) ^ (k e) ∂μ := by
      exact hX.integral_fun_prod_comp (fun e => (hsym e).aemeasurable_fst)
        (fun e => (continuous_pow (k e)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    _ ≤ ∏ e, ∫ x, x e ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianVector E) := by
      refine Finset.prod_le_prod (s := Finset.univ) ?_ ?_
      · intro e he
        exact (hmom e).1
      · intro e he
        have hfac : ∫ x, x e ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianVector E) =
            ∫ z, z ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) :=
          (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector e).integral_comp
            (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ (k e)) (by fun_prop)
        rw [hfac]
        exact (hmom e).2
    _ = ∫ x, ∏ e, x e ^ (k e) ∂(gaussianVector E) := by
      symm
      exact (iIndepFun_eval_gaussianVector E).integral_fun_prod_comp
        (fun e => (measurable_pi_apply e).aemeasurable)
        (fun e => (continuous_pow (k e)).aestronglyMeasurable)

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_le_integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_le_integral_sum_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hX : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hsym : ∀ e, IdentDistrib (X e) (fun w => -X e w) μ μ)
    (h2 : ∀ e p, 0 < p →
      Integrable (fun w => (X e w) ^ (2 * p)) μ ∧
        ∫ w, (X e w) ^ (2 * p) ∂μ ≤ gaussianEvenMoment p)
    (hc : ∀ t, 0 ≤ c t) :
    ∫ w, ∑ t, c t * ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e) ∂μ ≤
      ∫ x : E → ℝ, ∑ t, c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e) ∂(gaussianVector E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hXint : ∀ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset τ),
      Integrable (fun w => c t * ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e)) μ := fun t _ =>
    integrable_mul_prod_pow c k hsym (fun e p hp => (h2 e p hp).1) t
  have hGint : ∀ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset τ),
      Integrable (fun x : E → ℝ => c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e)) (gaussianVector E) := fun t _ =>
    integrable_mul_prod_pow_gaussianVector c k t
  calc
    ∫ w, ∑ t, c t * ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e) ∂μ =
        ∑ t, c t * ∫ w, ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e) ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun t w => c t * ∏ e, (X e w) ^ (k t e)) hXint]
      simp_rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ t, c t * ∫ x, ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e) ∂(gaussianVector E) := by
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t ht => ?_)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (integral_prod_pow_le_integral_prod_pow_gaussianVector hX hsym h2 (k t)) (hc t)
    _ = ∫ x, ∑ t, c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e) ∂(gaussianVector E) := by
      have hsum_eq :
          ∫ x, ∑ t, c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e) ∂(gaussianVector E) =
            ∑ t, ∫ x, c t * ∏ e, x e ^ (k t e) ∂(gaussianVector E) :=
        integral_finsetSum (s := Finset.univ)
          (f := fun t (y : E → ℝ) => c t * ∏ e, y e ^ (k t e)) hGint
      rw [hsum_eq]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [integral_const_mul]

name: NLAlib.memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_coordinate_sq_le_chernoff
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, specNorm A ≤ R) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    MemLp (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2)) (q : ℝ≥0∞)
      (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) ∧
      lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2)) (q : ℝ≥0∞)
        (Measure.pi fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 - 1) * specNorm (∑ i, ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i) +
        R ^ 2 * (Real.log (Fintype.card n) + q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hz (A : M) : specNorm A = 0 := by
      rw [Subsingleton.elim A 0, specNorm_zero]
    have hMzero : (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2)) = 0 := by
      funext x
      exact hz _
    rw [hMzero]
    constructor
    · exact MemLp.zero
    · simp only [lpNorm_zero, hz, mul_zero, Fintype.card_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero,
        Real.log_zero, zero_add]
      positivity
  | inr hn =>
    let κ : ι → Measure E := fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates
    have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i) :=
      (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
    have hκBound (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂κ i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R := by
      have hm : MeasurableSet {x : E | specNorm (L x) ≤ R} :=
        (isClosed_le (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using (L).continuous.norm)
          continuous_const).measurableSet
      apply (ae_map_iff measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable hm).mpr
      filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with A hA hb
      simpa only [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA] using hb
    let Z : ι → (ι → E) → M := fun i x => L (x i)
    have hZm (i : ι) : Measurable (Z i) :=
      (L).continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
    have hZi : iIndepFun Z (Measure.pi κ) :=
      (iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)).comp
        (fun _ => L) (fun _ => (L).continuous.measurable)
    have hZH (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi κ, (Z i x).IsHermitian :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => isHermitian_hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates (x i)
    have hZB (i : ι) : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi κ, specNorm (Z i x) ≤ R :=
      (measurePreserving_eval κ i).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (hκBound i)
    have h := memLp_and_lpNorm_specNorm_sum_sq_le_chernoff (Measure.pi κ)
      Z hR hZm hZi hZH hZB q hq
    have hSq : Measurable (fun x : E => L x ^ 2) := by
      simpa only [pow_two] using (L).continuous.measurable.matrix_mul (L).continuous.measurable
    have hMoment (i : ι) : (∫ x : ι → E, Z i x ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi κ) =
        ∫ A : M, A ^ 2 ∂ν i := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ x : E, L x ^ 2 ∂κ i :=
          (measurePreserving_eval κ i).hasLaw.integral_comp hSq.aestronglyMeasurable
        _ = ∫ A : M, (L (matrixRealCoordinates A)) ^ 2 ∂ν i :=
          ((show HasLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) (κ i) (ν i) from
            ⟨measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable, rfl⟩).integral_comp
              hSq.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
        _ = _ := integral_congr_ae ((hHerm i).mono fun A hA => by
          change (L (matrixRealCoordinates A)) ^ 2 = A ^ 2
          rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA])
    simp_rw [hMoment] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.abs_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_rpow_inv_sub_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q i),
          (fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hsmall : 16 * (p : ℝ) * R ≤ |ζ.im|) :
    let F
proof:
:= resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p)
    let B := lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2))
      (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν)
    |F 1 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) - F 0 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
      9 * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 := by
  let := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  dsimp only
  let F := resamplingInterpolation ν γ (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A + L x) ζ p)
  let B := lpNorm (fun x : ι → E => specNorm (∑ i, L (x i) ^ 2))
    (2 * (p : ℝ≥0∞)) (Measure.pi ν)
  change |F 1 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)) - F 0 ^ (1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ))| ≤
    9 * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := lpNorm_nonneg
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn =>
    have hFzero (t : ℝ) : F t = 0 := by
      dsimp only [F, resamplingInterpolation]
      simp [resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]
    rw [hFzero, hFzero, sub_self, abs_zero]
    positivity
  | inr hn =>
    let s : ℝ := 1 / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let α : ℝ := ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let K : ℝ := 9 * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4
    have hk : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hs : 0 ≤ s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
    have hα : α = 1 - s := by
      have hnum : ((2 * p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * p)]
        norm_num
      dsimp only [α, s]
      rw [hnum]
      field_simp
    have hFc : Continuous F :=
      continuous_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment ν hν γ A hA hζ hp
    have hFpos (x : ℝ) : 0 < F x :=
      resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_pos ν γ A hA hζ hp x
    have hD (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_resolventEvenMoment_and_abs_deriv_le
        ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov hR hBound A hA ζ hζ hp hsmall hx.1 hx.2
    have hDbound (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
        |deriv F x| ≤ K * F x ^ (1 - s) := by
      have hb := (hD x hx).2
      change |deriv F x| ≤ 9 * Real.sqrt x * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B *
          (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * F x ^ α at hb
      calc
        _ ≤ 9 * Real.sqrt x * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B *
              (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 * F x ^ α := hb
        _ = Real.sqrt x * (K * F x ^ α) := by dsimp only [K]; ring
        _ ≤ 1 * (K * F x ^ α) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr hx.2.le)
            (mul_nonneg (by dsimp only [K]; positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hFpos x).le α))
        _ = K * F x ^ (1 - s) := by rw [one_mul, hα]
    have he := Real.abs_rpow_sub_rpow_le_of_hasDerivAt_bound
      (f := F) (f' := deriv F) (a := 0) (b := 1) (s := s) (K := K)
      (by norm_num) hs hFc.continuousOn (fun x _ => hFpos x)
      (fun x hx => (hD x hx).1) hDbound
    have hScalar : (s * K) * (1 - 0) =
        9 * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R * B * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ 4 := by
      dsimp only [s, K]
      field_simp
      ring
    simpa only [s, hScalar] using he

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_one_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ A ∂ν i, A.IsHermitian)
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ]
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) γ
      (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + L x) ζ p) 1 =
      ∫ x : ι → M, resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + ∑ i, x i) ζ p ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => simp [resamplingInterpolation, resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]
  | inr hn =>
    have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
      (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
    let Φ : E → ℝ := fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + L x) ζ p
    have hΦ : Continuous Φ :=
      (contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ p (r := ⊤)).continuous
    rw [resamplingInterpolation_one _ γ _ hΦ]
    calc
      _ = ∫ x : ι → M, Φ (matrixRealCoordinates (∑ i, x i)) ∂Measure.pi ν :=
        ((identDistrib_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates_sum ν).comp hΦ.measurable).integral_eq
      _ = _ := integral_congr_ae ((ae_isHermitian_sum_pi ν hν).mono fun x hx => by
        dsimp only [Φ]
        rw [hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hx])

name: NLAlib.resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law
statement:
theorem resamplingInterpolation_zero_matrix_resolventEvenMoment_law
    (ν : ι → Measure M) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : M → M) 3 (ν i))
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ)
    (hHerm : ∀ᵐ A ∂ρ, A.IsHermitian)
    (A₀ : M) (hA₀ : A₀.IsHermitian)
    (hmean : (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) = A₀ + ∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν)
    (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) :
    resamplingInterpolation (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
      (centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) (fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + L x) ζ p) 0 =
      ∫ A : M, resolventEvenMoment A ζ p ∂ρ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with
  | inl hn => simp [resamplingInterpolation, resolventEvenMoment, normalizedTrace]
  | inr hn =>
    have (i : ι) : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates) :=
      (ν i).isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_matrixRealCoordinates.aemeasurable
    have := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
    have hγ := hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ hρ
    have := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
    let Φ : E → ℝ := fun x => resolventEvenMoment (A₀ + L x) ζ p
    have hΦ : Continuous Φ :=
      (contDiff_resolventEvenMoment_coordinate A₀ hA₀ ζ hζ p (r := ⊤)).continuous
    let m : E := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure
      (fun i => (ν i).map matrixRealCoordinates)
    have hm : m + matrixRealCoordinates A₀ = ∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A ∂ρ := by
      calc
        _ = matrixRealCoordinates ((∫ x : ι → M, ∑ i, x i ∂Measure.pi ν) + A₀) := by
          dsimp only [m]
          rw [integral_resamplingTripleOriginal_matrixRealCoordinates ν hν, map_add]
        _ = matrixRealCoordinates (∫ A : M, A ∂ρ) := by rw [hmean, add_comm A₀]
        _ = _ := ((matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv
          (m := n) (n := n)).toContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm
            (integrable_id_of_hasGaussianLaw_matrixRealCoordinates ρ hρ)).symm
    rw [resamplingInterpolation_zero _ _ _ hΦ]
    change (∫ z : E, Φ (m + z) ∂centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) = _
    have hshift : Continuous (fun z : E => Φ (m + z)) := hΦ.comp (by fun_prop)
    have ht := (hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates ρ).integral_comp hshift.aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [← ht]
    apply integral_congr_ae (hHerm.mono fun A hA => ?_)
    change Φ (m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ)) = _
    have he : m + (matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) =
        matrixRealCoordinates A - matrixRealCoordinates A₀ := by rw [← hm]; abel
    rw [he]
    dsimp only [Φ]
    rw [map_sub, hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA,
      hermitianMatrixFromRealCoordinates_matrixRealCoordinates hA₀]
    congr 1
    abel

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : ℝ)
    (f : E → F) (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    Integrable (fun q => B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) ∧
    Integrable (fun q => B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
        f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2)))
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) := by
  dsimp only
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  have hm := memLp_resamplingTriple_sums ν hν
  have hX := (hm.1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hXp := (hm.2.1.integrable one_le_two).comp_fst γ
  have hz : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E => q.2) ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    (measurable_snd : Measurable
      (fun q : (ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E)) × E => q.2)).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hY : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun q => μ + a • (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add
      ((hX.aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul a)).add
        (hz.const_smul b)
  have hYp : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun q => μ + a • (resamplingTripleFirst q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)
      ((resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) :=
    (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add
      ((hXp.aestronglyMeasurable.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul a)).add
        (hz.const_smul b)
  have hfY := hfc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY
  have hfYp := hfc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hYp
  constructor
  · exact B.integrable_of_bilin_of_bdd_right C (hX.sub (integrable_const μ)) hfY
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun q => hfb _))
  · apply B.integrable_of_bilin_of_bdd_right (2 * C) (hX.sub hXp) (hfY.sub hfYp)
    filter_upwards [] with q
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ((add_le_add (hfb _) (hfb _)).trans_eq (by ring))

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_resamplingAffine
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_resamplingAffine
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (a b : ℝ)
    (f : E → F) (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    let μ
proof:
:= ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    (∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - μ)
      (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2))
      ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) =
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) •
        ∫ q, B (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
          (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
            f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
          ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ := by
  dsimp only
  let μ := ∫ p, resamplingTripleOriginal p ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
  have hi := integrable_bilin_resamplingAffine ν hν γ a b f hfc C hfb B
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi.1, integral_prod_symm _ hi.2, ← integral_smul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with z
  exact integral_bilin_resamplingTriple ν hν
    (fun x => f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b x z))
    (hfc.comp (by unfold resamplingAffinePoint; fun_prop)) C (fun x => hfb _) B

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates
statement:
theorem hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates (ρ : Measure M) :
    HasLaw (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ)
      (centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) ρ
proof: := ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.integrable_id_of_hasGaussianLaw_matrixRealCoordinates
statement:
theorem integrable_id_of_hasGaussianLaw_matrixRealCoordinates
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ) :
    Integrable (fun A : M => A) ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp
    hρ.integrable
  have he (A : M) :
      (matrixRealCoordinatesContinuousLinearEquiv (m := n) (n := n)).symm
        (matrixRealCoordinates A) = A :=
    (matrixRealCoordinates : M ≃ₗ[ℝ] E).symm_apply_apply A
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, he] using hi

name: NLAlib.hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw
statement:
theorem hasGaussianLaw_id_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ) :
    HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) (centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ =
      (ρ.map matrixRealCoordinates).map
        (fun x : E => x - ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) := by
    rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop)
      measurable_matrixRealCoordinates]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  haveI := hρ.isGaussian_map
  exact IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw_eq_zero
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ) (a : J) :
    (∫ z : E, z a ∂centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have ht := (hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates ρ).integral_comp
    (measurable_pi_apply a).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  have he : (∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) a =
      ∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B a ∂ρ :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).integral_comp_comm hρ.integrable).symm
  rw [← ht]
  change (∫ A : M, matrixRealCoordinates A a - (∫ B : M, matrixRealCoordinates B ∂ρ) a ∂ρ) = 0
  rw [integral_sub (hρ.eval a).integrable (integrable_const _), integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, he, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.covariance_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw
statement:
theorem covariance_eval_centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw
    (ρ : Measure M) (hρ : HasGaussianLaw (matrixRealCoordinates : M → E) ρ) (a b : J) :
    cov[(fun z : E => z a), (fun z : E => z b); centeredMatrixCoordinateLaw ρ] =
      cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a),
        (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b); ρ]
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hρ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have ht := (hasLaw_centeredMatrixCoordinates ρ).covariance_fun_comp
    (measurable_pi_apply a).aemeasurable
    (measurable_pi_apply b).aemeasurable
  change cov[(fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A a - _),
    (fun A : M => matrixRealCoordinates A b - _); ρ] = _ at ht
  rw [covariance_sub_const_left (hρ.eval a).integrable,
    covariance_sub_const_right (hρ.eval b).integrable] at ht
  exact ht.symm

name: NLAlib.slepian_inequality_ge
statement:
theorem slepian_inequality_ge {ι Ω Ω' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω'] {P : Measure Ω} {Q : Measure Ω'}
    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (Y : ι → Ω' → ℝ)
    (hX : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => X t ω) P)
    (hY : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω t => Y t ω) Q)
    (hX0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ∂P = 0) (hY0 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, Y t ω ∂Q = 0)
    (hvar : ∀ t, ∫ ω, X t ω ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, Y t ω ^ 2 ∂Q)
    (hinc : ∀ s t, ∫ ω, (X s ω - X t ω) ^ 2 ∂P ≤
      ∫ ω, (Y s ω - Y t ω) ^ 2 ∂Q) (τ : ℝ) :
    P {ω | τ ≤ ⨆ t, X t ω} ≤ Q {ω | τ ≤ ⨆ t, Y t ω}
proof:
:= by
  have hP := hX.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hQ := hY.isProbabilityMeasure
  apply measure_ge_le_of_measure_gt_le
    (AEMeasurable.iSup fun t => (hX.eval t).aemeasurable)
    (AEMeasurable.iSup fun t => (hY.eval t).aemeasurable)
  exact slepian_inequality X Y hX hY hX0 hY0 hvar hinc

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (hν : ∀ i, MemLp (id : E → E) 2 (ν i))
    (γ : Measure E) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : E → E) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (hcov : ∀ i j,
      cov[(fun z : E => z i), (fun z : E => z j); γ] =
        cov[(fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q i),
          (fun q : ι × ((ι × Fin 3) → E) => resamplingTripleOriginal q j);
          resamplingTripleMeasure ν])
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
proof:
:= fun x => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)
    let f := fderiv ℝ Φ
    let df := fderiv ℝ f
    let μ := ∫ q, resamplingTripleOriginal q ∂resamplingTripleMeasure ν
    let a := Real.sqrt t
    let b := Real.sqrt (1 - t)
    HasDerivAt (resamplingInterpolation ν γ Φ)
      (((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / (4 * a)) •
          (∫ q, (f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1) q.2) -
              f (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleFirst q.1) q.2))
            (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) -
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 4) •
          ∫ q, df (resamplingAffinePoint μ a b (resamplingTripleSecond q.1) q.2)
            (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            (resamplingTripleOriginal q.1 - resamplingTripleFirst q.1)
            ∂(resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ) t := by
  dsimp only
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun x => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L x) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L x) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let f := fderiv ℝ Φ
  let df := fderiv ℝ f
  let B : E →L[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] ℂ) →L[ℝ] ℂ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →L[ℝ] ℂ)).flip
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ Φ :=
    contDiff_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate A hA ζ hζ p
  have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ f := hc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hdfc : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ df := hfc.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hΦ (y : E) : HasFDerivAt Φ (B.flip (f y)) y := by
    simpa only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_flip, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, f] using!
      (hc.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt
  have hf (y : E) : HasFDerivAt f (df y) y :=
    (hfc.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt
  let C0 : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p)
  let C1 : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 1) * ‖L‖
  let C2 : ℝ := ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ (2 * p + 2) * ‖L‖ ^ 2
  have hΦb (y : E) : ‖Φ y‖ ≤ C0 :=
    norm_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p y
  have hfb (y : E) : ‖f y‖ ≤ C1 :=
    norm_fderiv_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p y
  have hdfb (y : E) : ‖df y‖ ≤ C2 := by
    change ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y‖ ≤ C2
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ Φ), norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    exact norm_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_resolvent_coordinate_le A hA ζ hζ p y
  simpa only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
    Φ, f, df] using!
    hasDerivAt_resamplingInterpolation ν hν γ hγ hmean hcov Φ f df B
      hΦ hf hdfc.continuous C0 C1 C2 hΦb hfb hdfb ht ht1

name: NLAlib.ouB_pos
statement: private lemma ouB_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < ouB s
proof:
:= by
  unfold ouB
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.ouB_sq
statement: private lemma ouB_sq {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : ouB s ^ 2 = 1 - Real.exp (-(2 * s))
proof:
:= by
  unfold ouB
  have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]

name: NLAlib.ouB_mono
statement: private lemma ouB_mono {s₁ s₂ : ℝ} (h : s₁ ≤ s₂) : ouB s₁ ≤ ouB s₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold ouB
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have : Real.exp (-(2 * s₂)) ≤ Real.exp (-(2 * s₁)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_ouB
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_ouB {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt ouB (Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s) s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 1 - Real.exp (-(2 * s))) (2 * Real.exp (-(2 * s))) s := by
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul 2).neg.exp).const_sub 1
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply, id]; ring
  have hne : 1 - Real.exp (-(2 * s)) ≠ 0 := by
    have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    linarith
  have := h1.sqrt hne
  refine this.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold ouB
  have hb : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * s))) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by
    have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    linarith)
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.ouB_sq_eq_exp
statement: private lemma ouB_sq_eq_exp {s : ℝ} : Real.exp (-s) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-(2 * s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf

name: NLAlib.integrable_bdd_comp
statement:
private lemma integrable_bdd_comp (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Measurable k) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ z, |k z| ≤ B)
    (c d : ℝ) : Integrable (fun y => k (c + d * y)) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.mono' (integrable_const B) (hk.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB _))

name: NLAlib.integrable_bdd_comp_affine
statement:
private lemma integrable_bdd_comp_affine (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Measurable k) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ z, |k z| ≤ B)
    (c d e g : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => k (c + d * y) * (e + g * y)) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hB 0)
  refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_const (B * |e|)).add
    (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul (B * |g|)))
    ((hk.comp (by fun_prop)).mul (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  have h1 : |e + g * y| ≤ |e| + |g| * |y| := by rw [← abs_mul]; exact abs_add_le _ _
  have h2 := hB (c + d * y)
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  calc |k (c + d * y)| * |e + g * y| ≤ B * (|e| + |g| * |y|) :=
        mul_le_mul h2 h1 (abs_nonneg _) hB0
    _ = B * |e| + B * |g| * |y| := by ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_y_mul_bdd_comp
proof:
:= by
  have := integrable_bdd_comp_affine k hk B hB c d 0 1
  refine this.congr (Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
  simp only; ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integrand_time
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_integrand_time (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hfd : Differentiable ℝ f) (x y s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y))
      (deriv f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y)) s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y)
      (-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y) s := by
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-s)) (-Real.exp (-s)) s := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_id s).neg.exp
      refine this.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [Pi.neg_apply, id]; ring
    exact (ha.mul_const x).add ((hasDerivAt_ouB hs).mul_const y)
  exact (hfd _).hasDerivAt.comp s h1

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_ouP_time
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_ouP_time (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (C : ℝ)
    (hfb : ∀ z, |f z| ≤ C) (hdf : ∀ z, |deriv f z| ≤ C) (x s₀ : ℝ) (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ouP s f x)
      (∫ y, deriv f (Real.exp (-s₀) * x + ouB s₀ * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-s₀) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s₀)) / ouB s₀ * y) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) s₀
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hfb 0)
  set K := 1 / ouB (s₀ / 2) with hK
  have hb0 : 0 < ouB (s₀ / 2) := ouB_pos (by linarith)
  have hball : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ (s₀ / 2), 0 < s ∧ |Real.exp (-s)| ≤ 1 ∧
      |Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s| ≤ K := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hs
    have hs1 : s₀ / 2 < s := by linarith
    have hspos : 0 < s := by linarith
    refine ⟨hspos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]; exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    · have hbs : ouB (s₀ / 2) ≤ ouB s := ouB_mono hs1.le
      rw [abs_of_pos (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (ouB_pos hspos)), hK,
        div_le_div_iff₀ (ouB_pos hspos) hb0]
      have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
      nlinarith
  refine (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := gaussianReal 0 1)
    (F := fun s y => f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y))
    (F' := fun s y => deriv f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y))
    (x₀ := s₀) (bound := fun y => C * (|x| + K * |y|))
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ (by linarith : 0 < s₀ / 2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun s => (hfc.comp (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable)
  · exact integrable_bdd_comp f hfc.measurable C hfb _ _
  · exact ((hdfc.comp (by fun_prop)).mul (by fun_prop)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun y s hs => ?_)
    obtain ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ := hball s hs
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    have h1 : |-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y| ≤ |x| + K * |y| := by
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (abs_nonneg x)
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (abs_nonneg y)
      linarith
    exact mul_le_mul (hdf _) h1 (abs_nonneg _) hC
  · exact (integrable_const _ |>.add (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul K)).const_mul C
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun y s hs => ?_)
    exact hasDerivAt_integrand_time f hfd x y s (hball s hs).1

name: NLAlib.abs_ouP_le
statement:
private lemma abs_ouP_le (k : ℝ → ℝ) (hk : Measurable k) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ z, |k z| ≤ B) (s x : ℝ) :
    |ouP s k x| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  unfold ouP
  refine (abs_integral_le_integral_abs).trans ?_
  have := integral_mono (integrable_bdd_comp k hk B hB (Real.exp (-s) * x) (ouB s)).abs
    (integrable_const B) (fun y => hB _)
  simpa using this

name: NLAlib.abs_noise_moment_le
proof:
:= by
  refine (abs_integral_le_integral_abs).trans ?_
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  refine integral_mono (integrable_y_mul_bdd_comp k hk B hB c d).abs
    (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul B) (fun y => ?_)
  simp only [abs_mul]
  rw [mul_comm B]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB _) (abs_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.ibp_noise
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hder : ∀ y, HasDerivAt (fun y => f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y))
      (deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y) * ouB t) y := by
    intro y
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y) (ouB t) y := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id y).const_mul (ouB t)).const_add (Real.exp (-t) * x)
    exact (hfd _).hasDerivAt.comp y h1
  have := integral_mul_eq_integral_deriv_gaussianReal (fun y => f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y))
    (fun y => (hder y).differentiableAt) (C * |ouB t|) (fun y => by
      rw [(hder y).deriv, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdf _) (abs_nonneg _))
  rw [this]
  simp_rw [fun y => (hder y).deriv]
  rw [integral_mul_const, mul_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_noise_moment
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  refine (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := gaussianReal 0 1)
    (F := fun z y => y * f (Real.exp (-t) * z + ouB t * y))
    (F' := fun z y => Real.exp (-t) * (y * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * z + ouB t * y)))
    (x₀ := x) (bound := fun y => Real.exp (-t) * (C * |y|)) Filter.univ_mem ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun z => (continuous_id.mul
      (hfc.comp (by fun_prop))).aestronglyMeasurable)
  · exact integrable_y_mul_bdd_comp f hfc.measurable C hfb _ _
  · exact ((continuous_id.mul (hdfc.comp (by fun_prop))).const_mul _).aestronglyMeasurable
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun y z _ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm C]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdf _) (abs_nonneg _))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · exact (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul C).const_mul _
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun y z _ => ?_)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Real.exp (-t) * z + ouB t * y) (Real.exp (-t)) z := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul (Real.exp (-t))).add_const (ouB t * y)
    have := ((hfd _).hasDerivAt.comp z h1).const_mul y
    refine this.congr_deriv ?_
    ring

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_ouP_space
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_ouP_space (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (ouP t f) (Real.exp (-t) * ouP t (deriv f) x) x
proof:
:=
  hasDerivAt_ornsteinUhlenbeck f hf C hdf t x

name: NLAlib.deriv_ouP_eq
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rw [(hasDerivAt_ouP_space f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).deriv,
    ← ibp_noise f hf C hfb hdf t ht x]
  have := ouB_pos ht
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_deriv_ouP
statement:
private lemma hasDerivAt_deriv_ouP (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (ouP t f))
      (Real.exp (-t) ^ 2 / ouB t
        * ∫ y, y * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_ouP_eq f hf C hfb hdf t ht]
  have := (hasDerivAt_noise_moment f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).const_mul (Real.exp (-t) / ouB t)
  refine this.congr_deriv ?_
  ring

name: NLAlib.time_deriv_eq_generator
statement:
private lemma time_deriv_eq_generator (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ y, deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-t) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * t)) / ouB t * y) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x - x * deriv (ouP t f) x
proof:
:= by
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  rw [(hasDerivAt_deriv_ouP f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_ouP_space f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).deriv]
  have e : ∀ y, deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y)
      * (-Real.exp (-t) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * t)) / ouB t * y)
      = (-Real.exp (-t) * x) * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y)
        + Real.exp (-(2 * t)) / ouB t * (y * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y)) := by
    intro y; ring
  simp_rw [e]
  have i1 : Integrable (fun y => (-Real.exp (-t) * x) * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y))
      (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (integrable_bdd_comp (deriv f) hdfc.measurable C hdf _ _).const_mul _
  have i2 : Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (-(2 * t)) / ouB t
      * (y * deriv f (Real.exp (-t) * x + ouB t * y))) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
    (integrable_y_mul_bdd_comp (deriv f) hdfc.measurable C hdf _ _).const_mul _
  rw [integral_add i1 i2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, ouB_sq_eq_exp]
  unfold ouP
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_deriv_ouP_le
statement: private lemma abs_deriv_ouP_le (x : ℝ) : |deriv (ouP t f) x| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  rw [(hasDerivAt_ouP_space f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).deriv, abs_mul,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  have h1 := abs_ouP_le (deriv f) hdfc.measurable C hdf t x
  have h2 : Real.exp (-t) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hdf 0)
  nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-t), abs_nonneg (ouP t (deriv f) x)]

name: NLAlib.abs_deriv_deriv_ouP_le
statement:
private lemma abs_deriv_deriv_ouP_le (x : ℝ) :
    |deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x| ≤ 1 / ouB t * (C * ∫ y, |y| ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  rw [(hasDerivAt_deriv_ouP f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).deriv, abs_mul]
  have hb := ouB_pos ht
  have h1 := abs_noise_moment_le (deriv f) hdfc.measurable C hdf (Real.exp (-t) * x) (ouB t)
  have h2 : |Real.exp (-t) ^ 2 / ouB t| ≤ 1 / ouB t := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hb.le
    rw [ouB_sq_eq_exp]; exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  exact mul_le_mul h2 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.entropy_ibp_space
statement:
private lemma entropy_ibp_space (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hlow : ∀ z, δ ≤ f z) :
    ∫ x, (Real.log (ouP t f x) + 1)
        * (deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x - x * deriv (ouP t f) x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = -∫ x, deriv (ouP t f) x ^ 2 / ouP t f x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  set u := ouP t f with hu
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hdf 0)
  have hδC : δ ≤ C := (hlow 0).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hfb 0))
  have hu_low : ∀ x, δ ≤ u x := by
    intro x
    have := integral_mono (integrable_const δ) (integrable_bdd_comp f hfc.measurable C hfb
      (Real.exp (-t) * x) (ouB t)) (fun y => hlow _)
    simpa [hu, ouP] using this
  have hu_up : ∀ x, u x ≤ C := fun x =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_ouP_le f hfc.measurable C hfb t x)
  have hu_pos : ∀ x, 0 < u x := fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (hu_low x)
  set K1 := |Real.log δ| + |Real.log C| + 1 with hK1
  have hlog : ∀ x, |Real.log (u x) + 1| ≤ K1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : Real.log δ ≤ Real.log (u x) := Real.log_le_log hδ (hu_low x)
    have h2 : Real.log (u x) ≤ Real.log C := Real.log_le_log (hu_pos x) (hu_up x)
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_one]
    have : |Real.log (u x)| ≤ |Real.log δ| + |Real.log C| := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor
      · linarith [neg_abs_le (Real.log δ), abs_nonneg (Real.log C)]
      · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log C), abs_nonneg (Real.log δ)]
    linarith
  set B2 := 1 / ouB t * (C * ∫ y, |y| ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) with hB2
  have hB2 : 0 ≤ B2 := by
    have := ouB_pos ht
    have : 0 ≤ ∫ y, |y| ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := integral_nonneg (fun y => abs_nonneg y)
    positivity
  have hd1 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt u (deriv u x) x := fun x =>
    (hasDerivAt_ouP_space f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hd2 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (deriv u) (deriv (deriv u) x) x := fun x =>
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_ouP f hf C hfb hdf t ht x).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have hucont : Continuous u := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun x => (hd1 x).continuousAt)
  have hb1 : ∀ x, |deriv u x| ≤ C := abs_deriv_ouP_le f hf C hfb hdf t ht
  have hb2 : ∀ x, |deriv (deriv u) x| ≤ B2 := abs_deriv_deriv_ouP_le f hf C hfb hdf t ht
  
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => deriv u x * (Real.log (u x) + 1) with hh
  have hdh : ∀ x, HasDerivAt h
      (deriv (deriv u) x * (Real.log (u x) + 1) + deriv u x * (deriv u x / u x)) x := by
    intro x
    have hl := ((hd1 x).log (hu_pos x).ne').add_const 1
    exact (hd2 x).mul hl
  have hdh_bound : ∀ x, |deriv h x| ≤ B2 * K1 + C * (C / δ) := by
    intro x
    rw [(hdh x).deriv]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (hu_pos x)]
    have e1 := mul_le_mul (hb2 x) (hlog x) (abs_nonneg _) hB2
    have e2 : |deriv u x| / u x ≤ C / δ := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (hu_pos x) hδ]
      nlinarith [hb1 x, hu_low x, abs_nonneg (deriv u x)]
    have e3 := mul_le_mul (hb1 x) e2 (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hu_pos x).le) hC
    linarith
  have hibp := integral_mul_eq_integral_deriv_gaussianReal h (fun x => (hdh x).differentiableAt) _
    hdh_bound
  simp_rw [fun x => (hdh x).deriv] at hibp
  
  have hm1 : Measurable (deriv u) := measurable_deriv u
  have hm2 : Measurable (deriv (deriv u)) := measurable_deriv _
  have hmlog : Measurable (fun x => Real.log (u x) + 1) :=
    (hucont.measurable.log).add_const 1
  have iA : Integrable (fun x => deriv (deriv u) x * (Real.log (u x) + 1)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (B2 * K1)) (hm2.mul hmlog).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hb2 x) (hlog x) (abs_nonneg _) hB2
  have iB : Integrable (fun x => deriv u x * (deriv u x / u x)) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (C * (C / δ)))
      (hm1.mul (hm1.div hucont.measurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (hu_pos x)]
    have e2 : |deriv u x| / u x ≤ C / δ := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (hu_pos x) hδ]
      nlinarith [hb1 x, hu_low x, abs_nonneg (deriv u x)]
    exact mul_le_mul (hb1 x) e2 (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hu_pos x).le) hC
  have iX : Integrable (fun x => x * h x) (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul (C * K1))
      ((measurable_id.mul (hm1.mul hmlog))).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, hh]
    simp only [abs_mul]
    rw [mul_comm (C * K1)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul (hb1 x) (hlog x) (abs_nonneg _) hC)
      (abs_nonneg _)
  have e : ∀ x, (Real.log (u x) + 1) * (deriv (deriv u) x - x * deriv u x)
      = deriv (deriv u) x * (Real.log (u x) + 1) - x * h x := by
    intro x; simp only [hh]; ring
  simp_rw [e]
  rw [integral_sub iA iX, hibp, integral_add iA iB]
  have e2 : ∀ x, deriv u x * (deriv u x / u x) = deriv u x ^ 2 / u x := by
    intro x; ring
  simp_rw [e2]
  ring

name: NLAlib.ouB_ball_bounds
statement:
private lemma ouB_ball_bounds {s₀ s : ℝ} (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hs : s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ (s₀ / 2)) :
    0 < s ∧ |Real.exp (-s)| ≤ 1 ∧ |Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s| ≤ 1 / ouB (s₀ / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < ouB (s₀ / 2) := ouB_pos (by linarith)
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hs
  have hs1 : s₀ / 2 < s := by linarith
  have hspos : 0 < s := by linarith
  refine ⟨hspos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]; exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
  · have hbs : ouB (s₀ / 2) ≤ ouB s := ouB_mono hs1.le
    rw [abs_of_pos (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (ouB_pos hspos)),
      div_le_div_iff₀ (ouB_pos hspos) hb0]
    have : Real.exp (-(2 * s)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_ornsteinUhlenbeck_mul_log
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_ornsteinUhlenbeck_mul_log (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (δ C : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hlow : ∀ x, δ ≤ f x) (hup : ∀ x, f x ≤ C)
    (hdf : ∀ x, |deriv f x| ≤ C) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s => ∫ x, ornsteinUhlenbeck s f x * Real.log (ornsteinUhlenbeck s f x)
        ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
      (-∫ x, deriv (ornsteinUhlenbeck t f) x ^ 2 / ornsteinUhlenbeck t f x
        ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) t
proof:
:= by
  show HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, ouP s f x * Real.log (ouP s f x) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
    (-∫ x, deriv (ouP t f) x ^ 2 / ouP t f x ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) t
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  have hdfc : Continuous (deriv f) := hf.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hC : δ ≤ C := (hlow 0).trans (hup 0)
  have hC0 : 0 < C := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hC
  have hfb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C := fun x => by
    rw [abs_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (hlow x))]; exact hup x
  
  have hu_low : ∀ s x, δ ≤ ouP s f x := by
    intro s x
    have := integral_mono (integrable_const δ) (integrable_bdd_comp f hfc.measurable C hfb
      (Real.exp (-s) * x) (ouB s)) (fun y => hlow _)
    simpa [ouP] using this
  have hu_up : ∀ s x, ouP s f x ≤ C := fun s x =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans (abs_ouP_le f hfc.measurable C hfb s x)
  have hu_pos : ∀ s x, 0 < ouP s f x := fun s x => lt_of_lt_of_le hδ (hu_low s x)
  set K1 := |Real.log δ| + |Real.log C| + 1 with hK1
  have hlog : ∀ s x, |Real.log (ouP s f x)| ≤ K1 - 1 := by
    intro s x
    have h1 : Real.log δ ≤ Real.log (ouP s f x) := Real.log_le_log hδ (hu_low s x)
    have h2 : Real.log (ouP s f x) ≤ Real.log C := Real.log_le_log (hu_pos s x) (hu_up s x)
    rw [abs_le]; constructor
    · linarith [neg_abs_le (Real.log δ), abs_nonneg (Real.log C)]
    · linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log C), abs_nonneg (Real.log δ)]
  have hlog1 : ∀ s x, |Real.log (ouP s f x) + 1| ≤ K1 := fun s x => by
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_; rw [abs_one]; linarith [hlog s x]
  have hK1 : 0 ≤ K1 := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hlog1 0 0)
  have hcont : ∀ s, Continuous (ouP s f) := fun s => continuous_iff_continuousAt.2
    (fun x => (hasDerivAt_ornsteinUhlenbeck f hf C hdf s x :
      HasDerivAt (ouP s f) _ x).continuousAt)
  
  set D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s x => ∫ y, deriv f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) with hD
  set K := 1 / ouB (t / 2) with hK
  set M1 := ∫ y, |y| ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) with hM1
  have hD_bound : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball t (t / 2), ∀ x, |D s x| ≤ C * |x| + C * K * M1 := by
    intro s hs x
    obtain ⟨_, ha, hb⟩ := ouB_ball_bounds ht hs
    have hint : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => C * (|x| + K * |y|)) (gaussianReal 0 1) :=
      ((integrable_const _).add (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul K)).const_mul C
    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (f := fun y => deriv f (Real.exp (-s) * x + ouB s * y)
        * (-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y)) hint
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      have h1 : |-Real.exp (-s) * x + Real.exp (-(2 * s)) / ouB s * y| ≤ |x| + K * |y| := by
        refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (abs_nonneg x)
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (abs_nonneg y)
        linarith
      exact mul_le_mul (hdf _) h1 (abs_nonneg _) hC0.le))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [integral_const_mul,
      integral_add (integrable_const _) (integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul K),
      integral_const_mul]
    simp; ring
  
  have hmain := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := gaussianReal 0 1)
    (F := fun s x => ouP s f x * Real.log (ouP s f x))
    (F' := fun s x => (Real.log (ouP s f x) + 1) * D s x)
    (x₀ := t) (bound := fun x => K1 * (C * |x| + C * K * M1))
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t (by linarith : 0 < t / 2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · refine hmain.2.congr_deriv ?_
    have e : ∀ x, (Real.log (ouP t f x) + 1) * D t x = (Real.log (ouP t f x) + 1)
        * (deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x - x * deriv (ouP t f) x) := by
      intro x
      rw [hD]
      simp only
      rw [time_deriv_eq_generator f hf C hfb hdf t ht x]
    simp_rw [e]
    exact entropy_ibp_space f hf C hfb hdf t ht δ hδ hlow
  · exact Eventually.of_forall (fun s =>
      ((hcont s).measurable.mul (hcont s).measurable.log).aestronglyMeasurable)
  · refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (C * (K1 - 1)))
      ((hcont t).measurable.mul (hcont t).measurable.log).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul ((le_abs_self _).trans (abs_ouP_le f hfc.measurable C hfb t x) |>.trans'
      (by rw [abs_of_pos (hu_pos t x)])) (hlog t x) (abs_nonneg _) hC0.le
  · have e : D t = fun x => deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x - x * deriv (ouP t f) x :=
      funext (time_deriv_eq_generator f hf C hfb hdf t ht)
    rw [show (fun x => (Real.log (ouP t f x) + 1) * D t x)
      = fun x => (Real.log (ouP t f x) + 1) * (deriv (deriv (ouP t f)) x
          - x * deriv (ouP t f) x) from by rw [e]]
    exact (((hcont t).measurable.log.add_const 1).mul ((measurable_deriv _).sub
      (measurable_id.mul (measurable_deriv _)))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun x s hs => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hlog1 s x) (hD_bound s hs x) (abs_nonneg _) hK1
  · exact (((integrable_abs_gaussianReal.const_mul C).add (integrable_const _))).const_mul K1
  · refine Eventually.of_forall (fun x s hs => ?_)
    have h1 := hasDerivAt_ouP_time f hf C hfb hdf x s (ouB_ball_bounds ht hs).1
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_mul_log (hu_pos s x).ne').comp s h1

name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine_product
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine_product
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → κ → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X P)
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (hfc : Continuous f)
    (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C C' : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun q => B q.2 (f (μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2))) (P.prod γ) ∧
      ∀ i j, Integrable (fun q => B (Pi.single i 1)
        (df (μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))) (P.prod γ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hXa : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun q : Ω × (κ → ℝ) => X q.1) (P.prod γ) :=
    hX.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_measurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P) (ν := γ))
  have hZi : Integrable (fun q : Ω × (κ → ℝ) => q.2) (P.prod γ) :=
    (hγ.memLp_two.integrable one_le_two).comp_snd P
  have hY : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun q : Ω × (κ → ℝ) => μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (P.prod γ) :=
    (aestronglyMeasurable_const.add
      ((hXa.sub aestronglyMeasurable_const).const_smul a)).add
        (hZi.aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul b)
  constructor
  · exact B.integrable_of_bilin_of_bdd_right C hZi
      (hfc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun q => hfb _))
  · intro i j
    have hcoef : Continuous (fun y : κ → ℝ => B (Pi.single i 1) (df y (Pi.single j 1))) :=
      (B _).continuous.comp (hdf.clm_apply continuous_const)
    refine Integrable.of_bound (hcoef.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hY)
      (‖B (Pi.single i 1)‖ * (C' * ‖(Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : κ → ℝ)‖)) ?_
    filter_upwards [] with q
    exact ((B (Pi.single i 1)).le_opNorm _).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((df _).le_opNorm _) (norm_nonneg _)).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb _) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_gaussian_affine_product
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_gaussian_affine_product
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → κ → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X P)
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (μ : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C C' : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ q, B q.2 (f (μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2)) ∂P.prod γ) =
      b • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] •
        ∫ q, B (Pi.single i 1)
          (df (μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂P.prod γ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => (hf y).continuousAt)
  have hi := integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine_product P X hX γ hγ μ a b f hfc df hdf
    C C' hfb hdfb B
  let c (i j : κ) : ℝ := cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ]
  let G (i j : κ) (q : Ω × (κ → ℝ)) : ℂ :=
    B (Pi.single i 1) (df (μ + a • (X q.1 - μ) + b • q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
  have hinner (i j : κ) : Integrable (fun p => ∫ z, G i j (p, z) ∂γ) P :=
    (hi.2 i j).integral_prod_left
  have hterm (i j : κ) : Integrable (fun p => c i j • ∫ z, G i j (p, z) ∂γ) P := by
    refine ((hinner i j).smul (c i j)).congr ?_
    filter_upwards [] with p
    rfl
  have hsum (i : κ) : Integrable (fun p => ∑ j, c i j • ∫ z, G i j (p, z) ∂γ) P :=
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hterm i j)
  calc
    _ = ∫ p, ∫ z, B z (f (μ + a • (X p - μ) + b • z)) ∂γ ∂P :=
      integral_prod _ hi.1
    _ = ∫ p, b • ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j • ∫ z, G i j (p, z) ∂γ ∂P := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      exact integral_bilin_gaussian_affine γ hγ hmean μ (X p) a b f df hf hdf C C' hfb hdfb B
    _ = b • ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j • ∫ q, G i j q ∂P.prod γ := by
      rw [integral_smul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hsum i)]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi'
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hterm i j)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj'
      rw [integral_smul, ← integral_prod _ (hi.2 i j)]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_gaussian_sqrt_interpolation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_gaussian_sqrt_interpolation
    (γY γZ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γY] [IsGaussian γZ]
    (hYmean : (∫ y : E, y ∂γY)=0) (hZmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γZ)=0)
    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (ddf : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x)
    (hdf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt df (ddf x) x) (hddfc : Continuous ddf)
    (C₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤C₀)
    (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤C₁) (hddfb : ∀ x, ‖ddf x‖≤C₂)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht1 : t<1) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => ∫ q : E×E, f (Real.sqrt s•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-s)•q.2) ∂γY.prod γZ)
      ((1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-
          cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ]) •
          ∫ q : E×E, ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2)
            (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1) ∂γY.prod γZ) t
proof:
:= by
  have hdfc : Continuous df := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hdf x).continuousAt
  have hC₁ : 0≤C₁ := (norm_nonneg (df 0)).trans (hdfb 0)
  let a := Real.sqrt t
  let b := Real.sqrt (1-t)
  let W (q : E×E) := a•q.1+b•q.2
  let G (i j : κ) (q : E×E) := ddf (W q) (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1)
  have hYint : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.1) (γY.prod γZ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γY)).comp_fst γZ
  have hZint : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.2) (γY.prod γZ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γZ)).comp_snd γY
  have hiY : Integrable (fun q : E×E => df (W q) q.1) (γY.prod γZ) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun q : E×E => df (W q) q.1) := by dsimp only [W]; fun_prop
    apply Integrable.mono' (hYint.norm.const_mul C₁) hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => ((df _).le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hiZ : Integrable (fun q : E×E => df (W q) q.2) (γY.prod γZ) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun q : E×E => df (W q) q.2) := by dsimp only [W]; fun_prop
    apply Integrable.mono' (hZint.norm.const_mul C₁) hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => ((df _).le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hZ : (∫ q : E×E, df (W q) q.2 ∂γY.prod γZ) =
      b • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ] •
        ∫ q, G i j q ∂γY.prod γZ :=
    integral_apply_gaussian_affine γY γZ hZmean a b df ddf hdf hddfc C₁ C₂ hdfb hddfb
  have hY : (∫ q : E×E, df (W q) q.1 ∂γY.prod γZ) =
      a • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY] •
        ∫ q, G i j q ∂γY.prod γZ := by
    have hh := integral_apply_gaussian_affine γZ γY hYmean b a df ddf hdf hddfc
      C₁ C₂ hdfb hddfb
    have he : (∫ q : E×E, df (b•q.1+a•q.2) q.2 ∂γZ.prod γY) =
        ∫ q : E×E, df (W q) q.1 ∂γY.prod γZ := by
      simpa only [W,Prod.swap,add_comm] using
        (integral_prod_swap (μ := γY) (ν := γZ) (fun q : E×E => df (W q) q.1))
    have hG (i j : κ) :
        (∫ q : E×E, ddf (b•q.1+a•q.2) (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1) ∂γZ.prod γY) =
          ∫ q, G i j q ∂γY.prod γZ := by
      simpa only [G,W,Prod.swap,add_comm] using
        (integral_prod_swap (μ := γY) (ν := γZ) (G i j))
    rw [he] at hh
    simp_rw [hG] at hh
    exact hh
  have hchain := hasDerivAt_integral_sqrt_affine_path
    (fun q : E×E => q.1) (fun q : E×E => q.2) hYint hZint 0 f df hf hdfc
      C₀ C₁ hC₁ hfb hdfb ht ht1
  simp only [zero_add] at hchain
  have hcancelA : (1/(2*a))*a=(1/2 : ℝ) := by
    have ha : a≠0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht).ne'
    field_simp [ha]
  have hcancelB : (1/(2*b))*b=(1/2 : ℝ) := by
    have hb : b≠0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith : 0<1-t)).ne'
    field_simp [hb]
  have he : (∫ q : E×E, df (W q) ((1/(2*a))•q.1-(1/(2*b))•q.2) ∂γY.prod γZ) =
      (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-
          cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ]) •
          ∫ q, G i j q ∂γY.prod γZ := by
    simp_rw [map_sub,map_smul]
    have hiYs : Integrable (fun q : E×E => (1/(2*a)) • df (W q) q.1) (γY.prod γZ) :=
      hiY.smul _
    have hiZs : Integrable (fun q : E×E => (1/(2*b)) • df (W q) q.2) (γY.prod γZ) :=
      hiZ.smul _
    rw [integral_sub hiYs hiZs,integral_smul,integral_smul,hY,hZ,
      smul_smul,smul_smul,hcancelA,hcancelB]
    simp only [sub_smul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,smul_sub]
  exact hchain.congr_deriv he

name: NLAlib.integral_sub_integral_eq_gaussian_covariance_difference_integral
statement:
theorem integral_sub_integral_eq_gaussian_covariance_difference_integral
    (γY γZ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γY] [IsGaussian γZ]
    (hYmean : (∫ y : E, y ∂γY)=0) (hZmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γZ)=0)
    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (ddf : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x)
    (hdf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt df (ddf x) x) (hddfc : Continuous ddf)
    (C₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤C₀)
    (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤C₁) (hddfb : ∀ x, ‖ddf x‖≤C₂) :
    (∫ y : E, f y ∂γY)-(∫ z : E, f z ∂γZ) =
      (1/2 : ℝ) • ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-
          cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ]) •
          ∫ q : E×E, ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2)
            (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1) ∂γY.prod γZ
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  let H (t : ℝ) := ∫ q : E×E, f (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2) ∂γY.prod γZ
  let D (t : ℝ) := ∑ i, ∑ j,
    (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γY]-
      cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γZ]) •
      ∫ q : E×E, ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2)
        (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1) ∂γY.prod γZ
  have hYint : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.1) (γY.prod γZ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γY)).comp_fst γZ
  have hZint : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.2) (γY.prod γZ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γZ)).comp_snd γY
  have hHc : Continuous H := by
    simpa only [zero_add,H] using continuous_integral_affine_path
      (fun q : E×E => q.1) (fun q : E×E => q.2)
      hYint.aestronglyMeasurable hZint.aestronglyMeasurable 0
      Real.sqrt (fun t : ℝ => Real.sqrt (1-t)) Real.continuous_sqrt
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)) f hfc C₀ hfb
  have hDc : Continuous D := by
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro i _
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro j _
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ q : E×E,
        ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2)
          (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1) ∂γY.prod γZ) := by
      apply continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun _ : E×E => C₂)
      · intro t
        have hc : Continuous (fun q : E×E =>
            ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2)
              (Pi.single j 1) (Pi.single i 1)) := by fun_prop
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      · intro t
        exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
          have hd : ‖ddf (Real.sqrt t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)‖≤C₂ := by
            simpa only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] using
              ((ddf _).le_opNorm (Pi.single j 1)).trans
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hddfb _) (norm_nonneg _))
          simpa only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] using
            ((ddf _ (Pi.single j 1)).le_opNorm (Pi.single i 1)).trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd (norm_nonneg _))
      · exact integrable_const _
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by fun_prop
    exact hcont.const_smul _
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le
    (show (0 : ℝ)≤1 by norm_num) hHc.continuousOn
    (fun t ht => hasDerivAt_integral_gaussian_sqrt_interpolation γY γZ hYmean hZmean
      f df ddf hf hdf hddfc C₀ C₁ C₂ hfb hdfb hddfb ht.1 ht.2)
    ((hDc.const_smul (1/2 : ℝ)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
  have h0 : H 0=(∫ z : E, f z ∂γZ) := by
    simpa only [H,Real.sqrt_zero,sub_zero,Real.sqrt_one,zero_smul,one_smul,zero_add,
      Function.comp_def] using
      (measurePreserving_snd (μ := γY) (ν := γZ)).hasLaw.integral_comp hfc.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h1 : H 1=(∫ y : E, f y ∂γY) := by
    simpa only [H,sub_self,Real.sqrt_zero,Real.sqrt_one,zero_smul,one_smul,add_zero,
      Function.comp_def] using
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := γY) (ν := γZ)).hasLaw.integral_comp hfc.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul,h0,h1] at hFTC
  exact hFTC.symm

name: NLAlib.integrable_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw
    (V : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hV : HasGaussianLaw V P)
    (G : (ι → ℝ) → ℂ) (hGc : Continuous G) (C : ℝ) (hGb : ∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun ω => G (V ω)) P
proof:
:= by
  have := hV.isProbabilityMeasure
  exact Integrable.mono' (integrable_const C)
    (hGc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hV.aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => hGb _))

name: NLAlib.integrable_smul_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw
statement:
theorem integrable_smul_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw
    (U : Ω → ℝ) (V : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hUV : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (U ω, fun j => V j ω)) P)
    (G : (ι → ℝ) → ℂ) (hGc : Continuous G) (C : ℝ) (hGb : ∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ C) :
    Integrable (fun ω => U ω • G (fun j => V j ω)) P
proof:
:= by
  have := hUV.isProbabilityMeasure
  have hUi : Integrable U P := hUV.fst.memLp_two.integrable one_le_two
  have hGa := hGc.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hUV.snd.aemeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
  refine Integrable.mono' (hUi.norm.mul_const C)
    (hUi.aestronglyMeasurable.smul hGa) ?_
  filter_upwards [] with ω
  rw [norm_smul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hGb _) (norm_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.integral_smul_eq_sum_covariance_smul_integral_complex
statement:
theorem integral_smul_eq_sum_covariance_smul_integral_complex
    (U : Ω → ℝ) (V : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hUV : HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (U ω, fun j => V j ω)) P)
    (hU0 : ∫ ω, U ω ∂P = 0)
    (G : (ι → ℝ) → ℂ) (G' : ι → (ι → ℝ) → ℂ)
    (hG : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt G
      (∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j).smulRight
        (G' j x)) x)
    (hG'c : ∀ j, Continuous (G' j)) (C C' : ℝ)
    (hGb : ∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ C) (hG'b : ∀ j x, ‖G' j x‖ ≤ C') :
    (∫ ω, U ω • G (fun j => V j ω) ∂P) =
      ∑ j, cov[U, V j; P] • ∫ ω, G' j (fun j => V j ω) ∂P
proof:
:= by
  have hGc : Continuous G := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => (hG x).continuousAt
  have hleft := integrable_smul_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw U V hUV G hGc C hGb
  have hpartial (j : ι) : Integrable (fun ω => G' j (fun k => V k ω)) P :=
    integrable_complex_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw _ hUV.snd _ (hG'c j) C' (hG'b j)
  have hRe (x : ι → ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (G y).re)
      (∑ j, (G' j x).re • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j) x := by
    have he : Complex.reCLM.comp (∑ j,
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j).smulRight (G' j x)) =
        ∑ j, (G' j x).re • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j := by
      ext y
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_comm]
    have h := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hG x)
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have hIm (x : ι → ℝ) : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (G y).im)
      (∑ j, (G' j x).im • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j) x := by
    have he : Complex.imCLM.comp (∑ j,
        (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j).smulRight (G' j x)) =
        ∑ j, (G' j x).im • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℝ) j := by
      ext y
      simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_comm]
    have h := Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hG x)
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have hR := integral_mul_eq_sum_covariance_mul_integral U V hUV hU0
    (fun x => (G x).re) (fun j x => (G' j x).re) hRe
    (fun j => Complex.continuous_re.comp (hG'c j)) (max C C')
    (fun x => (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans ((hGb x).trans (le_max_left _ _)))
    (fun j x => (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans ((hG'b j x).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hI := integral_mul_eq_sum_covariance_mul_integral U V hUV hU0
    (fun x => (G x).im) (fun j x => (G' j x).im) hIm
    (fun j => Complex.continuous_im.comp (hG'c j)) (max C C')
    (fun x => (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans ((hGb x).trans (le_max_left _ _)))
    (fun j x => (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans ((hG'b j x).trans (le_max_right _ _)))
  have hrint (f : Ω → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f P) :
      (∫ ω, f ω ∂P).re = ∫ ω, (f ω).re ∂P :=
    (Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hf).symm
  have hiint (f : Ω → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f P) :
      (∫ ω, f ω ∂P).im = ∫ ω, (f ω).im ∂P :=
    (Complex.imCLM.integral_comp_comm hf).symm
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [hrint _ hleft]
    simp only [Complex.re_sum, Complex.smul_re, smul_eq_mul]
    simp_rw [hrint _ (hpartial _)]
    exact hR
  · rw [hiint _ hleft]
    simp only [Complex.im_sum, Complex.smul_im, smul_eq_mul]
    simp_rw [hiint _ (hpartial _)]
    exact hI

name: NLAlib.gaussian_coordinate_joint
proof:
:= by
  let L : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × (κ → ℝ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) i).prod
