name: NLAlib.integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine
statement:
theorem integrable_bilin_gaussian_affine
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (μ x : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (f : (κ → ℝ) → F)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (C : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C)
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    Integrable (fun z => B z (f (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z))) γ
proof:
:=
  integrable_bilin_comp_of_hasGaussianLaw id hγ
    (fun z => f (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z))
    (hfc.comp (by fun_prop)) C (fun z => hfb _) B

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_gaussian_affine
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_gaussian_affine
    (γ : Measure (κ → ℝ)) (hγ : HasGaussianLaw (id : (κ → ℝ) → κ → ℝ) γ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ z, z i ∂γ = 0)
    (μ x : κ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (df : (κ → ℝ) → (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt f (df y) y) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (C C' : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ y, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) (hdfb : ∀ y, ‖df y‖ ≤ C')
    (B : (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ z, B z (f (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)) ∂γ) =
      b • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : κ → ℝ => z i), (fun z : κ → ℝ => z j); γ] •
        ∫ z, B (Pi.single i 1) (df (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hγ.isProbabilityMeasure
  let g : (κ → ℝ) → F := fun z => f (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)
  let g' : κ → (κ → ℝ) → F := fun j z =>
    b • df (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z) (Pi.single j 1)
  have hg (z : κ → ℝ) : HasFDerivAt g
      (∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) j).smulRight
        (g' j z)) z := by
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun w : κ → ℝ => μ + a • (x - μ) + b • w)
        (b • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (κ → ℝ)) z := by
      simpa using (hasFDerivAt_const (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ + a • (x - μ)) z).add
        ((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) z).const_smul b)
    have h := (hf (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)).comp z hA
    have he : (df (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)).comp
        (b • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (κ → ℝ)) =
        ∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) j).smulRight
          (g' j z) := by
      symm
      convert ContinuousLinearMap.sum_proj_smulRight
        ((df (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)).comp
          (b • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (κ → ℝ))) using 1
      simp [g', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have hg'c (j : κ) : Continuous (g' j) := by
    dsimp [g']
    exact ((hdf.comp (by fun_prop)).clm_apply continuous_const).const_smul b
  have hg'b (j : κ) (z : κ → ℝ) : ‖g' j z‖ ≤ |b| * C' := by
    dsimp [g']
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
    have h := ((df (μ + a • (x - μ) + b • z)).le_opNorm (Pi.single j 1)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb _) (norm_nonneg _))
    simpa only [Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one] using h
  have h := integral_bilin_eq_sum_covariance_smul_integral_of_hasGaussianLaw id hγ hmean
    g g' hg hg'c C (|b| * C') (fun z => hfb _) hg'b B
  simpa only [id_eq, g, g', map_smul, integral_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul,
    mul_comm b] using h

name: NLAlib.standard_integral_id
statement: private theorem standard_integral_id : (∫ x : E, x ∂gaussianVector κ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianVector κ).memLp_two.integrable one_le_two
  ext k
  have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) k).integral_comp_comm hi
  have hz := integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector k)
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using he.symm.trans hz

name: NLAlib.standard_covariance
proof:
:= by
  rw [covariance_eq_sub (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector i))
    (memLp_two_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector j))]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [integral_mul_apply_gaussianVector,
    integral_eq_zero_of_hasLaw_gaussianReal (hasLaw_eval_gaussianVector i),
    zero_mul, sub_zero]

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_standardGaussianCorrelation
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_standardGaussianCorrelation (t : ℝ)
    (ht : -1 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun q : E × E => t • q.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • q.2)
      ((gaussianVector κ).prod (gaussianVector κ)) (gaussianVector κ)
proof:
:= by
  let θ := Real.arccos t
  have hr : MeasurePreserving (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ)
      ((gaussianVector κ).prod (gaussianVector κ))
      ((gaussianVector κ).prod (gaussianVector κ)) :=
    ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ).continuous.measurable,
      IsGaussian.map_rotation_eq_self standard_integral_id θ⟩
  have h := (measurePreserving_fst (μ := gaussianVector κ) (ν := gaussianVector κ)).comp hr
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.rotation_apply, θ,
    Real.cos_arccos ht ht1, Real.sin_arccos] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_standard_gaussian_gradient_integral
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_standard_gaussian_gradient_integral
    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (g : E → G) (dg : E → E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x) (hdfc : Continuous df)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (dg x) x) (hdgc : Continuous dg)
    (Cf Cd Cg Ce : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ Cf) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖ ≤ Cd)
    (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ Cg) (hdgb : ∀ x, ‖dg x‖ ≤ Ce)
    (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂gaussianVector κ) -
        B (∫ y : E, f y ∂gaussianVector κ) (∫ y : E, g y ∂gaussianVector κ) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ k,
        ∫ q : E × E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single k 1))
          (dg (t • q.1 + Real.sqrt (1 - t ^ 2) • q.2) (Pi.single k 1))
            ∂(gaussianVector κ).prod (gaussianVector κ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_gaussian_covariance_integral
    (gaussianVector κ) standard_integral_id f df g dg hf hdfc hg hdgc
    Cf Cd Cg Ce hfb hdfb hgb hdgb B
  simpa only [standard_covariance, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_smul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_smul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian
    (f : (κ → ℝ) → F) (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (i : κ)
    (hfi : Integrable f (gaussianVector κ))
    (hxfi : Integrable (fun x => x i • f x) (gaussianVector κ))
    (hdfi : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1)) (gaussianVector κ)) :
    (∫ x : κ → ℝ, x i • f x ∂gaussianVector κ) =
      ∫ x : κ → ℝ, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) ∂gaussianVector κ
proof:
:= by
  apply (SeparatingDual.eq_iff_forall_dual_eq (R := ℝ)).mpr
  intro ℓ
  have hd (x : κ → ℝ) : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ℓ (f y)) x=ℓ.comp (fderiv ℝ f x) :=
    (ℓ.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hf x).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  have hs := integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian
    (fun x => ℓ (f x)) (ℓ.differentiable.comp hf) i (ℓ.integrable_comp hfi)
    (by simpa only [map_smul,smul_eq_mul] using ℓ.integrable_comp hxfi)
    (by
      have hh := ℓ.integrable_comp hdfi
      simp_rw [hd,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      exact hh)
  simp_rw [hd,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs
  rw [← ℓ.integral_comp_comm hxfi,← ℓ.integral_comp_comm hdfi]
  simpa only [map_smul,smul_eq_mul] using hs

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (df : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hupdate : ∀ x t, HasDerivAt (fun y => f (Function.update x i y))
      (df (Function.update x i t)) t)
    (hfi : Integrable f (gaussianVector ι))
    (hxfi : Integrable (fun x => x i * f x)
      (gaussianVector ι))
    (hdfi : Integrable (fun x => df x)
      (gaussianVector ι)) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, x i * f x ∂(gaussianVector _)) =
      ∫ x : ι → ℝ, df x
        ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  let γ : ι → Measure ℝ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hleft :=
    integral_integral_update_pi γ i hxfi
  have hright :=
    integral_integral_update_pi γ i hdfi
  have hsections :
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(Measure.pi γ),
        (∫ t, t * f (Function.update x i t) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) =
        ∫ t, df (Function.update x i t)
          ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_integrable_comp_update_pi γ i hfi,
      ae_integrable_comp_update_pi γ i hxfi,
      ae_integrable_comp_update_pi γ i hdfi] with x h1 h2 h3
    have hd (t : ℝ) :
        HasDerivAt (fun y => f (Function.update x i y))
          (df (Function.update x i t)) t :=
      hupdate x t
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) :=
      fun t => (hd t).differentiableAt
    have hdeq : deriv (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) =
        fun t => df (Function.update x i t) :=
      funext fun t => (hd t).deriv
    have hdi : Integrable (deriv (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)))
        (gaussianReal 0 1) := by
      rw [hdeq]
      exact h3
    have hi := integral_mul_eq_integral_deriv_gaussianReal_of_integrable
      (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) hdiff h1
      (by simpa only [Function.update_self] using h2) hdi
    simpa only [hdeq] using hi
  calc
    _ = (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ∫ t, t * f (Function.update x i t) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
        ∂(Measure.pi γ)) := by
      simpa only [Function.update_self] using hleft.symm
    _ = (∫ x : ι → ℝ, ∫ t,
        df (Function.update x i t)
          ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) ∂(Measure.pi γ)) :=
      integral_congr_ae hsections
    _ = _ := hright

name: NLAlib.integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian
statement:
theorem integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussian
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (i : ι)
    (hfi : Integrable f (gaussianVector ι))
    (hxfi : Integrable (fun x => x i * f x)
      (gaussianVector ι))
    (hdfi : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1))
      (gaussianVector ι)) :
    (∫ x : ι → ℝ, x i * f x ∂(gaussianVector _)) =
      ∫ x : ι → ℝ, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1)
        ∂(gaussianVector _)
proof:
:= by
  apply integral_coordinate_mul_eq_integral_gaussian_of_hasDerivAt_update f
    (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1)) i _ hfi hxfi hdfi
  intro x t
  exact (hf (Function.update x i t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (hasDerivAt_update x i t)

name: NLAlib.rotation_inverse_fst
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change Real.cos θ*(Real.cos (-θ)*q.1 i+Real.sin (-θ)*q.2 i)+
    Real.sin θ*(-Real.sin (-θ)*q.1 i+Real.cos (-θ)*q.2 i)=q.1 i
  rw [Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg]
  linear_combination (q.1 i)*(Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ)

name: NLAlib.rotation_inverse_snd
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change -Real.sin θ*(Real.cos (-θ)*q.1 i+Real.sin (-θ)*q.2 i)+
    Real.cos θ*(-Real.sin (-θ)*q.1 i+Real.cos (-θ)*q.2 i)=q.2 i
  rw [Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg]
  linear_combination (q.2 i)*(Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ)

name: NLAlib.integral_comp_gaussian_rotation
statement:
private theorem integral_comp_gaussian_rotation
    (γ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γ] (hmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γ)=0)
    (h : E×E → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ q, h (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ q) ∂γ.prod γ)=∫ q, h q ∂γ.prod γ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ q, h q ∂(γ.prod γ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ) :=
      (integral_map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ).continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
        hh.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [IsGaussian.map_rotation_eq_self hmean θ]

name: NLAlib.hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_gaussian_rotation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_gaussian_rotation
    (γ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γ] (hmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γ)=0)
    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (g : E → G) (dg : E → E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x) (hdfc : Continuous df)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (dg x) x) (hdgc : Continuous dg)
    (Cf Cd Cg Ce : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤Cf) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤Cd)
    (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖≤Cg) (hdgb : ∀ x, ‖dg x‖≤Ce)
    (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℂ) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => ∫ q : E×E, B (f q.1)
        (g (Real.cos t•q.1+Real.sin t•q.2)) ∂γ.prod γ)
      (-Real.sin θ • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
        ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
          (dg (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ) θ
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hCe : 0≤Ce := (norm_nonneg (dg 0)).trans (hdgb 0)
  let K (w : E) : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ := B.flip.comp (dg w)
  have hK : Continuous K :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E G (F →L[ℝ] ℂ) B.flip).continuous.comp hdgc
  have hKb (w : E) : ‖K w‖≤‖B‖*Ce := by
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le B.flip (dg w)).trans (by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_flip]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdgb w) (norm_nonneg B))
  have hs := integral_parameter_bilin_gaussian_affine γ γ hmean
    (Real.cos θ) (-Real.sin θ) f df hf hdfc Cf Cd hfb hdfb K hK (‖B‖*Ce) hKb
  simp only [K,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply] at hs
  let H' (q : E×E) : ℂ := B (f q.1)
    (dg (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2) (-Real.sin θ•q.1+Real.cos θ•q.2))
  let H0 (q : E×E) : ℂ := B (f (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2)) (dg q.1 q.2)
  have hH'c : Continuous H' := by dsimp only [H']; fun_prop
  have hHchange : (∫ q, H' q ∂γ.prod γ)=(∫ q, H0 q ∂γ.prod γ) := by
    rw [← integral_comp_gaussian_rotation γ hmean H' hH'c (-θ)]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      dsimp only [H']
      rw [rotation_inverse_fst θ q,rotation_inverse_snd θ q]
      simp only [H0,ContinuousLinearMap.rotation_apply,Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg,neg_smul,
        sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hGchange (i j : κ) :
      (∫ q : E×E, B (df (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
        (dg q.1 (Pi.single i 1)) ∂γ.prod γ) =
      ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single j 1))
        (dg (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single i 1)) ∂γ.prod γ := by
    let h (q : E×E) := B (df (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
      (dg q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
    have hc : Continuous h := by dsimp only [h]; fun_prop
    rw [← integral_comp_gaussian_rotation γ hmean h hc θ]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      have he := rotation_inverse_fst (-θ) q
      simp only [neg_neg,Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg,neg_smul,← sub_eq_add_neg] at he
      dsimp only [h]
      rw [he]
      rfl
  have hval : (∫ q, H' q ∂γ.prod γ) =
      -Real.sin θ • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
        ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
          (dg (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ := by
    rw [hHchange]
    change (∫ q : E×E, B (f (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2)) (dg q.1 q.2) ∂γ.prod γ)=_
    have hss : (∫ q : E×E, B (f (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2)) (dg q.1 q.2) ∂γ.prod γ) =
        -Real.sin θ • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
          ∫ q : E×E, B (df (Real.cos θ•q.1-Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
            (dg q.1 (Pi.single i 1)) ∂γ.prod γ := by
      simpa only [neg_smul,← sub_eq_add_neg] using hs
    rw [hss]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [hGchange]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [covariance_comm]
  have hY : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.1) (γ.prod γ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)).comp_fst γ
  have hZ : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.2) (γ.prod γ) :=
    (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)).comp_snd γ
  have hh := hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_rotation (fun q : E×E => q.1) (fun q : E×E => q.2)
    hY hZ f hfc g dg hg hdgc Cf Cg Ce hfb hgb hdgb B θ
  exact hh.congr_deriv hval

name: NLAlib.integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_gaussian_covariance_integral
statement:
theorem integral_bilin_sub_bilin_integrals_eq_gaussian_covariance_integral
    [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    (γ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γ] (hmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γ)=0)
    (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (g : E → G) (dg : E → E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x) (hdfc : Continuous df)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (dg x) x) (hdgc : Continuous dg)
    (Cf Cd Cg Ce : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤Cf) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤Cd)
    (hgb : ∀ x, ‖g x‖≤Cg) (hdgb : ∀ x, ‖dg x‖≤Ce)
    (B : F →L[ℝ] G →L[ℝ] ℂ) :
    (∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂γ)-B (∫ y : E, f y ∂γ) (∫ y : E, g y ∂γ) =
      ∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
          ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
            (dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ
proof:
:= by
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hgc : Continuous g := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hg x).continuousAt
  have hCf : 0≤Cf := (norm_nonneg (f 0)).trans (hfb 0)
  have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (df 0)).trans (hdfb 0)
  have hCg : 0≤Cg := (norm_nonneg (g 0)).trans (hgb 0)
  have hCe : 0≤Ce := (norm_nonneg (dg 0)).trans (hdgb 0)
  let H (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := ∫ q : E×E, B (f q.1)
    (g (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2)) ∂γ.prod γ
  let D (t : ℝ) : ℂ := ∑ i, ∑ j,
    cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
      ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
        (dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ
  have hcoef (i j : κ) (t : ℝ) (q : E×E) :
      ‖B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
        (dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))‖≤‖B‖*Cd*Ce := by
    have hdf : ‖df q.1 (Pi.single i 1)‖≤Cd := by
      simpa only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] using
        ((df q.1).le_opNorm (Pi.single i 1)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb q.1) (norm_nonneg _))
    have hdg : ‖dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)‖≤Ce := by
      simpa only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] using
        ((dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2)).le_opNorm (Pi.single j 1)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdgb (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2)) (norm_nonneg _))
    exact (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans (by gcongr)
  have hDc : Continuous D := by
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro i _
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro j _
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ q : E×E,
        B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
          (dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ) := by
      apply continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun _ : E×E => ‖B‖*Cd*Ce)
      · intro t
        have hc : Continuous (fun q : E×E => B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
            (dg (t•q.1+Real.sqrt (1-t^2)•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))) := by fun_prop
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      · intro t
        exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => hcoef i j t q
      · exact integrable_const _
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by fun_prop
    exact hcont.const_smul (cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ])
  have hHd (θ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt H
      (-Real.sin θ • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
        ∫ q : E×E, B (df q.1 (Pi.single i 1))
          (dg (Real.cos θ•q.1+Real.sin θ•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂γ.prod γ) θ :=
    hasDerivAt_integral_bilin_gaussian_rotation γ hmean f df g dg hf hdfc hg hdgc
      Cf Cd Cg Ce hfb hdfb hgb hdgb B θ
  have hHc : Continuous H := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun θ => (hHd θ).continuousAt
  have hπ : (0 : ℝ)≤Real.pi/2 := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have htheta (θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ∈Icc (0 : ℝ) (Real.pi/2)) :
      HasDerivAt H (-Real.sin θ • D (Real.cos θ)) θ := by
    have hsin : 0≤Real.sin θ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hθ.1
      (by linarith [hθ.2,Real.pi_pos])
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (1-(Real.cos θ)^2)=Real.sin θ := by
      have he : 1-(Real.cos θ)^2=(Real.sin θ)^2 := by nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]
      rw [he,Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hsin]
    simpa only [D,hsqrt] using hHd θ
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hπ hHc.continuousOn
    (fun θ hθ => htheta θ ⟨hθ.1.le,hθ.2.le⟩)
    ((Real.continuous_sin.neg.smul (hDc.comp Real.continuous_cos)).intervalIntegrable 0 (Real.pi/2))
  have hchange := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := Real.pi/2) (f := Real.cos) (f' := fun θ => -Real.sin θ) (g := D)
    (fun θ _ => Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ) Real.continuous_sin.neg.continuousOn hDc
  simp only [Real.cos_zero,Real.cos_pi_div_two,Function.comp_def] at hchange
  have heq : (∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, D t)=H 0-H (Real.pi/2) := by
    have hh : -(∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, D t)=H (Real.pi/2)-H 0 := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_symm,← hchange]
      exact hFTC
    exact neg_injective (by simpa only [neg_sub,neg_neg] using hh)
  have h0 : H 0=(∫ y : E, B (f y) (g y) ∂γ) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun y : E => B (f y) (g y)) := by fun_prop
    simpa only [H,Real.cos_zero,Real.sin_zero,one_smul,zero_smul,add_zero,Function.comp_def] using
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := γ) (ν := γ)).hasLaw.integral_comp hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hfint : Integrable f γ := Integrable.of_bound hfc.aestronglyMeasurable Cf
    (Eventually.of_forall hfb)
  have hgint : Integrable g γ := Integrable.of_bound hgc.aestronglyMeasurable Cg
    (Eventually.of_forall hgb)
  have h1 : H (Real.pi/2)=B (∫ y : E, f y ∂γ) (∫ y : E, g y ∂γ) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun q : E×E => B (f q.1) (g q.2)) := by fun_prop
    have hi : Integrable (fun q : E×E => B (f q.1) (g q.2)) (γ.prod γ) := by
      apply Integrable.of_bound hc.aestronglyMeasurable (‖B‖*Cf*Cg)
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => (B.le_opNorm₂ _ _).trans
        (by gcongr <;> first | exact hfb _ | exact hgb _)
    simp only [H,Real.cos_pi_div_two,Real.sin_pi_div_two,zero_smul,one_smul,zero_add]
    rw [integral_prod _ hi]
    have hinner (y : E) : (∫ z : E, B (f y) (g z) ∂γ)=B (f y) (∫ z : E, g z ∂γ) :=
      (B (f y)).integral_comp_comm hgint
    simp_rw [hinner]
    exact (B.flip (∫ z : E, g z ∂γ)).integral_comp_comm hfint
  rw [h0,h1] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: NLAlib.integral_parameter_bilin_gaussian_affine
statement:
theorem integral_parameter_bilin_gaussian_affine
    (P : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (γ : Measure E) [IsGaussian γ] (hmean : (∫ z : E, z ∂γ)=0)
    (a b : ℝ) (f : E → F) (df : E → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (df x) x) (hdf : Continuous df)
    (Cf Cd : ℝ) (hfb : ∀ x, ‖f x‖≤Cf) (hdfb : ∀ x, ‖df x‖≤Cd)
    (K : E → E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℂ) (hK : Continuous K)
    (Ck : ℝ) (hKb : ∀ x, ‖K x‖≤Ck) :
    (∫ q : E×E, K q.1 q.2 (f (a•q.1+b•q.2)) ∂P.prod γ) =
      b • ∑ i, ∑ j, cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ] •
        ∫ q : E×E, K q.1 (Pi.single i 1)
          (df (a•q.1+b•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)) ∂P.prod γ
proof:
:= by
  have hγ := IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id (μ := γ)
  have hCf : 0≤Cf := (norm_nonneg (f 0)).trans (hfb 0)
  have hCd : 0≤Cd := (norm_nonneg (df 0)).trans (hdfb 0)
  have hCk : 0≤Ck := (norm_nonneg (K 0)).trans (hKb 0)
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => (hf x).continuousAt
  have hmc (i : κ) : (∫ z : E, z i ∂γ)=0 := by
    have hh := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : κ => ℝ) i).integral_comp_comm
      (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ))
    change (∫ z : E, z i ∂γ)=(∫ z : E, z ∂γ) i at hh
    simpa only [hmean,Pi.zero_apply] using hh
  let H (q : E×E) := K q.1 q.2 (f (a•q.1+b•q.2))
  let G (i j : κ) (q : E×E) := K q.1 (Pi.single i 1)
    (df (a•q.1+b•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
  have hHc : Continuous H := by dsimp only [H]; fun_prop
  have hGc (i j : κ) : Continuous (G i j) := by dsimp only [G]; fun_prop
  have hHi : Integrable H (P.prod γ) := by
    have hZi : Integrable (fun q : E×E => q.2) (P.prod γ) :=
      (IsGaussian.integrable_id (μ := γ)).comp_snd P
    apply Integrable.mono' (hZi.norm.const_mul (Ck*Cf)) hHc.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      dsimp only [H]
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖K q.1‖*‖q.2‖*‖f (a•q.1+b•q.2)‖ := (K q.1).le_opNorm₂ _ _
        _ ≤ Ck*‖q.2‖*Cf := by gcongr <;> first | exact hKb _ | exact hfb _
        _ = _ := by ring
  have hGi (i j : κ) : Integrable (G i j) (P.prod γ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hGc i j).aestronglyMeasurable (Ck*Cd)
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      dsimp only [G]
      have hd : ‖df (a•q.1+b•q.2) (Pi.single j 1)‖≤Cd := by
        have hh := ((df (a•q.1+b•q.2)).le_opNorm (Pi.single j 1)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdfb (a•q.1+b•q.2)) (norm_nonneg _))
        simpa only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] using hh
      have hh := (K q.1).le_opNorm₂ (Pi.single i 1) (df (a•q.1+b•q.2) (Pi.single j 1))
      simp only [Pi.norm_single,norm_one,mul_one] at hh
      exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul (hKb _) hd (norm_nonneg _) hCk)
  let c (i j : κ) : ℝ := cov[(fun z : E => z i),(fun z : E => z j);γ]
  have hterm (i j : κ) : Integrable (fun w : E => c i j • ∫ z : E, G i j (w,z) ∂γ) P :=
    ((hGi i j).integral_prod_left).smul (c i j)
  have hsum (i : κ) : Integrable (fun w : E => ∑ j, c i j • ∫ z : E, G i j (w,z) ∂γ) P :=
    integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ fun j _ => hterm i j
  calc
    _ = ∫ w, ∫ z, H (w,z) ∂γ ∂P := integral_prod _ hHi
    _ = ∫ w, b • ∑ i, ∑ j, c i j • ∫ z, G i j (w,z) ∂γ ∂P := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun w => by
        simpa only [H,G,c,zero_add,sub_zero] using
          integral_bilin_gaussian_affine γ hγ hmc 0 w a b f df hf hdf Cf Cd hfb hdfb (K w)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_smul,integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hsum i)]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hterm i j)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [integral_smul,← integral_prod _ (hGi i j)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_one_add_norm_pow_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integrable_one_add_norm_pow_gaussianVector (d : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d)
      (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : MemLp (fun x : ι → ℝ => x) (d : ENNReal)
      (gaussianVector ι) :=
    (hasGaussianLaw_id_gaussianVector ι).memLp (by simp)
  have h := ((memLp_const (1 : ℝ)).add hX.norm).integrable_norm_pow'
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 + ‖x‖)]

name: NLAlib.integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
statement:
theorem integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f (gaussianVector ι))
    (C : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hBound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) :
    Integrable f (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_one_add_norm_pow_gaussianVector d).const_mul C)
    hf.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hBound x

name: NLAlib.memLp_two_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
statement:
theorem memLp_two_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f (gaussianVector ι))
    (C : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hBound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) :
    MemLp f 2 (gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hf.aestronglyMeasurable).2
  refine Integrable.mono'
    ((integrable_one_add_norm_pow_gaussianVector (d * 2)).const_mul (C ^ 2))
    (hf.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  refine ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_
  have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg (f x)) (hBound x) 2
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, sq_abs, mul_pow, pow_mul] using h

name: NLAlib.deriv_update_eq_fderiv_single
statement:
theorem deriv_update_eq_fderiv_single {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun u => f (Function.update x i u)) t =
      fderiv ℝ f (Function.update x i t) (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:=
  (((hf.differentiable one_ne_zero) (Function.update x i t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (hasDerivAt_update x i t)).deriv

name: NLAlib.norm_update_le
statement:
private theorem norm_update_le (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖Function.update x i t‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + |t|
proof:
:= by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [Function.update, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  · simpa [Function.update, hji] using
      (norm_le_pi_norm x j).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg t))

name: NLAlib.section_growth
statement:
private theorem section_growth {f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (d : ℕ)
    (hBound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    ∀ t, |f (Function.update x i t)| ≤
      (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) * (1 + |t|) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have hN : 1 + ‖Function.update x i t‖ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) * (1 + |t|) := by
    have h := norm_update_le x i t
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) (abs_nonneg t)]
  calc
    |f (Function.update x i t)| ≤ C * (1 + ‖Function.update x i t‖) ^ d := hBound _
    _ ≤ C * ((1 + ‖x‖) * (1 + |t|)) ^ d :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hN d) hC
    _ = (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) * (1 + |t|) ^ d := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.integral_coord_mul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussianVector
statement:
theorem integral_coord_mul_eq_integral_fderiv_gaussianVector
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (C D : ℝ) (d e : ℕ)
    (hValue : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d)
    (hPartial : ∀ i x, |fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1)| ≤ D * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ e)
    (i : ι) :
    ∫ x, x i * f x ∂(gaussianVector ι) =
      ∫ x, fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1) ∂(gaussianVector ι)
proof:
:= by
  let μ : ι → Measure ℝ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 1
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    have h := hValue 0
    simp only [norm_zero, add_zero, one_pow, mul_one] at h
    exact (abs_nonneg _).trans h
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by
    have h := hPartial i 0
    simp only [norm_zero, add_zero, one_pow, mul_one] at h
    exact (abs_nonneg _).trans h
  have hFm : AEMeasurable f (Measure.pi μ) := hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hF2 := memLp_two_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth hFm C d hValue
  have hXi : MemLp (fun x : ι → ℝ => x i) 2 (Measure.pi μ) := by
    simpa using (memLp_id_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (2 : NNReal)).comp_measurePreserving
      (measurePreserving_eval μ i)
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun x : ι → ℝ => x i * f x) (Measure.pi μ) :=
    hXi.integrable_mul hF2
  have hDc : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (Pi.single i 1)) :=
    (hf.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hRightInt := integrable_gaussianVector_of_polynomial_growth
    hDc.measurable.aemeasurable D e (hPartial i)
  rw [← integral_integral_update_pi μ i hLeftInt,
    ← integral_integral_update_pi μ i hRightInt]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  refine ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_
  have hLine : Differentiable ℝ (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) :=
    fun t => (((hf.differentiable one_ne_zero) (Function.update x i t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
      (hasDerivAt_update x i t)).differentiableAt
  have hLineDeriv (t : ℝ) :
      |deriv (fun u => f (Function.update x i u)) t| ≤
        (D * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ e) * (1 + |t|) ^ e := by
    rw [deriv_update_eq_fderiv_single hf]
    exact section_growth D hD e (hPartial i) x i t
  have hStein := integral_mul_eq_integral_deriv_gaussianReal_of_polynomial_growth
    (fun t => f (Function.update x i t)) hLine
    (C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ d) (D * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ e) d e
    (section_growth C hC d hValue x i) hLineDeriv
  simpa only [Function.update_self, deriv_update_eq_fderiv_single hf] using hStein

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_mulVec_self_le

name: NLAlib.mulVec_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp0
  · simp
  have hnat : p.natDegree < q := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 hp
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range, aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.sum_mulVec, Matrix.sum_mulVec,

name: NLAlib.krylovFunApprox_eval_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem krylovFunApprox_eval_eq_aeval {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A b q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < q) :
    krylovFunApprox A (fun x => p.eval x) b Q = aeval A p *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovFunApprox, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q, cfc_polynomial p _ (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).isSelfAdjoint]
  exact mulVec_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq hQ b hK hp

name: NLAlib.krylovFunApprox_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq
statement:
theorem krylovFunApprox_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A b q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree < q)
    (hpf : ∀ j,
      p.eval ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j) =
      f ((Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j)) :
    krylovFunApprox A f b Q = aeval A p *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovFunApprox, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q, cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq _ hpf]
  exact mulVec_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq hQ b hK hp

name: NLAlib.krylovFunApprox_eq_aeval_interpolate
statement:
theorem krylovFunApprox_eq_aeval_interpolate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A b q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (hk : Fintype.card k ≤ q)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    krylovFunApprox A f b Q =
      aeval A (Lagrange.interpolate
        (Finset.univ.image (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues) id f) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  refine krylovFunApprox_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq hA hQ b hK ?_
    (eval_interpolate_eigenvalues _ f)
  refine (Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt f (Set.injOn_id _)).trans_le ?_
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simpa using hk)

name: NLAlib.mul_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, Q * (Qᵀ * A * Q) ^ j * Qᵀ = (Q * Qᵀ * A) ^ j * (Q * Qᵀ) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Matrix.mul_assoc (Q * Qᵀ * A), ← ih]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range, aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, hpow]

name: NLAlib.krylovFunApprox_congr
statement:
theorem krylovFunApprox_congr {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k' : Type*} [Fintype k']
    [DecidableEq k'] {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} {Q' : Matrix n k' ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hR : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    krylovFunApprox A f b Q = krylovFunApprox A f b Q'
proof:
:= by
  set hT : (Qᵀ * A * Q).IsHermitian := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA)
  set hT' : (Q'ᵀ * A * Q').IsHermitian := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q' hA)
  set s := Finset.univ.image hT.eigenvalues ∪ Finset.univ.image hT'.eigenvalues
  set p := Lagrange.interpolate s id f
  have hnode : ∀ x ∈ s, p.eval x = f x := fun x hx =>
    Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (v := id) f (Set.injOn_id _) hx
  have h1 : cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) = aeval (Qᵀ * A * Q) p := cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq hT
    fun i => hnode _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)))
  have h2 : cfc f (Q'ᵀ * A * Q') = aeval (Q'ᵀ * A * Q') p := cfc_eq_aeval_of_forall_eval_eq hT'
    fun i => hnode _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ i)))
  have hP : Q * Qᵀ = Q' * Q'ᵀ := mul_conjTranspose_eq_of_range_eq hQ hQ' hR
  simp only [krylovFunApprox, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h1, h2]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mul_transpose,
    mul_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mul_transpose, hP]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_self_le
statement:
private lemma dotProduct_sub_self_le (x y : n → ℝ) :
    (x - y) ⬝ᵥ (x - y) ≤ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) + 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 ≤ (x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y) := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
    dotProduct_comm y x] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  set T := Qᵀ * A * Q
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA)
  set c' := Qᵀ *ᵥ b
  set x := (cfc f A - aeval A p) *ᵥ b
  set w := (cfc f T - aeval T p) *ᵥ c'
  have hexact := mulVec_aeval_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq hQ b hK hp
  have he : cfc f A *ᵥ b - krylovFunApprox A f b Q = x - Q *ᵥ w := by
    simp only [x, w, T, c', krylovFunApprox, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub, hexact]
    abel
  have hx : x ⬝ᵥ x ≤ E ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) :=
    dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_mulVec_self_le hA (fun i => hfp _ (hspec i)) b
  have hw : w ⬝ᵥ w ≤ E ^ 2 * (c' ⬝ᵥ c') :=
    dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_mulVec_self_le hT
      (fun j => hfp _ (eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_mem_Icc hA hQ hspec j)) c'
  have hc : c' ⬝ᵥ c' ≤ b ⬝ᵥ b := by
    have h := sum_norm_sq_conjTranspose_mulVec_le hQ b
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
    simpa only [c', dotProduct, ← sq] using h
  have hQw : (Q *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ w) = w ⬝ᵥ w :=
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ w
  rw [he]
  refine (dotProduct_sub_self_le x (Q *ᵥ w)).trans ?_
  rw [hQw]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (sq_nonneg E)]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_inv_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hpE⟩ := exists_degree_lt_abs_eval_sub_inv_le q ha hac
  exact dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le hA hQ b hK hpdeg hspec
    fun x hx => by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hpE x hx

name: NLAlib.sequenceFromTranscript_eq
statement:
private theorem sequenceFromTranscript_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q i : ℕ)
    (hi : i ≤ q) :
    sequenceFromTranscript b ((powerQueryAlgorithm b q).transcript (A *ᵥ ·)) i =
      krylovSeq A b i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => simp [sequenceFromTranscript, krylovSeq]
  | succ i =>
    simp only [sequenceFromTranscript, show i < q by omega, dif_pos,
      transcript_powerQueryAlgorithm, krylovSeq]

name: NLAlib.run_arnoldiQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem run_arnoldiQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (arnoldiQueryAlgorithm b q).run (A *ᵥ ·) = arnoldiMatrix A b (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiQueryAlgorithm, QueryAlgorithm.run_withOutput]
  ext i j
  have h := InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed_eq_of_eq_prefix (𝕜 := ℝ)
    (f := sequenceFromTranscript b ((powerQueryAlgorithm b q).transcript (A *ᵥ ·)))
    (g := krylovSeq A b) (j := (j : ℕ))
    (fun k hk => sequenceFromTranscript_eq A b q k (by omega))
  exact congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ n => v.ofLp i) h

name: NLAlib.run_innerProductScalarProgram
statement:
theorem run_innerProductScalarProgram {K : Type*} [Ring K] [Star K]
    {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → K) :
    (innerProductScalarProgram x y).run = star x ⬝ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [innerProductScalarProgram, ScalarProgram.run, dotProduct]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [innerProductScalarProgram, ScalarProgram.run, ih, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.cost_innerProductScalarProgram
statement:
theorem cost_innerProductScalarProgram {K : Type*} [Zero K] {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → K) :
    (innerProductScalarProgram x y).cost = 3*k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [innerProductScalarProgram, ScalarProgram.cost, ih]; omega

name: NLAlib.run_matrixRecoveryProgram
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_matrixRecoveryProgram (A : Matrix n n K) :
    matrixRecoveryProgram.run A.mulVec = A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixRecoveryProgram, QueryProgram.run_map, QueryProgram.run_family,
    Matrix.mulVec_single_one, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_apply_of_matrixRecovery
statement:
theorem exists_matvecAlg_apply_of_matrixRecovery {β : Type*} (f : Matrix n n K → β) :
    ∃ alg : MatvecAlg K n β, alg.cost = Fintype.card n ∧ ∀ A, alg.run A = f A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨_, matrixRecoveryProgram.map f⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro A
  simpa only [MatvecAlg.run, QueryProgram.run_map] using congrArg f (run_matrixRecoveryProgram A)

name: NLAlib.QueryProgram.run_family
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_family (f : Q → R) {s : ℕ} (v : Fin s → Q) :
    (family v).run f = fun j => f (v j)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero => funext j; exact j.elim0
  | succ s ih =>
    simp only [family, run, run_map, ih]
    funext j
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ j => rfl

name: NLAlib.run_blockMultiplyProgram
statement:
theorem run_blockMultiplyProgram (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n (Fin s) K) :
    (blockMultiplyProgram Ω).run A.mulVec = A * Ω
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blockMultiplyProgram, QueryProgram.run_map, QueryProgram.run_family]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.run_blockPowerProgram
statement:
theorem run_blockPowerProgram (A : Matrix n n K) (q : ℕ) (Ω : Matrix n (Fin s) K) :
    (blockPowerProgram q Ω).run A.mulVec = A ^ q * Ω
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing Ω with
  | zero => simp [blockPowerProgram, QueryProgram.run]
  | succ q ih =>
    rw [blockPowerProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, run_blockMultiplyProgram, ih,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_subspaceIterate
statement:
theorem exists_matvecAlg_subspaceIterate (Ω : Matrix n (Fin s) K) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ alg : MatvecAlg K n (Submodule K (n → K)), alg.cost = s * q ∧
      ∀ A : Matrix n n K, alg.run A = subspaceIterate A Ω q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨s * q, (blockPowerProgram q Ω).map (fun B => LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin)⟩,
    rfl, ?_⟩
  intro A
  change QueryProgram.run A.mulVec _ = _
  rw [QueryProgram.run_map, run_blockPowerProgram]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.run_lanczosQueryAlgorithm

theorem run_lanczosQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem queryAt_lanczosQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q i : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.run_cgQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem run_cgQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ r₀ : n → ℝ)

statement:
theorem run_cgInitializedQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_truncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem history_truncate (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i j : ℕ) :
    (alg.truncate i).history f j = alg.history f j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih => rw [history, history, ih]; rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.transcript_truncate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transcript_truncate (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (alg.truncate i).transcript f = alg.history f i
proof:
:=
  history_truncate alg f i i

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_apply
statement:
theorem history_apply (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) (j : Fin i) :
    alg.history f i j = f (alg.queryAt f j)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact j.elim0
  | succ i ih =>
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
    · rw [history, Fin.snoc_last]
      rfl
    · rw [history, Fin.snoc_castSucc, ih]
      rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_eq_history
statement:
private theorem history_eq_history (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) {n m j : ℕ}
    (hn : j < n) (hm : j < m) : alg.history f n ⟨j, hn⟩ = alg.history f m ⟨j, hm⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [history_apply, history_apply]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.queryAt_eq_queries_transcript
statement:
theorem queryAt_eq_queries_transcript (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (j : Fin q) :
    alg.queryAt f j = alg.queries (alg.transcript f) j
proof:
:= by
  unfold queryAt queries transcript
  congr 1
  funext l
  exact history_eq_history alg f l.isLt (l.isLt.trans j.isLt)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.transcript_eq_of_forall_apply_queries_eq
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, i ≤ q → alg.history g i = alg.history f i := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; funext j; exact j.elim0
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hq : i < q := hi
      have hgf := h ⟨i, hq⟩
      rw [← queryAt_eq_queries_transcript alg f ⟨i, hq⟩] at hgf
      unfold history
      rw [ih (by omega)]
      congr 1
  exact key q le_rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_eq_of_forall_apply_queries_eq
proof:
:=
  congrArg alg.output (transcript_eq_of_forall_apply_queries_eq alg h)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsNonAdaptive.queries_eq
statement:
theorem IsNonAdaptive.queries_eq {alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (h : alg.IsNonAdaptive)
    (τ τ' : Fin q → R) : alg.queries τ = alg.queries τ'
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  exact h j j.isLt _ _

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.rank_le_ncard_of_col_eq_zero
statement:
private lemma rank_le_ncard_of_col_eq_zero {m : Type*} (M : Matrix m (Fin q) 𝕜)
    (S : Set (Fin q)) (h : ∀ j ∉ S, ∀ r, M r j = 0) : M.rank ≤ S.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS : S.Finite := Set.toFinite S
  have : Fintype S := hS.fintype
  let N : Matrix m S 𝕜 := fun r j => M r j
  let P : Matrix S (Fin q) 𝕜 := fun j k => if (j : Fin q) = k then 1 else 0
  have hMNP : M = N * P := by
    ext r k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    by_cases hk : k ∈ S
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨k, hk⟩ : S)]
      · simp [N, P]
      · intro b _ hb
        have : (b : Fin q) ≠ k := fun e => hb (Subtype.ext e)
        simp [N, P, this]
      · simp
    · rw [h k hk r]
      refine Eq.symm (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_)
      have : (b : Fin q) ≠ k := fun e => hk (e ▸ b.2)
      simp [P, this]
  calc M.rank = (N * P).rank := by rw [← hMNP]
    _ ≤ N.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _
    _ ≤ Fintype.card S := Matrix.rank_le_card_width N
    _ = S.ncard := by rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.rank_rightQueryMatrix_le_rightCount
statement:
theorem rank_rightQueryMatrix_le_rightCount (alg : QueryAlgorithm ((n → 𝕜) × (m → 𝕜)) R q β)
    (τ : Fin q → R) : (alg.rightQueryMatrix τ).rank ≤ alg.rightCount τ
proof:
:=
  rank_le_ncard_of_col_eq_zero _ _ fun j hj r => by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] at hj
    simp [QueryAlgorithm.rightQueryMatrix, hj]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.rank_leftQueryMatrix_le_leftCount
statement:
theorem rank_leftQueryMatrix_le_leftCount (alg : QueryAlgorithm ((n → 𝕜) × (m → 𝕜)) R q β)
    (τ : Fin q → R) : (alg.leftQueryMatrix τ).rank ≤ alg.leftCount τ
proof:
:=
  rank_le_ncard_of_col_eq_zero _ _ fun j hj r => by
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] at hj
    simp [QueryAlgorithm.leftQueryMatrix, hj]

name: NLAlib.run_gmresQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem run_gmresQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c x₀ r₀ : n → 𝕜)
    (hr : r₀ = c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q : ℕ) :
    (gmresQueryAlgorithm x₀ r₀ q).run (A *ᵥ ·) = gmresIterate A c x₀ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmresQueryAlgorithm, QueryAlgorithm.run_withOutput,
    krylovMatrixFromTranscript_eq, responseMatrix_powerQueryAlgorithm, hr]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.run_gmresQueryAlgorithm_zero
statement:
theorem run_gmresQueryAlgorithm_zero (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) :
    (gmresQueryAlgorithm 0 c q).run (A *ᵥ ·) = gmresIterate A c 0 q
proof:
:=
  run_gmresQueryAlgorithm A c 0 c (by simp) q

name: NLAlib.run_gmresInitializedQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem run_gmresInitializedQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c x₀ : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) :
    (gmresInitializedQueryAlgorithm c x₀ q).run (A *ᵥ ·) = gmresIterate A c x₀ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmresInitializedQueryAlgorithm, QueryAlgorithm.run_prependQuery]
  exact run_gmresQueryAlgorithm A c x₀ _ rfl q

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_withOutput
statement:
@[simp] theorem history_withOutput {q : ℕ} {α β : Type*} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q α)
    (output : (Fin q → R) → β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (alg.withOutput output).history f i = alg.history f i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih => rw [history, history, ih]; rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_withOutput
statement:
theorem run_withOutput {q : ℕ} {α β : Type*} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q α)
    (output : (Fin q → R) → β) (f : Q → R) :
    (alg.withOutput output).run f = output (alg.transcript f)
proof:
:= by
  change output ((alg.withOutput output).history f q) = output (alg.history f q)
  rw [history_withOutput]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.history_prependQuery
statement:
theorem history_prependQuery {q : ℕ} {β : Type*} (first : Q)
    (next : R → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (prependQuery first next).history f (i + 1) =
      Fin.cons (f first) ((next (f first)).history f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => ext j; fin_cases j; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [history, ih]
    change Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => R) (Fin.cons (f first) ((next (f first)).history f i))
      (f ((next (f first)).query i ((next (f first)).history f i))) =
      Fin.cons (f first) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => R) ((next (f first)).history f i)
        (f ((next (f first)).query i ((next (f first)).history f i))))
    exact (Fin.cons_snoc_eq_snoc_cons _ _ _).symm

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_prependQuery
statement:
theorem run_prependQuery {q : ℕ} {β : Type*} (first : Q)
    (next : R → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) :
    (prependQuery first next).run f = (next (f first)).run f
proof:
:= by
  change (next ((prependQuery first next).history f (q + 1) 0)).output
    (fun j => (prependQuery first next).history f (q + 1) j.succ) = _
  rw [history_prependQuery]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.replay_history_ofState
statement:
theorem replay_history_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    replay initial update ((ofState initial query update q).history f i) =
      (fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[i] initial
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [history, replay, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
    change update (replay initial update ((ofState initial query update q).history f i))
      (f (query (replay initial update ((ofState initial query update q).history f i)))) = _
    rw [ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_ofState
statement:
theorem run_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) :
    (ofState initial query update q).run f =
      (fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[q] initial
proof:
:=
  replay_history_ofState initial query update q f q

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.queryAt_ofState
statement:
theorem queryAt_ofState (initial : S) (query : S → Q) (update : S → R → S)
    (q : ℕ) (f : Q → R) (i : ℕ) :
    (ofState initial query update q).queryAt f i =
      query ((fun s => update s (f (query s)))^[i] initial)
proof:
:= by
  change query (replay initial update ((ofState initial query update q).history f i)) = _
  rw [replay_history_ofState]

name: NLAlib.iterate_mulVec_eq_pow
statement:
private theorem iterate_mulVec_eq_pow (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    (fun x => A *ᵥ x)^[q] b = A ^ q *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.run_powerQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem run_powerQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    (powerQueryAlgorithm b q).run (A *ᵥ ·) = A ^ q *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerQueryAlgorithm, QueryAlgorithm.run_ofState]
  exact iterate_mulVec_eq_pow A b q

name: NLAlib.queryAt_powerQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem queryAt_powerQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q i : ℕ) :
    (powerQueryAlgorithm b q).queryAt (A *ᵥ ·) i = A ^ i *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerQueryAlgorithm, QueryAlgorithm.queryAt_ofState]
  exact iterate_mulVec_eq_pow A b i

name: NLAlib.transcript_powerQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem transcript_powerQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K)
    (q : ℕ) (j : Fin q) :
    (powerQueryAlgorithm b q).transcript (A *ᵥ ·) j = A ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [QueryAlgorithm.transcript, QueryAlgorithm.history_apply, queryAt_powerQueryAlgorithm,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.krylovMatrixFromTranscript_eq
statement:
theorem krylovMatrixFromTranscript_eq (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovMatrixFromTranscript b ((powerQueryAlgorithm b q).transcript (A *ᵥ ·)) =
      krylovMatrix A b q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [krylovMatrixFromTranscript, krylovMatrix]
  split_ifs with hj
  · simp [hj]
  · rw [transcript_powerQueryAlgorithm]
    congr 3
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)

name: NLAlib.responseMatrix_powerQueryAlgorithm
statement:
theorem responseMatrix_powerQueryAlgorithm (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    (fun i j => (powerQueryAlgorithm b q).transcript (A *ᵥ ·) j i) =
      A * krylovMatrix A b q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [transcript_powerQueryAlgorithm, mul_krylovMatrix_apply]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_history
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => exact measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => j.elim0
  | succ i ih =>
    refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => ?_
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      simp only [QueryAlgorithm.history, Fin.snoc_last]
      exact hO.comp (measurable_id.prodMk
        ((halg.measurable_query i (by omega)).comp (ih (by omega))))
    | cast j =>
      simp only [QueryAlgorithm.history, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp (ih (by omega))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_transcript
proof:
:=
  halg.measurable_history hO le_rfl

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_run
statement:
theorem IsMeasurable.measurable_run {alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (halg : alg.IsMeasurable)
    {O : M → Q → R} (hO : Measurable (Function.uncurry O)) :
    Measurable fun x => alg.run (O x)
proof:
:=
  halg.measurable_output.comp (halg.measurable_transcript hO)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_queryMatrix
statement:
theorem IsMeasurable.measurable_queryMatrix {𝕜 n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝕜]
    {alg : QueryAlgorithm (n → 𝕜) R q β} (halg : alg.IsMeasurable) :
    Measurable (alg.queryMatrix : (Fin q → R) → Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun r => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => ?_
  exact (measurable_pi_apply r).comp ((halg.measurable_query j j.isLt).comp
    (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun l => measurable_pi_apply _))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_rightQueryMatrix
statement:
theorem IsMeasurable.measurable_rightQueryMatrix {𝕜 m n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝕜]
    {alg : QueryAlgorithm ((n → 𝕜) × (m → 𝕜)) R q β} (halg : alg.IsMeasurable) :
    Measurable (alg.rightQueryMatrix : (Fin q → R) → Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun r => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => ?_
  exact (measurable_pi_apply r).comp (measurable_fst.comp
    ((halg.measurable_query j j.isLt).comp (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun l => measurable_pi_apply _)))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.measurable_leftQueryMatrix
statement:
theorem IsMeasurable.measurable_leftQueryMatrix {𝕜 m n : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝕜]
    {alg : QueryAlgorithm ((n → 𝕜) × (m → 𝕜)) R q β} (halg : alg.IsMeasurable) :
    Measurable (alg.leftQueryMatrix : (Fin q → R) → Matrix m (Fin q) 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun r => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => ?_
  exact (measurable_pi_apply r).comp
    (measurable_snd.comp ((halg.measurable_query j j.isLt).comp
      (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun l => measurable_pi_apply _)))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.measurable_history_family
statement:
private theorem measurable_history_family {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    {alg : S → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (halg : IsMeasurableFamily alg) {O : M → Q → R}
    (hO : Measurable (Function.uncurry O)) :
    ∀ i ≤ q, Measurable fun p : S × M => (alg p.1).history (O p.2) i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; exact measurable_const
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => ?_
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      simp only [QueryAlgorithm.history, Fin.snoc_last]
      exact hO.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk ((halg.measurable_query i (by omega)).comp
        (measurable_fst.prodMk (ih (by omega)))))
    | cast j =>
      simp only [QueryAlgorithm.history, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp (ih (by omega))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurableFamily.measurable_run
statement:
theorem IsMeasurableFamily.measurable_run {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    {alg : S → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (halg : IsMeasurableFamily alg) {O : M → Q → R}
    (hO : Measurable (Function.uncurry O)) :
    Measurable fun p : S × M => (alg p.1).run (O p.2)
proof:
:=
  halg.measurable_output.comp
    (measurable_fst.prodMk (measurable_history_family halg hO q le_rfl))

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurableFamily.isMeasurable
statement:
theorem IsMeasurableFamily.isMeasurable {S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace S]
    {alg : S → QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (halg : IsMeasurableFamily alg) (s : S) :
    (alg s).IsMeasurable
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i hi => (halg.measurable_query i hi).comp measurable_prodMk_left,
    halg.measurable_output.comp measurable_prodMk_left⟩

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.IsMeasurable.truncate
statement:
theorem IsMeasurable.truncate {alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β} (halg : alg.IsMeasurable) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i ≤ q) : (alg.truncate i).IsMeasurable
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun j hj => halg.measurable_query j (by omega), measurable_const⟩

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartProductProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartProductProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (x : n → ℂ) :
    (hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary x).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)) *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  cases imaginary <;>
    simp only [hermitianPartProductProgram, QueryProgram.run, matrixAdjointOracle,
      Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, realPart_apply_coe, imaginaryPart_apply_coe,
      Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
  all_goals
    ext i
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
    norm_num
    <;> ring

name: NLAlib.hermitianPartChebyshevCost_eq
statement: theorem hermitianPartChebyshevCost_eq (M : ℕ) : hermitianPartChebyshevCost M = 2*M
proof:
:= by
  induction M with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ M ih => rw [hermitianPartChebyshevCost, ih]; omega

name: NLAlib.chebyshev_succ_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j=0
  · subst j; simp
  rw [if_neg hj, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Chebyshev.T_add_one,
    map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_ofNat, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
  rw [show (j:ℤ)-1=((j-1:ℕ):ℤ) by omega]
  congr 1
  simp only [show (2 : Matrix n n ℂ) = (2:ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) by
    ext i l; simp [Matrix.ofNat_apply, Matrix.one_apply], Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool)
    (b : n → ℂ) (M j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ M) :
    (hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) j =
      (aeval (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ))
        (Chebyshev.T ℂ (j:ℤ))) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  induction M generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    have hj0 : j=0 := by omega
    subst j
    simp [hermitianPartChebyshevProgram, QueryProgram.run]
  | succ M ih =>
    rw [hermitianPartChebyshevProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, QueryProgram.run_map,
      run_hermitianPartProductProgram]
    by_cases hlast : j=M+1
    · subst j
      rw [Function.update_self, chebyshev_succ_mulVec, ih M le_rfl, ih (M-1) (by omega)]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hlast]
      exact ih j (by omega)

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (imaginary : Bool)
    (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram imaginary b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix
        (if imaginary then (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) else (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ)) b M
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram, QueryProgram.run_map]
  ext r j
  rw [normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix_apply]
  rw [run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram A imaginary b M j (by have := j.isLt; omega)]

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedVectorProgram
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedVectorProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (normalMixedVectorProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M,
        normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalMixedVectorProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, QueryProgram.run_map,
    run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartProductProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartProductProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (x : n → ℂ) (r : n) :
    ((hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary x).run oracle) r =
      (hermitianPartScalarProgram imaginary (oracle (false,x) r) (oracle (true,x) r)).run
proof:
:= by
  cases imaginary <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram_succ_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevProgram_succ_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (b : n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (r : n) :
    let V
proof:
:= (hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b k).run oracle
    let response := (hermitianPartProductProgram imaginary (V k)).run oracle
    ((hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b (k+1)).run oracle) (k+1) r =
      (chebyshevStepScalarProgram k (response r) (V (k-1) r)).run := by
  dsimp only
  rw [hermitianPartChebyshevProgram, QueryProgram.run_bind, QueryProgram.run_map,
    Function.update_self, run_chebyshevStepScalarProgram]
  by_cases hk : k=0 <;> simp [hk, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (imaginary : Bool) (b : n → ℂ)
    (M : ℕ) (r : n) (j : Fin (M+1)) :
    ((hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram imaginary b M).run oracle) r j =
      (chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram j
        (((hermitianPartChebyshevProgram imaginary b M).run oracle) j r)).run
proof:
:= by
  rw [hermitianPartChebyshevVectorProgram, QueryProgram.run_map]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram_eq_scalar
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) (j k : Fin (M+1)) :
    let XY
proof:
:= (normalMixedVectorProgram b M).run oracle
    ((normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run oracle) j k =
      (crossGramScalarProgram XY.1 XY.2 j k).run := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalMixedMomentProgram, QueryProgram.run_map]
  exact (run_crossGramScalarProgram _ _ j k).symm

name: NLAlib.normalMixedProgramScalarWork_le
statement:
theorem normalMixedProgramScalarWork_le (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ)
    (oracle : Bool × (n → ℂ) → n → ℂ) :
    normalMixedProgramScalarWork b M oracle ≤ 13*Fintype.card n*(M+1)^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalMixedProgramScalarWork
  exact (normalMixedScalarWork_le_budget _ _ _ _ _ _).trans (normalMixedArithmeticBudget_le _ _)

name: NLAlib.run_normalMixedMomentProgram
statement:
theorem run_normalMixedMomentProgram (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) (M : ℕ) :
    (normalMixedMomentProgram b M).run (matrixAdjointOracle A) =
      (normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (realPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M)ᴴ *
        normalizedChebyshevVectorMatrix (imaginaryPart A : Matrix n n ℂ) b M
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalMixedMomentProgram, QueryProgram.run_map, run_normalMixedVectorProgram]

name: NLAlib.normalMixedMomentProgram_queryCount
statement:
theorem normalMixedMomentProgram_queryCount (M : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_arnoldiMatrix

theorem exists_matvecAlg_lanczosState (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.exists_matvecAlg_gmresIterate_zero
statement:
theorem exists_matvecAlg_gmresIterate_zero {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (c : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) :

name: NLAlib.QueryProgram.run_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_map (f : Q → R) (g : α → β) (p : QueryProgram Q R α q) :
    run f (map g p) = g (run f p)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | pure value => rfl
  | query value next ih => exact ih (f value)

name: NLAlib.QueryProgram.run_bind
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_bind (f : Q → R) (p : QueryProgram Q R α q)
    (next : α → QueryProgram Q R β r) :
    run f (bind p next) = run f (next (run f p))
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | pure value => rfl
  | query value branch ih => exact ih (f value)

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.prependQuery_afterFirst
statement:
theorem prependQuery_afterFirst {q : ℕ} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R (q + 1) β) :
    prependQuery (alg.query 0 Fin.elim0) alg.afterFirst = alg
proof:
:= by
  cases alg with
  | mk query output =>
    simp only [prependQuery, afterFirst]
    congr 1
    · funext i h
      cases i with
      | zero => exact congrArg (query 0) (funext fun j => j.elim0)
      | succ i =>
        change query (i + 1) (Fin.cons (h 0) (Fin.tail h)) = query (i + 1) h
        rw [Fin.cons_self_tail]
    · funext h
      change output (Fin.cons (h 0) (Fin.tail h)) = output h
      rw [Fin.cons_self_tail]

name: NLAlib.QueryAlgorithm.run_toProgram
statement:
theorem run_toProgram {q : ℕ} (alg : QueryAlgorithm Q R q β) (f : Q → R) :
    alg.toProgram.run f = alg.run f
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ q ih =>
    change (alg.afterFirst (f (alg.query 0 Fin.elim0))).toProgram.run f = _
    rw [ih, ← run_prependQuery, prependQuery_afterFirst]

name: NLAlib.MatvecAlg.cost_ofQueryAlgorithm
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_ofQueryAlgorithm {𝕜 n β : Type*} {q : ℕ}
    (alg : QueryAlgorithm (n → 𝕜) (n → 𝕜) q β) : (ofQueryAlgorithm alg).cost = q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.MatvecAlg.run_ofQueryAlgorithm
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_ofQueryAlgorithm {𝕜 n β : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring 𝕜] {q : ℕ}
    (alg : QueryAlgorithm (n → 𝕜) (n → 𝕜) q β) (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    (ofQueryAlgorithm alg).run A = alg.run A.mulVec
proof: := alg.run_toProgram A.mulVec

statement:
theorem cost_hermitianPartScalarProgram (imaginary : Bool) (y z : ℂ) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.cost_chebyshevStepScalarProgram_le
statement:
theorem cost_chebyshevStepScalarProgram_le (k : ℕ) (response previous : ℂ) :
    (chebyshevStepScalarProgram k response previous).cost ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k=0 <;> simp [chebyshevStepScalarProgram, hk, ScalarProgram.cost]

statement:

name: NLAlib.cost_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram
statement:
theorem cost_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram (j : ℕ) (x : ℂ) :
    (chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram j x).cost = 1
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.run_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram
statement:
theorem run_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram (j : ℕ) (x : ℂ) :
    (chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram j x).run = (normalizedChebyshevWeight j : ℂ)*x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.run_crossGramScalarProgram
statement:
theorem run_crossGramScalarProgram {p q : Type*} (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ)
    (j : p) (k : q) : (crossGramScalarProgram X Y j k).run = (Xᴴ * Y) j k
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossGramScalarProgram, run_innerProductScalarProgram]
  simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  exact (Fintype.equivFin n).symm.sum_comp (fun r => star (X r j) * Y r k)

name: NLAlib.cost_crossGramScalarProgram
statement:
theorem cost_crossGramScalarProgram {p q : Type*} (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ)
    (j : p) (k : q) : (crossGramScalarProgram X Y j k).cost = 3*Fintype.card n
proof:
:=
  cost_innerProductScalarProgram _ _

name: NLAlib.sum_cost_crossGramScalarProgram
statement:
theorem sum_cost_crossGramScalarProgram (M : ℕ)
    (X Y : Matrix n (Fin (M+1)) ℂ) :
    (∑ j, ∑ k, (crossGramScalarProgram X Y j k).cost) =
      3*Fintype.card n*(M+1)^2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cost_crossGramScalarProgram, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.normalMixedScalarWork_le_budget
statement:
theorem normalMixedScalarWork_le_budget (M : ℕ)
    (matrixResponse adjointResponse previous : Bool → Fin M → n → ℂ)
    (X Y : Matrix n (Fin (M+1)) ℂ) :
    normalMixedScalarWork M matrixResponse adjointResponse previous X Y ≤
      normalMixedArithmeticBudget (Fintype.card n) M
proof:
:= by
  have hstep (imaginary : Bool) (k : Fin M) (r : n) :
      (hermitianPartScalarProgram imaginary (matrixResponse imaginary k r)
        (adjointResponse imaginary k r)).cost +
        (chebyshevStepScalarProgram k
          (hermitianPartScalarProgram imaginary (matrixResponse imaginary k r)
            (adjointResponse imaginary k r)).run (previous imaginary k r)).cost ≤ 4 := by
    rw [cost_hermitianPartScalarProgram]
    have := cost_chebyshevStepScalarProgram_le k
      (hermitianPartScalarProgram imaginary (matrixResponse imaginary k r)
        (adjointResponse imaginary k r)).run (previous imaginary k r)
    omega
  unfold normalMixedScalarWork
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ _ : Bool, ∑ _ : Fin M, ∑ _ : n, 4) +
        (∑ _ : Fin (M+1), ∑ _ : n, (1+1)) + 3*Fintype.card n*(M+1)^2 := by
      gcongr
      · exact hstep _ _ _
      · simp [cost_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram]
      · simp [cost_chebyshevNormalizeScalarProgram]
      · exact (sum_cost_crossGramScalarProgram M X Y).le
    _ = normalMixedArithmeticBudget (Fintype.card n) M := by
      simp [normalMixedArithmeticBudget, Nat.mul_add]
      ring

name: NLAlib.normalMixedArithmeticBudget_le
statement:
theorem normalMixedArithmeticBudget_le (n M : ℕ) :
    normalMixedArithmeticBudget n M ≤ 13*n*(M+1)^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalMixedArithmeticBudget
  nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (10*n*M*M), Nat.zero_le (10*n*M), Nat.zero_le (8*n)]

name: NLAlib.QueryProgram.run_adaptResponses
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_adaptResponses (g : S → R) (f : Q → S) (p : QueryProgram Q R β q) :
    (adaptResponses g p).run f = p.run (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | pure value => rfl
  | query value next ih => exact ih (g (f value))

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_self_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_self_apply {k : Type*} (Q : Matrix n k ℝ) (i j : k) :
    (Qᵀ * Q) i j = Q.col i ⬝ᵥ Q.col j
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.col]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (i j : k) :
    Q.col i ⬝ᵥ Q.col j = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hQ.star_col_dotProduct_col i j

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.span_col_castLE
statement:
theorem span_col_castLE (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ q) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun j : Fin m => Q.col (Fin.castLE hm j)) =
      krylovSpace A b m
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp [krylovSpace]
  · exact hQ.nested ⟨m, hm⟩

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.col_mem
statement:
theorem col_mem (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) (j : Fin q) :
    Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hQ.nested j]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.range_mulVecLin
statement:
theorem range_mulVecLin (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) :
    LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, ← hQ.span_col_castLE le_rfl]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.col_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem col_dotProduct_eq_zero (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) (i : Fin q) {x : n → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ krylovSpace A b i) : Q.col i ⬝ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hQ.span_col_castLE i.isLt.le] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hQ.orth.col_dotProduct_col, if_neg]
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_castLE] at this
    omega
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [dotProduct_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [dotProduct_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.eq_sum_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_sum_of_mem (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) {x : n → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ krylovSpace A b q) : x = ∑ i, (Q.col i ⬝ᵥ x) • Q.col i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hQ.range_mulVecLin] at hx
  conv_lhs => rw [← mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ.orth hx]
  rw [mulVec_eq_sum_smul_col]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.mem_of_forall_le_dotProduct_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [hQ.eq_sum_of_mem hx, ← hQ.span_col_castLE hm]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < m
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩)
  · rw [h0 i (not_lt.1 hi), zero_smul]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.of_mem
statement:
theorem of_mem (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hmem : ∀ j : Fin q, Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1)) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hQ, fun i => ?_⟩
  set v : Fin (i + 1) → n → ℝ := fun j => Q.col (Fin.castLE i.isLt j)
  have hle : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) ≤ krylovSpace A b (i + 1) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact krylovSpace_mono A b (by simp; omega) (hmem _)
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ v :=
    hQ.linearIndependent_col.comp _ (Fin.castLE_injective _)
  refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle ?_
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli, Fintype.card_fin]
  exact finrank_krylovSpace_le A b _

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_iff :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q ↔
      HasOrthonormalCols Q ∧ ∀ j : Fin q, Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.orth, h.col_mem⟩, fun h => of_mem h.1 h.2⟩

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.le_krylovGrade
statement: theorem le_krylovGrade (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) : q ≤ krylovGrade A b
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (krylovSpace A b q) = q := by
    rw [← hQ.span_col_castLE le_rfl]
    exact (finrank_span_eq_card
      (hQ.orth.linearIndependent_col.comp _ (Fin.castLE_injective _))).trans (Fintype.card_fin _)
  have h2 := finrank_krylovSpace A b q
  omega

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.mulVec_col_mem
statement:
theorem mulVec_col_mem (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) (j : Fin q) :
    A *ᵥ Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 2)
proof:
:=
  mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b (hQ.col_mem j)

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_zero (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) {i j : Fin q}
    (hij : (j : ℕ) + 1 < i) : (Qᵀ * A * Q) i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]
  exact hQ.col_dotProduct_eq_zero i (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) (hQ.mulVec_col_mem j))

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.krylovSpace_le_of_mulVec_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ i : ℕ, (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b m := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hm
    | succ i ih => rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; exact hinv _ ih
  exact Submodule.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hpow i)

name: NLAlib.IsGradedKrylovBasis.transpose_mul_mul_apply_succ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_apply_succ_ne_zero (hQ : IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j + 1 < q) : (Qᵀ * A * Q) ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  rw [transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct] at h0
  
  have hAq : A *ᵥ Q.col ⟨j, by omega⟩ ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
    krylovSpace_mono A b (show j + 2 ≤ q by omega) (hQ.mulVec_col_mem ⟨j, by omega⟩)
  have hAj : A *ᵥ Q.col ⟨j, by omega⟩ ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1) := by
    refine hQ.mem_of_forall_le_dotProduct_eq_zero hAq (by omega) fun i hi => ?_
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (j + 1) i with hlt | hge
    · rw [← transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]; exact hQ.transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_zero hlt
    · obtain rfl : i = ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp only; omega)
      exact h0
  
  have hinv : ∀ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1), A *ᵥ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← hQ.span_col_castLE (show j + 1 ≤ q by omega)] at hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hy
      by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) = j
      · convert hAj using 3; exact Fin.ext (by simp [hk])
      · have hk' : (k : ℕ) < j := by have := k.isLt; omega
        exact krylovSpace_mono A b (by simp; omega) (hQ.mulVec_col_mem _)
    | zero => simp
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [Matrix.mulVec_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz
    | smul c y _ hy => rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy
  have hmem := krylovSpace_le_of_mulVec_mem (Nat.succ_pos j) hinv _ (hQ.col_mem ⟨j + 1, hj⟩)
  have h1 := hQ.col_dotProduct_eq_zero ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ hmem
  rw [hQ.orth.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos rfl] at h1
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.H_def
statement: theorem H_def (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) : D.H = D.Qᵀ * A * D.Q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply
statement: theorem H_apply (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (i j : Fin q) : D.H i j = D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ D.Q.col j)
proof:
:=
  transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct _ _ _ _ _

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.hasOrthonormalCols
statement: theorem hasOrthonormalCols (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) : HasOrthonormalCols D.Q
proof: := D.graded.orth

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.range_Q
statement: theorem range_Q (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) : LinearMap.range D.Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:=
  D.graded.range_mulVecLin

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.le_krylovGrade
statement: theorem le_krylovGrade (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) : q ≤ krylovGrade A b
proof: := D.graded.le_krylovGrade

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt
statement:
theorem H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {i j : Fin q}
    (hij : (j : ℕ) + 1 < i) : D.H i j = 0
proof:
:=
  D.graded.transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_zero hij

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.H_succ_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem H_succ_apply_ne_zero (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
    D.H ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  D.graded.transpose_mul_mul_apply_succ_ne_zero hj

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict_Q
statement:
theorem restrict_Q (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) :
    (D.restrict h).Q = D.Q.submatrix id (Fin.castLE h)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.H_restrict
statement:
theorem H_restrict (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) :
    (D.restrict h).H = D.H.submatrix (Fin.castLE h) (Fin.castLE h)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [H_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, H_apply]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.col_eq_smul_col
statement:
theorem col_eq_smul_col (D D' : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (j : Fin q) :
    D'.Q.col j = (D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j) • D.Q.col j
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : D'.Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
    krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) (D'.graded.col_mem j)
  conv_lhs => rw [D.graded.eq_sum_of_mem hmem]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i _ hij => ?_) (by simp)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · rw [dotProduct_comm, D'.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero j
      (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) (D.graded.col_mem i)), zero_smul]
  · rw [D.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero i
      (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) (D'.graded.col_mem j)), zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sq_col_dotProduct_col
statement:
theorem sq_col_dotProduct_col (D D' : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (j : Fin q) :
    (D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := D'.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col j j
  rw [if_pos rfl, D.col_eq_smul_col D' j, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
