    D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos rfl] at h1
  simpa [sq] using h1

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_sign
statement:
theorem exists_sign (D D' : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) :
    ∃ s : Fin q → ℤˣ, D'.Q = D.Q * diagonal fun i => ((s i : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => if 0 ≤ D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j then 1 else -1, ?_⟩
  ext r j
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  have hc : ((((if 0 ≤ D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j then 1 else -1 : ℤˣ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
      D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j := by
    have := D.sq_col_dotProduct_col D' j
    split_ifs with h
    · simp only [Units.val_one, Int.cast_one]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j - 1)]
    · simp only [Units.val_neg, Units.val_one, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j + 1)]
  rw [hc, mul_comm]
  exact congrFun (D.col_eq_smul_col D' j) r

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.Q_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem Q_eq_of_pos (D D' : ArnoldiDecomp A b q)
    (h0 : ∀ hq : 0 < q, 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) (h0' : ∀ hq : 0 < q, 0 < D'.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b)
    (hH : ∀ j (hj : j + 1 < q), 0 < D.H ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩)
    (hH' : ∀ j (hj : j + 1 < q), 0 < D'.H ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩) : D'.Q = D.Q
proof:
:= by
  set s : Fin q → ℝ := fun j => D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j
  have hs1 : ∀ j, 0 < s j → s j = 1 := fun j hj => by
    have := D.sq_col_dotProduct_col D' j
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s j - 1)]
  have hs : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < q), s ⟨j, hj⟩ = 1 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro hq
      refine hs1 _ ?_
      have h := h0' hq
      rw [D.col_eq_smul_col D', smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at h
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_left h (h0 hq).le
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      refine hs1 _ ?_
      have h := hH' j hj
      rw [H_apply, D.col_eq_smul_col D', D.col_eq_smul_col D' ⟨j, by omega⟩,
        Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, ← H_apply,
        show D.Q.col ⟨j, by omega⟩ ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col ⟨j, by omega⟩ = 1 from ih (by omega),
        one_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_left h (hH j hj).le
  ext r j
  have h := congrFun (D.col_eq_smul_col D' j) r
  rw [show D.Q.col j ⬝ᵥ D'.Q.col j = 1 from hs j j.isLt, one_smul] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isSymm_T
statement: theorem isSymm_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T.IsSymm
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul D.Q hA)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist
statement:
theorem T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i j : Fin q}
    (hij : 1 < |(i : ℤ) - j|) : D.T i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_abs.1 hij with h | h
  · exact D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (by omega)
  · rw [← (D.isSymm_T hA).apply i j]
    exact D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (by omega)

name: NLAlib.arnoldiMatrix_col
statement:
theorem arnoldiMatrix_col (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) (j : Fin q) :
    (arnoldiMatrix A b q).col j = arnoldiBasis A b j
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.range_fin_eq_image
statement:
private lemma range_fin_eq_image {α : Type*} (φ : ℕ → α) (q : ℕ) :
    Set.range (fun j : Fin q => φ j) = φ '' Set.Iio q
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, j.isLt, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_eq_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.span_image, ← Set.image_comp, krylovSpace]
  congr 1
  exact range_fin_eq_image (fun i => (A ^ i) *ᵥ b) j

name: NLAlib.mem_span_krylovSeq_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovSpace_eq_map]
  constructor
  · intro hx; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
    have : y = x := by
      have := congrArg (WithLp.toLp 2) hyx
      simpa using this
    rwa [← this]

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidt_ofLp_mem
statement:
private lemma gramSchmidt_ofLp_mem (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) j).ofLp ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_span_krylovSeq_iff, show Set.Iio (j + 1) = Set.Iic j from by ext; simp]
  exact gramSchmidt_mem_span ℝ _ le_rfl

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem
statement:
private lemma pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (A ^ j) *ᵥ b - (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) j).ofLp ∈ krylovSpace A b j
proof:
:= by
  have h := gramSchmidt_def'' ℝ (krylovSeq A b) j
  have hmem : (∑ i ∈ Finset.Iio j, (inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) i)
      (krylovSeq A b j) / ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) i‖ ^ 2) •
        gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) i) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (krylovSeq A b '' Set.Iio j) := by
    rw [← span_gramSchmidt_Iio]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, Finset.mem_Iio.1 hi, rfl⟩)
  rw [mem_span_krylovSeq_iff] at hmem
  convert hmem using 1
  have h' := congrArg WithLp.ofLp h
  rw [WithLp.ofLp_add] at h'
  change (A ^ j) *ᵥ b = _ at h'
  rw [h']
  abel

name: NLAlib.gramSchmidt_ne_zero_of_lt
statement:
private lemma gramSchmidt_ne_zero_of_lt (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j < krylovGrade A b) : gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h := pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem A b j
  rw [h0, WithLp.ofLp_zero, sub_zero] at h
  exact pow_mulVec_notMem_krylovSpace_of_lt_krylovGrade A b hj h

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiBasis, gramSchmidtNormed, WithLp.ofLp_smul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ _ (Nat.ne_of_gt hl)
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [inner_add_right, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [inner_smul_right, hy, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem arnoldiBasis_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    arnoldiBasis A b j ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiBasis_eq]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gramSchmidt_ofLp_mem A b j)

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_dotProduct
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiBasis, arnoldiBasis, ← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _))]
  split_ifs with hij
  · subst hij
    have hne := gramSchmidt_ne_zero_of_lt A b hi
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      gramSchmidtNormed_unit_length' (by simp [gramSchmidtNormed, hne]), one_pow]
  · simp only [gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
      gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ _ hij, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_dotProduct_of_ne
statement:
theorem arnoldiBasis_dotProduct_of_ne (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    arnoldiBasis A b i ⬝ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiBasis, arnoldiBasis, ← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _))]
  simp only [gramSchmidtNormed, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
    gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ _ hij, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.range_arnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem range_arnoldiMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (arnoldiMatrix A b q).mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, krylovSpace_eq_map, ← span_gramSchmidt_Iio,
    ← span_gramSchmidtNormed, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.image_comp]
  exact congrArg _ (range_fin_eq_image (fun j => arnoldiBasis A b j) q)

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_arnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_arnoldiMatrix {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) : HasOrthonormalCols (arnoldiMatrix A b q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  ext i j
  rw [transpose_mul_self_apply, arnoldiMatrix_col, arnoldiMatrix_col,
    arnoldiBasis_dotProduct A b (by omega) (by omega), Matrix.one_apply]
  simp [Fin.ext_iff]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_stoppedArnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_stoppedArnoldiMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (stoppedArnoldiMatrix A b q)
proof:
:=
  hasOrthonormalCols_arnoldiMatrix (min_le_right _ _)

name: NLAlib.range_stoppedArnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem range_stoppedArnoldiMatrix (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (stoppedArnoldiMatrix A b q).mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [stoppedArnoldiMatrix, range_arnoldiMatrix]
  rcases le_total q (krylovGrade A b) with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
  · rw [min_eq_right h, krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A b h]

name: NLAlib.card_stoppedArnoldiMatrix_le
statement:
theorem card_stoppedArnoldiMatrix_le (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (min q (krylovGrade A b))) ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  simpa using min_le_left q (krylovGrade A b)

name: NLAlib.card_stoppedArnoldiMatrix_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem card_stoppedArnoldiMatrix_eq_finrank (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (min q (krylovGrade A b))) = Module.finrank ℝ (krylovSpace A b q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_krylovSpace A b q]

name: NLAlib.arnoldiHessenberg_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt
statement:
theorem arnoldiHessenberg_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    {i j : Fin q} (hij : (j : ℕ) + 1 < i) : arnoldiHessenberg A b q i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [arnoldiHessenberg, transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct, arnoldiMatrix_col,
    arnoldiMatrix_col, arnoldiBasis, gramSchmidtNormed, WithLp.ofLp_smul, smul_dotProduct,
    ← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _))]
  have hx : WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j) ∈
      Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) '' Set.Iio i) := by
    rw [span_gramSchmidt_Iio, mem_span_krylovSeq_iff]
    exact krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega)
      (mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b (arnoldiBasis_mem_krylovSpace A b j))
  rw [inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span A b hx, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.arnoldiHessenberg_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt_of_isHermitian
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ((arnoldiMatrix A b q)ᵀ * A * arnoldiMatrix A b q).IsSymm := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul (arnoldiMatrix A b q) hA)
  rw [arnoldiHessenberg, ← hT.apply i j]
  exact arnoldiHessenberg_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt A b hij

name: NLAlib.transpose_arnoldiMatrix_mulVec_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_arnoldiMatrix_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    {i : Fin q} (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ)) : ((arnoldiMatrix A b q)ᵀ *ᵥ b) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : WithLp.toLp 2 b ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) '' Set.Iio i) := by
    rw [span_gramSchmidt_Iio, mem_span_krylovSeq_iff]
    simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (i := 0) hi
  have h0 := inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span A b hb
  have hrow : ((arnoldiMatrix A b q)ᵀ *ᵥ b) i = arnoldiBasis A b i ⬝ᵥ b := rfl
  rw [hrow, arnoldiBasis, gramSchmidtNormed, WithLp.ofLp_smul, smul_dotProduct,
    show b = (WithLp.toLp 2 b).ofLp from rfl, ← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _)), h0, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.arnoldiDecomp_Q
statement:
theorem arnoldiDecomp_Q (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    (arnoldiDecomp A b q h).Q = arnoldiMatrix A b q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.arnoldiDecomp_H
statement:
theorem arnoldiDecomp_H (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    (arnoldiDecomp A b q h).H = arnoldiHessenberg A b q
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_isGradedKrylovBasis_iff
statement:
theorem exists_isGradedKrylovBasis_iff (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (∃ Q : Matrix n (Fin q) ℝ, IsGradedKrylovBasis A b Q) ↔ q ≤ krylovGrade A b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, hQ⟩ => hQ.le_krylovGrade, fun h => ⟨_, (arnoldiDecomp A b q h).graded⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.arnoldiDecomp_H_subdiag_pos
proof:
:= by
  set D := arnoldiDecomp A b q h
  set g := fun k => (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) k).ofLp
  have hg : ∀ k, k < krylovGrade A b → 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) k‖ := fun k hk =>
    norm_pos_iff.2 (gramSchmidt_ne_zero_of_lt A b hk)
  have hperp : ∀ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1), arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ x = 0 :=
    fun x hx => D.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ hx
  rw [ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply]
  change arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j) > 0
  
  have h1 : A *ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) j‖⁻¹ •
      ((A ^ (j + 1)) *ᵥ b - A *ᵥ ((A ^ j) *ᵥ b - g j)) := by
    rw [arnoldiBasis_eq, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ',
      sub_sub_cancel]
  have h2 : arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ((A ^ j) *ᵥ b - g j)) = 0 :=
    hperp _ (mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b (pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem A b j))
  have h3 : arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (j + 1)) *ᵥ b - g (j + 1)) = 0 :=
    hperp _ (pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem A b (j + 1))
  have h4 : arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ g (j + 1) = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) (j + 1)‖ := by
    have hpos := hg (j + 1) (by omega)
    rw [arnoldiBasis_eq, smul_dotProduct, ← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _)), real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  rw [h1, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_sub, h2, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [dotProduct_sub, h4, sub_eq_zero] at h3
  rw [h3]
  exact mul_pos (inv_pos.2 (hg j (by omega))) (hg (j + 1) (by omega))

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_zero_dotProduct_pos
statement:
theorem arnoldiBasis_zero_dotProduct_pos (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ)
    (h : 0 < krylovGrade A b) : 0 < arnoldiBasis A b 0 ⬝ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hg := norm_pos_iff.2 (gramSchmidt_ne_zero_of_lt A b h)
  have hb : (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) 0).ofLp = b := by
    have h0 := pow_mulVec_sub_gramSchmidt_mem A b 0
    simp only [krylovSpace, Set.range_eq_empty, Submodule.span_empty,
      Submodule.mem_bot, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    exact h0.symm
  have hdot : (gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) 0).ofLp ⬝ᵥ b =
      ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) 0‖ ^ 2 := by
    conv_lhs => arg 2; rw [← hb]
    rw [← (inner_eq_star_dotProduct_ofLp (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun w => w ⬝ᵥ _) (star_trivial _)), real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [arnoldiBasis_eq, smul_dotProduct, hdot, smul_eq_mul]
  positivity

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.Q_eq_arnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem ArnoldiDecomp.Q_eq_arnoldiMatrix {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q)
    (h0 : ∀ hq : 0 < q, 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b)
    (hH : ∀ j (hj : j + 1 < q), 0 < D.H ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩) :
    D.Q = arnoldiMatrix A b q
proof:
:=
  (arnoldiDecomp A b q D.le_krylovGrade).Q_eq_of_pos D
    (fun hq => arnoldiBasis_zero_dotProduct_pos A b (by have := D.le_krylovGrade; omega)) h0
    (fun _ hj => arnoldiDecomp_H_subdiag_pos A b _ hj) hH

name: NLAlib.arnoldiBasis_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem arnoldiBasis_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : krylovGrade A b ≤ j) : arnoldiBasis A b j = 0
proof:
:= by
  set D := arnoldiDecomp A b (krylovGrade A b) le_rfl
  have hx : arnoldiBasis A b j ∈ krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b) := by
    rw [← krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A b (show krylovGrade A b ≤ j + 1 by omega)]
    exact arnoldiBasis_mem_krylovSpace A b j
  rw [D.graded.eq_sum_of_mem hx]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  have h0 : D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j = 0 :=
    arnoldiBasis_dotProduct_of_ne A b (by have := i.isLt; omega)
  rw [h0, zero_smul]

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis (A * Aᵀ) b (golubKahanU A b (k + 1)) ∧
      IsGradedKrylovBasis (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (golubKahanV A b (k + 1))
proof:
:=
  isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahan_of_dilationGrade
    (two_mul_le_dilationGrade_of_golubKahanSucceeds h)

name: NLAlib.golubKahanSucceeds_iff
statement:
theorem golubKahanSucceeds_iff (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    GolubKahanSucceeds A b k ↔
      k + 1 ≤ krylovGrade (A * Aᵀ) b ∧ k + 1 ≤ krylovGrade (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V h).1.le_krylovGrade,
      (isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V h).2.le_krylovGrade⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, hv⟩ j hj
    have hg := two_mul_le_krylovGrade_dilation hu hv
    constructor
    · rw [← lanczosBeta_dilation_odd]
      exact (lanczosBeta_pos (isHermitian_dilation A) _ (by omega) (by omega)).ne'
    · cases j with
      | zero =>
        have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
          intro hb
          have hz := (krylovGrade_eq_zero_iff (A * Aᵀ) b).2 hb
          omega
        change √(b ⬝ᵥ b) ≠ 0
        rw [← norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
        exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by simpa using hb)
      | succ j =>
        rw [← lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ]
        exact (lanczosBeta_pos (isHermitian_dilation A) _ (by omega) (by omega)).ne'

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (_h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) :
    (∀ j ≤ k, (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha) ∧
    (∀ j < k, (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun j _ => dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha A b j,
    fun j _ => dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta A b j⟩

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_diag
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_diag (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin k) :
    (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).B j.castSucc j =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha
proof:
:= by
  rw [GolubKahanDecomp.B, transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]
  exact dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha A b j

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_subdiag
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_B_subdiag (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin k) :
    (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).B j.succ j =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta
proof:
:= by
  rw [GolubKahanDecomp.B, transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]
  exact dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta A b j

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_transpose_mulVec
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp_transpose_mulVec (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (h : GolubKahanSucceeds A b k) (j : Fin (k + 1)) :
    Aᵀ *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).U.col j =
      (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).V *ᵥ
        (golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h).Bᵀ.col j +
      if j = Fin.last k then
        (golubKahanRecurrence A b k).alpha • (golubKahanRecurrence A b k).v else 0
proof:
:= by
  let D := golubKahanRecurrenceDecomp A b k h
  have hV := (isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahanU_V h).2
  have hm : Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j ∈ krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (k + 1) :=
    krylovSpace_mono _ _ (by omega)
      (transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (D.gradedU.col_mem j))
  have he := hV.eq_sum_of_mem hm
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at he
  have hfirst : ∀ l : Fin k,
      (golubKahanV A b (k + 1)).col l.castSucc ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j) = D.B j l := by
    intro l
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec, GolubKahanDecomp.B,
      transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]
    rfl
  have hlast : (golubKahanV A b (k + 1)).col (Fin.last k) ⬝ᵥ
      (Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j) = if j = Fin.last k then (golubKahanRecurrence A b k).alpha else 0 := by
    by_cases hj : j = Fin.last k
    · subst j
      rw [if_pos rfl, Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec]
      exact dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha A b k
    · rw [if_neg hj]
      have hjk : (j : ℕ) ≠ k := by
        intro heq
        exact hj (Fin.ext heq)
      exact hV.col_dotProduct_eq_zero (Fin.last k)
        (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (by have := j.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_last]; omega)
          (transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (D.gradedU.col_mem j)))
  simp_rw [hfirst] at he
  rw [hlast] at he
  change Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j = D.V *ᵥ D.Bᵀ.col j + _
  rw [he, mulVec_eq_sum_smul_col]
  congr 1
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact zero_smul _ _

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mulVec_col_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mulVec_col_eq_sum (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {j : Fin q} (hj : (j : ℕ) + 1 < q) :
    A *ᵥ D.Q.col j = ∑ i, D.H i j • D.Q.col i
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : A *ᵥ D.Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
    krylovSpace_mono A b (show (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ q by omega) (D.graded.mulVec_col_mem j)
  conv_lhs => rw [D.graded.eq_sum_of_mem hmem]
  simp only [H_apply]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = D.Q * D.Hbar
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hbar]
  ext r j
  have hmem : A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q.col j ∈ LinearMap.range D.Q.mulVecLin := by
    rw [D.range_Q]
    exact krylovSpace_mono A b (show (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ q + 1 by omega)
      ((D.restrict q.le_succ).graded.mulVec_col_mem j)
  have h := congrFun (mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range D.hasOrthonormalCols hmem) r
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  change (A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q).col j r =
    (D.Q * D.Qᵀ * A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q).col j r
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, ← h]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_vecMulVec (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * (D.restrict q.le_succ).H +
      vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (fun j => D.H (Fin.last q) j.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul, Hbar]
  ext r j
  rw [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Matrix.mul_apply,
    vecMulVec_apply]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q = (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * (D.restrict q.le_succ).H +
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ •
        vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (Pi.single (⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin q) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_vecMulVec]
  congr 1
  ext r j
  rw [vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hj : (j : ℕ) = q - 1
  · have hj' : j.castSucc = ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp [hj])
    rw [Pi.single_apply, if_pos (Fin.ext hj), hj']
    ring
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun h => hj (by rw [h])), mul_zero, mul_zero,
      D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (by simp; omega), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (h : krylovGrade A b ≤ q) :
    A * D.Q = D.Q * D.H
proof:
:= by
  ext r j
  have hmem : A *ᵥ D.Q.col j ∈ LinearMap.range D.Q.mulVecLin := by
    rw [D.range_Q]
    have hj := krylovSpace_le_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b _ (D.graded.col_mem j)
    rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A b h]
    exact mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b hj
  have h := congrFun (mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range D.hasOrthonormalCols hmem) r
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
  rw [H_def, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  change (A * D.Q).col j r = (D.Q * D.Qᵀ * A * D.Q).col j r
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, ← h]
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mul_Q_eq_mul_H_iff
statement:
theorem mul_Q_eq_mul_H_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * D.Q = D.Q * D.H ↔ krylovGrade A b = q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => le_antisymm ?_ D.le_krylovGrade, fun h => D.mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le h.le⟩
  
  have hinv : ∀ x ∈ krylovSpace A b q, A *ᵥ x ∈ krylovSpace A b q := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← D.range_Q] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨D.H *ᵥ y, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h]
  have hpow : ∀ i : ℕ, (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hq
    | succ i ih => rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; exact hinv _ ih
  exact krylovGrade_le_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (hpow q)

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.eq_of_forall_col_dotProduct_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.graded.eq_sum_of_mem hx, D.graded.eq_sum_of_mem hy]
  simp only [h]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) {i : Fin q}
    (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ)) : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ∈ krylovSpace A b i := by simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (i := 0) hi
  exact D.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero i hb

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero
statement:
theorem sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ ^ 2 = b ⬝ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range D.Q.mulVecLin := by
    rw [D.range_Q]; simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (i := 0) hq
  have h1 : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) = b ⬝ᵥ b := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose,
      ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial D.Q,
      mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range D.hasOrthonormalCols hb]
  rw [← h1, dotProduct, Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q), sq]
  · intro i _ hi
    rw [D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)),
      mul_zero]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
    (M : Matrix k k ℝ) {c : k → ℝ} (i₀ : k) (hc : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → c i = 0) :
    c ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ c) = c i₀ ^ 2 * M i₀ i₀
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : c = Pi.single i₀ (c i₀) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · subst hi; simp
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi, hc i hi]
  rw [hc']
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_single, Pi.single_eq_same]
  simp [dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
  ring

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_of_lt
statement: theorem vec_of_lt (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : D.vec j = D.Q.col ⟨j, hj⟩
proof:
:=
  dif_pos hj

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_mem
statement: theorem vec_mem (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : D.vec j ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  unfold vec
  split_ifs with h
  · exact krylovSpace_mono A b (show j + 1 ≤ q by omega) (D.graded.col_mem ⟨j, h⟩)
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.col_dotProduct_vec
statement:
theorem col_dotProduct_vec (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (i : Fin q) (k : ℕ) :
    D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ D.vec k = if (i : ℕ) = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold vec
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
  · rw [D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos (Fin.ext h2)]
  · rw [D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_neg (fun h => h2 (by rw [h]))]
  · exact absurd (h2 ▸ i.isLt) h1
  · exact dotProduct_zero _

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mulVec_vec_eq
statement:
theorem mulVec_vec_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
    A *ᵥ D.vec j =
      D.beta j • D.vec (j - 1) + D.alpha j • D.vec j + D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmemA : A *ᵥ D.vec j ∈ krylovSpace A b q := by
    rw [D.vec_of_lt (by omega)]
    exact krylovSpace_mono A b (show j + 2 ≤ q by omega) (D.graded.mulVec_col_mem ⟨j, by omega⟩)
  have hmemR : D.beta j • D.vec (j - 1) + D.alpha j • D.vec j + D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1)
      ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
    Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))
  refine D.eq_of_forall_col_dotProduct_eq hmemA hmemR fun i => ?_
  rw [D.vec_of_lt (show j < q by omega), ← ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply]
  simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← D.vec_of_lt (show j < q by omega),
    col_dotProduct_vec, alpha, beta, dif_pos (show j < q by omega),
    dif_pos (show 0 < j + 1 ∧ j + 1 < q by omega)]
  have hS : (ArnoldiDecomp.H D).IsSymm := D.isSymm_T hA
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((i : ℕ) + 1) j with h1 | h1
  · have h0 : ArnoldiDecomp.H D i ⟨j, by omega⟩ = 0 := by
      rw [← hS.apply]
      exact D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (i := ⟨j, by omega⟩) (j := i) h1
    rw [h0]
    simp only [show (i : ℕ) ≠ j - 1 by omega, show (i : ℕ) ≠ j by omega,
      show (i : ℕ) ≠ j + 1 by omega, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (j + 1) i with h2 | h2
  · rw [D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt h2]
    simp only [show (i : ℕ) ≠ j - 1 by omega, show (i : ℕ) ≠ j by omega,
      show (i : ℕ) ≠ j + 1 by omega, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rcases (show (i : ℕ) + 1 = j ∨ (i : ℕ) = j ∨ (i : ℕ) = j + 1 by omega) with h | h | h
  · rw [show i = ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ from Fin.ext (by simp; omega)]
    simp only [show j - 1 ≠ j by omega, show j - 1 ≠ j + 1 by omega, if_true, if_false,
      mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one, dif_pos (show 0 < j ∧ j < q by omega)]
    exact (hS.apply _ _).symm
  · rw [show i = ⟨j, by omega⟩ from Fin.ext h]
    simp only [show j ≠ j + 1 by omega, if_true, if_false, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one]
    split_ifs with h0 h0' <;> try simp
    omega
  · rw [show i = ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ from Fin.ext h]
    simp only [show j + 1 ≠ j - 1 by omega, show j + 1 ≠ j by omega, if_true, if_false,
      mul_zero, zero_add, mul_one]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul
statement:
theorem mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_beta_smul (D : LanczosDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q) :
    A * (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q =
      (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q * LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict q.le_succ) +
        D.beta q • vecMulVec (D.vec q) (Pi.single (⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin q) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ArnoldiDecomp.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul D hq, D.vec_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self q), beta,
    dif_pos ⟨hq, Nat.lt_succ_self q⟩]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem beta_ne_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
    D.beta j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [beta, dif_pos ⟨h0, hj⟩]
  simpa using D.H_succ_apply_ne_zero hj

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos
statement:
theorem beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) : 0 < LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q h) j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [beta, dif_pos ⟨h0, hj⟩]
  simpa using arnoldiDecomp_H_subdiag_pos A b h hj

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {p : Polynomial ℝ} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) :
    b ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
      (b ⬝ᵥ b) * Polynomial.aeval D.T p ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA D.hasOrthonormalCols b D.range_Q.ge hp,
    dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero _ (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) fun i hi =>
      D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)),
    D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.golubKahanRecurrence_mem
statement:
theorem golubKahanRecurrence_mem (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ∈ krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b (j + 1) ∧
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v ∈ krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hu : (golubKahanInit A b).u ∈ krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b 1 :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (self_mem_krylovSpace_succ _ _ 0)
    exact ⟨hu, Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hu)⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    have hu : (golubKahanStep A (golubKahanRecurrence A b j)).u ∈
        krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b (j + 1 + 1) := by
      apply Submodule.smul_mem
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_mul_transpose A b ih.2)
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.le_succ _) ih.1))
    have hv : (golubKahanStep A (golubKahanRecurrence A b j)).v ∈
        krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (j + 1 + 1) := by
      apply Submodule.smul_mem
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hu)
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.le_succ _) ih.2))
    simpa only [golubKahanRecurrence, Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using And.intro hu hv

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahan_of_dilationGrade
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_golubKahan_of_dilationGrade {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ}
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q ≤ krylovGrade (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis (A * Aᵀ) b (golubKahanU A b q) ∧
      IsGradedKrylovBasis (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (golubKahanV A b q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply IsGradedKrylovBasis.of_mem
    · change (golubKahanU A b q)ᴴ * golubKahanU A b q = 1
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      ext i j
      rw [transpose_mul_self_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
      have h := arnoldiBasis_dotProduct (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))
        (i := 2 * (i : ℕ)) (j := 2 * (j : ℕ)) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
        ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
        lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even, lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even] at h
      have he : (2 * (i : ℕ) = 2 * (j : ℕ)) ↔ i = j := by
        constructor
        · intro hij; apply Fin.ext; omega
        · rintro rfl; rfl
      simpa only [golubKahanU, Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, dotProduct,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply,
        mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, he] using h
    · intro j
      exact (golubKahanRecurrence_mem A b j).1
  · apply IsGradedKrylovBasis.of_mem
    · change (golubKahanV A b q)ᴴ * golubKahanV A b q = 1
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      ext i j
      rw [transpose_mul_self_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
      have h := arnoldiBasis_dotProduct (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))
        (i := 2 * (i : ℕ) + 1) (j := 2 * (j : ℕ) + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
        ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
        lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd, lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd] at h
      have he : (2 * (i : ℕ) + 1 = 2 * (j : ℕ) + 1) ↔ i = j := by
        constructor
        · intro hij; apply Fin.ext; omega
        · rintro rfl; rfl
      simpa only [golubKahanV, Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, dotProduct,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply,
        zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, he] using h
    · intro j
      exact (golubKahanRecurrence_mem A b j).2

name: NLAlib.two_mul_le_dilationGrade_of_golubKahanSucceeds
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (h k le_rfl).1
  rw [← lanczosBeta_dilation_odd] at hn
  have hg := (lanczosBeta_eq_zero_iff (isHermitian_dilation A)
    (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (j := 2 * k + 1) (by omega)).not.mp hn
  omega

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  have h := mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_mul_eq (C := A) (B' := A * Aᵀ)
    (by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]) hx
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  exact krylovSpace_mulVec_le_succ _ _ _ h

name: NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) {q : ℕ} {x : m → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ krylovSpace (A * Aᵀ) b q) : Aᵀ *ᵥ x ∈ krylovSpace (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) q
proof:
:=
  mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_mul_eq (by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]) hx

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.range_mul_V_le
statement:
theorem range_mul_V_le (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) :
    LinearMap.range (A * D.V).mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range D.U.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.gradedU.range_mulVecLin, Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  refine mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_mul_transpose A b ?_
  rw [← D.gradedV.range_mulVecLin]
  exact ⟨Pi.single j 1, by simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]⟩

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.mul_V_eq_U_mul_B
statement: theorem mul_V_eq_U_mul_B (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) : A * D.V = D.U * D.B
proof:
:= by
  rw [B, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial D.U,
    mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le D.gradedU.orth D.range_mul_V_le]

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.B_apply_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem B_apply_eq_zero_of_lt (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) {i : Fin (k + 1)} {j : Fin k}
    (h : (i : ℕ) < j) : D.B i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [B, transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    dotProduct_comm]
  refine D.gradedV.col_dotProduct_eq_zero j ?_
  have hu := transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (D.gradedU.col_mem i)
  exact krylovSpace_mono _ _ (show (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ j by omega) hu

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.B_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt
statement:
theorem B_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) {i : Fin (k + 1)}
    {j : Fin k} (h : (j : ℕ) + 1 < i) : D.B i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [B, transpose_mul_mul_apply_eq_dotProduct]
  refine D.gradedU.col_dotProduct_eq_zero i ?_
  have hv := mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_mul_transpose A b (D.gradedV.col_mem j)
  exact krylovSpace_mono _ _ (show (j : ℕ) + 1 + 1 ≤ i by omega) hv

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.transpose_B_mul_B_eq_T
statement: theorem transpose_B_mul_B_eq_T (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) : D.Bᵀ * D.B = D.lanczosV.T
proof:
:= by
  have hU : D.Uᵀ * D.U = 1 := D.gradedU.orth
  change D.Bᵀ * D.B = D.Vᵀ * (Aᵀ * A) * D.V
  have h := D.mul_V_eq_U_mul_B
  calc D.Bᵀ * D.B = (D.U * D.B)ᵀ * (D.U * D.B) := by
        rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc D.Uᵀ, hU, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = D.Vᵀ * (Aᵀ * A) * D.V := by
        rw [← h, Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.GolubKahanDecomp.transpose_mulVec_U_col_mem_range_V
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_U_col_mem_range_V (D : GolubKahanDecomp A b k) {j : Fin (k + 1)}
    (hj : (j : ℕ) < k) : Aᵀ *ᵥ D.U.col j ∈ LinearMap.range D.V.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.gradedV.range_mulVecLin]
  exact krylovSpace_mono _ _ (show (j : ℕ) + 1 ≤ k by omega)
    (transpose_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (D.gradedU.col_mem j))

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem lanczosState_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosState A b 0 = lanczosInit b
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_succ
statement:
theorem lanczosState_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosState A b (j + 1) = lanczosStep A (lanczosState A b j)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_zero
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosRecurrence A b 0 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖⁻¹ • b
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lanczosBeta_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) : lanczosBeta A b 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_succ_prev
statement:
theorem lanczosState_succ_prev (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (lanczosState A b (j + 1)).prev = lanczosRecurrence A b j
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosState_succ]; rfl

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_nonneg
statement: theorem lanczosBeta_nonneg (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ lanczosBeta A b j
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ j => rw [lanczosBeta, lanczosState_succ]; exact norm_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.sqrt_smul_inv_smul
statement: private lemma sqrt_smul_inv_smul (w : n → ℝ) : √(w ⬝ᵥ w) • ((√(w ⬝ᵥ w))⁻¹ • w) = w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : √(w ⬝ᵥ w) = 0
  · have hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = 0 := by
      have := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.1 h
      exact le_antisymm this (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
    rw [dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hw]; simp
  · rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.inv_sqrt_mul_self
statement: private lemma inv_sqrt_mul_self (w : n → ℝ) : (√(w ⬝ᵥ w))⁻¹ * (w ⬝ᵥ w) = √(w ⬝ᵥ w)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ w ⬝ᵥ w := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  set s := √(w ⬝ᵥ w) with hs
  have hw : w ⬝ᵥ w = s * s := (Real.mul_self_sqrt h0).symm
  rw [hw]
  by_cases h : s = 0
  · rw [h, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_one_smul
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_one_smul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) :
    lanczosBeta A b 1 • lanczosRecurrence A b 1 =
      A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b 0 - lanczosAlpha A b 0 • lanczosRecurrence A b 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lanczosBeta, lanczosRecurrence, lanczosAlpha, lanczosState_succ, lanczosStep,
    norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  rw [sqrt_smul_inv_smul]
  simp [lanczosInit]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_add_two_smul
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_add_two_smul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta A b (j + 2) • lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 2) =
      A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1) - lanczosAlpha A b (j + 1) • lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1)
        - lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) • lanczosRecurrence A b j
proof:
:= by
  have hp := lanczosState_succ_prev A b j
  simp only [lanczosBeta, lanczosRecurrence, lanczosAlpha] at hp ⊢
  rw [lanczosState_succ A b (j + 1)]
  simp only [lanczosStep, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  rw [sqrt_smul_inv_smul, hp]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_succ_eq
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_succ_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) = lanczosRecurrence A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ
      (A *ᵥ lanczosRecurrence A b j - lanczosAlpha A b j • lanczosRecurrence A b j -
        lanczosBeta A b j • (lanczosState A b j).prev)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lanczosBeta, lanczosRecurrence, lanczosAlpha, lanczosState_succ A b j, lanczosStep,
    norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  rw [smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, inv_sqrt_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.lanczosDecomp_mulVec_vec_eq
statement:
private theorem lanczosDecomp_mulVec_vec_eq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : krylovGrade A b ≤ q) (j : ℕ) :
    A *ᵥ D.vec j =
      D.beta j • D.vec (j - 1) + D.alpha j • D.vec j +
        D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < q
  · by_cases hj' : j + 1 < q
    · exact D.mulVec_vec_eq hA hj'
    have hlast : j + 1 = q := by omega
    have hmemA : A *ᵥ D.vec j ∈ krylovSpace A b q := by
      rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A b hq]
      exact mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b
        (krylovSpace_le_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b q (D.vec_mem j))
    have hmemR : D.beta j • D.vec (j - 1) + D.alpha j • D.vec j +
        D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1) ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
      Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem _))
    have hS : (ArnoldiDecomp.H D).IsSymm := D.isSymm_T hA
    refine D.eq_of_forall_col_dotProduct_eq hmemA hmemR fun i => ?_
    rw [D.vec_of_lt hj, ← ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply]
    simp only [dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      ← D.vec_of_lt hj, LanczosDecomp.col_dotProduct_vec,
      LanczosDecomp.alpha, LanczosDecomp.beta, dif_pos hj,
      dif_neg (show ¬(0 < j + 1 ∧ j + 1 < q) by omega), zero_mul, add_zero]
    rcases eq_or_ne (i : ℕ) j with hi | hi
    · have hif : i = ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fin.ext hi
      rw [hif]
      simp only [if_true, mul_one]
      by_cases hj0 : 0 < j
      · simp only [dif_pos (show 0 < j ∧ j < q from ⟨hj0, hj⟩), show j ≠ j - 1 by omega, if_false, mul_zero,
          zero_add]
      · simp only [dif_neg (show ¬(0 < j ∧ j < q) by omega), zero_mul, zero_add]
    · simp only [if_neg hi, mul_zero, add_zero]
      by_cases hprev : (i : ℕ) = j - 1
      · have hj0 : 0 < j := by have := i.isLt; omega
        have hif : i = ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext hprev
        rw [hif]
        simp only [dif_pos (show 0 < j ∧ j < q from ⟨hj0, hj⟩), if_true, mul_one]
        exact (hS.apply _ _).symm
      · rw [if_neg hprev, mul_zero]
        rw [← hS.apply i ⟨j, hj⟩]
        exact D.H_apply_eq_zero_of_add_one_lt (i := ⟨j, hj⟩) (j := i)
          (show (i : ℕ) + 1 < j by have := i.isLt; omega)
  · simp [LanczosDecomp.vec, LanczosDecomp.alpha, LanczosDecomp.beta, hj,
      show ¬j + 1 < q by omega]

name: NLAlib.lanczosCanonicalState_cur
statement:
private theorem lanczosCanonicalState_cur (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).cur = arnoldiBasis A b j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < krylovGrade A b
  · simp only [lanczosCanonicalState, LanczosDecomp.vec_of_lt _ hj,
      arnoldiDecomp_Q, arnoldiMatrix_col]
  · simp [lanczosCanonicalState, LanczosDecomp.vec, hj,
      arnoldiBasis_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le A b (not_lt.mp hj)]

name: NLAlib.lanczos_norm_smul_and_inv_smul
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · rw [h0 rfl]
    simp
  · have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c • v)‖ = c := by
      rw [WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, h1 hc0, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg hc]
    refine ⟨hn, ?_⟩
    rw [hn, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.lanczosStep_lanczosCanonicalState
proof:
:= by
  let D : LanczosDecomp A b (krylovGrade A b) :=
    arnoldiDecomp A b (krylovGrade A b) le_rfl
  have halpha : D.vec j ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ D.vec j) = D.alpha j := by
    by_cases hj : j < krylovGrade A b
    · rw [D.vec_of_lt hj, LanczosDecomp.alpha, dif_pos hj, LanczosDecomp.T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply]
    · simp [LanczosDecomp.vec, LanczosDecomp.alpha, hj]
  have hw : A *ᵥ (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).cur -
      ((lanczosCanonicalState A b j).cur ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).cur)) •
        (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).cur -
      (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).beta • (lanczosCanonicalState A b j).prev =
        D.beta (j + 1) • D.vec (j + 1) := by
    change A *ᵥ D.vec j - (D.vec j ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ D.vec j)) • D.vec j -
      D.beta j • lanczosCanonicalPrev D j = _
    rw [halpha, lanczosDecomp_mulVec_vec_eq D hA le_rfl]
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [lanczosCanonicalPrev, LanczosDecomp.beta]
    | succ j => simp only [lanczosCanonicalPrev, Nat.add_sub_cancel]; abel
  have hc : 0 ≤ D.beta (j + 1) := by
    by_cases hj : j + 1 < krylovGrade A b
    · exact (LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos A b le_rfl (by omega) hj).le
    · simp [LanczosDecomp.beta, hj]
  have hc0 : D.beta (j + 1) = 0 → D.vec (j + 1) = 0 := by
    intro h
    by_cases hj : j + 1 < krylovGrade A b
    · exact False.elim ((LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos A b le_rfl
        (by omega) hj).ne' h)
    · simp [LanczosDecomp.vec, hj]
  have hc1 : D.beta (j + 1) ≠ 0 → ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D.vec (j + 1))‖ = 1 := by
    intro h
    have hj : j + 1 < krylovGrade A b := by
      by_contra hj
      exact h (by simp [LanczosDecomp.beta, hj])
    rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, D.vec_of_lt hj,
      D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos rfl, Real.sqrt_one]
  obtain ⟨hn, hv⟩ := lanczos_norm_smul_and_inv_smul hc hc0 hc1
  unfold lanczosStep
  rw [hw]
  dsimp only
  rw [hv, hn]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_eq_lanczosCanonicalState
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hcur : (lanczosCanonicalState A b 0).cur = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖⁻¹ • b := by
      rw [lanczosCanonicalState_cur, arnoldiBasis, InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed]
      have hg : InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt ℝ (krylovSeq A b) 0 =
          WithLp.toLp 2 b := by
        simpa only [Nat.bot_eq_zero, krylovSeq, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec] using
          (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidt_bot ℝ (krylovSeq A b))
      rw [hg]
      simp [WithLp.ofLp_smul]
    change lanczosInit b = lanczosCanonicalState A b 0
    cases h : lanczosCanonicalState A b 0 with
    | mk p c beta =>
      have hp : p = 0 := by simpa [lanczosCanonicalState, lanczosCanonicalPrev] using congrArg LanczosState.prev h.symm
      have hb : beta = 0 := by
        simpa [lanczosCanonicalState, LanczosDecomp.beta] using congrArg LanczosState.beta h.symm
      simp only [h] at hcur
      simp [lanczosInit, hp, hb, hcur]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [lanczosState_succ, ih, lanczosStep_lanczosCanonicalState hA]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (j : ℕ) : lanczosRecurrence A b j = arnoldiBasis A b j
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRecurrence, lanczosState_eq_lanczosCanonicalState hA,
    lanczosCanonicalState_cur]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    (j : ℕ) : lanczosBeta A b (j + 1) = arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ arnoldiBasis A b j)
proof:
:= by
  have hprev : arnoldiBasis A b (j + 1) ⬝ᵥ (lanczosState A b j).prev = 0 := by
    cases j with
    | zero => simp [lanczosInit]
    | succ j =>
      rw [lanczosState_succ_prev, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA]
      exact arnoldiBasis_dotProduct_of_ne A b (by omega)
  rw [lanczosBeta_succ_eq, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA,
    lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_smul, hprev, arnoldiBasis_dotProduct_of_ne A b (by omega)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_pos
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_pos {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < j)
    (hj : j < krylovGrade A b) : 0 < lanczosBeta A b j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct hA]
  have h := arnoldiDecomp_H_subdiag_pos A b (q := j + 2) (by omega) (j := j) (by omega)
  rwa [ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply] at h

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : krylovGrade A b ≤ j) : lanczosBeta A b j = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j =>
    rw [lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct hA, arnoldiBasis_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le A b hj,
      zero_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_eq_zero_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ}
    (h0 : 0 < j) : lanczosBeta A b j = 0 ↔ krylovGrade A b ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le hA b⟩
  by_contra hlt
  exact (lanczosBeta_pos hA b h0 (not_le.1 hlt)).ne' h

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) {j : ℕ} (hj : krylovGrade A b ≤ j) : lanczosRecurrence A b j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA, arnoldiBasis_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le A b hj]

name: NLAlib.lanczosAlpha_eq_alpha
proof:
:= by
  rw [LanczosDecomp.alpha, dif_pos hj, LanczosDecomp.T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply, arnoldiDecomp_Q,
    arnoldiMatrix_col, lanczosAlpha, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_eq_beta
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero => simp [LanczosDecomp.beta]
  | succ j =>
    rw [LanczosDecomp.beta, dif_pos ⟨Nat.succ_pos j, hj⟩, LanczosDecomp.T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_apply,
      arnoldiDecomp_Q, arnoldiMatrix_col, arnoldiMatrix_col, lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct hA]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.isGradedKrylovBasis_lanczosRecurrence
statement:
theorem isGradedKrylovBasis_lanczosRecurrence {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    IsGradedKrylovBasis A b (Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin q) => lanczosRecurrence A b j r)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin q) => lanczosRecurrence A b j r) = arnoldiMatrix A b q := by
    ext r j
    simp [arnoldiMatrix, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA]
  rw [hQ]
  exact (arnoldiDecomp A b q h).graded

name: NLAlib.left_sub
statement: private theorem left_sub (u v : m → ℝ) : left (n := n) (u - v) = left u - left v
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [left]

name: NLAlib.right_sub
statement: private theorem right_sub (u v : n → ℝ) : right (m := m) (u - v) = right u - right v
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [right]

name: NLAlib.left_smul
statement: private theorem left_smul (a : ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) : left (n := n) (a • u) = a • left u
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [left]

name: NLAlib.right_smul
statement: private theorem right_smul (a : ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) : right (m := m) (a • v) = a • right v
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [right]

name: NLAlib.dot_left_right
statement: private theorem dot_left_right (u : m → ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) : left u ⬝ᵥ right v = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [left, right, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.dot_right_left
statement: private theorem dot_right_left (v : n → ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) : right v ⬝ᵥ left u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_comm, dot_left_right]

name: NLAlib.norm_left
statement:
private theorem norm_left (u : m → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (left (n := n) u)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  simp [left, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.norm_right
statement:
private theorem norm_right (v : n → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (right (m := m) v)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  simp [right, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.dilation_mulVec_left
statement:
private theorem dilation_mulVec_left (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) :
    dilation A *ᵥ left u = right (Aᵀ *ᵥ u)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [dilation, left, right, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.dilation_mulVec_right
statement:
private theorem dilation_mulVec_right (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    dilation A *ᵥ right v = left (A *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [dilation, left, right, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.lanczosStep_dilation_left
statement:
private theorem lanczosStep_dilation_left (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (v : n → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) :
    lanczosStep (dilation A) ⟨right v, left u, a⟩ =
      ⟨left u, right (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Aᵀ *ᵥ u - a • v)‖⁻¹ • (Aᵀ *ᵥ u - a • v)),
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Aᵀ *ᵥ u - a • v)‖⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lanczosStep, dilation_mulVec_left, dot_left_right, zero_smul, sub_zero,
    ← right_smul, ← right_sub, norm_right]

name: NLAlib.lanczosStep_dilation_right
statement:
private theorem lanczosStep_dilation_right (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (u : m → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) :
    lanczosStep (dilation A) ⟨left u, right v, a⟩ =
      ⟨right v, left (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v - a • u)‖⁻¹ • (A *ᵥ v - a • u)),
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v - a • u)‖⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lanczosStep, dilation_mulVec_right, dot_right_left, zero_smul, sub_zero,
    ← left_smul, ← left_sub, norm_left]

name: NLAlib.lanczosStep_twice_pairedState
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairedState, lanczosStep_dilation_right, lanczosStep_dilation_left]
  simp only [pairedState, golubKahanStep, norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_one_pairedState
statement:
private theorem lanczosState_one_pairedState (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) :
    lanczosState (dilation A) (left b) 1 = pairedState (golubKahanInit A b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosState_succ, lanczosState_zero]
  have hi : lanczosInit (left (n := n) b) =
      (⟨right (0 : n → ℝ), left (‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖⁻¹ • b), 0⟩ : LanczosState (m ⊕ n)) := by
    simp only [lanczosInit, norm_left, ← left_smul]
    congr 1
    ext (i | i) <;> rfl
  rw [hi, lanczosStep_dilation_left]
  simp only [zero_smul, sub_zero, pairedState, golubKahanInit,
    norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]

name: NLAlib.lanczosState_odd_pairedState
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact lanczosState_one_pairedState A b
  | succ j ih =>
    have he : 2 * (j + 1) + 1 = (2 * j + 1 + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, lanczosState_succ, lanczosState_succ, ih, lanczosStep_twice_pairedState]
    simp only [golubKahanRecurrence, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosRecurrence (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j + 1) =
      Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg LanczosState.cur (lanczosState_odd_pairedState A b j)

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosRecurrence (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j) =
      Sum.elim (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u (0 : n → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg LanczosState.prev (lanczosState_odd_pairedState A b j)
  simpa only [lanczosState_succ_prev, lanczosRecurrence, pairedState, left] using h

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_dilation_odd
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_dilation_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j + 1) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg LanczosState.beta (lanczosState_odd_pairedState A b j)

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    lanczosBeta (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * (j + 1)) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta
proof:
:= by
  have he : 2 * (j + 1) = (2 * j + 1) + 1 := by omega
  change (lanczosState (dilation A) (left b) (2 * (j + 1))).beta = _
  rw [he, lanczosState_succ, lanczosState_odd_pairedState,
    pairedState, lanczosStep_dilation_right]
  simp only [golubKahanRecurrence, Function.iterate_succ_apply', golubKahanStep,
    norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_alpha (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).alpha
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct (isHermitian_dilation A)
    (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j)
  rw [lanczosBeta_dilation_odd,
    ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
    ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
    lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd, lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even] at h
  change _ = right (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v ⬝ᵥ
    (dilation A *ᵥ left (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u) at h
  rw [dilation_mulVec_left] at h
  simp only [right, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add] at h
  change _ = (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v ⬝ᵥ
    (Aᵀ *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).u) at h
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec] at h
  exact h.symm

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta
statement:
theorem dotProduct_golubKahan_eq_beta (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) =
      (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).beta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := lanczosBeta_succ_eq_dotProduct (isHermitian_dilation A)
    (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * j + 1)
  have he : 2 * j + 1 + 1 = 2 * (j + 1) := by omega
  rw [he, lanczosBeta_dilation_even_succ,
    ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
    ← lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis (isHermitian_dilation A),
    lanczosRecurrence_dilation_even, lanczosRecurrence_dilation_odd] at h
  change _ = left (golubKahanRecurrence A b (j + 1)).u ⬝ᵥ
    (dilation A *ᵥ right (golubKahanRecurrence A b j).v) at h
  rw [dilation_mulVec_right] at h
  simpa only [left, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.col_mem_krylovSpace_of_hessenberg_intertwines
statement:
theorem col_mem_krylovSpace_of_hessenberg_intertwines
    (hH : IsUnreducedHessenberg H) (hcomm : A * Q = Q * H)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) : Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcols : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), j.val = k →
      Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro j hj
      by_cases hk : k = 0
      · have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.ext (hj.trans hk)
        subst j
        exact self_mem_krylovSpace_succ A (Q.col 0) 0
      · let p : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
        have hpj : (p : ℕ) + 1 = j := by dsimp [p]; omega
        have hprev := ih (k - 1) (by omega) p rfl
        have hA : A *ᵥ Q.col p ∈ krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1) := by
          have ha := mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A (Q.col 0) hprev
          rwa [hpj] at ha
        have hrest : (∑ a ∈ univ.erase j, H a p • Q.col a) ∈
            krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1) := by
          apply Submodule.sum_mem
          intro a ha
          have haj : a ≠ j := (mem_erase.mp ha).1
          by_cases hak : a.val < k
          · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
              (krylovSpace_mono A (Q.col 0) (by omega) (ih a.val hak a rfl))
          · have hzero : H a p = 0 := hH.1 a p (by
              have hne : a.val ≠ j.val := fun h => haj (Fin.ext h)
              dsimp [p]
              omega)
            rw [hzero, zero_smul]
            exact Submodule.zero_mem _
        have hcol : A *ᵥ Q.col p = ∑ a, H a p • Q.col a := by
          calc
            _ = (A * Q).col p := (col_mul_eq_mulVec_col A Q p).symm
            _ = (Q * H).col p := congrArg (fun M => M.col p) hcomm
            _ = _ := by ext i; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.col, Finset.sum_apply,
                Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
        have hscaled : H j p • Q.col j ∈ krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1) := by
          have hsum : H j p • Q.col j + (∑ a ∈ univ.erase j, H a p • Q.col a) =
              A *ᵥ Q.col p := by
            rw [hcol]
            exact add_sum_erase univ (fun a => H a p • Q.col a) (mem_univ j)
          have heq : H j p • Q.col j = A *ᵥ Q.col p -
              (∑ a ∈ univ.erase j, H a p • Q.col a) := eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr hsum
          rw [heq]
          exact Submodule.sub_mem _ hA hrest
        have hne : H j p ≠ 0 := hH.2 j p (by omega)
        convert Submodule.smul_mem (krylovSpace A (Q.col 0) (j + 1)) (H j p)⁻¹ hscaled
          using 1
        simp [smul_smul, hne]
  exact hcols j.val j rfl

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.isGradedKrylovBasis
statement:
theorem IsHessenbergForm.isGradedKrylovBasis (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H)
    (hH : IsUnreducedHessenberg H) : IsGradedKrylovBasis A (Q.col 0) Q
proof:
:= by
  apply IsGradedKrylovBasis.of_mem h.orth
  apply col_mem_krylovSpace_of_hessenberg_intertwines hH
  rw [h.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc, show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from h.orth, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.IsHessenbergForm.eq_arnoldiMatrix
statement:
theorem IsHessenbergForm.eq_arnoldiMatrix (h : IsHessenbergForm A Q H)
    (hH : IsUnreducedHessenberg H)
    (hpos : ∀ j (hj : j + 1 < n + 1), 0 < H ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩) :
    Q = arnoldiMatrix A (Q.col 0) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let D : ArnoldiDecomp A (Q.col 0) (n + 1) := ⟨Q, h.isGradedKrylovBasis hH⟩
  apply D.Q_eq_arnoldiMatrix
  · intro hn
    change 0 < Q.col ⟨0, hn⟩ ⬝ᵥ Q.col 0
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
      |>.trans_le (by rw [h.orth.col_dotProduct_col]; simp)
  · intro j hj
    change 0 < (Qᵀ * A * Q) ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ ⟨j, by omega⟩
    rw [h.transpose_mul_mul_eq]
    exact hpos j hj

name: NLAlib.dilation_mulVec_inl
statement:
private theorem dilation_mulVec_inl (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) :
    dilation A *ᵥ Sum.elim u (0 : n → ℝ) = Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) (Aᵀ *ᵥ u)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [dilation, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.dilation_mulVec_inr
statement:
private theorem dilation_mulVec_inr (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    dilation A *ᵥ Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) v = Sum.elim (A *ᵥ v) (0 : n → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) <;> simp [dilation, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.pow_dilation_mulVec_even
statement:
theorem pow_dilation_mulVec_even (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (dilation A) ^ (2 * j) *ᵥ Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ) =
      Sum.elim ((A * Aᵀ) ^ j *ᵥ b) (0 : n → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have he : 2 * (j + 1) = (2 * j + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih,
      dilation_mulVec_inl, dilation_mulVec_inr, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.pow_dilation_mulVec_odd
statement:
theorem pow_dilation_mulVec_odd (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    (dilation A) ^ (2 * j + 1) *ᵥ Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ) =
      Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) ((Aᵀ * A) ^ j *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, pow_dilation_mulVec_even,
    dilation_mulVec_inl, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  congr 2
  exact (pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq (by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]) j).symm

name: NLAlib.two_mul_le_krylovGrade_dilation
statement:
theorem two_mul_le_krylovGrade_dilation {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hleft : q ≤ krylovGrade (A * Aᵀ) b)
    (hright : q ≤ krylovGrade (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)) :
    2 * q ≤ krylovGrade (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let u : Fin q → m → ℝ := fun j => (A * Aᵀ) ^ (j : ℕ) *ᵥ b
  let v : Fin q → n → ℝ := fun j => (Aᵀ * A) ^ (j : ℕ) *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)
  let w : Fin q ⊕ Fin q → m ⊕ n → ℝ :=
    Sum.elim (fun j => Sum.elim (u j) (0 : n → ℝ))
      (fun j => Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) (v j))
  have hu : LinearIndependent ℝ u :=
    (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade _ _).2 hleft
  have hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v :=
    (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade _ _).2 hright
  have hw : LinearIndependent ℝ w := by
    let e := (LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow m n ℝ ℝ).symm
    have h := (linearIndependent_inl_union_inr' hu hv).map' e.toLinearMap e.ker
    convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | (funext j; cases j <;> rfl)
  have hle : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w) ≤
      krylovSpace (dilation A) (Sum.elim b (0 : n → ℝ)) (2 * q) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j | j, rfl⟩
    · change Sum.elim ((A * Aᵀ) ^ (j : ℕ) *ᵥ b) (0 : n → ℝ) ∈ _
      rw [← pow_dilation_mulVec_even]
      exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace _ _ (by omega)
    · change Sum.elim (0 : m → ℝ) ((Aᵀ * A) ^ (j : ℕ) *ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ b)) ∈ _
      rw [← pow_dilation_mulVec_odd]
      exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace _ _ (by omega)
  have hd := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  rw [finrank_span_eq_card hw, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin,
    finrank_krylovSpace] at hd
  omega

name: NLAlib.range_krylovMatrix
statement:
theorem range_krylovMatrix (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (krylovMatrix A b q).mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.mul_krylovMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem mul_krylovMatrix_apply (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ)
    (i : n) (j : Fin q) :
    (A * krylovMatrix A b q) i j = (A ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) *ᵥ b) i
proof:
:= by
  change (A *ᵥ (A ^ (j : ℕ) *ᵥ b)) i = _
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.exists_basis_toMatrix_eq_companionMatrix_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
statement:
theorem exists_basis_toMatrix_eq_companionMatrix_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
    {A : Matrix n n K} {b : n → K} (hb : krylovGrade A b = Fintype.card n) :
    ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin A.charpoly.natDegree) K (n → K),
      (∀ i, B i = (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ∧
      LinearMap.toMatrix B B (Matrix.toLin' A) = companionMatrix A.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let p := A.charpoly
  let pb := AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' (Matrix.charpoly_monic A)
  have hd : p.natDegree = Fintype.card n := Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim A
  have hli : LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin p.natDegree => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) :=
    (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade A b).mpr (by rw [hd, hb])
  have hspan : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K
      (Set.range fun i : Fin p.natDegree => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) := by
    change ⊤ ≤ krylovSpace A b p.natDegree
    rw [hd, krylovSpace_eq_top_of_krylovGrade_eq_card hb]
  let B₀ := Module.Basis.mk hli hspan
  let e : AdjoinRoot p ≃ₗ[K] (n → K) := pb.basis.equiv B₀ (Equiv.refl _)
  have hμ : minpoly K pb.gen = p := by
    change minpoly K (AdjoinRoot.root p) = p
    rw [AdjoinRoot.minpoly_root (Matrix.charpoly_monic A).ne_zero,
      (Matrix.charpoly_monic A).leadingCoeff, inv_one, C_1, mul_one]
  have hroot : aeval A (minpoly K pb.gen) = 0 := by
    rw [hμ]
    exact Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly A
  let φ : AdjoinRoot p →ₐ[K] Matrix n n K :=
    pb.lift A hroot
  let L : AdjoinRoot p →ₗ[K] (n → K) :=
    { toFun := fun x => φ x *ᵥ b
      map_add' := by intro x y; simp [map_add, Matrix.add_mulVec]
      map_smul' := by intro c x; simp [map_smul, Matrix.smul_mulVec] }
  have hφroot : φ (AdjoinRoot.root p) = A :=
    pb.lift_gen A hroot
  have hLb (i : Fin pb.dim) : L (pb.basis i) = (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b := by
    change φ (pb.basis i) *ᵥ b = _
    rw [pb.basis_eq_pow, map_pow]
    change φ (AdjoinRoot.root p) ^ (i : ℕ) *ᵥ b = _
    rw [hφroot]
  have heL : e.toLinearMap = L := by
    apply pb.basis.ext
    intro i
    change (pb.basis.equiv B₀ (Equiv.refl _)) (pb.basis i) = L (pb.basis i)
    rw [Module.Basis.equiv_apply]
    change (Module.Basis.mk hli hspan) ((Equiv.refl (Fin pb.dim)) i) = L (pb.basis i)
    rw [Module.Basis.mk_apply]
    exact (hLb i).symm
  have hint (x : AdjoinRoot p) : A *ᵥ e x = e (AdjoinRoot.root p * x) := by
    change Matrix.toLin' A (e.toLinearMap x) = e.toLinearMap (AdjoinRoot.root p * x)
    rw [heL]
    change A *ᵥ (φ x *ᵥ b) = φ (AdjoinRoot.root p * x) *ᵥ b
    rw [map_mul, hφroot, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have hcomp : e.symm.toLinearMap.comp ((Matrix.toLin' A).comp e.toLinearMap) =
      Algebra.lmul K (AdjoinRoot p) (AdjoinRoot.root p) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change e.symm (A *ᵥ e x) = AdjoinRoot.root p * x
    rw [hint, e.symm_apply_apply]
  refine ⟨pb.basis.map e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change e (pb.basis i) = _
    change e.toLinearMap (pb.basis i) = _
    rw [heL, hLb]
  · rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_map_left, LinearMap.toMatrix_map_right, hcomp,
      ← Algebra.leftMulMatrix_apply]
    exact leftMulMatrix_adjoinRoot_eq_companionMatrix (Matrix.charpoly_monic A)

name: NLAlib.minpoly_eq_charpoly_iff_exists_basis_toMatrix_eq_companionMatrix
statement:
theorem minpoly_eq_charpoly_iff_exists_basis_toMatrix_eq_companionMatrix
    (A : Matrix n n K) :
    minpoly K A = A.charpoly ↔
      ∃ B : Module.Basis (Fin A.charpoly.natDegree) K (n → K),
        LinearMap.toMatrix B B (Matrix.toLin' A) = companionMatrix A.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_exists_krylovGrade_eq_card A).mp
      ((minpoly_eq_charpoly_iff_natDegree_eq_card A).mp h)
    obtain ⟨B, _, hB⟩ := exists_basis_toMatrix_eq_companionMatrix_of_krylovGrade_eq_card hb
    exact ⟨B, hB⟩
  · rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
    have h := minpoly_companionMatrix (Matrix.charpoly_monic A)
    rw [← hB, LinearMap.minpoly_toMatrix, Matrix.minpoly_toLin'] at h
    exact h

name: NLAlib.ker_toSpanSingleton_aeval_eq_span_vectorMinpoly
statement:
theorem ker_toSpanSingleton_aeval_eq_span_vectorMinpoly
    (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton K[X]
      (Module.AEval' (Matrix.toLin' A)) (Module.AEval'.of (Matrix.toLin' A) b)) =
      Ideal.span {vectorMinpoly A b}
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_span_singleton,
    ← aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_vectorMinpoly_dvd]
  change p • (Module.AEval'.of (Matrix.toLin' A)) b = 0 ↔ aeval A p *ᵥ b = 0
  have hsmul : p • (Module.AEval'.of (Matrix.toLin' A)) b =
      (Module.AEval'.of (Matrix.toLin' A)) (aeval (Matrix.toLin' A) p b) := rfl
  rw [hsmul, LinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff]
  have hmap : aeval (Matrix.toLin' A) p = Matrix.toLin' (aeval A p) :=
    aeval_algHom_apply (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' :
      Matrix n n K ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (n → K)) A p
  rw [hmap]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.exists_vectorMinpoly_eq_minpoly
statement:
theorem exists_vectorMinpoly_eq_minpoly (A : Matrix n n K) :
    ∃ b : n → K, vectorMinpoly A b = minpoly K A
proof:
:= by
  let f : Module.End K (n → K) := Matrix.toLin' A
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Module.exists_ker_toSpanSingleton_eq_annihilator
    (R := K[X]) (M := Module.AEval' f)
  let b₀ := (Module.AEval'.of f).symm b
  have hfaith (p : K[X]) : aeval f p b₀ = 0 ↔ aeval f p = 0 := by
    have h := SetLike.ext_iff.mp hb p
    rw [Module.AEval.annihilator_eq_ker_aeval, RingHom.mem_ker] at h
    change p • b = 0 ↔ aeval f p = 0 at h
    have heq : p • b = 0 ↔ aeval f p b₀ = 0 := by
      apply (Module.AEval'.of f).symm.map_eq_zero_iff.symm.trans
      rfl
    exact heq.symm.trans h
  have hmap (p : K[X]) : aeval f p = Matrix.toLin' (aeval A p) := by
    exact (aeval_algHom_apply (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' :
      Matrix n n K ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (n → K)) A p)
  have hzero : aeval A (vectorMinpoly A b₀) = 0 := by
    apply (Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv' : Matrix n n K ≃ₐ[K] Module.End K (n → K)).injective
    rw [map_zero]
    change Matrix.toLin' (aeval A (vectorMinpoly A b₀)) = 0
    rw [← hmap]
    apply (hfaith _).mp
    rw [hmap]
    exact aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec A b₀
  have hdiv : minpoly K A ∣ vectorMinpoly A b₀ := minpoly.dvd K A hzero
  refine ⟨b₀, eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.monic A.isIntegral)
    (vectorMinpoly_monic A b₀) hdiv ?_⟩
  exact natDegree_le_of_dvd (vectorMinpoly_dvd_minpoly A b₀) (minpoly.monic A.isIntegral).ne_zero

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_exists_krylovGrade_eq_card
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_exists_krylovGrade_eq_card (A : Matrix n n K) :
    (minpoly K A).natDegree = Fintype.card n ↔
      ∃ b : n → K, krylovGrade A b = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hA
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_vectorMinpoly_eq_minpoly A
    exact ⟨b, by rw [← natDegree_vectorMinpoly, hb, hA]⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    exact le_antisymm (natDegree_minpoly_le_card A)
      (hb ▸ krylovGrade_le_natDegree_minpoly A b)

name: NLAlib.minpoly_eq_charpoly_iff_natDegree_eq_card
statement:
theorem minpoly_eq_charpoly_iff_natDegree_eq_card (A : Matrix n n K) :
    minpoly K A = A.charpoly ↔ (minpoly K A).natDegree = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]
  · intro h
    apply (eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.monic A.isIntegral)
      (Matrix.charpoly_monic A) (Matrix.minpoly_dvd_charpoly A) ?_).symm
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, h]

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_eq_top_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
  rw [finrank_krylovSpace, hb, min_self, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_degree_lt_aeval_eq_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
statement:
theorem existsUnique_degree_lt_aeval_eq_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
    {A : Matrix n n K} {b : n → K} (hb : krylovGrade A b = Fintype.card n)
    (B : Matrix n n K) (hAB : A * B = B * A) :
    ∃! p : K[X], p.degree < Fintype.card n ∧ aeval A p = B
proof:
:= by
  have hK := krylovSpace_eq_top_of_krylovGrade_eq_card hb
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpB⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ (B *ᵥ b)).mp (by rw [hK]; trivial)
  have heq : aeval A p = B := by
    apply Matrix.ext_iff_mulVec.mpr
    intro v
    obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ v).mp (by rw [hK]; trivial)
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      ((Commute.all p q).map (aeval A)).eq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hpB,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, aeval_mul_eq_mul_aeval_of_mul_eq hAB q,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  refine ⟨p, ⟨hp, heq⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (A := A) (b := b)
  · rw [hb]
    exact (degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt hq.1 hp)
  · rw [map_sub, hq.2, heq, sub_self, Matrix.zero_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_of_finrank_eigenspace_le_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_of_finrank_eigenspace_le_one
    (A : Matrix n n K) (hsplit : A.charpoly.Splits)
    (hgeom : ∀ μ : K, Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ) ≤ 1) :
    (minpoly K A).natDegree = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  let f := Matrix.toLin' A
  have hs : (minpoly K f).Splits := by
    rw [Matrix.minpoly_toLin']
    exact hsplit.of_dvd (Matrix.charpoly_monic A).ne_zero (Matrix.minpoly_dvd_charpoly A)
  have hbound (l : Multiset K) :
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (aeval f (l.map (fun μ => X - C μ)).prod)) ≤ l.card := by
    induction l using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      rw [Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.prod_zero, aeval_one, Module.End.one_eq_id,
        LinearMap.ker_id]
      simp
    | @cons μ l ih =>
      rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, map_mul]
      have h := LinearMap.finrank_ker_comp_le
        (f - algebraMap K (Module.End K (n → K)) μ)
        (aeval f (l.map (fun ν => X - C ν)).prod)
      have hμ := hgeom μ
      rw [Module.End.eigenspace_def] at hμ
      change Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker
        (f - algebraMap K (Module.End K (n → K)) μ)) ≤ 1 at hμ
      have heval : aeval f (X - C μ) =
          f - algebraMap K (Module.End K (n → K)) μ := by
        rw [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C]
      rw [heval, Module.End.mul_eq_comp]
      simp only [Multiset.card_cons]
      omega
  have h := hbound (minpoly K f).roots
  rw [← hs.eq_prod_roots_of_monic (minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral f)),
    minpoly.aeval, LinearMap.ker_zero, finrank_top,
    Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, ← hs.natDegree_eq_card_roots,
    Matrix.minpoly_toLin'] at h
  exact le_antisymm (natDegree_minpoly_le_card A) h

name: NLAlib.finrank_eigenspace_le_one_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
statement:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_le_one_of_krylovGrade_eq_card
    {A : Matrix n n K} {b : n → K} (hb : krylovGrade A b = Fintype.card n) (μ : K) :
    Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card n - 1)
  let M : Matrix n n K := A - algebraMap K (Matrix n n K) μ
  let L := M.mulVecLin.comp S.subtype
  have hinj : Function.Injective L := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hz : M *ᵥ ((x : n → K) - y) = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hxy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ ((x : n → K) - y)).mp
      (S.sub_mem x.property y.property)
    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
    · simp [hq0] at heq
      exact heq
    have hqnat : q.natDegree < Fintype.card n - 1 :=
      (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq0).mpr hq
    have hprod0 : (X - C μ) * q ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (monic_X_sub_C μ).ne_zero hq0
    have hdeg : ((X - C μ) * q).degree < (krylovGrade A b : WithBot ℕ) := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree hprod0, natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C μ).ne_zero hq0,
        natDegree_X_sub_C, hb]
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 + q.natDegree < Fintype.card n by omega)
    have hann : aeval A ((X - C μ) * q) *ᵥ b = 0 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← heq]
      exact hz
    exact (hprod0 (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero hdeg hann)).elim
  have hdimS : Module.finrank K S = Fintype.card n - 1 := by
