    rw [finrank_krylovSpace, hb, min_eq_left (Nat.sub_le _ _)]
  have hdimL : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range L) = Fintype.card n - 1 :=
    (LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj).trans hdimS
  have hrange : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range L) ≤
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range M.mulVecLin) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)
  have hnull := M.mulVecLin.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hnull
  have hker : Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ = LinearMap.ker M.mulVecLin := by
    apply Submodule.ext
    intro v
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change A *ᵥ v = μ • v ↔ M *ᵥ v = 0
    simp only [M, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_eq_zero]
  rw [hker]
  omega

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_finrank_eigenspace_le_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_finrank_eigenspace_le_one
    (A : Matrix n n K) (hsplit : A.charpoly.Splits) :
    (minpoly K A).natDegree = Fintype.card n ↔
      ∀ μ : K, Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_exists_krylovGrade_eq_card A).mp h
    exact finrank_eigenspace_le_one_of_krylovGrade_eq_card hb
  · exact natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_of_finrank_eigenspace_le_one A hsplit

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_map_algebraMap (A : Matrix n n K) :
    (minpoly L (A.map (algebraMap K L))).natDegree = (minpoly K A).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  let σ : K →+* L := algebraMap K L
  let ψ : Matrix n n K →+* Matrix n n L := σ.mapMatrix
  have hcomp : (algebraMap L (Matrix n n L)).comp σ =
      ψ.comp (algebraMap K (Matrix n n K)) := by
    ext c i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;>
      simp [ψ, hij, Matrix.algebraMap_eq_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.map_apply]
  have hann : aeval (A.map σ) ((minpoly K A).map σ) = 0 := by
    have h := map_aeval_eq_aeval_map hcomp (minpoly K A) A
    rw [minpoly.aeval, map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hup : (minpoly L (A.map σ)).natDegree ≤ (minpoly K A).natDegree := by
    have h := natDegree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd L (A.map σ) hann)
      ((minpoly.monic A.isIntegral).map σ).ne_zero
    simpa only [(minpoly.monic A.isIntegral).natDegree_map] using h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_vectorMinpoly_eq_minpoly A
  let ν := krylovGrade A b
  let M : Matrix n (Fin ν) K := fun i j => ((A ^ (j : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) i
  have hM : LinearIndependent K M.col :=
    (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade A b).mpr le_rfl
  have hML := Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_map σ hM
  have hpow (j : ℕ) : (A ^ j).map σ = (A.map σ) ^ j :=
    ψ.map_pow A j
  have hcols : (M.map σ).col =
      fun j : Fin ν => ((A.map σ) ^ (j : ℕ)) *ᵥ (σ ∘ b) := by
    funext j i
    change σ (((A ^ (j : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) i) = _
    rw [RingHom.map_mulVec, hpow]
  rw [hcols] at hML
  have hν : ν ≤ krylovGrade (A.map σ) (σ ∘ b) :=
    (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade (A.map σ) (σ ∘ b)).mp hML
  have hνμ : (minpoly K A).natDegree = ν := by
    rw [← hb, natDegree_vectorMinpoly]
  apply le_antisymm hup
  rw [hνμ]
  exact hν.trans (krylovGrade_le_natDegree_minpoly (A.map σ) (σ ∘ b))

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_eigenvalue_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_eigenvalue_finrank_eq_one
    (A : Matrix n n K) (hsplit : A.charpoly.Splits) :
    (minpoly K A).natDegree = Fintype.card n ↔
      ∀ μ : K, Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' A) μ →
        Module.finrank K (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_finrank_eigenspace_le_one A hsplit]
  constructor
  · intro h μ hμ
    have hpos := Module.End.pos_finrank_genEigenspace_of_hasEigenvalue hμ
      (by norm_num : 0 < (1 : ℕ))
    exact le_antisymm (h μ) (by exact hpos)
  · intro h μ
    by_cases hμ : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' A) μ
    · exact (h μ hμ).le
    · have hbot : Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' A) μ = ⊥ :=
        not_ne_iff.mp hμ
      rw [hbot]
      simp

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_real_eq_card_iff_complex_eigenvalue_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_real_eq_card_iff_complex_eigenvalue_finrank_eq_one
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (minpoly ℝ A).natDegree = Fintype.card n ↔
      ∀ μ : ℂ, Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))) μ →
        Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace
          (Matrix.toLin' (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))) μ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natDegree_minpoly_map_algebraMap (L := ℂ) A]
  exact natDegree_minpoly_eq_card_iff_eigenvalue_finrank_eq_one _
    (IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: NLAlib.exists_monic_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_natDegree_eq_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem exists_monic_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_natDegree_eq_krylovGrade
    (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    ∃ p : K[X], p.Monic ∧ p.natDegree = krylovGrade A b ∧ aeval A p *ᵥ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ _).mp
    (pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b)
  refine ⟨X ^ krylovGrade A b - q, monic_X_pow_sub hq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hd : (X ^ krylovGrade A b - q).degree =
        (X ^ krylovGrade A b : K[X]).degree :=
      degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (by simpa only [degree_X_pow] using hq)
    exact (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq hd).trans (natDegree_X_pow _)
  · rw [map_sub, Matrix.sub_mulVec, map_pow, aeval_X, heq, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.vectorMinpoly_monic
statement:
theorem vectorMinpoly_monic (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    (vectorMinpoly A b).Monic
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_monic_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_natDegree_eq_krylovGrade A b)).1

name: NLAlib.natDegree_vectorMinpoly
statement:
theorem natDegree_vectorMinpoly (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    (vectorMinpoly A b).natDegree = krylovGrade A b
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_monic_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_natDegree_eq_krylovGrade A b)).2.1

name: NLAlib.aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec
statement:
theorem aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    aeval A (vectorMinpoly A b) *ᵥ b = 0
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_monic_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_natDegree_eq_krylovGrade A b)).2.2

name: NLAlib.aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_vectorMinpoly_dvd
statement:
theorem aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_vectorMinpoly_dvd
    (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (p : K[X]) :
    aeval A p *ᵥ b = 0 ↔ vectorMinpoly A b ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hr : (p %ₘ vectorMinpoly A b).degree < krylovGrade A b := by
      simpa only [← natDegree_vectorMinpoly A b,
        degree_eq_natDegree (vectorMinpoly_monic A b).ne_zero] using
        degree_modByMonic_lt p (vectorMinpoly_monic A b)
    have hzero : aeval A (p %ₘ vectorMinpoly A b) *ᵥ b = 0 := by
      rw [modByMonic_eq_sub_mul_div, map_sub, map_mul, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
      have hc' := (Commute.all (vectorMinpoly A b) (p /ₘ vectorMinpoly A b)).map (aeval A)
      rw [hc'.eq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec,
        Matrix.mulVec_zero, hp, sub_self]
    exact (modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd (vectorMinpoly_monic A b)).mp
      (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero hr hzero)
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have hc := (Commute.all (vectorMinpoly A b) q).map (aeval A)
    rw [map_mul, hc.eq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_zero]

name: NLAlib.vectorMinpoly_dvd_minpoly
statement:
theorem vectorMinpoly_dvd_minpoly (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) :
    vectorMinpoly A b ∣ minpoly K A
proof:
:= by
  apply (aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_vectorMinpoly_dvd A b _).mp
  rw [minpoly.aeval, Matrix.zero_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.eq_vectorMinpoly_of_monic_of_natDegree_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (vectorMinpoly_monic A b) hp
    ((aeval_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_vectorMinpoly_dvd A b p).mp hzero)
  rw [hdeg, natDegree_vectorMinpoly]

name: NLAlib.natDegree_minpoly_le_card
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_le_card (A : Matrix n n K) :
    (minpoly K A).natDegree ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using
    natDegree_le_of_dvd (Matrix.minpoly_dvd_charpoly A) (Matrix.charpoly_monic A).ne_zero

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_col_mem_blockKrylovSpace
statement:
theorem pow_mulVec_col_mem_blockKrylovSpace (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) {q i : ℕ}
    (hi : i < q) (j : s) : (A ^ i) *ᵥ Ω.col j ∈ blockKrylovSpace A Ω q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(⟨i, hi⟩, j), rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_col_le_blockKrylovSpace
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_col_le_blockKrylovSpace (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (q : ℕ)
    (j : s) : krylovSpace A (Ω.col j) q ≤ blockKrylovSpace A Ω q
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 <| by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact pow_mulVec_col_mem_blockKrylovSpace A Ω i.isLt j

name: NLAlib.blockKrylovSpace_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem blockKrylovSpace_eq_iSup (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (q : ℕ) :
    blockKrylovSpace A Ω q = ⨆ j, krylovSpace A (Ω.col j) q
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) (iSup_le (krylovSpace_col_le_blockKrylovSpace A Ω q))
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j ?_
  change ((A ^ (i : ℕ)) * Ω).col j ∈ _
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A _ i.isLt

name: NLAlib.mem_blockKrylovSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_blockKrylovSpace_iff (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (q : ℕ) (x : n → K) :
    x ∈ blockKrylovSpace A Ω q ↔
      ∃ p : s → K[X], (∀ j, (p j).degree < q) ∧ x = ∑ j, aeval A (p j) *ᵥ Ω.col j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [blockKrylovSpace_eq_iSup]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ x).1 hx
    have h : ∀ j, ∃ p : K[X], p.degree < q ∧ f j = aeval A p *ᵥ Ω.col j := fun j =>
      (mem_krylovSpace_iff A _ q _).1 (hf j)
    choose p hpdeg hp using h
    refine ⟨p, hpdeg, ?_⟩
    rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hp j
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j ?_
    exact (mem_krylovSpace_iff A _ q _).2 ⟨p j, hp j, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.range_aeval_mul_le_blockKrylovSpace
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  exact krylovSpace_col_le_blockKrylovSpace A Ω q j
    ((mem_krylovSpace_iff A _ q _).2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.blockKrylovSpace_mono
statement:
theorem blockKrylovSpace_mono (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) {q q' : ℕ} (h : q ≤ q') :
    blockKrylovSpace A Ω q ≤ blockKrylovSpace A Ω q'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 <| by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    change ((A ^ (i : ℕ)) * Ω).col j ∈ _
    rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
    exact pow_mulVec_col_mem_blockKrylovSpace A Ω (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h) j

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_blockKrylovSpace_succ
statement:
theorem mulVec_mem_blockKrylovSpace_succ (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) {q : ℕ}
    {x : n → K} (hx : x ∈ blockKrylovSpace A Ω q) : A *ᵥ x ∈ blockKrylovSpace A Ω (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : blockKrylovSpace A Ω q ≤
      (blockKrylovSpace A Ω (q + 1)).comap (Matrix.mulVecLin A) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    change A *ᵥ ((A ^ (i : ℕ)) * Ω).col j ∈ blockKrylovSpace A Ω (q + 1)
    rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']
    exact pow_mulVec_col_mem_blockKrylovSpace A Ω (Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt) j
  exact hle hx

name: NLAlib.finrank_blockKrylovSpace_le
statement:
theorem finrank_blockKrylovSpace_le (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (q : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (blockKrylovSpace A Ω q) ≤ q * Fintype.card s
proof:
:=
  (finrank_range_le_card (R := K) _).trans (by simp)

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subspaceIterate_zero (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) :
    subspaceIterate A Ω 0 = LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  simp [subspaceIterate]

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_succ
statement:
theorem subspaceIterate_succ (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (k : ℕ) :
    subspaceIterate A Ω (k + 1) = (subspaceIterate A Ω k).map A.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [subspaceIterate, subspaceIterate, pow_succ', Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul,
    LinearMap.range_comp]

name: NLAlib.range_mul_eq_subspaceIterate_succ
statement:
theorem range_mul_eq_subspaceIterate_succ {k' : Type*} [Fintype k'] (A : Matrix n n K)
    (Ω : Matrix n s K) {k : ℕ} {Q : Matrix n k' K}
    (hQ : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = subspaceIterate A Ω k) :
    LinearMap.range (A * Q).mulVecLin = subspaceIterate A Ω (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [subspaceIterate_succ, ← hQ, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul, LinearMap.range_comp]

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_le_blockKrylovSpace
statement:
theorem subspaceIterate_le_blockKrylovSpace (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K) (k : ℕ) :
    subspaceIterate A Ω k ≤ blockKrylovSpace A Ω (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := range_aeval_mul_le_blockKrylovSpace A Ω (q := k + 1) (p := X ^ k)
    (by rw [degree_X_pow]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self k)
  simpa [subspaceIterate] using h

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_mul_le
statement:
theorem subspaceIterate_mul_le {s' : Type*} [Fintype s'] (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K)
    (R : Matrix s s' K) (k : ℕ) : subspaceIterate A (Ω * R) k ≤ subspaceIterate A Ω k
proof:
:= by
  rw [subspaceIterate, subspaceIterate, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mulVecLin_mul,
    LinearMap.range_comp]
  exact LinearMap.map_le_range

name: NLAlib.subspaceIterate_mul_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem subspaceIterate_mul_of_isUnit [DecidableEq s] (A : Matrix n n K) (Ω : Matrix n s K)
    {R : Matrix s s K} (hR : IsUnit R) (k : ℕ) :
    subspaceIterate A (Ω * R) k = subspaceIterate A Ω k
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (subspaceIterate_mul_le A Ω R k) ?_
  have h := subspaceIterate_mul_le A (Ω * R) R⁻¹ k
  rwa [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).1 hR),
    Matrix.mul_one] at h

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_mul_eq_of_range_le
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_mul_eq_of_range_le {k₁ k₂ : Type*} [Fintype k₁] [DecidableEq k₁]
    [Fintype k₂] [DecidableEq k₂] {Q : Matrix n k₁ ℝ} {Q' : Matrix n k₂ ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hQ' : HasOrthonormalCols Q')
    (hle : LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Qᵀ * Q') ∧
      Q'ᵀ * A * Q' = (Qᵀ * Q')ᵀ * (Qᵀ * A * Q) * (Qᵀ * Q')
proof:
:= by
  have hQQ : Qᵀ * Q = 1 := hQ
  
  have hcol : ∀ j, (Q * (Qᵀ * Q')).col j = Q'.col j := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hle (show Q'.col j ∈ LinearMap.range Q'.mulVecLin from by
      rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] at hz
    rw [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, ← hz, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, hQQ, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hproj : Q * (Qᵀ * Q') = Q' := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (hcol j) i
  have hproj' : Q'ᵀ * Q * Qᵀ = Q'ᵀ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose hproj
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change (Qᵀ * Q')ᵀ * (Qᵀ * Q') = 1
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    rw [show Q'ᵀ * Q * (Qᵀ * Q') = Q'ᵀ * (Q * (Qᵀ * Q')) by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc],
      hproj]
    exact hQ'
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    calc Q'ᵀ * A * Q' = (Q'ᵀ * Q * Qᵀ) * A * (Q * (Qᵀ * Q')) := by rw [hproj, hproj']
      _ = Q'ᵀ * Q * (Qᵀ * A * Q) * (Qᵀ * Q') := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_le_span_range
statement:
private lemma krylovSpace_le_span_range (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace A b q ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i : ℕ => (A ^ i) *ᵥ b)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono <| by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_succ_iff
statement:
private lemma linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_succ_iff (q : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin (q + 1) => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ↔
      LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin q => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ∧
        (A ^ q) *ᵥ b ∉ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun i : Fin (q + 1) => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) =
      Fin.snoc (fun i : Fin q => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ((A ^ q) *ᵥ b) := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp
  rw [h, linearIndependent_finSnoc]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_of_forall_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => exact linearIndependent_empty_type
  | succ q ih =>
    exact (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_succ_iff A b q).2
      ⟨ih fun i hi => h i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi), h q (Nat.lt_succ_self q)⟩

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_pow_mulVec_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h := mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b hx
  rw [krylovSpace_succ] at h
  exact (sup_le le_rfl ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).2 hq)) h

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_mem_of_pow_mulVec_mem
statement:
private lemma pow_mulVec_mem_of_pow_mulVec_mem {q : ℕ}
    (hq : (A ^ q) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q) (i : ℕ) : (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hpos
    · exact hq
    · exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hpos
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    exact mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b hq ih

name: NLAlib.span_range_eq_of_pow_mulVec_mem
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 <| by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact pow_mulVec_mem_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b hq i)
    (krylovSpace_le_span_range A b q)

name: NLAlib.exists_pow_mulVec_mem
statement: private lemma exists_pow_mulVec_mem : ∃ q, (A ^ q) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  have hli := linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_of_forall_not_mem A b
    (q := Fintype.card n + 1) fun i _ => hne i
  have := hli.fintype_card_le_finrank
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_fin] at this
  omega

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_eq_find
statement:
private lemma krylovGrade_eq_find [DecidablePred fun q => (A ^ q) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q] :
    krylovGrade A b = Nat.find (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b)
proof:
:= by
  set ν := Nat.find (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b)
  have hli := linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_of_forall_not_mem A b (q := ν)
    fun i hi => Nat.find_min (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b) hi
  rw [krylovGrade, span_range_eq_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (Nat.find_spec (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b)),
    krylovSpace, finrank_span_eq_card hli, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace :
    (A ^ krylovGrade A b) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [krylovGrade_eq_find]
  exact Nat.find_spec (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b)

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_notMem_krylovSpace_of_lt_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem pow_mulVec_notMem_krylovSpace_of_lt_krylovGrade {i : ℕ} (hi : i < krylovGrade A b) :
    (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∉ krylovSpace A b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [krylovGrade_eq_find] at hi
  exact Nat.find_min (exists_pow_mulVec_mem A b) hi

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_le_of_pow_mulVec_mem
statement:
theorem krylovGrade_le_of_pow_mulVec_mem {q : ℕ} (hq : (A ^ q) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q) :
    krylovGrade A b ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [krylovGrade_eq_find]
  exact Nat.find_min' _ hq

name: NLAlib.span_range_pow_mulVec_eq_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem span_range_pow_mulVec_eq_krylovSpace_krylovGrade :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i : ℕ => (A ^ i) *ᵥ b) =
      krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:=
  span_range_eq_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b)

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade (i : ℕ) :
    (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:=
  pow_mulVec_mem_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b) i

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_le_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_le_krylovSpace_krylovGrade (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace A b q ≤ krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:=
  (krylovSpace_le_span_range A b q).trans
    (span_range_pow_mulVec_eq_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b).le

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
proof:
:=
  mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b) hx

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le {q : ℕ} (h : krylovGrade A b ≤ q) :
    krylovSpace A b q = krylovSpace A b (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (krylovSpace_le_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A b q) (krylovSpace_mono A b h)

name: NLAlib.linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade {q : ℕ} :
    LinearIndependent K (fun i : Fin q => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ↔ q ≤ krylovGrade A b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hli
    have h1 : Module.finrank K (krylovSpace A b q) = q := by
      rw [krylovSpace, finrank_span_eq_card hli, Fintype.card_fin]
    calc q = Module.finrank K (krylovSpace A b q) := h1.symm
      _ ≤ krylovGrade A b := Submodule.finrank_mono (krylovSpace_le_span_range A b q)
  · intro hq
    exact linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_of_forall_not_mem A b fun i hi =>
      pow_mulVec_notMem_krylovSpace_of_lt_krylovGrade A b (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hq)

name: NLAlib.finrank_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_krylovSpace (q : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (krylovSpace A b q) = min q (krylovGrade A b)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ q ≤ krylovGrade A b, Module.finrank K (krylovSpace A b q) = q := fun q hq => by
    rw [krylovSpace, finrank_span_eq_card
      ((linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade A b).2 hq), Fintype.card_fin]
  rcases le_total q (krylovGrade A b) with h | h
  · rw [hle q h, min_eq_left h]
  · rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A b h, hle _ le_rfl, min_eq_right h]

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_le_natDegree_minpoly
statement:
theorem krylovGrade_le_natDegree_minpoly :
    krylovGrade A b ≤ (minpoly K A).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  set p := minpoly K A
  set m := p.natDegree
  have hint : IsIntegral K A := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral A
  have hmon : p.Monic := minpoly.monic hint
  have hpdeg : p.degree = m := degree_eq_natDegree hmon.ne_zero
  refine krylovGrade_le_of_pow_mulVec_mem A b (q := m) ?_
  have hdeg : (p - X ^ m).degree < (m : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rcases eq_or_ne (p - X ^ m) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0, degree_zero]; exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
    have h := degree_sub_lt_left (p := p) (q := X ^ m)
      (by rw [degree_X_pow, hpdeg]) hmon.ne_zero
      (by rw [hmon.leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_X_pow])
    rwa [hpdeg] at h
  have hmem := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b m (-(aeval A (p - X ^ m) *ᵥ b))).2
    ⟨-(p - X ^ m), by rwa [degree_neg], by rw [map_neg, Matrix.neg_mulVec]⟩
  have hp : aeval A p = 0 := minpoly.aeval K A
  rw [map_sub, hp, zero_sub, Matrix.neg_mulVec, neg_neg, map_pow, aeval_X] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_le_card
statement: theorem krylovGrade_le_card : krylovGrade A b ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.finrank_le _).trans (Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card K).le

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem krylovGrade_eq_zero_iff : krylovGrade A b = 0 ↔ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb := pow_krylovGrade_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b
    rw [h, krylovSpace_zero, Submodule.mem_bot, pow_zero, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hb
    exact hb
  · rintro rfl
    exact Nat.le_zero.1 (krylovGrade_le_of_pow_mulVec_mem A 0 (q := 0) (by simp))

name: NLAlib.sub_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
proof:
:= by
  set r := c - A *ᵥ x₀
  set S := krylovSpace A r (krylovGrade A r)
  have hr : r = A *ᵥ (xs - x₀) := by simp only [r, Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs]
  have hrK : r ∈ S := by
    simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A r 0
  let f : S →ₗ[K] S := (Matrix.mulVecLin A).restrict fun x hx =>
    mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade A r hx
  have hinjA : Function.Injective (Matrix.mulVec A) :=
    Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.2 hA
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := fun x y hxy =>
    Subtype.ext (hinjA (congrArg Subtype.val hxy))
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.1 hinj) ⟨r, hrK⟩
  have hy' : A *ᵥ (y : n → K) = A *ᵥ (xs - x₀) := by
    rw [← hr]; exact congrArg Subtype.val hy
  rw [← hinjA hy']
  exact y.2

name: NLAlib.inv_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade
proof:
:= by
  have hsol : A *ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ b) = b := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  simpa only [sub_zero, Matrix.mulVec_zero] using
    sub_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade hA hsol (0 : n → K)

name: NLAlib.eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n K} {b : n → K} {p : K[X]}
    (hp : p.degree < krylovGrade A b) (h0 : aeval A p *ᵥ b = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  set ν := krylovGrade A b
  have hli := (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade A b (q := ν)).2 le_rfl
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin ν, p.coeff i • ((A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) = 0 := by
    rw [← h0]
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · simp [hp0]
    have hnat : p.natDegree < ν := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 hp
    conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum_range' ν hnat]
    simp only [map_sum, Matrix.sum_mulVec, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, aeval_C,
      map_pow, aeval_X, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul,
      Matrix.smul_mulVec]
    exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => p.coeff i • (A ^ i) *ᵥ b) ν)
  have hc := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.1 hli _ hsum
  ext i
  rw [coeff_zero]
  by_cases hi : i < ν
  · exact hc ⟨i, hi⟩
  · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (by exact_mod_cast not_lt.1 hi))

name: NLAlib.pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) {q i : ℕ} (hi : i < q) :
    (A ^ i) *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.aeval_sum_fin_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  simp [map_sum, Matrix.sum_mulVec, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.mem_krylovSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_krylovSpace_iff (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) (x : n → K) :
    x ∈ krylovSpace A b q ↔
      ∃ p : K[X], p.degree < q ∧ x = Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).1 hx
    exact ⟨_, Polynomial.degree_sum_fin_lt c, (aeval_sum_fin_mulVec A b c).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    by_cases hp0 : p = 0
    · subst hp0; simp
    have hnat : p.natDegree < q := (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 hp
    rw [p.as_sum_range' q hnat]
    simp_rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
      (fun i => Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i), aeval_sum_fin_mulVec]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b i.isLt)

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem krylovSpace_zero (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) : krylovSpace A b 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovSpace, Set.range_eq_empty, Submodule.span_empty]

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_start_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem krylovSpace_start_zero (A : Matrix n n K) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace A 0 q = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  simp

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_succ
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_succ (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace A b (q + 1) = krylovSpace A b q ⊔ Submodule.span K {(A ^ q) *ᵥ b}
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovSpace, krylovSpace, ← Submodule.span_union]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases Fin.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last i with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | rfl
    · exact Or.inl ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  · rintro (⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl)
    · exact ⟨i.castSucc, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Fin.last q, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_mono
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_mono (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) {q q' : ℕ} (h : q ≤ q') :
    krylovSpace A b q ≤ krylovSpace A b q'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 <| by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h)

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ
statement:
theorem mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) {q : ℕ} {x : n → K}
    (hx : x ∈ krylovSpace A b q) : A *ᵥ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : krylovSpace A b q ≤ (krylovSpace A b (q + 1)).comap (Matrix.mulVecLin A) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change A *ᵥ ((A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1)
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']
    exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt)
  exact hle hx

name: NLAlib.self_mem_krylovSpace_succ
statement:
theorem self_mem_krylovSpace_succ (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    b ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (Nat.succ_pos q)

name: NLAlib.finrank_krylovSpace_le
statement:
theorem finrank_krylovSpace_le (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank K (krylovSpace A b q) ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  exact (finrank_range_le_card (R := K) (fun i : Fin q => (A ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b)).trans
    (by simp)

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_mulVec_le_succ
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_mulVec_le_succ (B : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace B (B *ᵥ b) q ≤ krylovSpace B b (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  change (B ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ (B *ᵥ b) ∈ _
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ]
  exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace _ _ (Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt)

name: NLAlib.mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_of_mul_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hle : krylovSpace B b q ≤ (krylovSpace B' (C *ᵥ b) q).comap C.mulVecLin := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change C *ᵥ ((B ^ (i : ℕ)) *ᵥ b) ∈ krylovSpace B' (C *ᵥ b) q
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, (pow_mul_eq_mul_pow_of_mul_eq hC.symm i).symm,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    exact pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace _ _ i.isLt
  exact hle hx

name: NLAlib.gmresIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem gmresIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c x₀ : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) :
    gmresIterate A c x₀ q - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmresIterate, add_sub_cancel_left, ← range_krylovMatrix]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_gmresIterate
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_gmresIterate (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c x₀ : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (gmresIterate A c x₀ q)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨gmresIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ q, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  let X := krylovMatrix A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
  have hyX : y ∈ LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin := (range_krylovMatrix A _ q).symm ▸ hy
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hyX
  have hres : c - A *ᵥ gmresIterate A c x₀ q =
      (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - (A * X) *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A * X) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) := by
    change c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + X *ᵥ _) = _
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    abel
  have hyres : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y) = (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - (A * X) *ᵥ v := by
    rw [← hv, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    abel
  have h := norm_sub_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_le (A * X) (c - A *ᵥ x₀) v
  have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
  simpa only [hres, hyres, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] using hs

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_le_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_le_of_sub_mem (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    {z : n → 𝕜} (hz : z - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ z)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsAffineMinimizer.le_of_sub_mem hx hz
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)),
    norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ z))]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_rangeProjector
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_rangeProjector (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    c - A *ᵥ x = (c - A *ᵥ x₀) -
      rangeProjector (A * krylovMatrix A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  let X := krylovMatrix A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
  have hxK : x - x₀ ∈ LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin :=
    (range_krylovMatrix A _ q).symm ▸ hx.1
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hxK
  change X *ᵥ v = x - x₀ at hv
  have hmem : A *ᵥ (x - x₀) ∈ LinearMap.range (A * X).mulVecLin := by
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hv]
  have hr : (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - A *ᵥ (x - x₀) = c - A *ᵥ x := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    abel
  have he := eq_rangeProjector_mulVec_of_minimal hmem (b := c - A *ᵥ x₀) (by
    intro z
    rw [hr]
    have hz : x₀ + X *ᵥ z - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ← range_krylovMatrix]
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have h := hx.norm_le_of_sub_mem hz
    have hzr : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + X *ᵥ z) = (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - (A * X) *ᵥ z := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      abel
    rwa [hzr] at h)
  rw [← he]
  exact hr.symm

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq {x' : n → 𝕜} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x') : c - A *ᵥ x = c - A *ᵥ x'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx.residual_eq_rangeProjector, hx'.residual_eq_rangeProjector]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.eq_of_mulVec_injective
proof:
:=
  hA (sub_right_injective (hx.residual_eq hx'))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.exists_residual_polynomial
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.exists_residual_polynomial (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    ∃ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      c - A *ᵥ x = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:=
  exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace hx.1

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_le_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_le_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec A c x₀ hp hp0
  rw [← he]
  exact hx.norm_le_of_sub_mem (by simpa using hy)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_norm_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_norm_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    IsLeast {v | ∃ p : 𝕜[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      v = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))‖}
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, he⟩ := hx.exists_residual_polynomial
    exact ⟨p, hp, hp0, by rw [he]⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, hp0, rfl⟩
    exact hx.norm_le_aeval hp hp0

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_le_of_le
proof:
:=
  hx'.norm_le_of_sub_mem (krylovSpace_mono A _ h hx.1)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_zero_of_grade_le
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_zero_of_grade_le (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hq : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ q) :
    c - A *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs⟩ := Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.2 hA c
  have h := hx.norm_le_of_sub_mem
    (krylovSpace_mono A _ hq (sub_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade hA hxs x₀))
  simp only [hxs, sub_self, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero] at h
  exact WithLp.toLp_injective 2 (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h (norm_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.star_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.star_dotProduct_eq_zero (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    {z : n → 𝕜} (hz : z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    star (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let X := krylovMatrix A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
  let B := A * X
  have hzX : z ∈ LinearMap.range X.mulVecLin := (range_krylovMatrix A _ q).symm ▸ hz
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hzX
  change X *ᵥ v = z at hv
  have hBP : Bᴴ * rangeProjector B = Bᴴ := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose (rangeProjector_mul B)
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, (rangeProjector_isHermitian B).eq] using h
  have hzero : Bᴴ *ᵥ ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) - rangeProjector B *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBP, sub_self]
  rw [hx.residual_eq_rangeProjector, ← hv, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  change star (B *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) - rangeProjector B *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) = 0
  rw [Matrix.star_mulVec, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hzero, dotProduct_zero]

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_star_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_star_dotProduct_eq_zero :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x ↔ x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ∧
      ∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, star (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx => ⟨hx.1, fun _ hz => hx.star_dotProduct_eq_zero hz⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨hx, ho⟩
  refine ⟨hx, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have hd := (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q).sub_mem hy hx
  have h0 := ho _ hd
  have hi : ⟪WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x),
      WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀)))⟫_𝕜 = 0 := by
    rw [inner_eq_zero_symm]
    simpa only [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp, dotProduct_comm] using h0
  have hr : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y) = (c - A *ᵥ x) - A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀)) := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    abel
  dsimp only
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, hr]
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x) - WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀)))‖ ^ 2
  rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := 𝕜), hi, map_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_hermitianPart_mulVec
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_hermitianPart_mulVec (r : n → ℝ) :
    r ⬝ᵥ (matrixHermitianPart A *ᵥ r) = r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : r ⬝ᵥ (Aᵀ *ᵥ r) = r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r) := by
    calc
      _ = (Aᵀ *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ r := dotProduct_comm _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
  simp only [matrixHermitianPart, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_add, smul_eq_mul, ht]
  ring

name: NLAlib.positive_real_parameters
statement:
private theorem positive_real_parameters [Nonempty n]
    (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef) :
    0 < lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ∧
      lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ≤ specNorm A ∧
      ∀ r : n → ℝ, lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) * (r ⬝ᵥ r) ≤
        r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hco (r : n → ℝ) :
      lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) * (r ⬝ᵥ r) ≤ r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r) := by
    have hp := hM.isHermitian.posSemidef_sub_lambdaMin_smul_one
    have hr := hp.quadForm_nonneg r
    simp only [quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq] at hr
    rw [dotProduct_hermitianPart_mulVec] at hr
    linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := hM.isHermitian.exists_unit_lambdaMin_eigenvector
  have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hv, one_pow]
  have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    simp only [hzero, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero] at hv
    norm_num at hv
  have hα : 0 < lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) := by
    have h := hM.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
    simpa only [star_trivial, he, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hvv, mul_one,
      RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq] using h
  refine ⟨hα, ?_, hco⟩
  have hl := hco v
  have hu := (le_abs_self (v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))).trans (abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm A v)
  simpa only [hvv, mul_one] using hl.trans hu

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec_self_le
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec_self_le {α ω : ℝ}
    (hω : 0 ≤ ω) (hco : ∀ r : n → ℝ, α * (r ⬝ᵥ r) ≤ r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r))
    (r : n → ℝ) :
    (r - ω • (A *ᵥ r)) ⬝ᵥ (r - ω • (A *ᵥ r)) ≤
      (1 - 2 * ω * α + ω ^ 2 * specNorm A ^ 2) * (r ⬝ᵥ r)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (A *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r) ≤ specNorm A ^ 2 * (r ⬝ᵥ r) := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, sq] using sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq A r
  have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hco r) hω
  have hu := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sq_nonneg ω)
  have he : (r - ω • (A *ᵥ r)) ⬝ᵥ (r - ω • (A *ᵥ r)) =
      r ⬝ᵥ r - 2 * ω * (r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r)) +
        ω ^ 2 * ((A *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r)) := by
    simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ r) r]
    ring
  rw [he]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.norm_residual_le_sqrt_pow
statement:
private theorem norm_residual_le_sqrt_pow {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hαβ : α ≤ specNorm A)
    (hco : ∀ r : n → ℝ, α * (r ⬝ᵥ r) ≤ r ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ r))
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ k x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - α ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hβ : 0 < specNorm A := hα.trans_le hαβ
  let ω := α / specNorm A ^ 2
  let δ := 1 - α ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2
  let B : Matrix n n ℝ := 1 - ω • A
  have hω : 0 ≤ ω := div_nonneg hα.le (sq_nonneg _)
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hβ)).mpr
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ hα.le hαβ 2))
  have hcoeff : 1 - 2 * ω * α + ω ^ 2 * specNorm A ^ 2 = δ := by
    dsimp [ω, δ]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hB (r : n → ℝ) :
      (B *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ r) ≤ δ * (r ⬝ᵥ r) := by
    have h := dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec_self_le hω hco r
    simpa only [B, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hcoeff] using h
  have hpow (j : ℕ) (r : n → ℝ) :
      ((B ^ j) *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ ((B ^ j) *ᵥ r) ≤ δ ^ j * (r ⬝ᵥ r) := by
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      simp only [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      calc
        (B *ᵥ ((B ^ j) *ᵥ r)) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ ((B ^ j) *ᵥ r)) ≤
            δ * (((B ^ j) *ᵥ r) ⬝ᵥ ((B ^ j) *ᵥ r)) := hB _
        _ ≤ δ * (δ ^ j * (r ⬝ᵥ r)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hδ
        _ = δ * δ ^ j * (r ⬝ᵥ r) := by ring
  let p : ℝ[X] := (1 - C ω * X) ^ k
  have hp : p.degree ≤ k := by
    apply degree_le_of_natDegree_le
    dsimp [p]
    compute_degree
  have hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1 := by simp [p]
  have heval : aeval A p = B ^ k := by
    simp only [p, B, map_pow, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_C, aeval_X,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hs : (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      δ ^ k * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) := by
    refine (hx.le_aeval hp hp0).trans ?_
    rw [heval]
    exact hpow _ _
  have hroot : (Real.sqrt δ ^ k) ^ 2 = δ ^ k := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm k 2, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt hδ]
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.sqrt δ ^ k * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow, hroot, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hs
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero
    (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _) (norm_nonneg _)) hnorm

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ k x)
    (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ k *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x) 0,
      Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x₀) 0, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero, le_refl]
  · have := hn
    obtain ⟨hα, hαβ, hco⟩ := positive_real_parameters hM
    exact norm_residual_le_sqrt_pow hα hαβ hco hx

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_posDef_hermitianPart
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_posDef_hermitianPart
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ k x)
    (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x) 0,
      Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x₀) 0, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero, le_refl]
  · have := hn
    obtain ⟨hα, hαβ, -⟩ := positive_real_parameters hM
    have hβ := hα.trans_le hαβ
    have hδ : 0 ≤ 1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2 :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hβ)).mpr
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ hα.le hαβ 2))
    simpa only [sqrt_pow_eq_rpow_half hδ] using
      hx.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart hM

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_restarted_gmres
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_restarted_gmres
    {c : n → ℝ} (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef)
    (xs : ℕ → n → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hcycle : ∀ j, IsGMRESIterate A c (xs j) m (xs (j + 1))) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs j)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ (j * m) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs 0)‖
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have he : m + j * m = (j + 1) * m := by ring
    calc
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs (j + 1))‖ ≤
          Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ m *
            ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs j)‖ :=
        (hcycle j).norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_posDef_hermitianPart hM
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ m *
          (Real.sqrt (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ (j * m) *
            ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs 0)‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (pow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) _)
      _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, he]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_restarted_gmres
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_restarted_gmres
    {c : n → ℝ} (hM : (matrixHermitianPart A).PosDef)
    (xs : ℕ → n → ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hcycle : ∀ j, IsGMRESIterate A c (xs j) m (xs (j + 1))) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs j)‖ ≤
      (1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2) ^ (((j * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ xs 0)‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ xs j) 0,
      Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ xs 0) 0, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero, le_refl]
  · have := hn
    obtain ⟨hα, hαβ, -⟩ := positive_real_parameters hM
    have hβ := hα.trans_le hαβ
    have hδ : 0 ≤ 1 - lambdaMin (matrixHermitianPart A) ^ 2 / specNorm A ^ 2 :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hβ)).mpr
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ hα.le hαβ 2))
    simpa only [sqrt_pow_eq_rpow_half hδ] using
      norm_sub_mulVec_le_sqrt_pow_of_restarted_gmres hM xs m hcycle j

name: NLAlib.christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_krylov_direction
statement:
theorem christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_krylov_direction
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < krylovGrade A b) :
    let p
proof:
:= christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 k
    aeval A p *ᵥ b ≠ 0 ∧ aeval A p *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b (k+1) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ krylovSpace A b k, (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = 0 := by
  let L := polynomialWeightedFunctional
    (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) X
  rw [← monicOrthogonalPolynomial_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffelPolynomial hA b hk]
  have hL : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le
      (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X hA b hk.le) le_rfl
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL
  have hd : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).degree = k := by
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hP.monic.ne_zero, hP.natDegree_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    exact hP.monic.ne_zero (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (by rw [hd]; exact_mod_cast hk) hzero)
  · apply (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b (k+1) _).mpr
    exact ⟨_, by rw [hd]; exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self k, rfl⟩
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b k v).mp hv
    rw [← polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X_mul]
    exact hP.orthogonal q hq

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_mulVec_eq_zero
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < krylovGrade A b) (hj : j < krylovGrade A b) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (aeval A (christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 i) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
      (A *ᵥ (aeval A (christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 j) *ᵥ b)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let d := fun k => aeval A (christoffelPolynomial
    (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 k) *ᵥ b
  have hD (k : ℕ) (hk : k < krylovGrade A b) :
      d k ∈ krylovSpace A b (k+1) ∧ ∀ v ∈ krylovSpace A b k, d k ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = 0 :=
    (christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_krylov_direction hA b hk).2
  change d i ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ d j) = 0
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hij | hji
  · have hzero := (hD j hj).2 (d i)
      (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega : i+1 ≤ j) (hD i hi).1)
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
      show Aᵀ = A by rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA.isHermitian,
      dotProduct_comm]
    exact hzero
  · exact (hD i hi).2 (d j)
      (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega : j+1 ≤ i) (hD j hj).1)

name: NLAlib.exists_nonzero_smul_christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_of_krylov_direction
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_smul_christoffelPolynomial_spectralMeasure_of_krylov_direction
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < krylovGrade A b)
    {d : m → ℝ} (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (hd : d ∈ krylovSpace A b (k+1))
    (horth : ∀ v ∈ krylovSpace A b k, d ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧ d = c • (aeval A
      (christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 k) *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialWeightedFunctional
    (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) X
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b (k+1) d).mp hd
  have hL : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 :=
    hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le
      (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X hA b hk.le) le_rfl
  have hpdeg : p.degree ≤ k := by
    apply (degree_le_iff_coeff_zero p _).mpr
    intro j hj
    have hkj : k < j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
      (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast (show k+1 ≤ j by omega)))
  have hp' := eq_C_mul_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_of_degree_le_of_orthogonal L hL hpdeg (by
    intro q hq
    rw [polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X_mul, ← hpd]
    exact horth _ ((mem_krylovSpace_iff A b k _).mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩))
  have heq : d = p.coeff k • (aeval A (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k) *ᵥ b) := by
    rw [hpd]
    simpa only [map_mul, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      smul_mul_assoc, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec] using
      congrArg (fun q : ℝ[X] => aeval A q *ᵥ b) hp'
  refine ⟨p.coeff k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_smul] at heq
    exact hd0 heq
  · simpa only [L, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffelPolynomial hA b hk] using heq

name: NLAlib.ofReal_mulVec
statement:
private theorem ofReal_mulVec {m k : Type*} [Fintype k] (A : Matrix m k ℝ) (v : k → ℝ) :
    (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ (A *ᵥ v) = A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) *ᵥ ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜).map_mulVec A v i

name: NLAlib.krylovMatrix_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem krylovMatrix_map_ofReal (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovMatrix (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ b) q =
      (krylovMatrix A b q).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hp := map_pow ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜).mapMatrix :
    Matrix n n ℝ →+* Matrix n n 𝕜) A (j : ℕ)
  change (A ^ (j : ℕ)).map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) = (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) ^ (j : ℕ) at hp
  simpa only [krylovMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, ← hp] using
    ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜).map_mulVec (A ^ (j : ℕ)) b i).symm

name: NLAlib.gmresIterate_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem gmresIterate_map_ofReal (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    gmresIterate (A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜)) ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ c)
      ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ x₀) q = (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ gmresIterate A c x₀ q
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ c) -
      A.map (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) *ᵥ ((algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ x₀) =
      (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ∘ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
    rw [← ofReal_mulVec]
    funext i
    simp
  dsimp only [gmresIterate]
  rw [hr]
  simp only [krylovMatrix_map_ofReal, ← Matrix.map_mul,
    moorePenroseInverse_map_ofReal, ← ofReal_mulVec]
  funext i
  simp

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_map_ofReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [hy.residual_eq (isGMRESIterate_gmresIterate _ _ _ _), gmresIterate_map_ofReal,
    ← ofReal_mulVec, hx.residual_eq (isGMRESIterate_gmresIterate _ _ _ _)]
  funext i
  simp

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.mulVec_transpose_Q_mulVec_self
statement:
theorem mulVec_transpose_Q_mulVec_self (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    D.Q *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) = b
proof:
:= by
  refine mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range D.hasOrthonormalCols ?_
  rw [D.range_Q]
  simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (i := 0) hq

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_smul_single
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_smul_single (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q) :
    D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b = (D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) • Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = 0
  · have : i = ⟨0, hq⟩ := Fin.ext hi
    subst this
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col]
  · rw [D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi), Pi.smul_apply,
      Pi.single_eq_of_ne (fun h => hi (by rw [h])), smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) :
    D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ • Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, D.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_smul_single hq]
  congr 1
  have h := D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq
  have h1 : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ = D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b := by
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col]
  rw [h1] at h
  rw [← h, Real.sqrt_sq hD.le]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y)) ⬝ᵥ
        (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y)) =
      (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) =
      D.Q *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, D.mulVec_transpose_Q_mulVec_self (Nat.succ_pos q),
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← D.mul_restrict_Q_eq_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_add]
    abel
  rw [hres]
  simpa only [star_trivial] using
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols D.hasOrthonormalCols _

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) {z : n → ℝ}
    (hz : z ∈ krylovSpace A b q) : ∃ y, z = (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (D.restrict q.le_succ).range_Q] at hz
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.restrict_Q_mulVec_mem
statement:
theorem restrict_Q_mulVec_mem (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b (q + 1)) (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (D.restrict q.le_succ).range_Q]
  exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) ↔
      ∀ y' : Fin q → ℝ,
        (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ≤
          (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y') ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y')
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsGMRESIterate, IsAffineMinimizer, add_sub_cancel_left]
  simp only [D.restrict_Q_mulVec_mem y, true_and, star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real]
  constructor
  · intro h y'
    have := h _ (D.restrict_Q_mulVec_mem y')
    rwa [D.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq, D.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq] at this
  · intro h z hz
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := D.exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem hz
    rw [D.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq, D.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq]
    exact h y'

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff_of_pos
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff_of_pos (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    (hD : 0 < D.Q.col 0 ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) ↔
      ∀ y' : Fin q → ℝ,
        (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ
            (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ≤
          (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y') ⬝ᵥ
            (√((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) • Pi.single 0 1 - D.Hbar *ᵥ y')
proof:
:= by
  rw [isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff,
    D.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single (Nat.succ_pos q) hD,
    norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isGMRESIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    ∃ y, x = x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := D.exists_eq_mulVec_of_mem hx.1
  exact ⟨y, by rw [← hy, add_sub_cancel]⟩

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isLeast_dotProduct_of_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem isLeast_dotProduct_of_isGMRESIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1))
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    IsLeast (Set.range fun y : Fin q → ℝ =>
        (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.Hbar *ᵥ y))
      ((c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := D.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isGMRESIterate hx
  rw [D.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y', rfl⟩
  exact (D.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_iff y).1 hx y'

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    (∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, z ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y)) = 0) ↔
      D.H *ᵥ y = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y)) = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - D.H *ᵥ y := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, ← sub_sub, Matrix.mulVec_sub (D.Qᵀ), H_def, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← neg_sub, neg_eq_zero, ← hr]
    ext i
    have := h _ (D.graded.col_mem i |> krylovSpace_mono A _ (by have := i.isLt; omega))
    simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply] using this
  · intro h z hz
    rw [← D.range_Q] at hz
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hz
    rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hr, h, sub_self, zero_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isCGIterate_add_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_add_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq (hA : A.PosDef) (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    {y : Fin q → ℝ} (hy : D.H *ᵥ y = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  refine isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero hA.isHermitian
    (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues_pos i).le) ?_ ((D.forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff y).2 hy)
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ← D.range_Q]
  exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRho_zero (a b : ℝ) :
    chebyshevRho a b 0 = ((b + a) / (b - a))⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_succ (a b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) =
      (2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) - chebyshevRho a b k)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.eval_T_nat_add_two
statement:
private theorem eval_T_nat_add_two (σ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ =
      2 * σ * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ -
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 2 by omega, Chebyshev.T_add_two,
    show ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 by omega]
  simp

name: NLAlib.eval_T_center_pos
statement:
private theorem eval_T_center_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_one.trans_le (Chebyshev.one_le_eval_T_real _
    (by rw [one_le_div (by linarith)]; linarith))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRho a b k = (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) /
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [chebyshevRho, Chebyshev.T_zero, Chebyshev.T_one, one_div]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [chebyshevRho_succ, ih]
    have hτ := (eval_T_center_pos ha hab (k + 1)).ne'
    have hden :
        2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) -
            (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) /
              (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) =
          (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) /
            (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) := by
      rw [eval_T_nat_add_two]
      field_simp
    rw [hden, inv_div]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRho_pos
statement:
theorem chebyshevRho_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < chebyshevRho a b k
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ ha hab]
  exact div_pos (eval_T_center_pos ha hab k) (eval_T_center_pos ha hab (k + 1))

name: NLAlib.two_mul_div_sub_chebyshevRho_pos
statement:
theorem two_mul_div_sub_chebyshevRho_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < 2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) - chebyshevRho a b k
proof:
:= by
  exact inv_pos.mp (chebyshevRho_pos ha hab (k + 1))

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) : chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ 0 = (2 / (b + a)) • (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_succ (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
      chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k + chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_succ
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_succ (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
      (chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) * chebyshevRho a b k) •
          chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ k +
        (4 * chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) / (b - a)) •
          (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_sub_succ
statement:
private theorem chebyshevIterate_sub_succ {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 2) - chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
      (chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) * chebyshevRho a b k) •
          (chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) - chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k) +
        (4 * chebyshevRho a b (k + 1) / (b - a)) •
          (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ ha hab (k + 1),
    chebyshevRho_eq_eval_T_div_eval_T_succ ha hab k]
  let τ₀ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
  let τ₁ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
  let τ₂ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
  have hτ₁ : τ₁ ≠ 0 := (eval_T_center_pos ha hab (k + 1)).ne'
  have hτ₂ : τ₂ ≠ 0 := (eval_T_center_pos ha hab (k + 2)).ne'
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hcoef : 4 / (b - a) * τ₁ * ((b + a) / 2) = τ₂ + τ₀ := by
    have ht := eval_T_nat_add_two ((b + a) / (b - a)) k
    have hs : 4 / (b - a) * τ₁ * ((b + a) / 2) =
        2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) * τ₁ := by field_simp; ring
    rw [hs]
    change τ₂ = 2 * ((b + a) / (b - a)) * τ₁ - τ₀ at ht
    linarith
  have hprod : τ₂ * (τ₁ / τ₂ * (τ₀ / τ₁)) = τ₀ := by field_simp
  have hprod' : τ₂ * (4 * (τ₁ / τ₂) / (b - a)) = 4 / (b - a) * τ₁ := by field_simp
  have hx₂ := chebyshevIterate_add_two ha hab A c x₀ k
  change chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 2) = τ₂⁻¹ •
    ((4 / (b - a) * τ₁) • (((b + a) / 2) • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) +
      (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1))) -
      τ₀ • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k) at hx₂
  change _ = (τ₁ / τ₂ * (τ₀ / τ₁)) • _ + (4 * (τ₁ / τ₂) / (b - a)) • _
  apply smul_right_injective (M := n → ℝ) hτ₂
  change τ₂ • (chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 2) -
      chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1)) =
    τ₂ • ((τ₁ / τ₂ * (τ₀ / τ₁)) •
      (chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) - chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k) +
      (4 * (τ₁ / τ₂) / (b - a)) • (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1)))
  rw [smul_sub, hx₂]
  simp only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hτ₂, one_smul]
  simp only [smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul, hprod, hprod', hcoef, add_smul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrence_eq_polynomial_pair
statement:
private theorem chebyshevRecurrence_eq_polynomial_pair {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k = chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k ∧
    chebyshevRecurrenceDirection a b A c x₀ k =
      chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) - chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    constructor
    · simp only [chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_zero, chebyshevIterate_zero]
    · rw [chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_zero, chebyshevIterate_one ha hab,
        chebyshevIterate_zero]
      abel
  | succ k ih =>
    have hx : chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) =
        chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (k + 1) := by
      rw [chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_succ, ih.1, ih.2]
      abel
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rw [chebyshevRecurrenceDirection_succ, ih.2, hx]
    exact (chebyshevIterate_sub_succ ha hab A c x₀ k).symm

name: NLAlib.chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate
statement:
theorem chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k = chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ k
proof:
:=
  (chebyshevRecurrence_eq_polynomial_pair ha hab A c x₀ k).1

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b k) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate ha hab,
    sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate ha hab]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k)‖ ≤
      (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate ha hab]
  have hsq := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le hA (p := chebyshevResidual a b k) hspec
    (fun x hx => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le ha hab hx) (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) :=
    (one_div_pos.mpr (eval_T_center_pos ha hab k)).le
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hsq
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b k) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))),
    mul_nonneg hnonneg (norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)))]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le_two_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ k) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:=
  (norm_sub_mulVec_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_le hA ha hab hspec c x₀ k).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (inv_eval_T_real_le_two_mul_pow k ha hab) (norm_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) ^ 2 *
        quadForm A (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate ha hab,
    chebyshevIterate_sub ha hab hxs]
  exact quadForm_aeval_mulVec_le hA (fun x hx => ha.le.trans hx.1) hspec
    (fun x hx => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le ha hab hx) (x₀ - xs)

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le_two_mul_pow
statement:
theorem quadForm_chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_sub_le_two_mul_pow
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (chebyshevRecurrenceIterate a b A c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevRecurrenceIterate_eq_chebyshevIterate ha hab]
  exact quadForm_chebyshevIterate_sub_le hA ha hab hspec hxs x₀ k

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_polyIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_polyIterate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (s : ℝ[X]) :
    c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s = aeval A (1 - X * s) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyIterate, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_add]
  abel

name: NLAlib.polyIterate_sub
statement:
theorem polyIterate_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ)
    (s : ℝ[X]) : polyIterate A c x₀ s - xs = aeval A (1 - X * s) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = -(A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs]; abel
  rw [polyIterate, mul_comm X s, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec,
    Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hr, Matrix.mulVec_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.polyIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem polyIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {s : ℝ[X]} {q : ℕ}
    (hs : s.degree < q) : polyIterate A c x₀ s - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
proof:
:=
  (mem_krylovSpace_iff _ _ _ _).2 ⟨s, hs, by rw [polyIterate, add_sub_cancel_left]⟩

name: NLAlib.quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {g s : ℝ[X]}
    {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S) (hg : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 ≤ g.eval x)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ S, |(1 - X * s).eval x| ≤ M) {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c)
    (x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (aeval A g) (polyIterate A c x₀ s - xs) ≤ M ^ 2 * quadForm (aeval A g) (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polyIterate_sub hxs]
  exact quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_le hA hspec hg hM _

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {s : ℝ[X]} {S : Set ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ S)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ S, |(1 - X * s).eval x| ≤ M) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ polyIterate A c x₀ s) ≤
      M ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mulVec_polyIterate]
  exact dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le hA hspec hM _

name: NLAlib.one_sub_X_mul_richardson
statement:
private lemma one_sub_X_mul_richardson (ω : ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    1 - X * (C ω * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (1 - C ω * X) ^ j) = (1 - C ω * X) ^ q
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination geom_sum_mul (1 - C ω * X) q

name: NLAlib.richardsonIterate_succ
statement:
theorem richardsonIterate_succ (ω : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ (q + 1) =
      richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q + ω • (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := sub_mulVec_polyIterate A c x₀ (C ω * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (1 - C ω * X) ^ j)
  rw [one_sub_X_mul_richardson] at hr
  simp only [richardsonIterate]
  rw [hr, polyIterate, polyIterate]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, map_add, map_mul, aeval_C, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    add_assoc]

name: NLAlib.richardsonIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem richardsonIterate_zero (ω : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ 0 = x₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [richardsonIterate, polyIterate]

name: NLAlib.abs_eval_richardson_le
statement:
private lemma abs_eval_richardson_le {ω a b x : ℝ} (hω : 0 ≤ ω) (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc a b) (q : ℕ) :
    |((1 - C ω * X) ^ q : ℝ[X]).eval x| ≤ max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, abs_pow]
  have h1 : 1 - ω * b ≤ 1 - ω * x := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2 hω]
  have h2 : 1 - ω * x ≤ 1 - ω * a := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 hω]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _)
    ((abs_le_max_abs_abs h1 h2).trans (max_comm _ _).le) q

name: NLAlib.quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  refine quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le hA hspec hg (fun x hx => ?_) hxs x₀
  rw [one_sub_X_mul_richardson]
  exact abs_eval_richardson_le hω hx q

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_richardsonIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_richardsonIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b ω : ℝ} (hω : 0 ≤ ω) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) (c x₀ : n → ℝ)
    (q : ℕ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω A c x₀ q) ≤
      (max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:= by
  refine dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le hA hspec (fun x hx => ?_) c x₀
  rw [one_sub_X_mul_richardson]
  exact abs_eval_richardson_le hω hx q

name: NLAlib.quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal
statement:
theorem quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (richardsonIterate (2 / (a + b)) A c x₀ q - xs) ≤
      (((b - a) / (b + a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have hab' : 0 < a + b := by linarith
  have hne : a + b ≠ 0 := hab'.ne'
  have hne' : b + a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h := quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le hA (ω := 2 / (a + b)) (by positivity) hspec (g := X)
    (fun x hx => by simpa using ha.le.trans hx.1) hxs x₀ q
  rw [aeval_X] at h
  have h1 : 1 - 2 / (a + b) * a = (b - a) / (b + a) := by field_simp; ring
  have h2 : 1 - 2 / (a + b) * b = -((b - a) / (b + a)) := by field_simp; ring
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (b + a) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rwa [h1, h2, abs_neg, max_self, abs_of_nonneg hnn] at h

name: NLAlib.one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic
statement:
private lemma one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic {p : ℝ[X]} (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    1 - X * ((1 - p) /ₘ X) = p
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : X ∣ 1 - p := by
    rw [X_dvd_iff, coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, eval_sub, hp0, eval_one, sub_self]
  have h := modByMonic_add_div (1 - p) X
  rw [(modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd monic_X).2 hdvd, zero_add] at h
  rw [h]; ring

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevIterate, sub_mulVec_polyIterate,
    one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_sub
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_sub {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q - xs =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b q) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chebyshevIterate, polyIterate_sub hxs,
    one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, h⟩ := exists_degree_lt_one_sub_eq_X_mul_of_eval_zero_eq_one
    (degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q) (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)
  have hs' : (1 - chebyshevResidual a b q) /ₘ X = s := by
    rw [h, mul_divByMonic_cancel_left _ monic_X]
  rw [chebyshevIterate, hs']
  exact polyIterate_sub_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ hs

name: NLAlib.quadForm_chebyshevIterate_sub_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_polyIterate_sub_le hA hspec (g := X)
    (fun x hx => by simpa using ha.le.trans hx.1)
    (s := (1 - chebyshevResidual a b q) /ₘ X) (fun x hx => by
      rw [one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)]
      exact abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab hx) hxs x₀
  rwa [aeval_X] at h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_chebyshevIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
