    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_self_sub_mulVec_polyIterate_le hA hspec (fun x hx => by
    rw [one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)]
    exact abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab hx) c x₀

name: NLAlib.one_le_eval_T_chebyshevCenter
statement:
private lemma one_le_eval_T_chebyshevCenter {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (q : ℤ) :
    1 ≤ (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:=
  Chebyshev.one_le_eval_T_real q (by rw [one_le_div (by linarith)]; linarith)

name: NLAlib.chebyshev_iterationPoly_add_two
statement:
private lemma chebyshev_iterationPoly_add_two {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (q : ℕ) :
    C ((Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
        ((1 - chebyshevResidual a b (q + 2)) /ₘ X) =
      C (4 / (b - a) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
          (C ((b + a) / 2) * ((1 - chebyshevResidual a b (q + 1)) /ₘ X) +
            chebyshevResidual a b (q + 1)) -
        C ((Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) *
          ((1 - chebyshevResidual a b q) /ₘ X)
proof:
:= by
  set σ := (b + a) / (b - a)
  have hS : ∀ k : ℕ, X * ((1 - chebyshevResidual a b k) /ₘ X) = 1 - chebyshevResidual a b k :=
    fun k => by
      have h := one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero (q := k) ha hab)
      linear_combination -h
  have hτ : ∀ k : ℕ, (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval σ ≠ 0 := fun k =>
    (zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_eval_T_chebyshevCenter ha hab k)).ne'
  have hR : ∀ (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ), (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval σ * (chebyshevResidual a b k).eval t =
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ (k : ℤ)).eval (σ - 2 / (b - a) * t) := fun k t => by
    rw [eval_chebyshevResidual]; exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hτ k)
  have hT : ∀ u : ℝ, (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval u =
      2 * u * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval u - (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval u := by
    intro u
    rw [show ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) + 2 by push_cast; ring, Chebyshev.T_add_two,
      show ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
    simp
  refine mul_left_cancel₀ X_ne_zero (Polynomial.funext fun t => ?_)
  have h2 := congrArg (eval t) (hS (q + 2))
  have h1 := congrArg (eval t) (hS (q + 1))
  have h0 := congrArg (eval t) (hS q)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, eval_sub, eval_one] at h2 h1 h0
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, eval_sub, eval_add, eval_C]
  have hσ : 4 / (b - a) * ((b + a) / 2) = 2 * σ := by
    simp only [σ]; field_simp; ring
  linear_combination
    (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ * h2 -
      4 / (b - a) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ * ((b + a) / 2) * h1 +
      (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval σ * h0 - hR (q + 2) t +
      (4 / (b - a) * ((b + a) / 2) - 4 / (b - a) * t) * hR (q + 1) t - hR q t +
      hT σ - hT (σ - 2 / (b - a) * t) +
      ((Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ -
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval (σ - 2 / (b - a) * t)) * hσ

name: NLAlib.eval_T_add_two_center
statement:
private lemma eval_T_add_two_center {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (q : ℕ) :
    (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) =
      4 / (b - a) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) * ((b + a) / 2) -
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))
proof:
:= by
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have e2 : ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) + 2 := by push_cast; ring
  have e1 : ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [e2, e1, Chebyshev.T_add_two]
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X, eval_ofNat]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chebyshevIterate_zero (a b : ℝ) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ 0 = x₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [chebyshevIterate, polyIterate, chebyshevResidual]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_one
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_one {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ 1 = x₀ + (2 / (b + a)) • (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hab' : b + a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hs : (1 - chebyshevResidual a b 1) /ₘ X = C (2 / (b + a)) := by
    have h : 1 - chebyshevResidual a b 1 = X * C (2 / (b + a)) := by
      refine Polynomial.funext fun t => ?_
      simp only [eval_sub, eval_one, eval_chebyshevResidual, Nat.cast_one, Chebyshev.T_one,
        eval_X, eval_mul, eval_C]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h, mul_divByMonic_cancel_left _ monic_X]
  rw [chebyshevIterate, polyIterate, hs, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.chebyshevIterate_add_two
statement:
theorem chebyshevIterate_add_two {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 2) =
      ((Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)))⁻¹ •
        ((4 / (b - a) * (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a))) •
            (((b + a) / 2) • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 1) +
              (c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 1))) -
          (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval ((b + a) / (b - a)) • chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ q)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly := congrArg (fun p => aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (chebyshev_iterationPoly_add_two ha hab q)
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_add, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    Matrix.smul_mulVec] at hpoly
  have hr : c - A *ᵥ chebyshevIterate a b A c x₀ (q + 1) =
      aeval A (chebyshevResidual a b (q + 1)) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
    rw [chebyshevIterate, sub_mulVec_polyIterate,
      one_sub_X_mul_divByMonic (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)]
  set σ := (b + a) / (b - a)
  set τ₂ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ
  set τ₁ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval σ
  set τ₀ := (Chebyshev.T ℝ (q : ℤ)).eval σ
  have hτ₂ : τ₂ ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_eval_T_chebyshevCenter ha hab _)).ne'
  have hrec : τ₂ = 4 / (b - a) * τ₁ * ((b + a) / 2) - τ₀ := eval_T_add_two_center hab q
  rw [eq_inv_smul_iff₀ hτ₂, hr]
  simp only [chebyshevIterate, polyIterate]
  rw [smul_add, hpoly, hrec]
  module

name: NLAlib.affineStationaryIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem affineStationaryIterate_zero (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) (d x₀ : n → 𝕜) :
    affineStationaryIterate H d x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.affineStationaryIterate_succ
statement:
theorem affineStationaryIterate_succ (H : Matrix n n 𝕜) (d x₀ : n → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    affineStationaryIterate H d x₀ (k + 1) = H *ᵥ affineStationaryIterate H d x₀ k + d
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.affineStationaryIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [affineStationaryIterate_succ, pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← ih,
      Matrix.mulVec_sub, eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr hxs]
    abel

name: NLAlib.splittingIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem splittingIterate_zero (M N : Matrix n n 𝕜) (b x₀ : n → 𝕜) :
    splittingIterate M N b x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.splittingIterate_succ
statement:
theorem splittingIterate_succ (M N : Matrix n n 𝕜) (b x₀ : n → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    splittingIterate M N b x₀ (k + 1) = (M⁻¹ * N) *ᵥ splittingIterate M N b x₀ k +
      M⁻¹ *ᵥ b
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.splitting_fixedPoint_iff
statement:
theorem splitting_fixedPoint_iff {M N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : IsUnit M) (b xs : n → 𝕜) :
    (M⁻¹ * N) *ᵥ xs + M⁻¹ *ᵥ b = xs ↔ (M - N) *ᵥ xs = b
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det M).mp hM
  have hmul : M *ᵥ ((M⁻¹ * N) *ᵥ xs + M⁻¹ *ᵥ b) = N *ᵥ xs + b := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hd, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h] at hmul
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec]
    exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (by simpa only [add_comm] using hmul)
  · intro h
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hM
    rw [hmul]
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec] at h
    simpa only [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).symm

name: NLAlib.sub_eq_mul_one_sub_inv_mul
statement:
theorem sub_eq_mul_one_sub_inv_mul {M N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : IsUnit M) :
    M - N = M * (1 - M⁻¹ * N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det M).mp hM), Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.splittingIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem splittingIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec {M N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : IsUnit M)
    {b xs : n → 𝕜} (hxs : (M - N) *ᵥ xs = b) (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) :
    splittingIterate M N b x₀ k - xs = ((M⁻¹ * N) ^ k) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:=
  affineStationaryIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec ((splitting_fixedPoint_iff hM b xs).mpr hxs) x₀ k

name: NLAlib.isUnit_sub_of_tendsto_splitting_pow_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_sub_of_tendsto_splitting_pow_zero {M N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : IsUnit M)
    (hpow : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (M⁻¹ * N) ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0)) : IsUnit (M - N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_mul_one_sub_inv_mul hM]
  exact hM.mul (Matrix.isUnit_one_sub_of_tendsto_pow_zero hpow)

name: NLAlib.splittingConverges_iff_tendsto_pow_zero
statement:
theorem splittingConverges_iff_tendsto_pow_zero {M N : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hM : IsUnit M) :
    SplittingConverges M N ↔ Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (M⁻¹ * N) ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨xs, -, huniq, hlim⟩ := h 0
    have hxs : xs = 0 := (huniq 0 (by simp)).symm
    subst xs
    apply (Matrix.tendsto_pow_zero_iff_forall_mulVec _).mpr
    intro x₀
    have heq (k : ℕ) : splittingIterate M N 0 x₀ k = ((M⁻¹ * N) ^ k) *ᵥ x₀ := by
      simpa using splittingIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec hM (b := 0) (xs := 0) (by simp) x₀ k
    exact (hlim x₀).congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall heq)
  · intro hpow b
    have hA := isUnit_sub_of_tendsto_splitting_pow_zero hM hpow
    let xs := (M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ b
    have hxs : (M - N) *ᵥ xs = b := by
      dsimp [xs]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
        ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mulVec]
    refine ⟨xs, hxs, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ys hys
      exact Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hA (hys.trans hxs.symm)
    · intro x₀
      have ht := ((Matrix.tendsto_pow_zero_iff_forall_mulVec _).mp hpow (x₀ - xs)).add_const xs
      have heq (k : ℕ) : splittingIterate M N b x₀ k =
          ((M⁻¹ * N) ^ k) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs) + xs :=
        eq_add_of_sub_eq (splittingIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec hM hxs x₀ k)
      simpa only [zero_add, ← heq] using ht

name: NLAlib.splittingConverges_iff_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem splittingConverges_iff_spectralRadius_lt_one {M N : Matrix n n ℂ} (hM : IsUnit M) :
    SplittingConverges M N ↔ spectralRadius ℂ (M⁻¹ * N) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [splittingConverges_iff_tendsto_pow_zero hM,
    tendsto_matrix_pow_zero_iff_spectralRadius_lt_one]

name: NLAlib.splittingConverges_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
statement:
theorem splittingConverges_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) :
    SplittingConverges M N ↔ spectralRadius ℂ ((M⁻¹ * N).map Complex.ofReal) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [splittingConverges_iff_tendsto_pow_zero hM,
    tendsto_real_matrix_pow_zero_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one]

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_iff
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c x₀ : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} {x : n → ℝ} :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ∧
        ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, cgObjective A c x ≤ cgObjective A c (x₀ + y)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_comm_of_isHermitian
statement:
private lemma dotProduct_mulVec_comm_of_isHermitian {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (u d : n → ℝ) : u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ d) = d ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : Aᵀ = A := by rw [← conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hT, dotProduct_comm]

name: NLAlib.cgObjective_add
statement:
theorem cgObjective_add {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (c u d : n → ℝ) :
    cgObjective A c (u + d) =
      cgObjective A c u + d ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u - c) + quadForm A d / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_mulVec_comm_of_isHermitian hA u d
  simp only [cgObjective, quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_add, dotProduct_add,
    add_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub]
  rw [dotProduct_comm d c]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.cgObjective_eq_add_quadForm_sub
statement:
theorem cgObjective_eq_add_quadForm_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (z : n → ℝ) :
    cgObjective A c z = cgObjective A c xs + quadForm A (z - xs) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := cgObjective_add hA c xs (z - xs)
  rw [add_sub_cancel, hxs, sub_self, dotProduct_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {c x₀ xs x : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) {q : ℕ} :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      IsAffineMinimizer (fun y => quadForm A (y - xs)) x₀ (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCGIterate_iff, IsAffineMinimizer]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => forall₂_congr fun y _ => ?_
  rw [cgObjective_eq_add_quadForm_sub hA hxs x, cgObjective_eq_add_quadForm_sub hA hxs (x₀ + y)]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hpsd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i) {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hx : x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (horth : ∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, z ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0) :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have hd : y - (x - x₀) ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q := Submodule.sub_mem _ hy hx
  have h := cgObjective_add hA c x (y - (x - x₀))
  have he : x + (y - (x - x₀)) = x₀ + y := by abel
  rw [he] at h
  have h0 : (y - (x - x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - c) = 0 := by
    rw [← neg_sub c, dotProduct_neg, horth _ hd, neg_zero]
  have hq := quadForm_nonneg_of_eigenvalues_nonneg hA hpsd (y - (x - x₀))
  linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem exists_isCGIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x, IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  have hH : A.IsHermitian := hA.isHermitian
  have hpos : ∀ i, 0 < hH.eigenvalues i := hA.eigenvalues_pos
  set r₀ := c - A *ᵥ x₀
  set K := krylovSpace A r₀ q
  let T : K →ₗ[ℝ] Module.Dual ℝ K :=
    LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun y z => (z : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (y : n → ℝ)))
      (fun y₁ y₂ z => by simp [Matrix.mulVec_add, dotProduct_add])
      (fun a y z => by simp [Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul])
      (fun y z₁ z₂ => by simp [add_dotProduct])
      (fun a y z => by simp [smul_dotProduct])
  let φ : Module.Dual ℝ K :=
    { toFun := fun z => (z : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ r₀
      map_add' := fun z₁ z₂ => by simp [add_dotProduct]
      map_smul' := fun a z => by simp [smul_dotProduct] }
  have hinj : Function.Injective T := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro y hy
    have h0 : quadForm A (y : n → ℝ) = 0 := by
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hy y
      simpa [T, quadForm] using this
    rw [quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hH] at h0
    have hall := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun i _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hpos i).le (sq_nonneg _)).1 h0
    have hyy : (y : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (y : n → ℝ) = 0 := by
      rw [← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => ?_
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 (hall i hi) with h | h
      · exact absurd h (hpos i).ne'
      · exact h
    exact Subtype.ext (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hyy)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective T :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      (Subspace.dual_finrank_eq).symm).1 hinj
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsurj φ
  refine ⟨x₀ + (y : n → ℝ),
    isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero hH (fun i => (hpos i).le) ?_ ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro z hz
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hy ⟨z, hz⟩
    simp only [T, φ, LinearMap.mk₂_apply, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at h
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add, h]
    simp only [r₀, dotProduct_sub]
    ring

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate_of_poly
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := (isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub hA hxs).1 hx
  have h := quadForm_sub_le_of_isAffineMinimizer hA (g := X) (by simpa using hpsd) hxs
    (by simpa only [aeval_X] using hx') hp hp0 hM
  simpa only [aeval_X] using h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    {c x₀ xs x : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    quadForm A (x - xs) ≤ (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hab.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
  · exact quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate_of_poly hA (fun i => ha.le.trans (hspec i).1) hxs hx
      (degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q) (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hlt)
      (fun i => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hlt (hspec i))
  have hpsd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues i := fun i => ha.le.trans (hspec i).1
  have hq0 := quadForm_nonneg_of_eigenvalues_nonneg hA hpsd (x₀ - xs)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | hq
  · 
    have hx0 : x = x₀ := by
      have h := hx.1
      rw [krylovSpace_zero, Submodule.mem_bot] at h
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 h
    subst hx0
    nlinarith
  · 
    have hp : (1 - C (1 / a) * X : ℝ[X]).degree ≤ q := by
      refine (degree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · exact degree_one_le.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le q)
      · exact (degree_C_mul_X_le _).trans (by exact_mod_cast hq)
    have h := quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate_of_poly hA hpsd hxs hx hp (by simp) (M := 0)
      (fun i => by
        have hi : hA.eigenvalues i = a := le_antisymm (hspec i).2 (hspec i).1
        simp [hi, ha.ne'])
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, zero_mul] at h
    exact h.trans (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.eq_of_isCGIterate_of_krylovGrade_le
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := (isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub hA.isHermitian hxs).1 hx
  have hmem : xs - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q := by
    rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le _ _ hq]
    exact sub_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade hA.isUnit hxs x₀
  have h := hx'.le_of_sub_mem hmem
  simp only [sub_self, quadForm_zero_right] at h
  by_contra hne
  have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos (x := x - xs) (sub_ne_zero.2 hne)
  simp only [star_trivial] at hpos
  exact absurd h (not_le.2 hpos)

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isCGIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosDef) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃! x, IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_isCGIterate hA c x₀ q
  refine ⟨x, hx, fun x' hx' => ?_⟩
  set xs := A⁻¹ *ᵥ c with hxsdef
  have hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c := by
    rw [hxsdef, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).1 hA.isUnit), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h1 := (isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub hA.isHermitian hxs).1 hx
  have h2 := (isCGIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer_quadForm_sub hA.isHermitian hxs).1 hx'
  have hmid : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q := by
    have : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x - x₀) + (x' - x₀)) := by
      ext i; simp; ring
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.add_mem _ h1.1 h2.1)
  have hle := h1.le_of_sub_mem hmid
  have heq := h1.apply_eq h2
  have hpar : ∀ u v : n → ℝ, quadForm A ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v)) =
      (quadForm A u + quadForm A v) / 2 - quadForm A ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v)) := by
    intro u v
    simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_add,
      Matrix.mulVec_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, add_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_sub, sub_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hmid' : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - xs = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x - xs) + (x' - xs)) := by
    ext i; simp; ring
  rw [hmid', hpar, ← heq] at hle
  have hd : quadForm A ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x - xs) - (x' - xs))) ≤ 0 := by linarith
  have hdd : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x - xs) - (x' - xs)) = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    simp only [star_trivial] at hpos
    rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial] at hd
    linarith
  have hsub : x - x' = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : n → ℝ => (2 : ℝ) • z) hdd
    simp only [smul_smul, smul_zero] at h
    norm_num at h
    simpa [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using h
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 hsub).symm

name: NLAlib.isAffineMinimizer_iff_isMinOn
statement:
theorem isAffineMinimizer_iff_isMinOn :
    IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ S x ↔
      x ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' x₀ S ∧ IsMinOn E (AffineSubspace.mk' x₀ S) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsAffineMinimizer, AffineSubspace.mem_mk', vsub_eq_sub, isMinOn_iff,
    SetLike.mem_coe]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h z hz => ?_, fun h y hy => h _ (by simpa using hy)⟩
  simpa using h (z - x₀) hz

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem IsAffineMinimizer.le_of_sub_mem (hx : IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ S x) {z : n → K}
    (hz : z - x₀ ∈ S) : E x ≤ E z
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hx.2 (z - x₀) hz

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_self
statement: theorem IsAffineMinimizer.le_self (hx : IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ S x) : E x ≤ E x₀
proof:
:=
  hx.le_of_sub_mem (by simp)

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.apply_eq
statement:
theorem IsAffineMinimizer.apply_eq {x' : n → K} (hx : IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ S x)
    (hx' : IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ S x') : E x = E x'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (hx.le_of_sub_mem hx'.1) (hx'.le_of_sub_mem hx.1)

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_of_le
proof:
:=
  hx'.le_of_sub_mem (h hx.1)

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_add_aeval
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_add]
  abel

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace {A : Matrix n n K}
    {c x₀ x : n → K} {q : ℕ} (hx : x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    ∃ p : K[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
      c - A *ᵥ x = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hxs⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff _ _ _ _).1 hx
  refine ⟨1 - X * s, (degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩).1,
    (degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩).2, ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_mulVec_add_aeval, ← hxs, add_sub_cancel]

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec (A : Matrix n n K) (c x₀ : n → K)
    {q : ℕ} {p : K[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q,
      c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y) = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.1 ⟨hp, hp0⟩
  exact ⟨aeval A s *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀), (mem_krylovSpace_iff _ _ _ _).2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩,
    sub_mulVec_add_aeval A c x₀ s⟩

name: NLAlib.exists_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hy⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff _ _ _ _).1 hx
  refine ⟨1 - X * s, (degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩).1,
    (degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩).2, ?_⟩
  have hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = -(A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs]; abel
  have hx' : x = x₀ + aeval A s *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by rw [← hy]; abel
  rw [hx', mul_comm X s, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hr, Matrix.mulVec_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_add_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_add_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec {A : Matrix n n K} {c xs : n → K}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → K) {q : ℕ} {p : K[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, x₀ + y - xs = aeval A p *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := degree_le_and_eval_zero_eq_one_iff.1 ⟨hp, hp0⟩
  refine ⟨aeval A s *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀), (mem_krylovSpace_iff _ _ _ _).2 ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  have hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = -(A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs]; abel
  rw [mul_comm X s, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, aeval_X, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hr, Matrix.mulVec_neg]
  abel

name: NLAlib.sub_mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_sub_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem sub_mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_sub_mulVec_eq {A : Matrix n n K} (hA : IsUnit A)
    {c x₀ x : n → K} {q : ℕ} :
    x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ↔
      ∃ p : K[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧ c - A *ᵥ x = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hp0, hres⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec A c x₀ hp hp0
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Matrix.mulVec A) := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.2 hA
  have : x = x₀ + y := hinj (sub_right_injective (hres.trans hy'.symm))
  rw [this, add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact hy

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval
statement:
theorem IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval {E : (n → K) → ℝ} {A : Matrix n n K} {c x₀ xs x : n → K}
    {q : ℕ} (hx : IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) x)
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) {p : K[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    E x ≤ E (xs + aeval A p *ᵥ (x₀ - xs))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hpoly⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_add_sub_eq_aeval_mulVec hxs x₀ hp hp0
  rw [← hpoly, add_sub_cancel]
  exact hx.2 y hy

name: NLAlib.IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval_residual
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hres⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec A c x₀ hp hp0
  rw [← hres]
  exact hx.2 y hy

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isAffineMinimizer
proof:
:= by
  have h := hx.le_aeval hxs hp hp0
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  refine quadForm_aeval_aeval_mulVec_le hA (S := Set.range hA.eigenvalues) (fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    ?_ ?_ (x₀ - xs)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hg i
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hM i

name: NLAlib.row_sum_pos_of_nonneg_isUnit
statement:
private theorem row_sum_pos_of_nonneg_isUnit {B : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hB : IsUnit B) (hpos : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ B i j) (i : n) : 0 < ∑ j, B i j
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 ≤ ∑ j, B i j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hpos i j
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hs
  intro hz
  have hrow : ∀ j, B i j = 0 := fun j =>
    (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k _ => hpos i k)).mp hz.symm j (mem_univ j)
  have hid := congrArg (fun C : Matrix n n ℝ => C i i)
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv B ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det B).mp hB))
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, hrow] at hid

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pos_of_nonneg_sum_one
statement:
private theorem dotProduct_pos_of_nonneg_sum_one {q x : n → ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hs : ∑ i, q i = 1) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) : 0 < q ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < q j := by
    by_contra! h
    have hle := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => h j)
    rw [hs] at hle
    norm_num at hle
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hq i) (hx i).le)
    ⟨j, mem_univ j, mul_pos hj (hx j)⟩

name: NLAlib.complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one_of_inverse_nonneg
statement:
theorem complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one_of_inverse_nonneg [Nonempty n]
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j) (hA : IsUnit (M - N))
    (hAinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (M - N)⁻¹ i j) :
    spectralRadius ℂ ((M⁻¹ * N).map Complex.ofReal) < 1
proof:
:= by
  let H := M⁻¹ * N
  have hH : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ H i j := fun i j =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hMinv i k) (hN k j)
  let x : n → ℝ := (M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)
  let d : n → ℝ := M⁻¹ *ᵥ (fun _ => 1)
  have hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i := fun i => by
    simpa [x, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using
      row_sum_pos_of_nonneg_isUnit (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hA) hAinv i
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i := fun i => by
    simpa [d, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using
      row_sum_pos_of_nonneg_isUnit (Matrix.isUnit_nonsing_inv_iff.mpr hM) hMinv i
  have hAx : (M - N) *ᵥ x = fun _ => 1 := by
    dsimp only [x]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hfix : H *ᵥ x + d = x := (splitting_fixedPoint_iff hM _ x).mpr hAx
  obtain ⟨_, q, _, hq, _, hqs, _, hqH⟩ := Matrix.exists_nonnegative_perron_pair hH
  have hqx := dotProduct_pos_of_nonneg_sum_one hq hqs hx
  have hqd := dotProduct_pos_of_nonneg_sum_one hq hqs hd
  have heq := congrArg (fun v => q ⬝ᵥ v) hfix
  rw [dotProduct_add, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, hqH, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at heq
  have hr : (spectralRadius ℂ (H.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < 1 := by nlinarith
  exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top _) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mp hr

name: NLAlib.inverse_nonneg_of_complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem inverse_nonneg_of_complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one [Nonempty n]
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j)
    (hρ : spectralRadius ℂ ((M⁻¹ * N).map Complex.ofReal) < 1) :
    IsUnit (M - N) ∧ ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (M - N)⁻¹ i j
proof:
:= by
  let H := M⁻¹ * N
  have hH : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ H i j := fun i j =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hMinv i k) (hN k j)
  have hZ : (1 - H).IsZMatrix := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hij, if_false, zero_sub]
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr (hH i j)
  have hr : (spectralRadius ℂ (H.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < 1 :=
    (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (matrix_spectralRadius_ne_top _) ENNReal.one_ne_top).mpr hρ
  have hB : (1 - H).IsNonsingularMMatrix :=
    (Matrix.isNonsingularMMatrix_iff_exists_shift_above_spectralRadius hZ).mpr
      ⟨1, H, hH, by simp, hr⟩
  have hfactor : M - N = M * (1 - H) := sub_eq_mul_one_sub_inv_mul hM
  have hunit : IsUnit (M - N) := by rw [hfactor]; exact hM.mul hB.2.1
  have hinv : (M - N)⁻¹ = (1 - H)⁻¹ * M⁻¹ := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    rw [hfactor, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (1 - H),
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hB.2.1),
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hM)]
  refine ⟨hunit, fun i j => ?_⟩
  rw [hinv]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hB.2.2 i k) (hMinv k j)

name: NLAlib.inverse_nonneg_iff_complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem inverse_nonneg_iff_complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one [Nonempty n]
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j) :
    (IsUnit (M - N) ∧ ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (M - N)⁻¹ i j) ↔
      spectralRadius ℂ ((M⁻¹ * N).map Complex.ofReal) < 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one_of_inverse_nonneg hM hMinv hN h.1 h.2,
    inverse_nonneg_of_complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one hM hMinv hN⟩

name: NLAlib.tendsto_splittingIterate_of_inverse_nonneg
statement:
theorem tendsto_splittingIterate_of_inverse_nonneg [Nonempty n]
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j) (hA : IsUnit (M - N))
    (hAinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (M - N)⁻¹ i j) (b x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (splittingIterate M N b x₀) atTop (𝓝 ((M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (splittingConverges_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one hM).mpr
    (complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one_of_inverse_nonneg hM hMinv hN hA hAinv)
  obtain ⟨xs, _, huniq, hlim⟩ := hc b
  have hsol : (M - N) *ᵥ ((M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ b) = b := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [huniq _ hsol]
  exact hlim x₀

name: NLAlib.splittingIterate_zero_nonneg_mono_le_of_inverse_nonneg
statement:
theorem splittingIterate_zero_nonneg_mono_le_of_inverse_nonneg
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j) (hA : IsUnit (M - N))
    (hAinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ (M - N)⁻¹ i j) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i)
    (k : ℕ) (i : n) :
    0 ≤ splittingIterate M N b 0 k i ∧
      splittingIterate M N b 0 k i ≤ splittingIterate M N b 0 (k + 1) i ∧
      splittingIterate M N b 0 (k + 1) i ≤ ((M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ b) i
proof:
:= by
  let H := M⁻¹ * N
  let d := M⁻¹ *ᵥ b
  let xs := (M - N)⁻¹ *ᵥ b
  have hH : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ H i j := fun i j =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j' _ => mul_nonneg (hMinv i j') (hN j' j)
  have hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i := fun i =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hMinv i j) (hb j)
  have hxs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ xs i := fun i =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hAinv i j) (hb j)
  have hmap : ∀ {u v : n → ℝ}, (∀ i, u i ≤ v i) → ∀ i, (H *ᵥ u) i ≤ (H *ᵥ v) i := by
    intro u v huv j
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (huv l) (hH j l)
  have hfix : H *ᵥ xs + d = xs := (splitting_fixedPoint_iff hM b xs).mpr (by
    dsimp only [xs]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hA), Matrix.one_mulVec])
  have hnonneg (j : ℕ) : ∀ l, 0 ≤ splittingIterate M N b 0 j l := by
    induction j with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro l
      rw [splittingIterate_succ]
      exact add_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun t _ => mul_nonneg (hH l t) (ih t)) (hd l)
  have hinc (j : ℕ) : ∀ l,
      splittingIterate M N b 0 j l ≤ splittingIterate M N b 0 (j + 1) l := by
    induction j with
    | zero => intro l; simpa using hnonneg 1 l
    | succ j ih =>
      intro l
      calc
        _ = (H *ᵥ splittingIterate M N b 0 j) l + d l := rfl
        _ ≤ (H *ᵥ splittingIterate M N b 0 (j + 1)) l + d l := by
          linarith [hmap ih l]
        _ = _ := rfl
  have hupper (j : ℕ) : ∀ l, splittingIterate M N b 0 j l ≤ xs l := by
    induction j with
    | zero => intro l; simpa using hxs l
    | succ j ih =>
      intro l
      change (H *ᵥ splittingIterate M N b 0 j) l + d l ≤ xs l
      have he : (H *ᵥ xs) l + d l = xs l := congrFun hfix l
      linarith [hmap ih l]
  exact ⟨hnonneg k i, hinc k i, hupper (k + 1) i⟩

name: NLAlib.splittingConverges_of_isNonsingularMMatrix
statement:
theorem splittingConverges_of_isNonsingularMMatrix [Nonempty n]
    {M N : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : IsUnit M) (hMinv : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ M⁻¹ i j)
    (hN : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ N i j) (hA : (M - N).IsNonsingularMMatrix) :
    SplittingConverges M N
proof:
:=
  (splittingConverges_iff_complex_spectralRadius_lt_one hM).mpr
    (complex_spectralRadius_inv_mul_lt_one_of_inverse_nonneg hM hMinv hN hA.2.1 hA.2.2)

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem cgRecurrence_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    cgRecurrence A c x₀ 0 = cgInit A c x₀
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_succ
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1) = cgStep A (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_r_eq
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_r_eq (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = c - A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).x
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ]
    simp only [cgStep, ih, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    abel

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k ∧
      (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1) ∧
        (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set K := krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨by simp [cgInit], self_mem_krylovSpace_succ _ _ 0,
      self_mem_krylovSpace_succ _ _ 0⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hx, hr, hp⟩ := ih
    have hmono : K (k + 1) ≤ K (k + 2) := krylovSpace_mono _ _ (by omega)
    have hAp : A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p ∈ K (k + 2) := mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ _ _ hp
    have hr' : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r -
        ((cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r /
          ((cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p))) •
          (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p) ∈ K (k + 2) :=
      Submodule.sub_mem _ (hmono hr) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hAp)
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, hr', Submodule.add_mem _ hr' (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hmono hp))⟩
    simp only [cgStep]
    rw [add_sub_right_comm]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (by omega) hx) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hp)

name: NLAlib.cgStep_of_r_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cgStep_of_r_eq_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {s : CGState n} (hs : s.r = 0) :
    cgStep A s = ⟨s.x, 0, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [cgStep, hs]

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_add_of_r_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rw [cgRecurrence_succ, cgStep_of_r_eq_zero A hk]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show k + (m + 1 + 1) = k + (m + 1) + 1 by omega, cgRecurrence_succ, ih,
      cgStep_of_r_eq_zero A rfl]

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_p_eq_zero_of_r_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_p_eq_zero_of_r_eq_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0) : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simpa [cgInit] using hk
  | succ k =>
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ] at hk ⊢
    simp only [cgStep] at hk ⊢
    rw [hk]
    simp

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_r_ne_zero_of_lt_krylovGrade
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_r_ne_zero_of_lt_krylovGrade (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  set r₀ := c - A *ᵥ x₀
  have hx := (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).1
  have hr₀ : A *ᵥ ((cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).x - x₀) = r₀ := by
    have h := cgRecurrence_r_eq A c x₀ k
    rw [h0, eq_comm, sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, ← h]
  have hle : krylovSpace A r₀ (k + 1) ≤ (krylovSpace A r₀ k).map A.mulVecLin := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    induction i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact ⟨_, hx, by simpa using hr₀⟩
    | succ j =>
      refine ⟨(A ^ (j : ℕ)) *ᵥ r₀, pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A r₀ j.isLt, ?_⟩
      simp [pow_succ', Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have h1 := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  have h2 := Submodule.finrank_map_le A.mulVecLin (krylovSpace A r₀ k)
  rw [finrank_krylovSpace] at h1 h2
  omega

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_p_sub_r_mem
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [cgInit]
  | succ k =>
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ]
    simp only [cgStep, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).2.2

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_sup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hy
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hz
  rw [add_dotProduct, smul_dotProduct, hM u hu, hp, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_p_dotProduct_r
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_p_dotProduct_r {k : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r =
      (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r
proof:
:= by
  have h := hr _ (cgRecurrence_p_sub_r_mem A c x₀ k)
  rwa [sub_dotProduct, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_p_eq_zero
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_p_eq_zero {k : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0)
    (hp0 : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p = 0) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := cgRecurrence_p_dotProduct_r hr
  rw [hp0, zero_dotProduct] at h
  exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h.symm

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_dotProduct_mulVec_comm
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_dotProduct_mulVec_comm (hA : A.PosDef) (x y : n → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.isHermitian.star_dotProduct_mulVec_comm y x

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_krylovSpace_succ_eq_sup
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_krylovSpace_succ_eq_sup (hA : A.PosDef) {k : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0)
    (hp : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p) = 0) :
    krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1) =
      krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k ⊔
        Submodule.span ℝ {(cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le (krylovSpace_mono _ _ k.le_succ)
    ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).2
      (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).2.2))
  by_cases hν : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ k
  · rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A _ (hν.trans k.le_succ),
      ← krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le A _ hν]
    exact le_sup_left
  push Not at hν
  rw [krylovSpace_succ]
  refine sup_le le_sup_left ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).2 ?_)
  have hpk := (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).2.2
  rw [krylovSpace_succ] at hpk
  obtain ⟨u, hu, z, hz, hpuz⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hpk
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hz
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · exfalso
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at hpuz
    have hq := hp _ (hpuz ▸ hu)
    have hp0 : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact (hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne).ne' hq
    exact cgRecurrence_r_ne_zero_of_lt_krylovGrade A c x₀ hν
      (cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_p_eq_zero hr hp0)
  · have he : A ^ k *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) =
        a⁻¹ • ((cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p - u) := by
      rw [← hpuz, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
    rw [he]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _))
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left hu))

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_orthogonality_succ
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_orthogonality_succ (hA : A.PosDef) {k : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0)
    (hp : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p) = 0) :
    (∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1),
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r = 0) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1),
      y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsup := cgRecurrence_krylovSpace_succ_eq_sup hA hr hp
  set s := cgRecurrence A c x₀ k with hs
  by_cases hr0 : s.r = 0
  · have h1 : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r = 0 := by
      rw [cgRecurrence_succ, ← hs]
      simp [cgStep, hr0]
    have h2 : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).p = 0 := by
      rw [cgRecurrence_succ, ← hs]
      simp [cgStep, hr0]
    simp [h1, h2]
  have hp0 : s.p ≠ 0 := fun h => hr0 (cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_p_eq_zero hr h)
  set ρ := s.r ⬝ᵥ s.r with hρdef
  set Q := s.p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ s.p) with hQdef
  have hQ : 0 < Q := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hp0
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by
    rw [hρdef, ← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    have hn : WithLp.toLp 2 s.r ≠ 0 := by simpa using hr0
    exact pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hn) 2
  set α := ρ / Q with hαdef
  have hr' : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r = s.r - α • (A *ᵥ s.p) := by
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ, ← hs]
    rfl
  have hp' : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).p =
      (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r +
        (((cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r ⬝ᵥ
          (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r) / ρ) • s.p := by
    rw [cgRecurrence_succ, ← hs]
    rfl
  have hpr : s.p ⬝ᵥ s.r = ρ := cgRecurrence_p_dotProduct_r hr
  have horth : ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (k + 1),
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hsup] at hy
    refine cgRecurrence_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_sup (fun u hu => ?_) ?_ hy
    · rw [hr', dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, hr u hu, hp u hu, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    · rw [hr', dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, hpr]
      change ρ - α * Q = 0
      rw [hαdef, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQ.ne', sub_self]
  refine ⟨horth, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [hsup] at hy
  refine cgRecurrence_dotProduct_eq_zero_of_mem_sup (fun u hu => ?_) ?_ hy
  · rw [hp', Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul,
      hp u hu, smul_zero, add_zero, cgRecurrence_dotProduct_mulVec_comm hA,
      dotProduct_comm]
    exact horth _ (mulVec_mem_krylovSpace_succ A _ hu)
  · set ρ' := (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r ⬝ᵥ
      (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r with hρ'def
    have hrr : s.r ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r = 0 :=
      horth _ (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).2.1
    have hX : α * (s.p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r)) = -ρ' := by
      have he : α • (A *ᵥ s.p) = s.r - (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r := by
        rw [hr', sub_sub_cancel]
      rw [cgRecurrence_dotProduct_mulVec_comm hA, dotProduct_comm, ← smul_eq_mul,
        ← smul_dotProduct, he, sub_dotProduct, hrr, zero_sub]
    have hα : α ≠ 0 := (div_pos hρ hQ).ne'
    rw [hp', Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul]
    change s.p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ (k + 1)).r) + ρ' / ρ * Q = 0
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hα
    rw [mul_add, hX, mul_zero, hαdef]
    field_simp
    ring

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_orthogonality
statement:
private lemma cgRecurrence_orthogonality (hA : A.PosDef) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k,
      y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [krylovSpace_zero]
  | succ k ih => exact cgRecurrence_orthogonality_succ hA ih.1 ih.2

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero (hA : A.PosDef) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ j).r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact (cgRecurrence_orthogonality hA c x₀ j).1 _
      (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ i).2.1)
  · rw [dotProduct_comm]
    exact (cgRecurrence_orthogonality hA c x₀ i).1 _
      (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ j).2.1)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cgRecurrence_p_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cgRecurrence_p_mulVec_eq_zero (hA : A.PosDef) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).p ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ j).p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact (cgRecurrence_orthogonality hA c x₀ j).2 _
      (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ i).2.2)
  · rw [cgRecurrence_dotProduct_mulVec_comm hA]
    exact (cgRecurrence_orthogonality hA c x₀ i).2 _
      (krylovSpace_mono _ _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
        (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ j).2.2)

name: NLAlib.span_cgRecurrence_r
statement:
theorem span_cgRecurrence_r (hA : A.PosDef) (k : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin k => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r) =
      krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k
proof:
:= by
  set ν := krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
  have hle : ∀ m, Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin m => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r) ≤
      krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) m := fun m => by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact krylovSpace_mono _ _ (show (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ m from i.isLt)
      (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ i).2.1
  have heq : ∀ m ≤ ν, Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin m => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r) =
      krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) m := fun m hm => by
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i : Fin m => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r) := by
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
      intro g hg j
      have h := congrArg (fun v => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ j).r ⬝ᵥ v) hg
      simp only [dotProduct_sum, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_zero] at h
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun i _ hij => by
        rw [dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero hA (fun h => hij (Fin.ext h.symm)), mul_zero])
        (by simp)] at h
      have hne : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ j).r ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ j).r ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
        cgRecurrence_r_ne_zero_of_lt_krylovGrade A c x₀ (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hm)
          (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h0)
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right hne
    refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (hle m) ?_
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hli, Fintype.card_fin, finrank_krylovSpace, min_eq_left hm]
  rcases le_total k ν with h | h
  · exact heq k h
  · refine le_antisymm (hle k) ?_
    rw [krylovSpace_eq_of_krylovGrade_le _ _ h, ← heq ν le_rfl]
    exact Submodule.span_mono (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨Fin.castLE h i, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.span_singleton_sup_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
private lemma span_singleton_sup_eq_of_sub_mem {S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)} {x y : n → ℝ}
    (h : x - y ∈ S) : (ℝ ∙ x) ⊔ S = (ℝ ∙ y) ⊔ S
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {u v : n → ℝ}, u - v ∈ S → (ℝ ∙ u) ⊔ S ≤ (ℝ ∙ v) ⊔ S := fun {u v} huv =>
    sup_le ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).2 (by
      rw [show u = v + (u - v) by abel]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v))
        (Submodule.mem_sup_right huv))) le_sup_right
  exact le_antisymm (key h) (key (by rw [← neg_sub]; exact S.neg_mem h))

name: NLAlib.span_range_fin_succ
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ m, Set.range (fun i : Fin m => g i) = g '' Set.Iio m := fun m => by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, j.isLt, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hr, hr, show Set.Iio (k + 1) = insert k (Set.Iio k) by ext; simp,
    Set.image_insert_eq, Submodule.span_insert]

name: NLAlib.span_cgRecurrence_p_eq_span_r
statement:
theorem span_cgRecurrence_p_eq_span_r (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin k => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).p) =
      Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin k => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [span_range_fin_succ (fun i => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).p),
      span_range_fin_succ (fun i => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).r), ih]
    refine span_singleton_sup_eq_of_sub_mem ?_
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [cgInit]
    | succ k =>
      rw [cgRecurrence_succ]
      simp only [cgStep, add_sub_cancel_left]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      rw [← ih, span_range_fin_succ (fun i => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).p)]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: NLAlib.span_cgRecurrence_p
statement:
theorem span_cgRecurrence_p (hA : A.PosDef) (k : ℕ) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin k => (cgRecurrence A c x₀ i).p) =
      krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [span_cgRecurrence_p_eq_span_r, span_cgRecurrence_r hA]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_mem (hA : A.PosDef) {k : ℕ} {z : n → ℝ}
    (hz : z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) k) : z ⬝ᵥ (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← span_cgRecurrence_r hA k] at hz
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero hA (Nat.ne_of_lt i.isLt)
  | zero => exact zero_dotProduct _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [add_dotProduct, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul a y _ hy => rw [smul_dotProduct, hy, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.isCGIterate_cgRecurrence
statement:
theorem isCGIterate_cgRecurrence (hA : A.PosDef) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    IsCGIterate A c x₀ k (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).x
proof:
:= by
  refine isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero hA.isHermitian
    (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues_pos i).le) (cgRecurrence_mem_krylovSpace A c x₀ k).1
    fun z hz => ?_
  rw [← cgRecurrence_r_eq]
  exact dotProduct_cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_mem hA hz

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_x_eq_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_x_eq_of_krylovGrade_le (hA : A.PosDef) {xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ k) : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).x = xs
proof:
:=
  eq_of_isCGIterate_of_krylovGrade_le hA hxs hk (isCGIterate_cgRecurrence hA c x₀ k)

name: NLAlib.cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem cgRecurrence_r_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le (hA : A.PosDef) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ k) : (cgRecurrence A c x₀ k).r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsUnit A := hA.isUnit
  have hxs : A *ᵥ (A⁻¹ *ᵥ c) = c := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).1 hU),
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [cgRecurrence_r_eq, cgRecurrence_x_eq_of_krylovGrade_le hA hxs hk, hxs, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveBasisShift_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i.val+1 < n
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    change ∑ j : Fin n, (if j.val=i.val+1 then 1 else 0)*v j = _
    rw [sum_eq_single (⟨i.val+1,hi⟩ : Fin n)]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      have hj' : j.val ≠ i.val+1 := by intro he; exact hj (Fin.ext he)
      simp only [if_neg hj',zero_mul]
    · simp
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    change ∑ j : Fin n, (if j.val=i.val+1 then 1 else 0)*v j = 0
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    have hj : j.val ≠ i.val+1 := by intro he; exact hi (he ▸ j.isLt)
    simp only [if_neg hj,zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveBasis_mulVec
statement:
theorem gmresCurveBasis_mulVec {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b v : Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    (gmresCurveBasis hn b *ᵥ v) i =
      b i*v ⟨0,hn⟩ + (if hi : i.val+1 < n then v ⟨i.val+1,hi⟩ else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmresCurveBasis,Matrix.add_mulVec]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply,Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec,Pi.smul_apply,op_smul_eq_mul,
    single_dotProduct,one_mul,gmresCurveBasisShift_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_gmresCurveBasis
statement:
theorem isUnit_gmresCurveBasis {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hb : b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ ≠ 0) : IsUnit (gmresCurveBasis hn b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
  intro v w hvw
  have hlast := congrFun hvw (⟨n-1,by omega⟩ : Fin n)
  simp only [gmresCurveBasis_mulVec,dif_neg (show ¬n-1+1<n by omega),add_zero] at hlast
  have hzero : v ⟨0,hn⟩ = w ⟨0,hn⟩ := mul_left_cancel₀ hb hlast
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j.val = 0
  · have he : j = ⟨0,hn⟩ := Fin.ext hj
    simpa only [he] using hzero
  · let i : Fin n := ⟨j.val-1,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩
    have hi : i.val+1 < n := by dsimp only [i]; have := j.isLt; omega
    have he : (⟨i.val+1,hi⟩ : Fin n) = j := Fin.ext (by dsimp only [i]; omega)
    have hrow := congrFun hvw i
    rw [gmresCurveBasis_mulVec,gmresCurveBasis_mulVec,dif_pos hi,dif_pos hi,hzero,he] at hrow
    exact add_left_cancel hrow

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_first
statement:
theorem gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_first {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ) :
    gmresCurveBasis hn b *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨0,hn⟩ (1 : ℂ) = b
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [gmresCurveBasis_mulVec]
  simp only [Pi.single_eq_same,mul_one]
  split_ifs with hi
  · have he : (⟨i.val+1,hi⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨0,hn⟩ := by
      intro hh
      have hval : i.val+1 = 0 := congrArg (fun t : Fin n => t.val) hh
      omega
    simp [he]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_succ
statement:
theorem gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_succ {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (j : Fin (n-1)) :
    gmresCurveBasis hn b *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨j.val+1,by have
proof:
:= j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) := by
  funext i
  rw [gmresCurveBasis_mulVec]
  have hj0 : (⟨0,hn⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨j.val+1,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ := by
    intro he
    have hval : 0 = j.val+1 := congrArg (fun t : Fin n => t.val) he
    omega
  simp only [Pi.single_apply,if_neg hj0,mul_zero,zero_add]
  by_cases hi : i.val+1 < n
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    have he : (⟨i.val+1,hi⟩ : Fin n) = ⟨j.val+1,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ ↔
        i = ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ := by
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    simp only [he]
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    have he : i ≠ (⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin n) := by
      intro heq
      have hval : i.val = j.val := congrArg (fun t : Fin n => t.val) heq
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    simp only [if_neg he]

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x ↔ x - x₀ ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q ∧
      ∀ z ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q, (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set K := krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxK, hmin⟩
    refine ⟨hxK, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    set α := (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x)
    set β := (A *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z)
    have hβ : 0 ≤ β := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    set t := α / (β + 1)
    have ht : t * (β + 1) = α := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by linarith)
    have h := hmin (x - x₀ + t • z) (K.add_mem hxK (K.smul_mem t hz))
    have hr : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (x - x₀ + t • z)) = (c - A *ᵥ x) - t • (A *ᵥ z) := by
      rw [show x₀ + (x - x₀ + t • z) = x + t • z by abel, Matrix.mulVec_add,
        Matrix.mulVec_smul]
      abel
    have hexp : ((c - A *ᵥ x) - t • (A *ᵥ z)) ⬝ᵥ ((c - A *ᵥ x) - t • (A *ᵥ z)) =
        (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) - 2 * t * α + t ^ 2 * β := by
      simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
        α, β, dotProduct_comm (c - A *ᵥ x) (A *ᵥ z)]
      ring
    simp only [star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, hr, hexp] at h
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (β + 1) ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * β - 2 * t * α) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have h2 : (β + 1) ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * β - 2 * t * α) = -(α ^ 2 * (β + 2)) := by
      rw [← ht]; ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : α ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg α]
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.1 (le_antisymm h3 (sq_nonneg α))
  · rintro ⟨hxK, horth⟩
    refine ⟨hxK, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hd : y - (x - x₀) ∈ K := K.sub_mem hy hxK
    have hr : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y) = (c - A *ᵥ x) - A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_add]; abel
    have h0 := horth _ hd
    have hAd : 0 ≤ (A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀))) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀))) :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    show (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤ (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y)) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y))
    rw [hr]
    generalize c - A *ᵥ x = r at h0 ⊢
    generalize A *ᵥ (y - (x - x₀)) = v at h0 hAd ⊢
    simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_comm r v, h0]
    linarith

name: NLAlib.exists_isGMRESIterate
statement:
theorem exists_isGMRESIterate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x, IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  set r₀ := c - A *ᵥ x₀
  set K := krylovSpace A r₀ q
  set W := K.map A.mulVecLin
  set U := orthonormalBasisMatrix W
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix W
  have hW : U *ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ r₀) ∈ W := by
    have h : U *ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ r₀) ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin := ⟨Uᵀ *ᵥ r₀, rfl⟩
    rwa [range_orthonormalBasisMatrix] at h
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hAs⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hW
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] at hAs
  refine ⟨x₀ + s, isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero.2
    ⟨by simpa using hs, fun z hz => ?_⟩⟩
  have hres : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + s) = r₀ - U *ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ r₀) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, hAs, ← sub_sub]
  have hperp : Uᵀ *ᵥ (r₀ - U *ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ r₀)) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, show Uᵀ * U = 1 from hU, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      sub_self]
  have hAz : A *ᵥ z ∈ LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin := by
    rw [range_orthonormalBasisMatrix]; exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hz
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hAz
  rw [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] at hv
  rw [hres, ← hv, dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hperp,
    zero_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq {x' : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x') : c - A *ᵥ x = c - A *ᵥ x'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, o1⟩ := isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero.1 hx
  obtain ⟨h2, o2⟩ := isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero.1 hx'
  have hd : x' - x ∈ krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q := by
    simpa using Submodule.sub_mem _ h2 h1
  have e : (c - A *ᵥ x) - (c - A *ᵥ x') = A *ᵥ (x' - x) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]; abel
  have h0 : (A *ᵥ (x' - x)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x' - x)) = 0 := by
    calc (A *ᵥ (x' - x)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x' - x)) =
        (A *ᵥ (x' - x)) ⬝ᵥ ((c - A *ᵥ x) - (c - A *ᵥ x')) := by rw [e]
      _ = 0 := by rw [dotProduct_sub, o1 _ hd, o2 _ hd, sub_self]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, e, dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h0]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.eq_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.eq_of_isUnit {x' : n → ℝ} (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x') : x = x'
proof:
:=
  Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.2 hA (sub_right_injective (hx.sub_mulVec_eq hx'))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧ c - A *ᵥ x = aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:=
  exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval_mulVec_of_sub_mem_krylovSpace hx.1

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.le_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.le_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]}
    (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:=
  IsAffineMinimizer.le_aeval_residual (F := fun r => r ⬝ᵥ r) hx hp hp0

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_dotProduct_aeval
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_dotProduct_aeval (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    IsLeast {v | ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval 0 = 1 ∧
        v = (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))}
      ((c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hr⟩ := hx.exists_sub_mulVec_eq_aeval
    exact ⟨p, hp, hp0, by rw [hr]⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, hp0, rfl⟩
    exact hx.le_aeval hp hp0

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.le_of_le
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.le_of_le {q' : ℕ} {x' : n → ℝ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x)
    (hx' : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q' x') (h : q ≤ q') :
    (c - A *ᵥ x') ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x') ≤ (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x)
proof:
:=
  IsAffineMinimizer.le_of_le hx hx' (krylovSpace_mono A _ h)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.sub_mulVec_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le (hA : IsUnit A)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hq : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ q) :
    c - A *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs⟩ := Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit.2 hA c
  have hmem := krylovSpace_mono A _ hq (sub_mem_krylovSpace_krylovGrade hA hxs x₀)
  have h := hx.2 _ hmem
  simp only [add_sub_cancel, hxs, sub_self, dotProduct_zero] at h
  exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1
    (le_antisymm h (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ M) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤ M ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:= by
  refine (hx.le_aeval hp hp0).trans ?_
  refine dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_le hA (S := Set.range hA.eigenvalues)
    (fun i => ⟨i, rfl⟩) ?_ _
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact hM i

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc (hA : A.IsHermitian) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (2 * ((√b - √a) / (√b + √a)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:=
  hx.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian hA (degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q)
    (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)
    fun i => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab (hspec i)

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_iff_isAffineMinimizer (hA : A.IsHermitian) {xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x ↔
      IsAffineMinimizer (fun y => quadForm (aeval A (X ^ 2 : ℝ[X])) (y - xs)) x₀
        (krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) x
proof:
:= by
  have hAs : Aᵀ = A := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA
  have hE : (fun y => (c - A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ y)) =
      fun y => quadForm (aeval A (X ^ 2 : ℝ[X])) (y - xs) := by
    funext y
    have hr : c - A *ᵥ y = -(A *ᵥ (y - xs)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs]; abel
    rw [hr, neg_dotProduct, dotProduct_neg, neg_neg, quadForm_def, star_trivial, map_pow, aeval_X,
      sq, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hAs,
      dotProduct_comm]
  simp only [IsGMRESIterate, star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, hE]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_dotProduct_self_le_specNorm_sq
statement:
private lemma mulVec_dotProduct_self_le_specNorm_sq (M : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    (M *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v) ≤ specNorm M ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq M v
  simpa [dotProduct, sq] using h

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.dotProduct_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul {V W : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {d : n → ℝ} (hVW : V * W = 1) (hAd : A = V * Matrix.diagonal d * W)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    {M : ℝ} (hM : ∀ i, |p.eval (d i)| ≤ M) :
    (c - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x) ≤
      (specNorm V * specNorm W * M) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
proof:
:= by
  have hWV : W * V = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hVW
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℕ, A ^ j = V * Matrix.diagonal d ^ j * W := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp [hVW]
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ih, hAd, pow_succ]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc W V, hWV, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hpA : aeval A p = V * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => p.eval (d i)) * W := by
    rw [aeval_eq_sum_range, ← aeval_diagonal d p, aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.mul_sum,
      Matrix.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hpow, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  set r₀ := c - A *ᵥ x₀
  set D := Matrix.diagonal fun i => p.eval (d i)
  have hD : (D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀)) ⬝ᵥ (D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀)) ≤ M ^ 2 * ((W *ᵥ r₀) ⬝ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀)) := by
    simp only [D, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    have h := hM i
    have hsq : p.eval (d i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [neg_abs_le (p.eval (d i))]) ((le_abs_self _).trans h)
    nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg ((W *ᵥ r₀) i)]
  refine (hx.le_aeval hp hp0).trans ?_
  rw [hpA, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  calc (V *ᵥ (D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀))) ⬝ᵥ (V *ᵥ (D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀)))
      ≤ specNorm V ^ 2 * ((D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀)) ⬝ᵥ (D *ᵥ (W *ᵥ r₀))) :=
        mulVec_dotProduct_self_le_specNorm_sq V _
    _ ≤ specNorm V ^ 2 * (M ^ 2 * (specNorm W ^ 2 * (r₀ ⬝ᵥ r₀))) := by
        gcongr
        exact hD.trans (by gcongr; exact mulVec_dotProduct_self_le_specNorm_sq W r₀)
    _ = (specNorm V * specNorm W * M) ^ 2 * (r₀ ⬝ᵥ r₀) := by ring

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_coordinate_eq_head
statement:
theorem sum_smul_coordinate_eq_head {n k : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℂ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (∑ j : Fin k, b ⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hk⟩ •
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hk⟩ (1 : ℂ)) = coordinateHead b k
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,coordinateHead]
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    rw [sum_eq_single (⟨i.val,hi⟩ : Fin k)]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hji
      have hn : (⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hk⟩ : Fin n) ≠ i := by
        intro he
        apply hji
        apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg (fun t : Fin n => t.val) he
      simp [Ne.symm hn]
    · simp
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    apply sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    have hn : (⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hk⟩ : Fin n) ≠ i := by
      intro he
      exact hi (by simpa only [← congrArg Fin.val he] using j.isLt)
    simp [Ne.symm hn]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveCorrection_mem
statement:
theorem gmresCurveCorrection_mem {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : Fin n → ℂ) (hk : k ≤ n) : gmresCurveCorrection A b k hk ∈ krylovSpace A b k
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro j _
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨j,rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.mulVec_gmresCurveCorrection
statement:
theorem mulVec_gmresCurveCorrection {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : Fin n → ℂ) (hk : k < n)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin (n-1), A^(j.val+1) *ᵥ b =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ)) :
    A *ᵥ gmresCurveCorrection A b k hk.le = coordinateHead b k
proof:
:= by
  unfold gmresCurveCorrection
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_sum]
  have he (j : Fin k) : A *ᵥ (A^j.val *ᵥ b) =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hk.le⟩ (1 : ℂ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,← pow_succ']
    exact hs ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩
  simp_rw [Matrix.mulVec_smul,he]
  exact sum_smul_coordinate_eq_head b hk.le

name: NLAlib.mulVec_eq_zero_of_coordinate_shift
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_zero_of_coordinate_shift {n k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : Fin n → ℂ) (hk : k < n)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin (n-1), A^(j.val+1) *ᵥ b =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ))
    {z : Fin n → ℂ} (hz : z ∈ krylovSpace A b k) (i : Fin n) (hi : k ≤ i.val) :
    (A *ᵥ z) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := (range_krylovMatrix A b k).symm ▸ hz
  change krylovMatrix A b k *ᵥ v = z at hv
  rw [← hv,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  change ∑ j : Fin k, (A*krylovMatrix A b k) i j*v j = 0
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [mul_krylovMatrix_apply]
  have he := hs ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩
  have hn : i ≠ (⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin n) := by
    intro heq
    have hval : i.val = j.val := congrArg (fun t : Fin n => t.val) heq
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  simp only [he,Pi.single_apply,if_neg hn,zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_gmresCurveCorrection
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_gmresCurveCorrection {n k : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : Fin n → ℂ) (hk : k < n)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin (n-1), A^(j.val+1) *ᵥ b =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ)) :
    IsGMRESIterate A b 0 k (gmresCurveCorrection A b k hk.le)
proof:
:= by
  apply isGMRESIterate_iff_forall_star_dotProduct_eq_zero.mpr
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero,sub_zero]
  refine ⟨gmresCurveCorrection_mem A b hk.le,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rw [mulVec_gmresCurveCorrection A b hk hs]
  apply sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i.val < k
  · simp [coordinateHead,hi]
  · have he := mulVec_eq_zero_of_coordinate_shift A b hk hs hz i (Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)
    simp only [Pi.star_apply,he,star_zero,zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_coordinate_tail
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_coordinate_tail {n k : ℕ}
    {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} {b x : Fin n → ℂ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate A b 0 k x)
    (hk : k < n)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin (n-1), A^(j.val+1) *ᵥ b =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ)) :
    b-A *ᵥ x = b-coordinateHead b k
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx.residual_eq (isGMRESIterate_gmresCurveCorrection A b hk hs),
    mulVec_gmresCurveCorrection A b hk hs]

name: NLAlib.preconditionedRichardsonIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem preconditionedRichardsonIterate_zero (ω : ℝ) (A P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) : preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ 0 = x₀
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.preconditionedRichardsonIterate_succ
statement:
theorem preconditionedRichardsonIterate_succ (ω : ℝ) (A P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ (k + 1) =
      preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k +
        ω • (P⁻¹ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [preconditionedRichardsonIterate, affineStationaryIterate_succ]
  simp only [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub, smul_sub]
  module

name: NLAlib.preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
statement:
theorem preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec (ω : ℝ) (A P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    {c xs : n → ℝ} (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k - xs =
      ((1 - ω • (P⁻¹ * A)) ^ k) *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  apply affineStationaryIterate_sub_eq_pow_mulVec
  rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hxs]
  abel

name: NLAlib.preconditionedRichardsonIterate_eq_mulVec_richardsonIterate
statement:
theorem preconditionedRichardsonIterate_eq_mulVec_richardsonIterate
    {A P W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hW : Wᵀ * P * W = 1) (ω : ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k =
      W *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω (Wᵀ * A * W) (Wᵀ *ᵥ c) (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) k
proof:
:= by
  have hU := isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).mp hU
  have hWW (v : n → ℝ) : W *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [preconditionedRichardsonIterate_zero, richardsonIterate_zero, hWW]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [preconditionedRichardsonIterate_succ, richardsonIterate_succ,
      Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, ← ih]
    congr 1
    rw [inv_eq_mul_transpose_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    rw [ih]

name: NLAlib.preconditionedRichardson_energy_bounds
statement:
private theorem preconditionedRichardson_energy_bounds {A P : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hP : P.PosDef) {a b ω : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (hlow : a • P ≤ A) (hup : A ≤ b • P) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (quadForm A (preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)) ∧
    (quadForm P (preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm P (x₀ - xs))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, -, hW⟩ := exists_isSymm_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hP
  have hU := isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).mp hU
  have hWW (v : n → ℝ) : W *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hAh : A.IsHermitian := by
    have hh : (b • P - A).IsHermitian := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hup).isHermitian
    have hbp : (b • P).IsHermitian := hP.isHermitian.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all b)
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using hbp.sub hh
  let B := Wᵀ * A * W
  have hBh : B.IsHermitian := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul W hAh
  have hcong (s : ℝ) : Wᵀ * (A - s • P) * W = B - s • 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hW]
  have hcong' (s : ℝ) : Wᵀ * (s • P - A) * W = s • 1 - B := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hW]
  have hlowB : (B - a • 1).PosSemidef := by
    have hh := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hlow).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same W
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hcong] using hh
  have hupB : (b • 1 - B).PosSemidef := by
    have hh := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hup).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same W
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, hcong'] using hh
  have hspec (i : n) : hBh.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
    let u : n → ℝ := hBh.eigenvectorBasis i
    have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
      simpa [u] using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hBh i i
    have hval := eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec hBh i
    have h1 := hlowB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    have h2 := hupB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hu] at h1 h2
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hxs' : B *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ xs) = Wᵀ *ᵥ c := by
    dsimp [B]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hWW, hxs]
  have hAq := quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le hBh hω hspec (g := X)
    (fun x hx => by simpa only [eval_X] using ha.le.trans hx.1) hxs' (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) k
  have hPq := quadForm_richardsonIterate_sub_le hBh hω hspec (g := 1)
    (by intro x hx; simp) hxs' (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) k
  rw [aeval_X] at hAq
  rw [map_one] at hPq
  have hq (C : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) :
      quadForm (Wᵀ * C * W) v = quadForm C (W *ᵥ v) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul C W v
  have hqA (v : n → ℝ) : quadForm B v = quadForm A (W *ᵥ v) := hq A v
  have hqP (v : n → ℝ) : quadForm (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) v = quadForm P (W *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [← hW]
    exact hq P v
  have hiter := preconditionedRichardsonIterate_eq_mulVec_richardsonIterate
    (A := A) hW ω c x₀ k
  change preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k =
    W *ᵥ richardsonIterate ω B (Wᵀ *ᵥ c) (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) k at hiter
  constructor
  · simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hqA, hWW, ← hiter] using hAq
  · simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hqP, hWW, ← hiter] using hPq

name: NLAlib.quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le
proof:
:=
  (preconditionedRichardson_energy_bounds hP ha hω hlow hup hxs x₀ k).1

name: NLAlib.quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_preconditioner
statement:
theorem quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_preconditioner
    {A P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : P.PosDef) {a b ω : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (hlow : a • P ≤ A) (hup : A ≤ b • P) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm P (preconditionedRichardsonIterate ω A P c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (max |1 - ω * a| |1 - ω * b| ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm P (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:=
  (preconditionedRichardson_energy_bounds hP ha hω hlow hup hxs x₀ k).2

name: NLAlib.max_abs_one_sub_optimal_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem max_abs_one_sub_optimal_mul_eq {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    max |1 - 2 / (a + b) * a| |1 - 2 / (a + b) * b| = (b - a) / (b + a)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : a + b ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hne' : b + a ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have h1 : 1 - 2 / (a + b) * a = (b - a) / (b + a) := by field_simp; ring
  have h2 : 1 - 2 / (a + b) * b = -((b - a) / (b + a)) := by field_simp; ring
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (b - a) / (b + a) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [h1, h2, abs_neg, max_self, abs_of_nonneg hnn]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal
statement:
theorem quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_of_optimal
    {A P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : P.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
