    (hlow : a • P ≤ A) (hup : A ≤ b • P) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm A (preconditionedRichardsonIterate (2 / (a + b)) A P c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (((b - a) / (b + a)) ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm A (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le hP ha
    (ω := 2 / (a + b)) (by
      have hpos : 0 < a + b := by linarith
      exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hpos.le) hlow hup hxs x₀ k
  rwa [max_abs_one_sub_optimal_mul_eq ha hab] at h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_preconditioner_of_optimal
statement:
theorem quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_preconditioner_of_optimal
    {A P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : P.PosDef) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hlow : a • P ≤ A) (hup : A ≤ b • P) {c xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : A *ᵥ xs = c) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    quadForm P (preconditionedRichardsonIterate (2 / (a + b)) A P c x₀ k - xs) ≤
      (((b - a) / (b + a)) ^ k) ^ 2 * quadForm P (x₀ - xs)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_preconditionedRichardsonIterate_sub_le_preconditioner hP ha
    (ω := 2 / (a + b)) (by
      have hpos : 0 < a + b := by linarith
      exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) hpos.le) hlow hup hxs x₀ k
  rwa [max_abs_one_sub_optimal_mul_eq ha hab] at h

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (c x₀ : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) (Q : Matrix n k 𝕜)
    (hQ : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q
      (x₀ + Q *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A * Q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ← hQ]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · intro y hy
    rw [← hQ] at hy
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hy
    have hres : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Q *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A * Q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))) =
        (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - (A * Q) *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse (A * Q) *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      abel
    have hyres : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + y) = (c - A *ᵥ x₀) - (A * Q) *ᵥ v := by
      rw [← hv, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      abel
    have h := norm_sub_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse_le (A * Q) (c - A *ᵥ x₀) v
    have hs := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
    simpa only [hres, hyres, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct] using hs

name: NLAlib.isGMRESIterate_of_reduced_leastSquares
statement:
theorem isGMRESIterate_of_reduced_leastSquares (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (c x₀ : n → 𝕜) (q : ℕ) (Q : Matrix n k 𝕜) (U : Matrix n l 𝕜) (H : Matrix l k 𝕜)
    (hQ : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hAQ : A * Q = U * H)
    (r : l → 𝕜) (hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = U *ᵥ r) :
    IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + Q *ᵥ (moorePenroseInverse H *ᵥ r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := isGMRESIterate_add_mulVec_moorePenroseInverse A c x₀ q Q hQ
  rw [hAQ, moorePenroseInverse_mul_left_of_hasOrthonormalCols U H hU, hr,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec r Uᴴ U, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.norm_frame_mulVec
statement:
private theorem norm_frame_mulVec (U : Matrix n l 𝕜) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (v : l → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ v)‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU]

name: NLAlib.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_of_reduced
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_of_reduced (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c x₀ : n → 𝕜)
    (Q : Matrix n k 𝕜) (U : Matrix n l 𝕜) (H : Matrix l k 𝕜)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hAQ : A * Q = U * H)
    (r : l → 𝕜) (hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = U *ᵥ r) (v : k → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Q *ᵥ v))‖ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (r - H *ᵥ v)‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Q *ᵥ v) = U *ᵥ (r - H *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, ← sub_sub, hr, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAQ,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_sub]
  rw [he, norm_frame_mulVec U hU]

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_norm_reduced
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.isLeast_norm_reduced {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {c x₀ x : n → 𝕜} {q : ℕ}
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (Q : Matrix n k 𝕜) (U : Matrix n l 𝕜) (H : Matrix l k 𝕜)
    (hQ : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hAQ : A * Q = U * H)
    (r : l → 𝕜) (hr : c - A *ᵥ x₀ = U *ᵥ r) :
    IsLeast (Set.range fun v : k → 𝕜 => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (r - H *ᵥ v)‖)
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hxQ : x - x₀ ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin := hQ.symm ▸ hx.1
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hxQ
    have he : x = x₀ + Q *ᵥ v := by rw [← Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, hv]; abel
    exact ⟨v, by rw [he, norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_of_reduced A c x₀ Q U H hU hAQ r hr]⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [← norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_of_reduced A c x₀ Q U H hU hAQ r hr]
    apply hx.norm_le_of_sub_mem
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ← hQ]
    exact ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_mulVec_sub_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_mulVec_sub_of_mul_eq_mul
    (hAZ : A * Z = V * H) (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) (y : p → 𝕜) :
    b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y) = V *ᵥ (g - H *ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, ← sub_sub, hr, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAZ,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_sub]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)
    (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) (y : p → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y)‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_mulVec_sub_of_mul_eq_mul hAZ hr]
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hV,
    norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.forall_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le_iff
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.forall_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le_iff
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)
    (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) (y : p → 𝕜) :
    (∀ y' : p → 𝕜, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y)‖ ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (g - H *ᵥ y')‖) ↔
    ∀ z ∈ LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + z))‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy z hz
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hz
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
    rw [hV.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul hAZ hr,
      hV.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul hAZ hr]
    exact hy y'
  · intro hy y'
    have h := hy (Z *ᵥ y') ⟨y', rfl⟩
    simpa only [hV.norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_of_mul_eq_mul hAZ hr] using h

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.exists_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.exists_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hAZ : A * Z = V * H)
    (hr : b - A *ᵥ x₀ = V *ᵥ g) :
    ∃ y : p → 𝕜, ∀ z ∈ LinearMap.range Z.mulVecLin,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + Z *ᵥ y))‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ (x₀ + z))‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 p →ₗ[𝕜] EuclideanSpace 𝕜 q := H.toEuclideanLin
  let S : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 q) := LinearMap.range L
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := S.starProjection_apply_mem (WithLp.toLp 2 g)
  refine ⟨u.ofLp, (hV.forall_norm_sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_le_iff hAZ hr _).mp ?_⟩
  intro y
  change ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 g : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 q) - L u‖ ≤
    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 g : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 q) - L (WithLp.toLp 2 y)‖
  rw [hu, Submodule.starProjection_minimal]
  refine ciInf_le (f := fun w : S => ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 g : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 q) - w‖)
    ?_ ⟨L (WithLp.toLp 2 y), ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
  exact ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩

name: NLAlib.krylovSpace_mul_mulVec_eq_map
statement:
theorem krylovSpace_mul_mulVec_eq_map (W B : Matrix n n ℝ) (v : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    krylovSpace (W * B) (W *ᵥ v) q = (krylovSpace (B * W) v q).map W.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [krylovSpace, krylovSpace, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  congr 2
  funext i
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    mul_pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.isAffineMinimizer_map_iff
statement:
theorem isAffineMinimizer_map_iff {W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hW : IsUnit W) {E : (n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    {x₀ x : n → ℝ} {S : Submodule ℝ (n → ℝ)} :
    IsAffineMinimizer E x₀ (S.map W.mulVecLin) x ↔
      IsAffineMinimizer (fun y => E (W *ᵥ y)) (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) S (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).1 hW
  have hWW : ∀ v, W *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hWW' : ∀ v, W⁻¹ *ᵥ (W *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul W hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hmem : ∀ v, v ∈ S.map W.mulVecLin ↔ W⁻¹ *ᵥ v ∈ S := fun v => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      simpa [hWW'] using hs
    · intro hv
      exact ⟨_, hv, by simp [hWW]⟩
  unfold IsAffineMinimizer
  rw [hmem, Matrix.mulVec_sub]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h y hy => ?_, fun h y hy => ?_⟩
  · have := h (W *ᵥ y) ((hmem _).2 (by rwa [hWW']))
    simpa [hWW, Matrix.mulVec_add] using this
  · have := h (W⁻¹ *ᵥ y) ((hmem _).1 hy)
    simpa [hWW, Matrix.mulVec_add] using this

name: NLAlib.cgObjective_mulVec
statement:
theorem cgObjective_mulVec (A W : Matrix n n ℝ) (c y : n → ℝ) :
    cgObjective A c (W *ᵥ y) = cgObjective (Wᵀ * A * W) (Wᵀ *ᵥ c) y
proof:
:= by
  have hq := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul A W y
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hq
  rw [cgObjective, cgObjective, hq, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one {P W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hW : Wᵀ * P * W = 1) :
    IsUnit W
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).2 (Matrix.isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hW)

name: NLAlib.inv_eq_mul_transpose_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem inv_eq_mul_transpose_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one {P W : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hW : Wᵀ * P * W = 1) : P⁻¹ = W * Wᵀ
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv ?_
  have h : W * (Wᵀ * P) = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.1 hW
  rwa [← Matrix.mul_assoc] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_isSymm_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_isSymm_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one {P : Matrix n n ℝ} (hP : P.PosDef) :
    ∃ W : Matrix n n ℝ, W.IsSymm ∧ Wᵀ * P * W = 1
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix n n ℝ := (hP.1.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℝ)
  set D : Matrix n n ℝ := Matrix.diagonal fun i => 1 / √(hP.1.eigenvalues i)
  have hUU : Uᵀ * U = 1 := transpose_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_self hP.1
  have hUU' : U * Uᵀ = 1 := eigenvectorUnitary_mul_transpose_self hP.1
  have hP' := eq_eigenvectorUnitary_mul_diagonal_mul_transpose hP.1
  have hD : Dᵀ = D := Matrix.diagonal_transpose _
  have hsym : (U * D * Uᵀ)ᵀ = U * D * Uᵀ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hD,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨U * D * Uᵀ, hsym, ?_⟩
  have hdiag : D * Matrix.diagonal hP.1.eigenvalues * D = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    ext i
    have hpos := hP.eigenvalues_pos i
    have hs : √(hP.1.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 = hP.1.eigenvalues i := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
    have hs0 : 0 < √(hP.1.eigenvalues i) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
    field_simp
    linarith [hs]
  rw [hsym, hP']
  calc U * D * Uᵀ * (U * Matrix.diagonal hP.1.eigenvalues * Uᵀ) * (U * D * Uᵀ)
      = U * (D * (Uᵀ * U) * Matrix.diagonal hP.1.eigenvalues * (Uᵀ * U) * D) * Uᵀ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by
        rw [hUU, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_one, hdiag, Matrix.mul_one, hUU']

name: NLAlib.isPCGIterate_iff_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem isPCGIterate_iff_isCGIterate {A P W : Matrix n n ℝ} (hW : Wᵀ * P * W = 1)
    {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} :
    IsPCGIterate A P c x₀ q x ↔
      IsCGIterate (Wᵀ * A * W) (Wᵀ *ᵥ c) (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) q (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).1 hU
  have hK : krylovSpace (P⁻¹ * A) (P⁻¹ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) q =
      (krylovSpace (Wᵀ * A * W) (Wᵀ *ᵥ c - (Wᵀ * A * W) *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀)) q).map W.mulVecLin := by
    have hr : Wᵀ *ᵥ c - (Wᵀ * A * W) *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ x₀) = Wᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hd, Matrix.mul_one,
        ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_sub]
    rw [hr, inv_eq_mul_transpose_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, krylovSpace_mul_mulVec_eq_map]
  rw [IsPCGIterate, hK, isAffineMinimizer_map_iff hU, IsCGIterate]
  simp only [cgObjective_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.quadForm_sub_le_of_isPCGIterate
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, -, hW⟩ := exists_isSymm_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hP
  have hU := isUnit_of_transpose_mul_mul_eq_one hW
  have hd := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det W).1 hU
  have hWW : ∀ v, W *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hd, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  
  have hAh : A.IsHermitian := by
    have h1 : (b • P - A).IsHermitian := (Matrix.le_iff.1 hup).1
    have h2 : (b • P).IsHermitian := hP.1.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all b)
    simpa using h2.sub h1
  set B := Wᵀ * A * W with hBdef
  have hWt : Wᴴ = Wᵀ := Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial W
  have hBh : B.IsHermitian := by
    have := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul W hAh
    rwa [hWt] at this
  
  have hcong : ∀ s : ℝ, Wᵀ * (A - s • P) * W = B - s • 1 := fun s => by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hW]
  have hcong' : ∀ s : ℝ, Wᵀ * (s • P - A) * W = s • 1 - B := fun s => by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, hW]
  have hlowB : (B - a • 1).PosSemidef := by
    have := (Matrix.le_iff.1 hlow).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same W
    rwa [hWt, hcong] at this
  have hupB : (b • 1 - B).PosSemidef := by
    have := (Matrix.le_iff.1 hup).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same W
    rwa [hWt, hcong'] at this
  have hspec : ∀ i, hBh.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b := fun i => by
    set u : n → ℝ := (hBh.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ)
    have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by simpa using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hBh i i
    have hval := eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec hBh i
    have h1 := hlowB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    have h2 := hupB.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hu] at h1 h2
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hxs' : B *ᵥ (W⁻¹ *ᵥ xs) = Wᵀ *ᵥ c := by
    rw [hBdef, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hWW, hxs]
  have hcg := quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate hBh ha hab hspec hxs'
    ((isPCGIterate_iff_isCGIterate hW).1 hx)
  have hq : ∀ v, quadForm (Wᵀ * A * W) v = quadForm A (W *ᵥ v) := fun v => by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul A W v
  simpa only [← Matrix.mulVec_sub, hq, hWW, hBdef] using hcg

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (b : m → ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) :
    (b - A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ y) = 2 * cgObjective (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) y + b ⬝ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  have hq := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self A y
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, star_trivial] at hq
  rw [cgObjective, hq, Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]
  simp only [dotProduct_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm (A *ᵥ y) b]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isCGLSIterate_iff_isCGIterate
statement:
theorem isCGLSIterate_iff_isCGIterate {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {x₀ x : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} :
    IsCGLSIterate A b x₀ q x ↔ IsCGIterate (Aᵀ * A) (Aᵀ *ᵥ b) x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Aᵀ *ᵥ b - (Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ x₀ = Aᵀ *ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  rw [IsCGLSIterate, IsCGIterate, hr, IsAffineMinimizer, IsAffineMinimizer]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => forall₂_congr fun y _ => ?_
  rw [dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq, dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq_add
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq_add {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {b : m → ℝ} {xs : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) (x : n → ℝ) :
    (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) =
      (b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs) + (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs))
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : (b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_sub, hxs, sub_self,
      zero_dotProduct]
  have hsplit : b - A *ᵥ x = (b - A *ᵥ xs) - A *ᵥ (x - xs) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]; abel
  rw [hsplit]
  generalize b - A *ᵥ xs = u at hcross ⊢
  generalize A *ᵥ (x - xs) = w at hcross ⊢
  have h : (u - w) ⬝ᵥ (u - w) = u ⬝ᵥ u - 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ w) + w ⬝ᵥ w := by
    simp only [dotProduct_sub, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm w u]; ring
  rw [h, hcross]; ring

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_sub_le_of_isCGLSIterate
statement:
theorem dotProduct_mulVec_sub_le_of_isCGLSIterate {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {σlo σhi : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < σlo) (hlohi : σlo ≤ σhi)
    (hlow : ∀ v, σlo ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (hup : ∀ v, (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ σhi ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)) {b : m → ℝ} {x₀ xs x : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGLSIterate A b x₀ q x) :
    (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x - xs)) ≤
      (2 * ((σhi - σlo) / (σhi + σlo)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)))
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (Aᵀ * A).IsHermitian := by
    simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self A
  have hq : ∀ v : n → ℝ, quadForm (Aᵀ * A) v = (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) := fun v => by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, star_trivial] using
      quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self A v
  have hspec : ∀ i, hG.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (σlo ^ 2) (σhi ^ 2) := fun i => by
    set u : n → ℝ := (hG.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ)
    have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by simpa using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hG i i
    have hval : hG.eigenvalues i = (A *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ u) := by
      rw [eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec hG i, ← hq]; rfl
    have h1 := hlow u
    have h2 := hup u
    rw [hu, mul_one] at h1 h2
    exact ⟨hval ▸ h1, hval ▸ h2⟩
  have hxs' : (Aᵀ * A) *ᵥ xs = Aᵀ *ᵥ b := by rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hxs]
  have h := quadForm_sub_le_of_isCGIterate hG (by positivity)
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ hlo.le hlohi 2) hspec hxs' (isCGLSIterate_iff_isCGIterate.1 hx)
  rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith), Real.sqrt_sq hlo.le, hq, hq] at h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_sub_mulVec_le_of_isCGLSIterate
statement:
theorem dotProduct_sub_mulVec_le_of_isCGLSIterate {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {σlo σhi : ℝ}
    (hlo : 0 < σlo) (hlohi : σlo ≤ σhi)
    (hlow : ∀ v, σlo ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v) ≤ (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v))
    (hup : ∀ v, (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ σhi ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v)) {b : m → ℝ} {x₀ xs x : n → ℝ}
    (hxs : Aᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ xs) = Aᵀ *ᵥ b) {q : ℕ} (hx : IsCGLSIterate A b x₀ q x) :
    (b - A *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ x) ≤ (b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs) +
      (2 * ((σhi - σlo) / (σhi + σlo)) ^ q) ^ 2 * ((A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (x₀ - xs)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_sub_mulVec_self_eq_add hxs x]
  linarith [dotProduct_mulVec_sub_le_of_isCGLSIterate hlo hlohi hlow hup hxs hx]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff
statement:
theorem isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (y : Fin q → ℝ) :
    IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ y) ↔
      D.H *ᵥ y = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (D.forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff y).1 h.2
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, (D.forall_dotProduct_sub_mulVec_eq_zero_iff y).2 h⟩
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ← D.range_Q]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isFOMIterate
proof:
:= by
  have hm := hx.1
  rw [← D.range_Q] at hm
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hm
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  change D.Q *ᵥ y = x - x₀ at hy
  rw [hy, add_sub_cancel]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isFOMIterate_fomIterate
statement:
theorem isFOMIterate_fomIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (hH : IsUnit D.H) : IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q (D.fomIterate x₀)
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff _).2
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hH), Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    (∃! x, IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q x) ↔ IsUnit D.H
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Function.Injective D.Q.mulVec :=
    Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.mpr D.hasOrthonormalCols.linearIndependent_col
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, huniq⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := D.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isFOMIterate hx
    have hy := (D.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff y).1 hx
    apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mp
    intro v w hvw
    have hshift : D.H *ᵥ (y + (v - w)) = D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, hvw, sub_self, add_zero]
      exact hy
    have heq := huniq (x₀ + D.Q *ᵥ (y + (v - w)))
      ((D.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff _).2 hshift)
    have hc : y + (v - w) = y := hQ (add_left_cancel heq)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (add_left_cancel (hc.trans (add_zero y).symm))
  · intro hH
    refine ⟨D.fomIterate x₀, D.isFOMIterate_fomIterate hH, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := D.exists_eq_add_mulVec_of_isFOMIterate hx
    have hy := (D.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff y).1 hx
    have hy₀ := (D.isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff _).1 (D.isFOMIterate_fomIterate hH)
    have heq : y = D.H⁻¹ *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) :=
      Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hH (hy.trans hy₀.symm)
    simp only [fomIterate, heq]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_det_ne_zero
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) :
    (∃! x, IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q x) ↔ D.H.det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.eq_fomIterate_of_isFOMIterate
statement:
theorem eq_fomIterate_of_isFOMIterate (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q)
    (hH : IsUnit D.H) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q x) :
    x = D.fomIterate x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, huniq⟩ := D.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit.mpr hH
  exact (huniq x hx).trans (huniq _ (D.isFOMIterate_fomIterate hH)).symm

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.fomIterate_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem fomIterate_eq_of_pos (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) (x₀ : n → ℝ) :
    D.fomIterate x₀ = x₀ + ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ •
      (D.Q *ᵥ (D.H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fomIterate, D.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single hq hD,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_neg_smul
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_neg_smul
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    {y : Fin q → ℝ}
    (hy : (D.restrict q.le_succ).H *ᵥ y =
      (D.restrict q.le_succ).Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) :
    c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q *ᵥ y) =
      -(D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ * y ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩) •
        D.Q.col (Fin.last q)
proof:
:= by
  let E := D.restrict q.le_succ
  let j : Fin q := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have hfit : E.Q *ᵥ (E.H *ᵥ y) = c - A *ᵥ x₀ := by
    rw [hy, E.mulVec_transpose_Q_mulVec_self hq]
  have hrel : A * E.Q = E.Q * E.H +
      D.H (Fin.last q) j.castSucc • vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (Pi.single j 1) :=
    D.mul_restrict_Q_eq_add_smul hq
  have hout : vecMulVec (D.Q.col (Fin.last q)) (Pi.single j 1) *ᵥ y =
      y j • D.Q.col (Fin.last q) := by
    ext i
    change (∑ k, D.Q.col (Fin.last q) i * (Pi.single j 1 : Fin q → ℝ) k * y k) =
      y j * D.Q.col (Fin.last q) i
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    change D.Q.col (Fin.last q) i * (Pi.single j 1 ⬝ᵥ y) = _
    rw [single_one_dotProduct, mul_comm]
  change c - A *ᵥ (x₀ + E.Q *ᵥ y) =
    -(D.H (Fin.last q) j.castSucc * y j) • D.Q.col (Fin.last q)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hrel, Matrix.add_mulVec,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hfit, Matrix.smul_mulVec, hout]
  simp only [sub_add_eq_sub_sub, sub_self, zero_sub, smul_smul, neg_smul]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_neg_smul_of_pos
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_neg_smul_of_pos
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hH : IsUnit (D.restrict q.le_succ).H) :
    c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀ =
      -(D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        ((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖) •
        D.Q.col (Fin.last q)
proof:
:= by
  have hy := ((D.restrict q.le_succ).isFOMIterate_add_mulVec_iff _).1
    ((D.restrict q.le_succ).isFOMIterate_fomIterate hH)
  have hr := D.sub_mulVec_add_mulVec_eq_neg_smul hq hy
  simpa only [fomIterate,
    (D.restrict q.le_succ).transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_sqrt_smul_single hq hD,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hr

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_of_pos
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_of_pos
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < (D.restrict q.le_succ).Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hs : 0 ≤ D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩)
    (hH : IsUnit (D.restrict q.le_succ).H) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀)‖ =
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        |((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩| * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (D.Q.col (Fin.last q))‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self, D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col,
      if_pos rfl, Real.sqrt_one]
  rw [D.sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_neg_smul_of_pos hq hD hH,
    WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hunit, mul_one,
    abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_arnoldiDecomp
statement:
theorem norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_arnoldiDecomp
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c x₀ : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hgrade : q + 1 ≤ krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀))
    (hH : IsUnit ((arnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1) hgrade).restrict
      q.le_succ).H) :
    let D
proof:
:= arnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1) hgrade
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ (D.restrict q.le_succ).fomIterate x₀)‖ =
      D.H (Fin.last q) ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ *
        |((D.restrict q.le_succ).H⁻¹ *ᵥ Pi.single (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) 1)
          ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩| * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖ := by
  let D := arnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) (q + 1) hgrade
  apply D.norm_sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_of_pos hq ?_ ?_ hH
  · change 0 < arnoldiBasis A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) 0 ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
    exact arnoldiBasis_zero_dotProduct_pos A (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos q) hgrade)
  · have hp := arnoldiDecomp_H_subdiag_pos A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) hgrade
      (j := q - 1) (by omega)
    have heq : q - 1 + 1 = q := by omega
    simpa only [D, heq, Fin.last] using hp.le

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
statement:
theorem sub_mulVec_fomIterate_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hgrade : krylovGrade A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ≤ q) (hH : IsUnit D.H) :
    c - A *ᵥ D.fomIterate x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hy : D.H *ᵥ (D.H⁻¹ *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀))) =
      D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hH), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hfit : A *ᵥ (D.Q *ᵥ (D.H⁻¹ *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)))) =
      c - A *ᵥ x₀ := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, D.mul_Q_eq_of_krylovGrade_le hgrade,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hy, D.mulVec_transpose_Q_mulVec_self hq]
  rw [fomIterate, Matrix.mulVec_add, hfit]
  abel

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_of_posDef
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isFOMIterate_of_posDef
    (D : ArnoldiDecomp A (c - A *ᵥ x₀) q) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    ∃! x, IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:= by
  apply D.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit.mpr
  have hQ : Function.Injective D.Q.mulVec :=
    Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.mpr D.hasOrthonormalCols.linearIndependent_col
  have hH : D.H.PosDef := by
    simpa only [H_def, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      using hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hQ
  exact hH.isUnit

name: NLAlib.IsFOMIterate.isCGIterate
statement:
theorem IsFOMIterate.isCGIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {c x₀ x : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (hx : IsFOMIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A.PosDef) : IsCGIterate A c x₀ q x
proof:
:=
  isCGIterate_of_forall_dotProduct_eq_zero hA.isHermitian
    (fun i => (hA.eigenvalues_pos i).le) hx.1 hx.2

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.isCGIterate_fomIterate
proof:
:= by
  have hH := D.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_iff_isUnit.mp
    (D.existsUnique_isFOMIterate_of_posDef hA)
  exact (D.isFOMIterate_fomIterate hH).isCGIterate hA

name: NLAlib.residual_norm_le_of_specNorm_aeval_le
statement:
private theorem residual_norm_le_of_specNorm_aeval_le
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q)
    (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) {M : ℝ} (hbound : specNorm (aeval A p) ≤ M) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (specNorm_nonneg _).trans hbound
  have hv : 0 ≤ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  have hprobe : (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) ≤
      specNorm (aeval A p) ^ 2 * ((c - A *ᵥ x₀) ⬝ᵥ (c - A *ᵥ x₀)) := by
    simpa only [dotProduct, sq] using sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (aeval A p) (c - A *ᵥ x₀)
  have hs := ((hx.le_aeval hp hp0).trans hprobe).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hbound 2) hv)
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hs
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (mul_nonneg hM0 (norm_nonneg _)) hnorm

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_complex_diagonalization
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_complex_diagonalization
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) {V : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : n → ℂ}
    (hV : IsUnit V)
    (hA : A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) = V * Matrix.diagonal d * V⁻¹)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (d i)‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (specNorm V * specNorm V⁻¹ * M) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply residual_norm_le_of_specNorm_aeval_le hx hp hp0
  rw [← specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (aeval A p), map_ofReal_aeval]
  exact specNorm_aeval_le_of_eq_mul_diagonal_mul
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hV)) hA p hM

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_normal
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_normal
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A * Aᵀ = Aᵀ * A)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)),
      ‖p.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) z‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty n with hn | hn
  · simp only [Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x) 0, Subsingleton.elim (c - A *ᵥ x₀) 0,
      WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero, le_refl]
  · have ht : (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))ᴴ = Aᵀ.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    have hAc : A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) * (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))ᴴ =
        (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))ᴴ * A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) := by
      rw [ht]
      change (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).mapMatrix A * (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).mapMatrix Aᵀ =
        (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).mapMatrix Aᵀ * (algebraMap ℝ ℂ).mapMatrix A
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hA]
    obtain ⟨U, d, hd⟩ := exists_unitary_diagonalization_of_normal hAc
    have hs : spectrum ℂ (A.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)) = Set.range d := by
      rw [hd]
      simpa only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Unitary.coe_star, spectrum_diagonal]
        using Unitary.spectrum_star_right_conjugate (R := ℂ) (a := Matrix.diagonal d) (U := U)
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := hn
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM (d i) (hs.symm ▸ ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    apply residual_norm_le_of_specNorm_aeval_le hx hp hp0
    rw [← specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ) (aeval A p), map_ofReal_aeval]
    exact specNorm_aeval_le_of_normal hAc p hM0 hM

name: NLAlib.natDegree_gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial
statement:
theorem natDegree_gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial {n : ℕ} (ev : Fin n → ℂ) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.charpoly_gmresCurveCompanion
statement:
theorem charpoly_gmresCurveCompanion {n : ℕ} (ev : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (gmresCurveCompanion ev).charpoly = ∏ i : Fin n, (X-C (ev i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmresCurveCompanion,Matrix.charpoly_reindex,
    charpoly_companionMatrix (p := gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial ev)
      (show (gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial ev).Monic from Lagrange.nodal_monic)]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveCompanion_apply
statement:
private theorem gmresCurveCompanion_apply {n : ℕ} (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (i j : Fin n) :
    gmresCurveCompanion ev i j =
      if j.val+1=n then -(gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial ev).coeff i.val
      else if i.val=j.val+1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gmresCurveCompanion,Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    companionMatrix,finCongr_symm,finCongr_apply_coe,natDegree_gmresCurveSpectrumPolynomial]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveCompanion_mulVec_single
statement:
theorem gmresCurveCompanion_mulVec_single {n : ℕ} (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin (n-1)) :
    gmresCurveCompanion ev *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have
proof:
:= j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val+1,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) := by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
  funext i
  change gmresCurveCompanion ev i ⟨j.val,by have := j.isLt; omega⟩ = _
  have hnot : j.val+1 ≠ n := by have := j.isLt; omega
  rw [gmresCurveCompanion_apply,if_neg hnot]
  simp only [Pi.single_apply,Fin.ext_iff]

name: NLAlib.charpoly_gmresCurveMatrix
statement:
theorem charpoly_gmresCurveMatrix {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hb : b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ ≠ 0) (ev : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (gmresCurveMatrix hn b ev).charpoly = ∏ i : Fin n, (X-C (ev i))
proof:
:= by
  have hW := isUnit_gmresCurveBasis hn b hb
  rw [gmresCurveMatrix,Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm,← mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hW),one_mul,
    charpoly_gmresCurveCompanion]

name: NLAlib.pow_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem pow_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hb : b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ ≠ 0) (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) :
    (gmresCurveMatrix hn b ev)^k *ᵥ b =
      gmresCurveBasis hn b *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨k,hk⟩ (1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hW := isUnit_gmresCurveBasis hn b hb
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero,Matrix.one_mulVec]
    exact (gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_first hn b).symm
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ',← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,ih (by omega),gmresCurveMatrix]
    simp only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    have hinv : (gmresCurveBasis hn b)⁻¹ *ᵥ
        (gmresCurveBasis hn b *ᵥ Pi.single ⟨k,by omega⟩ (1 : ℂ)) =
          Pi.single ⟨k,by omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hW),Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [hinv]
    have hs := gmresCurveCompanion_mulVec_single ev (⟨k,by omega⟩ : Fin (n-1))
    rw [hs]

name: NLAlib.pow_succ_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem pow_succ_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (b : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hb : b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ ≠ 0) (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (j : Fin (n-1)) :
    (gmresCurveMatrix hn b ev)^(j.val+1) *ᵥ b =
      Pi.single ⟨j.val,by have
proof:
:= j.isLt; omega⟩ (1 : ℂ) := by
  rw [pow_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec hn b hb ev _ (by have := j.isLt; omega)]
  exact gmresCurveBasis_mulVec_succ hn b j

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1)
    {M : ℝ} (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hM : ∀ i, |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ M) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤ M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hx.dotProduct_le_sq_mul_of_isHermitian hA hp hp0 hM
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (M * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hs
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ two_ne_zero (mul_nonneg hM0 (norm_nonneg _)) hnorm

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_Icc
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ q x) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a) / (Real.sqrt b + Real.sqrt a)) ^ q) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  exact hx.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian hA (degree_chebyshevResidual_le a b q)
    (eval_chebyshevResidual_zero ha hab)
    ((abs_nonneg _).trans (abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab
      ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩))
    (fun i => abs_eval_chebyshevResidual_le_two_mul_pow q ha hab (hspec i))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_two_intervals
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_two_intervals
    {a b c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hab : a < b) (hb : b < 0) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d)
    (hlen : d - c₁ = b - a) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a b ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((Real.sqrt |a * d| - Real.sqrt |b * c₁|) /
        (Real.sqrt |a * d| + Real.sqrt |b * c₁|)) ^ k) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_degree_le_abs_eval_le_on_two_intervals hab hb hc hcd hlen k
  exact hx.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_isHermitian hA hp hp0
    ((abs_nonneg _).trans (hbound a (Or.inl ⟨le_rfl, hab.le⟩)))
    (fun i => hbound _ (hspec i))

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals
    {c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-d) (-c₁) ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * ((d - c₁) / (d + c₁)) ^ k) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := hx.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_two_intervals hA
    (neg_lt_neg hcd) (neg_neg_of_pos hc) hc hcd (by ring) k hspec
  simpa only [neg_mul, abs_neg, ← sq, abs_sq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos (hc.trans hcd)] using h

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals_ratio
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals_ratio
    {c₁ d : ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hc : 0 < c₁) (hcd : c₁ < d) (k : ℕ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-d) (-c₁) ∪ Set.Icc c₁ d)
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate A c x₀ (2 * k) x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x)‖ ≤
      (2 * (((d / c₁) - 1) / ((d / c₁) + 1)) ^ k) *
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c - A *ᵥ x₀)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ((d / c₁) - 1) / ((d / c₁) + 1) = (d - c₁) / (d + c₁) := by
    rw [div_sub_one hc.ne', div_add_one hc.ne', div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hc.ne']
  rw [hr]
  exact hx.norm_sub_mulVec_le_of_eigenvalues_mem_symmetric_intervals hA hc hcd k hspec

name: NLAlib.roots_charpoly_schurSymmetricPreconditioned
statement:
theorem roots_charpoly_schurSymmetricPreconditioned [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    let C
proof:
:= cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) Shat * B * cfc (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) A
    let mu := (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self C).eigenvalues
    (schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B Shat).charpoly.roots =
      (Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m) • ({1} : Multiset 𝕜) +
        Finset.univ.val.bind (fun i : m =>
          {(saddleEigenvaluePlus (mu i) : 𝕜)} + {(saddleEigenvalueMinus (mu i) : 𝕜)}) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [schurSymmetricPreconditioned, symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq hA hS]
  exact roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one _ (hB ▸ B.rank_le_card_width)

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_schurSymmetricPreconditioned
statement:
theorem isHermitian_schurSymmetricPreconditioned [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) : (schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B Shat).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [schurSymmetricPreconditioned, symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq hA hS, kktMatrix]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.fromBlocks (by simp) Matrix.isHermitian_zero

name: NLAlib.count_one_roots_schurSymmetricPreconditioned
statement:
theorem count_one_roots_schurSymmetricPreconditioned [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) :
    (schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B Shat).charpoly.roots.count 1 =
      Fintype.card n - Fintype.card m
proof:
:= by
  rw [schurSymmetricPreconditioned, symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq hA hS]
  exact count_one_roots_charpoly_kktMatrix_one (posDef_saddle_coupling_gram hA hS hB)
    (hB ▸ B.rank_le_card_width)

name: NLAlib.schurSymmetricPreconditioned_eigenvalue_intervals
statement:
theorem schurSymmetricPreconditioned_eigenvalue_intervals [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {Shat : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) (hS : Shat.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : a • Shat ≤ saddleSchurComplement A B)
    (hb : saddleSchurComplement A B ≤ b • Shat) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : (lam : 𝕜) ∈ spectrum 𝕜 (schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B Shat)) :
    (lam = 1 ∧ Fintype.card m < Fintype.card n) ∨
      lam ∈ Set.Icc (saddleEigenvaluePlus a) (saddleEigenvaluePlus b) ∨
      lam ∈ Set.Icc (saddleEigenvalueMinus b) (saddleEigenvalueMinus a)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := (Polynomial.mem_roots (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).ne_zero).mpr
    (Matrix.mem_spectrum_iff_isRoot_charpoly.mp hlam)
  rw [roots_charpoly_schurSymmetricPreconditioned hA hS hB] at hr
  simp only [Multiset.mem_add, Multiset.mem_nsmul, Multiset.mem_singleton,
    Multiset.mem_bind, Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hr
  rcases hr with ⟨hne, he⟩ | ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by exact_mod_cast he, by omega⟩
  · have he := congrArg RCLike.re hi
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re] at he
    rw [he]
    have h := saddle_coupling_eigenvalues_mem_Icc hA hS B ha hb i
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨monotone_saddleEigenvaluePlus h.1, monotone_saddleEigenvaluePlus h.2⟩)
  · have he := congrArg RCLike.re hi
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_re] at he
    rw [he]
    have h := saddle_coupling_eigenvalues_mem_Icc hA hS B ha hb i
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨antitone_saddleEigenvalueMinus h.2, antitone_saddleEigenvalueMinus h.1⟩)

name: NLAlib.IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_zero_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsGMRESIterate.residual_eq_zero_of_aeval_eq_zero {M : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {c x₀ x : n → 𝕜} {q : ℕ} (hx : IsGMRESIterate M c x₀ q x)
    {p : 𝕜[X]} (hp : p.degree ≤ q) (hp0 : p.eval 0 = 1) (hM : aeval M p = 0) :
    c - M *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hx.norm_le_aeval hp hp0
  rw [hM, Matrix.zero_mulVec, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero] at h
  exact WithLp.toLp_injective 2 (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h (norm_nonneg _)))

name: NLAlib.gmres_triangular_schur_terminates
statement:
theorem gmres_triangular_schur_terminates {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef)
    {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m)
    {c x₀ x : (n ⊕ m) → 𝕜}
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate ((Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B))⁻¹ *
      kktMatrix A B) c x₀ 2 x) :
    c - ((Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 B (-saddleSchurComplement A B))⁻¹ * kktMatrix A B) *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hx.residual_eq_zero_of_aeval_eq_zero (p := (X - 1) ^ 2)
  · compute_degree; norm_num
  · norm_num
  · simpa only [map_pow, map_sub, aeval_X, map_one] using
      triangular_saddle_preconditioning_sub_one_sq hA hB

name: NLAlib.minres_symmetric_schur_terminates
statement:
theorem minres_symmetric_schur_terminates [Nonempty n] [Nonempty m]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.PosDef) {B : Matrix m n 𝕜} (hB : B.rank = Fintype.card m)
    {c x₀ x : (n ⊕ m) → 𝕜}
    (hx : IsGMRESIterate (schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B (saddleSchurComplement A B))
      c x₀ 3 x) :
    c - schurSymmetricPreconditioned A B (saddleSchurComplement A B) *ᵥ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hx.residual_eq_zero_of_aeval_eq_zero (p := (X - 1) * (X ^ 2 - X - 1))
  · compute_degree; norm_num
  · norm_num
  · simp only [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, map_one]
    rw [schurSymmetricPreconditioned,
      symmetric_saddle_preconditioning_eq hA (posDef_saddleSchurComplement hA hB)]
    exact kktMatrix_one_annihilator (saddle_coupling_gram_eq_one hA hB)

name: NLAlib.isUnit_of_charpoly_eq_product_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  apply (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mpr
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  rw [Matrix.det_eq_sign_charpoly_coeff,hc,coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero,eval_prod]
  apply mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero))
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  simpa only [eval_sub,eval_X,eval_C,zero_sub] using neg_ne_zero.mpr (hev i)

name: NLAlib.exists_matrix_gmres_any_convergence_curve
statement:
theorem exists_matrix_gmres_any_convergence_curve {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < f i) (hmono : Antitone f)
    (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (hev : ∀ i, ev i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : Fin n → ℂ),
      IsUnit A ∧ A.charpoly = ∏ i : Fin n, (X-C (ev i)) ∧
      ∀ (k : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℂ), IsGMRESIterate A b 0 k.val x →
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b-A *ᵥ x)‖ = f k
proof:
:= by
  let g := gmresCurveExtension f
  have hgn : g n = 0 := by simp [g,gmresCurveExtension]
  have hgp (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : 0 ≤ g j := by
    simpa only [g,gmresCurveExtension,dif_pos hj] using (hpos ⟨j,hj⟩).le
  have hgm (j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) : g (j+1) ≤ g j := by
    by_cases hnext : j+1 < n
    · simpa only [g,gmresCurveExtension,dif_pos hj,dif_pos hnext] using
        hmono (show (⟨j,hj⟩ : Fin n) ≤ ⟨j+1,hnext⟩ by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ j)
    · simp only [g,gmresCurveExtension,dif_pos hj,dif_neg hnext]
      exact (hpos ⟨j,hj⟩).le
  let b := gmresCurveVector g n
  have hb : b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show b ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ = (g (n-1) : ℂ) from
      gmresCurveVector_last hn g (hgp _ (by omega)) hgn]
    apply Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
    simpa only [g,gmresCurveExtension,dif_pos (show n-1<n by omega)] using
      (hpos (⟨n-1,by omega⟩ : Fin n)).ne'
  let A := gmresCurveMatrix hn b ev
  have hchar : A.charpoly = ∏ i : Fin n, (X-C (ev i)) :=
    charpoly_gmresCurveMatrix hn b hb ev
  refine ⟨A,b,isUnit_of_charpoly_eq_product_nonzero A ev hev hchar,hchar,?_⟩
  intro k x hx
  have hs := pow_succ_gmresCurveMatrix_mulVec hn b hb ev
  rw [hx.residual_eq_coordinate_tail k.isLt hs]
  have hnorm := norm_gmresCurveVector_tail g k.isLt hgp hgm hgn
  simpa only [b,g,gmresCurveExtension,dif_pos k.isLt] using hnorm

name: NLAlib.exists_matrix_gmresIterate_any_convergence_curve
statement:
theorem exists_matrix_gmresIterate_any_convergence_curve {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (f : Fin n → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < f i) (hmono : Antitone f)
    (ev : Fin n → ℂ) (hev : ∀ i, ev i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : Fin n → ℂ),
      IsUnit A ∧ A.charpoly = ∏ i : Fin n, (X-C (ev i)) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin n, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b-A *ᵥ gmresIterate A b 0 k.val)‖ = f k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A,b,hA,hchar,hcurve⟩ := exists_matrix_gmres_any_convergence_curve hn f hpos hmono ev hev
  exact ⟨A,b,hA,hchar,fun k => hcurve k _ (isGMRESIterate_gmresIterate A b 0 k.val)⟩

name: NLAlib.sum_curve_tail_differences
statement:
private theorem sum_curve_tail_differences (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (∑ i ∈ range n, if i < k then (0 : ℝ) else (f i^2-f (i+1)^2)) = f k^2-f n^2
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    have he : k = 0 := by omega
    subst k
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
    · rw [sum_range_succ,ih k hkn,if_neg (Nat.not_lt.mpr hkn)]
      ring
    · have he : k = n+1 := by omega
      subst k
      rw [sub_self]
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      exact if_pos (mem_range.mp hi)

name: NLAlib.norm_gmresCurveVector_tail
statement:
theorem norm_gmresCurveVector_tail {n k : ℕ} (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hk : k < n)
    (hpos : ∀ j < n, 0 ≤ f j) (hmono : ∀ j < n, f (j+1) ≤ f j) (hfn : f n = 0) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (gmresCurveVector f n-coordinateHead (gmresCurveVector f n) k)‖ = f k
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (i : Fin n) :
      ‖(gmresCurveVector f n-coordinateHead (gmresCurveVector f n) k) i‖^2 =
        if i.val < k then 0 else f i.val^2-f (i.val+1)^2 := by
    by_cases hi : i.val < k
    · simp [coordinateHead,hi]
    · have hnext : 0 ≤ f (i.val+1) := by
        by_cases hn : i.val+1 < n
        · exact hpos _ hn
        · have he : i.val+1 = n := by have := i.isLt; omega
          rw [he,hfn]
      have hdiff : 0 ≤ f i.val^2-f (i.val+1)^2 := by
        nlinarith [hpos _ i.isLt,hmono _ i.isLt]
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply,coordinateHead,if_neg hi,sub_zero,gmresCurveVector]
      simpa only [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,sq_abs] using Real.sq_sqrt hdiff
  have hsq : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (gmresCurveVector f n-coordinateHead (gmresCurveVector f n) k)‖^2 = f k^2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    change (∑ i : Fin n, ‖(gmresCurveVector f n-coordinateHead (gmresCurveVector f n) k) i‖^2) = _
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => if i < k then (0 : ℝ) else f i^2-f (i+1)^2),
      sum_curve_tail_differences f n k hk.le,hfn,zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),sub_zero]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (gmresCurveVector f n-coordinateHead (gmresCurveVector f n) k)),
    hpos k hk]

name: NLAlib.gmresCurveVector_last
statement:
theorem gmresCurveVector_last {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hpos : 0 ≤ f (n-1)) (hfn : f n = 0) :
    gmresCurveVector f n ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ = (f (n-1) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gmresCurveVector,show n-1+1=n by omega,hfn,zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),sub_zero,
    Real.sqrt_sq hpos]

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ)) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        4 * M / ρ ^ (2 * q - 1) / (ρ - 1) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
    hac hρ hFd hM hmatch (2 * q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < 2 * q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 < 2 * q by omega))
  have h := abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA hQ v hK hdeg hspec hfp
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {a c ρ M : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hρ : 1 < ρ)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    (hFd : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (openBernsteinEllipse ρ))
    (hM : ∀ z ∈ openBernsteinEllipse ρ, ‖F z‖ ≤ M)
    (hmatch : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, F t = (f (((c - a) * t + c + a) / 2) : ℂ)) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (cfc f A *ᵥ v - krylovFunApprox A f v Q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (4 * M / ρ ^ (q - 1) / (ρ - 1)) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_of_open_bernsteinEllipse_interval
    hac hρ hFd hM hmatch (q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show q - 1 < q by omega))
  have h := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le hA hQ v hK hdeg hspec hfp
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.inv_smul_one_sub_map_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_map_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    (z • (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℂ) - D.T.map Complex.ofRealHom)⁻¹
      ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =
      jacobiFraction (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ D.alpha) (Complex.ofRealHom ∘ D.beta) z q 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, q = m + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  exact inv_smul_one_sub_map_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero D.alpha D.beta m hz

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_diagonal_sqrt_apply_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem polynomialIntegral_diagonal_sqrt_apply_eq_sum
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))) p =
        ∑ r : Fin N, w r * p.eval (t r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialIntegral_apply, integral_eval_spectralMeasure, aeval_diagonal]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    Real.sqrt (w r)*(p.eval (t r)*Real.sqrt (w r)) = (Real.sqrt (w r))^2*p.eval (t r) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw r)]

name: NLAlib.discrete_hankel_posDef
statement:
private theorem discrete_hankel_posDef (t w : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialIntegral
      (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) N).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_spectralMeasure_iff _ _ _).mpr
  rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w)
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
  have hpos := discrete_hankel_posDef t w ht hw
  apply hasOrthonormalCols_iff_conjTranspose_mul_self.mpr
  ext i j
  have horth := functional_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_mul L
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos i.isLt.le)
    (hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_posDef_of_le hpos j.isLt.le)
    (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hpos i.isLt)
    (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef hpos j.isLt)
  rw [polynomialIntegral_diagonal_sqrt_apply_eq_sum t w (fun i => (hw i).le)] at horth
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial,
    discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix, Matrix.one_apply]
  have heq : (∑ r : Fin N, (Real.sqrt (w r)*(orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val).eval (t r))*
      (Real.sqrt (w r)*(orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r))) =
      ∑ r : Fin N, w r*(orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val*orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    rw [eval_mul]
    calc
      _ = (Real.sqrt (w r))^2*((orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val).eval (t r)*
          (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw r).le]
  rw [heq, horth]
  simp only [Fin.val_inj]

name: NLAlib.discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one
statement:
theorem discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w *
      (discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w)ᴴ = 1
proof:
:=
  (hasOrthonormalCols_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w ht hw).mul_conjTranspose_self

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_jacobi
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_jacobi
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) :
    (discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w)ᴴ * diagonal t *
      discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w =
        orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (polynomialIntegral
          (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
          (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)
            (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) N
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
  ext i j
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix, polynomialIntegral_diagonal_sqrt_apply_eq_sum t w hw]
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    star_trivial, discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix, eval_mul, eval_X]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt (w r))^2*(t r*(orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r)*
        (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L i.val).eval (t r)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw r)]

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mulVec_sqrt_eq_single
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mulVec_sqrt_eq_single
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hN : 0<N) :
    (discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w)ᴴ *ᵥ (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) =
      Pi.single ⟨0, hN⟩ (Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral
        (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)
          (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) 0))
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
  let Q := discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w
  let c := Real.sqrt (orthogonalPolynomialNorm L 0)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    (orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_posDef (discrete_hankel_posDef t w ht hw) hN)).ne'
  have hvec : (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) = c • Q.col ⟨0,hN⟩ := by
    ext r
    simp only [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, Q, discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix,
      orthonormalMomentPolynomial, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_zero,
      mul_one, eval_C, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    change Real.sqrt (w r) = c*(Real.sqrt (w r)*c⁻¹)
    field_simp
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q :=
    hasOrthonormalCols_discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix t w ht hw
  change Qᴴ *ᵥ (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) = Pi.single ⟨0,hN⟩ c
  rw [hvec]
  ext j
  change Q.col j ⬝ᵥ (c • Q.col ⟨0,hN⟩) = (Pi.single ⟨0,hN⟩ c : Fin N → ℝ) j
  rw [dotProduct_smul, hQ.col_dotProduct_col]
  by_cases hj : j = ⟨0,hN⟩ <;> simp [hj]

name: NLAlib.sum_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_diagonal_sqrt_mul_eq_div_weight
statement:
theorem sum_eval_orthonormalMomentPolynomial_diagonal_sqrt_mul_eq_div_weight
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (r s : Fin N) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
    (∑ j : Fin N, (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r) *
      (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t s)) = (if r=s then 1 else 0)/w r := by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
  have horth := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ => M r s)
    (discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one t w ht hw)
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial,
    Matrix.one_apply, discreteOrthogonalPolynomialEvaluationMatrix] at horth
  have hfactor : (Real.sqrt (w r)*Real.sqrt (w s)) *
      (∑ j : Fin N, (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t r)*
        (orthonormalMomentPolynomial L j.val).eval (t s)) = if r=s then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← horth, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  by_cases hrs : r=s
  · subst s
    rw [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (hw r).le, if_pos rfl] at hfactor
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    apply (eq_div_iff (hw r).ne').mpr
    nlinarith [hfactor]
  · rw [if_neg hrs] at hfactor ⊢
    rw [zero_div]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left
      (mul_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw r)).ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw s)).ne')

name: NLAlib.pow_mul_transpose_mul_eq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem pow_mul_transpose_mul_eq_mul_pow (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (B * Bᵀ) ^ k * B = B * (Bᵀ * B) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
    calc
      ((B * Bᵀ) ^ k * (B * Bᵀ)) * B =
          ((B * Bᵀ) ^ k * B) * (Bᵀ * B) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = B * (Bᵀ * B) ^ k * (Bᵀ * B) := by rw [ih]
      _ = _ := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pow_succ_left_normal_eq
statement:
theorem dotProduct_pow_succ_left_normal_eq (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ ((B * Bᵀ) ^ (k + 1) *ᵥ u) =
      (Bᵀ *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ ((Bᵀ * B) ^ k *ᵥ (Bᵀ *ᵥ u))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (B * Bᵀ) ^ (k + 1) = B * ((Bᵀ * B) ^ k * Bᵀ) := by
    rw [pow_succ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, pow_mul_transpose_mul_eq_mul_pow, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hp, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_X_sq_mul_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_X_sq_mul_comp_X_sq
    (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) (X ^ 2 * p.comp (X ^ 2)) =
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B) (Bᵀ *ᵥ u))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [add_comp, mul_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq
  | monomial k c =>
    rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_comp, C_comp, pow_comp, X_comp]
    rw [show (X ^ 2 * (C c * (X ^ 2) ^ k) : ℝ[X]) = C c * X ^ (2 * (k + 1)) by
      rw [← pow_mul, mul_left_comm, ← pow_add, show 2 + 2 * k = 2 * (k + 1) by omega]]
    rw [C_mul', C_mul', map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X]
    rw [integral_pow_two_mul_spectralMeasure_dilation, integral_pow_spectralMeasure,
      integral_pow_spectralMeasure, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    exact dotProduct_pow_succ_left_normal_eq B u k

name: NLAlib.map_sq_withDensity_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation
statement:
theorem map_sq_withDensity_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) :
    Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
      ((spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)).withDensity
        (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2))) =
      spectralMeasure (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B) (Bᵀ *ᵥ u)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let ν := μ.withDensity (fun x : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (x ^ 2))
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let hν := hasPolynomialMoments_withDensity_sq hμ
  let : IsFiniteMeasure ν := (integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp
    (by simpa only [eval_one] using hν 1)
  let s := univ.image (isHermitian_dilation B).eigenvalues
  let t := univ.image (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B).eigenvalues
  have hsμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s := by
    have hr : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.range (isHermitian_dilation B).eigenvalues := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      exact spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues _ _
    filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hsν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ s := by
    apply (ae_withDensity_iff (by fun_prop)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hsμ] with x hx _
    exact hx
  have ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂spectralMeasure (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B) (Bᵀ *ᵥ u), x ∈ t := by
    have hr : ∀ᵐ x ∂spectralMeasure (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B) (Bᵀ *ᵥ u),
        x ∈ Set.range (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B).eigenvalues := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      exact spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues _ _
    filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  apply measure_eq_of_integral_eval_eq_of_finite_carrier (s.image (fun x => x ^ 2) ∪ t)
  · apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) ((s.image (fun x => x ^ 2) ∪ t).finite_toSet.measurableSet)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hsν] with x hx
    exact mem_union_left _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · filter_upwards [ht] with x hx
    exact mem_union_right _ hx
  · intro p
    change polynomialIntegral (Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) ν)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_map_sq hν) p = _
    rw [polynomialIntegral_map_sq ν hν, polynomialIntegral_withDensity_sq μ hμ]
    exact polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_X_sq_mul_comp_X_sq B u p

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) j =
        D.alpha j
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j + 1) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ krylovGrade A b from (by omega : k ≤ q).trans D.le_krylovGrade)
  have ht (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) :
      (∑ i ∈ range k, D.alpha i) = -(monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).nextCoeff := by
    rw [monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (D.restrict hk) hA,
      ← Matrix.trace_eq_neg_charpoly_nextCoeff, D.T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix hA hk]
    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
    exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range D.alpha k).symm
  have hr := orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_eq_sub_nextCoeff L j hL
  have h0 := ht j hj.le
  have h1 := ht (j + 1) (by omega)
  rw [sum_range_succ] at h1
  change orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L j = _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) j =
        D.beta j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  have hn (k : ℕ) (hk : k < q) : orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, D.beta i ^ 2 := by
    rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (D.restrict hk.le) hA]
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using
      D.integral_sq_charpoly_restrict_T_eq_norm_sq_mul_prod_beta_sq hA hk
  cases j with
  | zero => simp [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, beta]
  | succ j =>
    have hH : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L j := by
      apply orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard
      rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
      exact_mod_cast (show j + 1 ≤ krylovGrade A b from (by omega : j + 1 ≤ q).trans D.le_krylovGrade)
    have h1 := hn (j + 1) hj
    have h0 := hn j (by omega)
    rw [prod_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ j + 1), ← mul_assoc, ← h0] at h1
    rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), Nat.add_sub_cancel, h1]
    exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hH.ne'

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq
statement:
theorem charpoly_restrict_T_succ_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 ≤ q) :
    (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)).charpoly =
      (X - C (D.alpha j)) * (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict (by omega : j ≤ q))).charpoly -
        C (D.beta j ^ 2) * (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict (by omega : j - 1 ≤ q))).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ j + 1) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast ((hk.trans hj).trans D.le_krylovGrade)
  have hr := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_succ_eq L j hL
  rw [D.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha hA (by omega),
    D.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq hA (by omega),
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (D.restrict hj) hA,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (D.restrict (by omega : j ≤ q)) hA,
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (D.restrict (by omega : j - 1 ≤ q)) hA] at hr
  exact hr

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_sq_charpoly_T_eq_zero_of_eq_grade
statement:
theorem integral_sq_charpoly_T_eq_zero_of_eq_grade (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : q = krylovGrade A b) :
    (∫ x, D.T.charpoly.eval x ^ 2 ∂spectralMeasure hA b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure hA b
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b
  have he : μ.support.encard = (q : ℕ∞) := by rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade, ← hq]
  have hfinite := Set.finite_of_encard_eq_coe he
  have hcard : hfinite.toFinset.card = q := by exact_mod_cast (hfinite.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card.symm.trans he)
  have hz := orthogonalPolynomialNorm_eq_zero_of_finite_support μ hμ hfinite
  rw [hcard] at hz
  rw [orthogonalPolynomialNorm, D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA] at hz
  simpa only [μ, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow] using hz

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq_of_eq_grade
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq_of_eq_grade
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : q = krylovGrade A b) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q =
        D.beta q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : D.beta q = 0 := by simp [beta]
  rw [hb, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  by_cases hq0 : q = 0
  · simp [hq0, orthogonalRecurrenceBeta]
  rw [orthogonalRecurrenceBeta, if_neg hq0, orthogonalPolynomialNorm,
    D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA]
  simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow,
    D.integral_sq_charpoly_T_eq_zero_of_eq_grade hA hq, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_T
statement: theorem posDef_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.PosDef) : D.T.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : Function.Injective D.Q.mulVec :=
    Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.mpr D.hasOrthonormalCols.linearIndependent_col
  simpa only [T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_def, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
    using hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hQ

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.jacobiLDLPivot_pos
statement:
theorem jacobiLDLPivot_pos (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.PosDef)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < q) : 0 < jacobiLDLPivot D.alpha D.beta k
proof:
:= by
  have hT := D.posDef_T hA
  rw [D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA.isHermitian] at hT
  exact jacobiLDLPivot_pos_of_posDef hT hk

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_ldl
statement:
theorem T_eq_ldl (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    D.T = jacobiLDLLower D.alpha D.beta q *
      diagonal (fun i : Fin q => jacobiLDLPivot D.alpha D.beta i.val) *
      (jacobiLDLLower D.alpha D.beta q)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA.isHermitian]
  apply jacobiMatrix_eq_ldl_of_posDef
  rw [← D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA.isHermitian]
  exact D.posDef_T hA

name: NLAlib.inv_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero (a β : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1)).PosDef) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) - jacobiMatrix a β (m + 1))⁻¹ 0 0 =
      jacobiFraction a β x (m + 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing a β with
  | zero =>
    rw [inv_apply_zero_zero, det_fin_one]
    simp [jacobiFraction, jacobiMatrix]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hx' := hx.submatrix (Fin.succ_injective _)
    rw [submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix] at hx'
    have hd1 := hx'.det_pos
    have ih' := ih _ _ hx'
    rw [inv_apply_zero_zero, submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix] at ih'
    rw [inv_apply_zero_zero, submatrix_succ_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix,
      det_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix, jacobiFraction, jacobiFraction_succ, ← ih']
    have hd1' := hd1.ne'
    field_simp

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem T_eq_jacobiMatrix (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    D.T = jacobiMatrix D.alpha D.beta q
proof:
:= by
  have hS : D.T.IsSymm := D.isSymm_T hA
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
  · rw [alpha, dif_pos i.isLt]
    rw [show j = i from Fin.ext h1.symm]
  · rw [beta, dif_pos ⟨by omega, j.isLt⟩, ← hS.apply]
    congr 1
    exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
  · rw [beta, dif_pos ⟨by omega, i.isLt⟩]
    congr 1
    exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
  · refine D.T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist hA ?_
    rw [lt_abs]
    omega

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.posDef_smul_one_sub_T
proof:
:= by
  
  have hray : ∀ w : n → ℝ, w ≠ 0 → w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) < x * (w ⬝ᵥ w) := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA w
    have h2 := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA w
    change w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) = _ at h1
    rw [h1, ← h2, Finset.mul_sum, ← sub_pos, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hww : 0 < w ⬝ᵥ w :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (w i))
        (fun h => hw (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 h.symm))
    rw [← h2] at hww
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ Finset.univ, 0 < ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have := Finset.sum_nonpos hcon
      linarith
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => ?_) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith [hx j, sq_nonneg ((hA.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w)]
    · nlinarith [hx i]
  have hQ := D.hasOrthonormalCols
  refine PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos ?_ fun v hv => ?_
  · change (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) - D.T)ᴴ = _
    rw [conjTranspose_sub, conjTranspose_smul, conjTranspose_one, (D.isHermitian_T hA).eq,
      star_trivial]
  · have hw : D.Q *ᵥ v ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hv (by
      have := congrArg (fun u => D.Qᵀ *ᵥ u) h0
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, show D.Qᵀ * D.Q = 1 from hQ] using this)
    have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = (D.Q *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (D.Q *ᵥ v) :=
      (star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ v).symm
    have hvT : v ⬝ᵥ (D.T *ᵥ v) = (D.Q *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (D.Q *ᵥ v)) := by
      rw [T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_def, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
    rw [star_trivial, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hvT, hvv, sub_pos]
    exact hray _ hw

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.inv_smul_one_sub_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem inv_smul_one_sub_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) {x : ℝ} (hx : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i < x) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ) - D.T)⁻¹ ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =
      jacobiFraction D.alpha D.beta x q 0
proof:
:= by
  have hAs : A.IsSymm := by
    rw [Matrix.IsSymm, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA
  have hpd := D.posDef_smul_one_sub_T hA hx
  rw [D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hAs] at hpd ⊢
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, q = m + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  exact inv_smul_one_sub_jacobiMatrix_apply_zero_zero D.alpha D.beta m hpd

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_pow_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_cutoff
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_pow_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_cutoff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ)
    {q s d : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hd : d < 2 * q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        4 * exp (-(d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * s)) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA hQ v hK
    ((degree_monomialChebyshevApprox_le s d).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hd))
    hspec (fun _ hx => abs_pow_sub_eval_monomialChebyshevApprox_le hs d hx)
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
