    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : exponentialApproxDegree b δ < 2 * q) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        2 * δ * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA hQ v hK
    ((degree_exponentialApprox_le b δ).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hq)) hspec
    (fun _ hx => abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le hb hδ hδ1 hx)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_exp_neg_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) b)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : exponentialApproxDegree b δ < q) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (cfc (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) A *ᵥ v -
      krylovFunApprox A (fun x : ℝ => exp (-x)) v Q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * δ) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_krylovFunApprox_self_le hA hQ v hK
    ((degree_exponentialApprox_le b δ).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hq)) hspec
    (fun _ hx => abs_exp_neg_sub_eval_exponentialApprox_le hb hδ hδ1 hx)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_of_beta_nonneg
statement:
theorem LanczosDecomp.T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_of_beta_nonneg
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hbeta : ∀ j < q, 0 ≤ D.beta j) :
    D.T = orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hk.trans D.le_krylovGrade
  have hH (k : ℕ) (hk : k < q) : 0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm L k := by
    apply orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk).trans D.le_krylovGrade
  rw [D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA, orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiMatrix L q hL hH]
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with hij hupper hlower
  · exact (D.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha hA i.isLt).symm
  · rw [D.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq hA j.isLt,
      Real.sqrt_sq (hbeta j.val j.isLt)]
  · rw [D.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq hA i.isLt,
      Real.sqrt_sq (hbeta i.val i.isLt)]
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.T_arnoldiDecomp_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem T_arnoldiDecomp_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    LanczosDecomp.T (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) = orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q
proof:
:= by
  apply LanczosDecomp.T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_of_beta_nonneg _ hA
  intro j hj
  rw [← lanczosBeta_eq_beta hA b hq hj]
  exact lanczosBeta_nonneg A b j

name: NLAlib.jacobiMatrix_lanczosAlpha_lanczosBeta_eq_T
statement:
theorem jacobiMatrix_lanczosAlpha_lanczosBeta_eq_T
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    jacobiMatrix (lanczosAlpha A b) (lanczosBeta A b) q =
      LanczosDecomp.T (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LanczosDecomp.T_eq_jacobiMatrix _ hA]
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with hij hupper hlower
  · exact lanczosAlpha_eq_alpha hA b hq i.isLt
  · exact lanczosBeta_eq_beta hA b hq j.isLt
  · exact lanczosBeta_eq_beta hA b hq i.isLt
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single
statement:
theorem aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (j : Fin q) : aeval D.T (D.poly j.val) *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) = Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc := transpose_mulVec_aeval_mulVec_eq D.hasOrthonormalCols b D.range_Q.ge
    (D.degree_poly_le j.val |>.trans (by exact_mod_cast j.isLt.le))
  change D.Qᵀ *ᵥ (aeval A (D.poly j.val) *ᵥ b) =
    aeval D.T (D.poly j.val) *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) at hc
  rw [← hc, ← D.vec_eq_aeval_poly, D.vec_of_lt j.isLt]
  funext k
  change D.Q.col k ⬝ᵥ D.Q.col j = (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : Fin q → ℝ) k
  rw [D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col]
  simp [Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i j : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i j =
      (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ * (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec (D.isHermitian_T hA)
    (D.poly j.val) (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) i
  rw [D.aeval_poly_T_mulVec_transpose_Q_eq_single, dotProduct_single, mul_one] at h
  have hc : D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b = Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ ((D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩) := by
    ext k
    by_cases hk : k = ⟨0, hq⟩
    · subst k
      simp
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero]
      have hk0 : k.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
      omega
  rw [hc, dotProduct_single] at h
  simpa only [mul_comm _ ((D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩)] using h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.startingCoordinate_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem startingCoordinate_ne_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩
  rw [hzero, zero_mul, mul_zero] at h
  exact D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_ne_zero hA hq ⟨0, hq⟩ h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul
statement:
theorem T_mulVec_eval_poly_eq_smul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    D.T *ᵥ (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) =
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i •
        (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  let s := (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ * (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (D.startingCoordinate_ne_zero hA hq)
    (D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_ne_zero hA hq i)
  have heq : (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) =
      s⁻¹ • (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i := by
    ext j
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq]
    change _ = s⁻¹ * (_ * s)
    field_simp
  rw [heq, Matrix.mulVec_smul, (D.isHermitian_T hA).mulVec_eigenvectorBasis,
    smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_eigenvectorBasis_T_eq_sign_smul_eval_poly
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvectorBasis_T_eq_sign_smul_eval_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i =
        (ε / ‖WithLp.toLp 2
          (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))‖) •
        (fun j : Fin q => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  let v : Fin q → ℝ := fun j => (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)
  let s := (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ * (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩
  have heq : ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i : Fin q → ℝ) = s • v := by
    ext j
    change _ = s * v j
    rw [D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq i j]
    exact mul_comm _ s
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (s • v)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [← heq, WithLp.toLp_ofLp]
    exact (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
  have hmul : |s| * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 1 := by
    simpa only [WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnorm
  have hvnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hmul
    exact zero_ne_one hmul
  refine ⟨s * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_pow, ← sq_abs s, ← mul_pow, hmul]
    norm_num
  · change _ = ((s * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖) / ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖) • v
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ s hvnorm]
    exact heq

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly
statement:
theorem mul_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_eq_inv_sum_sq_eval_poly
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 =
      (∑ j : Fin q, ((D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis (D.isHermitian_T hA) i i
  simp only [ite_true, dotProduct, ← pow_two] at hnorm
  let S := ∑ j : Fin q, ((D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) ^ 2
  have heq : (∑ j : Fin q, ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i j) ^ 2) =
      S * ((D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ *
        (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 := by
    change _ = (∑ j : Fin q,
      ((D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) ^ 2) * _
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq i j, mul_pow]
  rw [heq, mul_pow, D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq] at hnorm
  have hS : S ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    change S * _ = 1 at hnorm
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hnorm
    exact zero_ne_one hnorm
  change _ = S⁻¹
  rw [← one_div]
  apply (eq_div_iff hS).mpr
  change _ * S = 1
  nlinarith [hnorm]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_weight_mul_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly
statement:
theorem sum_weight_mul_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (j k : Fin q) :
    (∑ i : Fin q, (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 *
      (D.poly j.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
      (D.poly k.val).eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)) = if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hU := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ => M j k)
    (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorUnitary)
  simp only [Unitary.coe_star, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    star_trivial, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hU
  rw [← hU]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq i j,
    D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_eq_eval_poly_mul hA hq i k,
    ← D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq]
  ring

name: NLAlib.polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X_mul
statement:
theorem polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X_mul
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : m → ℝ) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialWeightedFunctional
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b))
      X (p*q) = (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (aeval A q *ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure hA b p (X*q)
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, map_mul, aeval_X, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  change (∫ x, (X*(p*q)).eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA b) = _
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_X]
  rw [← h]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with x
  ring

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix (polynomialWeightedFunctional
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) X) k).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos]
  intro p hp hp0
  rw [pow_two, polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X_mul]
  have hv0 : aeval A p *ᵥ b ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hp0 (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)) h)
  simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0

name: NLAlib.eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_zero_ne_zero
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) k).eval 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
  let P := monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k
  have hL : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hk
  have hP := isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hL
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hz
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := hP.monic.ne_zero
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := hr
    rw [h, mul_zero] at this
    exact hP0 this
  have hrd : r.degree < k := by
    have hd := congrArg natDegree hr
    rw [natDegree_monicOrthogonalPolynomial,
      natDegree_mul (monic_X_sub_C 0).ne_zero hr0, natDegree_X_sub_C] at hd
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hr0]
    exact_mod_cast (show r.natDegree < k by omega)
  have horth := hP.orthogonal r hrd
  have henergy : polynomialWeightedFunctional L X (r*r) = 0 := by
    change L (X*(r*r)) = 0
    change L (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k * r) = 0 at horth
    rw [hr] at horth
    simpa only [C_0, sub_zero, mul_assoc] using horth
  have hpos := (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_functional_sq_pos _ k).mp
    (posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_polynomialWeightedFunctional_spectralMeasure_X hA b hk) r hrd hr0
  rw [pow_two] at hpos
  exact hpos.ne' henergy

name: NLAlib.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffelPolynomial
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffelPolynomial
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < krylovGrade A b) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialWeightedFunctional
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) X) k =
      christoffelPolynomial (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) 0 k
proof:
:= by
  have hL (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ k+1) :
      hankelMomentDet (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)) j ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast (show j ≤ krylovGrade A b by omega)
  simpa only [C_0, sub_zero] using
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial_polynomialWeightedFunctional_X_sub_C _ k hL
      (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_zero_ne_zero hA b hk.le)

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffel_factors
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_spectralMeasure_eq_christoffel_factors
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
    monicJacobiMatrix q (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha L) (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta L) =
      darbouxLowerMatrix q (christoffelElimination L 0) *
        darbouxUpperMatrix q (christoffelQuotient L 0) := by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hk.trans hq
  have hz (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval 0 ≠ 0 :=
    eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_zero_ne_zero hA b (hk.trans hq)
  simpa only [zero_smul, sub_zero] using
    monicJacobiMatrix_sub_scalar_one_eq_christoffel_factors_of_finite q hL hz

name: NLAlib.monicJacobiMatrix_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
statement:
theorem monicJacobiMatrix_weighted_spectralMeasure_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary
    (hA : A.PosDef) (b : m → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
    monicJacobiMatrix q (orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha (polynomialWeightedFunctional L X))
        (orthogonalRecurrenceBeta (polynomialWeightedFunctional L X)) =
      darbouxUpperMatrix q (christoffelQuotient L 0) *
        darbouxLowerMatrix q (christoffelElimination L 0) +
          christoffelElimination L 0 (q-1) • terminalCoordinateMatrix q := by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA.isHermitian b)
  have hL (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : hankelMomentDet L k ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hk.trans hq
  have hz (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial L k).eval 0 ≠ 0 :=
    eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_zero_ne_zero hA b (hk.trans hq)
  simpa only [C_0, sub_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] using
    monicJacobiMatrix_christoffel_eq_reversed_factors_add_boundary_of_finite q hL hz

name: NLAlib.gaussNodes_mem_Ioo_sInf_sSup_support
statement:
theorem gaussNodes_mem_Ioo_sInf_sSup_support {μ : Measure ℝ} (hμ : HasPolynomialMoments μ)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : (n + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard)
    (hlo : BddBelow μ.support) (hhi : BddAbove μ.support) (i : Fin n) :
    gaussNodes μ hμ n i ∈ Ioo (sInf μ.support) (sSup μ.support)
proof:
:= by
  apply gaussNodes_mem_Ioo hμ _ hn
  filter_upwards [μ.support_mem_ae] with x hx
  exact ⟨csInf_le hlo hx, le_csSup hhi hx⟩

name: NLAlib.eq_of_gaussNodes_mem_support_gap
proof:
:= by
  apply gaussNodes_injective hμ hn
  apply eq_of_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_support_gap_le hμ hn hg hi hj
  · exact (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · exact (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes hμ hn _).mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.monic_spectral_eval_eigenvalue_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem monic_spectral_eval_eigenvalue_eq_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : Fin q) :
    (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q).eval
      ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA,
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).charpoly_eq, eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simp

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues_T_mem_Ioo_sInf_sSup_support
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_T_mem_Ioo_sInf_sSup_support (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : q < krylovGrade A b) (i : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i ∈
      Ioo (sInf (spectralMeasure hA b).support) (sSup (spectralMeasure hA b).support)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (spectralMeasure hA b).support.Finite := Set.finite_of_encard_le_coe
    (by rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade])
  apply D.eigenvalues_T_mem_Ioo_of_spectralMeasure hA hq
  filter_upwards [(spectralMeasure hA b).support_mem_ae] with x hx
  exact ⟨csInf_le hs.bddBelow hx, le_csSup hs.bddAbove hx⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eq_of_eigenvalues_T_mem_support_gap
statement:
theorem eq_of_eigenvalues_T_mem_support_gap (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a c : ℝ} (hg : Disjoint (Ioo a c) (spectralMeasure hA b).support) {i j : Fin q}
    (hi : (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i ∈ Ioo a c)
    (hj : (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues j ∈ Ioo a c) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  apply D.eigenvalues_T_injective hA
  apply eq_of_eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_of_mem_support_gap_le
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) _ hg hi hj
    (D.monic_spectral_eval_eigenvalue_eq_zero hA i) (D.monic_spectral_eval_eigenvalue_eq_zero hA j)
  rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eval_poly_eq_confluent_and_pos (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {m : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q) (x : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ range m, (D.poly j).eval x ^ 2) =
      D.beta m * ((D.poly m).derivative.eval x * (D.poly (m - 1)).eval x -
        (D.poly (m - 1)).derivative.eval x * (D.poly m).eval x) ∧
      0 < ∑ j ∈ range m, (D.poly j).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ[X] := ∑ j ∈ range m, C ((D.poly j).eval x) * D.poly j
  have hpol : (X - C x) * K = C (D.beta m) *
      (C ((D.poly (m - 1)).eval x) * D.poly m -
        C ((D.poly m).eval x) * D.poly (m - 1)) := by
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro y
    have he := D.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul hA hm0 hm y x
    simp only [K, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_finsetSum]
    convert he using 1
    · congr 1
      exact sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_comm _ _
    · ring
  have hd := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => p.derivative.eval x) hpol
  simp only [derivative_mul, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C, sub_zero,
    zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
    sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero] at hd
  have hK : K.eval x = ∑ j ∈ range m, (D.poly j).eval x ^ 2 := by
    simp only [K, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, pow_two]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hK, hd]
    ring
  · apply sum_pos' (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨0, mem_range.mpr hm0, ?_⟩
    have hp : (D.poly 0).natDegree = 0 :=
      natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (D.degree_poly (by omega))
    have hp0 : D.poly 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hd0 := D.degree_poly (show 0 < q by omega)
      simp [h] at hd0
    rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hp, eval_C]
    exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero (fun hc => hp0 (by rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hp, hc, C_0]))

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ q) : (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)) = jacobiMatrix D.alpha D.beta j
proof:
:= by
  change ArnoldiDecomp.H (D.restrict hj) = _
  rw [ArnoldiDecomp.H_restrict, show ArnoldiDecomp.H D = D.T from rfl, D.T_eq_jacobiMatrix hA]
  ext i k
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_castLE]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.jacobiContinuant_eq_charpoly_restrict_T
statement:
theorem jacobiContinuant_eq_charpoly_restrict_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ q) :
    jacobiContinuant D.alpha D.beta j = (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj)).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.T_restrict_eq_jacobiMatrix hA hj, charpoly_jacobiMatrix_eq_jacobiContinuant]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_sq_charpoly_restrict_T_eq_norm_sq_mul_prod_beta_sq
statement:
theorem integral_sq_charpoly_restrict_T_eq_norm_sq_mul_prod_beta_sq
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    (∫ x, ((LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj.le)).charpoly.eval x) ^ 2 ∂spectralMeasure hA b) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * ∏ k ∈ Icc 1 j, D.beta k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  let χ := (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj.le)).charpoly
  let c := (D.poly 0).leadingCoeff
  let t := ∏ k ∈ Icc 1 j, D.beta k
  have hLC (r : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) : L (C r * p) = r * L p := by
    rw [C_mul', map_smul]
    rfl
  have hC (r : ℝ) : L (C r) = r * L 1 := by simpa only [mul_one] using hLC r 1
  have hmass : L 1 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [polynomialIntegral_apply, integral_eval_spectralMeasure, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simp
  have hpoly (k : ℕ) (hk : k < q) : L (D.poly k ^ 2) = 1 := by
    simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, pow_two, eval_mul, if_true] using
      (D.integral_poly_mul_poly hA (i := k) (j := k) hk)
  have hpn : (D.poly 0).natDegree = 0 :=
    natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (D.degree_poly (by omega))
  have hp0 : D.poly 0 = C c := by
    simpa only [c, leadingCoeff, hpn] using eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hpn
  have hc0 := hpoly 0 (by omega)
  rw [hp0, ← map_pow C c, hC, hmass] at hc0
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hc0
  have he := congrArg (fun p : ℝ[X] => L (p ^ 2)) (D.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero hA hj)
  rw [hp0] at he
  change L ((χ * C c) ^ 2) = L ((C t * D.poly j) ^ 2) at he
  rw [show (χ * C c) ^ 2 = C (c ^ 2) * χ ^ 2 by rw [map_pow]; ring,
    show (C t * D.poly j) ^ 2 = C (t ^ 2) * D.poly j ^ 2 by rw [map_pow]; ring,
    hLC, hLC, hpoly j hj, mul_one] at he
  have hm : L (χ ^ 2) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hc)
    rw [he, ← mul_assoc, hc0, one_mul]
  simpa only [L, χ, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, t, prod_pow] using hm

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_charpoly_T
statement:
theorem isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_charpoly_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    IsMonicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b))
      q D.T.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨D.charpoly_T_monic.1, D.charpoly_T_monic.2, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_mul] using
    D.integral_eval_charpoly_mul_eq_zero hA hp

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T
statement:
theorem monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b))
      q = D.T.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let L := polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
  have hnondeg : ∀ p : ℝ[X], p.degree < q → p ≠ 0 → L (p ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp hp0 hzero
    apply hp0
    apply eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (A := A) (b := b)
    · exact hp.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade)
    · have hz : (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) = 0 := by
        simpa only [L, polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, pow_two, eval_mul,
          integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure] using hzero
      simpa using (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hz)
  have hdet : hankelMomentDet L q ≠ 0 := by
    apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_existsUnique_isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial L
    refine ⟨D.T.charpoly, D.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_charpoly_T hA, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    exact hp.eq_of_nonzero_sq (D.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_charpoly_T hA) hnondeg
  exact (isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_monicOrthogonalPolynomial L hdet).eq_of_nonzero_sq
    (D.isMonicOrthogonalPolynomial_charpoly_T hA) hnondeg

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.spectral_hankel_nonzero
statement:
private theorem spectral_hankel_nonzero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) :
    hankelMomentDet
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hankelMomentDet_ne_zero_of_le_support_encard
  rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast (hk.trans D.le_krylovGrade)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.spectral_norm_pos
statement:
private theorem spectral_norm_pos (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < q) :
    0 < orthogonalPolynomialNorm
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) k
proof:
:= by
  apply orthogonalPolynomialNorm_pos_of_lt_support_encard
  rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast ((Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk).trans D.le_krylovGrade)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ =
      (isHermitian_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
        (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q).eigenvalues₀
proof:
:= by
  apply eigenvalues₀_eq_of_charpoly_eq
  rw [← D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA]
  exact (charpoly_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix _
    (D.spectral_hankel_nonzero hA) (D.spectral_norm_pos hA)).symm

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_strict_interlacing
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_strict_interlacing {q : ℕ}
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b (q + 1)) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (q + 1)).symm i.succ) <
      (LanczosDecomp.isHermitian_T (D.restrict (Nat.le_succ q)) hA).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin q).symm i) ∧
      (LanczosDecomp.isHermitian_T (D.restrict (Nat.le_succ q)) hA).eigenvalues₀
        (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin q).symm i) <
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.cast (Fintype.card_fin (q + 1)).symm i.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.eigenvalues₀_T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix hA,
    LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_T_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (D.restrict (Nat.le_succ q)) hA]
  exact eigenvalues₀_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_strict_interlacing _
    (D.spectral_hankel_nonzero hA) (D.spectral_norm_pos hA) i

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues_T_mem_Ioo_of_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_T_mem_Ioo_of_spectralMeasure (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : q < krylovGrade A b) {a c : ℝ}
    (hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂spectralMeasure hA b, x ∈ Set.Icc a c) (j : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues j ∈ Set.Ioo a c
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (q : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade
  have hroot : (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)) q).eval
      ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues j) = 0 := by
    rw [D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA,
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).charpoly_eq, eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simp
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (eval_monicOrthogonalPolynomial_eq_zero_iff_exists_gaussNodes
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hn _).mp hroot
  rw [← hi]
  apply gaussNodes_mem_Ioo (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hs _ i
  rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hq)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments
statement:
theorem rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (v w : Fin q → ℝ) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hm : ∀ k < 2 * q, b ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ k) *ᵥ b) = ∑ i, w i * v i ^ k) :
    ∃ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin q),
      (∀ i, v (e i) = (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) ∧
      (∀ i, w (e i) = (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (q : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade
  apply quadrature_rule_eq_up_to_permutation_of_moments
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hq hn
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues v
    (fun i => (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2) w
    (D.eigenvalues_T_injective hA) hv
  · intro k hk
    rw [integral_pow_spectralMeasure]
    have h := D.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA hq (p := X ^ k) (by
      rw [degree_X_pow]
      exact_mod_cast hk)
    simpa only [map_pow, aeval_X, eval_pow, eval_X, Finset.mul_sum,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using h
  · intro k hk
    rw [integral_pow_spectralMeasure]
    exact hm k hk

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
statement:
theorem exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f) (Ioo a c)) :
    ∃ ξ ∈ Ioo a c,
      quadForm (cfc f A) b - ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ =
        iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f ξ / (2 * q).factorial *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A D.T.charpoly *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure hA b
  have hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Icc a c := by
    have hrange : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Set.range hA.eigenvalues := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      exact spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues hA b
    filter_upwards [hrange] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hspec i
  let hMom := hasPolynomialMoments_of_ae_mem_Icc hμ
  have hn : (q : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade
  let θ := (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues
  let w : Fin q → ℝ := fun i => (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2
  have hmoment : ∀ k < 2 * q, (∫ x, x ^ k ∂μ) = ∑ i, w i * θ i ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    have hp : (X ^ k : ℝ[X]).degree < (2 * q : ℕ) := by
      simp only [degree_pow, degree_X, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      exact_mod_cast hk
    have h := D.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hA hq (p := X ^ k) hp
    rw [← integral_eval_spectralMeasure hA b] at h
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, Finset.mul_sum, w, θ,
      mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h
  obtain ⟨e, heθ, hew⟩ := rule_eq_gaussNodes_gaussWeights_of_moments hMom hq hn
    θ w (D.eigenvalues_T_injective hA) hmoment
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * f (θ i)) =
      ∑ i, gaussWeights μ hMom q i * f (gaussNodes μ hMom q i) := by
    calc _ = ∑ i, w (e i) * f (θ (e i)) := (Equiv.sum_comp e _).symm
      _ = _ := sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [heθ i, hew i]
  have hvalue : (∑ i, gaussWeights μ hMom q i * f (gaussNodes μ hMom q i)) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ := by
    rw [← hsum, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, D.cfc_T_apply_zero_zero hA hq]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by dsimp only [w, θ]; ring
  have hnorm : orthogonalPolynomialNorm (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) q =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A D.T.charpoly *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2 := by
    change (∫ x, (monicOrthogonalPolynomial (polynomialIntegral μ hMom) q ^ 2).eval x ∂μ) = _
    rw [D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T hA]
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_pow, pow_two, Polynomial.eval_mul] using
      integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure hA b D.T.charpoly D.T.charpoly
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := exists_integral_sub_gaussRule_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    hac hμ hq hn hf hf' hD
  rw [hvalue, hnorm, integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm] at he
  exact ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_le_quadForm_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_le_quadForm_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ ≤ quadForm (cfc f A) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := D.exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    hA hq hac hspec hf hf' hD
  have hnon : 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f ξ / (2 * q).factorial *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A D.T.charpoly *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hpos ξ hξ) (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
statement:
theorem quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_T_of_iteratedDeriv_nonpos
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hneg : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f x ≤ 0) :
    quadForm (cfc f A) b ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, he⟩ := D.exists_quadForm_sub_cfc_T_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_norm
    hA hq hac hspec hf hf' hD
  have hnon : iteratedDeriv (2 * q) f ξ / (2 * q).factorial *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (aeval A D.T.charpoly *ᵥ b)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hneg ξ hξ) (by positivity))
      (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.spectralMeasure_diagonal_sqrt_eq_sum_dirac
statement:
theorem spectralMeasure_diagonal_sqrt_eq_sum_dirac (t w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) :
    spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i)) =
      ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • Measure.dirac (t i)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (w i) • Measure.dirac (t i)) := ⟨by simp⟩
  apply ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure
  intro f
  rw [integral_spectralMeasure, cfc_diagonal,
    integral_finsetSum_measure fun i _ =>
      (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, integral_smul_measure,
    integral_dirac, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hw _), smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    Real.sqrt (w i) * (f (t i) * Real.sqrt (w i)) = Real.sqrt (w i) ^ 2 * f (t i) := by ring
    _ = w i * f (t i) := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw i)]

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_diagonal_eq_card
statement:
theorem krylovGrade_diagonal_eq_card {N : ℕ} (t b : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ht : Function.Injective t) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≠ 0) :
    krylovGrade (Matrix.diagonal t) b = N
proof:
:= by
  let K : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal b * Matrix.vandermonde t
  have hK : K.det ≠ 0 := by
    change (Matrix.diagonal b * Matrix.vandermonde t).det ≠ 0
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact mul_ne_zero (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hb i))
      (Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr ht)
  have hunit : IsUnit K := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hK)
  have hcols := Matrix.linearIndependent_cols_of_isUnit hunit
  have heq : K.col = fun j : Fin N => ((Matrix.diagonal t) ^ j.val) *ᵥ b := by
    ext j i
    simp [K, Matrix.col, diagonal_pow, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal,
      Matrix.vandermonde_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [heq] at hcols
  have hgrade := (linearIndependent_pow_mulVec_iff_le_krylovGrade
    (A := Matrix.diagonal t) (b := b)).mp hcols
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa using krylovGrade_le_card (Matrix.diagonal t) b) hgrade

name: NLAlib.krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card
statement:
theorem krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card {N : ℕ} (t w : Fin N → ℝ)
    (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    krylovGrade (Matrix.diagonal t) (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i)) = N
proof:
:=
  krylovGrade_diagonal_eq_card t _ ht (fun i => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw i)).ne')

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul
statement:
theorem Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul
    (D : LanczosDecomp (Matrix.diagonal t) (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i)) q)
    (r : n) (j : Fin q) : D.Q r j = Real.sqrt (w r) * (D.poly j.val).eval (t r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (D.vec_eq_aeval_poly j.val) r
  rw [D.vec_of_lt j.isLt, aeval_diagonal] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.col, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.eta,
    Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.mul_apply, mul_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly_eq_div_weight
statement:
theorem sum_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly_eq_div_weight {N : ℕ} {t w : Fin N → ℝ}
    (D : LanczosDecomp (Matrix.diagonal t) (fun i => Real.sqrt (w i)) N)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (r s : Fin N) :
    (∑ j : Fin N, (D.poly j.val).eval (t r) * (D.poly j.val).eval (t s)) =
      (if r = s then 1 else 0) / w r
proof:
:= by
  have horth := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ => M r s)
    D.hasOrthonormalCols.mul_conjTranspose_self
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial,
    Matrix.one_apply] at horth
  have hfactor : (Real.sqrt (w r) * Real.sqrt (w s)) *
      (∑ j : Fin N, (D.poly j.val).eval (t r) * (D.poly j.val).eval (t s)) =
        if r = s then 1 else 0 := by
    rw [← horth, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [D.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul, D.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul]
    ring
  by_cases hrs : r = s
  · subst s
    rw [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (hw r).le, if_pos rfl] at hfactor
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    apply (eq_div_iff (hw r).ne').mpr
    nlinarith [hfactor]
  · rw [if_neg hrs] at hfactor ⊢
    rw [zero_div]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left
      (mul_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw r)).ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw s)).ne')

name: NLAlib.ArnoldiDecomp.transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_single_of_pos
statement:
theorem transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_single_of_pos (D : ArnoldiDecomp A b q) (hq : 0 < q)
    (h0 : 0 < D.Q.col ⟨0, hq⟩ ⬝ᵥ b) :
    D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b = Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ := h0
  have hsq := D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq
  rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hsq
  have heq : (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⟨0, hq⟩ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 b)]
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k = ⟨0, hq⟩
  · subst k
    simpa only [Pi.single_eq_same] using heq
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero]
    have hk0 : k.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
    omega

name: NLAlib.transpose_arnoldiMatrix_mulVec_eq_single
statement:
theorem transpose_arnoldiMatrix_mulVec_eq_single
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (h : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) :
    (arnoldiMatrix A b q)ᵀ *ᵥ b = Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (arnoldiDecomp A b q h).transpose_Q_mulVec_eq_single_of_pos hq
  exact arnoldiBasis_zero_dotProduct_pos A b (hq.trans_le h)

name: NLAlib.spectralMeasure_T_first_eq_sum_dirac
statement:
theorem spectralMeasure_T_first_eq_sum_dirac
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ} (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) :
    spectralMeasure (D.isHermitian_T hA) (Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖) =
      ∑ i : Fin q, ENNReal.ofReal ((b ⬝ᵥ b) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2) •
        Measure.dirac ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralMeasure
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [dotProduct_single, mul_pow, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  congr 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
statement:
theorem abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_lipschitzOnWith
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (v : n → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A v q ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a c : ℝ} {L : NNReal} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (hf : LipschitzOnWith L f (Icc a c)) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ v))| ≤
        Real.pi * (L : ℝ) * (c - a) / (4 * q) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hfp⟩ := exists_degree_le_abs_sub_eval_le_jackson_interval hac hf (2 * q - 1)
  have hdeg : p.degree < 2 * q := hp.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 < 2 * q by omega))
  have h := abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA hQ v hK hdeg hspec hfp
  have hcast : ((2 * q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = 2 * (q : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 2 * q - 1 + 1 = 2 * q by omega)
  rw [hcast] at h
  convert h using 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isUpperHessenberg_transpose_T
statement:
private theorem isUpperHessenberg_transpose_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) : IsUpperHessenberg D.Tᵀ
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply D.T_apply_eq_zero_of_one_lt_dist hA
  simp only [lt_abs]
  right
  omega

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.T_superdiagonal_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem T_superdiagonal_ne_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (i j : Fin q) (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) : D.T i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb := D.beta_ne_zero (j := j.val) (by omega) j.isLt
  rw [beta, dif_pos ⟨by omega, j.isLt⟩] at hb
  rw [← (D.isSymm_T hA).apply]
  convert hb using 2
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_ne_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis_apply_zero_ne_zero
    (D.isUpperHessenberg_transpose_T hA) (D.T_superdiagonal_ne_zero hA) hq i

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_pos
statement:
theorem sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_pos (D : LanczosDecomp A b q)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q) (i : Fin q) :
    0 < ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sq_pos_of_ne_zero (D.eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero_ne_zero hA hq i)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues_T_injective
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_T_injective (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    Function.Injective (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues
proof:
:=
  (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues_injective_of_unreduced
    (D.isUpperHessenberg_transpose_T hA) (D.T_superdiagonal_ne_zero hA)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha_mem_Icc_of_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem alpha_mem_Icc_of_eigenvalues (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {a c : ℝ} (hs : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) :
    D.alpha j ∈ Icc a c
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin q := ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hlo := mul_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mulVec_of_eigenvalues hA (fun k => (hs k).1) (D.Q.col i)
  have hhi := dotProduct_mulVec_le_mul_dotProduct_of_eigenvalues hA (fun k => (hs k).2) (D.Q.col i)
  rw [D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos rfl, mul_one] at hlo hhi
  have heq : D.alpha j = D.Q.col i ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ D.Q.col i) := by
    rw [alpha, dif_pos hj]
    change (D.Qᵀ * A * D.Q) i i = _
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_apply]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact ⟨hlo, hhi⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.alpha_mem_Icc_lambdaMin_lambdaMax
statement:
theorem alpha_mem_Icc_lambdaMin_lambdaMax (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : D.alpha j ∈ Icc (lambdaMin A) (lambdaMax A)
proof:
:= by
  apply D.alpha_mem_Icc_of_eigenvalues hA _ hj
  intro i
  rw [lambdaMin, lambdaMax, hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
  have hf : (Set.range hA.eigenvalues).Finite := Set.finite_range _
  exact ⟨csInf_le hf.bddBelow ⟨i, rfl⟩, le_csSup hf.bddAbove ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.abs_beta_le_specNorm
statement: theorem abs_beta_le_specNorm (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : |D.beta j| ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hT : specNorm D.T ≤ specNorm A := by
    change specNorm (D.Qᵀ * A * D.Q) ≤ specNorm A
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      specNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_le_of_hasOrthonormalCols D.hasOrthonormalCols A
  rw [beta]
  split_ifs with hj
  · exact (abs_apply_le_specNorm D.T _ _).trans hT
  · simpa using specNorm_nonneg A

name: NLAlib.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos_and_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos_and_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ krylovGrade A b) {j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < q) :
    0 < LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) j ∧
      LanczosDecomp.beta (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) j ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := LanczosDecomp.beta_arnoldiDecomp_pos A b hq hj0 hj
  exact ⟨hpos, by simpa only [abs_of_pos hpos] using
    LanczosDecomp.abs_beta_le_specNorm (arnoldiDecomp A b q hq) j⟩

name: NLAlib.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_dilation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_dilation_eq_zero
    (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k ≤ krylovGrade (dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)) :
    orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _)) k = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_polynomialIntegral_eq_zero
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) (map_neg_spectralMeasure_dilation B u)
  rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast hk

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq
    {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {u : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp (dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0) (2 * k)) :
    D.T.charpoly =
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
        (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) u)
          (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _)) k).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  have hk : (2 * k : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade
  have h := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_eq_comp_X_sq hμ
    (map_neg_spectralMeasure_dilation B u) k hk
  simp only [map_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation] at h
  rw [← D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (isHermitian_dilation B)]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem charpoly_T_dilation_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq
    {B : Matrix m n ℝ} {u : m → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (D : NLAlib.LanczosDecomp (dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0) (2 * k + 1)) :
    D.T.charpoly = X *
      (monicOrthogonalPolynomial
        (polynomialIntegral
          (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self B) (Bᵀ *ᵥ u))
          (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _)) k).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  have hk : (2 * k + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast D.le_krylovGrade
  have h := monicOrthogonalPolynomial_two_mul_add_one_eq_X_mul_comp_X_sq hμ
    (map_neg_spectralMeasure_dilation B u) k hk
  simp only [map_sq_withDensity_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation] at h
  rw [← D.monicOrthogonalPolynomial_spectralMeasure_eq_charpoly_T (isHermitian_dilation B)]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) : HasPolynomialMoments (spectralMeasure hA b)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  unfold spectralMeasure
  exact integrable_finsetSum_measure.mpr fun i _ =>
    (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

name: NLAlib.hankelMomentMatrix_spectralMeasure_eq_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem hankelMomentMatrix_spectralMeasure_eq_transpose_mul
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    let K : Matrix n (Fin q) ℝ
proof:
:= fun r j => ((A ^ j.val) *ᵥ b) r
    hankelMomentMatrix
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b))
      q = Kᵀ * K := by
  ext i j
  change (∫ x, (X ^ (i.val + j.val) : ℝ[X]).eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA b) =
    ((A ^ i.val) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ j.val) *ᵥ b)
  rw [pow_add]
  simp only [eval_mul]
  rw [integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure]
  simp only [map_pow, aeval_X]

name: NLAlib.support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure hA b
  let hμ := hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b
  have hle : (krylovGrade A b : ℕ∞) ≤ μ.support.encard := by
    apply (integral_sq_eval_pos_iff_le_support_encard μ hμ _).mp
    intro p hp hp0
    have hv0 : aeval A p *ᵥ b ≠ 0 := fun h => hp0 (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero hp h)
    have hpos := (dotProduct_star_self_pos_iff (v := aeval A p *ᵥ b)).mpr hv0
    simpa only [μ, pow_two, integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure, star_trivial] using hpos
  have hmin0 : (∫ x, (vectorMinpoly A b).eval x ^ 2 ∂μ) = 0 := by
    simp only [μ, pow_two, integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure,
      aeval_vectorMinpoly_mulVec, zero_dotProduct]
  have hs := (integral_sq_eval_eq_zero_iff (vectorMinpoly A b)
    (hμ.integrable_sq _)).mp hmin0
  have hsub : μ.support ⊆ ((vectorMinpoly A b).roots.toFinset : Set ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    simpa only [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset,
      mem_roots (vectorMinpoly_monic A b).ne_zero, IsRoot.def] using hs x hx
  have hcard : (vectorMinpoly A b).roots.toFinset.card ≤ krylovGrade A b := by
    exact (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans
      ((card_roots' _).trans_eq (natDegree_vectorMinpoly A b))
  exact le_antisymm ((Set.encard_mono hsub).trans (by exact_mod_cast hcard)) hle

name: NLAlib.posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_spectralMeasure_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_spectralMeasure_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (hankelMomentMatrix
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b))
      q).PosDef ↔ q ≤ krylovGrade A b
proof:
:= by
  rw [posDef_hankelMomentMatrix_iff_le_support_encard,
    support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

name: NLAlib.dilation_pow_two_mul
statement:
theorem dilation_pow_two_mul (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    dilation B ^ (2 * k) = fromBlocks ((B * Bᵀ) ^ k) 0 0 ((Bᵀ * B) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul, dilation_sq, fromBlocks_diagonal_pow]
  simp only [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.dilation_pow_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem dilation_pow_two_mul_add_one (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    dilation B ^ (2 * k + 1) =
      fromBlocks 0 (((B * Bᵀ) ^ k) * B) (((Bᵀ * B) ^ k) * Bᵀ) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, dilation_pow_two_mul, dilation, fromBlocks_multiply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
    conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_two_mul_spectralMeasure_dilation
statement:
theorem integral_pow_two_mul_spectralMeasure_dilation (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, x ^ (2 * k) ∂spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)) =
      ∫ x, x ^ k ∂spectralMeasure (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) u
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_pow_spectralMeasure, integral_pow_spectralMeasure, dilation_pow_two_mul]
  simp [fromBlocks_mulVec, Function.comp_def, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_two_mul_add_one_spectralMeasure_dilation
statement:
theorem integral_pow_two_mul_add_one_spectralMeasure_dilation (B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, x ^ (2 * k + 1) ∂spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_pow_spectralMeasure, dilation_pow_two_mul_add_one]
  simp [fromBlocks_mulVec, dotProduct, Fintype.sum_sum_type]

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_X_sq
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_X_sq (B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) (p.comp (X ^ 2)) =
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) u)
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [add_comp, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq
  | monomial k c =>
    rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, mul_comp, C_comp, pow_comp, X_comp,
      ← pow_mul, C_mul', C_mul', map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_pow, eval_X]
    simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using integral_pow_two_mul_spectralMeasure_dilation B u k

name: NLAlib.polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_neg_X
statement:
theorem polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_neg_X (B : Matrix m n ℝ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) (p.comp (-X)) =
    polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0))
      (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure _ _) p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [add_comp, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hp hq
  | monomial k c =>
    simp only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X, eval_monomial]
    rw [show (fun x : ℝ => c * (-x) ^ k) =
      (fun x => (c * (-1) ^ k) * x ^ k) by funext x; rw [neg_pow]; ring,
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    by_cases hk : Even k
    · rw [hk.neg_one_pow, mul_one]
    · obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hk
      rw [integral_pow_two_mul_add_one_spectralMeasure_dilation]
      simp

name: NLAlib.ae_mem_eigenvalue_finset
statement:
private theorem ae_mem_eigenvalue_finset {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : ι → ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂spectralMeasure hA b, x ∈ univ.image hA.eigenvalues
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ᵐ x ∂spectralMeasure hA b, x ∈ Set.range hA.eigenvalues := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    exact spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues hA b
  filter_upwards [hr] with x hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact mem_image.mpr ⟨i, mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.map_neg_spectralMeasure_dilation
statement:
theorem map_neg_spectralMeasure_dilation (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) :
    Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => -x)
      (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)) =
      spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let s := univ.image (isHermitian_dilation B).eigenvalues
  have hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s := ae_mem_eigenvalue_finset _ _
  apply measure_eq_of_integral_eval_eq_of_finite_carrier (s.image (fun x => -x) ∪ s)
  · apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) ((s.image (fun x => -x) ∪ s).finite_toSet.measurableSet)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    exact mem_union_left _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    exact mem_union_right _ hx
  · intro p
    rw [integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop) p.continuous.stronglyMeasurable]
    have h := polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_neg_X B u p
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_comp, eval_neg, eval_X] using h

name: NLAlib.map_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation
statement:
theorem map_sq_spectralMeasure_dilation (B : Matrix m n ℝ) (u : m → ℝ) :
    Measure.map (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
      (spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)) =
      spectralMeasure (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) u
proof:
:= by
  let μ := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_dilation B) (Sum.elim u 0)
  let ν := spectralMeasure (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) u
  let s := univ.image (isHermitian_dilation B).eigenvalues
  let t := univ.image (isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B).eigenvalues
  have hs : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s := ae_mem_eigenvalue_finset _ _
  have ht : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ t := ae_mem_eigenvalue_finset _ _
  apply measure_eq_of_integral_eval_eq_of_finite_carrier (s.image (fun x => x ^ 2) ∪ t)
  · apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) ((s.image (fun x => x ^ 2) ∪ t).finite_toSet.measurableSet)).mpr
    filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
    exact mem_union_left _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  · filter_upwards [ht] with x hx
    exact mem_union_right _ hx
  · intro p
    rw [integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop) p.continuous.stronglyMeasurable]
    have h := polynomialIntegral_spectralMeasure_dilation_comp_X_sq B u p
    simpa only [polynomialIntegral_apply, eval_comp, eval_pow, eval_X] using h

name: NLAlib.norm_sq_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_le_quadForm_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem norm_sq_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_le_quadForm_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f (leftRadauJacobiMatrix L q a) 0 0 ≤ quadForm (cfc f A) b := by
  dsimp only
  have hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have h := mass_mul_cfc_leftRadauJacobiMatrix_le_integral_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hac (spectralMeasure_ae_mem_interval hA b hspec)
    q hs hf hf' hD hpos
  rw [spectral_polynomialIntegral_one, integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 1, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 1) f x) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
    quadForm (cfc f A) b ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f (rightRadauJacobiMatrix L q c) 0 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have hs : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have h := integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_rightRadauJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hac (spectralMeasure_ae_mem_interval hA b hspec)
    q hs hf hf' hD hpos
  rw [spectral_polynomialIntegral_one, integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
statement:
theorem quadForm_le_norm_sq_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c)
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Icc a c) (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 2 ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a c))
    (hf' : ∀ k < 2 * q + 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDeriv k f) (Ioo a c))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f) (Ioo a c))
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a c, 0 ≤ iteratedDeriv (2 * q + 2) f x) :
    let L
proof:
:= polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure hA b) (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b)
    quadForm (cfc f A) b ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 * cfc f (lobattoJacobiMatrix L q a c) 0 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have hs : (q + 2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard := by
    rw [support_encard_spectralMeasure_eq_krylovGrade]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hs' : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ (spectralMeasure hA b).support.encard :=
    ((by exact_mod_cast (show q + 1 ≤ q + 2 by omega) : (q + 1 : ℕ∞) ≤ q + 2).trans hs)
  have hμac := spectralMeasure_ae_mem_interval hA b hspec
  obtain ⟨hJa, hJc⟩ := orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix_endpoint_shifts_posDef
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hμac (q + 1) (by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using hs)
  have h := integral_le_mass_mul_cfc_lobattoJacobiMatrix_of_iteratedDeriv_nonneg
    (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure hA b) hac hμac q hs' hJa hJc hf hf' hD hpos
  rw [spectral_polynomialIntegral_one, integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm] at h
  exact h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.exists_col_eq_aeval
statement:
theorem exists_col_eq_aeval (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : Fin q) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree = j ∧ D.Q.col j = aeval A p *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpj⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ _).1 (D.graded.col_mem j)
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hpj⟩
  have hnot : ¬ p.degree < j := fun hlt => by
    have h0 := D.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero j
      ((mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ _).2 ⟨p, hlt, hpj⟩)
    rw [D.hasOrthonormalCols.col_dotProduct_col, if_pos rfl] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · exact absurd (by rw [hp0, degree_zero]; exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _) hnot
  have h1 : p.natDegree < (j : ℕ) + 1 := (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 hp
  have h2 : ¬ p.natDegree < (j : ℕ) := fun h => hnot ((natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).1 h)
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp0]
  exact congrArg _ (show p.natDegree = (j : ℕ) by omega)

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly
statement: theorem degree_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) : (D.poly j).degree = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [poly, dif_pos hj]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (D.exists_col_eq_aeval ⟨j, hj⟩)).1

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.vec_eq_aeval_poly
statement:
theorem vec_eq_aeval_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) :
    D.vec j = aeval A (D.poly j) *ᵥ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [vec, poly]
  split_ifs with hj
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (D.exists_col_eq_aeval ⟨j, hj⟩)).2
  · simp

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.degree_poly_le
statement: theorem degree_poly_le (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (j : ℕ) : (D.poly j).degree ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < q
  · rw [D.degree_poly hj]
  · rw [poly, dif_neg hj, degree_zero]; exact bot_le

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_poly_mul_poly
statement:
theorem integral_poly_mul_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i j : ℕ}
    (hi : i < q) :
    ∫ x, (D.poly i).eval x * (D.poly j).eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA b =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure, ← vec_eq_aeval_poly, ← vec_eq_aeval_poly,
    D.vec_of_lt hi, col_dotProduct_vec]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.isHermitian_T
statement: theorem isHermitian_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : D.T.IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul D.Q hA

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.X_mul_poly
statement:
theorem X_mul_poly (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ} (hj : j + 1 < q) :
    X * D.poly j = C (D.beta j) * D.poly (j - 1) + C (D.alpha j) * D.poly j +
      C (D.beta (j + 1)) * D.poly (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (A := A) (b := b) ?_ ?_
  · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
    · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_mul_le _ _) ?_
      rw [degree_X]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (add_le_add le_rfl (D.degree_poly_le j)) ?_
      have : ((1 + j : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) < krylovGrade A b := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 + j < krylovGrade A b by have := D.le_krylovGrade; omega)
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have hd : ∀ (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ), k ≤ j + 1 → (C c * D.poly k).degree < krylovGrade A b :=
        fun c k hk => lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_mul_le _ _) (lt_of_le_of_lt
          (add_le_add degree_C_le (D.degree_poly_le k)) (by
            rw [zero_add]
            exact_mod_cast (show k < krylovGrade A b by have := D.le_krylovGrade; omega)))
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_add_le _ _) (max_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_add_le _ _)
        (max_lt (hd _ _ (by omega)) (hd _ _ (by omega)))) (hd _ _ le_rfl))
  · simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, aeval_X, aeval_C, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← vec_eq_aeval_poly, D.mulVec_vec_eq hA hj,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_self]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul
statement:
theorem sub_mul_sum_eval_poly_mul (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {m : ℕ}
    (hm0 : 0 < m) (hm : m < q) (x y : ℝ) :
    (x - y) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (D.poly j).eval x * (D.poly j).eval y =
      D.beta m * ((D.poly m).eval x * (D.poly (m - 1)).eval y -
        (D.poly (m - 1)).eval x * (D.poly m).eval y)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    have hrec := D.X_mul_poly hA (j := m) (by omega)
    have hx := congrArg (eval x) hrec
    have hy := congrArg (eval y) hrec
    simp only [eval_mul, eval_X, eval_C, eval_add] at hx hy
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0'
    · have hb0 : D.beta 0 = 0 := by simp [beta]
      simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, zero_add, hb0, zero_mul,
        Nat.sub_self] at hx hy ⊢
      linear_combination (D.poly 0).eval y * hx - (D.poly 0).eval x * hy
    · rw [ih hm0' (by omega)]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      linear_combination (D.poly m).eval y * hx - (D.poly m).eval x * hy

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.integral_eval_charpoly_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_eval_charpoly_mul_eq_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {r : ℝ[X]} (hr : r.degree < q) :
    ∫ x, D.T.charpoly.eval x * r.eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure]
  
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : aeval A r *ᵥ b ∈ LinearMap.range D.Q.mulVecLin := by
    rw [D.range_Q]; exact (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b q _).2 ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  rw [← hy, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    transpose_mulVec_aeval_mulVec_eq D.hasOrthonormalCols b D.range_Q.ge
      (natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.1 (by rw [charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, Fintype.card_fin])),
    ← ArnoldiDecomp.H_def, aeval_self_charpoly, Matrix.zero_mulVec, zero_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_T_monic
statement:
theorem charpoly_T_monic (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) :
    D.T.charpoly.Monic ∧ D.T.charpoly.natDegree = q
proof:
:=
  ⟨charpoly_monic _, by rw [charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, Fintype.card_fin]⟩

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.leadingCoeff_poly_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun p => coeff p (k + 1)) (D.X_mul_poly hA hk)
  simp only [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_mul] at h
  have hdk : (D.poly k).natDegree = k := natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (D.degree_poly (by omega))
  have hdk1 : (D.poly (k + 1)).natDegree = k + 1 :=
    natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (D.degree_poly hk)
  have h1 : (D.poly (k - 1)).coeff (k + 1) = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (D.degree_poly_le _) (by exact_mod_cast (by omega)))
  have h2 : (D.poly k).coeff (k + 1) = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (D.degree_poly_le _) (by exact_mod_cast (by omega)))
  rw [h1, h2, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, zero_add] at h
  rw [leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff, hdk, hdk1, h]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.leadingCoeff_poly_zero_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [ih (by omega), leadingCoeff_poly_eq D hA hj, Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    ring

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero
statement:
theorem charpoly_restrict_T_mul_poly_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j < q) :
    (LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict hj.le)).charpoly * D.poly 0 =
      C (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * D.poly j
proof:
:= by
  set D' : LanczosDecomp A b j := D.restrict hj.le
  set χ := (LanczosDecomp.T D').charpoly
  have hχdeg : χ.natDegree = j := by rw [charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hχ0 : D'.Qᵀ *ᵥ (aeval A χ *ᵥ b) = 0 := by
    rw [transpose_mulVec_aeval_mulVec_eq D'.hasOrthonormalCols b D'.range_Q.ge
      (natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.1 hχdeg.le), ← ArnoldiDecomp.H_def, aeval_self_charpoly,
      Matrix.zero_mulVec]
  have hmem : aeval A χ *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b (j + 1) := by
    refine (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ _).2 ⟨χ, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree (charpoly_monic _).ne_zero, hχdeg]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self j
  
  set c := D.vec j ⬝ᵥ (aeval A χ *ᵥ b)
  have hvec : aeval A χ *ᵥ b = c • D.vec j := by
    refine D.eq_of_forall_col_dotProduct_eq (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) hmem)
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (D.vec_mem j)) fun i => ?_
    rw [dotProduct_smul, col_dotProduct_vec, smul_eq_mul]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) j with hij | hij | hij
    · rw [if_neg hij.ne, mul_zero]
      have := congrFun hχ0 ⟨i, hij⟩
      exact this
    · rw [if_pos hij, mul_one]
      show _ = D.vec j ⬝ᵥ _
      rw [D.vec_of_lt hj]
      exact congrArg (fun k => D.Q.col k ⬝ᵥ _) (Fin.ext hij)
    · rw [if_neg hij.ne', mul_zero]
      exact D.graded.col_dotProduct_eq_zero i (krylovSpace_mono A b (by omega) hmem)
  
  have hχ : χ = C c * D.poly j := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    refine eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero (A := A) (b := b) ?_ ?_
    · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sub_le _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
      · rw [degree_eq_natDegree (charpoly_monic _).ne_zero, hχdeg]
        exact_mod_cast (show j < krylovGrade A b by have := D.le_krylovGrade; omega)
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_mul_le _ _) (lt_of_le_of_lt
          (add_le_add degree_C_le (D.degree_poly_le j)) ?_)
        rw [zero_add]
        exact_mod_cast (show j < krylovGrade A b by have := D.le_krylovGrade; omega)
    · rw [map_sub, Matrix.sub_mulVec, hvec, map_mul, aeval_C, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        ← vec_eq_aeval_poly, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
        Matrix.one_mulVec, sub_self]
  
  have hlead : c * (D.poly j).leadingCoeff = 1 := by
    have := (charpoly_monic (LanczosDecomp.T D')).leadingCoeff
    rw [show (LanczosDecomp.T D').charpoly = χ from rfl, hχ, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C]
      at this
    exact this
  have hp0 : D.poly 0 = C (D.poly 0).leadingCoeff := by
    have hd : (D.poly 0).natDegree = 0 :=
      natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some (D.degree_poly (by omega))
    conv_lhs => rw [eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hd]
    rw [leadingCoeff, hd]
  have hc : c * ((∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * (D.poly j).leadingCoeff) =
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k := by
    linear_combination (∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 j, D.beta k) * hlead
  rw [hχ, hp0, leadingCoeff_poly_zero_eq D hA hj, mul_right_comm, ← map_mul, hc]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.restrict_T_eq
statement:
private lemma restrict_T_eq (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) :
    LanczosDecomp.T (D.restrict h) =
      ((1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE h))ᵀ * D.T *
        (1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T, ArnoldiDecomp.H_restrict]
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.hasOrthonormalCols_submatrix_one
statement:
private lemma hasOrthonormalCols_submatrix_one {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) :
    HasOrthonormalCols ((1 : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE h))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Fin.castLE_inj]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_restrict_T_le (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {q' : ℕ}
    (h : q' ≤ q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin q'))) :
    (isHermitian_T (D.restrict h) hA).eigenvalues₀ i ≤
      (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ (Fin.castLE (by simpa using h) i)
proof:
:= by
  have hE := hasOrthonormalCols_submatrix_one h
  have key := Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_compression_le (D.isHermitian_T hA) hE
    i
  convert key using 2
  rw [restrict_T_eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T
statement:
theorem eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_restrict_T (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {q' : ℕ} (h : q' ≤ q) (i : Fin (Fintype.card (Fin q'))) :
    (D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues₀ ⟨i + (Fintype.card (Fin q) - Fintype.card (Fin q')),
      by have
proof:
:= i.isLt; simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this ⊢; omega⟩ ≤
      (isHermitian_T (D.restrict h) hA).eigenvalues₀ i := by
  have hE := hasOrthonormalCols_submatrix_one h
  have key := Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀_le_eigenvalues₀_compression (D.isHermitian_T hA) hE
    i
  convert key using 2
  rw [restrict_T_eq, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.cfc_T_apply_zero_zero
statement:
theorem cfc_T_apply_zero_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hq : 0 < q)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f D.T ⟨0, hq⟩ ⟨0, hq⟩ = ∑ i, f ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
      ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum (D.isHermitian_T hA) f (Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ 1)
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero _ (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q)
    fun i hi => Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi _] at h
  simpa only [Pi.single_eq_same, one_pow, one_mul, dotProduct_single, mul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero
statement:
theorem sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_T_apply_zero (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) : ∑ i, ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct (D.isHermitian_T hA) (Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ 1)
  simpa [dotProduct_single] using h

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_cfc_T_mulVec_eq_sum (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f D.T *ᵥ (D.Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) = (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ∑ i,
      f ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec_eq_of_apply_eq_zero _ (⟨0, hq⟩ : Fin q) fun i hi =>
      D.transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_eq_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => hi (Fin.ext h)),
    D.sq_transpose_Q_mulVec_apply_zero hq, cfc_T_apply_zero_zero D hA hq]

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (hq : 0 < q) {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.degree < 2 * q) :
    b ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) = (b ⬝ᵥ b) * ∑ i,
      p.eval ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, hq⟩) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hAs : A.IsSymm := by
    rw [Matrix.IsSymm, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA
  rw [D.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq hAs hq hp,
    ← cfc_polynomial p D.T (D.isHermitian_T hA).isSelfAdjoint, cfc_T_apply_zero_zero D hA hq]

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesState_succ
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesState_succ (t w : n → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    discreteStieltjesState t w (j + 1) = discreteStieltjesStep t w (discreteStieltjesState t w j)
proof:
:=
