  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: NLAlib.weightedRayleigh_eq_dotProduct
statement:
private theorem weightedRayleigh_eq_dotProduct (t w p : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) :
    weightedRayleigh t w p = weightVector w p ⬝ᵥ (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedRayleigh, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, dotProduct, weightVector]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    w r * p r * (t r * p r) = Real.sqrt (w r) ^ 2 * p r * (t r * p r) := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw r)]
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.weightedNorm_eq_norm
statement:
private theorem weightedNorm_eq_norm (w p : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) :
    weightedNorm w p = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (weightVector w p)‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (weightVector w p)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ r, w r * p r ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simp only [dotProduct, weightVector]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    calc
      _ = Real.sqrt (w r) ^ 2 * p r ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hw r)]
  unfold weightedNorm
  rw [← hsq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.weightVector_smul
statement:
private theorem weightVector_smul (w p : n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    weightVector w (a • p) = a • weightVector w p
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp only [weightVector, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: NLAlib.weightState_step
proof:
:= by
  let v := fun r => t r * s.cur r - weightedRayleigh t w s.cur * s.cur r - s.beta * s.prev r
  have hv : diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur -
      (weightVector w s.cur ⬝ᵥ (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur)) • weightVector w s.cur -
      s.beta • weightVector w s.prev = weightVector w v := by
    rw [← weightedRayleigh_eq_dotProduct t w s.cur hw]
    ext r
    simp only [v, weightVector, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Pi.sub_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  change LanczosState.mk (weightVector w s.cur) (weightVector w ((weightedNorm w v)⁻¹ • v))
      (weightedNorm w v) =
    LanczosState.mk (weightVector w s.cur)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur -
          (weightVector w s.cur ⬝ᵥ (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur)) • weightVector w s.cur -
          s.beta • weightVector w s.prev)‖⁻¹ •
        (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur -
          (weightVector w s.cur ⬝ᵥ (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur)) • weightVector w s.cur -
          s.beta • weightVector w s.prev))
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur -
          (weightVector w s.cur ⬝ᵥ (diagonal t *ᵥ weightVector w s.cur)) • weightVector w s.cur -
          s.beta • weightVector w s.prev)‖
  rw [hv, weightedNorm_eq_norm w v hw, weightVector_smul]

name: NLAlib.weightState_init
statement:
private theorem weightState_init (w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) :
    weightState w (discreteStieltjesInit w) = lanczosInit (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : Real.sqrt (∑ r, w r) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))‖ := by
    have hvec : weightVector w (fun _ => 1) = fun r => Real.sqrt (w r) := by
      ext r
      simp only [weightVector, mul_one]
    have hn := weightedNorm_eq_norm w (fun _ => 1) hw
    rw [hvec] at hn
    simpa only [weightedNorm, one_pow, mul_one] using hn
  unfold weightState discreteStieltjesInit lanczosInit
  congr 1
  · ext r
    simp [weightVector]
  · ext r
    simp only [weightVector, hnorm, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring

name: NLAlib.weightState_discreteStieltjesState
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact weightState_init w hw
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [discreteStieltjesState_succ, weightState_step t w hw, ih, lanczosState_succ]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_eq_mul_discreteStieltjesValues
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_eq_mul_discreteStieltjesValues
    (t w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (j : ℕ) (r : n) :
    lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j r =
      Real.sqrt (w r) * discreteStieltjesValues t w j r
proof:
:= by
  exact congrFun (congrArg LanczosState.cur (weightState_discreteStieltjesState t w hw j)).symm r

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_lanczosAlpha
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_lanczosAlpha (t w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (j : ℕ) :
    discreteStieltjesAlpha t w j = lanczosAlpha (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteStieltjesAlpha lanczosAlpha
  rw [weightedRayleigh_eq_dotProduct t w _ hw]
  have hcur := congrArg LanczosState.cur (weightState_discreteStieltjesState t w hw j)
  change weightVector w (discreteStieltjesValues t w j) =
    lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j at hcur
  rw [hcur]

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesBeta_eq_lanczosBeta
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesBeta_eq_lanczosBeta (t w : n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ r, 0 ≤ w r) (j : ℕ) :
    discreteStieltjesBeta t w j = lanczosBeta (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg LanczosState.beta (weightState_discreteStieltjesState t w hw j)
  exact h

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesBeta_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem discreteStieltjesBeta_zero (t w : n → ℝ) :
    discreteStieltjesBeta t w 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesMonicBeta_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem discreteStieltjesMonicBeta_zero (t w : n → ℝ) :
    discreteStieltjesMonicBeta t w 0 = ∑ r, w r
proof:
:= by
  simp [discreteStieltjesMonicBeta]

name: NLAlib.spectralMeasure_univ
statement:
theorem spectralMeasure_univ {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : n → ℝ) :
    spectralMeasure hA v Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v, spectralMeasure,
    ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _]
  simp

name: NLAlib.spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem spectralMeasure_compl_range_eigenvalues {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (v : n → ℝ) : spectralMeasure hA v (Set.range hA.eigenvalues)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [spectralMeasure, Measure.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Measure.dirac_apply, Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simp), mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_spectralMeasure {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : n → ℝ)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ∫ x, f x ∂spectralMeasure hA v = v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA f v, spectralMeasure,
    integral_finsetSum_measure fun i _ =>
      (integrable_dirac (by simp)).smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_smul_measure, integral_dirac, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _), smul_eq_mul,
    mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_eval_spectralMeasure {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : n → ℝ)
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ∫ x, p.eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA v = v ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_spectralMeasure hA v, cfc_polynomial p A hA.isSelfAdjoint]

name: NLAlib.integral_pow_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_pow_spectralMeasure {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (v : n → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) : ∫ x, x ^ k ∂spectralMeasure hA v = v ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ k) *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using integral_eval_spectralMeasure hA v (Polynomial.X ^ k)

name: NLAlib.integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_eval_mul_eval_spectralMeasure {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (p p' : ℝ[X]) :
    ∫ x, p.eval x * p'.eval x ∂spectralMeasure hA b = (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p' *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_eval_spectralMeasure hA b (p * p')
  simp only [eval_mul] at h
  rw [h, map_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    transpose_aeval hA]

name: NLAlib.integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm
statement:
theorem integral_spectralMeasure_eq_quadForm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (v : n → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ∫ x, f x ∂spectralMeasure hA v = quadForm (cfc f A) v
proof:
:=
  integral_spectralMeasure hA v f

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pow_mul_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
    (hM.pow i).eq]

name: NLAlib.mulVec_pow_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    simpa using mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ
      (hK (by simpa using pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hj))
  | succ j ih =>
    have ih := ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hj)
    have hstep : (Qᵀ * A * Q) ^ (j + 1) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) = Qᵀ *ᵥ (A ^ (j + 1) *ᵥ b) := by
      rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ih,
        show A *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ b) = A ^ (j + 1) *ᵥ b by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']]
    rw [hstep]
    exact mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ (hK (pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b hj))

name: NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_pow_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have hmem := hK (pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A b (show j < q by omega))
    calc Qᵀ *ᵥ (A ^ (j + 1) *ᵥ b) = Qᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ b)) := by
          rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      _ = Qᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (Q *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ b)))) := by
          rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q,
            mulVec_conjTranspose_mulVec_of_mem_range hQ hmem]
      _ = (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ (A ^ j *ᵥ b)) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ ((Qᵀ * A * Q) ^ j *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) := by rw [ih (by omega)]
      _ = (Qᵀ * A * Q) ^ (j + 1) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← pow_succ']

name: NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_aeval_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp0
  · simp
  have hnat : p.natDegree ≤ q := (natDegree_le_iff_degree_le).2 hp
  rw [aeval_eq_sum_range, aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.sum_mulVec, Matrix.sum_mulVec,
    Matrix.mulVec_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
    transpose_mulVec_pow_mulVec_eq hQ b hK
      ((Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)).trans hnat)]

name: NLAlib.isSymm_of_isHermitian
statement: private lemma isSymm_of_isHermitian {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : A.IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.IsSymm, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.IsSymm := isSymm_of_isHermitian hA'
  set B := Qᵀ * A * Q with hBdef
  set c := Qᵀ *ᵥ b
  have hB : B.IsSymm :=
    Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA')
  have hlift := fun {j : ℕ} (hj : j < q) => mulVec_pow_transpose_mul_mul_mulVec_eq hQ b hK hj
  have hQQ : ∀ x y : k → ℝ, (Q *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ y) = x ⬝ᵥ y := fun x y => by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hBv : ∀ w : k → ℝ, B *ᵥ w = Qᵀ *ᵥ (A *ᵥ (Q *ᵥ w)) := fun w => by
    simp only [hBdef, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hQt : ∀ (x : k → ℝ) (z : n → ℝ), x ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ z) = (Q *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ z := fun x z => by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  
  have hsplit0 : ∀ i j, i < q → j < q →
      b ⬝ᵥ (A ^ (i + j) *ᵥ b) = c ⬝ᵥ (B ^ (i + j) *ᵥ c) := fun i j hi hj => by
    rw [pow_add, pow_add, dotProduct_pow_mul_mulVec hA, dotProduct_pow_mul_mulVec hB,
      ← hlift hi, ← hlift hj, hQQ]
  have hsplit1 : ∀ i j, i < q → j < q →
      b ⬝ᵥ (A ^ (i + 1 + j) *ᵥ b) = c ⬝ᵥ (B ^ (i + 1 + j) *ᵥ c) := fun i j hi hj => by
    rw [add_assoc, pow_add A, pow_add A 1, pow_one, pow_add B, pow_add B 1, pow_one,
      dotProduct_pow_mul_mulVec hA,
      dotProduct_pow_mul_mulVec hB, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBv, hQt,
      hlift hi, hlift hj]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (2 * q - 1) with hlt | hge
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, rfl⟩ : ∃ i j, i < q ∧ j < q ∧ m = i + j :=
      ⟨min m (q - 1), m - min m (q - 1), by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
    exact hsplit0 i j hi hj
  · obtain rfl : m = (q - 1) + 1 + (q - 1) := by omega
    exact hsplit1 _ _ (by omega) (by omega)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_of_degree_lt_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp0
  · simp
  have hnat : p.natDegree < 2 * q := by
    have := (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hp0).2 (by exact_mod_cast hp)
    exact this
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range, Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range, Matrix.sum_mulVec,
    Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum, dotProduct_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq hA hQ b hK
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hm)) hnat)]

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_mem_Icc {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {a c : ℝ}
    (hspec : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc a c) (j : k) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ∈ Set.Icc a c
proof:
:= by
  have hB : (Qᴴ * A * Q).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA
  change hB.eigenvalues j ∈ Set.Icc a c
  have hw : (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : k → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : k → ℝ) = 1 := by
    simpa using eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eigenvectorBasis hB j j
  have hval := eigenvalues_eq_dotProduct_mulVec hB j
  generalize (hB.eigenvectorBasis j : k → ℝ) = w at hw hval
  have hQw : (Q *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ (Q *ᵥ w) = 1 := by
    have h := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ w
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    rw [h, hw]
  have hval' : hB.eigenvalues j = (Q *ᵥ w) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (Q *ᵥ w)) := by
    rw [hval]
    change w ⬝ᵥ ((Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ w) = _
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec w Qᵀ, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  have h1 := mul_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mulVec_of_eigenvalues hA (fun i => (hspec i).1)
    (Q *ᵥ w)
  have h2 := dotProduct_mulVec_le_mul_dotProduct_of_eigenvalues hA (fun i => (hspec i).2)
    (Q *ᵥ w)
  rw [hQw, mul_one] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨hval' ▸ h1, hval' ▸ h2⟩

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_le
statement:
private lemma abs_dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Polynomial ℝ} {E : ℝ} (hfp : ∀ i, |f (hA.eigenvalues i) -
      p.eval (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ E) (v : n → ℝ) :
    |v ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ v) - v ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ v)| ≤ E * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cfc_polynomial p A hA.isSelfAdjoint, dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA,
    dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_eq_sum hA, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul, abs_sq]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfp i) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.abs_dotProduct_cfc_mulVec_sub_le_of_degree_lt_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have hB : (Qᵀ * A * Q).IsHermitian := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA)
  have hexact := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_eq_of_degree_lt_two_mul hA hQ b hK hp
  have h1 := abs_dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_le hA (fun i => hfp _ (hspec i)) b
  have h2 := abs_dotProduct_cfc_sub_aeval_le hB
    (fun j => hfp _ (eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_mem_Icc hA hQ hspec j)) (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)
  have hcc : (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ≤ b ⬝ᵥ b := by
    have h := sum_norm_sq_conjTranspose_mulVec_le hQ b
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
    simpa only [dotProduct, ← sq] using h
  have h2' : |(Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) -
      (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval (Qᵀ * A * Q) p *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b))| ≤ E * (b ⬝ᵥ b) := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 E with hE0 | hE0
    · exact h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcc hE0)
    · have hbb0 : 0 ≤ b ⬝ᵥ b := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
      have hbb : b ⬝ᵥ b = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (by nlinarith [(abs_nonneg _).trans h1]) hbb0
      obtain rfl : b = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hbb
      simp
  have : b ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ b) - (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) =
      (b ⬝ᵥ (cfc f A *ᵥ b) - b ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval A p *ᵥ b)) -
        ((Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (cfc f (Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b)) -
          (Qᵀ *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (Polynomial.aeval (Qᵀ * A * Q) p *ᵥ (Qᵀ *ᵥ b))) := by
    rw [hexact]; ring
  rw [this]
  refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
  linarith

name: NLAlib.recurrenceMatrix_eq_arnoldiMatrix
statement:
private theorem recurrenceMatrix_eq_arnoldiMatrix {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    (Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin q) => lanczosRecurrence A b j.val r) = arnoldiMatrix A b q
proof:
:= by
  ext r j
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply, arnoldiMatrix, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis hA]

name: NLAlib.norm_toLp_sqrt_eq_sqrt_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))‖ ^ 2 = ∑ r, w r := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simp only [dotProduct, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (hw _)]
  rw [← hs, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin N) =>
      lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j.val r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [recurrenceMatrix_eq_arnoldiMatrix (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)]
  apply hasOrthonormalCols_arnoldiMatrix
  rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one
statement:
theorem lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mul_conjTranspose_eq_one
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    let Q
proof:
:= Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin N) =>
      lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j.val r
    Q * Qᴴ = 1 :=
  (hasOrthonormalCols_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt t w ht hw).mul_conjTranspose_self

name: NLAlib.transpose_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_jacobi
statement:
theorem transpose_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mul_diagonal_mul_eq_jacobi
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    let Q
proof:
:= Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin N) =>
      lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j.val r
    Qᵀ * diagonal t * Q = orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) N := by
  dsimp only
  rw [recurrenceMatrix_eq_arnoldiMatrix (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)]
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := by
    rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]
  exact T_arnoldiDecomp_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)
    (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) hq

name: NLAlib.transpose_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mulVec_sqrt_eq_single
statement:
theorem transpose_lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_mulVec_sqrt_eq_single
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let Q
proof:
:= Matrix.of fun r (j : Fin N) =>
      lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j.val r
    Qᵀ *ᵥ (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) =
      Pi.single ⟨0, hN⟩ (Real.sqrt (discreteStieltjesMonicBeta t w 0)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [recurrenceMatrix_eq_arnoldiMatrix (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t),
    discreteStieltjesMonicBeta_zero, ← norm_toLp_sqrt_eq_sqrt_sum w (fun r => (hw r).le)]
  apply transpose_arnoldiMatrix_mulVec_eq_single (diagonal t) _ hN
  rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_diagonal_sqrt_pos
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_diagonal_sqrt_pos (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t)
    (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) {j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j < N) :
    0 < lanczosBeta (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j
proof:
:= by
  apply lanczosBeta_pos (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) _ hj0
  rwa [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]

name: NLAlib.lanczosBeta_diagonal_sqrt_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lanczosBeta_diagonal_sqrt_eq_zero (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t)
    (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    lanczosBeta (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply lanczosBeta_eq_zero_of_krylovGrade_le (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t)
  rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < N) :
    discreteStieltjesAlpha t w j = orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) j
proof:
:= by
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := by
    rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]
  let D : LanczosDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N :=
    arnoldiDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N hq
  calc
    _ = lanczosAlpha (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j :=
      discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_lanczosAlpha t w (fun r => (hw r).le) j
    _ = D.alpha j := lanczosAlpha_eq_alpha (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) _ hq hj
    _ = _ := (D.orthogonalRecurrenceAlpha_spectralMeasure_eq_alpha (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) hj).symm

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesMonicBeta_eq_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesMonicBeta_eq_orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r)
    {j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    discreteStieltjesMonicBeta t w j = orthogonalRecurrenceBeta
      (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
        (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) j
proof:
:= by
  have hgrade := krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := hgrade.symm.le
  let D : LanczosDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N :=
    arnoldiDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N hq
  rw [discreteStieltjesMonicBeta, if_neg (ne_of_gt hj0),
    discreteStieltjesBeta_eq_lanczosBeta t w (fun r => (hw r).le)]
  by_cases hlt : j < N
  · rw [lanczosBeta_eq_beta (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) _ hq hlt]
    exact (D.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) hlt).symm
  · have heq : j = N := by omega
    subst j
    rw [D.orthogonalRecurrenceBeta_spectralMeasure_eq_beta_sq_of_eq_grade
      (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) hgrade.symm,
      lanczosBeta_diagonal_sqrt_eq_zero t w ht hw]
    simp [LanczosDecomp.beta]

name: NLAlib.jacobiMatrix_discreteStieltjes_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
statement:
theorem jacobiMatrix_discreteStieltjes_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    jacobiMatrix (discreteStieltjesAlpha t w) (discreteStieltjesBeta t w) N =
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
        (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
          (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) N
proof:
:= by
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := by
    rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]
  rw [show discreteStieltjesAlpha t w = lanczosAlpha (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))
      from funext (discreteStieltjesAlpha_eq_lanczosAlpha t w (fun r => (hw r).le)),
    show discreteStieltjesBeta t w = lanczosBeta (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r))
      from funext (discreteStieltjesBeta_eq_lanczosBeta t w (fun r => (hw r).le)),
    jacobiMatrix_lanczosAlpha_lanczosBeta_eq_T (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) _ hq,
    T_arnoldiDecomp_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) _ hq]

name: NLAlib.jacobiMatrix_discreteStieltjesAlpha_sqrt_monicBeta_eq
statement:
theorem jacobiMatrix_discreteStieltjesAlpha_sqrt_monicBeta_eq
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) :
    jacobiMatrix (discreteStieltjesAlpha t w)
      (fun j => Real.sqrt (discreteStieltjesMonicBeta t w j)) N =
      orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix
        (polynomialIntegral (spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))
          (hasPolynomialMoments_spectralMeasure (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)))) N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← jacobiMatrix_discreteStieltjes_eq_orthogonalPolynomialJacobiMatrix t w ht hw]
  have hbeta (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ discreteStieltjesBeta t w j := by
    rw [discreteStieltjesBeta_eq_lanczosBeta t w (fun r => (hw r).le)]
    exact lanczosBeta_nonneg _ _ _
  ext i j
  simp only [jacobiMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  split_ifs with hij hupper hlower
  · rfl
  · rw [discreteStieltjesMonicBeta, if_neg (by omega : j.val ≠ 0), Real.sqrt_sq (hbeta j.val)]
  · rw [discreteStieltjesMonicBeta, if_neg (by omega : i.val ≠ 0), Real.sqrt_sq (hbeta i.val)]
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.discreteStieltjesValues_eq_eval_lanczosPoly
statement:
theorem discreteStieltjesValues_eq_eval_lanczosPoly
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < N)
    (r : Fin N) :
    discreteStieltjesValues t w j r =
      (LanczosDecomp.poly (arnoldiDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N
        (by rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw])) j).eval (t r)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := by
    rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]
  let D : LanczosDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N :=
    arnoldiDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N hq
  have hpoly := D.Q_apply_diagonal_sqrt_eq_eval_poly_mul r ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hcur : D.Q r ⟨j, hj⟩ = lanczosRecurrence (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) j r := by
    simp only [D, arnoldiDecomp_Q, arnoldiMatrix, lanczosRecurrence_eq_arnoldiBasis
      (Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal t), Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [hcur, lanczosRecurrence_diagonal_sqrt_eq_mul_discreteStieltjesValues t w
    (fun r => (hw r).le)] at hpoly
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hw r)).ne' hpoly

name: NLAlib.sum_discreteStieltjesValues_mul_eq_div_weight
statement:
theorem sum_discreteStieltjesValues_mul_eq_div_weight
    (t w : Fin N → ℝ) (ht : Function.Injective t) (hw : ∀ r, 0 < w r) (r s : Fin N) :
    (∑ j : Fin N, discreteStieltjesValues t w j.val r * discreteStieltjesValues t w j.val s) =
      (if r = s then 1 else 0) / w r
proof:
:= by
  have hq : N ≤ krylovGrade (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) := by
    rw [krylovGrade_diagonal_sqrt_eq_card t w ht hw]
  let D : LanczosDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N :=
    arnoldiDecomp (diagonal t) (fun r => Real.sqrt (w r)) N hq
  have heval (j : Fin N) (r : Fin N) :
      discreteStieltjesValues t w j.val r = (D.poly j.val).eval (t r) :=
    discreteStieltjesValues_eq_eval_lanczosPoly t w ht hw j.isLt r
  simp_rw [heval]
  exact D.sum_eval_poly_mul_eval_poly_eq_div_weight hw r s

name: NLAlib.LanczosDecomp.spectralMeasure_T_first_total_eq_sum_dirac
statement:
theorem LanczosDecomp.spectralMeasure_T_first_total_eq_sum_dirac
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b : n → ℝ} {q : ℕ}
    (D : LanczosDecomp A b q) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    spectralMeasure (D.isHermitian_T hA) (fun j : Fin q => if j.val = 0 then ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ else 0) =
      ∑ i : Fin q, ENNReal.ofReal ((b ⬝ᵥ b) *
        ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvectorBasis i ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt⟩) ^ 2) •
        Measure.dirac ((D.isHermitian_T hA).eigenvalues i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralMeasure
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  have hfirst : (fun j : Fin q => if j.val = 0 then ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ else 0) =
      Pi.single ⟨0, hq⟩ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  rw [hfirst, dotProduct_single, mul_pow, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  congr 2
  ring

name: NLAlib.IsQR.headColumns_isQR
statement:
theorem IsQR.headColumns_isQR {M Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : IsQR M Q R)
    (hj : j ≤ n) :
    IsQR (headColumns M hj) (headColumns Q hj) (R.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : IsFullQR (headColumns M hj) Q (R.submatrix id (Fin.castLE hj)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, h.orth, ?_⟩
    · rw [h.eq]; ext i l; rfl
    · intro i l hil
      exact h.upper hil
  exact hf.isQR_castLE hj

name: NLAlib.IsQR.range_headColumns_eq_of_isUnit_overlap
statement:
theorem IsQR.range_headColumns_eq_of_isUnit_overlap
    {M Q R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (h : IsQR M Q R) (hj : j ≤ n)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin j) ℝ) (hU : IsUnit (Uᵀ * headColumns M hj)) :
    LinearMap.range (headColumns M hj).mulVecLin = LinearMap.range (headColumns Q hj).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have ht := h.headColumns_isQR hj
  have hi : IsUnit (R.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)) := by
    rw [ht.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_mul] at hU
    exact (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hU)
  exact ht.range_mulVecLin_eq (ht.isUnit_det_iff.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hi))

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithm_head_overlap_isUnit
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithm_head_overlap_isUnit
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (hj : j ≤ n) (hd : ∀ i : Fin j, d (Fin.castLE hj i) ≠ 0)
    (hΩ : IsUnit ((headColumns Q hj)ᵀ * headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj))
    {k : ℕ} (hqr : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    IsUnit ((headColumns Q hj)ᵀ * headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj) ∧
    LinearMap.range (headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.range (headColumns (A ^ k) hj).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have hUV : headColumns Q hj * (headColumns Q hj)ᵀ +
      tailColumns Q hj * (tailColumns Q hj)ᵀ = 1 := by
    rw [headColumns_projector_add_tailColumns_projector]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  have hAU : A * headColumns Q hj = headColumns Q hj *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => d (Fin.castLE hj i)) := by
    rw [mul_headColumns, hAQ, headColumns_mul_diagonal]
  have hAV : A * tailColumns Q hj = tailColumns Q hj *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => d ⟨j+i.val, by omega⟩) := by
    rw [mul_tailColumns, hAQ, tailColumns_mul_diagonal]
  have hi := isUnit_transpose_mul_pow_mul (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hQ hj)
    (hasOrthonormalCols_tailColumns hQ hj) hUV hAU hAV hd hΩ k
  rw [mul_headColumns, Matrix.mul_one] at hi
  have ht := (isQR_pow_qrAlgorithm hqr).headColumns_isQR hj
  have hi' := hi
  rw [ht.eq, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_mul] at hi'
  exact ⟨(Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hi'),
    ((isQR_pow_qrAlgorithm hqr).range_headColumns_eq_of_isUnit_overlap hj _ hi).symm⟩

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_qrAlgorithm_head_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_qrAlgorithm_head_le
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (hj : j ≤ n) {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin j, α ≤ |d (Fin.castLE hj i)|)
    (he : ∀ i : Fin (n-j), |d ⟨j+i.val, by omega⟩| ≤ β)
    (hΩ : IsUnit ((headColumns Q hj)ᵀ * headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj))
    {k : ℕ} (hqr : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj) (headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj) ≤
      (β / α) ^ k * overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj)
        (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj)
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 (i : Fin j) : d (Fin.castLE hj i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hi := hd i
    rw [hz, abs_zero] at hi
    linarith
  have hUV : headColumns Q hj * (headColumns Q hj)ᵀ +
      tailColumns Q hj * (tailColumns Q hj)ᵀ = 1 := by
    rw [headColumns_projector_add_tailColumns_projector]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  apply overlapTangentNorm_le_of_range_eq_subspaceIterate
    (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hQ hj) (hasOrthonormalCols_tailColumns hQ hj) hUV
    (by rw [mul_headColumns, hAQ, headColumns_mul_diagonal])
    (by rw [mul_tailColumns, hAQ, tailColumns_mul_diagonal]) hα hβ hd he hΩ rfl
  simpa only [subspaceIterate, mul_headColumns, Matrix.mul_one] using
    (qrAlgorithm_head_overlap_isUnit hQ hAQ hj hd0 hΩ hqr).2

name: NLAlib.specNorm_sub_frame_projector_le_overlapTangentNorm
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Uᵀ = Uᴴ from rfl, show Wᵀ = Wᴴ from rfl,
    specNorm_sub_frame_projector_eq_residual hU hW]
  have hc : specNorm (Uᵀ * W) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := specNorm_mul_le Uᵀ W
    rw [specNorm_transpose] at h
    exact h.trans (by nlinarith [specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hU,
      specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hW, specNorm_nonneg U, specNorm_nonneg W])
  have hi := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (Uᵀ * W) ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hUW)
  calc
    specNorm (projResidual U W) =
        specNorm (projResidual U W * (Uᵀ * W)⁻¹ * (Uᵀ * W)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hi, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ ≤ overlapTangentNorm U W * specNorm (Uᵀ * W) := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ overlapTangentNorm U W := by
      nlinarith [overlapTangentNorm_nonneg U W]

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_sub_frame_projector_le_overlapTangentNorm
statement:
theorem frobNorm_sub_frame_projector_le_overlapTangentNorm {U W : Matrix m k ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hW : HasOrthonormalCols W) (hUW : IsUnit (Uᵀ * W)) :
    frobNorm (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Fintype.card k) * overlapTangentNorm U W
proof:
:= by
  have hg := specNorm_sub_frame_projector_le_overlapTangentNorm hU hW hUW
  change specNorm (U * Uᴴ - W * Wᴴ) ≤ _ at hg
  rw [specNorm_sub_frame_projector_eq_residual hU hW] at hg
  have hF := frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq (projResidual U W) (1 : Matrix k k ℝ)
  have hone : frobSq (1 : Matrix k k ℝ) = Fintype.card k := by
    simp [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [Matrix.mul_one, hone] at hF
  have he := frobSq_sub_frame_projector_eq_two_mul_residual hU hW
  have hs := frobNorm_sq (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ)
  change _ = frobSq (U * Uᴴ - W * Wᴴ) at hs
  rw [he] at hs
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hg 2) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card k by positivity)
  have hr := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card k by positivity)
  have hn := overlapTangentNorm_nonneg U W
  have hp : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Fintype.card k) * overlapTangentNorm U W := by positivity
  nlinarith [frobNorm_nonneg (U * Uᵀ - W * Wᵀ)]

name: NLAlib.add_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_mul_of_isQR
proof:
:= by
  have hQQ : Qᵀ * Q = 1 := h.orth
  have hR : Qᵀ * (H - μ • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) = R := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial Q] using h.conjTranspose_mul_eq
  rw [← hR, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul, hQQ, sub_add_cancel]

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithm_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem qrAlgorithm_zero : qrAlgorithm qr μ A 0 = A
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithm_succ
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithm_succ (k : ℕ) :
    qrAlgorithm qr μ A (k + 1) =
      (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A k).2 * (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A k).1 +
        μ k • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.QRAlgorithmSucceeds.mono
statement:
theorem QRAlgorithmSucceeds.mono {k k' : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) (hk : k' ≤ k) :
    QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k'
proof: := fun j hj => h j (lt_of_lt_of_le hj hk)

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithmSucceeds_of_forall_isQR
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithmSucceeds_of_forall_isQR
    (hqr : ∀ M, IsQR M (qr M).1 (qr M).2) (k : ℕ) : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ => hqr _

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    (qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k)ᵀ * qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [qrAlgorithmQ]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hQ : (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A k).1ᵀ * (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A k).1 = 1 :=
      (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).orth
    rw [qrAlgorithmQ, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k)ᵀ, ih (h.mono (Nat.le_succ k)), Matrix.one_mul, hQ]

name: NLAlib.isUpperTriangular_qrAlgorithmR
statement:
theorem isUpperTriangular_qrAlgorithmR {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    (qrAlgorithmR qr μ A k).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact Matrix.blockTriangular_one
  | succ k ih =>
    exact (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)).upper.mul (ih (h.mono (Nat.le_succ k)))

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    qrAlgorithm qr μ A k = (qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k)ᵀ * A * qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [qrAlgorithmQ]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [qrAlgorithm_succ, add_smul_one_eq_transpose_mul_mul_of_isQR (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
      ih (h.mono (Nat.le_succ k)), qrAlgorithmQ, Matrix.transpose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.mul_qrAlgorithmQ_eq
statement:
theorem mul_qrAlgorithmQ_eq {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    A * qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k = qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k * qrAlgorithm qr μ A k
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ h
  have hQ' : qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k * (qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k)ᵀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ
  rw [qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul h, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ',
    Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.aeval_prod_eq_qrAlgorithmQ_mul_qrAlgorithmR
statement:
theorem aeval_prod_eq_qrAlgorithmQ_mul_qrAlgorithmR {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    aeval A (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, (X - C (μ j))) =
      qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k * qrAlgorithmR qr μ A k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [qrAlgorithmQ, qrAlgorithmR]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)
    have hk' := h.mono (Nat.le_succ k)
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ_comm, map_mul, ih hk', map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.sub_mul,
      mul_qrAlgorithmQ_eq hk', Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul,
      show qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k * qrAlgorithm qr μ A k - μ k • qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k =
        qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A k * (qrAlgorithm qr μ A k - μ k • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) by
          rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one],
      hk.eq, qrAlgorithmQ, qrAlgorithmR]
    simp only [qrAlgorithmFactors, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.pow_eq_qrAlgorithmQ_mul_qrAlgorithmR
proof:
:= by
  rw [← aeval_prod_eq_qrAlgorithmQ_mul_qrAlgorithmR h]
  simp

name: NLAlib.isQR_pow_qrAlgorithm
statement:
theorem isQR_pow_qrAlgorithm {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    IsQR (A ^ k) (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) (qrAlgorithmR qr (fun _ => 0) A k) where
  eq
proof:
:= pow_eq_qrAlgorithmQ_mul_qrAlgorithmR h
  orth := transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ h
  upper := isUpperTriangular_qrAlgorithmR h

name: NLAlib.range_qrAlgorithmQ_castLE_eq_subspaceIterate
statement:
theorem range_qrAlgorithmQ_castLE_eq_subspaceIterate (hA : IsUnit A.det) {k : ℕ}
    (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    LinearMap.range ((qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hj)).mulVecLin =
      subspaceIterate A ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hj)) k
proof:
:= by
  have hQR := isQR_pow_qrAlgorithm h
  have hdet : IsUnit (qrAlgorithmR qr (fun _ => 0) A k).det := by
    have hprod : IsUnit ((qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k).det *
        (qrAlgorithmR qr (fun _ => 0) A k).det) := by
      rw [← Matrix.det_mul, ← hQR.eq, Matrix.det_pow]
      exact hA.pow k
    exact (IsUnit.mul_iff.mp hprod).2
  have hR := hQR.isUnit_det_iff.mp hdet
  have hselect : A ^ k * (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hj) =
      (A ^ k).submatrix id (Fin.castLE hj) := by
    simpa only [Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.id_comp] using
      Matrix.mul_submatrix_one (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) (Fin.castLE hj) (A ^ k)
  rw [subspaceIterate, hselect]
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp [Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hj0
  rw [Matrix.range_mulVecLin, Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  exact (hQR.isGradedColumnBasis hR).nested ⟨i, by omega⟩

name: NLAlib.isHermitian_qrAlgorithm
statement:
theorem isHermitian_qrAlgorithm (hA : A.IsHermitian) {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k) :
    (qrAlgorithm qr μ A k).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul h]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul _ hA

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithmFactors_snd_apply_self_ne_zero
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithmFactors_snd_apply_self_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k)
    (hμ : ∀ j < k, IsUnit (A - μ j • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < k)
    (i : Fin n) : (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A j).2 i i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hj' : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A j := h.mono hj.le
  have hQ := transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ hj'
  set Q := qrAlgorithmQ qr μ A j
  have hsim : qrAlgorithm qr μ A j - μ j • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) =
      Qᵀ * (A - μ j • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) * Q := by
    rw [qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul hj', Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hQ]
  have hdetQ : Qᵀ.det * Q.det = 1 := by rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hQ, Matrix.det_one]
  have hdet : IsUnit (qrAlgorithm qr μ A j - μ j • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)).det := by
    rw [hsim, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, mul_comm Qᵀ.det, mul_assoc, hdetQ, mul_one]
    exact hμ j hj
  have hqr := h j hj
  rw [hqr.eq, Matrix.det_mul] at hdet
  exact hqr.isUnit_det_iff.1 (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hdet) i

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm (hA : IsUpperHessenberg A) {k : ℕ}
    (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k)
    (hR : ∀ j < k, ∀ i, (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A j).2 i i ≠ 0) :
    IsUpperHessenberg (qrAlgorithm qr μ A k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact hA
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := ih (h.mono (Nat.le_succ k)) fun j hj => hR j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)
    rw [qrAlgorithm_succ]
    exact (isUpperHessenberg_mul_of_isQR (hk.sub_smul_one (μ k)) (h k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
      (hR k (Nat.lt_succ_self k))).add_smul_one (μ k)

name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_qrAlgorithm
statement:
theorem isTridiagonal_qrAlgorithm (hS : A.IsHermitian) (hA : IsTridiagonal A) {k : ℕ}
    (h : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr μ A k)
    (hR : ∀ j < k, ∀ i, (qrAlgorithmFactors qr μ A j).2 i i ≠ 0) :
    IsTridiagonal (qrAlgorithm qr μ A k)
proof:
:=
  (isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm hA.1 h hR).isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian (isHermitian_qrAlgorithm hS h)

name: NLAlib.isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm_givensQR
statement:
theorem isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm_givensQR (hA : IsUpperHessenberg A) (k : ℕ) :
    IsUpperHessenberg (qrAlgorithm givensQR μ A k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact hA
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [qrAlgorithm_succ]
    exact (isUpperHessenberg_givensQR_snd_mul_fst (ih.sub_smul_one (μ k))).add_smul_one (μ k)

name: NLAlib.qrAlgorithmSucceeds_givensQR
statement:
theorem qrAlgorithmSucceeds_givensQR (hA : IsUpperHessenberg A) (k : ℕ) :
    QRAlgorithmSucceeds givensQR μ A k
proof:
:= fun j _ =>
  isQR_givensQR ((isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm_givensQR hA j).sub_smul_one (μ j))

name: NLAlib.isTridiagonal_qrAlgorithm_givensQR
statement:
theorem isTridiagonal_qrAlgorithm_givensQR (hS : A.IsHermitian) (hA : IsTridiagonal A) (k : ℕ) :
    IsTridiagonal (qrAlgorithm givensQR μ A k)
proof:
:=
  (isUpperHessenberg_qrAlgorithm_givensQR hA.1 k).isTridiagonal_of_isHermitian
    (isHermitian_qrAlgorithm hS (qrAlgorithmSucceeds_givensQR hA.1 k))

name: NLAlib.exists_isQR_isUpperHessenberg_not_isUpperHessenberg_mul
statement:
theorem exists_isQR_isUpperHessenberg_not_isUpperHessenberg_mul :
    ∃ A Q R : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      IsQR A Q R ∧ IsUpperHessenberg A ∧ ¬ IsUpperHessenberg (R * Q)
proof:
:= by
  let A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := !![0, 0, 0; 0, 1, 0; 0, 0, 2]
  let Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := !![3 / 5, 0, 4 / 5; 0, 1, 0; 4 / 5, 0, -(3 / 5)]
  let R : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := !![0, 0, 8 / 5; 0, 1, 0; 0, 0, -(6 / 5)]
  have heq : A = Q * R := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [A, Q, R, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q := by
    change Qᴴ * Q = 1
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [Q, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hR : R.IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [R] at *
  refine ⟨A, Q, R, ⟨heq, hQ, hR⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [A] at *
  · intro h
    have hbad := h 2 0 (by decide)
    norm_num [Q, R, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail] at hbad

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.sum_sq_coordinates_erase_eq_norm_sub_sq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_coordinates_erase_eq_norm_sub_sq (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i))‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hA.sum_sq_norm_eigenvectorCoordinates,
    ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  simp only [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_sub, hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul,
    Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_eigenvectorBasis]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one, sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero,
    not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp [(Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_eq_norm_sub_div
statement:
theorem tangent_eq_norm_sub_div (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - (star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) •
        ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i))‖ / ‖star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [tangent, tangentSq, sum_sq_coordinates_erase_eq_norm_sub_sq]
  rw [Real.sqrt_div (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _),
    Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_apply]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis
statement:
theorem eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u) :
    u = hA.eigenvectorCoordinates u i • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_injective
  ext j
  rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_eigenvectorBasis]
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · simp [hj]
  · rw [if_neg hj, mul_zero]
    have he := hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec u j
    rw [hu, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜),
      hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at he
    have hsub : ((hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i : ℝ) : 𝕜) *
        hA.eigenvectorCoordinates u j = 0 := by
      rw [RCLike.ofReal_sub, sub_mul, he, sub_self]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hsub).resolve_left
      (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hsimple j hj)))

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_eq_norm_sub_div_of_eigenvector
statement:
theorem tangent_eq_norm_sub_div_of_eigenvector (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - (star u ⬝ᵥ x) • u)‖ / ‖star u ⬝ᵥ x‖
proof:
:= by
  have heu := eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis hA hsimple hu
  let c := hA.eigenvectorCoordinates u i
  have hc : ‖c‖ = 1 := by
    rw [heu, WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul] at hu1
    simpa only [WithLp.toLp_ofLp, OrthonormalBasis.norm_eq_one, mul_one] using hu1
  have hcc : star c * c = 1 := by
    rw [RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, hc]
    norm_num
  have hover : star u ⬝ᵥ x = star c * (star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    rw [heu, star_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hproj : (star u ⬝ᵥ x) • u =
      (star ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) ⬝ᵥ x) • ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) := by
    rw [hover, heu, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    change (star c * _) * c = _
    rw [mul_right_comm, hcc, one_mul]
  rw [hproj, hover, norm_mul, norm_star, hc, one_mul]
  exact tangent_eq_norm_sub_div hA i x

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.coordinate_ne_zero_iff_overlap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coordinate_ne_zero_iff_overlap_ne_zero (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n}
    (hsimple : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvalues j ≠ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {u : n → 𝕜} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues i • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0 ↔ star u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have heu := eq_coordinate_smul_eigenvectorBasis hA hsimple hu
  have hc : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates u i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_smul] at heu
    rw [heu] at hu1
    simp at hu1
  rw [heu, star_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul,
    ← hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_apply]
  simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, star_eq_zero, hc, false_or]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.exact_eigenvector_of_tangentSq_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2) = 0 :=
    (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hq).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx))
  have hcoords : ∀ j, j ≠ i → hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hsq := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)).mp hsum j
      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (by nlinarith)
  constructor
  · apply hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_injective
    ext j
    rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜),
      hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · simp [hj]
    · simp [hcoords j hj]
  · have hnum : (∑ j, hA.eigenvalues j * ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2) =
        hA.eigenvalues i * ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
      · intro j _ hj; simp [hcoords j hj]
      · simp
    have hden : (∑ j, ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2) =
        ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
      · intro j _ hj; simp [hcoords j hj]
      · simp
    rw [hA.rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates, hnum, hden,
      mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx))]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_pos_of_not_eigenvector
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x)
  intro hzero
  have he := exact_eigenvector_of_tangentSq_eq_zero hA hx hzero.symm
  exact hnot (by rw [he.2]; exact he.1)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_unique
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_unique [Unique n] (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ = 1) :
    A *ᵥ x = rayleighQuotient A x • x
proof:
:= by
  have hc : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x default ≠ 0 := by
    have hp := hA.sum_sq_norm_eigenvectorCoordinates x
    simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, hx, one_pow] at hp
    intro hz
    simp [hz] at hp
  have hq : tangentSq hA default x = 0 := by
    simp [tangentSq, Finset.univ_unique]
  have he := exact_eigenvector_of_tangentSq_eq_zero hA hc hq
  rw [he.2]
  exact he.1

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_le_gap_div_four
statement:
theorem error_le_gap_div_four {g M q e : ℝ} (_hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hlocal : q ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (he : e ≤ M * q / (1 + q)) : e ≤ g / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 1 + q := by positivity
  have hMq : M * q ≤ g / 4 := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * M by positivity)).mp hlocal
    nlinarith
  have hfrac : M * q / (1 + q) ≤ M * q := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM.le hq) hq]
  exact he.trans (hfrac.trans hMq)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_div_gap_sub_le
statement:
theorem error_div_gap_sub_le {g e : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (heg : e ≤ g / 4) : e / (g - e) ≤ 2 * e / g
proof:
:= by
  have hge : 0 < g - e := by linarith
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hge hg).2
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg he (show 0 ≤ g - 2 * e by linarith)]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_sq_cubic_le
statement:
theorem tangent_sq_cubic_le {g M q e q' : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hlocal : q ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (herr : e ≤ M * q / (1 + q))
    (hstep : q' ≤ (e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q) :
    q' ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3 ∧ q' ≤ q / 4
proof:
:= by
  have heg := error_le_gap_div_four hg hM hq hlocal herr
  have hfrac := error_div_gap_sub_le hg he heg
  have hden : 0 < 1 + q := by positivity
  have heMq : e ≤ M * q := by
    apply herr.trans
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM.le hq) hq]
  have hratio : e / (g - e) ≤ 2 * M / g * q := by
    apply hfrac.trans
    calc
      2 * e / g ≤ 2 * (M * q) / g := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hg.le
      _ = 2 * M / g * q := by ring
  have hge : 0 < g - e := by linarith
  have hcubic : q' ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3 := by
    calc
      q' ≤ (e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q := hstep
      _ ≤ (2 * M / g * q) ^ 2 * q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hratio 2) hq
      _ = (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3 := by ring
  have hsmall : 2 * M / g * q ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * M by positivity)).mp hlocal
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).2
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hg).2
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hcubic, ?_⟩
  calc
    q' ≤ (2 * M / g * q) ^ 2 * q := by nlinarith [hcubic]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 * q :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hsmall 2) hq
    _ = q / 4 := by ring

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_le_tangent_sq_cube
statement:
theorem error_le_tangent_sq_cube {g M q q' e' : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hstep : q' ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3) (herr : e' ≤ M * q') :
    e' ≤ (4 * M ^ 3 / g ^ 2) * q ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  calc
    e' ≤ M * q' := herr
    _ ≤ M * ((2 * M / g) ^ 2 * q ^ 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hM
    _ = (4 * M ^ 3 / g ^ 2) * q ^ 3 := by ring

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.error_step_le_cube
statement:
theorem error_step_le_cube {g M q e q' e' : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hqone : q ≤ 1) (heg : e ≤ g / 4)
    (hlower : g * q / (1 + q) ≤ e)
    (hstep : q' ≤ (e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q) (herr : e' ≤ M * q') :
    e' ≤ (8 * M / g ^ 3) * e ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hqbound : q ≤ 2 * e / g := by
    have hlow := (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 1 + q by positivity)).mp hlower
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hg).2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqone he]
  have hge : 0 < g - e := by linarith
  have hfrac := error_div_gap_sub_le hg he heg
  calc
    e' ≤ M * q' := herr
    _ ≤ M * ((e / (g - e)) ^ 2 * q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep hM
    _ ≤ M * ((2 * e / g) ^ 2 * q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hfrac 2) hq) hM
    _ ≤ M * ((2 * e / g) ^ 2 * (2 * e / g)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqbound (sq_nonneg _)) hM
    _ = (8 * M / g ^ 3) * e ^ 3 := by ring

name: NLAlib.powerIterate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerIterate_zero (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x₀ : n → ℝ) : powerIterate A x₀ 0 = x₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [powerIterate]

name: NLAlib.powerIterate_succ
statement:
theorem powerIterate_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1) = A *ᵥ powerIterate A x₀ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerIterate, powerIterate, pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.powerIterate_mem_krylovSpace
statement:
theorem powerIterate_mem_krylovSpace (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    powerIterate A x₀ k ∈ krylovSpace A x₀ (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  pow_mulVec_mem_krylovSpace A x₀ (Nat.lt_succ_self k)

name: NLAlib.span_powerIterate_eq_subspaceIterate
statement:
theorem span_powerIterate_eq_subspaceIterate (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ℝ ∙ powerIterate A x₀ k = subspaceIterate A (Matrix.replicateCol Unit x₀) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [subspaceIterate, Matrix.range_mulVecLin]
  have h : Set.range (A ^ k * Matrix.replicateCol Unit x₀).col = {powerIterate A x₀ k} := by
    rw [Set.range_unique, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
    rfl
  rw [h]

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_smul
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_smul [Fintype n] (u x : n → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    overlapTangentSq u (c • x) = overlapTangentSq u x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overlapTangentSq, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hx : u ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_smul
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_smul (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    rayleighQuotient A (c • x) = rayleighQuotient A x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rayleighQuotient_def, RCLike.re_to_real, quadForm_def, star_trivial,
    Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.inv_norm_smul_smul
statement:
theorem inv_norm_smul_smul (w : n → ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (c • w)‖⁻¹ • (c • w) = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖⁻¹ • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc,
    smul_smul, mul_inv, mul_comm c⁻¹ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 w‖⁻¹,
    mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', mul_one]

name: NLAlib.powerStep_iterate_succ
statement:
theorem powerStep_iterate_succ (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (powerStep A)^[k + 1] x₀ =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1))‖⁻¹ • powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [powerStep, powerIterate]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
    set v := powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1)
    have hv : powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1 + 1) = A *ᵥ v := powerIterate_succ A x₀ (k + 1)
    rw [hv, powerStep, Matrix.mulVec_smul]
    set c := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖⁻¹
    by_cases hc : c = 0
    · have hv0 : v = 0 := by
        have h1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ = 0 := inv_eq_zero.1 hc
        have h2 := norm_eq_zero.1 h1
        simpa using congrArg WithLp.ofLp h2
      simp [hv0]
    · exact inv_norm_smul_smul _ (lt_of_le_of_ne (inv_nonneg.2 (norm_nonneg _)) (Ne.symm hc))

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq {A B : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {f : n → ℝ} (hB : ∀ i y, (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ y) =
      f i * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y)) (k : ℕ) (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ ((B ^ k) *ᵥ v) =
      f i ^ k * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ', ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hB, ih, pow_succ']; ring

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_powerIterate_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_powerIterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |hA.eigenvalues₀ i| ≤ ρ)
    (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    overlapTangentSq u (powerIterate A x₀ k) ≤
      (ρ / |hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀|) ^ (2 * k) * overlapTangentSq u x₀
proof:
:= by
  have hM : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |(X ^ k : ℝ[X]).eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)| ≤ ρ ^ k := fun i hi => by
    rw [eval_pow, eval_X, abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hρ i hi) k
  have h := overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le hA hu hu1 hM x₀
  rw [aeval_X_pow, eval_pow, eval_X] at h
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  rw [← div_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k 2, pow_mul, pow_mul, div_pow, div_pow ρ, sq_abs]

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_powerStep_iterate_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_powerStep_iterate_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |hA.eigenvalues₀ i| ≤ ρ)
    (x₀ : n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    overlapTangentSq u ((powerStep A)^[k] x₀) ≤
      (ρ / |hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀|) ^ (2 * k) * overlapTangentSq u x₀
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k =>
    rw [powerStep_iterate_succ]
    set v := powerIterate A x₀ (k + 1)
    by_cases hc : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖⁻¹ = 0
    · rw [hc, zero_smul]
      have h0 : overlapTangentSq u 0 = 0 := by simp [overlapTangentSq]
      rw [h0]
      exact mul_nonneg ((even_two_mul _).pow_nonneg _) (overlapTangentSq_nonneg u x₀)
    · rw [overlapTangentSq_smul _ _ hc]
      exact overlapTangentSq_powerIterate_le hA hu hu1 hρ x₀ (k + 1)

name: NLAlib.abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le_mul_overlapTangentSq
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le_mul_overlapTangentSq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i, |hA.eigenvalues i - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤ D) {x : n → ℝ} (hx : u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤ D * overlapTangentSq u x
proof:
:= by
  set L := hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ with hLdef
  set c := u ⬝ᵥ x with hcdef
  set w := x - c • u with hwdef
  have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hu1, one_pow]
  have huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = 0 := by
    simp only [hwdef, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, huu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← hcdef, sub_self]
  set N := w ⬝ᵥ w with hNdef
  have hxw : x = c • u + w := by simp [hwdef]
  have hxx : x ⬝ᵥ x = c ^ 2 + N := by
    rw [hxw, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, huu, dotProduct_comm w u, huw]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  have hsymm : ∀ y z : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = (A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ z := fun y z => by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
      (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA).eq]
  have hxAx : x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = L * c ^ 2 + w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) := by
    have hAu : ∀ z : n → ℝ, u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = L * (u ⬝ᵥ z) := fun z => by
      rw [hsymm, hu, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hxw]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hAu]
    rw [hu, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_comm w u, huw, huu]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  
  have hdiff : w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) - L * N =
      ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i - L) * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 := by
    have h := quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hA w
    rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial] at h
    rw [h, hNdef, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA w, Finset.mul_sum,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  have hbound : |w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) - L * N| ≤ D * N := by
    rw [hdiff, hNdef, ← sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA w, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w))]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hD i) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hc1 : 0 < c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := dotProduct_self_nonneg w
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    have := hD (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq, sub_self, abs_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x := by rw [hxx]; exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hc1 hN
  have hq : rayleighQuotient A x - L = (x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) - L * (x ⬝ᵥ x)) / (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by
    rw [rayleighQuotient_def, RCLike.re_to_real, RCLike.re_to_real, quadForm_def, star_trivial,
      sub_div, mul_div_assoc, div_self hpos.ne', mul_one]
  rw [overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one hu1, hq, hxAx, hxx, ← hcdef, abs_div,
    abs_of_pos (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hc1 hN),
    show L * c ^ 2 + w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) - L * (c ^ 2 + N) = w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) - L * N by ring,
    show c ^ 2 + N - c ^ 2 = N by ring]
  calc _ ≤ D * N / (c ^ 2 + N) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (by positivity)
    _ ≤ D * N / c ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hD0 hN) hc1 (by linarith)
    _ = D * (N / c ^ 2) := mul_div_assoc _ _ _

name: NLAlib.abs_rayleighQuotient_powerIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_powerIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (hl : hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ ≠ 0) {ρ D : ℝ}
    (hρ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |hA.eigenvalues₀ i| ≤ ρ)
    (hD : ∀ i, |hA.eigenvalues i - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤ D) {x₀ : n → ℝ} (hx₀ : u ⬝ᵥ x₀ ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (powerIterate A x₀ k) - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤
      D * ((ρ / |hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀|) ^ (2 * k) * overlapTangentSq u x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    have := hD (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq, sub_self, abs_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hxk : u ⬝ᵥ powerIterate A x₀ k ≠ 0 := by
    have h := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul hA hu (X ^ k) x₀
    rw [aeval_X_pow, eval_pow, eval_X] at h
    rw [powerIterate, h]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hl) hx₀
  exact (abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le_mul_overlapTangentSq hA hu hu1 hD hxk).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (overlapTangentSq_powerIterate_le hA hu hu1 hρ x₀ k) hD0)

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (μ : ℝ) (y : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) *ᵥ y) =
      (hA.eigenvalues i - μ) * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec hA (X - C μ) y i
  simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using h

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_inv_sub_mulVec
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_inv_sub_mulVec {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ μ) (v : n → ℝ) (i : n) :
    (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹ *ᵥ v) =
      (hA.eigenvalues i - μ)⁻¹ * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  set B := A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)
  have hker : ∀ y, B *ᵥ y = 0 → y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    have hc : ∀ j, (hA.eigenvectorBasis j : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ y = 0 := fun j => by
      have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec hA μ y j
      rw [show B *ᵥ y = 0 from hy, dotProduct_zero] at h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h.symm).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.2 (hμ j))
    have hyy := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA y
    simp only [hc, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow,
      Finset.sum_const_zero] at hyy
    exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hyy.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective B.mulVec := fun y z h =>
    sub_eq_zero.1 (hker _ (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, h, sub_self]))
  have hB : IsUnit B := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.1 hinj
  have hBB : B *ᵥ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ v) = v := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv B ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det B).1 hB),
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_sub_smul_mulVec hA μ (B⁻¹ *ᵥ v) i
  rw [hBB] at h
  rw [h, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 (hμ i)), one_mul]

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_inverseIterate_le
proof:
:= by
  have hf := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq hA (B := (A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹)
    (f := fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - μ)⁻¹)
    (fun i y => eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_inv_sub_mulVec hA hμ y i) k
  have hM : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |(hA.eigenvalues₀ i - μ)⁻¹ ^ k| ≤ d⁻¹ ^ k := fun i hi => by
    rw [abs_pow, abs_inv]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.2 (abs_nonneg _)) (inv_anti₀ hd (hdJ i hi)) k
  have h := overlapTangentSq_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu hu1
    (g := fun x => (x - μ)⁻¹ ^ k) hM (fun i => hf x₀ i)
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  have hJ : hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - μ ≠ 0 := by
    have := hμ (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq] at this
    exact sub_ne_zero.2 this
  rw [← div_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k 2, pow_mul, pow_mul, div_pow, div_pow |_|, sq_abs]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.abs_rayleighQuotient_inverseIterate_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_inverseIterate_sub_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ≠ μ) {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ}
    (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u) (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {d D : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdJ : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → d ≤ |hA.eigenvalues₀ i - μ|)
    (hD : ∀ i, |hA.eigenvalues i - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤ D) {x₀ : n → ℝ} (hx₀ : u ⬝ᵥ x₀ ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (inverseIterate A μ x₀ k) - hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀| ≤
      D * ((|hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - μ| / d) ^ (2 * k) * overlapTangentSq u x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
    have := hD (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq, sub_self, abs_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hxk : u ⬝ᵥ inverseIterate A μ x₀ k ≠ 0 := by
    have hf := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_pow_mulVec_eq hA
      (B := (A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ))⁻¹) (f := fun i => (hA.eigenvalues i - μ)⁻¹)
      (fun i y => eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_inv_sub_mulVec hA hμ y i) k
    have h := dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu
      (g := fun x => (x - μ)⁻¹ ^ k) (fun i => hf x₀ i)
    rw [inverseIterate, powerIterate, h]
    have hJ : hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - μ ≠ 0 := by
      have := hμ (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
      rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq] at this
      exact sub_ne_zero.2 this
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hJ)) hx₀
  exact (abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le_mul_overlapTangentSq hA hu hu1 hD hxk).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (overlapTangentSq_inverseIterate_le hA hμ hu hu1 hd hdJ x₀ k) hD0)

name: NLAlib.sq_overlapTangentNorm_replicateCol_eq_overlapTangentSq
statement:
theorem sq_overlapTangentNorm_replicateCol_eq_overlapTangentSq {u : n → ℝ}
    (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → ℝ) :
    overlapTangentNorm (Matrix.replicateCol Unit u) (Matrix.replicateCol Unit x) ^ 2 =
      overlapTangentSq u x
proof:
:= by
  have hu1 : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by rw [← norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hu, one_pow]
  let a : ℝ := u ⬝ᵥ x
  have hG : (Matrix.replicateCol Unit u)ᵀ * Matrix.replicateCol Unit x =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Unit => a) := by
    ext i j
    cases i
    cases j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct, a]
  have hR : projResidual (Matrix.replicateCol Unit u) (Matrix.replicateCol Unit x) *
      ((Matrix.replicateCol Unit u)ᵀ * Matrix.replicateCol Unit x)⁻¹ =
      Matrix.replicateCol Unit (a⁻¹ • (x - a • u)) := by
    rw [hG, Matrix.inv_subsingleton]
    ext i j
    cases j
    simp [projResidual, Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct, a, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    ring
  have hr : (x - a • u) ⬝ᵥ (x - a • u) = x ⬝ᵥ x - a ^ 2 := by
    simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, hu1, dotProduct_comm x u]
    change x ⬝ᵥ x - a * a - a * (a - a * 1) = x ⬝ᵥ x - a ^ 2
    ring
  rw [overlapTangentNorm, hR, specNorm_sq_replicateCol, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  simp only [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, hr, overlapTangentSq, hu1]
  change a⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * (x ⬝ᵥ x - a ^ 2)) = (1 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) - a ^ 2) / a ^ 2
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_pow_eq_of_invariant
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_pow_eq_of_invariant {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U : Matrix n s ℝ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : U * Uᵀ + V * Vᵀ = 1) {d : s → ℝ} {e : r → ℝ} (hAU : A * U = U * diagonal d)
    (hAV : A * V = V * diagonal e) (k : ℕ) :
    Uᵀ * A ^ k = diagonal d ^ k * Uᵀ ∧ Vᵀ * A ^ k = diagonal e ^ k * Vᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU
  have hV' : Vᵀ * V = 1 := hV
  
  have hUtV : Uᵀ * V = 0 := by
    have h1 : Uᵀ * (U * Uᵀ + V * Vᵀ) = Uᵀ := by rw [hUV, Matrix.mul_one]
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU', Matrix.one_mul, add_eq_left] at h1
    have h2 := congrArg (· * V) h1
    simpa [Matrix.mul_assoc, hV'] using h2
  have hVtU : Vᵀ * U = 0 := by
    have := congrArg Matrix.transpose hUtV
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_mul] using this
  
  have hpU : ∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k * U = U * diagonal d ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_assoc, hAU, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ih, Matrix.mul_assoc,
        ← pow_succ]
  have hpV : ∀ k : ℕ, A ^ k * V = V * diagonal e ^ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ih, Matrix.mul_assoc,
        ← pow_succ]
  have hsplit : A ^ k = U * diagonal d ^ k * Uᵀ + V * diagonal e ^ k * Vᵀ := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Matrix.mul_one (A ^ k), ← hUV]
    rw [Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hpU, hpV]
  constructor
  · rw [hsplit, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU', hUtV]
    simp
  · rw [hsplit, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hV', hVtU]
    simp

name: NLAlib.isUnit_transpose_mul_pow_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, (transpose_mul_pow_eq_of_invariant hU hV hUV hAU hAV k).1,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Matrix.det_mul, diagonal_pow,
    Matrix.det_diagonal]
  refine IsUnit.mul (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ => ?_))
    ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 hΩ)
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (hd i)

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_pow_mul_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_pow_mul_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U : Matrix n s ℝ} {V : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hUV : U * Uᵀ + V * Vᵀ = 1)
    {d : s → ℝ} {e : r → ℝ} (hAU : A * U = U * diagonal d) (hAV : A * V = V * diagonal e)
    {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hd : ∀ i, α ≤ |d i|) (he : ∀ j, |e j| ≤ β)
    {Ω : Matrix n s ℝ} (hΩ : IsUnit (Uᵀ * Ω)) (k : ℕ) :
    overlapTangentNorm U (A ^ k * Ω) ≤ (β / α) ^ k * overlapTangentNorm U Ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hUk, hVk⟩ := transpose_mul_pow_eq_of_invariant hU hV hUV hAU hAV k
  have hd0 : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0 := fun i h => by
    have := hd i; rw [h, abs_zero] at this; linarith
  set Dinv : Matrix s s ℝ := diagonal fun i => (d i ^ k)⁻¹ with hDinv
  set Y : Matrix r s ℝ := Vᵀ * Ω * (Uᵀ * Ω)⁻¹ with hY
  have hΩ' : (Uᵀ * Ω)⁻¹ * (Uᵀ * Ω) = 1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 hΩ)
  
  have hUkΩ : Uᵀ * (A ^ k * Ω) = diagonal d ^ k * (Uᵀ * Ω) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hUk, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hVkΩ : Vᵀ * (A ^ k * Ω) = diagonal e ^ k * (Vᵀ * Ω) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hVk, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h1 : Dinv * diagonal d ^ k = 1 := by
    rw [hDinv, diagonal_pow, diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero k (hd0 i))]
  have hinv : (Uᵀ * (A ^ k * Ω))⁻¹ = (Uᵀ * Ω)⁻¹ * Dinv := by
    refine Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv ?_
    rw [hUkΩ, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Dinv, h1, Matrix.one_mul, hΩ']
  
  have h0 : overlapTangentNorm U Ω = specNorm Y :=
    overlapTangentNorm_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_mul U hV hUV Ω
  have hk : overlapTangentNorm U (A ^ k * Ω) = specNorm (diagonal e ^ k * Y * Dinv) := by
    rw [overlapTangentNorm_eq_specNorm_transpose_mul_mul U hV hUV, hinv, hVkΩ, hY]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  
  have hE : specNorm (diagonal e ^ k) ≤ β ^ k := by
    rw [diagonal_pow]
    refine specNorm_diagonal_le (pow_nonneg hβ k) fun j => ?_
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply, abs_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (he j) k
  have hD : specNorm Dinv ≤ (α⁻¹) ^ k := by
    refine specNorm_diagonal_le (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hα.le) k) fun i => ?_
    rw [abs_inv, abs_pow, ← inv_pow]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.2 (abs_nonneg _)) (inv_anti₀ hα (hd i)) k
  rw [hk, h0]
  calc specNorm (diagonal e ^ k * Y * Dinv)
      ≤ specNorm (diagonal e ^ k * Y) * specNorm Dinv := specNorm_mul_le _ _
    _ ≤ (specNorm (diagonal e ^ k) * specNorm Y) * (α⁻¹) ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul (specNorm_mul_le _ _) hD (specNorm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (specNorm_nonneg _) (specNorm_nonneg _))
    _ ≤ (β ^ k * specNorm Y) * (α⁻¹) ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE (specNorm_nonneg _))
          (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hα.le) k)
    _ = (β / α) ^ k * specNorm Y := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]; ring

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentNorm_le_of_range_eq_subspaceIterate
statement:
theorem overlapTangentNorm_le_of_range_eq_subspaceIterate {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {U : Matrix n s ℝ}
    {V : Matrix n r ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V)
    (hUV : U * Uᵀ + V * Vᵀ = 1) {d : s → ℝ} {e : r → ℝ} (hAU : A * U = U * diagonal d)
    (hAV : A * V = V * diagonal e) {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hd : ∀ i, α ≤ |d i|) (he : ∀ j, |e j| ≤ β) {Ω : Matrix n s ℝ} (hΩ : IsUnit (Uᵀ * Ω))
    {k : ℕ} {Q₀ Qk : Matrix n s ℝ}
    (hQ₀ : LinearMap.range Q₀.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range Ω.mulVecLin)
    (hQk : LinearMap.range Qk.mulVecLin = subspaceIterate A Ω k) :
    overlapTangentNorm U Qk ≤ (β / α) ^ k * overlapTangentNorm U Q₀
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0 := fun i h => by
    have := hd i; rw [h, abs_zero] at this; linarith
  rw [← overlapTangentNorm_eq_of_range_eq U hQk.symm
      (isUnit_transpose_mul_pow_mul hU hV hUV hAU hAV hd0 hΩ k),
    ← overlapTangentNorm_eq_of_range_eq U hQ₀.symm hΩ]
  exact overlapTangentNorm_pow_mul_le hU hV hUV hAU hAV hα hβ hd he hΩ k

name: NLAlib.qrFlagConstant_nonneg
statement: theorem qrFlagConstant_nonneg (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : 0 ≤ qrFlagConstant Q
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (overlapTangentNorm_nonneg _ _)

name: NLAlib.sqrt_mul_overlapTangentNorm_le_qrFlagConstant
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_overlapTangentNorm_le_qrFlagConstant (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * (j : ℝ)) * overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj)
      (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj) ≤ qrFlagConstant Q
