proof:
:= by
  unfold qrFlagConstant
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i : Fin (n+1) =>
    Real.sqrt (2 * (i.val : ℝ)) * overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q (show i.val ≤ n by omega))
      (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (show i.val ≤ n by omega))) (fun i _ =>
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (overlapTangentNorm_nonneg _ _))
      (Finset.mem_univ (⟨j, by omega⟩ : Fin (n+1)))

name: NLAlib.transpose_headColumns_mul_headColumns_one
statement:
theorem transpose_headColumns_mul_headColumns_one (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    (headColumns Q hj)ᵀ * headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj =
      Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_headColumns, Matrix.mul_one]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_head_projector_qrAlgorithm_le
statement:
theorem frobNorm_head_projector_qrAlgorithm_le
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|)
    (hminor : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), IsUnit (Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)))
    {k : ℕ} (hqr : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    frobNorm (headColumns Q hj * (headColumns Q hj)ᵀ -
      headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj *
        (headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj)ᵀ) ≤
      qrFlagConstant Q * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hr := maxAdjacentAbsRatio_nonneg d
  have hc := qrFlagConstant_nonneg Q
  have hW : HasOrthonormalCols (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :=
    transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ hqr
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simpa [headColumns, Matrix.mul_apply] using mul_nonneg hc (pow_nonneg hr k)
  by_cases hjn : j = n
  · subst j
    have hf (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : headColumns Z le_rfl = Z := by ext a b; rfl
    rw [hf, hf]
    change frobNorm (Q * Qᴴ - _ * (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k)ᴴ) ≤ _
    rw [mul_eq_one_comm.mp hQ, mul_eq_one_comm.mp hW, sub_self, frobNorm_zero]
    positivity
  have hjlt : j < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hj hjn
  let a : Fin n := ⟨j-1, by omega⟩
  let b : Fin n := ⟨j, hjlt⟩
  have hab : a < b := by change j-1 < j; omega
  have ha : 0 < |d a| := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) (hd hab)
  have hlower (i : Fin j) : |d a| ≤ |d (Fin.castLE hj i)| := by
    exact hd.antitone (show Fin.castLE hj i ≤ a by change i.val ≤ j-1; omega)
  have hupper (i : Fin (n-j)) : |d ⟨j+i.val, by omega⟩| ≤ |d b| := by
    exact hd.antitone (show b ≤ (⟨j+i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin n) by change j ≤ j+i.val; omega)
  have ho : IsUnit ((headColumns Q hj)ᵀ * headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj) := by
    rw [transpose_headColumns_mul_headColumns_one]
    exact hminor j hj
  have hd0 (i : Fin j) : d (Fin.castLE hj i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := hlower i
    rw [hz, abs_zero] at h
    linarith
  have hi := (qrAlgorithm_head_overlap_isUnit hQ hAQ hj hd0 ho hqr).1
  have hg := frobNorm_sub_frame_projector_le_overlapTangentNorm
    (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hQ hj) (hasOrthonormalCols_headColumns hW hj) hi
  have ht := overlapTangentNorm_qrAlgorithm_head_le hQ hAQ hj ha (abs_nonneg _) hlower hupper ho hqr
  have hratio : |d b| / |d a| ≤ maxAdjacentAbsRatio d := by
    simpa only [a, b, show j-1+1=j by omega] using adjacentAbsRatio_le_max d a (by dsimp [a]; omega)
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hratio k
  have hsum := sqrt_mul_overlapTangentNorm_le_qrFlagConstant Q hj
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hg
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (j : ℝ)) * overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj)
        (headColumns (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) hj) := hg
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * (j : ℝ)) * ((|d b| / |d a|)^k *
        overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj) (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * (j : ℝ)) * overlapTangentNorm (headColumns Q hj)
        (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj)) * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow
        (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * (j:ℝ)))
          (overlapTangentNorm_nonneg (headColumns Q hj) (headColumns (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) hj)))]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum (pow_nonneg hr k)

name: NLAlib.exists_signs_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_le
statement:
theorem exists_signs_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_le
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|)
    (hminor : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), IsUnit (Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)))
    {k : ℕ} (hqr : QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, s i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      frobNorm (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) ≤
        (2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q) * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k ∧
      frobNorm (qrAlgorithm qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Matrix.diagonal d) ≤
        (2 * specNorm A * (2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q)) * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hW : HasOrthonormalCols (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :=
    transpose_mul_self_qrAlgorithmQ hqr
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hb⟩ := exists_signs_frobNorm_sub_le_of_head_projectors hQ hW
    (mul_nonneg (qrFlagConstant_nonneg Q) (pow_nonneg (maxAdjacentAbsRatio_nonneg d) k))
    (fun j hj => frobNorm_head_projector_qrAlgorithm_le hQ hAQ hd hminor hqr hj)
  have hb' : frobNorm (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) ≤
        (2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q) * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k := by
    convert hb using 1; ring
  refine ⟨s, hs, hb', ?_⟩
  have hsdiag : (Matrix.diagonal s)ᵀ * Matrix.diagonal s = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    nlinarith [hs i]
  have hV : HasOrthonormalCols (Q * Matrix.diagonal s) := by
    change (Q * Matrix.diagonal s)ᴴ * (Q * Matrix.diagonal s) = 1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ,
      hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
    exact hsdiag
  have hdiag : Qᵀ * A * Q = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAQ, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    change (Qᴴ * Q) * Matrix.diagonal d = _
    rw [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hrepr : (Q * Matrix.diagonal s)ᵀ * A * (Q * Matrix.diagonal s) = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    calc
      _ = Matrix.diagonal s * (Qᵀ * A * Q) * Matrix.diagonal s := by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.diagonal s * Matrix.diagonal d * Matrix.diagonal s := by rw [hdiag]
      _ = Matrix.diagonal d := by
        rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
        congr 1
        funext i
        change (s i * d i) * s i = d i
        calc
          _ = d i * s i ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = d i := by rw [hs i, mul_one]
  rw [qrAlgorithm_eq_transpose_mul_mul hqr, ← hrepr]
  have hp := frobNorm_conjTranspose_mul_mul_sub_le A hW hV
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hp
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * specNorm A * frobNorm (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) := hp
    _ ≤ 2 * specNorm A * ((2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q) * maxAdjacentAbsRatio d ^ k) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb' (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (specNorm_nonneg A))
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.tendsto_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ
statement:
theorem tendsto_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d)
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|)
    (hminor : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), IsUnit (Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)))
    (hqr : ∀ k, QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    Tendsto (fun k => frobNorm (qrAlgorithm qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Matrix.diagonal d)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∃ s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ, (∀ k i, s k i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => frobNorm (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k - Q * Matrix.diagonal (s k)))
          atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (maxAdjacentAbsRatio_nonneg d)
    (maxAdjacentAbsRatio_lt_one hd)
  choose s hs hframe hiter using fun k => exists_signs_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_le hQ hAQ hd hminor (hqr k)
  constructor
  · apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => frobNorm_nonneg _) hiter
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hp.const_mul (2 * specNorm A * (2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q))
  · refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => frobNorm_nonneg _) hframe
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hp.const_mul (2 * Real.sqrt n * qrFlagConstant Q)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_next_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_next_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .next y ↔
      A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧
        IsUnit (A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) ∧ step A x = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold advance
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_breakdown_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_breakdown_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .breakdown ↔ A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧
      ¬ IsUnit (A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold advance
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.advance_eq_success_iff
statement:
theorem advance_eq_success_iff (A : Matrix n n 𝕜) (x y : n → 𝕜) :
    advance A x = .success y ↔ A *ᵥ x = rayleighQuotient A x • x ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold advance
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_invariants
statement:
theorem run_invariants (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) (k : ℕ) :
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x k) i ≠ 0 ∧ tangentSq hA i (x k) ≤ g / (4 * M)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨hx, hlocal⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [hstep]
    exact ⟨(step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA ih.1 (hshift k)).2.1,
      tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood hA hg hM hgap hdiam ih.1 ih.2 (hshift k)⟩

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_tangent_le
statement:
theorem run_tangent_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) (k : ℕ) :
    tangent hA i (x (k + 1)) ≤ (2 * M / g) * tangent hA i (x k) ^ 3 ∧
      tangent hA i (x k) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * tangent hA i (x 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := run_invariants hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift
  have hcontract (j : ℕ) := tangent_step_le hA hg hM hgap hdiam
    (hinv j).1 (hinv j).2 (hshift j)
  constructor
  · rw [hstep]; exact (hcontract k).1
  · induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [hstep]
      calc
        _ ≤ tangent hA i (x k) / 2 := (hcontract k).2
        _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * tangent hA i (x 0)) / 2 := by linarith
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * tangent hA i (x 0) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_tangent_run
statement:
theorem tendsto_tangent_run (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => tangent hA i (x k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).mul_const
      (tangent hA i (x 0))
  simp only [zero_mul] at hpow
  exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (fun k => (run_tangent_le hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift k).2) hpow

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_rayleighQuotient_run
statement:
theorem tendsto_rayleighQuotient_run (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hstep : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = step A (x k))
    (hshift : ∀ k j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A (x k)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => rayleighQuotient A (x k)) atTop (𝓝 (hA.eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := tendsto_tangent_run hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift
  have hq : Tendsto (fun k => M * tangent hA i (x k) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (ht.pow 2).const_mul M
  have herr (k : ℕ) : |rayleighQuotient A (x k) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      M * tangent hA i (x k) ^ 2 := by
    rw [tangent_sq]
    have hinv := run_invariants hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift k
    apply (abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hinv.1).trans
    have hnonneg := tangentSq_nonneg hA i (x k)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 1 + tangentSq hA i (x k) by positivity)).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM.le hnonneg) hnonneg]
  have he := squeeze_zero (fun k => abs_nonneg (rayleighQuotient A (x k) - hA.eigenvalues i))
    herr hq
  exact tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using he)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvalue_eq_of_advance_success
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨heig, rfl⟩ := (advance_eq_success_iff A x y).mp hsuccess
  have hc := congrArg (fun v => hA.eigenvectorCoordinates v i) heig
  rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_mulVec, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜),
    hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hc
  have heq : hA.eigenvalues i = rayleighQuotient A x :=
    RCLike.ofReal_injective (mul_right_cancel₀ hx hc)
  exact ⟨rfl, heq.symm, by simpa only [heq] using heig⟩

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tendsto_of_advance_next
statement:
theorem tendsto_of_advance_next (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : ℕ → n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (x 0) i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i (x 0) ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hadvance : ∀ k, advance A (x k) = .next (x (k + 1))) :
    Tendsto (fun k => tangent hA i (x k)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => rayleighQuotient A (x k)) atTop (𝓝 (hA.eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  have hs (k : ℕ) := (advance_eq_next_iff A (x k) (x (k + 1))).mp (hadvance k)
  have hstep (k : ℕ) : x (k + 1) = step A (x k) := (hs k).2.2.symm
  have hshift (k : ℕ) := (hA.isUnit_sub_smul_one_iff_eigenvalues_ne _).mp (hs k).2.1
  exact ⟨tendsto_tangent_run hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift,
    tendsto_rayleighQuotient_run hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hstep hshift⟩

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_state_invariants
statement:
theorem run_state_invariants (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x₀ : n → 𝕜} (hunit : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x₀‖ = 1)
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x₀ i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x₀ ≤ g / (4 * M)) (k : ℕ) :
    match run A x₀ k with
    | .breakdown => True
    | .success y | .next y => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 ∧
        hA.eigenvectorCoordinates y i ≠ 0 ∧ tangentSq hA i y ≤ g / (4 * M)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact ⟨hunit, hx, hlocal⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [run]
    cases hstate : run A x₀ k with
    | breakdown => trivial
    | success y => simpa only [hstate] using ih
    | next y =>
      have hy : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 ∧ hA.eigenvectorCoordinates y i ≠ 0 ∧
          tangentSq hA i y ≤ g / (4 * M) := by simpa only [hstate] using ih
      dsimp only
      unfold advance
      split_ifs with hterm hsolve
      · exact hy
      · have hshift := (hA.isUnit_sub_smul_one_iff_eigenvalues_ne _).mp hsolve
        have hp := step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA hy.2.1 hshift
        exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1,
          tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood hA hg hM hgap hdiam hy.2.1 hy.2.2 hshift⟩
      · trivial

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_run_success
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_run_success (A : Matrix n n 𝕜)
    (x₀ : n → 𝕜) (k : ℕ) {y : n → 𝕜} (hsuccess : run A x₀ k = .success y) :
    A *ᵥ y = rayleighQuotient A y • y
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => cases hsuccess
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [run] at hsuccess
    cases hstate : run A x₀ k with
    | breakdown => simp [hstate] at hsuccess
    | success z =>
      simp only [hstate, Outcome.success.injEq] at hsuccess
      subst z
      exact ih hstate
    | next z =>
      simp only [hstate] at hsuccess
      obtain ⟨he, rfl⟩ := (advance_eq_success_iff A z y).mp hsuccess
      exact he

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.run_success_target
statement:
theorem run_success_target (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x₀ : n → 𝕜} (hunit : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x₀‖ = 1)
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x₀ i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x₀ ≤ g / (4 * M)) {k : ℕ} {y : n → 𝕜}
    (hsuccess : run A x₀ k = .success y) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ = 1 ∧ rayleighQuotient A y = hA.eigenvalues i ∧
      A *ᵥ y = hA.eigenvalues i • y
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := run_state_invariants hA hg hM hgap hdiam hunit hx hlocal k
  rw [hsuccess] at hinv
  have he := mulVec_eq_rayleighQuotient_smul_of_run_success A x₀ k hsuccess
  have hs : advance A y = .success y := (advance_eq_success_iff A y y).mpr ⟨he, rfl⟩
  have ht := eigenvalue_eq_of_advance_success hA hinv.2.1 hs
  exact ⟨hinv.1, ht.2.1, ht.2.2⟩

name: NLAlib.mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_coefficients
statement:
theorem mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_coefficients {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (A : Matrix n n K) (b : n → K) (q : ℕ) (y : n → K) :
    y ∈ krylovSpace A b q ↔ ∃ c : Fin q → K, krylovCoefficientVector A b c = y
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K

name: NLAlib.krylovCoefficientVector_mem
statement:
theorem krylovCoefficientVector_mem {K : Type*} [Field K] (A : Matrix n n K)
    (b : n → K) {q : ℕ} (c : Fin q → K) :
    krylovCoefficientVector A b c ∈ krylovSpace A b q
proof:
:=
  (mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_coefficients A b q _).mpr ⟨c, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_eq_div
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_eq_div (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    rayleighQuotient A x = x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) / (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayleighQuotient_def, quadForm_def, star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, RCLike.re_to_real]

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (x : n → ℝ) :
    rayleighQuotient A x ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (dotProduct_self_nonneg x) with h0 | hpos
  · rw [← h0, div_zero]; exact specNorm_nonneg A
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
    have h := abs_re_star_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm A x
    rw [star_trivial, RCLike.re_to_real, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans h

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    {z : r → ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) : 0 < z ⬝ᵥ z
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)
    (Ne.symm fun h => hz (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h))

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_compression
statement:
theorem rayleighQuotient_compression {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (z : r → ℝ) :
    rayleighQuotient (Qᴴ * A * Q) z = rayleighQuotient A (Q *ᵥ z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div, rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
  have hd := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ z
  simp only [star_trivial] at hd
  rw [hd]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec z Qᵀ, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q : Matrix n r ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    lambdaMax (Qᴴ * A * Q) =
      sSup (rayleighQuotient A '' {x | x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin ∧ x ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  let hT := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty r with
  | inl hr =>
    let := hr
    have he : {x : n → ℝ | x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin ∧ x ≠ 0} = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩ hz
      apply hz
      ext i
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [he, Set.image_empty, Real.sSup_empty, lambdaMax, hT.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty]
    exact Real.sSup_empty
  | inr hr =>
    let := hr
    let L := hT.eigenvalues₀ ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩
    have hbound : ∀ z : r → ℝ, z ≠ 0 → rayleighQuotient (Qᴴ * A * Q) z ≤ L := by
      intro z hz
      rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div, div_le_iff₀ (dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero hz)]
      exact dotProduct_mulVec_le_mul_dotProduct_of_eigenvalues hT
        (fun j => hT.eigenvalues₀_antitone (Nat.zero_le _)) z
    have hmax : ∃ z : r → ℝ, z ≠ 0 ∧ rayleighQuotient (Qᴴ * A * Q) z = L := by
      let i := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card r))
        (⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card r))
      let z : r → ℝ := hT.eigenvectorBasis i
      have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        have hn := (hT.eigenvectorBasis).norm_eq_one i
        change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 z‖ = 1 at hn
        simp [hz] at hn
      refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
      rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div, hT.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero hz).ne']
      simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, i, L]
    have hQinj : ∀ z : r → ℝ, Q *ᵥ z = 0 → z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hd := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ z
      simp only [star_trivial, hz, dotProduct_zero] at hd
      exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hd.symm
    rw [lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero hT]
    symm
    apply IsGreatest.csSup_eq
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, hL⟩ := hmax
      refine ⟨Q *ᵥ z, ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, fun h => hz (hQinj z h)⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (rayleighQuotient_compression A hQ z).symm.trans hL
    · rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hx⟩, rfl⟩
      simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
      rw [← rayleighQuotient_compression A hQ]
      exact hbound z (fun hz => hx (by simp [hz]))

name: NLAlib.ritzValues_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem ritzValues_eq_of_range_eq {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) {Q P : Matrix n r 𝕜}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P)
    (hspan : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin) :
    ritzValues hA Q hQ = ritzValues hA P hP
proof:
:= by
  let U := Qᴴ * P
  have hQU : Q * U = P := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hQ hspan.ge
  have hUU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := by
    have hgram : (Q * U)ᴴ * (Q * U) = Uᴴ * U := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Qᴴ Q,
        hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [hQU, hP.conjTranspose_mul_self] at hgram
    exact hgram.symm
  have hUt : U * Uᴴ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hUU
  apply eigenvalues₀_eq_of_charpoly_eq
  have hc : Pᴴ * A * P = Uᴴ * (Qᴴ * A * Q) * U := by
    rw [← hQU, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [hc, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc U Uᴴ, hUt, Matrix.one_mul]

name: NLAlib.lambdaMax_compression_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem lambdaMax_compression_eq_of_range_eq {r s : Type*} [Fintype r] [Fintype s]
    [DecidableEq r] [DecidableEq s] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} {P : Matrix n s ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hP : HasOrthonormalCols P) (hspan : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range P.mulVecLin) :
    lambdaMax (Qᴴ * A * Q) = lambdaMax (Pᴴ * A * P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA hQ,
    lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA hP, hspan]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_eq_lambdaMax
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_lambdaMax {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q = lambdaMax
      ((orthonormalBasisMatrix (krylovSpace A b q))ᴴ * A * orthonormalBasisMatrix (krylovSpace A b q))
proof:
:= by
  unfold lanczosRitzValue
  rw [dif_pos hA]
  split_ifs with hd
  · letI : Nonempty (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (krylovSpace A b q))) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hd
    exact (lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul _ hA)).symm
  · have hd0 : Module.finrank ℝ (krylovSpace A b q) = 0 := by omega
    rw [lambdaMax, (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul _ hA).spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    have : IsEmpty (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (krylovSpace A b q))) := by rw [hd0]; infer_instance
    simp only [Set.range_eq_empty, Real.sSup_empty]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q = sSup
      (rayleighQuotient A '' {x | x ∈ krylovSpace A b q ∧ x ≠ 0})
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_lambdaMax hA, lambdaMax_compression_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA
    (hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _), range_orthonormalBasisMatrix]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_eq_ritzValues
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_ritzValues {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] [Nonempty r]
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    {Q : Matrix n r ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hspan : LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin = krylovSpace A b q) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q = ritzValues hA Q hQ ⟨0, Fintype.card_pos⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_lambdaMax hA]
  have he : LinearMap.range (orthonormalBasisMatrix (krylovSpace A b q)).mulVecLin =
      LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin := (range_orthonormalBasisMatrix _).trans hspan.symm
  rw [lambdaMax_compression_eq_of_range_eq hA (hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _) hQ he]
  exact lambdaMax_eq_eigenvalues₀_zero (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA)

name: NLAlib.bddAbove_image
statement:
private lemma bddAbove_image (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    BddAbove (rayleighQuotient A '' {x | x ∈ krylovSpace A b q ∧ x ≠ 0})
proof:
:=
  ⟨specNorm A, by rintro _ ⟨y, _, rfl⟩; exact rayleighQuotient_le_specNorm A y⟩

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA]
  exact le_csSup (bddAbove_image A b q) ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, rfl⟩

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_nonneg
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : 0 ≤ lanczosRitzValue A b q
proof:
:= by
  rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA.isHermitian]
  apply Real.sSup_nonneg
  rintro _ ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
  rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
  exact div_nonneg (by simpa only [star_trivial] using hA.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x)
    (dotProduct_self_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · simpa [hy0, rayleighQuotient_eq_div] using lanczosRitzValue_nonneg hA b q
  · exact rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem_ne_zero hA.isHermitian b q hy hy0

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_le_specNorm
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_le_specNorm (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q ≤ specNorm A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : A.IsHermitian
  · rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA]
    apply Real.sSup_le _ (specNorm_nonneg A)
    rintro _ ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    exact rayleighQuotient_le_specNorm A x
  · unfold lanczosRitzValue
    rw [dif_neg hA]
    exact specNorm_nonneg A

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_eq_zero_of_space_eq_bot
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_zero_of_space_eq_bot (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : n → ℝ)
    (q : ℕ) (h : krylovSpace A b q = ⊥) : lanczosRitzValue A b q = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lanczosRitzValue, h]

name: NLAlib.lanczosRitzValue_eq_iSup_rat
statement:
theorem lanczosRitzValue_eq_iSup_rat {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    (b : n → ℝ) (q : ℕ) :
    lanczosRitzValue A b q = if q = 0 then 0 else ⨆ c : Fin q → ℚ,
      let v
proof:
:= krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))
      if v = 0 then rayleighQuotient A b else rayleighQuotient A v := by
  classical
  cases q with
  | zero => simp [lanczosRitzValue, krylovSpace_zero]
  | succ q =>
    simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · subst b
      simp [lanczosRitzValue, krylovCoefficientVector, rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
    let f := fun c : Fin (q + 1) → ℚ =>
      let v := krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))
      if v = 0 then rayleighQuotient A b else rayleighQuotient A v
    have hB : BddAbove (Set.range f) := by
      refine ⟨specNorm A, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      dsimp only [f]
      split_ifs <;> exact rayleighQuotient_le_specNorm A _
    let θ := ⨆ c, f c
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_sSup_rayleigh hA]
      refine csSup_le ⟨_, b, ⟨self_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b q, hb⟩, rfl⟩ ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, rfl⟩
      have hRat : ∀ c : Fin (q + 1) → ℚ,
          let v := krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))
          v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ θ * (v ⬝ᵥ v) := by
        intro c
        dsimp only
        let v := krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))
        by_cases hv : v = 0
        · change v ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) ≤ θ * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
          simp [hv]
        · have h := le_ciSup hB c
          change f c ≤ θ at h
          simp only [f, show krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ)) ≠ 0 from hv,
            ↓reduceIte, rayleighQuotient_eq_div] at h
          exact (div_le_iff₀ (dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero hv)).mp h
      have hDense : DenseRange (fun c : Fin (q + 1) → ℚ => fun j => (c j : ℝ)) :=
        DenseRange.piMap (fun _ => Rat.denseRange_cast)
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_krylovSpace_iff_exists_coefficients A b _ y).mp hy
      have hAll : (krylovCoefficientVector A b c) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ krylovCoefficientVector A b c) ≤
          θ * (krylovCoefficientVector A b c ⬝ᵥ krylovCoefficientVector A b c) := by
        refine hDense.induction_on (p := fun c =>
          (krylovCoefficientVector A b c) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ krylovCoefficientVector A b c) ≤
            θ * (krylovCoefficientVector A b c ⬝ᵥ krylovCoefficientVector A b c)) c ?_ hRat
        apply isClosed_le
        · simp only [krylovCoefficientVector, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_apply,
            Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          fun_prop
        · simp only [krylovCoefficientVector, dotProduct, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
            smul_eq_mul]
          fun_prop
      rw [hc] at hAll
      rw [rayleighQuotient_eq_div]
      exact (div_le_iff₀ (dotProduct_self_pos_of_ne_zero hy0)).mpr hAll
    · apply ciSup_le
      intro c
      split_ifs with hv
      · exact rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem_ne_zero hA b _
          (self_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b q) hb
      · exact rayleighQuotient_le_lanczosRitzValue_of_mem_ne_zero hA b _
          (krylovCoefficientVector_mem A b _) hv

name: NLAlib.measurable_lanczosRitzValue
statement:
theorem measurable_lanczosRitzValue {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (q : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun b : n → ℝ => lanczosRitzValue A b q)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [lanczosRitzValue_eq_iSup_rat hA]
  split_ifs
  · exact measurable_const
  · apply Measurable.iSup
    intro c
    have hv : Measurable (fun b : n → ℝ =>
        krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ))) := by
      simp only [krylovCoefficientVector]
      fun_prop
    have hr : Measurable (fun x : n → ℝ => rayleighQuotient A x) := by
      simp only [rayleighQuotient_eq_div, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      fun_prop
    exact Measurable.ite (show MeasurableSet {b |
      krylovCoefficientVector A b (fun j => (c j : ℝ)) = 0} from
      hv (measurableSet_singleton 0)) hr (hr.comp hv)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_weighted_average_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_weighted_average_sub_le {lam w : n → ℝ} {i : n} {M : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i)
    (hM : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |lam j - lam i| ≤ M) :
    |(∑ j, lam j * w j) / (∑ j, w j) - lam i| ≤
      M * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) /
        (1 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i)
proof:
:= by
  let s := ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw j
  have hsum : ∑ j, w j = w i + s := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, w j := by rw [hsum]; positivity
  have herr : (∑ j, lam j * w j) / (∑ j, w j) - lam i =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (lam j - lam i) * w j) / (∑ j, w j) := by
    have heq : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (lam j - lam i) * w j) =
        (∑ j, lam j * w j) - lam i * (∑ j, w j) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      simp only [← sub_mul]
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
      simp
    rw [heq]
    field_simp
  have habs : |∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (lam j - lam i) * w j| ≤ M * s := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, |(lam j - lam i) * w j| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, M * w j := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hw j)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) (hw j)
      _ = M * s := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
  rw [herr, abs_div, abs_of_pos hpos]
  calc
    _ ≤ M * s / (∑ j, w j) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right habs hpos.le
    _ = M * (s / w i) / (1 + s / w i) := by
      rw [hsum]
      have hd : 1 + s / w i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub
statement:
theorem gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub {lam w : n → ℝ} {i : n} {g : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i)
    (hg : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ lam j - lam i) :
    g * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) /
        (1 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i) ≤
      (∑ j, lam j * w j) / (∑ j, w j) - lam i
proof:
:= by
  let s := ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j
  have hs : 0 ≤ s := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hw j
  have hsum : ∑ j, w j = w i + s := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, w j := by rw [hsum]; positivity
  have hbound : g * s ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (lam j - lam i) * w j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) (hw j)
  have heq : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (lam j - lam i) * w j) =
      (∑ j, lam j * w j) - lam i * (∑ j, w j) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← sub_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    simp
  calc
    _ = g * s / (∑ j, w j) := by
      change g * (s / w i) / (1 + s / w i) = g * s / (∑ j, w j)
      rw [hsum]
      have hd : 1 + s / w i ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
      field_simp
    _ ≤ ((∑ j, lam j * w j) - lam i * (∑ j, w j)) / (∑ j, w j) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hpos.le
      rwa [← heq]
    _ = _ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.inverse_weight_ratio_le
statement:
theorem inverse_weight_ratio_le {w a : n → ℝ} {i : n} {d : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hi : 0 < w i) (hai : a i ≠ 0) (hd : 0 < d)
    (ha : ∀ j, j ≠ i → d ≤ |a j|) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j / a j ^ 2) / (w i / a i ^ 2) ≤
      (|a i| / d) ^ 2 * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / w i)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j / a j ^ 2) ≤
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / d ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hw j) (sq_pos_of_pos hd)
    have h := ha j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    nlinarith [sq_abs (a j)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w j) / d ^ 2) / (w i / a i ^ 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (div_nonneg hi.le (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [div_pow, sq_abs]; field_simp

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub
statement:
theorem gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i : n} {g : ℝ}
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    g * tangentSq hA i x / (1 + tangentSq hA i x) ≤
      |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i|
proof:
:= by
  rcases hextreme with hmin | hmax
  · have hl (j : n) (hj : j ≠ i) : g ≤ hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i := by
      simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hmin j))] using hgap j hj
    have h := gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub
      (fun j => sq_nonneg ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖)
      (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)) hl
    rw [← hA.rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates] at h
    exact h.trans (le_abs_self _)
  · have hl (j : n) (hj : j ≠ i) :
        g ≤ -hA.eigenvalues j - -hA.eigenvalues i := by
      have h := hgap j hj
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hmax j))] at h
      linarith
    have h := gap_mul_weight_ratio_le_weighted_average_sub
      (fun j => sq_nonneg ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖)
      (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)) hl
    simp only [neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_div] at h
    rw [← hA.rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates] at h
    have ha := neg_le_abs (rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i)
    change g * tangentSq hA i x / (1 + tangentSq hA i x) ≤ _ at h
    linarith

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvalues_ne_rayleighQuotient_of_extremal
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_ne_rayleighQuotient_of_extremal (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hnot : A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x) :
    ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x
proof:
:= by
  have herr := abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hx
  have heg := error_le_gap_div_four hg hM (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x) hlocal herr
  have hlow := gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub hA hgap hextreme hx
  have hq := tangentSq_pos_of_not_eigenvector hA hx hnot
  have hepos : 0 < |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i| :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hlow
  intro j hj
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    rw [← hj, sub_self, abs_zero] at hepos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hepos
  · have hgj := hgap j hji
    rw [hj] at hgj
    linarith

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le_cube_of_extremal
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le_cube_of_extremal (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i : n} {g M : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgM : g ≤ M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    (hextreme : (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues i ≤ hA.eigenvalues j) ∨
      (∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues i))
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hnot : A *ᵥ x ≠ rayleighQuotient A x • x) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      (8 * M / g ^ 3) * |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i| ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < M := hg.trans_le hgM
  have hμ := eigenvalues_ne_rayleighQuotient_of_extremal hA hg hM hgap hdiam
    hextreme hx hlocal hnot
  have hx' := (step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA hx hμ).2.1
  have herr := abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hx
  have heg := error_le_gap_div_four hg hM (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x) hlocal herr
  let e := |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i|
  have hge : 0 < g - e := by dsimp [e]; linarith
  have hsep : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g - e ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - rayleighQuotient A x| := by
    intro j hj
    have ht := abs_sub_le (hA.eigenvalues j) (rayleighQuotient A x) (hA.eigenvalues i)
    have hjg := hgap j hj
    dsimp [e]
    linarith
  have hstep := tangentSq_inverse_le hA hμ hge hsep hx
  rw [← (step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA hx hμ).2.2,
    abs_sub_comm (hA.eigenvalues i)] at hstep
  have hqone : tangentSq hA i x ≤ 1 := by
    have hb := (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * M by positivity)).mp hlocal
    nlinarith
  have herr' : |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      M * tangentSq hA i (step A x) := by
    apply (abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hx').trans
    have hq := tangentSq_nonneg hA i (step A x)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 1 + tangentSq hA i (step A x) by positivity)).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM.le hq) hq]
  exact error_step_le_cube hg hM.le (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x) (abs_nonneg _) hqone heg
    (gap_mul_tangentSq_div_le_abs_rayleighQuotient_sub hA hgap hextreme hx) hstep herr'

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem tangentSq_nonneg (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ tangentSq hA i x
proof: := by unfold tangentSq; positivity

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_sq
statement:
theorem tangent_sq (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    tangent hA i x ^ 2 = tangentSq hA i x
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x)

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_smul
statement:
theorem tangentSq_smul (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) (x : n → 𝕜)
    {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) : tangentSq hA i (c • x) = tangentSq hA i x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tangentSq, hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul, Pi.smul_apply, norm_smul,
    mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hc))

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      M * tangentSq hA i x / (1 + tangentSq hA i x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.rayleighQuotient_eq_sum_eigenvectorCoordinates]
  exact abs_weighted_average_sub_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)) hM

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.eigenvectorCoordinates_inverse_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_inv_sub_smul_mulVec hμ]
  exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero (RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hμ i)))) hx

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_inverse_le
statement:
theorem tangentSq_inverse_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {μ d : ℝ}
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ μ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hsep : ∀ j, j ≠ i → d ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - μ|)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0) :
    tangentSq hA i ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x) ≤
      (|hA.eigenvalues i - μ| / d) ^ 2 * tangentSq hA i x
proof:
:= by
  have hw (j : n) : ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates
      ((A - μ • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x) j‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x j‖ ^ 2 / (hA.eigenvalues j - μ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_inv_sub_smul_mulVec hμ, norm_mul, norm_inv,
      RCLike.norm_ofReal, mul_pow, inv_pow, sq_abs]
    exact (div_eq_inv_mul _ _).symm
  simp only [tangentSq, hw]
  exact inverse_weight_ratio_le (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
    (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx)) (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hμ i)) hd hsep

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero
statement:
theorem step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {x : n → 𝕜}
    (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (step A x)‖ = 1 ∧
      hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (step A x) i ≠ 0 ∧
      tangentSq hA i (step A x) =
        tangentSq hA i ((A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  let y := (A - rayleighQuotient A x • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))⁻¹ *ᵥ x
  have hy := eigenvectorCoordinates_inverse_ne_zero hA hμ hx
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hy
    change hA.eigenvectorCoordinates y i = 0
    rw [hz]
    simp [Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorCoordinates]
  have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by
    intro hz
    apply hy0
    exact congrArg WithLp.ofLp hz)
  have hc : ((‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) ≠ 0 :=
    RCLike.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero hn)
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (((‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y)‖ = 1 ∧ _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, tangentSq_smul hA i y hc⟩
  · rw [WithLp.toLp_smul, norm_smul, RCLike.norm_ofReal,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)), inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
  · change hA.eigenvectorCoordinates (((‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : 𝕜) • y) i ≠ 0
    rw [hA.eigenvectorCoordinates_smul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hc hy

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_step_le
statement:
theorem tangentSq_step_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * tangentSq hA i x ^ 3 ∧
      tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ tangentSq hA i x / 4
proof:
:= by
  let e := |rayleighQuotient A x - hA.eigenvalues i|
  have herr := abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hx
  have heg := error_le_gap_div_four hg hM (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x) hlocal herr
  have hge : 0 < g - e := by dsimp [e]; linarith
  have hsep : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g - e ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - rayleighQuotient A x| := by
    intro j hj
    have htri := abs_sub_le (hA.eigenvalues j) (rayleighQuotient A x) (hA.eigenvalues i)
    have hgj := hgap j hj
    dsimp [e]
    linarith
  have hs := tangentSq_inverse_le hA hμ hge hsep hx
  rw [← (step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA hx hμ).2.2] at hs
  rw [abs_sub_comm (hA.eigenvalues i)] at hs
  exact tangent_sq_cubic_le hg hM (tangentSq_nonneg hA i x) (abs_nonneg _) hlocal herr hs

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangent_step_le
statement:
theorem tangent_step_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangent hA i (step A x) ≤ (2 * M / g) * tangent hA i x ^ 3 ∧
      tangent hA i (step A x) ≤ tangent hA i x / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs := tangentSq_step_le hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hμ
  have ht : 0 ≤ tangent hA i x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ht' : 0 ≤ tangent hA i (step A x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsq := tangent_sq hA i x
  have hsq' := tangent_sq hA i (step A x)
  constructor
  · have hpos : 0 ≤ (2 * M / g) * tangent hA i x ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hpow : ((2 * M / g) * tangent hA i x ^ 3) ^ 2 =
        (2 * M / g) ^ 2 * tangentSq hA i x ^ 3 := by rw [← hsq]; ring
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  · nlinarith [hs.2]

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood
statement:
theorem tangentSq_step_le_neighborhood (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    tangentSq hA i (step A x) ≤ g / (4 * M)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (tangentSq_step_le hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hμ).2
  have hq := tangentSq_nonneg hA i x
  linarith

name: NLAlib.RayleighQuotientIteration.abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_rayleighQuotient_step_sub_le (hA : A.IsHermitian) {i : n} {g M : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → g ≤ |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i|)
    (hdiam : ∀ j, j ≠ i → |hA.eigenvalues j - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤ M)
    {x : n → 𝕜} (hx : hA.eigenvectorCoordinates x i ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : tangentSq hA i x ≤ g / (4 * M))
    (hμ : ∀ j, hA.eigenvalues j ≠ rayleighQuotient A x) :
    |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      (4 * M ^ 3 / g ^ 2) * tangent hA i x ^ 6
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := (step_norm_and_coordinates_ne_zero hA hx hμ).2.1
  have herr := abs_rayleighQuotient_sub_le hA hdiam hx'
  have hq := tangentSq_nonneg hA i (step A x)
  have he : |rayleighQuotient A (step A x) - hA.eigenvalues i| ≤
      M * tangentSq hA i (step A x) := by
    apply herr.trans
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (show 0 < 1 + tangentSq hA i (step A x) by positivity)).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM.le hq) hq]
  have h := error_le_tangent_sq_cube hM.le
    (tangentSq_step_le hA hg hM hgap hdiam hx hlocal hμ).1 he
  convert h using 1
  rw [← tangent_sq hA i x]
  ring

name: NLAlib.frobNorm_mul_sign_diagonal_sub_le
statement:
private theorem frobNorm_mul_sign_diagonal_sub_le
    (W Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s i ^ 2 = 1) :
    frobNorm (W * Matrix.diagonal s - Q) ≤ frobNorm (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s)
proof:
:= by
  have hDD : Matrix.diagonal s * Matrix.diagonal s = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, ← Matrix.diagonal_one]
    congr 1
    funext i
    nlinarith [hs i]
  have hD : HasOrthonormalCols (Matrix.diagonal s) := by
    change (Matrix.diagonal s)ᵀ * Matrix.diagonal s = 1
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose]
    exact hDD
  have he : (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s) * Matrix.diagonal s = W * Matrix.diagonal s - Q := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hDD, Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [← he]
  apply (frobNorm_mul_le_frobNorm_mul_specNorm _ _).trans
  nlinarith [specNorm_le_one_of_orthonormal hD, frobNorm_nonneg (W - Q * Matrix.diagonal s)]

name: NLAlib.tendsto_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ
statement:
theorem tendsto_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ
    {qr : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ × Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hA : A = Q * Matrix.diagonal d * Qᵀ)
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|)
    (hminor : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), IsUnit (Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj)))
    (hqr : ∀ k, QRAlgorithmSucceeds qr (fun _ => 0) A k) :
    Tendsto (qrAlgorithm qr (fun _ => 0) A) atTop (𝓝 (Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
      ∃ s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ, (∀ k i, s k i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k * Matrix.diagonal (s k)) atTop (𝓝 Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hAQ : A * Q = Q * Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    change Q * Matrix.diagonal d * (Qᴴ * Q) = _
    rw [hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
  obtain ⟨hiter, s, hs, hframe⟩ := tendsto_frobNorm_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ hQ hAQ hd hminor hqr
  constructor
  · apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
    simpa only [← frobNorm_eq_norm] using hiter
  · refine ⟨s, hs, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr ?_⟩
    have hz := squeeze_zero (fun k => frobNorm_nonneg
      (qrAlgorithmQ qr (fun _ => 0) A k * Matrix.diagonal (s k) - Q))
      (fun k => frobNorm_mul_sign_diagonal_sub_le _ _ _ (hs k)) hframe
    simpa only [← frobNorm_eq_norm] using hz

name: NLAlib.tendsto_qrAlgorithm_householder_and_alignedQ
statement:
theorem tendsto_qrAlgorithm_householder_and_alignedQ
    {A Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hA : A = Q * Matrix.diagonal d * Qᵀ)
    (hd : StrictAnti fun i => |d i|)
    (hminor : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ n), IsUnit (Qᵀ.submatrix (Fin.castLE hj) (Fin.castLE hj))) :
    Tendsto (qrAlgorithm (fun M => (householderQ M, householderR M)) (fun _ => 0) A)
        atTop (𝓝 (Matrix.diagonal d)) ∧
      ∃ s : ℕ → Fin n → ℝ, (∀ k i, s k i ^ 2 = 1) ∧
        Tendsto (fun k => qrAlgorithmQ (fun M => (householderQ M, householderR M))
          (fun _ => 0) A k * Matrix.diagonal (s k)) atTop (𝓝 Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_qrAlgorithm_and_alignedQ hQ hA hd hminor
  apply qrAlgorithmSucceeds_of_forall_isQR
  intro M
  simpa only [show (Fin.castLE (le_refl n) : Fin n → Fin n) = id from rfl,
    Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using isQR_householderQR M (le_refl n)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_self_eq_one
statement: private lemma dotProduct_self_eq_one {u : n → ℝ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1

name: NLAlib.sq_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mul_dotProduct
statement:
theorem sq_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mul_dotProduct (u v : n → ℝ) :
    (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 ≤ (u ⬝ᵥ u) * (v ⬝ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := real_inner_mul_inner_self_le (WithLp.toLp 2 u : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (WithLp.toLp 2 v)
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, star_trivial, WithLp.ofLp_toLp] at h
  simpa only [sq, dotProduct_comm v u] using h

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq

name: Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero [Nonempty n]

  hA.eigenvalues₀_antitone (Fin.zero_le _)

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_mul_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec hA X u i
  rw [aeval_X, hu, dotProduct_smul, eval_X, smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [sub_mul]; linarith

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul
statement:
theorem dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul (v w : n → ℝ) :
    v ⬝ᵥ w = ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA (v + w)
  have h2 := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v
  have h3 := sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA w
  simp only [dotProduct_add, add_sq, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_dotProduct] at h1
  rw [dotProduct_comm w v] at h1
  have h4 : ∑ i, 2 * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) = 2 * ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v) *
      ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
  rw [h4] at h1
  linarith

name: NLAlib.eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul_eq
statement:
theorem eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul_eq {u : n → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = L • u)
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (i : n) :
    ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ u) * g (hA.eigenvalues i) =
      ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ u) * g L
proof:
:= by
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 (eigenvalues_sub_mul_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq_zero hA hu i) with
    h | h
  · rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
  · rw [h, zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul hA u w,
    dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul hA u v, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [hw i, ← mul_assoc, eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul_eq hA hu g i]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sub_sq_dotProduct_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq
statement:
theorem sub_sq_dotProduct_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |g (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)| ≤ M) {v w : n → ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ i, (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w =
      g (hA.eigenvalues i) * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v)) :
    w ⬝ᵥ w - (u ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ v - (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set e := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card n)) with he
  set L := hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀
  set a : n → ℝ := fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ u with ha
  set c : n → ℝ := fun i => (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ v with hc
  set d : n → ℝ := fun i => c i - (u ⬝ᵥ v) * a i with hd
  have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := dotProduct_self_eq_one hu1
  have haa : ∑ i, a i ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA u, huu]
  have huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = ∑ i, a i * c i := dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul hA u v
  have huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = g L * (u ⬝ᵥ v) :=
    dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu hw
  have hag : ∀ i, a i * g (hA.eigenvalues i) = a i * g L := fun i =>
    eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul_eq hA hu g i
  
  have hwd : ∀ i, (hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w - (u ⬝ᵥ w) * a i =
      g (hA.eigenvalues i) * d i := fun i => by
    rw [hw i, huw, hd]; dsimp only
    have := hag i
    linear_combination (u ⬝ᵥ v) * this
  have hsq_v : v ⬝ᵥ v - (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 = ∑ i, d i ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ∑ i, d i ^ 2 = ∑ i, c i ^ 2 - 2 * (u ⬝ᵥ v) * ∑ i, a i * c i +
        (u ⬝ᵥ v) ^ 2 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hd, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    rw [h1, ← huv, haa, sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA v]; ring
  have hsq_w : w ⬝ᵥ w - (u ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 = ∑ i, (g (hA.eigenvalues i) * d i) ^ 2 := by
    have huw' : u ⬝ᵥ w = ∑ i, a i * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) :=
      dotProduct_eq_sum_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_mul hA u w
    have h1 : ∑ i, (g (hA.eigenvalues i) * d i) ^ 2 =
        ∑ i, ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 -
          2 * (u ⬝ᵥ w) * ∑ i, a i * ((hA.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w) +
            (u ⬝ᵥ w) ^ 2 * ∑ i, a i ^ 2 := by
      simp only [← hwd, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    rw [h1, ← huw', haa, sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hA w]; ring
  rw [hsq_v, hsq_w, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  rw [mul_pow]
  by_cases hi : e.symm i = i₀
  · 
    have hLi : hA.eigenvalues i = L := by
      change hA.eigenvalues₀ (e.symm i) = L; rw [hi]
    by_cases hrep : ∃ j, j ≠ i₀ ∧ hA.eigenvalues₀ j = L
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hjL⟩ := hrep
      have := hM j hj
      rw [hjL, ← hLi] at this
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (by simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) this 2) (sq_nonneg _)
    · push Not at hrep
      
      have hzero : ∀ j, j ≠ i → a j = 0 := fun j hj => by
        have hne : hA.eigenvalues j ≠ L := fun hjL => by
          exact hrep (e.symm j)
            (fun h => hj (e.symm.injective (h.trans hi.symm))) hjL
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 (eigenvalues_sub_mul_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq_zero hA hu j)
          with h | h
        · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.1 h) hne
        · exact h
      have hai : a i ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← haa, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => by rw [hzero j hj, sq, mul_zero])
          (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h)]
      have huv' : u ⬝ᵥ v = a i * c i := by
        rw [huv, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => by rw [hzero j hj, zero_mul])
          (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h)]
      have hdi : d i = 0 := by
        simp only [hd, huv']
        linear_combination (-(c i)) * hai
      rw [hdi]; simp
  · have := hM (e.symm i) hi
    change |g (hA.eigenvalues i)| ≤ M at this
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (by simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) this 2) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.tanSqAngle_eq_overlapTangentSq

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_nonneg

  div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (sq_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mul_dotProduct u x)) (sq_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.tanSqAngle_nonneg

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one {u : n → ℝ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) (x : n → ℝ) :
    overlapTangentSq u x = (x ⬝ᵥ x - (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) / (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [overlapTangentSq, dotProduct_self_eq_one hu, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.tanSqAngle_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem tanSqAngle_of_norm_eq_one {u : n → ℝ} (hu : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hux : u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    tanSqAngle u x hux = (x ⬝ᵥ x - (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) / (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one hu x

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq
proof:
:= by
  have huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = g (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀) * (u ⬝ᵥ v) :=
    dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu hw
  have hnum := sub_sq_dotProduct_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu hu1 hM hw
  rw [overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one hu1, overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one hu1, huw, mul_pow, div_pow,
    div_mul_div_comm]
  rw [huw, mul_pow] at hnum
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {p : ℝ[X]} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)| ≤ M) (b : n → ℝ) :
    overlapTangentSq u (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ≤
      (M / p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀)) ^ 2 * overlapTangentSq u b
proof:
:=
  overlapTangentSq_le_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu hu1 (g := fun x => p.eval x) hM
    (fun i => eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec hA p b i)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {u : n → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = L • u) (p : ℝ[X]) (b : n → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) = p.eval L * (u ⬝ᵥ b)
proof:
:=
  dotProduct_eq_mul_dotProduct_of_forall_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_eq hA hu
    (g := fun x => p.eval x) (fun i => eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct_aeval_mulVec hA p b i)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)

    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (hp : p.eval L ≠ 0) : u ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ≠ 0
