name: NLAlib.tanSqAngle_aeval_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem tanSqAngle_aeval_mulVec_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {p : ℝ[X]} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)| ≤ M) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (hp : p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀) ≠ 0) :
    tanSqAngle u (aeval A p *ᵥ b) (dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_ne_zero hA hu p b hb hp) ≤
      (M / p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀)) ^ 2 * tanSqAngle u b hb
proof:
:=
  overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le hA hu hu1 hM b

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_rayleigh_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_rayleigh_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) {b : n → ℝ}
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ y ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), y ≠ 0 ∧
      hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ^ 2 - y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) ≤
        (ε * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 + hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 *
          (2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) *
            ‖WithLp.toLp 2 y‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  have hH := hA.isHermitian
  set L := hH.eigenvalues₀ 0 with hLdef
  have htop : ∀ i, hH.eigenvalues i ≤ L := hH.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero
  have hpsd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hH.eigenvalues i := hA.eigenvalues_nonneg
  set c : n → ℝ := fun i => (hH.eigenvectorBasis i : n → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ b with hcdef
  have hc1 : 0 < (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hbb : b ⬝ᵥ b = ∑ i, c i ^ 2 := (sum_sq_eigenvectorBasis_dotProduct hH b).symm
  have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := dotProduct_self_eq_one hu1
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty n›
    exact (hpsd i).trans (htop i)
  set M := 2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q
  rcases hL.lt_or_eq with hLpos | hL0
  · 
    set α := (1 - ε) * L
    set γ := ε / (1 - ε)
    have hα : 0 < α := mul_pos (by linarith) hLpos
    have hγ : 0 ≤ γ := div_nonneg hε0.le (by linarith)
    have h1ε : 1 - ε ≠ 0 := (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - ε).ne'
    have hαγ : α * (1 + γ) = L := by
      simp only [α, γ]; field_simp; ring
    set p := chebyshevAmplifier α γ q
    have hp1 : p.eval L = 1 := by rw [← hαγ]; exact eval_chebyshevAmplifier_self _ hα hγ
    set y := aeval A p *ᵥ b
    have hy : y ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1) := (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b (q + 1) y).2
      ⟨p, (degree_chebyshevAmplifier_le α γ q).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self q),
        rfl⟩
    have hyy : y ⬝ᵥ y = ∑ i, p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 :=
      dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_sum hH p b
    have hyAy : y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = ∑ i, hH.eigenvalues i * p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 :=
      quadForm_aeval_mulVec_eq_sum hH p b
    have huy : u ⬝ᵥ y = u ⬝ᵥ b := by
      rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul hH hu p b, hp1, one_mul]
    have hylow : (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 ≤ y ⬝ᵥ y := by
      have := sq_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mul_dotProduct u y
      rwa [huy, huu, one_mul] at this
    refine ⟨y, hy, fun h0 => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h0, dotProduct_zero] at hylow; linarith
    
    have hterm : ∀ i, (L - hH.eigenvalues i) * (p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) ≤
        ε * L * (p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) + L * M ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := fun i => by
      have hl0 := hpsd i
      have hlL := htop i
      have hpc : 0 ≤ p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := by positivity
      rcases lt_or_ge α (hH.eigenvalues i) with hbig | hsmall
      · have : L - hH.eigenvalues i ≤ ε * L := by simp only [α] at hbig; linarith
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hpc
        have h2 : 0 ≤ L * M ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 := by positivity
        linarith
      · have hmem : hH.eigenvalues i ∈ Set.Icc (-α) α := ⟨by linarith, hsmall⟩
        have hpM := abs_eval_chebyshevAmplifier_le q hα hγ hmem
        have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by positivity
        have hsq : p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
          rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hpM 2
        have h1 : (L - hH.eigenvalues i) * (p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) ≤
            L * (M ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (by linarith) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (sq_nonneg _)) hpc hL
        have h2 : 0 ≤ ε * L * (p.eval (hH.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 * c i ^ 2) := by positivity
        nlinarith
    have hsum : L * (y ⬝ᵥ y) - y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) ≤ ε * L * (y ⬝ᵥ y) + L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) := by
      rw [hyy, hyAy, hbb, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
      have := hterm i
      linarith
    have hbound : L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) ≤ L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hc1]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hylow
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL (sq_nonneg M)) (dotProduct_self_nonneg b))
    calc L * (y ⬝ᵥ y) - y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) ≤ ε * L * (y ⬝ᵥ y) + L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) := hsum
      _ ≤ ε * L * (y ⬝ᵥ y) + L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2 * (y ⬝ᵥ y) := by linarith
      _ = (ε * L + L * M ^ 2 * (b ⬝ᵥ b) / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) * (y ⬝ᵥ y) := by ring
  · 
    have hall : ∀ i, hH.eigenvalues i = 0 := fun i =>
      le_antisymm (hL0 ▸ htop i) (hpsd i)
    have hbAb : b ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ b) = 0 := by
      have := quadForm_eq_sum_eigenvalues hH b
      simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, hall, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at this
      exact this
    refine ⟨b, self_mem_krylovSpace_succ A b q, fun h0 => ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hb (by rw [h0, dotProduct_zero])
    · rw [← hL0, hbAb]; simp

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_mulVec_le_of_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
  simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
  have h := dotProduct_mulVec_le_mul_dotProduct_of_eigenvalues (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA)
    hθ z
  have hQz := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ z
  simp only [star_trivial] at hQz
  rw [hQz]
  calc (Q *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ (Q *ᵥ z)) = z ⬝ᵥ ((Qᵀ * A * Q) *ᵥ z) := by
        rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec z Qᵀ,
          Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
    _ ≤ θ * (z ⬝ᵥ z) := h

name: NLAlib.exists_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_ge
statement:
theorem exists_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_ge [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) {b : n → ℝ}
    (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0) (q : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (q + 1) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    ∃ j, hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 -
        (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA.isHermitian).eigenvalues j ≤
      ε * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 + hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 *
        (2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyK, hy0, hy⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_sub_rayleigh_le hA hu hu1 hε0 hε1 hb q
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hK hyK
  have hk : Nonempty k := by
    by_contra h
    rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
    apply hy0
    rw [← hz]
    ext r
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  set hT := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA.isHermitian)
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ hT.eigenvalues Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  have hR := dotProduct_mulVec_le_of_mem_range hA.isHermitian hQ (θ := hT.eigenvalues j)
    (fun j' => hj j' (Finset.mem_univ _)) (hK hyK)
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hy
  have hpos : 0 < y ⬝ᵥ y := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_nonneg y)
    (Ne.symm fun h => hy0 (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp h))
  set B := ε * hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 + hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 *
    (2 / (1 + √(2 * (ε / (1 - ε)))) ^ q) ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 b‖ ^ 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2
  have : (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 - hT.eigenvalues j) * (y ⬝ᵥ y) ≤ B * (y ⬝ᵥ y) := by
    nlinarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hpos

name: NLAlib.exists_degree_le_eval_eq_one_abs_eval_le
statement:
theorem exists_degree_le_eval_eq_one_abs_eval_le {a c L : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hcL : c < L)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : ℝ[X], p.degree ≤ q ∧ p.eval L = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c,
      |p.eval x| ≤ 1 / (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((L - c) / (c - a)))
proof:
:= by
  set α := (c - a) / 2 with hαdef
  set m := (c + a) / 2 with hmdef
  set γ := 2 * ((L - c) / (c - a)) with hγdef
  have hca : 0 < c - a := by linarith
  have hα : 0 < α := by positivity
  have hγ : 0 ≤ γ := by have : 0 < L - c := by linarith
                        positivity
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ) :=
    Chebyshev.one_le_eval_T_real (q : ℤ) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨(chebyshevAmplifier α γ q).comp (X - C m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine degree_le_of_natDegree_le (natDegree_comp_le.trans ?_)
    rw [natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
    exact natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.2 (degree_chebyshevAmplifier_le α γ q)
  · rw [eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C,
      show L - m = α * (1 + γ) by simp only [hαdef, hmdef, hγdef]; field_simp; ring]
    exact eval_chebyshevAmplifier_self q hα hγ
  · intro x hx
    rw [eval_comp, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, eval_chebyshevAmplifier, abs_div,
      abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + γ))]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one (q : ℤ) ?_)
      (by linarith)
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hα, div_le_one hα, abs_le]
    constructor <;> simp only [hαdef, hmdef] <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 ∧
      overlapTangentSq u x ≤ overlapTangentSq u b /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a))) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpdeg, hp1, hM⟩ := exists_degree_le_eval_eq_one_abs_eval_le hac hc q
  replace hM : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → |p.eval (hA.eigenvalues₀ i)| ≤ _ := fun i hi => hM _ (hspec i hi)
  refine ⟨aeval A p *ᵥ b, (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b (q + 1) _).2
    ⟨p, hpdeg.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self q), rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul hA hu, hp1, one_mul]; exact hb
  · refine (overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le hA hu hu1 hM b).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [hp1, div_one, div_pow, one_pow, one_div_mul_eq_div]

name: NLAlib.pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real_one_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real_one_add_two_mul {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (q : ℕ) :
    (1 + 2 * γ + 2 * √(γ + γ ^ 2)) ^ q / 2 ≤ (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * γ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 2 * γ) q
  have hs : √((1 + 2 * γ) ^ 2 - 1) = 2 * √(γ + γ ^ 2) := by
    rw [show (1 + 2 * γ) ^ 2 - 1 = 2 ^ 2 * (γ + γ ^ 2) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  rwa [hs] at h

name: NLAlib.exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le_two_div_pow
statement:
theorem exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le_two_div_pow [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ x ∈ krylovSpace A b (q + 1), u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 ∧
      overlapTangentSq u x ≤
        (2 / (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a)) +
          2 * √((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a) + ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a)) ^ 2))
            ^ q) ^ 2 * overlapTangentSq u b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxK, hx0, hx⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le hA hu hu1 hac hc hspec hb q
  refine ⟨x, hxK, hx0, hx.trans ?_⟩
  set γ := (hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a)
  have hγ : 0 ≤ γ := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hT := pow_div_two_le_eval_T_real_one_add_two_mul hγ q
  set ρ := (1 + 2 * γ + 2 * √(γ + γ ^ 2)) ^ q
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by positivity
  have htan := overlapTangentSq_nonneg u b
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm, ← inv_pow]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.2 (by linarith [div_pos hρ two_pos])) ?_ 2) htan
  have := inv_anti₀ (by positivity : 0 < ρ / 2) hT
  rwa [inv_div] at this

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (j : k) :
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : ∀ i, -∑ i', |hA.eigenvalues i'| ≤ hA.eigenvalues i := fun i => by
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => |hA.eigenvalues i'|)
      (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    linarith [neg_abs_le (hA.eigenvalues i)]
  exact (eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_mem_Icc hA hQ
    (fun i => ⟨hlow i, hA.eigenvalues_le_eigenvalues₀_zero i⟩) j).2

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian)
    {i₀ : Fin (Fintype.card n)} {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, a ≤ hA.eigenvalues i)
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) {j₁ : k}
    (hj₁ : ∀ j, (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hxQ : x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) (hx : u ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁ ≤
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - a) * overlapTangentSq u x
proof:
:= by
  set L := hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ with hLdef
  set θ := (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁
  set c := u ⬝ᵥ x with hcdef
  set w := x - c • u with hwdef
  have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := dotProduct_self_eq_one hu1
  have hR := dotProduct_mulVec_le_of_mem_range hA hQ hj₁ hxQ
  have huw : u ⬝ᵥ w = 0 := by
    simp only [hwdef, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, huu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ← hcdef, sub_self]
  set N := w ⬝ᵥ w with hNdef
  have hxx : x ⬝ᵥ x = c ^ 2 + N := by
    have : x = c • u + w := by simp [hwdef]
    rw [this, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, huu, dotProduct_comm w u, huw]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  have hsymm : ∀ y z : n → ℝ, y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = (A *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ z := fun y z => by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose,
      (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mp hA).eq]
  have hAu : ∀ z : n → ℝ, u ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ z) = L * (u ⬝ᵥ z) := fun z => by
    rw [hsymm, hu, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
  have hxAx : x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = L * c ^ 2 + w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) := by
    have : x = c • u + w := by simp [hwdef]
    rw [this]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, hAu]
    rw [hu, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_comm w u, huw, huu]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    ring
  have hS : a * N ≤ w ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) := mul_dotProduct_le_dotProduct_mulVec_of_eigenvalues hA ha w
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := dotProduct_self_nonneg w
  have hc1 : 0 < c ^ 2 := by positivity
  have haL : 0 ≤ L - a := by
    have := ha (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq] at this
    linarith
  rw [overlapTangentSq_of_norm_eq_one hu1, hxx, ← hcdef, show c ^ 2 + N - c ^ 2 = N by ring,
    ← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ hc1]
  rw [hxx, hxAx] at hR
  have key : (L - θ) * (c ^ 2 + N) ≤ (L - a) * N := by nlinarith
  rcases le_or_gt (L - θ) 0 with hneg | hpos
  · nlinarith
  · nlinarith

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le_of_poly
proof:
:= by
  have hxK : aeval A p *ᵥ b ∈ krylovSpace A b q :=
    (mem_krylovSpace_iff A b q _).2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hx0 : u ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_of_mulVec_eq_smul hA hu]; exact mul_ne_zero hp1 hb
  have haL : 0 ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ i₀ - a := by
    have := ha (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) i₀)
    rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq] at this
    linarith
  refine (eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq hA hu hu1 ha hQ hj₁ (hK hxK)
    hx0).trans ?_
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (overlapTangentSq_aeval_mulVec_le hA hu hu1 hM b) haL

name: NLAlib.eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le
statement:
theorem eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_transpose_mul_mul_le [Nonempty n] {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) {u : n → ℝ} (hu : A *ᵥ u = hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 • u)
    (hu1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1) {a c : ℝ} (hac : a < c) (hc : c < hA.eigenvalues₀ 0)
    (hspec : ∀ i, i ≠ 0 → hA.eigenvalues₀ i ∈ Set.Icc a c) {b : n → ℝ} (hb : u ⬝ᵥ b ≠ 0)
    (q : ℕ) {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (q + 1) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) {j₁ : k}
    (hj₁ : ∀ j, (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j ≤
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁) :
    hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_mul Q hA).eigenvalues j₁ ≤
      (hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - a) * (overlapTangentSq u b /
        (Chebyshev.T ℝ q).eval (1 + 2 * ((hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 - c) / (c - a))) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ i, a ≤ hA.eigenvalues i := fun i => by
    set e := Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card n))
    have hi : hA.eigenvalues i = hA.eigenvalues₀ (e.symm i) := rfl
    rw [hi]
    by_cases h0 : e.symm i = 0
    · rw [h0]; linarith
    · exact (hspec _ h0).1
  obtain ⟨x, hxK, hx0, hx⟩ := exists_mem_krylovSpace_overlapTangentSq_le hA hu hu1 hac hc hspec hb q
  exact (eigenvalues_sub_eigenvalues_le_mul_overlapTangentSq hA hu hu1 ha hQ hj₁ (hK hxK) hx0).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (by
      have htop := ha (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin _) 0)
      rw [hA.eigenvalues_equivOfCardEq] at htop
      linarith))

name: NLAlib.transpose_mulVec_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem transpose_mulVec_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    Qᵀ *ᵥ (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_mulVec_aeval_mulVec_eq hQ b hK
    (by rw [Matrix.charpoly_degree_eq_dim]), Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly,
    Matrix.zero_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_range {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {x : n → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  change (Q *ᵥ y) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) = 0
  rw [← dotProduct_comm, ← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec,
    transpose_mulVec_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero hQ b hK, dotProduct_zero]

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
      (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) +
        (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly).degree < Fintype.card k := by
    rw [← hpdeg]
    exact degree_sub_lt_left (hpdeg.trans (Matrix.charpoly_degree_eq_dim _).symm)
      hp.ne_zero (hp.leadingCoeff.trans (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).leadingCoeff.symm)
  have hmem := hK ((mem_krylovSpace_iff A b _ _).2 ⟨_, hdeg, rfl⟩)
  have horth := dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_eq_zero_of_mem_range hQ b hK hmem
  have hsplit : aeval A p *ᵥ b = aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b +
      aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b := by
    rw [map_sub, Matrix.sub_mulVec]
    abel
  have horth' : (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
      (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b) = 0 :=
    (dotProduct_comm _ _).trans horth
  rw [hsplit, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, horth, horth']
  ring

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_self_le
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_charpoly_mulVec_self_le {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
        (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ≤
      (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add hQ b hK hp hpdeg]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => mul_self_nonneg _)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_iff
statement:
theorem dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_iff {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {Q : Matrix n k ℝ} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (b : n → ℝ)
    (hK : krylovSpace A b (Fintype.card k) ≤ LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin)
    (hq : Fintype.card k ≤ krylovGrade A b)
    {p : ℝ[X]} (hp : p.Monic) (hpdeg : p.degree = Fintype.card k) :
    (aeval A p *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ (aeval A p *ᵥ b) =
        (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
          (aeval A (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly *ᵥ b) ↔ p = (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hid := dotProduct_aeval_mulVec_self_eq_charpoly_add hQ b hK hp hpdeg
    have hz : (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b) ⬝ᵥ
        (aeval A (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly) *ᵥ b) = 0 := by linarith
    have hdeg : (p - (Qᵀ * A * Q).charpoly).degree < Fintype.card k := by
      rw [← hpdeg]
      exact degree_sub_lt_left (hpdeg.trans (Matrix.charpoly_degree_eq_dim _).symm)
        hp.ne_zero (hp.leadingCoeff.trans (Matrix.charpoly_monic _).leadingCoeff.symm)
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_aeval_mulVec_eq_zero
      (hdeg.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hq)) (dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 hz))
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: NLAlib.card_eq_of_range_eq_krylovSpace
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective Q.mulVecLin := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hh := congrArg (fun z => Qᵀ *ᵥ z) hxy
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      show Qᵀ * Q = 1 from hQ, Matrix.one_mulVec] using hh
  calc Fintype.card k = Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range Q.mulVecLin) := by
        rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]
    _ = q := by rw [hspan, finrank_krylovSpace, min_eq_left hq]

name: NLAlib.add_conjTranspose_le_of_half_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hA (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
  simpa only [smul_smul, show (2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2) = 1 by norm_num, one_smul,
    show (2 : ℝ) * -a = -2 * a by ring] using h

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_posSemidef_lyapunov
statement:
theorem existsUnique_posSemidef_lyapunov {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A + Aᴴ) ≤ (-a) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
    (B : Matrix n s 𝕜) :
    (∃! X : Matrix n n 𝕜, A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0) ∧
      ∀ X : Matrix n n 𝕜, A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0 → X.PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hq := re_quadForm_le_of_add_conjTranspose_le (add_conjTranspose_le_of_half_le hA)
  exact ⟨existsUnique_lyapunov_of_quadratic_bound ha hq _, fun X hX =>
    posSemidef_lyapunov_solution_of_quadratic_bound ha hq
      (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose B) hX⟩

name: NLAlib.existsUnique_posSemidef_compressedLyapunov
statement:
theorem existsUnique_posSemidef_compressedLyapunov {A : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A + Aᴴ) ≤ (-a) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (Bk : Matrix k s 𝕜) :
    let H
proof:
:= Vᴴ * A * V
    (∃! Y : Matrix k k 𝕜, H * Y + Y * Hᴴ + Bk * Bkᴴ = 0) ∧
      ∀ Y : Matrix k k 𝕜, H * Y + Y * Hᴴ + Bk * Bkᴴ = 0 → Y.PosSemidef := by
  dsimp only
  have hq := re_quadForm_le_of_add_conjTranspose_le (add_conjTranspose_le_of_half_le hA)
  have hc := re_quadForm_compression_le hq hV
  exact ⟨existsUnique_lyapunov_of_quadratic_bound ha hc _, fun Y hY =>
    posSemidef_lyapunov_solution_of_quadratic_bound ha hc
      (Matrix.posSemidef_self_mul_conjTranspose Bk) hY⟩

name: NLAlib.projectedLyapunov_forward_error
statement:
theorem projectedLyapunov_forward_error {A X : Matrix n n 𝕜}
    {V : Matrix n k 𝕜} {U : Matrix n l 𝕜} {H Y : Matrix k k 𝕜}
    {T : Matrix l k 𝕜} {B : Matrix n s 𝕜} {Bk : Matrix k s 𝕜} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hA : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (A + Aᴴ) ≤ (-a) • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜))
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hVU : Vᴴ * U = 0)
    (hAV : A * V = V * H + U * T) (hB : B = V * Bk)
    (hX : A * X + X * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ = 0)
    (hY : H * Y + Y * Hᴴ + Bk * Bkᴴ = 0) :
    frobNorm (X - V * Y * Vᴴ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm (T * Y) / (2 * a) ∧
      specNorm (X - V * Y * Vᴴ) ≤ specNorm (T * Y) / (2 * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hq := re_quadForm_le_of_add_conjTranspose_le (add_conjTranspose_le_of_half_le hA)
  have hH := compression_eq_of_arnoldi_relation hV hVU hAV
  have hc := re_quadForm_compression_le hq hV
  rw [hH] at hc
  have hXH := isHermitian_lyapunov_solution ha hq
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self B) hX
  have hYH := isHermitian_lyapunov_solution ha hc
    (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self Bk) hY
  have hEH := hXH.sub (Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose V hYH)
  have hR := projectedLyapunov_residual_norms_and_rank hV hU hVU hAV hB hYH hY
  have he : A * (X - V * Y * Vᴴ) + (X - V * Y * Vᴴ) * Aᴴ =
      -(A * (V * Y * Vᴴ) + (V * Y * Vᴴ) * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ) := by
    have hx := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hX
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
    calc
      _ = (A * X + X * Aᴴ) - (A * (V * Y * Vᴴ) + (V * Y * Vᴴ) * Aᴴ) := by abel
      _ = _ := by rw [hx]; abel
  have hf := frobNorm_le_lyapunov_div ha hq (X - V * Y * Vᴴ)
  have hs := specNorm_le_lyapunov_div ha hq hEH
  rw [he, frobNorm_neg, hR.1] at hf
  rw [he, specNorm_neg, hR.2.1] at hs
  exact ⟨hf, hs⟩

name: NLAlib.compression_eq_of_arnoldi_relation
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV, Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ V,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc Vᴴ U, hV.conjTranspose_mul_self, hVU,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.projectedLyapunov_residual_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hadj : Vᴴ * Aᴴ = Hᴴ * Vᴴ + Tᴴ * Uᴴ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_add] using
      congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose hAV
  have hl : A * (V * Y * Vᴴ) = (V * H + U * T) * Y * Vᴴ := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAV]
  have hr : V * Y * Vᴴ * Aᴴ = V * Y * (Hᴴ * Vᴴ + Tᴴ * Uᴴ) := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc (V * Y), hadj]
  calc
    _ = V * (H * Y + Y * Hᴴ + Bk * Bkᴴ) * Vᴴ +
        (U * T * Y * Vᴴ + V * Y * Tᴴ * Uᴴ) := by
      rw [hl, hr, hB]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      abel
    _ = _ := by rw [hY, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, zero_add]

name: NLAlib.projectedLyapunov_residual_norms_and_rank
proof:
:= A * (V * Y * Vᴴ) + (V * Y * Vᴴ) * Aᴴ + B * Bᴴ
    frobNorm R = Real.sqrt 2 * frobNorm (T * Y) ∧
      specNorm R = specNorm (T * Y) ∧ R.rank = 2 * (T * Y).rank := by
  dsimp only
  rw [projectedLyapunov_residual_eq hAV hB hY]
  have he : U * T * Y * Vᴴ + V * Y * Tᴴ * Uᴴ =
      U * (T * Y) * Vᴴ + V * (T * Y)ᴴ * Uᴴ := by
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hYH.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [he]
  have h := norms_and_rank_orthogonalCoupling hV hU hVU (T * Y)
  refine ⟨?_, h.2⟩
  rw [frobNorm, h.1, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), frobNorm]

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_of_forall_sqrt_le
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_of_forall_sqrt_le {k m d : Type*} [Fintype k] [Fintype m]
    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {U : Matrix m d ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε a : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haε : 3 * a ≤ ε)
    (hlo : ∀ x : d → ℝ,
      (1 - a) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ Real.sqrt (((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x)))
    (hhi : ∀ x : d → ℝ,
      Real.sqrt (((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x)) ≤ (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU]
  intro x
  have hx := dotProduct_self_nonneg x
  have hv := dotProduct_self_nonneg ((S * U) *ᵥ x)
  have ha1 : 0 ≤ 1 - a := by linarith
  constructor
  · have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg ha1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (hlo x) 2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hx, Real.sq_sqrt hv] at h
    have hc : 1 - ε ≤ (1 - a) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hx]
  · have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hhi x) 2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hx, Real.sq_sqrt hv] at h
    have hc : (1 + a) ^ 2 ≤ 1 + ε := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hx]

name: NLAlib.one_sub_le_measure_isSubspaceEmbedding_gaussianMatrix
proof:
:= by
  set μ := gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin m)
  set E := {G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ | IsSubspaceEmbedding ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) U ε}
  
  suffices hc : μ.real Eᶜ ≤ δ by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ μ.real E + μ.real Eᶜ := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = μ.real Set.univ := by simp
        _ = μ.real (E ∪ Eᶜ) := by rw [Set.union_compl_self]
        _ ≤ μ.real E + μ.real Eᶜ := measureReal_union_le _ _
    linarith
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with hd | hd
  · 
    subst hd
    have hE : Eᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext G
      simp only [E, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false,
        not_not]
      intro x
      have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst hx
      simp
    rw [hE, measureReal_empty]
    exact hδ0.le
  
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 / δ) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ0]; linarith)
  set t := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.log (2 / δ)) with ht
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 = 2 * Real.log (2 / δ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hδeq : 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) = δ := by
    rw [ht2, show -(2 * Real.log (2 / δ)) / 2 = -Real.log (2 / δ) by ring, Real.exp_neg,
      Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    field_simp
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by
    have : 0 < 18 * ((d : ℝ) + 2 * Real.log (2 / δ)) / ε ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  set sk := Real.sqrt k with hsk
  have hsk0 : 0 < sk := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hkpos
  set a := (Real.sqrt d + t) / sk with ha
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ht0) hsk0.le
  have haε : 3 * a ≤ ε := by
    
    have h1 : (Real.sqrt d + t) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * d + 2 * t ^ 2 := by
      have := Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt d - t)]
    have h2 : 18 * ((d : ℝ) + 2 * Real.log (2 / δ)) ≤ ε ^ 2 * k := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hk; linarith
    have h3 : (3 * (Real.sqrt d + t)) ^ 2 ≤ (ε * sk) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsk, Real.sq_sqrt hkpos.le]
      nlinarith
    have h4 : 3 * (Real.sqrt d + t) ≤ ε * sk :=
      (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).1 h3
    rw [ha, mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ hsk0]
    exact h4
  
  set φ : (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ) → (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) := fun G => (G * U)
  have hφ : Measurable φ := measurable_id.matrix_mul measurable_const
  set S1 := {H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ | singularValues H (Fintype.card (Fin d) - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt k - Real.sqrt d - t}
  set S2 := {H : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ | Real.sqrt k + Real.sqrt d + t ≤ specNorm H}
  have hsub : Eᶜ ⊆ φ ⁻¹' (S1 ∪ S2) := by
    intro G hG
    by_contra hgood
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, not_or, not_le, S1, S2, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hgood
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hgood
    apply hG
    have hGU : (φ G) = G * U := by simp [φ]
    rw [hGU] at hlo hhi
    have hSU : ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ, ((1 / sk) • G * U) *ᵥ x =
        (1 / sk) • ((G * U) *ᵥ x) := by
      intro x; rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec]
    have hnorm : ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ, Real.sqrt ((((1 / sk) • G * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ
        (((1 / sk) • G * U) *ᵥ x)) =
        (1 / sk) * Real.sqrt (((G * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((G * U) *ᵥ x)) := by
      intro x
      rw [hSU, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        Real.sqrt_mul (mul_self_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_mul_self (by positivity)]
    refine isSubspaceEmbedding_of_forall_sqrt_le hU hε1 ha0 haε (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ?_)
    · rw [hnorm]
      have h := singularValues_last_mul_norm_le (G * U) x
      simp only [norm_toLp_eq_sqrt_dotProduct_self] at h
      have hx := Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ⬝ᵥ x)
      have hlo' : (1 - a) * sk ≤ singularValues (G * U) (Fintype.card (Fin d) - 1) := by
        rw [ha, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsk0.ne']; linarith
      calc (1 - a) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)
          = ((1 - a) * sk) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) / sk := by field_simp
        _ ≤ singularValues (G * U) (Fintype.card (Fin d) - 1) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) / sk := by gcongr
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (((G * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((G * U) *ᵥ x)) / sk := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
    · rw [hnorm]
      have h := sqrt_mulVec_dotProduct_le_specNorm_mul (G * U) x
      have hx := Real.sqrt_nonneg (x ⬝ᵥ x)
      have hhi' : specNorm (G * U) ≤ (1 + a) * sk := by
        rw [ha, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsk0.ne']; linarith
      calc 1 / sk * Real.sqrt (((G * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((G * U) *ᵥ x))
          ≤ 1 / sk * (specNorm (G * U) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)) := by gcongr
        _ ≤ 1 / sk * ((1 + a) * sk * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x)) := by gcongr
        _ = (1 + a) * Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by field_simp
  have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc μ.real Eᶜ ≤ μ.real (φ ⁻¹' (S1 ∪ S2)) := measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (μ.map φ).real (S1 ∪ S2) :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (Measure.le_map_apply hφ.aemeasurable _)
    _ = (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin d)).real (S1 ∪ S2) := by
        rw [(hasLaw_gaussianMatrix_mul_right U hU).map_eq]
    _ ≤ (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin d)).real S1 + (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin d)).real S2 :=
        measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) + Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) :=
        add_le_add (measure_sigmaMin_le_sqrt_sub_sqrt_sub_le_gaussianMatrix hd t ht0)
          (measure_sqrt_add_sqrt_add_le_specNorm_le_gaussianMatrix t ht0)
    _ = δ := by rw [← two_mul, hδeq]

name: NLAlib.nonneg_of_ridgeLeverageScore_le
statement:
theorem nonneg_of_ridgeLeverageScore_le (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i ≤ u i) (i : m) : 0 ≤ u i
proof:
:=
  (ridgeLeverageScore_nonneg A hρ i).trans (hu i)

name: NLAlib.sampled_ridgeWhitenedRows_gram_sub
statement:
theorem sampled_ridgeWhitenedRows_gram_sub (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (p : m → ℝ≥0) {s : ℕ} (ω : Fin s → m) :
    (sampledRowMatrix (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ) p ω)ᵀ *
        sampledRowMatrix (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ) p ω -
        (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ)ᵀ * ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ =
      cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ) *
        ((sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω - Aᵀ * A) *
        cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ)
proof:
:= by
  let T := cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ)
  have hT : T.IsHermitian := cfc_predicate _ _
  have hTs : Tᵀ = T := hT.eq
  change (sampledRowMatrix (A * T) p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix (A * T) p ω -
    (A * T)ᵀ * (A * T) = T * ((sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω - Aᵀ * A) * T
  rw [sampledRowMatrix_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, hTs, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (p : m → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hdom : ∀ i, ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i ≤ t * (p i : ℝ))
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)).real
      {ω | ε < specNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ) *
        ((sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω - Aᵀ * A) *
        cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ))} ≤
      2 * Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrow (i : m) : ∑ a, ‖ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ i a‖ ^ 2 = ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i := by
    calc
      _ = ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ i ⬝ᵥ ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ i := by
        unfold dotProduct
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, pow_two]
      _ = ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ i) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)‖ ^ 2 :=
        (norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self _).symm
      _ = _ := norm_ridgeWhitenedRows_row_sq A hρ i
  have h := measureReal_specNorm_sampled_transpose_mul_sub_le
    (ridgeWhitenedRows A ρ) p hp ht (transpose_ridgeWhitenedRows_mul_le_one A hρ)
    (fun i => (hrow i).le.trans (hdom i)) hs hε
  simpa only [sampled_ridgeWhitenedRows_gram_sub] using h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le_of_upper_scores
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le_of_upper_scores
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i ≤ u i) (ht : 0 < ∑ i, u i)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u)
      (sum_normalizedSamplingProbabilities u (nonneg_of_ridgeLeverageScore_le A hρ u hu) ht))).real
      {ω | ε < specNorm (cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ) *
        ((sampledRowMatrix A (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u) ω)ᵀ *
          sampledRowMatrix A (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u) ω - Aᵀ * A) *
        cfc (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) (ridgeGram A ρ))} ≤
      2 * Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * (∑ i, u i) * (1 + ε / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le A hρ _ _ ht _ hs hε
  intro i
  rw [normalizedSamplingProbabilities, Real.coe_toNNReal _
    (div_nonneg (nonneg_of_ridgeLeverageScore_le A hρ u hu i) ht.le)]
  simpa only [mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht.ne'] using hu i

name: NLAlib.ridge_sampling_tail_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem ridge_sampling_tail_le_of_sample_size {d s : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {t ε δ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * t / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (2 * d / δ) ≤ s) :
    2 * d * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3))) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * d / δ) ≤ (s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (3 * t) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsize (show 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 / (3 * t) by positivity)
    have he : ε ^ 2 / (3 * t) * (3 * t / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (2 * d / δ)) =
        Real.log (2 * d / δ) := by field_simp
    rw [he] at h
    calc
      _ ≤ ε ^ 2 / (3 * t) * (s : ℝ) := h
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hsR : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hexp : -(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)) ≤
      -Real.log (2 * d / δ) := by
    have hden : 0 < 2 * t * (1 + ε / 3) := by positivity
    have hdenle : 2 * t * (1 + ε / 3) ≤ 3 * t := by nlinarith
    have hq : (s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (3 * t) ≤
        (s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hden hdenle
    simpa only [neg_div, neg_mul] using neg_le_neg (hlog.trans hq)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * d * Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * d / δ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp) (by positivity)
    _ = δ := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]; field_simp

name: NLAlib.measureReal_ridge_sampling_failure_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem measureReal_ridge_sampling_failure_le_of_sample_size
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m] [Nonempty n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (u : m → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i ≤ u i) (ht : 0 < ∑ i, u i)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * (∑ i, u i) / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (2 * Fintype.card n / δ) ≤ s) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u)
      (sum_normalizedSamplingProbabilities u (nonneg_of_ridgeLeverageScore_le A hρ u hu) ht))).real
      {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • ridgeGram A ρ ≤
          ridgeGram (sampledRowMatrix A (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u) ω) ρ ∧
        ridgeGram (sampledRowMatrix A (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u) ω) ρ ≤
          (1 + ε) • ridgeGram A ρ)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (measureReal_mono ?_)
    ((measureReal_specNorm_ridge_sampled_gram_sub_le_of_upper_scores A hρ u hu ht hs hε).trans
      (ridge_sampling_tail_le_of_sample_size (Fintype.card_pos) ht hε hε1 hδ hsize))
  intro ω hω
  by_contra hnot
  exact hω (ridgeGram_bounds_of_specNorm_whitened_sub_le A
    (sampledRowMatrix A (normalizedSamplingProbabilities u) ω) hρ hε.le (not_lt.mp hnot))

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem rowVolumeWeight_nonneg (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T S : Finset n) (s : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ rowVolumeWeight X T S s
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowVolumeWeight
  split_ifs
  · exact rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X S
  · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_rowVolumeWeight
statement:
theorem sum_rowVolumeWeight (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) :
    (∑ S : Finset n, rowVolumeWeight X T S s) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rowVolumeWeight, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset n => S ∈ T.powersetCard s) =
      T.powersetCard s := by ext S; simp
  rw [he, sum_rowSubsetVolume_powersetCard X T s hds]

name: NLAlib.sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos
statement:
theorem sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    0 < ∑ S : Finset n, rowVolumeWeight X T S s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]
  exact mul_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hst _))) hT

name: NLAlib.rowVolumePMF_toReal
statement:
theorem rowVolumePMF_toReal (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T S : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst S).toReal =
      rowVolumeWeight X T S s /
        (((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rowVolumePMF, finiteSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply, ENNReal.coe_toReal]
  rw [coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities _ (fun U => rowVolumeWeight_nonneg X T U s)
    (sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst), sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]

name: NLAlib.mem_support_rowVolumePMF_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_rowVolumePMF_iff (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T S : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    S ∈ (rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst).support ↔
      S ∈ T.powersetCard s ∧ 0 < rowSubsetVolume X S
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
      rowSubsetVolume X T := by
    rw [← sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]
    exact sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst
  have he : S ∈ (rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst).support ↔
      0 < (rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst S).toReal := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff, and_iff_left (PMF.apply_lt_top _ _), PMF.apply_pos_iff]
  rw [he, rowVolumePMF_toReal, div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hd, rowVolumeWeight]
  by_cases hS : S ∈ T.powersetCard s <;> simp [hS]

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem rowVolumeLaw_singleton (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T S : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst).real {S} =
      rowVolumeWeight X T S s /
        (((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.real, rowVolumeLaw, PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _
    (measurableSet_singleton S)]
  simp only [rowVolumePMF, finiteSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.coe_toReal]
  rw [coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities _ (fun U => rowVolumeWeight_nonneg X T U s)
    (sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst), sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]

name: NLAlib.integral_rowVolumeLaw
statement:
theorem integral_rowVolumeLaw {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card)
    (f : Finset n → E) :
    ∫ S, f S ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst =
      ∑ S : Finset n, (rowVolumeWeight X T S s /
        (((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T)) • f S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rowVolumeLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [rowVolumePMF, finiteSamplingPMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply, ENNReal.coe_toReal]
  simp_rw [coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities _ (fun U => rowVolumeWeight_nonneg X T U s)
    (sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst), sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]

name: NLAlib.leverageScore_nonneg
statement: theorem leverageScore_nonneg (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) : 0 ≤ leverageScore A i
proof:
:=
  (re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem _
    (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A))
    (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A) i).1

name: NLAlib.leverageScore_le_one
statement: theorem leverageScore_le_one (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (i : m) : leverageScore A i ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (re_diag_mem_Icc_of_isHermitian_of_isIdempotentElem _
    (Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian A))
    (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem A) i).2

name: NLAlib.sum_leverageScore_eq_rank
statement:
theorem sum_leverageScore_eq_rank [DecidableEq m] (A : Matrix m n ℝ) :
    ∑ i, leverageScore A i = (A.rank : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_mul_moorePenroseInverse A]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q]
    {A : Matrix m n ℝ} {U : Matrix m q ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hUA : U * (Uᵀ * A) = A) (hr : Fintype.card q ≤ A.rank) (i : m) :
    leverageScore A i = ∑ j, U i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold leverageScore
  rw [← mul_conjTranspose_eq_mul_moorePenroseInverse hU hUA hr, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, sq]

name: NLAlib.leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_self
statement:
theorem leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_self [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq q] {U : Matrix m q ℝ}
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (i : m) : leverageScore U i = ∑ j, U i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hUU : U * (Uᵀ * U) = U := by
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial U, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  have hr : Fintype.card q ≤ U.rank := by
    have h1 : (Uᵀ * U).rank ≤ U.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _
    rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial U, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      Matrix.rank_one] at h1
    exact h1
  exact leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU hUU hr i

name: NLAlib.posSemidef_rowVolumeAdjugateDefect
statement:
theorem posSemidef_rowVolumeAdjugateDefect (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) :
    (rowVolumeAdjugateDefect X T s).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
  apply smul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X T)))
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro S _
  split_ifs
  · exact (rowSubsetGram_posSemidef X S).adjugate.nonneg
  · exact le_rfl

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeAdjugateDefect_eq_zero_of_full_support
statement:
theorem rowVolumeAdjugateDefect_eq_zero_of_full_support (X : Matrix n d 𝕜)
    (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hfull : ∀ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, IsUnit (rowSubsetGram X S)) :
    rowVolumeAdjugateDefect X T s = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowVolumeAdjugateDefect
  have hz : (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s,
      if rowSubsetVolume X S = 0 then (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate else 0) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro S hS
    exact if_neg ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X S).mpr (hfull S hS)).ne'
  rw [hz, smul_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_rowSubsetGram_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect
statement:
theorem integral_inv_rowSubsetGram_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹ ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      (((T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) •
        (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ - rowVolumeAdjugateDefect X T s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c := (T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d)
  let c' := (T.card - (Fintype.card d - 1)).choose (s - (Fintype.card d - 1))
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < c := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hst _))
  have hAdj := sum_adjugate_rowSubsetGram_powersetCard X T s hd ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans hds)
  change (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate) =
    (c' : 𝕜) • (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate at hAdj
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ] at hAdj
  have hsum : (∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S • (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹) =
      (c' : ℝ) • (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate -
        ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, if rowSubsetVolume X S = 0 then (rowSubsetGram X S).adjugate else 0 := by
    simp_rw [rowSubsetVolume_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hAdj]
  have hAdjT : (rowSubsetGram X T).adjugate = rowSubsetVolume X T • (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ := by
    have h := rowSubsetVolume_smul_inv_eq_adjugate_sub_ite X T
    rw [if_neg hT.ne', sub_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hratio : ((((c : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T)⁻¹) * (c' : ℝ)) * rowSubsetVolume X T =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ = (c' : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) := by field_simp [hc.ne', hT.ne']
      _ = _ := Nat.cast_choose_pred_div_choose hd hds hst
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum, hsum, smul_sub, hAdjT, smul_smul, smul_smul, hratio]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.integral_inv_rowSubsetGram_le
statement:

    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d)

      (((T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) •
        (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹
proof:

name: NLAlib.integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_eq_integral_inv
statement:
theorem integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_eq_integral_inv
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      ∫ S, (rowSubsetGram X S)⁻¹ ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum, integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum]

name: NLAlib.integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S - rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T) *
        (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S - rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)ᴴ
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) -
        rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)ᴴ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z := ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T
  let p := fun S => rowVolumeWeight X T S s / Z
  have hZ : 0 < Z := by
    dsimp only [Z]
    rw [← sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]
    exact sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst
  have hp : ∑ S, p S = 1 := by
    simp only [p, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds]
    exact div_self hZ.ne'
  have hmean : ∑ S, p S • rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S = rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T := by
    simpa only [integral_rowVolumeLaw, p, Z] using
      integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T s hT hds hst
  simpa only [integral_rowVolumeLaw, p, Z] using
    sum_smul_sub_mul_conjTranspose p hp (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X) (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T) hmean

name: NLAlib.integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect
statement:
theorem integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S - rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T) *
        (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S - rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T)ᴴ
      ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      (((T.card - s : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) •
        (rowSubsetGram X T)⁻¹ - rowVolumeAdjugateDefect X T s
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose,
    integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_eq_integral_inv,
    integral_inv_rowSubsetGram_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect X T s hd hT hds hst,
    rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_of_isUnit X T
      ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X T).mp hT)]
  have hn : T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 = (s - Fintype.card d + 1) + (T.card - s) := by omega
  have hr : ((T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) /
      ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 =
      ((T.card - s : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hn, Nat.cast_add]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← hr, sub_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: NLAlib.integral_centered_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_le
statement:

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_eq_sub_defect
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_eq_sub_defect
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < Fintype.card d)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S) ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      (((T.card - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((s - Fintype.card d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T) - RCLike.re (rowVolumeAdjugateDefect X T s).trace
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm (S : Finset n) : frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S) =
      RCLike.re (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ).trace := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  calc
    _ = RCLike.re (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S)ᴴ
        ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst).trace := by
      rw [Matrix.re_trace_integral (Integrable.of_finite)]
      exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hnorm)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_eq_integral_inv,
        integral_inv_rowSubsetGram_eq_smul_inv_sub_defect X T s hd hT hds hst,
        Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, map_sub, RCLike.smul_re,
        ← rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul_conjTranspose_of_isUnit X T
          ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit X T).mp hT), ← hnorm]

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ T, traceExp (θ • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j) ∂(uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure) ≤
      d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ)
proof:
:=
  (integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le_iid hk0 hk A hA θ).trans
    (integral_traceExp_uniform_iid_le A L hL hA hbound hmean θ)

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_upper
statement:
theorem matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_upper
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ((uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
      {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j)}).toReal ≤
      d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  let μ := (uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
  let Y : ExactRowSubset α k → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun T => ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j
  let θ := Real.log (1 + ε) / L
  have hθ : 0 < θ := div_pos (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) hL
  have hset : {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • Y T)} =
      {T | (1 + ε) * k ≤ lambdaMax (Y T)} := by
    ext T
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, lambdaMax_smul_of_pos _ hc,
      one_div_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hkR]
  change (μ {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • Y T)}).toReal ≤ _
  rw [hset]
  have hlap := measureReal_lambdaMax_ge_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp μ Y hθ
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun T =>
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun j _ => hA j))) Integrable.of_finite ((1 + ε) * k)
  have htr := integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le hk0 hk A L hL.le hA hbound hmean θ
  have hg : chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ = ε / L := by
    rw [chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne']
    dsimp only [θ]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL.ne', Real.exp_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 + ε)]
    congr 1
    ring
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * ((1 + ε) * k)) *
        (d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ)) :=
      hlap.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    _ = d * Real.exp (((k : ℝ) / L) * (ε - (1 + ε) * Real.log (1 + ε))) := by
      rw [hg]
      rw [show Real.exp (-θ * ((1 + ε) * k)) * (d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * (ε / L))) =
        d * (Real.exp (-θ * ((1 + ε) * k)) * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * (ε / L))) by ring,
        ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      dsimp only [θ]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_mul_log_one_add_le hε.le hε1)
        (show 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) / L by positivity)
      calc
        _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) / L) * -(ε ^ 2 / 3) := hh
        _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_lower
statement:
theorem matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_lower
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ((uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
      {T | lambdaMin ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j) ≤ 1 - ε}).toReal ≤
      d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (2 * L))
proof:
:= by
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  let μ := (uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
  let Y : ExactRowSubset α k → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun T => ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j
  let θ := Real.log (1 - ε) / L
  have hθ : θ < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
    (Real.log_neg (by linarith) (by linarith)) hL
  have hset : {T | lambdaMin ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • Y T) ≤ 1 - ε} =
      {T | lambdaMin (Y T) ≤ (1 - ε) * k} := by
    ext T
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, lambdaMin_smul_of_pos _ hc,
      one_div_mul_eq_div, div_le_iff₀ hkR]
  change (μ {T | lambdaMin ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • Y T) ≤ 1 - ε}).toReal ≤ _
  rw [hset]
  have hlap := measureReal_lambdaMin_le_le_exp_mul_integral_traceExp μ Y hθ
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun T =>
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun j _ => hA j))) Integrable.of_finite ((1 - ε) * k)
  have htr := integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le hk0 hk A L hL.le hA hbound hmean θ
  have hg : chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ = -ε / L := by
    rw [chernoffCgfCoefficient, if_neg hL.ne']
    dsimp only [θ]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hL.ne', Real.exp_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 - ε)]
    congr 1
    ring
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-θ * ((1 - ε) * k)) *
        (d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ)) :=
      hlap.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    _ = d * Real.exp (((k : ℝ) / L) * (-ε - (1 - ε) * Real.log (1 - ε))) := by
      rw [hg]
      rw [show Real.exp (-θ * ((1 - ε) * k)) * (d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * (-ε / L))) =
        d * (Real.exp (-θ * ((1 - ε) * k)) * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * (-ε / L))) by ring,
        ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      dsimp only [θ]
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_sub_mul_log_one_sub_le hε.le hε1)
        (show 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) / L by positivity)
      calc
        _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) / L) * -(ε ^ 2 / 2) := hh
        _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.measure_norm_uniform_subset_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem measure_norm_uniform_subset_sub_one_le
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ((uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
      {T | ε ≤ ‖(1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j - 1‖}).toReal ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  let Y : ExactRowSubset α k → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ :=
    fun T => (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j
  let μ := (uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure
  have hsub : {T | ε ≤ ‖Y T - 1‖} ⊆
      {T | lambdaMin (Y T) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪ {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y T)} := by
    intro T hT
    have hsum : (∑ j ∈ T.val, A j).IsHermitian :=
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun j _ => hA j)
    have hYT : (Y T).IsHermitian := hsum.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (1 / (k : ℝ)))
    exact lambdaMin_le_or_le_lambdaMax_of_le_norm_sub_one hYT hT
  have hl := matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_lower hk0 hk A L hL hA hbound hmean hε hε1
  have hu := matrix_chernoff_uniform_subset_upper hk0 hk A L hL hA hbound hmean hε hε1.le
  have he : d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (2 * L)) ≤
      d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hn : 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 * (k : ℝ) := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * L) (by positivity : 0 < 3 * L)]
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ (μ ({T | lambdaMin (Y T) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪ {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y T)})).toReal :=
      measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (μ {T | lambdaMin (Y T) ≤ 1 - ε}).toReal +
        (μ {T | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y T)}).toReal := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (2 * L)) +
        d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L)) := add_le_add hl hu
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_vecMulVec {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (a : m → ℂ) (b : n → ℂ) :
    ‖Matrix.vecMulVec a b‖ ^ 2 = (∑ i, ‖a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j, ‖b j‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, norm_mul, mul_pow]

name: NLAlib.frobenius_norm_sq_map_ofReal_eq_frobSq
statement:
theorem frobenius_norm_sq_map_ofReal_eq_frobSq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) : ‖A.map Complex.ofReal‖ ^ 2 = frobSq A
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq, frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobenius_average_sub_mean_sq
statement:
theorem integral_frobenius_average_sub_mean_sq
    {ι m n : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (p : ι → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) (Z : ι → Matrix m n ℂ)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ ω : Fin c → ι,
        ‖(1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, Z (ω j) - ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) * ‖Z i‖ ^ 2 -
        ‖∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun _ _ => .of_finite)]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun _ _ => .of_finite)]
  have hentry : ∀ ω : Fin c → ι, ∀ a b,
      ((1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, Z (ω j) - ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i) a b =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, Z (ω j) a b - ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i a b := by
    intro ω a b
    simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [hentry]
  have hscalar : ∀ a b,
      ∫ ω : Fin c → ι,
          ‖(1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, Z (ω j) a b - ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i a b‖ ^ 2
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp) =
        (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) * ‖Z i a b‖ ^ 2 -
          ‖∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • Z i a b‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro a b
    have h := integral_centered_average_norm_sq_pi (finiteSamplingLaw p hp)
      (fun i => Z i a b) hc
    simpa only [integral_finiteSamplingLaw, smul_eq_mul] using h
  simp_rw [hscalar, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hswap : (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, (1 / (c : ℝ)) * ((p i : ℝ) * ‖Z i a b‖ ^ 2)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ a, ∑ b, (1 / (c : ℝ)) * ((p i : ℝ) * ‖Z i a b‖ ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ a, ∑ i, ∑ b, (1 / (c : ℝ)) * ((p i : ℝ) * ‖Z i a b‖ ^ 2)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hswap]

name: NLAlib.sampledRowMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem sampledRowMatrix_mul {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {m n q : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (D : Matrix n q 𝕜) (p : m → ℝ≥0) {s : ℕ} (ω : Fin s → m) :
    sampledRowMatrix (A * D) p ω = sampledRowMatrix A p ω * D
proof:
:= by
  ext j b
  simp only [sampledRowMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix
statement:
theorem sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (p : n → ℝ≥0)
    {c : ℕ} (ω : Fin c → n) :
    sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) • ∑ j, columnRowSample A B p (ω j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a b
  simp only [sampledColumnMatrix, sampledRowMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, columnRowSample, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hscale : (Real.sqrt ((c : ℝ) * p (ω j)))⁻¹ ^ 2 =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) * (p (ω j) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), mul_inv, one_div]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
  rw [← sq, hscale]

name: NLAlib.sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample
statement:
theorem sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (p : n → ℝ≥0)
    (hsupport : ∀ i, p i = 0 → Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b) = 0) :
    ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • columnRowSample A B p i = A * B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, columnRowSample, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    Matrix.mul_apply, smul_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : p i = 0
  · have hzero := congrArg (fun M : Matrix m t ℂ => M a b) (hsupport i hi)
    simpa only [hi, NNReal.coe_zero, inv_zero, mul_zero, zero_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
      Matrix.zero_apply] using hzero.symm
  · rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (show (p i : ℝ) ≠ 0 by exact_mod_cast hi), one_smul]

name: NLAlib.sum_probability_mul_frobenius_columnRowSample_sq
statement:
theorem sum_probability_mul_frobenius_columnRowSample_sq
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (p : n → ℝ≥0) :
    ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) * ‖columnRowSample A B p i‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, ((∑ a, ‖A a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ b, ‖B i b‖ ^ 2) / p i
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [columnRowSample, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (p i).coe_nonneg), mul_pow,
    frobenius_norm_sq_vecMulVec]
  by_cases hi : (p i : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [hi]
  · field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq
statement:
theorem integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (p : n → ℝ≥0)
    (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hsupport : ∀ i, p i = 0 → Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b) = 0)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∫ ω : Fin c → n, ‖sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp) =
      (1 / (c : ℝ)) *
        (∑ i, ((∑ a, ‖A a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ b, ‖B i b‖ ^ 2) / p i - ‖A * B‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix]
  have h := integral_frobenius_average_sub_mean_sq p hp (columnRowSample A B p) hc
  rwa [sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample A B p hsupport,
    sum_probability_mul_frobenius_columnRowSample_sq] at h

name: NLAlib.columnRowWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem columnRowWeight_nonneg {m n t 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype t] [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n t 𝕜) (i : n) : 0 ≤ columnRowWeight A B i
proof:
:= by
  unfold columnRowWeight
  positivity

name: NLAlib.columnRowWeight_sq
statement:
theorem columnRowWeight_sq {m n t 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype t] [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜]
    (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n t 𝕜) (i : n) :
    columnRowWeight A B i ^ 2 = (∑ a, ‖A a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ b, ‖B i b‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnRowWeight, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _),
    Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)]

name: NLAlib.vecMulVec_eq_zero_of_columnRowWeight_eq_zero
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_eq_zero_of_columnRowWeight_eq_zero
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (i : n)
    (hi : columnRowWeight A B i = 0) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [frobenius_norm_sq_vecMulVec, ← columnRowWeight_sq, hi, zero_pow (by decide)]
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hn)

name: NLAlib.sum_columnRowProbabilities
statement:
theorem sum_columnRowProbabilities {m n t 𝕜 : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [NormedAddCommGroup 𝕜] (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) (B : Matrix n t 𝕜)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) : ∑ i, columnRowProbabilities A B i = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply NNReal.coe_injective
  rw [NNReal.coe_sum, NNReal.coe_one]
  simp only [columnRowProbabilities, Real.coe_toNNReal _
    (div_nonneg (columnRowWeight_nonneg A B _) hW.le)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_self hW.ne']

name: NLAlib.sum_columnRowWeight_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_columnRowWeight_sq_le
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) :
    (∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => sq_nonneg ‖A a i‖))
    (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => sq_nonneg ‖B i b‖))
    (fun i _ => (columnRowWeight_sq A B i).le)
  rw [frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq, frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum_norm_sq,
    Finset.sum_comm (f := fun a i => ‖A a i‖ ^ 2)]
  exact h

name: NLAlib.integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_of_columnRowProbabilities
statement:
theorem integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_of_columnRowProbabilities
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      ‖sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) =
      ((∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 - ‖A * B‖ ^ 2) / (c : ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      ‖sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2 / (c : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : ∀ i, (columnRowProbabilities A B i : ℝ) =
      columnRowWeight A B i / ∑ j, columnRowWeight A B j := by
    intro i
    exact Real.coe_toNNReal _ (div_nonneg (columnRowWeight_nonneg A B i) hW.le)
  have hsupp : ∀ i, columnRowProbabilities A B i = 0 →
      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    apply vecMulVec_eq_zero_of_columnRowWeight_eq_zero A B i
    have hzero : (columnRowProbabilities A B i : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hi]; rfl
    rw [hp i, div_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
    exact hzero.resolve_right hW.ne'
  have hmom : (∑ i, ((∑ a, ‖A a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ b, ‖B i b‖ ^ 2) /
      columnRowProbabilities A B i) = (∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 := by
    simp_rw [← columnRowWeight_sq, hp]
    have hterm : ∀ i, columnRowWeight A B i ^ 2 /
        (columnRowWeight A B i / ∑ j, columnRowWeight A B j) =
        (∑ j, columnRowWeight A B j) * columnRowWeight A B i := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : columnRowWeight A B i = 0
      · simp [hi]
      · field_simp
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, pow_two]
  have heq := integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq A B (columnRowProbabilities A B)
    (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW) hsupp hc
  rw [hmom, one_div_mul_eq_div] at heq
  refine ⟨heq, ?_⟩
  rw [heq]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  exact (sub_le_self _ (sq_nonneg _)).trans (sum_columnRowWeight_sq_le A B)

name: NLAlib.mul_eq_zero_of_sum_columnRowWeight_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mul_eq_zero_of_sum_columnRowWeight_eq_zero
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (hW : ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i = 0) :
    A * B = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ∀ i, columnRowWeight A B i = 0 := by
    have hh := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun i _ => columnRowWeight_nonneg A B i)).mp hW
    exact fun i => hh i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h := sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample A B (fun _ => (0 : ℝ≥0))
    (fun i _ => vecMulVec_eq_zero_of_columnRowWeight_eq_zero A B i (hw i))
  simpa using h.symm

name: NLAlib.sampledColumnMatrix_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem sampledColumnMatrix_map_ofReal {m n : Type*}
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (p : n → ℝ≥0) {c : ℕ} (ω : Fin c → n) :
    sampledColumnMatrix (A.map Complex.ofReal) p ω =
      (sampledColumnMatrix A p ω).map Complex.ofReal
proof:
:= by
  ext a j
  simp [sampledColumnMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.real_smul]

name: NLAlib.sampledRowMatrix_map_ofReal
statement:
theorem sampledRowMatrix_map_ofReal {n t : Type*}
    (B : Matrix n t ℝ) (p : n → ℝ≥0) {c : ℕ} (ω : Fin c → n) :
    sampledRowMatrix (B.map Complex.ofReal) p ω =
      (sampledRowMatrix B p ω).map Complex.ofReal
proof:
:= by
  ext j b
  simp [sampledRowMatrix, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.real_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_of_columnRowProbabilities
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_of_columnRowProbabilities
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n t ℝ)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      frobSq (sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) =
      ((∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) ^ 2 - frobSq (A * B)) / (c : ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      frobSq (sampledColumnMatrix A (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω *
        sampledRowMatrix B (columnRowProbabilities A B) ω - A * B)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw (columnRowProbabilities A B)
        (sum_columnRowProbabilities A B hW))) ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B / (c : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : columnRowWeight (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) =
      columnRowWeight A B := by
    funext i
    simp [columnRowWeight, Matrix.map_apply]
  have hp : columnRowProbabilities (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) =
      columnRowProbabilities A B := by
    unfold columnRowProbabilities
    rw [hw]
  have h := integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_of_columnRowProbabilities
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) (by rwa [hw]) hc
  simp only [hp, hw, sampledColumnMatrix_map_ofReal, sampledRowMatrix_map_ofReal] at h
  have hmap : ∀ X : Matrix m (Fin c) ℝ, ∀ Y : Matrix (Fin c) t ℝ,
      X.map Complex.ofReal * Y.map Complex.ofReal -
        A.map Complex.ofReal * B.map Complex.ofReal =
        (X * Y - A * B).map Complex.ofReal := by
    intro X Y
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum]
  simp_rw [hmap, frobenius_norm_sq_map_ofReal_eq_frobSq] at h
  have hAB : A.map Complex.ofReal * B.map Complex.ofReal =
      (A * B).map Complex.ofReal := (Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom)).symm
  rwa [hAB, frobenius_norm_sq_map_ofReal_eq_frobSq] at h

name: NLAlib.sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix_zero_samples
statement:
theorem sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix_zero_samples
    {m n t : Type*} (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ) (p : n → ℝ≥0)
    (ω : Fin 0 → n) : sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω = 0
proof:
:= by

  simp [Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetOutcome_act

:= by

  · funext i
    rfl
  · apply Subtype.ext
    ext i
