name: NLAlib.iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_invariant
statement:
theorem iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_invariant
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α)
    (I : Fin k → α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (σ ∘ I, permuteExactRowSubset σ T)).toReal =
      (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (I, T)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  exact toReal_map_pmf_invariant (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α))
    (iidSubsetOutcome hk) (iidSubsetSourceAct σ) (iidSubsetPairAct σ)
    (fun z => by simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply]) (iidSubsetOutcome_act hk σ) (I, T)

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_first_marginal
statement:
theorem iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_first_marginal
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (I : Fin k → α) :
    (∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (I, T)).toReal) =
      1 / (Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : DecidableEq ((Fin k → α) × ExactRowSubset α k) :=
    fun z w => Classical.propDecidable (z = w)
  have hI : (Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hP : (Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp only [iidSubsetJointPMF, toReal_map_pmf_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hinner : ∀ z : (Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α,
      (∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, if iidSubsetOutcome hk z = (I, T) then
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α) z).toReal else 0) =
      if z.2 ∘ z.1 = I then
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α) z).toReal else 0 := by
    intro z
    simp only [iidSubsetOutcome, Prod.mk.injEq]
    by_cases hz : z.2 ∘ z.1 = I <;> simp [hz]
  have hstep : (∑ z : (Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α,
      ∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, if iidSubsetOutcome hk z = (I, T) then
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α) z).toReal else 0) =
      ∑ z : (Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α, if z.2 ∘ z.1 = I then
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α) z).toReal else 0 :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => hinner z)
  change (∑ z : (Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α,
      ∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, if iidSubsetOutcome hk z = (I, T) then
        (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((Fin k → α) × Equiv.Perm α) z).toReal else 0) = _
  rw [hstep]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
  have hperm : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm α,
      (∑ J : Fin k → α, if σ ∘ J = I then
        ((Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α))⁻¹ else 0) =
      ((Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α))⁻¹ := by
    intro σ
    rw [← (permuteSequenceEquiv σ).symm.sum_comp]
    change (∑ J : Fin k → α, if (permuteSequenceEquiv σ) ((permuteSequenceEquiv σ).symm J) = I
      then ((Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ) * Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α))⁻¹ else 0) = _
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp
  simp_rw [hperm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetMarginal_invariant
statement:
theorem iidSubsetMarginal_invariant
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    iidSubsetMarginal hk (permuteExactRowSubset σ T) = iidSubsetMarginal hk T
proof:
:= by
  unfold iidSubsetMarginal
  rw [← (permuteSequenceEquiv σ).sum_comp]
  change (∑ I, (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (σ ∘ I, permuteExactRowSubset σ T)).toReal) = _
  simp_rw [iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_invariant]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetMarginal_eq
statement:
theorem iidSubsetMarginal_eq
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T U : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    iidSubsetMarginal hk T = iidSubsetMarginal hk U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_perm_exactRowSubset T U
  rw [← hσ, iidSubsetMarginal_invariant]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetMarginal_eq_uniform
statement:
theorem iidSubsetMarginal_eq_uniform
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    iidSubsetMarginal hk T = 1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (ExactRowSubset α k) := exactRowSubset_nonempty hk
  have hsum : (∑ U : ExactRowSubset α k, iidSubsetMarginal hk U) = 1 := by
    unfold iidSubsetMarginal
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hh := sum_toReal_pmf (iidSubsetJointPMF hk)
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hh
    exact hh
  have hc : (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ) * iidSubsetMarginal hk T = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _U : ExactRowSubset α k, iidSubsetMarginal hk T := by simp
      _ = ∑ U : ExactRowSubset α k, iidSubsetMarginal hk U :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun U _ => iidSubsetMarginal_eq hk T U)
      _ = 1 := hsum
  have hN : 0 < (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) from
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨T⟩)
  apply (eq_div_iff hN.ne').mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hc

name: NLAlib.conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeKernel
statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeKernel
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m s ℝ) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : ε < 1)
    (happrox : (1 - ε) • ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ ≤ ridgeGram Bᵀ ρ) :
    Aᵀ * (1 - rangeProjector B) * A ≤
      (ρ / (1 - ε)) • ridgeKernel Aᵀ ρ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hα : 0 < 1 - ε := sub_pos.mpr hε
  let : Invertible (1 - ε) := invertibleOfNonzero hα.ne'
  have hi := inv_le_inv_of_posDef ((posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).smul hα) happrox
  rw [Matrix.inv_smul _ _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp
    (posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).isUnit), invOf_eq_inv] at hi
  have hR : 1 - rangeProjector B ≤ (ρ / (1 - ε)) • (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ := by
    refine (one_sub_rangeProjector_le_smul_inv_ridgeGram B hρ).trans ?_
    have hh := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hi hρ.le
    simpa only [smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv] using hh
  have hp := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hR).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same A
  apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
  simpa only [ridgeKernel, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial,
    Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hp

name: NLAlib.specNorm_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le_of_regularized_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_sq_le_of_regularized_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m s ℝ) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : ε < 1)
    (happrox : (1 - ε) • ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ ≤ ridgeGram Bᵀ ρ) :
    specNorm ((1 - rangeProjector B) * A) ^ 2 ≤ ρ / (1 - ε)
proof:
:= by
  let R := (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) - rangeProjector B
  have hR := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian B) (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem B)
  have hRR : R * R = R := hR.2
  have hRT : Rᵀ = R := hR.1.eq
  have hGram : (R * A)ᴴ * (R * A) = Aᵀ * R * A := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, hRT]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc R R A, hRR]
  have hc : 0 ≤ ρ / (1 - ε) := div_nonneg hρ.le (sub_pos.mpr hε).le
  apply specNorm_sq_le_of_conjTranspose_mul_self_le _ hc
  rw [hGram]
  refine (conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeKernel A B hρ hε happrox).trans ?_
  exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (ridgeKernel_le_one Aᵀ hρ) hc

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeEffectiveDimension_of_regularized_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeEffectiveDimension_of_regularized_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m s ℝ) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : ε < 1)
    (happrox : (1 - ε) • ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ ≤ ridgeGram Bᵀ ρ) :
    frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector B) * A) ≤
      ρ / (1 - ε) * ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ
proof:
:= by
  let R := (1 : Matrix m m ℝ) - rangeProjector B
  have hR := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian B) (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem B)
  have hRR : R * R = R := hR.2
  have hRT : Rᵀ = R := hR.1.eq
  have hGram : (R * A)ᴴ * (R * A) = Aᵀ * R * A := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_mul, hRT]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc R R A, hRR]
  have hf : frobSq (R * A) = (Aᵀ * R * A).trace := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self, hGram, RCLike.re_to_real]
  have ht := (Matrix.le_iff.mp
    (conjTranspose_mul_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeKernel A B hρ hε happrox)).trace_nonneg
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, ← ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace Aᵀ ρ,
    ridgeEffectiveDimension_transpose A hρ] at ht
  rw [hf]
  exact sub_nonneg.mp ht

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_of_regularized_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_bestRankFrobSq_of_regularized_le
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix m s ℝ) {ρ ε : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : ε < 1)
    (happrox : (1 - ε) • ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ ≤ ridgeGram Bᵀ ρ) (k : ℕ) :
    frobSq ((1 - rangeProjector B) * A) ≤
      ((k : ℝ) * ρ + bestRankFrobSq A k) / (1 - ε)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 0 ≤ ρ / (1 - ε) := div_nonneg hρ.le (sub_pos.mpr hε).le
  refine (frobSq_one_sub_rangeProjector_mul_le_ridgeEffectiveDimension_of_regularized_le
    A B hρ hε happrox).trans ?_
  calc
    ρ / (1 - ε) * ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ ≤
        ρ / (1 - ε) * ((k : ℝ) + bestRankFrobSq A k / ρ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (ridgeEffectiveDimension_le_rank_add_div_bestRankFrobSq A hρ k) hc
    _ = ((k : ℝ) * ρ + bestRankFrobSq A k) / (1 - ε) := by
      field_simp [hρ.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hε).ne']

name: NLAlib.toReal_map_pmf_apply
statement:
theorem toReal_map_pmf_apply {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
    ((p.map f) b).toReal = ∑ a, if f a = b then (p a).toReal else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype, ENNReal.toReal_sum]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    by_cases ha : f a = b
    · rw [if_pos ha.symm, if_pos ha]
    · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm ha), if_neg ha, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
  · intro a _
    split_ifs
    · exact p.apply_ne_top a
    · simp

name: NLAlib.sum_toReal_pmf
statement: theorem sum_toReal_pmf {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) : ∑ a, (p a).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh : ∑ a, p a = 1 := by simpa only [tsum_fintype] using p.tsum_coe
  have hr := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hh
  rwa [ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun a _ => p.apply_ne_top a), ENNReal.toReal_one] at hr

name: NLAlib.toReal_map_pmf_invariant
statement:
theorem toReal_map_pmf_invariant {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : PMF α) (f : α → β) (e : α ≃ α) (g : β ≃ β)
    (hp : ∀ a, (p (e a)).toReal = (p a).toReal)
    (hf : ∀ a, f (e a) = g (f a)) (b : β) :
    ((p.map f) (g b)).toReal = ((p.map f) b).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [toReal_map_pmf_apply, toReal_map_pmf_apply,
    ← e.sum_comp (fun a => if f a = g b then (p a).toReal else 0)]
  simp_rw [hf, hp, g.injective.eq_iff]

name: NLAlib.card_image_univ_sequence_le
statement:
theorem card_image_univ_sequence_le {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (I : Fin k → α) :
    (Finset.univ.image I).card ≤ k

name: NLAlib.image_univ_subset_sequenceSupportExtension
statement:
theorem image_univ_subset_sequenceSupportExtension
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (I : Fin k → α) :
    Finset.univ.image I ⊆ (sequenceSupportExtension hk I).val

    (card_image_univ_sequence_le I) hk)).1

name: NLAlib.exists_perm_exactRowSubset
statement:
theorem exists_perm_exactRowSubset {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (T U : ExactRowSubset α k) : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm α, permuteExactRowSubset σ T = U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_map_finset_eq T.val U.val
    (T.property.trans U.property.symm)
  exact ⟨σ, Subtype.ext hσ⟩

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetOutcome_support_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
  apply Finset.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨z.1 i, ?_, rfl⟩
  exact image_univ_subset_sequenceSupportExtension hk z.1
    (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_eq_zero_of_not_subset
statement:
theorem iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_eq_zero_of_not_subset
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (I : Fin k → α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k)
    (h : ¬Finset.univ.image I ⊆ T.val) : (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (I, T)).toReal = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [iidSubsetJointPMF, toReal_map_pmf_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro z _
  split_ifs with hz
  · exfalso
    apply h
    have hh := iidSubsetOutcome_support_subset hk z
    simpa only [hz] using hh
  · rfl

name: NLAlib.uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi
statement:
theorem uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi
    {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ι → α)).toMeasure =
      Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro f
  rw [Measure.pi_singleton]
  simp_rw [PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton _)]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply,
    Fintype.card_fun, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Nat.cast_pow, ENNReal.inv_pow]

name: NLAlib.iIndepFun_uniform_sequence_comp
statement:
theorem iIndepFun_uniform_sequence_comp
    {ι α β : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] [MeasurableSpace β] (f : α → β) :
    iIndepFun (fun a (I : ι → α) => f (I a))
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype (ι → α)).toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi (ι := ι) (α := α)]
  exact iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : ι => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)
    (X := fun _ : ι => f) (fun _ => Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable)

name: NLAlib.integral_uniform_sequence_comp_eval
statement:
theorem integral_uniform_sequence_comp_eval
    {ι α E : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : α → E) (a : ι) :
    (∫ I : ι → α, f (I a) ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (ι → α)).toMeasure) =
      (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi (ι := ι) (α := α)]
  have hev := (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : ι =>
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure) a).map_eq
  have hmap := integral_map
    (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure))
    (φ := fun I : ι → α => I a) (f := f)
    (measurable_pi_apply a).aemeasurable StronglyMeasurable.of_discrete.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hmap, hev, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    ← Finset.smul_sum, one_div]

name: NLAlib.integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum
statement:
theorem integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card)
    (f : Finset n → E) :
    (∫ S, f S ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      ((((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) * rowSubsetVolume X T)⁻¹) •
        ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S • f S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw]
  have hsum : (∑ S : Finset n, rowVolumeWeight X T S s • f S) =
      ∑ S ∈ T.powersetCard s, rowSubsetVolume X S • f S := by
    simp only [rowVolumeWeight, ite_smul, zero_smul, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    congr 1
    ext S
    simp
  rw [← hsum, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: NLAlib.integrable_rowSubsetPseudoinverse
statement:
theorem integrable_rowSubsetPseudoinverse (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    Integrable (rowSubsetPseudoinverse X) (rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst)
proof: := .of_finite

name: NLAlib.integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse
statement:
theorem integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := sum_rowVolumeWeight_pos X T s hT hds hst
  rw [sum_rowVolumeWeight X T s hds] at hZ
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum, sum_rowSubsetVolume_smul_pseudoinverse_powersetCard X T s hds,
    smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hZ.ne', one_smul]

name: NLAlib.integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul
statement:
theorem integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul {r : Type*} [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card)
    (Y : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S * Y ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) =
      rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T * Y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse X S ∂rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) * Y := by
      rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw, integral_rowVolumeLaw]
      simp only [Matrix.sum_mul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun M => M * Y) (integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse X T s hT hds hst)

    (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card)
    (R : Ω → Finset n) (hR : HasLaw R (rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst) μ) :

proof:

name: NLAlib.measure_norm_uniform_iid_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem measure_norm_uniform_iid_sub_one_le
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk : 0 < k) (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure
      {I | ε ≤ ‖(1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ a, A (I a) - 1‖}).toReal ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure
  let X : Fin k → (Fin k → α) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun a I => A (I a)
  have hm (a : Fin k) : Measurable (X a) := Measurable.of_discrete
  have hi : iIndepFun X μ := iIndepFun_uniform_sequence_comp (ι := Fin k) A
  have hp (a : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ I ∂μ, (X a I).PosSemidef := by
    apply ae_of_all
    intro I
    apply (hA (I a)).posSemidef_iff_eigenvalues_nonneg.mpr
    intro i
    apply (hbound (I a)).1.trans
    rw [lambdaMin, (hA (I a)).spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact csInf_le (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hb (a : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ I ∂μ, lambdaMax (X a I) ≤ L :=
    ae_of_all _ (fun I => (hbound (I a)).2)
  have he (a : Fin k) : ∫ I, X a I ∂μ = 1 := by
    change (∫ I : Fin k → α, A (I a) ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure) = 1
    rw [integral_uniform_sequence_comp_eval A a]
    exact hmean
  have hl := matrix_chernoff_sampling_lower μ hk X L hL hm hi hp hb he hε.le hε1
  have hu := matrix_chernoff_sampling_upper μ hk X L hL hm hi hp hb he hε.le hε1.le
  let Y : (Fin k → α) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ :=
    fun I => (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ a, A (I a)
  have hsub : {I | ε ≤ ‖Y I - 1‖} ⊆
      {I | lambdaMin (Y I) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪ {I | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y I)} := by
    intro I hI
    have hs : (∑ a, A (I a)).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun a _ => hA (I a))
    have hY : (Y I).IsHermitian := hs.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all (1 / (k : ℝ)))
    exact lambdaMin_le_or_le_lambdaMax_of_le_norm_sub_one hY hI
  have he' : d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (2 * L)) ≤
      d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hn : 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 * (k : ℝ) := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * L) (by positivity : 0 < 3 * L)]
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ ≤ (μ ({I | lambdaMin (Y I) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪ {I | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y I)})).toReal :=
      measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ (μ {I | lambdaMin (Y I) ≤ 1 - ε}).toReal +
        (μ {I | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax (Y I)}).toReal := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (2 * L)) +
        d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L)) := add_le_add hl hu
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

name: NLAlib.measure_le_norm_leverage_gram_sub_one
statement:
theorem measure_le_norm_leverage_gram_sub_one
    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hk : 0 < k)
    (U : Matrix n (Fin d) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (p : n → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hdom : ∀ i, β * (∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2) / d ≤ p i)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)
      {ω | ε ≤ ‖(leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U)ᴴ * (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U) - 1‖}).toReal ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-β * k * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)
  let X : n → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := columnRowSample Uᴴ U p
  have hPSD : ∀ i, (X i).PosSemidef := by
    intro i
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_star_self (U i)).smul
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (p i).coe_nonneg)
  have htrace : ∀ i, (X i).trace.re = (∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2) / p i := by
    intro i
    simp only [X, columnRowSample, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.smul_apply,
      Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.smul_re,
      Complex.re_sum, smul_eq_mul]
    change (∑ a, (p i : ℝ)⁻¹ * (star (U i a) * U i a).re) = _
    have hnorm : ∀ z : ℂ, (star z * z).re = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro z
      have heq : (Complex.normSq z : ℂ) = star z * z := Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self
      have hh := congrArg Complex.re heq
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using hh.symm
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm _ (p i : ℝ)⁻¹, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [hnorm]
  have hbound : ∀ i, (X i).trace.re ≤ (d : ℝ) / β := by
    intro i
    rw [htrace]
    by_cases hi : (p i : ℝ) = 0
    · rw [hi, div_zero]
      positivity
    · have hip : 0 < (p i : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne (p i).coe_nonneg (Ne.symm hi)
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hip hβ]
      have hh := hdom i
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hd] at hh
      nlinarith
  have hsupport : ∀ i, p i = 0 →
      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => Uᴴ a i) (fun b => U i b) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hq : ∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have hh := hdom i
      rw [hi, NNReal.coe_zero, div_le_iff₀ hd, zero_mul] at hh
      have hnn : 0 ≤ ∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hrow : ∀ a, U i a = 0 := by
      intro a
      have hh := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun a _ => sq_nonneg ‖U i a‖)).mp hq
      exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (hh a (Finset.mem_univ a)))
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, hrow]
  let ν := finiteSamplingLaw p hp
  let M : Fin k → (Fin k → n) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun j ω => X (ω j)
  have hmean : ∀ j, ∫ ω, M j ω ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν) = 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [show (fun ω => M j ω) = (fun ω : Fin k → n => X (ω j)) from rfl,
      integral_comp_eval (show AEStronglyMeasurable X ν from .of_discrete)]
    change (∫ i, X i ∂finiteSamplingLaw p hp) = 1
    rw [integral_finiteSamplingLaw]
    exact (sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample Uᴴ U p hsupport).trans hU
  have hind : iIndepFun M (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (fun _ => (show AEMeasurable X ν from Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable))
  have hp : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν), (M j ω).PosSemidef :=
    fun j => ae_of_all _ (fun ω => hPSD (ω j))
  have hb : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ ω ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν),
      lambdaMax (M j ω) ≤ (d : ℝ) / β :=
    fun j => ae_of_all _ (fun ω =>
      (lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef (hPSD (ω j))).trans (hbound (ω j)))
  have hl := matrix_chernoff_sampling_lower (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) hk M
    ((d : ℝ) / β) (div_pos hd hβ) (fun _ => .of_discrete) hind hp hb hmean hε0.le hε1
  have hu := matrix_chernoff_sampling_upper (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)) hk M
    ((d : ℝ) / β) (div_pos hd hβ) (fun _ => .of_discrete) hind hp hb hmean hε0.le hε1.le
  have hsub : {ω | ε ≤ ‖(leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U)ᴴ * (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U) - 1‖} ⊆
      {ω | lambdaMin ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j, M j ω) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪
      {ω | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j, M j ω)} := by
    intro ω hω
    have hh := lambdaMin_le_or_le_lambdaMax_of_le_norm_sub_one
      (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U)) hω
    simpa only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
      conjTranspose_leverageSamplingSketch_mul_self, M, X] using hh
  have hexp : Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 * k / (2 * ((d : ℝ) / β))) ≤
      Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 * k / (3 * ((d : ℝ) / β))) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
    have hprod : 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 * (k : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) / β) := by positivity
    nlinarith only [hprod]
  calc
    _ ≤ (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => ν)).real
      ({ω | lambdaMin ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j, M j ω) ≤ 1 - ε} ∪
       {ω | 1 + ε ≤ lambdaMax ((1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j, M j ω)}) := measureReal_mono hsub
    _ ≤ _ := measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 * k / (2 * ((d : ℝ) / β))) +
        d * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 * k / (3 * ((d : ℝ) / β))) := add_le_add hl hu
    _ ≤ 2 * d * Real.exp (-ε ^ 2 * k / (3 * ((d : ℝ) / β))) := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp hd.le]
    _ = _ := by congr 2; field_simp

name: NLAlib.norm_leverage_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_gram_le
statement:
theorem norm_leverage_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_gram_le
    {n q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] {d k : ℕ}
    (U : Matrix n (Fin d) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (A : Matrix n q ℂ) (hUA : U * (Uᴴ * A) = A)
    (p : n → ℝ≥0) (ω : Fin k → n) {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ‖(leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U)ᴴ * (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U) - 1‖ ≤ ε)
    (x : q → ℂ) :
    (1 - ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
          EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
        EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 + ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let y := (Uᴴ * A) *ᵥ x
  have ha : U *ᵥ y = A *ᵥ x := by
    dsimp only [y]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hUA]
  have hnorm : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ y) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 y : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin d))‖ ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_specNorm_gram_sub_one_le U
      (show specNorm (Uᴴ * U - 1) ≤ (0 : ℝ) by rw [hU, sub_self, specNorm_zero]) y
    simp only [sub_zero, add_zero, one_mul] at hl hu
    exact le_antisymm hu hl
  have hh := norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_specNorm_gram_sub_one_le
    (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U) (by simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using h) y
  rw [← hnorm, ha, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ha] at hh
  exact hh

name: NLAlib.leverage_tail_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem leverage_tail_le_of_sample_size {d k : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {β ε δ : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * (d : ℝ) / (β * ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * d / δ) ≤ k) :
    2 * d * Real.exp (-β * k * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d)) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * d / δ) ≤ β * k * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsize
      (show 0 ≤ β * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d) by positivity)
    have hc : β * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d) *
        (3 * d / (β * ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * d / δ)) = Real.log (2 * d / δ) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hc] at hh
    calc
      _ ≤ β * ε ^ 2 / (3 * d) * (k : ℝ) := hh
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * d * Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * d / δ)) := by
      gcongr
      simpa only [neg_div, neg_mul] using neg_le_neg hlog
    _ = δ := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.measure_leverage_embedding_failure_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem measure_leverage_embedding_failure_le_of_sample_size
    {n q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d] (hk : 0 < k)
    (U : Matrix n (Fin d) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (A : Matrix n q ℂ) (hUA : U * (Uᴴ * A) = A)
    (p : n → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hdom : ∀ i, β * (∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2) / d ≤ p i)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * (d : ℝ) / (β * ε ^ 2) * Real.log (2 * d / δ) ≤ k) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)
      {ω | ∃ x : q → ℂ,
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
          EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2 <
          (1 - ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 ∨
        (1 + ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 <
          ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
            EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2}).toReal ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : {ω | ∃ x : q → ℂ,
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
          EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2 <
          (1 - ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 ∨
        (1 + ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 <
          ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (leverageSamplingSketch p ω *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) :
            EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin k))‖ ^ 2} ⊆
      {ω | ε ≤ ‖(leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U)ᴴ * (leverageSamplingSketch p ω * U) - 1‖} := by
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hω
    by_contra hnot
    change ¬ε ≤ ‖_‖ at hnot
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := norm_leverage_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_gram_le U hU A hUA p ω
      (not_le.mp hnot).le x
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> linarith
  exact (measureReal_mono hsub).trans
    ((measure_le_norm_leverage_gram_sub_one hk U hU p hp hβ hdom hε0 hε1).trans
      (leverage_tail_le_of_sample_size (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)) hβ hε0 hδ hsize))

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_zero_range
statement:
theorem norm_mulVec_sq_bounds_of_zero_range
    {n q k : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype q] [Fintype k]
    (S : Matrix k n ℂ) (A : Matrix n q ℂ) (U : Matrix n (Fin 0) ℂ)
    (hUA : U * (Uᴴ * A) = A) (ε : ℝ) (x : q → ℂ) :
    (1 - ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) : EuclideanSpace ℂ k)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (S *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) : EuclideanSpace ℂ k)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 + ε) * ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ x) : EuclideanSpace ℂ n)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A = 0 := by
    rw [← hUA]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp [hA]

name: NLAlib.re_trace_columnRowSample_gram
statement:
private theorem re_trace_columnRowSample_gram (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (p : m → ℝ≥0) (i : m) :
    (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i).trace.re = (∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2) / p i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [columnRowSample, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.smul_re, Complex.re_sum,
    smul_eq_mul]
  change (∑ a, (p i : ℝ)⁻¹ * (star (C i a) * C i a).re) = _
  have hnorm (z : ℂ) : (star z * z).re = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hz : (Complex.normSq z : ℂ) = star z * z := Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self
    have h := congrArg Complex.re hz
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using h.symm
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm _ (p i : ℝ)⁻¹, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [hnorm]

name: NLAlib.sq_columnRowSample_gram
proof:
:= by
  have hdot : (fun b => C i b) ⬝ᵥ (fun a => star (C i a)) =
      ((∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_sum,
      Complex.ofReal_pow]
    rfl
  simp only [columnRowSample, pow_two, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hdot, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul]
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Complex.real_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  push_cast
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_smul_sub_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hright : (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (W i * M)) = M * M := by
    simp only [← Matrix.smul_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hmean]
  have hleft : (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (M * W i)) = M * M := by
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_smul]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hmean]
  have hconst : (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • M ^ 2) = M ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
    have hp' : ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hp
    rw [hp', one_smul]
  have hexp (i : m) : (W i - M) ^ 2 = W i ^ 2 - W i * M - M * W i + M ^ 2 := by
    noncomm_ring
  simp_rw [hexp, smul_add, smul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    hright, hleft, hconst]
  noncomm_ring

name: NLAlib.covariance_sample_properties
statement:
private theorem covariance_sample_properties (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (p : m → ℝ≥0)
    (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hdom : ∀ i, (∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2) ≤ t * (p i : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i) = Cᴴ * C ∧
      (∀ i, columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i ≤ t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ∧
      Cᴴ * C ≤ t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) ∧
      (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i) ^ 2) ≤ t • (Cᴴ * C)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := columnRowSample Cᴴ C p
  have htrace (i : m) : (W i).trace.re ≤ t := by
    rw [re_trace_columnRowSample_gram]
    by_cases hi : (p i : ℝ) = 0
    · rw [hi, div_zero]
      exact ht.le
    · exact (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_le_of_ne (p i).coe_nonneg (Ne.symm hi))).mpr (hdom i)
  have hW (i : m) : W i ≤ t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) :=
    ((posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).specNorm_le_iff ht.le).mp
      ((posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).specNorm_le_re_trace.trans (htrace i))
  have hsupport : ∀ i, p i = 0 →
      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => Cᴴ a i) (fun b => C i b) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hq : ∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · simpa only [hi, NNReal.coe_zero, mul_zero] using hdom i
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
    have hrow (a : n) : C i a = 0 := by
      have hh := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun a _ => sq_nonneg ‖C i a‖)).mp hq
      exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (hh a (Finset.mem_univ a)))
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hrow, star_zero, zero_mul,
      Matrix.zero_apply]
  have hmean : (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • W i) = Cᴴ * C :=
    sum_probability_smul_columnRowSample Cᴴ C p hsupport
  have hmass : ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hM : Cᴴ * C ≤ t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [← hmean]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left (hW i) (p i).coe_nonneg
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_smul, hmass, one_smul]
  refine ⟨hmean, hW, hM, ?_⟩
  change (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • W i ^ 2) ≤ t • (Cᴴ * C)
  rw [← hmean, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [smul_comm t]
  apply smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left _ (p i).coe_nonneg
  rw [sq_columnRowSample_gram]
  exact smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right
    (by simpa only [W, re_trace_columnRowSample_gram] using htrace i)
    (posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).nonneg

name: NLAlib.centered_covariance_sample_bounds
statement:
private theorem centered_covariance_sample_bounds (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (p : m → ℝ≥0)
    (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hC : Cᴴ * C ≤ 1) (hdom : ∀ i, (∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2) ≤ t * (p i : ℝ)) :
    (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i - Cᴴ * C)) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i, specNorm (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i - Cᴴ * C) ≤ t) ∧
      (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i - Cᴴ * C) ^ 2) ≤
        t • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hmean, hW, hM, hsecond⟩ := covariance_sample_properties C p hp ht hdom
  have hmass : ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hmean, ← Finset.sum_smul, hmass, one_smul, sub_self]
  · intro i
    apply (((posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).isHermitian.sub
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C).isHermitian).specNorm_le_iff_sandwich ht.le).mpr
    constructor
    · have h := add_le_add (neg_le_neg hM) (posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).nonneg
      simpa only [add_zero, zero_add, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using h
    · exact (sub_le_self _ (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C).nonneg).trans (hW i)
  · rw [sum_smul_sub_sq hp _ _ hmean]
    have hMsq : 0 ≤ (Cᴴ * C) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [pow_two, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using
        (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (Cᴴ * C)).nonneg
    exact (sub_le_self _ hMsq).trans (hsecond.trans
      (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hC ht.le))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sampled_gram_sub_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sampled_gram_sub_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m] [Nonempty n]
    (C : Matrix m n ℂ) (p : m → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hC : Cᴴ * C ≤ 1)
    (hdom : ∀ i, (∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2) ≤ t * (p i : ℝ))
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)).real
      {ω | ε < specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix C p ω)ᴴ * sampledRowMatrix C p ω - Cᴴ * C)} ≤
        2 * Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  let ν := finiteSamplingLaw p hp
  let μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => ν)
  let W := columnRowSample Cᴴ C p
  let M := Cᴴ * C
  let c : ℝ := 1 / (s : ℝ)
  let V := ∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (W i - M) ^ 2
  let Y (i : m) := c • (W i - M)
  let Z (j : Fin s) (ω : Fin s → m) := Y (ω j)
  obtain ⟨hcenter, hbound, hvariance⟩ := centered_covariance_sample_bounds C p hp ht hC hdom
  have hc : 0 < c := one_div_pos.mpr hsR
  have hWH (i : m) : (W i - M).IsHermitian :=
    (posSemidef_columnRowSample_gram C p i).isHermitian.sub
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self C).isHermitian
  have hYH (i : m) : (Y i).IsHermitian :=
    (hWH i).smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial c))
  have hZmeas (j : Fin s) : Measurable (Z j) :=
    (show Measurable Y from Measurable.of_discrete).comp (measurable_pi_apply j)
  have hZbound (j : Fin s) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (Z j ω) ≤ t / s := by
    apply ae_of_all
    intro ω
    change specNorm (c • (W (ω j) - M)) ≤ t / s
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc,
      ← specNorm_eq_norm]
    calc
      _ ≤ c * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound (ω j)) hc.le
      _ = t / s := by dsimp only [c]; ring
  have hYmean : ∫ i, Y i ∂ν = 0 := by
    change (∫ i, c • (W i - M) ∂finiteSamplingLaw p hp) = 0
    rw [integral_smul, integral_finiteSamplingLaw]
    change c • (∑ i, (p i : ℝ) • (columnRowSample Cᴴ C p i - Cᴴ * C)) = 0
    rw [hcenter, smul_zero]
  have hmean (j : Fin s) : ∫ ω, Z j ω ∂μ = 0 := by
    change (∫ ω : Fin s → m, Y (ω j) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => ν)) = 0
    rw [integral_comp_eval (show AEStronglyMeasurable Y ν from .of_discrete), hYmean]
  have hV : V.PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    apply smul_nonneg (p i).coe_nonneg
    simpa only [pow_two, (hWH i).eq] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self (W i - M)).nonneg
  have hVnorm : specNorm V ≤ t := (hV.specNorm_le_iff ht.le).mpr hvariance
  have hYsq : (∫ i, Y i ^ 2 ∂ν) = c ^ 2 • V := by
    change (∫ i, (c • (W i - M)) ^ 2 ∂finiteSamplingLaw p hp) = _
    rw [integral_finiteSamplingLaw]
    simp only [smul_pow]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact smul_comm _ _ _
  have hvar : (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = c • V := by
    have he (j : Fin s) : (∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = c ^ 2 • V := by
      change (∫ ω : Fin s → m, Y (ω j) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => ν)) = _
      calc
        _ = ∫ i, Y i ^ 2 ∂ν := integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin s => ν) (i := j)
          (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun i => Y i ^ 2) ν from .of_discrete)
        _ = _ := hYsq
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    dsimp only [c]
    field_simp
  have hvarnorm : specNorm (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ t / s := by
    rw [hvar, specNorm_eq_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc,
      ← specNorm_eq_norm]
    calc
      _ ≤ c * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hVnorm hc.le
      _ = t / s := by dsimp only [c]; ring
  have hsum (ω : Fin s → m) : ∑ j, Z j ω =
      (sampledRowMatrix C p ω)ᴴ * sampledRowMatrix C p ω - Cᴴ * C := by
    rw [sampledRowMatrix_conjTranspose, sampledColumnMatrix_mul_sampledRowMatrix]
    change (∑ j, c • (W (ω j) - M)) = c • ∑ j, W (ω j) - M
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, smul_sub, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
    have hcs : c * (s : ℝ) = 1 := by dsimp only [c]; field_simp
    rw [hcs, one_smul]
  have htail := (integral_and_measureReal_specNorm_sum_le_bernstein_hermitian μ Z
    (div_nonneg ht.le hsR.le) hZmeas
    (iIndepFun_pi fun _ => (show AEMeasurable Y ν from Measurable.of_discrete.aemeasurable))
    (fun j => ae_of_all _ fun ω => hYH (ω j)) hZbound hmean).2 ε hε.le
  have hden : 0 < specNorm (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) + t / s * ε / 3 := by
    have hn := specNorm_nonneg (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ)
    positivity
  have hexp : -(ε ^ 2 / 2) /
      (specNorm (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) + t / s * ε / 3) ≤
        -(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)) := by
    have hD : specNorm (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ) + t / s * ε / 3 ≤
        t / s * (1 + ε / 3) := by nlinarith only [hvarnorm]
    calc
      _ ≤ -(ε ^ 2 / 2) / (t / s * (1 + ε / 3)) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden (by positivity)).mpr
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hD (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ε])
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  calc
    _ ≤ μ.real {ω | ε ≤ specNorm (∑ j, Z j ω)} := measureReal_mono fun ω hω => by
      change ε ≤ specNorm (∑ j, Z j ω)
      rw [hsum]
      exact hω.le
    _ ≤ bernsteinTail (2 * Fintype.card n)
        (specNorm (∑ j, ∫ ω, Z j ω ^ 2 ∂μ)) (t / s) ε := htail
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [bernsteinTail, if_neg hden.ne']
      simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_specNorm_sampled_transpose_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_specNorm_sampled_transpose_mul_sub_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m] [Nonempty n]
    (C : Matrix m n ℝ) (p : m → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hC : Cᵀ * C ≤ 1)
    (hdom : ∀ i, (∑ a, ‖C i a‖ ^ 2) ≤ t * (p i : ℝ))
    {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)).real
      {ω | ε < specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix C p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix C p ω - Cᵀ * C)} ≤
        2 * Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (2 * t * (1 + ε / 3)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hCc : (C.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * C.map Complex.ofReal ≤ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) := by
    rw [conjTranspose_map_ofReal_mul_self C, ← map_one (realMatrixComplexification (𝕜 := ℂ))]
    exact (realMatrixComplexification_le_iff _ _).mpr hC
  have hdc (i : m) : ∑ a, ‖(C.map Complex.ofReal) i a‖ ^ 2 ≤ t * (p i : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Matrix.map_apply, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hdom i
  have hn (ω : Fin s → m) :
      specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix (C.map Complex.ofReal) p ω)ᴴ *
        sampledRowMatrix (C.map Complex.ofReal) p ω - (C.map Complex.ofReal)ᴴ * C.map Complex.ofReal) =
      specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix C p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix C p ω - Cᵀ * C) := by
    rw [sampledRowMatrix_map_ofReal,
      conjTranspose_map_ofReal_mul_self (sampledRowMatrix C p ω),
      conjTranspose_map_ofReal_mul_self C, ← map_sub]
    exact specNorm_map_ofReal _
  simpa only [hn] using measureReal_specNorm_sampled_gram_sub_le
    (C.map Complex.ofReal) p hp ht hCc hdc hs hε

name: NLAlib.memLp_inclusionIndicator
statement:
private theorem memLp_inclusionIndicator (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) (i : n) :
    MemLp (inclusionIndicator i) 2 (lEnsembleLaw L hL)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MemLp.of_bound (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (ae_of_all _ fun S => ?_)
  simp only [inclusionIndicator]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.measureReal_mem_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_mem_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) (i : n) :
    (lEnsembleLaw L hL).real {S | i ∈ S} = lEnsembleKernel L i i
proof:
:= by
  have h := measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw L hL {i}
  simpa only [Finset.singleton_subset_iff, principalMinor, Matrix.toBlock,
    Matrix.det_submatrix_singleton] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_inclusionIndicator
statement:
private theorem integral_inclusionIndicator (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) (i : n) :
    ∫ S, inclusionIndicator i S ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL = lEnsembleKernel L i i
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_subset_indicator_lEnsembleLaw L hL {i}
  simpa only [Finset.singleton_subset_iff, inclusionIndicator, principalMinor, Matrix.toBlock,
    Matrix.det_submatrix_singleton] using h

name: NLAlib.integral_inclusionIndicator_mul
statement:
private theorem integral_inclusionIndicator_mul (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∫ S, inclusionIndicator i S * inclusionIndicator j S ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL =
      lEnsembleKernel L i i * lEnsembleKernel L j j - lEnsembleKernel L i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : (fun S => inclusionIndicator i S * inclusionIndicator j S) =
      fun S => if ({i, j} : Finset n) ⊆ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    funext S
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hj : j ∈ S <;>
      simp [inclusionIndicator, Finset.insert_subset_iff, hi, hj]
  rw [he, integral_subset_indicator_lEnsembleLaw]
  change ((lEnsembleKernel L).submatrix
    (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)
    (Subtype.val : ↥({i, j} : Finset n) → n)).det = _
  rw [Matrix.det_submatrix_pair _ hij]
  have hs : lEnsembleKernel L j i = lEnsembleKernel L i j := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => A i j) (lEnsembleKernel_isHermitian hL).eq
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_apply] using hh
  rw [hs, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.covariance_mem_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem covariance_mem_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    covariance (fun S : Finset n => if i ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      (fun S : Finset n => if j ∈ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) (lEnsembleLaw L hL) =
      -lEnsembleKernel L i j ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change covariance (inclusionIndicator i) (inclusionIndicator j) _ = _
  rw [covariance_eq_sub (memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL i) (memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL j)]
  change (∫ S, inclusionIndicator i S * inclusionIndicator j S ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL) - _ = _
  rw [integral_inclusionIndicator_mul L hL hij,
    integral_inclusionIndicator L hL, integral_inclusionIndicator L hL]
  ring

name: NLAlib.card_eq_sum_inclusionIndicator
statement:
private theorem card_eq_sum_inclusionIndicator (S : Finset n) :
    (S.card : ℝ) = ∑ i, inclusionIndicator i S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [inclusionIndicator, Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.integral_card_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem integral_card_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    ∫ S, (S.card : ℝ) ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL = (lEnsembleKernel L).trace
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [card_eq_sum_inclusionIndicator]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL i).integrable (by norm_num)]
  simp only [integral_inclusionIndicator, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag]

name: NLAlib.variance_card_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem variance_card_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    variance (fun S : Finset n => (S.card : ℝ)) (lEnsembleLaw L hL) =
      (lEnsembleKernel L - lEnsembleKernel L * lEnsembleKernel L).trace
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcov (i j : n) : covariance (inclusionIndicator i) (inclusionIndicator j)
      (lEnsembleLaw L hL) =
      (if i = j then lEnsembleKernel L i i else 0) -
        lEnsembleKernel L i j * lEnsembleKernel L j i := by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [covariance_eq_sub (memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL i) (memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL i)]
      have he : inclusionIndicator i * inclusionIndicator i = inclusionIndicator i := by
        funext S
        simp only [Pi.mul_apply, inclusionIndicator]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
      rw [he, integral_inclusionIndicator L hL]
      simp only [ite_true]
    · have hh := covariance_mem_lEnsembleLaw L hL hij
      change covariance (inclusionIndicator i) (inclusionIndicator j) _ = _ at hh
      have hs : lEnsembleKernel L j i = lEnsembleKernel L i j := by
        have he := congrArg (fun A : Matrix n n ℝ => A i j) (lEnsembleKernel_isHermitian hL).eq
        simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_apply] using he
      simpa only [if_neg hij, zero_sub, hs, pow_two] using hh
  simp_rw [card_eq_sum_inclusionIndicator]
  rw [variance_fun_sum (fun i => memLp_inclusionIndicator L hL i), Matrix.trace_sub]
  simp only [hcov, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleKernel_scaled_rowGram
statement:
theorem lEnsembleKernel_scaled_rowGram (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    lEnsembleKernel (ρ⁻¹ • (A * Aᵀ)) = ridgeKernel A ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hL : (ρ⁻¹ • (A * Aᵀ)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
      (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self Aᵀ).smul (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le)
  have hm : 1 + ρ⁻¹ • (A * Aᵀ) = ρ⁻¹ • ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ := by
    simp only [ridgeGram, Matrix.transpose_transpose, smul_add, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ.ne', one_smul, add_comm]
  have hi : (1 + ρ⁻¹ • (A * Aᵀ))⁻¹ = ρ • (ridgeGram Aᵀ ρ)⁻¹ := by
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
    rw [hm, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp
        (posDef_ridgeGram Aᵀ hρ).isUnit), smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ.ne', one_smul]
  rw [lEnsembleKernel_eq_one_sub_inv hL, hi, ridgeKernel_eq_one_sub_smul_inv A hρ]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_mem_lEnsembleRidgeLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_mem_lEnsembleRidgeLaw (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (i : m) :
    (lEnsembleRidgeLaw A ρ hρ).real {S | i ∈ S} = ridgeLeverageScore A ρ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold lEnsembleRidgeLaw
  rw [measureReal_mem_lEnsembleLaw, lEnsembleKernel_scaled_rowGram A hρ]
  exact (ridgeLeverageScore_eq_ridgeKernel_apply A ρ i).symm

name: NLAlib.integral_card_lEnsembleRidgeLaw
statement:
theorem integral_card_lEnsembleRidgeLaw (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∫ S, (S.card : ℝ) ∂lEnsembleRidgeLaw A ρ hρ = ridgeEffectiveDimension A ρ
proof:
:= by
  unfold lEnsembleRidgeLaw
  rw [integral_card_lEnsembleLaw, lEnsembleKernel_scaled_rowGram A hρ,
    ridgeEffectiveDimension_eq_trace]

name: NLAlib.sum_sequenceLabelCount
statement:
theorem sum_sequenceLabelCount {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (I : Fin k → α) : ∑ j, sequenceLabelCount I j = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold sequenceLabelCount
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sequenceLabelCount_permute
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetConditionalWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem iidSubsetConditionalWeight_nonneg
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) (I : Fin k → α) :
    0 ≤ iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I
proof:
:= by
  unfold iidSubsetConditionalWeight
  positivity

name: NLAlib.sum_iidSubsetConditionalWeight
statement:
theorem sum_iidSubsetConditionalWeight
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    ∑ I, iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨T⟩ : 0 < Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k)).ne'
  unfold iidSubsetConditionalWeight
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  change (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ) * iidSubsetMarginal hk T = 1
  rw [iidSubsetMarginal_eq_uniform]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetConditionalWeight_invariant
statement:
theorem iidSubsetConditionalWeight_invariant
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α)
    (T : ExactRowSubset α k) (I : Fin k → α) :
    iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk (permuteExactRowSubset σ T) (σ ∘ I) =
      iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [iidSubsetConditionalWeight, iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_invariant]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetExpectedCount_invariant
statement:
theorem iidSubsetExpectedCount_invariant
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) (j : α) :
    iidSubsetExpectedCount hk (permuteExactRowSubset σ T) (σ j) =
      iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j
proof:
:= by
  unfold iidSubsetExpectedCount
  rw [← (permuteSequenceEquiv σ).sum_comp]
  change (∑ I, iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk (permuteExactRowSubset σ T) (σ ∘ I) *
      sequenceLabelCount (σ ∘ I) (σ j)) = _
  simp_rw [iidSubsetConditionalWeight_invariant, sequenceLabelCount_permute]

name: NLAlib.permuteExactRowSubset_swap_eq
statement:
theorem permuteExactRowSubset_swap_eq
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (T : ExactRowSubset α k) (i j : α) (hij : i ∈ T.val ↔ j ∈ T.val) :
    permuteExactRowSubset (Equiv.swap i j) T = T
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext a
  simp only [permuteExactRowSubset, Finset.mem_map_equiv, Equiv.symm_swap]
  by_cases hai : a = i
  · subst a; simpa using hij.symm
  · by_cases haj : a = j
    · subst a; simpa using hij
    · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hai haj]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hh := iidSubsetExpectedCount_invariant hk (Equiv.swap i j) T i
  rw [permuteExactRowSubset_swap_eq T i j (iff_of_true hi hj), Equiv.swap_apply_left] at hh
  exact hh.symm

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) {j : α} (hj : j ∉ T.val) :
    iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold iidSubsetExpectedCount
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro I _
  by_cases hq : (iidSubsetJointPMF hk (I, T)).toReal = 0
  · simp [iidSubsetConditionalWeight, hq]
  have hs : Finset.univ.image I ⊆ T.val := by
    by_contra hnot
    exact hq (iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_eq_zero_of_not_subset hk I T hnot)
  have hc : sequenceLabelCount I j = 0 := by
    unfold sequenceLabelCount
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a _
    have hne : I a ≠ j := by
      intro heq
      apply hj
      rw [← heq]
      exact hs (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
    simp [hne]
  rw [hc, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.sum_iidSubsetExpectedCount
statement:
theorem sum_iidSubsetExpectedCount
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    ∑ j, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j = k
proof:
:= by
  unfold iidSubsetExpectedCount
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_sequenceLabelCount]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_iidSubsetConditionalWeight, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_one_of_mem
statement:
theorem iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_one_of_mem
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k)
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) {i : α} (hi : i ∈ T.val) :
    iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ j ∈ T.val, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j) = k := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j := Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
        (fun j _ hj => iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem hk T hj)
      _ = _ := sum_iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T
  have heq : (k : ℝ) * iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T i = (k : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _j ∈ T.val, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T i := by simp [T.property]
      _ = ∑ j ∈ T.val, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j := Finset.sum_congr rfl
        (fun j hj => iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_of_mem hk T hi hj)
      _ = k := hsum
  have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0.ne'
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hkR
  simpa only [mul_one] using heq

name: NLAlib.sum_sequence_eq_sum_count_smul
statement:
theorem sum_sequence_eq_sum_count_smul
    {α E : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} (I : Fin k → α) (A : α → E) :
    (∑ a, A (I a)) = ∑ j, sequenceLabelCount I j • A j
proof:
:= by
  unfold sequenceLabelCount
  simp only [Finset.sum_smul, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: NLAlib.sum_conditionalWeight_smul_sequence_sum
statement:
theorem sum_conditionalWeight_smul_sequence_sum
    {α E : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) (A : α → E) :
    (∑ I, iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I • ∑ a, A (I a)) = ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sum_sequence_eq_sum_count_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  change (∑ j, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j • A j) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ T.val, iidSubsetExpectedCount hk T j • A j := (Finset.sum_subset
      (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun j _ hj => by
        rw [iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_zero_of_not_mem hk T hj, zero_smul])).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [iidSubsetExpectedCount_eq_one_of_mem hk0 hk T hj, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities
statement:
theorem sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e)
    (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank) : ∑ e, o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w e = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_normalizedSamplingProbabilities
  · intro e
    exact (o.weight_mul_edgeResistance_mem_Icc w (fun e => (hw e).le) e).1
  · rw [(o.sum_weight_mul_edgeResistance w hw).1]
    exact_mod_cast hr

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.coe_resistanceSamplingProbabilities
statement:
theorem coe_resistanceSamplingProbabilities (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e)
    (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank) (e : E) :
    (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w e : ℝ) =
      w e * o.edgeResistance w e / (o.laplacian w).rank
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 0 < ∑ e, w e * o.edgeResistance w e := by
    rw [(o.sum_weight_mul_edgeResistance w hw).1]
    exact_mod_cast hr
  rw [resistanceSamplingProbabilities, coe_normalizedSamplingProbabilities _
    (fun e => (o.weight_mul_edgeResistance_mem_Icc w (fun e => (hw e).le) e).1) ht,
    (o.sum_weight_mul_edgeResistance w hw).1]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.resistanceSampledWeights_nonneg
statement:
theorem resistanceSampledWeights_nonneg (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e)
    {q : ℕ} (ω : Fin q → E) (e : E) : 0 ≤ o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω e
proof:
:= by
  unfold resistanceSampledWeights
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw e) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w e).coe_nonneg)

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.sampled_weightedIncidence_gram_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sampled_weightedIncidence_gram_eq_sum (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 ≤ w e)
    (p : E → ℝ≥0) {q : ℕ} (ω : Fin q → E) :
    (sampledRowMatrix (o.weightedIncidence w) p ω)ᵀ *
      sampledRowMatrix (o.weightedIncidence w) p ω =
      ∑ j, (w (ω j) / ((q : ℝ) * (p (ω j) : ℝ))) •
        Matrix.vecMulVec (o.incidence (ω j)) (o.incidence (ω j))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, sampledRowMatrix, weightedIncidence,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (p (ω j) : ℝ)))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (w (ω j)) ^ 2 *
        (o.incidence (ω j) a * o.incidence (ω j) b) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (hw (ω j))]
      ring

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.laplacian_resistanceSampledWeights_eq_sampled_gram
statement:
theorem laplacian_resistanceSampledWeights_eq_sampled_gram
    (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank)
    {q : ℕ} (ω : Fin q → E) :
    o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) =
      (sampledRowMatrix (o.weightedIncidence w) (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω)ᵀ *
        sampledRowMatrix (o.weightedIncidence w) (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [o.laplacian_eq_sum_weight_smul_vecMulVec _
    (o.resistanceSampledWeights_nonneg w (fun e => (hw e).le) ω),
    o.sampled_weightedIncidence_gram_eq_sum w (fun e => (hw e).le)]
  have hf := Finset.sum_fiberwise' (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)) ω (fun e =>
    (w e / ((q : ℝ) * (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w e : ℝ))) •
      Matrix.vecMulVec (o.incidence e) (o.incidence e))
  rw [← hf]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  rw [Finset.sum_const, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [resistanceSampledWeights, if_neg hr.ne', sampleCount]
  ring

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.laplacian_resistanceSampledWeights_eq_zero_of_rank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem laplacian_resistanceSampledWeights_eq_zero_of_rank_eq_zero
    (w : E → ℝ) (hr : (o.laplacian w).rank = 0) {q : ℕ} (ω : Fin q → E) :
    o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [resistanceSampledWeights, if_pos hr, laplacian_zero]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.card_resistanceSampledWeights_support_le
statement:
theorem card_resistanceSampledWeights_support_le (w : E → ℝ) {q : ℕ} (ω : Fin q → E) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω e ≠ 0)).card ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  apply (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (card_sampleCount_support_le ω)
  intro e he
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at he ⊢
  intro hz
  apply he
  unfold resistanceSampledWeights
  split_ifs <;> simp [hz]

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le
    [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E]
    (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin q => finiteSamplingLaw (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w)
      (o.sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities w hw hr))).real
      {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • o.laplacian w ≤ o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ∧
        o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ≤ (1 + ε) • o.laplacian w)} ≤
      2 * (o.laplacian w).rank *
        Real.exp (-(q : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (3 * (o.laplacian w).rank))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := o.weightedIncidence w
  let U : Matrix E (Fin C.rank) ℝ := orthonormalBasisMatrix (LinearMap.range C.mulVecLin)
  have hU : HasOrthonormalCols U := hasOrthonormalCols_orthonormalBasisMatrix _
  have hRange : LinearMap.range U.mulVecLin = LinearMap.range C.mulVecLin :=
    range_orthonormalBasisMatrix _
  have hRank : (o.laplacian w).rank = C.rank := Matrix.rank_transpose_mul_self C
  have hrC : 0 < C.rank := hRank ▸ hr
  have hUA : U * (Uᵀ * C) = C := mul_conjTranspose_mul_eq_of_range_le hU hRange.ge
  have hP : rangeProjector C = U * Uᵀ :=
    rangeProjector_eq_mul_conjTranspose_of_range_eq hU hRange.symm
  have hrow (e : E) : ∑ a, ‖U e a‖ ^ 2 = w e * o.edgeResistance w e := by
    calc
      _ = (U * Uᵀ) e e := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, pow_two]
      _ = rangeProjector C e e := congrArg (fun M : Matrix E E ℝ => M e e) hP.symm
      _ = _ := (o.weight_mul_edgeResistance_eq_diag w (fun e => (hw e).le) e).symm
  have hdom (e : E) : ∑ a, ‖U e a‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (C.rank : ℝ) * (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w e : ℝ) := by
    rw [hrow, o.coe_resistanceSamplingProbabilities w hw hr e, hRank]
    have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < C.rank := by exact_mod_cast hrC
    exact le_of_eq (by field_simp)
  have h := measureReal_sampled_gram_sandwich_failure_le hrC hq C U hU hUA
    (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) (o.sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities w hw hr)
    hdom hε hε1
  have hEvent : {ω : Fin q → E | ¬ ((1 - ε) • o.laplacian w ≤
      o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ∧
      o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ≤ (1 + ε) • o.laplacian w)} =
      {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • (Cᵀ * C) ≤
        (sampledRowMatrix C (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω)ᵀ *
          sampledRowMatrix C (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω ∧
        (sampledRowMatrix C (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω)ᵀ *
          sampledRowMatrix C (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) ω ≤
            (1 + ε) • (Cᵀ * C))} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rw [o.laplacian_resistanceSampledWeights_eq_sampled_gram w hw hr ω]
    rfl
  rw [hEvent]
  simpa only [← hRank] using h

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (X : Ω → Fin q → E)
    (hX : HasLaw X (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin q => finiteSamplingLaw
      (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w) (o.sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities w hw hr))) μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    μ.real {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • o.laplacian w ≤ o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w (X ω)) ∧
      o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w (X ω)) ≤ (1 + ε) • o.laplacian w)} ≤
      2 * (o.laplacian w).rank *
        Real.exp (-(q : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (3 * (o.laplacian w).rank))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun ω => ¬ ((1 - ε) • o.laplacian w ≤
      o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ∧
      o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ≤ (1 + ε) • o.laplacian w))
    (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet]
  exact o.measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le w hw hr hq hε hε1

name: NLAlib.GraphEdgeOrientation.measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le_of_sample_size
    [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSingletonClass E]
    (w : E → ℝ) (hw : ∀ e, 0 < w e) (hr : 0 < (o.laplacian w).rank)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * (o.laplacian w).rank / ε ^ 2 *
      Real.log (2 * (o.laplacian w).rank / δ) ≤ q) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin q => finiteSamplingLaw (o.resistanceSamplingProbabilities w)
      (o.sum_resistanceSamplingProbabilities w hw hr))).real
      {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • o.laplacian w ≤ o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ∧
        o.laplacian (o.resistanceSampledWeights w ω) ≤ (1 + ε) • o.laplacian w)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (o.measureReal_resistance_sampling_failure_le w hw hr hq hε hε1).trans
  have hb := leverage_tail_le_of_sample_size hr (β := 1) (by norm_num) hε hδ
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using hsize)
  simpa only [neg_one_mul] using hb

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeDeletionStep_toReal_erase
statement:
theorem rowVolumeDeletionStep_toReal_erase (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) {i : n}
    (hi : i ∈ T) (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hdt : Fintype.card d < T.card) :
    (rowVolumeDeletionStep X T (T.erase i)).toReal =
      (1 - rowSubsetLeverage X T i) / (T.card - Fintype.card d : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : T.erase i ∈ T.powersetCard (T.card - 1) :=
    Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨Finset.erase_subset _ _, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi⟩
  have hc : (T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (T.card - 1 - Fintype.card d) =
      T.card - Fintype.card d := by
    rw [show T.card - 1 - Fintype.card d = (T.card - Fintype.card d) - 1 by omega,
      Nat.choose_symm (by omega), Nat.choose_one_right]
  rw [rowVolumeDeletionStep, rowVolumeKernel_eq X T (T.card - 1) hT (by omega) (Nat.sub_le _ _),
    rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight, if_pos hE, hc,
    rowSubsetVolume_erase_eq X T hi hT]
  have ht : ((T.card - Fintype.card d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hdt).ne'
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.pmf_eq_zero_of_not_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) ENNReal.zero_ne_top).mp
  rw [rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight, if_neg hR, zero_div, ENNReal.toReal_zero]

name: NLAlib.pmf_full_size
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply PMF.ext
  intro R
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)).mp
  change (rowVolumePMF X T T.card hT hdt le_rfl R).toReal = (PMF.pure T R).toReal
  rw [rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight, Finset.powersetCard_self]
  by_cases hR : R = T
  · subst R
    simp [hT.ne', PMF.pure_apply]
  · simp [hR, PMF.pure_apply]

name: NLAlib.bind_deletionStep
statement:
private theorem bind_deletionStep (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (t : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hdt : Fintype.card d < t) (htt : t ≤ T.card) :
    (rowVolumePMF X T t hT hdt.le htt).bind (rowVolumeDeletionStep X) =
      rowVolumePMF X T (t - 1) hT (by omega) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = (rowVolumePMF X T t hT hdt.le htt).bind (rowVolumeKernel X (t - 1)) := by
      apply PMF.ext
      intro S
      rw [PMF.bind_apply, PMF.bind_apply]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro R
      by_cases hR : R ∈ T.powersetCard t
      · rw [rowVolumeDeletionStep, (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hR).2]
      · rw [pmf_eq_zero_of_not_mem X T R t hT hdt.le htt hR, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    _ = _ := rowVolumePMF_bind_kernel X T (t - 1) t hT (by omega) (by omega) htt

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeDeletionPMF_eq
statement:
theorem rowVolumeDeletionPMF_eq (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (q : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hq : q + Fintype.card d ≤ T.card) :
    rowVolumeDeletionPMF X q T =
      rowVolumePMF X T (T.card - q) hT (by omega) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [rowVolumeDeletionPMF, Nat.sub_zero] using (pmf_full_size X T hT (by omega)).symm
  | succ q ih =>
    rw [rowVolumeDeletionPMF, ih (by omega), bind_deletionStep X T (T.card - q) hT
      (by omega) (Nat.sub_le _ _)]
    congr 1

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeDeletionPMF_sub_eq
statement:
theorem rowVolumeDeletionPMF_sub_eq (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    rowVolumeDeletionPMF X (T.card - s) T = rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowVolumeDeletionPMF_eq X T (T.card - s) hT (by omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeDeletionLaw_sub_eq
statement:
theorem rowVolumeDeletionLaw_sub_eq (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    rowVolumeDeletionLaw X T (T.card - s) = rowVolumeLaw X T s hT hds hst
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowVolumeDeletionLaw rowVolumeLaw
  rw [rowVolumeDeletionPMF_sub_eq X T s hT hds hst]

name: NLAlib.sampled_gram_bounds_of_specNorm_frame_sub_le
statement:
theorem sampled_gram_bounds_of_specNorm_frame_sub_le {r s : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m (Fin r) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hUA : U * (Uᵀ * A) = A) (p : m → ℝ≥0) (ω : Fin s → m)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hbound : specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix U p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix U p ω - 1) ≤ ε) :
    (1 - ε) • (Aᵀ * A) ≤ (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ∧
      (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ≤ (1 + ε) • (Aᵀ * A)
proof:
:= by
  let D := Uᵀ * A
  let T := (sampledRowMatrix U p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix U p ω
  have hH : (T - 1).IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (sampledRowMatrix U p ω)).sub
      Matrix.isHermitian_one
  have hsand := (hH.specNorm_le_iff_sandwich hε).mp hbound
  have hLo : (1 - ε) • (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) ≤ T := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
    have h := add_le_add_right hsand.1 (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    convert h using 1 <;> abel
  have hHi : T ≤ (1 + ε) • (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) := by
    rw [add_smul, one_smul]
    have h := add_le_add_right hsand.2 (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    convert h using 1
    abel
  have hcong (X Y : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (h : X ≤ Y) :
      Dᵀ * X * D ≤ Dᵀ * Y * D := by
    apply Matrix.le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul] using
      (Matrix.le_iff.mp h).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same D
  have hAD : Dᵀ * D = Aᵀ * A := by
    have hu : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU.conjTranspose_mul_self
    calc
      _ = (U * D)ᵀ * (U * D) := by
        rw [Matrix.transpose_mul U D]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Uᵀ U D, hu, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = _ := by rw [show U * D = A from hUA]
  have hsamp : sampledRowMatrix A p ω = sampledRowMatrix U p ω * D := by
    rw [← hUA, sampledRowMatrix_mul]
  have hsampleGram : Dᵀ * T * D =
      (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω := by
    rw [hsamp, Matrix.transpose_mul (sampledRowMatrix U p ω) D]
    simp only [T, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · have h := hcong _ _ hLo
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hAD, hsampleGram] using h
  · have h := hcong _ _ hHi
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hAD, hsampleGram] using h

name: NLAlib.measureReal_sampled_gram_sandwich_failure_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_sampled_gram_sandwich_failure_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    {r s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s)
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix m (Fin r) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (hUA : U * (Uᵀ * A) = A) (p : m → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hdom : ∀ i, (∑ a, ‖U i a‖ ^ 2) ≤ (r : ℝ) * (p i : ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin s => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)).real
      {ω | ¬ ((1 - ε) • (Aᵀ * A) ≤ (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ∧
        (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ≤ (1 + ε) • (Aᵀ * A))} ≤
      2 * r * Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 / (3 * r))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hgram : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU.conjTranspose_mul_self
  have htail := measureReal_specNorm_sampled_transpose_mul_sub_le U p hp hrR
    (by rw [hgram]) hdom hs hε
  simp only [hgram, Fintype.card_fin] at htail
  have hsubset : {ω : Fin s → m | ¬ ((1 - ε) • (Aᵀ * A) ≤
      (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ∧
      (sampledRowMatrix A p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix A p ω ≤ (1 + ε) • (Aᵀ * A))} ⊆
      {ω | ε < specNorm ((sampledRowMatrix U p ω)ᵀ * sampledRowMatrix U p ω - 1)} := by
    intro ω hω
    by_contra hnot
    exact hω (sampled_gram_bounds_of_specNorm_frame_sub_le A U hU hUA p ω hε.le (not_lt.mp hnot))
  refine (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans (htail.trans ?_)
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (r : ℝ) * (1 + ε / 3) := by positivity
  have hdenle : 2 * (r : ℝ) * (1 + ε / 3) ≤ 3 * r := by nlinarith
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden (by positivity)).mpr
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenle
    (show 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) * ε ^ 2 by positivity)
  nlinarith only [hh]

name: NLAlib.isUnit_det_one_add
statement:
private theorem isUnit_det_one_add {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    IsUnit (1 + L).det
proof:
:=
  isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le
    (hL.one_le_det_one_add)))

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleKernel_mul_one_add
statement:
theorem lEnsembleKernel_mul_one_add {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    lEnsembleKernel L * (1 + L) = L
proof:
:= by
  rw [lEnsembleKernel, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_det_one_add hL), Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleKernel_eq_one_sub_inv
statement:
theorem lEnsembleKernel_eq_one_sub_inv {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    lEnsembleKernel L = 1 - (1 + L)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (1 + L) (isUnit_det_one_add hL)
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul] at h
  change (1 + L)⁻¹ + lEnsembleKernel L = 1 at h
  apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
  simpa only [add_comm] using h

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleKernel_isHermitian
statement:
theorem lEnsembleKernel_isHermitian {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    (lEnsembleKernel L).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [lEnsembleKernel_eq_one_sub_inv hL]
  exact Matrix.isHermitian_one.sub ((Matrix.isHermitian_one.add hL.isHermitian).inv)

name: NLAlib.integral_subset_indicator_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem integral_subset_indicator_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hL : L.PosSemidef) (J : Finset n) :
    ∫ S, (if J ⊆ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL =
      principalMinor (lEnsembleKernel L) J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [integral_lEnsembleLaw]
  have hsum : (∑ S : Finset n, if J ⊆ S then principalMinor L S else 0) =
      (1 + L).det * principalMinor (lEnsembleKernel L) J := by
    exact Matrix.sum_det_principal_minors_superset L (lEnsembleKernel L)
      (lEnsembleKernel_mul_one_add hL) J
  have he : (∑ S : Finset n, lEnsembleProbability L S *
      if J ⊆ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      (∑ S : Finset n, if J ⊆ S then principalMinor L S else 0) / (1 + L).det := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro S _
    by_cases h : J ⊆ S <;> simp [h, lEnsembleProbability]
  rw [he, hsum, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (isUnit_det_one_add hL).ne_zero]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hL : L.PosSemidef) (J : Finset n) :
    (lEnsembleLaw L hL).real {S | J ⊆ S} = principalMinor (lEnsembleKernel L) J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm : MeasurableSet {S : Finset n | J ⊆ S} := (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet
  have hi := integral_indicator_one (μ := lEnsembleLaw L hL) hm
  have he : (∫ S, (if J ⊆ S then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL) =
      (lEnsembleLaw L hL).real {S | J ⊆ S} := by
    simpa only [Set.indicator_apply, Pi.one_apply, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using hi
  rw [← he]
  exact integral_subset_indicator_lEnsembleLaw L hL J

name: NLAlib.measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    {S : Ω → Finset n} (hS : HasLaw S (lEnsembleLaw L hL) μ) (J : Finset n) :
    μ.real {ω | J ⊆ S ω} = principalMinor (lEnsembleKernel L) J
proof:
:= by
  have hm : MeasurableSet {T : Finset n | J ⊆ T} := (Set.toFinite _).measurableSet
  have he := hS.measureReal_eq hm
