  exact he.trans (measureReal_subset_lEnsembleLaw L hL J)

name: NLAlib.rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal
statement:
theorem rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) :
    rowSubsetVolume Q Finset.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rowSubsetVolume, rowSubsetGram, coordinateSelector_univ,
    Matrix.mul_one, hQ.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.det_one, RCLike.one_re]

name: NLAlib.projectionRowVolumeLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem projectionRowVolumeLaw_singleton (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (S : Finset n) :
    (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ).real {S} =
      if S.card = Fintype.card d then rowSubsetVolume Q S else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectionRowVolumeLaw
  rw [rowVolumeLaw_singleton, rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal Q hQ]
  simp [rowVolumeWeight]

name: NLAlib.integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw
statement:
theorem integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (f : Finset n → E) :
    (∫ S, f S ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) =
      ∑ J : SizedSubset n d, rowSubsetVolume Q J.val • f J.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold projectionRowVolumeLaw
  rw [integral_rowVolumeLaw_eq_inv_smul_sum, rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal Q hQ]
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, inv_one, one_smul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_attach]
  let e : {S // S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d)} ≃ SizedSubset n d :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun S => by simp
  rw [← e.sum_comp]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_cramer_minor_sq_of_orthonormal
statement:
private theorem sum_cramer_minor_sq_of_orthonormal [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hE : Qᴴ * E = 0) :
    (∑ J : SizedSubset n d, ∑ i, ∑ j,
      ‖((Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2) =
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) * frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  have he (j : r) : Qᴴ *ᵥ (fun a => E a j) = 0 := by
    funext i
    exact congrFun (congrFun hE i) j
  have hdet (i : d) (j : r) :
      (∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
        ‖((Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ a, ‖E a j‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg RCLike.re (det_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_sum_norm_sq
      (Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)))
    rw [RCLike.ofReal_re] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact re_det_gram_updateCol_of_orthonormal Q hQ _ (he j) i
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ J : SizedSubset n d,
        ‖((Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [hdet]
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
        frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hE : Qᴴ * E = 0) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * E) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) ≤
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) * frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ J : SizedSubset n d, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        ‖((Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro J _
      by_cases hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume Q J.val
      · exact le_of_eq (rowSubsetVolume_mul_frobSq_pseudoinverse_mul Q J hJ E)
      · have hz := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hJ) (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg Q J.val)
        simp only [hz, smul_eq_mul, zero_mul]
        positivity
    _ = _ := sum_cramer_minor_sq_of_orthonormal Q hQ E hE

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_eq_of_full_support
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_eq_of_full_support [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (E : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hE : Qᴴ * E = 0)
    (hfull : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q S)) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * E) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) =
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) * frobSq E
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw]
  calc
    _ = ∑ J : SizedSubset n d, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        ‖((Q.updateCol i (fun a => E a j)).submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id).det‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro J _
      exact rowSubsetVolume_mul_frobSq_pseudoinverse_mul Q J
        ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit Q J.val).mpr (hfull J.val (by simp [J.property]))) E
    _ = _ := sum_cramer_minor_sq_of_orthonormal Q hQ E hE

name: NLAlib.integral_sum_norm_sq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le
statement:
theorem integral_sum_norm_sq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (e : n → 𝕜)
    (he : Qᴴ *ᵥ e = 0) :
    (∫ S, ∑ i, ‖(rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S *ᵥ e) i‖ ^ 2 ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) ≤
      (Fintype.card d : ℝ) * ∑ a, ‖e a‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let E : Matrix n (Fin 1) 𝕜 := fun a _ => e a
  have hE : Qᴴ * E = 0 := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun he i
  have h := integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le Q hQ E hE
  simpa only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Fin.sum_univ_one, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, E] using h

name: NLAlib.projectionVolumeInterpolant_sizedSubset
statement:
theorem projectionVolumeInterpolant_sizedSubset [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜) (J : SizedSubset n d)
    (hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume Q J.val) :
    projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A J.val =
      Q * ((Q.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id)⁻¹ * A.submatrix (sizedSubsetIndex J) id)
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectionVolumeInterpolant, rowSubsetPseudoinverse_sizedSubset_mul Q J hJ A]

name: NLAlib.integral_projectionVolumeInterpolant
statement:
theorem integral_projectionVolumeInterpolant [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (∫ S, projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) = Q * (Qᴴ * A)
proof:
:= by
  have hmean := integral_rowSubsetPseudoinverse_mul Q Finset.univ (Fintype.card d)
    (by rw [rowSubsetVolume_univ_of_orthonormal Q hQ]; exact zero_lt_one) le_rfl
    (by simpa only [Finset.card_univ] using card_le_card_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ) A
  simp only [rowSubsetPseudoinverse_univ, hQ.moorePenroseInverse_eq_conjTranspose] at hmean
  calc
    _ = Q * (∫ S, rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * A ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) := by
      rw [integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw, integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw]
      simp only [projectionVolumeInterpolant, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.mul_smul]
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun B => Q * B) hmean

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) =
      frobSq (projResidual Q A) +
        ∫ S, frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * projResidual Q A) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (∫ S, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) =
      ∫ S, (frobSq (projResidual Q A) + frobSq (rowSubsetPseudoinverse Q S * projResidual Q A))
        ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ := by
    rw [integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw, integral_projectionRowVolumeLaw]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro J _
    by_cases hJ : 0 < rowSubsetVolume Q J.val
    · rw [projectionVolumeInterpolant, frobSq_rowSubset_interpolation_error Q hQ J.val
        ((rowSubsetVolume_pos_iff_isUnit Q J.val).mp hJ)]
    · have hz := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hJ) (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg Q J.val)
      rw [hz, zero_smul, zero_smul]
  rw [heq, integral_add (.of_finite) (.of_finite)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq]
  have h := integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_le Q hQ (projResidual Q A)
    (conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ A)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq_of_full_support
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq_of_full_support [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (hfull : ∀ S ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n).powersetCard (Fintype.card d),
      IsUnit (rowSubsetGram Q S)) :
    (∫ S, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_eq,
    integral_frobSq_projectionRowVolume_solve_eq_of_full_support Q hQ (projResidual Q A)
      (conjTranspose_mul_residual hQ A) hfull]
  ring

name: NLAlib.integral_projectionVolumeInterpolant_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_projectionVolumeInterpolant_of_hasLaw [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (R : Ω → Finset n) (hR : HasLaw R (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) μ) :
    (∫ ω, projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A (R ω) ∂μ) = Q * (Qᴴ * A)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ S, projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ :=
      hR.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable (projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A)
        (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) from .of_discrete)
    _ = _ := integral_projectionVolumeInterpolant Q hQ A

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le_of_hasLaw [Fintype r]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    (Q : Matrix n d 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (A : Matrix n r 𝕜)
    (R : Ω → Finset n) (hR : HasLaw R (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) μ) :
    (∫ ω, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A (R ω)) ∂μ) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) + 1) * frobSq (projResidual Q A)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ S, frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S) ∂projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ :=
      hR.integral_comp (show AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun S => frobSq (A - projectionVolumeInterpolant Q A S))
        (projectionRowVolumeLaw Q hQ) from .of_discrete)
    _ ≤ _ := integral_frobSq_projectionVolumeInterpolant_error_le Q hQ A

name: NLAlib.rowVolumeKernel_eq
statement:
theorem rowVolumeKernel_eq (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ T.card) :
    rowVolumeKernel X s T = rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds hst
proof:
:= by
  simp [rowVolumeKernel, hT, hds, hst]

name: NLAlib.mass_mul_kernel
statement:
private theorem mass_mul_kernel (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T R S : Finset n) (s t : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (htt : t ≤ T.card) (hR : R ∈ T.powersetCard t) :
    (rowVolumePMF X T t hT (hds.trans hst) htt R).toReal *
        (rowVolumeKernel X s R S).toReal =
      if S ∈ R.powersetCard s then rowSubsetVolume X S /
        ((((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (t - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
          ((t - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ)) * rowSubsetVolume X T)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hRc := (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hR).2
  have hc₁ : ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (t - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.choose_ne_zero (Nat.sub_le_sub_right htt _))
  have hc₂ : ((t - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.choose_ne_zero (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hst _))
  rw [rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight, if_pos hR]
  by_cases hRp : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X R
  · rw [rowVolumeKernel_eq X R s hRp hds (hRc ▸ hst), rowVolumePMF_toReal,
      hRc, rowVolumeWeight]
    split_ifs
    · field_simp
    · simp
  · have hz : rowSubsetVolume X R = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hRp) (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X R)
    rw [hz, zero_div, zero_mul]
    split_ifs with hSR
    · have hSz : rowSubsetVolume X S = 0 := le_antisymm
        ((rowSubsetVolume_mono X (Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hSR).1).trans_eq hz)
        (rowSubsetVolume_nonneg X S)
      rw [hSz, zero_div]
    · rfl

name: NLAlib.rowVolumePMF_bind_kernel
statement:
theorem rowVolumePMF_bind_kernel (X : Matrix n d 𝕜) (T : Finset n) (s t : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < rowSubsetVolume X T) (hds : Fintype.card d ≤ s)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (htt : t ≤ T.card) :
    (rowVolumePMF X T t hT (hds.trans hst) htt).bind (rowVolumeKernel X s) =
      rowVolumePMF X T s hT hds (hst.trans htt)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply PMF.ext
  intro S
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _) (PMF.apply_ne_top _ _)).mp
  rw [PMF.toReal_bind_eq_sum]
  let den : ℝ := (((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (t - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
    ((t - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ)) * rowSubsetVolume X T
  have hsum : (∑ R : Finset n,
      (rowVolumePMF X T t hT (hds.trans hst) htt R).toReal * (rowVolumeKernel X s R S).toReal) =
      ∑ R ∈ T.powersetCard t, if S ∈ R.powersetCard s then rowSubsetVolume X S / den else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ R ∈ T.powersetCard t,
          (rowVolumePMF X T t hT (hds.trans hst) htt R).toReal *
            (rowVolumeKernel X s R S).toReal := by
        symm
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
        intro R _ hR
        rw [rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight, if_neg hR, zero_div, zero_mul]
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun R hR => mass_mul_kernel X T R S s t hT hds hst htt hR
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_powersetCard_ite_mem T S s t hst,
    rowVolumePMF_toReal, rowVolumeWeight]
  split_ifs with hS
  · have hc := Nat.choose_mul (n := T.card - Fintype.card d)
      (k := t - Fintype.card d) (s := s - Fintype.card d) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hst _)
    have he₁ : T.card - Fintype.card d - (s - Fintype.card d) = T.card - s := by omega
    have he₂ : t - Fintype.card d - (s - Fintype.card d) = t - s := by omega
    rw [he₁, he₂] at hc
    have hcr : ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (t - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
        ((t - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) =
      ((T.card - Fintype.card d).choose (s - Fintype.card d) : ℝ) *
        ((T.card - s).choose (t - s) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
    have hn : ((T.card - s).choose (t - s) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
      Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.choose_ne_zero (Nat.sub_le_sub_right htt s))
    dsimp only [den]
    rw [hcr, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  · simp

name: NLAlib.integral_ite_eq_uniformOfFintype
statement:
theorem integral_ite_eq_uniformOfFintype (r : ρ) :
    (∫ a : ρ, (if a = r then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype ρ).toMeasure) =
      (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

name: NLAlib.integral_ite_coordinate_eq_coordinate_pi_uniformOfFintype
statement:
theorem integral_ite_coordinate_eq_coordinate_pi_uniformOfFintype
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (∫ h : ι → ρ, (if h i = h j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => (PMF.uniformOfFintype ρ).toMeasure)) =
      (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi fun _ : ι => (PMF.uniformOfFintype ρ).toMeasure
  let δ (r : ρ) (a : ρ) : ℝ := if a = r then 1 else 0
  have hδ (r : ρ) : Measurable (δ r) := Measurable.of_discrete
  have hcoord (r : ρ) (k : ι) :
      (∫ h : ι → ρ, δ r (h k) ∂μ) = (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [integral_comp_eval (hδ r).aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact integral_ite_eq_uniformOfFintype r
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun k (h : ι → ρ) => h k) μ :=
    iIndepFun_pi (fun _ : ι => aemeasurable_id)
  have hpair (r : ρ) :
      (∫ h : ι → ρ, δ r (h i) * δ r (h j) ∂μ) = (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    have hh := ((hind.indepFun hij).comp (hδ r) (hδ r)).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
      (Measurable.of_discrete.aestronglyMeasurable) (Measurable.of_discrete.aestronglyMeasurable)
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hcoord, pow_two] using hh
  have hpoint (h : ι → ρ) : (if h i = h j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∑ r, δ r (h i) * δ r (h j) := by
    simp only [δ, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    simp only [eq_comm]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite]
  change (∑ r : ρ, ∫ h : ι → ρ, δ r (h i) * δ r (h j) ∂μ) = _
  simp_rw [hpair]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hcard : (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le_iid
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_uniform_subset_le_iid
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ T, traceExp (θ • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j) ∂(uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure) ≤
      ∫ I : Fin k → α, traceExp (θ • ∑ a, A (I a))
        ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  let B : α → selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) := fun j => ⟨A j, hA j⟩
  have hh := integral_uniform_subset_convex_le_iid hk0 hk B
    (fun M => traceExp (θ • M.val)) (convexOn_traceExp_smul_selfAdjoint θ)
  have hs (s : Finset α) : (↑(∑ j ∈ s, B j) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = ∑ j ∈ s, A j := by
    exact (map_sum (selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).subtype (fun j => B j) s)
  have hi (I : Fin k → α) : (↑(∑ a, B (I a)) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) = ∑ a, A (I a) := by
    exact (map_sum (selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)).subtype (fun a => B (I a)) Finset.univ)
  simpa only [hs, hi] using hh

name: NLAlib.integral_traceExp_uniform_iid_le
statement:
theorem integral_traceExp_uniform_iid_le
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] {d k : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (A : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).IsHermitian)
    (hbound : ∀ j, 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L)
    (hmean : (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) • ∑ j, A j = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∫ I : Fin k → α, traceExp (θ • ∑ a, A (I a))
      ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure) ≤
      d * Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ)
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure
  let X : Fin k → (Fin k → α) → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ := fun a I => A (I a)
  have hm (a : Fin k) : Measurable (X a) := Measurable.of_discrete
  have hh (a : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ I ∂μ, (X a I).IsHermitian :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun I => hA (I a))
  have hb (a : Fin k) : ∀ᵐ I ∂μ,
      0 ≤ lambdaMin (X a I) ∧ lambdaMax (X a I) ≤ L :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun I => hbound (I a))
  have hi : iIndepFun X μ := by
    rw [show μ = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)
      from uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi (ι := Fin k) (α := α)]
    change iIndepFun (fun a (I : Fin k → α) => A (I a))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure))
    exact iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : Fin k => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)
      (X := fun _ : Fin k => A)
      (fun _ => (show Measurable A from .of_discrete).aemeasurable)
  have he (a : Fin k) : ∫ I, X a I ∂μ = 1 := by
    rw [show μ = Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)
      from uniform_function_toMeasure_eq_pi (ι := Fin k) (α := α)]
    have hev := (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : Fin k =>
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure) a).map_eq
    have hmap := integral_map
      (μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k => (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure))
      (φ := fun I : Fin k → α => I a) (f := A)
      (measurable_pi_apply a).aemeasurable Measurable.of_discrete.aestronglyMeasurable
    change (∫ I, A (I a) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin k =>
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).toMeasure)) = 1
    rw [← hmap, hev, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
    simp only [PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
      ← Finset.smul_sum]
    simpa only [one_div] using hmean
  have hexp (a : Fin k) : Integrable (fun I => matrixExp (θ • X a I)) μ :=
    Integrable.of_finite
  have hcum := trace_cgf_subadditivity μ X θ hm hh hi hexp
  have hcH : (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian :=
    isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun a _ => cfc_predicate Real.log _)
  have hsum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
      (((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) := by
    have hc (a : Fin k) :=
      (chernoff_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X a) L hL (hm a) (hh a) (hb a) θ).2
    have hs : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
        (∑ _a : Fin k, chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) := by
      unfold cumulantSum
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun a _ => by simpa only [he, Matrix.le_iff] using hc a)
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul] using hs
  calc
    _ ≤ traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := by
      simpa only [X, Finset.smul_sum] using hcum
    _ ≤ traceExp (((k : ℝ) * chernoffCgfCoefficient L θ) •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ)) :=
      traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcH (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (IsSelfAdjoint.all _)) hsum
    _ = _ := by rw [traceExp_smul_one_eq_card_mul_exp, Fintype.card_fin]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_le_of_probability_domination
statement:
theorem integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_le_of_probability_domination
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n t ℂ)
    (p : n → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hdom : ∀ i, β * columnRowWeight A B i / ∑ j, columnRowWeight A B j ≤ p i)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n, ‖sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω - A * B‖ ^ 2
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)) ≤
      ‖A‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2 / (β * c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i
  have hsupp : ∀ i, p i = 0 → Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => A a i) (fun b => B i b) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    apply vecMulVec_eq_zero_of_columnRowWeight_eq_zero A B i
    have hh := hdom i
    rw [hi, NNReal.coe_zero, div_le_iff₀ hW, zero_mul] at hh
    have hw := columnRowWeight_nonneg A B i
    nlinarith
  have hterm (i : n) : columnRowWeight A B i ^ 2 / p i ≤ (W / β) * columnRowWeight A B i := by
    by_cases hi : (p i : ℝ) = 0
    · rw [hi, div_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hW.le hβ.le) (columnRowWeight_nonneg A B i)
    · have hip : 0 < (p i : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_ne (p i).coe_nonneg (Ne.symm hi)
      rw [show (W / β) * columnRowWeight A B i = W * columnRowWeight A B i / β by ring,
        div_le_div_iff₀ hip hβ]
      have hh := hdom i
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hW] at hh
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh (columnRowWeight_nonneg A B i)
      dsimp only [W]
      nlinarith
  have hmoment : (∑ i, ((∑ a, ‖A a i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ b, ‖B i b‖ ^ 2) / p i) ≤ W ^ 2 / β := by
    simp_rw [← columnRowWeight_sq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (W / β) * columnRowWeight A B i := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hterm i)
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; change (W / β) * W = W ^ 2 / β; ring
  rw [integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq A B p hp hsupp hc, one_div_mul_eq_div]
  calc
    _ ≤ (W ^ 2 / β) / (c : ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      ((sub_le_self _ (sq_nonneg _)).trans hmoment) (Nat.cast_nonneg c)
    _ ≤ (‖A‖ ^ 2 * ‖B‖ ^ 2 / β) / (c : ℝ) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sum_columnRowWeight_sq_le A B) hβ.le)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg c)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_le_of_probability_domination
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_sampled_mul_sub_le_of_probability_domination
    {m n t : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t]
    [MeasurableSpace n] [MeasurableSingletonClass n]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (B : Matrix n t ℝ)
    (p : n → ℝ≥0) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hW : 0 < ∑ i, columnRowWeight A B i) {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hdom : ∀ i, β * columnRowWeight A B i / ∑ j, columnRowWeight A B j ≤ p i)
    {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ ω : Fin c → n,
      frobSq (sampledColumnMatrix A p ω * sampledRowMatrix B p ω - A * B)
      ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => finiteSamplingLaw p hp)) ≤ frobSq A * frobSq B / (β * c)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : columnRowWeight (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) =
      columnRowWeight A B := by
    funext i
    simp [columnRowWeight, Matrix.map_apply]
  have h := integral_frobenius_sampled_mul_sub_sq_le_of_probability_domination
    (A.map Complex.ofReal) (B.map Complex.ofReal) p hp (by rwa [hw]) hβ
    (by simpa only [hw] using hdom) hc
  simp only [sampledColumnMatrix_map_ofReal, sampledRowMatrix_map_ofReal] at h
  have hmap : ∀ X : Matrix m (Fin c) ℝ, ∀ Y : Matrix (Fin c) t ℝ,
      X.map Complex.ofReal * Y.map Complex.ofReal - A.map Complex.ofReal * B.map Complex.ofReal =
        (X * Y - A * B).map Complex.ofReal := by
    intro X Y
    ext a b
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Complex.ofReal_sum]
  simpa only [hmap, frobenius_norm_sq_map_ofReal_eq_frobSq] using h

name: NLAlib.sum_principalMinor_eq_det_one_add
statement:
theorem sum_principalMinor_eq_det_one_add (L : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    ∑ S : Finset n, principalMinor L S = (1 + L).det
proof:
:= by
  exact (Matrix.det_one_add_eq_sum_principal_minors L).symm

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleProbability_nonneg
statement:
theorem lEnsembleProbability_nonneg {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    (S : Finset n) : 0 ≤ lEnsembleProbability L S
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (principalMinor_nonneg hL S) ((by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1).trans
    (hL.one_le_det_one_add))

name: NLAlib.sum_lEnsembleProbability
statement:
theorem sum_lEnsembleProbability {L : Matrix n n ℝ} (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    ∑ S : Finset n, lEnsembleProbability L S = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lEnsembleProbability, ← Finset.sum_div, sum_principalMinor_eq_det_one_add]
  exact div_self (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one
    (hL.one_le_det_one_add)))

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleLaw_univ
statement:
theorem lEnsembleLaw_univ (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) :
    lEnsembleLaw L hL Set.univ = 1
proof: := measure_univ

name: NLAlib.integral_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem integral_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    (f : Finset n → ℝ) :
    ∫ S, f S ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL = ∑ S, lEnsembleProbability L S * f S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [lEnsembleLaw, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [lEnsemblePMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (lEnsembleProbability_nonneg hL _), smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.lEnsembleLaw_singleton
statement:
theorem lEnsembleLaw_singleton (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) (S : Finset n) :
    (lEnsembleLaw L hL).real {S} = lEnsembleProbability L S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Measure.real, lEnsembleLaw,
    PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton S)]
  simp only [lEnsemblePMF, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (lEnsembleProbability_nonneg hL S)]

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_lEnsembleLaw
statement:
theorem integral_prod_lEnsembleLaw (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef) (z : n → ℝ) :
    ∫ S, (∏ i ∈ S, z i) ∂lEnsembleLaw L hL =
      (1 + Matrix.diagonal z * L).det / (1 + L).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_lEnsembleLaw, Matrix.det_one_add_diagonal_mul]
  simp only [lEnsembleProbability, principalMinor, Matrix.toBlock, div_mul_eq_mul_div,
    Finset.sum_div]

name: NLAlib.integral_prod_lEnsembleLaw_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem integral_prod_lEnsembleLaw_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} (L : Matrix n n ℝ) (hL : L.PosSemidef)
    {S : Ω → Finset n} (hS : HasLaw S (lEnsembleLaw L hL) μ) (z : n → ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, (∏ i ∈ S ω, z i) ∂μ =
      (1 + Matrix.diagonal z * L).det / (1 + L).det
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun T : Finset n => ∏ i ∈ T, z i)
      (lEnsembleLaw L hL) := (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact (hS.integral_comp hm).trans (integral_prod_lEnsembleLaw L hL z)

name: NLAlib.uniformExactRowSubsetPMF_toReal_apply
statement:
theorem uniformExactRowSubsetPMF_toReal_apply
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (T : ExactRowSubset α k) :
    (uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk T).toReal = 1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [uniformExactRowSubsetPMF, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply, one_div]

name: NLAlib.sum_uniformSubset_mul_conditionalWeight
statement:
theorem sum_uniformSubset_mul_conditionalWeight
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (I : Fin k → α) :
    (∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, (1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)) *
      iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I) = 1 / (Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T0⟩ := exactRowSubset_nonempty hk
  have hN : (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨T0⟩ : 0 < Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k)).ne'
  simp only [iidSubsetConditionalWeight]
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, one_div_mul_cancel hN, one_mul]
  exact iidSubsetJointPMF_toReal_first_marginal hk I

name: NLAlib.uniform_subset_average_convex_le_iid
statement:
theorem uniform_subset_average_convex_le_iid
    {α E : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (A : α → E) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) :
    (∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, (1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)) *
      f (∑ j ∈ T.val, A j)) ≤
      ∑ I : Fin k → α, (1 / (Fintype.card (Fin k → α) : ℝ)) * f (∑ a, A (I a))
proof:
:= by
  have hJensen : ∀ T : ExactRowSubset α k,
      f (∑ j ∈ T.val, A j) ≤ ∑ I : Fin k → α,
        iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I * f (∑ a, A (I a)) := by
    intro T
    have hh := hf.map_sum_le (t := Finset.univ)
      (w := iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T)
      (fun I _ => iidSubsetConditionalWeight_nonneg hk T I)
      (sum_iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T)
      (fun (I : Fin k → α) _ => Set.mem_univ (∑ a, A (I a)))
    rw [sum_conditionalWeight_smul_sequence_sum hk0 hk T A] at hh
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hh
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, (1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)) *
        ∑ I : Fin k → α, iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I * f (∑ a, A (I a)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun T _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJensen T) (by positivity))
    _ = ∑ I : Fin k → α,
        (∑ T : ExactRowSubset α k, (1 / (Fintype.card (ExactRowSubset α k) : ℝ)) *
          iidSubsetConditionalWeight hk T I) * f (∑ a, A (I a)) := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [sum_uniformSubset_mul_conditionalWeight]

name: NLAlib.integral_uniform_subset_convex_le_iid
statement:
theorem integral_uniform_subset_convex_le_iid
    {α E : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] {k : ℕ}
    [MeasurableSpace (ExactRowSubset α k)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (ExactRowSubset α k)]
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ Fintype.card α) (A : α → E) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) :
    (∫ T, f (∑ j ∈ T.val, A j) ∂(uniformExactRowSubsetPMF hk).toMeasure) ≤
      ∫ I : Fin k → α, f (∑ a, A (I a)) ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → α)).toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [PMF.integral_eq_sum, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [uniformExactRowSubsetPMF_toReal_apply, PMF.uniformOfFintype_apply,
    ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, smul_eq_mul, one_div]
  simpa only [one_div] using uniform_subset_average_convex_le_iid hk0 hk A f hf

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.zero
statement: theorem zero (ℓ : ℕ) (G : Matrix d d 𝕜) : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G G 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> simp

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.trans
statement:
theorem trans (h₁ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G H Δ₁)
    (h₂ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ H K Δ₂) :
    CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G K (Δ₁ + Δ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : G - K = (G - H) + (H - K) := by abel
  constructor
  · exact add_nonneg h₁.loss_nonneg h₂.loss_nonneg
  · rw [heq]
    exact add_nonneg h₁.sub_nonneg h₂.sub_nonneg
  · rw [heq, add_smul]
    exact add_le_add h₁.sub_le h₂.sub_le
  · rw [heq, Matrix.trace_add, map_add]
    nlinarith [h₁.trace_loss, h₂.trace_loss]

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.add
statement:
theorem add (h₁ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G₁ H₁ Δ₁)
    (h₂ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G₂ H₂ Δ₂) :
    CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (G₁ + G₂) (H₁ + H₂) (Δ₁ + Δ₂)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (G₁ + G₂) - (H₁ + H₂) = (G₁ - H₁) + (G₂ - H₂) := by abel
  constructor
  · exact add_nonneg h₁.loss_nonneg h₂.loss_nonneg
  · rw [heq]
    exact add_nonneg h₁.sub_nonneg h₂.sub_nonneg
  · rw [heq, add_smul]
    exact add_le_add h₁.sub_le h₂.sub_le
  · rw [heq, Matrix.trace_add, map_add]
    nlinarith [h₁.trace_loss, h₂.trace_loss]

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.specNorm_sub_le
statement: theorem specNorm_sub_le (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G H Δ) : specNorm (G - H) ≤ Δ
proof:
:=
  ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp h.sub_nonneg).specNorm_le_iff h.loss_nonneg).mpr h.sub_le

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.re_trace_projector_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef (hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp)
    (Matrix.le_iff.mp hD)
  have hr := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp h).1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, Matrix.mul_smul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.trace_smul, RCLike.smul_re,
    trace_eq_rank_of_isIdempotentElem P hp, RCLike.natCast_re] at hr
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.re_trace_complement_gram_eq_error
statement:
private theorem re_trace_complement_gram_eq_error {m : Type*} [Fintype m]
    (A : Matrix m d 𝕜) {P : Matrix d d 𝕜} (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) :
    RCLike.re ((1 - P) * (Aᴴ * A)).trace = frobSq (A - A * P)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  rw [← frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul hQ.1 hQ.2 A, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one]

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.loss_le_bestRankFrobSq_div
statement:
theorem loss_le_bestRankFrobSq_div {A : Matrix m d 𝕜} {B : Matrix r d 𝕜}
    (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Aᴴ * A) (Bᴴ * B) Δ)
    {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) (hkd : k ≤ Fintype.card d) :
    Δ ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hA⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let P := hA.leadingRightProjector k
  let G := Aᴴ * A
  let H := Bᴴ * B
  let D := G - H
  have hs := hA.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k
  have hp := hA.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k
  have hrank : P.rank = k := hA.rank_leadingRightProjector_of_le hkd
  have hUpper := re_trace_projector_mul_le hs hp h.sub_le
  rw [hrank] at hUpper
  have hQ := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  have hH : H.PosSemidef := Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self B
  have hCompH := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef
    (hQ.1.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hQ.2) hH)).1
  have hTail : RCLike.re ((1 - P) * G).trace = bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    rw [re_trace_complement_gram_eq_error A hs hp]
    exact hA.frobSq_sub_mul_leadingRightProjector k
  have hSplit : RCLike.re D.trace =
      RCLike.re (P * D).trace + RCLike.re ((1 - P) * D).trace := by
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
    ring
  have hComp : RCLike.re ((1 - P) * D).trace =
      RCLike.re ((1 - P) * G).trace - RCLike.re ((1 - P) * H).trace := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  have hTrace := h.trace_loss
  change (ℓ : ℝ) * Δ ≤ RCLike.re D.trace at hTrace
  have hden : 0 < ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hkℓ
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hden).mpr
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hkℓ.le]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.specNorm_sub_gram_le_bestRankFrobSq_div
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_gram_le_bestRankFrobSq_div {A : Matrix m d 𝕜} {B : Matrix r d 𝕜}
    (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Aᴴ * A) (Bᴴ * B) Δ)
    {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) (hkd : k ≤ Fintype.card d) :
    specNorm (Aᴴ * A - Bᴴ * B) ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  h.specNorm_sub_le.trans (h.loss_le_bestRankFrobSq_div hkℓ hkd)

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.frobSq_error_le_bestRankFrobSq_add
statement:
theorem frobSq_error_le_bestRankFrobSq_add {A : Matrix m d 𝕜} {B : Matrix r d 𝕜}
    (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Aᴴ * A) (Bᴴ * B) Δ) {k : ℕ}
    (hkd : k ≤ Fintype.card d) (P : Matrix d d 𝕜)
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (_hRank : P.rank = k)
    (hMax : ∀ Q : Matrix d d 𝕜, Q.IsHermitian → IsIdempotentElem Q → Q.rank = k →
      RCLike.re (Q * (Bᴴ * B)).trace ≤ RCLike.re (P * (Bᴴ * B)).trace) :
    frobSq (A - A * P) ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k + (k : ℝ) * Δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hA⟩ := exists_isSVD A
  let Q := hA.leadingRightProjector k
  let G := Aᴴ * A
  let H := Bᴴ * B
  let D := G - H
  have hsQ := hA.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k
  have hpQ := hA.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k
  have hrQ : Q.rank = k := hA.rank_leadingRightProjector_of_le hkd
  have hCompD := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef
    (hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp) (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp h.sub_nonneg))).1
  have hMaxQ := hMax Q hsQ hpQ hrQ
  have hUpper := re_trace_projector_mul_le hsQ hpQ h.sub_le
  rw [hrQ] at hUpper
  have hError : frobSq (A - A * P) = RCLike.re G.trace - RCLike.re (P * G).trace := by
    rw [← re_trace_complement_gram_eq_error A hs hp]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, G]
  have hTail : bestRankFrobSq A k = RCLike.re G.trace - RCLike.re (Q * G).trace := by
    rw [← hA.frobSq_sub_mul_leadingRightProjector k,
      ← re_trace_complement_gram_eq_error A hsQ hpQ]
    simp only [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, G]
    rfl
  have hPD : RCLike.re (P * D).trace = RCLike.re (P * G).trace - RCLike.re (P * H).trace := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  have hQD : RCLike.re (Q * D).trace = RCLike.re (Q * G).trace - RCLike.re (Q * H).trace := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div
statement:
theorem frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div {A : Matrix m d 𝕜} {B : Matrix r d 𝕜}
    (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Aᴴ * A) (Bᴴ * B) Δ) {k : ℕ}
    (hkℓ : k < ℓ) (hkd : k ≤ Fintype.card d) (P : Matrix d d 𝕜)
    (hs : P.IsHermitian) (hp : IsIdempotentElem P) (hRank : P.rank = k)
    (hMax : ∀ Q : Matrix d d 𝕜, Q.IsHermitian → IsIdempotentElem Q → Q.rank = k →
      RCLike.re (Q * (Bᴴ * B)).trace ≤ RCLike.re (P * (Bᴴ * B)).trace) :
    frobSq (A - A * P) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  have hError := h.frobSq_error_le_bestRankFrobSq_add hkd P hs hp hRank hMax
  have hDelta := h.loss_le_bestRankFrobSq_div hkℓ hkd
  have hScale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDelta (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)
  have hden : 0 < ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hkℓ
  have heq : bestRankFrobSq A k + (k : ℝ) * (bestRankFrobSq A k / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
      (ℓ : ℝ) / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkℓ.le] at hden ⊢
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hden]
    ring
  rw [← heq]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.CovarianceLossCertificate.frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div_of_isSVD
statement:
theorem frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div_of_isSVD [DecidableEq r]
    {A : Matrix m d 𝕜}
    {B : Matrix r d 𝕜} {p q : ℕ} {U : Matrix r (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix d (Fin q) 𝕜}
    (hB : NLAlib.IsSVD B U V) (h : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Aᴴ * A) (Bᴴ * B) Δ)
    {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) (hkd : k ≤ Fintype.card d) :
    frobSq (A - A * hB.leadingRightProjector k) ≤
      (ℓ : ℝ) / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  apply h.frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div hkℓ hkd
    (hB.leadingRightProjector k) (hB.leadingRightProjector_isHermitian k)
    (hB.leadingRightProjector_isIdempotentElem k)
    (hB.rank_leadingRightProjector_of_le hkd)
  intro Q hQ hQQ hRank
  exact hB.re_trace_mul_gram_le_leadingRightProjector k hQ hQQ hRank.le

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_merge_certificate
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_merge_certificate (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    {G₁ G₂ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜} {s₁ s₂ : FrequentDirectionsState ℓ d 𝕜}
    (h₁ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G₁ (s₁.sketchᴴ * s₁.sketch) s₁.loss)
    (h₂ : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ G₂ (s₂.sketchᴴ * s₂.sketch) s₂.loss) :
    CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (G₁ + G₂)
      ((s₁.merge hℓ s₂).sketchᴴ * (s₁.merge hℓ s₂).sketch) (s₁.merge hℓ s₂).loss
proof:
:= by
  let rows := List.ofFn (fun i => s₁.sketch i) ++ List.ofFn (fun i => s₂.sketch i)
  let t := FrequentDirectionsState.run hℓ rows
  have hNode : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (s₁.sketchᴴ * s₁.sketch + s₂.sketchᴴ * s₂.sketch)
      (t.sketchᴴ * t.sketch) t.loss := by
    simpa only [rows, rowStreamGram_append, rowStreamGram_ofFn] using
      (frequentDirections_run_invariant hℓ hℓd rows).certificate
  exact (h₁.add h₂).trans hNode

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_mergeMany_certificate
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_mergeMany_certificate (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    (blocks : List (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜 × FrequentDirectionsState ℓ d 𝕜))
    (hBlocks : ∀ p ∈ blocks,
      CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ p.1 (p.2.sketchᴴ * p.2.sketch) p.2.loss) :
    CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (blocks.map Prod.fst).sum
      ((FrequentDirectionsState.mergeMany hℓ (blocks.map Prod.snd)).sketchᴴ *
        (FrequentDirectionsState.mergeMany hℓ (blocks.map Prod.snd)).sketch)
      (FrequentDirectionsState.mergeMany hℓ (blocks.map Prod.snd)).loss
proof:
:= by
  have hBefore : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (blocks.map Prod.fst).sum
      (blocks.map (fun p => p.2.sketchᴴ * p.2.sketch)).sum
      (blocks.map (fun p => p.2.loss)).sum := by
    induction blocks with
    | nil => simpa using CovarianceLossCertificate.zero ℓ (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    | cons p ps ih =>
      have hp := hBlocks p (by simp)
      have ht := ih (by intro q hq; exact hBlocks q (by simp [hq]))
      simpa only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] using hp.add ht
  let rows := (blocks.map Prod.snd).flatMap (fun s => List.ofFn (fun i => s.sketch i))
  have hGram : rowStreamGram rows = (blocks.map (fun p => p.2.sketchᴴ * p.2.sketch)).sum := by
    clear hBefore hBlocks
    dsimp only [rows]
    induction blocks with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons p ps ih =>
      simpa only [List.map_cons, List.flatMap_cons, rowStreamGram_append,
        rowStreamGram_ofFn, List.sum_cons] using congrArg (p.2.sketchᴴ * p.2.sketch + ·) ih
  have hNode := (frequentDirections_run_invariant hℓ hℓd rows).certificate
  rw [hGram] at hNode
  simpa only [FrequentDirectionsState.mergeMany, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
    hBefore.trans hNode

name: NLAlib.FrequentDirectionsMergeTree.certificate
statement:
theorem certificate (tree : FrequentDirectionsMergeTree d 𝕜) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) :
    CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (rowStreamGram tree.rows)
      ((tree.run hℓ).sketchᴴ * (tree.run hℓ).sketch) (tree.run hℓ).loss
proof:
:= by
  induction tree with
  | leaf xs => exact (frequentDirections_run_invariant hℓ hℓd xs).certificate
  | node left right ihL ihR =>
    simpa only [rows, run, rowStreamGram_append] using
      frequentDirections_merge_certificate hℓ hℓd ihL ihR

name: NLAlib.FrequentDirectionsMergeTree.specNorm_sub_gram_le
statement:
theorem specNorm_sub_gram_le (tree : FrequentDirectionsMergeTree d 𝕜)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) :
    specNorm (rowStreamGram tree.rows - (tree.run hℓ).sketchᴴ * (tree.run hℓ).sketch) ≤
      bestRankFrobSq (Matrix.ofRowList tree.rows) k / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := tree.certificate hℓ hℓd
  rw [rowStreamGram_eq_gram_ofRowList] at hc ⊢
  exact hc.specNorm_sub_gram_le_bestRankFrobSq_div hkℓ (by simpa using (hkℓ.le.trans hℓd))

name: NLAlib.FrequentDirectionsMergeTree.frobSq_error_le
statement:
theorem frobSq_error_le (tree : FrequentDirectionsMergeTree d 𝕜)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    {U : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    (hB : IsSVD (tree.run hℓ).sketch U V) {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) :
    frobSq (Matrix.ofRowList tree.rows - Matrix.ofRowList tree.rows * hB.leadingRightProjector k) ≤
      (ℓ : ℝ) / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq (Matrix.ofRowList tree.rows) k
proof:
:= by
  have hc := tree.certificate hℓ hℓd
  rw [rowStreamGram_eq_gram_ofRowList] at hc
  exact CovarianceLossCertificate.frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div_of_isSVD
    hB hc hkℓ (by simpa using (hkℓ.le.trans hℓd))

name: NLAlib.fdShrinkageLoss_nonneg
statement:
@[simp] theorem fdShrinkageLoss_nonneg (C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ fdShrinkageLoss C
proof: := sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.fdShrinkage_radicand_nonneg
statement:
theorem fdShrinkage_radicand_nonneg (C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (i : Fin ℓ) : 0 ≤ singularValues C i ^ 2 - fdShrinkageLoss C
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (i : ℕ) ≤ ℓ - 1 := by omega
  have hs := singularValues_antitone C hi
  have hn := singularValues_nonneg C (ℓ - 1)
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (pow_le_pow_left₀ hn hs 2)

name: NLAlib.fdRightFrame_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem fdRightFrame_hasOrthonormalCols {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) : HasOrthonormalCols (fdRightFrame (ℓ := ℓ) V)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : HasOrthonormalCols (rectDiag (fun _ => 1) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜) := by
    rw [HasOrthonormalCols, conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag]
    ext i j
    have hi : (i : ℕ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hℓd
    simp [hi, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  exact hV.mul hE

name: NLAlib.fdRightFrame_mul_conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fdRightFrame, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (rectDiag (fun _ => 1)),
    rectDiag_mul_conjTranspose_rectDiag]
  simp only [one_pow, RCLike.ofReal_one]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.fdShrinkage_gram_loss
statement:
theorem IsSVD.fdShrinkage_gram_loss {C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD C U V)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (_hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) :
    Cᴴ * C - (fdShrinkageRows C V)ᴴ * fdShrinkageRows C V =
      fdShrinkageLoss C • (fdRightFrame (ℓ := ℓ) V * (fdRightFrame (ℓ := ℓ) V)ᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜 :=
    rectDiag (fun i => Real.sqrt (singularValues C i ^ 2 - fdShrinkageLoss C))
  have hB : (fdShrinkageRows C V)ᴴ * fdShrinkageRows C V = V * (Sᴴ * S) * Vᴴ := by
    simp only [fdShrinkageRows, S, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hDiag : Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin d => ((singularValues C j ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)) - Sᴴ * S =
      fdShrinkageLoss C • Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin d => if (j : ℕ) < ℓ then (1 : 𝕜) else 0) := by
    rw [show Sᴴ * S = Matrix.diagonal (fun j : Fin d => if (j : ℕ) < ℓ then
      ((Real.sqrt (singularValues C j ^ 2 - fdShrinkageLoss C) ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) else 0) from
      conjTranspose_rectDiag_mul_rectDiag _]
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < ℓ
      · have hn := fdShrinkage_radicand_nonneg C hℓ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin ℓ)
        simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, if_pos hi,
          Matrix.smul_apply, Real.sq_sqrt hn, RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, mul_one]
        rw [← RCLike.ofReal_sub]
        congr 1
        ring
      · have hz : singularValues C i = 0 := singularValues_eq_zero_of_height_le C
          (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using not_lt.mp hi)
        simp [hi, hz]
    · simp [Matrix.sub_apply, hij]
  rw [h.conjTranspose_mul_self, hB, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, hDiag,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, fdRightFrame_mul_conjTranspose]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.fdShrinkage_gram_loss_bounds
statement:
theorem IsSVD.fdShrinkage_gram_loss_bounds {C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD C U V)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) :
    0 ≤ Cᴴ * C - (fdShrinkageRows C V)ᴴ * fdShrinkageRows C V ∧
      Cᴴ * C - (fdShrinkageRows C V)ᴴ * fdShrinkageRows C V ≤
        fdShrinkageLoss C • (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  let F := fdRightFrame (ℓ := ℓ) V
  have hF := fdRightFrame_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_right hℓd
  have hs : (F * Fᴴ).IsHermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_mul_conjTranspose_self F
  have hp : IsIdempotentElem (F * Fᴴ) := by
    change (F * Fᴴ) * (F * Fᴴ) = F * Fᴴ
    calc
      _ = F * (Fᴴ * F) * Fᴴ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hF.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hQ := one_sub_projector_isHermitian_isIdempotentElem hs hp
  have hQPSD := hQ.1.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hQ.2
  have hPPSD := hs.posSemidef_of_isIdempotentElem hp
  rw [h.fdShrinkage_gram_loss hℓ hℓd]
  constructor
  · exact (hPPSD.smul (fdShrinkageLoss_nonneg C)).nonneg
  · rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← smul_sub]
    exact hQPSD.smul (fdShrinkageLoss_nonneg C)

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.fdShrinkage_frobSq_loss
statement:
theorem IsSVD.fdShrinkage_frobSq_loss {C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD C U V)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) :
    frobSq C - frobSq (fdShrinkageRows C V) = (ℓ : ℝ) * fdShrinkageLoss C
proof:
:= by
  have hF := fdRightFrame_hasOrthonormalCols h.conjTranspose_mul_right hℓd
  have ht := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜 => RCLike.re M.trace)
    (h.fdShrinkage_gram_loss hℓ hℓd)
  simp only [Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    Matrix.trace_smul, RCLike.smul_re] at ht
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, hF.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.trace_one, RCLike.natCast_re,
    Fintype.card_fin, mul_comm] at ht
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.fdShrinkageRows_last_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fdShrinkageRows_last_eq_zero (C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    (V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (j : Fin d) :
    fdShrinkageRows C V ⟨ℓ - 1, by omega⟩ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [fdShrinkageRows, Matrix.mul_apply, rectDiag_apply_ofReal, fdShrinkageLoss]

name: NLAlib.fdShrinkageLoss_eq_zero_of_rank_lt
statement:
theorem fdShrinkageLoss_eq_zero_of_rank_lt (C : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    (hC : C.rank < ℓ) : fdShrinkageLoss C = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fdShrinkageLoss, singularValues_eq_zero_of_rank_le C (by omega), zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)]

name: NLAlib.rowStreamGram_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem rowStreamGram_nil : rowStreamGram ([] : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.rowStreamGram_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowStreamGram_cons (a : Fin d → 𝕜) (rows : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) :
    rowStreamGram (a :: rows) = Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a + rowStreamGram rows
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.rowStreamGram_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowStreamGram_append (xs ys : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) :
    rowStreamGram (xs ++ ys) = rowStreamGram xs + rowStreamGram ys
proof:
:= by
  simp [rowStreamGram, List.map_append, List.sum_append]

name: NLAlib.rowStreamGram_eq_gram_ofRowList
statement:
theorem rowStreamGram_eq_gram_ofRowList (rows : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) :
    rowStreamGram rows = (Matrix.ofRowList rows)ᴴ * Matrix.ofRowList rows
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.conjTranspose_ofRowList_mul_ofRowList rows).symm

name: NLAlib.rowStreamGram_ofFn
statement:
theorem rowStreamGram_ofFn {N : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin d) 𝕜) :
    rowStreamGram (List.ofFn (fun i => A i)) = Aᴴ * A
proof: := Matrix.sum_rowGrams_ofFn A

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_initial_invariant
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_initial_invariant (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    FrequentDirectionsInvariant hℓ (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜)
      FrequentDirectionsState.initial
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · simpa [FrequentDirectionsState.initial] using
      CovarianceLossCertificate.zero ℓ (0 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜)
  · simp [FrequentDirectionsState.initial]

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_step_invariant
proof:
:= by
  let C := s.insertRow hℓ a
  let B := fdShrinkageRows C V
  let δ := fdShrinkageLoss C
  have hInsert : Cᴴ * C = s.sketchᴴ * s.sketch + Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a :=
    Matrix.conjTranspose_updateRow_mul_updateRow_eq_add s.sketch (fdLastRow hℓ) a hs.last_row_zero
  have hBounds := hSVD.fdShrinkage_gram_loss_bounds hℓ hℓd
  have hLoss := hSVD.fdShrinkage_frobSq_loss hℓ hℓd
  have hTrace : RCLike.re (Cᴴ * C - Bᴴ * B).trace = (ℓ : ℝ) * δ := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
      ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    exact hLoss
  have hStepCert : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (Cᴴ * C) (Bᴴ * B) δ :=
    ⟨fdShrinkageLoss_nonneg C, hBounds.1, hBounds.2, hTrace.ge⟩
  have hBefore : CovarianceLossCertificate ℓ (G + Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a) (Cᴴ * C) s.loss := by
    have hc := hs.certificate.add (CovarianceLossCertificate.zero ℓ (Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a))
    simpa only [hInsert, add_zero] using hc
  have hD : G + Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a - Bᴴ * B =
      (G - s.sketchᴴ * s.sketch) + (Cᴴ * C - Bᴴ * B) := by rw [hInsert]; abel
  constructor
  · funext j
    exact fdShrinkageRows_last_eq_zero C V hℓ j
  · exact hBefore.trans hStepCert
  · change RCLike.re (G + Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a - Bᴴ * B).trace = (ℓ : ℝ) * (s.loss + δ)
    rw [hD, Matrix.trace_add, map_add, hs.trace_eq, hTrace]
    ring

name: NLAlib.FrequentDirectionsRun.invariant
statement:
theorem FrequentDirectionsRun.invariant {hℓ : 0 < ℓ} {s out : FrequentDirectionsState ℓ d 𝕜}
    {rows : List (Fin d → 𝕜)} (hRun : FrequentDirectionsRun hℓ s rows out) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    (G : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜) (hs : FrequentDirectionsInvariant hℓ G s) :
    FrequentDirectionsInvariant hℓ (G + rowStreamGram rows) out
proof:
:= by
  induction hRun generalizing G with
  | nil s => simpa using hs
  | @cons s out a rows U V hSVD hTail ih =>
    have hNext := frequentDirections_step_invariant hℓd hs a hSVD
    have hOut := ih (G + Matrix.vecMulVec (star a) a) hNext
    simpa only [rowStreamGram_cons, add_assoc] using hOut

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_runFrom_realizes
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_runFrom_realizes (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (s : FrequentDirectionsState ℓ d 𝕜)
    (rows : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) :
    FrequentDirectionsRun hℓ s rows (FrequentDirectionsState.runFrom hℓ s rows)
proof:
:= by
  induction rows generalizing s with
  | nil => exact FrequentDirectionsRun.nil s
  | cons a rows ih =>
    let w := FrequentDirectionsState.svdChoice (s.insertRow hℓ a)
    exact FrequentDirectionsRun.cons w.property (ih (FrequentDirectionsState.next hℓ s a))

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_run_invariant
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_run_invariant (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    (rows : List (Fin d → 𝕜)) :
    FrequentDirectionsInvariant hℓ (rowStreamGram rows) (FrequentDirectionsState.run hℓ rows)
proof:
:= by
  have hRun := frequentDirections_runFrom_realizes hℓ FrequentDirectionsState.initial rows
  have hInv := hRun.invariant hℓd 0 (frequentDirections_initial_invariant hℓ)
  simpa only [zero_add, FrequentDirectionsState.run] using hInv

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_runMatrix_invariant
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_runMatrix_invariant {N : ℕ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d)
    (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin d) 𝕜) :
    FrequentDirectionsInvariant hℓ (Aᴴ * A) (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rowStreamGram_ofFn, FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix] using frequentDirections_run_invariant hℓ hℓd
    (List.ofFn (fun i => A i))

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_runMatrix_frobSq_loss
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_runMatrix_frobSq_loss {N : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin d) 𝕜) :
    frobSq A - frobSq (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A).sketch =
      (ℓ : ℝ) * (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A).loss
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (frequentDirections_runMatrix_invariant hℓ hℓd A).trace_eq
  rw [Matrix.trace_sub, map_sub, ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_conjTranspose_mul_self] at ht
  exact ht

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_runMatrix_specNorm_sub_gram_le
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_runMatrix_specNorm_sub_gram_le {N : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) :
    specNorm (Aᴴ * A - (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A).sketchᴴ *
      (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A).sketch) ≤
        bestRankFrobSq A k / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (frequentDirections_runMatrix_invariant hℓ hℓd A).certificate
  exact hc.specNorm_sub_gram_le_bestRankFrobSq_div hkℓ (by simpa using (hkℓ.le.trans hℓd))

name: NLAlib.frequentDirections_runMatrix_frobSq_error_le
statement:
theorem frequentDirections_runMatrix_frobSq_error_le {N : ℕ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) (A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin d) 𝕜)
    {U : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin ℓ) 𝕜} {V : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) 𝕜}
    (hB : IsSVD (FrequentDirectionsState.runMatrix hℓ A).sketch U V)
    {k : ℕ} (hkℓ : k < ℓ) :
    frobSq (A - A * hB.leadingRightProjector k) ≤
      (ℓ : ℝ) / ((ℓ - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k
proof:
:= by
  exact CovarianceLossCertificate.frobSq_error_le_capacity_mul_bestRankFrobSq_div_of_isSVD
    hB (frequentDirections_runMatrix_invariant hℓ hℓd A).certificate hkℓ (by simpa using (hkℓ.le.trans hℓd))

name: NLAlib.srhtSharpRowBound_le_manuscript
statement:
theorem srhtSharpRowBound_le_manuscript {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    srhtSharpRowBound n d δ ≤ srhtManuscriptRowBound n d δ
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne n)
  let t := Real.log (2 * n / δ)
  let a := 256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * n / δ)
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
    linarith
  have hlog : t ≤ Real.log (4 * n / δ) := by
    apply Real.log_le_log (by positivity)
    gcongr
    linarith
  have he : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
  have he2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (4 * n / δ) := ht.trans hlog
  have ha : 32 * t ≤ a := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2 hlog0
    dsimp only [a]
    nlinarith
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by linarith
  have hsd := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
  have hst := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 8 * t by positivity)
  have hsa := Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg ha0 (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
  have hcross : (2 * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (8 * t)) ^ 2 = 32 * t * d := by
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsd, hst]
    ring
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
  have hroots : 2 * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (8 * t) ≤ Real.sqrt (a * d) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (a * d), Real.sqrt_nonneg (8 * t), Real.sqrt_nonneg (d : ℝ)]
  change (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (8 * t)) ^ 2 ≤ d + Real.sqrt (a * d) + a
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.srhtManuscriptRowBound_le_additive
statement:
theorem srhtManuscriptRowBound_le_additive {n d : ℕ}
    {δ : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ 256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * n / δ)) :
    srhtManuscriptRowBound n d δ ≤
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (d + 256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * n / δ))
proof:
:= by
  let a := 256 * Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * n / δ)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (mul_nonneg ha (Nat.cast_nonneg d))
  have hp : 0 ≤ (a - d) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  change (d : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (a * d) + a ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (d + a)
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (a * d)]

name: NLAlib.measurable_srhtSignedFrame
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Measurable (Matrix.diagonal : (Fin n → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, hij] <;> fun_prop
  exact (measurable_const.matrix_mul hd).matrix_mul measurable_const

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_srhtSignedFrame
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_srhtSignedFrame {n d : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ)
proof:
:= by
  let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal ξ
  have hD : Dᵀ * D = 1 := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_transpose, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp only [← sq, hξ, Matrix.diagonal_one]
  change (H * D * U)ᴴ * (H * D * U) = 1
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Hᵀ, hH, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc Dᵀ, hD, Matrix.one_mul]
  exact hU

name: NLAlib.hasSubgaussianMGF_srhtNormalizedRow_dotProduct
statement:
theorem hasSubgaussianMGF_srhtNormalizedRow_dotProduct {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (j : Fin n) (u : Fin d → ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ξ => srhtNormalizedRow H U j ξ ⬝ᵥ u)
      (‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2) (rademacherVector (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne n
  let a : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * H j i) * (U *ᵥ u) i
  have hscale : ∀ i : Fin n, (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * H j i) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n), hflat]
    field_simp
  have ha : a ⬝ᵥ a = u ⬝ᵥ u := by
    have hUnorm := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU u
    simp only [star_trivial] at hUnorm
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, ((Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * H j i) * (U *ᵥ u) i) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [a, dotProduct, ← sq]
      _ = ∑ i, (U *ᵥ u) i ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [mul_pow, hscale, one_mul]
      _ = _ := by simpa only [dotProduct, ← sq] using hUnorm
  have hlin : ∀ ξ : Fin n → ℝ, srhtNormalizedRow H U j ξ ⬝ᵥ u =
      ∑ i, a i * ξ i := by
    intro ξ
    dsimp only [srhtNormalizedRow]
    rw [smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul]
    change Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ((H * Matrix.diagonal ξ * U)
      *ᵥ u) j = _
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    change Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (∑ i, H j i *
      ((Matrix.diagonal ξ) *ᵥ (U *ᵥ u)) i) = _
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, Finset.mul_sum, a]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  have hh := hasSubgaussianMGF_sum_mul_rademacher a
    (HasLaw.id (μ := rademacherVector (Fin n)))
  have ha' : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖₊ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖₊ ^ 2 := by
    apply NNReal.coe_injective
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_pow, coe_nnnorm, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using ha
  simpa only [id_eq, ← hlin, ha'] using hh

name: NLAlib.measure_srht_row_sq_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le
statement:
theorem measure_srht_row_sq_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (j : Fin n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (rademacherVector (Fin n))
      {ξ | d + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * t) + 2 * t ≤
        (n : ℝ) * ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
          (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t))
proof:
:= by
  have hh := measureReal_sq_norm_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le
    (rademacherVector (Fin n)) (srhtNormalizedRow H U j)
    (hasSubgaussianMGF_srhtNormalizedRow_dotProduct H hflat U hU j) ht
  have hsq : ∀ ξ : Fin n → ℝ,
      srhtNormalizedRow H U j ξ ⬝ᵥ srhtNormalizedRow H U j ξ =
      (n : ℝ) * ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
        (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a)) := by
    intro ξ
    rw [srhtNormalizedRow, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, ← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, hsq] using hh

name: NLAlib.srht_chi_square_threshold_le
statement:
theorem srht_chi_square_threshold_le {d : ℕ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    d + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * t) + 2 * t ≤
      (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (8 * t)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg d)
  have hr := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 8 * t by positivity)
  have hrt : Real.sqrt t ≤ Real.sqrt (8 * t) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg (d : ℝ))
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg d)]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measure_srhtSharpRowBound_failure_le
statement:
theorem measure_srhtSharpRowBound_failure_le {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    ((rademacherVector (Fin n))
      {ξ | ∃ j : Fin n, srhtSharpRowBound n d δ <
        (n : ℝ) * ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
          (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a))}).toReal ≤ δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne n)
  have ht : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * n / δ) := by
    apply Real.log_nonneg
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
    linarith
  let μ := (rademacherVector (Fin n))
  let B : Fin n → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun j => {ξ | srhtSharpRowBound n d δ <
    (n : ℝ) * ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
      (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a))}
  have hrow (j : Fin n) : (μ (B j)).toReal ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * n / δ)) := by
    have hsub : B j ⊆ {ξ | d + 2 * Real.sqrt (d * Real.log (2 * n / δ)) +
        2 * Real.log (2 * n / δ) ≤ (n : ℝ) *
          ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
            (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a))} := by
      intro ξ hξ
      exact (srht_chi_square_threshold_le ht).trans hξ.le
    have hh := (measure_mono hsub).trans
      (measure_srht_row_sq_ge_add_two_sqrt_mul_add_le H hflat U hU j ht)
    have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by simp) hh
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.exp_pos _).le] using hr
  have hset : {ξ | ∃ j : Fin n, srhtSharpRowBound n d δ <
        (n : ℝ) * ((fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a) ⬝ᵥ
          (fun a => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a))} = ⋃ j, B j := by
    ext ξ
    simp only [B, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
  rw [hset]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (μ (B j)).toReal := measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le B
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * n / δ)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hrow j)
    _ = δ / 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        nsmul_eq_mul, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (n : ℝ) / δ)]
      field_simp

name: NLAlib.bijective_khatriRaoCommonIndex
statement:

    Function.Bijective (khatriRaoCommonIndex (r := r) (h := h) (k := k))

name: NLAlib.hasOrthonormalCols_khatriRaoCommonIsometry
statement:
theorem hasOrthonormalCols_khatriRaoCommonIsometry (r k : ℕ) {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    HasOrthonormalCols (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
  have hnorm : (h : ℝ) ^ k * ((Real.sqrt h)⁻¹ ^ k * (Real.sqrt h)⁻¹ ^ k) = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]
    have he : (h : ℝ) * ((Real.sqrt h)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt h)⁻¹) = 1 := by
      rw [← mul_inv, ← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    rw [he, one_pow]
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    khatriRaoCommonIsometry, star_trivial, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simpa using hnorm
  · simp [hab, Ne.symm hab]

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoCommonRow_eq_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem khatriRaoCommonRow_eq_khatriRaoProbe {r h k : ℕ}

    khatriRaoCommonRow ξ η a =
      khatriRaoProbe (khatriRaoCommonFactors ξ η) (khatriRaoCommonIndex a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold khatriRaoCommonRow khatriRaoProbe
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoCommonRow_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry
statement:
theorem khatriRaoCommonRow_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry {r h k : ℕ}
    (ξ : Fin r → ℝ) (η : Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) (a : Fin r) :
    (∑ t, khatriRaoCommonRow ξ η t * khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k t a) =
      khatriRaoCommonProjection ξ η a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [khatriRaoCommonRow, khatriRaoCommonIsometry, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_irrel]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  simp only [khatriRaoCommonProjection, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Fintype.prod_sum]
  ring

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoCommonSketch_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry
statement:
theorem khatriRaoCommonSketch_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry {r h k m : ℕ}

    (khatriRaoCommonSketch z * khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) i a =
      (Real.sqrt m)⁻¹ * khatriRaoCommonProjection (z i).1 (z i).2 a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, khatriRaoCommonSketch, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    khatriRaoCommonRow_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry]

name: NLAlib.not_isSubspaceEmbedding_of_row_sq_gt
statement:
private theorem not_isSubspaceEmbedding_of_row_sq_gt {m n r : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r]
    (S : Matrix m n ℝ) (U : Matrix n r ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (i : m) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hrow : 1 + ε < ∑ a, (S * U) i a ^ 2) :
    ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let x : r → ℝ := (S * U) i
  let q : ℝ := ∑ a, x a ^ 2
  have hq : 0 ≤ q := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hupper := ((isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU).1 h x).2
  have hsingle : q ^ 2 ≤ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) := by
    have he : ((S * U) *ᵥ x) i = q := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, q, x, pow_two]
    rw [dotProduct]
    have ht := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun j => ((S * U) *ᵥ x) j * ((S * U) *ᵥ x) j)
      (fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simpa only [he, pow_two] using ht
  have hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = q := by simp only [dotProduct, q, pow_two]
  rw [hx] at hupper
  change 1 + ε < q at hrow
  have hqpos : 0 < q := by linarith
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sum_sq_khatriRaoCommonProjection_of_all_one
statement:
theorem sum_sq_khatriRaoCommonProjection_of_all_one {r h k : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (ξ : Fin r → ℝ) (η : Fin k → Fin h → ℝ)
    (hξ : ∀ a, ξ a ^ 2 = 1) (hη : ∀ j t, η j t = 1) :
    ∑ a, khatriRaoCommonProjection ξ η a ^ 2 = (r : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity))
  have hc : (Real.sqrt (h : ℝ))⁻¹ * h = Real.sqrt h := by
    calc
      _ = (Real.sqrt (h : ℝ))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt h * Real.sqrt h) := by
        rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg h)]
      _ = Real.sqrt h := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs, one_mul]
  have hpow : (Real.sqrt (h : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = (h : ℝ) ^ k := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm k 2, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg h)]
  simp only [khatriRaoCommonProjection, hη, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, hc, Finset.prod_const, mul_pow, hξ,
    one_mul]
  simp [hpow]

name: NLAlib.not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_of_all_one
statement:
theorem not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_of_all_one {r h k m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hsize : 2 * m ≤ r * h ^ k)
    (z : Fin m → (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ)) (i : Fin m)
    (hξ : ∀ a, (z i).1 a ^ 2 = 1) (hη : ∀ j t, (z i).2 j t = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
      (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) ε
proof:
:= by
  intro hEmbed
  apply not_isSubspaceEmbedding_of_row_sq_gt _ _
    (hasOrthonormalCols_khatriRaoCommonIsometry r k hh) i (le_max_right ε 0) _
    (hEmbed.mono (le_max_left ε 0))
  simp only [khatriRaoCommonSketch_mul_khatriRaoCommonIsometry, mul_pow,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_sq_khatriRaoCommonProjection_of_all_one hh _ _ hξ hη,
    inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg m)]
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsizeR : 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) ^ k := by exact_mod_cast hsize
  have he : (1 : ℝ) + max ε 0 < (m : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((r : ℝ) * (h : ℝ) ^ k) := by
    apply (lt_inv_mul_iff₀ hmR).2
    have hmax : max ε 0 < 1 := max_lt hε zero_lt_one
    nlinarith
  exact he

name: NLAlib.measurePreserving_khatriRaoCommonFactors
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_khatriRaoCommonFactors (r h k : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving
      (fun z : (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) => khatriRaoCommonFactors z.1 z.2)
      ((rademacherVector (Fin r)).prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => rademacherVector (Fin h)))
      (Measure.pi fun j : Fin (k + 1) =>
        rademacherVector (Fin (khatriRaoCommonDimensions r h k j)))
proof:
:= by
  let e : ((Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ
      (∀ j : Fin (k + 1), Fin (khatriRaoCommonDimensions r h k j) → ℝ) :=
    { Fin.consEquiv (fun j => Fin (khatriRaoCommonDimensions r h k j) → ℝ) with
      measurable_toFun := by
        apply measurable_pi_iff.2
        intro i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · change Measurable (fun z : (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) => z.1)
          exact measurable_fst
        · change Measurable (fun z : (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) => z.2 j)
          exact (measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd
      measurable_invFun := by
        change Measurable (fun z : ∀ j : Fin (k + 1), Fin (khatriRaoCommonDimensions r h k j) → ℝ =>
          (z 0, fun j : Fin k => z j.succ))
        exact (measurable_pi_apply 0).prodMk
          (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => measurable_pi_apply j.succ) }
  change MeasurePreserving e _ _
  refine ⟨e.measurable, (Measure.pi_eq fun s _ => ?_).symm⟩
  rw [e.map_apply, Fin.prod_univ_succ, ← Measure.pi_pi, ← Measure.prod_prod]
  congr 1 with ⟨x, f⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, Fin.forall_fin_succ]
  change (x ∈ s 0 ∧ ∀ i : Fin k, f i ∈ s i.succ) ↔
    (x, f) ∈ s 0 ×ˢ Set.univ.pi (fun i : Fin k => s i.succ)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hf⟩
    exact ⟨hx, fun i _ => hf i⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hf⟩
    exact ⟨hx, fun i => hf i (Set.mem_univ i)⟩

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_commonPositiveEvent
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_commonPositiveEvent (r h k : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (commonPositiveEvent r h k)
