:=
  MeasurableSet.univ.prod (measurableSet_singleton _)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_commonPositiveEvent
statement:
private theorem measureReal_commonPositiveEvent (r h k : ℕ) :
    ((rademacherVector (Fin r)).prod
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => rademacherVector (Fin h))).real
      (commonPositiveEvent r h k) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hmass : rademacherMeasure {(1 : ℝ)} = (1 / 2 : ENNReal) := by
    norm_num [rademacherMeasure]
  rw [Measure.real, commonPositiveEvent, Measure.prod_prod, measure_univ, one_mul]
  simp only [Measure.pi_singleton, hmass, Finset.prod_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  norm_num [ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_div, ← pow_mul]

name: NLAlib.measureReal_exists_commonPositiveEvent
statement:
private theorem measureReal_exists_commonPositiveEvent (r h k m : ℕ) :
    (khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r h k m).real
      {z | ∃ i, z i ∈ commonPositiveEvent r h k} =
      1 - (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k)) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  let μ := (rademacherVector (Fin r)).prod
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => rademacherVector (Fin h))
  have he : {z : Fin m → (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) |
      ∃ i, z i ∈ commonPositiveEvent r h k} =
      (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin m => (commonPositiveEvent r h k)ᶜ)ᶜ := by
    ext z
    simp
  rw [he, measureReal_compl (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun _ =>
    (measurableSet_commonPositiveEvent r h k).compl)]
  rw [probReal_univ]
  simp only [khatriRaoCommonSignLaw, Measure.real, Measure.pi_pi,
    ENNReal.toReal_pow, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  have hp : μ.real (commonPositiveEvent r h k)ᶜ =
      1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k) := by
    rw [measureReal_compl (measurableSet_commonPositiveEvent r h k),
      probReal_univ, measureReal_commonPositiveEvent]
  exact congrArg (fun p : ℝ => 1 - p ^ m) hp

name: NLAlib.one_sub_pow_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch
    {r h k m : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hsize : 2 * m ≤ r * h ^ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    1 - (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k)) ^ m ≤
      (khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r h k m).real
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
          (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) ε}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← measureReal_exists_commonPositiveEvent r h k m]
  apply ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness)
  apply measure_mono_ae
  have hrow : ∀ᵐ z ∂khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r h k m,
      ∀ i a, (z i).1 a ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    have heval := (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae
      (μ := fun _ : Fin m => (rademacherVector (Fin r)).prod
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => rademacherVector (Fin h))) (i := i))
    have hfst : ∀ᵐ w ∂(rademacherVector (Fin r)).prod
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => rademacherVector (Fin h)),
        ∀ a, w.1 a ^ 2 = 1 :=
      measurePreserving_fst.quasiMeasurePreserving.tendsto_ae.eventually
        ae_forall_sq_eq_one_rademacherVector
    exact heval.eventually hfst
  filter_upwards [hrow] with z hz he
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := he
  apply not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_of_all_one hh hm hsize z i (hz i) _ hε
  have hi' : (z i).2 = fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ) := hi.2
  intro j t
  exact congrFun (congrFun hi' j) t

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_eq_one_of_lt
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_eq_one_of_lt
    {r h k m : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hmr : m < r) {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    (khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r h k m).real
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
        (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) ε} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : {z : Fin m → (Fin r → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin h → ℝ) |
      ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
      (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) ε} = Set.univ := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    intro hz
    have hd := hz.card_le (hasOrthonormalCols_khatriRaoCommonIsometry r k hh)
      hε
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hd
    omega
  rw [he, probReal_univ]

name: NLAlib.one_sub_exp_neg_sqrt_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch
statement:
theorem one_sub_exp_neg_sqrt_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch
    {r h k m : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hm : 0 < m) (hrm : r ≤ m)
    (hsize : 2 * m ≤ r * h ^ k)
    (hprob : Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (r : ℝ)) ≤
      (khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r h k m).real
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
          (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r h k) ε}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans _
    (one_sub_pow_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch hh hm hsize hε)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k) := by positivity
  have hp1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k) ≤ 1 :=
    pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hb : (1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k)) ^ m ≤
      Real.exp (-((m : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k))) := by
    have he : 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k) ≤
        Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k)) := by
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
        Real.add_one_le_exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k))
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1) he m
    simpa only [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_neg] using hp
  have hmr : (r : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hrm
  have hmp : Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (h * k) :=
    hprob.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmr hp0)
  have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hmp)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hmoment : ∀ j (a : Fin (n j) → ℝ),
      Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p)) (ν j) ∧
        (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ g) ^ (2 * p) ∂ν j) ≤ B * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p))
    (a : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        B ^ d * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      simp only [khatriRaoProbe, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty,
        dotProduct, mul_one, Fintype.sum_unique]
      refine ⟨integrable_const _, ?_⟩
      rw [integral_const]
      simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul, pow_zero, one_mul]
      rw [show ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) = (‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2) ^ p by rw [pow_mul]]
      rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
      simp only [dotProduct, Fintype.sum_unique, ← pow_two, pow_mul]
      exact le_refl _
  | succ d ih =>
      let ν' : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) := fun j => ν j.succ
      let T : Matrix (Fin (n 0)) (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ)) ℝ :=
        fun i b => a (Fin.cons i b)
      have htail (b : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ)) → ℝ) :=
        ih ν' (fun j => hmoment j.succ) b
      have hnorm := integrable_and_integral_norm_mulVec_pow_two_mul_le
        (khatriRaoProbe (n := fun j : Fin d => n j.succ))
        measurable_khatriRaoProbe.aemeasurable hp (pow_nonneg hB d) htail T
      let F : (Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) → ℝ :=
        fun g => ((T *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g.2) ⬝ᵥ g.1) ^ (2 * p)
      have hFmeas : StronglyMeasurable F := by
        apply Continuous.stronglyMeasurable
        dsimp [F]
        unfold khatriRaoProbe mulVec dotProduct
        fun_prop
      have hFnonneg (g) : 0 ≤ F g := Even.pow_nonneg (even_two.mul_right p) _
      have hfactor (g : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) :=
        hmoment 0 (T *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)
      have hinner : Integrable (fun g => ∫ g₀, ‖F (g₀, g)‖ ∂ν 0) (Measure.pi ν') := by
        apply (hnorm.1.const_mul B).mono_nonneg
          hFmeas.norm.integral_prod_left'.aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact ae_of_all _ fun _ => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
        · apply ae_of_all
          intro g
          simpa only [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hFnonneg _)] using (hfactor g).2
      have hFi : Integrable F ((ν 0).prod (Measure.pi ν')) :=
        (integrable_prod_iff' hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable).2
          ⟨ae_of_all _ fun g => (hfactor g).1, hinner⟩
      have hFb : (∫ g, F g ∂(ν 0).prod (Measure.pi ν')) ≤
          B ^ (d + 1) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) := by
        rw [integral_prod_symm _ hFi]
        calc
          (∫ g, ∫ g₀, F (g₀, g) ∂ν 0 ∂Measure.pi ν') ≤
              ∫ g, B * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)‖ ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν' :=
            integral_mono hFi.integral_prod_right (hnorm.1.const_mul B)
              (fun g => (hfactor g).2)
          _ = B * ∫ g, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)‖ ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν' :=
            integral_const_mul _ _
          _ ≤ B * (B ^ d * frobSq T ^ p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm.2 hB
          _ = B ^ (d + 1) * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) := by
            have hT : frobSq T = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 := by
              rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
              simpa only [T, dotProduct, ← pow_two] using sum_norm_sq_tensor_slices a
            rw [hT, pow_mul, pow_succ]
            ring
      let e : ((Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ
          (∀ j : Fin (d + 1), Fin (n j) → ℝ) :=
        { Fin.consEquiv (fun j => Fin (n j) → ℝ) with
          measurable_toFun := by
            apply measurable_pi_iff.2
            intro i
            refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
            · simpa only [Fin.consEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_zero] using
                (measurable_fst : Measurable (fun g :
                  (Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) => g.1))
            · simpa only [Fin.consEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_def] using
                (measurable_pi_apply j).comp measurable_snd
          measurable_invFun := by
            change Measurable (fun g : ∀ j : Fin (d + 1), Fin (n j) → ℝ =>
              (g 0, fun j : Fin d => g j.succ))
            exact (measurable_pi_apply 0).prodMk
              (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun j => measurable_pi_apply j.succ) }
      have he : MeasurePreserving e ((ν 0).prod (Measure.pi ν')) (Measure.pi ν) := by
        refine ⟨e.measurable, (Measure.pi_eq fun s _ => ?_).symm⟩
        rw [e.map_apply, Fin.prod_univ_succ, ← Measure.pi_pi, ← Measure.prod_prod]
        congr 1 with ⟨x, f⟩
        simp [e, Fin.forall_fin_succ]
      have hpoint : (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) ∘
          (fun g : (Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) =>
            Fin.cons g.1 g.2) = F := by
        funext g
        rw [Function.comp_apply, dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_cons]
        rfl
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hc : Integrable ((fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) ∘
            (fun g : (Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) =>
              Fin.cons g.1 g.2)) ((ν 0).prod (Measure.pi ν')) := by
          rw [hpoint]
          exact hFi
        exact (he.integrable_comp (show Measurable
            (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) from by
          unfold khatriRaoProbe dotProduct
          fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable).1 hc
      · rw [← he.integral_comp']
        change (∫ g, ((fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) ∘
          (fun g : (Fin (n 0) → ℝ) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) =>
            Fin.cons g.1 g.2)) g ∂(ν 0).prod (Measure.pi ν')) ≤ _
        rw [hpoint]
        exact hFb

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le_of_exp_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le_of_exp_sq
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (a : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)) ^ d *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  exact integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le ν hp (by positivity)
    (fun j a => integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_le_of_directional_exp_sq
      (ν j) hK (hpsi j) p a) a

name: NLAlib.integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_projected_khatriRaoProbe_le
statement:
theorem integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_projected_khatriRaoProbe_le
    {d : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ}
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (a : Fin r → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
      (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
        (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * K ^ (2 * p)) ^ d *
          ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_le_of_exp_sq
    ν hK hpsi hp (U *ᵥ a)
  have hnorm : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ a)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    simpa only [star_trivial, hU.conjTranspose_mul_self, Matrix.one_mulVec] using
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self U a
  have hnorm' : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (U *ᵥ a)‖ ^ (2 * p) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) := by rw [pow_mul, hnorm, ← pow_mul]
  have hpoint (g) : a ⬝ᵥ (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) =
      (U *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g := by
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec, dotProduct_comm]
  simpa only [hpoint, hnorm'] using h

name: NLAlib.measurable_srhtSketch
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_srhtSketch {n k : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : (Fin n → ℝ) × ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k => srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Measurable (fun T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k =>
      (selectionMatrix (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop))ᵀ) := .of_discrete
  have hD : Measurable (fun ω : (Fin n → ℝ) × ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k =>
      Matrix.diagonal ω.1) := by
    apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, hij] <;> fun_prop
  unfold srhtSketch
  exact (((hR.comp measurable_snd).matrix_mul measurable_const).matrix_mul hD).const_smul
    (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k))

name: NLAlib.srhtSketch_mul_apply
statement:
theorem srhtSketch_mul_apply {n k d : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (ξ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k) (a : Fin k) (b : Fin d) :
    (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) a b = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) *
      srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop a) b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [srhtSketch, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, srhtSignedFrame]
  rw [transpose_selectionMatrix_mul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.sum_srhtRowEnumeration
statement:
theorem sum_srhtRowEnumeration {n k : ℕ} (T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k)
    {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] (f : Fin n → E) :
    (∑ a : Fin k, f (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop a)) = ∑ j ∈ T.val, f j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.map (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop).toEmbedding, f j :=
      (Finset.sum_map _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [T.val.map_orderEmbOfFin_univ T.prop]

name: NLAlib.transpose_srhtSketch_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_srhtSketch_mul_self {n k d : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (ξ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k) :
    (srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) =
      ((n : ℝ) / k) • ∑ j ∈ T.val,
        Matrix.vecMulVec (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j) (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [srhtSketch_mul_apply]
  have hm (j : Fin k) :
      (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) a) *
      (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) b) =
      ((n : ℝ) / k) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) a *
        srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) b) := by
    calc
      _ = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ 2 *
          (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) a *
            srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (T.val.orderEmbOfFin T.prop j) b) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) / k by positivity)]
  simp_rw [hm]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ => ((n : ℝ) / k) * z)
    (sum_srhtRowEnumeration T (fun j => srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j a * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j b))

name: NLAlib.srhtPopulationAtom_posSemidef
statement:
theorem srhtPopulationAtom_posSemidef {n d : ℕ}
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (j : Fin n) : (srhtPopulationAtom V j).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_star_self (fun a => (V j a : ℂ))).smul (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: NLAlib.trace_srhtPopulationAtom
statement:
theorem trace_srhtPopulationAtom {n d : ℕ} (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (srhtPopulationAtom V j).trace.re = (n : ℝ) * (V j ⬝ᵥ V j)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ a, ((n : ℝ) • (star (V j a : ℂ) * (V j a : ℂ)))).re =
    (n : ℝ) * ∑ a, V j a * V j a
  simp only [Complex.re_sum, Complex.smul_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.mean_srhtPopulationAtom
statement:
theorem mean_srhtPopulationAtom {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hV : HasOrthonormalCols V) :
    (1 / (Fintype.card (Fin n) : ℝ)) • ∑ j, srhtPopulationAtom V j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne n
  have he := hV
  change Vᴴ * V = 1 at he
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at he
  ext a b
  have hab := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ => M a b) he
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hab
  simp only [srhtPopulationAtom, Fintype.card_fin, ← Finset.smul_sum,
    smul_smul, one_div_mul_cancel hn, one_smul, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_sum]
  rw [hab]
  by_cases h : a = b <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply, h]

name: NLAlib.map_ofReal_srhtSketch_gram
statement:
theorem map_ofReal_srhtSketch_gram {n k d : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (ξ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k) :
    ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U)).map Complex.ofReal =
      (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, srhtPopulationAtom (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_srhtSketch_mul_self]
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, srhtPopulationAtom,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_sum,
    Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.real_smul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one]
  ring

name: NLAlib.transpose_srhtSketch_full_rows_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_srhtSketch_full_rows_mul_self {n d : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) (T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) n) :
    (srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne n
  have hT : T.val = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_card T.val (by simpa using T.prop)
  rw [transpose_srhtSketch_mul_self, hT, div_self hn, one_smul]
  calc
    _ = (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ)ᵀ * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ := by
      ext a b
      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    _ = 1 := by simpa only [HasOrthonormalCols, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using
      (hasOrthonormalCols_srhtSignedFrame H hH U hU ξ hξ)

name: NLAlib.dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_cons
statement:
theorem dotProduct_khatriRaoProbe_cons {d : ℕ} {n : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ}
    (a : (∀ j : Fin (d + 1), Fin (n j)) → ℝ)
    (g₀ : Fin (n 0) → ℝ) (g : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ) → ℝ) :
    a ⬝ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (Fin.cons g₀ g) =
      (fun i => ∑ b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ),
        a (Fin.cons i b) * khatriRaoProbe g b) ⬝ᵥ g₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold dotProduct
  rw [← (Fin.consEquiv (fun j => Fin (n j))).sum_comp]
  change (∑ x : Fin (n 0) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ)),
    a (Fin.cons x.1 x.2) * khatriRaoProbe (Fin.cons g₀ g) (Fin.cons x.1 x.2)) = _
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  simp only [khatriRaoProbe, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  ring

name: NLAlib.sum_norm_sq_tensor_slices
statement:

    (∑ i : Fin (n 0), ∑ b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ), a (Fin.cons i b) ^ 2) =
      ∑ b, a b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← (Fin.consEquiv (fun j => Fin (n j))).sum_comp]
  change _ = ∑ x : Fin (n 0) × (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j.succ)), a (Fin.cons x.1 x.2) ^ 2
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) :
    ∫ g, khatriRaoProbe g a * khatriRaoProbe g b ∂Measure.pi ν =
      if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [khatriRaoProbe, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod
    (fun j (g : Fin (n j) → ℝ) => g (a j) * g (b j))]
  simp only [hsecond]
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hab]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hab
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (if_neg hj)

name: NLAlib.integrable_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem integrable_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a b : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) :
    Integrable (fun g => khatriRaoProbe g a * khatriRaoProbe g b) (Measure.pi ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hL2 (a : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) :
      MemLp (fun g => khatriRaoProbe g a) 2 (Measure.pi ν) := by
    apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq
      ((measurable_pi_apply a).comp measurable_khatriRaoProbe).aestronglyMeasurable).2
    apply integrable_of_integral_eq_one
    simpa [pow_two] using integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe ν hsecond a a
  exact (hL2 a).integrable_mul (hL2 b)

name: NLAlib.integral_quadForm_khatriRaoProbe_eq_trace
statement:
theorem integral_quadForm_khatriRaoProbe_eq_trace
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (A : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) ℝ) :
    (∫ g, quadForm A (khatriRaoProbe g) ∂Measure.pi ν) = A.trace
proof:
:= by
  exact integral_quadForm_eq_trace_of_second_moments A
    (fun a => ((measurable_pi_apply a).comp measurable_khatriRaoProbe).aemeasurable)
    (integral_khatriRaoProbe_mul_khatriRaoProbe ν hsecond)

name: NLAlib.integral_projected_khatriRaoProbe_mul_projected_khatriRaoProbe
statement:
theorem integral_projected_khatriRaoProbe_mul_projected_khatriRaoProbe
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)]
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (i j : Fin r) :
    ∫ g, (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) i * (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) j
        ∂Measure.pi ν = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := Matrix.vecMulVec (fun a => U a i) (fun a => U a j)
  have hpoint (g : ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ) :
      (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) i * (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) j =
        quadForm A (khatriRaoProbe g) := by
    simp only [A, quadForm, star_trivial, Matrix.vecMulVec_mulVec,
      dotProduct_smul, op_smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    rw [dotProduct_comm (khatriRaoProbe g) (fun a => U a i)]
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [integral_quadForm_khatriRaoProbe_eq_trace ν hsecond]
  have hU' : Uᵀ * U = 1 := hU
  simpa only [A, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using congrArg (fun M => M i j) hU'

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_rademacher_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_rademacher_le

          Real.log (4 * r / δ) ^ d) / ε) ≤ m) :

      {g | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε} ≤ δ
proof:

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoLowerMode_bounds
statement:
theorem khatriRaoLowerMode_bounds {r k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hr : 4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ)) :
    0 < khatriRaoLowerMode r k ∧
      Real.log (r : ℝ) / (4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ≤ khatriRaoLowerMode r k ∧
      (khatriRaoLowerMode r k : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (r : ℝ) / (2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hkR : 0 < (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have hx : 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ) / (2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hd).2
    nlinarith
  have hfloor := Nat.floor_le (le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hx)
  have hlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one
    (Real.log (r : ℝ) / (2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2))
  have hhalf : Real.log (r : ℝ) / (4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) =
      (Real.log (r : ℝ) / (2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) / 2 := by ring
  constructor
  · unfold khatriRaoLowerMode
    exact Nat.floor_pos.2 (by linarith)
  · unfold khatriRaoLowerMode
    exact ⟨by rw [hhalf]; linarith, hfloor⟩

name: NLAlib.sqrt_le_mul_pow_lowerMode
statement:
private theorem sqrt_le_mul_pow_lowerMode {r k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hlog : 4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ)) :
    Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) ≤
      (r : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrR : 0 < (r : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < 2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have hf := (le_div_iff₀ hd).1 (khatriRaoLowerMode_bounds hk hlog).2.2
  have harg : Real.log (r : ℝ) / 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ) -
      ((khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  have he : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k) =
      Real.exp (-(((khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    simp [one_div, inv_pow]
  rw [he]
  calc
    Real.sqrt (r : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log (r : ℝ) / 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_half, Real.exp_log hrR]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (r : ℝ) -
        ((khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr harg
    _ = (r : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((khatriRaoLowerMode r k * k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log 2)) := by rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hrR, div_eq_mul_inv, Real.exp_neg]

name: NLAlib.two_mul_le_mul_pow_lowerMode
statement:
private theorem two_mul_le_mul_pow_lowerMode {r k m : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hlog : 4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ))
    (hbudget : (m : ℝ) ≤ khatriRaoLowerConstant k * r * Real.log (r : ℝ) ^ k) :
    2 * m ≤ r * khatriRaoLowerMode r k ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hd : 0 < 4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have hdPow : 0 < (4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ k := pow_pos hd k
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hf := (khatriRaoLowerMode_bounds hk hlog).2.1
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg hlog0 hd.le) hf k
  have hc : (2 : ℝ) * khatriRaoLowerConstant k =
      ((4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ k)⁻¹ := by
    unfold khatriRaoLowerConstant
    field_simp
  have hbudget2 : 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤
      (r : ℝ) * (Real.log (r : ℝ) / (4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) ^ k := by
    calc
      2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (khatriRaoLowerConstant k * r * Real.log (r : ℝ) ^ k) := by
        linarith
      _ = (r : ℝ) * (Real.log (r : ℝ) / (4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) ^ k := by
        rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc
          _ = (2 * khatriRaoLowerConstant k) * r * Real.log (r : ℝ) ^ k := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hc]; ring
  have hs : 2 * (m : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) * (khatriRaoLowerMode r k : ℝ) ^ k :=
    hbudget2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
  exact_mod_cast hs

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoLowerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem khatriRaoLowerConstant_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < khatriRaoLowerConstant k
proof:
:= by
  unfold khatriRaoLowerConstant
  have : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  positivity

name: NLAlib.one_sub_exp_neg_sqrt_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_of_le_lower_growth
statement:
theorem one_sub_exp_neg_sqrt_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_of_le_lower_growth
    {r k m : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hr : 2 ^ (4 * k) ≤ r) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hbudget : (m : ℝ) ≤ khatriRaoLowerConstant k * r * Real.log (r : ℝ) ^ k)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) :
    1 - Real.exp (-Real.sqrt (r : ℝ)) ≤
      (khatriRaoCommonSignLaw r (khatriRaoLowerMode r k) k m).real
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoCommonSketch z)
          (khatriRaoCommonIsometry r (khatriRaoLowerMode r k) k) ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hrpos : 0 < r := (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) _).trans_le hr
  have hrR : (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * k) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (4 * k)) hrR
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hlog
  have hlog' : 4 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (r : ℝ) := by
    push_cast at hlog
    nlinarith
  have hh := (khatriRaoLowerMode_bounds hk hlog').1
  by_cases hmr : m < r
  · rw [measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch_eq_one_of_lt hh hmr hε]
    linarith [Real.exp_pos (-Real.sqrt (r : ℝ))]
  · exact one_sub_exp_neg_sqrt_le_measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoCommonSketch
      hh hm (by omega) (two_mul_le_mul_pow_lowerMode hk hlog' hbudget)
      (sqrt_le_mul_pow_lowerMode hk hrpos hlog') hε

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoFixedParameterConstant_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : 1 ≤ (4 : ℝ) / δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by linarith)
  have hL : 0 < 1 + Real.log (4 / δ) := by linarith [Real.log_nonneg hdiv]
  unfold khatriRaoFixedParameterConstant
  positivity

name: NLAlib.khatriRao_budget_le_fixedParameterConstant_mul_rank_log_pow
statement:
theorem khatriRao_budget_le_fixedParameterConstant_mul_rank_log_pow
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {C r ε δ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
    C * (r * Real.log (4 * r / δ) / ε ^ 2 +
      (r * Real.log (4 * r / δ) ^ (d - 1) + Real.log (4 * r / δ) ^ d) / ε) ≤
      khatriRaoFixedParameterConstant d C ε δ * r * (1 + Real.log r) ^ (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let L := 1 + Real.log (4 / δ)
  let l := 1 + Real.log r
  let t := Real.log (4 * r / δ)
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr
  have hl1 : 1 ≤ l := by dsimp [l]; linarith [Real.log_nonneg hr]
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by
    have hdiv : 1 ≤ (4 : ℝ) / δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by linarith)
    dsimp [L]
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hdiv]
  have htl : t = l + L - 2 := by
    dsimp [t, l, L]
    rw [show 4 * r / δ = r * (4 / δ) by ring,
      Real.log_mul hr0.ne' (ne_of_gt (div_pos (by norm_num) hδ))]
    ring
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by rw [htl]; linarith
  have ht : t ≤ L * l := by
    rw [htl]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hL1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hl1)]
  have hlr : l ≤ r := by
    dsimp [l]
    linarith [Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hr0]
  have hlpow : l ≤ l ^ (d - 1) := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_right₀ hl1 (show 1 ≤ d - 1 by omega)
    simpa only [pow_one] using h
  have h1 : r * t ≤ L * r * l ^ (d - 1) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ r * (L * l) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hr0.le
      _ ≤ r * (L * l ^ (d - 1)) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h2 : r * t ^ (d - 1) ≤ L ^ (d - 1) * r * l ^ (d - 1) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ r * (L * l) ^ (d - 1) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  have h3 : t ^ d ≤ L ^ d * r * l ^ (d - 1) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (L * l) ^ d := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht0 ht d
      _ = L ^ d * l ^ (d - 1) * l := by
        have he : l ^ d = l ^ (d - 1) * l := by
          conv_lhs => rw [show d = (d - 1) + 1 by omega]
          rw [pow_succ]
        rw [mul_pow, he]
        ring
      _ ≤ L ^ d * l ^ (d - 1) * r := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  change C * (r * t / ε ^ 2 + (r * t ^ (d - 1) + t ^ d) / ε) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ C * (L * r * l ^ (d - 1) / ε ^ 2 +
        (L ^ (d - 1) * r * l ^ (d - 1) + L ^ d * r * l ^ (d - 1)) / ε) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by dsimp [khatriRaoFixedParameterConstant, L, l]; ring

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_le_of_rank_log_budget
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_le_of_rank_log_budget
    {d r m : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hbudget : khatriRaoFixedParameterConstant d (khatriRaoSharpEmbeddingConstant d K) ε δ *
      r * (1 + Real.log r) ^ (d - 1) ≤ m) :
    (khatriRaoSampleLaw ν m).real
      {g | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_le hd hr hm ν hK
    hpsi hsecond U hU hε hδ hδ1.le
  have hC : 0 ≤ khatriRaoSharpEmbeddingConstant d K := by
    unfold khatriRaoSharpEmbeddingConstant khatriRaoEmbeddingConstant
    positivity
  exact (khatriRao_budget_le_fixedParameterConstant_mul_rank_log_pow hd hC
    (by exact_mod_cast hr) hε hδ hδ1).trans hbudget

name: NLAlib.hasLaw_projected_khatriRaoProbe_samples
statement:
theorem hasLaw_projected_khatriRaoProbe_samples
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {r : ℕ}
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw
      (fun g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ =>
        fun i => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i))
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m =>
        (Measure.pi ν).map (fun g => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) (khatriRaoSampleLaw ν m)
proof:
:= by
  have hproj : Measurable (fun g => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g) := by
    unfold khatriRaoProbe Matrix.mulVec dotProduct
    fun_prop
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ((Measure.pi ν).map (fun g => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hproj.aemeasurable
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i => hproj.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)).aemeasurable
  · exact Measure.pi_map_pi (fun _ : Fin m => hproj.aemeasurable)

name: NLAlib.iIndepFun_projected_khatriRaoProbe_samples
statement:
theorem iIndepFun_projected_khatriRaoProbe_samples
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))

    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
      (fun i : Fin m => fun g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ =>
        Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) (khatriRaoSampleLaw ν m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold khatriRaoSampleLaw
  apply ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_pi
    (X := fun _ : Fin m => fun g => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g)
  intro i

  unfold khatriRaoProbe Matrix.mulVec dotProduct

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoSketch_mul_apply
statement:
theorem khatriRaoSketch_mul_apply {r : ℕ}
    (g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) (i : Fin m) (a : Fin r) :
    (khatriRaoSketch g * U) i a =
      (1 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) * (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [khatriRaoSketch, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: NLAlib.transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self
statement:
theorem transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self {r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) :
    (khatriRaoSketch g * U)ᵀ * (khatriRaoSketch g * U) =
      (m : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin m,
        Matrix.vecMulVec (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i))
proof:
:= by
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hc : (1 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 = (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hmpos.le]
    simp
  ext a b
  change (∑ i, (khatriRaoSketch g * U) i a * (khatriRaoSketch g * U) i b) = _
  simp only [khatriRaoSketch_mul_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    _ = (1 / Real.sqrt (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 *
        ((Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) a * (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) b) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hc]

name: NLAlib.transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self_sub_one
statement:
theorem transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self_sub_one {r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) :
    (khatriRaoSketch g * U)ᵀ * (khatriRaoSketch g * U) - 1 =
      (m : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin m,
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmne : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hm)
  rw [transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self hm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub]
  congr 1
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hmne, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_iff
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_iff {r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε ↔
      specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i : Fin m,
        Matrix.vecMulVec (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) (Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe (g i)) - 1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU hε,
    transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self hm]

name: NLAlib.one_lt_log_four_mul_rank_div
statement:
theorem one_lt_log_four_mul_rank_div {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) : 1 < Real.log (4 * r / δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hrr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hratio : (4 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * r / δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hlog : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log (4 * r / δ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hratio
  have hf : 1 < Real.log 4 := by
    rw [Real.log_four_eq]
    nlinarith [Real.log_two_gt_d9]
  exact hf.trans_le hlog

name: NLAlib.khatriRaoMomentOrder_bounds
statement:
theorem khatriRaoMomentOrder_bounds {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    1 ≤ khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ ∧
      Real.log (4 * r / δ) ≤ (khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ : ℝ) ∧
      (khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (4 * r / δ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := one_lt_log_four_mul_rank_div hr hδ hδ1
  refine ⟨Nat.one_le_ceil_iff.2 (by linarith), Nat.le_ceil _, ?_⟩
  have hu := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (le_of_lt (lt_trans zero_lt_one ht))
  change (⌈Real.log (4 * r / δ)⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ _
  linarith

name: NLAlib.rank_mul_exp_neg_two_mul_khatriRaoMomentOrder_le
statement:
theorem rank_mul_exp_neg_two_mul_khatriRaoMomentOrder_le
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) :
    (r : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * (khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ : ℝ)) ≤ δ / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hrr : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hr)
  have hb := khatriRaoMomentOrder_bounds hr hδ hδ1
  have hq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have he : Real.exp (-2 * (khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp (-Real.log (4 * r / δ)) := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith [hb.2.1])
  have hratio : 0 < (4 : ℝ) * r / δ := by positivity
  rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hratio] at he
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he hrr.le
  have heq : (r : ℝ) * (4 * r / δ)⁻¹ = δ / 4 := by field_simp
  simpa only [heq] using hmul

name: NLAlib.mul_sqrt_add_pow_div_le_of_khatriRao_budget
statement:
theorem mul_sqrt_add_pow_div_le_of_khatriRao_budget {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {C r m t q ε : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hm : 0 < m)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqt : q ≤ 2 * t) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbudget : khatriRaoEmbeddingConstant d C *
      (r * t / ε ^ 2 + (r * t ^ (d - 1) + t ^ d) / ε) ≤ m) :
    C * (Real.sqrt (q * r / m) + q ^ (d - 1) * (r + q) / m) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  let A := khatriRaoEmbeddingConstant d C
  let L := r * t ^ (d - 1) + t ^ d
  have htwo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ d := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have hA : 0 < A := by dsimp [A, khatriRaoEmbeddingConstant]; positivity
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have hvar : A * (r * t / ε ^ 2) ≤ m := by
    have hpart : 0 ≤ A * (L / ε) := mul_nonneg hA.le (div_nonneg hL hε.le)
    change A * (r * t / ε ^ 2 + L / ε) ≤ m at hbudget
    nlinarith
  have hrow : A * (L / ε) ≤ m := by
    have hpart : 0 ≤ A * (r * t / ε ^ 2) := by positivity
    change A * (r * t / ε ^ 2 + L / ε) ≤ m at hbudget
    nlinarith
  have hAvar : 8 * C ^ 2 ≤ A := by
    have hsq : C ^ 2 ≤ (C + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htwo (by positivity : 0 ≤ 16 * (C + 1) ^ 2)
    dsimp [A, khatriRaoEmbeddingConstant]
    nlinarith
  have hArow : 2 * C * 2 ^ d ≤ A := by
    have hbase : 2 * C ≤ 16 * (C + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg C]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbase (by positivity)
  have hvar' : A * (r * t) ≤ m * ε ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hvar (sq_nonneg ε)
    have hepsne : ε ≠ 0 := hε.ne'
    field_simp [hepsne] at hmul
    nlinarith
  have hqvar : 4 * C ^ 2 * (q * r) ≤ m * ε ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAvar (mul_nonneg hr ht)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * C ^ 2 * r)
    nlinarith
  have hrad : 0 ≤ q * r / m := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq hr) hm.le
  have hsqrt : C * Real.sqrt (q * r / m) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hrad
    have hdiv : (4 * C ^ 2 * (q * r)) / m ≤ ε ^ 2 :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hm).2 (by nlinarith [hqvar])
    have heq : (4 * C ^ 2 * (q * r)) / m = 4 * C ^ 2 * (q * r / m) := by ring
    rw [heq] at hdiv
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (q * r / m)]
  have hqpow : q ^ (d - 1) ≤ (2 * t) ^ (d - 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hq hqt _
  have hqd : q ^ d ≤ (2 * t) ^ d := pow_le_pow_left₀ hq hqt _
  have htwopred : (2 : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) ≤ 2 ^ d :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.sub_le d 1)
  have hscale : q ^ (d - 1) * (r + q) ≤ 2 ^ d * L := by
    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqpow hr
    have hpow : q ^ (d - 1) * q = q ^ d := by
      rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hd]
    have hpred := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htwopred
      (mul_nonneg hr (pow_nonneg ht (d - 1)))
    rw [mul_pow] at hprod hqd
    dsimp [L]
    nlinarith
  have hrow' : A * L ≤ m * ε := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrow hε.le
    have hepsne : ε ≠ 0 := hε.ne'
    field_simp [hepsne] at hmul
    nlinarith
  have hlinear : C * (q ^ (d - 1) * (r + q) / m) ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hArow hL
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hC
    rw [← mul_div_assoc]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hm).2
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.measurable_srhtWithReplacementSketch
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_srhtWithReplacementSketch {n k : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun ω : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin n) =>
      srhtWithReplacementSketch H ω.1 ω.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Measurable (fun I : Fin k → Fin n => (selectionMatrix I)ᵀ) := .of_discrete
  have hD : Measurable (fun ω : (Fin n → ℝ) × (Fin k → Fin n) => Matrix.diagonal ω.1) := by
    apply Matrix.measurable_iff_entries.mpr
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, hij] <;> fun_prop
  unfold srhtWithReplacementSketch
  exact (((hR.comp measurable_snd).matrix_mul measurable_const).matrix_mul hD).const_smul
    (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k))

name: NLAlib.srhtWithReplacementSketch_mul_apply
statement:
theorem srhtWithReplacementSketch_mul_apply {n k d : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (I : Fin k → Fin n) (a : Fin k) (b : Fin d) :
    (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) a b = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) *
      srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I a) b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [srhtWithReplacementSketch, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, srhtSignedFrame]
  rw [transpose_selectionMatrix_mul]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.map_ofReal_srhtWithReplacementSketch_gram
statement:
theorem map_ofReal_srhtWithReplacementSketch_gram {n k d : ℕ}
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (I : Fin k → Fin n) :
    ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ * (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)).map
      Complex.ofReal = (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ a, srhtPopulationAtom (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ) (I a)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ * (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) =
      ((n : ℝ) / k) • ∑ a, Matrix.vecMulVec (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I a))
        (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I a)) := by
    ext a b
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
      Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp_rw [srhtWithReplacementSketch_mul_apply]
    have hm (j : Fin k) :
        (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) a) *
        (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) b) =
        ((n : ℝ) / k) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) a * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) b) := by
      calc
        _ = Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) / k) ^ 2 *
            (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) a * srhtSignedFrame H U ξ (I j) b) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) / k by positivity)]
    simp_rw [hm]
    exact (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
  rw [hG]
  ext a b
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, srhtPopulationAtom,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_sum,
    Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.real_smul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one]
  ring

name: NLAlib.measure_srhtWithReplacement_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows
statement:
theorem measure_srhtWithReplacement_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows
    {n d k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hk : 0 < k)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hflat : ∀ j, (n : ℝ) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j) ≤ L)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → Fin n)).toMeasure
      {I | ε < specNorm ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
        (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  let V := srhtSignedFrame H U ξ
  let A := srhtPopulationAtom V
  have hPSD (j : Fin n) : (A j).PosSemidef := srhtPopulationAtom_posSemidef V j
  have hbound (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L := by
    refine ⟨lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef (hPSD j), ?_⟩
    have ht := trace_srhtPopulationAtom V j
    exact (lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef (hPSD j)).trans (by
      change (srhtPopulationAtom V j).trace.re ≤ L
      rw [ht]
      exact hflat j)
  have hmean := mean_srhtPopulationAtom V (hasOrthonormalCols_srhtSignedFrame H hH U hU ξ hξ)
  have hc := measure_norm_uniform_iid_sub_one_le hk A L hL
    (fun j => (hPSD j).isHermitian) hbound hmean hε hε1
  have hsub : {I : Fin k → Fin n | ε < specNorm ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
      (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1)} ⊆
      {I | ε ≤ ‖(1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ a, A (I a) - 1‖} := by
    intro I hI
    have hm : (((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
        (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1).map Complex.ofReal) =
        (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ a, A (I a) - 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.map_sub Complex.ofReal Complex.ofReal_sub, map_ofReal_srhtWithReplacementSketch_gram]
      congr 1
      ext a b
      by_cases hab : a = b <;> simp [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hab]
    have hn : specNorm ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
          (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1) ≤
        ‖((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
          (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1).map Complex.ofReal‖ :=
      by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Complex.coe_algebraMap] using specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ)
          ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ * (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1)
    rw [hm] at hn
    exact hI.le.trans hn
  exact (measureReal_mono hsub).trans hc

name: NLAlib.measure_srhtWithReplacement_gram_failure_le_of_sharp_sample_size
statement:
theorem measure_srhtWithReplacement_gram_failure_le_of_sharp_sample_size
    {n d k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hk : 0 < k)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (hHflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hsize : 3 * srhtSharpRowBound n d δ / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * d / δ) ≤ k) :
    (srhtWithReplacementLaw n k {ω | ε < specNorm
      ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U)ᵀ *
        (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let L := srhtSharpRowBound n d δ
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    apply sq_pos_of_pos
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hdR) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  let E : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {ξ | ∃ j : Fin n,
    L < (n : ℝ) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j)}
  have hE := measure_srhtSharpRowBound_failure_le H hHflat U hU hδ hδ1
  have hcond (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) (hξ : ξ ∉ E) :
      ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → Fin n)).toMeasure
        {I | ε < specNorm ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U)ᵀ *
          (srhtWithReplacementSketch H ξ I * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have hrows (j : Fin n) : (n : ℝ) *
        (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j) ≤ L := by
      by_contra hnot
      exact hξ ⟨j, lt_of_not_ge hnot⟩
    exact (measure_srhtWithReplacement_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows hk H hH U hU ξ hsign
      hL hrows hε hε1).trans
      (srht_tail_le_half_of_sample_size (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)) hL hε hδ hsize)
  have hh := measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le_of_measurableSet (rademacherVector (Fin n))
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin k → Fin n)).toMeasure E
    {ω | ε < specNorm ((srhtWithReplacementSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U)ᵀ *

      fun_prop)
    (show 0 ≤ δ / 2 by positivity)
    ((ae_forall_sq_eq_one_rademacherVector (ι := Fin n)).mono fun ξ hξ => hcond ξ hξ)
  change (rademacherVector (Fin n)).real E ≤ δ / 2 at hE
  exact hh.trans (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows
statement:
theorem measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows
    {n d k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ n)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) {L ε : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hflat : ∀ j, (n : ℝ) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j) ≤ L)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ((uniformExactRowSubsetPMF (show k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) by simpa using hk)).toMeasure
      {T | ε < specNorm ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤
      2 * d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L))
proof:
:= by
  let V := srhtSignedFrame H U ξ
  let A := srhtPopulationAtom V
  have hPSD (j : Fin n) : (A j).PosSemidef := srhtPopulationAtom_posSemidef V j
  have hbound (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ lambdaMin (A j) ∧ lambdaMax (A j) ≤ L := by
    refine ⟨lambdaMin_nonneg_of_posSemidef (hPSD j), ?_⟩
    have ht := trace_srhtPopulationAtom V j
    exact (lambdaMax_le_trace_of_posSemidef (hPSD j)).trans (by
      change (srhtPopulationAtom V j).trace.re ≤ L
      rw [ht]
      exact hflat j)
  have hmean := mean_srhtPopulationAtom V (hasOrthonormalCols_srhtSignedFrame H hH U hU ξ hξ)
  have hc := measure_norm_uniform_subset_sub_one_le hk0
    (show k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) by simpa using hk) A L hL
    (fun j => (hPSD j).isHermitian) hbound hmean hε hε1
  have hsub : {T : ExactRowSubset (Fin n) k | ε <
      specNorm ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1)} ⊆
      {T | ε ≤ ‖(1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j - 1‖} := by
    intro T hT
    have hm : (((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1).map Complex.ofReal) =
        (1 / (k : ℝ)) • ∑ j ∈ T.val, A j - 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.map_sub Complex.ofReal Complex.ofReal_sub, map_ofReal_srhtSketch_gram]
      congr 1
      ext a b
      by_cases hab : a = b <;> simp [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hab]
    have hnorm : specNorm ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1) ≤
        ‖((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1).map Complex.ofReal‖ :=
      by
        simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm, Complex.coe_algebraMap] using specNorm_le_specNorm_map_ofReal (𝕜 := ℂ)
          ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1)
    rw [hm] at hnorm
    exact hT.le.trans hnorm
  exact (measureReal_mono hsub).trans hc

name: NLAlib.srht_tail_le_half_of_sample_size
statement:
theorem srht_tail_le_half_of_sample_size {d k : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {L ε δ : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsize : 3 * L / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * d / δ) ≤ k) :
    2 * d * Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) * k / (3 * L)) ≤ δ / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlog : Real.log (4 * d / δ) ≤ ε ^ 2 * k / (3 * L) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsize (show 0 ≤ ε ^ 2 / (3 * L) by positivity)
    have he : ε ^ 2 / (3 * L) * (3 * L / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * d / δ)) =
        Real.log (4 * d / δ) := by field_simp
    rw [he] at hh
    calc
      _ ≤ ε ^ 2 / (3 * L) * (k : ℝ) := hh
      _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * d * Real.exp (-Real.log (4 * d / δ)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      simpa only [neg_div, neg_mul] using neg_le_neg hlog
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity : 0 < 4 * (d : ℝ) / δ)]
      field_simp
      ring

name: NLAlib.measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_sharp_sample_size
statement:
theorem measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_sharp_sample_size
    {n d k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero d] (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k ≤ n)
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (hHflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hsize : 3 * srhtSharpRowBound n d δ / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * d / δ) ≤ k) :
    (srhtLaw hk {ω | ε < specNorm
      ((srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let L := srhtSharpRowBound n d δ
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    apply sq_pos_of_pos
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hdR) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  let E : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {ξ | ∃ j : Fin n,
    L < (n : ℝ) * (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j)}
  have hE := measure_srhtSharpRowBound_failure_le H hHflat U hU hδ hδ1
  have hcond (ξ : Fin n → ℝ) (hsign : ∀ i, ξ i ^ 2 = 1) (hξ : ξ ∉ E) :
      ((uniformExactRowSubsetPMF (show k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) by simpa using hk)).toMeasure
        {T | ε < specNorm ((srhtSketch H ξ T * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ξ T * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤
          δ / 2 := by
    have hrows (j : Fin n) : (n : ℝ) *
        (srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j ⬝ᵥ srhtSignedFrame H U ξ j) ≤ L := by
      by_contra hnot
      exact hξ ⟨j, lt_of_not_ge hnot⟩
    exact (measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_flat_rows hk0 hk H hH U hU ξ hsign hL hrows hε hε1).trans
      (srht_tail_le_half_of_sample_size (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d)) hL hε hδ hsize)
  have hh := measureReal_prod_le_measureReal_add_of_sections_le_of_measurableSet (rademacherVector (Fin n))
    (uniformExactRowSubsetPMF (show k ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n) by simpa using hk)).toMeasure E
    {ω | ε < specNorm ((srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U) - 1)}
    (by
      dsimp only [E]
      simp only [Set.ofPred_exists]
      apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
      intro j
      apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      unfold dotProduct
      fun_prop)
    (by
      apply measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      simp only [specNorm_eq_norm]
      fun_prop)
    (show 0 ≤ δ / 2 by positivity)
    ((ae_forall_sq_eq_one_rademacherVector (ι := Fin n)).mono fun ξ hξ => hcond ξ hξ)
  change (rademacherVector (Fin n)).real E ≤ δ / 2 at hE
  exact hh.trans (by linarith)

name: NLAlib.measure_srht_capped_gram_failure_le
statement:
theorem measure_srht_capped_gram_failure_le
    {n d k : ℕ} [NeZero n] [NeZero d]
    (H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hH : Hᵀ * H = 1)
    (hHflat : ∀ i j, H i j ^ 2 = 1 / (n : ℝ))
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hcount : k = srhtCappedRowCount n d ε δ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (srhtLaw hk {ω | ε < specNorm
      ((srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U)ᵀ * (srhtSketch H ω.1 ω.2 * U) - 1)}).toReal ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfull : k = n
  · clear hcount
    subst k
    rw [measure_srht_full_rows_failure_eq_zero H hH U hU hε.le]
    exact hδ.le
  let T := 3 * srhtManuscriptRowBound n d δ / ε ^ 2 * Real.log (4 * d / δ)
  have hkn : k = ⌈T⌉₊ := by
    change k = min n ⌈T⌉₊ at hcount
    rcases le_total n ⌈T⌉₊ with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h] at hcount
      exact False.elim (hfull hcount)
    · simpa only [min_eq_right h] using hcount
  have hdR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  have hsharp : 0 < srhtSharpRowBound n d δ := by
    apply sq_pos_of_pos
    apply add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hL : 0 < srhtManuscriptRowBound n d δ :=
    hsharp.trans_le (srhtSharpRowBound_le_manuscript hδ hδ1)
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (4 * d / δ) := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hδ]
    linarith
  have hT : 0 < T := by dsimp only [T]; positivity
  apply measure_srht_gram_failure_le_of_manuscript_sample_size
    (by rw [hkn]; exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr hT) hk H hH hHflat U hU hε hε1 hδ hδ1
  change T ≤ (k : ℝ)
  rw [hkn]
  exact Nat.le_ceil T

name: NLAlib.covariance_scale_bound
statement:
private theorem covariance_scale_bound {d r q m : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    (2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (4 * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r) * m) +
      2 * (q : ℝ) * (2 * khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r (2 * q))) / m ≤
      (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K 1) +
        32 * 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 ^ (d - 2) * K ^ (2 * d)) *
      (Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m) + (q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m by omega)
  have hrad : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * r / m := by positivity
  let V := khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K 1
  let ρ : ℝ := 32 * 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 ^ (d - 2) * K ^ (2 * d)
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := by dsimp [V, khatriRaoVarianceBudget]; positivity
  have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
  have harg : (q : ℝ) * (4 * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r) * m =
      (4 * V * ((q : ℝ) * r / m)) * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [V, khatriRaoVarianceBudget]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hvar : 2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (4 * khatriRaoVarianceBudget d K r) * m) / m =
      2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V) * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m) := by
    rw [harg, Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hrad),
      Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * V), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hmR]
    field_simp
  have hlin : 2 * (q : ℝ) * (2 * khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r (2 * q)) ≤
      ρ * (q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) := by
    have hlast : (r : ℝ) + 4 * (2 * q : ℕ) ≤ 8 * ((r : ℝ) + q) := by
      push_cast
      nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ r from Nat.cast_nonneg r]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlast
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * (q : ℝ) * 2 ^ (d - 1) * K ^ (2 * d) *
        ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (d - 2))
    have hpow : (q : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ (d - 2) = (q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, show d - 2 + 1 = d - 1 by omega]
    dsimp [khatriRaoMomentRadius, ρ]
    push_cast at hmul ⊢
    rw [mul_pow] at hmul
    rw [mul_pow]
    convert hmul using 1 <;> first | rfl | (rw [← hpow]; ring) | ring
  rw [add_div, hvar]
  have hldiv : 2 * (q : ℝ) * (2 * khatriRaoMomentRadius d K r (2 * q)) / m ≤
      ρ * ((q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m) := by
    convert div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlin hmR.le using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have hcross : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V)) *
      ((q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m) + ρ * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m) := by
    positivity
  change _ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V) + ρ) * _
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V) * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m) +
        ρ * ((q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m) := add_le_add le_rfl hldiv
    _ = (2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V) + ρ) *
        (Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m) + (q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m) -
        ((2 * Real.sqrt (4 * V)) * ((q : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) * ((r : ℝ) + q) / m) +
          ρ * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * r / m)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := sub_le_self _ hcross

name: NLAlib.measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_not_isSubspaceEmbedding_khatriRaoSketch_le
    {d r m : ℕ} {n : Fin d → ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (ν : ∀ j : Fin d, Measure (Fin (n j) → ℝ))
    [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν j)] {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hpsi : ∀ j (u : Fin (n j) → ℝ), ‖WithLp.toLp 2 u‖ = 1 →
      ∫⁻ g, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ((u ⬝ᵥ g / K) ^ 2)) ∂ν j ≤ 2)
    (hsecond : ∀ j (a b : Fin (n j)),
      ∫ g, g a * g b ∂ν j = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (U : Matrix (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j)) (Fin r) ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hbudget : khatriRaoSharpEmbeddingConstant d K *
      ((r : ℝ) * Real.log (4 * r / δ) / ε ^ 2 +
        ((r : ℝ) * Real.log (4 * r / δ) ^ (d - 1) +
          Real.log (4 * r / δ) ^ d) / ε) ≤ m) :
    (khatriRaoSampleLaw ν m).real
      {g | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  let y : (∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ) → Fin r → ℝ :=
    fun g => Uᵀ *ᵥ khatriRaoProbe g
  let κ : ℝ := max 1 K
  let v := khatriRaoVarianceBudget d κ r
  let q := khatriRaoMomentOrder r δ
  let R := khatriRaoMomentRadius d κ r (2 * q)
  let C := khatriRaoCovarianceScaleConstant d K
  have hκ : 1 ≤ κ := le_max_left _ _
  have hκpos : 0 < κ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hκ
  have hy : Measurable y := by unfold y khatriRaoProbe Matrix.mulVec dotProduct; fun_prop
  have hdir (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (a : Fin r → ℝ) :
      Integrable (fun g => (a ⬝ᵥ y g) ^ (2 * p)) (Measure.pi ν) ∧
        (∫ g, (a ⬝ᵥ y g) ^ (2 * p) ∂Measure.pi ν) ≤
          (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * κ ^ (2 * p)) ^ d * (a ⬝ᵥ a) ^ p := by
    have h := integrable_and_integral_pow_two_mul_dotProduct_projected_khatriRaoProbe_le
      ν hK hpsi U hU (p := p) (by omega) a
    refine ⟨h.1, h.2.trans ?_⟩
    rw [show ‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ (2 * p) = (‖WithLp.toLp 2 a‖ ^ 2) ^ p by rw [pow_mul],
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
    gcongr
    · exact pow_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg a) p
    · exact le_max_right 1 K
  have hmom (p : ℕ) : Integrable (fun g => (y g ⬝ᵥ y g) ^ p) (Measure.pi ν) := by
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · subst p; simp
    have hnorm := integrable_and_integral_norm_mulVec_pow_two_mul_le y hy.aemeasurable
      (p := p) (by omega) (show 0 ≤ (2 * (p.factorial : ℝ) * κ ^ (2 * p)) ^ d by positivity)
      (fun a => by simpa only [pow_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hdir p (by omega) a)
      (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    simpa only [Matrix.one_mulVec, pow_mul, norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hnorm.1
  have hys (i j : Fin r) : ∫ g, y g i * y g j ∂Measure.pi ν = if i = j then 1 else 0 :=
    integral_projected_khatriRaoProbe_mul_projected_khatriRaoProbe ν hsecond U hU i j
  have hqb := khatriRaoMomentOrder_bounds hr hδ hδ1
  have hv : 2 ≤ v := two_le_khatriRaoVarianceBudget hr hκ
  have hvpos : 0 < v := by linarith
  have hR : 1 ≤ R := one_le_khatriRaoMomentRadius (by dsimp [q]; omega : 1 ≤ 2 * q) hκ
  have hstep p (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
      (hA : A.IsHermitian) :=
    (integrable_and_integral_trace_add_centered_rankOne_pow_le y hy hys hA hp hv hR
      (fun l hl2 hlp x => by
        have hraw := integrable_and_integral_rankOneProbe_le_factorial hr hl2 hd y hy hκpos.le hdir x
        refine ⟨hraw.1, hraw.2.trans ?_⟩
        gcongr
        · exact dotProduct_self_nonneg x
        · unfold khatriRaoMomentRadius
          positivity
        · exact khatriRaoMomentRadius_mono hκpos.le (show l ≤ 2 * q by omega))).2
  let N : ℝ := 2 * Real.sqrt ((q : ℝ) * (4 * v) * m) + 2 * (q : ℝ) * (2 * R)
  have hN : 0 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; positivity
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C, khatriRaoCovarianceScaleConstant]; positivity
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m by omega)
  have hscale : Real.exp 1 * (N / m) ≤ ε := by
    have hprof := covariance_scale_bound (r := r) (q := q) hd hm hκpos.le
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprof (Real.exp_pos 1).le
    apply hmul.trans
    have ht := one_lt_log_four_mul_rank_div hr hδ hδ1
    have hb := mul_sqrt_add_pow_div_le_of_khatriRao_budget (by omega)
      (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 1).le hC) (Nat.cast_nonneg r) hmR (by linarith)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg q) hqb.2.2 hε hbudget
    simpa only [C, khatriRaoCovarianceScaleConstant, κ, mul_assoc] using hb
  have hratio : N / ((m : ℝ) * ε) ≤ 1 / Real.exp 1 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hmR hε) (Real.exp_pos 1)).2
    have hmultiply := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale hmR.le
    field_simp at hmultiply
    nlinarith
  have htail := measureReal_lt_specNorm_smul_rankOneCovarianceSum_le hy hmom
    (show 0 < r by omega) (show 0 < 4 * v by positivity)
    (show 0 ≤ 2 * R by linarith) hqb.1 hm hε hstep
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg hN (mul_nonneg hmR.le hε.le)) hratio (2 * q)
  have hexp : (1 / Real.exp 1) ^ (2 * q) = Real.exp (-2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
    rw [one_div, ← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hconf := rank_mul_exp_neg_two_mul_khatriRaoMomentOrder_le hr hδ hδ1
  have hfail : (khatriRaoSampleLaw ν m).real
      {g | ε < specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • rankOneCovarianceSum y g)} ≤ δ := by
    apply htail.trans
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Nat.cast_nonneg r)).trans
    rw [hexp]
    exact hconf.trans (by linarith)
  have hevent : {g : Fin m → ∀ j : Fin d, Fin (n j) → ℝ |
        ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε} ⊆
      {g | ε < specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • rankOneCovarianceSum y g)} := by
    intro g hg
    change ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (khatriRaoSketch g) U ε at hg
    change ε < specNorm ((m : ℝ)⁻¹ • rankOneCovarianceSum y g)
    rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU hε.le] at hg
    rw [transpose_khatriRaoSketch_mul_self_sub_one (by omega)] at hg
    simpa only [rankOneCovarianceSum, centeredRankOneCovariance, y, not_le] using hg
  exact (measureReal_mono hevent).trans hfail

name: NLAlib.measurable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error
statement:
theorem measurable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ) =>
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
  intro h
  have hentry (i : ι) (r : ρ) (y : ι → ℝ) :
      (if h i = r then y i else 0) = (if h i = r then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * y i := by
    split_ifs <;> simp
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, countSketchMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  simp_rw [hentry]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.integrable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    Integrable (fun z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ) =>
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1))
      (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold countSketchLaw
  apply (integrable_prod_iff (measurable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error U).aestronglyMeasurable).2
  refine ⟨ae_of_all _ (fun h => ?_), Integrable.of_finite⟩
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← pow_two]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun a _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ =>
    integrable_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq h U hU a b

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq_scaled_contractions
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq_scaled_contractions
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (∫ z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ),
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1)
        ∂countSketchLaw) =
      (Fintype.card ρ : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else
          (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [countSketchLaw, integral_prod _ (integrable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error U hU)]
  simp_rw [integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error _ U hU]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun _ _ => Integrable.of_finite]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · simp only [hij, if_true, integral_zero, mul_zero]
  · simp only [hij, if_false]
    have he (h : ι → ρ) : (if h i = h j then
        (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b) else 0) =
      (if h i = h j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        ((U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b)) := by
      split_ifs <;> simp
    simp_rw [he, integral_mul_const,
      integral_ite_coordinate_eq_coordinate_pi_uniformOfFintype i j hij]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (∫ z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ),
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1)
        ∂countSketchLaw) =
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d -
        2 * ∑ i, leverageScore U i ^ 2) / Fintype.card ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq_scaled_contractions U hU,
    sum_offDiagonal_frame_contractions_eq U hU]
  simp_rw [leverageScore_eq_sum_sq_of_self hU]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
