name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem columnValue_ne_zero_iff {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r ≠ 0 ↔ r ∈ x.1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r ∈ x.1
  · simp [UniformSparseColumn.value, hr, Sign.val_ne_zero]
  · simp [UniformSparseColumn.value, hr]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_sq
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_sq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r ^ 2 = supportIndicator x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r ∈ x.1
  · simp [UniformSparseColumn.value, supportIndicator, hr, Sign.val_sq]
  · simp [UniformSparseColumn.value, supportIndicator, hr]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_columnValue_sq
statement:
theorem sum_columnValue_sq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r ^ 2 = (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [columnValue_sq]
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin m => r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) =
        (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)) := by
    ext r
    simp
  calc
    (∑ r : Fin m, supportIndicator x r) =
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin m =>
          r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))).card : ℝ) := by
      simp [supportIndicator, Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff]
    _ = ((x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).card : ℝ) := by rw [hfilter]
    _ = (s : ℝ) := by rw [(x.1).prop]

name: NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero_iff {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0 ↔ r ∈ (X i).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformSparseMatrix, mul_ne_zero_iff, and_iff_right (invSqrt_ne_zero hs)]
  exact columnValue_ne_zero_iff (X i) r

name: NLAlib.card_filter_uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.card_filter_uniformSparseMatrix_ne_zero {m s n : ℕ}
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i : Fin n) :
    Fintype.card {r : Fin m // uniformSparseMatrix X r i ≠ 0} = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (matrixColumnSupportEquiv X hs i)]
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  change Nat.card (↥(SetLike.coe (X i).1 : Set (Fin m))) = s
  rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  exact Set.powersetCard.ncard_eq (X i).1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sketchGram_apply
statement:
theorem sketchGram_apply {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i j : Fin n) :
    sketchGram (uniformSparseMatrix X) i j =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j)
          r
proof:
:= by
  rw [sketchGram, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, uniformSparseMatrix]
  calc
    (∑ r, invSqrt s * UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r *
        (invSqrt s * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r)) =
        invSqrt s ^ 2 *
          ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      ring
    _ = (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
          ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r := by
      rw [invSqrt_sq hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sketchGram_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem sketchGram_diag {m s n : ℕ} (X : UniformSparseSample m s n)
    (hs : 0 < s) (i : Fin n) : sketchGram (uniformSparseMatrix X) i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [UniformSparse.sketchGram_apply X hs]
  have hs0 : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hs)
  rw [show (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r) = (s : ℝ) by
    simpa [pow_two] using sum_columnValue_sq (X i)]
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.embeddedGram_apply
statement:
theorem embeddedGram_apply {m s n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n) (hs : 0 < s) (a c : Fin d) :
    embeddedGram F (uniformSparseMatrix X) a c =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embeddedGram, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, rowMatrix]
  simp_rw [UniformSparse.sketchGram_apply X hs]
  calc
    (∑ i, F.u i a * ∑ j,
        ((1 / (s : ℝ)) *
          ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) * F.u j c) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
          ((∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
            F.u i a * F.u j c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    _ = (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.gramError_eq_hollow
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_hollow {m s n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample m s n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X) = UniformSparse.hollowGram F X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a c
  rw [gramError, Matrix.sub_apply, embeddedGram_apply F X hs]
  have hparseval := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ => M a c) F.parseval
  have hparseval' : (∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c) =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c := by
    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using hparseval
  let T : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun i j =>
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
      F.u i a * F.u j c
  have hsplit (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j, T i j) = T i i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, T i j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    ring
  have hdiag : (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, T i i =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c := by
    have hTi (i : Fin n) : T i i = (s : ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u i c := by
      dsimp [T]
      rw [show (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r) =
          (s : ℝ) by
        simpa [pow_two] using sum_columnValue_sq (X i)]
    simp_rw [hTi, mul_assoc]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hs0 : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hs)
    rw [show (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ((s : ℝ) * ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c) =
        ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c by field_simp]
    exact hparseval'
  simp only [UniformSparse.hollowGram]
  change (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (∑ i, ∑ j, T i j) -
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c =
    (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, T i j
  simp_rw [hsplit]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add, hdiag]
  ring

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_equivFin_symm_iff
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_equivFin_symm_iff
    {ρ ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {U : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (S : Matrix ρ (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding (S.reindex (Equiv.refl _) (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm) U ε ↔
      IsSubspaceEmbedding S
        (U.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ)) ε
proof:
:= by
  have h := isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_iff (S := S)
    (hU.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ))
    (Equiv.refl ρ) (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm (Fintype.equivFin κ).symm hε
  have hUback :
      (U.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ)).reindex
        (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm (Fintype.equivFin κ).symm = U := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.reindex_apply]
  rwa [hUback] at h

name: NLAlib.measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge_fintype
statement:
theorem measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge_fintype
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (sparseStackMeasure (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (sparseBlockRows (Fintype.card κ) (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (Fintype.card ι) (canonicalB_pos hε hε1)).real
      {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrixOn ι z) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hevent : {z : SparseStackSelectors
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (sparseBlockRows (Fintype.card κ) (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (Fintype.card ι) | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrixOn ι z) U ε} =
      {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix
        (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z))
        (U.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ)) ε} := by
    ext z
    exact isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_equivFin_symm_iff hU _ hε.le
  rw [hevent]
  exact measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge hδ hδ1 hε hε1
    (hU.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ))

name: NLAlib.measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge_fintype
statement:
theorem measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge_fintype
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix ι κ ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (uniformSparseMeasure
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε *
          sparseBlockRows (Fintype.card κ) (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε) (Fintype.card ι)
        (UniformSparse.le_rows (canonicalB_pos hε hε1))).real
      {X | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrixOn ι X) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hevent : {X : UniformSparseSample
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε *
          sparseBlockRows (Fintype.card κ) (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder (Fintype.card κ) δ) ε) (Fintype.card ι) |
        IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrixOn ι X) U ε} =
      {X | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X)
        (U.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ)) ε} := by
    ext X
    exact isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_equivFin_symm_iff hU _ hε.le
  rw [hevent]
  exact measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge hδ hδ1 hε hε1
    (hU.reindex (Fintype.equivFin ι) (Fintype.equivFin κ))

proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Sign.val_sq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Sign.val_sq (z : Sign) : z.val ^ 2 = 1

:= by
  cases z <;> norm_num [Sign.val]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Sign.val_ne_zero
statement: theorem Sign.val_ne_zero (z : Sign) : z.val ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases z <;> norm_num [Sign.val]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedBasis_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) (a : Fin b) :
    signedBasis Z g i a = if a = Z.hash g i then (Z.sgn g i).val else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.inner_signedBasis
statement:
theorem inner_signedBasis {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ =
      if Z.hash g i = Z.hash g j
      then (Z.sgn g i).val * (Z.sgn g j).val else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [Real.inner_apply, signedBasis_apply]
  by_cases hij : Z.hash g i = Z.hash g j
  · rw [hij]
    simp
  · simp only [hij, if_false]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a ha
    by_cases hai : a = Z.hash g i
    · have haj : a ≠ Z.hash g j := by
        intro haj
        exact hij (hai.symm.trans haj)
      rw [if_pos hai, if_neg haj]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg hai]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis_normSq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedBasis_normSq {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (signedBasis Z g i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [euclideanNormSq, inner_signedBasis]
  simpa [pow_two] using Sign.val_sq (Z.sgn g i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.inner_signedBasis_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inner_signedBasis_self {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g i⟫_ℝ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [euclideanNormSq] using signedBasis_normSq Z g i

name: NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i = invSqrt s *
      (if a = Z.hash g i then (Z.sgn g i).val else 0)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.invSqrt_ne_zero
statement: theorem invSqrt_ne_zero {s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) : invSqrt s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_ne_zero
  exact ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (Nat.cast_pos.2 hs))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.invSqrt_sq
statement:
theorem invSqrt_sq {s : ℕ} (_hs : 0 < s) :
    invSqrt s ^ 2 = 1 / (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [invSqrt, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg s)]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i ≠ 0 ↔ a = Z.hash g i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = Z.hash g i
  · simp [sparseStackMatrix_apply, ha, invSqrt_ne_zero hs, Sign.val_ne_zero]
  · simp [sparseStackMatrix_apply, ha]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.exactly_one_nonzero_in_block
statement:
theorem exactly_one_nonzero_in_block {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃! a : Fin b, sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Z.hash g i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff Z hs g (Z.hash g i) i).2 rfl
  · intro a ha
    exact (sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero_iff Z hs g a i).1 ha

name: NLAlib.card_filter_sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.NLAlib.card_filter_sparseStackMatrix_ne_zero {s b n : ℕ}
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (i : Fin n) :
    Fintype.card {r : Fin s × Fin b // sparseStackMatrix Z r i ≠ 0} = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (columnSupportEquiv Z hs i)]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.block_gram_apply
statement:
theorem block_gram_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ a : Fin b, sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) i * sparseStackMatrix Z (g, a) j) =
      invSqrt s ^ 2 * ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [Real.inner_apply, sparseStackMatrix_apply, signedBasis_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sketchGram_apply
statement:
theorem sketchGram_apply {s b n : ℕ} (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    sketchGram (sparseStackMatrix Z) i j =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sketchGram, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [block_gram_apply Z]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, invSqrt_sq hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.embeddedGram_eq_fullExpansion
statement:
theorem embeddedGram_eq_fullExpansion {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    embeddedGram F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = fullGramExpansion F Z
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [embeddedGram, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, rowMatrix]
  simp_rw [sketchGram_apply Z hs]
  simp only [fullGramExpansion]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g hg
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fullExpansion_eq_one_add_hollow
statement:
theorem fullExpansion_eq_one_add_hollow {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    fullGramExpansion F Z = 1 + hollowGram F Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a c
  have hs0 : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hs))
  have hparseval := congrArg
    (fun M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ ↦ M a c) F.parseval
  have hparseval' : (∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c) =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c := by
    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using hparseval
  let T : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun i j ↦
    (∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u j c
  have hsplit (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j, T i j) = T i i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, T i j := by
    have hi : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) := Finset.mem_univ i
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hi]
    ring
  have hdiag :
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, T i i =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c := by
    have hTi (i : Fin n) : T i i = (s : ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u i c := by
      have hone :
          (∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g i⟫_ℝ) = (s : ℝ) := by
        simp only [inner_signedBasis_self]
        simp
      dsimp [T]
      rw [hone]
    simp_rw [hTi]
    calc
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, (s : ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u i c =
          ((1 / (s : ℝ)) * (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c := by
            simp_rw [mul_assoc]
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i c := by field_simp [hs0]
      _ = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c := hparseval'
  simp only [fullGramExpansion, hollowGram, Matrix.add_apply]
  change (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (∑ i, ∑ j, T i j) =
    (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c +
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, T i j
  simp_rw [hsplit]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [mul_add]
  rw [hdiag]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_eq_hollow
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_hollow {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = hollowGram F Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramError, embeddedGram_eq_fullExpansion F Z hs,
    fullExpansion_eq_one_add_hollow F Z hs]
  abel

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.hollowGram_block_first
statement:
theorem hollowGram_block_first {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) :
    hollowGram F Z = fun a c ↦ (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
      ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [hollowGram]
  congr 1
  have hfixed (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u j c) =
        ∑ g, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c := by
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (∑ g, ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ) * F.u i a * F.u j c) =
      ∑ i, ∑ g, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          exact hfixed i
    _ = ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c :=
      Finset.sum_comm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_eq_block_first
statement:
theorem gramError_eq_block_first {s b n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (Z : SparseStackSample s b n) (hs : 0 < s) :
    gramError F (sparseStackMatrix Z) = fun a c ↦ (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
      ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        ⟪signedBasis Z g i, signedBasis Z g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramError_eq_hollow F Z hs, hollowGram_block_first F Z]

name: NLAlib.measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (Z : Ω → SparseStackSelectors
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
          n)
    (hlaw : HasLaw Z (sparseStackMeasure (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
      (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n (canonicalB_pos hε hε1)) μ) :
    1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω | IsSubspaceEmbedding
      (sparseStackMatrix
        (SparseStackSelectors.toSample (Z ω))) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hmass := FiniteLaw.real_preimage_of_hasLaw
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
          n
      (canonicalB_pos hε hε1)) Z hlaw
    {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix
      (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z)) U ε}
  rw [← FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure] at hmass
  change μ.real {ω | IsSubspaceEmbedding
    (sparseStackMatrix
      (SparseStackSelectors.toSample (Z ω))) U ε} = _ at hmass
  rw [hmass]
  exact measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge hδ hδ1 hε hε1 hU

name: NLAlib.measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge_of_hasLaw
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (X : Ω → UniformSparseSample
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε * sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n)
    (hlaw : HasLaw X (uniformSparseMeasure
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε * sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n
      (UniformSparse.le_rows (canonicalB_pos hε hε1))) μ) :
    1 - δ ≤ μ.real {ω | IsSubspaceEmbedding
      (uniformSparseMatrix (X ω)) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hmass := FiniteLaw.real_preimage_of_hasLaw
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw
      (UniformSparse.le_rows (canonicalB_pos hε hε1))) X hlaw
    {x | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix x) U ε}
  rw [← FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure] at hmass
  change μ.real {ω | IsSubspaceEmbedding
    (uniformSparseMatrix (X ω)) U ε} = _ at hmass
  rw [hmass]
  exact measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge hδ hδ1 hε hε1 hU

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.card_sign
statement: @[simp] theorem card_sign : Fintype.card Sign = 2
proof: := by decide

name: NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_hash
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.NLAlib.SparseStackSelectors.toSample_hash {s b n : ℕ}
    (z : SparseStackSelectors s b n)

name: NLAlib.ae_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_quadForm
statement:
theorem ae_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_quadForm
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a b : d) :
    (fun σ : ι → ℝ =>
      (((countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ) a b) =ᵐ[
      Measure.pi (fun _ => rademacherMeasure)]
        fun σ => quadForm (countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b) σ
proof:
:= by
  have hsign : ∀ i : ι, ∀ᵐ σ : ι → ℝ ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => rademacherMeasure),
      σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1 := fun i =>
    (Measure.tendsto_eval_ae_ae (μ := fun _ : ι => rademacherMeasure) (i := i)).eventually
      ae_eq_one_or_neg_one_rademacherMeasure
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_all.2 hsign] with σ hσ
  rw [countSketch_gram_error_eq h σ U hU]
  apply mul_countSketchGram_sub_one_mul_apply_eq_quadForm
  intro i
  rcases hσ i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.integrable_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a b : d) :
    Integrable (fun σ : ι → ℝ =>
      (((countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ) a b ^ 2)
      (Measure.pi fun _ => rademacherMeasure)
proof:
:= by
  apply (integrable_quadForm_sq_rademacherVector (countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b)).congr
  exact (ae_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_quadForm h U hU a b).symm.mono
    fun _ hx => congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) hx

name: NLAlib.integral_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq
statement:
theorem integral_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a b : d) :
    (∫ σ : ι → ℝ,
      (((countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ) a b ^ 2
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => rademacherMeasure)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else if h i = h j then
        (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_congr_ae ((ae_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_quadForm h U hU a b).mono
    fun _ hx => congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) hx)]
  rw [integral_quadForm_sq_rademacherVector_of_diag_zero _
    (countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag h U a b)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [countSketchHollowCoefficient]
  · by_cases hh : h i = h j
    · simp only [countSketchHollowCoefficient, Matrix.of_apply,
        if_neg hij, if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_pos hh, if_pos hh.symm]
    · simp only [countSketchHollowCoefficient, Matrix.of_apply,
        if_neg hij, if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_neg hh, if_neg (Ne.symm hh),
        zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero, add_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem integral_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_zero
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (a b : d) :
    (∫ σ : ι → ℝ,
      (((countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ) a b
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => rademacherMeasure)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_countSketch_gram_error_apply_eq_quadForm h U hU a b),
    integral_quadForm_rademacherVector]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (∫ σ : ι → ℝ,
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1)
        ∂Measure.pi (fun _ => rademacherMeasure)) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, if i = j then 0 else if h i = h j then
        (U i a * U j b) ^ 2 + (U i a * U j b) * (U j a * U i b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq, frobInner_eq_sum_mul, ← pow_two]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun a _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun b _ => integrable_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq h U hU a b]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun b _ => integrable_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq h U hU a b]
  simp_rw [integral_countSketch_gram_error_apply_sq h U hU]

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_of_isEmpty

    {ρ ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [IsEmpty κ]

    IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε

name: NLAlib.measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge
statement:
theorem measure_sparseStack_embedding_success_ge
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (sparseStackMeasure (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n
        (canonicalB_pos hε hε1)).real
      {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding
        (sparseStackMatrix
          (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z)) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst d
    have hevent : {z : SparseStackSelectors
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder 0 δ) ε)
            (sparseBlockRows 0 (sparseMomentOrder 0 δ) ε) n |
        IsSubspaceEmbedding
        (sparseStackMatrix
          (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z)) U ε} = Set.univ := by
      ext z
      simp [isSubspaceEmbedding_of_isEmpty]
    rw [hevent, probReal_univ]
    linarith
  · have hmain := fully_independent_sparseStack_matrix
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd) hδ hδ1 hε hε1 U hU
    simpa only [sparseStackMeasure, FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure] using hmain.oseSuccess

name: NLAlib.measure_sparseStack_gram_failure_le
statement:
theorem measure_sparseStack_gram_failure_le
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (sparseStackMeasure (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
      (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n
      (canonicalB_pos hε hε1)).real
      {z | ε < specNorm (Uᵀ *
        ((sparseStackMatrix
            (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z))ᵀ *
          sparseStackMatrix
            (SparseStackSelectors.toSample z) * U) - 1)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sparseStackMeasure, FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure,
    specNorm_eq_norm, sketchGram] using
    (fully_independent_sparseStack_matrix
      hd hδ hδ1 hε hε1 U hU).operatorFailure

name: NLAlib.measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge
statement:
theorem measure_uniformSparse_embedding_success_ge
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    1 - δ ≤
      (uniformSparseMeasure
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε * sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ)
            ε)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n
        (UniformSparse.le_rows
          (canonicalB_pos hε hε1))).real
      {X | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) U ε}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst d
    have hevent : {X : UniformSparseSample
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder 0 δ) ε * sparseBlockRows 0 (sparseMomentOrder 0 δ)
            ε)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder 0 δ) ε) n | IsSubspaceEmbedding
        (uniformSparseMatrix X) U ε} = Set.univ := by
      ext X
      simp [isSubspaceEmbedding_of_isEmpty]
    rw [hevent, probReal_univ]
    linarith
  · simpa only [uniformSparseMeasure, FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure] using
      (UniformSparse.matrix_ose_success
        (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd) hδ hδ1 hε hε1 U hU)

name: NLAlib.measure_uniformSparse_gram_failure_le
statement:
theorem measure_uniformSparse_gram_failure_le
    {n d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    {U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (uniformSparseMeasure
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε * sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε)
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε) n
      (UniformSparse.le_rows
        (canonicalB_pos hε hε1))).real
      {X | ε < specNorm (Uᵀ * ((uniformSparseMatrix X)ᵀ *
        uniformSparseMatrix X * U) - 1)} ≤ δ
proof:

  simpa only [uniformSparseMeasure, FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure,

    (UniformSparse.matrix_operator_failure

name: NLAlib.sparse_embedding_parameters
statement:
theorem sparse_embedding_parameters
    {d : ℕ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε : ℝ) <
        1356 * (sparseMomentOrder d δ : ℝ) / ε ∧
      (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε : ℝ) <
        306456 * ((d : ℝ) + sparseMomentOrder d δ) / ε ^ 2 ∧
      2 ≤ sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d δ) ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hs, hm, hb⟩ := main_parameter_package (delta := δ) hd hε hε1
  exact ⟨hs, hm, hb⟩

name: NLAlib.integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_le
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_le
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (∫ z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ),
      frobSq ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1)
        ∂countSketchLaw) ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d) / Fintype.card ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_eq U hU]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact sub_le_self _ (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le
statement:
theorem measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ)).real
      {z | ε ≤ specNorm ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ *
        (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1)} ≤
      ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d) /
        ((Fintype.card ρ : ℝ) * ε ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let E := fun z : (ι → ρ) × (ι → ℝ) =>
    (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1
  have hεsq : 0 < ε ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hε
  have hmarkov := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
    (ae_of_all (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ)) (fun z => frobSq_nonneg (E z)))
    (integrable_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error U hU) (ε ^ 2)
  have hsubset : {z | ε ≤ specNorm (E z)} ⊆ {z | ε ^ 2 ≤ frobSq (E z)} := by
    intro z hz
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ hε.le hz 2).trans (specNorm_sq_le_frobSq (E z))
  calc
    _ ≤ (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ)).real {z | ε ^ 2 ≤ frobSq (E z)} :=
      measureReal_mono hsubset
    _ ≤ (((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d) / Fintype.card ρ) / ε ^ 2 := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hεsq).2
      have hh := hmarkov.trans (integral_frobSq_countSketch_gram_error_le U hU)
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hh
    _ = _ := by rw [div_div]

name: NLAlib.measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le_of_rows
statement:
theorem measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le_of_rows
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hrows : ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d) / (δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ Fintype.card ρ) :
    (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ)).real
      {z | ε ≤ specNorm ((countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U)ᵀ *
        (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2 * U) - 1)} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le U hU hε).trans
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ρ := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hm (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).2
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hδ (sq_pos_of_pos hε))).1 hrows
  simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using hh

name: NLAlib.measure_countSketch_embedding_failure_le_of_rows
statement:
theorem measure_countSketch_embedding_failure_le_of_rows
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hrows : ((Fintype.card d : ℝ) ^ 2 + Fintype.card d) / (δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ Fintype.card ρ) :
    (countSketchLaw (ι := ι) (ρ := ρ)).real
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (countSketchMatrix z.1 z.2) U ε} ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (measureReal_mono (fun z hz => ?_))
    (measure_countSketch_gram_failure_le_of_rows U hU hε hδ hrows)
  by_contra hbad
  apply hz
  exact isSubspaceEmbedding_of_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU
    (not_le.mp hbad).le

name: NLAlib.transpose_countSketchMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_countSketchMatrix_mul_apply
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ) i j =
      if h i = h j then σ i * σ j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, countSketchMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (h i)]
  · by_cases hij : h i = h j
    · simp [hij]
    · simp [hij, Ne.symm hij]
  · intro r _ hri
    simp [Ne.symm hri]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag
statement:
@[simp] theorem countSketchHollowCoefficient_diag
    (h : ι → ρ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (a b : d) (i : ι) :
    countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [countSketchHollowCoefficient]

name: NLAlib.mul_countSketchGram_sub_one_mul_apply_eq_quadForm
statement:
theorem mul_countSketchGram_sub_one_mul_apply_eq_quadForm
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, σ i ^ 2 = 1)
    (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (a b : d) :
    (Uᵀ * ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ - 1) * U : Matrix d d ℝ) a b =
      quadForm (countSketchHollowCoefficient h U a b) σ
proof:
:= by
  have hgram (i j : ι) :
      (((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ - 1) : Matrix ι ι ℝ) i j =
        if i = j then 0 else if h i = h j then σ i * σ j else 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, transpose_countSketchMatrix_mul_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [if_true, Matrix.one_apply_eq, ← pow_two, hσ, sub_self]
    · simp only [hij, if_false, Matrix.one_apply_ne hij, sub_zero]
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_apply, quadForm_eq_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, hgram, Finset.mul_sum, star_trivial]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> by_cases hh : h i = h j <;>
    simp only [hij, hh, if_true, if_false, countSketchHollowCoefficient, Matrix.of_apply,
      mul_zero, zero_mul]; ring

name: NLAlib.countSketch_gram_error_eq
statement:
theorem countSketch_gram_error_eq
    (h : ι → ρ) (σ : ι → ℝ) (U : Matrix ι d ℝ) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) :
    (countSketchMatrix h σ * U)ᵀ * (countSketchMatrix h σ * U) - 1 =
      Uᵀ * ((countSketchMatrix h σ)ᵀ * countSketchMatrix h σ - 1) * U
proof:
:= by
  have hUt : Uᵀ * U = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hU.conjTranspose_mul_self
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hUt,
    Matrix.transpose_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_basis
statement:
theorem coeff_basis (i j : I) :
    B.coeff i (B.basis j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simpa [coeff, mul_assoc] using B.orthonormal_same i
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte]
    simpa [coeff, mul_assoc] using B.orthonormal_ne i j h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.reconstruct
statement:
theorem reconstruct (f : Omega → ℝ) (x : Omega) :
    f x = ∑ i, B.coeff i f * B.basis i x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [coeff] using B.reconstruction f x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.expect_one
statement: theorem expect_one : B.expect (fun _ => 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [WeightedONBasis.expect] using B.sum_weight

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_mul_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_sum (i : I) (a : Omega → ℝ) (c : I → ℝ) :
    B.coeff i (fun x => a x * ∑ j, c j * B.basis j x) =
      ∑ j, c j * B.coeff i (fun x => a x * B.basis j x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.coeff_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_sum {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (i : I) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    B.coeff i (fun x => ∑ k, f k x) = ∑ k, B.coeff i (f k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.mulOp_mul
statement:
theorem mulOp_mul (a b : Omega → ℝ) :
    B.mulOp a * B.mulOp b = B.mulOp (fun x => a x * b x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [mulOp]
  calc
    (∑ k, B.coeff i (fun x => a x * B.basis k x) *
        B.coeff k (fun x => b x * B.basis j x)) =
        ∑ k, B.coeff k (fun x => b x * B.basis j x) *
          B.coeff i (fun x => a x * B.basis k x) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            ring
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => a x *
          ∑ k, B.coeff k (fun y => b y * B.basis j y) * B.basis k x) := by
            symm
            exact B.coeff_mul_sum i a
              (fun k => B.coeff k (fun y => b y * B.basis j y))
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => a x * (b x * B.basis j x)) := by
            congr 1
            funext x
            rw [← B.reconstruct (fun y => b y * B.basis j y) x]
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => (a x * b x) * B.basis j x) := by
            congr 2
            funext x
            ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_one
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_one :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun _ => (1 : Matrix A A ℝ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  rcases out with ⟨a, i⟩
  rcases inp with ⟨b, j⟩
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    simp [matrixMulOp, Matrix.one_apply, B.coeff_basis]
  · simp [matrixMulOp, coeff, hab]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_mul
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_mul (M N : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp M * B.matrixMulOp N =
      B.matrixMulOp (fun x => M x * N x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  rcases out with ⟨a, i⟩
  rcases inp with ⟨c, j⟩
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [matrixMulOp, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Matrix.mul_apply]
  change (∑ b, ∑ k,
      B.coeff i (fun x => M x a b * B.basis k x) *
        B.coeff k (fun x => N x b c * B.basis j x)) =
    B.coeff i (fun x => (∑ b, M x a b * N x b c) * B.basis j x)
  have hfun :
      (fun x => (∑ b, M x a b * N x b c) * B.basis j x) =
        (fun x => ∑ b, (M x a b * N x b c) * B.basis j x) := by
    funext x
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hfun, B.coeff_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  calc
    (∑ k, B.coeff i (fun x => M x a b * B.basis k x) *
        B.coeff k (fun x => N x b c * B.basis j x)) =
        ∑ k, B.coeff k (fun x => N x b c * B.basis j x) *
          B.coeff i (fun x => M x a b * B.basis k x) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            ring
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => M x a b *
          ∑ k, B.coeff k (fun y => N y b c * B.basis j y) * B.basis k x) := by
            symm
            exact B.coeff_mul_sum i (fun x => M x a b)
              (fun k => B.coeff k (fun y => N y b c * B.basis j y))
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => M x a b * (N x b c * B.basis j x)) := by
            congr 1
            funext x
            rw [← B.reconstruct (fun y => N y b c * B.basis j y) x]
    _ = B.coeff i (fun x => (M x a b * N x b c) * B.basis j x) := by
            congr 2
            funext x
            ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp_pow
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_pow (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    B.matrixMulOp M ^ k = B.matrixMulOp (fun x => M x ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction k with
  | zero => exact (B.matrixMulOp_one (A := A)).symm
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, ih, B.matrixMulOp_mul]
      congr 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.WeightedONBasis.matrix_vacuum_moment
statement:
theorem matrix_vacuum_moment (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a, (B.matrixMulOp M ^ k) (a, B.vacuum) (a, B.vacuum)) =
      B.expect (fun x => Matrix.trace (M x ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.matrixMulOp_pow]
  simp only [matrixMulOp, coeff, B.vacuum_eq_one, mul_one, WeightedONBasis.expect, Matrix.trace]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidGramError_apply
statement:
theorem iidGramError_apply {m n d : ℕ} (b : ℕ) (F : Frame n d)
    (omega : Configuration m n) (a c : Fin d) :
    iidGramError b F omega a c = (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        etaCoordinate b (r, i) omega * etaCoordinate b (r, j) omega *
          F.u i a * F.u j c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [iidGramError, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_moment_identity
statement:
theorem vacuum_moment_identity {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      (multiplicationOperator b hb F ^ k)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n) (a, vacuumPattern m n)) =
      (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [multiplicationOperator, productONBasis,
    WeightedONBasis.expect, FiniteLaw.expect] using
      (productONBasis b hb m n).matrix_vacuum_moment (iidGramError b F) k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_smul
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_smul (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I) (c : ℝ)
    (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ c • M omega) = c • B.matrixMulOp M
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp, WeightedONBasis.coeff, Matrix.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro omega homega
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_fintype_sum
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_fintype_sum (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I)
    (M : K → Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ ∑ k, M k omega) =
      ∑ k, B.matrixMulOp (M k)
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp, WeightedONBasis.coeff,
    Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_finset_sum
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_finset_sum (B : WeightedONBasis Omega I)
    (S : Finset K) (M : K → Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) :
    B.matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ S, M k omega) =
      ∑ k ∈ S, B.matrixMulOp (M k)
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp, WeightedONBasis.coeff,
    Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrixMulOp_scalar_external
statement:
theorem matrixMulOp_scalar_external {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (a : Configuration m n → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).matrixMulOp (fun omega ↦ a omega • M) =
      externalTensor M ((productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp a)
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [WeightedONBasis.matrixMulOp, WeightedONBasis.mulOp,
    WeightedONBasis.coeff, externalTensor, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro omega homega
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplicationOperator_eq_globalJacobi
statement:
theorem multiplicationOperator_eq_globalJacobi {m n d b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) :
    multiplicationOperator (m := m) b hb F = globalJacobiOperator (m := m) b F
proof:
:= by
  let B := productONBasis b hb m n
  let J := jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1))
  change B.matrixMulOp (iidGramError b F) = _
  rw [show iidGramError b F = fun omega ↦ (1 / (m : ℝ)) •
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (etaCoordinate b (r, i) omega * etaCoordinate b (r, j) omega) •
          Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (F.u i)) (WithLp.ofLp (F.u j)) from rfl]
  rw [matrixMulOp_smul]
  rw [matrixMulOp_fintype_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r hr
  rw [matrixMulOp_fintype_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [matrixMulOp_finset_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [matrixMulOp_scalar_external]
  rw [mulOp_etaCoordinate_mul hb (r, i) (r, j)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.asOperator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem asOperator_apply (A : FullOp d m n)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :

      WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec A x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_asOperator
statement: theorem norm_asOperator (A : FullOp d m n) : ‖asOperator A‖ = ‖A‖
proof:
:=
  Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM A

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeZ_eq_cast_grade
statement:
theorem gradeZ_eq_cast_grade (p : Pattern m n) :
    Pattern.gradeZ p = (p.grade : ℤ)
proof:
:= by

  simp only [Pattern.gradeZ, weightZ, Pattern.grade]
  norm_cast

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fullGradeZ_eq_cast_grade
statement:
theorem fullGradeZ_eq_cast_grade (x : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    fullGradeZ x = (x.2.grade : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  gradeZ_eq_cast_grade x.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_apply (nu : ℕ)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) nu out inp =
      if out = inp ∧ out.2.grade = nu then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : out = inp
  · subst inp
    by_cases hg : out.2.grade = nu <;>
      simp [gradeProjection, hg]
  · simp [gradeProjection, h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_transpose (nu : ℕ) :
    (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu).transpose =
      gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, gradeProjection_apply]
  by_cases hEq : out = inp
  · subst inp
    simp
  · have h' : inp ≠ out := Ne.symm hEq
    simp [hEq, h']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mul_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_mul_self (nu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu * gradeProjection nu =
      gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext out inp
  by_cases hEq : out = inp
  · subst inp
    by_cases hg : out.2.grade = nu <;> simp [hg]
  · simp [hEq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_norm_le_one (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeProjection, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by norm_num)).2
  intro x
  by_cases h : x.2.grade = nu <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mul_gradeProjection
statement:
@[simp] theorem gradeProjection_mul_gradeProjection
    {mu nu : ℕ} (h : mu ≠ nu) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) mu * gradeProjection nu = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [gradeProjection, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext out inp
  by_cases hEq : out = inp
  · subst inp
    by_cases hmu : out.2.grade = mu
    · have hnu : out.2.grade ≠ nu := by
        intro hx
        exact h (hmu.symm.trans hx)
      simp [hmu, h]
    · simp [hmu]
  · simp [hEq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_mulVec
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mulVec (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (a : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x a =
      if a.2.grade = nu then x a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [gradeProjection, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq_nonneg
statement:
theorem sumSq_nonneg {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sumSq_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem sumSq_eq_dotProduct {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    sumSq x = dotProduct x x
proof:
:= by
  simp [sumSq, dotProduct, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_toLp_sq
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sq {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 = sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp [sumSq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_normSq
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_normSq (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) =
      ∑ a with a.2.grade = nu, x a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sumSq, gradeProjection_mulVec]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases h : a.2.grade = nu <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeProjection_normSq_le
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_normSq_le (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤ sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeProjection_normSq]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    (Finset.filter_subset (fun a : Fin d × Pattern m n ↦ a.2.grade = nu)
      Finset.univ) ?_
  intro a _ _
  exact sq_nonneg (x a)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    {A : Matrix I J ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (henergy : ∀ x : J → ℝ,
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec A x) ≤ C ^ 2 * sumSq x) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.l2_opNorm_def]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hC
  intro x
  change ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec A (WithLp.ofLp x))‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖
  have hsq := henergy (WithLp.ofLp x)
  have hout := norm_toLp_sq (Matrix.mulVec A (WithLp.ofLp x))
  have hin := norm_toLp_sq (WithLp.ofLp x)
  have hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = sumSq (WithLp.ofLp x) := by
    simpa using hin
  rw [← hout, ← hx] at hsq
  have hright : 0 ≤ C * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg hC (norm_nonneg _)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2
    (Matrix.mulVec A (WithLp.ofLp x)))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_grade_relation
statement:
theorem homogeneous_grade_relation {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A)
    {out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n} (hentry : A out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + delta
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fullGradeZ_eq_cast_grade] using hA hentry

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_smul
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hentry
  have hAentry : A out inp ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hentry
    simp [hz]
  exact hA hAentry

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.homogeneous_add
statement:
theorem homogeneous_add {delta : ℤ} {A B : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A)
    (hB : IsFullGradeShift delta B) :
    IsFullGradeShift delta (A + B)
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hentry
  by_cases hAz : A out inp = 0
  · have hBn : B out inp ≠ 0 := by
      intro hBz
      exact hentry (by simp [hAz, hBz])
    exact hB hBn
  · exact hA hAz

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.output_projection_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem output_projection_of_homogeneous {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hcompatible : (mu : ℤ) = (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A * gradeProjection nu =
      A * gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [gradeProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = nu
  · by_cases hentry : A out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := homogeneous_grade_relation hA hentry
      have houtInt : (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (mu : ℤ) := by
        rw [hrel, hin, ← hcompatible]
      have hout : out.2.grade = mu := by exact_mod_cast houtInt
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
statement:
theorem input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (nu : ℕ)
    (himpossible : ∀ mu : ℕ, (mu : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    A * gradeProjection (d := d) nu = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [gradeProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.zero_apply]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = nu
  · by_cases hentry : A out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := homogeneous_grade_relation hA hentry
      exfalso
      exact (himpossible out.2.grade (by simpa [hin] using hrel))
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.incompatible_grade_block_zero
statement:
theorem incompatible_grade_block_zero {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hincompatible : (mu : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A * gradeProjection nu = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [gradeProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    Matrix.zero_apply]
  by_cases hout : out.2.grade = mu
  · by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = nu
    · by_cases hentry : A out inp = 0
      · simp [hout, hin, hentry]
      · have hrel := homogeneous_grade_relation hA hentry
        exfalso
        apply hincompatible
        simpa [hout, hin] using hrel
    · simp [hout, hin]
  · simp [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Word.orderedAdjoint_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem Word.orderedAdjoint_involutive (w : Word) :
    w.orderedAdjoint.orderedAdjoint = w
proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Word.degree_orderedAdjoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem Word.degree_orderedAdjoint (w : Word) :
    w.orderedAdjoint.degree = -w.degree
proof:
:= by

proof:

  · simp
  · intro δ h hw

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iidLaw_weight (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) (m n : ℕ)
    (omega : Configuration m n) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega = ∏ s, mass b (omega s)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ternaryLaw_expect_eq
statement:
theorem ternaryLaw_expect_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (g : TernaryOutcome → ℝ) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect g = expect b g
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.productBasis_orthonormal
statement:
theorem productBasis_orthonormal {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (p q : Pattern m n) :
    productWeightedInner b hb (productBasis b p) (productBasis b q) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  let mu : Site m n → FiniteLaw TernaryOutcome :=
    fun _ ↦ ternaryLaw b (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)
  let f : Site m n → TernaryOutcome → ℝ := fun s x ↦
    basisFun b (p s) x * basisFun b (q s) x
  have hpoint (omega : Configuration m n) :
      productBasis b p omega * productBasis b q omega = ∏ s, f s (omega s) := by
    simp only [productBasis, f, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have hfactor := FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes mu f
  have hlocal (s : Site m n) :
      (mu s).expect (f s) = if p s = q s then 1 else 0 := by
    dsimp [mu, f]
    change expect b (fun x ↦
      basisFun b (p s) x * basisFun b (q s) x) = _
    simpa [ternaryWeightedInner] using
      basis_orthonormal hb (p s) (q s)
  change (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
      (fun omega ↦ productBasis b p omega * productBasis b q omega) = _
  calc
    (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ productBasis b p omega * productBasis b q omega) =
      (FiniteLaw.independentProduct mu).expect (fun omega ↦ ∏ s, f s (omega s)) := by
        apply FiniteLaw.expect_congr
        intro omega
        exact hpoint omega
    _ = ∏ s, (mu s).expect (f s) := hfactor
    _ = ∏ s, if p s = q s then 1 else 0 := by simp_rw [hlocal]
    _ = if p = q then 1 else 0 := by
      by_cases hpq : p = q
      · subst q
        simp
      · simp only [hpq, if_false]
        have hex : ∃ s, p s ≠ q s := by
          by_contra hall
          push Not at hall
          exact hpq (funext hall)
        obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hex
        apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ s)
        simp [hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.local_reproducing
statement:
theorem local_reproducing {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (y x : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b y *
        (∑ i, basisFun b i y * basisFun b i x) =
      if x = y then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := basis_reconstruction hb
    (fun z : TernaryOutcome ↦ if z = y then 1 else 0) x
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  cases y <;>
    simpa [ternaryWeightedInner, expect, mul_assoc,
      Finset.mul_sum] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.product_kernel_factor
statement:
theorem product_kernel_factor {m n b : ℕ} (omega x : Configuration m n) :
    (∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) =
      ∏ s, ∑ i, basisFun b i (omega s) *
        basisFun b i (x s)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) =
        ∑ p : Pattern m n, ∏ s,
          (basisFun b (p s) (omega s) *
            basisFun b (p s) (x s)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro p hp
          exact Finset.prod_mul_distrib.symm
    _ = ∏ s, ∑ i, basisFun b i (omega s) *
          basisFun b i (x s) := by
      exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun s i ↦
        basisFun b i (omega s) *
          basisFun b i (x s))).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.weighted_product_kernel
statement:
theorem weighted_product_kernel {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (omega x : Configuration m n) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega *
        (∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) =
      ∏ s, if x s = omega s then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [iidLaw_weight, product_kernel_factor]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  exact local_reproducing hb (omega s) (x s)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.productBasis_reconstruction
statement:
theorem productBasis_reconstruction {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : Configuration m n → ℝ) (x : Configuration m n) :
    f x = ∑ p : Pattern m n,
      ((iidLaw b hb m n).expect (fun omega ↦ productBasis b p omega * f omega)) *
        productBasis b p x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect]
  calc
    f x = ∑ omega : Configuration m n,
        f omega * (∏ s, if x s = omega s then 1 else 0) := by
      symm
      calc
        (∑ omega : Configuration m n,
            f omega * (∏ s, if x s = omega s then 1 else 0)) =
          f x * (∏ s, if x s = x s then 1 else 0) := by
            apply Fintype.sum_eq_single x
            intro omega hne
            have hex : ∃ s, x s ≠ omega s := by
              by_contra hall
              push Not at hall
              exact hne (funext hall).symm
            obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hex
            have hz : (∏ t, if x t = omega t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := by
              apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ s)
              simp [hs]
            calc
              f omega * (∏ t, if x t = omega t then 1 else 0) = f omega * 0 :=
                congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ f omega * z) hz
              _ = 0 := by ring
        _ = f x := by simp
    _ = ∑ omega : Configuration m n,
        f omega * ((iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega *
          ∑ p : Pattern m n, productBasis b p omega * productBasis b p x) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro omega homega
      rw [weighted_product_kernel hb omega x]
    _ = ∑ p : Pattern m n,
        (∑ omega : Configuration m n,
          (iidLaw b hb m n).weight omega *
            (productBasis b p omega * f omega)) *
            productBasis b p x := by
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro omega homega
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.coordinate_product_factorization
statement:
theorem coordinate_product_factorization {m n b : ℕ} (s : Site m n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) (omega : Configuration m n) :
    productBasis b out omega *
        (etaCoordinate b s omega * productBasis b inp omega) =
      ∏ t, coordinateFactor b s out inp t (omega t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [productBasis, etaCoordinate, coordinateFactor]
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mulOp_etaCoordinate
statement:
theorem mulOp_etaCoordinate {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (s : Site m n) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp (etaCoordinate b s) =
      siteKernel s (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  let mu : Site m n → FiniteLaw TernaryOutcome :=
    fun _ ↦ ternaryLaw b (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)
  let f : Site m n → TernaryOutcome → ℝ := coordinateFactor b s out inp
  have hpoint (omega : Configuration m n) :
      productBasis b out omega *
          (etaCoordinate b s omega * productBasis b inp omega) = ∏ t, f t (omega t) :=
    coordinate_product_factorization s out inp omega
  have hfactor := FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes mu f
  have hlocal (t : Site m n) :
      (mu t).expect (f t) =
        if t = s then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s)
        else if out t = inp t then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hts : t = s
    · subst t
      dsimp [mu, f]
      rw [ternaryLaw_expect_eq]
      unfold coordinateFactor
      simp only [if_pos]
      simpa [ternaryWeightedInner, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using
          multiplication_matrix hb (out s) (inp s)
    · dsimp [mu, f]
      rw [ternaryLaw_expect_eq]
      unfold coordinateFactor
      simp only [hts, if_false, one_mul]
      simpa [ternaryWeightedInner] using
          basis_orthonormal hb (out t) (inp t)
  have hprod :
      (∏ t, if t = s then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s)
        else if out t = inp t then 1 else 0) =
      if agreesOutsideSite s out inp
        then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s) else 0 := by
    by_cases hagree : agreesOutsideSite s out inp
    · simp only [hagree, if_true]
      calc
        (∏ t, if t = s then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s)
          else if out t = inp t then 1 else 0) =
          ∏ t, if t = s then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s)
            else 1 := by
              apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
              intro t ht
              by_cases hts : t = s
              · simp [hts]
              · simp [hts, hagree t hts]
        _ = jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s) := by simp
    · simp only [hagree, if_false]
      unfold agreesOutsideSite at hagree
      push Not at hagree
      obtain ⟨t, hts, hout⟩ := hagree
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ t)
      simp [hts, hout]
  simp only [WeightedONBasis.mulOp, WeightedONBasis.coeff,
    productONBasis, siteKernel]
  have hexpect : (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
      (fun omega ↦ productBasis b out omega *
        (etaCoordinate b s omega * productBasis b inp omega)) =
      if agreesOutsideSite s out inp
        then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s) else 0 := by
    calc
    (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ productBasis b out omega *
          (etaCoordinate b s omega * productBasis b inp omega)) =
      (FiniteLaw.independentProduct mu).expect (fun omega ↦ ∏ t, f t (omega t)) := by
        apply FiniteLaw.expect_congr
        intro omega
        exact hpoint omega
    _ = ∏ t, (mu t).expect (f t) := hfactor
    _ = ∏ t, if t = s then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s)
        else if out t = inp t then 1 else 0 := by simp_rw [hlocal]
    _ = if agreesOutsideSite s out inp
        then jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) (out s) (inp s) else 0 := hprod
  simpa [FiniteLaw.expect, mul_assoc] using hexpect

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mulOp_etaCoordinate_mul
statement:
theorem mulOp_etaCoordinate_mul {m n b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (s t : Site m n) :
    (productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp
        (fun omega ↦ etaCoordinate b s omega * etaCoordinate b t omega) =
      siteKernel s (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1))) *
        siteKernel t (jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mulOp_etaCoordinate hb s, ← mulOp_etaCoordinate hb t]
  symm
  exact (productONBasis b hb m n).mulOp_mul (etaCoordinate b s) (etaCoordinate b t)

proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_siteKernel
statement:
theorem transpose_siteKernel (s : Site m n) (A : LevelOp) :
    (siteKernel s A).transpose = siteKernel s A.transpose
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  by_cases h : agreesOutsideSite s inp out
  · have h' : agreesOutsideSite s out inp := agreesOutsideSite_symm.mpr h
    simp [siteKernel, h, h']
  · have h' : ¬ agreesOutsideSite s out inp := by
      intro hs
      exact h (agreesOutsideSite_symm.mp hs)
    simp [siteKernel, h, h']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_pairKernel
statement:
theorem transpose_pairKernel (s t : Site m n) (A B : LevelOp) :
    (pairKernel s t A B).transpose = pairKernel s t A.transpose B.transpose
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  by_cases h : agreesOutsidePair s t inp out
  · have h' : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp := agreesOutsidePair_symm.mpr h
    simp [pairKernel, h, h']
  · have h' : ¬ agreesOutsidePair s t out inp := by
      intro hs
      exact h (agreesOutsidePair_symm.mp hs)
    simp [pairKernel, h, h']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pairKernel_swap
statement:
theorem pairKernel_swap (s t : Site m n) (A B : LevelOp) :
    pairKernel s t A B = pairKernel t s B A
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  by_cases h : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp
  · have h' : agreesOutsidePair t s out inp := agreesOutsidePair_swap.mp h
    simp [pairKernel, h, h', mul_comm]
  · have h' : ¬ agreesOutsidePair t s out inp := by
      intro hs
      exact h (agreesOutsidePair_swap.mpr hs)
    simp [pairKernel, h, h']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeZ_sub_eq_site
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Pattern.gradeZ, Pattern.gradeZ, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    (∑ x, (weightZ (out x) - weightZ (inp x))) =
        ∑ x, if x = s then weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s) else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          by_cases hx : x = s
          · subst x
            simp
          · have heq := h x hx
            simp [hx, heq]
    _ = weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s) := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gradeZ_sub_eq_pair
statement:
theorem gradeZ_sub_eq_pair {s t : Site m n} {out inp : Pattern m n}
    (hst : s ≠ t) (h : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp) :
    Pattern.gradeZ out - Pattern.gradeZ inp =
      (weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s)) +
      (weightZ (out t) - weightZ (inp t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Pattern.gradeZ, Pattern.gradeZ, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    (∑ x, (weightZ (out x) - weightZ (inp x))) =
        ∑ x, if x = s then weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s)
          else if x = t then weightZ (out t) - weightZ (inp t) else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x _
            by_cases hxs : x = s
            · subst x
              simp
            · by_cases hxt : x = t
              · subst x
                simp [hxs]
              · have heq := h x hxs hxt
                simp [hxs, hxt, heq]
    _ = ∑ x, ((if x = s then weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s) else 0) +
        (if x = t then weightZ (out t) - weightZ (inp t) else 0)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          by_cases hxs : x = s
          · subst x
            simp [hst]
          · by_cases hxt : x = t
            · subst x
              simp [hxs]
            · simp [hxs, hxt]
    _ = (weightZ (out s) - weightZ (inp s)) +
        (weightZ (out t) - weightZ (inp t)) := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteKernel_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hnonzero
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsideSite s out inp
  · have hlocal : A (out s) (inp s) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [siteKernel, hoff] using hnonzero
    have hw := hA hlocal
    have hd := gradeZ_sub_eq_site hoff
    omega
  · exact (hnonzero (by simp [siteKernel, hoff])).elim

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pairKernel_homogeneous
statement:
theorem pairKernel_homogeneous {δ ε : ℤ} {A B : LevelOp}
    (hA : IsLevelGradeShift δ A)
    (hB : IsLevelGradeShift ε B)
    {s t : Site m n} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    IsGradeShift (δ + ε) (pairKernel s t A B)
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hnonzero
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp
  · have hprod : A (out s) (inp s) * B (out t) (inp t) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [pairKernel, hoff] using hnonzero
    have hAlocal : A (out s) (inp s) ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).1
    have hBlocal : B (out t) (inp t) ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).2
    have hwA := hA hAlocal
    have hwB := hB hBlocal
    have hd := gradeZ_sub_eq_pair hst hoff
    omega
  · exact (hnonzero (by simp [pairKernel, hoff])).elim

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.wordKernel_homogeneous
statement:
theorem wordKernel_homogeneous (w : Word) {s t : Site m n} (hst : s ≠ t) :
    IsGradeShift w.degree (wordKernel s t w)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [wordKernel, Word.degree] using
    pairKernel_homogeneous w.1.op_homogeneous w.2.op_homogeneous hst

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_wordKernel
statement:
theorem transpose_wordKernel (s t : Site m n) (w : Word) :
    (wordKernel s t w).transpose = wordKernel t s w.orderedAdjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordKernel, transpose_pairKernel, pairKernel_swap]
  rcases w with ⟨a, b⟩
  simp [wordKernel, Word.orderedAdjoint, Leg.transpose_op]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ketBra_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ketBra_apply (out inp i j : Level) :
    ketBra out inp i j = if i = out ∧ j = inp then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_ketBra
statement:
@[simp] theorem transpose_ketBra (out inp : Level) :
    (ketBra out inp).transpose = ketBra inp out
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [ketBra, Matrix.transpose_apply, and_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_pCreate
statement: @[simp] theorem transpose_pCreate : pCreate.transpose = pDestroy
proof:
:= by
  simp [pCreate, pDestroy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_pDestroy
statement: @[simp] theorem transpose_pDestroy : pDestroy.transpose = pCreate
proof:
:= by
  simp [pCreate, pDestroy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_rPromote
statement: @[simp] theorem transpose_rPromote : rPromote.transpose = rDemote
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_rDemote

proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_jacobi
statement: @[simp] theorem transpose_jacobi (ρ : ℝ) : (jacobi ρ).transpose = jacobi ρ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [jacobi, pCreate, pDestroy, rPromote, rDemote, ketBra,
      Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jacobi_apply
statement:
theorem jacobi_apply (ρ : ℝ) (i j : Level) :
    jacobi ρ i j =
      match i, j with
      | .zero, .one => 1
      | .one, .zero => 1
      | .one, .two => ρ
      | .two, .one => ρ
      | _, _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [jacobi, pCreate, pDestroy, rPromote, rDemote, ketBra]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pCreate_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem pCreate_sq : pCreate * pCreate = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [pCreate, ketBra, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rPromote_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem rPromote_sq : rPromote * rPromote = 0
proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pCreate_mul_rPromote
statement: @[simp] theorem pCreate_mul_rPromote : pCreate * rPromote = 0

:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pCreate_mul_rDemote

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rPromote_mul_pCreate
statement:
@[simp] theorem rPromote_mul_pCreate :
    rPromote * pCreate = ketBra .two .zero
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [pCreate, rPromote, ketBra, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pCreate_homogeneous
statement: theorem pCreate_homogeneous : IsLevelGradeShift 1 pCreate
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp h
  cases out <;> cases inp <;>
    simp [pCreate, ketBra, weightZ, Level.weight] at h ⊢

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pDestroy_homogeneous
statement: theorem pDestroy_homogeneous : IsLevelGradeShift (-1) pDestroy
proof:
:= by

    simp [pDestroy, ketBra, weightZ, Level.weight] at h ⊢

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rPromote_homogeneous

proof:
:= by
