name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.univ_ternaryOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem univ_ternaryOutcome :
    (Finset.univ : Finset TernaryOutcome) = {.neg, .zero, .pos}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  cases x <;> simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.univ_level
statement:
@[simp] theorem univ_level :
    (Finset.univ : Finset Level) = {.zero, .one, .two}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  cases x <;> simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_mass
statement:
theorem sum_mass {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∑ x, mass b x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)
  simp [mass, univ_ternaryOutcome]
  field_simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mass_nonneg
statement:
theorem mass_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    0 ≤ mass b x
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  cases x
  · exact div_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hbR.le)
  · simp only [mass]
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    exact (div_le_one hbR).2 (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hb))
  · exact div_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hbR.le)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ternaryLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem ternaryLaw_weight (b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).weight z = mass b z
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem eta_zero (b : ℕ) : eta b .zero = 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sq_sqrt_nat
statement: theorem sq_sqrt_nat (b : ℕ) : (Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 = (b : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg b : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_cube
statement:
theorem eta_cube {b : ℕ} (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x ^ 3 = (b : ℝ) * eta b x
proof:
:= by
  have hs := sq_sqrt_nat b
  cases x <;> simp [eta, pow_succ, hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_eta
statement: theorem expect_eta {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : expect b (eta b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)
  simp [expect, mass, eta, univ_ternaryOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_eta_sq
statement:
theorem expect_eta_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    expect b (fun x => eta b x ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)
  have hs := sq_sqrt_nat b
  simp [expect, mass, eta, univ_ternaryOutcome, hs]
  field_simp
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.law_expect_eta
statement:
theorem law_expect_eta {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect (eta b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change expect b (eta b) = 0
  exact expect_eta hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.law_expect_eta_sq
statement:
theorem law_expect_eta_sq {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (ternaryLaw b hb).expect (fun x => eta b x ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change expect b (fun x => eta b x ^ 2) = 1
  exact expect_eta_sq hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sqrt_b_sub_one_pos
statement:
theorem sqrt_b_sub_one_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    0 < Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_pos]
  exact sub_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hb)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sq_sqrt_b_sub_one
statement:
theorem sq_sqrt_b_sub_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) ^ 2 = (b : ℝ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hb))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.basis_orthonormal
statement:
theorem basis_orthonormal {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (i j : Level) :
    ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i) (basisFun b j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  have hs0 : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sqrt_b_sub_one_pos hb)
  have hsb := sq_sqrt_nat b
  have hsm := sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [ternaryWeightedInner, expect, basisFun, mass, eta, univ_ternaryOutcome] <;>
    field_simp <;> nlinarith [hsb, hsm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.basis_reconstruction
statement:
theorem basis_reconstruction {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : TernaryOutcome → ℝ) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    f x = ∑ i, ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i) f * basisFun b i x
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  have hs0 : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sqrt_b_sub_one_pos hb)
  have hsb := sq_sqrt_nat b
  have hsm := sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb
  cases x <;>
    simp [ternaryWeightedInner, expect, basisFun, mass, eta, univ_ternaryOutcome,
      univ_level] <;>
    field_simp
  all_goals simp only [hsb, hsm]
  all_goals ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e0
statement:
theorem mul_e0 {b : ℕ} (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .zero x = basisFun b .one x
proof:
:= by
  simp [basisFun]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e1
statement:
theorem mul_e1 {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .one x =
      basisFun b .zero x + Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) * basisFun b .two x
proof:
:= by
  have hspos := sqrt_b_sub_one_pos hb
  have hsne : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hspos
  have hsq := sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb
  cases x <;> simp [basisFun, eta] <;>
    field_simp <;> nlinarith [hsq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mul_e2
statement:
theorem mul_e2 {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b .two x =
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) * basisFun b .one x
proof:
:= by
  have hspos := sqrt_b_sub_one_pos hb
  have hsne : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hspos
  cases x <;> simp [basisFun, eta] <;> field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplication_recurrence
statement:
theorem multiplication_recurrence {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b)
    (j : Level) (x : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b x * basisFun b j x =
      ∑ i, jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) i j * basisFun b i x
proof:
:= by
  cases j
  · simpa [jacobi_apply, univ_level] using mul_e0 (b := b) x
  · simpa [jacobi_apply, univ_level, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using mul_e1 hb x
  · simpa [jacobi_apply, univ_level] using mul_e2 hb x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplication_matrix
statement:
theorem multiplication_matrix {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (i j : Level) :
    ternaryWeightedInner b (basisFun b i)
        (fun x => eta b x * basisFun b j x) =
      jacobi (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  have hs0 : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sqrt_b_sub_one_pos hb)
  have hsb := sq_sqrt_nat b
  have hsm := sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [ternaryWeightedInner, expect, basisFun, mass, eta, univ_ternaryOutcome,
      jacobi_apply] <;>
    field_simp <;> nlinarith [hsb, hsm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_externalTensor
statement:
theorem transpose_externalTensor
    (M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (K : FockOp m n) :
    (externalTensor M K).transpose = externalTensor M.transpose K.transpose
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_orderedWordTerm
statement:
theorem transpose_orderedWordTerm
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) (w : Word) :
    (orderedWordTerm u r i j w).transpose =
      orderedWordTerm u r j i w.orderedAdjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedWordTerm, transpose_externalTensor, Matrix.transpose_vecMulVec,
    transpose_wordKernel]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.externalTensor_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hnonzero
  have hKnonzero : K out.2 inp.2 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hnonzero).2
  exact hK hKnonzero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedWordTerm_homogeneous
statement:
theorem orderedWordTerm_homogeneous
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (w : Word) :
    IsFullGradeShift w.degree (orderedWordTerm u r i j w)
proof:
:= by
  apply externalTensor_homogeneous
  apply wordKernel_homogeneous
  intro hsite
  exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd hsite)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.matchesUpTo_of_map_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem matchesUpTo_of_map_restrict_eq {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ S : Finset ι, S.card ≤ k →
      μ.toMeasure.map (fun x : ι → α => fun i : S => x i) =
        ν.toMeasure.map (fun x : ι → α => fun i : S => x i)) :
    MatchesUpTo μ ν k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro S hS f hf
  let x₀ : ι → α := μ.toPMF.support_nonempty.choose
  let r : (ι → α) → (S → α) := fun x i => x i
  let g : (S → α) → ℝ := fun y => f (fun i => if hi : i ∈ S then y ⟨i, hi⟩ else x₀ i)
  have hfg : f = g ∘ r := by
    funext x
    apply hf
    intro i hi
    simp [r, hi]
  have hm : HasLaw r (μ.toMeasure.map r) μ.toMeasure :=
    ⟨(measurable_of_finite r).aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  have hn : HasLaw r (ν.toMeasure.map r) ν.toMeasure :=
    ⟨(measurable_of_finite r).aemeasurable, rfl⟩
  rw [← integral_toMeasure, ← integral_toMeasure, hfg,
    hm.integral_comp (measurable_of_finite g).aestronglyMeasurable,
    hn.integral_comp (measurable_of_finite g).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rw [h S hS]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.matchesUpTo_iff_map_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem matchesUpTo_iff_map_restrict_eq {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ} :
    MatchesUpTo μ ν k ↔ ∀ S : Finset ι, S.card ≤ k →
      μ.toMeasure.map (fun x : ι → α => fun i : S => x i) =
        ν.toMeasure.map (fun x : ι → α => fun i : S => x i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h S hS
    let r : (ι → α) → (S → α) := fun x i => x i
    apply Measure.ext
    intro s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_finite r) hs,
      Measure.map_apply (measurable_of_finite r) hs]
    apply (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mp
    change μ.toMeasure.real (r ⁻¹' s) = ν.toMeasure.real (r ⁻¹' s)
    rw [real_toMeasure, real_toMeasure]
    apply h S hS
    intro x y hxy
    have hr : r x = r y := by
      funext i
      exact hxy i i.property
    change (if r x ∈ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = if r y ∈ s then 1 else 0
    rw [hr]
  · exact matchesUpTo_of_map_restrict_eq

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem product_weight (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (a : alpha) (b : beta) :
    (product mu nu).weight (a, b) = mu.weight a * nu.weight b
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_expect_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem product_expect_eq_iterated (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (f : alpha × beta → ℝ) :
    (product mu nu).expect f =
      mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.expect (fun b ↦ f (a, b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect, FiniteLaw.expect, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [product_weight]
  simp_rw [FiniteLaw.expect, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_prob_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem product_prob_eq_iterated (mu : FiniteLaw alpha) (nu : FiniteLaw beta)
    (event : Set (alpha × beta)) :
    (product mu nu).prob event =
      mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.prob {b | (a, b) ∈ event})
proof:
:= by
  rw [prob, product_expect_eq_iterated]
  apply expect_congr
  intro a
  rw [prob]
  apply expect_congr
  intro b
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.product_prob_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [product_prob_eq_iterated]
  calc
    mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.prob {b | (a, b) ∈ event}) ≤
        mu.expect (fun _ ↦ delta) := expect_mono mu h
    _ = delta := expect_const mu delta

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.le_product_prob
proof:
:= by
  rw [product_prob_eq_iterated]
  calc
    p = mu.expect (fun _ ↦ p) := (expect_const mu p).symm
    _ ≤ mu.expect (fun a ↦ nu.prob {b | (a, b) ∈ event}) := expect_mono mu h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.ext_weight
statement:
theorem ext_weight [Fintype α] {μ ν : FiniteLaw α}
    (h : μ.weight = ν.weight) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  cases μ with
  | mk w hw hs =>
    cases ν with
    | mk v hv ht =>
      dsimp at h
      subst v
      rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.uniform_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_weight [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] (x : α) :
    (uniform : FiniteLaw α).weight x = 1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_weight [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f : α → β) (y : β) :
    (map μ f).weight y = ∑ x, if f x = y then μ.weight x else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_expect
statement:
theorem map_expect [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f : α → β) (g : β → ℝ) :
    (map μ f).expect g = μ.expect (fun x => g (f x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, map_weight]
  calc
    (∑ y, (∑ x, if f x = y then μ.weight x else 0) * g y) =
        ∑ y, ∑ x, (if f x = y then μ.weight x else 0) * g y := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ x, μ.weight x * g (f x) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_uniform_equiv
statement:
theorem map_uniform_equiv [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β]
    (e : α ≃ β) :
    map (uniform : FiniteLaw α) e = (uniform : FiniteLaw β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ext_weight
  funext y
  simp only [map_weight, uniform_weight]
  rw [show (∑ x, if e x = y then 1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) else 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (e.symm y)]
    · simp
    · intro x _ hx
      have hxy : e x ≠ y := by
        intro h
        apply hx
        exact e.injective (h.trans (e.apply_symm_apply y).symm)
      simp [hxy]
    · simp]
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_zero (μ : FiniteLaw α) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [FiniteLaw.expect]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_one (μ : FiniteLaw α) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FiniteLaw.expect] using μ.sum_weight

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expect_const (μ : FiniteLaw α) (c : ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun _ => c) = c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.expect (fun _ => c) = (∑ x, μ.weight x) * c := by
      simp_rw [FiniteLaw.expect, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = c := by rw [μ.sum_weight, one_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_add
statement:
theorem expect_add (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => f x + g x) = μ.expect f + μ.expect g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_sub
statement:
theorem expect_sub (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f g : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => f x - g x) = μ.expect f - μ.expect g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_smul
statement:
theorem expect_smul (μ : FiniteLaw α) (c : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    μ.expect (fun x => c * f x) = c * μ.expect f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _hx
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_congr
statement:
theorem expect_congr (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : μ.expect f = μ.expect g
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _hx
  rw [h x]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_nonneg
statement:
theorem expect_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ μ.expect f
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _hx => mul_nonneg (μ.weight_nonneg x) (hf x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_mono
statement:
theorem expect_mono (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hfg : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : μ.expect f ≤ μ.expect g
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _hx
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfg x) (μ.weight_nonneg x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_empty (μ : FiniteLaw α) : μ.prob ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    μ.prob ∅ = μ.expect (fun _ => 0) := by
      rw [prob]
      apply μ.expect_congr
      intro x
      unfold indicator
      simp
    _ = 0 := μ.expect_zero

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_univ
statement: @[simp] theorem prob_univ (μ : FiniteLaw α) : μ.prob Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    μ.prob Set.univ = μ.expect (fun _ => 1) := by
      rw [prob]
      apply μ.expect_congr
      intro x
      unfold indicator
      simp
    _ = 1 := μ.expect_one

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_nonneg
statement: theorem prob_nonneg (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) : 0 ≤ μ.prob s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply μ.expect_nonneg
  intro x
  unfold indicator
  split <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_le_one
statement: theorem prob_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) : μ.prob s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    μ.prob s ≤ μ.expect (fun _ => 1) := by
      apply μ.expect_mono
      intro x
      unfold indicator
      split <;> norm_num
    _ = 1 := μ.expect_one

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (μ : FiniteLaw α) {s t : Set α} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    μ.prob s ≤ μ.prob t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply μ.expect_mono
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · have hxt : x ∈ t := hst hx
    simp [indicator, hx, hxt]
  · unfold indicator
    simp only [hx, ↓reduceIte]
    split <;> norm_num

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_compl
statement:
theorem prob_compl (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) :
    μ.prob sᶜ = 1 - μ.prob s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    μ.prob sᶜ = μ.expect (fun x => 1 - indicator s x) := by
      rw [prob]
      apply μ.expect_congr
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [indicator, hx]
    _ = μ.expect (fun _ => 1) - μ.expect (indicator s) := μ.expect_sub _ _
    _ = 1 - μ.prob s := by rw [μ.expect_one]; rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_singleton
statement:
theorem prob_singleton [DecidableEq α] (μ : FiniteLaw α) (a : α) :
    μ.prob {a} = μ.weight a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [prob, FiniteLaw.expect, indicator]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.markov_mul
statement:
theorem markov_mul (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (threshold : ℝ) :
    threshold * μ.prob {x | threshold ≤ f x} ≤ μ.expect f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [prob, FiniteLaw.expect, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _hx
  by_cases hlarge : threshold ≤ f x
  · simp [indicator, hlarge]
    calc
      threshold * μ.weight x = μ.weight x * threshold := by ring
      _ ≤ μ.weight x * f x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlarge (μ.weight_nonneg x)
  · simp [indicator, hlarge]
    exact mul_nonneg (μ.weight_nonneg x) (hf x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.markov
statement:
theorem markov (μ : FiniteLaw α) {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {threshold : ℝ} (hthreshold : 0 < threshold) :
    μ.prob {x | threshold ≤ f x} ≤ μ.expect f / threshold
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hthreshold).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using μ.markov_mul hf threshold

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.independentProduct_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem independentProduct_weight (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (x : ι → α) :
    (independentProduct μ).weight x = ∏ i, (μ i).weight (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_factorizes
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i, (μ i).expect (f i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i, f i (x i)) =
        ∑ x : ι → α, ∏ i, ((μ i).weight (x i) * f i (x i)) := by
      rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _hx
      simp only [independentProduct_weight, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    _ = ∏ i, ∑ a, ((μ i).weight a * f i a) := by
      exact (Fintype.prod_sum
        (fun i a => (μ i).weight a * f i a)).symm
    _ = ∏ i, (μ i).expect (f i) := by
      simp only [FiniteLaw.expect]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i ∈ s, f i (x i)) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, (μ i).expect (f i)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ι → α → ℝ := fun i a => if i ∈ s then f i a else 1
  have hgpoint (x : ι → α) :
      (∏ i, g i (x i)) = ∏ i ∈ s, f i (x i) := by
    simp [g]
  have hgexpect (i : ι) :
      (μ i).expect (g i) = if i ∈ s then (μ i).expect (f i) else 1 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · simp [g, hi]
    · simp [g, hi]
  calc
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i ∈ s, f i (x i)) =
        (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => ∏ i, g i (x i)) := by
      apply (independentProduct μ).expect_congr
      intro x
      exact (hgpoint x).symm
    _ = ∏ i, (μ i).expect (g i) :=
      expect_independentProduct_factorizes μ g
    _ = ∏ i ∈ s, (μ i).expect (f i) := by
      simp_rw [hgexpect]
      simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_apply
statement:
theorem expect_independentProduct_apply
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => f (x i)) = (μ i).expect f
proof:
:= by
  have h := expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on μ {i} (fun _ => f)
  simpa using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_apply
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_apply
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (s : Set α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i ∈ s} = (μ i).prob s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i ∈ s} =
        (independentProduct μ).expect (fun x => indicator s (x i)) := by
      rw [prob]
      apply (independentProduct μ).expect_congr
      intro x
      simp [indicator]
    _ = (μ i).expect (indicator s) :=
      expect_independentProduct_apply μ i (indicator s)
    _ = (μ i).prob s := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_eq
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_eq
    [DecidableEq α] (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (i : ι) (a : α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i = a} = (μ i).weight a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (independentProduct μ).prob {x | x i = a} =
        (μ i).prob {a} := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
        prob_independentProduct_apply μ i ({a} : Set α)
    _ = (μ i).weight a := prob_singleton (μ i) a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.indicator_cylinder
statement:
theorem indicator_cylinder (s : ι → Set α) (x : ι → α) :
    indicator (cylinder s) x = ∏ i, indicator (s i) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hall : ∀ i, x i ∈ s i
  · simp [indicator, cylinder, hall]
  · push Not at hall
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hall
    have hleft : x ∉ cylinder s := by
      intro hx
      exact hi (hx i)
    rw [indicator]
    simp only [hleft, ↓reduceIte]
    symm
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp [indicator, hi]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_independentProduct_cylinder
statement:
theorem prob_independentProduct_cylinder
    (μ : ι → FiniteLaw α) (s : ι → Set α) :
    (independentProduct μ).prob (cylinder s) = ∏ i, (μ i).prob (s i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (independentProduct μ).prob (cylinder s) =
        (independentProduct μ).expect
          (fun x => ∏ i, indicator (s i) (x i)) := by
      rw [prob]
      apply (independentProduct μ).expect_congr
      intro x
      exact indicator_cylinder s x
    _ = ∏ i, (μ i).expect (indicator (s i)) :=
      expect_independentProduct_factorizes μ (fun i => indicator (s i))
    _ = ∏ i, (μ i).prob (s i) := by
      simp only [prob]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.toPMF_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPMF_apply (μ : FiniteLaw α) (x : α) :
    μ.toPMF x = ENNReal.ofReal (μ.weight x)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.toPMF_ofPMF
statement: @[simp] theorem toPMF_ofPMF (p : PMF α) : (ofPMF p).toPMF = p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (p.apply_ne_top x)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.ofPMF_toPMF
statement: @[simp] theorem ofPMF_toPMF (μ : FiniteLaw α) : ofPMF μ.toPMF = μ
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ofPMF μ.toPMF).weight = μ.weight := by
    funext x
    exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (μ.weight_nonneg x)
  exact ext_weight h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.integral_toMeasure
statement:
theorem integral_toMeasure [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ.toMeasure) = μ.expect f
proof:
:= by
  rw [toMeasure, PMF.integral_eq_sum]
  simp only [toPMF_apply, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (μ.weight_nonneg _), smul_eq_mul, FiniteLaw.expect]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.real_toMeasure
statement:
theorem real_toMeasure [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (μ : FiniteLaw α) (s : Set α) :
    μ.toMeasure.real s = μ.prob s
proof:
:= by
  have hs : MeasurableSet s := s.toFinite.measurableSet
  rw [← integral_indicator_one hs, integral_toMeasure, prob]
  congr 1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.real_preimage_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem real_preimage_of_hasLaw
    [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (ν : FiniteLaw α)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (Z : Ω → α) (hlaw : HasLaw Z ν.toMeasure μ) (s : Set α) :
    μ.real (Z ⁻¹' s) = ν.prob s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← real_toMeasure]
  exact hlaw.measureReal_eq s.toFinite.measurableSet

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.refl
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.refl [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α]
    (μ : FiniteLaw (ι → α)) (k : ℕ) : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ μ k
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS f hf
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.mono
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS f hf
  exact h S (hS.trans hkl) f hf

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.prob_cylinder_eq
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo.prob_cylinder_eq
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α]
    {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ}
    (h : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ ν k) (S : Finset ι) (hS : S.card ≤ k)
    (a : ι → α) :
    μ.prob {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i = a i} =
      ν.prob {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i = a i}
proof:
:= by
  let event : Set (ι → α) := {x | ∀ i ∈ S, x i = a i}
  have hdep : DependsOn S (FiniteLaw.indicator event) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hmem : x ∈ event ↔ y ∈ event := by
      constructor
      · intro hx i hi
        rw [← hxy i hi]
        exact hx i hi
      · intro hy i hi
        rw [hxy i hi]
        exact hy i hi
    simp only [FiniteLaw.indicator]
    split <;> split <;> simp_all
  simpa [FiniteLaw.prob, event] using
    h S hS (FiniteLaw.indicator event) hdep

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.congr
statement:
theorem congr {k : ℕ} {f g : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) (hfg : f = g) : HasLocalDegree k g
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  exact hf

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.constant
statement:
theorem constant (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := ι) (α := α) k (fun _ => c)
proof:
:= by
  apply atom ∅ (fun _ => c)
  · simp
  · intro x y hxy
    rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.neg
proof:
:= by
  simpa using smul (-1) hf

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sub
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using add hf (neg hg)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.mono
statement:
theorem mono {k l : ℕ} {f : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) (hkl : k ≤ l) : HasLocalDegree l f
proof:
:= by
  induction hf with
  | atom S f hcard hdep =>
      exact atom S f (hcard.trans hkl) hdep
  | zero => exact zero
  | add hf hg ihf ihg => exact add ihf ihg
  | smul c hf ih => exact smul c ih

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sum_finset
statement:
theorem sum_finset {β : Type*} {k : ℕ} (T : Finset β)
    (f : β → (ι → α) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ T, HasLocalDegree k (f t)) :
    HasLocalDegree k (fun x => ∑ t ∈ T, f t x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction T using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (zero : HasLocalDegree k (fun _ : ι → α => 0))
  | @insert t T ht ih =>
      have hhead := hf t (Finset.mem_insert_self t T)
      have htail : ∀ u ∈ T, HasLocalDegree k (f u) := by
        intro u hu
        exact hf u (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu)
      simpa [Finset.sum_insert ht] using add hhead (ih htail)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
statement:
theorem sum_fintype {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {k : ℕ}
    (f : β → (ι → α) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ t, HasLocalDegree k (f t)) :
    HasLocalDegree k (fun x => ∑ t, f t x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa using sum_finset (Finset.univ : Finset β) f
    (fun t _ht => hf t)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.mul_local_left
statement:
private theorem mul_local_left {k l : ℕ} (S : Finset ι)
    (f : (ι → α) → ℝ) (hcard : S.card ≤ k) (hdep : DependsOn S f)
    {g : (ι → α) → ℝ} (hg : HasLocalDegree l g) :
    HasLocalDegree (k + l) (fun x => f x * g x)
proof:
:= by
  induction hg with
  | atom T g hT hgd =>
      apply atom (S ∪ T) (fun x => f x * g x)
      · calc
          (S ∪ T).card ≤ S.card + T.card := Finset.card_union_le S T
          _ ≤ k + l := Nat.add_le_add hcard hT
      · intro x y hxy
        have hfxy : f x = f y := hdep x y (fun i hi => hxy i (Finset.mem_union_left T hi))
        have hgxy : g x = g y := hgd x y (fun i hi => hxy i (Finset.mem_union_right S hi))
        change f x * g x = f y * g y
        rw [hfxy, hgxy]
  | zero =>
      simpa using (zero : HasLocalDegree (k + l) (fun _ : ι → α => 0))
  | add hg₁ hg₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      simpa [mul_add] using add ih₁ ih₂
  | smul c hg ih =>
      have hscaled := smul c ih
      convert hscaled using 1
      funext x
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.mul
proof:
:= by
  induction hf with
  | atom S f hS hfd => exact mul_local_left S f hS hfd hg
  | zero =>
      simpa using (zero : HasLocalDegree (k + l) (fun _ : ι → α => 0))
  | add hf₁ hf₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      simpa [add_mul] using add ih₁ ih₂
  | smul c hf ih =>
      have hscaled := smul c ih
      convert hscaled using 1
      funext x
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.HasLocalDegree.expect_eq_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem expect_eq_of_matchesUpTo [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]
    {μ ν : FiniteLaw (ι → α)} {k : ℕ} {f : (ι → α) → ℝ}
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ ν k) (hf : HasLocalDegree k f) :
    μ.expect f = ν.expect f
proof:
:= by
  induction hf with
  | atom S f hcard hdep => exact hmatch S hcard f hdep
  | zero => simp
  | add hf hg ihf ihg =>
      rw [μ.expect_add, ν.expect_add, ihf, ihg]
  | smul c hf ih =>
      rw [μ.expect_smul, ν.expect_smul, ih]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_plus_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .lightLight = Lplus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .plus .lightLight = {(.pUp, .pUp)} by decide]
  simp [Lplus, wordSum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_plus_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .lightHeavy = Xplus m u + Yplus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .plus .lightHeavy = {(.pUp, .rUp), (.rUp, .pUp)} by decide]
  simp [Xplus, Yplus, wordSum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_plus_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_plus_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .plus .heavyHeavy = Hplus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .plus .heavyHeavy = {(.rUp, .rUp)} by decide]
  simp [Hplus, wordSum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_zero_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .lightLight = Lzero m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .zero .lightLight =
    {(.pUp, .pDown), (.pDown, .pUp)} by decide]
  simp [Lzero, wordSum, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_zero_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .lightHeavy =
      Xzero m u + XzeroAdj m u + Yzero m u + YzeroAdj m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .zero .lightHeavy =
    {(.pUp, .rDown), (.rUp, .pDown), (.rDown, .pUp), (.pDown, .rUp)} by decide]
  simp [Xzero, XzeroAdj, Yzero, YzeroAdj, wordSum]
  abel

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_zero_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_zero_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .zero .heavyHeavy = Hzero m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .zero .heavyHeavy =
    {(.rUp, .rDown), (.rDown, .rUp)} by decide]
  simp [Hzero, wordSum, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_lightLight
statement:
theorem family_minus_lightLight (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .lightLight = Lminus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .minus .lightLight = {(.pDown, .pDown)} by decide]
  simp [Lminus, wordSum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem family_minus_lightHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .lightHeavy = XplusAdj m u + YplusAdj m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .minus .lightHeavy =
    {(.rDown, .pDown), (.pDown, .rDown)} by decide]
  simp [XplusAdj, YplusAdj, wordSum, add_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.family_minus_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem family_minus_heavyHeavy (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    family m u .minus .heavyHeavy = Hminus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [family, show wordsIn .minus .heavyHeavy = {(.rDown, .rDown)} by decide]
  simp [Hminus, wordSum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_plus_named
statement:
theorem band_plus_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .plus =
      Lplus m u + ρ • (Xplus m u + Yplus m u) + ρ ^ 2 • Hplus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [band_eq_three_families, family_plus_lightLight,
    family_plus_lightHeavy, family_plus_heavyHeavy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_zero_named
statement:
theorem band_zero_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .zero = Lzero m u +
      ρ • (Xzero m u + XzeroAdj m u + Yzero m u + YzeroAdj m u) +
      ρ ^ 2 • Hzero m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [band_eq_three_families, family_zero_lightLight,
    family_zero_lightHeavy, family_zero_heavyHeavy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_minus_named
statement:
theorem band_minus_named (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    band m u ρ .minus =
      Lminus m u + ρ • (XplusAdj m u + YplusAdj m u) +
        ρ ^ 2 • Hminus m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [band_eq_three_families, family_minus_lightLight,
    family_minus_lightHeavy, family_minus_heavyHeavy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_row_bound
statement:
theorem blockGram_row_bound
    {d ell energy diagonal cross : ℝ}
    (_henergy : 0 ≤ energy)
    (hdiag : diagonal ≤ d * energy)
    (hcross : cross ≤ (ell - 1) * energy) :
    diagonal + cross ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.blockGram_finite_row_bound
statement:
theorem blockGram_finite_row_bound
    {ell : ℕ} (diagonalIndex : Fin ell) (entry : Fin ell → ℝ)
    {d energy : ℝ}
    (hdiag : entry diagonalIndex ≤ d * energy)
    (hoff : ∀ j, j ≠ diagonalIndex → entry j ≤ energy) :
    (∑ j, entry j) ≤ (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * energy
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : diagonalIndex ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ell)) := Finset.mem_univ _
  have hother :
      (∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase diagonalIndex), entry j) ≤
        ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase diagonalIndex), energy := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    exact hoff j (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)
  have hcard : (Finset.univ.erase diagonalIndex).card = ell - 1 := by
    simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem]
  have hell : 1 ≤ ell := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by
    intro hz
    simpa [hz] using diagonalIndex.isLt)
  calc
    (∑ j, entry j) = entry diagonalIndex +
        ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase diagonalIndex), entry j := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hmem]
          ring
    _ ≤ d * energy + ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase diagonalIndex), energy :=
      add_le_add hdiag hother
    _ = d * energy + ((ell - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * energy := by simp [hcard]
    _ = (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * energy := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hell]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_product_into_envelope
statement:
theorem mixed_product_into_envelope
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt y ≤ (x + y) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsx : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_nonneg x
  have hsy : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt y := Real.sqrt_nonneg y
  have hx' : (Real.sqrt x) ^ 2 = x := Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have hy' : (Real.sqrt y) ^ 2 = y := Real.sq_sqrt hy
  nlinarith [two_mul_le_add_sq (Real.sqrt x) (Real.sqrt y)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.parameter_envelope
statement:
theorem parameter_envelope
    {rootTerm linearTerm sparseTerm ε : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hroot : rootTerm ≤ ε)
    (hlinear : linearTerm ≤ ε ^ 2)
    (hsparse : sparseTerm ≤ ε) :
    rootTerm + linearTerm + sparseTerm ≤ 3 * ε
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self hε0 hε1]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparsity_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem sparsity_parameter_arithmetic
    {ν q s ε : ℝ}
    (hν : ν + 1 ≤ 2 * q + 1)
    (_hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 * q + 1 ≤ ε * s) :
    (ν + 1) / s ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hs).2
  linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.dense_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem dense_parameter_arithmetic
    {d ν m ε : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hscale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m) :
    (d + ν) / m ≤ ε ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hm).2 hscale

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.dense_sqrt_parameter_arithmetic
statement:
theorem dense_sqrt_parameter_arithmetic
    {d ν m ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hscale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m) :
    Real.sqrt ((d + ν) / m) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  exact ⟨hε, dense_parameter_arithmetic hm hscale⟩

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.final_parameter_envelope
statement:
theorem final_parameter_envelope
    {d ν q m s ε : ℝ}
    (hν : ν ≤ 2 * q)
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hmScale : d + ν ≤ ε ^ 2 * m)
    (hsScale : 2 * q + 1 ≤ ε * s) :
    Real.sqrt ((d + ν) / m) + (d + ν) / m + (ν + 1) / s ≤ 3 * ε
proof:
:= by
  apply parameter_envelope hε0 hε1
  · exact dense_sqrt_parameter_arithmetic hε0 hm hmScale
  · exact dense_parameter_arithmetic hm hmScale
  · exact sparsity_parameter_arithmetic (ν := ν) (q := q) (s := s) (ε := ε)
      (by linarith) hε0 hs hsScale

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_leg
statement:
theorem sum_leg {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Leg → A) :
    ∑ a, f a = f .pUp + f .pDown + f .rUp + f .rDown
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset Leg) = {.pUp, .pDown, .rUp, .rDown} by decide]
  simp [add_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_shift
statement:
theorem sum_shift {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Shift → A) :
    ∑ δ, f δ = f .plus + f .zero + f .minus
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset Shift) = {.plus, .zero, .minus} by decide]
  simp [add_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_heaviness
statement:
theorem sum_heaviness {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Heaviness → A) :
    ∑ h, f h = f .lightLight + f .lightHeavy + f .heavyHeavy
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset Heaviness) =
    {.lightLight, .lightHeavy, .heavyHeavy} by decide]
  simp [add_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jacobi_eq_weighted_legs
statement:
theorem jacobi_eq_weighted_legs (ρ : ℝ) :
    jacobi ρ = ∑ a : Leg, ρ ^ a.heavy • a.op
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  cases out <;> cases inp <;>
    simp [sum_leg, jacobi, Leg.op, Leg.heavy, pCreate, pDestroy,
      rPromote, rDemote, ketBra]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.pairKernel_jacobi_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem pairKernel_jacobi_eq_all_words
    (ρ : ℝ) (s t : Site m n) :
    pairKernel s t (jacobi ρ) (jacobi ρ) =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • wordKernel s t w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp
  · simp only [pairKernel, wordKernel, hoff, if_pos, Matrix.sum_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_leg, Word.heavy,
      Leg.heavy]
    cases hos : out s <;> cases his : inp s <;>
      cases hot : out t <;> cases hit : inp t <;>
      simp [jacobi, Leg.op, pCreate, pDestroy, rPromote, rDemote, ketBra] <;> ring
  · simp [pairKernel, wordKernel, hoff, Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_leg]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.orderedJacobiTerm_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem orderedJacobiTerm_eq_all_words
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) :
    orderedJacobiTerm u ρ r i j =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • orderedWordTerm u r i j w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  rw [orderedJacobiTerm, pairKernel_jacobi_eq_all_words]
  simp only [externalTensor, orderedWordTerm, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_ordered_pairs_comm
statement:
theorem sum_ordered_pairs_comm {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] [Module ℝ A]
    (c : Word → ℝ) (f : Fin m → Fin n → Fin n → Word → A) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ∑ w, c w • f r i j w) =
      ∑ w, c w • (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f r i j w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hj (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ∑ w, c w • f r i j w) =
        ∑ w, c w • (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f r i j w) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro w _
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  have hi (r : Fin m) :
      (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ∑ w, c w • f r i j w) =
        ∑ w, c w • (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, f r i j w) := by
    simp_rw [hj r]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro w _
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  simp_rw [hi]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rawMultiplication_eq_all_words
statement:
theorem rawMultiplication_eq_all_words
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    rawMultiplication m u ρ =
      ∑ w : Word, ρ ^ w.heavy • physicalWordSum m u w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rawMultiplication physicalWordSum
  simp_rw [orderedJacobiTerm_eq_all_words]
  exact sum_ordered_pairs_comm (m := m) (n := n)
    (fun w ↦ ρ ^ w.heavy) (fun r i j w ↦ orderedWordTerm u r i j w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_all_cells
statement:
theorem sum_all_cells {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Word → A) :
    (∑ δ : Shift, ∑ h : Heaviness, ∑ w ∈ wordsIn δ h, f w) =
      ∑ w : Word, f w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_shift]
  simp only [sum_heaviness]
  simp only [wordsIn, Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_leg]
  simp [Word.shift, Word.heaviness]
  abel

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rawMultiplication_eq_sum_bands
statement:
theorem rawMultiplication_eq_sum_bands
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    rawMultiplication m u ρ = ∑ δ : Shift, band m u ρ δ
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawMultiplication_eq_all_words]
  symm
  exact sum_all_cells (fun w ↦ ρ ^ w.heavy • physicalWordSum m u w)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_lightLight
statement:
theorem cell_lightLight
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .lightLight = family m u δ .lightLight
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w hw
  have hh : w.heavy = 0 := by
    have hcell : w.heaviness = .lightLight :=
      ((mem_wordsIn w δ .lightLight).mp hw).2
    rw [Word.heavy_eq_heaviness]
    rw [hcell]
  simp [hh]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_lightHeavy
statement:
theorem cell_lightHeavy
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .lightHeavy = ρ • family m u δ .lightHeavy
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell, family, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w hw
  have hh : w.heavy = 1 := by
    have hcell : w.heaviness = .lightHeavy :=
      ((mem_wordsIn w δ .lightHeavy).mp hw).2
    rw [Word.heavy_eq_heaviness]
    rw [hcell]
  simp [hh]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cell_heavyHeavy
statement:
theorem cell_heavyHeavy
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    cell m u ρ δ .heavyHeavy = ρ ^ 2 • family m u δ .heavyHeavy
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell, family, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w hw
  have hh : w.heavy = 2 := by
    have hcell : w.heaviness = .heavyHeavy :=
      ((mem_wordsIn w δ .heavyHeavy).mp hw).2
    rw [Word.heavy_eq_heaviness]
    rw [hcell]
  simp [hh]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_eq_three_families
statement:
theorem band_eq_three_families
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    band m u ρ δ =
      family m u δ .lightLight +
        ρ • family m u δ .lightHeavy +
        ρ ^ 2 • family m u δ .heavyHeavy
proof:
:= by
  rw [band, sum_heaviness, cell_lightLight, cell_lightHeavy, cell_heavyHeavy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.band_homogeneous
statement:
theorem band_homogeneous
    (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (δ : Shift) :
    IsFullGradeShift δ.degree (band m u ρ δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hnonzero
  classical
  simp only [band, cell, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply] at hnonzero
  by_contra hgrade
  have hz : ∀ h : Heaviness, ∀ w ∈ wordsIn δ h,
      (ρ ^ w.heavy • physicalWordSum m u w) out inp = 0 := by
    intro h w hw
    by_cases hc : ρ ^ w.heavy = 0
    · simp [hc]
    · have hshift := (mem_wordsIn w δ h).mp hw |>.1
      rw [Matrix.smul_apply]
      apply mul_eq_zero.mpr
      right
      simp only [physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j hj
      by_contra hterm
      have hom := orderedWordTerm_homogeneous u r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) w hterm
      rw [Word.degree_eq_shift, hshift] at hom
      exact hgrade hom
  apply hnonzero
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro h _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro w hw
  exact hz h w hw

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne
statement:
theorem siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne
    (s t : Site m n) (hst : s ≠ t) (A B : LevelOp) :
    siteKernel s A * siteKernel t B = pairKernel s t A B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp
  · let mid : Pattern m n := Function.update out s (inp s)
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single mid]
    · have hs : agreesOutsideSite s out mid := by
        intro x hxs
        simp [mid, hxs]
      have ht : agreesOutsideSite t mid inp := by
        intro x hxt
        by_cases hxs : x = s
        · subst x
          simp [mid]
        · simp [mid, hxs, hoff x hxs hxt]
      have hmids : mid s = inp s := by simp [mid]
      have hmidt : mid t = out t := by
        simp [mid, Ne.symm hst]
      simp [siteKernel, pairKernel, hoff, hs, ht, hmids, hmidt]
    · intro other _ hother
      by_cases hs : agreesOutsideSite s out other
      · by_cases ht : agreesOutsideSite t other inp
        · have heq : other = mid := by
            funext x
            by_cases hxs : x = s
            · subst x
              have hst' : s ≠ t := hst
              simpa [mid] using ht s hst'
            · have hx := hs x hxs
              simpa [mid, hxs] using hx.symm
          exact (hother heq).elim
        · simp [siteKernel, ht]
      · simp [siteKernel, hs]
    · intro hnot
      exact (hnot (Finset.mem_univ mid)).elim
  · rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp only [pairKernel, hoff, if_false]
    apply (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun mid _ ↦ ?_)
    by_cases hs : agreesOutsideSite s out mid
    · by_cases ht : agreesOutsideSite t mid inp
      · exfalso
        apply hoff
        intro x hxs hxt
        exact (hs x hxs).trans (ht x hxt)
      · simp [siteKernel, ht]
    · simp [siteKernel, hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.siteJacobiProduct_eq_pairKernel
statement:
theorem siteJacobiProduct_eq_pairKernel
    (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) (ρ : ℝ) :
    siteKernel (r, i) (jacobi ρ) * siteKernel (r, j) (jacobi ρ) =
      pairKernel (r, i) (r, j) (jacobi ρ) (jacobi ρ)
proof:
:= by
  apply siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne
  intro h
  exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd h)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.globalJacobiOperator_eq_smul_rawMultiplication
statement:
theorem globalJacobiOperator_eq_smul_rawMultiplication
    (F : Frame n d) :
    globalJacobiOperator (m := m) b F =
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) • rawMultiplication m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a)
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [globalJacobiOperator]
  unfold rawMultiplication orderedJacobiTerm
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hij : i ≠ j := Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
  rw [siteJacobiProduct_eq_pairKernel r i j hij]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_homogeneous
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ)
    (δ : Shift) :
  IsFullGradeShift δ.degree (normalizedBand m F b δ)
proof:
:= by
  apply homogeneous_smul
  exact band_homogeneous
    (m := m) (fun i a ↦ F.u i a) (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1)) δ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuumPattern_grade
statement:
@[simp] theorem vacuumPattern_grade :
    (vacuumPattern m n).grade = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [vacuumPattern, Pattern.grade, Level.weight]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_compatible
proof:
:= by
  cases delta with
  | plus =>
      simp [nextGrade] at hnext
      subst mu
      simp [Shift.degree]
  | zero =>
      simp [nextGrade] at hnext
      subst mu
      simp [Shift.degree]
  | minus =>
      simp only [nextGrade] at hnext
      split at hnext
      case isTrue htwo =>
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hnext
        subst mu
        simp [Shift.degree]
        omega
      case isFalse htwo => simp at hnext

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_none_impossible
proof:
:= by
  cases delta with
  | plus => simp [nextGrade] at hnext
  | zero => simp [nextGrade] at hnext
  | minus =>
      simp only [nextGrade] at hnext
      split at hnext
      case isTrue htwo => simp at hnext
      case isFalse htwo =>
        intro mu hmu
        simp [Shift.degree] at hmu
        omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_output_projection
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_output_projection
    (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ) (delta : Shift)
    (nu mu : ℕ) (hnext : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * normalizedBand m F b delta *
        gradeProjection nu =
      normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  apply output_projection_of_homogeneous
    (normalizedBand_homogeneous F b delta)
  exact nextGrade_compatible hnext

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_vanishes_of_nextGrade_none
statement:
theorem normalizedBand_vanishes_of_nextGrade_none
    (F : Frame n d) (b : ℕ) (delta : Shift)
    (nu : ℕ) (hnext : nextGrade delta nu = none) :
    normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
    (normalizedBand_homogeneous F b delta) nu
  exact nextGrade_none_impossible hnext

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.multiplicationOperator_eq_sum_normalizedBands
statement:
theorem multiplicationOperator_eq_sum_normalizedBands
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) :
    multiplicationOperator (m := m) b hb F =
      ∑ δ : Shift, normalizedBand m F b δ
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicationOperator_eq_globalJacobi hb F,
    globalJacobiOperator_eq_smul_rawMultiplication]
  rw [rawMultiplication_eq_sum_bands]
  simp [normalizedBand, Finset.smul_sum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_moment_identity_bands
statement:
theorem vacuum_moment_identity_bands
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      ((∑ δ : Shift, normalizedBand m F b δ) ^ k)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n) (a, vacuumPattern m n)) =
      (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← multiplicationOperator_eq_sum_normalizedBands hb F]
  exact vacuum_moment_identity hb F k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.concrete_band_envelope
statement:
theorem concrete_band_envelope
    (F : Frame n d) (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (shift : Shift) :
    ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant *
        (aTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by omega
  have hmNat : 1 ≤ s * b := Nat.mul_pos hs hb0
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) := by positivity
  have ha : 0 ≤ aTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    aTerm_nonneg _ _ _
  have hbt : 0 ≤ bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    bTerm_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hm
  have hc : 0 ≤ cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ) :=
    cTerm_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hsR
  have hdir : Frame.rows F =
      (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) := rfl
  cases shift with
  | plus =>
      apply plus_band_envelope_of_components F nu ha hc
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
          (m := s * b) F nu hmNat
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Heavy.norm_normalized_Hplus_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · exact hbt
  | zero =>
      apply zero_band_envelope_of_components F nu hc
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Light.normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
          (m := s * b) F nu hmNat
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Heavy.norm_normalized_Hzero_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · exact hbt
      · exact ha
  | minus =>
      apply minus_band_envelope_of_components F nu ha hc
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Light.normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
          (m := s * b) F nu hmNat
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_minus_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · rw [← hdir]
        exact Heavy.norm_normalized_Hminus_restricted_le
          F s b nu hs hb
      · exact hbt

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.concrete_band_bound_le_beta
statement:
theorem concrete_band_bound_le_beta
    (F : Frame n d) (s b q nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (hnu : nu ≤ 2 * q) (shift : Shift) :
    ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandEnvelope d q (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < (s : ℝ) := by positivity
  exact (concrete_band_envelope F s b nu hs hb shift).trans
    (grade_envelope_le_betaEnvelope hnu hm hsR)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.aTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem aTerm_nonneg (d nu m : ℝ) : 0 ≤ aTerm d nu m
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.bTerm_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold bTerm
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cTerm_nonneg
statement:
theorem cTerm_nonneg {nu s : ℝ} (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 ≤ cTerm nu s
proof:
:= by
  unfold cTerm
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.lightPlus_scalar_bound
statement:
theorem lightPlus_scalar_bound {d nu m : ℝ}
    (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) * (m + nu)) / m ≤
      aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := zero_lt_one.trans_le hm
  have hD : 0 ≤ d + nu + 1 := by positivity
  have hnuDiv : 0 ≤ nu / m := div_nonneg hnu hm0.le
  have hDdiv : 0 ≤ (d + nu + 1) / m := div_nonneg hD hm0.le
  have hsqrtNu : Real.sqrt (nu / m) ≤ Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) := by
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hm0.le)
  have hsqrtOne : Real.sqrt (1 + nu / m) ≤ 1 + Real.sqrt (nu / m) := by
    have hsq : (1 + nu / m) ≤ (1 + Real.sqrt (nu / m)) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hnuDiv, Real.sqrt_nonneg (nu / m)]
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
    exact ⟨by positivity, hsq⟩
  have hfactor :
      Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) * (m + nu)) / m =
        Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) * Real.sqrt (1 + nu / m) := by
    have hmne : m ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hm0
    have hrewrite :
        ((d + nu + 1) * (m + nu)) / m ^ 2 =
          ((d + nu + 1) / m) * (1 + nu / m) := by
      field_simp
    calc
      Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) * (m + nu)) / m =
          Real.sqrt (((d + nu + 1) * (m + nu)) / m ^ 2) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_div (by positivity : 0 ≤ (d + nu + 1) * (m + nu))]
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hm0]
      _ = Real.sqrt (((d + nu + 1) / m) * (1 + nu / m)) := by rw [hrewrite]
      _ = Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) * Real.sqrt (1 + nu / m) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul hDdiv]
  rw [hfactor]
  have ha := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((d + nu + 1) / m)
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) * Real.sqrt (1 + nu / m) ≤
        Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) * (1 + Real.sqrt (nu / m)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrtOne ha
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m) *
        (1 + Real.sqrt ((d + nu + 1) / m)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hsqrtNu 1) ha
    _ = aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m := by
      unfold aTerm bTerm
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hDdiv]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.plus_row_envelope
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by norm_num)
  rw [bandConstant]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zero_row_envelope
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := Real.one_le_sqrt.mpr (by norm_num)
  rw [bandConstant]
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.common_row_envelope
statement:
theorem common_row_envelope {a b c total : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (isZero : Bool)
    (htotal : total ≤ if isZero then
      4 * b + (3 + Real.sqrt 2) * c
    else a + 2 * b + (5 / 2 : ℝ) * c) :
    total ≤ bandConstant * (a + b + c)
proof:
:= by
  cases isZero
  · exact htotal.trans (plus_row_envelope ha hb hc)
  · exact htotal.trans (zero_row_envelope ha hb hc)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.grade_envelope_le_betaEnvelope
statement:
theorem grade_envelope_le_betaEnvelope {d q nu : ℕ} {m s : ℝ}
    (hnu : nu ≤ 2 * q) (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s) :
    bandConstant * (aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m + cTerm nu s) ≤
      bandEnvelope d q m s
proof:
:= by
  have hnumNat : d + nu + 1 ≤ momentDim d q := by
    simp [momentDim]
    omega
  have hnum : (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnumNat
  have hdiv : ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) / m ≤
      (momentDim d q : ℕ) / m :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hm.le
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) / m) ≤
      Real.sqrt ((momentDim d q : ℕ) / m) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdiv
  have hsparseNat : nu + 1 ≤ 2 * q + 1 := by omega
  have hsparseNum : ((nu + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsparseNat
  have hsparse : ((nu + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / s ≤
      ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / s :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsparseNum hs.le
  rw [bandEnvelope]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ bandConstant_pos.le
  unfold aTerm bTerm cTerm
  simpa using add_le_add (add_le_add hroot hdiv) hsparse

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.card_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem card_shift : Fintype.card Shift = 3
proof: := by decide

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.card_bandWord
statement: @[simp] theorem card_bandWord (N : ℕ) : Fintype.card (BandWord N) = 3 ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [BandWord]
  | succ N ih => simp [BandWord, ih, pow_succ, mul_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_wordOperator_eq_pow
statement:
theorem sum_wordOperator_eq_pow (B : Shift → FullOp d m n) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ w : BandWord N, wordOperator B w) = (∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      change (∑ _w : Fin 1, (1 : FullOp d m n)) = 1
      have hU : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) = {0} := by
        ext w
        fin_cases w
        simp
      rw [hU]
      simp
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [show (∑ w : BandWord (N + 1), wordOperator B w) =
          ∑ delta : Shift, ∑ w : BandWord N, wordOperator B w * B delta by
        simp [BandWord, wordOperator, Fintype.sum_prod_type]]
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ih, pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_forward_le
statement:
theorem nextGrade_forward_le {delta : Shift} {nu mu : ℕ}
    (h : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) : mu ≤ nu + 2
proof:
:= by
  cases delta with
  | plus => simp [nextGrade] at h; omega
  | zero => simp [nextGrade] at h; omega
  | minus =>
      simp only [nextGrade] at h
      split at h
      · simp at h; omega
      · simp at h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.nextGrade_backward_le
statement:
theorem nextGrade_backward_le {delta : Shift} {nu mu : ℕ}
    (h : nextGrade delta nu = some mu) : nu ≤ mu + 2
proof:
:= by
  cases delta with
  | plus => simp [nextGrade] at h; omega
  | zero => simp [nextGrade] at h; omega
  | minus =>
      simp only [nextGrade] at h
      split at h
      · simp at h; omega
      · simp at h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.startGrade_le_twice_length_of_walk_to_zero
statement:
theorem startGrade_le_twice_length_of_walk_to_zero
    {N nu : ℕ} (w : BandWord N)
    (h : walkGradeFrom nu w = some 0) : nu ≤ 2 * N
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing nu with
  | zero =>
      simpa [BandWord, walkGradeFrom] using Option.some.inj h
  | succ N ih =>
      rcases w with ⟨delta, w⟩
      simp only [walkGradeFrom] at h
      cases hnext : nextGrade delta nu with
      | none => simp [hnext] at h
      | some mu =>
          simp only [hnext, Option.bind_some] at h
          have hmu : mu ≤ 2 * N := ih w h
          have hback : nu ≤ mu + 2 := nextGrade_backward_le hnext
          omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_word_eq_zero_of_walk_ne_zero
statement:
theorem projected_word_eq_zero_of_walk_ne_zero
    (_F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {N nu : ℕ} (w : BandWord N)
    (hwalk : walkGradeFrom nu w ≠ some 0) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection nu = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing nu with
  | zero =>
      have hnu : nu ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst nu
        exact hwalk rfl
      simpa [BandWord, wordOperator] using
        (gradeProjection_mul_gradeProjection
          (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (Ne.symm hnu))
  | succ N ih =>
      rcases w with ⟨delta, w⟩
      cases hnext : nextGrade delta nu with
      | none =>
          have hz : B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu = 0 := by
            apply input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output (hhom delta) nu
            exact nextGrade_none_impossible hnext
          change gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
            (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu = 0
          calc
            gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
                (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu =
                gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  (B delta * gradeProjection nu) := by noncomm_ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hz, mul_zero]
      | some mu =>
          have hrest : walkGradeFrom mu w ≠ some 0 := by
            simpa [walkGradeFrom, hnext] using hwalk
          have ihz := ih w hrest
          have hins : gradeProjection (d := d) mu * B delta * gradeProjection nu =
              B delta * gradeProjection nu := by
            apply output_projection_of_homogeneous (hhom delta)
            exact nextGrade_compatible hnext
          change gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
            (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu = 0
          calc
            gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
                  (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu =
                gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  (B delta * gradeProjection nu) := by noncomm_ring
            _ = gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  (gradeProjection mu * B delta * gradeProjection nu) := by
                    rw [hins]
            _ =
                (gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  gradeProjection mu) * (B delta * gradeProjection nu) := by
                    noncomm_ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [ihz, zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.closed_projected_word_norm_le
statement:
theorem closed_projected_word_norm_le
    (_F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q t N nu : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    (w : BandWord N) (hlen : t + N = 2 * q)
    (hstart : nu ≤ 2 * t)
    (hwalk : walkGradeFrom nu w = some 0) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection nu‖ ≤
      beta ^ N
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing t nu with
  | zero =>
      have hnu : nu = 0 := by
        simpa [BandWord, walkGradeFrom] using Option.some.inj hwalk
      subst nu
      simpa [BandWord, wordOperator] using
        (gradeProjection_norm_le_one
          (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 0)
  | succ N ih =>
      rcases w with ⟨delta, w⟩
      cases hnext : nextGrade delta nu with
      | none => simp [walkGradeFrom, hnext] at hwalk
      | some mu =>
          have hrest : walkGradeFrom mu w = some 0 := by
            simpa [walkGradeFrom, hnext] using hwalk
          have hnuBack : nu ≤ 2 * (N + 1) :=
            startGrade_le_twice_length_of_walk_to_zero ⟨delta, w⟩ hwalk
          have hnuQ : nu ≤ 2 * q := by
            by_cases htq : t ≤ q
            · exact hstart.trans (by omega)
            · omega
          have hmuStart : mu ≤ 2 * (t + 1) := by
            have := nextGrade_forward_le hnext
            omega
          have hlen' : (t + 1) + N = 2 * q := by omega
          have ihbound := ih (t := t + 1) (nu := mu) w hlen' hmuStart hrest
          have hstep := hband delta nu hnuQ
          have hins : gradeProjection (d := d) mu * B delta * gradeProjection nu =
              B delta * gradeProjection nu := by
            apply output_projection_of_homogeneous (hhom delta)
            exact nextGrade_compatible hnext
          change ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
            (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu‖ ≤ beta ^ (N + 1)
          calc
            ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 *
                (wordOperator B w * B delta) * gradeProjection nu‖ =
                ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  (B delta * gradeProjection nu)‖ := by
                    congr 1
                    noncomm_ring
            _ = ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                  (gradeProjection mu * B delta * gradeProjection nu)‖ := by
                    rw [hins]
            _ =
                ‖(gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                    gradeProjection mu) * (B delta * gradeProjection nu)‖ := by
                  congr 1
                  noncomm_ring
            _ ≤ ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w *
                    gradeProjection mu‖ * ‖B delta * gradeProjection nu‖ :=
              norm_mul_le _ _
            _ ≤ beta ^ N * beta := by
              exact mul_le_mul ihbound hstep (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hbeta _)
            _ = beta ^ (N + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_word_norm_le
statement:
theorem projected_word_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    (w : BandWord (2 * q)) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection 0‖ ≤
      beta ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hwalk : walkGradeFrom 0 w = some 0
  · exact closed_projected_word_norm_le F B hhom hbeta hband w
      (t := 0) (by omega) (by omega) hwalk
  · rw [projected_word_eq_zero_of_walk_ne_zero F B hhom w hwalk, norm_zero]
    exact pow_nonneg hbeta _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.projected_power_norm_le
statement:
theorem projected_power_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * (∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q) *
        gradeProjection 0‖ ≤ (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hexpand :
      gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * (∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q) *
          gradeProjection 0 =
        ∑ w : BandWord (2 * q),
          gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection 0 := by
    rw [← sum_wordOperator_eq_pow]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hexpand]
  calc
    ‖∑ w : BandWord (2 * q),
        gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection 0‖ ≤
        ∑ w : BandWord (2 * q),
          ‖gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * wordOperator B w * gradeProjection 0‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _w : BandWord (2 * q), beta ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ ↦
        projected_word_norm_le F B hhom hbeta hband w
    _ = (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
      simp [mul_pow]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vacuum_diagonal_sum_le
statement:
theorem vacuum_diagonal_sum_le
    (F : Frame n d) (B : Shift → FullOp d m n)
    (hhom : ∀ delta, IsFullGradeShift delta.degree (B delta))
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖B delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      ((∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q))
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  let T : FullOp d m n := ∑ delta : Shift, B delta
  let A : FullOp d m n :=
    gradeProjection (d := d) 0 * T ^ (2 * q) * gradeProjection 0
  have hA : ‖A‖ ≤ (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
    simpa [A, T] using projected_power_norm_le F B hhom hbeta hband
  have hdiag (a : Fin d) :
      (T ^ (2 * q)) (a, vacuumPattern m n)
          (a, vacuumPattern m n) =
        A (a, vacuumPattern m n)
          (a, vacuumPattern m n) := by
    simp [A, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
      vacuumPattern_grade]
  calc
    (∑ a : Fin d,
      ((∑ delta : Shift, B delta) ^ (2 * q))
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)
        (a, vacuumPattern m n)) =
        ∑ a : Fin d, (T ^ (2 * q))
          (a, vacuumPattern m n)
          (a, vacuumPattern m n) := by rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ _a : Fin d, (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro a _ha
      rw [hdiag]
      calc
        A (a, vacuumPattern m n)
            (a, vacuumPattern m n) ≤
            |A (a, vacuumPattern m n)
              (a, vacuumPattern m n)| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ‖A‖ := by
          simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using abs_apply_le_specNorm A _ _
        _ ≤ (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := hA
    _ = (d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ}
    (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand m F b delta * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (iidLaw b hb m n).expect
        (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace ((iidGramError b F omega) ^
          (2 * q))) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vacuum_moment_identity_bands hb F (2 * q)]
  exact vacuum_diagonal_sum_le F (normalizedBand m F b)
    (fun delta ↦ normalizedBand_homogeneous F b delta) hbeta hband

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.norm_three_le
statement:
private theorem norm_three_le (A B C : FullOp d m n) :
    ‖A + B + C‖ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + ‖C‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖A + B + C‖ ≤ ‖A + B‖ + ‖C‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖A‖ + ‖B‖) + ‖C‖ := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_add_le _ _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_plus_mul_projection
statement:
private theorem normalizedBand_plus_mul_projection
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    normalizedBand m F b .plus * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      ((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a)) * gradeProjection nu +
      ((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a) + Yplus m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a)))) *
            gradeProjection nu +
      ((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 • Hplus m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a))) *
          gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedBand, band_plus_named]
  simp only [smul_add, add_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_zero_mul_projection
statement:

        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xzero m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a) + XzeroAdj m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a) +
            Yzero m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a) + YzeroAdj m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a)))) *
              gradeProjection nu +
      ((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 • Hzero m (fun i a ↦ F.u i a))) *
          gradeProjection nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.normalizedBand_minus_mul_projection
statement:
private theorem normalizedBand_minus_mul_projection

    normalizedBand m F b .minus * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.plus_band_envelope_of_components
statement:
theorem plus_band_envelope_of_components
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) {a c : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlight :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ a + bTerm d nu m)
    (hmixed :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + Yplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ bTerm d nu m + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * c)
    (hheavy :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 • Hplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ c)
    (hbTerm : 0 ≤ bTerm d nu m) :
    ‖normalizedBand m F b .plus * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant * (a + bTerm d nu m + c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedBand_plus_mul_projection]
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) * gradeProjection nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + Yplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
            gradeProjection nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
          Hplus m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) * gradeProjection nu‖ := norm_three_le _ _ _
    _ ≤ (a + bTerm d nu m) +
        (bTerm d nu m + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * c) + c := by linarith
    _ = a + 2 * bTerm d nu m + (5 / 2 : ℝ) * c := by ring
    _ ≤ bandConstant * (a + bTerm d nu m + c) :=
      plus_row_envelope ha hbTerm hc

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zero_band_envelope_of_components
statement:
theorem zero_band_envelope_of_components
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlight :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ 3 * bTerm d nu m)
    (hmixed :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
        (Xzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + XzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) +
          Yzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + YzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bTerm d nu m + (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * c)
    (hheavy :
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
        Hzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ 2 * c)
    (hbTerm : 0 ≤ bTerm d nu m) (ha : 0 ≤ aTerm d nu m) :
    ‖normalizedBand m F b .zero * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandConstant * (aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m + c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedBand_zero_mul_projection]
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)) * gradeProjection nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + XzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) +
            Yzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x) + YzeroAdj m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x)))) *
              gradeProjection nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 •
          Hzero m (fun i x ↦ F.u i x))) * gradeProjection nu‖ := norm_three_le _ _ _
    _ ≤ 3 * bTerm d nu m +
        (bTerm d nu m + (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * c) + 2 * c := by linarith
    _ = 4 * bTerm d nu m + (3 + Real.sqrt 2) * c := by ring
    _ ≤ bandConstant * (aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m + c) :=
      zero_row_envelope ha hbTerm hc

statement:

    _ ≤ (a + bTerm d nu m) +
