name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s
statement:
theorem rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s {s b : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by positivity
  rw [sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb, Nat.cast_mul]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hsR hbR) hsR).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_div_stack_le_inv_s
statement:
theorem rho_div_stack_le_inv_s {s b : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by positivity
  have hrho0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hrhoSq := sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb
  have hrhoLe : Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ≤ (b : ℝ) := by
    have hbTwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
    nlinarith
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hsR hbR) hsR).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_div_stack_nonneg
statement:
theorem rho_div_stack_nonneg {s b : ℕ} :
    0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rho_sq_div_stack_nonneg
statement:
theorem rho_sq_div_stack_nonneg {s b : ℕ} :
    0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_plus_absorb
statement:
theorem mixed_plus_absorb {s b d nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1))) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          (nu : ℝ) / s)
proof:
:= by
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by positivity
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnu : (0 : ℝ) ≤ nu := by positivity
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) + nu + 1 := by positivity
  have hh : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) - 1 := by
    have hbOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hb)
    linarith
  have hsqrtMul :
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) *
          Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) =
        Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hnu]
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hh]
    ring
  have hamgm := mixed_product_into_envelope
    (show 0 ≤ ((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ) by positivity) hD
  have hheavy :
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) / s := by
    have hcoef := rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s hs hb
    rw [sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb] at hcoef
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hnu
    calc
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (nu : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) := hmul
      _ = (nu : ℝ) / s := by ring
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) =
        (Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← hsqrtMul]
      ring
    _ ≤ ((((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) + ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) /
        2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hamgm hmR.le
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          (nu : ℝ) / s) := by
      have hsum := add_le_add_right hheavy
        (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)))
      calc
        ((((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) + ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) /
            2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
                (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
          ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            (((d : ℝ) + nu + 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
              (nu : ℝ) / s) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mixed_zero_absorb
statement:
theorem mixed_zero_absorb {s b d nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    2 * (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))) ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnu : (0 : ℝ) ≤ nu := by positivity
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) + nu := by positivity
  have hh : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) - 1 := by
    have hbOne : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hb)
    linarith
  have hsqrtMul :
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) *
          Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu)) =
        Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + nu) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hnu]
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hh]
    ring
  have hamgm := mixed_product_into_envelope
    (show 0 ≤ ((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ) by positivity) hD
  have hcoef := rho_sq_div_stack_le_inv_s hs hb
  rw [sq_sqrt_b_sub_one hb] at hcoef
  have hheavy :
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) / s := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hnu
    calc
      (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (nu : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) := hmul
      _ = (nu : ℝ) / s := by ring
  calc
    2 * (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))) =
        (2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          (Real.sqrt (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) *
            Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + nu))) := by
      rw [← hsqrtMul]
      ring
    _ ≤ (2 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ((((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ) + ((d : ℝ) + nu)) / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hamgm (by positivity)
    _ = (((b : ℝ) - 1) * (nu : ℝ)) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) / s := by
      linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.directional_absorb
statement:
theorem directional_absorb {s b nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hcoef := rho_div_stack_le_inv_s hs hb
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) ≤
        (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = (nu : ℝ) / s := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.iidColumnSampleLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iidColumnSampleLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).weight Y =
      ∏ i, (nestedYLaw hb s).weight (Y i)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.iidColumnSampleLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
statement:
theorem iidColumnSampleLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
    (hb : 0 < b) (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).weight Y =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight (toYArray Y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [iidColumnSampleLaw_weight, nestedYLaw_weight,
    iidArrayLaw_weight, toYArray]
  calc
    (∏ i : Fin n, ∏ g : Fin s, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (Y i g)) =
        ∏ g : Fin s, ∏ i : Fin n, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (Y i g) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_comm]
    _ = ∏ z : Fin s × Fin n, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (Y z.2 z.1) := by
      rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.iidColumnSampleLaw_expect_toYArray_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
statement:
theorem iidColumnSampleLaw_expect_toYArray_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
    (hb : 0 < b) (f : YArray b s n → ℝ) :
    (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).expect (fun Y => f (toYArray Y)) =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (iidColumnSampleEquiv (b := b) (s := s) (n := n))
  intro Y
  rw [iidColumnSampleLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight hb Y]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatYVector_apply (Y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatYVector Y r = flatYValue Y r
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledFlatYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem exactScaledFlatYVector_apply (hb : 0 < b)
    (Y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    exactScaledFlatYVector hb Y r =
      exactScale (s := s) hb * flatYValue Y r
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYVector_inner_eq_sum_blocks
statement:
theorem flatYVector_inner_eq_sum_blocks (Y Z : NestedY b s) :
    inner ℝ (flatYVector Y) (flatYVector Z) =
      ∑ g, inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y g)) (unscaledYVector (Z g))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply, flatYVector_apply,
    unscaledYVector_apply, flatYValue]
  calc
    (∑ r : Fin (s * b),
        yValue (flatOutcome Y r) * yValue (flatOutcome Z r)) =
        ∑ ga : Fin s × Fin b,
          yValue (flatOutcome Y (finProdFinEquiv ga)) *
            yValue (flatOutcome Z (finProdFinEquiv ga)) := by
      exact (finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp (fun r : Fin (s * b) =>
        yValue (flatOutcome Y r) * yValue (flatOutcome Z r))).symm
    _ = ∑ g : Fin s, ∑ a : Fin b,
          yValue (Y g a) * yValue (Z g a) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [flatOutcome_pair]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledFlatYVector_inner
statement:
theorem exactScaledFlatYVector_inner (hb : 0 < b)
    (Y Z : NestedY b s) :
    inner ℝ (exactScaledFlatYVector hb Y) (exactScaledFlatYVector hb Z) =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 * inner ℝ (flatYVector Y) (flatYVector Z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply,
    exactScaledFlatYVector_apply, flatYVector_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    exactScaledIIDError hb F Y =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 • iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_symmetric
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_symmetric (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (exactScaledIIDError hb F Y).transpose = exactScaledIIDError hb F Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul]
  ext a c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
  have h := congrFun (congrFun
    (iidVectorError_symmetric F (toYArray Y)) a) c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
  rw [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.groupedExactError_eq_hollow
statement:
theorem groupedExactError_eq_hollow (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) :
    groupedExactError F X = UniformSparse.hollowGram F X
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [groupedExactError, UniformSparse.hollowGram]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have hrows :
    (∑ g : Fin s, ∑ q : Fin b,
        UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, q)) *
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, q))) =
        ∑ z : Fin s × Fin b,
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv z) *
            UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv z) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  calc
    (∑ g : Fin s, ∑ q : Fin b,
        UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, q)) *
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, q))) * F.u i a * F.u j c =
        (∑ z : Fin s × Fin b,
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv z) *
            UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv z)) * F.u i a * F.u j c := by
      rw [hrows]
    _ = (∑ r : Fin (s * b),
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) * F.u i a * F.u j
              c := by
      rw [finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp (fun r : Fin (s * b) =>
        UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) (a c : Fin d) :
    exactScaledIIDError hb F Y a c =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (∑ g, exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 *
          inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g))
            (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) * F.u i a * F.u j c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [exactScaledIIDError, iidVectorError, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul, toYArray]
  ring_nf
  have hreorder :
      (∑ g : Fin s, ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g)) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (∑ g : Fin s,
          inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hreorder]
  have hfactor :
      (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (∑ g : Fin s, exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 *
            inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c) =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (∑ g : Fin s,
            inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) *
            F.u i a * F.u j c := by
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  rw [hfactor]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactColumnWeight_pos
statement:
theorem exactColumnWeight_pos {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    0 < (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :=
    exactColumnNonempty (le_rows (s := s) hb)
  rw [uniformSparseColumnLaw]
  change 0 < 1 / (Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) : ℝ)
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalYLaw_weight {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) /
        (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumn_disintegrates
statement:
theorem jointColumn_disintegrates {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y
proof:
:= by
  rw [UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_weight]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (exactColumnWeight_pos hb x)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_mixture
statement:
theorem conditionalYLaw_mixture {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (∑ x, (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
      (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight y) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← UniformSparse.jointColumn_disintegrates hb hs y]
  exact jointColumn_y_marginal hb hs y

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_transform
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi (transformColumn pi eps x) =
      supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi (transformColumn pi eps x) =
        ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (y, transformColumn pi eps x) * phi (totalSupport y) := rfl
    _ = ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (transformY pi eps y, transformColumn pi eps x) *
            phi (totalSupport (transformY pi eps y)) := by
      exact ((transformYEquiv pi eps).sum_comp
        (fun y => (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (y, transformColumn pi eps x) * phi (totalSupport y))).symm
    _ = ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
          phi (totalSupport y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      rw [jointColumnLaw_weight_transform hb hs, totalSupport_transformY]
    _ = supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_constant
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_constant {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x = supportFiberMoment hb hs phi z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pi, eps, h⟩ := exists_transformColumn_eq x z
  rw [← h, supportFiberMoment_transform]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_supportFiberMoment
statement:
theorem sum_supportFiberMoment {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
  calc
    (∑ x, supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x) =
        ∑ y, ∑ x, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
          phi (totalSupport y) := by
      simp only [supportFiberMoment]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ y, (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y * phi (totalSupport y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, jointColumn_y_marginal]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect
statement:
theorem supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :=
    exactColumnNonempty (le_rows (s := s) hb)
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
  have hconst : ∀ z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
      supportFiberMoment hb hs phi z = supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x :=
    fun z => supportFiberMoment_constant hb hs phi z x
  have hN : N * supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y)) := by
    calc
      N * supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
          ∑ _z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
            supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x := by simp [N]
      _ = ∑ z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
          supportFiberMoment hb hs phi z := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro z _
        exact (hconst z).symm
      _ = _ := sum_supportFiberMoment hb hs phi
  rw [uniformSparseColumnLaw]
  change supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
    (1 / N) * (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [N]
    positivity
  calc
    supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x =
        (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y)) / N := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hN0).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using hN
    _ = (1 / N) *
        (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y)) := by
      field_simp [hN0]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_expect_supportFunction
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_supportFunction {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (phi : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y)) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => phi (totalSupport y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
  simp only [UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  change supportFiberMoment hb hs phi x /
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x = _
  rw [supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect hb hs]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (exactColumnWeight_pos hb x)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_expect_minSupport
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_minSupport {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect
      (fun y => (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)) =
      (s : ℝ) * couplingA (s := s) hb
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect
        (fun y => (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)) =
        (nestedYLaw hb s).expect
          (fun y => (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)) := by
      exact conditional_expect_supportFunction hb hs
        (fun k => (min k s : ℝ)) x
    _ = (s : ℝ) * couplingA (s := s) hb := by
      rw [couplingA]
      have hsR : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hs
      field_simp [hsR]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_congr_column
statement:
theorem compatible_congr_column {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    Compatible y x ↔ Compatible y z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold Compatible
  split_ifs with hlarge
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hmatch⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [← hsupport] using hsub
      · intro r hr
        have hrx : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [hsupport] using hr
        simpa [← hsign r hrx] using hmatch r hrx
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hmatch⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [hsupport] using hsub
      · intro r hr
        have hrz : r ∈ (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [← hsupport] using hr
        simpa [hsign r hr] using hmatch r hrz
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hmatch⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [← hsupport] using hsub
      · intro r hr
        have hrx := hsub hr
        simpa [← hsign r hrx] using hmatch r hr
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hmatch⟩
      constructor
      · simpa [hsupport] using hsub
      · intro r hr
        have hrx : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          have : r ∈ (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := hsub hr
          simpa [← hsupport] using this
        simpa [hsign r hrx] using hmatch r hr

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_congr_column
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_congr_column {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x =
      (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight z
proof:
:= by
  have hc := compatible_congr_column y x z hsupport hsign
  by_cases hxy : Compatible y x
  · have hyz := hc.mp hxy
    rw [selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible hb hs _ _ hxy,
      selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible hb hs _ _ hyz]
  · have hyz : ¬ Compatible y z := by simpa [hc] using hxy
    rw [selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible hb hs _ _ hxy,
      selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible hb hs _ _ hyz]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_congr_column
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_congr_column {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
      (z.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (hsign : ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))), x.2 r = z.2 r) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, z)
proof:
:= by
  change (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y * (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x =
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y * (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight z
  rw [selectionKernel_weight_congr_column hb hs y x z hsupport hsign]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw_eq_rawSampleLaw
statement:
theorem selectorArrayLaw_eq_rawSampleLaw (hb : 0 < b) :
    selectorArrayLaw hb s n = sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorVector_eq_signedBasis
statement:
theorem selectorVector_eq_signedBasis (x : XArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (i : Fin n) :
    selectorVector (x (g, i)) = signedBasis (toSample x) g i
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [selectorVector, signedBasis_apply, toSample_hash, toSample_sign]
  by_cases h : a = (x (g, i)).1
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseVectorError_eq_gramError
statement:
theorem sparseVectorError_eq_gramError (hs : 0 < s)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    sparseVectorError F x = gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramError_eq_block_first F (toSample x) hs]
  ext a c
  simp only [sparseVectorError, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [selectorVector_eq_signedBasis, selectorVector_eq_signedBasis]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flattenY_apply_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem flattenY_apply_pair (y : YArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) (i : Fin n) :
    flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), i) = y (g, i) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [flattenY]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_weight_eq_iidLaw_weight
statement:
theorem iidArrayLaw_weight_eq_iidLaw_weight (hb : 1 < b)
    (y : YArray b s n) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).weight y =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).weight (flattenY y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iidArrayLaw_weight, iidLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [yVectorLaw_weight (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_prod_type'
    (fun z : Fin s × Fin n ↦ fun a : Fin b ↦
      mass b (y z a))]
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv (nestedSiteEquiv s b n)
  intro z
  rcases z with ⟨⟨g, i⟩, a⟩
  simp [nestedSiteEquiv, flattenY_apply_pair]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_expect_flatten_eq_iidLaw_expect
statement:
theorem iidArrayLaw_expect_flatten_eq_iidLaw_expect (hb : 1 < b)
    (f : Configuration (s * b) n → ℝ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ f (flattenY y)) =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (flattenYEquiv s b n)
  intro y
  rw [iidArrayLaw_weight_eq_iidLaw_weight hb y]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.eta_eq_sqrt_mul_yValue
statement:
theorem eta_eq_sqrt_mul_yValue (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    eta b z = Real.sqrt b * yValue z
proof:
:= by
  cases z <;> simp [eta, yValue]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_eta_flatten_product
statement:
theorem sum_eta_flatten_product (_hb : 0 < b) (y : YArray b s n)
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    (∑ a : Fin b,
      eta b (flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), i)) *
        eta b (flattenY y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a), j))) =
      (b : ℝ) * inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (y (g, i)))
        (unscaledYVector (y (g, j)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [flattenY_apply_pair, eta_eq_sqrt_mul_yValue,
    PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply, unscaledYVector_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  have hsqrt := sq_sqrt_nat b
  calc
    Real.sqrt b * yValue (y (g, i) a) *
        (Real.sqrt b * yValue (y (g, j) a)) =
        (Real.sqrt b) ^ 2 *
          (yValue (y (g, i) a) * yValue (y (g, j) a)) := by ring
    _ = (b : ℝ) *
          (yValue (y (g, i) a) * yValue (y (g, j) a)) := by rw [hsqrt]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidVectorError_eq_flattened_iidGramError
statement:
theorem iidVectorError_eq_flattened_iidGramError
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (y : YArray b s n) :
    iidVectorError F y = iidGramError b F (flattenY y)
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [iidVectorError, iidGramError, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsR : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hs)
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  let C : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun i j ↦ F.u i a * F.u j c
  let E : Fin (s * b) → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun r i j ↦
    etaCoordinate b (r, i) (flattenY y) *
      etaCoordinate b (r, j) (flattenY y)
  let Y : Fin s → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ := fun g i j ↦
    inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (y (g, i))) (unscaledYVector (y (g, j)))
  have hrow (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
      (∑ q : Fin b, E (finProdFinEquiv (g, q)) i j) = (b : ℝ) * Y g i j := by
    simpa [E, Y, etaCoordinate] using sum_eta_flatten_product
      (b := b) (n := n) (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) y g i j
  have hreindex :
      (∑ r : Fin (s * b), ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        E r i j * C i j) =
      (b : ℝ) * ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        Y g i j * C i j := by
    calc
      (∑ r : Fin (s * b), ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          E r i j * C i j) =
          ∑ ga : Fin s × Fin b, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            E (finProdFinEquiv ga) i j * C i j := by
        exact (finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp
          (fun r : Fin (s * b) ↦ ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            E r i j * C i j)).symm
      _ = ∑ g, ∑ q, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            E (finProdFinEquiv (g, q)) i j * C i j := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      _ = ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            (∑ q, E (finProdFinEquiv (g, q)) i j) * C i j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g _
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            ((b : ℝ) * Y g i j) * C i j := by
        simp_rw [hrow]
      _ = (b : ℝ) * ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            Y g i j * C i j := by
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
  change (1 / (s : ℝ)) *
      ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, Y g i j * C i j =
    (1 / ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, E r i j * C i j
  rw [hreindex]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod
statement:
theorem nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y =
      ∏ r : Fin (s * b), mass b (flatOutcome y r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestedYLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [yVectorLaw_weight]
  calc
    (∏ g : Fin s, ∏ a : Fin b, mass b (y g a)) =
        ∏ ga : Fin s × Fin b, mass b (y ga.1 ga.2) :=
      (Fintype.prod_prod_type
        (fun ga : Fin s × Fin b => mass b (y ga.1 ga.2))).symm
    _ = ∏ ga : Fin s × Fin b,
        mass b (flatOutcome y (finProdFinEquiv ga)) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro ga _
      rw [flatOutcome_pair]
    _ = ∏ r : Fin (s * b), mass b (flatOutcome y r) :=
      finProdFinEquiv.prod_comp
        (fun r : Fin (s * b) => mass b (flatOutcome y r))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight_transformY
statement:
theorem nestedYLaw_weight_transformY {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight (transformY pi eps y) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod hb, nestedYLaw_weight_eq_flat_prod hb]
  simp_rw [flatOutcome_transformY, mass_actOutcome]
  exact pi.symm.prod_comp
    (fun r : Fin (s * b) => mass b (flatOutcome y r))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatSupport_transformY
statement:
theorem flatSupport_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    flatSupport (transformY pi eps y) =
      (flatSupport y).map pi.toEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp [flatSupport, flatOutcome_transformY]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.totalSupport_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem totalSupport_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    totalSupport (transformY pi eps y) = totalSupport y
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalSupport, totalSupport, flatSupport_transformY]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_transform_iff
statement:
theorem compatible_transform_iff {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    Compatible (transformY pi eps y) (transformColumn pi eps x) ↔
      Compatible y x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Compatible, Compatible, totalSupport_transformY]
  split_ifs with hlarge
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
      constructor
      · intro r hr
        have hmap : pi r ∈
            ((transformColumn pi eps x).1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [transformColumn] using hr
        have hy := hsub hmap
        simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hy
      · intro r hr
        have hmap : pi r ∈
            ((transformColumn pi eps x).1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [transformColumn] using hr
        have hs := hsign (pi r) hmap
        have hs' := congrArg (actOutcome (eps (pi r))) hs
        simpa [flatOutcome_transformY, transformColumn] using hs'
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
      constructor
      · intro r hr
        have hr' : pi.symm r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [transformColumn] using hr
        have hy := hsub hr'
        simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hy
      · intro r hr
        have hr' : pi.symm r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) := by
          simpa [transformColumn] using hr
        have hs := hsign (pi.symm r) hr'
        simpa [flatOutcome_transformY, transformColumn] using
          congrArg (actOutcome (eps r)) hs
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
      constructor
      · intro r hr
        have hmap : pi r ∈ flatSupport (transformY pi eps y) := by
          simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hr
        have hx := hsub hmap
        simpa [transformColumn] using hx
      · intro r hr
        have hmap : pi r ∈ flatSupport (transformY pi eps y) := by
          simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hr
        have hs := hsign (pi r) hmap
        have hs' := congrArg (actOutcome (eps (pi r))) hs
        simpa [flatOutcome_transformY, transformColumn] using hs'
    · rintro ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
      constructor
      · intro r hr
        have hr' : pi.symm r ∈ flatSupport y := by
          simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hr
        have hx := hsub hr'
        simpa [transformColumn] using hx
      · intro r hr
        have hr' : pi.symm r ∈ flatSupport y := by
          simpa [flatSupport_transformY] using hr
        have hs := hsign (pi.symm r) hr'
        simpa [flatOutcome_transformY, transformColumn] using
          congrArg (actOutcome (eps r)) hs

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hxy : Compatible y x) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x =
      1 / (Nat.card (ChoiceColumn y) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty (ChoiceColumn y) := choiceColumn_nonempty hb hs y
  let c : ChoiceColumn y := ⟨x, hxy⟩
  rw [UniformSparse.selectionKernel, FiniteLaw.map_weight,
    Finset.sum_eq_single c]
  · rw [if_pos (by rfl)]
    change 1 / (Fintype.card (ChoiceColumn y) : ℝ) =
        1 / (Nat.card (ChoiceColumn y) : ℝ)
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  · intro z _ hz
    have hne : (z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) ≠ x := by
      intro h
      apply hz
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact h
    simp [hne]
  · simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
    (hxy : ¬ Compatible y x) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty (ChoiceColumn y) := choiceColumn_nonempty hb hs y
  rw [UniformSparse.selectionKernel, FiniteLaw.map_weight]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro z _
  have hne : (z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) ≠ x := by
    intro h
    apply hxy
    simpa [h] using z.prop
  simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.choiceColumn_card_transform
statement:
theorem choiceColumn_card_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    Nat.card (ChoiceColumn (transformY pi eps y)) =
      Nat.card (ChoiceColumn y)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.card_congr (transformChoiceEquiv pi eps y)).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.selectionKernel_weight_transform
statement:
theorem selectionKernel_weight_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs (transformY pi eps y)).weight
        (transformColumn pi eps x) =
      (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : Compatible y x
  · have ht : Compatible (transformY pi eps y)
        (transformColumn pi eps x) :=
      (compatible_transform_iff pi eps y x).2 hxy
    rw [selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible hb hs _ _ ht,
      selectionKernel_weight_of_compatible hb hs _ _ hxy,
      choiceColumn_card_transform]
  · have ht : ¬ Compatible (transformY pi eps y)
        (transformColumn pi eps x) := by
      simpa [compatible_transform_iff pi eps y x] using hxy
    rw [selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible hb hs _ _ ht,
      selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible hb hs _ _ hxy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue_outcomeOfSign
statement:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.negateOutcome_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem negateOutcome_involutive (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    negateOutcome (negateOutcome z) = z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yValue_negateOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem yValue_negateOutcome (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    yValue (negateOutcome z) = -yValue z
proof: := by cases z <;> norm_num [yValue, negateOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipSign_involutive
statement: @[simp] theorem flipSign_involutive (e : Sign) : flipSign (flipSign e) = e
proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem yVectorLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y = ∏ a, mass b (y a)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mem_support
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_support {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    a ∈ support y ↔ y a ≠ .zero
proof: := by simp [support]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem supportSize_eq_zero_iff {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize y = 0 ↔ y = zeroY b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply funext
    intro a
    have hempty : support y = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp h
    have hnot : a ∉ support y := by simp [hempty]
    have : ¬y a ≠ .zero := by simpa [mem_support] using hnot
    simpa [zeroY] using not_ne_iff.mp this
  · rintro rfl
    simp [supportSize, support, zeroY]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zeroY_weight
statement:
theorem zeroY_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (zeroY b) = p0 b
proof:
:= by
  simp [yVectorLaw_weight, zeroY, mass, p0]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_nonneg
statement: theorem p0_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 ≤ p0 b
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hbase : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 1 / (b : ℝ) := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < b)).2 hbR
  exact pow_nonneg hbase _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_lt_one
statement: theorem p0_lt_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : p0 b < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hbase0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 1 / (b : ℝ) := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    exact (div_le_one hbR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hb)
  have hbase1 : (1 : ℝ) - 1 / (b : ℝ) < 1 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (b : ℝ) := one_div_pos.mpr hbR
    linarith
  exact pow_lt_one₀ hbase0 hbase1 (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.p0_le_exp_neg_one
statement:
theorem p0_le_exp_neg_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    p0 b ≤ Real.exp (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1b : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
  simpa [p0] using
    (Real.one_sub_div_pow_le_exp_neg (n := b) (t := (1 : ℝ)) h1b)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.one_sub_p0_pos
statement: theorem one_sub_p0_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < 1 - p0 b
proof:
:= by
  linarith [p0_lt_one hb]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.one_le_cB
statement: theorem one_le_cB {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : 1 ≤ cB b
proof:
:= by
  rw [cB, one_le_inv₀ (one_sub_p0_pos hb)]
  linarith [p0_nonneg hb]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cB_le_cStar
statement: theorem cB_le_cStar {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : cB b ≤ convexOrderConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [cB, convexOrderConstant]
  apply inv_anti₀ expGap_pos
  linarith [p0_le_exp_neg_one hb]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_nonneg {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) : 0 ≤ kernelWeight hb y x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : supportSize y = 0
  · simp [kernelWeight, hzero, (selectorLaw b hb).weight_nonneg x]
  · by_cases hmatch : selectorMatches y x
    · simp [kernelWeight, hzero, hmatch]
    · simp [kernelWeight, hzero, hmatch]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_kernelWeight
statement:
theorem sum_kernelWeight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    ∑ x, kernelWeight hb y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : supportSize y = 0
  · simp [kernelWeight, hzero, (selectorLaw b hb).sum_weight]
  · rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [kernelWeight, hzero, ↓reduceIte]
    have sign_univ : (Finset.univ : Finset Sign) = {.plus, .minus} := by
      ext e
      cases e <;> simp
    have hsign (a : Fin b) :
        (∑ e : Sign, if selectorMatches y (a, e)
          then 1 / (supportSize y : ℝ) else 0) =
          if a ∈ support y then 1 / (supportSize y : ℝ) else 0 := by
      cases hya : y a <;>
        simp [sign_univ, selectorMatches, outcomeOfSign, support, hya]
    simp_rw [hsign]
    have hreindex :
        (∑ a, if a ∈ support y then 1 / (supportSize y : ℝ) else 0) =
          ∑ a ∈ support y, 1 / (supportSize y : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter] using
        (Finset.sum_filter (s := Finset.univ)
          (p := fun a => a ∈ support y)
          (f := fun _ => 1 / (supportSize y : ℝ))).symm
    rw [hreindex]
    have hcard : ((support y).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (support y).card ≠ 0 by simpa [supportSize] using hzero)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, supportSize]
    field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectionKernel_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectionKernel_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (selectionKernel hb y).weight x = kernelWeight hb y x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumnLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem jointColumnLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) =
      (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y * kernelWeight hb y x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.mass_negateOutcome
statement:
theorem mass_negateOutcome (b : ℕ) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b (negateOutcome z) = mass b z

:= by
  cases z <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.negateY_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem negateY_involutive {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_negateY

theorem yVectorLaw_weight_negateY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (negateY y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.support_negateY

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_negateY
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_negateY {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_negateY
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_negateY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    kernelWeight hb (negateY y) (a, flipSign e) = kernelWeight hb y (a, e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases e <;> cases h : y a <;>
    simp [kernelWeight, supportSize_negateY, selectorMatches, negateY,
      flipSign, outcomeOfSign, negateOutcome, h, selectorLaw]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.swapY_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem swapY_involutive {b : ℕ} (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    swapY a c (swapY a c y) = y
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp [swapY]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_swapY
statement:
theorem yVectorLaw_weight_swapY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (swapY a c y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yVectorLaw_weight, swapY]
  exact Function.Bijective.prod_comp (Equiv.swap a c).bijective
    (fun k => mass b (y k))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_eq_sum
statement:
theorem supportSize_eq_sum {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize y = ∑ a, if y a = .zero then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supportSize, support]
  symm
  simpa using
    (Finset.sum_boole (R := ℕ) (fun a : Fin b => y a ≠ .zero) Finset.univ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_swapY
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_swapY {b : ℕ} (a c : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize (swapY a c y) = supportSize y
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportSize_eq_sum, supportSize_eq_sum]
  change (∑ k, if y (Equiv.swap a c k) = .zero then 0 else 1) =
    ∑ k, if y k = .zero then 0 else 1
  exact Function.Bijective.sum_comp (Equiv.swap a c).bijective
    (fun k => if y k = .zero then 0 else 1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_swapY
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_swapY {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (a c : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    kernelWeight hb (swapY a c y) (c, e) = kernelWeight hb y (a, e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases e <;> cases h : y a <;>
    simp [kernelWeight, supportSize_swapY, selectorMatches, swapY,
      outcomeOfSign, h, selectorLaw]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_swap
statement:
theorem xMarginal_swap {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a c : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    xMarginal hb (c, e) = xMarginal hb (a, e)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    xMarginal hb (c, e) = ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (c, e)) := rfl
    _ = ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (swapY a c y, (c, e)) := by
      exact ((swapYEquiv a c).sum_comp
        (fun y => (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (c, e)))).symm
    _ = ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (a, e)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      rw [jointColumnLaw_weight, jointColumnLaw_weight,
        yVectorLaw_weight_swapY hb a c y, kernelWeight_swapY hb y a c e]
    _ = xMarginal hb (a, e) := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_flip
statement:
theorem xMarginal_flip {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (a : Fin b) (e : Sign) :
    xMarginal hb (a, flipSign e) = xMarginal hb (a, e)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    xMarginal hb (a, flipSign e) =
        ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (a, flipSign e)) := rfl
    _ = ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (negateY y, (a, flipSign e)) := by
      exact ((negateYEquiv b).sum_comp
        (fun y => (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (a, flipSign e)))).symm
    _ = ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, (a, e)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      rw [jointColumnLaw_weight, jointColumnLaw_weight,
        yVectorLaw_weight_negateY hb y, kernelWeight_negateY hb y a e]
    _ = xMarginal hb (a, e) := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_constant
statement:
theorem xMarginal_constant {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x z : SignedHash b) :
    xMarginal hb x = xMarginal hb z
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨a, e⟩
  rcases z with ⟨c, f⟩
  cases e <;> cases f
  · exact (xMarginal_swap hb a c .plus).symm
  · exact (xMarginal_swap hb a c .plus).symm.trans
      (by simpa [flipSign] using (xMarginal_flip hb c .plus).symm)
  · exact (xMarginal_swap hb a c .minus).symm.trans
      (by simpa [flipSign] using xMarginal_flip hb c .plus)
  · exact (xMarginal_swap hb a c .minus).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sum_xMarginal
statement:
theorem sum_xMarginal {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∑ x, xMarginal hb x = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ x, xMarginal hb x) =
        ∑ y, ∑ x, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) := by
      simp only [xMarginal]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ z : YVector b × SignedHash b, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight z := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = 1 := (jointColumnLaw hb).sum_weight

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight
statement:
theorem xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    xMarginal hb x = (selectorLaw b hb).weight x
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ∀ z : SignedHash b, xMarginal hb z = xMarginal hb x :=
    fun z => xMarginal_constant hb z x
  have hcard : Fintype.card (SignedHash b) = 2 * b := by
    simp [SignedHash, Fintype.card_prod, card_sign,
      Nat.mul_comm]
  have hsum : (2 * (b : ℝ)) * xMarginal hb x = 1 := by
    calc
      (2 * (b : ℝ)) * xMarginal hb x =
          (Fintype.card (SignedHash b) : ℝ) * xMarginal hb x := by
        rw [hcard]
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = ∑ z : SignedHash b, xMarginal hb x := by simp
      _ = ∑ z : SignedHash b, xMarginal hb z := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro z _hz
        exact (hconst z).symm
      _ = 1 := sum_xMarginal hb
  have hbR : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)
  rw [selectorLaw]
  dsimp
  apply (eq_div_iff (by positivity : (2 * (b : ℝ)) ≠ 0)).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_minFiber
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_minFiber {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) =
      supportFiberMoment hb hs (fun k => (min k s : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [supportFiberMoment]
  simp only [coordinateFiberMoment]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  by_cases hxy : Compatible y x
  · have hoverlap := compatible_inner_eq_min hxy
    calc
      (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r *
          ((UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) * flatYValue y r)) =
          (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
            (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * flatYValue y r) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r _
        ring
      _ = (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
          (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ) := by rw [hoverlap]
  · have hk := selectionKernel_weight_of_not_compatible hb hs y x hxy
    have hj : (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) = 0 := by
      change (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y * (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x = 0
      rw [hk, mul_zero]
    simp [hj]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        ((s : ℝ) * couplingA (s := s) hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_minFiber hb hs]
  rw [supportFiberMoment_eq_weight_mul_expect hb hs]
  congr 1
  rw [couplingA]
  have hsR : (s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hs
  field_simp [hsR]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_s_mul_active
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_s_mul_active {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    (∑ t, UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t) =
      (s : ℝ) * (UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hterm (t : Fin (s * b)) :
      UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t =
        if t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) then
          UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r
        else 0 := by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))
    · rw [if_pos ht]
      exact (aligned_coordinateFiberMoment_eq hb hs x r t hr ht).symm
    · rw [if_neg ht]
      have ht' : t ∉ x.1 := fun h =>
        ht (Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mpr h)
      rw [columnValue_of_notMem x ht', zero_mul]
  calc
    (∑ t : Fin (s * b),
        UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t) =
        ∑ t : Fin (s * b),
        if t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) then
          UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t _
      exact hterm t
    _ =
        ((x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))).card : ℝ) *
          (UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) := by simp
    _ = (s : ℝ) *
        (UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) := by
      rw [x.1.prop]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.active_aligned_moment_value
statement:
theorem active_aligned_moment_value {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        couplingA (s := s) hb
proof:
:= by
  have hsum1 := weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq hb hs x
  have hsum2 := weighted_coordinateFiberMoment_eq_s_mul_active hb hs x r hr
  rw [hsum2] at hsum1
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
        couplingA (s := s) hb * UniformSparseColumn.value x r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))
  · have hr' : r ∈ x.1 := Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp hr
    have ha := active_aligned_moment_value hb hs x r hr
    rw [columnValue_of_mem x hr'] at ha ⊢
    calc
      coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
          1 * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r := by ring
      _ = (x.2 r).val ^ 2 * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r := by
        rw [Sign.val_sq]
      _ = ((x.2 r).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) *
          (x.2 r).val := by ring
      _ = ((uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
          couplingA (s := s) hb) * (x.2 r).val := by rw [ha]
      _ = _ := by ring
  · have hr' : r ∉ x.1 := fun h =>
        hr (Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mpr h)
    rw [coordinateFiberMoment_off hb hs x r hr,
      columnValue_of_notMem x hr', mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter_coordinate {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect (fun y => flatYValue y r) =
      couplingA (s := s) hb * UniformSparseColumn.value x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
  simp only [UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  change coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r /
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x = _
  rw [coordinateFiberMoment_eq hb hs]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (exactColumnWeight_pos hb x)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).expect
      (fun y => exactScale (s := s) hb * flatYValue y r) =
      UniformSparseColumn.value x r
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_smul, UniformSparse.conditional_barycenter_coordinate hb hs]
  rw [exactScale]
  have ha := couplingA_pos hb hs
  field_simp [ne_of_gt ha]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalSampleLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalSampleLaw_weight (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).weight Y =
      ∏ i, (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs (X i)).weight (Y i)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw (n := n) hb hs).weight Y =
      ∑ X, (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight X *
        (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).weight Y
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_weight
statement:
theorem conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_weight
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) :
    (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw (n := n) hb hs).weight Y =
      (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).weight Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight,
    uniformSparseSampleLaw, FiniteLaw.independentProduct_weight,
    conditionalSampleLaw_weight, iidColumnSampleLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  calc
    (∑ X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n,
        ∏ i : Fin n,
          (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight (X i) *
            (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs (X i)).weight (Y i)) =
        ∏ i : Fin n, ∑ x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
          (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
            (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight (Y i) := by
      exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) =>
        (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x *
          (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs x).weight (Y i))).symm
    _ = ∏ i : Fin n, (nestedYLaw hb s).weight (Y i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact conditionalYLaw_mixture hb hs (Y i)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (f : IidColumnSample b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw (n := n) hb hs).expect f =
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
        (fun X => (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro X _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro Y _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_expect
statement:
theorem conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_expect
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (f : IidColumnSample b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw (n := n) hb hs).expect f =
      (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).expect f
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect, FiniteLaw.expect]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro Y _
  rw [conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_weight hb hs Y]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_cross_inner_block
statement:
theorem conditional_cross_inner_block
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (g : Fin s) :
    (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect (fun Y =>
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ 2 *
        inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) =
      ∑ a : Fin b,
        UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)) *
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))
proof:
:= by
  let scale := exactScale (s := s) hb
  calc
    (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect (fun Y =>
        scale ^ 2 *
          inner ℝ (unscaledYVector (Y i g)) (unscaledYVector (Y j g))) =
        (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect (fun Y =>
          ∑ a : Fin b,
            (scale * flatYValue (Y i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))) *
              (scale * flatYValue (Y j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)))) := by
      apply (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect_congr
      intro Y
      simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply,
        unscaledYVector_apply, flatYValue, flatOutcome_pair]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      dsimp [scale]
      ring
    _ = ∑ a : Fin b,
        (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect (fun Y =>
          (scale * flatYValue (Y i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))) *
            (scale * flatYValue (Y j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)))) := by
      exact FiniteLaw.expect_sum (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X) _
    _ = ∑ a : Fin b,
        (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs (X i)).expect (fun y =>
          scale * flatYValue y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))) *
        (UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs (X j)).expect (fun y =>
          scale * flatYValue y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      exact expect_two_coordinates
        (mu := fun k : Fin n => UniformSparse.conditionalYLaw hb hs (X k)) hij
        (fun y => scale * flatYValue y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)))
        (fun y => scale * flatYValue y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)))
    _ = ∑ a : Fin b,
        UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)) *
          UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      dsimp [scale]
      rw [conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate hb hs,
        conditional_scaled_barycenter_coordinate hb hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_matrix_transfer
statement:
theorem conditional_matrix_transfer
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
        (exactScaledIIDError hb F) = groupedExactError F X
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply, groupedExactError]
  simp_rw [exactScaledIIDError_apply_grouped hb F]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z * F.u i a * F.u j c)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  exact conditional_cross_inner_block hb hs X
    (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_matrix_transfer_gramError
statement:
theorem conditional_matrix_transfer_gramError
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
        (exactScaledIIDError hb F) = gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UniformSparse.conditional_matrix_transfer hb hs F X,
    groupedExactError_eq_hollow F X, UniformSparse.gramError_eq_hollow F X hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flipMask_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipMask_same {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m) :
    flipMask q q = .minus
proof: := by simp [flipMask]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flipMask_of_ne
statement:
theorem flipMask_of_ne {m : ℕ} {q r : Fin m} (hrq : r ≠ q) :
    flipMask q r = .plus
proof: := by simp [flipMask, hrq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYValue_flipYAt_same
proof:
:= by
  simp [flipYAt, flatYValue, flipMask, actOutcome, yValue_negateOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_flip_off_sameActive
statement:
theorem transformColumn_flip_off_sameActive {b s : ℕ}
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) =
        ((transformColumn (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) x).1 :
          Finset (Fin (s * b))) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))),
        x.2 r = (transformColumn (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) x).2 r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · simp [transformColumn, transformSupport]
  · intro r hr
    have hrq : r ≠ q := by
      intro h
      subst r
      exact hq hr
    simp [transformColumn, flipMask_of_ne hrq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_flipYAt_off
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_flipYAt_off {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (flipYAt q y, x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)
proof:
:= by
  let z := transformColumn (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) x
  have hz := transformColumn_flip_off_sameActive x q hq
  calc
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (flipYAt q y, x) =
        (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (flipYAt q y, z) :=
      jointColumnLaw_weight_congr_column hb hs (flipYAt q y) x z hz.1 hz.2
    _ = (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) := by
      exact jointColumnLaw_weight_transform hb hs
        (Equiv.refl _) (flipMask q) y x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_off
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_off {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (q : Fin (s * b))
    (hq : q ∉ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q =
      -coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q := by
    calc
      coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q =
          ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (flipYAt q y, x) *
            flatYValue (flipYAt q y) q := by
        exact ((flipYAtEquiv q).sum_comp
          (fun y => (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
            flatYValue y q)).symm
      _ = ∑ y, -((UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
            flatYValue y q) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _
        rw [jointColumnLaw_weight_flipYAt_off hb hs x q hq,
          flatYValue_flipYAt_same]
        ring
      _ = -coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x q := by
        simp [coordinateFiberMoment]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_stabilizer
statement:
theorem transformColumn_stabilizer {m s : ℕ}
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m))
    (hsupport : (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).map pi.toEmbedding =
      (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    transformColumn pi (stabilizerMask x pi) x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact hsupport
  · funext r
    simp [transformColumn, stabilizerMask]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.swap_maps_support_self
statement:
theorem swap_maps_support_self {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    (r t : Fin m) (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).map (Equiv.swap r t).toEmbedding =
      (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  rw [show u ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)).map (Equiv.swap r t).toEmbedding ↔
      (Equiv.swap r t).symm u ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)) by simp]
  change Equiv.swap r t u ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)) ↔
    u ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))
  by_cases hur : u = r
  · subst u
    simp [hr, ht]
  · by_cases hut : u = t
    · subst u
      simp [hr, ht]
    · rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hur hut]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_swap_eq
statement:
theorem transformColumn_swap_eq {m s : ℕ} (x : UniformSparseColumn m s)
    (r t : Fin m) (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin m))) :
    transformColumn (Equiv.swap r t)
      (stabilizerMask x (Equiv.swap r t)) x = x
proof:
:=
  transformColumn_stabilizer x (Equiv.swap r t)
    (swap_maps_support_self x r t hr ht)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatYValue_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatYValue_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatYValue (transformY pi eps y) r =
      (eps r).val * flatYValue y (pi.symm r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [flatYValue]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coordinateFiberMoment_swap
statement:
theorem coordinateFiberMoment_swap {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r t : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t =
      (stabilizerMask x (Equiv.swap r t) t).val *
        coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r
proof:
:= by
  let pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b)) := Equiv.swap r t
  let eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign := stabilizerMask x pi
  have hfix : transformColumn pi eps x = x := by
    exact transformColumn_swap_eq x r t hr ht
  calc
    coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t =
        ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (transformY pi eps y, x) *
          flatYValue (transformY pi eps y) t := by
      exact ((transformYEquiv pi eps).sum_comp
        (fun y => (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
          flatYValue y t)).symm
    _ = ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) *
          ((eps t).val * flatYValue y r) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      have hw := jointColumnLaw_weight_transform hb hs pi eps y x
      rw [hfix] at hw
      rw [hw, flatYValue_transformY]
      simp [pi]
    _ = (eps t).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r := by
      rw [coordinateFiberMoment, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      ring
    _ = (stabilizerMask x (Equiv.swap r t) t).val *
        coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.aligned_coordinateFiberMoment_eq
statement:
theorem aligned_coordinateFiberMoment_eq {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (r t : Fin (s * b))
    (hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))))
    (ht : t ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value x r * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
      UniformSparseColumn.value x t * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x t
proof:
:= by
  have hr' : r ∈ x.1 := Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp hr
  have ht' : t ∈ x.1 := Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp ht
  rw [coordinateFiberMoment_swap hb hs x r t hr ht,
    columnValue_of_mem x hr', columnValue_of_mem x ht']
  simp [stabilizerMask]
  calc
    (x.2 r).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r =
        1 * ((x.2 r).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) := by ring
    _ = (x.2 t).val ^ 2 *
        ((x.2 r).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) := by
      rw [Sign.val_sq]
    _ = (x.2 t).val *
        ((x.2 t).val * (x.2 r).val * coordinateFiberMoment hb hs x r) := by
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_plus_left
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_plus_left (e : Sign) : signMul .plus e = e
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_plus_right
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_plus_right (e : Sign) : signMul e .plus = e
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_self
statement: @[simp] theorem signMul_self (e : Sign) : signMul e e = .plus
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_assoc
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_assoc (e f g : Sign) :
    signMul (signMul e f) g = signMul e (signMul f g)
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases g <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_left_cancel_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_left_cancel_self (e f : Sign) :
    signMul e (signMul e f) = f
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_right_cancel_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_right_cancel_self (e f : Sign) :
    signMul (signMul e f) f = e
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.signMul_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem signMul_val (e f : Sign) :
    (signMul e f).val = e.val * f.val
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> norm_num [signMul, Sign.val]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_plus
statement: @[simp] theorem actOutcome_plus (z : TernaryOutcome) : actOutcome .plus z = z
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_involutive (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e (actOutcome e z) = z
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> simp [actOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_signMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_signMul (e f : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome (signMul e f) z = actOutcome e (actOutcome f z)
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> simp [signMul, actOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_eq_zero_iff (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e z = .zero ↔ z = .zero
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases z <;> simp [actOutcome, negateOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.actOutcome_ne_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem actOutcome_ne_zero_iff (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    actOutcome e z ≠ .zero ↔ z ≠ .zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, ne_eq, not_congr (actOutcome_eq_zero_iff e z)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.yValue_actOutcome
statement:
@[simp] theorem yValue_actOutcome (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    yValue (actOutcome e z) = e.val * yValue z
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases z <;> norm_num [actOutcome, negateOutcome, yValue, Sign.val]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.outcomeOfSign_signMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem outcomeOfSign_signMul (e f : Sign) :
    outcomeOfSign (signMul e f) = actOutcome e (outcomeOfSign f)
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mass_actOutcome
statement:
theorem mass_actOutcome (b : ℕ) (e : Sign) (z : TernaryOutcome) :
    mass b (actOutcome e z) = mass b z
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  · rfl
  · exact mass_negateOutcome b z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatOutcome_transformY
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatOutcome_transformY {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (r : Fin (s * b)) :
    flatOutcome (transformY pi eps y) r =
      actOutcome (eps r) (flatOutcome y (pi.symm r))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, a⟩ := finProdFinEquiv.surjective r
  subst r
  rw [flatOutcome_pair]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformY_inverse_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformY_inverse_left {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) (transformY pi eps y) = y
proof:
:= by
  funext g a
  have h := flatOutcome_transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps)
    (transformY pi eps y) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))
  simpa [inverseMask] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformY_inverse_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformY_inverse_right {b s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    transformY pi eps (transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) y) = y
proof:
:= by
  funext g a
  have h := flatOutcome_transformY pi eps
    (transformY pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) y) (finProdFinEquiv (g, a))
  simpa [inverseMask] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mem_transformSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_transformSupport {m s : ℕ} (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m))
    (S : UniformSparseSupport m s) (r : Fin m) :
    r ∈ (transformSupport pi S : Finset (Fin m)) ↔ pi.symm r ∈ (S : Finset (Fin m))
proof:
:= by
  simp [transformSupport]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnValue_transformColumn
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnValue_transformColumn {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) (r : Fin m) :
    UniformSparseColumn.value (transformColumn pi eps x) r =
      (eps r).val * UniformSparseColumn.value x (pi.symm r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hr : pi.symm r ∈ x.1
  · have hrt : r ∈ (transformColumn pi eps x).1 := by
      exact Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp
        ((mem_transformSupport pi x.1 r).mpr
          (Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mpr hr))
    rw [columnValue_of_mem _ hrt, columnValue_of_mem x hr]
    exact signMul_val _ _
  · have hrt : r ∉ (transformColumn pi eps x).1 := by
      intro h
      apply hr
      exact Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp
        ((mem_transformSupport pi x.1 r).mp
          (Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mpr h))
    rw [columnValue_of_notMem _ hrt, columnValue_of_notMem x hr]
    ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_inverse_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformColumn_inverse_left {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    transformColumn pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) (transformColumn pi eps x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    ext r
    simp [transformColumn, transformSupport]
  · funext r
    simp [transformColumn, inverseMask]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.transformColumn_inverse_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem transformColumn_inverse_right {m s : ℕ}
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    transformColumn pi eps
      (transformColumn pi.symm (inverseMask pi eps) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    ext r
    simp [transformColumn, transformSupport]
  · funext r
    simp [transformColumn, inverseMask]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumn_x_marginal
statement:
theorem jointColumn_x_marginal {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).prob {z | z.2 = x} = (selectorLaw b hb).weight x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (jointColumnLaw hb).prob {z | z.2 = x} = xMarginal hb x := by
      rw [FiniteLaw.prob, FiniteLaw.expect, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      change (∑ y, ∑ x', (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x') *
        FiniteLaw.indicator {z : YVector b × SignedHash b | z.2 = x} (y, x')) =
          ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x)
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      simp [FiniteLaw.indicator]
    _ = (selectorLaw b hb).weight x := xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight hb x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorWeight_pos
statement:
theorem selectorWeight_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    0 < (selectorLaw b hb).weight x
proof:
:= by
  rw [selectorLaw]
  dsimp
  positivity

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalYLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (y : YVector b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y =
      (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) / (selectorLaw b hb).weight x
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.jointColumn_disintegrates
statement:
