theorem jointColumn_disintegrates {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) =
      (selectorLaw b hb).weight x * (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y
proof:
:= by
  rw [conditionalYLaw_weight]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (selectorWeight_pos hb x)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipAt_apply_same {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a y a = negateOutcome (y a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [flipAt]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem flipAt_apply_of_ne {b : ℕ} {a k : Fin b} (hka : k ≠ a) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a y k = y k
proof:
:= by
  simp [flipAt, hka]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.flipAt_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem flipAt_involutive {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    flipAt a (flipAt a y) = y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext k
  by_cases hka : k = a
  · subst k
    simp
  · simp [flipAt, hka]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.yVectorLaw_weight_flipAt
statement:
theorem yVectorLaw_weight_flipAt {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (flipAt a y) = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yVectorLaw_weight]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  by_cases hka : k = a
  · subst k
    simp [mass_negateOutcome]
  · simp [flipAt_apply_of_ne hka]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.supportSize_flipAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportSize_flipAt {b : ℕ} (a : Fin b) (y : YVector b) :
    supportSize (flipAt a y) = supportSize y
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportSize_eq_sum, supportSize_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  by_cases hka : k = a
  · subst k
    cases h : y a <;> simp [flipAt, negateOutcome, h]
  · simp [flipAt_apply_of_ne hka]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_flipAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_flipAt_of_ne {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) (ha : a ≠ x.1) :
    kernelWeight hb (flipAt a y) x = kernelWeight hb y x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hxa : x.1 ≠ a := Ne.symm ha
  simp [kernelWeight, supportSize_flipAt, selectorMatches,
    flipAt_apply_of_ne hxa]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fiberMoment_off
statement:
theorem fiberMoment_off {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) (ha : a ≠ x.1) :
    fiberMoment hb x a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : fiberMoment hb x a = -fiberMoment hb x a := by
    calc
      fiberMoment hb x a =
          ∑ y, (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (flipAt a y, x) *
            yValue ((flipAt a y) a) := by
        exact ((flipAtEquiv a).sum_comp
          (fun y => (jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) * yValue (y a))).symm
      _ = ∑ y, -((jointColumnLaw hb).weight (y, x) * yValue (y a)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _hy
        rw [jointColumnLaw_weight, jointColumnLaw_weight,
          yVectorLaw_weight_flipAt hb a y,
          kernelWeight_flipAt_of_ne hb y x a ha]
        simp
      _ = -fiberMoment hb x a := by
        simp [fiberMoment]
  linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.zeroSupportMass
statement:
theorem zeroSupportMass {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
      (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) = p0 b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
        (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
        (yVectorLaw b hb).prob {zeroY b} := by
      rw [FiniteLaw.prob, FiniteLaw.expect]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      by_cases hy : y = zeroY b
      · subst y
        simp [FiniteLaw.indicator, supportSize_eq_zero_iff]
      · have hs : supportSize y ≠ 0 := by
          simpa [supportSize_eq_zero_iff] using hy
        simp [FiniteLaw.indicator, hy, hs]
    _ = (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (zeroY b) :=
      FiniteLaw.prob_singleton (yVectorLaw b hb) (zeroY b)
    _ = p0 b := zeroY_weight hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.kernelWeight_mul_selectedValue
statement:
theorem kernelWeight_mul_selectedValue {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (y : YVector b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    kernelWeight hb y x * yValue (y x.1) =
      x.2.val * kernelWeight hb y x -
        x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
          (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hzero : supportSize y = 0
  · have hy : y = zeroY b := (supportSize_eq_zero_iff y).mp hzero
    subst y
    simp [kernelWeight, hzero, zeroY, yValue]
  · by_cases hmatch : selectorMatches y x
    · have hyx : y x.1 = outcomeOfSign x.2 := hmatch
      simp [kernelWeight, hzero, hmatch, hyx]
      ring
    · simp [kernelWeight, hzero, hmatch]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fiberMoment_selected
statement:
theorem fiberMoment_selected {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    fiberMoment hb x x.1 =
      x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x * (1 - p0 b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    fiberMoment hb x x.1 =
        ∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
          (kernelWeight hb y x * yValue (y x.1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      rw [jointColumnLaw_weight]
      ring
    _ = ∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
        (x.2.val * kernelWeight hb y x -
          x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
            (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _hy
      rw [kernelWeight_mul_selectedValue hb y x]
    _ = x.2.val * xMarginal hb x -
        x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
          (∑ y, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y *
            (if supportSize y = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
      simp_rw [mul_sub]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      simp only [xMarginal, jointColumnLaw_weight]
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _hy
        ring
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y _hy
        ring
    _ = x.2.val * (selectorLaw b hb).weight x * (1 - p0 b) := by
      rw [xMarginal_eq_selectorWeight hb x, zeroSupportMass hb]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.cB_mul_one_sub_p0
statement:
theorem cB_mul_one_sub_p0 {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    cB b * (1 - p0 b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cB]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (one_sub_p0_pos hb))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_expect_yValue
statement:
theorem conditional_expect_yValue {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).expect (fun y => yValue (y a)) =
      if a = x.1 then x.2.val * (1 - p0 b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = x.1
  · subst a
    rw [if_pos rfl, FiniteLaw.expect]
    simp only [conditionalYLaw_weight]
    simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    change fiberMoment hb x x.1 / (selectorLaw b hb).weight x = _
    rw [fiberMoment_selected hb x]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (selectorWeight_pos hb x)]
  · rw [if_neg ha, FiniteLaw.expect]
    simp only [conditionalYLaw_weight]
    simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    change fiberMoment hb x a / (selectorLaw b hb).weight x = 0
    rw [fiberMoment_off hb x a ha, zero_div]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter_coordinate
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter_coordinate {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (x : SignedHash b) (a : Fin b) :
    (conditionalYLaw hb x).expect (fun y => cB b * yValue (y a)) =
      if a = x.1 then x.2.val else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_smul, conditional_expect_yValue hb x a]
  by_cases ha : a = x.1
  · rw [if_pos ha, if_pos ha]
    calc
      cB b * (x.2.val * (1 - p0 b)) = x.2.val * (cB b * (1 - p0 b)) := by ring
      _ = x.2.val := by rw [cB_mul_one_sub_p0 hb, mul_one]
  · simp [ha]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_barycenter
statement:
theorem conditional_barycenter {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : SignedHash b) :
    conditionalBarycenter hb x = selectorVector x
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact conditional_barycenter_coordinate hb x a

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.coe_barycenter_exactScaledIID
statement:
theorem coe_barycenter_exactScaledIID
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) :
    ((FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
        (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F) : symmetricMatrices d) :
      Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) =
      FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
        (exactScaledIIDError hb F)
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [FiniteLaw.barycenter, Submodule.coe_sum,
    Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    exactScaledIIDSymmetricError, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.barycenter_exactScaledIID_eq_exact
statement:
theorem barycenter_exactScaledIID_eq_exact
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
        (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F) = exactSymmetricError F X
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_barycenter_exactScaledIID hb hs F X]
  exact conditional_matrix_transfer_gramError hb hs F X

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.conditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem conditional_convex_order
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n)
    (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ) (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    Phi (exactSymmetricError F X) ≤
      (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect
        (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← barycenter_exactScaledIID_eq_exact hb hs F X]
  exact FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X)
    (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F) Phi hPhi

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.unconditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_convex_order
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d)
    (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ) (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
        (fun X => Phi (exactSymmetricError F X)) ≤
      (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
        (fun X => Phi (exactSymmetricError F X)) ≤
        (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => (conditionalSampleLaw hb hs X).expect
            (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y))) := by
      apply FiniteLaw.expect_mono
      intro X
      exact UniformSparse.conditional_convex_order hb hs F X Phi hPhi
    _ = (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw (n := n) hb hs).expect
        (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y)) :=
      (conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated hb hs
        (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y))).symm
    _ = (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y)) :=
      conditionalSampleMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidColumnSampleLaw_expect
        hb hs (fun Y => Phi (exactScaledIIDSymmetricError hb F Y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIIDError_trace_even
statement:
theorem exactScaledIIDError_trace_even (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (Y : IidColumnSample b s n) (q : ℕ) :
    ((exactScaledIIDError hb F Y) ^ (2 * q)).trace =
      exactScale (s := s) hb ^ (4 * q) *
        ((iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace
proof:
:= by
  rw [exactScaledIIDError_eq_smul, smul_pow, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [← pow_mul]
  congr 1
  omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.iidColumn_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem iidColumn_trace_moment_eq_product
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
        (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
        (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun y => ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      iidColumnSampleLaw_expect_toYArray_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
        (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)
        (fun y => ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
    _ = (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
        (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      iid_trace_moment_eq_product hs hb F q

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScaledIID_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem exactScaledIID_trace_moment_eq_product
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((exactScaledIIDError (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F Y) ^
          (2 * q)).trace) =
      exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((exactScaledIIDError (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F Y) ^
          (2 * q)).trace) =
        (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun Y => exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^
            (4 * q) * ((iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      apply (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect_congr
      intro Y
      exact exactScaledIIDError_trace_even
        (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F Y q
    _ = exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun Y => ((iidVectorError F (toYArray Y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      exact FiniteLaw.expect_smul _ _ _
    _ = exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      rw [iidColumn_trace_moment_eq_product hs hb F q]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.unconditional_trace_moment_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_trace_moment_order
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
        (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      (iidColumnSampleLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((exactScaledIIDError hb F Y) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [traceEvenPower, exactSymmetricError,
    exactScaledIIDSymmetricError] using
      (UniformSparse.unconditional_convex_order hb hs F
        (traceEvenPower (d := d) q)
        (convexOn_traceEvenPower d q))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.trace_moment_le_scaled_product
statement:
theorem trace_moment_le_scaled_product
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))).expect
        (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ (iidColumnSampleLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun Y => ((exactScaledIIDError (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F Y) ^
          (2 * q)).trace) :=
      UniformSparse.unconditional_trace_moment_order
        (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) hs F q
    _ = _ := exactScaledIID_trace_moment_eq_product hs hb F q

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.nestedYLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem nestedYLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s : ℕ)
    (y : NestedY b s) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y = ∏ g, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (y g)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.flatOutcome_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem flatOutcome_pair {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (g : Fin s) (a : Fin b) :
    flatOutcome y (finProdFinEquiv (g, a)) = y g a
proof:
:= by
  simp [flatOutcome]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.mem_flatSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_flatSupport {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s)
    (r : Fin (s * b)) : r ∈ flatSupport y ↔ flatOutcome y r ≠ .zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [flatSupport]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.totalSupport_eq_sum
statement:
theorem totalSupport_eq_sum {b s : ℕ} (y : NestedY b s) :
    totalSupport y = ∑ g, supportSize (y g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [totalSupport, flatSupport]
  calc
    (Finset.univ.filter fun r : Fin (s * b) => flatOutcome y r ≠ .zero).card =
        ∑ r : Fin (s * b), if flatOutcome y r = .zero then 0 else 1 := by
      symm
      simpa using
        (Finset.sum_boole (R := ℕ)
          (fun r : Fin (s * b) => flatOutcome y r ≠ .zero) Finset.univ)
    _ = ∑ ga : Fin s × Fin b,
        if flatOutcome y (finProdFinEquiv ga) = .zero then 0 else 1 := by
      exact (finProdFinEquiv.sum_comp
        (fun r : Fin (s * b) => if flatOutcome y r = .zero then 0 else 1)).symm
    _ = ∑ g, ∑ a, if y g a = .zero then 0 else 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [flatOutcome_pair]
    _ = ∑ g, supportSize (y g) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro g _
      exact (supportSize_eq_sum (y g)).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_totalSupport
statement:
theorem activeBlockCount_le_totalSupport (y : NestedY b s) :
    activeBlockCount y ≤ totalSupport y
proof:
:= by
  rw [activeBlockCount, totalSupport_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro g _
  unfold blockActive
  split
  · omega
  · omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_s
statement: theorem activeBlockCount_le_s (y : NestedY b s) : activeBlockCount y ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [activeBlockCount]
  calc
    (∑ g : Fin s, blockActive y g) ≤ ∑ _g : Fin s, 1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro g _
      unfold blockActive
      split <;> omega
    _ = s := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.activeBlockCount_le_min
statement:
theorem activeBlockCount_le_min (y : NestedY b s) :
    activeBlockCount y ≤ min (totalSupport y) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.le_min]
  exact ⟨activeBlockCount_le_totalSupport y, activeBlockCount_le_s y⟩

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.expect_vectorActiveIndicator
statement:
theorem expect_vectorActiveIndicator {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (yVectorLaw b hb).expect vectorActiveIndicator = 1 - p0 b
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : {y : YVector b | supportSize y = 0} = {zeroY b} := by
    ext y
    simp [supportSize_eq_zero_iff]
  calc
    (yVectorLaw b hb).expect vectorActiveIndicator =
        (yVectorLaw b hb).prob ({zeroY b}ᶜ) := by
      rw [FiniteLaw.prob]
      apply (yVectorLaw b hb).expect_congr
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y = zeroY b
      · subst y
        simp [vectorActiveIndicator, FiniteLaw.indicator,
          supportSize_eq_zero_iff]
      · have hsupp : supportSize y ≠ 0 := by
          simpa [supportSize_eq_zero_iff] using hy
        simp [vectorActiveIndicator, FiniteLaw.indicator, hy, hsupp]
    _ = 1 - (yVectorLaw b hb).prob {zeroY b} :=
      FiniteLaw.prob_compl (yVectorLaw b hb) {zeroY b}
    _ = 1 - p0 b := by
      rw [FiniteLaw.prob_singleton, zeroY_weight hb]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.expect_activeBlockCount
statement:
theorem expect_activeBlockCount {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => (activeBlockCount y : ℝ)) =
      (s : ℝ) * (1 - p0 b)
proof:
:= by
  change (nestedYLaw hb s).expect
      (fun y => ((∑ g, blockActive y g : ℕ) : ℝ)) = _
  simp_rw [Nat.cast_sum]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  have hcoord (g : Fin s) :
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => (blockActive y g : ℝ)) = 1 - p0 b := by
    calc
      (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => (blockActive y g : ℝ)) =
          (nestedYLaw hb s).expect (fun y => vectorActiveIndicator (y g)) := by
        apply (nestedYLaw hb s).expect_congr
        intro y
        simp [blockActive, vectorActiveIndicator]
      _ = (yVectorLaw b hb).expect vectorActiveIndicator := by
        exact FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_apply
          (fun _ : Fin s => yVectorLaw b hb) g vectorActiveIndicator
      _ = 1 - p0 b := expect_vectorActiveIndicator hb
  simp_rw [hcoord]
  simp
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.one_sub_p0_le_couplingA
statement:
theorem one_sub_p0_le_couplingA {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    1 - p0 b ≤ couplingA (s := s) hb
proof:
:= by
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hpoint (y : NestedY b s) :
      (activeBlockCount y : ℝ) ≤ (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast activeBlockCount_le_min y
  have hexpect := (nestedYLaw hb s).expect_mono hpoint
  rw [expect_activeBlockCount hb] at hexpect
  rw [couplingA]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hsR).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.couplingA_pos
statement:
theorem couplingA_pos {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 < couplingA (s := s) hb
proof:
:=
  (one_sub_p0_pos hb).trans_le (one_sub_p0_le_couplingA hb hs)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale_le_cB
statement:
theorem exactScale_le_cB {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    exactScale (s := s) hb ≤ cB b
proof:
:= by
  rw [exactScale, cB]
  exact inv_anti₀ (one_sub_p0_pos hb) (one_sub_p0_le_couplingA hb hs)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exactScale_le_cStar
statement:
theorem exactScale_le_cStar {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    exactScale (s := s) hb ≤ convexOrderConstant
proof:
:=
  (exactScale_le_cB hb hs).trans (cB_le_cStar hb)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
    {z : TernaryOutcome} (hz : z ≠ .zero) : outcomeOfSign (signOfOutcome z) = z
proof:
:= by
  cases z <;> simp_all [signOfOutcome, outcomeOfSign]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.compatible_inner_eq_min
statement:
theorem compatible_inner_eq_min {b s : ℕ} {y : NestedY b s}
    {x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s} (hxy : Compatible y x) :
    (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value x r * flatYValue y r) =
      (min (totalSupport y) s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hlarge : s ≤ totalSupport y
  · have h := hxy
    simp only [Compatible, if_pos hlarge] at h
    rcases h with ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
    have hterm (r : Fin (s * b)) :
        UniformSparseColumn.value x r * flatYValue y r =
          if r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) then 1 else 0 := by
      by_cases hr : r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b)))
      · have hout := hsign r hr
        have hr' : r ∈ x.1 := Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp hr
        rw [columnValue_of_mem x hr', flatYValue, hout,
          yValue_outcomeOfSign]
        simpa [hr, pow_two] using Sign.val_sq (x.2 r)
      · have hr' : r ∉ x.1 := fun hmem =>
          hr (Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mpr hmem)
        rw [columnValue_of_notMem x hr', if_neg hr]
        simp
    simp_rw [hterm]
    have hsum :
        (∑ r : Fin (s * b),
          if r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = s := by
      calc
        (∑ r : Fin (s * b),
          if r ∈ (x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
            ((x.1 : Finset (Fin (s * b))).card : ℝ) := by simp
        _ = s := by rw [(x.1).prop]
    rw [hsum, min_eq_right (by exact_mod_cast hlarge)]
  · have h := hxy
    simp only [Compatible, if_neg hlarge] at h
    rcases h with ⟨hsub, hsign⟩
    have hterm (r : Fin (s * b)) :
        UniformSparseColumn.value x r * flatYValue y r =
          if r ∈ flatSupport y then 1 else 0 := by
      by_cases hr : r ∈ flatSupport y
      · have hrx := hsub hr
        have hout := hsign r hr
        have hrx' : r ∈ x.1 := Set.powersetCard.mem_coe_iff.mp hrx
        rw [columnValue_of_mem x hrx', flatYValue, hout,
          yValue_outcomeOfSign]
        have hnzero : outcomeOfSign (x.2 r) ≠ .zero := by
          cases x.2 r <;> simp [outcomeOfSign]
        simpa [hr, hout, hnzero, pow_two] using Sign.val_sq (x.2 r)
      · have hyzero : flatOutcome y r = .zero := by
          by_contra hnzero
          exact hr ((mem_flatSupport y r).mpr hnzero)
        rw [if_neg hr, flatYValue, hyzero]
        simp [yValue]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    have hsum :
        (∑ r : Fin (s * b), if r ∈ flatSupport y then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
          (totalSupport y : ℝ) := by
      rw [totalSupport]
      simpa only [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter] using
        (Finset.sum_boole (R := ℝ)
          (fun r : Fin (s * b) => r ∈ flatSupport y) Finset.univ)
    rw [hsum, min_eq_left (by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hlarge))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.choiceColumn_nonempty
statement:
theorem choiceColumn_nonempty {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (_hs : 0 < s)
    (y : NestedY b s) : Nonempty (ChoiceColumn y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsm : s ≤ s * b := by
    nlinarith [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)]
  by_cases hlarge : s ≤ totalSupport y
  · obtain ⟨t, htsub, htcard⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_subset_card_eq hlarge
    let S : UniformSparseSupport (s * b) s := ⟨t, htcard⟩
    let signs : Fin (s * b) → Sign := fun r => signOfOutcome (flatOutcome y r)
    refine ⟨⟨(S, signs), ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [Compatible, if_pos hlarge]
    refine ⟨htsub, ?_⟩
    intro r hr
    symm
    apply outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
    exact (mem_flatSupport y r).mp (htsub hr)
  · have hKle : totalSupport y ≤ s := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hlarge)
    have hflatuniv : flatSupport y ⊆ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (s * b))) :=
      Finset.subset_univ _
    obtain ⟨t, hflat, htuniv, htcard⟩ :=
      Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq hflatuniv hKle (by simpa using hsm)
    let S : UniformSparseSupport (s * b) s := ⟨t, htcard⟩
    let signs : Fin (s * b) → Sign := fun r => signOfOutcome (flatOutcome y r)
    refine ⟨⟨(S, signs), ?_⟩⟩
    simp only [Compatible, if_neg hlarge]
    refine ⟨hflat, ?_⟩
    intro r hr
    symm
    apply outcomeOfSign_signOfOutcome_of_ne_zero
    exact (mem_flatSupport y r).mp hr

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selectorArrayLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem selectorArrayLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (x : XArray b s n) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).weight x =
      ∏ z : ArraySite s n, (selectorLaw b hb).weight (x z)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidArrayLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem iidArrayLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight y =
      ∏ z : ArraySite s n, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (y z)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight
statement:
@[simp] theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y =
      ∑ x, (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).weight x *
        (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).weight y
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.oneColumn_mixture_weight
statement:
theorem oneColumn_mixture_weight {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (y : YVector b) :
    (∑ x : SignedHash b, (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
        (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight y) =
      (yVectorLaw b hb).weight y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← jointColumn_disintegrates hb y]
  simp_rw [jointColumnLaw_weight, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_kernelWeight hb, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (y : YArray b s n) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).weight y =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).weight y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conditionalMixtureLaw_weight, selectorArrayLaw_weight,
    conditionalArrayLaw, FiniteLaw.independentProduct_weight,
    iidArrayLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  calc
    (∑ x : ArraySite s n → SignedHash b,
        ∏ z : ArraySite s n,
          (selectorLaw b hb).weight (x z) *
            (conditionalYLaw hb (x z)).weight (y z)) =
        ∏ z : ArraySite s n, ∑ x : SignedHash b,
          (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
            (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight (y z) :=
      (Fintype.prod_sum (fun z (x : SignedHash b) ↦
        (selectorLaw b hb).weight x *
          (conditionalYLaw hb x).weight (y z))).symm
    _ = ∏ z : ArraySite s n, (yVectorLaw b hb).weight (y z) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro z _hz
      exact oneColumn_mixture_weight hb (y z)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (f : YArray b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f =
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect f
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect, FiniteLaw.expect]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _hy
  rw [conditionalMixtureLaw_weight_eq_iidArrayLaw_weight hb s n y]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
statement:
theorem conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated
    {b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (s n : ℕ) (f : YArray b s n → ℝ) :
    (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect f =
      (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect, conditionalMixtureLaw_weight]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _hx
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _hy
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.unconditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_convex_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ)
    (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ Phi (sparseSymmetricError F x)) ≤
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ Phi (sparseSymmetricError F x)) ≤
        (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
          (fun x ↦ (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
            (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))) := by
      apply FiniteLaw.expect_mono
      intro x
      exact conditional_convex_order hb F x Phi hPhi
    _ = (conditionalMixtureLaw hb s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y)) :=
      (conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iterated hb s n
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))).symm
    _ = (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y)) :=
      conditionalMixtureLaw_expect_eq_iidArrayLaw_expect hb s n
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw_weight_transform
statement:
theorem jointColumnLaw_weight_transform {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (y : NestedY b s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
        (transformY pi eps y, transformColumn pi eps x) =
      (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)
proof:
:= by
  change (nestedYLaw hb s).weight (transformY pi eps y) *
      (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs (transformY pi eps y)).weight
        (transformColumn pi eps x) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y * (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x
  rw [nestedYLaw_weight_transformY hb,
    selectionKernel_weight_transform hb hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.le_rows
statement: theorem le_rows {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) : s ≤ s * b
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hb)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.exists_transformColumn_eq
statement:
theorem exists_transformColumn_eq {m s : ℕ}
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn m s) :
    ∃ (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (eps : Fin m → Sign),
      transformColumn pi eps x = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_map_finset_eq
    (x.1 : Finset (Fin m)) (z.1 : Finset (Fin m)) (by
      rw [x.1.prop, z.1.prop])
  let eps : Fin m → Sign := fun r => signMul (z.2 r) (x.2 (pi.symm r))
  refine ⟨pi, eps, ?_⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact hpi
  · funext r
    simp [transformColumn, eps]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_transform
statement:
theorem xMarginal_transform {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s * b))) (eps : Fin (s * b) → Sign)
    (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs (transformColumn pi eps x) = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs (transformColumn pi eps x) =
        ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (y, transformColumn pi eps x) := rfl
    _ = ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (transformY pi eps y, transformColumn pi eps x) := by
      exact ((transformYEquiv pi eps).sum_comp
        (fun y => (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight
          (y, transformColumn pi eps x))).symm
    _ = ∑ y, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      exact jointColumnLaw_weight_transform hb hs pi eps y x
    _ = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_constant
statement:
theorem xMarginal_constant {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s)
    (x z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pi, eps, h⟩ := exists_transformColumn_eq x z
  rw [← h, xMarginal_transform]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.sum_xMarginal
statement:
theorem sum_xMarginal {b s : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∑ x, UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ x, UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x) =
        ∑ y, ∑ x, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x) := by
      simp only [UniformSparse.xMarginal]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ z : NestedY b s × UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
        (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight z := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = 1 := (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).sum_weight

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.xMarginal_eq_exactColumnWeight
statement:
theorem xMarginal_eq_exactColumnWeight {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (x : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :
    UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x =
      (uniformSparseColumnLaw (le_rows (s := s) hb)).weight x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Nonempty (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) :=
    exactColumnNonempty (le_rows (s := s) hb)
  have hconst : ∀ z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s,
      UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs z = UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x :=
    fun z => UniformSparse.xMarginal_constant hb hs z x
  have hsum : (Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) : ℝ) *
      UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = 1 := by
    calc
      (Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) : ℝ) * UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x =
          ∑ _z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s, UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x := by simp
      _ = ∑ z : UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s, UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs z := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro z _
        exact (hconst z).symm
      _ = 1 := UniformSparse.sum_xMarginal hb hs
  rw [uniformSparseColumnLaw]
  change UniformSparse.xMarginal hb hs x = 1 / (Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) : ℝ)
  apply (eq_div_iff (by positivity :
    (Fintype.card (UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) : ℝ) ≠ 0)).2
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.jointColumn_y_marginal
statement:
theorem jointColumn_y_marginal {b s : ℕ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hs : 0 < s) (y : NestedY b s) :
    (∑ x, (UniformSparse.jointColumnLaw hb hs).weight (y, x)) =
      (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ x, (nestedYLaw hb s).weight y *
    (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).weight x) = _
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, (UniformSparse.selectionKernel hb hs y).sum_weight, mul_one]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_sum
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_sum {Omega K : Type*} [Fintype Omega] [Fintype K]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ ∑ k, f k omega) = ∑ k, mu.expect (f k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum {Omega K : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (S : Finset K) (f : K → Omega → ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ ∑ k ∈ S, f k omega) = ∑ k ∈ S, mu.expect (f k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const {Omega : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (f : Omega → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mu.expect (fun omega ↦ f omega * c) = mu.expect f * c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteLaw.expect]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro omega _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.expect_two_coordinates
statement:
theorem expect_two_coordinates
    {I A : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype A]
    (mu : I → FiniteLaw A) {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) (f g : A → ℝ) :
    (FiniteLaw.independentProduct mu).expect (fun x ↦ f (x i) * g (x j)) =
      (mu i).expect f * (mu j).expect g
proof:
:= by
  have h := FiniteLaw.expect_independentProduct_factorizes_on mu {i, j}
    (fun k a ↦ if k = i then f a else g a)
  simpa [hij, Ne.symm hij] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.unscaledYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem unscaledYVector_apply {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    unscaledYVector y a = yValue (y a)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledYVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledYVector_apply {b : ℕ} (y : YVector b) (a : Fin b) :
    scaledYVector y a = cB b * yValue (y a)
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaled_inner_eq
statement:
theorem scaled_inner_eq {b : ℕ} (y z : YVector b) :
    inner ℝ (scaledYVector y) (scaledYVector z) =
      cB b ^ 2 * inner ℝ (unscaledYVector y) (unscaledYVector z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply,
    scaledYVector_apply, unscaledYVector_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_cross_inner
statement:
theorem conditional_cross_inner
    {b s n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (x : XArray b s n)
    {z z' : ArraySite s n} (hzz : z ≠ z') :
    (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
        (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (scaledYVector (y z)) (scaledYVector (y z'))) =
      inner ℝ (selectorVector (x z)) (selectorVector (x z'))
proof:
:= by
  unfold conditionalArrayLaw
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply,
    scaledYVector_apply, selectorVector]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  calc
    (FiniteLaw.independentProduct (fun q ↦ conditionalYLaw hb (x q))).expect
        (fun y ↦ (cB b * yValue (y z a)) * (cB b * yValue (y z' a))) =
        (conditionalYLaw hb (x z)).expect (fun yz ↦ cB b * yValue (yz a)) *
          (conditionalYLaw hb (x z')).expect (fun yz ↦ cB b * yValue (yz a)) :=
      expect_two_coordinates (mu := fun q ↦ conditionalYLaw hb (x q))
        (i := z) (j := z') hzz
        (fun yz : YVector b ↦ cB b * yValue (yz a))
        (fun yz : YVector b ↦ cB b * yValue (yz a))
    _ = (if a = (x z).1 then (x z).2.val else 0) *
        (if a = (x z').1 then (x z').2.val else 0) := by
      rw [conditional_barycenter_coordinate hb (x z) a,
        conditional_barycenter_coordinate hb (x z') a]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_eq_smul
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [scaledIIDVectorError, iidVectorError, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [scaled_inner_eq]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply {Omega A : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (M : Omega → Matrix A A ℝ) (a c : A) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter mu M a c = mu.expect (fun omega ↦ M omega a c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [FiniteLaw.barycenter, Matrix.sum_apply, FiniteLaw.expect]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_matrix_transfer
statement:
theorem conditional_matrix_transfer {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDVectorError F) =
      sparseVectorError F x
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [FiniteLaw.barycenter_apply, scaledIIDVectorError, sparseVectorError,
    Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_finset_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [FiniteLaw.expect_mul_const]
  rw [conditional_cross_inner hb x (hzz := by
    intro hsite
    exact (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) (congrArg Prod.snd hsite))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseVectorError_symmetric
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, sparseVectorError, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply congrArg ((1 / (s : ℝ)) * ·)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  rw [sum_sum_erase_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [real_inner_comm]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iidVectorError_symmetric
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, iidVectorError, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply congrArg ((1 / (s : ℝ)) * ·)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  rw [sum_sum_erase_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [real_inner_comm]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_symmetric
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaledIIDVectorError_eq_smul]
  ext a c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
  have hs := congrFun (congrFun (iidVectorError_symmetric F y) a) c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply] at hs
  rw [hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect {Omega E : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (mu : FiniteLaw Omega) (p : Omega → E) (Phi : E → ℝ)
    (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    Phi (FiniteLaw.barycenter mu p) ≤ mu.expect (fun omega ↦ Phi (p omega))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FiniteLaw.barycenter, FiniteLaw.expect, smul_eq_mul] using
    hPhi.map_sum_le (t := Finset.univ) (w := mu.weight) (p := p)
      (fun i _ ↦ mu.weight_nonneg i) mu.sum_weight (fun _ _ ↦ Set.mem_univ _)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.coe_barycenter_scaledIID
statement:
theorem coe_barycenter_scaledIID {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    ((FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDSymmetricError F) :
        symmetricMatrices d) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) =
      FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDVectorError F)
proof:
:= by
  ext a c
  simp only [FiniteLaw.barycenter, Submodule.coe_sum,
    Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
    scaledIIDSymmetricError, smul_eq_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.barycenter_scaledIID_eq_sparse
statement:
theorem barycenter_scaledIID_eq_sparse {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n) :
    FiniteLaw.barycenter (conditionalArrayLaw hb x) (scaledIIDSymmetricError F) =
      sparseSymmetricError F x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_barycenter_scaledIID hb F x]
  exact conditional_matrix_transfer hb F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_convex_order
statement:
theorem conditional_convex_order {b s n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (x : XArray b s n)
    (Phi : symmetricMatrices d → ℝ) (hPhi : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ Phi) :
    Phi (sparseSymmetricError F x) ≤
      (conditionalArrayLaw hb x).expect
        (fun y ↦ Phi (scaledIIDSymmetricError F y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← barycenter_scaledIID_eq_sparse hb F x]
  exact FiniteLaw.map_barycenter_le_expect (conditionalArrayLaw hb x)
    (scaledIIDSymmetricError F) Phi hPhi

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaledIIDVectorError_trace_even
statement:
theorem scaledIIDVectorError_trace_even (F : Frame n d)
    (y : YArray b s n) (q : ℕ) :
    ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace =
      cB b ^ (4 * q) * ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace
proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.selector_trace_moment_eq_raw
statement:
theorem selector_trace_moment_eq_raw (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ ((sparseVectorError F x) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
        (fun ω ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample ω))) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  rw [selectorArrayLaw_eq_rawSampleLaw]
  apply (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect_congr
  intro x
  rw [sparseVectorError_eq_gramError hs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.iid_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem iid_trace_moment_eq_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
        (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
        (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ ((iidGramError b F (flattenY y)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      apply (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect_congr
      intro y
      rw [iidVectorError_eq_flattened_iidGramError hs hb]
    _ = (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
        (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      iidArrayLaw_expect_flatten_eq_iidLaw_expect
        (s := s) (n := n) hb
        (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.scaled_iid_trace_moment_eq_product
statement:
theorem scaled_iid_trace_moment_eq_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
        (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ cB b ^ (4 * q) *
            ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      apply (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect_congr
      intro y
      exact scaledIIDVectorError_trace_even F y q
    _ = cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ ((iidVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      exact FiniteLaw.expect_smul _ _ _
    _ = cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun ω ↦ ((iidGramError b F ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace) := by
      rw [iid_trace_moment_eq_product hs hb F q]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.unconditional_trace_moment_order
statement:
theorem unconditional_trace_moment_order (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (selectorArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun x ↦ ((sparseVectorError F x) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      (iidArrayLaw hb s n).expect
        (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [traceEvenPower, sparseSymmetricError,
    scaledIIDSymmetricError] using
      (unconditional_convex_order hb F
        (traceEvenPower (d := d) q)
        (convexOn_traceEvenPower d q))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.raw_trace_moment_le_scaled_product
statement:
theorem raw_trace_moment_le_scaled_product (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
        (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega ↦ ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
        (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
        (selectorArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun x ↦ ((sparseVectorError F x) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      (selector_trace_moment_eq_raw hs (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q).symm
    _ ≤ (iidArrayLaw (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) s n).expect
          (fun y ↦ ((scaledIIDVectorError F y) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      unconditional_trace_moment_order (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q
    _ = cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega ↦ ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      scaled_iid_trace_moment_eq_product hs hb F q

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.conditional_traceEvenPower_order
statement:

    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1)
    (frameLaw : FiniteLaw Omega) (frames : Omega → Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ omega shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) (frames omega)
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :

      (FiniteLaw.product frameLaw
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)

          (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
        {outcome | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample outcome.2))
            (rowMatrix (frames outcome.1).u) eps}
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteLaw.le_product_prob
  intro omega
  exact rounded_success_probability_of_band_bounds
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 (frames omega) (hband omega)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
      {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q eps
  let b := sparseBlockRows d q eps
  let beta := bandEnvelope d q (sparseRows d q eps) s
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (one_le_sparseMomentOrder d delta)
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    simpa [s, q] using sparseColumnSparsity_pos (q := sparseMomentOrder d delta) heps0
  have hbTwo : 2 ≤ b := by
    simpa [b, q] using two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
  have hb : 1 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hbTwo
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < sparseRows d q eps := by
    rw [sparseRows]
    positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta := bandEnvelope_nonneg hm hsR
  have hband' : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta := by
    intro shift nu hnu
    dsimp [q, s, b, beta]
    exact hband shift nu hnu
  have htail := failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (n := n) (s := s) (b := b) hs hb F hq hbeta0 hband' heps0
  let hb0 : 0 < b := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb
  let scale := exactScale (s := s) hb0
  have hscale0 : 0 ≤ scale := by
    exact (inv_pos.mpr (couplingA_pos hb0 hs)).le
  have hscaleStar : scale ≤ convexOrderConstant := by
    exact exactScale_le_cStar hb0 hs
  have hscaleSq : scale ^ 2 ≤ convexOrderConstant ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [convexOrderConstant_pos]
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps := by positivity
  have hbase : 3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps ≤
      momentBase d q eps := by
    rw [momentBase]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ heps0.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscaleSq (by norm_num)) hbeta0
  have hpow : (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) ≤
      (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase0 hbase _
  calc
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
      {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} =
        (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb0)).prob
          {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
      simp [s, b, q]
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) := htail
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ delta := by
      simpa [q] using rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
        hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
      {X | eps < ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :
      {X : UniformSparseSample
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
            sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n |
        eps < ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} =
      {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
    ext X
    have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (uniformSparseMatrix X) heps0.le
    simpa [not_le] using not_congr hiff
  rw [hevent]
  exact UniformSparse.rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F hband

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_success_probability_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_success_probability_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    1 - delta ≤
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
        {X | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
proof:
:= by
  let mu := uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
    (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
      (canonicalB_pos
        (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))
  let good : Set (UniformSparseSample
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
        sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
      (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n) :=
    {X | IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
  have hfail : mu.prob goodᶜ ≤ delta := by
    change mu.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤ delta
    exact UniformSparse.rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
      hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F hband
  calc
    1 - delta ≤ 1 - mu.prob goodᶜ := sub_le_sub_left hfail 1
    _ = mu.prob good := by
      simpa using (FiniteLaw.prob_compl mu goodᶜ).symm
    _ = _ := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.raw_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem raw_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b delta *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
        (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      (d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have htransfer := raw_trace_moment_le_scaled_product hs hb F q
  have hiid := iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (m := s * b) hb F hbeta hband
  have hcB0 : 0 ≤ cB b :=
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num).trans
      (one_le_cB (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  calc
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
        (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
        cB b ^ (4 * q) *
          (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
            (fun omega ↦ Matrix.trace
              ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q))) := htransfer
    _ ≤ cB b ^ (4 * q) *
        ((d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiid (pow_nonneg hcB0 _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
      have hc : cB b ^ (4 * q) = (cB b ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [hc]
      calc
        (cB b ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) *
            ((d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) =
            (d : ℝ) * ((cB b ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) *
              (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) := by ring
        _ = (d : ℝ) * ((cB b ^ 2) * (3 * beta)) ^ (2 * q) := by
          congr 1
          exact (mul_pow (cB b ^ 2) (3 * beta) (2 * q)).symm
        _ = (d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
          congr 2
          ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseStack_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem sparseStack_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ delta nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b delta *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).prob
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (d : ℝ) * ((3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) / eps) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmarkov := sparseStack_ose_failure_tail
    (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q hq eps heps
  have hmoment := raw_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds hs hb F hbeta hband
  calc
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).prob
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
          (fun z ↦ ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
            eps ^ (2 * q) := hmarkov
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) /
          eps ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmoment (pow_nonneg heps.le _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) * ((3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) / eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      rw [div_pow]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (by
          have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
          omega : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)).prob
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q eps
  let b := sparseBlockRows d q eps
  let beta := bandEnvelope d q (sparseRows d q eps) s
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (one_le_sparseMomentOrder d delta)
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    simpa [s, q] using sparseColumnSparsity_pos (q := sparseMomentOrder d delta) heps0
  have hbTwo : 2 ≤ b := by
    simpa [b, q] using two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
  have hb : 1 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hbTwo
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < sparseRows d q eps := by
    rw [sparseRows]
    positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta := by
    exact bandEnvelope_nonneg hm hsR
  have hband' : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta := by
    intro shift nu hnu
    dsimp [q, s, b, beta]
    exact hband shift nu hnu
  have htail := sparseStack_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (s := s) (b := b) hs hb F hq hbeta0 hband' heps0
  have hcB0 : 0 ≤ cB b :=
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num).trans
      (one_le_cB (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  have hcBStar : cB b ≤ convexOrderConstant :=
    cB_le_cStar (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)
  have hcSq : cB b ^ 2 ≤ convexOrderConstant ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [convexOrderConstant_pos]
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps := by positivity
  have hbase : 3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps ≤
      momentBase d q eps := by
    rw [momentBase]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ heps0.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcSq (by norm_num)) hbeta0
  have hpow : (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) ≤
      (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase0 hbase _
  calc
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (by
          have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
          omega : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)).prob
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} =
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).prob
          {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
            simp [s, b, q]
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) := htail
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ delta := by
      simpa [q] using rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
        hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (by
          have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
          omega : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)).prob
      {z | eps < ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :
      {z : SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n |
        eps < ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} =
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
    ext z
    have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))
        heps0.le
    simpa [not_le] using not_congr hiff
  rw [hevent]
  exact rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F hband

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_success_probability_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem rounded_success_probability_of_band_bounds
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu,
      nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta →
      ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
          (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)) :
    1 - delta ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (by
          have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
          omega : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)).prob
        {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
proof:
:= by
  let hbpos : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps := by
    have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
    omega
  let mu := sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
    (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n hbpos
  let good : Set (SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
      (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n) :=
    {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
  have hgoodCompl : goodᶜ =
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
    ext z
    rfl
  have hfail : mu.prob goodᶜ ≤ delta := by
    rw [hgoodCompl]
    simpa [mu] using rounded_failure_le_delta_of_band_bounds
      hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F hband
  calc
    1 - delta ≤ 1 - mu.prob goodᶜ := sub_le_sub_left hfail 1
    _ = mu.prob good := by
      simpa using (FiniteLaw.prob_compl mu goodᶜ).symm
    _ = (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (by
          have h := two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
            (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
          omega : 0 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)).prob
        {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
      rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq
statement: theorem euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq {d : ℕ} (x : EVec d) : euclideanNormSq x = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.applyMatrix_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem applyMatrix_one {d : ℕ} (x : EVec d) :
    applyMatrix (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp [applyMatrix]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.parseval_iff_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem parseval_iff_transpose_mul {n d : ℕ} (u : Fin n → EVec d) :
    frameOperator u = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) ↔
      (rowMatrix u).transpose * rowMatrix u = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    ext a b
    simp [frameOperator, rowMatrix, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    ext a b
    simp [frameOperator, rowMatrix, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.transpose_mul_rowMatrix
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_rowMatrix {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) :
    (rowMatrix F.u).transpose * rowMatrix F.u =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (parseval_iff_transpose_mul F.u).mp F.parseval

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.synthesize_inner
statement:
theorem synthesize_inner {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : EVec d) :
    ⟪synthesize F S a, x⟫_ℝ = ∑ i ∈ S, a i * ⟪F.u i, x⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  simp [synthesize, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator_mulVec
statement:
theorem partialFrameOperator_mulVec {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : EVec d) :
    applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F S) x = synthesize F S (analyze F x)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [applyMatrix, PiLp.toLp_apply, partialFrameOperator, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    synthesize, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul,
    PiLp.inner_apply, analyze, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Real.inner_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.reconstruct
statement:
theorem reconstruct {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec d) :
    synthesize F Finset.univ (analyze F x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← partialFrameOperator_mulVec]
  have hpartial : partialFrameOperator F Finset.univ =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) := by
    ext a b
    have hab := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ ↦ M a b) F.parseval
    simpa [partialFrameOperator, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using hab
  rw [hpartial]
  exact applyMatrix_one x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.analysis_energy_eq
statement:
theorem analysis_energy_eq {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec d) :
    (∑ i, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) = euclideanNormSq x
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := reconstruct F x
  calc
    (∑ i, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) =
        ⟪synthesize F Finset.univ (analyze F x), x⟫_ℝ := by
          rw [synthesize_inner]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          simp [analyze, pow_two]
    _ = ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ := by rw [hrec]
    _ = euclideanNormSq x := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.subset_analysis
statement:
theorem subset_analysis {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (x : EVec d) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) ≤ euclideanNormSq x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F x i) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ i, (analyze F x i) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (fun i ↦ sq_nonneg (analyze F x i))
    _ = euclideanNormSq x := analysis_energy_eq F x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.subset_synthesis
statement:
theorem subset_synthesis {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    euclideanNormSq (synthesize F S a) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, |a i| ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let y : EVec d := synthesize F S a
  let b : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ ⟪F.u i, y⟫_ℝ
  have hid : euclideanNormSq y = ∑ i ∈ S, a i * b i := by
    change ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ = _
    simpa [y, b] using synthesize_inner F S a y
  have hpoint (i : Fin n) : 2 * a i * b i ≤ (a i) ^ 2 + (b i) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a i - b i)]
  have hsum :
      2 * (∑ i ∈ S, a i * b i) ≤
        (∑ i ∈ S, (a i) ^ 2) + ∑ i ∈ S, (b i) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      2 * (∑ i ∈ S, a i * b i) = ∑ i ∈ S, 2 * a i * b i := by
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        ring
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, ((a i) ^ 2 + (b i) ^ 2) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi ↦ hpoint i)
      _ = (∑ i ∈ S, (a i) ^ 2) + ∑ i ∈ S, (b i) ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hb : (∑ i ∈ S, (b i) ^ 2) ≤ euclideanNormSq y := by
    simpa [b, analyze] using subset_analysis F S y
  have hsquares : euclideanNormSq y ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, (a i) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hsum]
  simpa only [sq_abs] using hsquares

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vector_normSq_le_one
statement:
theorem vector_normSq_le_one {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (F.u i) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := subset_analysis F {i} (F.u i)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ euclideanNormSq (F.u i) := by
    exact real_inner_self_nonneg
  have hii : analyze F (F.u i) i = euclideanNormSq (F.u i) := rfl
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, hii] at h
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.vector_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem vector_norm_le_one {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d) (i : Fin n) :
    ‖F.u i‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := vector_normSq_le_one F i
  rw [euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq] at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (F.u i)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.partialFrameOperator_contraction
statement:
theorem partialFrameOperator_contraction {n d : ℕ} (F : Frame n d)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : EVec d) :
    euclideanNormSq (applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F S) x) ≤ euclideanNormSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [partialFrameOperator_mulVec]
  calc
    euclideanNormSq (synthesize F S (analyze F x)) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ S, |analyze F x i| ^ 2 := subset_synthesis F S (analyze F x)
    _ = ∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F x i) ^ 2 := by simp only [sq_abs]
    _ ≤ euclideanNormSq x := subset_analysis F S x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.bandEnvelope_le_three_bandConstant
statement:
theorem bandEnvelope_le_three_bandConstant
    {d q : ℕ} {m s epsilon : ℝ}
    (hepsilon0 : 0 < epsilon) (hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hmScale : scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℝ) ≤ epsilon ^ 2 * m)
    (hsScale : scaleConstant * ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ epsilon * s) :
    bandEnvelope d q m s ≤ 3 * bandConstant * epsilon / scaleConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hL1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ scaleConstant := by nlinarith [ninety_lt_scaleConstant]
  have hepsilonL : epsilon ≤ scaleConstant := hepsilon1.trans hL1
  have hdense : (momentDim d q : ℝ) / m ≤ epsilon ^ 2 / scaleConstant ^ 2 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hm (sq_pos_of_pos scaleConstant_pos)).2
    nlinarith
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ epsilon / scaleConstant := (div_pos hepsilon0 scaleConstant_pos).le
  have ht1 : epsilon / scaleConstant ≤ 1 := (div_le_one scaleConstant_pos).2 hepsilonL
  have hlinear : (momentDim d q : ℝ) / m ≤ epsilon / scaleConstant := by
    calc
      (momentDim d q : ℝ) / m ≤ epsilon ^ 2 / scaleConstant ^ 2 := hdense
      _ = (epsilon / scaleConstant) ^ 2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ epsilon / scaleConstant := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (epsilon / scaleConstant)]
  have hroot : Real.sqrt ((momentDim d q : ℝ) / m) ≤ epsilon / scaleConstant := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
    exact ⟨ht0, by simpa [div_pow] using hdense⟩
  have hsparse : ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / s ≤ epsilon / scaleConstant := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hs scaleConstant_pos).2
    nlinarith
  rw [bandEnvelope]
  have hsum : Real.sqrt ((momentDim d q : ℝ) / m) +
      (momentDim d q : ℝ) / m + ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / s ≤
        3 * (epsilon / scaleConstant) := by linarith
  calc
    bandConstant * (Real.sqrt ((momentDim d q : ℝ) / m) +
        (momentDim d q : ℝ) / m + ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / s) ≤
        bandConstant * (3 * (epsilon / scaleConstant)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum bandConstant_pos.le
    _ = 3 * bandConstant * epsilon / scaleConstant := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_bandEnvelope_le
statement:
theorem rounded_bandEnvelope_le
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ}
    (hepsilon0 : 0 < epsilon) (hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1) :
    bandEnvelope d q (sparseRows d q epsilon) (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon) ≤
      3 * bandConstant * epsilon / scaleConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hsNat : 0 < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := sparseColumnSparsity_pos hepsilon0
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := by exact_mod_cast hsNat
  have hmLower := sparseRows_lower (d := d) (q := q) hepsilon0
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < sparseRows d q epsilon :=
    (rowTarget_pos hepsilon0).trans_le hmLower
  have hmScale : scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℝ) ≤
      epsilon ^ 2 * (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℝ) := by
    have hraw := (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hepsilon0)).mp
      (by simpa [rowTarget] using hmLower)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hraw
  have hsScale : scaleConstant * ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      epsilon * (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon : ℝ) := by
    have hraw := (div_le_iff₀ hepsilon0).mp
      (sparseColumnSparsity_lower q epsilon)
    simpa [mul_comm] using hraw

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_moment_base_lt_442

          3 * convexOrderConstant ^ 2 * (3 * bandConstant * epsilon / scaleConstant) / epsilon := by

proof:
:= by
  have hsNat : 0 < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := sparseColumnSparsity_pos hepsilon
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := by exact_mod_cast hsNat
  have hmLower := sparseRows_lower (d := d) (q := q) hepsilon

    (rowTarget_pos hepsilon).trans_le hmLower
  have hDq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by positivity

      (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon) := by

      (add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (div_nonneg hDq hm.le))
