name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
statement:
theorem rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
    {d : ℕ} {delta epsilon : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (hepsilon0 : 0 < epsilon) (hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1) :
    (d : ℝ) *
        (momentBase d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) epsilon) ^
          (2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta) ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  let rho := momentBase d q epsilon
  have hrho0 : 0 ≤ rho := by
    simpa [rho, q] using
      momentBase_nonneg (d := d) (q := sparseMomentOrder d delta) hepsilon0
  have hrho : rho ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    exact (momentBase_lt_half (d := d) (q := q) hepsilon0 hepsilon1).le
  have hpow : rho ^ (2 * q) ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ (2 * q) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hrho0 hrho _
  have hhalfFour : ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ (2 * q) = ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ^ q := by
    rw [pow_mul]
    norm_num
  calc
    (d : ℝ) *
        (momentBase d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) epsilon) ^
          (2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta) = (d : ℝ) * rho ^ (2 * q) := by
      simp [rho, q]
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ (2 * q)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ = (d : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ^ q := by rw [hhalfFour]
    _ ≤ delta := by
      simpa [q] using four_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le hd hdelta0 hdelta1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div
statement:
theorem FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (A : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ ω, (A ω).IsHermitian) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    μ.prob {ω | ε ≤ ‖A ω‖} ≤
      μ.expect (fun ω => ((A ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace) / ε ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow_ne : 2 * q ≠ 0 := Nat.mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Nat.ne_of_gt hq)
  have hevent : {ω | ε ≤ ‖A ω‖} = {ω | ε ^ (2 * q) ≤ ‖A ω‖ ^ (2 * q)} := by
    ext ω
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hε.le (norm_nonneg _) hpow_ne).symm
  rw [hevent]
  calc
    μ.prob {ω | ε ^ (2 * q) ≤ ‖A ω‖ ^ (2 * q)} ≤
        μ.expect (fun ω => ‖A ω‖ ^ (2 * q)) / ε ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact μ.markov
        (fun ω => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (A ω)) (2 * q))
        (pow_pos hε (2 * q))
    _ ≤ μ.expect (fun ω => ((A ω) ^ (2 * q)).trace) / ε ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (μ.expect_mono (fun ω => by
          simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using specNorm_pow_two_mul_le_trace_pow (hA ω) hq))
        (pow_nonneg hε.le (2 * q))

statement:
theorem sparseStack_ose_failure_tail {s b n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε} ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε} ≤
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
          {z | ε ≤ ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} := by
      apply FiniteLaw.prob_mono
      intro z hz
      have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))
          hε.le
      by_contra htail
      exact hz (hiff.mp (not_le.mp htail).le)
    _ ≤ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q) := sparseStack_matrix_markov_tail hb F q hq ε hε

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseStack_ose_success_probability
statement:
theorem sparseStack_ose_success_probability {s b n d : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (δ : ℝ)
    (hmoment :
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        ε ^ (2 * q) ≤ δ) :
    1 - δ ≤ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
      {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε}
proof:
:= by
  let good : Set (SparseStackSelectors s b n) :=
    {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε}
  have hfail : (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob goodᶜ ≤ δ := by
    calc
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob goodᶜ =
          (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
            {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε} := by
        rfl
      _ ≤ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
            (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
          ε ^ (2 * q) := sparseStack_ose_failure_tail hb F q hq ε hε
      _ ≤ δ := hmoment
  calc
    1 - δ ≤ 1 - (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob goodᶜ := by
      exact sub_le_sub_left hfail 1
    _ = (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob good := by
      simpa using (FiniteLaw.prob_compl (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb) goodᶜ).symm
    _ = (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).prob
        {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) ε} := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseColumnSparsity_lt_six_scaleConstant_mul_q_div

theorem sparseColumnSparsity_lt_six_scaleConstant_mul_q_div
    {q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ}

    (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon : ℝ) < 6 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon
proof:
:= by
  have hqReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hcount : (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 3 * (q : ℝ) := by
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hA :
      scaleConstant * ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / epsilon ≤
        3 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hepsilon0).2
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount scaleConstant_pos.le
    nlinarith
  have hL : (1 : ℝ) ≤ scaleConstant := by nlinarith [ninety_lt_scaleConstant]
  have hLq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) := mul_le_mul hL hqReal (by norm_num) scaleConstant_pos.le
  have hunit : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hepsilon0).2
    nlinarith
  calc
    (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon : ℝ) <
        scaleConstant * ((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / epsilon + 1 :=
      sparseColumnSparsity_lt_add_one hepsilon0
    _ ≤ 3 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon +
        (3 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon) := add_le_add hA hunit
    _ = 6 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon := by ring

statement:
theorem sparseRows_lower
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    rowTarget d q epsilon ≤ (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon
  have hsNat : 0 < s := sparseColumnSparsity_pos hepsilon
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hsNat
  have hb : rowTarget d q epsilon / (s : ℝ) ≤ (sparseBlockRows d q epsilon : ℝ) := by
    simpa [s] using sparseBlockRows_lower d q epsilon
  calc
    rowTarget d q epsilon = (s : ℝ) * (rowTarget d q epsilon / (s : ℝ)) := by
      field_simp
    _ ≤ (s : ℝ) * (sparseBlockRows d q epsilon : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hs.le
    _ = (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℕ) := by simp [sparseRows, s]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseRows_scale_condition
statement:
theorem sparseRows_scale_condition
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :

      (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℝ)
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseRows_lt_rowTarget_add_s
statement:
theorem sparseRows_lt_rowTarget_add_s
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℝ) <
      rowTarget d q epsilon + sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon
proof:
:= by
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon
  have hsNat : 0 < s := sparseColumnSparsity_pos hepsilon
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hsNat
  have hquot : 0 ≤ rowTarget d q epsilon / (s : ℝ) := by
    exact (div_pos (rowTarget_pos hepsilon) hs).le
  have hb : (sparseBlockRows d q epsilon : ℝ) <
      rowTarget d q epsilon / (s : ℝ) + 1 := by
    simpa [sparseBlockRows, s] using Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hquot
  calc
    (sparseRows d q epsilon : ℝ) =
        (s : ℝ) * (sparseBlockRows d q epsilon : ℝ) := by simp [sparseRows, s]
    _ < (s : ℝ) * (rowTarget d q epsilon / (s : ℝ) + 1) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hb hs
    _ = rowTarget d q epsilon + s := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.sparseColumnSparsity_lt_rowTarget
statement:
theorem sparseColumnSparsity_lt_rowTarget
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hepsilon0 : 0 < epsilon) (hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1) :
    (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon : ℝ) < rowTarget d q epsilon
proof:
:= by
  have hqPos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hq
  have hqDq : (q : ℝ) ≤ (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast q_le_momentDim d q
  have hsmall : 6 * (q : ℝ) * epsilon < scaleConstant * (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by
    calc
      6 * (q : ℝ) * epsilon ≤ 6 * (q : ℝ) := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hepsilon1
          (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6 * (q : ℝ))
      _ < scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by nlinarith [ninety_lt_scaleConstant]) hqPos
      _ ≤ scaleConstant * (momentDim d q : ℕ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqDq scaleConstant_pos.le
  have hcore : 6 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) * epsilon <
      scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by
    calc
      6 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) * epsilon = scaleConstant * (6 * (q : ℝ) * epsilon) := by ring
      _ < scaleConstant * (scaleConstant * (momentDim d q : ℕ)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsmall
          scaleConstant_pos
      _ = scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by ring
  have hscaled : 6 * scaleConstant * (q : ℝ) / epsilon < rowTarget d q epsilon := by
    rw [rowTarget]
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ hepsilon0 (sq_pos_of_pos hepsilon0)).2
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcore hepsilon0
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg epsilon]
  exact (sparseColumnSparsity_lt_six_scaleConstant_mul_q_div hq hepsilon0 hepsilon1).trans hscaled

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.two_le_sparseBlockRows
statement:
theorem two_le_sparseBlockRows
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hepsilon0 : 0 < epsilon) (hepsilon1 : epsilon ≤ 1) :
    2 ≤ sparseBlockRows d q epsilon
proof:
:= by
  have hsNat : 0 < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := sparseColumnSparsity_pos hepsilon0
  have hs : (0 : ℝ) < sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := by exact_mod_cast hsNat
  have hsM : (sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon : ℝ) < rowTarget d q epsilon :=
    sparseColumnSparsity_lt_rowTarget hq hepsilon0 hepsilon1
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) < rowTarget d q epsilon / sparseColumnSparsity q epsilon := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ hs).2
    simpa using hsM
  have hbCast : (1 : ℝ) < sparseBlockRows d q epsilon :=
    hratio.trans_le (sparseBlockRows_lower d q epsilon)
  exact_mod_cast hbCast

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.three_rowTarget_lt_306456
statement:
theorem three_rowTarget_lt_306456
    {d q : ℕ} {epsilon : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    3 * rowTarget d q epsilon <
      306456 * ((d : ℝ) + q) / epsilon ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hDqNat : momentDim d q ≤ 2 * (d + q) := momentDim_le_two_mul_add hd
  have hDq : (momentDim d q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((d : ℝ) + q) := by
    exact_mod_cast hDqNat
  have hDqPosNat : 0 < momentDim d q := by simp [momentDim]
  have hDqPos : (0 : ℝ) < (momentDim d q : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hDqPosNat
  have hLsq : scaleConstant ^ 2 < (226 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_lt_mul_self scaleConstant_pos.le scaleConstant_lt_226
  have hnum : 3 * (scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ)) <
      306456 * ((d : ℝ) + q) := by
    calc
      3 * (scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ)) <
          3 * ((226 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ)) := by
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
          (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hLsq hDqPos) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 3 * ((226 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * ((d : ℝ) + q))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDq (by positivity)) (by norm_num)
      _ = 306456 * ((d : ℝ) + q) := by ring
  calc
    3 * rowTarget d q epsilon =
        (3 * (scaleConstant ^ 2 * (momentDim d q : ℕ))) / epsilon ^ 2 := by
      rw [rowTarget]
      ring
    _ < (306456 * ((d : ℝ) + q)) / epsilon ^ 2 :=
      (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (sq_pos_of_pos hepsilon)).2 hnum
    _ = 306456 * ((d : ℝ) + q) / epsilon ^ 2 := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.matrix_markov_tail
statement:
theorem matrix_markov_tail
    (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).prob
        {X | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} ≤
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  exact FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb))
    (fun X ↦ gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X))
    (fun X ↦ gramError_isHermitian F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) q hq eps heps

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.ose_failure_tail
statement:
theorem ose_failure_tail
    (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).prob
        {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).prob
        {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).prob
          {X | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} := by
      apply FiniteLaw.prob_mono
      intro X hbad
      by_contra htail
      exact hbad
          ((norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (uniformSparseMatrix X) heps.le).mp
            (not_le.mp htail).le)
    _ ≤ (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q) :=
      matrix_markov_tail hb F q hq eps heps

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))).expect
        (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) ≤
      (d : ℝ) *
        (3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) ^
          (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  let hb0 : 0 < b := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb
  let scale := exactScale (s := s) hb0
  have htransfer := trace_moment_le_scaled_product hs hb F q
  have hiid := iid_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (m := s * b) hb F hbeta hband
  have hscale0 : 0 ≤ scale := by
    dsimp [scale, exactScale]
    exact (inv_pos.mpr (couplingA_pos hb0 hs)).le
  calc
    _ ≤ scale ^ (4 * q) *
        (iidLaw b hb (s * b) n).expect
          (fun omega => ((iidGramError b F omega) ^ (2 * q)).trace) :=
      htransfer
    _ ≤ scale ^ (4 * q) *
        ((d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiid (pow_nonneg hscale0 _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) * (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
      have hpow : scale ^ (4 * q) = (scale ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [hpow]
      calc
        (scale ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) * ((d : ℝ) * (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) =
            (d : ℝ) * ((scale ^ 2) ^ (2 * q) *
              (3 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) := by ring
        _ = (d : ℝ) * ((scale ^ 2) * (3 * beta)) ^ (2 * q) := by
          congr 1
          exact (mul_pow (scale ^ 2) (3 * beta) (2 * q)).symm
        _ = (d : ℝ) * (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q) := by
          congr 2
          ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.failure_tail_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))).prob
        {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (d : ℝ) *
        ((3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) /
          eps) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmarkov := ose_failure_tail
    (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q hq eps heps
  have hmoment := trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (n := n) hs hb F hbeta hband
  calc
    _ ≤ (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q) := hmarkov
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) *
          (3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) ^
            (2 * q)) / eps ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmoment (pow_nonneg heps.le _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) *
        ((3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) /
          eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      rw [div_pow]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.signedBasis_inner_hasLocalDegree_two
statement:
theorem signedBasis_inner_hasLocalDegree_two
    (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) 2
      (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
        ⟪signedBasis (toSample z) g i, signedBasis (toSample z) g j⟫_ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasLocalDegree.atom {(g, i), (g, j)} _
  · simpa using
      (Finset.card_insert_le (g, i) ({(g, j)} : Finset (Fin s × Fin n)))
  · intro z z' hagree
    have hi : z (g, i) = z' (g, i) := by
      exact hagree (g, i) (by simp)
    have hj : z (g, j) = z' (g, j) := by
      exact hagree (g, j) (by simp)
    change
      ⟪signedBasis (toSample z) g i, signedBasis (toSample z) g j⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪signedBasis (toSample z') g i, signedBasis (toSample z') g j⟫_ℝ
    rw [inner_signedBasis, inner_signedBasis]
    simp only [toSample_hash, toSample_sign]
    have hiHash := congrArg (fun x : SignedHash b => x.1) hi
    have hjHash := congrArg (fun x : SignedHash b => x.1) hj
    have hiSign := congrArg (fun x : SignedHash b => x.2) hi
    have hjSign := congrArg (fun x : SignedHash b => x.2) hj
    simp only [hiHash, hjHash, hiSign, hjSign]
    rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two
statement:
theorem gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (a c : Fin d) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) 2
      (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n => (gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) a
          c)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner (g : Fin s) (i j : Fin n) :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) 2
        (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
          ⟪signedBasis (toSample z) g i,
            signedBasis (toSample z) g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c) := by
    have h := signedBasis_inner_hasLocalDegree_two
      (b := b) g i j
    have hscaled := HasLocalDegree.smul (F.u i a * F.u j c) h
    convert hscaled using 1
    funext z
    ring
  have hsum :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) 2
        (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
          ∑ g, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            ⟪signedBasis (toSample z) g i,
              signedBasis (toSample z) g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c) := by
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
    intro g
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
    intro i
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_finset (Finset.univ.erase i)
      (fun j z =>
        ⟪signedBasis (toSample z) g i,
          signedBasis (toSample z) g j⟫_ℝ * F.u i a * F.u j c)
    intro j hj
    exact hinner g i j
  have hscaled := HasLocalDegree.smul (1 / (s : ℝ)) hsum
  apply HasLocalDegree.congr hscaled
  funext z
  have hblock := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ => A a c)
    (gramError_eq_block_first F (toSample z) hs)
  simpa using hblock.symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree
statement:
theorem gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (r : ℕ) (a c : Fin d) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) (2 * r)
      (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ r) a
          c)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing a c with
  | zero =>
      simpa using
        (HasLocalDegree.constant (ι := Fin s × Fin n)
          (α := SignedHash b) 0 ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c))
  | succ r ihr =>
      have hsum :
          HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b)
            (2 * r + 2)
            (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
              ∑ x : Fin d,
                ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ r) a x *
                  (gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) x c) := by
        apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
        intro x
        exact HasLocalDegree.mul (ihr a x)
          (gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two (b := b) hs F x c)
      have hdegree :
          HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b)
            (2 * (Nat.succ r))
            (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
              ∑ x : Fin d,
                ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ r) a x *
                  (gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) x c) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_succ] using hsum
      apply HasLocalDegree.congr hdegree
      funext z
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.trace_power_hasLocalDegree
statement:
theorem trace_power_hasLocalDegree
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (r : ℕ) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) (2 * r)
      (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
        ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ r).trace)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin s × Fin n) (α := SignedHash b) (2 * r)
        (fun z : SparseStackSelectors s b n =>
          ∑ a : Fin d, ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ r) a a) := by
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
    intro a
    exact gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree (b := b) hs F r a a
  apply HasLocalDegree.congr hsum
  funext z
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (SparseStackSelectors s b n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb) (4 * q)) :
    μ.expect (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
        (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:

    (trace_power_hasLocalDegree (b := b) hs F (2 * q))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (SparseStackSelectors s b n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {z | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div μ
    (fun z => gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)))
    (fun z => gramError_isHermitian F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)))
    q hq eps heps
  rw [trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul hs hb F q μ hmatch] at htail
  exact htail

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (SparseStackSelectors s b n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        μ.prob {z | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} := by
      apply FiniteLaw.prob_mono
      intro z hfail
      have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))
          heps.le
      by_contra htail
      exact hfail (hiff.mp (not_le.mp htail).le)
    _ ≤ (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n hb).expect
          (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q) :=
      matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
        hs hb F q hq eps heps μ hmatch

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (SparseStackSelectors s b n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (d : ℝ) * ((3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) / eps) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmarkov := ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    hs (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q hq eps heps μ hmatch
  have hmoment := raw_trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    hs hb F hbeta hband
  calc
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)).expect
            (fun z => ((gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
          eps ^ (2 * q) := hmarkov
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) ^ (2 * q)) /
          eps ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmoment (pow_nonneg heps.le _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) * ((3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta) / eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      rw [div_pow]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (μ : FiniteLaw
      (SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))
      (4 * sparseMomentOrder d delta)) :
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q eps
  let b := sparseBlockRows d q eps
  let beta := bandEnvelope d q (sparseRows d q eps) s
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (one_le_sparseMomentOrder d delta)
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    simpa [s, q] using sparseColumnSparsity_pos (q := sparseMomentOrder d delta) heps0
  have hbTwo : 2 ≤ b := by
    simpa [b, q] using two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
  have hb : 1 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hbTwo
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < sparseRows d q eps := by
    rw [sparseRows]
    positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta := bandEnvelope_nonneg hm hsR
  have hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta := by
    intro shift nu hnu
    dsimp [q, s, b, beta]
    exact rounded_band_bound
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1 F shift nu hnu
  have hmatch' : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw s b n (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)) (4 * q) := by
    simpa [q, s, b] using hmatch
  have htail := limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    hs hb F hq hbeta0 hband heps0 μ hmatch'
  have hcB0 : 0 ≤ cB b :=
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num).trans
      (one_le_cB (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))
  have hcBStar : cB b ≤ convexOrderConstant :=
    cB_le_cStar (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)
  have hcSq : cB b ^ 2 ≤ convexOrderConstant ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [convexOrderConstant_pos]
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps := by positivity
  have hbase : 3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps ≤
      momentBase d q eps := by
    rw [momentBase]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ heps0.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcSq (by norm_num)) hbeta0
  have hpow : (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) ≤
      (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase0 hbase _
  calc
    μ.prob {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (d : ℝ) * (3 * cB b ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      simpa [q, s, b, beta] using htail
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ delta := by
      simpa [q] using rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
        hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (μ : FiniteLaw
      (SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))
      (4 * sparseMomentOrder d delta)) :
    μ.prob {z | eps < ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :
      {z : SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n |
        eps < ‖gramError F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))‖} =
      {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
    ext z
    have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z))
        heps0.le
    simpa [not_le] using not_congr hiff
  rw [hevent]
  exact rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F μ hmatch

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_ose_success_probability_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem rounded_ose_success_probability_of_matchesUpTo
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (μ : FiniteLaw
      (SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
        (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))
      (4 * sparseMomentOrder d delta)) :
    1 - delta ≤
      μ.prob {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
proof:
:= by
  let good : Set
      (SparseStackSelectors (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n) :=
    {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps}
  have hfail : μ.prob goodᶜ ≤ delta := by
    have hcomp : goodᶜ =
        {z | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
      ext z
      rfl
    rw [hcomp]
    exact rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
      hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F μ hmatch
  calc
    1 - delta ≤ 1 - μ.prob goodᶜ := sub_le_sub_left hfail 1
    _ = μ.prob good := by
      simpa using (FiniteLaw.prob_compl μ goodᶜ).symm
    _ = μ.prob {z | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample z)) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.rounded_band_bound
statement:
theorem rounded_band_bound
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (shift : Shift) (nu : ℕ)
    (hnu : nu ≤ 2 * sparseMomentOrder d delta) :
    ‖normalizedBand (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) F
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bandEnvelope d (sparseMomentOrder d delta)
        (sparseRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps := sparseColumnSparsity_pos
      heps0
  have hbTwo : 2 ≤ sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps :=
    two_le_main_sparseBlockRows (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
  have hb : 1 < sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps := by omega
  rw [sparseRows_eq_s_mul_b]
  exact concrete_band_bound_le_beta F
    (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
    (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
    (sparseMomentOrder d delta) nu hs hb hnu shift

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fully_independent_sparseStack
statement:
theorem fully_independent_sparseStack
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d) :
    MainConclusions delta eps F heps0 heps1
proof:
:= by
  apply main_conclusions_of_band_bounds hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F
  intro shift nu hnu
  exact rounded_band_bound heps0 heps1 F shift nu hnu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fully_independent_sparseStack_matrix
statement:
theorem fully_independent_sparseStack_matrix
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hU : U.transpose * U = (1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) :
    MatrixMainConclusions delta eps U heps0 heps1
proof:
:= by
  let F := frameOfMatrix U hU
  have hmain : MainConclusions delta eps F heps0 heps1 :=
    fully_independent_sparseStack hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F
  refine
    { operatorFailure := ?_
      oseSuccess := ?_
      exactColumnSparsity := hmain.exactColumnSparsity
      qAtLeastOne := hmain.qAtLeastOne
      sparsityStrict := hmain.sparsityStrict
      rowsStrict := hmain.rowsStrict
      bAtLeastTwo := hmain.bAtLeastTwo
      rowsFactor := hmain.rowsFactor }
  · simpa [F] using hmain.operatorFailure
  · simpa [F] using hmain.oseSuccess

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.fully_independent_sparseStack_independent_frame
statement:
theorem fully_independent_sparseStack_independent_frame
    {Omega : Type*} [Fintype Omega]
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1)
    (frameLaw : FiniteLaw Omega) (frames : Omega → Frame n d) :
    1 - delta ≤
      (FiniteLaw.product frameLaw
        (sparseStackSelectorLaw (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n
          (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1))).prob
        {outcome | IsSubspaceEmbedding (sparseStackMatrix (toSample outcome.2))
            (rowMatrix (frames outcome.1).u) eps}
proof:
:= by
  apply independent_frame_ose_success_of_band_bounds
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 frameLaw frames
  intro omega shift nu hnu
  exact rounded_band_bound heps0 heps1 (frames omega) shift nu hnu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.one_le_sparseMomentOrder
statement:
theorem one_le_sparseMomentOrder (d : ℕ) (delta : ℝ) :
    1 ≤ sparseMomentOrder d delta

:= by
  exact Nat.le_max_left _ _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.log2_ratio_le_sparseMomentOrder
statement:
theorem log2_ratio_le_sparseMomentOrder (d : ℕ) (delta : ℝ) :
    Real.logb 2 ((d : ℝ) / delta) ≤ (sparseMomentOrder d delta : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Real.logb 2 ((d : ℝ) / delta) ≤
        (⌈Real.logb 2 ((d : ℝ) / delta)⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    _ ≤ (sparseMomentOrder d delta : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_max_right 1 ⌈Real.logb 2 ((d : ℝ) / delta)⌉₊

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ratio_le_two_pow_sparseMomentOrder
statement:
theorem ratio_le_two_pow_sparseMomentOrder
    {d : ℕ} {delta : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    (d : ℝ) / delta ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ sparseMomentOrder d delta
proof:
:= by
  have hdReal : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd
  have hratio : 0 < (d : ℝ) / delta := div_pos hdReal hdelta
  have hlog := log2_ratio_le_sparseMomentOrder d delta
  have hrpow :=
    (Real.logb_le_iff_le_rpow (b := (2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) hratio).mp hlog
  simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using hrpow

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.half_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le
statement:
theorem half_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le
    {d : ℕ} {delta : ℝ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ sparseMomentOrder d delta ≤ delta / d
proof:
:= by
  have hdReal : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hd
  have hratio : 0 < (d : ℝ) / delta := div_pos hdReal hdelta
  have hinv := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hratio
    (ratio_le_two_pow_sparseMomentOrder hd hdelta)
  calc
    ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ sparseMomentOrder d delta =
        1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ sparseMomentOrder d delta) := by
      rw [one_div_pow]
    _ ≤ 1 / ((d : ℝ) / delta) := hinv
    _ = delta / d := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.four_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le
statement:
theorem four_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le
    {d : ℕ} {delta : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1) :
    (d : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ^ sparseMomentOrder d delta ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  have hdReal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hdPos : (0 : ℝ) < d := zero_lt_one.trans_le hdReal
  have hhalf : ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ q ≤ delta / d := by
    simpa [q] using half_pow_sparseMomentOrder_le hd hdelta0
  have hhalf0 : 0 ≤ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ q := by positivity
  have hsq : (((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ q) ^ 2 ≤ (delta / d) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_le_mul_self hhalf0 hhalf
  have hfour : ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ^ q = (((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ q) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show ((1 : ℝ) / 4) = ((1 : ℝ) / 2) * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) by norm_num]
    simp [mul_pow, pow_two]
  have hfirst : (d : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 4) ^ q ≤ delta ^ 2 / d := by
    rw [hfour]
    calc
      (d : ℝ) * (((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ q) ^ 2 ≤
          (d : ℝ) * (delta / d) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hdPos.le
      _ = delta ^ 2 / d := by field_simp
  have hdeltaD : delta ≤ (d : ℝ) := hdelta1.trans hdReal
  have hmul : delta * delta ≤ delta * (d : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdeltaD hdelta0.le
  have hsecond : delta ^ 2 / (d : ℝ) ≤ delta := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdPos).2
    simpa [pow_two] using hmul
  exact hfirst.trans hsecond

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.ninety_lt_scaleConstant
statement: theorem ninety_lt_scaleConstant : (90 : ℝ) < scaleConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (1 : ℝ) < convexOrderConstant ^ 2 := by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.columnInner_hasLocalDegree_two
statement:
theorem columnInner_hasLocalDegree_two
    (i j : Fin n) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) 2
      (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
        ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasLocalDegree.atom {i, j} _
  · simpa using (Finset.card_insert_le i ({j} : Finset (Fin n)))
  · intro X X' hagree
    have hi : X i = X' i := hagree i (by simp)
    have hj : X j = X' j := hagree j (by simp)
    change (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) =
      ∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X' i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X' j) r
    rw [hi, hj]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two
statement:
theorem gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (a c : Fin d) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) 2
      (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n => gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X) a c)
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (i j : Fin n) :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) 2
        (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
          (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
            F.u i a * F.u j c) := by
    have h := columnInner_hasLocalDegree_two (b := b) (s := s) i j
    have hscaled := HasLocalDegree.smul (F.u i a * F.u j c) h
    convert hscaled using 1
    funext X
    ring
  have hsum :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) 2
        (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
          ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
            (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
              F.u i a * F.u j c) := by
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
    intro i
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_finset (Finset.univ.erase i)
      (fun j X =>
        (∑ r, UniformSparseColumn.value (X i) r * UniformSparseColumn.value (X j) r) *
          F.u i a * F.u j c)
    intro j _hj
    exact hterm i j
  have hscaled := HasLocalDegree.smul (1 / (s : ℝ)) hsum
  apply HasLocalDegree.congr hscaled
  funext X
  have hhollow := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ => A a c)
    (UniformSparse.gramError_eq_hollow F X hs)
  simpa [UniformSparse.hollowGram] using hhollow.symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree
statement:
theorem gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (r : ℕ) (a c : Fin d) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (2 * r)
      (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ r) a
          c)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing a c with
  | zero =>
      simpa using
        (HasLocalDegree.constant (ι := Fin n)
          (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) 0
          ((1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) a c))
  | succ r ihr =>
      have hsum :
          HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
            (2 * r + 2)
            (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
              ∑ x : Fin d,
                ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ r) a x * gramError F
                    (uniformSparseMatrix X) x c) := by
        apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
        intro x
        exact HasLocalDegree.mul (ihr a x)
          (UniformSparse.gramError_entry_hasLocalDegree_two (b := b) hs F x c)
      have hdegree :
          HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s)
            (2 * (Nat.succ r))
            (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
              ∑ x : Fin d,
                ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ r) a x * gramError F
                    (uniformSparseMatrix X) x c) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_succ] using hsum
      apply HasLocalDegree.congr hdegree
      funext X
      rw [pow_succ, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.trace_power_hasLocalDegree
statement:
theorem trace_power_hasLocalDegree
    (hs : 0 < s) (F : Frame n d) (r : ℕ) :
    HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (2 * r)
      (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
          ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ r).trace)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :
      HasLocalDegree (ι := Fin n) (α := UniformSparseColumn (s * b) s) (2 * r)
        (fun X : UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n =>
          ∑ a : Fin d, ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ r) a a) := by
    apply HasLocalDegree.sum_fintype
    intro a
    exact UniformSparse.gramError_pow_entry_hasLocalDegree (b := b) hs F r a a
  apply HasLocalDegree.congr hsum
  funext X
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d) (q : ℕ)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)) (4 * q)) :
    μ.expect (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) =
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
        (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasLocalDegree.expect_eq_of_matchesUpTo hmatch
  have hdegree : 2 * (2 * q) = 4 * q := by omega
  simpa only [hdegree] using
    (UniformSparse.trace_power_hasLocalDegree (b := b) hs F (2 * q))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {X | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} ≤
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have htail := FiniteLaw.prob_le_norm_le_expect_trace_pow_div μ
    (fun X ↦ gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X))
    (fun X ↦ gramError_isHermitian F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) q hq eps heps
  rw [UniformSparse.trace_even_moment_eq_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul hs hb F q μ hmatch] at htail
  exact htail

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
statement:
theorem ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (eps : ℝ) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        μ.prob {X | eps ≤ ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} := by
      apply FiniteLaw.prob_mono
      intro X hbad
      by_contra htail
      exact hbad
          ((norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (uniformSparseMatrix X) heps.le).mp
            (not_le.mp htail).le)
    _ ≤ (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n) (le_rows (s := s) hb)).expect
          (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
        eps ^ (2 * q) :=
      UniformSparse.matrix_markov_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
        hs hb F q hq eps heps μ hmatch

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
statement:
theorem limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) (F : Frame n d)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {beta : ℝ} (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta)
    {eps : ℝ} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (UniformSparseSample (s * b) s n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))) (4 * q)) :
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
      (d : ℝ) *
        ((3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) /
          eps) ^ (2 * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmarkov := UniformSparse.ose_failure_tail_of_matchesUpTo_four_mul
    hs (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) F q hq eps heps μ hmatch
  have hmoment := trace_moment_le_of_band_bounds
    (n := n) hs hb F hbeta hband
  calc
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
          (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb))).expect
            (fun X => ((gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)) ^ (2 * q)).trace) /
          eps ^ (2 * q) := hmarkov
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) *
          (3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) ^
            (2 * q)) / eps ^ (2 * q) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmoment (pow_nonneg heps.le _)
    _ = (d : ℝ) *
        ((3 * exactScale (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb) ^ 2 * beta) /
          eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      rw [div_pow]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (μ : FiniteLaw
      (UniformSparseSample
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
          sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1)))
      (4 * sparseMomentOrder d delta)) :
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let q := sparseMomentOrder d delta
  let s := sparseColumnSparsity q eps
  let b := sparseBlockRows d q eps
  let beta := bandEnvelope d q (sparseRows d q eps) s
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt (one_le_sparseMomentOrder d delta)
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    simpa [s, q] using sparseColumnSparsity_pos (q := sparseMomentOrder d delta) heps0
  have hbTwo : 2 ≤ b := by
    simpa [b, q] using two_le_main_sparseBlockRows
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1
  have hb : 1 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) hbTwo
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < sparseRows d q eps := by
    rw [sparseRows]
    positivity
  have hsR : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs
  have hbeta0 : 0 ≤ beta := bandEnvelope_nonneg hm hsR
  have hband : ∀ shift nu, nu ≤ 2 * q →
      ‖normalizedBand (s * b) F b shift *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ beta := by
    intro shift nu hnu
    dsimp [q, s, b, beta]
    exact rounded_band_bound
      (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1 F shift nu hnu
  have hmatch' : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := s) (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb)))
      (4 * q) := by
    simpa [q, s, b] using hmatch
  have htail := UniformSparse.limited_failure_tail_of_band_bounds
    (n := n) hs hb F hq hbeta0 hband heps0 μ hmatch'
  let hb0 : 0 < b := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hb
  let scale := exactScale (s := s) hb0
  have hscale0 : 0 ≤ scale := by
    exact (inv_pos.mpr (couplingA_pos hb0 hs)).le
  have hscaleStar : scale ≤ convexOrderConstant := by
    exact exactScale_le_cStar hb0 hs
  have hscaleSq : scale ^ 2 ≤ convexOrderConstant ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [convexOrderConstant_pos]
  have hbase0 : 0 ≤ 3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps := by positivity
  have hbase : 3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps ≤
      momentBase d q eps := by
    rw [momentBase]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ heps0.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscaleSq (by norm_num)) hbeta0
  have hpow : (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) ≤
      (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hbase0 hbase _
  calc
    μ.prob {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} ≤
        (d : ℝ) * (3 * scale ^ 2 * beta / eps) ^ (2 * q) := by
      simpa [scale, hb0] using htail
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) * (momentBase d q eps) ^ (2 * q) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
    _ ≤ delta := by
      simpa [q] using rounded_scalar_failure_le_delta
        hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.UniformSparse.rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
statement:
theorem rounded_operator_norm_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    {n d : ℕ} {delta eps : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdelta0 : 0 < delta) (hdelta1 : delta ≤ 1)
    (heps0 : 0 < eps) (heps1 : eps ≤ 1) (F : Frame n d)
    (μ : FiniteLaw
      (UniformSparseSample
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
          sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
        (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n))
    (hmatch : FiniteLaw.MatchesUpTo μ
      (uniformSparseSampleLaw (n := n)
        (le_rows (s := sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (canonicalB_pos (d := d) (delta := delta) heps0 heps1)))
      (4 * sparseMomentOrder d delta)) :
    μ.prob {X | eps < ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  have hevent :
      {X : UniformSparseSample
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps *
            sparseBlockRows d (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps)
          (sparseColumnSparsity (sparseMomentOrder d delta) eps) n |
        eps < ‖gramError F (uniformSparseMatrix X)‖} =
      {X | ¬ IsSubspaceEmbedding (uniformSparseMatrix X) (rowMatrix F.u) eps} := by
    ext X
    have hiff := norm_gramError_le_iff_isSubspaceEmbedding F (uniformSparseMatrix X) heps0.le
    simpa [not_le] using not_congr hiff
  rw [hevent]
  exact UniformSparse.rounded_ose_failure_le_delta_of_matchesUpTo
    hd hdelta0 hdelta1 heps0 heps1 F μ hmatch

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.COne_mul_AUpOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_AUpOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    COne F r i * AUpOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pUp, .rUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne,
    AUpOne, orderedWordTerm, externalTensor,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u j inp.1 * rUpAt r j p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p *
            rUpAt r j p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .rUp) out.2 inp.2 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_rUpAt_of_ne r hij)
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using congrArg
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) * t) h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.COne_mul_AUpOne_self
statement:
theorem COne_mul_AUpOne_self (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    COne F r i * AUpOne F r i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne,
    AUpOne, Matrix.zero_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u i inp.1 * rUpAt r i p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p *
            rUpAt r i p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_rUpAt_self r i)
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] at h
      rw [h, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.COne_mul_ADownOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_ADownOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    COne F r i * ADownOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pUp, .rDown)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne,
    ADownOne, orderedWordTerm, externalTensor,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u j inp.1 * rDownAt r j p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p *
            rDownAt r j p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .rDown) out.2 inp.2 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_rDownAt_of_ne r hij)
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using congrArg
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) * t) h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.COne_mul_ADownOne_self
statement:
theorem COne_mul_ADownOne_self (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    COne F r i * ADownOne F r i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne,
    ADownOne, Matrix.zero_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u i inp.1 * rDownAt r i p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p *
            rDownAt r i p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_rDownAt_self r i)
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] at h
      rw [h, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.CMatrix_mul_AUpMatrix
statement:
theorem CMatrix_mul_AUpMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    CMatrix F r * AUpMatrix F r =
      ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pUp, .rUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CMatrix_eq_sum_COne,
    AUpMatrix_eq_sum_one, Matrix.sum_mul]

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [COne_mul_AUpOne_self]
  simp only [add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact COne_mul_AUpOne_of_ne F r (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.Xplus_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Xplus_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Xplus m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
      (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (AUpStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Xplus_eq_CStack_mul_AUpStack]
  have hins := rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection
    (m := m) F nu
  have hout := gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection
    (m := m) F (nu + 1)
  have hout' :
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) =
        CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) := by
    convert hout using 1
  calc
    (CStack (m := m) F *
        AUpStack (m := m) F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      CStack (m := m) F *
        (AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = CStack (m := m) F *
        (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) *
          AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      rw [hins]
    _ = (CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hout']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.Xzero_grade_factor_add_one
statement:
theorem Xzero_grade_factor_add_one (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    Xzero m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) =
      (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k) *
        (ADownStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Xzero_eq_CStack_mul_ADownStack]
  have hins := rowProjection_ADownStack_output
    (m := m) F k
  have hout := gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection
    (m := m) F k
  calc
    (CStack (m := m) F *
        ADownStack (m := m) F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1) =
      CStack (m := m) F *
        (ADownStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = CStack (m := m) F *
        (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k *
          ADownStack (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1)) := by
      rw [hins]
    _ = (CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k) *
        (ADownStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_Xplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Xplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          (nu : ℝ) / s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalized_directional_term_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_Xplus_restricted_le (m := s * b) F nu)
        rho_div_stack_nonneg
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa [bTerm] using
        mixed_plus_absorb
          (d := d) (nu := nu) hs hb

proof:
:= by

  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖XplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) *
