name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_Xzero_pair_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Xzero_pair_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) / s
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu +
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu := by
    simp only [smul_add, add_mul]
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))) := by
      have h₁ := norm_normalized_Xzero_restricted_le F s b nu
      have h₂ := norm_normalized_XzeroAdj_restricted_le F s b nu
      linarith
    _ ≤ _ := mixed_zero_absorb hs hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.nu_div_s_le_cTerm
statement:
private theorem nu_div_s_le_cTerm {s nu : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (nu : ℝ) / s ≤ cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cTerm
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le_tex
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le_tex (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((nu : ℝ) / s)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu +
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu := by
    simp only [smul_add, add_mul]
  rw [hsplit]
  have hX := norm_normalized_Xplus_restricted_le F s b nu hs hb
  have hY := norm_normalized_Yplus_restricted_le
    F s b nu hs hb
  have hB : 0 ≤ bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ)
      (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    bTerm_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
            (nu : ℝ) / s) + (nu : ℝ) / s := add_le_add hX hY
    _ ≤ bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((nu : ℝ) / s) := by linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((nu : ℝ) / s) :=
      norm_normalized_mixed_plus_restricted_le_tex F s b nu hs hb
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have h := nu_div_s_le_cTerm (nu := nu) hs
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_minus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_mixed_minus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (XplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (XplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            XplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu +
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu := by
    simp only [smul_add, add_mul]
  rw [hsplit]
  have hX := norm_normalized_XplusAdj_restricted_le F s b nu hs hb
  have hY := norm_normalized_YplusAdj_restricted_le
    F s b nu hs hb
  have hB : 0 ≤ bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ)
      (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
    bTerm_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hnu := nu_div_s_le_cTerm (nu := nu) hs
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            XplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
            (nu : ℝ) / s) + (nu : ℝ) / s := add_le_add hX hY
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le_tex
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le_tex (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * ((nu : ℝ) / s)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu +
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu := by
    simp only [smul_add, add_mul]
    abel
  rw [hsplit]
  have hX := norm_normalized_Xzero_pair_restricted_le F s b nu hs hb
  have hY := norm_normalized_Yzero_pair_restricted_le
    F s b nu hs hb
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) / s) +
        Real.sqrt 2 * ((nu : ℝ) / s) := add_le_add hX hY
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Xzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            XzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * cTerm (nu : ℝ) (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        (1 + Real.sqrt 2) * ((nu : ℝ) / s) :=
      norm_normalized_mixed_zero_restricted_le_tex F s b nu hs hb
    _ ≤ _ := by
      have hM : (0 : ℝ) < ((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hfirst :
          ((d : ℝ) + nu) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
            bTerm (d : ℝ) (nu : ℝ) (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        unfold bTerm
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hM.le
      have hnu := nu_div_s_le_cTerm (nu := nu) hs
      have hsqrt : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
      exact add_le_add hfirst (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnu hsqrt)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_Xplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Xplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Xplus m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hC := CStack_restricted_norm (m := m) F (nu + 1)
  have hC' :
      ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (nu + 1 : ℕ)) := by
    convert hC using 1
  calc
    _ = ‖(gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
            CStack (m := m) F *
            rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
          (AUpStack (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu)‖ :=
      congrArg norm (Xplus_grade_factor (m := m) F nu)
    _ ≤
        ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2) *
            CStack (m := m) F *
            rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ *
          ‖AUpStack (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (nu + 1 : ℕ)) * Real.sqrt nu := by
      exact mul_le_mul
        hC'
        (AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F nu)
        (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1)) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)]
      push_cast
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_Xzero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Xzero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Xzero m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))
proof:
:= by
  rcases nu with (_ | k)
  · rw [Xzero_gradeProjection_zero]
    simp
  · have hC := CStack_restricted_norm (m := m) F k
    have hC' :
        ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) *
            CStack (m := m) F *
            rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k‖ ≤
          Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (k : ℝ)) := hC
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
          norm_num
    calc
      _ = ‖(gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) *
              CStack (m := m) F *
              rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k) *
            (ADownStack (m := m) F *
              gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1))‖ :=
        congrArg norm (Xzero_grade_factor_add_one (m := m) F k)
      _ ≤
          ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1) *
              CStack (m := m) F *
              rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) k‖ *
            ‖ADownStack (m := m) F *
              gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 1)‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          Real.sqrt (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul hC'
          (ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm
            (m := m) F (k + 1))
          (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ = Real.sqrt (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((d : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg (k + 1))]
        ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_XplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le
statement:
theorem norm_XplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖XplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 2)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ‖(XplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)).transpose‖ := by
      exact (specNorm_transpose _).symm
    _ = ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) *
          Xplus m (Frame.rows F)‖ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, transpose_XplusAdj, gradeProjection_transpose]
    _ = ‖Xplus m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) k‖ := by
      rw [gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
        (Xplus_homogeneous (m := m) F) (k + 2) k (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ _ := norm_Xplus_restricted_le (m := m) F k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.XplusAdj_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem XplusAdj_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    XplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
    (XplusAdj_homogeneous (m := m) F) 0
  intro mu
  omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.XplusAdj_gradeProjection_one
statement:
theorem XplusAdj_gradeProjection_one (F : Frame n d) :
    XplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
    (XplusAdj_homogeneous (m := m) F) 1
  intro mu
  omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_XplusAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_XplusAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖XplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases nu with (_ | _ | k)
  · rw [XplusAdj_gradeProjection_zero]
    simp
  · rw [XplusAdj_gradeProjection_one]
    simp
  · calc
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + k + 1)) :=
        norm_XplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le (m := m) F k
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((d : ℝ) + ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
        push_cast
        nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg d : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d),
          (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Mixed.norm_XzeroAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_XzeroAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖XzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) * ((d : ℝ) + nu))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ‖(XzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu).transpose‖ := by
      exact (specNorm_transpose _).symm
    _ = ‖gradeProjection (d := d) nu *
          Xzero m (Frame.rows F)‖ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, transpose_XzeroAdj, gradeProjection_transpose]
    _ = ‖Xzero m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := by
      rw [gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
        (Xzero_homogeneous (m := m) F) nu nu (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ _ := norm_Xzero_restricted_le (m := m) F nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.frameRows_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem frameRows_apply (F : Frame n d) (i : Fin n) (k : Fin d) :
    Frame.rows F i k = F.u i k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair_apply_left
proof:
:= by
  simp [setPair, hst]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem setPair_apply_right (p : Pattern m n) (s t : Site m n)
    (a b : Level) :
    setPair p s a t b t = b
proof:
:= by
  simp [setPair]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair_apply_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  simp [setPair, hxs, hxt]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.agreesOutsidePair_setPair
statement:
theorem agreesOutsidePair_setPair (p : Pattern m n) (s t : Site m n)
    (a b : Level) :
    agreesOutsidePair s t p (setPair p s a t b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxs hxt
  symm
  exact setPair_apply_of_ne p hxs hxt a b

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.eq_setPair_iff
statement:
theorem eq_setPair_iff {out inp : Pattern m n} {s t : Site m n}
    (hst : s ≠ t) (a b : Level) :
    inp = setPair out s a t b ↔
      agreesOutsidePair s t out inp ∧ inp s = a ∧ inp t = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨agreesOutsidePair_setPair out s t a b,
      setPair_apply_left out hst a b, setPair_apply_right out s t a b⟩
  · rintro ⟨hout, hs, ht⟩
    funext x
    by_cases hxs : x = s
    · subst x
      simpa [setPair_apply_left out hst a b] using hs
    · by_cases hxt : x = t
      · subst x
        simpa using ht
      · rw [setPair_apply_of_ne out hxs hxt]
        exact (hout x hxs hxt).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.pairKernel_ketBra_apply
statement:
theorem pairKernel_ketBra_apply {s t : Site m n} (hst : s ≠ t)
    (os is ot it : Level) (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pairKernel s t (ketBra os is) (ketBra ot it) out inp =
      if out s = os ∧ out t = ot ∧ inp = setPair out s is t it then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pairKernel, ketBra]
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsidePair s t out inp
  · rw [if_pos hoff]
    by_cases hos : out s = os
    · by_cases hot : out t = ot
      · simp only [hos, hot, true_and]
        have heqiff : inp = setPair out s is t it ↔ inp s = is ∧ inp t = it := by
          rw [eq_setPair_iff hst]
          simp [hoff]
        by_cases his : inp s = is
        · by_cases hit : inp t = it
          · have heq := heqiff.mpr ⟨his, hit⟩
            rw [if_pos his, if_pos hit, if_pos heq]
            norm_num
          · have hne : inp ≠ setPair out s is t it := by
              intro heq
              exact hit (heqiff.mp heq).2
            simp [his, hit, hne]
        · have hne : inp ≠ setPair out s is t it := by
            intro heq
            exact his (heqiff.mp heq).1
          simp [his, hne]
      · simp [hos, hot]
    · simp [hos]
  · rw [if_neg hoff]
    have hne : inp ≠ setPair out s is t it := by
      intro h
      apply hoff
      rw [h]
      exact agreesOutsidePair_setPair out s t is it
    simp [hne]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.transpose_physicalWordSum
statement:
theorem transpose_physicalWordSum (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (w : Word) :
    (physicalWordSum m u w).transpose =
      physicalWordSum m u w.orderedAdjoint
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_apply]
  have hterm (r : Fin m) (i j : Fin n) :
      orderedWordTerm u r i j w inp out =
        orderedWordTerm u r j i w.orderedAdjoint out inp := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun M : FullOp d m n ↦ M out inp)
      (transpose_orderedWordTerm u r i j w)
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  simp_rw [hterm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  exact (sum_sum_erase_comm Finset.univ
    (fun i j ↦ orderedWordTerm u r i j w.orderedAdjoint out inp)).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_transpose
statement:
theorem Hprime_transpose (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) :
    (Hprime m u).transpose = Hprime m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hprime, wordSum, transpose_physicalWordSum]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlus_wordKernel_apply
statement:
theorem yPlus_wordKernel_apply {r : Fin m} {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.rUp, .pUp) out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .two ∧ out (r, j) = .one ∧
          inp = setPair out (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsite : (r, i) ≠ (r, j) := by
    intro h
    exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  simpa [wordKernel, Leg.op, rPromote, pCreate] using
    pairKernel_ketBra_apply hsite .two .one .one .zero out inp

proof:
:= by

statement:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedYplus_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedYplus_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.rUp, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .two ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [orderedWordTerm, externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  simp_rw [yPlus_wordKernel_apply hij]
  by_cases hout : σ (r, i) = .two ∧ σ (r, j) = .one
  · simp [hout]
  · have hz (τ : Pattern m n) :
        ¬(σ (r, i) = .two ∧ σ (r, j) = .one ∧
          τ = setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero) := by
      intro h
      exact hout ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
    simp [hz, hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedYzero_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedYzero_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.rDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .one ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .two (r, j) .zero)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [orderedWordTerm, externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  simp_rw [yZero_wordKernel_apply hij]
  by_cases hout : σ (r, i) = .one ∧ σ (r, j) = .one
  · simp [hout]
  · have hz (τ : Pattern m n) :
        ¬(σ (r, i) = .one ∧ σ (r, j) = .one ∧
          τ = setPair σ (r, i) .two (r, j) .zero) := by
      intro h
      exact hout ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
    simp [hz, hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.orderedHprime_mulVec
statement:
theorem orderedHprime_mulVec (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm u r i j (.pDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ) =
      if σ (r, i) = .zero ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
        ∑ l, u i k * u j l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [orderedWordTerm, externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  simp_rw [hprime_wordKernel_apply hij]
  by_cases hout : σ (r, i) = .zero ∧ σ (r, j) = .one
  · simp [hout]
  · have hz (τ : Pattern m n) :
        ¬(σ (r, i) = .zero ∧ σ (r, j) = .one ∧
          τ = setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero) := by
      intro h
      exact hout ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
    simp [hz, hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.physicalWordSum_homogeneous
statement:
theorem physicalWordSum_homogeneous (u : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (w : Word) :
    IsFullGradeShift w.degree (physicalWordSum m u w)
proof:
:= by
  intro out inp hnonzero
  classical
  simp only [physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_apply] at hnonzero
  by_contra hgrade
  apply hnonzero
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  by_contra hterm
  exact hgrade
    (orderedWordTerm_homogeneous u r
      (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) w hterm)

proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy_eq_nested
statement:
theorem markedEnergy_eq_nested (a b : Level) (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    markedEnergy a b F x =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ levelInRow p r a,
        ∑ j ∈ (levelInRow p r b).erase i,
          (contract F j x p) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_rowMark_eq_nested a b
    (fun p _ _ j ↦ (contract F j x p) ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.light_fresh_energy_at_le
statement:
theorem light_fresh_energy_at_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
        (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
      (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
          (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro a _
      simpa only [contract_eq_analyze] using
        subset_analysis F ((p.freshInRow r).erase a) (fiber x p)
    _ = (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      norm_cast
      rw [← Pattern.card_light_eq_sum_card_lightInRow]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.heavy_fresh_energy_at_le
statement:
theorem heavy_fresh_energy_at_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
      ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
        (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
      (p.heavy.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ p.freshInRow r |>.erase a,
          (contract F c x p) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
          euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro a _
      simpa only [contract_eq_analyze] using
        subset_analysis F ((p.freshInRow r).erase a) (fiber x p)
    _ = (p.heavy.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      norm_cast
      rw [← Pattern.card_heavy_eq_sum_card_heavyInRow]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.markedEnergy_one_zero_le
statement:
theorem markedEnergy_one_zero_le (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    markedEnergy .one .zero F x ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [markedEnergy_eq_nested]
  simp only [levelInRow_one, levelInRow_zero]
  calc
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
          contract F j x p ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ p, (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      by_cases hp : p.grade = nu
      · calc
          (∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
              ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
                contract F j x p ^ 2) ≤
              (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) :=
                light_fresh_energy_at_le F x p
          _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            · exact_mod_cast (hp ▸ p.card_light_le_grade)
            · exact real_inner_self_nonneg
      · have hfiber : fiber x p = 0 := fiber_eq_zero_of_not_grade hx hp
        calc
          (∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
              ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
                contract F j x p ^ 2) ≤
              (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) :=
                light_fresh_energy_at_le F x p
          _ = 0 := by simp [hfiber, euclideanNormSq]
          _ = (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
            simp [hfiber, euclideanNormSq]
    _ = (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      simpa [fiber, fiber] using (full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber x).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.two_mul_markedEnergy_two_zero_le
statement:
theorem two_mul_markedEnergy_two_zero_le (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :
    2 * markedEnergy .two .zero F x ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [markedEnergy_eq_nested]
  simp only [levelInRow_two, levelInRow_zero]
  calc
    2 * (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
        ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
          contract F j x p ^ 2) =
        ∑ p, 2 * (∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
          ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
            contract F j x p ^ 2) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ p, (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      by_cases hp : p.grade = nu
      · have hlocal := heavy_fresh_energy_at_le F x p
        have hcountNat : 2 * p.heavy.card ≤ nu := by
          simpa [hp] using p.two_mul_card_heavy_le_grade
        have hcount : (2 : ℝ) * (p.heavy.card : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hcountNat
        calc
          2 * (∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
              ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
                contract F j x p ^ 2) ≤
              2 * ((p.heavy.card : ℝ) *
                euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)) := by linarith
          _ = ((2 : ℝ) * (p.heavy.card : ℝ)) *
                euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by ring
          _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount real_inner_self_nonneg
      · have hfiber : fiber x p = 0 := fiber_eq_zero_of_not_grade hx hp
        have hlocal := heavy_fresh_energy_at_le F x p
        calc
          2 * (∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
              ∑ j ∈ (p.freshInRow r).erase i,
                contract F j x p ^ 2) ≤
              2 * ((p.heavy.card : ℝ) *
                euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)) := by linarith
          _ = 0 := by simp [hfiber, euclideanNormSq]
          _ = (nu : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
            simp [hfiber, euclideanNormSq]
    _ = (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      simpa [fiber, fiber] using (full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber x).symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
    {delta : ℤ} {A : FullOp d m n}
    (hA : IsFullGradeShift delta A) (mu nu : ℕ)
    (hcompatible : (mu : ℤ) = (nu : ℤ) + delta) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) mu * A = A * gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hentry : A out inp = 0
  · simp [hentry]
  · have hrel := homogeneous_grade_relation hA hentry
    have hiff : out.2.grade = mu ↔ inp.2.grade = nu := by
      constructor
      · intro hout
        have hinInt : (inp.2.grade : ℤ) = (nu : ℤ) := by
          rw [hout] at hrel
          omega
        exact_mod_cast hinInt
      · intro hin
        have houtInt : (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (mu : ℤ) := by
          rw [hin] at hrel
          omega
        exact_mod_cast houtInt
    by_cases hout : out.2.grade = mu
    · simp [hout, hiff.mp hout]
    · have hin : inp.2.grade ≠ nu := fun h ↦ hout (hiff.mpr h)
      simp [hout, hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le
statement:
theorem norm_YplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2)‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2)‖ =
        ‖(YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2)).transpose‖ := by
      exact (specNorm_transpose
        (YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2))).symm
    _ = ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (nu + 2) *
          Yplus m (Frame.rows F)‖ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, transpose_YplusAdj,
        gradeProjection_transpose]
    _ = ‖Yplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := by
      rw [gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
        (Yplus_homogeneous (m := m) F) (nu + 2) nu (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) := norm_Yplus_restricted_le (m := m) F nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YplusAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_YplusAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnu : 2 ≤ nu
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnu
    have h := norm_YplusAdj_restricted_add_two_le (m := m) F k
    calc
      ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (2 + k)‖ =
          ‖YplusAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)‖ := by
        rw [Nat.add_comm]
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) := h
      _ ≤ ((2 + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ 2 + k by omega)
  · have himpossible : ∀ mu : ℕ,
        (mu : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + (-2) := by
      intro mu hmu
      have hnuLt : nu < 2 := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnu
      have hmuNonneg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (mu : ℤ) := by positivity
      omega
    have hz := input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
      (YplusAdj_homogeneous (m := m) F) nu himpossible
    rw [hz]
    simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_YzeroAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_YzeroAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ =
        ‖(YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu).transpose‖ := by
      exact (specNorm_transpose
        (YzeroAdj m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu)).symm
    _ = ‖gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Yzero m (Frame.rows F)‖ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, transpose_YzeroAdj,
        gradeProjection_transpose]
    _ = ‖Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := by
      rw [gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
        (Yzero_homogeneous (m := m) F) nu nu (by norm_num)]
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2 := norm_Yzero_restricted_le (m := m) F nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_directional_term_eq
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_directional_term_eq {s b : ℕ}
    (A : FullOp d m n) (P : FullOp d m n) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • A)) * P‖ =
      (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) * ‖A * P‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity :
      0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))),
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalized_directional_term_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖Yplus (s * b) (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_Yplus_restricted_le (m := s * b) F nu)
        rho_div_stack_nonneg
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) / s := directional_absorb hs hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_YplusAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_YplusAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      (nu : ℝ) / s
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalized_directional_term_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖YplusAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (nu : ℝ) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_YplusAdj_restricted_le (m := s * b) F nu)
        rho_div_stack_nonneg
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) / s := directional_absorb hs hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yzero_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yzero_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalized_directional_term_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          ((nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_Yzero_restricted_le (m := s * b) F nu)
        rho_div_stack_nonneg
    _ = (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          (nu : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2 := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (directional_absorb hs hb)
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_YzeroAdj_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_YzeroAdj_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_normalized_directional_term_eq]
  calc
    Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
        ‖YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          ((nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_YzeroAdj_restricted_le (m := s * b) F nu)
        rho_div_stack_nonneg
    _ = (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          (nu : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ ((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2 := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (directional_absorb hs hb)
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_normalized_Yzero_pair_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_normalized_Yzero_pair_restricted_le (F : Frame n d)
    (s b nu : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 1 < b) :
    ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
        (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
          (Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
            YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt 2 * ((nu : ℝ) / s)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) •
            (Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F) +
              YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F)))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu +
        ((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu := by
    simp only [smul_add, add_mul]
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • Yzero (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ +
        ‖((1 / (((s * b : ℕ) : ℝ))) •
          (Real.sqrt ((b : ℝ) - 1) • YzeroAdj (s * b) (Frame.rows F))) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * (((nu : ℝ) / s) / Real.sqrt 2) := by
      have h₁ := norm_normalized_Yzero_restricted_le F s b nu hs hb
      have h₂ := norm_normalized_YzeroAdj_restricted_le F s b nu hs hb
      linarith
    _ = Real.sqrt 2 * ((nu : ℝ) / s) := by
      have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
      have hsqrtSq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hsqrtPos]
      nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_energy_of_supported
statement:
theorem Yplus_energy_of_supported (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Yplus_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Yplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Yplus_energy_of_supported (m := m) F
    (gradeProjection_supported (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu x)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  calc
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (Yplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq
          (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) := h
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (gradeProjection_normSq_le nu x) (sq_nonneg (nu : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_restricted_two_mul_energy

proof:

    (gradeProjection_supported (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu x)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  calc
    2 * sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq
          (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) := h
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (gradeProjection_normSq_le nu x) (sq_nonneg (nu : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Hprime_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x
proof:
:= by

    (gradeProjection_supported (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu x)
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at h
  calc
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem Yzero_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
      (Matrix.mulVec
        (Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      ((nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  have htwo := Yzero_restricted_two_mul_energy (m := m) F nu x
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hconstant : ((nu : ℝ) / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 =
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, hsqrt]
  rw [hconstant]
  nlinarith [sumSq_nonneg
    (Matrix.mulVec
      (Yzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.norm_Yplus_restricted_le
statement:
theorem norm_Yplus_restricted_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Yplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ)
proof:

proof:

    (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg nu) (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2))

    intro r _

    (hgrade : input.grade = ν) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [Profile.yPlus_light]
  have hle : input.light ≤ ν := by
    simpa [hgrade] using input.light_le_grade
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul hle hle

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yZero_count
statement:
theorem yZero_count {ν : ℕ} (input : Profile) (hheavy : 1 ≤ input.heavy)
    (hgrade : input.grade = ν) :
    2 * (input.yZero.light * input.heavy) ≤ ν * ν
proof:
:= by
  have houtGrade : input.yZero.grade = ν := by
    rw [input.yZero_grade hheavy, hgrade]
  have hout : input.yZero.light ≤ ν := by
    simpa [houtGrade] using input.yZero.light_le_grade
  have hin : 2 * input.heavy ≤ ν := by
    simpa [hgrade] using input.two_mul_heavy_le_grade
  simpa [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mul_le_mul hout hin

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.directional_energy_sq_bound
statement:
theorem directional_energy_sq_bound
    {ν inputEnergy reindexedEnergy outputEnergy : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν) (_hinput : 0 ≤ inputEnergy)
    (hOutputCS : outputEnergy ≤ ν * reindexedEnergy)
    (hInputParseval : reindexedEnergy ≤ ν * inputEnergy) :
    outputEnergy ≤ ν ^ 2 * inputEnergy
proof:
:= by
  calc
    outputEnergy ≤ ν * reindexedEnergy := hOutputCS
    _ ≤ ν * (ν * inputEnergy) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInputParseval hν
    _ = ν ^ 2 * inputEnergy := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.directional_energy_half_sq_bound
statement:
theorem directional_energy_half_sq_bound
    {ν inputEnergy reindexedEnergy outputEnergy : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 ≤ ν)
    (hOutputCS : outputEnergy ≤ ν * reindexedEnergy)
    (hInputHeavy : 2 * reindexedEnergy ≤ ν * inputEnergy) :
    2 * outputEnergy ≤ ν ^ 2 * inputEnergy
proof:
:= by
  calc
    2 * outputEnergy ≤ 2 * (ν * reindexedEnergy) := by linarith
    _ = ν * (2 * reindexedEnergy) := by ring
    _ ≤ ν * (ν * inputEnergy) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInputHeavy hν
    _ = ν ^ 2 * inputEnergy := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light
statement:
theorem sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light (σ : Pattern m n)
    {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (f : Site m n → A) :
    (∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, f (r, c)) =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, f s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Pattern.lightInRow, Pattern.light, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.normSq_sum_le_card
statement:
theorem normSq_sum_le_card {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (z : α → EVec d) :
    euclideanNormSq (∑ a ∈ s, z a) ≤
      (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ a ∈ s, euclideanNormSq (z a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq] using norm_sum_sq_le_card_mul_sum_norm_sq s z

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber
statement:
theorem full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber (v : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq v =
      ∑ σ, euclideanNormSq (fiber v σ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumSq, euclideanNormSq, PiLp.inner_apply,
    Real.inner_apply, fiber]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro σ _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_fullFiber
statement:
theorem Yplus_fullFiber (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ =
      ∑ s ∈ σ.light, yPlusMarked F x σ s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rw [show fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ k =
      Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) by rfl]
  rw [Yplus_mulVec_marked]
  simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply] using
    sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light σ
      (fun s ↦ yPlusMarked F x σ s.1 s.2 k)

  simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply] using
    sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light σ
      (fun s ↦ yZeroMarked F x σ s.1 s.2 k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_fullFiber
statement:
theorem Hprime_fullFiber (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x) σ =

proof:

statement:
theorem sum_subtype_eq_filter {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : {x // p x}, g x.1) = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter p, g x
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter p) (by simp) g

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rowMark_eq_nested
statement:
theorem sum_rowMark_eq_nested (a b : Level)
    (g : Pattern m n → Fin m → Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n a b, g z.pattern z.row z.left z.right) =
      ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ levelInRow p r a,
        ∑ j ∈ (levelInRow p r b).erase i, g p r i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv (rowMarkNestedEquiv (m := m) (n := n) a b)
    (fun z ↦ g z.pattern z.row z.left z.right)
    (fun z ↦ g z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2.1.1 z.2.2.2.1) (by intro z; rfl)]
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  simp_rw [sum_subtype_eq_filter]
  rw [sum_subtype_eq_filter (fun i : Fin n ↦ p (r, i) = a)
    (fun i ↦ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun j : Fin n ↦ j ≠ i ∧ p (r, j) = b), g p r i j)]
  change (∑ i ∈ levelInRow p r a,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun j : Fin n ↦ j ≠ i ∧ p (r, j) = b), g p r i j) = _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [show Finset.univ.filter
      (fun j : Fin n ↦ j ≠ i ∧ p (r, j) = b) =
      (levelInRow p r b).erase i by
    ext j
    simp [levelInRow]]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.rowMark_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem rowMark_ext {a b : Level} {x y : RowMark m n a b}
    (hpattern : x.pattern = y.pattern)
    (hrow : x.row = y.row) (hleft : x.left = y.left)
    (hright : x.right = y.right) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | mk xp xr xl xright xne xleftState xrightState =>
    cases y with
    | mk yp yr yl yright yne yleftState yrightState =>
      dsimp at hpattern hrow hleft hright
      subst yp
      subst yr
      subst yl
      subst yright
      rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.setPair_restore
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  by_cases hxs : x = s
  · subst x
    simpa [setPair_apply_left _ hst] using hs.symm
  · by_cases hxt : x = t
    · subst x
      simpa using ht.symm
    · rw [setPair_apply_of_ne _ hxs hxt,
        setPair_apply_of_ne _ hxs hxt]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_rowMarkTransition

      ∑ z : RowMark m n ia ib, f z
proof:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_marked_reindex
statement:
theorem Yplus_marked_reindex (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ z : RowMark m n .two .one,
      (contract F z.right x
        (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
          (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .one .zero,
        (contract F z.right x z.pattern) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rowMarkTransition_pattern, rowMarkTransition_right] using
    sum_rowMarkTransition (m := m) (n := n) .two .one .one .zero
      (fun z ↦ (contract F z.right x z.pattern) ^ 2)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_distinct_level_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_distinct_level_pairs (σ : Pattern m n) (r : Fin m)
    {a b : Level} (hab : a ≠ b) (f : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = b then f i j else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ σ (r, i) = a),
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ σ (r, j) = b), f i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexpand (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = b then f i j else 0) =
        ∑ j, if j ≠ i then
          (if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = b then f i j else 0) else 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.filter_ne' Finset.univ i, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [show (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ σ (r, i) = a),
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ σ (r, j) = b), f i j) =
      ∑ i, if σ (r, i) = a then
        (∑ j, if σ (r, j) = b then f i j else 0) else 0 by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]]
  simp_rw [hexpand]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : σ (r, i) = a
  · simp only [hi, true_and, if_true]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : σ (r, j) = b
    · have hji : j ≠ i := by
        intro h
        subst j
        exact hab (hi.symm.trans hj)
      simp [hj, hji]
    · simp [hj]
  · simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.sum_same_level_pairs
statement:
theorem sum_same_level_pairs (σ : Pattern m n) (r : Fin m)
    (a : Level) (f : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        if σ (r, i) = a ∧ σ (r, j) = a then f i j else 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ σ (r, i) = a),
        ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ σ (r, j) = a)).erase i, f i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : σ (r, i) = a
  · simp only [hi, true_and, if_true]
    rw [← Finset.filter_erase, Finset.sum_filter]
  · simp [hi]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Yplus_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
          x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Yplus, wordSum, physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_mulVec,
    Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .pUp)) x (k, σ)) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if σ (r, i) = .two ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
            ∑ l, F.u i k * F.u j l *
              x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
          else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact orderedYplus_mulVec (Frame.rows F) x r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) k σ
    _ = ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
          ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero) := by
      simpa only [Pattern.heavyInRow, Pattern.lightInRow] using
        sum_distinct_level_pairs σ r (a := .two) (b := .one) (by decide)
          (fun a c ↦ ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Yzero_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yzero m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
        ∑ c ∈ (σ.lightInRow r).erase a,
          ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Yzero, wordSum, physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_mulVec,
    Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ)) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if σ (r, i) = .one ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
            ∑ l, F.u i k * F.u j l *
              x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .two (r, j) .zero)
          else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact orderedYzero_mulVec (Frame.rows F) x r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1) k σ
    _ = ∑ a ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
          ∑ c ∈ (σ.lightInRow r).erase a,
            ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
              x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero) := by
      simpa only [Pattern.lightInRow] using
        sum_same_level_pairs σ r .one
          (fun a c ↦ ∑ l, F.u a k * F.u c l *
            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_mulVec_coeff
statement:
theorem Hprime_mulVec_coeff (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,

proof:

    Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        Matrix.mulVec (orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pDown, .pUp)) x (k, σ)) =
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          if σ (r, i) = .zero ∧ σ (r, j) = .one then
            ∑ l, F.u i k * F.u j l *
              x (l, setPair σ (r, i) .one (r, j) .zero)
          else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _

    _ = ∑ a ∈ σ.freshInRow r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r,

            x (l, setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero) := by

statement:
@[simp] theorem fiber_apply (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.contract_eq_analyze

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_mulVec_marked
statement:
theorem Yplus_mulVec_marked (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (k : Fin d) (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x (k, σ) =
      ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ σ.lightInRow r, yPlusMarked F x σ r c k

  intro l hl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.yPlusMarked_normSq_le
statement:
theorem yPlusMarked_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (σ : Pattern m n)
    (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x σ r c) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
        (contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x σ r c) ≤
        ∑ a ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
          |contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)| ^ 2 := by
      exact subset_synthesis F (σ.heavyInRow r)
        (fun a ↦ contract F c x (setPair σ (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero))
    _ = _ := by simp only [sq_abs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Yplus_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .two .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_rowMark_eq_nested (m := m) (n := n) .two .one
    (fun p r a c ↦ (contract F c x
      (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2)]
  simp only [levelInRow_two, levelInRow_one]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  have hnot : a ∉ p.lightInRow r := by
    intro hlight
    have haTwo : p (r, a) = .two := by simpa using ha
    have haOne : p (r, a) = .one := by simpa using hlight
    simp_all
  rw [Finset.erase_eq_self.mpr hnot]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yzero_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Yzero_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ (p.lightInRow r).erase c,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .one .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .two
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_rowMark_eq_nested (m := m) (n := n) .one .one
    (fun p r a c ↦ (contract F c x
      (setPair p (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2)]
  simp only [levelInRow_one]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  exact sum_sum_erase_comm (p.lightInRow r)
    (fun a c ↦ (contract F c x
      (setPair p (r, a) .two (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) |>.symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq
statement:
theorem Hprime_output_coeff_energy_eq (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
      ∑ a ∈ p.freshInRow r,
        (contract F c x
          (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ z : RowMark m n .zero .one,
        (contract F z.right x
          (setPair z.pattern (z.row, z.left) .one
            (z.row, z.right) .zero)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_rowMark_eq_nested (m := m) (n := n) .zero .one
    (fun p r a c ↦ (contract F c x
      (setPair p (r, a) .one (r, c) .zero)) ^ 2)]
  simp only [levelInRow_zero, levelInRow_one]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  have hnot : a ∉ p.lightInRow r := by
    intro hlight
    have haZero : p (r, a) = .zero := by simpa using ha
    have haOne : p (r, a) = .one := by simpa using hlight
    simp_all
  rw [Finset.erase_eq_self.mpr hnot]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Directional.Yplus_output_fiber_le_marked
statement:
theorem Yplus_output_fiber_le_marked (F : Frame n d) {nu : ℕ}
    {x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ} (hx : SupportedAtGrade nu x)
    (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
      (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (Yplus m (Frame.rows F)) x) p) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.grade = nu + 2
  · by_cases hheavy : p.heavy.Nonempty
    · have hcardNat : p.light.card ≤ nu := by
        have hformula := p.grade_eq_card_light_add_two_mul_card_heavy
        have hone : 1 ≤ p.heavy.card := Finset.one_le_card.mpr hheavy
        omega
      have hcard : (p.light.card : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hcardNat
      rw [Yplus_fullFiber]
      calc
        euclideanNormSq
            (∑ s ∈ p.light, yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2) ≤
            (p.light.card : ℝ) * ∑ s ∈ p.light,
              euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2) :=
          normSq_sum_le_card p.light
            (fun s ↦ yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2)
        _ = (p.light.card : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
              euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c) := by
          rw [← sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light p
            (fun s ↦ euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2))]
        _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
              euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard
          exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ ↦
            Finset.sum_nonneg fun c _ ↦ real_inner_self_nonneg
    · have hempty : p.heavy = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hheavy
      have hrow (r : Fin m) : p.heavyInRow r = ∅ := by
        ext a
        constructor
        · intro ha
          have hsite : (r, a) ∈ p.heavy := by simpa using ha
          simp [hempty] at hsite
        · simp
      have hzero (r : Fin m) (c : Fin n) :
          euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c) = 0 := by
        have hle := yPlusMarked_normSq_le F x p r c
        rw [hrow] at hle
        simp only [Finset.sum_empty] at hle
        exact le_antisymm hle real_inner_self_nonneg
      rw [Yplus_fullFiber]
      calc
        euclideanNormSq
            (∑ s ∈ p.light, yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2) ≤
            (p.light.card : ℝ) * ∑ s ∈ p.light,
              euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2) :=
          normSq_sum_le_card p.light
            (fun s ↦ yPlusMarked F x p s.1 s.2)
        _ = 0 := by simp [hzero]
        _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
              euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c) := by
          exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)
            (Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ ↦
              Finset.sum_nonneg fun c _ ↦ real_inner_self_nonneg)
  · have hpInt : (p.grade : ℤ) ≠ (nu : ℤ) + 2 := by
      intro h
      apply hp
      exact_mod_cast h
    have hz := fullFiber_mulVec_eq_zero_of_grade
      (Yplus_homogeneous (m := m) F) hx p hpInt
    rw [hz]
    have hrhs : 0 ≤ (nu : ℝ) * ∑ r, ∑ c ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        euclideanNormSq (yPlusMarked F x p r c) :=
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ ↦
          Finset.sum_nonneg fun c _ ↦ real_inner_self_nonneg)
    simpa [euclideanNormSq] using hrhs
