name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.rowProjection_CStackTranspose_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem rowProjection_CStackTranspose_gradeProjection
    (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu *
        (CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) =
      (CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Heavy.rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = mu + 1
  · by_cases hentry : (CStack F).transpose out inp = 0
    · have hz : CStack F inp out = 0 := by
        simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hentry
      simp [hin, hz]
    · have hentry' : CStack F inp out ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hentry
      have hrel := CMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry'
      have hout : out.2.grade = mu := by
        rw [hin] at hrel
        push_cast at hrel
        have hz : (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (mu : ℤ) := by omega
        exact_mod_cast hz
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_cogram
statement:
theorem CStack_restricted_cogram (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    let P
proof:
:= gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)
    let R := Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu
    let B := P * CStack (m := m) F * R
    B * B.transpose = P * ghat F * P := by
  dsimp
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Heavy.rowGradeProjection_transpose, gradeProjection_transpose]
  have hins := rowProjection_CStackTranspose_gradeProjection
    (m := m) F mu
  have hins' :
      Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu *
        ((CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)) =
      (CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hins]
  calc
    (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu) *
      (Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu *
        ((CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1))) =
      (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu) *
          ((CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)) := by
      rw [hins']
    _ = gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
          (Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu *
            ((CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
              gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1))) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
        ((CStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)) := by
      rw [hins']
    _ = gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        (CStack (m := m) F * (CStack (m := m) F).transpose) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [CStack_mul_transpose]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_restricted_norm
statement:
theorem CStack_restricted_norm (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)
  let R := Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu
  let B := P * CStack (m := m) F * R
  have hP : ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := gradeProjection_norm_le_one (mu + 1)
  have hG :
      ‖ghat (m := m) F * P‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) := by
    have hsharp := ghat_gradeProjection_norm_le
      (m := m) F (mu + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le mu))
    dsimp [P]
    (convert hsharp using 1; push_cast; ring)
  have hcogram : ‖B * B.transpose‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) := by
    rw [show B * B.transpose = P * ghat (m := m) F * P by
      simpa [B, P, R] using CStack_restricted_cogram (m := m) F mu]
    calc
      ‖P * ghat (m := m) F * P‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖ghat (m := m) F * P‖ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * ((d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul hP hG (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) := one_mul _
  have hBconj : B.transpose.conjTranspose = B := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hsquare : ‖B * B.transpose‖ = ‖B‖ * ‖B‖ := by
    calc
      ‖B * B.transpose‖ =
          ‖B.transpose.conjTranspose * B.transpose‖ := by rw [hBconj]
      _ = ‖B.transpose‖ * ‖B.transpose‖ :=
        Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self B.transpose
      _ = ‖B‖ * ‖B‖ := by
        rw [show ‖B.transpose‖ = ‖B‖ from specNorm_transpose B]
  have hdm : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt hdm
  change ‖B‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ))
  rw [hsquare] at hcogram
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg B, Real.sqrt_nonneg ((d : ℝ) + (mu : ℝ))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_transpose_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem CMatrix_transpose_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (p : Pattern m n) (out : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    (CMatrix F r).transpose p out =
      ∑ i, F.u i out.1 * pAt r i p out.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, CMatrix, pAt, pDagAt]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (transpose_siteKernel (r, i) pCreate) p) out.2
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, transpose_pCreate] at h
  rw [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_apply
statement:
theorem ghat_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    ghat (m := m) F out inp =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j,
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          (pDagAt r i * pAt r j) out.2 inp.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [ghat, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, CMatrix,
    CMatrix_transpose_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _hr
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  simp only [pDagAt, pAt]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro mid _hmid
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem ghat_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    (ghat (m := m) F).transpose = ghat F
proof:
:= by
  rw [ghat]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.transpose_transpose]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_apply (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    blockProjection (d := d) T ell out inp =
      if out = inp ∧ InBlock T ell out.2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : out = inp
  · subst inp
    by_cases hb : InBlock T ell out.2 <;>
      simp [blockProjection, Matrix.diagonal, hb]
  · simp [blockProjection, Matrix.diagonal, h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_transpose (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (blockProjection (d := d) T ell).transpose = blockProjection T ell
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, blockProjection_apply]
  by_cases h : out = inp
  · subst inp
    simp
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockProjection_mul_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockProjection_mul_self (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    blockProjection (d := d) T ell * blockProjection T ell =
      blockProjection T ell
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [blockProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGramApply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnGramApply_apply (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n) (i : Fin n) :
    columnGramApply F x i = ∑ j, columnGram F i j * x j
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGramApply_eq_analyze_synthesize
statement:
theorem columnGramApply_eq_analyze_synthesize (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n)
    (i : Fin n) :
    columnGramApply F x i =
      analyze F (synthesize F Finset.univ (fun j ↦ x j)) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [columnGramApply_apply, columnGram, analyze, synthesize,
    PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _ha
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.columnGram_energy_le
statement:
theorem columnGram_energy_le (F : Frame n d) (x : EVec n) :
    euclideanNormSq (columnGramApply F x) ≤
      euclideanNormSq x
proof:
:= by
  let y : EVec d := synthesize F Finset.univ (fun j ↦ x j)
  have hanalysis : euclideanNormSq (columnGramApply F x) =
      ∑ i, (analyze F y i) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [euclideanNormSq, PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    rw [columnGramApply_eq_analyze_synthesize]
    simp [y, pow_two]
  calc
    euclideanNormSq (columnGramApply F x) =
        ∑ i, (analyze F y i) ^ 2 := hanalysis
    _ = euclideanNormSq y := analysis_energy_eq F y
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, |x j| ^ 2 := subset_synthesis F Finset.univ (fun j ↦ x j)
    _ = euclideanNormSq x := by
      rw [euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.two_columnGram_pairing_le
statement:
theorem two_columnGram_pairing_le (F : Frame n d) (x y : EVec n) :
    2 * inner ℝ (columnGramApply F x) y ≤
      euclideanNormSq x + euclideanNormSq y
proof:
:= by
  have hcs : inner ℝ (columnGramApply F x) y ≤
      ‖columnGramApply F x‖ * ‖y‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have hcontractSq := columnGram_energy_le F x
  rw [euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq,
    euclideanNormSq_eq_norm_sq] at hcontractSq ⊢
  have hcontract : ‖columnGramApply F x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (columnGramApply F x), norm_nonneg x]
  have hmul : ‖columnGramApply F x‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcontract (norm_nonneg y)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖x‖ - ‖y‖)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim
statement:
theorem sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim (F : Frame n d) :
    (∑ a, ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i a) = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag (a : Fin d) : ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i a = 1 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun F.parseval a) a
    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply] using h
  simp_rw [hdiag]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_frame_normSq_eq_dim
statement:
theorem sum_frame_normSq_eq_dim (F : Frame n d) :
    (∑ i, euclideanNormSq (F.u i)) = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i, euclideanNormSq (F.u i)) =
        ∑ i, ∑ a, F.u i a * F.u i a := by
      simp only [euclideanNormSq, PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply]
    _ = ∑ a, ∑ i, F.u i a * F.u i a := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = (d : ℝ) := sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim F

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharedVector_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (a : Fin d) (s : Site m n) :
    sharedVector F r (a, s) = if s.1 = r then F.u s.2 a else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_apply_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem sharedVector_apply_index (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (z : Fin d × Site m n) :
    sharedVector F r z =
      if z.2.1 = r then F.u z.2.2 z.1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_inner
statement:
theorem sharedVector_inner (F : Frame n d) (r q : Fin m) :
    inner ℝ (sharedVector F r) (sharedVector F q) =
      if r = q then (d : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply, sharedVector_apply_index]
  change (∑ z : Fin d × Site m n,
    (if z.2.1 = r then F.u z.2.2 z.1 else 0) *
      (if z.2.1 = q then F.u z.2.2 z.1 else 0)) = _
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  by_cases hrq : r = q
  · subst q
    simp
    exact sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim F
  · simp [hrq, Ne.symm hrq]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedVector_normSq
statement:
theorem sharedVector_normSq (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    inner ℝ (sharedVector F r) (sharedVector F r) = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sharedVector_inner F r r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedQ_apply
statement:
theorem sharedQ_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (out inp : Fin d × Site m n) :
    sharedQ F out inp =
      if out.2.1 = inp.2.1 then
        F.u out.2.2 out.1 * F.u inp.2.2 inp.1
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sharedQ, sharedRankOne, Matrix.sum_apply,
    sharedVector_apply_index]
  by_cases hrow : out.2.1 = inp.2.1
  · rw [if_pos hrow]
    simp [hrow]
  · rw [if_neg hrow]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _hr
    by_cases hout : out.2.1 = r
    · have hin : inp.2.1 ≠ r := by
        intro heq
        exact hrow (hout.trans heq.symm)
      simp [hout, hin]
    · simp [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreLift_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem hardCoreLift_transpose_mul (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell).transpose * hardCoreLift T ell =
      (permutationCount ell : ℝ) •
        (1 : Matrix (BlockIndex d T ell) (BlockIndex d T ell) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x y
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hardCoreLift]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ out, ∑ pi, ∑ sigma,
        coordinateDelta out (blockLabel T ell x pi) *
          coordinateDelta out (blockLabel T ell y sigma)) =
      ∑ pi, ∑ sigma, ∑ out,
        coordinateDelta out (blockLabel T ell x pi) *
          coordinateDelta out (blockLabel T ell y sigma) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro pi _hpi
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ pi, ∑ sigma,
        coordinateDelta (blockLabel T ell x pi)
          (blockLabel T ell y sigma) := by
      simp_rw [sum_coordinateDelta_mul_coordinateDelta]
    _ = ((permutationCount ell : ℝ) •
        (1 : Matrix (BlockIndex d T ell) (BlockIndex d T ell) ℝ)) x y := by
      by_cases hxy : x = y
      · subst y
        simp [coordinateDelta, blockLabel_eq_iff, permutationCount]
      · simp [coordinateDelta, blockLabel_eq_iff, hxy,
          permutationCount]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_comm_four
statement:
theorem sum_comm_four
    {A B C D : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C] [Fintype D]
    (f : A → B → C → D → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d) =
      ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d) =
        ∑ a, ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ d, f a b c d := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _ha
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ d, f a b c d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _hc
      calc
        (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ d, f a b c d) =
            ∑ a, ∑ d, ∑ b, f a b c d := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _ha
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        _ = ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreLift_compression_apply
statement:
theorem hardCoreLift_compression_apply
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (LabelledIndex d m n ell) (LabelledIndex d m n ell) ℝ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    ((hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell).transpose * A *
      hardCoreLift (d := d) T ell) x y =
      ∑ pi, ∑ sigma, A (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hardCoreLift]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [sum_comm_four]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro pi _hpi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro sigma _hsigma
  simp [coordinateDelta]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreEmbedding_transpose_mul
statement:
theorem hardCoreEmbedding_transpose_mul
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell).transpose *
        hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell =
      (1 : Matrix (BlockIndex d T ell) (BlockIndex d T ell) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hNnat : 0 < permutationCount ell := permutationCount_pos ell
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < (permutationCount ell : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hNnat
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (permutationCount ell : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN)
  have hscalar :
      (1 / Real.sqrt (permutationCount ell : ℝ)) *
          (1 / Real.sqrt (permutationCount ell : ℝ)) *
            (permutationCount ell : ℝ) = 1 := by
    field_simp [hsqrt]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  rw [hardCoreEmbedding, Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul, hardCoreLift_transpose_mul]
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, hscalar, one_smul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreEmbedding_energy
statement:
theorem hardCoreEmbedding_energy (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) :
    sumSq ((hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell).mulVec x) =
      sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram,
    hardCoreEmbedding_transpose_mul]
  simp [quadForm, sumSq, Matrix.mulVec,
    dotProduct, Matrix.one_apply, pow_two]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem hardCoreCompressedG_transpose
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell).transpose = hardCoreCompressedG F T ell
proof:
:= by
  simp [hardCoreCompressedG, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ quadForm (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hardCoreCompressedG,
    ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial (hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell),
    quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul]
  exact labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg F ell _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_le
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : BlockIndex d T ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    quadForm (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell) x ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hardCoreCompressedG,
    ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial (hardCoreEmbedding (d := d) T ell),
    quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul,
    ← hardCoreEmbedding_energy T ell x]
  exact labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le F ell _ hell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_isHermitian
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_isHermitian
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) :
    (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  exact hardCoreCompressedG_transpose F T ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ‖hardCoreCompressedG F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hellR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hell
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
  have hc : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  apply (specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
    (hardCoreCompressedG F T ell)
    (hardCoreCompressedG_isHermitian F T ell)
    ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) hc).2
  intro x
  have hupper := hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_le F T ell x hell
  rw [sumSq_eq_dotProduct] at hupper
  exact (abs_of_nonneg
    (hardCoreCompressedG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg F T ell x)).trans_le hupper

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le_grade
statement:
theorem hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le_grade
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell nu : ℕ)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hle : ell ≤ nu) :
    ‖hardCoreCompressedG F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖hardCoreCompressedG F T ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1 :=
      hardCoreCompressedG_norm_le F T ell hell
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := by
      have hleR : (ell : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
      linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_eq_sum_COne
statement:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem CStack_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    CStack (m := m) F * (CStack (m := m) F).transpose = ghat F
proof:
:= by

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CStack_transpose_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem CStack_transpose_apply (F : Frame n d)
    (out : Heavy.RowFock m n) (inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem CMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {out : Fin d × Pattern m n} {inp : Pattern m n}
    (hentry : CMatrix F r out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (inp.grade : ℤ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hentry
  have hk : pDagAt r i out.2 inp ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hi).2
  have hh := siteKernel_homogeneous pCreate_homogeneous (r, i) hk
  simpa [pDagAt, gradeZ_eq_cast_grade] using hh

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix_grade_relation
statement:
theorem cMatrix_grade_relation (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {out : Pattern m n} {inp : Fin d × Pattern m n}
    (hentry : cMatrix F r out inp ≠ 0) :
    (out.grade : ℤ) = (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [cMatrix_eq_sum_cOne] at hentry
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, cOne] at hentry
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hentry
  have hk : pDagAt r i out inp.2 ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hi).2
  have hh := siteKernel_homogeneous pCreate_homogeneous (r, i) hk
  simpa [cOne, pDagAt, gradeZ_eq_cast_grade] using hh

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_apply
statement:
theorem pDagAt_apply (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) :
    pDagAt r i out inp =
      if out (r, i) = .one ∧
          inp = Heavy.setSite out (r, i) .zero then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pDagAt, pCreate] using
    Heavy.siteKernel_ketBra_apply
      (m := m) (n := n) (r, i) .one .zero out inp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_sq_zero
statement:
theorem pDagAt_sq_zero (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    pDagAt r i * pDagAt r i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply]
  by_cases hout : out (r, i) = .one
  · simp only [pDagAt_apply, hout, true_and]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Heavy.setSite out (r, i) .zero)]
    · simp [Heavy.setSite]
    · intro other _ hne
      simp [hne]
    · simp
  · simp [pDagAt_apply, hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pDagAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pDagAt r i * pDagAt r j =
      wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pDagAt, wordKernel, Leg.op] using
    siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne (m := m) (n := n)
      (r, i) (r, j) (by
        intro h
        exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd h)) pCreate pCreate

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_cOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_cOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    COne F r i * cOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pUp, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne, cOne, orderedWordTerm,
    externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u j inp.1 * pDagAt r j p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p * pDagAt r j p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .pUp) out.2 inp.2 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne r hij)
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using congrArg
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) * t) h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_cOne_self
statement:
theorem COne_mul_cOne_self (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    COne F r i * cOne F r i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, COne, cOne, Matrix.zero_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u i inp.1 * pDagAt r i p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p * pDagAt r i p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_sq_zero r i)
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.zero_apply] at h
      rw [h, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_cMatrix
statement:
theorem CMatrix_mul_cMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    CMatrix F r * cMatrix F r =
      ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.pUp, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CMatrix_eq_sum_COne, cMatrix_eq_sum_cOne, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [COne_mul_cOne_self]
  simp only [add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact COne_mul_cOne_of_ne F r (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_eq_CStack_mul_CreateAnalysisStack
statement:
theorem Lplus_eq_CStack_mul_CreateAnalysisStack (F : Frame n d) :
    Lplus m (Frame.rows F) =
      CStack (m := m) F * CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Lplus, wordSum, physicalWordSum, Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.mul_apply, CStack, CreateAnalysisStack]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  have h := congrArg
    (fun M : FullOp d m n ↦ M out inp) (CMatrix_mul_cMatrix F r)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply] using h.symm

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.rowProjection_CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem rowProjection_CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) *
        CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
      CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Heavy.rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = nu
  · by_cases hentry : CreateAnalysisStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := cMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      have hout : out.2.grade = nu + 1 := by
        rw [hin] at hrel
        exact_mod_cast hrel
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection
statement:
theorem gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1) *
        CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu =
      CStack (m := m) F *
        Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Heavy.rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = mu
  · by_cases hentry : CStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := CMatrix_grade_relation F inp.1 hentry
      have hout : out.2.grade = mu + 1 := by
        rw [hin] at hrel
        exact_mod_cast hrel
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Lplus_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Lplus m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
      (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lplus_eq_CStack_mul_CreateAnalysisStack]
  have hins := rowProjection_CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection
    (m := m) F nu
  have hout := gradeProjection_CStack_rowProjection (m := m) F (nu + 1)
  calc
    (CStack (m := m) F * CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu =
        CStack (m := m) F *
          (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = CStack (m := m) F *
        (Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) *
          CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      rw [hins]
    _ = (CStack (m := m) F *
          Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem pDagAt_transpose (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n) :
    (pDagAt r i).transpose = pAt r i
proof:
:= by
  simp [pDagAt, pAt, transpose_siteKernel]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt_ne_zero_input_one
statement:
theorem pAt_ne_zero_input_one (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (out inp : Pattern m n) (h : pAt r i out inp ≠ 0) :
    inp (r, i) = .one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [pAt, siteKernel] at h
  by_cases hoff : agreesOutsideSite (r, i) out inp
  · simp only [hoff, if_pos, pDestroy, ketBra] at h
    by_contra hne
    simp [hne] at h
  · simp [hoff] at h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.no_light_site_of_block_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hempty : p.light = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hp.2
  have : s ∈ p.light := by simp [hs]
  simp [hempty] at this

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Ctranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
statement:
theorem Ctranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n))
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (hx : SupportedOnBlock T 0 x)
    (r : Fin m) :
    (CMatrix F r).transpose.mulVec x = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, CMatrix_transpose_apply,
    Pi.zero_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro out _hout
  by_cases hb : InBlock T 0 out.2
  · apply mul_eq_zero.mpr
    left
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _hi
    apply mul_eq_zero.mpr
    right
    by_contra hne
    exact no_light_site_of_block_zero hb (r, i)
      (pAt_ne_zero_input_one r i p out.2 hne)
  · rw [hx out hb, mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
statement:
theorem ghat_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n))
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (hx : SupportedOnBlock T 0 x) :
    (ghat (m := m) F).mulVec x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ghat, Matrix.sum_mulVec]
  funext out
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r _hr
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  rw [Ctranspose_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight F T x hx r]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_quadratic_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
statement:
theorem ghat_quadratic_eq_zero_of_zeroLight
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n))
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (hx : SupportedOnBlock T 0 x) :
    quadForm (ghat (m := m) F) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadForm_def, star_trivial, ghat_mulVec_eq_zero_of_zeroLight F T x hx]
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.two_crossPairing_le
statement:
theorem two_crossPairing_le (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    2 * crossPairing F z k l hkl ≤
      componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l
proof:
:= by
  let w : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k → ℝ :=
    (crossMatrix F k l hkl).mulVec (z l)
  have hpoint (a : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) :
      2 * z k a * w a ≤ (z k a) ^ 2 + (w a) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z k a - w a)]
  have hsum :
      2 * crossPairing F z k l hkl ≤
        componentEnergy z k + sumSq w := by
    calc
      2 * crossPairing F z k l hkl = ∑ a, 2 * z k a * w a := by
        simp only [crossPairing, w, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _ha
        ring
      _ ≤ ∑ a, ((z k a) ^ 2 + (w a) ^ 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ha ↦ hpoint a
      _ = componentEnergy z k + sumSq w := by
        simp [componentEnergy, sumSq, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hcontract : sumSq w ≤ componentEnergy z l := by
    exact crossMatrix_energy_le F k l hkl (z l)
  linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossPairing_le_half
statement:
theorem crossPairing_le_half (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    crossPairing F z k l hkl ≤
      (componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l) / 2
proof:
:= by
  linarith [two_crossPairing_le F z k l hkl]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.crossPairingTotal_le_half
statement:
theorem crossPairingTotal_le_half (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    crossPairingTotal F z k l ≤
      (componentEnergy z k + componentEnergy z l) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [crossPairingTotal, dif_pos hkl]
  exact crossPairing_le_half F z k l hkl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sharedLegGramQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem sharedLegGramQuadratic_le (F : Frame n d) (z : DomainFamily m n ell)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    sharedLegGramQuadratic F z ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k
proof:
:= by
  have hcross :
      (∑ k, ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
        crossPairingTotal F z k l) ≤
        ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k := by
    apply offDiagonal_sum_le hell
    intro k l hkl
    exact crossPairingTotal_le_half F z k l hkl
  unfold sharedLegGramQuadratic
  calc
    (d : ℝ) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k +
        ∑ k, ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
          crossPairingTotal F z k l ≤
      (d : ℝ) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k +
        ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ k, componentEnergy z k :=
      add_le_add_right hcross _
    _ = ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) *
        ∑ k, componentEnergy z k := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_offDiagonal_left
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_left {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy i) =
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
proof:
:= by
  have hcard (i : Fin ell) : (Finset.univ.erase i).card = ell - 1 := by
    simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy i) =
        ∑ i, (((ell - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * energy i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp [hcard i]
    _ = (((ell - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ i, energy i) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hell]
          norm_num

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_offDiagonal_right
statement:
theorem sum_offDiagonal_right {ell : ℕ} (_hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy j) =
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
proof:
:= by
  let total : ℝ := ∑ i, energy i
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy j) =
        ∑ i, (total - energy i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          exact Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ = (ell : ℝ) * total - total := by
          simp [total, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * total := by ring
    _ = ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i := by rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.offDiagonal_sum_le
statement:
theorem offDiagonal_sum_le {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    (energy : Fin ell → ℝ) (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j) ≤
      ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j) ≤
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i),
          ((energy i + energy j) / 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i _
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j hj
            exact hcross i j (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1.symm
    _ = ((∑ i, ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy i) +
          (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), energy j)) / 2 := by
            simp only [add_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
    _ = ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i := by
          rw [sum_offDiagonal_left hell, sum_offDiagonal_right hell]
          ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate
statement:
theorem blockGram_of_pairwise_certificate {ell : ℕ} (hell : 1 ≤ ell)
    {d quadratic : ℝ}
    (energy diagonal : Fin ell → ℝ)
    (cross : Fin ell → Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hquadratic : quadratic ≤
      (∑ i, diagonal i) +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, diagonal i ≤ d * energy i)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      cross i j ≤ (energy i + energy j) / 2) :
    quadratic ≤ (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i
proof:
:= by
  have hdiagSum : (∑ i, diagonal i) ≤ d * ∑ i, energy i := by
    calc
      (∑ i, diagonal i) ≤ ∑ i, d * energy i := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact hdiag i
      _ = d * ∑ i, energy i := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hcrossSum := offDiagonal_sum_le hell energy cross hcross
  calc
    quadratic ≤ (∑ i, diagonal i) +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), cross i j := hquadratic
    _ ≤ d * ∑ i, energy i +
        ((ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i := add_le_add hdiagSum hcrossSum
    _ = (d + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i, energy i := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.compressed_lightSector_bound
statement:
theorem compressed_lightSector_bound
    {d ell hard bosonic energy : ℝ}
    (hcompression : hard ≤ bosonic)
    (hbosonic : bosonic ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy) :
    hard ≤ (d + ell - 1) * energy
proof:
:=
  hcompression.trans hbosonic

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord_eq_iff
statement:
theorem domainOfWord_eq_iff {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (w v : Fin ell → Site m n) :
    domainOfWord k w = domainOfWord k v ↔
      (w k).1 = (v k).1 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ k → w j = v j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · exact congrArg
        (fun z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k ↦ z.1) h
    · intro j hj
      have hfun := congrArg
        (fun z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k ↦ z.2) h
      exact congrFun hfun ⟨j, hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨hrow, hoff⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hrow
    · funext j
      exact hoff j.1 j.2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_at
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfDomain_at {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n) :
    wordOfDomain k z i k = (z.1, i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordOfDomain]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_off
statement:
theorem wordOfDomain_off {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n)
    (j : Fin ell) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    wordOfDomain k z i j = z.2 ⟨j, hjk⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [wordOfDomain, hjk]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainOfWord_wordOfDomain
statement:
@[simp] theorem domainOfWord_wordOfDomain {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (z : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) (i : Fin n) :
    domainOfWord k (wordOfDomain k z i) = z
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [domainOfWord]
  · funext j
    simp [domainOfWord, wordOfDomain, j.2]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.wordOfDomain_domainOfWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem wordOfDomain_domainOfWord {ell : ℕ} (k : Fin ell)
    (w : Fin ell → Site m n) :
    wordOfDomain k (domainOfWord k w) (w k).2 = w
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · subst j
    simp [domainOfWord]
  · simp [wordOfDomain, domainOfWord, hjk]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.qSlot_relabelSlots
statement:
theorem qSlot_relabelSlots (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell))
    (out inp : LabelledIndex d m n ell) :
    qSlot F k (relabelSlots pi out) (relabelSlots pi inp) =
      qSlot F (pi k) out inp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdomain :
      domainOfWord k (relabelSlots pi out).2 =
          domainOfWord k (relabelSlots pi inp).2 ↔
        domainOfWord (pi k) out.2 = domainOfWord (pi k) inp.2 := by
    rw [domainOfWord_eq_iff, domainOfWord_eq_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hrow, hoff⟩
      refine ⟨hrow, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      have hj' : pi.symm j ≠ k := by
        intro heq
        apply hj
        simpa using congrArg pi heq
      simpa [relabelSlots] using hoff (pi.symm j) hj'
    · rintro ⟨hrow, hoff⟩
      refine ⟨hrow, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      have hpij : pi j ≠ pi k := fun h ↦ hj (pi.injective h)
      simpa [relabelSlots] using hoff (pi j) hpij
  simp only [qSlot]
  rw [if_congr hdomain rfl rfl]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VMatrix_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem VMatrix_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    VMatrix (m := m) F k * (VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose =
      qSlot (m := m) F k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, VMatrix, qSlot]
  by_cases hdom : domainOfWord k out.2 = domainOfWord k inp.2
  · rw [if_pos hdom]
    rw [hdom]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hdom]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro z _hz
    by_cases hzout : z = domainOfWord k out.2
    · have hzinp : z ≠ domainOfWord k inp.2 := by
        intro heq
        exact hdom (hzout.symm.trans heq)
      rw [if_pos hzout, if_neg hzinp]
      simp
    · rw [if_neg hzout]
      simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.transpose_VMatrix_mul_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_VMatrix_mul_apply (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell)
    (z z' : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) :
    ((VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose * VMatrix (m := m) F k) z z' =
      if z = z' then (d : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, VMatrix]
  by_cases hzz : z = z'
  · subst z'
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    let f : LabelledIndex d m n ell → ℝ := fun out ↦
      (if z = domainOfWord k out.2 then F.u (out.2 k).2 out.1 else 0) *
        (if z = domainOfWord k out.2 then F.u (out.2 k).2 out.1 else 0)
    calc
      (∑ out : LabelledIndex d m n ell,
        (if z = domainOfWord k out.2 then
          F.u (out.2 k).2 out.1 else 0) *
        (if z = domainOfWord k out.2 then
          F.u (out.2 k).2 out.1 else 0)) = ∑ out, f out := rfl
      _ = ∑ t : ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k × Fin n × Fin d,
          f ((labelledIndexEquiv (d := d) k).symm t) :=
        ((labelledIndexEquiv (d := d) k).symm.sum_comp f).symm
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ a : Fin d, F.u i a * F.u i a := by
        simp only [f, labelledIndexEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk,
          domainOfWord_wordOfDomain, wordOfDomain_at]
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
        simp
        rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      _ = (d : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        exact sum_frame_coordinate_sq_eq_dim F
  · rw [if_neg hzz]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro out _hout
    by_cases hz : z = domainOfWord k out.2
    · have hz' : z' ≠ domainOfWord k out.2 := by
        intro heq
        exact hzz (hz.trans heq.symm)
      simp [hz, hz']
    · simp [hz]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.transpose_VMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem transpose_VMatrix_mul (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    (VMatrix (m := m) F k).transpose * VMatrix (m := m) F k =
      (d : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k)
        (ParticleDomainIndex m n ell k) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z z'
  rw [transpose_VMatrix_mul_apply F k z z']
  by_cases hzz : z = z'
  · subst z'
    simp
  · simp [hzz]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram
statement:
theorem coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (x : J → ℝ) :
    sumSq (A.mulVec x) =
      quadForm (A.transpose * A) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumSq_eq_dotProduct, ← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A,
    quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, star_trivial]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateEnergy_sigma
statement:
theorem coordinateEnergy_sigma (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    sumSq z = ∑ k, componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumSq, componentEnergy, sigmaToFamily]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sum_blocks
statement:
theorem coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sum_blocks
    (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    quadForm
        ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose * VAllMatrix F ell) z =
      ∑ k, ∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, VAllMatrix,
    blockGramPairing]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  simp_rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGramPairing_self
statement:
theorem blockGramPairing_self (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (k : Fin ell) :
    blockGramPairing F ell z k k =
      (d : ℝ) * componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [blockGramPairing, transpose_VMatrix_mul]
  simp [componentEnergy, sigmaToFamily, sumSq,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _ha
  ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockGramPairing_cross
statement:
theorem blockGramPairing_cross (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (k l : Fin ell) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    blockGramPairing F ell z k l =
      crossPairing F (sigmaToFamily z) k l hkl
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockGramPairing, transpose_VMatrix_mul_cross F k l hkl]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_blockGramPairing_eq_sharedLeg
statement:
theorem sum_blockGramPairing_eq_sharedLeg (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    (∑ k, ∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l) =
      sharedLegGramQuadratic F (sigmaToFamily z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrow (k : Fin ell) :
      (∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l) =
        (d : ℝ) * componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k +
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
            crossPairingTotal F (sigmaToFamily z) k l := by
    calc
      (∑ l, blockGramPairing F ell z k l) =
          (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, blockGramPairing F ell z k l) +
            blockGramPairing F ell z k k :=
        (Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ k)).symm
      _ = blockGramPairing F ell z k k +
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, blockGramPairing F ell z k l :=
        add_comm _ _
      _ = (d : ℝ) * componentEnergy (sigmaToFamily z) k +
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase k,
            crossPairingTotal F (sigmaToFamily z) k l := by
        rw [blockGramPairing_self]
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro l hl
        have hlk : l ≠ k := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hl).1
        have hkl : k ≠ l := Ne.symm hlk
        rw [blockGramPairing_cross F ell z k l hkl]
        simp [crossPairingTotal, hkl]
  simp_rw [hrow]
  unfold sharedLegGramQuadratic
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sharedLeg
statement:
theorem coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sharedLeg
    (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) :
    quadForm
        ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose * VAllMatrix F ell) z =
      sharedLegGramQuadratic F (sigmaToFamily z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sum_blocks,
    sum_blockGramPairing_eq_sharedLeg]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VAllMatrix_energy_le
statement:
theorem VAllMatrix_energy_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (z : AllDomainIndex m n ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    sumSq ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).mulVec z) ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq z
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram,
    coordinateQuadratic_VAll_gram_eq_sharedLeg,
    coordinateEnergy_sigma]
  exact sharedLegGramQuadratic_le F (sigmaToFamily z) hell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.coordinate_dot_sq_le
statement:
theorem coordinate_dot_sq_le {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x y : I → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, x i * y i) ^ 2 ≤ sumSq x * sumSq y
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sumSq] using
    (Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.univ) x y)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.gramQuadratic_le_of_energy_le
statement:
theorem gramQuadratic_le_of_energy_le
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hA : ∀ z : J → ℝ,
      sumSq (A.mulVec z) ≤ c * sumSq z)
    (x : I → ℝ) :
    quadForm (A * A.transpose) x ≤
      c * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  let z : J → ℝ := A.transpose.mulVec x
  have hgram : sumSq z = quadForm (A * A.transpose) x := by
    simpa [z] using coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram A.transpose x
  have hinner : sumSq z = ∑ i, x i * A.mulVec z i := by
    calc
      sumSq z = quadForm (A * A.transpose) x := hgram
      _ = ∑ i, x i * A.mulVec z i := by
        simp only [quadForm_def, star_trivial, dotProduct]
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  have hcs : sumSq z ^ 2 ≤
      sumSq x * sumSq (A.mulVec z) := by
    rw [hinner]
    exact coordinate_dot_sq_le x (A.mulVec z)
  have hmul : sumSq x * sumSq (A.mulVec z) ≤
      sumSq x * (c * sumSq z) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA z) (sumSq_nonneg x)
  have hchain : sumSq z ^ 2 ≤
      sumSq x * (c * sumSq z) := hcs.trans hmul
  have hznonneg := sumSq_nonneg z
  have hbound : sumSq z ≤ c * sumSq x := by
    by_cases hz : sumSq z = 0
    · rw [hz]
      exact mul_nonneg hc (sumSq_nonneg x)
    · have hzpos : 0 < sumSq z := lt_of_le_of_ne hznonneg (Ne.symm hz)
      nlinarith
  rw [← hgram]
  exact hbound

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_relabelSlots
statement:
theorem labelledG_relabelSlots (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell))
    (out inp : LabelledIndex d m n ell) :
    labelledG F ell (relabelSlots pi out) (relabelSlots pi inp) =
      labelledG F ell out inp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [labelledG, Matrix.sum_apply, qSlot_relabelSlots]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp pi (fun k ↦ qSlot F k out inp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.qSlot_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem qSlot_transpose (F : Frame n d) (k : Fin ell) :
    (qSlot (m := m) F k).transpose = qSlot F k
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, qSlot]
  by_cases hdom : domainOfWord k out.2 = domainOfWord k inp.2
  · rw [if_pos hdom.symm, if_pos hdom]
    ring
  · have hrev : domainOfWord k inp.2 ≠ domainOfWord k out.2 :=
      fun h ↦ hdom h.symm
    rw [if_neg hrev, if_neg hdom]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelledG_transpose (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    (labelledG (m := m) F ell).transpose = labelledG F ell
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelledG, Matrix.transpose_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  exact qSlot_transpose (m := m) F k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.VAllMatrix_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem VAllMatrix_mul_transpose (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell * (VAllMatrix F ell).transpose =
      labelledG F ell
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, VAllMatrix,
    labelledG, Matrix.sum_apply]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _hk
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (VMatrix_mul_transpose (m := m) F k) out) inp
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_isHermitian
statement:
theorem labelledG_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) :
    (labelledG (m := m) F ell).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  change (labelledG (m := m) F ell).transpose = labelledG F ell
  exact labelledG_transpose F ell

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg
statement:
theorem labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : LabelledIndex d m n ell → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ quadForm (labelledG F ell) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← VAllMatrix_mul_transpose]
  have hgram :
      sumSq
          ((VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose.mulVec x) =
        quadForm
          (VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell *
            (VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose) x := by
    simpa using coordinateEnergy_mulVec_eq_gram
      (VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell).transpose x
  rw [← hgram]
  exact sumSq_nonneg _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le
statement:
theorem labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ)
    (x : LabelledIndex d m n ell → ℝ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    quadForm (labelledG F ell) x ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  have hellR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hell
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
  have hc : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1 := by
    linarith
  rw [← VAllMatrix_mul_transpose]
  exact gramQuadratic_le_of_energy_le
    (VAllMatrix (m := m) F ell)
    ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) hc
    (fun z ↦ VAllMatrix_energy_le F ell z hell) x

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_norm_le
statement:
theorem labelledG_norm_le (F : Frame n d) (ell : ℕ) (hell : 1 ≤ ell) :
    ‖labelledG (m := m) F ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hellR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ell : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hell
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
  have hc : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1 := by
    linarith
  apply (specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le
    (labelledG (m := m) F ell) (labelledG_isHermitian F ell)
    ((d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1) hc).2
  intro x
  have hupper := labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_le F ell x hell
  rw [sumSq_eq_dotProduct] at hupper
  exact (abs_of_nonneg (labelledG_coordinateQuadratic_nonneg F ell x)).trans_le hupper

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_norm_le_grade
statement:
theorem labelledG_norm_le_grade (F : Frame n d) (ell nu : ℕ)
    (hell : 1 ≤ ell) (hle : ell ≤ nu) :
    ‖labelledG (m := m) F ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖labelledG (m := m) F ell‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (ell : ℝ) - 1 :=
      labelledG_norm_le F ell hell
    _ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := by
      have hleR : (ell : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
      linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pAt r i * pDagAt r j =
      wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pDown, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pAt, pDagAt, wordKernel, Leg.op] using
    siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne (m := m) (n := n)
      (r, i) (r, j) (by
        intro h
        exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd h)) pDestroy pCreate

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cOne_transpose_mul_cOne_of_ne
statement:
theorem cOne_transpose_mul_cOne_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r j =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
        (.pDown, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, cOne, orderedWordTerm,
    externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i p out.2) *
        (F.u j inp.1 * pDagAt r j p inp.2)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          ∑ p, (pDagAt r i).transpose out.2 p * pDagAt r j p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      ring
    _ = (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pDown, .pUp) out.2 inp.2 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pAt_mul_pDagAt_of_ne r hij)
      rw [pDagAt_transpose]
      change (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        ((pAt r i * pDagAt r j) out.2 inp.2) = _
      rw [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.cMatrix_transpose_mul_cMatrix
statement:
theorem cMatrix_transpose_mul_cMatrix (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (cMatrix F r).transpose * cMatrix F r =
      D0Row F r +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
            (.pDown, .pUp)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [cMatrix_eq_sum_cOne, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
  rw [D0Row]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    (∑ j, (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r j) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r j) +
          (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    _ = (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r i +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          (cOne F r i).transpose * cOne F r j := add_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact cOne_transpose_mul_cOne_of_ne F r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self (F : Frame n d) :
    (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F).transpose * CreateAnalysisStack F =
      D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, CreateAnalysisStack]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [D0, Matrix.sum_apply, Hprime, wordSum,
    physicalWordSum, Matrix.add_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  have h := congrArg (fun M : FullOp d m n ↦ M out inp)
    (cMatrix_transpose_mul_cMatrix F r)
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_column_inner
statement:
theorem pDagAt_column_inner (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (a b : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ p, pDagAt r i p a * pDagAt r i p b) =
      if a = b ∧ a (r, i) = .zero then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Site m n := (r, i)
  let marked := Heavy.setSite a s .one
  by_cases ha : a s = .zero
  · have hrestore : Heavy.setSite marked s .zero = a := by
      simpa [marked, s] using
        Heavy.setSite_restore (b := .one) a s ha
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single marked]
    · simp only [pDagAt_apply]
      simp [marked, s, hrestore, ha, eq_comm]
    · intro p _ hpne
      by_cases hp : p s = .one
      · by_cases heq : a = Heavy.setSite p s .zero
        · have hpmark : p = marked := by
            calc
              p = Heavy.setSite
                    (Heavy.setSite p s .zero) s .one := by
                symm
                exact Heavy.setSite_restore (b := .zero) p s hp
              _ = marked := by rw [← heq]
          exact (hpne hpmark).elim
        · simp [pDagAt_apply, s, hp, heq]
      · simp [pDagAt_apply, s, hp]
    · simp
  · have hzero (p : Pattern m n) : pDagAt r i p a = 0 := by
      rw [pDagAt_apply]
      by_cases hp : p s = .one
      · by_cases heq : a = Heavy.setSite p s .zero
        · exfalso
          apply ha
          rw [heq]
          exact Heavy.setSite_apply_self _ _ _
        · simp [s, hp, heq]
      · simp [s, hp]
    have hane : a (r, i) ≠ .zero := by simpa [s] using ha
    simp [hzero, hane]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_apply
statement:
theorem D0Row_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D0Row F r out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        partialFrameOperator F (out.2.freshInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [D0Row, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, cOne]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ p,
        (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i p out.2) *
          (F.u i inp.1 * pDagAt r i p inp.2)) =
        ∑ i, (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i p out.2 * pDagAt r i p inp.2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = ∑ i, (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
        (if out.2 = inp.2 ∧ out.2 (r, i) = .zero then 1 else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [pDagAt_column_inner]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hp : out.2 = inp.2
      · simp only [hp, true_and, if_true]
        simp [partialFrameOperator, Pattern.freshInRow, Finset.sum_filter]
      · simp [hp]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_fullFiber
statement:
theorem D0Row_fullFiber (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D0Row F r) x) p =
      applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F (p.freshInRow r)) (fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k
  simp only [fiber, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, D0Row_apply, applyMatrix,
    PiLp.toLp_apply]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0Row_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem D0Row_norm_le_one (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    ‖D0Row F r‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le (by norm_num)
  intro x
  rw [full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber]
  calc
    (∑ p, euclideanNormSq
        (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D0Row F r) x) p)) =
        ∑ p, euclideanNormSq
          (applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F (p.freshInRow r))
            (fiber x p)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [D0Row_fullFiber]
    _ ≤ ∑ p, euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      exact partialFrameOperator_contraction F (p.freshInRow r) (fiber x p)
    _ = 1 ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      rw [full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber]
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D0_norm_le
statement:
theorem D0_norm_le (F : Frame n d) :
    ‖D0 (m := m) F‖ ≤ (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D0]
  calc
    ‖∑ r, D0Row F r‖ ≤ ∑ r, ‖D0Row F r‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _r : Fin m, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      exact D0Row_norm_le_one F r
    _ = (m : ℝ) := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.matrix_typed_block_cs
statement:
theorem matrix_typed_block_cs
    {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] [DecidableEq K]
    (B : Matrix K J ℝ) (A : Matrix J I ℝ) :
    ‖B * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A.transpose * A‖ * ‖B * B.transpose‖
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ‖B * A‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul B A
  have hAconj : A.conjTranspose = A.transpose := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hBconj : B.transpose.conjTranspose = B := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hAgram : ‖A.transpose * A‖ = ‖A‖ * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [← hAconj, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hBcogram : ‖B * B.transpose‖ = ‖B‖ * ‖B‖ := by
    calc
      ‖B * B.transpose‖ =
          ‖B.transpose.conjTranspose * B.transpose‖ := by rw [hBconj]
      _ = ‖B.transpose‖ * ‖B.transpose‖ :=
        Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self B.transpose
      _ = ‖B‖ * ‖B‖ := by
        rw [show ‖B.transpose‖ = ‖B‖ from specNorm_transpose B]
  calc
    ‖B * A‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖B‖ * ‖A‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hmul 2
    _ = (‖A‖ * ‖A‖) * (‖B‖ * ‖B‖) := by ring
    _ = ‖A.transpose * A‖ * ‖B * B.transpose‖ := by rw [hAgram, hBcogram]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu).transpose *
      (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) =
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu *
          (D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, gradeProjection_transpose]
  calc
    (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu *
        (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F).transpose) *
        (CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu) =
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu *
        ((CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F).transpose *
          CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F) *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [CreateAnalysisStack_transpose_mul_self]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let A := CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
    gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
  have hP : ‖P‖ ≤ 1 := gradeProjection_norm_le_one nu
  have hD0P : ‖D0 F * P‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ‖D0 F * P‖ ≤ ‖D0 F‖ * ‖P‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (m : ℝ) * 1 := mul_le_mul (D0_norm_le F) hP
        (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = (m : ℝ) := mul_one _
  have hHP :
      ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
    simpa [P] using norm_Hprime_restricted_le
      (m := m) F nu
  have hgram : ‖A.transpose * A‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := by
    rw [show A.transpose * A = P *
        (D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) * P by
      simpa [A, P] using CreateAnalysisStack_restricted_gram
        (m := m) F nu]
    calc
      ‖P * (D0 F + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)) * P‖ ≤
          ‖P‖ * ‖(D0 F + Hprime m
            (Frame.rows F)) * P‖ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        exact Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖(D0 F + Hprime m
            (Frame.rows F)) * P‖ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖D0 F * P + Hprime m
            (Frame.rows F) * P‖ := by
        rw [one_mul, Matrix.add_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖D0 F * P‖ +
          ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := add_le_add hD0P hHP
  have hconj : A.conjTranspose = A.transpose := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hsquare : ‖A‖ * ‖A‖ = ‖A.transpose * A‖ := by
    rw [← hconj, Matrix.l2_opNorm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  have hmn : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt hmn
  change ‖A‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg A, Real.sqrt_nonneg ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_transpose_eq_Lminus
statement:

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lminus_transpose_eq_Lplus
statement:
theorem Lminus_transpose_eq_Lplus (F : Frame n d) :

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.aTerm_add_bTerm_mono_nat
statement:
theorem aTerm_add_bTerm_mono_nat {k nu m : ℕ} (d : ℕ)
    (hknu : k ≤ nu) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    aTerm d k m + bTerm d k m ≤
      aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm)
  have hknuR : (k : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hknu
  have hfrac :
      ((d : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) / (m : ℝ) ≤
        ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) / (m : ℝ) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hmR.le
  have ha : aTerm d k m ≤ aTerm d nu m := by
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hfrac
  have hb : bTerm d k m ≤ bTerm d nu m := by
    exact hfrac
  exact add_le_add ha hb

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Lplus m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt
        (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) * ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lplus_grade_factor]
  have hC := CStack_restricted_norm (m := m) F (nu + 1)
  have hC' :
      ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
          CStack (m := m) F *
          Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) := by
    (convert hC using 1; push_cast; ring)
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 2) *
            CStack (m := m) F *
            Heavy.rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ *
          ‖CreateAnalysisStack (m := m) F *
            gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ :=
      Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) *
        Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) := by
      exact mul_le_mul hC'
        (CreateAnalysisStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F nu)
        (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.sqrt
        (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) * ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity :
        0 ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt
        (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) * ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))) /
          (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hmR)]
  calc
    (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
        ‖Lplus m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt
        (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) * ((m : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le (m := m) F nu) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
statement:
theorem normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  exact (normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le (m := m) F nu hm).trans
    (lightPlus_scalar_bound
      (Nat.cast_nonneg d) (Nat.cast_nonneg nu) hmR)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Lzero m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
  have hG : ‖ghat (m := m) F * P‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) := by
    simpa [P] using ghat_gradeProjection_norm_le_all
      (m := m) F nu
  have hD : ‖D1 (m := m) F * P‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
    simpa [P] using D1_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F nu
  have hH :
      ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
    simpa [P] using norm_Hprime_restricted_le
      (m := m) F nu
  rw [Lzero_eq_ghat_sub_D1_add_Hprime, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.sub_mul]
  change ‖ghat (m := m) F * P - D1 (m := m) F * P +
      Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖ghat (m := m) F * P - D1 (m := m) F * P‖ +
        ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖ghat (m := m) F * P‖ + ‖D1 (m := m) F * P‖) +
        ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖ := by
      exact add_le_add
        (norm_sub_le (ghat (m := m) F * P) (D1 (m := m) F * P))
        (le_refl ‖Hprime m (Frame.rows F) * P‖)
    _ ≤ (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ)) + (nu : ℝ) := by
      exact add_le_add (add_le_add hG hD) hH
    _ ≤ 3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) := by
      have hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
      linarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le
statement:
theorem normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lzero m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hmR)]
  calc
    (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
        ‖Lzero m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      (1 / (m : ℝ)) * (3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ))) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le (m := m) F nu) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
statement:
theorem normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lzero m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      3 * bTerm d nu m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm
  calc
    _ ≤ 3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ) :=
      normalized_Lzero_gradeProjection_norm_le (m := m) F nu hm
    _ ≤ 3 * bTerm d nu m := by
      unfold bTerm
      calc
        3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ) ≤
            (3 * ((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1)) / (m : ℝ) := by
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hmR.le
        _ = 3 * (((d : ℝ) + (nu : ℝ) + 1) / (m : ℝ)) := by ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lminus_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem Lminus_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    Lminus m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply input_grade_vanishes_of_no_output
    (Lminus_homogeneous (m := m) F) 0
  intro mu
  omega

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lminus_gradeProjection_one
statement:
theorem Lminus_gradeProjection_one (F : Frame n d) :
    Lminus m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by

    (Lminus_homogeneous (m := m) F) 1
  intro mu
