name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_eq_shift
statement:
theorem normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_eq_shift
    (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lminus m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 2)‖ =
      ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) k‖
proof:
:= by
  have hshift :
      gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 2) *
          Lplus m (Frame.rows F) =
        Lplus m (Frame.rows F) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) k := by
    exact gradeProjection_mul_eq_mul_gradeProjection_of_homogeneous
      (Lplus_homogeneous (m := m) F) (k + 2) k (by norm_num)
  calc
    _ = ‖(((1 / (m : ℝ)) •
          Lminus m (Frame.rows F)) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (k + 2)).transpose‖ := by
      exact (specNorm_transpose _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_smul,
        Lminus_transpose_eq_Lplus, gradeProjection_transpose,
        Matrix.mul_smul, hshift, Matrix.smul_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
statement:
theorem normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope
    (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lminus m (Frame.rows F)) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu‖ ≤
      aTerm d nu m + bTerm d nu m
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : 0 < (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hm
  have henv_nonneg (r : ℕ) :
      0 ≤ aTerm d r m + bTerm d r m :=
    add_nonneg (aTerm_nonneg _ _ _)
      (bTerm_nonneg
        (Nat.cast_nonneg d) (Nat.cast_nonneg r) hmR)
  rcases nu with (_ | _ | k)
  · rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Lminus_gradeProjection_zero]
    simpa using henv_nonneg 0
  · rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Lminus_gradeProjection_one]
    simpa using henv_nonneg 1
  · calc
      _ = ‖((1 / (m : ℝ)) • Lplus m
            (Frame.rows F)) *
          gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) k‖ := by
        exact normalized_Lminus_gradeProjection_norm_eq_shift (m := m) F k
      _ ≤ aTerm d k m + bTerm d k m :=
        normalized_Lplus_gradeProjection_norm_le_envelope (m := m) F k hm
      _ ≤ aTerm d (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) m +
          bTerm d (((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) m :=
        aTerm_add_bTerm_mono_nat (k := k) (nu := k + 2) (m := m)
          d (by omega) hm
      _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem canonicalLightWord_mem (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) :
    canonicalLightWord T ell p k ∈ p.1.light
proof:
:=
  (lightSupportEquiv T ell p k).2

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_injective
statement:
theorem canonicalLightWord_injective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) :
    Function.Injective (canonicalLightWord T ell p)
proof:
:= by
  intro k l h
  exact (lightSupportEquiv T ell p).injective (Subtype.ext h)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.canonicalLightWord_surjective
statement:
theorem canonicalLightWord_surjective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (s : Site m n) :
    s ∈ p.1.light ↔ ∃ k, canonicalLightWord T ell p k = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (lightSupportEquiv T ell p).surjective ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨k, congrArg Subtype.val hk⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact canonicalLightWord_mem T ell p k

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_refl (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (k : Fin ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)) k =
      canonicalLightWord T ell p k
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_refl_fun
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_refl_fun
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (p : BlockPattern T ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)) =
      canonicalLightWord T ell p
proof: := rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_injective
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_injective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    Function.Injective (permutedLightWord T ell p pi)
proof:
:=
  (canonicalLightWord_injective T ell p).comp pi.injective

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_mem (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (k : Fin ell) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p pi k ∈ p.1.light
proof:
:=
  canonicalLightWord_mem T ell p (pi k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_surjective
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_surjective (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p : BlockPattern T ell) (pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (s : Site m n) :
    s ∈ p.1.light ↔ ∃ k, permutedLightWord T ell p pi k = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalLightWord_surjective T ell p s]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨pi.symm k, ?_⟩
    simp [permutedLightWord, hk]
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact ⟨pi k, hk⟩

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_permutationOfLightWord
statement:
@[simp] theorem permutedLightWord_permutationOfLightWord
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ) (p : BlockPattern T ell)
    (w : Fin ell → Site m n)
    (hmem : ∀ k, w k ∈ p.1.light) (hinj : Function.Injective w) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p
      (permutationOfLightWord T ell p w hmem hinj) = w
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp [permutedLightWord, permutationOfLightWord, canonicalLightWord]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pattern_eq_of_light_heavy_eq
statement:
theorem pattern_eq_of_light_heavy_eq {p q : Pattern m n}
    (hlight : p.light = q.light) (hheavy : p.heavy = q.heavy) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  have hL : (p s = .one) ↔ (q s = .one) := by
    rw [← Pattern.mem_light, ← Pattern.mem_light, hlight]
  have hH : (p s = .two) ↔ (q s = .two) := by
    rw [← Pattern.mem_heavy, ← Pattern.mem_heavy, hheavy]
  cases hp : p s <;> cases hq : q s <;> simp_all

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutedLightWord_eq_iff
statement:
theorem permutedLightWord_eq_iff
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (p q : BlockPattern T ell)
    (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    permutedLightWord T ell p pi = permutedLightWord T ell q sigma ↔
      p = q ∧ pi = sigma
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hword
    have hlight : p.1.light = q.1.light := by
      ext s
      rw [canonicalLightWord_surjective T ell p s,
        canonicalLightWord_surjective T ell q s]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
        refine ⟨sigma (pi.symm k), ?_⟩
        have hkword := congrFun hword (pi.symm k)
        simpa [permutedLightWord, hk] using hkword.symm
      · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
        refine ⟨pi (sigma.symm k), ?_⟩
        have hkword := congrFun hword (sigma.symm k)
        simpa [permutedLightWord, hk] using hkword
    have hpqVal : p.1 = q.1 :=
      pattern_eq_of_light_heavy_eq hlight (p.2.1.trans q.2.1.symm)
    have hpq : p = q := Subtype.ext hpqVal
    subst q
    have hpi : pi = sigma := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro k
      exact canonicalLightWord_injective T ell p
        (congrFun hword k)
    exact ⟨rfl, hpi⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.relabelSlots_blockLabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabelSlots_blockLabel
    (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (rho pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) (x : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    relabelSlots rho (blockLabel T ell x pi) =
      blockLabel T ell x (rho.trans pi)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.blockLabel_eq_iff
statement:
theorem blockLabel_eq_iff (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    blockLabel T ell x pi = blockLabel T ell y sigma ↔
      x = y ∧ pi = sigma
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ha : x.1 = y.1 :=
      congrArg (fun z : LabelledIndex d m n ell ↦ z.1) h
    have hw : permutedLightWord T ell x.2 pi =
        permutedLightWord T ell y.2 sigma :=
      congrArg (fun z : LabelledIndex d m n ell ↦ z.2) h
    obtain ⟨hp, hpi⟩ := (permutedLightWord_eq_iff T ell x.2 y.2 pi sigma).mp hw
    exact ⟨Prod.ext ha hp, hpi⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.permutationCount_pos
statement: theorem permutationCount_pos (ell : ℕ) : 0 < permutationCount ell
proof:
:= by
  exact Fintype.card_pos

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.labelledG_blockLabel_relative
statement:
theorem labelledG_blockLabel_relative
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell)
    (pi sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell)) :
    labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma) =
      labelledG F ell
        (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
        (blockLabel T ell y (pi.symm.trans sigma))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma) =
        labelledG F ell
          (relabelSlots pi.symm (blockLabel T ell x pi))
          (relabelSlots pi.symm (blockLabel T ell y sigma)) :=
      (labelledG_relabelSlots F ell pi.symm _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_sum_labelledG_blockLabel
statement:
theorem sum_sum_labelledG_blockLabel
    (F : Frame n d) (T : Finset (Site m n)) (ell : ℕ)
    (x y : BlockIndex d T ell) :
    (∑ pi, ∑ sigma,
      labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma)) =
      (permutationCount ell : ℝ) *
        ∑ tau, labelledG F ell
          (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
          (blockLabel T ell y tau)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), ∑ sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell),
      labelledG F ell (blockLabel T ell x pi) (blockLabel T ell y sigma)) =
        ∑ pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), ∑ sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), labelledG F ell
          (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
          (blockLabel T ell y (pi.symm.trans sigma)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro pi _hpi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro sigma _hsigma
      exact labelledG_blockLabel_relative F T ell x y pi sigma
    _ = ∑ pi : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), ∑ tau : Equiv.Perm (Fin ell), labelledG F ell
          (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
          (blockLabel T ell y tau) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro pi _hpi
      exact Equiv.sum_comp (relativePermEquiv pi)
        (fun tau ↦ labelledG F ell
          (blockLabel T ell x (Equiv.refl (Fin ell)))
          (blockLabel T ell y tau))
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ,
        permutationCount]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_coordinateDelta_mul_coordinateDelta
statement:
theorem sum_coordinateDelta_mul_coordinateDelta
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (x y : I) :
    (∑ z, coordinateDelta z x * coordinateDelta z y) =
      coordinateDelta x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst y
    simp [coordinateDelta]
  · simp [coordinateDelta, hxy, Ne.symm hxy]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_mul_pAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem pDagAt_mul_pAt_of_ne (r : Fin m) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    pDagAt r i * pAt r j =
      wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .pDown)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pAt, pDagAt, wordKernel, Leg.op] using
    siteKernel_mul_siteKernel_of_ne (m := m) (n := n)
      (r, i) (r, j) (by
        intro h
        exact hij (congrArg Prod.snd h)) pCreate pDestroy

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne
statement:
theorem COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    COne F r i * (COne F r j).transpose =
      orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
        (.pUp, .pDown)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, COne, orderedWordTerm,
    externalTensor, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p, (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
        (F.u j inp.1 * pDagAt r j inp.2 p)) =
        (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p *
            (pDagAt r j).transpose p inp.2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      ring
    _ = (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        wordKernel (r, i) (r, j) (.pUp, .pDown) out.2 inp.2 := by
      rw [pDagAt_transpose]
      have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K out.2 inp.2)
        (pDagAt_mul_pAt_of_ne r hij)
      change (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) *
        ((pDagAt r i * pAt r j) out.2 inp.2) = _
      rw [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition
statement:
theorem CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    CMatrix F r * (CMatrix F r).transpose =
      D1Row F r +
        ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j
            (.pUp, .pDown)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [CMatrix_eq_sum_COne, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
  rw [D1Row, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  calc
    (∑ j, COne F r i * (COne F r j).transpose) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          COne F r i * (COne F r j).transpose) +
          COne F r i * (COne F r i).transpose := by
      rw [Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    _ = COne F r i * (COne F r i).transpose +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          COne F r i * (COne F r j).transpose := add_comm _ _
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact COne_mul_COne_transpose_of_ne F r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.ghat_eq_D1_add_lightHop
statement:
theorem ghat_eq_D1_add_lightHop (F : Frame n d) :
    ghat (m := m) F = D1 F +
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .pUp .pDown
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ghat]
  simp only [D1, wordSum, physicalWordSum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  exact CMatrix_mul_transpose_decomposition F r

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.Lzero_eq_ghat_sub_D1_add_Hprime
statement:
theorem Lzero_eq_ghat_sub_D1_add_Hprime (F : Frame n d) :
    Lzero m (Frame.rows F) =
      (ghat F - D1 F) + Hprime m (Frame.rows F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lzero, Hprime]
  have h := ghat_eq_D1_add_lightHop (m := m) F
  rw [h]
  abel

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.pDagAt_row_inner
statement:
theorem pDagAt_row_inner (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (a b : Pattern m n) :
    (∑ p, pDagAt r i a p * pDagAt r i b p) =
      if a = b ∧ a (r, i) = .one then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Site m n := (r, i)
  let erased := Heavy.setSite a s .zero
  by_cases ha : a s = .one
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single erased]
    · have hfirst : a (r, i) = .one ∧
          erased = Heavy.setSite a (r, i) .zero := by
        constructor
        · simpa [s] using ha
        · rfl
      have hsecond :
          (b (r, i) = .one ∧
            erased = Heavy.setSite b (r, i) .zero) ↔ b = a := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hb, heq⟩
          calc
            b = Heavy.setSite
                (Heavy.setSite b (r, i) .zero) (r, i) .one := by
              symm
              exact Heavy.setSite_restore (b := .zero) b (r, i) hb
            _ = Heavy.setSite erased (r, i) .one := by rw [← heq]
            _ = a := by
              exact Heavy.setSite_restore
                (b := .zero) a (r, i) (by simpa [s] using ha)
        · rintro rfl
          exact hfirst
      simp only [pDagAt_apply, if_pos hfirst]
      by_cases hab : b = a
      · subst b
        simp [hfirst]
      · have hn : ¬(b (r, i) = .one ∧
            erased = Heavy.setSite b (r, i) .zero) :=
          fun hb ↦ hab (hsecond.mp hb)
        have hab' : a ≠ b := Ne.symm hab
        simp [hn, hab']
    · intro p _ hpne
      have hz : pDagAt r i a p = 0 := by
        rw [pDagAt_apply]
        simp [s, erased, ha, hpne]
      rw [hz, zero_mul]
    · simp
  · have hzero (p : Pattern m n) : pDagAt r i a p = 0 := by
      rw [pDagAt_apply]
      simp [s, ha]
    have hane : a (r, i) ≠ .one := by simpa [s] using ha
    simp [hzero, hane]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1Row_apply
statement:
theorem D1Row_apply (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m)
    (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D1Row F r out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [D1Row, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, COne]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ p,
        (F.u i out.1 * pDagAt r i out.2 p) *
          (F.u i inp.1 * pDagAt r i inp.2 p)) =
        ∑ i, (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
          ∑ p, pDagAt r i out.2 p * pDagAt r i inp.2 p := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      ring
    _ = ∑ i, (F.u i out.1 * F.u i inp.1) *
        (if out.2 = inp.2 ∧ out.2 (r, i) = .one then 1 else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [pDagAt_row_inner]
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hp : out.2 = inp.2
      · simp only [hp, true_and, if_true]
        simp [partialFrameOperator, Pattern.lightInRow, Finset.sum_filter]
      · simp [hp]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_apply
statement:
theorem D1_apply (F : Frame n d) (out inp : Fin d × Pattern m n) :
    D1 (m := m) F out inp =
      if out.2 = inp.2 then
        ∑ r, partialFrameOperator F (out.2.lightInRow r) out.1 inp.1
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [D1, Matrix.sum_apply, D1Row_apply]
  by_cases hp : out.2 = inp.2
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [hp]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_rows
statement:
theorem D1_fullFiber_rows (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p =
      ∑ r, applyMatrix (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r))
        (fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext k
  simp only [fiber, PiLp.toLp_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    applyMatrix, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  change (∑ inp : Fin d × Pattern m n,
      D1 (m := m) F (k, p) inp * x inp) =
    ∑ r, ∑ l, (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r)) k l * x (l, p)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [D1_apply]
  calc
    (∑ l, ∑ q,
        (if p = q then
          ∑ r, (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r)) k l else 0) *
            x (l, q)) =
        ∑ l, (∑ r, (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r)) k l) *
          x (l, p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      simp
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ r,
        (partialFrameOperator F (p.lightInRow r)) k l * x (l, p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_fullFiber_sites
statement:
theorem D1_fullFiber_sites (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p =
      ∑ s ∈ p.light,
        (analyze F (fiber x p) s.2) • F.u s.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [D1_fullFiber_rows]
  simp_rw [partialFrameOperator_mulVec]
  ext k
  simp only [synthesize, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply]
  exact sum_rows_light_eq_sum_light p
    (fun s ↦ analyze F (fiber x p) s.2 * F.u s.2 k)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.analyze_smul_frame_normSq_le
statement:
theorem analyze_smul_frame_normSq_le (F : Frame n d)
    (v : EVec d) (i : Fin n) :
    euclideanNormSq ((analyze F v i) • F.u i) ≤
      euclideanNormSq v
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (analyze F v i) ^ 2 ≤ euclideanNormSq v := by
    have h := subset_analysis F ({i} : Finset (Fin n)) v
    simpa using h
  have hu := vector_normSq_le_one F i
  have hscale :
      euclideanNormSq ((analyze F v i) • F.u i) =
        (analyze F v i) ^ 2 * euclideanNormSq (F.u i) := by
    simp only [euclideanNormSq, PiLp.inner_apply, Real.inner_apply,
      WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    ring
  rw [hscale]
  calc
    (analyze F v i) ^ 2 * euclideanNormSq (F.u i) ≤
        (analyze F v i) ^ 2 * 1 := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ euclideanNormSq v := by simpa using ha

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_output_fiber_energy_le
statement:
theorem D1_output_fiber_energy_le (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (p : Pattern m n) :
    euclideanNormSq
        (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p) ≤
      (p.light.card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        euclideanNormSq (fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D1_fullFiber_sites]
  calc
    euclideanNormSq
        (∑ s ∈ p.light, (analyze F (fiber x p) s.2) • F.u s.2) ≤
        (p.light.card : ℝ) * ∑ s ∈ p.light,
          euclideanNormSq
            ((analyze F (fiber x p) s.2) • F.u s.2) :=
      normSq_sum_le_card p.light
        (fun s ↦ (analyze F (fiber x p) s.2) • F.u s.2)
    _ ≤ (p.light.card : ℝ) * ∑ _s ∈ p.light,
          euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro s _
      exact analyze_smul_frame_normSq_le F (fiber x p) s.2
    _ = (p.light.card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      simp
      ring

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_supported_energy_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber]
  calc
    (∑ p, euclideanNormSq
        (fiber (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F) x) p)) ≤
        ∑ p, (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          euclideanNormSq (fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      by_cases hp : p.grade = nu
      · have hcardNat : p.light.card ≤ nu := by
          simpa [hp] using p.card_light_le_grade
        have hcard : (p.light.card : ℝ) ≤ (nu : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hcardNat
        have hsquare : (p.light.card : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have hc0 : 0 ≤ (p.light.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          have hn0 : 0 ≤ (nu : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
          nlinarith
        exact (D1_output_fiber_energy_le F x p).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsquare real_inner_self_nonneg)
      · have hz : fiber x p = 0 := by
          ext k
          exact hx k p hp
        have hlocal := D1_output_fiber_energy_le (m := m) F x p
        rw [hz] at hlocal ⊢
        simpa [euclideanNormSq] using hlocal
    _ = (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      rw [full_normSq_eq_sum_fiber, Finset.mul_sum]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_restricted_energy
statement:
theorem D1_restricted_energy (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec
          (D1 (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) ≤
      (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
  calc
    sumSq
        (Matrix.mulVec (D1 (m := m) F)
          (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x)) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq
          (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x) :=
      D1_supported_energy_le F (gradeProjection_supported nu x)
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gradeProjection_normSq_le nu x)
        (sq_nonneg (nu : ℝ))

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.D1_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem D1_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖D1 (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)
    (D1_restricted_energy (m := m) F nu)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.sum_prod3
statement:
theorem sum_prod3 {A B C : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype C]
    (f : A × B × C → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, f t) = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, f (a, b, c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _ha
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.domainKToFiber_fiberToDomainK

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Light.normSq_eq_coordinateEnergy
statement:
theorem normSq_eq_coordinateEnergy (x : EVec n) :
    euclideanNormSq x = sumSq (fun i ↦ x i)
