        (rUpAt_mul_rDownAt_of_ne r hij)
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using congrArg
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ (F.u i out.1 * F.u j inp.1) * t) h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpMatrix_gram_row
statement:
theorem AUpMatrix_gram_row (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (AUpMatrix F r).transpose * AUpMatrix F r =
      (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .rUp)) +
      ∑ i, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [AUpMatrix_eq_sum_one, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r j) =
      ∑ i, ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r j) +
          (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact (Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
    _ = (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r j) +
        ∑ i, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact AUpOne_transpose_mul_AUpOne_of_ne F r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownMatrix_gram_row
statement:
theorem ADownMatrix_gram_row (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (ADownMatrix F r).transpose * ADownMatrix F r =
      (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rDown)) +
      ∑ i, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ADownMatrix_eq_sum_one, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_sum]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r j) =
      ∑ i, ((∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r j) +
          (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact (Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
    _ = (∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r j) +
        ∑ i, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      exact ADownOne_transpose_mul_ADownOne_of_ne F r
        (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack_gram
statement:
theorem AUpStack_gram (F : Frame n d) :
    (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack (m := m) F =
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rDown .rUp + DUp (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack (m := m) F =
        ∑ r, (AUpMatrix F r).transpose * AUpMatrix F r := by
      ext out inp
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, AUpStack,
        Matrix.sum_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = ∑ r, ((∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .rUp)) +
        ∑ i, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      exact AUpMatrix_gram_row F r
    _ = (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rDown, .rUp)) +
        ∑ r, ∑ i, (AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rDown .rUp + DUp (m := m) F := by
      rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gram
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gram (F : Frame n d) :
    (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F =
      wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rUp .rDown + DDown (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F =
        ∑ r, (ADownMatrix F r).transpose * ADownMatrix F r := by
      ext out inp
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, ADownStack,
        Matrix.sum_apply]
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = ∑ r, ((∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rDown)) +
        ∑ i, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      exact ADownMatrix_gram_row F r
    _ = (∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
          orderedWordTerm (Frame.rows F) r i j (.rUp, .rDown)) +
        ∑ r, ∑ i, (ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = wordSum m (Frame.rows F) .rUp .rDown + DDown (m := m) F := by
      rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gram_sub_diagonal
statement:
theorem Hzero_gram_sub_diagonal (F : Frame n d) :
    Hzero m (Frame.rows F) =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack (m := m) F +
      (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F -
      (DUp (m := m) F + DDown (m := m) F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AUpStack_gram, ADownStack_gram]
  unfold Hzero
  abel

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpOne_mulVec
statement:
theorem AUpOne_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x σ =
      if σ (r, i) = .two then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, AUpOne]
  exact one_rUp_analysis F x r i σ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownOne_mulVec
statement:
theorem ADownOne_mulVec (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) (r : Fin m) (i : Fin n)
    (σ : Pattern m n) :
    Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x σ =
      if σ (r, i) = .one then
        analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, ADownOne]
  exact one_rDown_analysis F x r i σ

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.subset_analysis_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem subset_analysis_le_card_mul (F : Frame n d) (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (v : EVec d) :
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F v i) ^ 2) ≤
      (S.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq v
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ S, (analyze F v i) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ S, euclideanNormSq v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have h := subset_analysis F {i} v
      simpa using h
    _ = (S.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq v := by simp

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DUp_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem DUp_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)) =
        ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ σ,
          if σ (r, i) = .two then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      simp only [sumSq, AUpOne_mulVec]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      by_cases h : σ (r, i) = .two <;> simp [h]
    _ = ∑ r, ∑ σ, ∑ i,
          if σ (r, i) = .two then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r, ∑ i,
          if σ (r, i) = .two then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Pattern.heavyInRow, Finset.sum_filter]
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .two,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x
            (setSite z.pattern (z.row, z.col) .one)) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [Pattern.heavyInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .two
          (fun p r i ↦ (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite p (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2)
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .one,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x z.pattern) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sum_marked_reindex .two .one]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      simp only [markedTransition, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
      rw [setSite_restore z.pattern (z.row, z.col) z.state]
    _ = ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2 := by
      symm
      simpa only [Pattern.lightInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .one
          (fun p _ i ↦ (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2)
    _ ≤ ∑ p, ∑ r, ((p.lightInRow r).card : ℝ) *
          euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      exact subset_analysis_le_card_mul F (p.lightInRow r) (Directional.fiber x p)
    _ = ∑ p, (p.light.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum,
        ← Pattern.card_light_eq_sum_card_lightInRow]
    _ ≤ ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast p.card_light_le_grade)
        real_inner_self_nonneg

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.DDown_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem DDown_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)) =
        ∑ r, ∑ i, ∑ σ,
          if σ (r, i) = .one then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      simp only [sumSq, ADownOne_mulVec]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      by_cases h : σ (r, i) = .one <;> simp [h]
    _ = ∑ r, ∑ σ, ∑ i,
          if σ (r, i) = .one then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r, ∑ i,
          if σ (r, i) = .one then
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i) ^ 2 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ σ.lightInRow r,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .two)) i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Pattern.lightInRow, Finset.sum_filter]
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .one,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x
            (setSite z.pattern (z.row, z.col) .two)) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [Pattern.lightInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .one
          (fun p r i ↦ (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite p (r, i) .two)) i) ^ 2)
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .two,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x z.pattern) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sum_marked_reindex .one .two]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      simp only [markedTransition, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
      rw [setSite_restore z.pattern (z.row, z.col) z.state]
    _ = ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.heavyInRow r,
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2 := by
      symm
      simpa only [Pattern.heavyInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .two
          (fun p _ i ↦ (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2)
    _ ≤ ∑ p, ∑ r, ((p.heavyInRow r).card : ℝ) *
          euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      exact subset_analysis_le_card_mul F (p.heavyInRow r) (Directional.fiber x p)
    _ = ∑ p, (p.heavy.card : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum,
        ← Pattern.card_heavy_eq_sum_card_heavyInRow]
    _ ≤ ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      have hcard : p.heavy.card ≤ p.grade := by
        have htwo := p.two_mul_card_heavy_le_grade
        omega
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard)
        real_inner_self_nonneg

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUp_energy_le_weighted
statement:
theorem AUp_energy_le_weighted (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x)) ≤
      ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x)) =
        ∑ r, ∑ σ,
          (∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
            analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [sumSq, AUpMatrix_mulVec]
    _ ≤ ∑ r, ∑ σ,
        ((σ.heavyInRow r).card : ℝ) *
          ∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro σ _
      exact sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r,
        ((σ.heavyInRow r).card : ℝ) *
          ∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ σ, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ σ.heavyInRow r,
        ((σ.heavyInRow r).card : ℝ) *
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .two,
        ((z.pattern.heavyInRow z.row).card : ℝ) *
          (analyze F
            (Directional.fiber x (setSite z.pattern (z.row, z.col) .one)) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [Pattern.heavyInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .two
          (fun σ r i ↦ ((σ.heavyInRow r).card : ℝ) *
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x (setSite σ (r, i) .one)) i) ^ 2)
    _ = ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .one,
        ((((setSite z.pattern (z.row, z.col) .two).heavyInRow z.row).card : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x z.pattern) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sum_marked_reindex .two .one]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      simp only [markedTransition, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
      rw [setSite_restore z.pattern (z.row, z.col) z.state]
    _ ≤ ∑ z : MarkedSite m n .one,
        (rowGrade z.pattern z.row : ℝ) *
          (analyze F (Directional.fiber x z.pattern) z.col) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro z _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast card_heavy_after_promote_le_rowGrade z.state)
        (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = ∑ p, ∑ r, ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r,
        (rowGrade p r : ℝ) * (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2 := by
      symm
      simpa only [Pattern.lightInRow] using
        sum_markedSite (m := m) (n := n) .one
          (fun p r i ↦ (rowGrade p r : ℝ) *
            (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2)
    _ = ∑ p, ∑ r, (rowGrade p r : ℝ) *
        ∑ i ∈ p.lightInRow r, (analyze F (Directional.fiber x p) i) ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ p, ∑ r, (rowGrade p r : ℝ) *
        euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (subset_analysis F (p.lightInRow r) (Directional.fiber x p)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber x p) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      norm_cast
      rw [sum_rowGrade]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gram
statement:
theorem quadratic_gram
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    (A : Matrix I J ℝ) (x : J → ℝ) :
    quadForm (A.transpose * A) x =
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self,
    star_trivial, sumSq_eq_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DUp
statement:
theorem quadratic_DUp (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) x =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) x =
        ∑ r, ∑ i,
          quadForm ((AUpOne F r i).transpose * AUpOne F r i) x := by
      simp only [quadForm, DUp, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [quadratic_gram]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_DDown
statement:
theorem quadratic_DDown (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) x =
      ∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) x =
        ∑ r, ∑ i,
          quadForm ((ADownOne F r i).transpose * ADownOne F r i) x := by
      simp only [quadForm, DDown, Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [quadratic_gram]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_Hzero
statement:
theorem quadratic_Hzero (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (Hzero m (Frame.rows F)) x =
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) x) +
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) x) -
      (quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) x + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hzero_gram_sub_diagonal]
  calc
    quadForm
          ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack F +
            (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack F -
            (DUp F + DDown F)) x =
        quadForm
            ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack F +
              (ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack F) x -
          quadForm (DUp F + DDown F) x := by
      simp [quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.sub_mulVec,
        dotProduct_add, dotProduct_sub]
    _ =
        (quadForm ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * AUpStack F) x +
          quadForm ((ADownStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack F) x) -
        (quadForm (DUp F) x + quadForm (DDown F) x) := by
      simp [quadForm, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [quadratic_gram, quadratic_gram]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.quadratic_gradeConj
statement:
theorem quadratic_gradeConj (M : FullOp d m n) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    quadForm (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * M * gradeProjection nu) x =
      quadForm M (Matrix.mulVec (gradeProjection (d := d) nu) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_mul M
    (gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu) x
  rwa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, gradeProjection_transpose] at h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_transpose
statement:
theorem Hzero_transpose (F : Frame n d) :
    (Hzero m (Frame.rows F)).transpose = Hzero m (Frame.rows F)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hzero wordSum
  rw [Matrix.transpose_add,
    Directional.transpose_physicalWordSum,
    Directional.transpose_physicalWordSum]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_homogeneous
statement:
theorem Hzero_homogeneous (F : Frame n d) :
    IsFullGradeShift 0 (Hzero m (Frame.rows F))
proof:
:= by
  apply homogeneous_add
  · simpa [Hzero, wordSum, Word.degree, Leg.degree] using
      Directional.physicalWordSum_homogeneous
        (m := m) (Frame.rows F) (.rUp, .rDown)
  · simpa [Hzero, wordSum, Word.degree, Leg.degree] using
      Directional.physicalWordSum_homogeneous
        (m := m) (Frame.rows F) (.rDown, .rUp)

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Hzero_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection nu =
      Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  apply output_projection_of_homogeneous
    (Hzero_homogeneous (m := m) F) nu nu
  norm_num

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeConj_quadratic_abs_le
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeConj_quadratic_abs_le (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    |quadForm
      (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) *
        gradeProjection nu) x| ≤
      2 * (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x
proof:
:= by
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu
  let y := Matrix.mulVec P x
  have hUp :
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) y) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
    rw [coordNormSq_AUpStack]
    simpa only [P, y] using
      AUp_grade_energy (m := m) F nu x
  have hDown :
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) y) ≤
        (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
    rw [coordNormSq_ADownStack]
    simpa only [P, y] using
      ADown_grade_energy (m := m) F nu x
  have hDiag :
      quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) y + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) y ≤
        (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
    calc
      quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) y + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) y =
          (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpOne F r i) y)) +
          (∑ r, ∑ i, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownOne F r i) y)) := by
        rw [quadratic_DUp, quadratic_DDown]
      _ ≤ ∑ p, (p.grade : ℝ) * euclideanNormSq (Directional.fiber y p) :=
        Dcombined_energy_le_weighted F y
      _ = (nu : ℝ) * sumSq y := by
        simpa [P, y] using weighted_gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) nu x
      _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (gradeProjection_normSq_le nu x) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hDiag0 :
      0 ≤ quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) y + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) y := by
    rw [quadratic_DUp, quadratic_DDown]
    exact add_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sumSq_nonneg _)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ sumSq_nonneg _)
  have hUp0 :
      0 ≤ sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) y) :=
    sumSq_nonneg _
  have hDown0 :
      0 ≤ sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) y) :=
    sumSq_nonneg _
  have hNorm0 : 0 ≤ sumSq x := sumSq_nonneg x
  have hNu0 : 0 ≤ (nu : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rw [quadratic_gradeConj, quadratic_Hzero, abs_le]
  change
    -(2 * (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x) ≤
          sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) y) +
            sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) y) -
            (quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) y + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) y) ∧
      sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack (m := m) F) y) +
            sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack (m := m) F) y) -
            (quadForm (DUp (m := m) F) y + quadForm (DDown (m := m) F) y) ≤
        2 * (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeConj_isHermitian
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeConj_isHermitian (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    (gradeProjection (d := d) nu * Hzero m (Frame.rows F) *
      gradeProjection nu).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, gradeProjection_transpose,
    Hzero_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hzero_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hzero_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hzero m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤
      2 * (nu : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Hzero_grade_factor]
  apply (specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le _
    (Hzero_gradeConj_isHermitian (m := m) F nu) (2 * (nu : ℝ)) (by positivity)).2
  intro x
  have h := Hzero_gradeConj_quadratic_abs_le (m := m) F nu x
  rwa [sumSq_eq_dotProduct] at h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGradeProjection_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowGradeProjection_transpose (mu : ℕ) :
    (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu).transpose = rowGradeProjection mu
proof:
:= by
  ext out inp
  by_cases h : out = inp
  · subst inp
    simp [rowGradeProjection, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  · have h' : inp ≠ out := Ne.symm h
    simp [rowGradeProjection, Matrix.transpose_apply, h, h']

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one (mu : ℕ) :
    ‖rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowGradeProjection, Matrix.l2_opNorm_diagonal]
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by norm_num)).2
  intro x
  by_cases h : x.2.grade = mu <;> simp [h]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection
statement:
theorem rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection nu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = nu
  · by_cases hentry : AUpStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := AUpMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      have hout : out.2.grade = nu + 1 := by
        rw [hin] at hrel
        exact_mod_cast hrel
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_ADownStack_input
statement:
theorem rowProjection_ADownStack_input (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu * ADownStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1) =
      rowGradeProjection mu * ADownStack (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hout : out.2.grade = mu
  · by_cases hentry : ADownStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hout, hentry]
    · have hrel := ADownMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      have hin : inp.2.grade = mu + 1 := by
        rw [hout] at hrel
        exact_mod_cast hrel.symm
      simp [hout, hin]
  · simp [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_AUpStack_input
statement:
theorem rowProjection_AUpStack_input (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) k =
      rowGradeProjection (k + 1) * AUpStack (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hout : out.2.grade = k + 1
  · by_cases hentry : AUpStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hout, hentry]
    · have hrel := AUpMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      have hin : inp.2.grade = k := by
        rw [hout] at hrel
        push_cast at hrel
        have hz : (inp.2.grade : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) := by omega
        exact_mod_cast hz
      simp [hout, hin]
  · simp [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_ADownStack_output
statement:
theorem rowProjection_ADownStack_output (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu * ADownStack (m := m) F *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1) =
      ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (mu + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [rowGradeProjection, gradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = mu + 1
  · by_cases hentry : ADownStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := ADownMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      have hout : out.2.grade = mu := by
        rw [hin] at hrel
        push_cast at hrel
        have hz : (out.2.grade : ℤ) = (mu : ℤ) := by omega
        exact_mod_cast hz
      simp [hin, hout]
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.rowProjection_zero_AUpStack
statement:
theorem rowProjection_zero_AUpStack (F : Frame n d) :
    rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0 * AUpStack (m := m) F = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [rowGradeProjection, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.zero_apply]
  by_cases hout : out.2.grade = 0
  · by_cases hentry : AUpStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hout, hentry]
    · have hrel := AUpMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      rw [hout] at hrel
      have : (0 : ℤ) < (inp.2.grade : ℤ) + 1 := by omega
      omega
  · simp [hout]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext out inp
  simp only [gradeProjection, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.zero_apply]
  by_cases hin : inp.2.grade = 0
  · by_cases hentry : ADownStack F out inp = 0
    · simp [hin, hentry]
    · have hrel := ADownMatrix_grade_relation F out.1 hentry
      rw [hin] at hrel
      have : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (out.2.grade : ℤ) := by omega
      omega
  · simp [hin]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.coordNormSq_AUpStack
statement:
theorem coordNormSq_AUpStack (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpStack F) x) =
      ∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (AUpMatrix F r) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumSq, sumSq, AUpStack, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.coordNormSq_ADownStack
statement:
theorem coordNormSq_ADownStack (F : Frame n d)
    (x : Fin d × Pattern m n → ℝ) :
    sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownStack F) x) =
      ∑ r, sumSq (Matrix.mulVec (ADownMatrix F r) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sumSq, sumSq, ADownStack, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt nu
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  intro x
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, coordNormSq_AUpStack]
  calc
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := AUp_grade_energy F nu x
    _ = (Real.sqrt nu) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) nu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt nu
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_of_normSq_mulVec_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  intro x
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, coordNormSq_ADownStack]
  calc
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) * sumSq x := ADown_grade_energy F nu x
    _ = (Real.sqrt nu) ^ 2 * sumSq x := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg nu)]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpMatrix_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem BUpMatrix_transpose (F : Frame n d) (r : Fin m) :
    (BUpMatrix F r).transpose = ADownMatrix F r
proof:
:= by
  ext σ inp
  simp only [BUpMatrix, ADownMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  have h := congrArg (fun K : FockOp m n ↦ K σ inp.2) (rUpAt_transpose r i)
  simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.BUpStack_rowGradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem BUpStack_rowGradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (mu : ℕ) :
    ‖BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (mu + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let B := BUpStack (m := m) F
  let R := rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) mu
  let A := ADownStack (m := m) F
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) (mu + 1)
  have ht : (B * R).transpose = R * A := by
    simp [B, R, A, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc
    ‖B * R‖ = ‖(B * R).transpose‖ := (specNorm_transpose (B * R)).symm
    _ = ‖R * A‖ := by rw [ht]
    _ = ‖R * A * P‖ := by
      rw [rowProjection_ADownStack_input (m := m) F mu]
    _ = ‖R * (A * P)‖ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ ‖R‖ * ‖A * P‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul R (A * P)
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖A * P‖ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one mu)
        (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ 1 * Real.sqrt (mu + 1) := by
      have ha := ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F (mu + 1)
      have ha' : ‖A * P‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((mu : ℝ) + 1) := by
        simpa [A, P, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using ha
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha' zero_le_one
    _ = Real.sqrt (mu + 1) := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_grade_factor
statement:
theorem Hplus_grade_factor (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    Hplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
      (BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)) *
        (AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hplus_eq_BUpStack_mul_AUpStack]
  have hins := rowProjection_AUpStack_gradeProjection (m := m) F nu
  calc
    (BUpStack (m := m) F * AUpStack (m := m) F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu =
        BUpStack (m := m) F *
          (AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = BUpStack (m := m) F *
        (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1) *
          AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu) := by
      rw [hins]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le (nu : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (nu + 2) * Real.sqrt nu ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnu : 0 ≤ (nu : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hnu2 : 0 ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) + 2) * Real.sqrt (nu : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hsquare :
      (Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) + 2) * Real.sqrt (nu : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
        ((nu : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hnu2, Real.sq_sqrt hnu]
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg
    (((nu : ℝ) + 1) + Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) + 2) * Real.sqrt (nu : ℝ))]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hplus_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hplus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hplus_grade_factor]
  calc
    _ ≤
        ‖BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ *
          ‖AUpStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ :=
      Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) + 2) * Real.sqrt nu := by
      have hb := BUpStack_rowGradeProjection_norm (m := m) F (nu + 1)
      have hb' :
          ‖BUpStack (m := m) F * rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (nu + 1)‖ ≤
            Real.sqrt ((nu : ℝ) + 2) := by
        (convert hb using 1; norm_num; ring)
      exact mul_le_mul hb' (AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F nu)
        (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1 := sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le nu

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hplus_transpose_eq_Hminus
statement:
theorem Hplus_transpose_eq_Hminus (F : Frame n d) :
    (Hplus m (Frame.rows F)).transpose = Hminus m (Frame.rows F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hplus, Hminus, wordSum, wordSum,
    Directional.transpose_physicalWordSum]
  rfl

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack
statement:
theorem Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Hplus_transpose_eq_Hminus, Hplus_eq_BUpStack_mul_AUpStack,
    Matrix.transpose_mul, BUpStack_transpose]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.AUpStackTranspose_rowGradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem AUpStackTranspose_rowGradeProjection_norm
    (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖(AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt k
proof:
:= by
  let A := AUpStack (m := m) F
  let R := rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)
  let P := gradeProjection (d := d) (m := m) (n := n) k
  have ht : (A.transpose * R).transpose = R * A := by
    simp [A, R, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc
    ‖A.transpose * R‖ = ‖(A.transpose * R).transpose‖ :=
      (specNorm_transpose (A.transpose * R)).symm
    _ = ‖R * A‖ := by rw [ht]
    _ = ‖R * A * P‖ := by
      rw [rowProjection_AUpStack_input (m := m) F k]
    _ = ‖R * (A * P)‖ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ ‖R‖ * ‖A * P‖ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖A * P‖ := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (rowGradeProjection_norm_le_one (k + 1))
        (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ 1 * Real.sqrt k := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (AUpStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F k) zero_le_one
    _ = Real.sqrt k := one_mul _

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_grade_factor_add_two
statement:
theorem Hminus_grade_factor_add_two (F : Frame n d) (k : ℕ) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) =
      ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)) *
      (ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack]
  have hout := rowProjection_ADownStack_output (m := m) F (k + 1)
  have hout' :
      rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) *
          ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) =
        ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) := by
    convert hout using 1
  calc
    ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2) =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        (ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1) *
          ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)) := by
      rw [hout']
    _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_zero
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_zero (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    ADownStack_gradeProjection_zero, Matrix.mul_zero]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_one
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_one (F : Frame n d) :
    Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hminus_eq_AUpStackTranspose_mul_ADownStack]
  have hout := rowProjection_ADownStack_output (m := m) F 0
  have hout' :
      rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0 * ADownStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) 1 =
        ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) 1 := by
    convert hout using 1
  have hz : (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
      rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0 = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.transpose (rowProjection_zero_AUpStack (m := m) F)
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_mul] using h
  calc
    ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose * ADownStack (m := m) F) *
        gradeProjection (d := d) 1 =
      (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        (ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) 1) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        (rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0 * ADownStack (m := m) F *
          gradeProjection (d := d) 1) := by rw [hout']
    _ = ((AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
        rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) 0) *
          (ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) 1) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hz, Matrix.zero_mul]

name: NLAlib.SparseSketch.Heavy.Hminus_gradeProjection_norm
statement:
theorem Hminus_gradeProjection_norm (F : Frame n d) (nu : ℕ) :
    ‖Hminus m (Frame.rows F) * gradeProjection (d := d) nu‖ ≤ (nu : ℝ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases nu with (_ | _ | k)
  · rw [Hminus_gradeProjection_zero]
    norm_num
  · rw [Hminus_gradeProjection_one]
    norm_num
  · rw [Hminus_grade_factor_add_two]
    calc
      _ ≤
          ‖(AUpStack (m := m) F).transpose *
            rowGradeProjection (m := m) (n := n) (k + 1)‖ *
          ‖ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)‖ :=
        Matrix.l2_opNorm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt k * Real.sqrt (k + 2) := by
        have hd := ADownStack_gradeProjection_norm (m := m) F (k + 2)
        have hd' :
            ‖ADownStack (m := m) F * gradeProjection (d := d) (k + 2)‖ ≤
              Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 2) := by
          (convert hd using 1; norm_num)
        exact mul_le_mul
          (AUpStackTranspose_rowGradeProjection_norm (m := m) F k)
          hd'
          (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        simpa [mul_comm] using sqrt_mul_sqrt_add_two_le k
      _ ≤ ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_osiCrossSuccessEvent
statement:
theorem measurableSet_osiCrossSuccessEvent {S : Ω → Matrix k n 𝕜} (hS : Measurable S)
    (Q : Matrix n (Fin d) 𝕜) (Qperp : Matrix n s 𝕜) (B : Matrix t s 𝕜) (α : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (osiCrossSuccessEvent S Q Qperp B α)
proof:
:= by
  let X := fun ω => (S ω * Q)ᴴ
  let Z := fun ω => B * (S ω * Qperp)ᴴ
  have hX : Measurable X := Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp (hS.matrix_mul measurable_const)
  have hZ : Measurable Z := measurable_const.matrix_mul
    (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp (hS.matrix_mul measurable_const))
  have hR : MeasurableSet {ω | (X ω).rank = d} := by
    simpa only [Set.preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Fintype.card_fin] using
      (measurableSet_setOf_full_row_rank (m := Fin d) (n := k)).preimage hX
  have hF : Measurable (fun ω => frobSq (Z ω * pinvR (X ω))) :=
    measurable_frobSq.comp (hZ.matrix_mul (measurable_pinvR.comp hX))
  have he : osiCrossSuccessEvent S Q Qperp B α =
      {ω | (X ω).rank = d ∧ frobSq (Z ω * pinvR (X ω)) ≤ (20 / α) * frobSq B} := by
    ext ω
    change ((X ω).rank = d ∧ frobSq (Z ω * moorePenroseInverse (X ω)) ≤ (20 / α) * frobSq B) ↔
      ((X ω).rank = d ∧ frobSq (Z ω * pinvR (X ω)) ≤ (20 / α) * frobSq B)
    by_cases hr : (X ω).rank = d
    · rw [moorePenroseInverse_eq_pinvR _
        (isUnit_mul_conjTranspose_of_rank_eq_card _ (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hr))]
    · simp only [hr, false_and]
  rw [he]
  exact hR.inter (measurableSet_le hF measurable_const)

name: NLAlib.IsObliviousSubspaceInjection.measureReal_osiCrossSuccessEvent_ge
statement:
theorem IsObliviousSubspaceInjection.measureReal_osiCrossSuccessEvent_ge
    {S : Ω → Matrix k n 𝕜} {α : ℝ} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : IsObliviousSubspaceInjection S d α μ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (Q : Matrix n (Fin d) 𝕜) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (Qperp : Matrix n s 𝕜) (hQperp : HasOrthonormalCols Qperp) (B : Matrix t s 𝕜) :
    9 / 10 ≤ μ.real (osiCrossSuccessEvent S Q Qperp B α)
proof:
:= by
  let Z := fun ω => B * (S ω * Qperp)ᴴ
  let f := fun ω => frobSq (Z ω)
  have hfe (ω : Ω) : f ω = frobSq (S ω * (Qperp * Bᴴ)) := by
    change frobSq (Z ω) = _
    rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (Z ω)]
    simp only [Z, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hfI : Integrable f μ :=
    (h.isotropic.integrable_frobSq_mul (Qperp * Bᴴ)).congr
      (ae_of_all μ fun ω => (hfe ω).symm)
  have hfE : ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ = frobSq B := by
    simp_rw [hfe]
    rw [h.isotropic.integral_frobSq_mul,
      frobSq_mul_left_of_orthonormal hQperp.conjTranspose_mul_self,
      frobSq_conjTranspose]
  have hfM : Measurable f :=
    measurable_frobSq.comp (measurable_const.matrix_mul
      (Matrix.measurable_conjTranspose.comp (h.measurable.matrix_mul measurable_const)))
  have hmark : μ.real {ω | 20 * frobSq B < f ω} ≤ 1 / 20 := by
    by_cases hB : B = 0
    · have hz : ∀ ω, f ω = 0 := by simp [f, Z, hB]
      simp only [hB, frobSq_zero, mul_zero, hz, lt_self_iff_false,
        Set.ofPred_false, measureReal_empty]
      norm_num
    · have hb : 0 < frobSq B := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg B)
        (Ne.symm fun hz => hB ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff B).mp hz))
      have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all μ fun ω => frobSq_nonneg (Z ω)) hfI (20 * frobSq B)
      rw [hfE] at hm
      calc
        μ.real {ω | 20 * frobSq B < f ω} ≤ μ.real {ω | 20 * frobSq B ≤ f ω} :=
          measureReal_mono fun ω hω => by
            change 20 * frobSq B < f ω at hω
            change 20 * frobSq B ≤ f ω
            exact hω.le
        _ ≤ frobSq B / (20 * frobSq B) :=
          (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hb)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hm)
        _ = 1 / 20 := by field_simp [hb.ne']
  let bad := {ω | ¬ IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α} ∪ {ω | 20 * frobSq B < f ω}
  have hbadM : MeasurableSet bad :=
    (measurableSet_isSubspaceInjection h.measurable Q α).compl.union
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hfM)
  have hbad : μ.real bad ≤ 1 / 10 := by
    calc
      μ.real bad ≤ μ.real {ω | ¬ IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α} +
          μ.real {ω | 20 * frobSq B < f ω} := measureReal_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 / 20 + 1 / 20 := add_le_add (h.injection Q hQ) hmark
      _ = 1 / 10 := by norm_num
  have hgood : 9 / 10 ≤ μ.real badᶜ := by
    rw [measureReal_compl hbadM, probReal_univ]
    linarith
  refine hgood.trans (measureReal_mono ?_)
  intro ω hω
  change ¬((¬IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α) ∨ 20 * frobSq B < f ω) at hω
  change ((S ω * Q)ᴴ).rank = d ∧
    frobSq (Z ω * moorePenroseInverse ((S ω * Q)ᴴ)) ≤ (20 / α) * frobSq B
  have hinj : IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α := by
    by_contra hnot
    exact hω (Or.inl hnot)
  have hf : f ω ≤ 20 * frobSq B := not_lt.mp fun hnot => hω (Or.inr hnot)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hinj.rank_conjTranspose_mul_eq_card hQ hα
  · calc
      frobSq (Z ω * moorePenroseInverse ((S ω * Q)ᴴ)) ≤ frobSq (Z ω) / α :=
        hinj.frobSq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_le hQ hα (Z ω)
      _ ≤ (20 * frobSq B) / α := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hf hα.le
      _ = (20 / α) * frobSq B := by ring

name: NLAlib.norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
private theorem norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols [DecidableEq r]
    {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (x : r → 𝕜) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
    star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ,
    norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.isClosed_setOf_isSubspaceInjection
statement:
theorem isClosed_setOf_isSubspaceInjection (U : Matrix n r 𝕜) (α : ℝ) :
    IsClosed {S : Matrix k n 𝕜 | IsSubspaceInjection S U α}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsSubspaceInjection, Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro x
  apply isClosed_le continuous_const
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  fun_prop

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.isSubspaceInjection_iff_gram
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.isSubspaceInjection_iff_gram [DecidableEq r]
    {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (S : Matrix k n 𝕜) (α : ℝ) :
    IsSubspaceInjection S Q α ↔
      (α : 𝕜) • (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜) ≤ (S * Q)ᴴ * (S * Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.le_iff]
  let H := (S * Q)ᴴ * (S * Q) - (α : 𝕜) • (1 : Matrix r r 𝕜)
  have hH : H.IsHermitian :=
    (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S * Q)).sub
      (Matrix.isHermitian_one.smul (show IsSelfAdjoint (α : 𝕜) by simp [IsSelfAdjoint]))
  have he (x : r → 𝕜) : RCLike.re (quadForm H x) =
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((S * Q) *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 - α * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [H, quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec,
      dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_sub, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
    rw [← quadForm, quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self]
  rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hH, fun x => ?_⟩
    change 0 ≤ quadForm H x
    rw [← hH.ofReal_re_quadForm x]
    apply RCLike.ofReal_nonneg.mpr
    rw [he, sub_nonneg]
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ] using h x
  · rintro ⟨_, h⟩ x
    have hp : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (quadForm H x) := (RCLike.nonneg_iff.mp (h x)).1
    rw [he, sub_nonneg] at hp
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ] using hp

name: NLAlib.HasOrthonormalCols.isSubspaceInjection_iff_le_singularValues_sq
statement:
theorem HasOrthonormalCols.isSubspaceInjection_iff_le_singularValues_sq
    [DecidableEq r] [Nonempty r] {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q)
    (S : Matrix k n 𝕜) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    IsSubspaceInjection S Q α ↔ α ≤ singularValues (S * Q) (Fintype.card r - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs : Real.sqrt α ≤ singularValues (S * Q) (Fintype.card r - 1) := by
      apply le_singularValues_last
      intro x hx
      apply (Real.sqrt_le_iff).mpr
      refine ⟨norm_nonneg _, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ, hx,
        one_pow, mul_one] using h x
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg α) hs 2
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hα] at hp
  · intro h x
    have hv := singularValues_last_mul_norm_le (S * Q) x
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀
      (mul_nonneg (singularValues_nonneg _ _) (norm_nonneg _)) hv 2
    rw [mul_pow] at hp
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (sq_nonneg ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖)
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, norm_mulVec_sq_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ]
      using hmul.trans hp

name: NLAlib.measurableSet_isSubspaceInjection
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_setOf_isSubspaceInjection Q α).measurableSet.preimage hS

name: NLAlib.IsObliviousSubspaceInjection.measureReal_isSubspaceInjection_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hm := h.injection Q hQ
  have hc := measureReal_add_measureReal_compl (μ := μ)
    (measurableSet_isSubspaceInjection h.measurable Q α)
  rw [probReal_univ] at hc
  change μ.real {ω | IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α} +
    μ.real {ω | ¬ IsSubspaceInjection (S ω) Q α} = 1 at hc
  linarith

name: NLAlib.integrable_sketch_gram
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.integrable_iff_entries.mpr fun i j => ?_
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ => (hS c i).star.integrable_mul (hS c j)

name: NLAlib.integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq
statement:
private theorem integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq {S : Ω → Matrix k n 𝕜}
    (hS : ∀ i j, MemLp (fun ω => S ω i j) 2 μ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S ω *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ =
      RCLike.re (quadForm (∫ ω, (S ω)ᴴ * S ω ∂μ) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_sketch_gram hS
  have hq := (quadFormContinuousLinearMap x).integral_comp_comm hi
  have hqi := (quadFormContinuousLinearMap x).integrable_comp hi
  have he (ω : Ω) : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S ω *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 =
      RCLike.re (quadForm ((S ω)ᴴ * S ω) x) := by
    rw [quadForm_conjTranspose_mul_self, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  simp only [quadFormContinuousLinearMap_apply] at hq hqi
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_re hqi, hq]

name: NLAlib.eq_of_isHermitian_of_quadForm_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hle {C D : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hC : C.IsHermitian) (hD : D.IsHermitian)
      (he : ∀ x, quadForm C x = quadForm D x) : C ≤ D := by
    rw [Matrix.le_iff, Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨hD.sub hC, fun x => ?_⟩
    change 0 ≤ quadForm (D - C) x
    have hz : quadForm (D - C) x = 0 := by
      simp only [quadForm, Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (he x).symm
    rw [hz]
  exact le_antisymm (hle hA hB h) (hle hB hA fun x => (h x).symm)

name: NLAlib.isIsotropicSketch_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropicSketch_iff {S : Ω → Matrix k n 𝕜} :
    IsIsotropicSketch S μ ↔ (∀ i j, MemLp (fun ω => S ω i j) 2 μ) ∧
      ∀ x : n → 𝕜, ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S ω *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ =
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.memLp, fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq h.memLp, h.integral_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.one_mulVec, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  · rintro ⟨hm, hv⟩
    refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
    have hG := Matrix.isHermitian_integral (ae_of_all μ fun ω =>
      Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S ω))
    refine eq_of_isHermitian_of_quadForm_eq hG Matrix.isHermitian_one fun x => ?_
    rw [← hG.ofReal_re_quadForm x, ← Matrix.isHermitian_one.ofReal_re_quadForm x]
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_norm_mulVec_sq_eq hm, hv]
    simp only [quadForm, Matrix.one_mulVec, norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]

name: NLAlib.IsIsotropicSketch.integrable_norm_mulVec_sq
statement:
theorem integrable_norm_mulVec_sq (h : IsIsotropicSketch S μ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S ω *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  refine integrable_finsetSum _ fun i _ => ?_
  have hi : MemLp (fun ω => (S ω *ᵥ x) i) 2 μ := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact memLp_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (h.memLp i j).mul_const (x j)
  exact hi.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)

name: NLAlib.IsIsotropicSketch.integral_norm_mulVec_sq
statement:
theorem integral_norm_mulVec_sq (h : IsIsotropicSketch S μ) (x : n → 𝕜) :
    ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (S ω *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (isIsotropicSketch_iff.mp h).2 x

name: NLAlib.IsIsotropicSketch.frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col
statement:
private theorem frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (M : Matrix k p 𝕜) :
    frobSq M = ∑ j, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (M.col j)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Matrix.col_apply]

name: NLAlib.IsIsotropicSketch.integrable_frobSq_mul
statement:
theorem integrable_frobSq_mul (h : IsIsotropicSketch S μ) {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (M : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    Integrable (fun ω => frobSq (S ω * M)) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  exact integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ => h.integrable_norm_mulVec_sq (M.col j)

name: NLAlib.IsIsotropicSketch.integral_frobSq_mul
statement:
theorem integral_frobSq_mul (h : IsIsotropicSketch S μ) {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (M : Matrix n p 𝕜) :
    ∫ ω, frobSq (S ω * M) ∂μ = frobSq M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col, col_mul_eq_mulVec_col]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => h.integrable_norm_mulVec_sq (M.col j)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => h.integral_norm_mulVec_sq (M.col j)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col
statement:
private theorem frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b]
    (M : Matrix a b 𝕜) : frobSq M = ∑ j, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (M.col j)‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_sq, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Matrix.col_apply]

name: NLAlib.frame_lower
proof:
:= by
  have he : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (Q *ᵥ x)‖ ^ 2 = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct,
      star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hQ,
      norm_toLp_sq_eq_re_star_dotProduct]
  simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, he] using h x

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceInjection.rank_conjTranspose_mul_eq_card
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceInjection.rank_conjTranspose_mul_eq_card {S : Matrix k n 𝕜}
    {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} {α : ℝ} (h : IsSubspaceInjection S Q α)
    (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hα : 0 < α) :
    ((S * Q)ᴴ).rank = Fintype.card r
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (S * Q).mulVecLin := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hz : (S * Q) *ᵥ (x - y) = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hxy
    have hb := frame_lower h hQ (x - y)
    rw [hz, WithLp.toLp_zero, norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero] at hb
    have hs : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 0 :=
      (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hα).mp (by simpa only [mul_zero] using hb)
    have hn : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y)‖ = 0 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (WithLp.toLp 2 (x - y))]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((WithLp.toLp_eq_zero 2).mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hn))
  rw [Matrix.rank_conjTranspose, Matrix.rank,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceInjection.frobSq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceInjection.frobSq_mul_moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose_le
    {S : Matrix k n 𝕜} {Q : Matrix n r 𝕜} {α : ℝ}
    (h : IsSubspaceInjection S Q α) (hQ : HasOrthonormalCols Q) (hα : 0 < α)
    (Z : Matrix t k 𝕜) :
    frobSq (Z * moorePenroseInverse ((S * Q)ᴴ)) ≤ frobSq Z / α
proof:
:= by
  let A := S * Q
  let C := moorePenroseInverse A * Zᴴ
  have hlower : α * frobSq C ≤ frobSq (A * C) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col, frobSq_eq_sum_norm_col, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
      simpa only [col_mul_eq_mulVec_col, A] using frame_lower h hQ (C.col j)
  have hP : specNorm (rangeProjector A) ≤ 1 :=
    (rangeProjector_isHermitian A).specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
      (rangeProjector_isIdempotentElem A)
  have hcon : frobSq (A * C) ≤ frobSq Z := by
    calc
      frobSq (A * C) = frobSq (rangeProjector A * Zᴴ) := by
        change frobSq (A * (moorePenroseInverse A * Zᴴ)) =
          frobSq ((A * moorePenroseInverse A) * Zᴴ)
        exact congrArg frobSq (Matrix.mul_assoc A (moorePenroseInverse A) Zᴴ).symm
      _ ≤ specNorm (rangeProjector A) ^ 2 * frobSq Zᴴ :=
        frobSq_mul_le_specNorm_sq_mul_frobSq _ _
      _ ≤ 1 ^ 2 * frobSq Zᴴ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (specNorm_nonneg _) hP 2) (frobSq_nonneg _)
      _ = frobSq Z := by rw [one_pow, one_mul, frobSq_conjTranspose]
  have he : frobSq C = frobSq (Z * moorePenroseInverse ((S * Q)ᴴ)) := by
    rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (Z * moorePenroseInverse ((S * Q)ᴴ)),
      Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, ← moorePenroseInverse_conjTranspose,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  rw [he] at hlower
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hα).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hlower.trans hcon)

name: NLAlib.lintegral_ofReal_sq_sub_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_ofReal_sq_sub_le {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {X Y : α → ℝ} (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hXa : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ 2))
    (hYb : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ 2)) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((a + b) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hzero : ∀ {Z : α → ℝ}, Measurable Z →
      ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Z ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (0 ^ 2) → Z =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
    intro Z hZ h
    rw [show ((0 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 0 by ring, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, nonpos_iff_eq_zero,
      lintegral_eq_zero_iff (hZ.pow_const 2).ennreal_ofReal] at h
    filter_upwards [h] with ω hω
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at hω ⊢
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Z ω)]
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with ha0 | hapos
  · subst ha0
    have hX0 := hzero hX hXa
    calc ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ∂μ = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hX0] with ω hω
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
          rw [hω]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [zero_add]; exact hYb
  rcases hb.eq_or_lt with hb0 | hbpos
  · subst hb0
    have hY0 := hzero hY hYb
    calc ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ∂μ = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hY0] with ω hω
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
          rw [hω]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [add_zero]; exact hXa
  
  set c₁ := 1 + b / a with hc₁
  set c₂ := 1 + a / b with hc₂
  have hc₁0 : 0 ≤ c₁ := by positivity
  have hc₂0 : 0 ≤ c₂ := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal c₁ * ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) +
        ENNReal.ofReal c₂ * ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) := by
    intro ω
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc₁0, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc₂0,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
    have key : c₁ * X ω ^ 2 + c₂ * Y ω ^ 2 - (X ω - Y ω) ^ 2 =
        (b * X ω + a * Y ω) ^ 2 / (a * b) := by
      rw [hc₁, hc₂]; field_simp; ring
    have : 0 ≤ (b * X ω + a * Y ω) ^ 2 / (a * b) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hmX : Measurable fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (hX.pow_const 2)
  have hmY : Measurable fun ω => ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (hY.pow_const 2)
  calc ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal ((X ω - Y ω) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (ENNReal.ofReal c₁ * ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) +
          ENNReal.ofReal c₂ * ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2)) ∂μ := lintegral_mono hpt
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c₁ * ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (X ω ^ 2) ∂μ +
          ENNReal.ofReal c₂ * ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Y ω ^ 2) ∂μ := by
        rw [lintegral_add_left (hmX.const_mul _), lintegral_const_mul _ hmX,
          lintegral_const_mul _ hmY]
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c₁ * ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ 2) + ENNReal.ofReal c₂ * ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ 2) :=
        by gcongr
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((a + b) ^ 2) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc₁0, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc₂0,
          ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        congr 1
        rw [hc₁, hc₂]; field_simp; ring

name: NLAlib.measurable_mulVec_dotProduct
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Measurable.mul ?_ ?_ <;>
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => (hS i j).mul measurable_const

name: NLAlib.sub_eq_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_of_polarization
statement:
theorem sub_eq_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_of_polarization (S : Matrix k n ℝ) (u v : n → ℝ) :
    ((S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v))) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v))) -
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v)) ⬝ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v))) -
      ((S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) -
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v)) ⬝ᵥ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v))) =
      (S *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ v) - u ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_sub, smul_dotProduct,
    dotProduct_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
    smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm v u, dotProduct_comm (S *ᵥ v) (S *ᵥ u)]
  ring

name: NLAlib.lintegral_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_sq_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_sq_le {S : Ωs → Matrix k n ℝ}
    (hS : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => S ω i j) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hmom : ∀ x : n → ℝ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2))
    (a b : n → ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ b) - a ⬝ᵥ b) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (a ⬝ᵥ a) * (b ⬝ᵥ b))
proof:
:= by
  have haa := dotProduct_self_nonneg a
  have hbb := dotProduct_self_nonneg b
  
  by_cases ha0 : a ⬝ᵥ a = 0
  · have : a = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp ha0
    subst this
    simp
  by_cases hb0 : b ⬝ᵥ b = 0
  · have : b = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hb0
    subst this
    simp
  have hapos : 0 < a ⬝ᵥ a := lt_of_le_of_ne haa (Ne.symm ha0)
  have hbpos : 0 < b ⬝ᵥ b := lt_of_le_of_ne hbb (Ne.symm hb0)
  set na := Real.sqrt (a ⬝ᵥ a) with hna
  set nb := Real.sqrt (b ⬝ᵥ b) with hnb
  have hna0 : 0 < na := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hapos
  have hnb0 : 0 < nb := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hbpos
  have hna2 : na ^ 2 = a ⬝ᵥ a := Real.sq_sqrt haa
  have hnb2 : nb ^ 2 = b ⬝ᵥ b := Real.sq_sqrt hbb
  set c := Real.sqrt (nb / na) with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hnb0 hna0)
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 = nb / na := Real.sq_sqrt (div_pos hnb0 hna0).le
  set u := c • a with hu
  set v := c⁻¹ • b with hv
  set p := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u + v) with hp
  set q := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (u - v) with hq
  set Z : (n → ℝ) → Ωs → ℝ := fun x ω => (S ω *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x with hZ
  have hZm : ∀ x, Measurable (Z x) := fun x =>
    (measurable_mulVec_dotProduct hS x x).sub measurable_const
  have hdiff : ∀ ω, Z p ω - Z q ω = (S ω *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ b) - a ⬝ᵥ b := by
    intro ω
    simp only [hZ, hp, hq]
    rw [sub_eq_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_of_polarization, hu, hv, Matrix.mulVec_smul,
      Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0.ne', one_mul, one_mul]
  have hpq : p ⬝ᵥ p + q ⬝ᵥ q = na * nb := by
    have huu : u ⬝ᵥ u = na * nb := by
      rw [hu, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← sq,
        hc2, ← hna2]
      field_simp
    have hvv : v ⬝ᵥ v = na * nb := by
      rw [hv, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
        ← sq, inv_pow, hc2, ← hnb2]
      field_simp
    simp only [hp, hq, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add,
      sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm v u]
    rw [huu, hvv]; ring
  have hp0 := dotProduct_self_nonneg p
  have hq0 := dotProduct_self_nonneg q
  have hmp : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Z p ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((ε * (p ⬝ᵥ p)) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow]; exact hmom p
  have hmq : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Z q ω ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((ε * (q ⬝ᵥ q)) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow]; exact hmom q
  have h := lintegral_ofReal_sq_sub_le (hZm p) (hZm q) (mul_nonneg hε hp0) (mul_nonneg hε hq0)
    hmp hmq
  simp only [hdiff] at h
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  rw [← mul_add, hpq, ← hna2, ← hnb2]
  ring

name: NLAlib.lintegral_frobSq_transpose_mul_sketch_sub_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_frobSq_transpose_mul_sketch_sub_le {d₁ d₂ : Type*} [Fintype d₁]
    [Fintype d₂] (S : Ωs → Matrix k n ℝ) (hS : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω => S ω i j) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hmom : ∀ x : n → ℝ, ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2))
    (A : Matrix n d₁ ℝ) (B : Matrix n d₂ ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq (Aᵀ * (S ω)ᵀ * S ω * B - Aᵀ * B)) ∂μ
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2 * frobSq A * frobSq B)
proof:
:= by
  have hentry : ∀ ω i j, (Aᵀ * (S ω)ᵀ * S ω * B - Aᵀ * B) i j =
      (S ω *ᵥ (fun l => A l i)) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ (fun l => B l j)) -
        (fun l => A l i) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => B l j) := by
    intro ω i j
    have h : Aᵀ * (S ω)ᵀ * S ω * B = (S ω * A)ᵀ * (S ω * B) := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, h]
    rfl
  have hfrob : ∀ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (frobSq (Aᵀ * (S ω)ᵀ * S ω * B - Aᵀ * B)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ (fun l => A l i)) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ (fun l => B l j)) -
        (fun l => A l i) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => B l j)) ^ 2) := by
    intro ω
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq]
    simp_rw [hentry ω]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _]
  have hm : ∀ i j, Measurable fun ω =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (((S ω *ᵥ (fun l => A l i)) ⬝ᵥ (S ω *ᵥ (fun l => B l j)) -
        (fun l => A l i) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => B l j)) ^ 2) := fun i j =>
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
      (((measurable_mulVec_dotProduct hS _ _).sub measurable_const).pow_const 2)
  simp_rw [hfrob]
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => hm i j]
  have hA : frobSq A = ∑ i, (fun l => A l i) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => A l i) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_comm]; simp [dotProduct, sq]
  have hB : frobSq B = ∑ j, (fun l => B l j) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => B l j) := by
    rw [frobSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_comm]; simp [dotProduct, sq]
  set a : d₁ → ℝ := fun i => (fun l => A l i) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => A l i) with ha
  set b : d₂ → ℝ := fun j => (fun l => B l j) ⬝ᵥ (fun l => B l j) with hb
  have ha0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i := fun i => dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hb0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b j := fun j => dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hsum : ε ^ 2 * frobSq A * frobSq B = ∑ i, ∑ j, ε ^ 2 * a i * b j := by
    rw [hA, hB, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  rw [hsum, ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) (ha0 i)) (hb0 j)]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => hm i j, ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun j _ =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ε) (ha0 i)) (hb0 j)]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => lintegral_mulVec_dotProduct_sub_sq_le hS hε hmom _ _

name: NLAlib.mul_frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_bounds
statement:
theorem mul_frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_bounds
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {P P₀ : Matrix m m 𝕜}
    {a b c γ : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hγ : 1 ≤ γ)
    (hlo : a * frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤ frobSq ((1 - P) * B) + c)
    (hhi : frobSq ((1 - P₀) * B) + c ≤ b * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A))
    (hopt : frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤ γ * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * B)) :
    a * frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤ γ * b * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi (zero_le_one.trans hγ)
  have h₃ := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ) hc
  nlinarith

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_preserving
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_preserving
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {family : Set (Matrix m m 𝕜)}
    {P P₀ : Matrix m m 𝕜} {ε c γ : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hγ : 1 ≤ γ) (hP : P ∈ family) (hP₀ : P₀ ∈ family)
    (hcost : ∀ Q ∈ family,
      (1 - ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A) ≤ frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ∧
        frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ≤ (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A))
    (hopt : ∀ Q ∈ family, frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤ γ * frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤
      (γ * (1 + ε) / (1 - ε)) * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_bounds hc hγ
    (hcost P hP).1 (hcost P₀ hP₀).2 (hopt P₀ hP₀)
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hε)).2
  nlinarith [h]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_one_sided_projection_cost_preserving
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_one_sided_projection_cost_preserving
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {family : Set (Matrix m m 𝕜)}
    {P P₀ : Matrix m m 𝕜} {ε c γ : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hγ : 1 ≤ γ)
    (hP : P ∈ family) (hP₀ : P₀ ∈ family)
    (hcost : ∀ Q ∈ family,
      frobSq ((1 - Q) * A) ≤ frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ∧
        frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ≤ (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A))
    (hopt : ∀ Q ∈ family, frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤ γ * frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤ γ * (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_bounds (a := 1) hc hγ
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using (hcost P hP).1)
    (hcost P₀ hP₀).2 (hopt P₀ hP₀)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_sketch_le_of_le_sInf
statement:
private theorem frobSq_sketch_le_of_le_sInf
    {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {family : Set (Matrix m m 𝕜)}
    {P : Matrix m m 𝕜} {γ : ℝ} (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hopt : frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤
      γ * sInf ((fun Q : Matrix m m 𝕜 => frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) '' family)) :
    ∀ Q ∈ family, frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤ γ * frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : BddBelow ((fun Q : Matrix m m 𝕜 => frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) '' family) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨Q, _, rfl⟩
    exact frobSq_nonneg _
  intro Q hQ
  exact hopt.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (csInf_le hb ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩) hγ)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_preserving_of_sInf
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_preserving_of_sInf
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {family : Set (Matrix m m 𝕜)}
    {P P₀ : Matrix m m 𝕜} {ε c γ : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hγ : 1 ≤ γ) (hP : P ∈ family) (hP₀ : P₀ ∈ family)
    (hcost : ∀ Q ∈ family,
      (1 - ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A) ≤ frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ∧
        frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ≤ (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A))
    (hopt : frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤
      γ * sInf ((fun Q : Matrix m m 𝕜 => frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) '' family)) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤
      (γ * (1 + ε) / (1 - ε)) * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A)
proof:
:=
  frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_projection_cost_preserving hc hε hγ hP hP₀ hcost
    (frobSq_sketch_le_of_le_sInf (zero_le_one.trans hγ) hopt)

name: NLAlib.frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_one_sided_projection_cost_preserving_of_sInf
statement:
theorem frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_one_sided_projection_cost_preserving_of_sInf
    {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜} {family : Set (Matrix m m 𝕜)}
    {P P₀ : Matrix m m 𝕜} {ε c γ : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hγ : 1 ≤ γ)
    (hP : P ∈ family) (hP₀ : P₀ ∈ family)
    (hcost : ∀ Q ∈ family,
      frobSq ((1 - Q) * A) ≤ frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ∧
        frobSq ((1 - Q) * B) + c ≤ (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - Q) * A))
    (hopt : frobSq ((1 - P) * B) ≤
      γ * sInf ((fun Q : Matrix m m 𝕜 => frobSq ((1 - Q) * B)) '' family)) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * A) ≤ γ * (1 + ε) * frobSq ((1 - P₀) * A)
proof:
:=
  frobSq_one_sub_mul_le_of_one_sided_projection_cost_preserving hc hγ hP hP₀ hcost
    (frobSq_sketch_le_of_le_sInf (zero_le_one.trans hγ) hopt)

name: NLAlib.isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_iff_of_gram_eq
statement:
theorem isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_iff_of_gram_eq
    {p : Type*} [Fintype p] {A : Matrix m n 𝕜} {B : Matrix m l 𝕜}
    {C : Matrix m p 𝕜} (h : B * Bᴴ = C * Cᴴ) {k : ℕ} {a b c : ℝ} :
    IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset A B k a b c ↔
      IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset A C k a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset,
    frobSq_mul_eq_of_mul_conjTranspose_eq h]

name: NLAlib.frobSq_projResidual_eq_frobSq_one_sub_mul
statement:
theorem frobSq_projResidual_eq_frobSq_one_sub_mul {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    (Q : Matrix m r 𝕜) (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    frobSq (projResidual Q A) = frobSq ((1 - Q * Qᴴ) * A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [residual_eq_one_sub_mul]

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.frobSq_leadingFactor_add_tail_eq
statement:
theorem IsSVD.frobSq_leadingFactor_add_tail_eq {p q : ℕ} {A : Matrix m n 𝕜}
    {U : Matrix m (Fin p) 𝕜} {V : Matrix n (Fin q) 𝕜} (h : IsSVD A U V) (ℓ : ℕ)
    {P : Matrix m m 𝕜} (hP : IsStarProjection P) :
    frobSq ((1 - P) * h.leadingFactor ℓ) + frobSq (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ) =
      frobSq ((1 - P) * A) + frobSq (P * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ))
proof:
:= by
  let T := A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ
  have hs : P.IsHermitian := hP.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hPT : frobSq (P * T) = RCLike.re (P * (T * Tᴴ)).trace := by
    rw [← frobSq_conjTranspose (P * T), Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hs.eq,
      frobSq_mul_projector_eq_re_trace_mul hs hP.isIdempotentElem Tᴴ,
      Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose]
  have hDef := frobSq_one_sub_mul_add_sub_eq hP A (h.leadingFactor ℓ) (frobSq T)
  rw [h.sub_leadingFactor_gram_eq_tail_gram ℓ,
    ← frobSq_eq_re_trace_mul_conjTranspose, ← hPT] at hDef
  linarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_leadingFactor_of_le
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨frobSq_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  intro P hP hRank
  have hs : P.IsHermitian := hP.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hp := hP.isIdempotentElem
  have hExact := h.frobSq_leadingFactor_add_tail_eq ℓ hP
  have hCapture := h.mul_frobSq_projector_tail_le_mul_bestRankFrobSq hℓp hkℓ hs hp hRank.le
  have hBest := bestRankFrobSq_le_frobSq_sub_of_rank_le A (P * A) k
    ((Matrix.rank_mul_le_left P A).trans hRank.le)
  rw [show A - P * A = (1 - P) * A by rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul]] at hBest
  have hTail0 : 0 ≤ bestRankFrobSq A k := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hScale hTail0
  have hεBest := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBest hε
  have hℓpos : (0 : ℝ) < ℓ := by exact_mod_cast hℓ
  have hProjected : frobSq (P * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)) ≤ ε * frobSq ((1 - P) * A) := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hℓpos).mp
    calc
      (ℓ : ℝ) * frobSq (P * (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)) ≤ (k : ℝ) * bestRankFrobSq A k := hCapture
      _ ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) * (ε * bestRankFrobSq A k) := by nlinarith [hMul]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hεBest hℓpos.le
  constructor
  · rw [one_mul, hExact]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (frobSq_nonneg _)
  · rw [hExact]
    nlinarith

name: NLAlib.IsSVD.isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_leadingFactor
proof:
:= min (Nat.ceil ((k : ℝ) / ε)) (min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n))
    IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset A (h.leadingFactor ℓ) k 1 (1 + ε)
      (frobSq (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ)) := by
  let M := min (Fintype.card m) (Fintype.card n)
  let ℓ := min (Nat.ceil ((k : ℝ) / ε)) M
  change IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset A (h.leadingFactor ℓ) k 1 (1 + ε)
    (frobSq (A - h.truncatedMatrix ℓ))
  have hceil := Nat.le_ceil ((k : ℝ) / ε)
  have hkDiv : (k : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) / ε := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hε0).mpr
    simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε1.le (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)
  have hkCeil : k ≤ Nat.ceil ((k : ℝ) / ε) := by exact_mod_cast hkDiv.trans hceil
  have hkℓ : k ≤ ℓ := Nat.le_min.mpr ⟨hkCeil, hkm⟩
  have hℓp : ℓ ≤ p := by
    have hm : M ≤ Fintype.card m := Nat.min_le_left _ _
    have hLM : ℓ ≤ M := Nat.min_le_right _ _
    have hh := hLM.trans hm
    simpa only [h.card_left] using hh
  by_cases hCap : ℓ = M
  · have hz := h.sub_truncatedMatrix_eq_zero_of_min_le (show M ≤ ℓ by omega)
    refine ⟨frobSq_nonneg _, ?_⟩
    intro P hP _
    have he := h.frobSq_leadingFactor_add_tail_eq ℓ hP
    rw [hz, Matrix.mul_zero, frobSq_zero, add_zero, add_zero] at he
    constructor
    · simpa only [hz, frobSq_zero, add_zero, one_mul] using he.ge
    · simp only [hz, frobSq_zero, add_zero, he]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε0.le (frobSq_nonneg ((1 - P) * A))]
  · have hLCeil : ℓ = Nat.ceil ((k : ℝ) / ε) := by dsimp only [ℓ]; omega
    have hScale : (k : ℝ) ≤ ε * ℓ := by
      rw [hLCeil]
      have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hε0).mp hceil
      nlinarith
    exact h.isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_leadingFactor_of_le hℓp
      (hk.trans_le hkℓ) hkℓ hε0.le hScale

name: NLAlib.isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_zero_rank
statement:
theorem isProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset_zero_rank (A : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    IsProjectionCostPreservingWithOffset A (0 : Matrix m (Fin 0) 𝕜) 0 1 1 (frobSq A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨frobSq_nonneg A, ?_⟩
  intro P _ hRank
  have hP : P = 0 := eq_zero_of_matrix_rank_eq_zero hRank
  simp [hP]

name: NLAlib.jl_distributional
statement:
theorem jl_distributional (k n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).real {G |
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x
        - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)}
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6))
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · refine prob_le_one.trans ?_
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, neg_zero, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero]
    norm_num
  by_cases hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x = 0
  · have hx : x = 0 := dotProduct_self_eq_zero.mp hx0
    subst hx
    simp
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hpos : 0 < x ⬝ᵥ x := lt_of_le_of_ne (dotProduct_self_star_nonneg x) (Ne.symm hx0)
  set r := Real.sqrt (x ⬝ᵥ x) with hr_def
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
  set u := r⁻¹ • x with hu_def
  have hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1 := by
    rw [hu_def, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← sq, inv_pow, hr_def, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0]
  have hxu : x = r • u := by rw [hu_def, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  
  have hid : ∀ G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ,
      ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x
        = (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * ∑ i, (G *ᵥ u) i ^ 2 := by
    intro G
