    have hsq : (1 / Real.sqrt k) ^ 2 = 1 / k := by
      rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hkpos.le, one_pow]
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = x ⬝ᵥ x := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
    conv_lhs => rw [hxu]
    rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← sq, mul_pow, hsq, hr2]
    simp only [dotProduct, ← sq]
    ring
  set f : (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ) → (Fin k → ℝ) := fun G => G *ᵥ u with hf_def
  have hf : Measurable f := by
    refine measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i => ?_
    simp only [hf_def, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    fun_prop
  set B₁ : Set (Fin k → ℝ) := {y | (1 + ε) * k ≤ ∑ i, y i ^ 2} with hB₁_def
  set B₂ : Set (Fin k → ℝ) := {y | ∑ i, y i ^ 2 ≤ (1 - ε) * k} with hB₂_def
  have hB₁ : MeasurableSet B₁ := measurableSet_le measurable_const (by fun_prop)
  have hB₂ : MeasurableSet B₂ := measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have hsub : {G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ |
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x
        - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)} ⊆ f ⁻¹' (B₁ ∪ B₂) := by
    intro G hG
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hid] at hG
    set s := ∑ i, (G *ᵥ u) i ^ 2 with hs_def
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, hB₁_def, hB₂_def, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hf_def,
      ← hs_def]
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    have habs : |s - k| < ε * k := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    have heq : (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * s - x ⬝ᵥ x = (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * (s - k) := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k)] at hG
    have : (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * |s - k| < (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * (ε * k) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left habs (by positivity)
    have h3 : (x ⬝ᵥ x) / k * (ε * k) = ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by field_simp
    linarith
  set c := ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6 with hc_def
  have hlaw := gaussianMatrix_map_mulVec_of_dotProduct_self_eq_one (k := k) u hu
  have h₁ : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) B₁
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * c)) := by
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
    refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (measureReal_le_sum_sq_le_gaussianVector hε0.le)).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_))
    have hlog := log_one_add_le_sub_sq_div_two_add_pow_three_div_three hε0.le
    have : (k : ℝ) / 2 * (2 * c) ≤ (k : ℝ) / 2 * (ε - Real.log (1 + ε)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [hc_def]; linarith) (by positivity)
    linarith
  have h₂ : (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) B₂
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * c)) := by
    rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
    refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (measureReal_sum_sq_le_one_sub_mul_le_gaussianVector hε0.le hε1)).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_))
    have hlog := log_one_sub_le_neg_sub_sq_div_two hε0.le hε1
    have hε3 : 0 ≤ ε ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hc : c ≤ ε ^ 2 / 4 := by rw [hc_def]; linarith
    have : (k : ℝ) / 2 * (ε + Real.log (1 - ε)) ≤ (k : ℝ) / 2 * (-(ε ^ 2 / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  calc _ ≤ gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n) (f ⁻¹' (B₁ ∪ B₂)) := measure_mono hsub
    _ = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) (B₁ ∪ B₂) := by
        rw [← Measure.map_apply hf (hB₁.union hB₂), hf_def, hlaw]
    _ ≤ (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) B₁
          + (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin k => gaussianReal 0 1) B₂ := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * c)) + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * c)) :=
        add_le_add h₁ h₂
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * c)) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le, two_mul]

name: NLAlib.jl_lemma
statement:
theorem jl_lemma (k n N : ℕ) (p : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).real {G | ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))}
      ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6))
proof:
:= by
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) ?_
  set b := 2 * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6)) with hb
  let bad : Fin N → Fin N → Set (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ) := fun i j => {G |
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))}
  have hsub : {G | ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))}
      ⊆ ⋃ i, ⋃ j, bad i j := by
    rintro G ⟨i, j, -, hG⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hG⟩⟩
  calc _ ≤ gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n) (⋃ i, ⋃ j, bad i j) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ i, gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n) (⋃ j, bad i j) := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, ∑ j : Fin N, gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n) (bad i j) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin N, ∑ _j : Fin N, ENNReal.ofReal b :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
          by rw [← ofReal_measureReal]
             exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (jl_distributional k n (p i - p j) hε0 hε1)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((N : ℝ) ^ 2 * b) := by
        have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hN, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (Nat.cast_nonneg N),
          ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
        simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, sq,
          mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hb, mul_assoc]

name: NLAlib.jl_distributional_of_hasLaw
statement:
theorem jl_distributional_of_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {k n : ℕ}
    {X : Ω → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ} (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)) μ)
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    μ.real {ω |
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • X ω) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • X ω) *ᵥ x
        - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x)}
      ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) * (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ =>
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x - x ⬝ᵥ x| := by
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    fun_prop
  rw [hX.measureReal_eq (p := fun G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ =>
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x ⬝ᵥ ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ x - x ⬝ᵥ x| > ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x))
    (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hc.measurable)]
  exact jl_distributional k n x hε0 hε1

name: NLAlib.sq_div_four_sub_pow_three_div_six_pos
statement:
theorem sq_div_four_sub_pow_three_div_six_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    0 < ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6
proof:
:= by
  have h : ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6 = ε ^ 2 * (3 - 2 * ε) / 12 := by ring
  rw [h]; have : 0 < ε ^ 2 := by positivity
  apply div_pos _ (by norm_num); nlinarith

name: NLAlib.sq_mul_two_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_of_inv_mul_log_le
statement:
theorem sq_mul_two_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_of_inv_mul_log_le {N : ℕ} {k c δ : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hk : c⁻¹ * Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ k) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 * Real.exp (-k * c) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · simp [hδ.le]
  have hA : 0 < 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ := by positivity
  have hlog : Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ k * c := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hc.le
    rwa [mul_comm c⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', mul_one] at this
  have hexp : Real.exp (-k * c) ≤ δ / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    calc Real.exp (-k * c) ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ)) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.2; linarith
      _ = δ / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hA, inv_div]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (N : ℝ) ^ 2 * 2 * Real.exp (-k * c) = (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (-k * c) := by ring
    _ ≤ (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * (δ / (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by gcongr
    _ = δ := by field_simp

name: NLAlib.jl_lemma_prob_le_of_log_le
statement:
theorem jl_lemma_prob_le_of_log_le (k n N : ℕ) (p : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε)
    (hε1 : ε < 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hk : (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6)⁻¹ * Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ) ≤ k) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).real {G | ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))}
      ≤ δ
proof:
:=
  (jl_lemma k n N p hε0 hε1).trans <|
    sq_mul_two_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_of_inv_mul_log_le
      (sq_div_four_sub_pow_three_div_six_pos hε0 hε1) hδ hk

name: NLAlib.jl_lemma_prob_le_half
statement:
theorem jl_lemma_prob_le_half (k n N : ℕ) (p : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε)
    (hε1 : ε < 1) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hk : 48 * Real.log N / ε ^ 2 ≤ k) :
    (gaussianMatrix (Fin k) (Fin n)).real {G | ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))}
      ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply jl_lemma_prob_le_of_log_le k n N p hε0 hε1 (by norm_num)
  have hc := sq_div_four_sub_pow_three_div_six_pos hε0 hε1
  have hε2 : 0 < ε ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hN' : (2 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlogN : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log N := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hN'
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  
  have hL : Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (1 / 2)) ≤ 4 * Real.log N := by
    have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by linarith
    have : 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (1 / 2) = 2 * 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this, Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num), Real.log_pow]
    push_cast; linarith
  
  have hci : (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6)⁻¹ ≤ 12 / ε ^ 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hc (by positivity), inv_div]
    have : ε ^ 3 = ε ^ 2 * ε := by ring
    rw [this]
    nlinarith [mul_pos hε2 (sub_pos.2 hε1)]
  have hlogN0 : 0 ≤ Real.log N := hlog2.le.trans hlogN
  calc (ε ^ 2 / 4 - ε ^ 3 / 6)⁻¹ * Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (1 / 2))
      ≤ (12 / ε ^ 2) * (4 * Real.log N) := by
        apply mul_le_mul hci hL _ (by positivity)
        apply Real.log_nonneg
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
    _ = 48 * Real.log N / ε ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ k := hk

name: NLAlib.jl_lemma_exists
statement:
theorem jl_lemma_exists (k n N : ℕ) (p : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin n) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε)
    (hε1 : ε < 1) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hk : 48 * Real.log N / ε ^ 2 ≤ k) :
    ∃ S : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ, ∀ i j,
      (1 - ε) * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)) ≤ S *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ S *ᵥ (p i - p j) ∧
      S *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ S *ᵥ (p i - p j) ≤ (1 + ε) * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hall : {G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin n) ℝ | ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧
      |((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
        - (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)| > ε * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j))} = Set.univ := by
    refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun G => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hcon ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G)
    refine ⟨i, j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl
      simp at hij
    · rw [gt_iff_lt, lt_abs]
      by_cases h : (1 - ε) * ((p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ (p i - p j)) ≤
          ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j) ⬝ᵥ
            ((1 / Real.sqrt k) • G) *ᵥ (p i - p j)
      · left; have := hij h; linarith
      · right; push Not at h; linarith
  have h := jl_lemma_prob_le_half k n N p hε0 hε1 hN hk
  rw [hall, probReal_univ] at h
  norm_num at h

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq_fin
statement:
private theorem specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq_fin {m n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    specNorm (Aᵀ * A - 1) ≤ ε ↔
      ∀ j : Fin n, 1 - ε ≤ singularValues A j ^ 2 ∧ singularValues A j ^ 2 ≤ 1 + ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [specNorm_gram_sub_one_eq_norm_singularValues_sq_sub_one,
    pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hε]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro j
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨hlo, hup⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: NLAlib.transpose_mul_self_sub_one_reindex
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_self_sub_one_reindex {q : Type*} [Fintype q] [DecidableEq q]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (em : m ≃ p) (en : n ≃ q) :
    (A.reindex em en)ᵀ * (A.reindex em en) - 1 = (Aᵀ * A - 1).reindex en en
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
  change (Aᵀ * A).submatrix en.symm en.symm - 1 =
    (Aᵀ * A).submatrix en.symm en.symm - (1 : Matrix n n ℝ).submatrix en.symm en.symm
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]

name: NLAlib.specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq
statement:
theorem specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq (A : Matrix m n ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    specNorm (Aᵀ * A - 1) ≤ ε ↔ ∀ j : Fin (Fintype.card n),
      1 - ε ≤ singularValues A j ^ 2 ∧ singularValues A j ^ 2 ≤ 1 + ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq_fin
    (A.reindex (Fintype.equivFin m) (Fintype.equivFin n)) hε
  rwa [transpose_mul_self_sub_one_reindex, specNorm_reindex, singularValues_reindex] at h

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_singularValues
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_singularValues
    {S : Matrix p m ℝ} {U : Matrix m n ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε ↔ ∀ j : Fin (Fintype.card n),
      Real.sqrt (1 - ε) ≤ singularValues (S * U) j ∧
        singularValues (S * U) j ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU hε,
    specNorm_gram_sub_one_le_iff_singularValues_sq (S * U) hε]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro j
  have hlo0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ε := by linarith
  have hup0 : 0 ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hlo := Real.sq_sqrt hlo0
  have hup := Real.sq_sqrt hup0
  have hs := singularValues_nonneg (S * U) j
  have hls := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - ε)
  have hus := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 + ε)
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le_of_isSubspaceEmbedding
statement:
theorem specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le_of_isSubspaceEmbedding
    {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {U : Matrix m d ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε) :
    specNorm ((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hGram : (((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ).IsHermitian := by
    have hG := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self (S * U)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hG
    exact hG.sub Matrix.isHermitian_one
  apply (specNorm_le_iff_abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le _ hGram ε hε).2
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hlo, hup⟩ := (isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU).1 h x
  have hq : x ⬝ᵥ ((((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) : Matrix d d ℝ) *ᵥ x) =
      ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    have hM := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self (S * U) x
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hM
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, ← hM, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hq, abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le
    {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {U : Matrix m d ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε ↔ specNorm ((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le_of_isSubspaceEmbedding hU hε,
    isSubspaceEmbedding_of_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU⟩

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols [DecidableEq d] {S : Matrix k m ℝ}
    {U : Matrix m d ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) {ε : ℝ} :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε ↔ ∀ x : d → ℝ,
      (1 - ε) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ∧
      ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ≤ (1 + ε) * (x ⬝ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hUx : ∀ x, (U *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ x := fun x => by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU x
  unfold IsSubspaceEmbedding
  simp only [hUx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.mul_right
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.mul_right {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {U : Matrix m d ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε) (C : Matrix d e ℝ) : IsSubspaceEmbedding S (U * C) ε
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simpa only [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using h (C *ᵥ x)

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.of_mul_right
proof:
:= by
  have := h.mul_right D
  rwa [Matrix.mul_assoc, hCD, Matrix.mul_one] at this

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_mul_right_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.of_mul_right (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv C hC), fun h => h.mul_right C⟩

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.mono
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.mono {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {U : Matrix m d ℝ} {ε ε' : ℝ}
    (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε) (hεε' : ε ≤ ε') : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε'
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hn : 0 ≤ (U *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (U *ᵥ x) := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h x
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_of_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU]
  intro x
  have hb := abs_dotProduct_mulVec_le_specNorm ((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) x
  have hq : x ⬝ᵥ (((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) *ᵥ x) =
      ((S * U) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((S * U) *ᵥ x) - x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    have h := star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self (S * U) x
    simp only [star_trivial, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, ← h, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  rw [hq] at hb
  have hn : 0 ≤ x ⬝ᵥ x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg (x i)
  have hε : specNorm ((S * U)ᵀ * (S * U) - 1) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ ε * (x ⬝ᵥ x) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hn
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := abs_le.mp (hb.trans hε)
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: NLAlib.isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_iff
statement:
theorem isSubspaceEmbedding_reindex_iff
    {ρ ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {S : Matrix p m ℝ} {U : Matrix m n ℝ} (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U)
    (ep : p ≃ ρ) (em : m ≃ ι) (en : n ≃ κ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    IsSubspaceEmbedding (S.reindex ep em) (U.reindex em en) ε ↔
      IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le
      (hU.reindex em en) hε,
    isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_specNorm_transpose_mul_self_sub_one_le hU hε]
  have hprod : S.reindex ep em * U.reindex em en = (S * U).reindex ep en := by
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv]
  rw [hprod, transpose_mul_self_sub_one_reindex, specNorm_reindex]

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.card_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.card_le {m n r : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {S : Matrix m n ℝ} {U : Matrix n r ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S U ε) (hU : HasOrthonormalCols U) (hε : ε < 1) :
    Fintype.card r ≤ Fintype.card m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrank : (S * U).rank = Fintype.card r := by
    apply (rank_eq_card_iff_forall_mulVec_eq_zero (S * U)).2
    intro x hx
    have hlo := ((isSubspaceEmbedding_iff_of_hasOrthonormalCols hU).1 h x).1
    rw [hx, dotProduct_zero] at hlo
    have hq : x ⬝ᵥ x ≤ 0 := by
      have hp : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
      nlinarith
    exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 (le_antisymm hq (dotProduct_self_nonneg _))
  rw [← hrank]
  exact Matrix.rank_le_card_height _

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_le
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_le
    {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {A : Matrix m d ℝ} {M : Matrix d e ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S A ε) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1)
    (hM : HasOrthonormalCols (S * A * M)) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (A * M) ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 + ε) / (1 - ε))
proof:
:= by
  let B := A * M
  have hSB : HasOrthonormalCols (S * B) := by
    simpa only [B, Matrix.mul_assoc] using hM
  have hB := h.mul_right M
  change IsSubspaceEmbedding S B ε at hB
  have hcoords (x : e → ℝ) :
      (1 - ε) * ((B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ x ∧
        x ⬝ᵥ x ≤ (1 + ε) * ((B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) := by
    have hx : (S *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) ⬝ᵥ (S *ᵥ (B *ᵥ x)) = x ⬝ᵥ x := by
      simpa only [star_trivial, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] using
        star_mulVec_dotProduct_mulVec_self_of_hasOrthonormalCols hSB x
    simpa only [hx] using hB x
  have ha : 0 < 1 - ε := sub_pos.mpr hε1
  have hb : 0 ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hnorm : specNorm B ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / (1 - ε)) := by
    apply specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    intro x
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / (1 - ε))]
    calc
      (B *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ (B *ᵥ x) ≤ (x ⬝ᵥ x) / (1 - ε) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ ha).2 (by nlinarith [(hcoords x).1])
      _ = 1 / (1 - ε) * (x ⬝ᵥ x) := by ring
  have hP : specNorm (B * moorePenroseInverse B) ≤ 1 :=
    (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isHermitian B).specNorm_le_one_of_isIdempotentElem
      (mul_moorePenroseInverse_isIdempotentElem B)
  have hPv (x : m → ℝ) :
      ((B * moorePenroseInverse B) *ᵥ x) ⬝ᵥ ((B * moorePenroseInverse B) *ᵥ x) ≤
        x ⬝ᵥ x := by
    have hp := sum_sq_mulVec_le_specNorm_sq (B * moorePenroseInverse B) x
    have hp2 : specNorm (B * moorePenroseInverse B) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [specNorm_nonneg (B * moorePenroseInverse B)]
    have hx := dotProduct_self_nonneg x
    simp only [dotProduct, ← pow_two] at hp hx ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hpinv : specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ε) := by
    apply specNorm_le_of_mulVec_sq_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    intro x
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hb]
    have hx := (hcoords (moorePenroseInverse B *ᵥ x)).2
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec] at hx
    exact hx.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hPv x) hb)
  change specNorm B * specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B) ≤ _
  calc
    specNorm B * specNorm (moorePenroseInverse B) ≤
        Real.sqrt (1 / (1 - ε)) * Real.sqrt (1 + ε) :=
      mul_le_mul hnorm hpinv (specNorm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.sqrt ((1 + ε) / (1 - ε)) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / (1 - ε))]
      congr 1
      ring

name: NLAlib.IsSubspaceEmbedding.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_inv_le_of_isQR
statement:
theorem IsSubspaceEmbedding.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_inv_le_of_isQR
    [LinearOrder d] {S : Matrix k m ℝ} {A : Matrix m d ℝ} {Q : Matrix k d ℝ}
    {R : Matrix d d ℝ} {ε : ℝ} (h : IsSubspaceEmbedding S A ε)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hQR : IsQR (S * A) Q R) (hR : IsUnit R) :
    moorePenroseConditionNumber (A * R⁻¹) ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 + ε) / (1 - ε))
proof:
:= by
  apply h.moorePenroseConditionNumber_mul_le hε hε1
  have hQ : S * A * R⁻¹ = Q := by
    rw [hQR.eq, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hR), Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [hQ]
  exact hQR.orth

theorem IsIrreducible.perron_power_limit_and_rate
    {A : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hA : A.IsIrreducible) (hAne : A ≠ 0)
    {p q : ι → ℝ} (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i)
    (hAp : A *ᵥ p = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • p)
    (hqA : q ᵥ* A = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal • q)
    (hperipheral : ∀ μ ∈ spectrum ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal),
      ‖μ‖ = (spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal →
        μ = ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal : ℂ)) :
    let T
:= ((spectralRadius ℂ (A.map Complex.ofReal)).toReal)⁻¹ • A
    let P := (q ⬝ᵥ p)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec p q
    Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => T ^ k) atTop (𝓝 P) ∧
      ∀ θ : ℝ, (spectralRadius ℂ ((T - P).map Complex.ofReal)).toReal < θ → θ < 1 →

theorem exists_complex_cs_decomposition_of_embedding {p q : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq p] [DecidableEq q]
    (U : Matrix (p ⊕ q) (p ⊕ q) ℂ) (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (e : p ↪ q) :
    let c
:= fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
    (∀ i, c i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ∃ V₁ W₁ : Matrix p p ℂ, ∃ V₂ W₂ : Matrix q q ℂ,
      V₁ᴴ * V₁ = 1 ∧ W₁ᴴ * W₁ = 1 ∧ V₂ᴴ * V₂ = 1 ∧ W₂ᴴ * W₂ = 1 ∧
      (Matrix.fromBlocks V₁ 0 0 V₂)ᴴ * U * Matrix.fromBlocks W₁ 0 0 W₂ =
        (csCanonicalMatrix c ((1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e)).map Complex.ofRealHom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let c := fun i : p => singularValues U.toBlocks₁₁ ((Fintype.equivFin p) i)
  let C : Matrix p p ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (c i : ℂ))
  let S : Matrix p p ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (Real.sqrt (1 - c i ^ 2) : ℂ))
  let E₀ := (1 : Matrix q q ℝ).submatrix id e
  let E := E₀.map Complex.ofRealHom
  have hE₀ : HasOrthonormalCols E₀ := by
    have h : HasOrthonormalCols (1 : Matrix q q ℝ) := by simp [HasOrthonormalCols]
    exact h.submatrix_cols e
  have hE : Eᴴ * E = 1 := by
    rw [show Eᴴ = E₀ᵀ.map Complex.ofRealHom from by ext; simp [E],
      ← Matrix.map_mul (f := Complex.ofRealHom) (L := E₀ᵀ) (M := E₀), (show E₀ᵀ * E₀ = 1 from hE₀)]
    simp
  obtain ⟨V₀, W₀, hSVD⟩ := exists_isSVD U.toBlocks₁₁
  let ep := Fintype.equivFin p
  let V : Matrix p p ℂ := V₀.submatrix id ep
  let W : Matrix p p ℂ := W₀.submatrix id ep

    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, h.mul_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,

    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ) (xs : n → ℝ)
    (hxs : IsLeastSquaresSolution A b xs) {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ)
    (hσ : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      σ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) (N : ℕ) :
    let q
:= 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
    let V := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2 / σ ^ 2
    (∑ ω : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (runSumError A b xs N ω x)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      tailInitialWeight q N * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2 +
        (((1 + q) / (1 - q)) * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V
proof:
:= by
  have hσnorm := hσ
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hσ ⊢
  let q := 1 - σ ^ 2 / frobSq A
  let V := ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / σ ^ 2
  let C := (1 + q) / (1 - q)
  change _ ≤ tailInitialWeight q N * _ + (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A σ hσ
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    have hp : 0 < σ ^ 2 / frobSq A := div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hσ0) hF
    linarith
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := div_nonneg (dotProduct_self_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg σ)
  have hnoise : (1 - q) * V = ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) / frobSq A := by
    dsimp [q, V]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hσ0, ne_of_gt hF]
    ring
  induction N generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    let E := (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
    let G := ∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, q ^ (t + 1)
    have hmean : (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (∑ ω : Fin (N + 1) → m,
        (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) • runSumError A b xs (N + 1) ω x) ≤ (1 + G) * E := by
      rw [sum_paths_smul_runSumError_eq_sum_pow_mulVec A hA b xs hxs x (N + 1),
        dotProduct_sum]
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), q ^ t * E := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro t _
          exact (le_abs_self _).trans
            (by simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using
              abs_dotProduct_pow_meanError_mulVec_le_of_mem_range A hA σ hσnorm _ hx t)
        _ = (1 + G) * E := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_range_succ']
          simp only [pow_zero]
          dsimp [G]
          ring
    have hstep : (∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) ≤
        q * E + (1 - q) * V := by
      rw [hnoise]
      exact expected_sqErr_step_le_add_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x σ hσ hx
    have hfuture :
        (∑ i, prob A i * (∑ ω : Fin N → m, (∏ j, prob A (ω j)) *
          (runSumError A b xs N ω (step A b x i) ⬝ᵥ
            runSumError A b xs N ω (step A b x i)))) ≤
        tailInitialWeight q N * (q * E + (1 - q) * V) +
          (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ i, prob A i *
            (tailInitialWeight q N * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs)) +
              (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (ih _ (step_sub_mem_range_of_sub_mem_range A b xs x hx i)) (prob_nonneg A i)
        _ = tailInitialWeight q N *
            (∑ i, prob A i * ((step A b x i - xs) ⬝ᵥ (step A b x i - xs))) +
              (C * N - tailInitialWeight q N) * V := by
          simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, sum_prob A hA,
            one_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep (tailInitialWeight_nonneg hq0 N)) le_rfl
    have hrec := sum_paths_norm_runSumError_sq_succ A hA b xs x N
    simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hrec
    rw [hrec]
    have hc : 1 + 2 * G ≤ C := one_add_two_mul_sum_pow_succ_le hq0 hq1 N
    have ht : tailInitialWeight q (N + 1) = 1 + 2 * G + q * tailInitialWeight q N :=
      tailInitialWeight_succ q N
    rw [ht]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hcv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hV
    change -E + 2 * _ + _ ≤ _
    nlinarith only [hmean, hfuture, hcv]

theorem integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_sq_le
    [MeasurableSpace m] [MeasurableSingletonClass m]
    (A : Matrix m n ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (b : m → ℝ)
    (x : n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin)
    (burn N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let xs
:= moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
    let κ := frobConditionNumber A
    let q := 1 - 1 / κ ^ 2
    let V := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 *
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (b - A *ᵥ xs)‖ ^ 2
    let E := ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (x - xs)‖ ^ 2
    let M := ∫ ω, ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (tailAverage A b x burn N ω - xs)‖ ^ 2
      ∂((kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA burn).toMeasure.prod
        (kaczmarzRowPathPMF A hA N).toMeasure)
    M ≤ q ^ burn * E + (2 * κ ^ 2 - 1) * V / N ∧
      M ≤ (2 * κ ^ 2 - 1) / N * (κ ^ 2 * q ^ burn / N * E + V)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self]
  let xs := moorePenroseInverse A *ᵥ b
  let κ := frobConditionNumber A
  let q := 1 - 1 / κ ^ 2
  let V := specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) ^ 2 * ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs))
  let E := (x - xs) ⬝ᵥ (x - xs)
  let C := 2 * κ ^ 2 - 1
  have hM : 0 < specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A) := by
    rw [specNorm_eq_norm]
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr ((moorePenroseInverse_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA)
  have hF : 0 < frobSq A := lt_of_le_of_ne (frobSq_nonneg A)
    (Ne.symm ((frobSq_eq_zero_iff A).not.mpr hA))
  have hκ : 0 < κ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [κ, frobConditionNumber]
    rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq]
    exact mul_pos hF (sq_pos_of_pos hM)
  have hκne : κ ≠ 0 := fun h => by simp [h] at hκ
  have hr : 1 - (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 / frobSq A = q := by
    dsimp [q, κ, frobConditionNumber]
    rw [mul_pow, frobNorm_sq]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, inv_pow]
  have hs := fun v (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin) =>
    inv_specNorm_moorePenroseInverse_sq_mul_dotProduct_le A hv
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := hr ▸ rate_nonneg_of_lower_bound_on_range A _ hs
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by dsimp [q]; linarith [one_div_pos.mpr hκ]
  have hC : (1 + q) / (1 - q) = C := by
    dsimp [q, C]
    field_simp [hκne]
    ring
  have hV : ((b - A *ᵥ xs) ⬝ᵥ (b - A *ᵥ xs)) /
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 = V := by
    dsimp [V]
    rw [inv_pow, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have he : x - xs ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin :=
    Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (moorePenroseInverse_mulVec_mem_range_transpose A b)
  have hsNorm : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range Aᵀ.mulVecLin,
      (specNorm (moorePenroseInverse A))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (A *ᵥ v)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] using hs
  have hb := integral_norm_tailAverage_sub_sq_le A hA b xs
    (isLeastSquaresSolution_moorePenroseInverse_mulVec A b) (inv_pos.mpr hM) hsNorm
    x he burn N hN
  dsimp only at hb
  simp only [norm_toLp_sq_eq_dotProduct_self] at hb
  rw [hr, hC, hV] at hb
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := dotProduct_self_nonneg _
  have hqE : 0 ≤ q ^ burn * E := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq0 burn) hE
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hw1 : tailInitialWeight q N / (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hNpos)]
    exact tailInitialWeight_le_sq hq0 hq1.le N
  have hw2 : tailInitialWeight q N ≤ C * κ ^ 2 := by
    have hw := tailInitialWeight_le_div hq0 hq1 N
    rw [hC] at hw
    have hd : C / (1 - q) = C * κ ^ 2 := by
      have hden : 1 - q = 1 / κ ^ 2 := by dsimp [q]; ring
      simp only [hden, one_div, div_inv_eq_mul]
    rwa [hd] at hw
  constructor
  · refine hb.trans ?_
    change (tailInitialWeight q N / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * q ^ burn * E + C * V / N ≤
      q ^ burn * E + C * V / N
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw1 hqE
    nlinarith only [ht]
  · refine hb.trans ?_
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw2 (sq_nonneg (N : ℝ))) hqE
    calc
      _ ≤ (C * κ ^ 2 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) * (q ^ burn * E) + C * V / N := by
        nlinarith only [ht]
      _ = C / N * (κ ^ 2 * q ^ burn / N * E + V) := by
        field_simp

theorem integrable_and_integral_fderiv_sub_sub_smul_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (A : M) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (a : ℝ)
    (x D V : Ω → E) (hxm : AEMeasurable x μ) (hDm : AEMeasurable D μ)
    (hVm : AEMeasurable V μ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hBound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (L (D ω)) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (L (V ω)) ≤ r) :
    let Φ : E → ℂ
:= fun y => normalizedTrace
      (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
    Integrable (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω]) μ ∧
      (∫ ω, (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω] ∂μ) =
        a ^ 2 • ∫ ω, resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let Φ : E → ℂ := fun y => normalizedTrace
    (resolvent (A + L y) ζ ^ p * resolvent (A + L y) (star ζ) ^ p)
  let C : ℝ := 2 * ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
    ((2 * p + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (|ζ.im|⁻¹) ^ (2 * p + 3) * r ^ 3
  have hKm : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ := by
    have hc := (continuous_resolventMomentTaylorKernel A hA ζ hζ p a).measurable
    have h := hc.comp_aemeasurable (hxm.prodMk (hDm.prodMk hVm))
    exact h.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hKb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      ‖resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [hBound] with ω hω
    apply norm_resolventMomentTaylorKernel_le A hA ζ hζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) hr
    · simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω.1
    · simpa only [specNorm_eq_norm] using hω.2
  have hKi : Integrable
      (fun ω => resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω)) μ :=
    (integrable_const C).mono' hKm hKb
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      (fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω + a • D ω) - fderiv ℝ Φ (x ω)) (D ω) -
        a • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Φ (x ω - a • V ω) ![D ω, D ω] =
      a ^ 2 • resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) :=
    fderiv_sub_sub_smul_iteratedFDeriv_two_normalizedTrace_mixed_eq_kernel
      A hA ζ hζ p (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) a
  refine ⟨hKi, (hKi.smul (a ^ 2)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hpoint ω).symm), ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, a ^ 2 • resolventMomentTaylorKernel A ζ p a (x ω) (D ω) (V ω) ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpoint)
    _ = _ := integral_smul _ _

theorem integrable_and_specNorm_card_smul_integral_resolventCubicRemainder_le
    (ν : ι → Measure E) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ν i)]
    (γ : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ] (L : E →L[ℝ] M)
    (A : C × Z → M)
    (hAm : AEMeasurable A ((Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ))
    (hAH : ∀ᵐ q ∂(Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ, (A q).IsHermitian)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hHerm : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, (L x).IsHermitian)
    (hBound : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ν i, specNorm (L x) ≤ R)
    (a : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : ζ.im ≠ 0) :
    let P
:= (Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1).prod γ
    let Q := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
    let D := fun (q : C × Z) i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1))
    let F := fun (q : C × Z) i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 2))
    let T := fun (q : C × Z) i => resolventCubicRemainder (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a ζ
    Integrable (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => T (q.1.2, q.2) q.1.1) Q ∧
      (∀ i, Integrable (fun q : C × Z => T q i) P) ∧
      specNorm ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) •
        (∫ q : (ι × C) × Z, T (q.1.2, q.2) q.1.1 ∂Q)) ≤
        (96 * R * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 4 + 288 * a ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * |ζ.im|⁻¹ ^ 6) *
          ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let P₀ := Measure.pi fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1
  let P := P₀.prod γ
  let Q := (resamplingTripleMeasure ν).prod γ
  let drop : (ι × C) × Z → C × Z := fun q => (q.1.2, q.2)
  let D : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 1))
  let F : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => L (q.1 (i, 0) - q.1 (i, 2))
  let T : (C × Z) → ι → M := fun q i => resolventCubicRemainder (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a ζ
  let m : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → (C × Z) → ℝ := fun s t q =>
    specNorm (∑ i, (L (q.1 (i, s) - q.1 (i, t))) ^ 2)
  let σ : ℝ := ∫ x : ι → E, specNorm (∑ i, (L (x i)) ^ 2) ∂Measure.pi ν
  let r : ℝ := 2 * R
  let c : ℝ := |ζ.im|⁻¹
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)
  have hdrop : MeasurePreserving drop Q P := by
    exact (measurePreserving_snd (μ := (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure) (ν := P)).comp
      (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (PMF.uniformOfFintype ι).toMeasure P₀ γ)
  have hAll : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, ∀ i, ∀ s : Fin 3,
      (L (q.1 (i, s))).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (L (q.1 (i, s))) ≤ R := by
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro i
    rw [ae_all_iff]
    intro s
    have hl := (measurePreserving_eval (fun k : ι × Fin 3 => ν k.1) (i, s)).hasLaw.comp
      (measurePreserving_fst (μ := P₀) (ν := γ)).hasLaw
    apply ae_of_ae_map (p := fun x : E => (L x).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (L x) ≤ R) hl.aemeasurable
    rw [hl.map_eq]
    filter_upwards [hHerm i, hBound i] with x hH hB
    exact ⟨hH, hB⟩
  have hE (q : C × Z) (i : ι) : F q i - D q i = L (q.1 (i, 1) - q.1 (i, 2)) := by
    simp only [F, D, map_sub]
    abel
  have hGood : ∀ᵐ q ∂P, (A q).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D q i).IsHermitian ∧ (F q i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D q i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F q i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F q i - D q i) ≤ r := by
    filter_upwards [hAH, hAll] with q hA hq
    refine ⟨hA, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hsub (s t : Fin 3) : specNorm (L (q.1 (i, s) - q.1 (i, t))) ≤ r := by
      rw [map_sub]
      exact (specNorm_sub_le _ _).trans (by dsimp [r]; linarith [(hq i s).2, (hq i t).2])
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hsub 0 1, hsub 0 2, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [D]; rw [map_sub]; exact (hq i 0).1.sub (hq i 1).1
    · dsimp [F]; rw [map_sub]; exact (hq i 0).1.sub (hq i 2).1
    · rw [hE]; exact hsub 1 2
  have hLmeas (i : ι) (s : Fin 3) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => L (q.1 (i, s))) :=
    L.continuous.measurable.comp ((measurable_pi_apply (i, s)).comp measurable_fst)
  have hDmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => D q i) := by
    simpa only [D, map_sub] using (hLmeas i 0).fun_sub (hLmeas i 1)
  have hFmeas (i : ι) : Measurable (fun q : C × Z => F q i) := by
    simpa only [F, map_sub] using (hLmeas i 0).fun_sub (hLmeas i 2)
  have hTi (i : ι) : Integrable (fun q : C × Z => T q i) P := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder A _ _ hAm (hDmeas i).aemeasurable
        (hFmeas i).aemeasurable a ζ).aestronglyMeasurable
      (12 * r ^ 3 * c ^ 4 + 9 * a ^ 2 * r ^ 5 * c ^ 6) ?_
    filter_upwards [hGood] with q hq
    exact specNorm_resolventCubicRemainder_le_uniform (A q) (D q i) (F q i) a r ζ hq.1
      (hq.2 i).1 (hq.2 i).2.1 hr (hq.2 i).2.2.1 (hq.2 i).2.2.2.1
      (hq.2 i).2.2.2.2 hζ
  have hDs : Measurable (fun p : ι × C => L (p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 1))) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    simpa only [map_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_def] using
      (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 0))).fun_sub
        (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 1)))
  have hFs : Measurable (fun p : ι × C => L (p.2 (p.1, 0) - p.2 (p.1, 2))) := by
    apply measurable_from_prod_countable_right
    intro i
    simpa only [map_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Function.comp_def] using
      (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 0))).fun_sub
        (L.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (i, 2)))
  have hGoodSel : ∀ᵐ q ∂Q, (A (drop q)).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D (drop q) i).IsHermitian ∧ (F (drop q) i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D (drop q) i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F (drop q) i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F (drop q) i - D (drop q) i) ≤ r := by
    exact ae_of_ae_map (p := fun q : C × Z => (A q).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ i,
      (D q i).IsHermitian ∧ (F q i).IsHermitian ∧ specNorm (D q i) ≤ r ∧
        specNorm (F q i) ≤ r ∧ specNorm (F q i - D q i) ≤ r)
      hdrop.measurable.aemeasurable (by rw [hdrop.map_eq]; exact hGood)
  have hAmpull : AEMeasurable (A ∘ drop) Q := by
    have hh : AEMeasurable A (Q.map drop) := by rwa [hdrop.map_eq]
    exact hh.comp_aemeasurable hdrop.measurable.aemeasurable
  have hTsel : Integrable (fun q : (ι × C) × Z => T (drop q) q.1.1) Q := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (aemeasurable_resolventCubicRemainder (A ∘ drop) _ _

    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k)) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L)
    (hVarianceBound : (∫ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ V) :
    let Y
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let v := specNorm V
    (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sqrt v + L / 3 ≤ t →
      μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
        4 * intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))
proof:
:= by
  intro Y v
  
  have hsecond : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ X id id measurable_id measurable_id
      hMeas hIndep hL2 hL2 hMean
    show (∫ ω, (∑ k, X k ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ
    simpa only [id, sq] using h
  refine ⟨hsecond, ?_⟩
  
  have hXint : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k => (hL2 k).integrable one_le_two
  have hYmeas : Measurable Y := Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun k _ => hMeas k)
  have hYHerm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (Y ω).IsHermitian := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hHerm] with ω h
    exact isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => h k)
  have hYint : Integrable Y μ := integrable_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXint k)
  have hS : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef]
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hH
    have : Y ω ^ 2 = Matrix.conjTranspose (Y ω) * Y ω := by rw [hH.eq, sq]
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, this]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).nonneg
  have hVS : (V - ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := hVarianceBound
  have hVpsd : V.PosSemidef := by simpa using hVS.add hS
  have hv : 0 < v := by
    show 0 < ‖V‖
    exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hV
  have hr : 0 ≤ intrinsicDimension V :=
    div_nonneg (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp hVpsd.trace_nonneg).1 (le_of_lt hv)
  intro t ht
  have hsq := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv
  have hsqsq : Real.sqrt v ^ 2 = v := Real.sq_sqrt hv.le
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLpos
  · 
    subst hL0
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hzero : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X k ω = 0 := by
      intro k
      have hneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (-X k ω).PosSemidef := by
        filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω hH hB
        exact neg_posSemidef _ hH hB
      have hint : Integrable (fun ω => (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re) μ :=
        trace_re_integrable μ (fun ω => -X k ω) (hXint k).neg
      have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun ω => (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re := by
        filter_upwards [hneg] with ω h
        exact (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp h.trace_nonneg).1
      have hI : ∫ ω, (Matrix.trace (-X k ω)).re ∂μ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_trace_re μ (fun ω => -X k ω) (hXint k).neg, integral_neg, hMean k]
        simp
      have htr0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae hnn hint).mp hI
      filter_upwards [hneg, htr0] with ω h1 h2
      have h3 := Complex.nonneg_iff.mp h1.trace_nonneg
      have htr : Matrix.trace (-X k ω) = 0 :=
        Complex.ext (by simpa using h2) (by simpa using h3.2.symm)
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp (h1.trace_eq_zero_iff.mp htr)
    have hY0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y ω = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hzero] with ω h
      show ∑ k, X k ω = 0
      simp [h]
    have hnull : μ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} = 0 := by
      rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
      filter_upwards [hY0] with ω h
      simp only [h, lambdaMax_zero, not_le]
      exact htpos
    rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hr) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  · 
    have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [div_pos hLpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    have hts : Real.sqrt v ≤ t := by linarith [div_pos hLpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
    have hDpos : 0 < v + L * t / 3 := by positivity
    have ht2 : v + L * t / 3 ≤ t ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht htpos.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hts hsq.le]
    obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ, θ = t / (v + L * t / 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hθ : 0 < θ := by rw [hθdef]; positivity
    have hθL : θ < 3 / L := by
      rw [hθdef, div_lt_div_iff₀ hDpos hLpos]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ, g = (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h1θ : 1 - θ * L / 3 = v / (v + L * t / 3) := by
      rw [hθdef]; field_simp; ring
    have hg0 : 0 ≤ g := by
      rw [hgdef, h1θ]; positivity
    have hgv : g * v = θ * t + -(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3) := by
      rw [hgdef, h1θ, hθdef]; field_simp; ring
    have ha : 1 ≤ θ * t := by
      rw [hθdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← sq, le_div_iff₀ hDpos]; linarith
    
    set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (θ * x) - θ * x - 1 with hψdef
    have hψnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x := fun x => by
      simp only [hψdef]; linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (θ * x)]
    have hψmono : MonotoneOn ψ (Set.Ici 0) := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      simp only [hψdef]
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ θ * x := mul_nonneg hθ.le hx
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (θ * (y - x))
      have h2 : Real.exp (θ * y) = Real.exp (θ * x) * Real.exp (θ * (y - x)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      have h3 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (θ * x) := Real.one_le_exp hx0
      have h4 : 0 ≤ θ * (y - x) := mul_nonneg hθ.le (by linarith)
      rw [h2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (Real.exp_pos (θ * x)).le]
    have hψt : 0 < ψ t := by
      simp only [hψdef]
      have := Real.add_one_lt_exp (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hθ htpos))
      linarith
    
    have hExpk : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := fun k =>
      exp_integrable μ (X k) (hMeas k) (hHerm k) hθ.le (hBound k)
    have hYexp : Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
      integrable_matrixExp_smul_sum_of_iIndepFun μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExpk
    have hTEint : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω)) μ :=
      trace_re_integrable μ _ hYexp
    have hYtrint : Integrable (fun ω => (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ :=
      trace_re_integrable μ Y hYint
    have hYtr0 : ∫ ω, (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [integral_trace_re μ Y hYint]
      have : ∫ ω, Y ω ∂μ = 0 := by
        show ∫ ω, ∑ k, X k ω ∂μ = 0
        rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun k _ => hXint k)]
        simp [hMean]
      rw [this]; simp
    have hψeq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) =
        traceExp (θ • Y ω) - θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re - d := by
      filter_upwards [hYHerm] with ω hH
      rw [traceFunction_eq_sum ψ _ hH, traceExp_smul_eq_sum _ hH θ, trace_re_eq_sum _ hH]
      simp only [hψdef, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hψint : Integrable (fun ω => traceFunction ψ (Y ω)) μ :=
      ((hTEint.sub (hYtrint.const_mul θ)).sub (integrable_const (d : ℝ))).congr
        (hψeq.mono fun _ h => h.symm)
    have hψI : ∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ = ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ - d := by
      have hA : Integrable (fun ω => θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ := hYtrint.const_mul θ
      have hB : Integrable (fun ω => traceExp (θ • Y ω) - θ * (Matrix.trace (Y ω)).re) μ :=
        hTEint.sub hA
      rw [integral_congr_ae hψeq, integral_sub hB (integrable_const _),
        integral_sub hTEint hA, integral_const_mul, hYtr0]
      simp
    have hLap := measure_lambdaMax_ge_le_integral_traceFunction_div μ Y ψ hYmeas hYHerm hψnn hψmono hψint t htpos.le hψt
    
    have hE1 : ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ ≤ traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := by
      calc ∫ ω, traceExp (θ • Y ω) ∂μ = ∫ ω, traceExp (∑ k, θ • X k ω) ∂μ := by
            congr 1; funext ω; show traceExp (θ • ∑ k, X k ω) = _; rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        _ ≤ _ := trace_cgf_subadditivity μ X θ hMeas hHerm hIndep hExpk
    have hcumH : (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian :=
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
    have hcum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ (g • ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
      have hk : ∀ k, (matrixLog (∫ ω, matrixExp (θ • X k ω) ∂μ)) ≤
          (g • ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
        intro k
        rw [hgdef]
        exact (bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L θ hLpos hθ hθL (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hL2 k)
          (hMean k) (hBound k)).2
      unfold cumulantSum
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k)
    rw [← hsecond] at hcum
    have hgS : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ).IsHermitian :=
      hS.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
    have hgV : (g • V).IsHermitian :=
      hVpsd.isHermitian.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial g))
    have hSV : (g • ∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ (g • V) := by
      rw [Matrix.le_iff]
      rw [← smul_sub]
      exact hVS.smul hg0
    have hE2 : traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ traceExp (g • V) :=
      (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hcumH hgS hcum).trans
        (traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ hgS hgV hSV)
    
    have hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) := by
      refine ⟨convex_Ici 0, ?_⟩
      intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
      have := convexOn_exp.2 (Set.mem_univ (g * x)) (Set.mem_univ (g * y)) ha hb hab
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at this ⊢
      have e : g * (a * x + b * y) = a * (g * x) + b * (g * y) := by ring
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [this, hab]
    have hID := traceFunction_le_intrinsicDimension_mul (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) hconv (by simp) V hVpsd
    have hφeq : traceFunction (fun x => Real.exp (g * x) - 1) V = traceExp (g • V) - d := by
      rw [traceFunction_eq_sum _ _ hVpsd.isHermitian, traceExp_smul_eq_sum _ hVpsd.isHermitian g]
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hnum : ∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ ≤ intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) := by
      rw [hψI]
      have h1 : intrinsicDimension V * (Real.exp (g * ‖V‖) - 1) ≤
          intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hr
        show Real.exp (g * v) - 1 ≤ Real.exp (g * v)
        linarith
      linarith [hφeq ▸ hID]
    have hfour := exp_le_four ha
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))
    calc μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)}
        ≤ (∫ ω, traceFunction ψ (Y ω) ∂μ) / ψ t := hLap
      _ ≤ intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (g * v) / ψ t :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hψt.le
      _ ≤ 4 * intrinsicDimension V * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3)) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hψt, hgv, Real.exp_add]
          simp only [hψdef]
          have hrE := mul_nonneg hr hE.le
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfour hrE]

private lemma NLAlib.hermitian_bernstein_package {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {d N : ℕ} [NeZero d]
    (X : Fin N → Ω → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hMeas : ∀ k, Measurable (X k))
    (hHerm : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X k ω).IsHermitian)
    (hL2 : ∀ k, MemLp (X k) 2 μ) (hIndep : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hMean : ∀ k, (∫ ω, X k ω ∂μ) = 0)
    (hBound : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ L) :
    let Y
:= fun ω => ∑ k, X k ω
    let v := hermitianSecondMoment μ Y
    v = specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) ∧
    (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * v * Real.log d) + L * Real.log d / 3 ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
      bernsteinTail d v L t
proof:
:= by
  intro Y v
  have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne d)
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hd
  
  have hsm : (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_integral_mul μ X id id measurable_id measurable_id hMeas
      hIndep (fun k => hL2 k) (fun k => hL2 k) hMean

    simp only [Y, sq]
    exact h
  have hv : v = specNorm (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    show specNorm (∫ ω, Y ω ^ 2 ∂μ) = _
    rw [hsm]
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := hv ▸ specNorm_nonneg _
  have hBpsd : (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.posSemidef_sum
    intro k _
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
    apply integral_nonneg_of_ae
    filter_upwards [hHerm k] with ω hH
    have : X k ω ^ 2 = Matrix.conjTranspose (X k ω) * X k ω := by rw [hH.eq, sq]
    rw [Pi.zero_apply, this]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).nonneg
  have hBH : (∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ).IsHermitian := hBpsd.isHermitian
  have hP1 : ∀ t : ℝ, μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤ d := fun t =>
    (measureReal_le_one (μ := μ)).trans hd
  have htail0 : bernsteinTail d v L 0 = d := by
    unfold bernsteinTail
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rfl
    · exact absurd rfl h2
    · simp
  have htailNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ bernsteinTail d v L t := by
    intro t
    unfold bernsteinTail
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  rcases hL.eq_or_lt with hL0 | hLpos
  · 
    subst hL0
    have hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, lambdaMax (Y ω) ≤ 0 := by
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ k, (X k ω).IsHermitian ∧ lambdaMax (X k ω) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [ae_all_iff]
        intro k
        filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω h1 h2 using ⟨h1, h2⟩
      filter_upwards [h1] with ω hω
      have hle : (∑ k, X k ω) ≤ 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonpos
        intro k _
        have := le_algebraMap_of_spectrum_le (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ (hω k).1 (hω k).2)
          (hω k).1.isSelfAdjoint
        simpa using this
      have hYH : (∑ k, X k ω).IsHermitian := isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => (hω k).1)
      have hspec : ∀ x ∈ spectrum ℝ (∑ k, X k ω), x ≤ 0 :=
        (le_algebraMap_iff_spectrum_le (r := (0 : ℝ)) hYH.isSelfAdjoint).mp (by simpa using hle)
      exact Real.sSup_nonpos hspec
    refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤ 0 := integral_nonpos_of_ae hY
      have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * v * Real.log d) + 0 * Real.log d / 3 := by
        rw [zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    · intro t ht
      rcases ht.eq_or_lt with h0 | htp
      · subst h0
        rw [htail0]
        exact hP1 0
      · have hnull : μ {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} = 0 := by
          rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
          filter_upwards [hY] with ω hω
          simp only [not_le]
          linarith
        rw [measureReal_def, hnull, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
        exact htailNonneg t
  · 
    set B := ∑ k, ∫ ω, X k ω ^ 2 ∂μ with hBdef
    have hcumH : ∀ θ : ℝ, (cumulantSum μ X θ).IsHermitian := fun θ =>
      isSelfAdjoint_sum _ (fun k _ => by unfold matrixLog; exact IsSelfAdjoint.cfc)
    have hInt : ∀ k, Integrable (X k) μ := fun k => (hL2 k).integrable one_le_two
    have hEcont : ∀ θ : ℝ,
        Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ => matrixExp (θ • A)) := by
      intro θ
      let : NormedAlgebra ℚ (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ) :=
        NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℂ _
      dsimp [matrixExp]
      fun_prop
    have hExp : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => matrixExp (θ • X k ω)) μ := by
      intro θ hθ k
      refine Integrable.of_bound
        ((hEcont θ).comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hMeas k).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Real.exp (θ * L)) ?_
      filter_upwards [hHerm k, hBound k] with ω hH hB
      rw [matrixExp_smul_eq_cfc _ hH]
      apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      intro x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_mem_spectrum_of_lambdaMax_le _ hH hB x hx) hθ.le)
    have hcgf : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤
          d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v) := by
      intro θ hθ hθL
      have hg : 0 ≤ (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) := by
        have : θ * L < 3 := (lt_div_iff₀ hLpos).mp hθL
        apply div_nonneg (by positivity)
        linarith
      have hsum : (cumulantSum μ X θ) ≤ (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • B) := by
        unfold cumulantSum
        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
        rw [hBdef, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ (fun k _ => (bernstein_matrix_mgf_cgf_le μ (X k) L θ hLpos hθ hθL
          (hMeas k) (hHerm k) (hL2 k) (hMean k) (hBound k)).2)
      calc traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)
          ≤ traceExp (((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3)) • B) :=
            traceExp_le_traceExp _ _ (hcumH θ)
              (hBH.smul (isSelfAdjoint_iff.mpr (star_trivial _))) hsum
        _ ≤ d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * ‖B‖) := traceExp_smul_le_mul_exp_mul_norm _ hBH hg
        _ = _ := by rw [hv, specNorm_eq_norm]
    have hE : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        (∫ ω, lambdaMax (Y ω) ∂μ) ≤
          (Real.log d + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v) / θ := by
      intro θ hθ hθL
      have h1 := (integral_lambdaMax_sum_le_log_traceExp_cumulantSum_div μ X hθ hMeas hHerm hInt hIndep (hExp θ hθ))
      have hpos : 0 < traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ) := traceExp_pos_of_isHermitian _ (hcumH θ)
      have hlog : Real.log (traceExp (cumulantSum μ X θ)) ≤
          Real.log d + (θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v := by
        calc _ ≤ Real.log (d * Real.exp ((θ ^ 2 / 2) / (1 - θ * L / 3) * v)) :=
              Real.log_le_log hpos (hcgf θ hθ hθL)
          _ = _ := by rw [Real.log_mul hd0.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
      exact h1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hlog hθ.le)
    have hT : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < 3 / L →
        μ.real {ω | t ≤ lambdaMax (Y ω)} ≤
